title: App Dev & Support Engineer III
description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.
  
  
**Job Track Description:**
**Job Description – Technical Lead (Application Development)**
**Experience:**
7 -12 Years
  
  
**Location:**
Noida, India
  
  
**Role Type:**
Technical Lead
  
  
**Domain:**
Pension Administration & Benefits Administration (Preferred)
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a highly skilled
**Technical Lead**
with 10+ years of experience in software engineering and architecture to lead the development of a
**web portal and mobile application**
for pension and benefits administration.
  
  
This role collaborates closely with the development team, participates actively in solution design, gathers requirements, and drives the technical execution from concept to delivery.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in
**.NET Core, C#, Azure Kubernetes, SQL Server, Azure DevOps, API-driven architectures, and modern front-end JS technologies**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership
* Lead technical architecture, design, and development for the pension administration web and mobile platforms.
* Provide hands-on development support in backend services, REST APIs, gRPC services, and frontend components when required.
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions.
* Conduct architectural reviews, design reviews, and code reviews to maintain high engineering standards.
* Guide the team in performance optimization, security best practices, and application scalability.
* Team Leadership & Collaboration
* Lead a cross-functional team of backend, frontend, and full-stack developers.
* Collaborate daily with developers, product owners, UX designers, and QA to ensure smooth sprint execution.
* Mentor engineers, conduct technical training, and promote best coding practices.
* Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Requirement Gathering & Stakeholder Management
* Work with product managers, business users, SMEs, and stakeholders to understand functional and non-functional requirements.
* Convert business needs into technical specifications, architecture diagrams, and actionable development tasks.
* Communicate effectively about progress, risks, dependencies, and technical decisions.
* Delivery Management
* Drive agile ceremonies: sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, and retrospectives.
* Ensure high-quality deliverables through strong CI/CD workflows, automated testing, and robust DevOps practices.
* Oversee end-to-end software development lifecycle (SDLC) including design, development, testing, deployment, and post-release support.
* DevOps, Testing & Quality Assurance
* Work with Azure DevOps for source control, pipelines, release management, and automated deployments.
* Ensure adoption of automated testing: unit tests, integration tests.
* Implement coding standards, documentation practices, and quality gates in CI/CD pipelines.

**Required Technical Skills & Experience**
**Backend Technologies**

* 10+ years of experience with .NET Core / .NET 8/9, C#, Azure Kubernetes, Entity Framework
* Strong expertise in building REST APIs and gRPC services.
* Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes.
* Deep understanding of API security frameworks (JWT, OAuth2, role-based access).

**Frontend & Mobile**

* Good understanding of JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, Node.js.
* Experience guiding teams building UI using React.js, Next.js, component libraries, and responsive UI principles.
* Familiarity with frontend build tools (Webpack, npm, bundlers) and testing tools (Jest, RTL).

**DevOps & Cloud**

* Strong experience with Azure DevOps, Git repositories, branching strategies, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Understanding of cloud-native architecture and deployment practices (Azure preferred).
* Familiarity with Docker/Kubernetes is a plus.

**Testing & Quality**

* Experience with automated testing frameworks
* Knowledge of performance testing, accessibility standards, and monitoring/observability.

**Leadership & Management Skills**

* Proven experience leading engineering teams of 10–15 members.
* Strong ability to break down requirements, plan sprints, and manage delivery timelines.
* Excellent problem-solving, decision-making, and escalation management skills.
* Experience building SaaS-based products or working in a startup-like environment is mandatory.
* Experience using AI-assisted coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor).

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with Keycloak or similar identity management systems.
* Familiarity with Figma, UI design workflows, or data visualization libraries.
* Prior experience in pension, financial services, or benefits administration domain.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar.

Conduent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, national origin, age, gender identity, gender expression, sex/gender, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, use of a guide dog or service animal, military/veteran status, citizenship status, basis of genetic information, or any other group protected by law.

Complete the form and then email it as an attachment to FTADAAA@conduent.com. You may also click here to access Conduent's ADAAA Accommodation Policy.

title: Senior AI & Decision Science Engineer
description:
**OUR STORY**
**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**
**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**
**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**
**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**
**Full-Stack AI & Automation Engineer**
**Human Resources - Strategic Planning & Analytics CoE**
**About The Team & Your Role**
Strategic Planning & Analytics team is architected to move beyond traditional HR, functioning as a strategic engine that fuels ST’s growth through five specialized pillars: Business Partnerships, Products & AI, Workforce Insights, Data Science, and Workforce Planning Architecture. We are currently in an ambitious build-phase, moving away from legacy processes to create a sophisticated, tech-enabled function that mirrors the engineering excellence of the semiconductor industry. We don’t want to just manage headcount; we want to orchestrate the future of HR using AI.
  
  
As a member of this team, you won’t be working in a silo. You will be at the intersection of human capital and advanced technology, leveraging AI and data science to solve complex organizational challenges and expected to be a foundational builder. We are looking for pioneers to help us design and implement our first generation of advanced analytics and AI-driven products. You won't just be using technology—you will be architecting the roadmap, selecting the tools, and establishing the frameworks that will define how ST manages its global talent for years to come. If you are energized by the challenge of redefining the "H" in HR through the lens of data and innovation, you’ve found the right place.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* End-to-End AI Prototyping: Architect, build, and deploy conversational bots and transactional AI agents from scratch in a sandbox environment.
* Workflow Orchestration & Automation: Design and manage complex, multi-system automation workflows using tools like n8n to automate actions (e.g., orchestrating system lookups, mock API executions, and conditional task routing).
* LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering: Integrate prototypes securely with internal OpenAI/ChatGPT APIs, mastering prompt design, function calling, tool use, and state management.
* Interface & UI/UX Evolution: Build lightweight, responsive web interfaces (e.g., Streamlit, Next.js) for quick stakeholder testing, ensuring the backend logic is decoupled via webhooks for future migration into Microsoft Teams.
* Code Hygiene & Handoff Documentation: Maintain code transparency, track version changes, and collaborate efficiently using GitHub. Author structured "Industrialization Blueprints" (JSON payloads, API mappings, and logic flows) to seamlessly hand over for full scale production

**Required Background & Skills**

* AI Orchestration Frameworks: Expert-level workflow creation using tools like n8n (advanced JavaScript/Python execution nodes, webhooks, and sub-workflows) or equivalent orchestration frameworks
* AI & LLM Mastery: Practical experience implementing conversational APIs, embedding architectures, vector stores, and advanced prompt engineering constraints.
* Full-Stack Core Development: Strong programming proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/Node.js. Comfort writing clean API connectors, handling RESTful requests, parsing JSON, and maintaining code via GitHub.
* Enterprise Collaboration Ecosystems: Prior familiarity or structural understanding of building integration layers, bots, or webhooks for the Microsoft 365 / MS Teams ecosystem is highly desirable.
* Candidate should possess “Can-do” attitude, with an ability to thrive in an unstructured environment
* 9 to 12 years of software engineering/automation experience (with at least 2–3 years focused on building AI agents/bots from scratch).
* Masters/ PhD in Computer Science, Information Technology equivalent
* Understanding of HCM systems like Oracle is an added advantage
* Excellent English, quantitative, technical, and storytelling skills

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.
  
  
At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.
  
  
To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

title: Jul_POS19_Principal Software Engineer
description:
**Principal Full-Stack Software Engineer**
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
  
  
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
At SimCorp, we build products that power investment management and financial institutions worldwide. We support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations. Investment Operations is a product area within SimCorp’s Product Division, which delivers functionality enabling the operations users to be highly efficient. It also offers full STP and automation capability for the workflows and processes seamlessly across the product areas and the financial institutions workflows.
  
  
As part of our Investment Operations Product Area, you will contribute to the development of enterprise products within this product area. You will collaborate with colleagues from Ukraine, Poland, Denmark and Germany, while gaining deep expertise in applied finance and modern software engineering practices.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As a Principal Software Engineer, you will:
  
  

* Provide technical leadership in design, development, and testing.
* Define and own test architecture and quality strategy at team level.
* Balance active coding (C#, Angular, APL) with guiding automation initiatives
* Drive adoption of automation-first practices across the team.
* Ensure high-quality delivery by monitoring coverage, test metrics, and quality KPIs.
* Mentor and coach engineers in development, automation, and testing skills.
* Represent QA Dev combined approach in cross-team forums.
* Collaborate with stakeholders (POs, TLs, architects) to align technical and quality goals.
* Conduct in-depth root cause analysis for complex defects and ensure preventive actions
* Advocate for and implement improvements in tools, CI/CD pipelines, and engineering processes.
* Continuously assessing and improving engineering processes, recommending new tools and technologies to enhance productivity and software quality
* Represent the team in technical forums and contribute to cross-team knowledge exchange.

**Your Qualifications**

* We are looking for an engineer who has demonstrated leadership abilities
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in software engineering with combined Dev QA responsibilities.
* Expertise in .NET / C# and working knowledge of Angular.
* Known for impactful leadership, resulting in improved efficiency and project success among engineering teams
* Extensive background in test automation (E2E, API, Integration) and test strategy
* Solid experience in architecting and developing enterprise-scale applications.
* Extensive knowledge of Cloud and On-Prem infrastructures (Microsoft Azure experience)
* Deep expertise in CI/CD pipelines and tools (Git, TeamCity, Azure DevOps).
* Thorough understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and Domain-Driven Design
* Familiarity with XP practices (TDD, pair programming, continuous integration).
* Experience with relational databases (SQL).
* Readiness to learn APL, developing new features and debugging existing functionality, with full support from our team throughout the learning process.
* Proficient English communication skills (Upper-Intermediate or higher), both written and spoken
* Ability to mentor, motivate, and guide a team toward technical excellence and efficient delivery

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience with Azure or similar cloud platforms.
* Background in FinTech or capital markets.
* Knowledge and experience in the financial domain, fintech, derivatives (options, futures, swaps, etc.) is an advantage.

**Benefits**
Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work & life balance: flexible work hours, a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP sprints where you have 3 weeks per quarter you can spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.
  
  
**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
**WHO WE ARE?**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

title: Packaged/SaaS Application Engineer
description:
**Project Role :**
Packaged/SaaS Application Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Configure and support packaged or SaaS applications to adapt features, manage releases, and ensure system stability. Use standard tools, APIs, and low-code platforms to align solutions with business needs while preserving compatibility and performance.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Salesforce Technical Architecture
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**

15 years full time education
  
  
**Summary**
As a Packaged or Software as a Service Application Engineer, a typical day involves configuring and supporting packaged or cloud-based applications to meet evolving business requirements. This role requires managing application features, overseeing release cycles, and ensuring the overall stability and performance of the systems. The engineer works closely with various teams to align solutions with organizational goals, utilizing standard tools, application programming interfaces, and low-code platforms to maintain compatibility and optimize functionality. * Coordinate cross-functional efforts to ensure alignment of technical strategies with business objectives.

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Salesforce Technical Architecture.
* Experience in designing and implementing complex Salesforce solutions that integrate with other enterprise systems.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, including declarative and programmatic development.
* Ability to utilize APIs and low-code tools to customize and extend packaged or SaaS applications.

title: Web Developer
description:
Location: Gurugram, India

Employment: Full-Time | In Office

Salary: 30k-40k

Department: Web & Technology

About the Role

Savvy Signature is looking for a capable and detail-oriented Web Developer to build

modern, responsive and conversion-focused digital experiences.

We don't see website development as an isolated technical function.

Our websites sit within a broader growth ecosystem involving SEO, advertising, analytics,

CRM, automation, conversion tracking and lead generation.

What You'll Be Responsible For:

**Website Development**

● Develop responsive websites and landing pages.

● Build and maintain WordPress websites.

● Translate Figma designs into functional web experiences.

● Develop responsive layouts across desktop, tablet and mobile.

● Create reusable website components where appropriate.

● Implement interactive front-end functionality.

● Maintain and improve existing client websites.

**Performance & Technical Quality**

● Optimise website speed and performance.

● Improve Core Web Vitals.

● Troubleshoot front-end and back-end issues.

● Test websites across browsers, devices and screen sizes.

● Maintain clean and structured code.

● Support website security, backups and maintenance.

● Assist with staging environments, deployment and migrations.

**Marketing & Integrations**

● Implement forms and lead-generation functionality.

● Integrate websites with CRM platforms and third-party applications.

● Assist with Google Analytics and conversion-tracking implementation.

● Support technical SEO requirements.

● Work with marketers to implement landing pages and conversion improvements.

● Support API and automation integrations where required.

**Technical Capabilities**

Depending on experience, we are interested in skills across:

● WordPress

● HTML5

● CSS3

● JavaScript

● PHP

● Responsive development

● Figma-to-web implementation

● APIs

● Git/version control

● Hosting environments

● DNS management

● Website migrations

● Technical SEO

● Performance optimisation

Experience with WooCommerce, custom WordPress development, modern JavaScript

frameworks, CRM integrations or automation platforms would be highly regarded.

**WHY JOIN SAVVY SIGNATURE?**

Build More Than a CV. Build Real-World Capability.

Savvy Signature offers a different environment from a traditional single-service agency or

large corporate marketing department.

Because we work across marketing, creative, technology, websites, advertising, SEO,

CRM, automation and analytics, our team members gain exposure to how these areas

connect to create business growth.

**Work With Young Entrepreneurs**

One of the biggest opportunities at Savvy Signature is the people you'll work alongside.

You'll have exposure to young entrepreneurs, founders, business owners and

ambitious professionals across Australia and India.

You'll see how businesses make decisions, solve problems, develop new ideas and pursue

growth.

**Work Across Real Businesses**

Your work won't be limited to hypothetical projects or internal exercises.

You'll contribute to real client businesses, marketing campaigns, websites, brands and

growth initiatives.

That means learning not only how to do the work, but why the work matters commercially.

**Develop Cross-Disciplinary Skills**

Modern businesses don't operate in isolated departments.

Marketing connects with sales. Websites connect with advertising. CRM connects with

automation. Creative connects with conversion. Data connects everything.

Working at Savvy Signature gives you the opportunity to understand these connections and

build a much broader professional skill set.

**Exposure to Modern Technology & AI**

The marketing and technology landscape is changing quickly.

We encourage our team to explore AI, automation, emerging platforms and smarter

workflows that can improve creativity, productivity and client outcomes.

The objective isn't to replace thinking with technology. It's to become better at using

technology to solve problems.

**Responsibility as You Grow**

We believe career progression should come with capability.

As you demonstrate reliability, initiative and stronger decision-making, you'll have

opportunities to take greater ownership of projects, clients and responsibilities.

We want people who eventually become leaders, specialists and problem-solvers, not

people who remain dependent on instructions.

If you want the opportunity to work alongside young entrepreneurs, contribute to real

businesses, develop practical skills and gain international exposure across Australia and

India, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply now: https://savvysignatureindia.com/careers

Build skills. Take ownership. Work across markets. Grow with Savvy Signature

title: Senior System Developer
description:
VergeCloud is looking for a hands-on System Engineer to work on the core of our CDN and edge infrastructure platform. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys building high-performance, low-latency, secure systems close to the network, operating system, and runtime layer.

You will contribute directly to VergeCloud’s CDN core, including request processing, caching, reverse proxying, traffic routing, TLS handling, DNS integration, observability, WAF, rate limiting, bot mitigation, and DDoS protection capabilities.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable writing production-grade Rust code and working with distributed infrastructure that handles high-volume internet traffic across edge locations.

Key responsibilities include:

* Develop and maintain CDN core services using Rust.
* Build high-performance caching, proxying, routing, and traffic management components.
* Work on HTTP, HTTPS, TLS, TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, and edge networking systems.
* Improve CDN performance, reliability, scalability, and resource efficiency.
* Contribute to WAF, rate limiting, bot mitigation, and DDoS protection features.
* Debug production issues across CDN edge nodes, origin connectivity, cache behavior, DNS, TLS, and network paths.
* Work closely with SRE, security, and platform teams to build reliable edge infrastructure.

Requirements
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, or backend engineering.
* Strong production-level programming experience in
  **Rust or C**
  .
* Strong understanding of Linux systems, networking, processes, memory, filesystems, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Deep knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP, HTTPS, TLS/SSL, and DNS.
* Experience building high-performance, concurrent, asynchronous, or event-driven systems.
* Understanding of caching, reverse proxying, load balancing, request routing, and traffic management.
* Experience debugging complex production issues across application, network, operating system, and infrastructure layers.
* Good understanding of distributed systems, high availability, fault tolerance, and scalable service design.
* Experience with logs, metrics, tracing, monitoring, and production observability.

Preferred skills:

* Experience with CDN, edge computing, WAF, API gateway, reverse proxy, load balancer, or DDoS protection platforms.
* Familiarity with Tokio or other async Rust runtimes.
* Knowledge of NGINX, Envoy, HAProxy, Varnish, OpenResty, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of BGP, Anycast, traffic engineering, and global routing.
* Experience with eBPF, XDP, DPDK, or kernel-level networking.
* Familiarity with Kafka, ClickHouse, Redis, object storage, and large-scale log pipelines.
* Understanding of OWASP CRS, ModSecurity concepts, bot mitigation, rate limiting, and API security.
* Exposure to WebAssembly, V8, or edge function runtimes.

Benefits
  
  

* Opportunity to work on the core technology of a deep-tech edge cloud platform.
* Build CDN, DNS, WAF, DDoS protection, video delivery, and edge computing infrastructure from India for global customers.
* High ownership role with direct impact on platform architecture, performance, reliability, and security.
* Work on challenging systems engineering problems involving Rust, Linux, networking, distributed systems, and high-scale traffic.
* Collaborate with a strong technical team across platform engineering, SRE, security, and product.
* Exposure to production-scale internet infrastructure, edge networking, caching, traffic routing, and security systems.
* Opportunity to grow into senior engineering, platform architecture, or infrastructure leadership roles.
* Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
* On-site collaboration in Bangalore with a fast-moving engineering team.

title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Advertising Core Infra
description:
**Description**
Would you like to build highly available, scalable and distributed engineering systems for one of the largest data lakes in Amazon? Does Petabyte scale excite you?
  
  
Spektr is Amazon Ads' exabyte-scale central data lake: the unified catalog for petabytes of campaign, ad-serving, billing, and measurement data. Hundreds of teams and Amazon's advertiser-facing AI agents depend on it for discovery, ingestion, transformation, and querying at scale. If you want large-scale engineering with tangible business impact, this is the team.
  
  
We're rebuilding Spektr ground-up with an AI-first architecture, and building fully-automated domain agents that let customers manage their big data lifecycle in a single click. In parallel, we're adopting Apache Iceberg / S3 Tables with serverless compute, scaling horizontally via a data mesh pattern for 5× growth in volume and demand. If you thrive on greenfield experimentation and shipping things that matter to the business, keep reading.
  
  
As a Sr SDE on this team, you will own the core platform services that power Amazon Ads data infrastructure, consolidating legacy systems into clean, API-first services that cut job creation time from weeks to less than a day. You will build MCP-enabled AI interfaces that let AI agents create and run data pipelines on Spektr at 99%+ success rate, directly shaping how GenAI discovers and consumes data across Amazon Ads. You will design and operate high-scale Java services on AWS-native infrastructure (Spark, EMR Serverless, Kinesis, Step Functions), processing petabytes of data daily at 99.9% availability. You will also drive deployment automation, replacing manual release cycles with CI/CD pipelines that accelerate delivery velocity for a platform serving Tier-1 advertising data systems.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Engage with key decision makers such as Product & Program Managers to understand customer requirements and brainstorm on solutions
* Design, code and deploy components and micro-services for the core job management pipeline
* Ensure testability, maintanability and low operational footprint for your code
* Participate in operational responsibilities with your team
* Innovate on AWS technology to improve latency, reduce cost and operations

A day in the life
  
  

* Focus on core engineering opportunities to guarantee system availability that matches our data growth
* Work with a skilled team of engineers, managers and decision makers to consistently meet customer demand
* Automate monitoring of data availability, quality and usability via simplified metrics and drive innovations to improve guarantees for our customers

**About The Team**
The mission of the Ads Datalake team is to provide data that helps the advertising organization make informed analyses and decisions for our customers and to determine and deploy investments for future growth via a set of central and unified products and services.
  
  
Our team focuses on simplicity, usability, speed, compliance, cost efficiency and enabling high-velocity decision making so our customers can generate high quality insights faster.
  
  
We are a global team with presence across India and North America.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Back End Developer
description:
**About Simora**

Simora.ai is the contextual layer for AI video. AI models can generate a video, but they don’t understand a brand, its audience, the language people actually speak or what works in their market. Simora adds that context, for enterprises, we go further. We build custom studios and AI workflows around how their teams actually create content, so large organisations can produce videos at scale in their own format, brand and process. Over 1000+ brands, agencies and enterprises use Simora today.

**The role**

You will own Simora’s backend. That means architecture, databases, infrastructure, performance and the systems that let thousands of users and large organisations use the product at the same time. You will decide how things should be built, build them and stand behind them in production.

**Our stack**

Node.js, Cloudflare Workers, Postgres, MongoDB, AWS, object storage, background job workflows, containers for media processing, plus a wide set of AI model APIs for video, voice and language. Experience with these helps, but strong fundamentals matter more than any specific tool.

**You are the right person if you**

* Have 4+ years of backend experience, including at least 2-3 products backend you built and ran end to end
* Have set up the complete backend of a product end to end, from first architecture to live users, and kept it running
* Plan before you build: you think through the design, then execute, and you can explain every decision
* Know your code better than anyone else. Use any AI tool you like, but you understand every line that goes to production and can find the cause of a bug quickly
* Move fast and take ownership, the way a startup needs, without waiting to be told what to do next
* Have taken a system from small scale to large scale and know what breaks along the way
* Are strong with databases: data modelling, query performance and moving data safely
* Have worked with heavy async workloads such as media processing, queues or long-running jobs
* Think about cost per user as seriously as speed

**This role is not for you if**

* You have never built a full product backend end to end on your own, only parts of one
* You depend on AI to write code you can’t explain or debug without it
* You need a detailed spec and someone to plan the work before you can start
* You prefer working on a narrow, well-defined module in a large team
* You have mostly worked on CRUD APIs and not on systems under real load

**What you get**

Full ownership of the backend of a product used by brands every day, direct work with the founders and a big say in how Simora is built from here.

In-office,

title: Senior Associate Technology L1_Python
description:
**Job Description**
Publicis Sapient is looking for Python Developers to join our team of bright thinkers and enablers. You will use your problem-solving skills, craft, and creativity to design and develop infrastructure interfaces for complex business applications. You will build and orchestrate agentic, GenAI-powered workflows that transform how our clients operate – from data ingestion and enrichment to intelligent, LLM-driven automation. We are on a mission to transform the world, and you will be instrumental in shaping how we do it with your ideas, thoughts, and solutions.
  
  
**Your Impact:**

* Build and orchestrate agentic workflows using LangChain and LangGraph to power scalable, production-ready GenAI solutions.
* Develop reusable components for data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and validation that accelerate delivery across projects.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and traceability across agent workflows to support dependable, enterprise-grade AI applications.
* Implement performance monitoring with tools like LangSmith and apply tuning mechanisms to continuously improve agent accuracy and efficiency.
* Deploy and maintain Python-based GenAI services in production, leveraging Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools for reliable releases.
* Architect secure API communication and access management, using JWT, OAuth, and RBAC, to safeguard sensitive client data.
* Apply NLP, LLM, and retrieval techniques, including vector stores and embeddings, to build context-aware, intelligent solutions for clients.

**Qualifications**
**Your Skills & Experience:**

* Strong Python fundamentals (OOP, data structures, error handling) with hands-on experience using Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, or Dask.
* Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and Semantic Kernel, building agent orchestration, memory, and tool-use workflows.
* Proficiency in Python API frameworks (Flask/FastAPI), with experience using IDEs such as VSCode and PyCharm.
* Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases, time-series data, and data modeling and schema design.
* Basic integration experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch, plus exposure to vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Chroma) and embedding-based retrieval.
* Proficiency with AWS Cloud Services and production deployment practices, including Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools.
* Strong understanding of security & access management – JWT, OAuth, RBAC – and secure API communication.

**Additional Information**
**Set Yourself Apart With:**

* Prior work on GenAI, CoPilot, or RAG-based systems.
* Familiarity with marketing data models and real-time customer journeys.
* Exposure to NLP, LLMs, and retrieval frameworks beyond the core requirements above.

**A Tip from the Hiring Manager:**
“AI is evolving fast – join us to work hands-on with big clients, sharpen your skills, and stay future-ready.
  
  
**Benefits of Working Here:**

* Gender-Neutral Policy
* 18 paid holidays throughout the year.
* Generous parental leave and new parent transition program
* Flexible work arrangements
* Employee Assistance Programs to help you in wellness and well-being.

**Company Description**
Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

title: Software Development Engineer, AFT External Fulfillment
description:
**Description**
Are you seeking an environment where you can apply state-of-the-art computer science techniques, build large-scale distributed systems, and directly impact how millions of customers experience ultra-fast delivery? Do you want to build the next generation of Quick Commerce fulfillment technology from the ground up?
  
  
Amazon's Quick Commerce (QC) business is scaling rapidly across multiple cities, fulfilling hundreds of thousands of daily orders with high expansion targets. We are building a brand-new QC under-the roof-fulfillment stack on AFT foundations.
  
  
Join the QC Fulfillment Technology team and be part of developing large-scale, composable, work-cell-based systems that power our micro-stores - from inbound receiving and guided stowing to picking, staging, and last-mile handoff. These systems will be used by thousands of store associates to delight millions of customers with 10-minute delivery. In this role, the SDE will be responsible for designing, developing, and operating scalable fulfillment services.
  
  
This is a true 0→1 opportunity where your code will directly impact how Quick Commerce fulfillment operates at Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable services and APIs for the QC fulfillment stack
* Develop systems that enforce operational controls beyond Amazon sites, including external fulfillment environments with our 3P partners
* Collaborate with Senior SDEs, Principal Engineers, TPMs, and Product Managers to define technical solutions that solve fulfillment challenges at scale
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following Amazon's engineering best practices
* Drive continuous improvement in system performance, reliability, and operational efficiency, targeting industry-leading speeds
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical planning sessions
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to raising the engineering bar across the team
* Work in a fast-paced, agile environment with rapid iteration cycles, shipping new capabilities in weeks not months

**About The Team**
We are a fast-paced and focused team of passionate Amazonians building industry-leading Quick Commerce fulfillment technology. We are standing up QC fulfillment stack that will scale beyond Amazon sites and beyond India. Our team is part of AFT, and works closely with IN Tez (QC), DEX, Speed Fulfillment teams, following a collaborative engagement model with joint workshops, and dedicated SME support.
  
  
The team values high ownership, bias for action, and insists on the highest standards while following a build-fast-and-iterate-fast methodology. We believe in speed through autonomy and safety through guardrails.
  
  
This team is suitable for passionate engineers who are equally interested in contributing to architecture and product strategy while building high-performing, scalable systems that directly impact Quick Commerce operations and Amazon Now's growth.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience working in fulfillment, logistics, or supply chain technology

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Advertising Core Infra
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Would you like to build highly available, scalable and distributed engineering systems for one of the largest data lakes in Amazon? Does Petabyte scale excite you?  
  
Spektr is Amazon Ads' exabyte-scale central data lake: the unified catalog for petabytes of campaign, ad-serving, billing, and measurement data. Hundreds of teams and Amazon's advertiser-facing AI agents depend on it for discovery, ingestion, transformation, and querying at scale. If you want large-scale engineering with tangible business impact, this is the team.  
  
We're rebuilding Spektr ground-up with an AI-first architecture, and building fully-automated domain agents that let customers manage their big data lifecycle in a single click. In parallel, we're adopting Apache Iceberg / S3 Tables with serverless compute, scaling horizontally via a data mesh pattern for 5 growth in volume and demand. If you thrive on greenfield experimentation and shipping things that matter to the business, keep reading.  
  
As a Sr SDE on this team, you will own the core platform services that power Amazon Ads data infrastructure, consolidating legacy systems into clean, API-first services that cut job creation time from weeks to less than a day. You will build MCP-enabled AI interfaces that let AI agents create and run data pipelines on Spektr at 99%+ success rate, directly shaping how GenAI discovers and consumes data across Amazon Ads. You will design and operate high-scale Java services on AWS-native infrastructure (Spark, EMR Serverless, Kinesis, Step Functions), processing petabytes of data daily at 99.9% availability. You will also drive deployment automation, replacing manual release cycles with CI/CD pipelines that accelerate delivery velocity for a platform serving Tier-1 advertising data systems.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Engage with key decision makers such as Product & Program Managers to understand customer requirements and brainstorm on solutions
* Design, code and deploy components and micro-services for the core job management pipeline
* Ensure testability, maintanability and low operational footprint for your code
* Participate in operational responsibilities with your team
* Innovate on AWS technology to improve latency, reduce cost and operations

  
A day in the life  

* Focus on core engineering opportunities to guarantee system availability that matches our data growth
* Work with a skilled team of engineers, managers and decision makers to consistently meet customer demand
* Automate monitoring of data availability, quality and usability via simplified metrics and drive innovations to improve guarantees for our customers

  
About the team  
The mission of the Ads Datalake team is to provide data that helps the advertising organization make informed analyses and decisions for our customers and to determine and deploy investments for future growth via a set of central and unified products and services.  
  
Our team focuses on simplicity, usability, speed, compliance, cost efficiency and enabling high-velocity decision making so our customers can generate high quality insights faster.  
  
We are a global team with presence across India and North America.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Software Dev Engineer II, Profit Intelligence
description:
**Description**
Are you interested in building intelligence systems from the ground up?
  
  
Are you interested in working with Applied Scientists, Big Data Engineers and Software Development Engineers to build large-scale data intelligence systems?
  
  
Are you interested to work in a team that positively impacts different key pillars of Amazon like Pricing, Promotions, Advertising, Auto inventory purchasing, Auto inventory removal, Inventory placement?
  
  
Are you interested in working for a team that builds cool systems yet has great work-life balance?
  
  
Profit intelligence systems measures, predicts true profit(/loss) for each item as a result of a specific shipment to an Amazon customer.
  
  
Prot Intelligence is all about providing intelligent ways for Amazon to understand profitability across retail business. What are the hidden factors driving the growth or profitability across millions of shipments each day?
  
  
Profit Intelligence provides these answers.
  
  
We compute the profitability of each and every shipment that gets shipped out of Amazon. Guess what, we predict the profitability of future possible shipments too. We are a team of agile, can-do engineers, who believe that not only are moon shots possible but that they can be done before lunch. All it takes is finding new ideas that challenge our preconceived notions of how things should be done. Process and procedure matter less than ideas and the practical work of getting stuff done. This is a place for exploring the new and taking risks.
  
  
We push the envelope in using cloud services in AWS as well as the latest in distributed systems, forecasting algorithms, and data mining.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to design and build AI-powered data platforms that transform large-scale business data into actionable insights. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and data engineering — owning end-to-end development of tools that help business leaders make faster, better decisions.
  
  
This is a high-impact role on a team where the software you ship directly shapes financial and operational strategy across Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Architect and build scalable platforms that ingest, process, and serve insights from petabyte-scale datasets
  
  
Integrate large language models and generative AI capabilities into internal analytics tools — enabling natural language querying, anomaly explanation, and automated reporting
  
  
Design ML pipelines for anomaly detection, forecasting, and trend analysis over structured and semi-structured business data
  
  
Partner with scientists, analysts, and PMs to translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped technical solutions
  
  
Drive engineering excellence: define coding standards, lead design reviews, and set the bar for operational health (monitoring, oncall, runbooks)
  
  
Mentor junior engineers; raise the technical capability of the team through clear documentation and code review
  
  
Own your services in production — you build it, you run it
  
  
Build and operate our foundational data infrastructure comprising of the entire spectrum of AWS Services - Storage (Redshift Data Shares, s3 data lakes), Orchestration (Step Functions, Glue and Internal Java Based Orchestration Tools), Processing (Spark & Flink - KDA), Streaming services (AWS Kinesis) and real-time large scale event aggregation stores.
  
  
Making it fully configurable and self-service for non-engineers.
  
  
Build and evolve tools that empower Amazonians to access data and build reliable, scalable and configurable way to generate Unit Economics for all Amazon Businesses. This includes UIs and frameworks for configuring rules, simulating their application, approval workows for rule changes, APIs and caching layers for high-throughput serving of Unit Economics Historicals and Predictions.
  
  
Build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like inhouse Reporting Applications and BI tools), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for designing and building platforms for crunching 100s of TB of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Support Engineer III, Chronicle
description:
**Description**
Impact
  
  
Ever wondered how Amazon offers the Earth's biggest selection and still manages to offer lower prices every day to our customers? Our retail business teams work with a massive array of vendors and business financial performance metrics to expand selection and drive costs lower. Given the rapid growth of our business, this requires our category leaders, financial analysts, site merchandisers and vendor managers to quickly analyze vendors, categories and brands, diving deep into data showing business efficiency down to the unit sale level. The technology that enables this has huge visibility and impact and is critical to Amazon's continued profitability and growth.
  
  
Innovation
  
  
We're working on the future. If you are seeking an environment where you can drive innovation. If you want to apply state-of-the-art software technologies to solve real world problems. If you want the satisfaction of providing visible benefit to end-users in an iterative fast paced environment, this is your opportunity. The responsibilities of this role will be key in paving the future of Amazon Retail and transforming how we do business.
  
  
Opportunity
  
  
You will be part of a team of creative, top-notch engineers who work hard, have fun, and make history.
  
  
As a Support Engineer, you will build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like in-house Applications and external aplications ), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for crunching and providing support for petabytes of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.
  
  
Be part of a high performance, high profile team with a complete, entirely localized business charter to enhance business profitability for the Amazon Consumer business.
  
  
Platform runs entirely on AWS; high scale, engineering challenges.
  
  
Very successful team that has developed a reputation of delivering results within Amazon.
  
  
We regularly research new technologies and invest for the future of our scalability
  
  
This role is on the Chronicle team within Selling Partner Services. We own the Turismo product suite, which is powered by Ripple, a dynamic query engine. Turismo is a well loved product, with 15k+ users globally. Ripple is a PrestoDB based query engine that is built to scale, and processes 2M+ queries per week. We are a full stack team, with Product managers, UX designers, TPMs, SDEs, DEs and Data Scientists.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Provide support of incoming tickets, including extensive troubleshooting tasks, with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services
* Work on operations and maintenance driven coding projects
* Software deployment support in staging and production environments
* Develop tools to aid operations and maintenance
* System and Support status reporting
* Ownership of one or more ETL products or components
* Customer notification and workflow coordination and follow-up to maintain service level agreements
* Work with support team for handing-off or taking over active support issues and creating a team specific knowledge base and skill sets

**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of software development, or 2+ years of technical support experience
* Experience scripting in modern program languages
* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of web services, distributed systems, and web application development

* Continuously identify opportunities to improve software quality, operational efficiency, engineering processes, and system performance.
* Communicate technical solutions and progress effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

* Strong experience designing cloud-native applications using AWS and serverless architectures.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architecture.

* Experience building workflow automation, business process orchestration, or event-driven business applications.
* Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, including data modelling and performance optimisation.
* Experience defining and maintaining cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code, with practical experience of AWS CloudFormation.
* Good understanding of Kubernetes and modern cloud deployment environments.
* Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and observability practices for production systems.
* Strong understanding of secure software development principles and cloud security best practices.
* Experience designing highly available, resilient, business-critical software systems.
* Ability to analyse complex business processes and design scalable software solutions that automate workflows and improve operational efficiency.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience within financial services, payments, banking, or other regulated industries.
* Knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Clean Architecture, and modern software architecture patterns.
* Experience working with distributed caching technologies such as Redis.

exposure to electronics manufacturing. In this role, you will initially work closely with our

external software development partner to co-develop, customize, and deploy our ERP

solution, take internal technical ownership, and train factory personnel.

heading an in-house software engineering team to design, develop, and integrate our

maintainability.

barcode/QR scanners, Zebra thermal label printers, and shop-floor data collection

terminals.

stores, production lines, quality, and dispatch teams

Data Governance & Compliance: Enforce strict data discipline across departments

accurately in real time.

reports/dashboards, resolve technical issues, and lead post-launch feature additions.

**manufacturing ERP implementations and architecture.**

Electronics Manufacturing (EMS) plant is essential. Understanding reel-level

component handling, PCB assembly stages, and Job Work inventory flow is

mandatory.

team, define an MES development roadmap, and bridge the gap between IT and

industrial automation.

databases for machine telemetry is a plus.

with handheld barcode scanners, industrial label printers, and shop-floor

hardware/PLC/machine protocols.

As a forward‑thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting‑edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long‑term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.
  
  
From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.
  
  
**About The Department**

* The AI and Digital Platform team supports Franklin Templeton’s Sales and Distribution organization by delivering AI, digital, data, and workflow solutions that drive business performance. The team includes software engineers, AI specialists, data professionals, architects, and product partners who collaborate in small, multidisciplinary teams. The environment is hands-on, evidence-driven, and highly collaborative, giving employees opportunities to solve complex business problems, shape enterprise AI products, mentor peers, and influence technical direction.

***How You Will Add Value?***
***Core Responsibilities***

* You will lead Generative AI solution design and delivery.
* You will build scalable full-stack applications and services.
* You will shape AI user experiences and technical architecture.
* You will develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions and agent workflows.
* You will create reusable AI platforms, services, and components.
* You will implement secure, reliable, and scalable production systems.

***Strategic Responsibilities***

* You will define architecture standards and implementation patterns.
* You will balance quality, cost, latency, and security requirements.
* You will establish telemetry, evaluation, and monitoring approaches.
* You will guide engineering decisions using data and product outcomes.
* You will improve delivery processes and operational excellence.

***Team & Collaboration***

* You will mentor and develop engineering talent.
* You will conduct design and code reviews.
* You will collaborate with product, data science, and architecture teams.
* You will partner with governance and security stakeholders.
* You will resolve complex technical and business trade-offs.

***What Will Help You Be Successful in This Role?***
***Experience, Education & Certifications***

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Equivalent practical experience accepted.
* 8+ years of software engineering experience.
* Experience delivering complex production software.
* Experience building enterprise Generative AI solutions.

***Technical Skills***

* Expert Python development.
* FastAPI or Django frameworks.
* APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation and vector search.
* Agent orchestration and Model Context Protocol.
* Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms.
* Security, observability, and production operations.

***Soft Skills***

* Strong technical leadership.
* Effective stakeholder collaboration.
* Excellent mentoring capabilities.
* Sound engineering judgement.
* Data-driven decision-making.

**Work Shift Timings - 2:00 PM - 11:00 PM IST**

title: Senior Software Engineer, Security and Privacy, Detection AI, Core
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience building software for data privacy or security (e.g., identity and access management).
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products.
* 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
* Experience in security systems, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.
* Experience as a technical lead with a proven track record of leading teams.
* Experienced in navigating high-ambiguity environments and defining technical strategy for engineering teams.

**About The Job**
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
  
  
As a Senior Software Engineer (L5) on the detection and response AI team, you will take end-to-end ownership of different workstreams across the Detection AI space. You will operate with high autonomy, translating ambiguous organizational goals into clear technical roadmaps. You will research, identify, and lead critical problems for the team to solve. Partnering alongside a peer Tech Lead, you will carve out multi-quarter technical initiatives, establish architectural direction, and multiply the output of a talented pool of L3 and L4 engineers.
  
  
This team build multi-agent systems to autonomously triage, investigate, and remediate security events, and architect governance frameworks, evaluation pipelines, and observability dashboards for security AI. We operate key enterprise platforms (Brief, Incident Communications) orchestrating critical communications during major Alphabet incidents.
  
  
The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Scope out problems in detection and response space and enable the organizational strategy to move left in the detection pipeline.
* Set technical direction, author comprehensive design documents, and lead design reviews for complex, multi-quarter features within the team.
* Partner closely with cross-functional peers and sister SWE teams to resolve architectural dependencies and align project timelines.
* Guide, mentor, and delegate tasks to adjacent junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a collaborative engineering culture.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: AI Foundry BU Deployed Engineer
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
  
  
At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
  
  
**Your Team's Impact**
**AI Foundry - BU Deployed Engineer**
The AI Foundry Forward Deployed SBU Engineer serves as the bridge between AI platform capabilities and real-world financial workflows. This role combines deep domain expertise in capital markets with strong AI engineering skills to rapidly design, prototype, deploy, and scale AI-native solutions for specific business units and strategic client opportunities.
  
  
Unlike a traditional software engineer, this individual is expected to operate at the intersection of product, engineering, consulting, and financial workflows. They must understand how investment professionals, advisors, bankers, analysts, portfolio managers, and relationship managers work, and be capable of helping existing teams translate their applications from legacy systems to modern AI-native designs. The ideal candidate is comfortable with tackling large open-ended problems, designing agent workflows with product teams, integrating APIs and MCPs with engineers, and demonstrating solutions directly to clients.
  
  
****What You'll Do****

title: SAP Consultants - Lead
description:
**What you will do on your journey with WebBeds.**

As an SAP Consultant Lead / SAP ABAP Developer Lead, you will join the growing global SAP team at WebBeds and play a key role in our SAP S/4HANA and RISE with SAP transformation journey.

**\***
These roles are based in Hyderabad and can also be considered in Bangalore, Pune, Chennai or Noida. We are building an internal SAP capability to drive innovation, reduce reliance on external partners and establish long-term ownership of our business processes and SAP solutions.'

We are recruiting across multiple functional and technical domains, with opportunities for SAP R2R, O2C, P2P & FP&A, together with an SAP ABAP Developer Lead.

Each successful candidate will lead delivery and solution ownership within their area of expertise. Functional Leads will collaborate with Finance, Procurement, Commercial and Operations teams to translate business requirements into scalable SAP solutions, while the SAP ABAP Developer Lead will partner with Functional Leads, Global Process Owners and technical teams to deliver Clean Core-aligned developments, integrations, analytics and automation.

All roles will contribute to process standardisation, innovation, compliance, operational excellence and measurable business value.

**In this role you will:**

**Key responsibilities**

* **End-to-end delivery:**
  lead delivery within your assigned functional domain or ABAP technical specialism, from requirements and solution design through testing, deployment, go-live, hypercare and operational handover.
* **Stakeholder partnership:**
  partner with business stakeholders, Global Process Owners, SAP teams, integration teams and delivery partners to define scalable future-state solutions.
* **SAP best practice:**
  champion SAP S/4HANA best practices, RISE with SAP, fit-to-standard delivery and Clean Core principles.
* **Design, testing and deployment:**
  lead or support workshops, fit-gap analysis, solution design, documentation, SIT, UAT, end-to-end testing, data migration, cutover and production readiness.
* **Automation and governance:**
  drive automation, process standardisation, continuous improvement, controls, compliance and governance.
* **Innovation:**
  identify opportunities to apply SAP Signavio, SAP Business AI, Joule, SAP BTP, SAP Build, Datasphere, SAC, Cloud ALM and LeanIX where relevant to your role (nice to have).
* **Specialist leadership:**
  provide leadership within your specialist area through design assurance, quality oversight, knowledge transfer and effective collaboration with internal and external teams.
* **Record-to-Report (R2R) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own end-to-end R2R processes within SAP S/4HANA, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Tax, Financial Close, Statutory and Management Reporting, Profitability Analysis (CO-PA), Bank Reconciliations and Finance Controls, and partner with O2C and P2P process owners to support an integrated Finance operating model across the WebBeds SAP landscape.
* **Order-to-Cash (O2C) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own end-to-end O2C processes within SAP S/4HANA, including Customer Master Data, Sales Order Management, Pricing, Billing and Invoicing, Accounts Receivable, Credit Management, Collections, Dispute Management, Cash Application, Revenue Management and customer experience optimisation, and lead the design, configuration, standardisation and continuous improvement of SAP SD and FSCM capabilities to strengthen revenue assurance, working capital, collections effectiveness and operational efficiency.
* **Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own end-to-end P2P processes within SAP S/4HANA, including Supplier Master Data and Onboarding, Sourcing and Contracts, Requisitions, Purchase Orders, Goods and Service Receipts, Invoice Verification, Supplier Reconciliations, Payment Integration, Spend Visibility, Procurement Compliance, Supplier Performance, and SAP MM procurement and inventory management.
* **Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own planning and performance management processes, including budgeting, rolling forecasts, scenario modelling, cost and profit centre planning, allocations, profitability analysis, business performance analysis, management reporting, dashboards, planning standardisation, SAC Planning, Datasphere and decision-support insights.
* **SAP ABAP Developer Lead:**
  own the technical design and delivery of SAP ABAP and BTP solutions across R2R, O2C, P2P & FP&A, translating functional requirements into scalable RICEFW objects, custom transactions, reports, interfaces, forms, workflows, CDS-based data models, APIs, integrations, Fiori services and intelligent automation solutions aligned with Clean Core principles.

**The skills we would love to see in your suitcase!**

* Proven experience in at least one of the functional domains (R2R, O2C, P2P, FP&A) or in SAP ABAP development, with relevant professional experience, technical expertise and business process knowledge.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, strong hands-on SAP ABAP experience in S/4HANA, including ABAP Objects, Data Dictionary, ALV, Smart Forms or Adobe Forms, enhancements, BAdIs, user exits and performance optimisation.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, experience developing across SAP FI, CO, MM and SD business processes, with the ability to understand functional specifications and intended business outcomes.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, integration experience using IDocs, BAPIs, APIs, SAP Integration Suite or equivalent SAP integration technologies.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, advanced experience with ABAP CDS Views, including data models, analytical queries and consumption views supporting Fiori, Datasphere, SAC and Finance reporting.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, experience with RAP, OData services, APIs, SAP Gateway, Fiori/UI5 extensibility and SAP BTP or side-by-side extension patterns.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, exposure to SAP Business AI, Joule, SAP Build, AI-assisted development, workflow automation or agentic automation is strongly preferred (nice to have).
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, the ability to lead technical design, code reviews, development standards, documentation, testing, transport governance, defect resolution and developer mentoring.
* Please apply for the role that best aligns with your experience and state clearly in your application which role or domain best matches your background, demonstrating relevant depth in that area.
* Applications will be assessed against the requirements of the selected functional domain or SAP ABAP technical role.
