title: Software Engineer
description:
**Software Engineer**

**Location:**
New Delhi, India

**Experience:**
2–5 years

**About the Company**

Storm Finance provides an agentic AI intelligence layer for finance teams, designed to work on top of existing accounting software and ERPs. Its AI agents autonomously handle reconciliation, accruals, accounts receivable and payable workflows, month-end close, reporting, forecasting, and financial insights, without requiring businesses to migrate their systems. The company’s mission is to make real-time, zero-touch finance the standard for every business, closing the gap between financial reality and business decision-making. Its vision is “Intelligence Without Disruption.” Storm Finance brings together finance-domain expertise and technical product depth, with a focus on finance automation and agentic AI for high-trust, audit-sensitive workflows. Its values include putting finance first, treating accuracy as non-negotiable, building trust, designing for autonomy, and delivering intelligence across systems businesses already use. The role is based in New Delhi and sits within the engineering function, contributing to backend software for a finance-focused technology product.

**About the Role**

Storm Finance is seeking a mid-level Software Engineer with Java and Spring Boot experience to build and maintain backend applications and REST APIs in New Delhi. You will help design scalable services, connect them with databases, and contribute to software quality through unit and integration testing, code reviews, and production troubleshooting. The work supports a finance technology product that applies agentic AI to workflows where accuracy and trust matter. You will collaborate with product and engineering teams to deliver reliable backend capabilities. This is a full-time, on-site role for candidates with two to five years of experience. Candidates should have a bachelor’s degree in engineering or technology, or a Master of Technology, in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. English is the required language.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain backend applications using Java and Spring Boot, contributing software that supports Storm Finance’s finance intelligence product and its workflow automation capabilities.
* Develop and maintain REST APIs, designing clear service interfaces that enable dependable communication between backend components and connected systems.
* Design scalable backend services and integrate them with databases, applying sound software design practices to support reliable product functionality.
* Write unit and integration tests for application code, helping verify behavior and maintain quality as backend services evolve.
* Troubleshoot production software issues, investigate causes, and contribute fixes that restore dependable service behavior.
* Review code and suggest improvements that strengthen readability, maintainability, and overall engineering quality.
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to understand requirements and deliver backend capabilities aligned with product needs.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Professional Java development experience, with the ability to build backend applications and apply object-oriented programming principles to maintainable software.
* Practical Spring Boot experience developing backend services and applications, including familiarity with common patterns for structuring service code.
* REST API development skills, including implementing and maintaining interfaces that support communication between services and connected systems.
* Experience with microservices and backend software design, including contributing to scalable services and understanding service boundaries.
* SQL and Hibernate skills for integrating Java applications with databases and working with persisted application data.
* Experience using Git in a software development workflow, including managing code changes and collaborating through shared repositories.
* Ability to write unit tests and integration tests, apply problem-solving skills, and troubleshoot software issues methodically.

**Additional Plus**

* A Master of Technology in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is relevant to the role’s education profile.
* Specialization in Java development, backend engineering, or Spring Boot aligns with the technical focus of this position.
* Experience in software development, artificial intelligence, accounting software, or financial technology is relevant to the employer’s product domain.

**What You'll Bring**

* Two to five years of professional software engineering experience, with a focus on Java and backend development.
* A Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, or Master of Technology in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Strong problem-solving capability and a foundation in object-oriented programming, software design, testing, and code quality.
* English communication skills and the ability to collaborate with product and engineering teams in an on-site, full-time role in New Delhi.

**Why Join Us**

At Storm Finance, you can contribute to a mission-critical finance product built to make real-time, zero-touch finance more accessible to businesses. The product brings an agentic AI intelligence layer to existing accounting software and ERPs, aiming to help finance teams act on current financial information without changing their systems. The company’s work spans reconciliation, accruals, accounts receivable and payable workflows, month-end close, reporting, forecasting, and financial insights. This role offers the opportunity to build Java and Spring Boot backend capabilities that support those product workflows, from REST APIs and scalable services to database integration and software quality. Storm Finance combines finance-domain expertise with technical product depth in an early-stage environment focused on finance automation. Engineers can take direct ownership of product work involving high-trust, audit-sensitive workflows, where accuracy and trust are central to the company’s stated values. You will collaborate with product and engineering colleagues while strengthening the reliability and quality of backend software. The role is based on-site in New Delhi and offers scope to contribute across application development, service design, testing, code review, and production issue resolution.

**What We Offer**

* Direct ownership of backend product work in an early-stage environment focused on finance automation and agentic AI for high-trust, audit-sensitive workflows.
* The opportunity to contribute to a finance product that works with existing accounting software and ERPs, without requiring system migration.
* A role spanning Java and Spring Boot application development, REST APIs, scalable services, database integration, testing, code review, and production troubleshooting.

title: Software Engineer 3, AI Framework Integrations
description:
AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI — and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience (ABX) org, we're standing up a brand new engineering team in Gurugram to make that happen, and we're looking for Software Engineers to be among its founding members.
  
  
The team owns the connective layer between MongoDB and third-party AI frameworks, platforms, and tools — the integrations that let developers use MongoDB effectively with the AI stack they've already chosen. That means shipping into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech, working mostly in Python and TypeScript, and partnering with the Database Experience (DBX) org when an integration needs new driver, platform, or product capability underneath it.
  
  
This is a strong role for an engineer who wants to grow into the AI space with real ownership. You'll own well-scoped projects from design through release, work with fast-moving and sometimes unproven technologies, and get a clear view of how the ecosystem is evolving. Priorities shift as frameworks change and customer demand moves, so we're looking for engineers who are adaptable, ask good questions, and take pride in shipping. Much of your work will happen in public: sending pull requests to upstream repositories, working through external maintainer review cycles, and participating in developer communities as MongoDB.
  
  
You'll work closest with the engineers sitting next to you, pairing on hard problems, reviewing each other's code, and dividing up a broad portfolio, with senior engineers and your manager close at hand as you take on larger pieces of it.
  
  
MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our cultural values every day. We value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Position expectations
  
  

* Build, test, and ship MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra
* Own well-scoped projects end to end on weekly-to-quarterly timelines, taking responsibility for the scope, schedule, and quality of your own work and communicating progress and trade-offs clearly
* Solve day-to-day technical problems with growing independence, using the team's established patterns and past practice to guide your decisions, and seeking guidance on non-standard problems
* Contribute to exploratory work on new frameworks: help evaluate an integration's feasibility, build a first working version of the piece you own, and share what you learn with the team
* Contribute high-quality code upstream to repositories MongoDB doesn't own, following the team's contribution practices and maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy through external maintainer review cycles
* Work within and improve the team's engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing across framework and server versions, version compatibility checks, and release steps. Suggest improvements where you see repeated friction
* Help keep the integrations you work on healthy: monitor for upstream breaking changes, handle upgrades, triage incoming issues, and follow through after release
* Coordinate with adjacent teams, including DBX, when your work depends on driver, platform, or product capability, and escalate cross-team dependencies and risks early rather than working around them
* Collaborate with product management, product design, and other partners to understand what users need from an integration and how your work connects to the team's objectives
* Write clear documentation, give useful code reviews, share what you know with teammates, and follow through on your commitments
* Develop specialized knowledge of the Python or TypeScript AI builder ecosystems — frameworks, agent and retrieval patterns, vector search — and bring interesting developments back to the team

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience building backend systems, libraries, or other developer-facing software, with solid proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript
* Experience designing, writing, testing, and debugging software in a shared, long-lived code base, with an eye for the tests and documentation that make it maintainable
* Track record of delivering scoped projects reliably and on time, with growing independence and good judgment about when to ask for help
* Demonstrated ability to work on several projects at once and keep quality and commitments intact as priorities shift
* Clear interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape: AI frameworks, agentic patterns, RAG and retrieval, embedding, or vector search
* Solid verbal and written technical communication, including the ability to write things down clearly for teammates and partners you won't always overlap with in real time
* Enjoys collaboration and being part of a close-knit team; is approachable, curious, and intellectually honest
* Eager to learn, with a strong technical foundation and an interest in deepening it

Nice to Have
  
  

* Open source contributions, especially any work that landed in a repository you don't own
* Experience building AI or framework integrations, MCP servers, agent skills, or plugins for agentic applications, professionally or as side projects
* Familiarity with the agentic AI tooling ecosystem (AI IDEs, CLIs, and assistants) and how developers integrate with it
* Experience with CI/CD and automated testing for libraries that support multiple versions or platforms
* Experience working with databases; familiarity with MongoDB query patterns
* Exposure to vector search, embedding pipelines, or index management
* Working knowledge of Java, Go, C#, or Rust
* Experience with containerization tools (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) and with AI frameworks and libraries
* Familiarity with Jira and related tools

Success measures
  
  

* In the first month, you will understand the team's scope, how our integrations are structured, where the relevant repositories and pipelines live, and how we build, test, and release. You'll have landed your first code contribution and know who to ask when you're blocked
* In three months, you will be delivering scoped work on one or more integrations with growing independence, will have landed an upstream contribution, and will be comfortable running the team's testing and release process for your own changes
* In six months, you will own a well-defined area or project end to end, deliver against quarterly objectives with limited oversight, and have made at least one concrete improvement to the quality or efficiency of how the team works
* In twelve months, you will be a dependable owner of a piece of the portfolio, will have delivered multiple meaningful features or integrations, will be handling upstream and customer issues in your area with confidence, and will be helping teammates get up to speed on what you know best

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

**ABOUT SUTRA.AI**

Sutra.AI is an AI transformation platform purpose-built for mid-market businesses, teams that want enterprise-grade AI outcomes without building a large AI organization. The platform orchestrates end-to-end:

data → opportunities → projects → production apps/APIs, with value tracking built in.

**We're hiring a Principal AI Engineer (R&D Lead) to own the execution of our AI systems end-to-end.**

This is the execution backbone of our AI platform. You'll architect and ship production systems, set engineering standards, and work directly with founders on high-priority initiatives. You'll turn ambiguous problems into scalable solutions, independently, with minimal oversight.

**This is not a research role. Not a coordination role. This is a builder + owner role.**

The systems you build will be used by the entire team. The patterns you establish will be replicated across the organization. High-leverage by design.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

evaluation harnesses

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Must-Haves**

• B.Tech (CS) Degree from IIT

• 5-7 years total software engineering experience

• 2-3+ years building production AI/ML systems (not just research or experiments)

• Strong backend engineering skills: Python, APIs, async systems, distributed architectures

• Team-oriented mindset: mentor others, prioritize company impact, low ego

title: Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems)
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
11
  
  
**Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems)**
**Role Summary**
As the Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems), you will help architect and build the organization’s next generation of autonomous AI workflows. This is a multidisciplinary technical role operating at the intersection of Software Engineering, Data Engineering, and Machine Learning Engineering. You will move beyond simple "chatbots" to design production-grade Agentic Systems: intelligent applications capable of reasoning, planning, and executing complex tasks autonomously.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Agentic Systems Architecture & Core Engineering**

* Architect & Build Multi-Agent Workflows: Lead the hands-on design and coding of stateful, production-grade agentic systems using Python and orchestration frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
* Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Communication: Design and implement robust A2A protocols enabling autonomous agents to collaborate, hand off sub-tasks, and negotiate execution paths dynamically within multi-agent environments.
* State Management & Orchestration: Engineer robust control flows for non-deterministic agents; implement complex message passing, memory persistence, and interruptible state handling to support long-running autonomous tasks.
* Tool Interface Design (MCP): Implement and standardize the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to create universal interfaces between agents, data sources, and operational tools, ensuring modularity and scalability.
* Model Integration & Optimization: Utilize proxy services (i.e. LiteLLM) to manage model routing and fallback strategies; optimize context windows and inference costs across proprietary and open-source models.
* Production Deployment: Containerize agentic workloads using Docker and orchestrate deployments on Kubernetes; leverage AWS AgentCore or similar cloud-native services for scalable infrastructure.

**Data Engineering & Operational Real-Time Integration**

* Build Agent Data Pipelines: Write and maintain high-throughput ingestion pipelines (using Databricks or Python-based ETL) that transform raw operational signals into structured context for agents.
* Real-Time Context Injection: Ensure agents have access to "operational real-time" data (seconds/minutes latency) by optimizing retrieval architectures and vector store performance.
* Cross-Functional Engineering: Act as the technical bridge between Data Engineering and AI teams; translate complex agent requirements into concrete data schemas and pipeline specifications, while stepping in to resolve hands-on bottlenecks in data availability.

**Observability, Governance & Human-in-the-Loop**

* LLMOps & Tracing: Implement comprehensive observability using tools like Langfuse to trace agent reasoning steps, monitor token usage, and debug latency issues in production.
* Safety & Control Frameworks: Design hybrid execution modes ranging from Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) for sensitive operations to fully autonomous execution; build "break-glass" mechanisms and guardrails for automated decision-making.
* Evaluation & Reliability: Establish technical standards for testing non-deterministic outputs; automate evaluation pipelines to measure agent accuracy, hallucination rates, and drift before deployment.

**Technical Leadership & Strategy**

* Technical Roadmap Definition: Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to scope feasibility for autonomous projects; define the "Agentic Architecture" roadmap.
* Mentorship & Standards: Define code quality standards, architectural patterns, and PR review processes for the AI engineering team; upskill team members on the latest agentic frameworks and methodologies.
* Innovation: Proactively prototype with emerging tools (e.g., new reasoning models, graph-based RAG) to solve high-value business problems, moving successful experiments into the production roadmap.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Experience: 7+ years of total technical experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or Machine Learning.
* GenAI Specialization: 2+ years of specific experience building and deploying LLM-based applications or Agentic Systems in production.
* Database & Lakehouse Mastery: Experience architecting storage layers for AI, including Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant), NoSQL/Relational Databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB), and modern Data Lakehouses (specifically Databricks or Snowflake).
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Expertise in cloud architecture and container orchestration (AWS, GCP, or Azure) using Kubernetes and Docker. You must be comfortable deploying and scaling your own applications.
* LLM Ecosystem: Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and orchestration libraries (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen). You understand the mechanics of RAG, embeddings, and context window management.
* Hybrid Engineering Skillset: A unique blend of Data Science (understanding model behavior, probability, and prompting) and Software Engineering (CI/CD, API design, asynchronous programming, and system reliability).
* Language Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Python for systems engineering, capable of writing modular, testable, and maintainable production code.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field.

**Preferred**

* Advanced Education: Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
* NLP Expertise: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP), ranging from foundational techniques (e.g., text processing, embeddings, classification) to modern architectures.
* Graph Technologies: Experience with Knowledge Graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune), Graph Databases, and GraphML (Graph Machine Learning) to support complex reasoning and relationship modeling.
* Agentic Tooling: Specific experience with LangGraph, LiteLLM, Langfuse, AWS AgentCore, or implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Advanced Architectures: Proven track record of implementing Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, swarm intelligence, or multi-modal agent workflows.
* Real-Time Operations: Experience working in environments requiring operational real-time processing (e.g., FinTech, Energy, Logistics).

**Why This Role Matters**
You won't just be building chatbots here; you will be architecting the organization’s "central nervous system." As the Lead AI Engineer for Agentic Systems, you are bridging the gap between static data models and active decision-making. The autonomous workflows you design—capable of planning, collaborating (A2A), and executing tasks—will fundamentally change how we operate, moving us from human-dependent processes to self-healing, intelligent systems. This is a rare opportunity to define the standards for Agentic AI in a production environment, working with a stack that represents the absolute cutting edge of the industry.
  
  
**About S&P Global Energy**
At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a motivated DevOps Engineer with 1 to 2 years of hands-on experience in containerization, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, automation, and production support. The candidate will help build and maintain reliable deployment pipelines, manage infrastructure as code, support databases and application services, and strengthen security, backup, and disaster recovery practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* CI/CD, Automation & Application Deployment
* Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins for automated build, test, and deployment workflows.
* Build and manage Docker images and containers; support containerized application deployments and troubleshooting.
* Work with developers to deploy and operate Node.js applications across development, staging, and production environments.
* Write and maintain Bash scripts to automate routine operations, deployments, health checks, and log-management tasks.
* Cloud & Infrastructure Management
* Provision, configure, and maintain infrastructure on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including compute instances, virtual cloud networks (VCNs), storage, access controls, and related cloud services.
* Use Terraform to define, provision, and manage infrastructure as code; maintain reusable configurations and track changes safely.
* Monitor application and infrastructure availability, resource utilization, logs, and performance; investigate incidents and support root-cause analysis.
* Maintain environment configuration and deployment documentation, and follow controlled change and rollback procedures.
* Databases, Messaging & Caching
* Support the setup, configuration, monitoring, backup, restore, and troubleshooting of PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB.
* Support Redis for caching and related operational tasks, and Kafka for messaging/broker health and basic troubleshooting.
* Coordinate with development teams on database connectivity, performance, capacity, access permissions, and service availability.
* Help verify backup completion and participate in restore testing; follow approved procedures for database changes.
* Security, Reliability & Disaster Recovery
* Apply infrastructure security best practices, including least-privilege access, secrets handling, secure configurations, and timely patching.
* Support access management, firewall/network rules, vulnerability remediation, and secure handling of credentials and configuration files.
* Assist in setting up and maintaining backup and disaster recovery (DR) procedures, recovery documentation, and periodic DR/restore tests.
* Monitor service alerts, respond to incidents, escalate risks promptly, and participate in on-call or scheduled production support as required.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Containers: Docker images, containers, registries, volumes, networks, and basic troubleshooting.
* Cloud: Hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including compute, networking, IAM, storage, and monitoring fundamentals.
* CI/CD & IaC: Jenkins pipeline fundamentals and Terraform for infrastructure provisioning.
* Databases & Services: Operational familiarity with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, Kafka, and Node.js application deployments.
* Scripting: Bash scripting for automation and routine system administration.
* Security & DR: Basic server hardening, access management, patching, backup/restore, monitoring, and disaster recovery concepts.
* Operating Systems & Networking: Linux administration, command-line troubleshooting, DNS, TCP/IP, ports, and basic networking.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree, diploma, or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 1 to 2 years of relevant experience in DevOps, cloud/infrastructure operations, deployment automation, or system administration.
* Candidates should be comfortable learning new tools, working with developers, and following documented operational procedures.
* Cloud, Linux, Docker, Jenkins, or Terraform certifications are a plus, but are not mandatory.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Reliability and success rate of CI/CD pipelines and deployments.
* Timely resolution or escalation of infrastructure and deployment incidents.
* Availability and health monitoring of applications, databases, and cloud resources.
* Completion of scheduled backups and participation in successful restore/DR tests.
* Infrastructure changes documented and managed through approved automation and change-control processes.

**Note: The role is intended for an early-career engineer. Practical hands-on knowledge of the listed technologies is preferred. Experience supporting workloads hosted on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is required.**

title: Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems)
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
11
  
  
**Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems)**
**Role Summary**
As the Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems), you will help architect and build the organization’s next generation of autonomous AI workflows. This is a multidisciplinary technical role operating at the intersection of Software Engineering, Data Engineering, and Machine Learning Engineering. You will move beyond simple "chatbots" to design production-grade Agentic Systems: intelligent applications capable of reasoning, planning, and executing complex tasks autonomously.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Agentic Systems Architecture & Core Engineering**

* Architect & Build Multi-Agent Workflows: Lead the hands-on design and coding of stateful, production-grade agentic systems using Python and orchestration frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
* Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Communication: Design and implement robust A2A protocols enabling autonomous agents to collaborate, hand off sub-tasks, and negotiate execution paths dynamically within multi-agent environments.
* State Management & Orchestration: Engineer robust control flows for non-deterministic agents; implement complex message passing, memory persistence, and interruptible state handling to support long-running autonomous tasks.
* Tool Interface Design (MCP): Implement and standardize the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to create universal interfaces between agents, data sources, and operational tools, ensuring modularity and scalability.
* Model Integration & Optimization: Utilize proxy services (i.e. LiteLLM) to manage model routing and fallback strategies; optimize context windows and inference costs across proprietary and open-source models.
* Production Deployment: Containerize agentic workloads using Docker and orchestrate deployments on Kubernetes; leverage AWS AgentCore or similar cloud-native services for scalable infrastructure.

**Data Engineering & Operational Real-Time Integration**

* Build Agent Data Pipelines: Write and maintain high-throughput ingestion pipelines (using Databricks or Python-based ETL) that transform raw operational signals into structured context for agents.
* Real-Time Context Injection: Ensure agents have access to "operational real-time" data (seconds/minutes latency) by optimizing retrieval architectures and vector store performance.
* Cross-Functional Engineering: Act as the technical bridge between Data Engineering and AI teams; translate complex agent requirements into concrete data schemas and pipeline specifications, while stepping in to resolve hands-on bottlenecks in data availability.

**Observability, Governance & Human-in-the-Loop**

* LLMOps & Tracing: Implement comprehensive observability using tools like Langfuse to trace agent reasoning steps, monitor token usage, and debug latency issues in production.
* Safety & Control Frameworks: Design hybrid execution modes ranging from Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) for sensitive operations to fully autonomous execution; build "break-glass" mechanisms and guardrails for automated decision-making.
* Evaluation & Reliability: Establish technical standards for testing non-deterministic outputs; automate evaluation pipelines to measure agent accuracy, hallucination rates, and drift before deployment.

**Technical Leadership & Strategy**

* Technical Roadmap Definition: Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to scope feasibility for autonomous projects; define the "Agentic Architecture" roadmap.
* Mentorship & Standards: Define code quality standards, architectural patterns, and PR review processes for the AI engineering team; upskill team members on the latest agentic frameworks and methodologies.
* Innovation: Proactively prototype with emerging tools (e.g., new reasoning models, graph-based RAG) to solve high-value business problems, moving successful experiments into the production roadmap.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Experience: 7+ years of total technical experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or Machine Learning.
* GenAI Specialization: 2+ years of specific experience building and deploying LLM-based applications or Agentic Systems in production.
* Database & Lakehouse Mastery: Experience architecting storage layers for AI, including Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant), NoSQL/Relational Databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB), and modern Data Lakehouses (specifically Databricks or Snowflake).
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Expertise in cloud architecture and container orchestration (AWS, GCP, or Azure) using Kubernetes and Docker. You must be comfortable deploying and scaling your own applications.
* LLM Ecosystem: Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and orchestration libraries (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen). You understand the mechanics of RAG, embeddings, and context window management.
* Hybrid Engineering Skillset: A unique blend of Data Science (understanding model behavior, probability, and prompting) and Software Engineering (CI/CD, API design, asynchronous programming, and system reliability).
* Language Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Python for systems engineering, capable of writing modular, testable, and maintainable production code.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field.

**Preferred**

* Advanced Education: Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
* NLP Expertise: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP), ranging from foundational techniques (e.g., text processing, embeddings, classification) to modern architectures.
* Graph Technologies: Experience with Knowledge Graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune), Graph Databases, and GraphML (Graph Machine Learning) to support complex reasoning and relationship modeling.
* Agentic Tooling: Specific experience with LangGraph, LiteLLM, Langfuse, AWS AgentCore, or implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Advanced Architectures: Proven track record of implementing Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, swarm intelligence, or multi-modal agent workflows.
* Real-Time Operations: Experience working in environments requiring operational real-time processing (e.g., FinTech, Energy, Logistics).

**Why This Role Matters**
You won't just be building chatbots here; you will be architecting the organization’s "central nervous system." As the Lead AI Engineer for Agentic Systems, you are bridging the gap between static data models and active decision-making. The autonomous workflows you design—capable of planning, collaborating (A2A), and executing tasks—will fundamentally change how we operate, moving us from human-dependent processes to self-healing, intelligent systems. This is a rare opportunity to define the standards for Agentic AI in a production environment, working with a stack that represents the absolute cutting edge of the industry.

At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration.

description:

Orion delivers game-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity. We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education.
  
  
**Job Overview:**
We are seeking an innovative and highly skilled
**Lead Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer**
to spearhead the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI-powered solutions. In this role, you will lead a team of engineers and data scientists to harness cutting-edge Generative AI technologies and implement them to solve complex business problems, enhance user experiences, and drive innovation. This role combines deep technical expertise, leadership, and a strong understanding of AI trends and tools.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Technical Leadership:

+ Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of Generative AI solutions.
+ Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and data scientists working on GenAI projects.
+ Stay updated with the latest trends, research, and advancements in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).

* Solution Development:

+ Architect, train, and fine-tune state-of-the-art LLMs and generative AI models
+ Develop and optimize pipelines for prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and domain-specific fine-tuning.

+ Ensure scalability, performance, and security of AI solutions deployed in production.
+ Integration and Deployment:

* API Development:

+ Ability to define and deliver API access for GenAI services, facilitating integration with other systems and applications.
+ Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate GenAI solutions into enterprise applications and services.
+ Utilize cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP) to deploy and manage AI models and APIs.
+ Leverage MLOps practices for continuous model monitoring, retraining, and improvement.

* Data Strategy and Preparation:

+ Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure high-quality data acquisition, preprocessing, and augmentation for model training and fine-tuning.
+ Implement data governance and privacy practices in line with organizational policies.

* Innovation and Research:

+ Experiment with new generative AI techniques, such as multimodal AI, reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and active learning.
+ Evaluate and recommend AI frameworks, libraries, and platforms for project requirements.

* Stakeholder Collaboration:

+ Work closely with product managers, business stakeholders, and UX designers to define AI-powered product features and use cases.
+ Present technical concepts, project progress, and AI capabilities to non-technical audiences.

**Key Requirements**

* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms and services for AI/ML, such as Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
* Hands on experience in any of LLMs such as OpenAI’s ChatGPT Models , Gemini, Llama 2 ,Claude 2 ,Grok
* Hands on experience in any of the agentic frameworks like LangChain, Semantic kernel, AutoGen, CrewAi
* Hands on experience using any of vector database like Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate, Faiss
* Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF)
* Strong expertise in LLMs and generative AI frameworks like OpenAI, Hugging Face Transformers, or similar platforms.
* Deep understanding of natural language processing (NLP) concepts, including tokenization, embeddings, and sequence-to-sequence models.
* Proficiency in Python and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn.
* Experience in CI/CD pipeline management and automation tools, particularly within the Azure DevOps environment. Knowledge of containerization (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools is also important
* Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices, such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Docker.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field (Ph.D. preferred).
* 8+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with 2+ years specifically in Generative AI.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in building Conversational AI applications using cloud-based services and in orchestrating AI/ML services for building a complete solution
* Minimum of 6 years of extensive full-time experience in Data Analysis, Statistics, Machine Learning, or Computer Science
* Proven track record of leading AI projects from inception to production.
* Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF).
* Certifications in AI/ML or cloud platforms (e.g., Azure AI Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning).

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
  
  
Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.
  
  
As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.
  
  
**About Your Team**
Asset Management Platforms (AMP) is responsible for the design, engineering and delivery of technology solutions that support Fidelity's global Asset Management business. We partner with Research Analysts, Portfolio Managers, Asset Management Operations, Sustainability teams, and Distribution teams across Europe and Asia to deliver modern platforms that enhance investment research, knowledge discovery, data-driven insights, and informed investment decision-making.
  
  
Our team develops and supports the technology ecosystem used across multiple investment capabilities, including Equities, Fixed Income, Multi-Asset, Systematic Investing, and Sustainable Investing. Our platforms underpin critical research processes including company and market research, sustainability analysis, financial modelling, investment content management, knowledge discovery, collaboration, and research analytics, enabling investment professionals to generate high-quality investment insights and improve client outcomes.
  
  
As Artificial Intelligence continues to transform investment research and software engineering, we are investing in modern engineering practices that combine AI-assisted software development with AI-powered research capabilities to improve productivity, accelerate insight generation, and enhance engineering quality. The AI Solutions Engineer will play a key role in designing, developing, and delivering enterprise AI solutions while enabling engineering teams to adopt AI-enabled development practices safely, effectively, and responsibly across the Research Technology platform.
  
  
**About Your Role**
The AI Solutions Engineer is a hands-on technical engineer responsible for accelerating software engineering delivery through the effective adoption of Artificial Intelligence and modern engineering practices.
  
  
Working closely with Engineering Leads, Solution Architects, Product Owners and software engineering teams, you will identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI-assisted development while maintaining Fidelity's high standards for architecture, engineering governance, software quality and security.
  
  
You will combine strong software engineering expertise with practical knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI-powered development tooling to establish best practices for AI-assisted software engineering. This includes to make effective use of technologies such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI coding assistants to improve software design, implementation, testing, documentation and operational support.
  
  
The role is equally focused on engineering excellence and innovation. You will apply modern software and AI engineering practices through hands-on design, development, testing, deployment, and production support, contribute to architectural decisions within established standards, support the adoption and continuous improvement of CI/CD, DevSecOps practices and implement approved security, governance, and Responsible AI controls throughout the software development lifecycle.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to shape how AI is adopted across Asset Management Platforms, helping engineering teams deliver high-quality software faster while ensuring solutions remain secure, maintainable and aligned with Fidelity's engineering standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Engineering Enablement**

* Design, build, deploy, and support enterprise AI applications using LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool calling, and agentic workflows.
* Build grounded RAG pipelines covering document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata enrichment, hybrid retrieval, reranking, citation, and response validation.
* Develop AI agents capable of planning, reasoning, maintaining context, invoking approved tools, and executing governed business workflows.
* Integrate commercial and open-source models through platforms such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent services.
* Implement prompt and model configuration management, evaluation datasets, automated quality testing, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Evaluate AI technologies progmatically and select solutions based on business value, quality, security, latency, scalability, and cost.
* Coach and mentor engineering teams in the effective use of Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI-assisted development tools.

**Software Engineering**

* Build complete AI-assisted apps using modern frontend technologies such as Angular or React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Develop secure and scalable APIs, microservices, and orchestration services using Python, FastAPI, Node.js, or NestJS.
* Integrate applications with enterprise APIs, market and research data, document repositories, collaboration platforms, and structured and unstructured data sources.
* Work with Relational, NoSQL, Cloud and vector technologies such as PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Snowflake and pgvector.
* Participate in engineering practices, including modular design, API contracts, code reviews, performance optimization and secure coding.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Champion modern engineering practices including Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery and DevSecOps.
* Work with engineering teams to optimise software delivery pipelines.
* Promote unit test automation and engineering best practises throughout the SDLC.
* Create reusable AI services, reference implementations, engineering standards, and ready-to-use development capabilities that improve developer productivity.

**Architecture & Governance**

* Collaborate with Solution Architects and Engineering Leads to ensure solutions align with Fidelity's target architecture.
* Ensure AI-assisted software development complies with engineering standards, security policies and regulatory requirements.
* Promote sound software engineering principles including maintainability, scalability, resilience and observability.
* Implement controls for prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, unsafe responses, hallucination, unauthorized tool use, and third-party model risk.
* Balance innovation with appropriate technology risk management and governance.
* Communicate technical decisions, risks, trade-offs, and delivery progress clearly to engineering, architecture, product, and business stakeholders.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build strong working relationships with Engineering Leads, Product Owners, Solution Architects and software engineering teams.
* Partner with investment technology stakeholders to understand engineering challenges and identify opportunities for AI-enabled improvement.
* Establish and support communities of practice around AI-assisted software engineering.
* Deliver demonstrations, technical workshops and knowledge-sharing sessions with senior investment professionals.
* Stay informed on emerging AI technologies and assess their applicability within Fidelity's engineering environment.

**About You**
We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on AI Engineer who combines strong full-stack engineering capability with practical experience in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI. You are comfortable taking AI-powered applications and services through design, development, integration, testing, deployment, and production support within established architecture and engineering standards.
  
  
You are naturally curious about emerging technologies, enjoy solving complex engineering challenges, and apply AI pragmatically to improve business outcomes and developer productivity without compromising software quality, security, governance, or Responsible AI principles.
  
  
You are comfortable contributing to architectural and technical discussions with senior engineers, collaborating with Product, Architecture, Data Engineering, and Quality Engineering teams, and engaging with investment stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into secure, scalable, and production-ready AI solutions.
  
  
**Software Engineering Experience**

* 6+ years experience in software engineering, including experience leading the technical delivery of complex enterprise applications.
* Demonstrable experience building, deploying, and supporting production Generative AI or LLM-powered applications.
* Strong hands-on engineering skills in Python and at least one modern frontend stack using TypeScript with Angular / React.
* Experience developing APIs and distributed services using frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js, or NestJS.
* Strong experience with RAG, including embeddings, vector search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, citations, and evaluation.
* Experience building AI agents or orchestrated AI workflows using LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent frameworks.
* Experience with LLM capabilities such as structured output, function or tool calling, conversation state, prompt management, and model routing.
* Strong experience designing and delivering enterprise software solutions.
* Excellent understanding of modern software engineering principles and design patterns.
* Experience working within Agile software delivery teams.
* Strong understanding of engineering governance, software quality and secure software development practices.
* Experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with DevSecOps practices and engineering automation.

**AI Engineering Experience**

* Practical experience using AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf or similar LLM-based engineering assistants.
* Experience integrating AI into software engineering workflows including code generation, documentation, automated testing, code review and developer productivity.
* Understanding of prompt engineering and effective techniques for interacting with Large Language Models.
* Familiarity with emerging AI concepts such as AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic development workflows.
* Understanding of AI governance, responsible AI practices and the effective use of AI within enterprise engineering environments.
* Passion for staying current with developments in AI-assisted software engineering.

**Technical Skills**
Experience with many of the following technologies and practices:
  
  

* Python, Angular, Nodejs, TypeScript or similar modern programming languages
* LLM application development and prompt engineering
* Enterprise RAG and vector search
* AI agents, tool calling, and workflow orchestration
* Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP)
* Containerisation technologies including Docker and Kubernetes
* Git-based source control and collaborative development workflows
* REST APIs and event-driven architectures

Amazon Now is building the future of 10-minute delivery for India's fast-growing grocery and essentials market, and we're looking for talented engineers who want to do more than write code — you'll own components that thousands of customers touch within minutes of a change going live, and help shape the product, the architecture, and the business roadmap. This is not maintenance work; it's a high-visibility, grounds-up initiative where you'll design and build the entire shopping lifecycle — discovery, storefront, ordering, and delivery — using modern ReactJS front-ends and backend services built from scratch.
  
  
You'll work alongside senior engineers and product leaders to solve difficult, ambiguous problems at scale, making pragmatic trade-offs without over-engineering. If you thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where your work directly influences both the technology and the customer experience on a platform designed to scale beyond India, this is the role for you.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
We are seeking a skilled and dynamic Full Stack Developer proficient in React.js and Node.js to design, develop, and maintain robust web applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building scalable front-end interfaces and efficient back-end services, ensuring seamless performance, responsiveness, and security. This role directly contributes to business growth by delivering user-centric solutions, optimizing system performance, and driving innovation across the technology stack.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* 3 to 5year experience in Design, develop, and deploy modern web applications using React.js (front-end) and Node.js (back-end).
* Build and consume RESTful APIs to support application functionality.
* Develop robust server-side logic, authentication systems, and data processing workflows using Node.js.
* Design and manage databases such as MySQL, ensuring optimal performance and data integrity.
* Integrate third-party APIs and services for payments, notifications, and analytics.
* Ensure best practices in application security, performance optimization, and scalability.

**Job Specifications:**
**Skills**

* Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), React.js, Node.js,
* Solid understanding of front-end architecture, state management (Redux, Context API), and component-based development.
* Hands-on experience with database design and query optimization in My SQL databases.
* Experience with RESTful API design and integration.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS is preferred.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Git version control, and Agile methodologies.
* Proficient in implementing secure authentication (JWT, OAuth2) and following OWASP best practices.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code.

Office environment – This is a full-time role in our Chennai office

0%

Liquidity Services (NASDAQ: LQDT) operates the world’s largest B2B e-commerce marketplace platform for surplus assets, with over $15 billion in completed transactions to more than 6 million qualified buyers worldwide and 15,000 corporate and government sellers. title: Software Dev Engineer II, Profit Intelligence
description:
**Description**
Are you interested in building intelligence systems from the ground up?
  
  
Are you interested in working with Applied Scientists, Big Data Engineers and Software Development Engineers to build large-scale data intelligence systems?
  
  
Are you interested to work in a team that positively impacts different key pillars of Amazon like Pricing, Promotions, Advertising, Auto inventory purchasing, Auto inventory removal, Inventory placement?
  
  
Are you interested in working for a team that builds cool systems yet has great work-life balance?
  
  
Profit intelligence systems measures, predicts true profit(/loss) for each item as a result of a specific shipment to an Amazon customer.
  
  
Prot Intelligence is all about providing intelligent ways for Amazon to understand profitability across retail business. What are the hidden factors driving the growth or profitability across millions of shipments each day?
  
  
Profit Intelligence provides these answers.
  
  
We compute the profitability of each and every shipment that gets shipped out of Amazon. Guess what, we predict the profitability of future possible shipments too. We are a team of agile, can-do engineers, who believe that not only are moon shots possible but that they can be done before lunch. All it takes is finding new ideas that challenge our preconceived notions of how things should be done. Process and procedure matter less than ideas and the practical work of getting stuff done. This is a place for exploring the new and taking risks.
  
  
We push the envelope in using cloud services in AWS as well as the latest in distributed systems, forecasting algorithms, and data mining.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to design and build AI-powered data platforms that transform large-scale business data into actionable insights. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and data engineering — owning end-to-end development of tools that help business leaders make faster, better decisions.
  
  
This is a high-impact role on a team where the software you ship directly shapes financial and operational strategy across Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Architect and build scalable platforms that ingest, process, and serve insights from petabyte-scale datasets
  
  
Integrate large language models and generative AI capabilities into internal analytics tools — enabling natural language querying, anomaly explanation, and automated reporting
  
  
Design ML pipelines for anomaly detection, forecasting, and trend analysis over structured and semi-structured business data
  
  
Partner with scientists, analysts, and PMs to translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped technical solutions
  
  
Drive engineering excellence: define coding standards, lead design reviews, and set the bar for operational health (monitoring, oncall, runbooks)
  
  
Mentor junior engineers; raise the technical capability of the team through clear documentation and code review
  
  
Own your services in production — you build it, you run it
  
  
Build and operate our foundational data infrastructure comprising of the entire spectrum of AWS Services - Storage (Redshift Data Shares, s3 data lakes), Orchestration (Step Functions, Glue and Internal Java Based Orchestration Tools), Processing (Spark & Flink - KDA), Streaming services (AWS Kinesis) and real-time large scale event aggregation stores.
  
  
Making it fully configurable and self-service for non-engineers.
  
  
Build and evolve tools that empower Amazonians to access data and build reliable, scalable and configurable way to generate Unit Economics for all Amazon Businesses. This includes UIs and frameworks for configuring rules, simulating their application, approval workows for rule changes, APIs and caching layers for high-throughput serving of Unit Economics Historicals and Predictions.
  
  
Build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like inhouse Reporting Applications and BI tools), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for designing and building platforms for crunching 100s of TB of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Support Engineer III, Chronicle
description:
**Description**
Impact
  
  
Ever wondered how Amazon offers the Earth's biggest selection and still manages to offer lower prices every day to our customers? Our retail business teams work with a massive array of vendors and business financial performance metrics to expand selection and drive costs lower. Given the rapid growth of our business, this requires our category leaders, financial analysts, site merchandisers and vendor managers to quickly analyze vendors, categories and brands, diving deep into data showing business efficiency down to the unit sale level. The technology that enables this has huge visibility and impact and is critical to Amazon's continued profitability and growth.
  
  
Innovation
  
  
We're working on the future. If you are seeking an environment where you can drive innovation. If you want to apply state-of-the-art software technologies to solve real world problems. If you want the satisfaction of providing visible benefit to end-users in an iterative fast paced environment, this is your opportunity. The responsibilities of this role will be key in paving the future of Amazon Retail and transforming how we do business.
  
  
Opportunity
  
  
You will be part of a team of creative, top-notch engineers who work hard, have fun, and make history.
  
  
As a Support Engineer, you will build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like in-house Applications and external aplications ), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for crunching and providing support for petabytes of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.
  
  
Be part of a high performance, high profile team with a complete, entirely localized business charter to enhance business profitability for the Amazon Consumer business.
  
  
Platform runs entirely on AWS; high scale, engineering challenges.
  
  
Very successful team that has developed a reputation of delivering results within Amazon.
  
  
We regularly research new technologies and invest for the future of our scalability
  
  
This role is on the Chronicle team within Selling Partner Services. We own the Turismo product suite, which is powered by Ripple, a dynamic query engine. Turismo is a well loved product, with 15k+ users globally. Ripple is a PrestoDB based query engine that is built to scale, and processes 2M+ queries per week. We are a full stack team, with Product managers, UX designers, TPMs, SDEs, DEs and Data Scientists.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Provide support of incoming tickets, including extensive troubleshooting tasks, with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services

* Develop tools to aid operations and maintenance

* Ownership of one or more ETL products or components
* Customer notification and workflow coordination and follow-up to maintain service level agreements

* 2+ years of software development, or 2+ years of technical support experience
* Experience scripting in modern program languages
* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of web services, distributed systems, and web application development
* Experience troubleshooting & maintaining hardware & software RAID
* Experience with REST web services, XML, JSON

title: Solution Architect / Functional Architect - Cloud
description:
**Job Title:**
Solution Architect / Functional Architect - Cloud
  
  
**Department**
: IT
  
  
**About Business line/Function:**
Wealth Management (WM) - Strategy and Architecture
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
As a member of the IS Architecture team, you will be in charge of helping projects define their Solution Architecture while migrating the Information System of Wealth Management into BNPP group Cloud platform. You will review their proposals with Enterprise Architects as well as Engineering/Production teams and Security teams to ensure that solutions proposed are aligned and compliant with BNPP policies and BNPP Cloud offering.
  
  
You will be assigned to a fixed set of IT Divisions/Departments (2 or 3) for which you will manage the solutioning for Cloud migration and BAU evolutions of the applications under their management. In addition, you may be assigned to specific transversal projects for which you will do the solutioning end-to-end.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Maintain the Division/Department architecture reference documentation all along the changes brought by projects:
* IT system diagrams (Division level, or per sub-block)
* Application referential (with the help of Application Owners)
* Division level principles and related non-conformities and remediation plans
* Obsolescence KPIs
* Lead the Cloud solution architecture on the projects they are assigned to:
* Supporting the Project Manager/Business Analysts during solution ideation, design, and implementation
* Collaborating with application teams and Business Analysts/Tech leads of impacted applications to design solutions consistent from a functional and technical point of view
* Ensuring the alignment of projects with our architecture principles and IT standards
* Ensuring the solution is optimized for running on our IBM Private Cloud
* Support project managers, Business analysts and technical leads along the architecture validation process by:
* Leading the build of a consistent architecture documentation
* Presenting their projects in architecture validation committee
* Being the reference point on a set of applications for support/evolution activities

title: SAP Consultants - Lead
description:
**What you will do on your journey with WebBeds.**

As an SAP Consultant Lead / SAP ABAP Developer Lead, you will join the growing global SAP team at WebBeds and play a key role in our SAP S/4HANA and RISE with SAP transformation journey.

**\***
These roles are based in Hyderabad and can also be considered in Bangalore, Pune, Chennai or Noida. We are building an internal SAP capability to drive innovation, reduce reliance on external partners and establish long-term ownership of our business processes and SAP solutions.'

We are recruiting across multiple functional and technical domains, with opportunities for SAP R2R, O2C, P2P & FP&A, together with an SAP ABAP Developer Lead.

Each successful candidate will lead delivery and solution ownership within their area of expertise. Functional Leads will collaborate with Finance, Procurement, Commercial and Operations teams to translate business requirements into scalable SAP solutions, while the SAP ABAP Developer Lead will partner with Functional Leads, Global Process Owners and technical teams to deliver Clean Core-aligned developments, integrations, analytics and automation.

All roles will contribute to process standardisation, innovation, compliance, operational excellence and measurable business value.

**In this role you will:**

**Key responsibilities**

* **End-to-end delivery:**
  lead delivery within your assigned functional domain or ABAP technical specialism, from requirements and solution design through testing, deployment, go-live, hypercare and operational handover.
* **Stakeholder partnership:**
  partner with business stakeholders, Global Process Owners, SAP teams, integration teams and delivery partners to define scalable future-state solutions.
* **SAP best practice:**
  champion SAP S/4HANA best practices, RISE with SAP, fit-to-standard delivery and Clean Core principles.
* **Design, testing and deployment:**
  lead or support workshops, fit-gap analysis, solution design, documentation, SIT, UAT, end-to-end testing, data migration, cutover and production readiness.
* **Automation and governance:**
  drive automation, process standardisation, continuous improvement, controls, compliance and governance.
* **Innovation:**
  identify opportunities to apply SAP Signavio, SAP Business AI, Joule, SAP BTP, SAP Build, Datasphere, SAC, Cloud ALM and LeanIX where relevant to your role (nice to have).
* **Specialist leadership:**
  provide leadership within your specialist area through design assurance, quality oversight, knowledge transfer and effective collaboration with internal and external teams.
* **Record-to-Report (R2R) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own end-to-end R2R processes within SAP S/4HANA, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Tax, Financial Close, Statutory and Management Reporting, Profitability Analysis (CO-PA), Bank Reconciliations and Finance Controls, and partner with O2C and P2P process owners to support an integrated Finance operating model across the WebBeds SAP landscape.
* **Order-to-Cash (O2C) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own end-to-end O2C processes within SAP S/4HANA, including Customer Master Data, Sales Order Management, Pricing, Billing and Invoicing, Accounts Receivable, Credit Management, Collections, Dispute Management, Cash Application, Revenue Management and customer experience optimisation, and lead the design, configuration, standardisation and continuous improvement of SAP SD and FSCM capabilities to strengthen revenue assurance, working capital, collections effectiveness and operational efficiency.
* **Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own end-to-end P2P processes within SAP S/4HANA, including Supplier Master Data and Onboarding, Sourcing and Contracts, Requisitions, Purchase Orders, Goods and Service Receipts, Invoice Verification, Supplier Reconciliations, Payment Integration, Spend Visibility, Procurement Compliance, Supplier Performance, and SAP MM procurement and inventory management.
* **Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own planning and performance management processes, including budgeting, rolling forecasts, scenario modelling, cost and profit centre planning, allocations, profitability analysis, business performance analysis, management reporting, dashboards, planning standardisation, SAC Planning, Datasphere and decision-support insights.
* **SAP ABAP Developer Lead:**
  own the technical design and delivery of SAP ABAP and BTP solutions across R2R, O2C, P2P & FP&A, translating functional requirements into scalable RICEFW objects, custom transactions, reports, interfaces, forms, workflows, CDS-based data models, APIs, integrations, Fiori services and intelligent automation solutions aligned with Clean Core principles.

**The skills we would love to see in your suitcase!**

* Proven experience in at least one of the functional domains (R2R, O2C, P2P, FP&A) or in SAP ABAP development, with relevant professional experience, technical expertise and business process knowledge.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, strong hands-on SAP ABAP experience in S/4HANA, including ABAP Objects, Data Dictionary, ALV, Smart Forms or Adobe Forms, enhancements, BAdIs, user exits and performance optimisation.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, experience developing across SAP FI, CO, MM and SD business processes, with the ability to understand functional specifications and intended business outcomes.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, integration experience using IDocs, BAPIs, APIs, SAP Integration Suite or equivalent SAP integration technologies.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, advanced experience with ABAP CDS Views, including data models, analytical queries and consumption views supporting Fiori, Datasphere, SAC and Finance reporting.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, experience with RAP, OData services, APIs, SAP Gateway, Fiori/UI5 extensibility and SAP BTP or side-by-side extension patterns.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, exposure to SAP Business AI, Joule, SAP Build, AI-assisted development, workflow automation or agentic automation is strongly preferred (nice to have).
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, the ability to lead technical design, code reviews, development standards, documentation, testing, transport governance, defect resolution and developer mentoring.
* Please apply for the role that best aligns with your experience and state clearly in your application which role or domain best matches your background, demonstrating relevant depth in that area.
* Applications will be assessed against the requirements of the selected functional domain or SAP ABAP technical role.

description:
**Company Overview**
Acentra Health exists to empower better health outcomes through technology, services, and clinical expertise. Our mission is to innovate health solutions that deliver maximum value and impact.
  
  
Lead the Way is our rallying cry at Acentra Health. Think of it as an open invitation to embrace the mission of the company; to actively engage in problem-solving; and to take ownership of your work every day. Acentra Health offers you unparalleled opportunities. In fact, you have all you need to take charge of your career and accelerate better outcomes - making this a great time to join our team of passionate individuals dedicated to being a vital partner for health solutions in the public sector.
  
  
**Job Summary And Responsibilities**
**About the Job:**

As a .NET full stack developer in the healthcare industry, you will break down the features, estimate planning, and design. This role also involves developing, testing, and reviewing codes, mentoring team members, documenting, monitoring, and reporting status, and supporting product releases.
  
  
**What you will do:**
  
  

* Understand business requirements, perform end-to-end impact analysis, and liaise with business analysts to reduce ambiguity in requirements.
* Work closely with the solution architect to arrive at a high-level estimation.
* Prepare design documents and details at a component level. Breakdown the requirement into deliverable tasks.
* Estimate tasks and work with the technical leads in planning and sequencing.
* Research new technologies/components to meet business requirements and prepare technical documentation.
* Develop complex tasks and perform unit testing.
* Monitor progress, report status, and highlight risks.
* Modify and document new and existing program code to rectify errors or to enhance product capability.
* Mentor team members, render technical support, and perform code reviews.
* Prepare lifecycle documentation for newly created and existing software programs, including changes that reflect new user requirements and defect resolutions discovered after the testing phase.
* Own, develop, document, and implement system designs, codes, and testing standards.
* Analyze proposed changes at a system level and recommend designs and solutions that minimize the impact on interfacing systems while maximizing code re-usability and maintaining business value.
* Support the release manager and ensure to meet all the development checklists.

**Job Requirements And Qualifications**
**Education & Experience:**


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, software engineering, or a related area, or equivalent experience, desired.
* 7 to 9 years of relevant experience in .Net technologies.

**Technical Skills:**
In-depth knowledge and demonstrable experience in the following technologies and methodologies:
  
  

* C#.NET, .NET6+, MVC.NET, Angular, or one of Bootstrap, ReactJS, VueJS.
* ASP.NET Web API, .Net core, JWT, OAuth2, JSON.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, build automation, and release processes (Azure DevOps or similar tools).
* Microservices development and architecture.
* Good to have: MSTest, PL\SQL.

**Soft Skills:**


* Attention to detail. Dedicated self-starter with excellent people skills.
* Quick learner and a go-getter.
* Effective time and project management.
* Analytical thinker and a great team player.
* Strong leadership, interpersonal & problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills are a must.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a creative mindset to bring fresh ideas to table.
* Should demonstrate confidence and self-assurance in their skills and expertise enabling them to contribute to team success and engage with colleagues and clients in a positive, assured manner.
* Should be accountable and responsible for deliverables and outcomes.
* Should demonstrate task ownership, meet deadlines, & ensure high-quality results.
* Demonstrates strong collaboration skills by working effectively with cross-functional teams, sharing insights, and contributing to shared goals and solutions.
* Continuously explore emerging trends, technologies, and industry best practices to drive innovation and maintain a competitive edge.
