description: The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.The Private Credit Tech group at D. E. Shaw & Co. is looking for an experienced software developer to join our Tech team based in Hyderabad and Gurugram. This team is an extension of the firm's Private Credit business, based in the New York and London offices. The Private Credit business involves providing loans to private companies to facilitate capital for business growth, expansion, or refinancing existing debt. The Private Credit Tech team plays a critical role by developing the tools used by the business team for their daily workflows, working closely with the analysts to build analytical and operational tools that streamline pre- and post-trade business functions.WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:In this role, you will collaborate directly with the product manager, the desk (based out of US and UK), and the Financial Research team based out of our India office to understand their workflows and requirements. You will design, build, and own full-stack web application platforms spanning post-trade analytics, underwriting and modeling, and deal-sourcing workflows, driving projects from requirements gathering and architecture through implementation, testing, and deployment. A core part of the role is developing a deep understanding of the desk's point of view so you can propose sound technical solutions to real business problems, while balancing pragmatic, quick-turnaround delivery with designs that endure as requirements evolve. You will take end-to-end ownership of the systems you build and hold a high bar for both quality and timeliness, championing clean coding practices, thoughtful design reviews, and robust, performance applications. You will actively use generative AI tools to accelerate your own productivity across prototyping, coding, testing, and troubleshooting, and look for opportunities to apply GAI to unlock new capabilities and streamline business workflows. You will also partner with other infrastructure teams to deliver solutions that scale and contribute to a strong engineering culture through knowledge sharing and mentorship — with the opportunity to grow into leading a small team by next year.WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:The ideal candidate should hold-Basic qualifications:A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related technical field, with an exceptional foundation in algorithms, data structures, and object-oriented programming5 years of software development experience, with strong hands-on programming experience in PythonFront-end development experience, especially in ReactJS/Redux, with the ability to deliver full-stack web applicationsGood SQL skills to understand the existing infrastructure and build new toolsTechnical and architecture design experience, with the ability to translate vague, high-level requirements into well-structured, coherent designsHands-on experience using generative AI / LLM-assisted developer tools to accelerate development and automationExcellent problem-solving and analytical skillsExcellent written and oral communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholdersThe drive to learn about the finance domain and related analyticsAn interest in and aptitude for mentoring and leading a small teamPreferred qualifications:Prior experience in the finance domain, particularly in private credit, fixed income, or capital marketsExperience owning projects end-to-end and driving them to completionInterested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/LeadTechPCJuly26We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. title: Architect, Apps & AI
description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Industry Solutions - Global Center Innovation and Delivery Center (GCID) delivers end-to-end solutions by enabling accelerated adoption and productive use of Microsoft technologies. An organization of well over 1000+ exceptional people, GCID presents a great opportunity for highly skilled services professionals to make a foray into consulting, solution development and delivery roles.
  
  
The Architect is a senior leader responsible for the successful technical execution and delivery of complex client projects across diverse domains. This role acts as a strategic anchor between clients, senior leadership, delivery managers, project managers, and delivery teams. In the AI-first GCID organization, Architect(s) are expected to embed AI-native thinking into delivery models, ensuring solutions are intelligent, scalable, and aligned with business outcomes. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, demonstrates breadth of expertise, and advocates for solutions that deliver true client value.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**AI-First Delivery Leadership**

* Embed AI-first principles into delivery workflows, leveraging automation and intelligent orchestration where applicable.
* Own the Architecture and drive end-to-end delivery of complex projects, ensuring solutions are scalable, robust, and aligned with client business outcomes.
* Drive engineering excellence through reusable components, accelerators, and scalable architecture.
* Oversee technical execution across multiple projects, ensuring adherence to best practices, quality standards, and compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to define strategies, delivery plans, milestones, and risk mitigation approaches.
* Act as a technical point of contact for clients, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ensure delivery models are optimized for modern, AI-native execution, including integration of automation and intelligent processes.
* Ability to step into at‑risk projects, quickly assess issues, and establish a credible path to recovery or exit.

**Engineering Excellence**
Promote high-quality engineering throughout all projects. Enforce coding standards, architectural integrity, and performance goals. Establish secure coding, TDD, and observability practices. Support ongoing learning and certifications. Advance modern methodologies like Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD for scalable solutions. Build a team culture of technical rigor, innovation, and accountability.
  
  
**Innovation & Thought Leadership**
Track new technologies to guide strategy. Drive innovation in delivery, assets, and tools for better efficiency. Promote best practices and continuous improvement across teams.
  
  
**Client Engagement & Solutioning**
Apply design thinking to develop user-centric solutions that also support business objectives, architecture, and project delivery. Collaborate with clients to identify their needs and provide guidance throughout each stage of the project. Participate in pre-sales and solutioning activities by preparing estimates, proofs-of-concept, and technical proposals. Additionally, maintain strong client relationships to ensure satisfaction and ongoing value.
  
  
**Team Management & Mentorship**
Lead cross-functional teams, promote learning and collaboration, and uphold technical standards. Review work, offer feedback, and support team growth.
  
  
**Quality & Compliance**
Ensure secure, compliant, and reliable solution delivery through secure coding, test‑driven development, observability, design reviews, and quality gates across all engagements.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 16+ years of experience in software/solution engineering, with at least 8-12 years as Architect and delivery leadership roles.
* Proven experience in leading delivery of complex, multi-disciplinary projects.
* Strong understanding of modern delivery methodologies (Agile, Scrum, DevOps, etc.).
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and team leadership skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Relevant certifications are a plus.

**Areas of Expertise**
**Full Stack Application Engineering**




+ End-to-end design and development of modern web and mobile applications using React, Angular, Next.js, Blazor, or equivalent frameworks
+ Strong backend expertise using .NET / Java / Node.js / Python, with clean architecture, domain-driven design, and API-first principles
+ Experience building microservices and distributed systems using REST, gRPC, event-driven patterns, and asynchronous processing
+ Hands-on expertise with relational and NoSQL databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB) and performance tuning
+ Strong understanding of state management, scalability, resiliency, and application security

**AI Driven Application Development**

* Proven expertise in AI‑driven application development, embedding intelligence directly into modern, cloud‑native applications.
* Extensive hands‑on experience using GitHub Copilot as a core engineering capability to accelerate solution design, coding, refactoring, testing, and documentation across delivery teams.
* Demonstrated ability to foster a Copilot‑assisted engineering culture (“vibe”) - enabling rapid iteration, AI pair‑programming, explain‑as‑you‑build workflows, and high‑velocity delivery without compromising engineering quality.
* Strong experience modernizing application landscapes using GitHub Copilot‑assisted approaches, including rapid codebase comprehension, dependency analysis, large‑scale refactoring, and migration to cloud‑native and AI‑enabled architectures.
* Effective use of GitHub Copilot across the entire SDLC, from solutioning and scaffolding through CI/CD automation, test generation, production readiness, and operational excellence.
* Ability to coach and enable teams and customers on effective Copilot usage patterns, prompt strategies, and safe AI‑assisted engineering practices in enterprise environments.
* Apply Responsible AI principles across design and delivery, incorporating security, privacy, governance, and compliance controls into production‑grade engineering workflows.

**AI-Enabled Application Development**

* Ability to translate business scenarios into production‑grade AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, Azure AI Foundry, and custom ML models, with hands‑on delivery of RAG architectures leveraging Azure AI Search, vector databases, enterprise data grounding, and integration patterns.
* Strong expertise in prompt engineering, context management, grounding strategies, and LLM integration for copilots, conversational interfaces, intelligent workflows, and decision‑support applications.
* Proven experience designing and implementing single‑agent and multi‑agent AI systems, including task boundaries, tool invocation, memory management, collaboration, delegation, and coordination, using frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, and LangGraph.
* Deep understanding of agentic workflows, combining LLM reasoning with external tools, APIs, and enterprise data sources, alongside agent lifecycle management - planning, execution, retries, failure handling, and human‑in‑the‑loop patterns.
* Designs enterprise‑ready AI solutions with built‑in observability and operational excellence, including telemetry, prompt tracing, agent behavior logging, model metrics, experimentation, drift monitoring, and cost/performance optimization, while applying Responsible AI principles across security, privacy, governance, and compliance - balancing speed, quality, and enterprise constraints at scale.

**Cloud-Native Architecture (Azure)**




+ Deep experience designing cloud‑native, PaaS‑first solutions on Azure, prioritizing managed services over IaaS to improve scalability, resilience, security, and operational efficiency.
+ Proven expertise in architecting and delivering solutions using Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, AKS, Azure Functions, and API Management, selecting the right compute model based on workload characteristics and business needs.
+ Strong working knowledge of identity, security, and networking architectures, including Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Managed Identity, Key Vault integration, private endpoints, and VNET‑integrated application deployments.
+ Design and implementation of architectures that support high availability, horizontal scalability, disaster recovery, and fault tolerance, including multi‑region deployment patterns and resiliency strategies.
+ Experience in cost‑aware architecture design, applying cost optimization strategies such as right‑sizing, autoscaling, consumption‑based services, and proactive cost governance.
+ Apply Microsoft Well‑Architected Framework principles across reliability, security, performance efficiency, operational excellence, and cost optimization, incorporating architecture reviews and continuous improvement into delivery.
+ Hands‑on experience building cloud‑ready landing patterns, integrating application architectures with enterprise networking, security baselines, and platform standards.

**DevOps, Platform & Developer Productivity**




+ Strong expertise in designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions, enabling automated build, test, security scanning, and deployment workflows across environments.
+ Proven hands‑on experience with Infrastructure‑as‑Code (IaC) using Bicep, ARM, and Terraform, leveraging GitHub Copilot to scaffold modules, generate templates, and propose secure configurations aligned with enterprise standards.
+ Deep understanding of observability and reliability engineering, including centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, SLOs, and proactive alerting for production systems.
+ Demonstrated ability to enhance developer productivity and delivery velocity through inner‑source practices, reusable components, reference implementations, accelerators, and automation.
+ Experience embedding DevSecOps practices into delivery pipelines, including secure coding checks, dependency scanning, secrets management, policy enforcement, and compliance validation.
+ Effective use of GitHub Copilot across the DevOps lifecycle, including authoring pipeline definitions, generating runbooks and release notes, assisting with PR summaries, and accelerating troubleshooting and incident response.
+ Strong grasp of platform engineering principles, building paved‑road solutions and self‑service capabilities that balance speed, governance, and operational excellence.
+ Ability to continuously improve engineering throughput, quality, and system reliability, while maintaining enterprise security and compliance expectations.

**Solutioning, Pre-Sales & Technical Leadership**




+ Lead technical solutioning, estimations, and support architecture design during pre-sales and delivery shaping
+ Translate business outcomes into clear architecture, execution plans, and risk mitigation strategies
+ Influence technical direction across multiple teams and engagements
+ Act as a trusted advisor to clients and internal leadership

**Frontier Engineering & Customer Enablement Skills**




+ Lead rapid prototyping, pilots, and early-stage deployments for enterprise customers
+ Ability to go from whiteboard to production with minimal friction

You will collaborate with engineering, QA, and DevOps teams to improve platform reliability, optimize performance, automate deployments, and deliver high-quality software solutions.

**AreaEssential Requirements**

You will lead development of core platform capabilities across distributed services and data systems, shaping long-term architecture for a mission-critical platform where scale, accuracy, resiliency, and auditability are essential. You will also partner across product and operations to drive modernization, automation, and AI-enabled engineering practices. We oversee the full lifecycle of report production and distribution—ensuring quality, scalability, and operational excellence through advanced QC workflows, exception management tools (including the Aladdin dashboard), and robust monitoring frameworks. The team manages reporting inventory and KPIs, supports both standardized and highly customized data sets, and enables access to reporting-ready data through digital portals and reporting libraries. We also power a dynamic self-service experience, offering secure document delivery via API, SFTP, and Secure Links, along with flexible tools for client-driven report configuration and branding. By owning the critical systems and processes behind client reporting, the team plays a central role in shaping client experience, driving automation and innovation, and delivering scalable, resilient solutions for industry-leading clients. horizontal scaling, Azure/AWS/GCP) Exposure to CI/CD and observability tooling Interest in financial systems, reporting platforms, or investment processes
  
  
**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

**real-world automation, intelligence, and agentic workflows**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with customers to deeply understand domain workflows, systems, and data flows (e.g., connected vehicles, factory systems, IoT environments)
* Translate real-world signals (sensor data, logs, events) into insights, workflows, and automated actions
* Build and showcase AI-driven workflows, automations, and agentic use cases
* Design and articulate end-to-end solutions (data ingestion → processing → decision → action)
* Act as a technical advisor, guiding customers on how DevRev can integrate into and enhance their existing systems
* Deliver tailored demos, PoCs, and solution walkthroughs grounded in real-world use cases (not generic SaaS demos)
* Support integrations with external systems via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines
* Contribute to technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and solution architectures
* Stay current on industry trends (renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, IoT, AI) and bring insights into customer conversations

**Qualifications & Skills**
**Domain Expertise**

* Experience in renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, industrial systems, or IoT environments
* Strong understanding of:
* Connected systems (vehicles, machines, robotics, embedded systems)
* Sensor ecosystems (CAN, telemetry, vision systems, IoT devices)
* Real-world data (signals, logs, time-series)
* Familiarity with manufacturing workflows (inspection, defect detection, production cycles).
* Ability to explain data flow from system → processing → business outcomes

**Engineering Depth**

* Strong system-level thinking
* Experience with:
* Data pipelines, APIs, integrations, distributed systems
* Experience in Python / TypeScript / JavaScript (or similar)
* Understanding of system design, reliability, and failure handling
* Exposure to AI/ML in industrial use cases (vision systems, predictive maintenance, log-stream analysis, etc.)

**Problem Solving & Use Case Thinking**

* Ability to translate data → insights → workflows → actions
* Experience designing end-to-end systems
* Strong analytical mindset to identify automation opportunities from real-world signals

**AI & Tools**

* Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents
* Familiarity with prompt design and AI workflows
* Tools: Postman, GitHub, Jira, Cursor, Claude Code

**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

title: Agentic AI Engineering
description:
**Agentic AI- 8-15 Years**

**Location: Bangalore,Pune,Hyderabad,Chennai.**

**Engineering Foundation**

*Non-negotiable. This is what we screen on first, and there is no AI in it.*

* Data modelling across SQL and NoSQL, and a clear view of where each one breaks
* Event-driven architecture in production with Kafka, RabbitMQ or equivalent. Ordering, replay, idempotency, dead-letter handling
* Distributed systems failure modes: partial failure, retries, backpressure, timeouts, circuit breakers
* Caching strategy and invalidation, at a scale where getting it wrong hurt
* Observability. You have instrumented a system, not just read someone else's dashboard
* At least one cloud deeply. Not three superficially
* API and integration patterns against real enterprise surfaces such as ERPs, CRMs and data platforms
* CI/CD, containers, release engineering
* You have owned something in production. On-call, incidents, the whole thing

Agent systems are distributed systems with a non-deterministic component in the middle. If the fundamentals are not there, the AI layer does not survive contact with production.

**AI Engineering**

*Two capabilities that do not come free with an engineering background. These are the ones we probe hardest.*

**Evaluation and Error Analysis**

* You have built an eval set for a non-deterministic system and used it to make a decision
* You can decompose a failure: is this a model problem, a retrieval problem, a data problem or a product problem?
* You debug agent behaviour systematically, with traces and evidence, not by gut feel

**Context Engineering**

* Deliberate management of what enters the model on each turn, and why
* Memory strategy: what persists across steps, across sessions, and what should not
* Tool surface design: what the agent can reach, how it is scoped, what happens when a tool fails
* Cost and latency as first-class design constraints, not something discovered in the invoice

**Consulting and Client Leadership**

*Equal weight to the engineering. This is a client-facing role in a services business.*

* Carry a market point of view on models, tooling and delivery patterns, and translate it into what it means for a specific client, in their language
* Run discovery workshops, solution reviews and delivery cadences with client teams
* Advise clients on standing up their own AI capability: practice structure, operating model, skills, governance, build versus buy, and adoption across their engineering org
* Shape and defend technical proposals, PoC plans and roadmaps. Own the story end to end
* Translate business problems into architectures for CXO-level stakeholders without hiding behind jargon
* Say no when the answer is no. Tell a client when agents are the wrong tool, and be able to explain why

**Delivery and Architecture**

*The work itself.*

* Own end-to-end delivery of AI-native programs, from architecture through production
* Design multi-agent orchestration using LangGraph, CrewAI or equivalent. Agent topology, tool routing, memory, state, fallback and recovery paths
* Integrate agent systems with enterprise systems of record, not toy datasets
* Build RAG where RAG is the right answer, from chunking through retrieval, re-ranking and evaluation
* Run agentic coding workflows with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or equivalent, and lead projects where AI writes significant portions of the codebase while you guide, review and ship it
* Work with MCP and shared-context tooling. Design what agents are permitted to reach and under what controls
* Bring governance into the design from day one: agent identity, privilege scoping, audit, human-in-the-loop, kill switches
* Contribute to reusable frameworks and accelerators the wider practice can use

**Team and Practice**

* Build AI engineering capability across the delivery organisation through mentoring, standards and review quality
* Evaluate new models, frameworks and tooling before the hype catches up, and kill the ones that do not earn their place
* Contribute to internal knowledge bases and practice assets

AI/ML Engineer, EIT

* Experience working with both structured and unstructured data, including feature engineering, information retrieval, dimensionality reduction, and feature extraction.
* Demonstrated problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across technical and business teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s or PhD in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Mining, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline.
* Experience with advanced analytics, predictive modeling, machine learning, statistical techniques, and data visualization.
* Advanced proficiency with Python/R, Spark, SQL, MLOps, GenAIOps, and agentic AI workflows.
* Experience designing and operating production Generative AI solutions utilizing RAG, embeddings, vector and semantic search, tool calling, orchestration, structured outputs, and AI evaluation frameworks.
* Experience with Snowflake Cortex, Microsoft Foundry, Azure ML, Azure AI Search, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agents SDK, Databricks, or comparable AI/ML platforms.
* Experience with Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, dbt, Azure DevOps, or comparable enterprise platforms.
* Experience with MLflow or comparable experiment tracking and model registry capabilities, containerization technologies such as Docker/Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code practices.
* Knowledge of enterprise identity and access management, privacy, data governance, model risk management, security, and Responsible AI controls.
* Experience operating production AI/ML solutions with model observability, service-level monitoring, cost controls, incident management, usage telemetry, and continuous performance improvement.

title: Senior AI & Decision Science Engineer
description:
**OUR STORY**
**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**
**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**
**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**
**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**
**Full-Stack AI & Automation Engineer**
**Human Resources - Strategic Planning & Analytics CoE**
**About The Team & Your Role**
Strategic Planning & Analytics team is architected to move beyond traditional HR, functioning as a strategic engine that fuels ST’s growth through five specialized pillars: Business Partnerships, Products & AI, Workforce Insights, Data Science, and Workforce Planning Architecture. We are currently in an ambitious build-phase, moving away from legacy processes to create a sophisticated, tech-enabled function that mirrors the engineering excellence of the semiconductor industry. We don’t want to just manage headcount; we want to orchestrate the future of HR using AI.
  
  
As a member of this team, you won’t be working in a silo. You will be at the intersection of human capital and advanced technology, leveraging AI and data science to solve complex organizational challenges and expected to be a foundational builder. We are looking for pioneers to help us design and implement our first generation of advanced analytics and AI-driven products. You won't just be using technology—you will be architecting the roadmap, selecting the tools, and establishing the frameworks that will define how ST manages its global talent for years to come. If you are energized by the challenge of redefining the "H" in HR through the lens of data and innovation, you’ve found the right place.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* End-to-End AI Prototyping: Architect, build, and deploy conversational bots and transactional AI agents from scratch in a sandbox environment.
* Workflow Orchestration & Automation: Design and manage complex, multi-system automation workflows using tools like n8n to automate actions (e.g., orchestrating system lookups, mock API executions, and conditional task routing).
* LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering: Integrate prototypes securely with internal OpenAI/ChatGPT APIs, mastering prompt design, function calling, tool use, and state management.
* Interface & UI/UX Evolution: Build lightweight, responsive web interfaces (e.g., Streamlit, Next.js) for quick stakeholder testing, ensuring the backend logic is decoupled via webhooks for future migration into Microsoft Teams.
* Code Hygiene & Handoff Documentation: Maintain code transparency, track version changes, and collaborate efficiently using GitHub. Author structured "Industrialization Blueprints" (JSON payloads, API mappings, and logic flows) to seamlessly hand over for full scale production

**Required Background & Skills**

* AI Orchestration Frameworks: Expert-level workflow creation using tools like n8n (advanced JavaScript/Python execution nodes, webhooks, and sub-workflows) or equivalent orchestration frameworks
* AI & LLM Mastery: Practical experience implementing conversational APIs, embedding architectures, vector stores, and advanced prompt engineering constraints.
* Full-Stack Core Development: Strong programming proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/Node.js. Comfort writing clean API connectors, handling RESTful requests, parsing JSON, and maintaining code via GitHub.
* Enterprise Collaboration Ecosystems: Prior familiarity or structural understanding of building integration layers, bots, or webhooks for the Microsoft 365 / MS Teams ecosystem is highly desirable.
* Candidate should possess “Can-do” attitude, with an ability to thrive in an unstructured environment
* 9 to 12 years of software engineering/automation experience (with at least 2–3 years focused on building AI agents/bots from scratch).
* Masters/ PhD in Computer Science, Information Technology equivalent
* Understanding of HCM systems like Oracle is an added advantage
* Excellent English, quantitative, technical, and storytelling skills

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.
  
  
At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.
  
  
To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. title: Software Test Engineer [Manual + Automation]
description:
**QA Engineer - Manual + Automation**

**Roles & Responsibilities | 4+ Years Experience**

**Core Responsibilities**

* Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and technical documents to design effective test cases.
* Develop, maintain, and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for functional, integration, regression, system, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Perform manual testing across web applications and mobile apps on Android and iOS, including functional, regression, compatibility, usability, installation/update, and device/OS-specific scenarios.
* Validate mobile-specific scenarios such as installation/upgrade, permissions, notifications, deep links, orientation, background/foreground behavior, offline/poor-network conditions, and different screen sizes.
* Perform testing on physical devices and emulators/simulators across representative Android and iOS versions, and capture device logs/crash details when troubleshooting issues.
* Identify, log, track, and retest defects using tools such as JIRA, Bugzilla, or similar.
* Ensure comprehensive test coverage and maintain traceability between requirements and test cases.
* Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives in an Agile/Scrum environment.

**Automation Testing Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts for web applications and, where applicable, mobile applications.
* Hands-on experience with Playwright or Selenium for web UI automation testing; exposure to Appium or a similar mobile automation framework is preferred.
* Candidate should have used Playwright and/or Selenium in previous projects and should be able to create and maintain automation test suites independently. Experience testing Android and/or iOS applications in real projects is also expected.
* Identify suitable manual test cases for automation and improve smoke and regression coverage through automation.
* Analyze automation failures and identify whether issues are related to application defects, test scripts, test data, or environment/configuration.
* Maintain reusable automation components, page objects, test fixtures, test data, and utilities.
* Integrate automated tests with CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar.
* Generate and review automation execution reports and communicate failures clearly to the development team.

**Collaboration & Reporting**

* Work closely with developers, product managers, and business analysts to clarify requirements and resolve issues.
* Provide timely and detailed test execution status reports to the QA Lead / Project Manager.
* Support UAT by assisting business users and validating fixes.
* Work with developers to improve application testability and contribute to continuous testing practices.

**Quality Assurance Practices**

* Follow industry best practices for QA, including risk-based testing and defect management.
* Ensure compliance with organizational quality standards and processes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing practices, automation coverage, and methodologies.

**Additional Expectations**

* Mentor junior testers by sharing knowledge and reviewing test cases and automation scripts.
* Take ownership of testing for assigned modules or projects with minimal supervision.
* Provide input for test effort estimation and project planning.
* Identify opportunities for test optimization and improvements in QA processes.
* Be able to explain automation framework design, locator strategy, waits, assertions, reporting, test data management, and troubleshooting of flaky tests.

**Key Skills Required**

* Strong knowledge of STLC (Software Testing Life Cycle) and SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle).
* Proficiency in writing test cases, test scenarios, and clear bug reports.
* Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA, Bugzilla, Mantis, or similar.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology.
* Good understanding of functional, regression, integration, UAT, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing.
* Basic knowledge of SQL for backend data validation.
* Practical experience with Playwright or Selenium WebDriver.
* Hands-on mobile app testing experience on Android and/or iOS; familiarity with Appium or a similar mobile automation framework is an added advantage.
* Good understanding of Page Object Model (POM), reusable components, assertions, waits, test fixtures, and data-driven testing.
* Experience with at least one programming/scripting language such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Python.
* Basic understanding of API testing and API automation using Postman, REST Assured, Playwright API testing, or similar.
* Familiarity with Git/version control and basic CI/CD concepts.
* Ability to troubleshoot flaky tests and improve automation reliability.
* Understanding of when a test case should be automated versus kept as a manual test.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Experience testing across multiple browsers such as Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari/WebKit, and across representative Android/iOS devices and OS versions.
* Experience with mobile app testing, including native/hybrid apps, WebView flows, device permissions, network conditions, app lifecycle, and release validation, is preferred.
* Familiarity with Android Studio/ADB, Xcode device logs, crash logs, or similar mobile debugging tools is an advantage.
* Experience running automation tests in CI/CD pipelines and generating test reports.
* Basic knowledge of performance, accessibility, or security testing is an added advantage.

title: Principal API Integration
description:
******Job Description******
Become part of the team powering household names like Kleenex®, Cottonelle®, Scott®, and WypAll®. At Arbex, everything you need is right here—innovation, growth, and the chance to leave a real mark.
  
  
You were made to create what’s next: designing new technologies, diving into data, optimising digital experiences, and constantly developing better, faster ways to get results. You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to building technology for a purpose that matters. Here, you’ll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, well-being, and career development while you help us shape the future of tissue and hygiene for billions of people around the world.  We’ll be Unstoppable Together.
  
  
****About You****
In one of our professional roles, you’ll focus on winning with consumers and the market, while putting safety, mutual respect, and human dignity at the centre.
  
  
We are looking for a
**Principal API Integration**
to provide deep technical and architectural expertise across Arbex's API and enterprise integration landscape, with particular focus on Unify. The initial focus of the role will be supporting the migration and transformation of integrations inherited from the Kimberly-Clark spin-off into Arbex's CPI/Unify integration ecosystem, ensuring business continuity while progressively establishing a simpler, sustainable and well-governed integration landscape.As the new environment matures, this role will become a key contributor to Arbex's integration architecture strategy and governance, with particular focus on API architecture, reusable integration patterns and the evolution of the Unify ecosystem.
  
  
Job responsibilities include:
  
  
**Transition & Migration**

* Provide architectural guidance for the migration of inherited integrations into the Arbex Unify/CPI landscape.
* Support migration and upgrade project teams in assessing existing API integrations and determining appropriate target integration patterns based on business criticality, complexity and long-term maintainability.
* Work closely with application, platform, security and business teams to ensure safe migration and continuity of critical business processes.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, consolidate or retire inherited integrations instead of recreating legacy solutions, supporting future stages of the integration modernization strategy.
* Assess opportunities to replace point-to-point integrations with reusable APIs, integration services or event-based patterns where appropriate.
* Support complex technical decisions, troubleshooting and root cause analysis.

**Architecture & Engineering**

* Collaborate in the definition and evolution of API and enterprise integration architecture and patterns across Arbex.
* Provide deep technical and architectural expertise in Unify and API-based integration, supporting the evolution of Arbex's target integration ecosystem.
* Define and promote reusable patterns for REST APIs, synchronous and asynchronous integration, messaging and event-driven architectures.
* Apply strong API design practices covering API contracts, lifecycle management, versioning, security, discoverability and reuse.
* Provide expertise around OpenAPI, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, authentication and authorization patterns, and enterprise API security.
* Promote loosely coupled, reusable and supportable integration solutions, reducing unnecessary point-to-point dependencies.
* Contribute to standards for observability, monitoring, resilience, error handling and operational support.
* Evaluate proposed designs with a pragmatic balance between reuse, simplicity, maintainability, delivery speed and business value.
* Act as the senior technical escalation point for critical API integration incidents, collaborating with external support partners when deep technical or architectural expertise is required.
* Review root causes, corrective actions and lessons learned to prevent recurrence and improve integration reliability.

**Strategy & Governance**

* Contribute to the definition and continuous evolution of the Arbex Integration Strategy, including architecture principles, standards, reusable patterns and decision frameworks.
* Act as a senior member of a future Integration Architecture Board, reviewing and approving integration requirements and solution designs.
* Ensure architecture governance is proportional to complexity and risk, avoiding unnecessary controls or approval layers.
* Mentor functional analysts and engineers and help raise integration architecture capabilities across the organization.
* Bring external experience and challenge existing approaches when simpler or more effective alternatives exist.
* Help translate lessons learned during the migration into sustainable architecture patterns and engineering practices for Arbex.

To succeed in this role, you will need the following experience and qualifications:
  
  

* 15+ years of relevant enterprise technology experience, with significant depth in API.
* Deep knowledge of API integration patterns and technologies.
* Demonstrated experience with complex integration migration or transformation programs.
* Experience establishing or applying integration architecture standards and governance in large enterprise environments.
* Strong technical authority and ability to influence functional and engineering teams, architects, vendors and senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to balance architecture quality, simplicity, delivery speed and business risk.
* Experience working with globally distributed technology teams and system integrators.

****Total Benefits****
We believe that our employees are our greatest asset, and we're committed to providing them with the resources they need to be successful. If you're looking for a rewarding career with a company that cares about its employees, then ARBEX is the place for you.

title: Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is expanding across existing and new regions. Our Networking organization builds systems that manage Internet and backbone traffic, mitigate congestion, and reduce customer impact while enabling network operations to scale efficiently.
  
  
The Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer mentors engineering teams and leads the architecture of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems. This role identifies and eliminates performance and scalability bottlenecks for hyperscale workloads, defines scalability requirements with stakeholders, and designs elastic, high-impact systems while driving innovation in data plane platforms.
  
  
We are seeking a Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer to define technical direction and lead the development of highly available, scalable network control, intelligent routing and automation systems. You will combine deep networking knowledge with software and distributed systems expertise to connect real-time observability with safe, automated routing decisions.
  
  
Your work will span autonomous traffic management, policy-driven network optimization, and software-based routing infrastructure. You will identify performance and scalability bottlenecks, define requirements with stakeholders, and design resilient services that protect customer connectivity during growth, failures, and infrastructure changes.
  
  
This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad architectural influence. Based in IDC alongside the engineering team, you will lead initiatives from design through production operations, contribute to critical implementations, and establish standards for availability, security, observability, and safe deployment. You will collaborate across engineering and operations teams while mentoring senior engineers and developing technical leadership.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Define technical strategy and architecture for scalable routing, network control, and automation systems.
* Design algorithms and distributed services for route computation, congestion management, traffic steering, fault isolation, and recovery.
* Correlate network and infrastructure signals to assess customer impact and enable safe automated responses.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and optimize capacity, resource utilization, routing convergence, and behavior under heavy load.
* Architect and build highly available, fault-tolerant systems with reliable state management, replication, automated failover, and recovery.
* Define service-level objectives, operational KPIs, telemetry, monitoring, and alerting for service health and routing outcomes.
* Establish simulation, scale testing, phased migrations, in-service upgrades, verification, and rollback practices.
* Lead production troubleshooting, incident response, and root-cause analysis; establish runbooks and drive reliability improvements.
* Integrate security controls, auditability, infrastructure as code, and automated deployment, patching, and lifecycle management.
* Contribute production-quality code, review designs and implementations, and maintain architecture and operational documentation.
* Partner with cross-functional engineering, product, and business stakeholders to define technical strategy and deliver high-impact initiatives.
* Mentor senior engineers, influence architectural direction, and promote engineering excellence through technical leadership, hiring, and knowledge sharing.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of relevant experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, network control planes, or network automation platforms.
* Strong Linux systems and networking knowledge, including containers, process and memory behavior, network namespaces, resource isolation, and packet-level troubleshooting.
* Experience designing highly available distributed services with reliable state management, observability, overload protection, and failure recovery.
* Demonstrated ability to lead architecture and delivery across teams, resolve ambiguous requirements, communicate technical trade-offs, and mentor senior engineers.
* Deep knowledge of L2/L3 networking, routing and switching, software-defined networking, traffic engineering, and WAN technologies.
* Strong expertise in BGP and MP-BGP, IPv4/IPv6, route reflection, routing policy, and VPN address families, including practical experience with convergence and reachability troubleshooting.
* Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Python, Java, or C++, with experience in API design, concurrency, automated testing, and production debugging.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Production expertise with Junos and Juniper cRPD or comparable virtualized routing platforms.
* Experience with BGP Add-Path, Optimal Route Reflection (ORR), Prefix Independent Convergence (BGP-PIC), route-flap damping, and large-scale routing tables.
* Knowledge of MPLS, RSVP-TE, PCEP, bandwidth reservation, latency-aware routing, and shared-risk link groups.
* Experience with NETCONF, Junos XML APIs, gRPC, OpenConfig, and model-driven network automation.
* Experience tuning containerized networking workloads, including cgroups, socket buffers, veth, and SR-IOV.
* Experience with infrastructure as code, automated lifecycle orchestration, and rolling upgrades for stateful services.
* Understanding of Clos fabrics, overlay/underlay integration, ECMP behavior, and backbone transit.
* Experience building distributed active measurement and telemetry systems.
* Experience with simulation, failure injection, or formal methods to validate complex distributed-system behavior.
* Experience applying traffic prediction, machine learning, or AI techniques to network optimization, anomaly detection, or operational intelligence.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. The team operates globally with representatives in London, Paris, Asia and New York and plays a critical role in providing innovative solutions. Our expertise and projects also lead us to be a key contact for both operations and group risk management team.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
BNP Paribas CIB has launched the very ambitious plan aiming to strengthen our organisation and adapt CIB to ensure it remains a healthy and sustainable business in the long term, providing solutions to our clients, and core to the Group in its diversified business mix.
  
  
In this context, the Global Markets Quantitative Research is tasked to build along with the Global Markets IT a new pricing and risk management platform covering all asset classes for both flow and exotics products. To support this initiative, the bank has decided to create in India a pole of expertise around architecture, front office risk management, P&L Explain. The need for such a team originates from the necessity to harmonize, industrialize, and strengthen our tools to support ever growing trade volumes while ensuring a high level of data quality and coping with more stringent regulations.
  
  
After the successful creation of a team in Mumbai we are now opening an office in Bangalore, focusing on functional architecture (core and cross-asset topics) and compute (high performance computing)

Direct Responsibilities

* Familiarization with BNP Paribas’s risk and pricing framework
* Recruitment locally of up to 4 collaborators (Junior and mid senior levels) by the end of 2026
* Define and implement in collaboration with teams located in Paris and London the tools required to efficiently monitor the quality of risks and P&L Explain data generated on a daily basis

description:
**About Ema**
Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.
  
  
**The Role**
We are looking for an Engineering Leader to manage and scale multiple product lines in the Voice, BPO, and Workforce Management space. This is a high-impact leadership role that sits at the intersection of real-time voice systems, operations research, and data-intensive platform engineering.
  
  
You will report directly to the Head of Engineering and own the engineering organization that builds the infrastructure powering Ema’s Voice AI Employees, Agent QA, auto-learning pipelines, rich analytics, and workforce optimization capabilities — all operating as scalable, multi-tenant systems deployed across global geographies.
  
  
You will collaborate with Product, ML/AI, and Go-to-Market teams to translate customer needs into production systems that handle high volumes of voice data, deliver real-time insights, and continuously improve through automated learning loops. As the owner of multiple product lines, you will balance roadmap priorities across Voice, BPO operations, and WFM (work force management) — ensuring each product evolves cohesively while meeting distinct customer needs.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Scalable Multi-Tenant Systems**

* Architect and build multi-tenant systems that serve enterprise customers across geographies with strict data residency, isolation, and compliance requirements.
* Design high-throughput ingestion systems capable of processing large volumes of voice data, call metadata, and operational telemetry in near real-time.
* Make foundational architectural decisions on data stores, stream processing, and storage tiers — balancing query performance, cost, and operational simplicity.
* Champion SOLID principles, clean architecture, and engineering rigor across all codebases — ensuring systems are testable, extensible, and maintainable at scale.

**Team Building & Engineering Culture**

* Recruit, hire, and develop senior engineers across a multi-disciplinary function spanning voice engineering, backend systems, data engineering, and applied operations research.
* Establish engineering standards, code review culture, and a strong bias toward shipping — with equal commitment to system reliability and customer experience.
* Coach and grow senior/staff engineers into technical leaders; manage engineering managers as the organization scales.
* Drive cross-functional alignment with Product, ML/AI, and Go-to-Market teams to ensure the platform evolves in lockstep with customer needs and market feedback.

**Voice Platform & Agent QA**

* Design auto-learning systems that continuously improve voice agents from production interactions — closed-loop feedback, model retraining triggers, and quality regression detection.
* Deliver rich voice analytics: call volume trends, handle time distributions, first-call resolution metrics, agent performance dashboards, and anomaly detection.
* Build scalable voice pipeline across geographies – keeping in mind PII, security and compliance requirements.

**Workforce Management & Operations Research**

* Build WFM capabilities including demand forecasting, shift scheduling, real-time adherence monitoring, and capacity planning — applying operations research techniques to optimize workforce utilization.
* Design and implement optimization algorithms for headcount modeling, skill-based routing, and workload balancing across multi-site, multi-timezone contact center operations.
* Partner with ML/AI teams to integrate predictive models for call volume forecasting, attrition risk, and staffing efficiency.

**Required**
**What We Look For**

**Good to have**

* Background in operations research or optimization: scheduling algorithms, linear/integer programming, constraint satisfaction, or demand forecasting models.
* Experience building analytics platforms: OLAP systems, real-time dashboards, metric computation engines, or BI infrastructure.
* Prior work on auto-learning or continuous improvement systems: feedback loops from production data, automated retraining pipelines, or quality monitoring systems.
* Experience with AI/ML-powered products in enterprise settings — agentic automation, LLM orchestration, or AI-driven UX.
* Familiarity with WFM or contact center operations — staffing models, Erlang-based capacity planning, or real-time adherence systems.

**Why Ema**

* Build at the intersection of Voice AI, operations research, and enterprise-scale systems — a rare combination of deeply technical challenges with direct customer impact.

description:
**Staff Engineer C++**
**Let’s be unstoppable together!**
Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.
  
  
At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www.circana.com.
  
  
**Role Overview:**
We are seeking Staff Engineers to drive design, evolution, and execution of our next-generation, massively parallel processing (MPP) clustered database engine (Whitebox) that currently powers large-scale retail and consumer analytics solutions across Circana clients in 22+ countries and serving millions of queries every day in real-time against massive data sets . This is a highly technical role for an expert who bridges the gap between High-Performance Computing (HPC) and Big Data systems engineering and low-latency machine learning infrastructure and involves database internals, distributed systems, performance engineering, data processing at scale.
  
  
In this role, you will be one of the primary designers and developer responsible for building low-latency, high-throughput distributed database kernels. You will design bare-metal optimized software layers, ensuring our database product fully exploits modern multi-core, vectorized hardware and distributed network fabrics to process terabyte/petabyte-scale datasets and where appropriate, seamlessly executes highly performant analytics and in-database ML inference directly on relational and the occasional vector datasets.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* Architecture & Design: Play a key role in core architectural choices and roadmap for our distributed database kernel, including query execution engines, custom/hybrid columnar storage layers, distributed transaction managers, and cluster coordination protocols.
* Low-Level Development: Write, optimize, and maintain highly performant, production-ready backend code utilizing modern C++ (C++20/23).
* Parallel Execution Planning: Architect MPP execution engines that distribute, schedule, and execute queries across several dozens to hundreds of nodes using MPI and hybrid OpenMP models.
* Hardware Optimization: Profile and eliminate execution bottlenecks by implementing explicit SIMD vectorization (AVX-512, ARM Neon, SVE) and ensuring absolute cache locality (L1/L2/L3).
* Distributed Memory & Networks: Design ultra-low latency cluster communication subsystems utilizing RDMA, RoCE, or kernel-bypass tech (DPDK).
* In-Database ML Framework Design: Architect and implement a native, highly performant, zero-copy ML execution framework directly inside the MPP engine to eliminate data serialization and transport bottlenecks between the database and external AI pipelines.
* Functional & High-Performance Algorithms: Develop mathematically rigorous, cache-oblivious, and highly vectorized algorithms for real-time statistical computations, matrix operations/manipulations on clustered data
* Vector & Embedding Infrastructure: Design and optimize or embed/reference distributed high-dimensional vector storage subsystems, custom SIMD-accelerated indexing structures (e.g., HNSW, IVF-PQ), and parallelized approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms.
* Be comfortable working in a cross country/multi time zone team of elite systems engineers, implementing as well as conducting rigorous peer design and development reviews
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams in defining and developing new platform capabilities.
* Actively participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical mentoring.
* Investigate and resolve complex performance and scalability issues.

**Required Technical Qualifications:**

* Minimum - 4 years Computer Science engineering degree from a reputed institute. Masters in HPC (high performance computing) and Bigdata engineering areas preferred for Senior staff engineer and above roles

* Hardware-Aware Engineering: Documented experience with microarchitectural optimization, loop vectorization, pointer-aliasing constraints, and manual SIMD intrinsics programming.
* Concurrency Mechanics: Deep understanding of OS internals, memory barriers, lock-free data structures, and atomics (std::atomic).
* Database Internals: Practical experience designing core database subsystems (e.g., vectorized query operators, LSM-trees, B-trees, custom buffer pools, columnar serialization frameworks and query plan optimizers).
* Strong debugging, performance tuning, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in one or more leading memory and compute monitoring/performance tools (such as Valgrind, Purify, Intel/AMD/ARM diagnostics etc.)

**Bonus Qualifications:**

* Track record contributing to open-source or work experience on proprietary distributed engines (e.g., ClickHouse, DuckDB, Doris, CockroachDB, RocksDB, ScyllaDB, or Velox).
* Experience with cloud-native distributed, elastic environments, object storage tiering (S3/GCS), or zero-copy networking.
* Experience integrating heterogeneous acceleration (NVIDIA CUDA / ROCm) into big data workloads and hybrid CPU/GPU setups.
* Vector & Graph Algorithmic experience: Experience building or modifying high-performance vector index/search engines, graph-based indices, or localized quantization frameworks.
* Functional domain awareness – CPG, Retail, Pharma verticals

**What We Offer**

* Work on the bleeding edge of data infrastructure, tackling next gen big data engineering problems to support real time querying and analytics against some of the largest data sets at high concurrency
* Challenging engineering problems - all the way from functional/data science algorithm implementations on a HPC setup to bare metal/close to OS kernel level programming involving handling of hundreds of billions of records to support real-time analytics at scale.
* Plenty of valuable exposure to broader BI/Analytics/Bigdata ecosystem including great opportunity to functionally better understand CPG, Retail and related domains.

Stimulating work environment and a great Circana work culture that allows members to bring their best daily.

Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.

**Job Description**

As part of our world-class software engineering team, you will be building the next-generation observability platforms for LinkedIn, including but not limited to: instrumenting applications and infrastructure to collect meaningful metrics, logs, and traces; Collaborate with development teams to ensure consistent and comprehensive instrumentation across all systems; Develop and maintain libraries, frameworks, and tools to simplify instrumentation. You will work and learn among the best, putting to use your passion for building and scaling observability platforms and your passion for writing code that performs at an extreme scale - come join our Observability Engineering team and share the knowledge with a broader community, while making a real impact within Linkedin.

The Observability Experience (OE) group is charted to simplify and drive observability for LinkedIn. The Observability Platforms (sub team of OE) is responsible for billions of operational metrics ingested every minute within LinkedIn. Observability Platforms maintains the platforms and products for metrics ingestion, storage, retrieval, visualization, alerting, incident creation & escalation, remediation, health-checking and experience platform(s). We are one of the very few companies globally with a custom-built platform to support billions of telemetry signals ingested/processed in realtime at millions of QPS.

This role will be based in Bangalore, India.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

Responsibilities:

* Architect, build, run, and scale real-time streaming systems/real-time processing systems at massive scale.
* Own the technical direction of the observability platform end to end - the collection, processing/enriching telemetry events and evolve it so insight keeps pace with the growth of our systems.
* Scale distributed systems and make the hard architectural trade-offs - across processing models, data delivery guarantees, storage tiers, and the balance of cost, latency, and durability - while writing code and delivering with speed and quality.
* Serve as a role model and coach for engineers, with a strong bias for action, providing architectural guidance and mentorship to up-level the engineering organization.
* Develop multi-tier scalable, high-volume performing, and reliable user-centric applications that operate 24x7. Produce high-quality infrastructure that is thoroughly tested, code reviewed & resilient.
* Partner with teams across the company to drive adoption of the platform(s), turning their instrumentation and diagnostic needs into measurable improvements in engineering productivity.

* Navigate and resolve cross-team conflicts to align stakeholders and foster a cohesive, collaborative engineering culture.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* BA/BS Degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* 12+ years of industry experience in software design and development, with problem-solving and system-design skills
* 12+ years of experience programming in object-oriented languages such as Java, C++, Python, Go, C and/or other Functional languages
* Experience building and operating large-scale streaming and real-time processing systems, including stateful processing and data delivery guarantees
* Hands on experience developing large-scale observability platforms with a deep understanding of distributed systems, microservice architecture, Pub-Sub systems, logging /metrics / tracing platforms
* 5+ years of experience in an architect or technical leadership position

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 8+ years building and optimizing large-scale distributed processing systems and client-server architectures.
* Experience with stream processing and messaging technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Samza, Beam, or Spark Streaming, including stateful stream processing, windowing, watermarks, and delivery semantics.
* Depth in observability systems across metrics, logs, traces, and events, including high-cardinality ingestion and low-latency query at scale.
* Experience building systems with AI and using AI-powered coding agents and assistants in everyday development to design, implement, test, and review software at a higher velocity and quality bar.

* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts and drive technical strategy across teams and geographies.
* Maintainer or contributor of open source projects
