Our teams work collaboratively to drive the production of alphas and financial strategies – the foundation of a balanced, global investment platform.
  
  
WorldQuant is built on a culture that pairs academic sensibility with accountability for results. Employees are encouraged to think openly about problems, balancing intellectualism and practicality. Excellent ideas come from anyone, anywhere. Employees are encouraged to challenge conventional thinking and possess an attitude of continuous improvement.
  
  
Our goal is to hire the best and the brightest. We value intellectual horsepower first and foremost, and people who demonstrate an outstanding talent. There is no roadmap to future success, so we need people who can help us build it.
  
  
Technologists on this team research, design, code, test, and deploy solutions that enable the firm’s front-office quant teams to make effective use of the our framework. Our environment is relaxed yet intellectually driven, and we seek people who think in code, enjoy solving complex engineering problems, and are motivated by working closely with like-minded researchers, engineers, and business stakeholders. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, solution delivery, and quant research enablement. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with researchers, embedded technology teams, and platform stakeholders to build scalable tools, APIs, services, and workflows that improve adoption and support the continued evolution of the firm’s ecosystem. We are looking for a hands-on technologist who enjoys building robust systems, working closely with users, and solving intellectually challenging problems. The ideal candidate is practical, curious, collaborative, and motivated by delivering tools and platforms that help researchers and investment professionals work more effectively.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Participate in the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of solutions
* Build and maintain APIs, services, tools, and platform components that enable seamless integration with front-office quant workflows.
* Interface with users of the platform to understand their use cases and help them make effective use of available tools and services.

* Contribute to scalable platform capabilities, including workflow tooling, metadata management, distributed storage, and integration services.
* Research best practices and propose feature specifications and enhancements for the platform roadmap.
* Develop and maintain tools that complement the core platform offering and improve usability, adoption, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure solutions are reliable, secure, scalable, and aligned with firmwide engineering standards.
* Produce clear documentation, user guides, and technical materials to support adoption and long-term maintainability.
* Collaborate with global teams in an open, intellectually curious, and delivery-focused environment.

**What You’ll Bring**

* University degree, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
* At least 5 years of professional software engineering experience.
* Strong English communication skills and experience working in a global environment.
* Expertise in software lifecycle management methodologies and tools, including Git and JIRA.

* Interest in open architecture, graph-based frameworks, metadata-driven systems, and extensible platform design.

title: Sr Manager - Customer Interaction Suite
description:
**About The Company**
Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
  
  
Job Description — Solution Engineer (aka STS), CCaaS & Voice AI (Individual Contributor)
  
  
Company: Tata Communications
  
  
Function: Solution Engineering (aka STS) — Customer Interaction Suite
  
  
Role Type: Individual Contributor (IC) — no people management
  
  
Location: Pune, Mumbai, Bengaluru, or Gurugram (hybrid; on-site as per project needs)
  
  
Experience: 6–9 years in contact centre / cloud telephony / voice AI solution engineering
  
  
Travel: Up to 30% (client sites within India and occasional overseas)
  
  
**About The Role (a Note From The Hiring Head)**
Tata Communications is one of the world’s most interconnected digital infrastructure companies, built on our Digital Fabric that connects networks, cloud, and customer interactions for global enterprises. Within our customer experience portfolio, we sell and deliver cloud contact centre (CCaaS) and AI-driven engagement solutions end to end — including our InstaCC™ contact centre platform, the Smartflo CCaaS platform, and the Kaleyra CCaaS/CPaaS suite we acquired in 2023 (messaging, voice, video and chat APIs), alongside a global OEM ecosystem spanning Genesys Cloud CX, Amazon Connect, Webex Contact Centre, NICE CXone
  
  
Every enterprise deal we win now hinges on two things: a well-architected CCaaS solution and a compelling Voice AI story — voice bots, IVR transformation, speech-enabled self-service, and agent-assist. I am looking for a hands-on Solution Engineer who lives in that intersection: someone who can take a customer’s call-flow diagram and turn it into a winning, priced, demonstrable solution.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Pre-sales and Solution Design
  
  

* Own the technical win in the sales cycle: conduct discovery workshops with enterprise customers, document their current contact centre estate (telephony, routing, IVR, CRM, WFM, analytics), and translate business requirements into a target-state CCaaS + Voice AI architecture.
* Design end-to-end solutions across our portfolio — InstaCC, Smartflo, and Kaleyra CCaaS/CPaaS — and across OEM platforms (Genesys Cloud CX, Amazon Connect, Webex Contact Centre, NICE CXone, Five9), including telephony integration (SIP trunking, WebRTC, SBCs), channel routing (voice, chat, WhatsApp, email), and CRM/helpdesk integration.
* Architect the Voice AI components specifically: conversational IVR and voice bots, ASR/STT and TTS selection, NLU and LLM-driven dialogue design, barge-in, DTMF fallbacks, latency and WER budgets, and clear escalation to human agents.

Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept
  
  

* Build and maintain compelling demos that showcase CCaaS workflows and Voice AI behaviours (voice bot conversations, sentiment detection, agent-assist) that our sales teams can take into customer rooms.
* Scope, build, and run PoCs with customers; define success criteria (containment, deflection, CSAT impact) and deliver crisp readouts.

RFPs, RFIs and Commercial Support
  
  

* Lead the technical portions of RFPs/RFIs and solution defence presentations; write the technical response, solution narrative, and architecture diagrams.
* Support commercials: build bill-of-materials, platform sizing, voice/AI consumption estimates, and effort/cost inputs for SOW and pricing decisions — while keeping the solution technically honest.

Partner and Ecosystem Engagement
  
  

* Work closely with our platform partners (Genesys, Amazon, Webex, and others) on roadmap access, licensing nuances, and joint solutioning for large deals.
* Validate third-party and our own AI component choices (speech engines, LLM-based voice agents, analytics) against real customer use cases.

Implementation Handoff and Feedback
  
  

* Hand over won deals to delivery/implementation teams with clean solution documentation; join the first design reviews to ensure what was sold is what gets built.
* Feed market learnings — what wins, what doesn’t, what customers ask for — back into our product and portfolio teams.

Must-Have (Non-Negotiable)
  
  

* CCaaS depth — 6+ years designing, demonstrating, or deploying contact centre solutions on at least one leading platform (Genesys Cloud/CX, Amazon Connect, NICE CXone, Five9, Avaya, Webex CC) and a working command of cloud telephony: SIP, PRI/trunking, WebRTC, SBCs, DTMF, call recording, and omni-channel routing.
* Voice AI expertise — Demonstrable experience designing and delivering voice AI / conversational AI solutions: IVR and voice-bot design, ASR/STT and TTS engines (e.g., Azure Speech, Google STT, Amazon Transcribe/Polly), NLU and/or LLM-driven dialogue flows, barge-in and error handling, and real-world tuning for accuracy (WER), latency, and containment.
* Solution engineering craft — Proven track record in pre-sales: discovery, solution architecture, demos, PoCs, RFP/RFI responses, BoM and pricing support.
* India market context — Understanding of India’s telecom/enterprise landscape relevant to voice workloads: carrier numbering and provisioning practices, TRAI/DoT compliance considerations, and how enterprise contact centres buy telephony in India.
* Communication — Ability to explain architecture to CIOs and call flows to operations heads; comfortable presenting and debating in customer rooms; excellent written technical documentation.

Good to Have
  
  

* Exposure to CPaaS APIs (messaging, voice, WhatsApp) — experience with Kaleyra or similar is a plus.
* CRM and ecosystem integration knowledge (Salesforce, MS Dynamics, helpdesk platforms).
* Working knowledge of speech analytics, sentiment analysis, real-time agent-assist, and LLM-based voice agents.
* Relevant certifications (Genesys, AWS Connect, Google/cloud speech services, etc.).
* Experience with managed services or telco hosting models in the CCaaS space.

What Success Looks Like (KPIs)
  
  

* Technical win rate on supported opportunities; number of deals where our solution architecture and demos were decisive.
* PoC success rate and time-to-PoC.
* Quality and completeness of RFP responses and solution documentation (on-time, high first-pass accuracy).
* Accuracy of solution/BOM estimates versus won contract scope.
* Customer and internal stakeholder feedback (sales, delivery, partners).

Experience handling premium or luxury interior product showrooms.

Exposure to working with architects, interior designers, builders, and high-end residential clients.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Delhi
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 4-6 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

● End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.

● Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.

● AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.

● System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.

● Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.

● Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.

**What We Look For**

● Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).

● Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.

● Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).

● Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.

● Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.

● Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

● Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).

● Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

title: R&D Engineer 3, Software
description:
**Overview**
Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Observability Engineer to design, build, and continuously improve monitoring and observability for our enterprise environment. Most of the work focuses on on-premises systems: physical servers, virtualized infrastructure, and on-prem Kubernetes clusters, along with the infrastructure layers underneath them. Some cloud use cases are also in scope. Your goal is to give system owners and business stakeholders an accurate, actionable view of the health and uptime of the systems they depend on.
  
  
You will also help shape how we apply agentic AI to observability, moving from dashboards and alerts toward intelligent triage, correlation, and assisted remediation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Architecture and Design
  
  

* Design end-to-end monitoring and observability solutions for enterprise applications running on VMs, Kubernetes, and bare-metal servers, and extend them to cloud workloads where needed.
* Define a layered monitoring strategy that covers hardware, OS, virtualization, network, storage, platform services, and applications.
* Set standards for metrics, logs, alerting, dashboards, and service health models, including SLIs and SLOs where they apply.
* Make sound architectural decisions on tool roles, data flows, retention, scalability, and high availability across the observability stack.
* Define alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability.
* Design service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers.
* Secure observability platforms and integrations through access controls, authentication, encryption, and vulnerability remediation. Maintain compliance with enterprise security standards through platform hardening, audit readiness, and regular security reviews.

Implementation
  
  

* Build and maintain monitoring with Zabbix, covering templates, discovery, triggers, proxies, and integrations.
* Design and maintain log collection, parsing, enrichment, and routing pipelines into Splunk, including forwarders, sourcetypes, field extractions, indexes, and searches.
* Contribute to metrics and visualization with Prometheus and Grafana, particularly for Kubernetes workloads and unified dashboards.
* Automate the configuration and onboarding of monitoring using infrastructure-as-code and APIs.

Agentic AI for Observability
  
  

* Design and implement AI agents that support observability workflows. Examples include alert triage and deduplication, cross-source event correlation, root-cause hypotheses, incident summarization, and runbook-driven remediation with human-in-the-loop approval.
* Integrate LLM-based agents with monitoring and logging platforms through APIs and tool protocols such as MCP.
* Define guardrails, permission boundaries, and auditability for AI-driven actions on production systems.
* Measure the real impact of these agents on operations, for example on MTTD, MTTR, alert noise, and on-call load.

Collaboration
  
  

* Work closely with system owners to understand architecture, failure modes, and dependencies, and to translate them into meaningful monitoring.
* Partner with consumers and stakeholders of those systems to define what “healthy” and “available” mean to them, and to make sure observability gives them the visibility they need.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring, and run knowledge sharing across operations, infrastructure, and development teams.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Regularly review alert quality, coverage gaps, and signal-to-noise ratio, and tune or retire monitoring accordingly.
* Use incidents and post-mortems as input to improve detection and response.
* Track the evolution of the observability toolset and the wider technology landscape.

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 5+ years in infrastructure, operations, or observability engineering, with at least 3 years focused on monitoring and observability, primarily in on-premises enterprise environments.
* Hands-on, production-level experience with Zabbix and Splunk.
* Proven experience monitoring physical servers, virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V, KVM), and Kubernetes clusters.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure layers: compute, OS (Linux and Windows), networking, storage, and the dependencies between them.
* Solid experience with log collection and processing at scale: parsing, normalization, enrichment, retention, and search optimization.
* Practical experience applying agentic AI (LLM agents, tool use, automation) to monitoring, operations, or incident management, along with a working understanding of how these systems behave and where their risks lie.
* Experience designing monitoring architecture, not only operating existing tools.
* Experience defining alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability.
* Experience designing service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers.
* Working knowledge of securing observability platforms, including access control, authentication, encryption, and hardening.
* Strong scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) and comfort working with REST APIs.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work with both technical owners and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with Prometheus (exporters, alerting rules, Alert manager, long-term storage).
* Experience with Grafana (dashboard design, multi-source visualization, alerting).
* Experience monitoring cloud workloads (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and hybrid environments.
* Software development experience, such as building integrations, tools, exporters, or services.

title: Head of Engineering (Technical Leadership)
description:
**About IndiaMART:**

IndiaMART is an online B2B marketplace connecting buyers and suppliers. Our mission is to make doing business easy. We are investing in the technology, platforms and engineering capabilities that help businesses discover, connect and grow.

**About the role:**

We are looking for a hands-on engineering leader to build an AI-native engineering organisation at IndiaMART. You will shape technical direction and make AI an integral part of how teams design, build, test and operate software, while strengthening the platforms and production systems our business depends on.

This role combines current, personal AI practice with broad systems judgment and the ability to lead people and change. You will work across product engineering, data, infrastructure and security, build the AI infrastructure and developer tools teams need, and turn new capabilities into dependable engineering outcomes.

**Key responsibilities:**

* **Build an AI-native engineering organisation**
  . Shape how teams design, build, test and operate software using AI. Establish shared platforms, developer tools and reusable patterns that help teams turn ideas into reliable products faster, and measure success through adoption, quality and business impact.
* **Build the AI foundations teams need**
  . Establish model and data access, developer tools, evaluation, observability, permissions and cost controls. Help teams adopt effective workflows and improve them as model capabilities evolve.
* **Lead technology and engineering**
  . Set technical direction and priorities, own delivery, develop managers and senior engineers, and build a culture of sound engineering judgment and accountability.
* **Build capabilities teams want to use**
  . Create practical, reusable paths for APIs, frontends, data, testing, deployment and operations. Treat shared services as internal products, with clear interfaces, support and migration plans.
* **Improve the existing estate**
  . Connect decisions across applications, databases, messaging, cloud and security. Simplify or retire systems in stages, informed by reliability, customer outcomes and operating cost.
* **Make safe delivery routine**
  . Embed security, testing, observability and recovery into everyday work. Reduce repeated manual intervention and approvals through effective controls and clear accountability.

**What you should bring:**

* **Bring practical experience building with AI and strong engineering judgment**
  . You understand how models, agents, data and conventional software fit together, can evaluate their limitations, and can guide teams from promising prototypes to dependable production systems.
* **Personal technical depth**
  : consequential software or platforms you helped build, with decisions, mistakes and results you can explain in detail.
* **Technical breadth**
  : judgment across applications and frontends, APIs, data, infrastructure, reliability, security and AI. You understand how choices interact and when to involve specialists.
* **Delivery ownership**
  : a record of delivering engineering outcomes across teams, resolving obstacles and staying accountable through adoption, maintenance and later consequences.
* **People leadership**
  : experience leading through managers, developing technical leaders and owning organisation outcomes, with the judgment to integrate specialist teams and operate at substantial scale.
* **Clear communication and influence**
  : explain choices to technical, product and business audiences, work through disagreement and secure adoption across reporting lines.

**Relevant experience:**

Experience building shared platforms, scaling software products or improving complex production systems is particularly relevant. We welcome technical founders, early engineering leaders and operators from established companies who bring sustained ownership and measurable engineering impact.

**What success looks like:**

AI-native workflows and shared capabilities that teams adopt; faster delivery with better quality; less repeated work and manual intervention; reliable, secure systems; and stronger technical leaders. Establish baselines and demonstrate improvements in delivery effort, reliability and operating cost.

**Reporting to**
: Chief Product Officer

**Location:**
Noida Sector 135

title: Senior AI & Decision Science Engineer
description:

**Full-Stack AI & Automation Engineer**
**Human Resources - Strategic Planning & Analytics CoE**
**About The Team & Your Role**
Strategic Planning & Analytics team is architected to move beyond traditional HR, functioning as a strategic engine that fuels ST’s growth through five specialized pillars: Business Partnerships, Products & AI, Workforce Insights, Data Science, and Workforce Planning Architecture. We are currently in an ambitious build-phase, moving away from legacy processes to create a sophisticated, tech-enabled function that mirrors the engineering excellence of the semiconductor industry. We don’t want to just manage headcount; we want to orchestrate the future of HR using AI.
  
  
As a member of this team, you won’t be working in a silo. If you are energized by the challenge of redefining the "H" in HR through the lens of data and innovation, you’ve found the right place.

* End-to-End AI Prototyping: Architect, build, and deploy conversational bots and transactional AI agents from scratch in a sandbox environment.
* Workflow Orchestration & Automation: Design and manage complex, multi-system automation workflows using tools like n8n to automate actions (e.g., orchestrating system lookups, mock API executions, and conditional task routing).
* LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering: Integrate prototypes securely with internal OpenAI/ChatGPT APIs, mastering prompt design, function calling, tool use, and state management.
* Interface & UI/UX Evolution: Build lightweight, responsive web interfaces (e.g., Streamlit, Next.js) for quick stakeholder testing, ensuring the backend logic is decoupled via webhooks for future migration into Microsoft Teams.
* Code Hygiene & Handoff Documentation: Maintain code transparency, track version changes, and collaborate efficiently using GitHub. Author structured "Industrialization Blueprints" (JSON payloads, API mappings, and logic flows) to seamlessly hand over for full scale production

**Required Background & Skills**

* AI Orchestration Frameworks: Expert-level workflow creation using tools like n8n (advanced JavaScript/Python execution nodes, webhooks, and sub-workflows) or equivalent orchestration frameworks
* AI & LLM Mastery: Practical experience implementing conversational APIs, embedding architectures, vector stores, and advanced prompt engineering constraints.
* Full-Stack Core Development: Strong programming proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/Node.js. Comfort writing clean API connectors, handling RESTful requests, parsing JSON, and maintaining code via GitHub.
* Enterprise Collaboration Ecosystems: Prior familiarity or structural understanding of building integration layers, bots, or webhooks for the Microsoft 365 / MS Teams ecosystem is highly desirable.
* Candidate should possess “Can-do” attitude, with an ability to thrive in an unstructured environment
* 9 to 12 years of software engineering/automation experience (with at least 2–3 years focused on building AI agents/bots from scratch).
* Masters/ PhD in Computer Science, Information Technology equivalent
* Understanding of HCM systems like Oracle is an added advantage
* Excellent English, quantitative, technical, and storytelling skills

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.
  
  
At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.
  
  
To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**About us:**

ConveGenius is an AI-native education infrastructure company transforming how governments, enterprises, and social institutions deliver learning and governance outcomes at population scale. Operating across B2G and B2B segments, the company partners with state governments, CSR funders, philanthropies, and social enterprises to build intelligent education ecosystems that are both impactful and commercially sustainable.

At its core, ConveGenius runs two synergistic business lines:

* **SwiftAI**
  – the intelligence and automation layer that powers citizen engagement, governance efficiency, and real-time decision-making for governments and institutions.
* **SwiftSchool**
  – the learning infrastructure layer that integrates adaptive learning, digital classrooms, and analytics to drive measurable student and system outcomes.

This dual-engine model enables ConveGenius to serve as the technology backbone for education reform — connecting classrooms, communities, and command centres through a unified AI-powered framework. Unlike traditional edtech companies that deliver content, ConveGenius builds infrastructure — platforms that integrate deeply into public delivery systems while enabling private and philanthropic partners to scale their missions with measurable results.

With operations across 22+ Indian states and partnerships with multilaterals, CSR alliances, and government departments, ConveGenius has established itself as a partner-friendly enterprise trusted for aligning policy priorities with social and financial returns. Supported by institutional investors and guided by a double bottom line philosophy, the company consistently delivers impact at scale and profitability with purpose.

As ConveGenius enters its next phase of growth, it is shaping the future of AI-led public education infrastructure — where technology, partnerships, and governance intelligence converge to redefine how nations learn and thrive.

**Learn more about us:**
https://linktr.ee/convegenius11

As the Sr. ML Engineer at ConveGenius, you will design, build, and ship production LLM-powered systems that power personalised learning in Indian languages and educational contexts. You own applications end-to-end: RAG and agentic pipelines, evaluation harnesses, and the services that serve them in production — with a strong bar for software engineering, not just model or prompt work. Fine-tuning experience is a plus for this role, not a requirement.

This role is part of a 0-to-1 vertical build. The person joining should be comfortable with ambiguity, high ownership, rapid iteration, hands-on execution, team building, and periods of high-intensity work during the early setup phase.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, build, and ship production-grade LLM applications: RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and tool-calling systems for education-specific use cases such as question answering, content generation, adaptive feedback, and curriculum alignment.
* Own full system architecture: data pipelines, retrieval layers, orchestration, APIs, and service infrastructure — written as maintainable, tested production code, not notebooks or scripts.
* Build rigorous LLM evaluation frameworks: task-specific benchmarks, regression testing, human eval loops, and automated quality gates to catch degradation before it ships.
* Own latency and cost at the application layer: caching strategies, request batching, model/route selection, and prompt-context optimisation to keep production systems fast and affordable at scale.
* Build data pipelines for grounding and instruction data, including multilingual and Indic language sources.
* Assess new open-source and closed model releases for domain applicability, cost, and production readiness.
* Define and track system performance metrics, evaluation benchmarks, and reliability targets across all shipped features.
* Work with open-source and sovereign LLMs, integrating them into production-proven serving and orchestration frameworks.
* Where warranted, fine-tune or adapt foundation models (LoRA/QLoRA/SFT) — a strong plus, not a gating requirement for this role.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Strong production Python engineering: clean, tested, maintainable code — not scripts or notebooks. Comfortable owning services in production.
* Hands-on experience building and shipping RAG or agentic systems in production: retrieval design, orchestration (e.g. LangChain/LangGraph or equivalent), tool calling, and multi-step reasoning pipelines.
* Demonstrated experience building LLM evaluation systems: benchmarks, regression tests, human-eval workflows, and quality monitoring — not just anecdotal "it works."
* Experience building and operating backend systems/services: APIs, data pipelines, deployment, and monitoring in a real production environment.
* Working knowledge of ML pipelines, data preparation, and model deployment.
* Experience working with open-source and sovereign LLMs, using standard, production-proven frameworks.
* Understanding of cloud platforms and infrastructure for serving ML/LLM systems at scale.

**Good to Have**

* Hands-on fine-tuning experience with LoRA, QLoRA, SFT, DPO, or similar preference-optimisation techniques.
* Familiarity with DeepSpeed, FSDP, or large-scale distributed training frameworks.
* Experience with inference optimisation (quantisation, ONNX, efficient serving) at the model layer

title: AI Infrastructure Architect
description:
**Project Role :**
AI Infrastructure Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Architect and build custom Artificial Intelligence (AI) infrastructure/hardware solutions. Optimize AI infrastructure/hardware performance, power consumption, cost and scalability of computational stack. Advise on AI infrastructure technology and vendor evaluation, selection and full stack integration.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Large Language Models (LLMs)
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
Amazon Web Services (AWS)
  
  
**Minimum 15 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As an AI Infrastructure Architect, a typical day involves designing and constructing tailored artificial intelligence infrastructure and hardware solutions that meet organizational needs. This role requires continuous evaluation and enhancement of system performance, power efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and scalability across the computational stack. The position also includes providing expert advice on emerging AI infrastructure technologies, assessing vendor offerings, and overseeing the seamless integration of full-stack solutions to support advanced AI applications. Collaboration with various teams to align infrastructure capabilities with strategic objectives is a key aspect of daily activities.

* Should have Influencing and Advisory skills.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams.
* Lead the evaluation and selection of AI infrastructure technologies and vendors to ensure optimal alignment with project goals.
* Drive innovation by identifying opportunities to enhance infrastructure efficiency and scalability through emerging technologies.

Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Good To Have Skills: Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Strong understanding of AI infrastructure design principles including hardware optimization and computational resource management.
* Experience in performance tuning and power consumption optimization for large-scale AI systems.
* Ability to integrate complex AI hardware and software stacks to achieve scalable and cost-effective solutions.
* Familiarity with vendor evaluation processes and full-stack AI infrastructure integration.

Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have minimum 15 years of experience in Large Language Models (LLMs).
* This position is based at our Kolkata office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

Spektr is Amazon Ads' exabyte-scale central data lake: the unified catalog for petabytes of campaign, ad-serving, billing, and measurement data. Hundreds of teams and Amazon's advertiser-facing AI agents depend on it for discovery, ingestion, transformation, and querying at scale. If you want large-scale engineering with tangible business impact, this is the team.
  
  
We're rebuilding Spektr ground-up with an AI-first architecture, and building fully-automated domain agents that let customers manage their big data lifecycle in a single click. As a Sr SDE on this team, you will own the core platform services that power Amazon Ads data infrastructure, consolidating legacy systems into clean, API-first services that cut job creation time from weeks to less than a day. You will build MCP-enabled AI interfaces that let AI agents create and run data pipelines on Spektr at 99%+ success rate, directly shaping how GenAI discovers and consumes data across Amazon Ads. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.8B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The AI Platform Team**
The AI Platform team is one of Rippling's highest-priority engineering investments and sits at the center of the company's broader AI strategy. The team is building the foundational infrastructure that powers AI capabilities across Rippling's entire product ecosystem, including HR, Payroll, Benefits, Recruiting, IT, Finance, Compliance, and Workforce Management. Rather than building standalone chatbots or simple LLM integrations, the team focuses on creating deeply integrated AI systems that understand Rippling's rich business context, permissions model, workflows, and enterprise data.
  
  
The team is developing core platform capabilities such as AI agents, workflow automation engines, evaluation frameworks, feedback loops, data pipelines, and self-healing systems that can identify issues, surface insights, and help automate complex enterprise workflows. These systems operate with real business context, approvals, permissions, and auditability requirements, enabling customers to safely delegate operational tasks while maintaining control and governance.
  
  
One of the unique aspects of Rippling AI is that it is built directly on top of Rippling's unified data model and permission system. The platform can reason across HR, IT, Payroll, and Finance data while respecting access controls and providing verifiable outputs. The team is solving challenging problems around agent orchestration, workflow execution, reliability, permissions, evaluations, observability, data quality, and scalable AI infrastructure.
  
  
This is an ideal environment for engineers who enjoy building large-scale backend and platform systems, working through ambiguity, and owning products end-to-end. Engineers on the team are highly hands-on, spend the majority of their time coding, and have the opportunity to shape how AI becomes a core part of enterprise software. The role offers significant ownership, visibility, and a strong path toward Staff-level engineering scope over time.
  
  
****What you will do:****

* Build foundational AI platform systems that support Rippling’s broader AI strategy across HR, IT, Finance, payroll, benefits, recruiting, compliance, and internal workflows.
* Work as a deeply hands-on Senior Software Engineer, with around 60% of time expected to be spent coding, debugging, reviewing code, and owning implementation.
* Contribute to the design and build-out of AI platform capabilities such as background agents, automated workflows, evaluation systems, data pipelines, and model quality feedback loops.
* Help build systems that allow AI agents to automate repetitive enterprise workflows with the right permissions, controls, approvals, and auditability.
* Work on platform systems that support self-healing and self-improving workflows, where AI can detect negative product signals and help identify root causes.
* Partner with Staff Engineers, Product, Infra, Platform, and Engineering stakeholders to convert ambiguous product/platform problems into scalable technical solutions.
* Own well-defined to moderately ambiguous components end-to-end — from design and implementation to testing, launch, monitoring, and iteration.
* Participate actively in design discussions, code reviews, debugging, production support, and operational improvements.
* Build reliable, scalable, and maintainable backend/platform systems that can support Rippling’s product ecosystem.

****What’s exciting about this role:****

* This is not a generic chatbot or lightweight LLM wrapper role. The team is building core AI platform infrastructure that can make Rippling’s product surface more autonomous, context-aware, and self-improving.
* Engineers will get exposure to AI agents, automated enterprise workflows, self-healing systems, and custom intelligence layers built around Rippling-specific product context.
* The role offers strong learning, ownership, and growth opportunities for engineers who want to work at the intersection of backend/platform engineering and AI infrastructure.
* This is a strong opportunity for a high-potential Senior Engineer to grow toward Staff-level scope over time.
* Rippling AI is a high-priority company initiative, and the team needs strong Senior Engineers who can add meaningful hands-on execution capacity.
* The AI Platform team is lean and supports a broad set of internal engineering and product stakeholders, creating a need for engineers who can ramp quickly and contribute with high ownership.
* The team needs builders who are strong in backend/platform engineering and are comfortable working on scalable production systems.

* Generic LLMs do not fully understand Rippling’s proprietary workflows, policy logic, query language, company data, and permissions, so the team needs engineers who can help build AI infrastructure around Rippling’s real product context.
* The team moves fast, and candidates need to be comfortable with ambiguity, changing priorities, and rapid iteration.
* Coding is a core expectation for this role; this cannot be filled by someone who is not actively hands-on.
* Start by owning meaningful components within AI Platform initiatives such as background agents, workflow automation, evaluations, data pipelines, or self-healing systems.
* Grow from owning individual components to owning larger services, workflows, or platform modules end-to-end. Build depth in Rippling’s product context, AI platform systems, infrastructure, and internal engineering patterns.

* Become a trusted engineer who can independently deliver scalable, reliable, production-grade systems with limited hand-holding. Ability to ramp quickly into Rippling’s AI platform, codebase, product context, and internal systems.

We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

The Software Engineering Manager would provide leadership in the design, development, and deployment of Caterpillar’s state-of-the-art digital products within the areas of e-commerce. This position is accountable for hiring, managing, and mentoring multiple software engineers and pod leads who are transforming and building a world-class eCommerce application, in line with the CAT Digital Strategy.

We are looking for a Software Engineering Manager with expertise and passion to imagine, build and develop innovative products. This is a high growth space and a big opportunity that needs a dynamic product creator. The ideal candidate will be curious, have attention to detail, be energized by a dynamic environment, be comfortable with strategic thinking while also diving deep.

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead strong development teams and build creative technology solutions that positively impact international customers, relish large ownership and diverse technologies, join our team today!

As a Software Engineering Manager, you will identify, hire, and build world-class teams of Software Engineers to define, drive, and execute on our strategic vision. You will improve/initiate processes that allow these teams to collaborate with local as well as global teams with a high degree of efficiency. You will develop teams of highly motivated and talented individuals that can collaborate with Project Managers, Product Managers and Software Engineers across the company on a high impact initiative. You will design, build and own features and programs that will delight our dealers / customers.

This key role is expected to establish and mature product software engineering capability in India. The role will report to CAT Digital India Senior Engineering Manager.

**JOB DUTIES:**

* The position supports the CAT Digital strategy, recognizes the service requirements/needs of dealers and customers, corporate and business unit goals, and gives input to leadership in formulating global concepts, strategies and plans to deliver service solutions.
* Typical internal customers include various contacts throughout Caterpillar worldwide and its subsidiaries. External contacts include various customers, dealers, and vendors throughout worldwide markets.
* The role is responsible for the overall development life cycle of the solution and manage complex projects with significant impact.
* Responsibilities include supervising a team and a project related to developing business and technical solutions.
* Work with product managers in developing a strategy and road map to provide compelling capabilities that helps them succeed in their business goals.
* Work closely with senior engineers to develop the best technical design and approach for new product development.
* Continuously improve and drive engineering best practices around software engineering & lead the craftsmanship, resilience, and scalability of our solutions. Establish durable ways of working with product peers and other internal engineering teams.
* Encourage innovation, implementation of cutting-edge technologies, including outside-of-the-box thinking, teamwork, self-organization, and diversity.
* Project management - prioritization, planning of features, Stakeholder management and tracking of commitments. Develops detailed work plans, project estimates, resource plans, and status reports. Monitors and troubleshoots performance and schedule issues.
* Career management and development of direct reports: The position is responsible for all personnel issues and performance evaluation of subordinates, as well as overall employee satisfaction for the division.
* Provides technical support, and direction to teams and pod leads. Acquires resources necessary to accomplish work on time.

title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Advertising Core Infra
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Would you like to build highly available, scalable and distributed engineering systems for one of the largest data lakes in Amazon? Does Petabyte scale excite you?  
  
Spektr is Amazon Ads' exabyte-scale central data lake: the unified catalog for petabytes of campaign, ad-serving, billing, and measurement data. Hundreds of teams and Amazon's advertiser-facing AI agents depend on it for discovery, ingestion, transformation, and querying at scale. If you want large-scale engineering with tangible business impact, this is the team.  
  
We're rebuilding Spektr ground-up with an AI-first architecture, and building fully-automated domain agents that let customers manage their big data lifecycle in a single click. In parallel, we're adopting Apache Iceberg / S3 Tables with serverless compute, scaling horizontally via a data mesh pattern for 5 growth in volume and demand. If you thrive on greenfield experimentation and shipping things that matter to the business, keep reading.  
  
As a Sr SDE on this team, you will own the core platform services that power Amazon Ads data infrastructure, consolidating legacy systems into clean, API-first services that cut job creation time from weeks to less than a day. You will build MCP-enabled AI interfaces that let AI agents create and run data pipelines on Spektr at 99%+ success rate, directly shaping how GenAI discovers and consumes data across Amazon Ads. You will design and operate high-scale Java services on AWS-native infrastructure (Spark, EMR Serverless, Kinesis, Step Functions), processing petabytes of data daily at 99.9% availability. You will also drive deployment automation, replacing manual release cycles with CI/CD pipelines that accelerate delivery velocity for a platform serving Tier-1 advertising data systems.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Engage with key decision makers such as Product & Program Managers to understand customer requirements and brainstorm on solutions
* Design, code and deploy components and micro-services for the core job management pipeline
* Ensure testability, maintanability and low operational footprint for your code
* Participate in operational responsibilities with your team
* Innovate on AWS technology to improve latency, reduce cost and operations

  
A day in the life  

* Focus on core engineering opportunities to guarantee system availability that matches our data growth
* Work with a skilled team of engineers, managers and decision makers to consistently meet customer demand
* Automate monitoring of data availability, quality and usability via simplified metrics and drive innovations to improve guarantees for our customers

  
About the team  
The mission of the Ads Datalake team is to provide data that helps the advertising organization make informed analyses and decisions for our customers and to determine and deploy investments for future growth via a set of central and unified products and services.  
  
Our team focuses on simplicity, usability, speed, compliance, cost efficiency and enabling high-velocity decision making so our customers can generate high quality insights faster.  
  
We are a global team with presence across India and North America.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Exasol Evergreen Talents Hunt Challenge
description:
**Exasol Evergreen Talents Hunt Challenge**

**Location: Chennai, India**

🚀
**Why Exasol? Why Now?**

Exasol is a high-performance analytics database built for data at scale, for the new AI era. At Exasol, our engineers solve hard problems across distributed systems, performance, reliability and real-world customer workloads needed for this new AI era.

The new AI era requires creators and builders who enjoy building robust technology and tackling complex technical challenges. We are building an evergreen talent community that enjoys doing so.

Here is an opportunity for you to be part of this evergreen talent community. Yes, it’s not a challenge for a job opening, but more a fodder for the hungry minds, a challenging teaser to the builder of the new AI era, that may lead to new opportunities in Exasol.

💼
**How It Works?**

1. Go through the OpenSource Challenge listed below
2. Show us how you think, build and solve it
3. Enjoy handsome rewards for best solutions
4. Get into our Exasol Evergreen talent community.
5. As part of Exasol Evergreen talent community, you will be prioritized for roles opening within Exasol. You will also be invited to participate in their meetups, conferences, webinars and any other events. You could be eligible for testing Exasol pre-releases

**🎯The Challenge - Welcome to Exasol's Opensource Challenge**

1. Pick a public open source project that is not hosted by Exasol
2. The project must have at least 100 stars on GitHub
3. Make it compatible with or add a feature for Exasol (e.g., by contributing a connector to the upstream project)
4. Add automatic integration tests
5. The upstream maintainers must accept and merge your contribution
6. Make sure you will be able to maintain it
7. Present the result

💡
**Example Projects**

The list below is just to show what kind of upstream projects we mean. Participants to not have to pick those. There are hundreds of potential projects out in the world.

* GitHub - xo/usql: Universal command-line interface for SQL databases
* GitHub - dbeaver/cloudbeaver: Cloud Database Manager
* GitHub - kayak/pypika: PyPika is a python SQL query builder that exposes the full richness of the SQL language using a syntax that reflects the resulting query. PyPika excels at all sorts of SQL queries but is especially useful for data analysis.

✅
**The Dos**

1. Integrate with an existing open source project
2. Ensure it is getting accepted upstream
3. Make it maintainable. This is the most critical point
4. Even if you maintain an upstream project, you can participate

❌
**The Donts**

1. Don’t start a new open source project just to integrate Exasol
2. Maintainability should not require rewriting and more work

📊
**Evaluation**

If someone manages to fulfill all criteria of the challenge, we will do a code and documentation review, to gauge how well that was executed.

Criteria (in descending order of importance):

1. Security
2. User experience
3. Performance
4. Maintainability

Winners (multiple categories) will be declared post evaluation and prizes given.

📈
**What’s in it for You**

Completing a challenge gives you the opportunity to connect with Exasol, demonstrate your skills and ability to build new things, and become part of the broader global data community.

If you’re hungry to learn, unafraid to fail, and energized by the idea of helping the world’s leading organizations unlock the power of their data — we want to hear from you.

Apply now and be part of Exasol’s next chapter.

title: Software Dev Engineer II, Profit Intelligence
description:
**Description**
Are you interested in building intelligence systems from the ground up?
  
  
Are you interested in working with Applied Scientists, Big Data Engineers and Software Development Engineers to build large-scale data intelligence systems?
  
  
Are you interested to work in a team that positively impacts different key pillars of Amazon like Pricing, Promotions, Advertising, Auto inventory purchasing, Auto inventory removal, Inventory placement?
  
  
Are you interested in working for a team that builds cool systems yet has great work-life balance?
  
  
Profit intelligence systems measures, predicts true profit(/loss) for each item as a result of a specific shipment to an Amazon customer.
  
  
Prot Intelligence is all about providing intelligent ways for Amazon to understand profitability across retail business. What are the hidden factors driving the growth or profitability across millions of shipments each day?
  
  
Profit Intelligence provides these answers.
  
  
We compute the profitability of each and every shipment that gets shipped out of Amazon. Guess what, we predict the profitability of future possible shipments too. We are a team of agile, can-do engineers, who believe that not only are moon shots possible but that they can be done before lunch. All it takes is finding new ideas that challenge our preconceived notions of how things should be done. Process and procedure matter less than ideas and the practical work of getting stuff done. This is a place for exploring the new and taking risks.
  
  
We push the envelope in using cloud services in AWS as well as the latest in distributed systems, forecasting algorithms, and data mining.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to design and build AI-powered data platforms that transform large-scale business data into actionable insights. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and data engineering — owning end-to-end development of tools that help business leaders make faster, better decisions.
  
  
This is a high-impact role on a team where the software you ship directly shapes financial and operational strategy across Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Architect and build scalable platforms that ingest, process, and serve insights from petabyte-scale datasets
  
  
Integrate large language models and generative AI capabilities into internal analytics tools — enabling natural language querying, anomaly explanation, and automated reporting
  
  
Design ML pipelines for anomaly detection, forecasting, and trend analysis over structured and semi-structured business data
  
  
Partner with scientists, analysts, and PMs to translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped technical solutions
  
  
Drive engineering excellence: define coding standards, lead design reviews, and set the bar for operational health (monitoring, oncall, runbooks)
  
  
Mentor junior engineers; raise the technical capability of the team through clear documentation and code review
  
  
Own your services in production — you build it, you run it
  
  
Build and operate our foundational data infrastructure comprising of the entire spectrum of AWS Services - Storage (Redshift Data Shares, s3 data lakes), Orchestration (Step Functions, Glue and Internal Java Based Orchestration Tools), Processing (Spark & Flink - KDA), Streaming services (AWS Kinesis) and real-time large scale event aggregation stores.
  
  
Making it fully configurable and self-service for non-engineers.
  
  
Build and evolve tools that empower Amazonians to access data and build reliable, scalable and configurable way to generate Unit Economics for all Amazon Businesses. This includes UIs and frameworks for configuring rules, simulating their application, approval workows for rule changes, APIs and caching layers for high-throughput serving of Unit Economics Historicals and Predictions.
  
  
Build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like inhouse Reporting Applications and BI tools), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for designing and building platforms for crunching 100s of TB of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Support Engineer III, Chronicle
description:
**Description**
Impact
  
  
Ever wondered how Amazon offers the Earth's biggest selection and still manages to offer lower prices every day to our customers? Our retail business teams work with a massive array of vendors and business financial performance metrics to expand selection and drive costs lower. Given the rapid growth of our business, this requires our category leaders, financial analysts, site merchandisers and vendor managers to quickly analyze vendors, categories and brands, diving deep into data showing business efficiency down to the unit sale level. The technology that enables this has huge visibility and impact and is critical to Amazon's continued profitability and growth.
  
  
Innovation
  
  
We're working on the future. If you are seeking an environment where you can drive innovation. If you want to apply state-of-the-art software technologies to solve real world problems. If you want the satisfaction of providing visible benefit to end-users in an iterative fast paced environment, this is your opportunity. The responsibilities of this role will be key in paving the future of Amazon Retail and transforming how we do business.
  
  
Opportunity
  
  
You will be part of a team of creative, top-notch engineers who work hard, have fun, and make history.
  
  
As a Support Engineer, you will build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like in-house Applications and external aplications ), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for crunching and providing support for petabytes of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.
  
  
Be part of a high performance, high profile team with a complete, entirely localized business charter to enhance business profitability for the Amazon Consumer business.
  
  
Platform runs entirely on AWS; high scale, engineering challenges.
  
  
Very successful team that has developed a reputation of delivering results within Amazon.
  
  
We regularly research new technologies and invest for the future of our scalability
  
  
This role is on the Chronicle team within Selling Partner Services. We own the Turismo product suite, which is powered by Ripple, a dynamic query engine. Turismo is a well loved product, with 15k+ users globally. Ripple is a PrestoDB based query engine that is built to scale, and processes 2M+ queries per week. We are a full stack team, with Product managers, UX designers, TPMs, SDEs, DEs and Data Scientists.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Provide support of incoming tickets, including extensive troubleshooting tasks, with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services
* Work on operations and maintenance driven coding projects
* Software deployment support in staging and production environments
* Develop tools to aid operations and maintenance
* System and Support status reporting
* Ownership of one or more ETL products or components
* Customer notification and workflow coordination and follow-up to maintain service level agreements
* Work with support team for handing-off or taking over active support issues and creating a team specific knowledge base and skill sets

**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of software development, or 2+ years of technical support experience
* Experience scripting in modern program languages
* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of web services, distributed systems, and web application development
* Experience troubleshooting & maintaining hardware & software RAID
* Experience with REST web services, XML, JSON

title: Director – Cell Therapy IT, Software Engineering - Salesforce
description:
**Director - Cell Therapy IT, Software Engineering - Salesforce**
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to build the digital backbone that delivers next‑generation cell therapies to patients at scale?In this role, you will build and deliver the software platforms that power end‑to‑end activities related to cell therapy across development, manufacturing, and supply. Your work will directly influence how quickly and safely therapies move from treatment sites to manufacturing lines and back to patients.
  
  
You will lead a global engineering organization to compose, build, and industrialize enterprise-grade systems—spanning a Cell Orchestration platform built on Salesforce, AWS- services, and agentic AI automation. Partnering closely with operational and technology leaders, you will define a modern, scalable stack and translate strategy into robust, compliant solutions that drive speed, quality, and reliability. Based in Chennai, India, you will be at the center of a high-impact mission with global reach. How will you scale intelligent automation to orchestrate one of the most complex supply chains in healthcare?
  
  

* Accountabilities:
* Technology Planning and Architecture: Define and evolve a scalable technology strategy and reference architecture that underpins cell therapy operations from vein-to-vein, aligning platform choices with business outcomes.
* Platform Leadership: Lead the build and delivery of the Salesforce-based cellular coordination system, ensuring it is robust, scalable, secure, and fit for regulated environments.
* SDLC Ownership and DevSecOps: Own end-to-end software delivery from design to deployment and support, embedding DevSecOps, automation, and built-in quality to accelerate releases and reduce risk.
* Integration and Interoperability: Orchestrate integrations across Salesforce Service & Life Sciences -Cloud, MuleSoft, mobile-first apps, AWS services, and event streaming (e.g., Kafka) to enable seamless data and workflow continuity.
* Regulatory and Compliance Readiness: Bake compliance into every phase (GxP, HIPAA, FDA, GDPR), establishing traceability, validation, and auditability without slowing down delivery.
* Agentic AI Development or similar Automation experience is essential. Support advancing agentic AI to build autonomous software agents. They complete complex operational tasks and make decisions safely and at scale.
* Technical Roadmap: Life Sciences Cloud: Guide the industrialization of Agent-force Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud and the Advanced Therapy Module to enable next-generation cell therapy delivery.
* Engineering Excellence and GenAI-Enabled SDLC: Establish best- practices for full-stack engineering and leverage GenAI for code generation, testing, and SDLC automation to boost productivity and quality.
* Talent Leadership and Culture: Build and mentor a high-performing global-team of engineers and solution architects, cultivating innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Vendor and Partner Management: Manage external partners to deliver quality, secure, and compliant solutions, optimizing for value and speed.
* Innovation and Future-Readiness: Stay ahead of LLMs, autonomous agents, and cloud-native advances; translate emerging tech into practical upgrades that modernize systems and unlock new capabilities.
* Essential Skills/Experience:
* Bachelor's - degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 12+ years of software development experience, including 5+ years in a leadership role within life sciences, biotech, or manufacturing IT environments.
* Experience managing sophisticated Salesforce environments and multi-cloud implementations.
* Experience in leading multiple Product Development teams globally with engineering and delivery ownership
* Experience building and deploying software solutions in regulated environments (GxP , HIPAA, FDA).
* Expertise in modern development tools and platforms: AWS, Azure, Python, Salesforce (Service Cloud and Life Sciences), MuleSoft, Confluent / Kafka.
* Expertise delivering digital solutions across patient engagement, R&D, and product commercialization.
* Desirable Skills/Experience:
* Salesforce certifications (e.g., Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, Platform Developer II).
* Familiarity with AI/ML features within Salesforce ecosystem (Einstein, predictive analytics).
* Understanding of GenAI use cases in software development and automated testing.
* Hands-on experience with Agentic AI tools and frameworks
* Solid background in system architecture, secure coding practices, and cloud-native design.
* Why AstraZeneca:

Join a purpose-led team where advanced technology meets scientific ambition to change what’s possible for patients. Here, unexpected teams—engineers, data scientists, and operational leaders—get in the same room to tackle problems that matter, with the investment and freedom to experiment through hackathons, prototypes, and scaled delivery. You will help build the digital capabilities that accelerate medicines to those who need them, supported by a collaborative culture that values kindness alongside ambition, rigorous standards alongside creativity, and continuous learning at every step.
  
  
When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  

* Call to Action:

If you’re ready to lead the platforms and AI-powered systems that deliver cell therapies faster and more reliably, take charge from Chennai. Develop what comes next.

22-Oct-2026
  
  
**Closing Date**
28-Oct-2026

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics.
