title: Data Platform Architect
description:
**Project Role :**
Data Platform Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Architects the data platform blueprint and implements the design, encompassing the relevant data platform components. Collaborates with the Integration Architects and Data Architects to ensure cohesive integration between systems and data models.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Snowflake Data Warehouse
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
AI Agents & Workflow Integration
  
  
**Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
**Role Summary / Description**
AI Powered Tech Talent
  
  
As a Senior Engineer in AI Infrastructure Architecture for Snowflake, you will own significant portions of the end-to-end architecture and engineering of optimized data and AI infrastructure for production machine learning and AI-enabled applications. You will design scalable warehouses, Snowpark workloads, AI-ready data/feature pipelines, model-enablement patterns, automation and operational controls that align with client standards, SLAs, security, compliance and cost-efficiency expectations. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, platform modernization, regulated data workloads, FinOps and production reliability, while mentoring engineers and partnering with architects to translate business requirements into robust Snowflake-based AI infrastructure solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Own end-to-end architecture and design of optimized Snowflake data and AI infrastructure, including warehouses, Snowpark workloads, secure data architecture, AI-ready feature/data pipelines, model integration and AI application enablement.
  
  
Design and tune scalable Snowflake warehouses, tasks, streams, Snowpark services, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streamlit applications and cloud integrations, including compute sizing, query optimization, governance, access controls and high-throughput data access design.
  
  
Serve as an authoritative AI infrastructure expert on Snowflake, applying deep knowledge of Snowflake Data Cloud capabilities, data/AI application patterns, governance, security and cost levers.
  
  
Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security, compliance, cost and operational complexity.
  
  
Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation actions.
  
  
Drive architecture decision-making by documenting rationale, trade-offs, assumptions and dependencies so decisions are transparent, defensible and aligned with business SLAs and standards.
  
  
Define and maintain AI infrastructure roadmap inputs, capacity planning models, scaling strategies, cost forecasts and performance improvement opportunities.
  
  
Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization.
  
  
Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards.
  
  
Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with business outcomes and translate requirements into actionable architecture standards.
  
  
Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large-scale engineering solutions.
  
  
Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C++, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages.
  
  
Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform-native workflow tooling.
  
  
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced engineering or client delivery environment.
  
  
Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large-scale solutions.
  
  
Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.
  
  
Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns.
  
  
**Required Skills/ Experience**
Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake warehouses, databases, schemas, secure data sharing/access controls, Snowpark, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streams/Tasks, Streamlit and cloud ecosystem integrations.
  
  
Experience architecting scalable data and feature pipelines, AI application integrations, model-enablement patterns, governance, query/warehouse optimization and secure data access.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python, dbt/Terraform, CI/CD, DataOps, MLOps/AI enablement patterns, observability and incident response practices.
  
  
Ability to optimize Snowflake AI infrastructure for performance, cost, scalability, security, reliability and compliance.
  
  
Experience producing architecture decision records, reference implementations, standards, runbooks and reusable platform patterns.
  
  
Good to Have Skills
  
  
Snowflake certifications such as SnowPro Advanced Architect, SnowPro Advanced Data Engineer or related AI/data platform credentials.
  
  
Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail/e-commerce, telecom, manufacturing, energy or public sector environments where data/AI platforms must meet compliance, security, reliability and cost-control requirements.
  
  
Exposure to Snowpark, Cortex/AI features, vector search, retrieval pipelines, feature engineering, model enablement and AI application architecture.
  
  
Knowledge of Snowflake governance, secure data sharing, FinOps, infrastructure partner/vendor collaboration and production support operating models.

title: Applied Scientist
description:
**Role:**
Applied Scientist – Machine Learning

**Function:**
Machine Learning / Applied Science

**Location:**
Gurugram, India (Onsite)

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
Information Technology & Services, Computer Software, Industrial Automation

**About Company**

An industrial AI startup using Causal AI to help semiconductor and manufacturing companies find and fix the root causes of equipment and process failures. The company's Causal Intelligence Platform integrates multimodal factory data with explainable causal reasoning — going beyond surface-level correlations.

It is seed-funded at $3M and backed by Capria Ventures and Endiya Partners. The team of 19 engineers brings deep expertise in semiconductor defect analysis, causal reasoning, and graph intelligence.

The company operates with high agency, low bureaucracy, and a real-world-first culture. Solutions are built for explainability and deployed in secure, private environments — co-developed closely with customers.

**Position Overview**

This role sits at the intersection of applied ML research and production engineering, directly shaping the scientific direction of the company's Causal Intelligence Platform. The Applied Scientist will design and ship ML systems that turn chaotic multimodal industrial data — time-series, logs, waveforms, and documents — into reliable root-cause insights used by engineers at semiconductor fabs, utilities, and advanced manufacturing lines. The work spans LLM/RAG pipelines, time-series diagnostics, and scalable multimodal ingestion, with direct influence on product architecture and customer outcomes.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Design and develop ML algorithms for time-series, log, and waveform-based diagnostics across industrial datasets
* Build and optimize LLM/RAG pipelines including structured extraction, hybrid search, and domain-specific reasoning
* Architect scalable multimodal ingestion frameworks covering documents, logs, sensor streams, alarms, and images
* Productize ML models in collaboration with engineering teams into reliable, customer-facing systems
* Define use cases, benchmarks, and evaluation frameworks with product teams
* Lead ML projects end-to-end and contribute to patents, technical architecture documents, and research publications
* Prototype aggressively, iterate on real customer feedback, and own outcomes from research through deployment

**Must Have Criteria**

* BS/MS/PhD in AI/ML, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field
* 2–5 years of hands-on experience in ML research or applied ML roles
* Strong Python programming skills with a track record of building and scaling ML systems in production
* Hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG architecture, prompt engineering, or fine-tuning
* Demonstrated experience with time-series modeling, anomaly detection, or statistical signal processing
* Proven ability to take ML projects from experimentation to deployed, customer-facing systems

**Nice to Have**

* Startup or early-stage product-building experience
* Background in semiconductor, manufacturing, battery systems, or industrial data domains
* Experience building agents or autonomous reasoning systems
* Contributions to open-source ML or LLM tooling
* Direct experience working with customers or field engineering teams

**What We Offer**

* Frontier ML problems on multimodal industrial data with real, measurable customer impact
* High agency and direct influence on product and scientific direction at a seed-stage company
* ESOPs and rapid growth opportunities

* Experience with vector databases such as Milvus, FAISS, or ChromaDB.
* Knowledge of distributed training/inference frameworks like Ray, vLLM, or BentoML.
* Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

* Experience building AI agents using frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, or Autogen.

title: Senior Fullstack .NET Developer (5+ Years)
company: Ravarem Technologies - An Offshore Development Center
description:
**Position Summary**

We are seeking a senior full-stack developer to help modernize OT365, a mature brand operations platform used to control branding and the distribution of print and promotional items. The successful candidate will build new, maintainable platform capabilities while carefully analyzing and preserving the business-critical workflows embedded in the existing application.This is not a greenfield project in the conventional sense. The work combines modern product development with legacy-system analysis, incremental migration, customer-specific workflow discovery, and integration with production and fulfillment systems. The developer must be comfortable working where requirements are partly documented and partly expressed through existing code, database logic, configuration, and operational practice.

**About OT365:**

OT365 supports customer-specific product catalogs, permissions, personalization, proofing, ordering, approvals, inventory, production, fulfillment, and reporting. The platform has also been extended to support reusable event-resource scheduling, personalized data-merge products, timed multi-touch Easy Touch campaigns, analytics, and CRM-connected workflows.

Building on our MoneyGram project experience, an emerging product vision would extend OT365 to coordinated retail and multi-location brand rollouts. Potential capabilities include location-specific requirements, production and distribution of rollout materials, delivery and installation scheduling, installation-status and exception tracking, and photographic proof of completion. The detailed workflows are not yet defined and will require structured product and technical discovery.

The modernization program will establish a modern React user experience, a service-oriented .NET backend, reusable analytics, and defined integration boundaries, with Linux as the target operating system. PostgreSQL is the expected target database, but discovery must validate its feasibility, cost, performance, operational implications, and migration risk. The existing SQL Server database, Pageflex, and selected legacy components will remain important during discovery and may coexist with modernized capabilities during transition.

**Primary Responsibilities**

·     Design, build, test, document, and support modern OT365 capabilities using .NET, C#, React, JavaScript or TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and the existing SQL Server platform.

·     Develop RESTful APIs using a controller-service-model architecture with clear separation of business logic, data access, and transport concerns.

·     Implement PostgreSQL data access using Npgsql and well-structured ADO.NET, with clear separation between data access and business logic rather than relying on Entity Framework or Dapper.

·     Analyze the existing SQL Server schema, queries, stored procedures, data behavior, and integrations to support discovery, controlled coexistence, migration planning, reconciliation, cutover, and rollback.

·     Analyze existing ASP.NET, C#, JavaScript, jQuery, SQL, stored procedure, Pageflex, and configuration-based behavior to determine the true business requirement.

·     Translate legacy and customer-specific workflows into reusable platform capabilities, configuration, rules, and extension points.

·     Build responsive customer-facing and administrative experiences in React.

·     Support catalogs, user and group permissions, variable-data personalization, proofing, pricing, approvals, ordering, inventory, campaigns, events, production, fulfillment, and analytics.

·     Participate in discovery and technical design for emerging retail and multi-location rollout capabilities without prematurely converting incomplete product ideas into fixed implementation commitments.

·     Integrate with systems such as EPMS, Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft identity services, shipping carriers, tax services, and other customer or production platforms.

·     Create automated unit, integration, and regression tests for new behavior and migration-critical workflows.

·     Use Cursor AI as an integral development tool, creating and following project plans, rules, skills, and other repository guidance while independently validating generated code and technical decisions.

·     Develop, deploy, diagnose, and support the application in a Linux-based runtime environment.

·     Participate in Jira-based Agile delivery, including backlog refinement, estimation, sprint planning, daily coordination, code reviews, defect investigation, deployment, and production stabilization.

·     Document technical decisions, service contracts, data flows, operational procedures, and discovered legacy behavior.

·     Communicate risks and uncertainties early, propose options, and take ownership of work through verification and production readiness.

**Required Technical Qualifications:**

·     Strong professional experience developing production applications with C# and modern .NET.

·     Strong React experience, including component design, state management, API integration, forms, validation, and responsive user interfaces.

·     Strong PostgreSQL skills, including relational design, complex queries, transactions, indexing, performance analysis, concurrency, and operational troubleshooting.

·     Strong SQL Server skills sufficient to analyze and migrate a mature production schema, stored procedures, queries, data behavior, and integrations.

·     Practical experience with Npgsql and ADO.NET, or the ability to work effectively within an ADO.NET-based data-access standard.

·     Experience migrating production data and application behavior between database platforms, preferably from SQL Server to PostgreSQL.

·     Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating with third-party systems.

·     Experience modernizing, decomposing, or incrementally replacing a mature legacy application.

·     Working knowledge of authentication, authorization, role-based access, secure coding, logging, auditing, and error handling.

·     Experience with Git-based development, pull requests, code review, CI/CD pipelines, and disciplined release practices.

·     Demonstrated experience using Cursor AI for production software development, including creating and adhering to Cursor plans, rules, skills, and project-specific instructions.

·     Experience working with Jira and delivering software through an Agile development process.

·     Ability to diagnose behavior across the browser, API, application services, database, scheduled processes, and external integrations.

**Professional Qualifications:**

·     Demonstrated ownership: follows work from requirement through implementation, verification, documentation, and production support.

·     Strong analytical and reverse-engineering ability; does not require perfectly documented requirements before making progress.

·     Clear written and verbal English communication with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

·     Able to work effectively with a distributed U.S. and India team and maintain reliable scheduled overlap.

·     Comfortable asking precise questions, documenting assumptions, and distinguishing confirmed behavior from inference.

·     Customer-oriented judgment and respect for the operational consequences of changes to a production platform.

**Preferred Experience:**

·     ASP.NET Framework 4.8, JavaScript, jQuery, or migration from older Microsoft web stacks.

·     Familiarity with Linux command-line tools, application configuration, process and service management, logs, networking, permissions, scripting, deployment, and troubleshooting.

·     Pageflex, variable-data publishing, document composition, PDF or bitmap proof generation, or another rendering engine.

·     Print, promotional products, marketing operations, web-to-print, inventory, production, or fulfillment workflows.

·     CRM integrations, particularly Salesforce or HubSpot.

·     Dashboards, reporting, analytics, exports, or integration with business-intelligence tools.

·     Multi-tenant or highly configurable B2B SaaS applications with customer-specific rules and permissions.

·     Retail rollout, field service, installation coordination, location management, photographic verification, proof-of-completion, or exception and rework workflows.

·     SQL Server-to-PostgreSQL migration, including data-type mapping, sequence and identity behavior, stored-procedure replacement, validation, reconciliation, coexistence, cutover, and rollback.

·     Azure or comparable cloud infrastructure, observability, automated deployment, and application security.

**What Success Looks Like**

·     Produces maintainable, tested code that conforms to the agreed architecture and coding standards.

·     Learns the existing platform without blindly reproducing every legacy implementation choice.

·     Preserves critical customer workflows while helping move the platform toward reusable, configurable capabilities.

·     Reduces uncertainty by documenting discovered behavior, decisions, dependencies, and risks.

·     Works independently on well-defined outcomes while collaborating closely on architecture and ambiguous requirements.

·     Earns trust through predictable delivery, honest status reporting, thoughtful problem-solving, and production ownership.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a motivated DevOps Engineer with 1 to 2 years of hands-on experience in containerization, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, automation, and production support. The candidate will help build and maintain reliable deployment pipelines, manage infrastructure as code, support databases and application services, and strengthen security, backup, and disaster recovery practices.

**Key ResponsibilitiesCI/CD, Automation & Application Deployment**

* Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins for automated build, test, and deployment workflows.
* Build and manage Docker images and containers; support containerized application deployments and troubleshooting.
* Work with developers to deploy and operate Node.js applications across development, staging, and production environments.
* Write and maintain Bash scripts to automate routine operations, deployments, health checks, and log-management tasks.

**Cloud & Infrastructure Management**

* Provision, configure, and maintain infrastructure on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including compute instances, virtual cloud networks (VCNs), storage, access controls, and related cloud services.
* Use Terraform to define, provision, and manage infrastructure as code; maintain reusable configurations and track changes safely.
* Monitor application and infrastructure availability, resource utilization, logs, and performance; investigate incidents and support root-cause analysis.
* Maintain environment configuration and deployment documentation, and follow controlled change and rollback procedures.

**Databases, Messaging & Caching**

* Support the setup, configuration, monitoring, backup, restore, and troubleshooting of PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB.
* Support Redis for caching and related operational tasks, and Kafka for messaging/broker health and basic troubleshooting.
* Coordinate with development teams on database connectivity, performance, capacity, access permissions, and service availability.
* Help verify backup completion and participate in restore testing; follow approved procedures for database changes.

**Security, Reliability & Disaster Recovery**

* Apply infrastructure security best practices, including least-privilege access, secrets handling, secure configurations, and timely patching.
* Support access management, firewall/network rules, vulnerability remediation, and secure handling of credentials and configuration files.
* Assist in setting up and maintaining backup and disaster recovery (DR) procedures, recovery documentation, and periodic DR/restore tests.
* Monitor service alerts, respond to incidents, escalate risks promptly, and participate in on-call or scheduled production support as required.

**Required Technical Skills**

* **Containers:** Docker images, containers, registries, volumes, networks, and basic troubleshooting.
* **Cloud: Hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including compute, networking, IAM, storage, and monitoring fundamentals.**
* **CI/CD & IaC:** Jenkins pipeline fundamentals and Terraform for infrastructure provisioning.
* **Databases & Services:** Operational familiarity with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, Kafka, and Node.js application deployments.
* **Scripting:** Bash scripting for automation and routine system administration.
* **Security & DR:** Basic server hardening, access management, patching, backup/restore, monitoring, and disaster recovery concepts.
* **Operating Systems & Networking:** Linux administration, command-line troubleshooting, DNS, TCP/IP, ports, and basic networking.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree, diploma, or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 1 to 2 years of relevant experience in DevOps, cloud/infrastructure operations, deployment automation, or system administration.
* Candidates should be comfortable learning new tools, working with developers, and following documented operational procedures.
* Cloud, Linux, Docker, Jenkins, or Terraform certifications are a plus, but are not mandatory.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Reliability and success rate of CI/CD pipelines and deployments.
* Timely resolution or escalation of infrastructure and deployment incidents.
* Availability and health monitoring of applications, databases, and cloud resources.
* Completion of scheduled backups and participation in successful restore/DR tests.
* Infrastructure changes documented and managed through approved automation and change-control processes.

**Note:** The role is intended for an early-career engineer. Practical hands-on knowledge of the listed technologies is preferred. Experience supporting workloads hosted on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is required.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:

Support Engineer II
  
  
**Other Comparable Titles**
Product Specialist, Techno-Functional Architect
  
  
**Overview**
Join our leading AI-driven Global Supply Chain Solutions Software Product Company, recognized as one of the “Best Places to Work”. We are seeking a skilled Senior Support Engineer to enhance customer experience and provide robust solution support to Blue Yonder (BY) customers. The role demands an innovative, proactive approach to customer value creation and involves resolving complex technical issues with high expertise.
  
  
**Scope**

* Customer Solution Ownership: Achieve high customer satisfaction and positively impact NPS scores through end-to-end ownership, engagement, and proactive support.
* Global Team: Collaborate with 120+ global associates across the US, Mexico, India, Australia, and the UK, with rapid growth expected.

**Our Current Technical Environment**

* Software: BY Discrete, SQL, AppDynamics, Splunk, Oracle/MSQL, Java, GIT, Rest API, OAuth
* Cloud Architecture: MS Azure (ARM templates, AKS, Application gateway, Virtue Networks, Event Hub, Azure AD)
* Application Architecture: Scalable, resilient, event-driven, secure multi-tenant microservices architecture
* Frameworks/Others: Kubernetes, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Spark, NoSQL, RDBMS, Springboot, Gradle GIT, Ignite

**What You’ll Do**

* Support Engagements: Work with global technical and functional teams to support various customer engagements.
* Customer Interaction: Understand customer requests, support designed products/solutions to meet business requirements, and ensure high customer satisfaction.
* Issue Resolution: Address and resolve technical issues adhering to SLAs, document learnings, and create knowledge articles.
* Environment Management: Replicate and maintain customer environments and knowledge of customer solution architecture and integration points.
* Customer Satisfaction: Provide quality and timely solutions to improve customer satisfaction and follow-up until closure.
* Stakeholder Interaction: Interact with internal and external stakeholders and report to management.
* Process Improvement: Identify areas for improvement and automation in routine tasks.
* Continuous Learning: Stay updated with new technologies and products, demonstrate quick learning ability, and maintain good interpersonal and communication skills.
* Architecture Simplification: Drive simpler, more robust, and efficient architecture and designs.
* Product Representation: Confidently represent product and portfolio, including vision and technical roadmaps, within the company and to strategic customers when necessary.

**Detailed Responsibilities**

* Customer Issue Resolution: Understand customer-raised issues, especially in Cloud/SaaS environments, and take appropriate actions to resolve them.
* Code Review: Review product source code or design documents as necessary.
* Case Management: Own and resolve all cases for global customers, adhering to defined SLAs.
* Knowledge Sharing: Document learnings and create knowledge articles for repeated cases.
* Environment Replication: Replicate and maintain customer environments.
* Solution Knowledge: Maintain knowledge of customer solutions and customizations.
* Urgency in Interaction: Demonstrate a sense of urgency and swiftness in all customer interactions.
* Techno-Functional Point of Contact: Act as the techno-functional POC for all cases, ensuring timely triage and assignment.
* Global Collaboration: Utilize instant messenger and other tools to collaborate globally.
* Shift Work: Work in rotational shifts and be flexible with timings.
* Goal Achievement: Meet organizational and team-level goals.
* Customer Satisfaction: Improve customer satisfaction by providing quality and timely solutions and follow-up until case closure.
* Process Automation: Identify areas for improvement and scope for automation in routine tasks or activities.
* Team Player: Help in meeting team-level goals and be a team player.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree (STEM preferred) with a minimum of 5 to 7 years of experience.
* Team Experience: Experience in working as a team.
* Skills: Good communication and strong analytical skills.
* Technical Proficiency: Experience in working with SQL/Oracle DB complex queries.
* Domain Knowledge: Fair understanding of the Supply Chain domain.
* Support Engineering Experience: Experience in support engineering roles.
* Techno-Functional Expertise: Possess strong techno-functional expertise.
* Tech Savviness: Ability to adapt to any technology quickly.
* Critical Issue Support: Provide technical and solution support during critical/major issues.
* Tool Experience: Experience with varied tools such as AppDynamics, Splunk, and ServiceNow.
* Shift Flexibility: Flexible to work in shift timings:

+ Shift 1: 6 am to 3 pm
+ Shift 2: 2 pm to 11 pm
+ Shift 3: 10 pm to 7 am

By joining us, you will be part of a dynamic team committed to enhancing customer satisfaction through innovative solutions and continuous improvement in the supply chain industry.

title: PLC Automation Engineer
description:
About Our Company

We are an emerging technology company focused on Industrial IoT, smart manufacturing, factory automation, and manufacturing digitization.

Our solutions integrate industrial machines, PLCs, sensors, control panels, and IoT gateways with software platforms to enable real-time machine monitoring, production tracking, energy monitoring, and data-driven manufacturing.

We are looking for a versatile, hands-on engineer who can work across industrial automation, electrical control panels, embedded systems, and IoT communication.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. PLC Programming, HMI & SCADA**

\* Develop, program, and troubleshoot industrial PLC systems.

\* Work with Siemens, Mitsubishi, Delta, Omron, or equivalent PLC platforms.

\* Develop and configure HMI screens and SCADA applications.

\* Integrate PLCs with sensors, actuators, VFDs, motors, and other industrial equipment.

\* Implement machine logic, alarms, interlocks, production counters, and machine-status monitoring.

**2. Electrical Control Panel Design & Assembly**

\* Design, assemble, wire, and test industrial electrical control panels and PLC panels.

\* Prepare electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, and bills of materials.

\* Select and integrate MCBs/MCCBs, contactors, relays, SMPS units, terminal blocks, PLCs, VFDs, and protection devices.

\* Perform cable termination, ferruling, panel testing, and electrical troubleshooting.

\* Support machine installation, commissioning, and panel modification at customer sites.

**3. Industrial IoT & Machine Connectivity**

\* Integrate industrial PLCs and machines with IoT gateways and cloud-based platforms.

\* Work with Modbus RTU, Modbus TCP, RS485, and Ethernet communication.

\* Understand MQTT and HTTP/REST API communication for transferring machine data to servers.

\* Configure gateways to collect machine-running status, production counts, alarms, energy data, and other industrial parameters.

\* Troubleshoot communication issues between PLCs, gateways, and server applications.

**4. Embedded Systems & Firmware**

\* Understand microcontrollers such as STM32 and other embedded platforms.

\* Develop, modify, or troubleshoot embedded C/C++ firmware.

\* Work with GPIO, digital inputs/outputs, UART, RS485, Ethernet, and relevant communication interfaces.

\* Assist in developing firmware for Industrial IoT gateways and communicating with PLCs and servers.

\* Perform hardware testing, firmware debugging, and prototype validation.

**5. Testing, Deployment & Documentation**

\* Conduct factory acceptance testing, integration testing, and on-site commissioning.

\* Troubleshoot hardware, firmware, PLC, and communication issues.

\* Coordinate with the software development team to integrate machine data with dashboards and backend APIs.

\* Prepare technical documentation, I/O lists, wiring diagrams, PLC backups, test reports, and installation guides.

**Required Skills**

\* Hands-on experience with PLC programming and industrial automation.

\* Practical knowledge of HMI and SCADA configuration.

\* Experience in industrial control panel wiring and electrical troubleshooting.

\* Understanding of industrial communication protocols, particularly Modbus RTU/TCP and RS485.

\* Knowledge of IoT gateways and machine-to-server communication.

\* Basic practical knowledge of embedded C/C++ and microcontrollers.

\* Understanding of MQTT, HTTP, or REST API communication.

\* Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and documentation skills.

\* Willingness to work at manufacturing sites and travel when required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.

Experience with STM32 or similar microcontrollers.

Familiarity with Ethernet-based industrial communication and cloud-connected devices.

Knowledge of OPC UA, industrial networking, VFDs, and industrial sensors.

Experience integrating factory machines with IoT dashboards or production-monitoring systems.

**What We Offer**

Opportunity to work on complete industrial automation and IoT projects.

Hands-on involvement in developing and deploying Industrial IoT gateway solutions.

Exposure to PLCs, electrical panels, embedded systems, and software integration.

Opportunity to take ownership of technical projects and grow with an emerging technology company.

Application: Candidates should share their resume and details of their PLC projects, control panel work, IoT integrations, or embedded systems experience.

Candidates with practical project experience will be preferred over candidates with theoretical knowledge alone.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

**About Your Team**
Asset Management Platforms (AMP) is responsible for the design, engineering and delivery of technology solutions that support Fidelity's global Asset Management business. We partner with Research Analysts, Portfolio Managers, Asset Management Operations, Sustainability teams, and Distribution teams across Europe and Asia to deliver modern platforms that enhance investment research, knowledge discovery, data-driven insights, and informed investment decision-making.
  
  
Our team develops and supports the technology ecosystem used across multiple investment capabilities, including Equities, Fixed Income, Multi-Asset, Systematic Investing, and Sustainable Investing. Our platforms underpin critical research processes including company and market research, sustainability analysis, financial modelling, investment content management, knowledge discovery, collaboration, and research analytics, enabling investment professionals to generate high-quality investment insights and improve client outcomes.
  
  
As Artificial Intelligence continues to transform investment research and software engineering, we are investing in modern engineering practices that combine AI-assisted software development with AI-powered research capabilities to improve productivity, accelerate insight generation, and enhance engineering quality. The AI Solutions Engineer will play a key role in designing, developing, and delivering enterprise AI solutions while enabling engineering teams to adopt AI-enabled development practices safely, effectively, and responsibly across the Research Technology platform.
  
  
**About Your Role**
The AI Solutions Engineer is a hands-on technical engineer responsible for accelerating software engineering delivery through the effective adoption of Artificial Intelligence and modern engineering practices.
  
  
Working closely with Engineering Leads, Solution Architects, Product Owners and software engineering teams, you will identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI-assisted development while maintaining Fidelity's high standards for architecture, engineering governance, software quality and security.
  
  
You will combine strong software engineering expertise with practical knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI-powered development tooling to establish best practices for AI-assisted software engineering. This includes to make effective use of technologies such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI coding assistants to improve software design, implementation, testing, documentation and operational support.
  
  
The role is equally focused on engineering excellence and innovation. You will apply modern software and AI engineering practices through hands-on design, development, testing, deployment, and production support, contribute to architectural decisions within established standards, support the adoption and continuous improvement of CI/CD, DevSecOps practices and implement approved security, governance, and Responsible AI controls throughout the software development lifecycle.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to shape how AI is adopted across Asset Management Platforms, helping engineering teams deliver high-quality software faster while ensuring solutions remain secure, maintainable and aligned with Fidelity's engineering standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Engineering Enablement**

* Design, build, deploy, and support enterprise AI applications using LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool calling, and agentic workflows.
* Build grounded RAG pipelines covering document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata enrichment, hybrid retrieval, reranking, citation, and response validation.
* Develop AI agents capable of planning, reasoning, maintaining context, invoking approved tools, and executing governed business workflows.
* Integrate commercial and open-source models through platforms such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent services.
* Implement prompt and model configuration management, evaluation datasets, automated quality testing, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Evaluate AI technologies progmatically and select solutions based on business value, quality, security, latency, scalability, and cost.
* Coach and mentor engineering teams in the effective use of Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI-assisted development tools.

**Software Engineering**

* Build complete AI-assisted apps using modern frontend technologies such as Angular or React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Develop secure and scalable APIs, microservices, and orchestration services using Python, FastAPI, Node.js, or NestJS.
* Integrate applications with enterprise APIs, market and research data, document repositories, collaboration platforms, and structured and unstructured data sources.
* Work with Relational, NoSQL, Cloud and vector technologies such as PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Snowflake and pgvector.
* Participate in engineering practices, including modular design, API contracts, code reviews, performance optimization and secure coding.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Champion modern engineering practices including Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery and DevSecOps.
* Work with engineering teams to optimise software delivery pipelines.
* Promote unit test automation and engineering best practises throughout the SDLC.
* Create reusable AI services, reference implementations, engineering standards, and ready-to-use development capabilities that improve developer productivity.

**Architecture & Governance**

* Collaborate with Solution Architects and Engineering Leads to ensure solutions align with Fidelity's target architecture.
* Ensure AI-assisted software development complies with engineering standards, security policies and regulatory requirements.
* Promote sound software engineering principles including maintainability, scalability, resilience and observability.
* Implement controls for prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, unsafe responses, hallucination, unauthorized tool use, and third-party model risk.
* Balance innovation with appropriate technology risk management and governance.
* Communicate technical decisions, risks, trade-offs, and delivery progress clearly to engineering, architecture, product, and business stakeholders.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build strong working relationships with Engineering Leads, Product Owners, Solution Architects and software engineering teams.
* Partner with investment technology stakeholders to understand engineering challenges and identify opportunities for AI-enabled improvement.
* Establish and support communities of practice around AI-assisted software engineering.
* Deliver demonstrations, technical workshops and knowledge-sharing sessions with senior investment professionals.
* Stay informed on emerging AI technologies and assess their applicability within Fidelity's engineering environment.

**About You**
We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on AI Engineer who combines strong full-stack engineering capability with practical experience in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI. You are comfortable taking AI-powered applications and services through design, development, integration, testing, deployment, and production support within established architecture and engineering standards.
  
  
You are naturally curious about emerging technologies, enjoy solving complex engineering challenges, and apply AI pragmatically to improve business outcomes and developer productivity without compromising software quality, security, governance, or Responsible AI principles.
  
  
You are comfortable contributing to architectural and technical discussions with senior engineers, collaborating with Product, Architecture, Data Engineering, and Quality Engineering teams, and engaging with investment stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into secure, scalable, and production-ready AI solutions.
  
  
**Software Engineering Experience**

* 6+ years experience in software engineering, including experience leading the technical delivery of complex enterprise applications.
* Demonstrable experience building, deploying, and supporting production Generative AI or LLM-powered applications.
* Strong hands-on engineering skills in Python and at least one modern frontend stack using TypeScript with Angular / React.

* Passion for staying current with developments in AI-assisted software engineering.

**Technical Skills**

**Personal Attributes**

**Feel rewarded**

title: AI/ML Engineer: SIGINT & ELINT
description:
**About the Role**

Auric AI Labs is developing the world's most advanced AI-powered vision intelligence platform for defense applications. We are building an AI-native intelligence system from scratch. No legacy DSP pipeline, no AI-as-classifier-stage, no hybrid compromises. We need an engineer to build the deep learning models that detect, classify, geolocate, and fingerprint radar and communications emitters directly from raw IQ data.

**Why this role exists**

Most “AI in SIGINT” today is AI bolted onto a 1990s DSP pipeline as a final classification stage. Filter, threshold, extract feature,
*then*
hand the leftovers to a small neural network. Each stage before the network throws away information the network could have used. Each hand-crafted feature is a prior the model is forced to inherit.

We are not doing that.

We are betting that an AI-native architecture, where deep learning operates on raw IQ data with minimal pre-processing, learns its own features, and replaces the deterministic stack rather than supplementing it, delivers a 5-10x improvement on every metric that matters: detection in low SNR, classification of unknown waveforms, specific emitter ID, real-time anomaly detection, cognitive EW.

This is not an “AI feature” inside a conventional product. The model
*is*
the product.

**The actual problems**

* **The signals are designed to defeat you:**
  A modern LPI radar deliberately spreads its energy below the noise floor. A frequency-agile emitter changes frequency every pulse. Your job is to find structure that has been deliberately hidden.
* **You will not have real training data:**
  Zero, for the signals that matter most. Before you can train a model, you have to answer a harder question: what does it mean for a model trained entirely in simulation to be trustworthy in the real world? You will design the synthetic data pipeline, the channel models, the validation methodology, and the test for knowing when your simulator is wrong.
* **Every emitter is unique:**
  Two radars of the same model number have hardware differences (oscillator drift, amplifier non-linearities, timing jitter) that fingerprint them individually. The problem is not “which class of radar,” it is “have I seen this specific transmitter before, even in a different mode, even years ago.” Open-set, fine-grained, unlabelled.
* **The DSP world will tell you it cannot be done:**
  Some of their reasons are right. You will need to engage with them honestly, then figure out which ones are wrong and why.

**Who we are looking for**

Not a list of traits, those describe nothing. Specific, observable things we will recognise when we see them:

* **AI-native instinct:**
  Your first instinct on a new problem is not “what filter, transform, or heuristic applies here” but “what should a learned function take in, what should it output, and what is the right inductive bias.” You think in terms of data, loss, and architecture the way a DSP engineer thinks in filter coefficients. You see hand-engineered features as priors to be questioned, not assumed.
* **You reason about whether a model fits its data:**
  Not just whether it trains. You can look at a problem and argue, before writing code, why a particular architecture is or is not suited to the structure of the data it will see. You know that complex-valued signals, long-range temporal dependencies, and small distribution shifts each break specific assumptions, and you can name which.
* **You design experiments that can fail:**
  Most ML work tunes until the loss goes down. Yours starts with the question: what result would prove I am wrong. You build the falsifying test before you build the model. With synthetic data and no real ground truth, this discipline is the entire difference between research that works and research that only seems to.
* **You read papers to find what the authors did not say:**
  You reproduce a paper and notice the seed dependence the authors quietly omitted, the dataset preprocessing buried in the appendix, the hyperparameter that does most of the work. This habit is rare and it is what separates engineers who absorb a field from engineers who collect summaries of it.
* **The best work on your CV is work nobody assigned:**
  A paper you reproduced because the result seemed too clean. A side project that became four months. An idea you kept thinking about after the class or job that introduced it had ended. The single hardest thing to fake.
* **You can turn a vague objective into a defensible ML problem:**
  “Detect this radar” is not a specification. You can take an objective in plain English, decide what the inputs are, what the outputs should be, what the right loss is, and what evaluation would actually mean the system works in the field. This translation is most of the job.

title: Principal Member Technical Staff - Data engineer
description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

Nielsen’s Digital Content AI team builds and operates data-processing pipelines that turn digital audience and interaction signals into reliable, analytics-ready datasets. As a principal-level individual contributor, you will bring a Solution first mindset and strong data understanding to the full lifecycle: understand new data sources, build reusable ingestion and transformation workflows, validate and enrich data, publish it to downstream data platforms, and keep production processing dependable. You will lead multiple cross-functional projects through measurable business deliverables, providing technical direction through expertise and influence rather than formal people management. You will work across mobile, Connected TV (CTV), desktop/laptop and web use cases, partnering with product, data collection, platform, quality and downstream analytics teams.  
  

* Lead the technical design and delivery of batch and near-daily data pipelines, from raw inputs through curated outputs and publication to the Master Data Layer (MDL).
* Profile and interpret incoming telemetry from diverse data sources; identify data gaps and translate source formats into dependable processing logic.
* Apply an AI-first approach to engineering and operations: identify appropriate opportunities for AI-assisted data exploration, code and test generation, classification, anomaly detection and workflow automation; validate outputs rigorously and use AI responsibly with appropriate privacy and security controls.
* Design and operate real-time and streaming event workflows alongside batch pipelines, managing event validation, schema evolution, ordering and duplication, late or replayed events, processing latency, backpressure and failure recovery.
* Build and maintain parsers, configuration-driven workflows, event/session logic, business rules and schema mappings for application usage and in-app activity across mobile, CTV, desktop/laptop and web products.
* Develop data-stitching and transformation logic that correlates relevant sources, derives sessions and engagement measures, and produces consistent intermediate and curated datasets.
* Deliver data processing for streaming/video, e-commerce and advertising use cases, including event classification, purchase and product/category/search activity, app and web usage, and incremental dataset updates.
* Integrate reference and enrichment data—including content metadata and classification inputs—where required; collaborate with machine-learning and platform teams to operationalize model-based classification and enrichment.
* Build reusable frameworks for onboarding new applications, platforms, data sources and markets; support configuration, historical backfills, reprocessing and safe daily refreshes.
* Orchestrate and operate workflows using tools such as Airflow and AWS workflow services; monitor schedules, dependencies, retries, failures and data availability, and troubleshoot production issues through root-cause analysis.
* Implement and evolve automated data-quality controls, including schema and completeness checks, freshness and volume monitoring, null/range/duplicate checks, event consistency, stitching validation and reconciliation between processing layers and MDL.
* Create and use operational dashboards, alerts and job-level telemetry to make pipeline health, data quality, performance and processing costs visible; improve reliability and efficiency based on those signals.
* Optimize distributed processing and cloud data layouts for correctness, scalability, runtime and cost, working with technologies such as Spark, Parquet, Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Athena and EMR.
* Contribute to design reviews, code reviews, testing strategy, release readiness, runbooks and technical documentation; maintain clear data contracts, schemas and operational ownership boundaries.
* Provide technical direction and mentoring to engineers, lead moderately complex initiatives through influence, and communicate risks, dependencies, estimates and delivery status to cross-functional partners.
* Drive multiple projects or workstreams end to end, translating business needs into scope, milestones and technical plans; coordinate dependencies and stakeholders; and remain accountable for quality, adoption, timelines and measurable business outcomes—not people-management responsibilities.
* Handle sensitive data responsibly and follow Nielsen’s security, privacy, access-control and engineering practices.

 **Qualifications**

* Typically 10–15 years of relevant data engineering or data processing experience, or equivalent depth of expertise delivering complex production data systems.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; a relevant advanced degree or specialized certification is a plus.
* Expert-level SQL and strong programming skills in Python and/or Scala/Java, with substantial hands-on experience building distributed data-processing workloads using Apache Spark or a comparable framework.
* Proven experience designing, deploying and supporting production data pipelines and data-lake/lakehouse workflows on AWS or a comparable cloud platform.
* Practical experience with object storage and columnar formats such as S3 and Parquet, workflow orchestration, metadata/catalog services, and query engines such as Athena or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of data semantics and modeling, source-to-target lineage, schema evolution, data contracts, event-driven and batch-processing patterns, partitioning, incremental loads, backfills and idempotent/recoverable processing.
* Hands-on knowledge of real-time event processing concepts, including delivery guarantees, event-time handling, ordering, deduplication, replay, latency and backpressure.
* An AI-first engineering mindset and practical judgment about where AI/ML can improve data understanding, processing, quality or operational efficiency, with the ability to verify AI-generated outputs.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate unfamiliar or inconsistent source data, convert business rules into testable processing logic, and diagnose issues across multiple pipeline stages.
* A track record of independently driving multiple complex, cross-functional projects from problem definition through production delivery, with clear ownership of business outcomes and no reliance on formal people-management authority.
* Experience building data-quality checks, reconciliation, monitoring and alerting for production data products.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, sound technical judgment, and a track record of independently owning complex deliverables from discovery through production support.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs and coordinate delivery across teams.

 **Additional Information**

* Familiarity with stitching diverse telemetry, user activity, and digital interaction signals to derive session- or content-level metrics.
* Experience with content metadata/reference-data enrichment, entity matching, e-commerce event classification, advertising datasets or ML-assisted data processing.
* Experience with AWS services such as Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda, Step Functions, Glue, Athena and EMR, and with Grafana or Datadog for operational observability.
* Experience improving reusable onboarding frameworks, pipeline resilience, data lineage, operational cost visibility or large-scale backfill processes.

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: AI or ML Engineer

The ideal candidate will be at the heart of designing and building the intelligent systems that power our products and services. This role involves working on the complete lifecycle of machine learning projects, from data collection and preprocessing to model development, deployment, and maintenance. You will be a key player in transforming complex data into actionable insights and creating AI-driven solutions that solve real-world problems.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Design and Develop ML Models: Research, design, and develop machine learning and deep learning models to address business challenges. This includes everything from selecting the right algorithms to building predictive models from the ground up
* Data Pipeline and Preprocessing: Build and maintain robust data pipelines. You will be responsible for gathering data from various sources, cleaning it, and transforming it into a usable format for model training
* Model Training and Evaluation: Train, test, and validate machine learning models to ensure they are accurate, reliable, and meet business requirements. This involves performing statistical analysis and running experiments to optimize model performance
* Deployment and MLOps: Deploy trained models into production environments and maintain their lifecycle. You will implement MLOps best practices for monitoring, retraining, and updating models to ensure they remain effective over time
* Collaboration and Innovation: Work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to integrate AI/ML models into our applications and systems

* Build Generative AI & LLM Workflows: Design, develop, and optimize LLM-powered applications and agentic workflows, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and multi-step orchestration, to deliver production-grade generative AI features
* Ensure LLM Reliability & Evaluation: Establish evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and structured, type-safe output validation to ensure generative AI systems are accurate, safe, cost-efficient, and reliable in production
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

* Proficiency with Pydantic for data validation and enforcing structured, type-safe outputs from LLMs

* Demonstrated solid programming proficiency in languages like Python, R, or Java

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes
* Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling, fine-tuning, or prompt-optimization techniques
* Experience in Databricks
* Proven experience deploying and managing machine learning models in a production environment
* Knowledge of MLOps principles and tools
* Contributions to open-source projects or a solid portfolio of relevant personal projects

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Would you like to build highly available, scalable and distributed engineering systems for one of the largest data lakes in Amazon? Does Petabyte scale excite you?  
  
Spektr is Amazon Ads' exabyte-scale central data lake: the unified catalog for petabytes of campaign, ad-serving, billing, and measurement data. Hundreds of teams and Amazon's advertiser-facing AI agents depend on it for discovery, ingestion, transformation, and querying at scale. If you want large-scale engineering with tangible business impact, this is the team.  
  
We're rebuilding Spektr ground-up with an AI-first architecture, and building fully-automated domain agents that let customers manage their big data lifecycle in a single click. In parallel, we're adopting Apache Iceberg / S3 Tables with serverless compute, scaling horizontally via a data mesh pattern for 5 growth in volume and demand. If you thrive on greenfield experimentation and shipping things that matter to the business, keep reading.  
  
As a Sr SDE on this team, you will own the core platform services that power Amazon Ads data infrastructure, consolidating legacy systems into clean, API-first services that cut job creation time from weeks to less than a day. You will build MCP-enabled AI interfaces that let AI agents create and run data pipelines on Spektr at 99%+ success rate, directly shaping how GenAI discovers and consumes data across Amazon Ads. You will design and operate high-scale Java services on AWS-native infrastructure (Spark, EMR Serverless, Kinesis, Step Functions), processing petabytes of data daily at 99.9% availability. You will also drive deployment automation, replacing manual release cycles with CI/CD pipelines that accelerate delivery velocity for a platform serving Tier-1 advertising data systems.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Engage with key decision makers such as Product & Program Managers to understand customer requirements and brainstorm on solutions
* Design, code and deploy components and micro-services for the core job management pipeline
* Ensure testability, maintanability and low operational footprint for your code
* Participate in operational responsibilities with your team
* Innovate on AWS technology to improve latency, reduce cost and operations

  
A day in the life  

* Focus on core engineering opportunities to guarantee system availability that matches our data growth
* Work with a skilled team of engineers, managers and decision makers to consistently meet customer demand
* Automate monitoring of data availability, quality and usability via simplified metrics and drive innovations to improve guarantees for our customers

  
About the team  
The mission of the Ads Datalake team is to provide data that helps the advertising organization make informed analyses and decisions for our customers and to determine and deploy investments for future growth via a set of central and unified products and services.  
  
Our team focuses on simplicity, usability, speed, compliance, cost efficiency and enabling high-velocity decision making so our customers can generate high quality insights faster.  
  
We are a global team with presence across India and North America.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience

title: Cyber Operate- SOAR + Anthropic - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design and technology as we partner with clients to transform their security posture.
  
  
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Serving as a primary point of contact for client stakeholders and supporting security automation strategy and value realization
* Designing, developing, and managing SOAR playbooks for triage, enrichment, investigation, containment, escalation, and remediation
* Leading integrations across security platforms, including security information and event management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), identity and access management (IAM), threat intelligence, ticketing, firewall, email, cloud, and endpoint security tools
* Building and optimizing AI-augmented SOAR workflows, including alert triage, contextual enrichment, incident summarization, escalation logic, and governed decisioning
* Defining automation metrics, dashboards, technical documentation, and workflow improvements to enhance reliability, scalability, and security operations maturity

**The team**
Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes managing the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security, business transformation, and ensuring continuous compliance. Services include Cyber-as-a-Service, Managed Application Security, and Managed Extended Detect & Respond (MXDR).
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai**
**Shift Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**

Required:
  
  

* 6+ years of experience in cybersecurity, SOAR engineering, security automation, or security operations
* Experience with SOAR platforms such as Cortex XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, Swimlane, IBM Resilient, or Tines
* Experience with security operations center processes, security information and event management (SIEM) workflows, and incident response lifecycle activities

* Experience with Python, PowerShell, Bash, JSON, REST APIs, or similar scripting and automation technologies
* Experience designing AI-augmented SOAR workflows that include large language model (LLM)-based reasoning, prompt engineering, output validation, and human-in-the-loop decisioning

* Experience with multi-cloud security environments across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, detection engineering, and incident response practices
* Experience with information technology service management (ITSM) or case management tools such as ServiceNow or Jira
* Relevant certifications in cybersecurity, cloud security, or SOAR or SIEM platforms
* Experience with AI-assisted playbook generation, machine learning-based alert triage, or automated incident summarization in enterprise SOAR platforms
* Experience architecting Claude-based or equivalent agentic security operations center capabilities, including tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), extended reasoning, or structured outputs

title: Director – Cell Therapy IT, Software Engineering - Salesforce
description:
**Director - Cell Therapy IT, Software Engineering - Salesforce**
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to build the digital backbone that delivers next‑generation cell therapies to patients at scale?In this role, you will build and deliver the software platforms that power end‑to‑end activities related to cell therapy across development, manufacturing, and supply. Your work will directly influence how quickly and safely therapies move from treatment sites to manufacturing lines and back to patients.
  
  
You will lead a global engineering organization to compose, build, and industrialize enterprise-grade systems—spanning a Cell Orchestration platform built on Salesforce, AWS- services, and agentic AI automation. Partnering closely with operational and technology leaders, you will define a modern, scalable stack and translate strategy into robust, compliant solutions that drive speed, quality, and reliability. Based in Chennai, India, you will be at the center of a high-impact mission with global reach. How will you scale intelligent automation to orchestrate one of the most complex supply chains in healthcare?
  
  

* Accountabilities:
* Technology Planning and Architecture: Define and evolve a scalable technology strategy and reference architecture that underpins cell therapy operations from vein-to-vein, aligning platform choices with business outcomes.
* Platform Leadership: Lead the build and delivery of the Salesforce-based cellular coordination system, ensuring it is robust, scalable, secure, and fit for regulated environments.
* SDLC Ownership and DevSecOps: Own end-to-end software delivery from design to deployment and support, embedding DevSecOps, automation, and built-in quality to accelerate releases and reduce risk.
* Integration and Interoperability: Orchestrate integrations across Salesforce Service & Life Sciences -Cloud, MuleSoft, mobile-first apps, AWS services, and event streaming (e.g., Kafka) to enable seamless data and workflow continuity.
* Regulatory and Compliance Readiness: Bake compliance into every phase (GxP, HIPAA, FDA, GDPR), establishing traceability, validation, and auditability without slowing down delivery.
* Agentic AI Development or similar Automation experience is essential. Support advancing agentic AI to build autonomous software agents. They complete complex operational tasks and make decisions safely and at scale.
* Technical Roadmap: Life Sciences Cloud: Guide the industrialization of Agent-force Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud and the Advanced Therapy Module to enable next-generation cell therapy delivery.
* Engineering Excellence and GenAI-Enabled SDLC: Establish best- practices for full-stack engineering and leverage GenAI for code generation, testing, and SDLC automation to boost productivity and quality.
* Talent Leadership and Culture: Build and mentor a high-performing global-team of engineers and solution architects, cultivating innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Vendor and Partner Management: Manage external partners to deliver quality, secure, and compliant solutions, optimizing for value and speed.
* Innovation and Future-Readiness: Stay ahead of LLMs, autonomous agents, and cloud-native advances; translate emerging tech into practical upgrades that modernize systems and unlock new capabilities.
* Essential Skills/Experience:
* Bachelor's - degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 12+ years of software development experience, including 5+ years in a leadership role within life sciences, biotech, or manufacturing IT environments.
* Experience managing sophisticated Salesforce environments and multi-cloud implementations.
* Experience in leading multiple Product Development teams globally with engineering and delivery ownership
* Experience building and deploying software solutions in regulated environments (GxP , HIPAA, FDA).
* Expertise in modern development tools and platforms: AWS, Azure, Python, Salesforce (Service Cloud and Life Sciences), MuleSoft, Confluent / Kafka.
* Expertise delivering digital solutions across patient engagement, R&D, and product commercialization.
* Desirable Skills/Experience:
* Salesforce certifications (e.g., Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, Platform Developer II).
* Familiarity with AI/ML features within Salesforce ecosystem (Einstein, predictive analytics).
* Understanding of GenAI use cases in software development and automated testing.
* Hands-on experience with Agentic AI tools and frameworks
* Solid background in system architecture, secure coding practices, and cloud-native design.
* Why AstraZeneca:

Join a purpose-led team where advanced technology meets scientific ambition to change what’s possible for patients. Here, unexpected teams—engineers, data scientists, and operational leaders—get in the same room to tackle problems that matter, with the investment and freedom to experiment through hackathons, prototypes, and scaled delivery. You will help build the digital capabilities that accelerate medicines to those who need them, supported by a collaborative culture that values kindness alongside ambition, rigorous standards alongside creativity, and continuous learning at every step.
  
  
When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

If you’re ready to lead the platforms and AI-powered systems that deliver cell therapies faster and more reliably, take charge from Chennai. Develop what comes next.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Rotork is the market-leading global flow control and instrumentation company, helping our customers manage the flow or liquids, gases and powders across many industries worldwide.
  
  
Our purpose is Keeping the World Flowing for Future Generations.
  
  
**Job Description**
Join our dynamic and specialised team in a key role that will truly make a difference. As part of this team, you will act as the bridge between raw Engineering data and actionable business intelligence, contributing to one of the largest MS Dynamics 365 rollouts globally.
  
  
You will be embedded within the deployment team, focusing on the integrity, analysis, and visualization of data to ensure an accelerated and successful rollout of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 solution. You will interpret complex data sets, identify trends, and provide the Engineering teams with the insights needed to optimize product structures and configurations. You will be responsible for ensuring that the global transition to D365 is backed by high-quality, validated data.
  
  
Main Responsibilities:
  
  

* Data Insight & Trends: Identify, analyse, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets using statistical techniques to support D365 deployment.
* Reporting & Dashboards: Develop and maintain automated reporting capabilities (Power BI/Excel) to monitor data cleanliness and project progress.
* ETL Management: Extract, transform, and load (ETL) Engineering and CPQ data, ensuring seamless flow between legacy systems and D365.
* Data Quality Assurance: Define and implement data profiling and cleansing routines to ensure "single version of truth" accuracy through all migration test cycles.
* Stakeholder Communication: Present analysis results and data-driven solutions to senior leaders and internal customers to influence project timescales and strategy.
* Process Improvement: Locate and define new process improvement opportunities for data collection and management.
* Migration Support: Support production cut-over and provide early-life support by resolving data-related discrepancies in real-time.

Required Skills and Experience:
  
  

* Technical Proficiency: Strong knowledge of and experience with databases (SQL, etc.) and programming for data manipulation (Python, R, or ETL frameworks).
* Advanced Analytics: Expertise in Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, XLOOKUP, SUMPRODUCT), MS access and data visualization tools like Power BI.
* Data Lifecycle Knowledge: Proven experience in data profiling, Master Data Management (MDM), data cleansing, and complex data migrations.
* Analytical Mindset: Strong ability to collect, organise, and disseminate significant amounts of information with meticulous attention to detail and accuracy.
* Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to identify, investigate, and resolve data anomalies within large, complex datasets.
* Communication: Ability to effectively communicate technical data findings to a non-technical audience and build relationships across global Engineering teams.
* Agility: Comfortable working to tight deadlines and adept at switching priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Qualifications**
This role is perfect for someone -
  
  
Who holds a bachelor’s degree in engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field and with a professional experience of 5 - 8 years. You should be someone who thrives in a process-driven environment, excels at delivering end-to-end data solutions, and is technically oriented yet capable of influencing project stakeholders. You are disciplined, proactive, and passionate about turning data into a strategic asset.
  
  
Required Competencies:
  
  

* Decision-Making: Able to make data-backed decisions quickly during critical project phases.
* Analytical Rigor: A methodical approach to troubleshooting and data validation.
* Adaptability: Able to cope with the unexpected and manage data issues effectively during system transitions.
* Collaborative Spirit: A team player who shares insights but demonstrates a high level of individual initiative.
