title: AI Tech lead
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The AI Tech Lead serves as a key technical resource for the ZenAI platform and a critical escalation point for complex platform, integration, and engineering issues. The role requires deep platform expertise and is responsible for feature evaluation, advanced technical consulting, and development of the internal tools on which the team depends. The AI Tech Lead ensures that solutions deployed on ZenAI are optimized for performance, cost efficiency, and model selection; advises power users and technical audiences on advanced platform capabilities; and serves as the technical liaison to vendor engineering and support teams. This role will initially operate as an individual contributor and is expected to evolve into a people-leadership position with one to three direct reports as the team grows. The role also provides complementary coverage across time zones in partnership with the global AI Capabilities & Governance team.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Master Data and Capacity Model Ownership:**
  Own the capacity model and related planning master data in SAP IBP. Use the master data dashboard to identify gaps or inaccuracies in production run rates, changeover constraints, material lead times, resource calendars and other planning parameters. Coordinate corrections with the relevant supply planners and master data stewards responsible for maintaining the source data in ECC/S/4HANA.

* **Constraint Identification and Alert Generation:**
  Run SAP IBP heuristics and planning algorithms to identify constraints across the supply network. Generate system alerts for capacity bottlenecks, material shortages, safety stock violations, and demand-supply imbalances.

* **Scenario Building:**
  Build comparable scenarios with consistent assumptions that enable the Supply Planers in both the Mid-Term and Short-Term to evaluate alternatives. Ensure scenarios are structured, repeatable, and documented so that leadership can compare options on a level playing field.

* **Resolution Modelling:**
  Execute resolution modelling in SAP S4 ePPDS and SAP IBP to test proposed solutions before they are committed. Validate feasibility of allocation changes, schedule adjustments, and capacity rebalancing options.

* **Digital Twin Development:**
  Drive digital twin development as organizational maturity evolves. Progress the modelling capability through maturity stages: heuristic-based planning, optimizer-driven planning, and ultimately AI/Joule-enabled autonomous planning.

* **Data and Parameter Stewardship:**
  Serve as the owner of planning parameters, ensuring that safety stock targets, lot sizes, planning horizons, and aggregation rules are correctly configured and regularly reviewed for accuracy. Ensure issues identified through modelling or business plan validation are escalated and corrected at source where required.

**RESOURCES MANAGED**

***Financial Accountability***

None.

***Supervision***

Initially an individual contributor role. Expected to supervise one to three ZICC-based direct reports (AI Tech Analysts) over time as the team grows.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

The following education and experience qualifications are required or preferred:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field required; advanced degree preferred
* 8+ years of professional experience in technical roles such as software engineering, platform engineering, or solution architecture
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with API integrations, enterprise system connections, and automation platforms
* Demonstrated expertise with AI platforms and technologies, including agentic and generative AI
* Experience evaluating, testing, and rolling out new platform features in an enterprise environment
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues across multiple systems
* Experience building internal tooling, dashboards, and automation solutions
* Prior people leadership or team lead experience preferred
* Experience in the pharmaceutical, life sciences, or regulated industry preferred

**TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIREMENTS**

The following technical skills are required or preferred:

* Deep expertise with enterprise AI platforms and technologies, including agents, workflows, skills, integrations, and agentic AI; experience with Langdock, OpenAI, or similar platforms preferred.
* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) services and MCP gateways; experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and event-driven architectures
* Strong proficiency in Python and scripting languages for automation and tooling
* Experience with Databricks preferred
* Proficiency with database technologies (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and reporting frameworks
* Understanding of FinOps principles, token/cost tracking, and spend optimization
* Experience with AI-assisted coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, GPT Codex, or similar)
* Experience with Flask, Posit/RStudio, or similar application development frameworks
* Proficiency with collaboration tools (Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Confluence)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

**PHYSICAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

Primarily office-based at the Zoetis India Capability Center (ZICC) in Hyderabad, India. Occasional travel (0-10%). **Job Description**
**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Senior/Principal AI Engineer, you will drive the end-to-end development of GenAI applications, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, and LLM-based workflows, while ensuring high standards of performance, scalability, and responsible AI practices. You will provide technical leadership, mentor teams, and translate complex AI capabilities into impactful business solutions.
  
  
**What Will You Do In This Role**

* Implement Agentic AI systems leveraging frameworks such as LangChain, Google ADK, Strands, and Semantic Kernel, enabling multi-step reasoning and task orchestration.
* Apply advanced prompt engineering techniques (ReAct, few-shot learning, chain-of-thought, prompt chaining) to improve accuracy, determinism, and robustness of LLM systems.

description:
**Job Description**
The Core Engineering
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The Core Engineering builds and operates the platforms, applications, data solutions, models, and analytics that power critical processes for The Core divisions of the firm (e.g., Risk, responsible for the risk profile of firm activities; Controllers, responsible for the financial control and reporting obligations; Compliance, responsible for the firm’s compliance, regulatory, and reputational risks; Corporate Treasury, responsible for the firm’s liquidity, funding, balance sheet, etc.; and Human Capital Management, responsible for attracting, developing, and managing a global workforce). A centralized engineering structure in support of The Core enables a common platform model and operating framework that promotes consistent governance and scalable solutions, leveraging cloud, AI, and machine learning for innovation and efficiency. The Core Engineering’s 2,000+ engineers and strats deliver engineering, data, analytics, and quantitative capabilities within six business units:
  
  

* Metrics & Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm’s risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions
* The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics
* Financials & Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm’s financials and a wide range of reporting functions
* Non-Financial Risk & Controls: responsible for non-financial risk and control processes
* Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement
* Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk

**YOUR IMPACT**
Are you passionate about leveraging cutting-edge AI/ML techniques, including Large Language Models, to solve complex, mission-critical problems in a dynamic environment? Do you want to contribute to safeguarding a leading global financial institution?
  
  
**OUR IMPACT**
We are Compliance Engineering, a global team of engineers and scientists dedicated to preventing, detecting, and mitigating regulatory and reputational risks across Goldman Sachs. We build and operate a suite of platforms and applications that protect the firm and its clients.
  
  
**We Offer**

* Access to petabyte scale of structured and unstructured data to fuel your AI/ML models, including textual data suitable for LLM applications.
* The opportunity to work with state-of-the-art LLM models and agentic framework.
* A collaborative environment where you can learn from and contribute to a team of experienced engineers and scientists.
* The chance to make a tangible impact on the firm's ability to manage risk and maintain its reputation.

Within Compliance Engineering, we are seeking an experienced AI/ML Engineer to join our Engineering team. This role will focus on solving highly complex business problems using AI/ML techniques, incorporating latest emerging trends om building out vertical AI agents to run on data at massive scale.
  
  
**How You Will Fulfill Your Potential**
As a member of our team, you will:
  
  

* Design, develop, and implement GenAI-driven solutions, including agentic frameworks for automating compliance processes, RAG pipelines, and embeddings of compliance knowledge bases.
* Explore diverse AI/ML problems, such as model fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and experimentation with different algorithmic approaches to address novel business challenges.
* Develop, test, and maintain high-quality, production-ready code.
* Collaborate effectively with compliance officers, legal counsel, and other stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, maintainability, and adherence to coding standards. Promote best practices for AI/ML development, including version control, testing, and documentation.
* Stay current with the latest advancements in AI/ML platforms, tools, and techniques to solve business problems.

**Qualifications**
A successful candidate will possess the following attributes:
  
  

* A Bachelor's, master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, or a similar field of study.
* Preferably 3+ years AI/ML industry experience for Bachelor’s/Masters, 1 year for PhD with a focus on Language Models.
* Strong foundation in machine learning algorithms, including deep learning architectures (e.g., transformers, RNNs, CNNs)
* Proficiency in Python and relevant libraries/frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, scikit-learn.
* Demonstrated expertise in GenAI techniques, including but not limited to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model fine-tuning, prompt engineering, AI agents, and evaluation techniques.
* Experience working with embedding models and vector databases.
* Experience with MLOps practices, including model deployment, containerization (Docker, kubernetes), CI/CD, and model monitoring.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Curiosity, ownership and willingness to work in a collaborative environment.

Experience in some of the following is desired and can set you apart from other candidates:
  
  

* Experience with Agentic Frameworks (e.g., Langchain, AutoGen) and their application to real-world problems.
* Understanding of scalability and performance optimization techniques for real-time inference such as quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation.
* Experience with model interpretability techniques.
* Prior experience in code reviews/ architecture design for distributed systems.
* Experience with data governance and data quality principles.
* Familiarity with financial regulations and compliance requirements.

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

title: Senior Product Manager, Agents
description:
**Job Requirements**
**About Phenom and the Agents team**
Phenom builds the AI talent platform that large enterprises use to hire, onboard and grow their people. The Agents team builds the AI agents that do hiring work end to end: the Sourcing Agent, the Intake Agent, outreach and candidate-fraud detection, along with the platform products that power them.
  
  
Our bet is goal-driven hiring. A hiring manager states an outcome, such as "20 qualified ICU nurses in Dallas this quarter", and agents work backwards through intake, sourcing and outreach to deliver it. These agents run inside Phenom and inside the tools recruiters and managers already use, connected through open standards like MCP and agent-to-agent protocols.
  
  
The work is high-stakes: agents act on candidate data and influence employment decisions for some of the largest employers in healthcare, retail and financial services.
  
  
**About The Role**
You will own a portfolio of products end to end: what they do, how well they do it, and whether customers get the hiring outcomes they paid for. The role is one part platform product manager and one part forward-deployed builder. You will define how our agents are designed, evaluated and governed, and you will also sit with enterprise customers to map their hiring workflows, demo working agents, and see deployments through to steady state.
  
  
You may also own the platform products these agents depend on, such as the hiring ontology, sourcing and data collection, document intelligence, and the hiring-data pipelines that feed reinforcement learning. A great agent is only as good as the data, structure and feedback loops beneath it.
  
  
We want someone who builds, not someone who only manages a roadmap. You prototype with coding agents before writing a spec, you write your own evals, and you can explain exactly why an agent failed on a real customer's data.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India, working closely with customers worldwide, sales and leadership
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Own an agent**
Own the vision, roadmap and outcomes for an agent (for example, sourcing, intake or fraud), from problem definition through launch, adoption and iteration.
  
  
Define each agent's job in outcome terms: what goal it accepts, what it is allowed to do on its own, and when it hands back to a recruiter or hiring manager.
  
  
Own the metrics that prove agents work, such as goal-fulfilment rate, qualified candidates delivered, time to first qualified slate and recruiter acceptance, and report them in weekly business reviews.
  
  
**Own the platform products that power agents**
Own one or more shared platform products that agents build on, for example:
  
  
**Hiring ontology:**
the structured model of skills, roles, credentials and requirements that agents reason over.
  
  
**Sourcing and data collection:**
how candidate and job data is acquired, enriched, deduplicated and kept fresh, with consent and provenance tracked.
  
  
**Document intelligence:**
parsing and understanding resumes, job descriptions, credentials and onboarding documents.
  
  
**Hiring-data RL pipelines:**
turning recruiter decisions, candidate responses and hiring outcomes into governed training and reinforcement-learning signals that make agents better over time.
  
  
Treat each platform product as a product: define its internal and external customers, roadmap, quality metrics and service levels.
  
  
Decide what belongs in the shared platform and what belongs inside a single agent, so new agents reuse capabilities instead of rebuilding them.
  
  
**Set the quality bar with evals**
Build and maintain evaluation sets drawn from real customer workflows, and decide what "good enough to ship" means for each agent.
  
  
Run regression, LLM-as-judge and human-review loops with engineering and data science, and turn failures into prioritised fixes.
  
  
Balance accuracy, latency and cost as models and prompts change.
  
  
**Work forward-deployed with strategic customers**
Lead discovery with enterprise talent-acquisition teams: map their hiring workflows, systems and constraints, and find where agents create the most value.

Turn what you learn in each deployment into reusable configurations, playbooks and platform features, so the tenth customer is faster than the first.
  
  
**Must-have Requirements**

, and 8+ years combining PM with adjacent product-building roles (forward-deployed engineering, solutions architecture, product consulting, founder, customer success, sales, etc.). At least 1 of those years spent shipping LLM-powered products used in production.

title: Senior ML Engineer - Inference and Model Serving
description:
**Role overview**

We are hiring a senior ML engineer to own how our language and speech models run in production. Our

agents depend on fast, reliable inference: every spoken reply passes through speech recognition, a

language model and speech synthesis within a tight latency budget. You will serve these models on

GPUs at the lowest cost per call without losing quality, build the security and metering layers around

them, and automate how models move from registry to production. You will work with the architect on

model-serving interfaces and with the AI engineers who build agents on top.

**Key responsibilities**

**Language model serving**

* Serve open-weight language models with engines such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM or SGLang, tuned

for both time to first token and throughput.

* Apply continuous batching, prefix caching, speculative decoding and multi-LoRA serving to cut

latency and cost per request.

* Manage GPU memory with PagedAttention, FlashAttention, KV-cache quantisation and tensor

or pipeline parallelism, to maximise batch size and context length without out-of-memory

failures.

* Quantise models (INT8, INT4, FP8) and choose precision per model based on measured quality

and speed.

Speech model serving

* Serve streaming speech recognition and speech synthesis models on GPUs, with low time to first

partial transcript and time to first audio.

* Batch and schedule many concurrent audio streams on shared GPUs without letting one stream

delay another.

* Work with AI engineers to optimise end-to-end latency of the speech pipeline, from audio

chunking to model execution to streaming output.

* Place speech and language models on GPUs to balance latency, utilisation and cost when they

run side by side.

**Performance and quality**

* Profile models and serving stacks with tools such as NVIDIA Nsight Systems and Nsight Compute,

then find and fix bottlenecks.

* Use compilers and runtimes such as TensorRT, TVM or PyTorch Inductor to fuse operations and

reduce memory traffic.

* Check every optimisation against quality evals — task accuracy, word error rate and voice

quality — and block any change that makes a model faster but worse.

* Benchmark candidate models and hardware on latency, throughput, quality and cost, and

recommend what to serve.

**Scale, cost and deployment**

* Autoscale GPU capacity with traffic, plan capacity for peaks, and track cost per request, per call

and per tenant.

* Deploy to cloud, on-premises and restricted-network environments, including air-gapped installs

for enterprise clients.

* Build fallback paths across model sizes, replicas and providers, so traffic keeps flowing when a

model or node fails.

**Access, metering and MLOps**

* Design secure model endpoints with OAuth2, JWT and role-based access control, and enforce

strict multi-tenant isolation.

* Build high-throughput metering for input and output tokens, audio seconds and GPU time,

feeding rate limits, billing and cost allocation.

* Build CI/CD pipelines that profile, regression-test and deploy models from registries such as

MLflow or Hugging Face Hub into Kubernetes.

* Monitor latency, throughput, GPU utilisation and errors with OpenTelemetry and Prometheus,

and respond to production incidents.

**Required qualifications and skills**

* Strong Python and working C++ skills.
* Hands-on experience serving language models in production with engines such as vLLM,

TensorRT-LLM, SGLang or Triton Inference Server.

* Experience serving or optimising speech or other streaming models under strict real-time

latency budgets.

* Solid understanding of GPU architecture — streaming multiprocessors, memory hierarchy,

asynchronous copies — and how it drives inference performance.

* Practical experience with quantisation, batching strategies, KV-cache management and model

parallelism.

* Experience profiling and fixing performance problems with tools such as Nsight Systems or

PyTorch Profiler.

* Experience running GPU workloads on Kubernetes, with CI/CD, monitoring and autoscaling.
* Ability to measure quality alongside speed, and to explain trade-offs between latency,

throughput, cost and accuracy.

* A degree in computer science, computer or electrical engineering, or a related field, or

equivalent practical experience, with clear examples of delivered work.

**Preferred experience**

* Writing or modifying custom GPU kernels in CUDA or Triton, including kernel fusion.
* Deep familiarity with recent NVIDIA architectures such as Ampere, Hopper and Blackwell.
* Serving large models (70B+ parameters) across multiple GPUs or nodes under strict latency

budgets.

* API gateways and rate limiting (Envoy, Kong), and streaming systems (Kafka, Redpanda).
* Air-gapped or on-premises GPU deployments for enterprise clients.
* Serving vision or multimodal models.
* A masters degree or PhD in a relevant field.

**Success in the role**

Success means our language and speech models respond fast enough for natural conversation, at a cost

per call that scales with the business. In your first six months, that looks like:

* Latency: speech and language models meet their per-hop budgets at p95 under peak traffic.
* Cost: cost per call and GPU utilisation are tracked, and both improve measurably.
* Quality: no optimisation ships without passing quality evals, and quality never drops unnoticed.
* Reliability: model endpoints stay available through node and model failures, with fallbacks that

work.

* Deployment: new models reach production through an automated, tested pipeline, in the cloud

or on-premises.

* Metering: every tenants usage is measured accurately for rate limits and billing.

title: Research Engineer, Portfolio Management Group (PMG Tech), Associate
description:
**About This Role**
Your team
  
  
Portfolio Management Group Technology (PMG Tech) is the horizontal technology platform within BlackRock’s Portfolio Management Group. The team integrates portfolio management, risk management, and quantitative workflows with advanced engineering, artificial intelligence, and data capabilities, making technology a strategic driver of investment and risk outcomes.
  
  
Risk and Quantitative Analysis (RQA) provides independent oversight of BlackRock’s investment and enterprise risks through quantitative analysis, risk expertise, and evidence-based insights. In partnership with PMG Tech, RQA uses advanced engineering, artificial intelligence, and data platforms to enhance decision-making, strengthen risk management capabilities, and scale innovative solutions across investment, operational, technology, and enterprise risk domains.
  
  
Your role and impact
  
  
As a Research (AI) Engineer, you will partner with RQA, PMG Tech, and business stakeholders to develop data workflows, analytics solutions, and artificial intelligence-assisted capabilities that transform risk and quantitative challenges into actionable insights.
  
  
Embedded within a PMG Tech Pod, a business-focused, cross-functional team, you will collaborate with risk managers, quantitative analysts, artificial intelligence leads, and engineers. You will deliver high-quality data assets, analytical tools, and technology solutions that support risk management and informed decision-making.
  
  
This role requires an understanding of business problems and risk workflows, along with the ability to translate requirements into scalable data solutions. You will use Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), cloud data platforms, workflow orchestration, and visualization tools to develop and operate data-intensive applications. You will also apply data quality practices, continuous integration and continuous delivery processes, and data operations to create reliable, production-grade solutions.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Build and maintain web-harvesting processes, data pipelines, transformations, and workflows that support research hypotheses and data analysis.
* Develop platform capabilities that source high-quality data and create scalable, reliable, and maintainable data solutions.
* Create research utilities, prototypes, dashboards, and exploratory tools that support insight generation and research workflows.
* Engage with investors, researchers, risk managers, and quantitative analysts to understand their workflows and translate business requirements into effective data solutions.
* Collaborate with core engineering teams to adopt data-extraction and data-management capabilities that accelerate investment research.
* Partner with artificial intelligence leads to source data and build applications that supplement research with artificial intelligence-assisted insights.

Your experience
  
  

* Strong programming capabilities in Python and Structured Query Language, supported by analytical thinking and effective problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated experience in data engineering, data analytics, or the development of data-intensive applications.
* Knowledge of, or curiosity about, investment research and risk-management workflows or similar domains.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, research, and business teams and translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, data science, data engineering, or a related field.
* Experience with web-harvesting techniques and cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform, and Google Cloud Storage.
* Exposure to artificial intelligence and machine learning tooling, large language model experimentation, retrieval-augmented generation, summarization, and question-and-answer applications. Experience with dashboards, notebooks, lightweight research tools, enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, or directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing is beneficial.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Solution Engineer : Mumbai
description:

.

title: Head - Technology & AI | E-Commerce | AI Agents | Engineering & Automations
description:
**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Ergode builds and scales digital-first businesses across global marketplaces.

We have made a clear strategic choice: **Technology, Artificial Intelligence and automation will sit at the core of how we scale revenue, improve margins and increase productivity.**

We are looking for a **hands-on Technology & AI leader** who can convert business problems into working, adopted systems — quickly.

This is not a traditional IT leadership role.

You will own the intersection of **business, engineering, AI, automation, data, integrations, infrastructure and security**. You will work directly with the CEO and business leaders to identify high-impact problems, decide what should be built internally versus externally, and ensure solutions move from idea production adoption measurable business outcome.

Some of our systems need modernization. Some need stronger ownership and architecture. Others need to be replaced or rebuilt. We would rather be transparent about that upfront.

We need someone who enjoys that challenge.

**What You Will Own**
=====================

**1. Technology Execution & Delivery**
--------------------------------------

You will create an execution culture where technology commitments translate into shipped outcomes.

You will:

* Run Technology on clear weekly priorities with an owner, deadline and measurable outcome for every major initiative.
* Establish strong engineering execution across product development, integrations, automation, infrastructure and AI.
* Track commitments through completion — not merely development activity.
* Identify blockers early and make fast build/buy/outsource decisions.
* Hold internal teams and external partners accountable for scope, timelines, quality and business outcomes.
* Build clear visibility from:

**Business Requirement**  **Development**  **Production**  **Adoption**  **Business Impact**

* Develop engineers and technology managers into stronger owners and future leaders.
* Create sufficient documentation, architecture standards and ownership so no critical system depends on one employee or vendor.

### **Success means:**

Leadership should never need to repeatedly ask, **“Where is this project stuck and who owns it?”**

**2. Business-First Technology Strategy**
=========================================

Technology exists to improve business outcomes.

You will:

* Deeply understand how Ergode makes money across marketplaces, brands and channels.
* Understand marketplace fees, margins, inventory, pricing, advertising, catalogue operations, fulfilment and customer experience.
* Own the Technology & AI roadmap based on impact on:
  + Revenue
  + Gross margin
  + Productivity
  + Operating cost
  + Speed
  + Customer/vendor experience
* Work directly with business heads to identify operational bottlenecks.
* Challenge processes that should be eliminated or simplified before automating them.
* Translate business problems into scalable technology solutions.
* Own technology economics including cloud, AI/token usage, software licences, development and outsourcing.
* Report technology performance to leadership in **business outcomes rather than project activity**.

**3. AI, Agents & Intelligent Automation**
==========================================

AI is not an innovation project at Ergode. It is becoming part of how the company operates.

You will:

* Identify high-volume and high-value manual work suitable for AI or automation.
* Build and deploy AI agents and GenAI workflows into **real production environments**.
* Develop reusable AI architecture rather than disconnected experiments.
* Integrate AI into areas including:
  + Catalogue and content
  + Marketplace listings
  + Pricing
  + Inventory
  + Customer support
  + Sales
  + Finance
  + HR
  + Reporting and decision support
* Build with LLM APIs, RAG, agentic workflows, orchestration frameworks and workflow automation.
* Establish before/after baselines for every major automation.
* Measure:
  + hours/FTE capacity saved
  + cycle-time reduction
  + cost reduction
  + quality improvement
  + revenue/margin impact
  + user adoption
* Kill pilots that do not produce value and scale the ones that do.
* Ensure business teams actually adopt what Technology builds.

### **We are not looking for:**

Someone who has attended AI courses or built demos.

### **We are looking for:**

Someone who has **put AI into production and can show what changed because of it.**

**4. E-commerce Platforms & Marketplace Technology**
====================================================

Our technology must support a complex global marketplace operation.

You will own and strengthen:

* Marketplace integrations including Amazon SP-API, Walmart, eBay and other channels.
* Catalogue and listing infrastructure.
* Pricing and quantity synchronization.
* Order processing.
* Inventory and warehouse integrations.
* Returns, refunds and reconciliation workflows.
* Marketplace reporting and operational intelligence.
* API reliability and monitoring.

You will build toward a connected architecture where catalogue, inventory, order and marketplace information flows reliably across systems.

The goal is not simply integration.

The goal is **reliable commerce at scale**.

**5. Product & Platform Ownership**
===================================

You will take ownership of Ergode’s core internal technology platforms and ensure they become dependable business systems.

This includes:

* evaluating existing architecture,
* identifying technical debt,
* establishing clear module ownership,
* improving reliability and usability,
* prioritising development based on business value,
* and driving adoption after launch.

Technology is not complete when code is deployed.

**A feature is complete when the business can reliably use it and the expected outcome is visible.**

**6. Data Foundation & Decision Intelligence**
==============================================

AI is only as strong as the underlying data.

You will:

* Build reliable data flows across business systems.
* Establish clear sources of truth for critical business information.
* Reduce duplicate datasets and manual reconciliation.
* Improve data quality and ownership.
* Enable dashboards and AI systems to consume trustworthy business data.
* Build APIs and integration layers that allow new agents and applications to be deployed quickly.

**7. Architecture, Cloud & Engineering Quality**
================================================

You should be technically strong enough to challenge architecture and engineering decisions yourself.

You will:

* Review architecture for scalability, reliability, maintainability, security and cost.
* Establish coding, testing, documentation and deployment standards.
* Strengthen CI/CD and monitoring.
* Review estimates rather than blindly accepting them.
* Prototype when speed requires it.
* Make pragmatic technology choices rather than over-engineering.

We expect a leader who can move comfortably between a **CEO conversation about ROI and an engineering conversation about architecture.**

**8. Security, Reliability & AI Governance**
============================================

You will own the reliability and security of Ergode’s technology environment.

Responsibilities include:

* Cloud and infrastructure reliability
* Monitoring and uptime
* Incident management
* Root-cause analysis
* Backups and disaster recovery
* Identity and access management
* SSO
* Endpoint/device security
* Data protection

You will also establish practical AI governance covering:

* which company information can be shared with which AI systems,
* permissions available to AI agents,
* human review requirements for critical decisions,
* auditability,
* and acceptable AI use.

Compliance should appropriately address DPDP and relevant international privacy/security requirements.

**9. Build vs Buy vs Outsource**
================================

We do not believe everything must be built internally.

We do believe **Ergode must own the outcome.**

You will decide when to:

**BUILD** — when capability creates strategic advantage.

**BUY** — when a reliable product already solves the problem economically.

**OUTSOURCE** — when an external specialist can deliver faster.

For outsourced work, you will own:

* requirements,
* architecture,
* vendor selection,
* commercial evaluation,
* milestones,
* SLAs,
* quality,
* security,
* source code,
* documentation,
* handover.

No critical Ergode technology should become permanently dependent on one vendor or individual.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within the first 6–12 months, we expect visible movement across these areas:

### **Execution**

* Major technology initiatives have clear owners, deadlines and outcomes.
* Delivery predictability improves materially.
* Chronic technology bottlenecks reduce.

### **AI & Automation**

* Multiple AI agents/workflows are operating in production.
* Automation impact is quantified monthly.
* Manual workload is measurably reduced in targeted processes.
* Business adoption is visible rather than assumed.

### **Core Platforms**

* Critical marketplace and internal systems become more reliable.
* Technical ownership and documentation improve.
* Important business workflows no longer depend on fragile manual processes.

### **Data**

* Critical catalogue, inventory, order and operational data become more connected and trustworthy.

### **Business Partnership**

* Business leaders increasingly bring problems to Technology because they expect **working solutions, not project discussions**.

**Who We Are Looking For**
==========================

**Must-Haves**
--------------

* 10+ years of meaningful technology experience.
* 5+ years leading engineering/technology teams.
* Evidence of personally owning major technology delivery.
* Strong understanding of software engineering, architecture, APIs and integrations.
* AI/automation systems deployed into production with measurable impact.
* Practical experience with:
  + LLM APIs
  + RAG
  + AI agents / agentic workflows
  + Python
  + workflow automation platforms such as n8n/Make or equivalent
* Cloud experience across AWS, Azure or GCP.
* API/integration architecture experience.
* DevOps, deployment and monitoring understanding.
* Ability to evaluate architecture, code/design decisions and engineering estimates.
* Experience managing external technology partners.
* Experience owning meaningful technology budgets.
* Strong business and commercial orientation.

**Strongly Preferred**
----------------------

Experience in one or more of:

* E-commerce
* Marketplaces
* Retail technology
* D2C
* SaaS/platform businesses
* ERP/OMS/WMS
* Amazon SP-API or other marketplace integrations
* High-volume order/catalogue/inventory systems
* AI-first enterprise transformation

**Who Will NOT Fit This Role**
==============================

This role is probably not for you if:

* Your experience is predominantly IT infrastructure/helpdesk.
* Your leadership style is primarily delegation without technical depth.
* Your AI experience consists mainly of courses, certifications or prototypes.
* You measure success by projects delivered rather than business outcomes achieved.
* You require large teams before you can execute.
* You prefer lengthy planning cycles over shipping, learning and improving.
* You cannot challenge engineers, vendors and business leaders when necessary.

**The Person Behind the Resume**
================================

We care about experience, but we care equally about how you operate.

We value people who demonstrate:

**Ownership. Bias for action. Curiosity. Commercial thinking. High standards. Candour. Learning velocity.**

We would rather hire a builder who has repeatedly solved difficult problems than someone with the perfect title.

title: Staff Program Manager, FinOps and Procurement Operations
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do**

As a Staff Program Manager in Product Operations, you will run the financial operations that keep Teradata's product organization licensed, funded, and accountable for spend. You will own day-to-day execution across software purchasing, cloud FinOps, cross-charges, and budget tracking, and you will run the controls and reporting that leaders use to make spend decisions. Based in India, you will work closely with global Product, Engineering, Finance, and Procurement stakeholders.

* **Software purchasing and PO operations:** Own the end-to-end purchasing cycle for product software, tooling, and services, from usage analysis and vendor quotes through requisitions in Oracle Fusion, approval routing, contract signature, PO issuance, receipting, and invoice resolution.
* **Renewals and licensing:** Maintain the product software license and renewal register, surface renewals well before term end, and work with Procurement and system owners to confirm options, terms, and required license quantities.
* **FinOps and cloud-spend execution:** Track R&D cloud spend against budget across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, prepare recurring spend reporting, validate cloud provider invoices and marketplace offers, and coordinate savings plan and commitment purchases while monitoring realized savings.
* **Cloud cost optimization:** Coordinate cost optimization workstreams, including account decommissioning and transfers, tagging and cost allocation, and follow-through with product and engineering owners on savings actions.
* **Cross-charge and budget tracking:** Track cloud, tooling, and software budgets and outlooks, validate and reconcile monthly cross-charges and chargebacks between departments, and reconcile monthly against Finance records with clear variance explanations.
* **Planning cycles:** Support annual budgeting and quarterly outlooks by working with budget owners and Finance on spend assumptions, license requirements, and forecast changes.
* **Operational controls:** Run controls over purchasing and spend, including approval hierarchy checks, complete cost center and GL coding, confirmation of delivery before receipting, and audit-ready records.
* **Reporting and follow-through:** Produce recurring reports and dashboards for Product Operations and product leadership, and drive open actions, missing data, and blockers to closure.
* **AI and automation:** Apply foundational AI skills to automate routine reporting, reconciliation, and follow-up, and identify manual steps that should be simplified or retired rather than automated.

**Who You’ll Work With**

You will work as part of Teradata's Product Operations team, collaborating daily with:

* Finance partners on budgets, outlooks, cross-charges, and monthly reconciliation.
* Procurement on supplier engagement, contract renewals, purchase orders, and invoice resolution.
* Product and Engineering leaders, budget owners, and system owners on spend ownership, license requirements, and cost optimization actions.
* Cloud FinOps and cloud operations teams on spend data, tagging, cost allocation, and savings initiatives.
* Software vendors, resellers, and cloud service providers on quotes, order forms, and billing.
* US-based Product Operations leadership during a regular daily overlap with US business hours.

Collaborate with colleagues who share a commitment to leveraging AI responsibly, ensuring our people and customers benefit from the opportunities AI creates.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* 6+ years in procurement operations, software asset management, FinOps, or financial operations, including at least 3 years in enterprise software, cloud, or technology companies.
* Hands-on procure-to-pay experience in an ERP such as Oracle Fusion, including requisitions, approval workflows, purchase orders, receipts, and invoice matching.
* Working knowledge of public cloud billing and cost management on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including invoice validation, savings plans or commitments, and cost allocation.
* Demonstrated experience with budget and forecast tracking, variance analysis, and cross-charge or chargeback reconciliation with Finance.
* Advanced Excel skills and experience building recurring reports or dashboards in Power BI or similar tools.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to drive follow-up across functions and time zones and escalate issues early.
* Ability to work a schedule that provides a regular daily overlap with US business hours.
* Foundational AI skills and the ability to understand how AI can be applied to improve outcomes in your area of expertise.

**What You'll Bring**

* FinOps Certified Practitioner or a comparable certification.

title: Sr. Partner Operations Manager, Prime Video
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

How often have you had an opportunity to be at ground zero of a disruptive, fast-growing, and revolutionary global Amazon service? How frequently do you get to start from the foundation and solve customer needs at a global scale in a fast-growing entertainment streaming industry? At Prime Video, we are pioneering a new generation of digital supply chain at a remarkable speed to accelerate our market position and global reach. If this sounds interesting, come build the future of streaming entertainment with us!  
  
Prime Video is a global premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies — all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business — available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic and global environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. The Partner Operations Management (POM) team is looking for a bright, partner-obsessed, driven, and creative individual to join our team in India. POM is responsible for driving a world-class partner experience through enabling partners to deliver assets of all varieties on-time, in full and at the Prime Video quality bar.  
  
As a Sr. Partner Operations Manager, you will serve as the primary relationship owner for our third-party studios, content distributors, and fulfillment vendors (collectively "partners") in India. You will build and nurture long-term, strategic partnerships — engaging studio executives to influence their supply chain investments, delivery workflows, and feature adoption strategies. You will be the voice of the partner within Prime Video, capturing partner-specific insights and regional nuance to ensure our partners succeed and our customers benefit.  
  
In this role, you will own the end-to-end partner experience — from driving timely and cost-effective delivery of source materials to identifying improvement opportunities through reporting, data analysis, and innovative workflow enhancements. You will conduct regular partner business reviews, manage complex escalations, and tailor strategies to individual partner contexts across India's diverse content landscape (including SVOD, AVOD, TVOD,Channels, and partner direct business lines). The ability to develop, own, and report on key performance metrics is critical.  
This role will work with executive-level leadership within the streaming community. Internal teams include content acquisition, marketing, engineering, content processing, legal, finance, and accounting teams. External teams vary based on partner and may include marketing, rights management, IT, engineering, localization, compliance, and digital operations teams.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned studio partners in India, building trusted executive-level relationships that influence partner investments in delivery capabilities and content quality
* Conduct trend analysis and deep dives on partner performance against KPI targets to drive perfect delivery to Prime Video
* Act as the voice of the partner — capturing partner-specific feedback, regional nuances, and operational realities to advocate for solutions that enable partner success
* Own and lead regular partner business reviews (WBRs,MBRs, QBRs), translating performance data into actionable strategies tailored to each partner's context
* Manage complex escalations that may span across multiple business units, driving resolution while maintaining strong partner relationships
* Distill insights on partner capabilities to advise and enhance business strategies such as new content and market launches in India
* Drive partner adoption of delivery best practices and new platform capabilities by tailoring strategies to individual partner needs and technical maturity
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, product development, and cost reduction through data analysis and direct partner engagement
* Drive long-term solutions through next-gen automation and AI innovations to complex workflows
* Mentor team members and help develop talent across the organization

  
A day in the life  

* Engage directly with studio partner executives to understand their priorities, address delivery challenges, and align on strategic goals
* Lead partner performance reviews, using data-driven insights combined with partner context to identify root causes and drive improvements
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure partner feedback is heard and acted upon, influencing how Prime Video builds and evolves its tools and features
* Design workflow strategies for accelerated content delivery in multiple languages and formats across India's diverse content ecosystem, while simplifying and eliminating redundant practices
* Streamline business and technology solutions that strengthen our partnerships while advancing our services
* Work effectively in a team environment and cross-functionally with Prime Video Catalog technology teams, engineers, business teams, analytics, and product

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 7+ years of account management, project or program management or buying experience, or MBA
* Experience communicating results to senior leadership, or experience in building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience building and growing relationships with internal and external partners
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Can work proactively and independently, meet deadlines, and deliver on projects and tasks
* Experience negotiating with internal and external stakeholders

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree or above in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
* Knowledge of digital video landscape, including solid understanding of digital video distribution technologies
* Experience in analyzing data to drive decisions
* Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
* Experience in the entertainment industry
* Experience building and maintaining relationships with business partners

The role exists to ensure that AI agents, copilots, RAG applications, model deployments, enterprise knowledge assistants, and AI-enabled business workflows are designed using secure, scalable, compliant, cost-aware, and reusable architecture patterns.

The architect will work closely with business groups, platform owners, security, infrastructure, integration, data engineering, governance, and external partners to translate AI use cases into production-ready solution architectures.

The AI Architect – Microsoft Foundry will be responsible for:

**Strategy & Planning:**

* Define and govern Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI Foundry architecture principles, design standards, and reusable reference patterns for enterprise AI solutions.
* Design and Implement Foundry-led and hybrid Foundry + Databricks solution patterns for copilots, agents, RAG applications, business assistants, and AI-enabled workflows.
* Translate approved business AI use cases into solution architecture documents, platform-fit decisions, integration patterns, and production-readiness plans.
* Define model selection guidance covering accuracy, latency, cost, privacy, security, data sensitivity, and business purpose.
* Establish architecture guardrails for prompt engineering, RAG grounding, tool calling, human-in-the-loop approvals, write-back controls, and auditability.
* Support Orbia AI governance, ARB submissions, decision records, architecture exceptions, and platform standards for Microsoft Foundry solutions.
* Partner with Data, Analytics & AI leadership to align Foundry architecture with Orbia’s AI enablement roadmap and scalable operating model.

**Acquisition & Deployment:**

* Evaluate Microsoft Foundry capabilities, model catalog options, agent frameworks, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and adjacent Azure AI services for enterprise fit.
* Collaborate with cloud, infrastructure, network, security, integration, and data platform teams to design DEV / QA / PROD-ready deployment patterns.
* Define secure integration between Foundry agents and enterprise systems including SharePoint, SAP, ServiceNow, Databricks, APIs, Power BI, and internal business applications.
* Design API-led and event-enabled integration patterns using Azure API Management, Entra ID, OAuth, managed identity, service principals, and approved enterprise gateways.
* Lead technical design reviews for Foundry agents, tools, knowledge bases, grounding data, model endpoints, evaluation workflows, monitoring, and release gates.
* Support partner and vendor technical reviews to validate delivery approach, platform compatibility, security posture, and architecture compliance.

**Operational Management:**

* Define operational runbooks for Foundry agent lifecycle management, prompt/version control, model deployment tracking, evaluations, monitoring, telemetry, and incident support.
* Ensure Foundry solutions follow least-privilege RBAC, access reviews, environment segregation, audit logging, data protection, and responsible AI controls.
* Provide guidance to AI engineers, data engineers, platform admins, business analysts, and implementation partners on approved design and implementation patterns.
* Monitor and optimize solution design for token consumption, Azure AI Search cost, model endpoint usage, latency, quality, security, and scalability.
* Review delivered solutions against architecture principles, Orbia governance expectations, and production acceptance criteria before go-live.
* Continuously improve Foundry architecture standards based on lessons learned, platform roadmap changes, business adoption, and operational feedback.
* Provide application management support for issue and request related to MS foundry services.

**EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, LANGUAGE, & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Language(s) and level of proficiency: English written and verbal communication at professional working proficiency level.

title: Team Lead, Provider Data Operations
description:
**Our Mission**
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
**About The Role**
***We’re hiring an AI-first Operations Team Lead; an operations leader who uses AI to build better workflows, not just talk about its potential.***
As a Provider Data Operations Team Lead, you will lead and coach a team while owning productivity, quality, and SLA performance. You will bring clarity to ambiguous problems, remove workflow bottlenecks, and ensure the team executes consistently against operational goals.
  
  
You will also use AI hands-on in your daily work. You’ll identify repetitive or error-prone tasks, test AI-enabled approaches, balance speed with accuracy and human review, and turn successful experiments into repeatable workflows the broader team can adopt safely and effectively.
  
  
**A Day in the Life of a Provider Data Operations Team Lead:**

* Use AI to Improve Daily Operations: Use AI tools hands-on to analyze problems, accelerate routine work, summarize information, improve data quality, and support better decisions. Regularly ask where a manual workflow can be simplified, automated, or redesigned.
* Identify, Pilot & Scale AI-Enabled Solutions: Spot high-value opportunities to reduce repetitive work or prevent errors. Design practical pilots, define success measures, evaluate results, and partner with AI, Product, Systems, and Operations teams to turn proven ideas into sustainable workflows.
* Balance Speed, Accuracy & Human Review: Apply sound judgment to determine where AI can operate independently and where human validation is required. Monitor output quality, surface risks, and ensure AI-enabled processes remain accurate, explainable, and aligned with established guardrails.
* Lead Team Execution & Daily Operations: Oversee day-to-day operations for a team of 8-10 Researchers, Associates, and Senior Associates. Provide clear direction on case handling, workflow interpretation, and complex troubleshooting to deliver consistently against productivity, quality, and SLA targets.
* Manage Workflows & Drive Throughput: Own workload distribution, proactively identify bottlenecks, and reallocate work to maintain flow and meet operational goals. Independently manage complex workstreams with minimal supervision.
* Ensure Quality & Process Adherence: Provide quality oversight through case reviews, audits, and trend analysis. Ensure consistent application of SOPs and policies, address escalations, and maintain high standards across both human and AI-assisted outputs.
* Coach & Develop Team Members: Deliver coaching tailored to individual strengths and development areas. Support onboarding, training, and continuous skill-building, including helping team members use AI tools confidently, responsibly, and effectively.
* Lead Change & Drive Adoption: Translate new tools and pilots into clear operating guidance. Gather team feedback, address adoption barriers, and reinforce the behaviors needed to make improved workflows stick.
* Partner with Stakeholders in India and the US: Build strong cross-functional relationships, align on priorities and success measures, manage expectations, and escalate appropriately to ensure smooth execution across time zones.
* Navigate Ambiguity & Drive Continuous Improvement: Break ambiguous problems into clear next steps, use data and experimentation to learn quickly, and create repeatable processes from successful solutions.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in data operations, business operations, analytics, research, or customer service. People management experience is preferred; however, strong individual contributors with hands-on AI or automation experience and demonstrated readiness to transition into a leadership role will also be considered.
* An AI-native approach to problem-solving: you naturally explore whether manual work can be improved, automated, or supported by AI.
* Experience using Claude is a plus.
* Hands-on experience in building AI-enabled tools, agents, workflow automations, or data/process automation solutions to solve business or operational problems.
* Ability to evaluate AI output critically, recognize limitations, and design appropriate human-review checks to protect accuracy and data quality.
* Demonstrated ability to turn experiments into documented, measurable, repeatable workflows and coach others through change.
* Strong operations leadership, including workload management, performance coaching, SLA ownership, quality oversight, and escalation handling.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to use data to diagnose problems and measure impact.
* Curious, hands-on, and quick to learn new tools; comfortable experimenting within defined guardrails.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace applications, plus experience with tools such as Salesforce and Confluence and the ability to work with large data sets.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a track record of building engaged, adaptable, and high-performing teams.
* A Bachelor’s degree from a reputed institution with a strong academic record.
* Experience in US healthcare or healthcare technology is a plus.
* Experience working across global or cross-time-zone teams, particularly India and the US, is a plus.

**You do not need to be an engineer or an AI researcher.**
You should be excited to learn, willing to experiment hands-on, and motivated to use AI to make operations faster, more accurate, and easier to scale.
  
  
**Benefits**

* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare/creche facility for kids
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave

* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2025-2026

**About Us**
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values -

title: Agentic AI Engineering
description:
**Agentic AI- 8-15 Years**

**Location: Bangalore,Pune,Hyderabad,Chennai.**

**Engineering Foundation**

*Non-negotiable. This is what we screen on first, and there is no AI in it.*

* Data modelling across SQL and NoSQL, and a clear view of where each one breaks
* Event-driven architecture in production with Kafka, RabbitMQ or equivalent. Ordering, replay, idempotency, dead-letter handling
* Distributed systems failure modes: partial failure, retries, backpressure, timeouts, circuit breakers
* Caching strategy and invalidation, at a scale where getting it wrong hurt
* Observability. You have instrumented a system, not just read someone else's dashboard
* At least one cloud deeply. Not three superficially
* API and integration patterns against real enterprise surfaces such as ERPs, CRMs and data platforms
* CI/CD, containers, release engineering
* You have owned something in production. On-call, incidents, the whole thing

Agent systems are distributed systems with a non-deterministic component in the middle. If the fundamentals are not there, the AI layer does not survive contact with production.

**AI Engineering**

*Two capabilities that do not come free with an engineering background. These are the ones we probe hardest.*

**Evaluation and Error Analysis**

* You have built an eval set for a non-deterministic system and used it to make a decision
* You can decompose a failure: is this a model problem, a retrieval problem, a data problem or a product problem?
* You debug agent behaviour systematically, with traces and evidence, not by gut feel

**Context Engineering**

* Deliberate management of what enters the model on each turn, and why
* Memory strategy: what persists across steps, across sessions, and what should not
* Tool surface design: what the agent can reach, how it is scoped, what happens when a tool fails
* Cost and latency as first-class design constraints, not something discovered in the invoice

**Consulting and Client Leadership**

*Equal weight to the engineering. This is a client-facing role in a services business.*

* Carry a market point of view on models, tooling and delivery patterns, and translate it into what it means for a specific client, in their language
* Run discovery workshops, solution reviews and delivery cadences with client teams
* Advise clients on standing up their own AI capability: practice structure, operating model, skills, governance, build versus buy, and adoption across their engineering org
* Shape and defend technical proposals, PoC plans and roadmaps. Own the story end to end
* Translate business problems into architectures for CXO-level stakeholders without hiding behind jargon
* Say no when the answer is no. Tell a client when agents are the wrong tool, and be able to explain why

**Delivery and Architecture**

*The work itself.*

* Own end-to-end delivery of AI-native programs, from architecture through production
* Design multi-agent orchestration using LangGraph, CrewAI or equivalent. Agent topology, tool routing, memory, state, fallback and recovery paths
* Integrate agent systems with enterprise systems of record, not toy datasets
* Build RAG where RAG is the right answer, from chunking through retrieval, re-ranking and evaluation
* Run agentic coding workflows with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or equivalent, and lead projects where AI writes significant portions of the codebase while you guide, review and ship it
* Work with MCP and shared-context tooling. Design what agents are permitted to reach and under what controls
* Bring governance into the design from day one: agent identity, privilege scoping, audit, human-in-the-loop, kill switches
* Contribute to reusable frameworks and accelerators the wider practice can use

**Team and Practice**

* Build AI engineering capability across the delivery organisation through mentoring, standards and review quality
* Evaluate new models, frameworks and tooling before the hype catches up, and kill the ones that do not earn their place
* Contribute to internal knowledge bases and practice assets
