Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.

**Meet the Team**  
Core to the health and growth of our business, Millennium's Information Technology organization builds the flexible, scalable platforms and advanced proprietary systems that support the firm's active, multi-manager model. Within this organization, the Quality Engineering team partners with the Equities Transactional Systems team on Comet, the firm's next-generation equity post-trade platform covering trade lifecycle event processing, positions, P&L, option expiry and corporate actions, built as high-throughput services and data pipelines on AWS.

**What You'll Do**

  

* Own test strategy and execution for new features, partnering with developers, business analysts, and Middle Office and Operations stakeholders from design through release.
* Translate business rules into comprehensive test scenarios and edge cases across the trade lifecycle, including trades, positions, P&L, option expiry, corporate actions, as-of events, backdated events, and corrections.
* Independently calculate expected realized, unrealized, and mark-to-market P&L results, and reconcile exceptions against source-of-truth datasets and legacy systems.
* Design, build, and maintain automated test coverage across Java/Spring Boot microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, Kafka event flows, batch jobs, data workflows, and user interfaces.
* Validate batch and workflow behavior, including reruns, failures, idempotency, and cache consistency between Redis and the database.
* Build data-validation and reconciliation checks to protect the integrity of setup data, positions, balances, and downstream outputs.
* Expand regression coverage and quality gates within CI pipelines to continuously validate changes.
* Track, triage, and document defects with clear reproduction steps; use logs and metrics to support root-cause analysis, verify fixes, and support release readiness through environment validation, smoke and sanity testing, access and entitlement checks, and test sign-off documentation.

**What You Bring**

  

* Prior fintech or capital-markets experience in quality engineering for pre-trade or post-trade equity systems within a hedge fund, investment bank, asset manager, or fintech organization.
* 5+ years of experience in software quality engineering and test automation.
* Hands-on knowledge of corporate actions and option expiry, including their impact on positions and P&L.
* Strong Java test-automation skills, including JUnit or TestNG, REST Assured, Spring Boot Test, and Mockito.
* Experience testing REST and GraphQL APIs, including contract, schema, authentication, and entitlement validation.
* Advanced SQL skills for data validation and reconciliation; PostgreSQL experience is preferred, though experience with any relational database is welcome.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes on AWS, CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions, Git, and Agile delivery practices.
* A precise, analytical approach; strong written and verbal communication skills; sound judgment when using AI coding assistants; and the ability to collaborate effectively with developers, Middle Office, and Operations.

**Job Requirements**  

We are seeking a passionate and motivated DevOps Engineer with exposure to AI and Cloud Technologies to join our growing team. This role is ideal for professionals with 1+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) who are looking to expand their expertise in AI infrastructure, automation, and cloud-native technologies.  
The successful candidate will build agentic AI solutions on Azure that boost efficiency for our team and for the development teams using our cloud infrastructure and deployment tools. You'll embed AI agents into our cloud runtime and CI/CD pipelines, with governance and human-in-the-loop oversight, to automate routine tasks and speed up provisioning and deployments.

**Key Responsibilities**

Agentic Engineering

* Identify AI use cases that boost efficiency and let us scale to more teams and partners without proportional effort.
* Pinpoint manual work that grows with every new team or partner, such as onboarding, provisioning, and support requests.
* Design and build AI agents for the selected use cases, from prototype to production.
* Embed agents into CI/CD pipelines, provisioning workflows, and the cloud runtime.
* Operate, monitor, and maintain agents in production.
* Enforce governance, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop approval for agent actions.
* Measure efficiency and scalability gains, and continuously improve agent quality, reliability, and cost.

Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Operations

* Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure on Azure or AWS.
* Operate Kubernetes and container platforms for application and AI workloads.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning with Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Build and maintain Helm charts for application deployments.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, and deployment issues.

* Automate operational tasks with PowerShell and C#.
* Drive release management, deployment automation, and environment provisioning.

* Maintain MLOps workflows with Azure ML, MLflow, or Kubeflow.
* Monitor performance of AI workloads and their infrastructure.

Monitoring & Reliability

* Resolve incidents, run root cause analyses, and optimize performance.

Improve system reliability, scalability, and availability.

* Familiarity with agent frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or LangChain
* Experience integrating agents with tools, APIs, and knowledge sources (e.g., MCP, RAG)

* Ability to evaluate and monitor agents for quality, reliability, and cost
* Ability to identify use cases where AI improves efficiency and scalability
* Exposure to Azure ML, Kubeflow, or MLflow.
* Understanding of AI-assisted operations (AIOps).

* Helm, including building reusable charts for teams to use

Monitoring & Logging

Operating systems

* Solid understanding of CI/CD and deployment automation.

* Basic knowledge of AI/ML deployment and MLOps.

title: Senior Professional Services Cloud Architect, Professional Services, ProServe India
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services (ProServe) is looking for an experienced Senior Professional Services Cloud Architect to join our India team. As a key member of the strategic account team, you will lead technical sales engagements, shape solution architecture, and influence revenue throughout the sales cycle for some of the largest enterprises in Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail.  
  
You will act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers accelerate their cloud adoption — from migration and modernization to cloud-native applications and emerging technologies such as generative AI and agentic AI. You will create and lead the solution design that delivers each customer's business outcomes. Working as the link between ProServe Account Executives (PAEs) and our Delivery teams, you will make sure proposed solutions are realistic, achievable, and make the best use of ProServe and our partners. We are expanding our teams targeting Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail industry segments in India, and this is a compelling time to join and help shape how these customers build on AWS.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead cloud solution design during pre-sales engagements: run demonstrations, conduct initial scoping, and architect scalable, secure AWS solutions across Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail enterprises.
* Design complex AWS solutions, estimates, and proposals that deliver customer business outcomes, defining project scope and technical approaches for Statements of Work using ProServe offerings and delivery kits.
* Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, and proof-of-concept implementations while advising C-suite and senior technical stakeholders on cloud modernization, generative AI, and agentic AI strategies.
* Ensure smooth hand-offs to Delivery teams so that scope, architecture, and expected outcomes are fully understood at launch, and lead delivery of complex engagements as needed, including migrations, data and analytics, and application development.
* Share knowledge across the organization through mentoring, reusable artifacts, and contributions to ProServe best practices, and represent AWS ProServe at customer events and industry conferences across India.

  
A day in the life  
You might start your morning reviewing architecture designs for a customer's cloud migration, then join a working session with their engineering team to refine a data warehousing solution. After lunch, you could lead a stakeholder review presenting progress and recommendations to senior executives. Later, you collaborate with partners and internal teams to scope a new engagement, before wrapping up by documenting reusable patterns from a recently completed project to share across the organization.  
  
About the team  
Our ProServe team in {ADDRESS} works with some of the country's largest Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail enterprises to help them realize their cloud ambitions on AWS. You will partner closely with PAEs who own the customer relationship, Delivery teams including Engagement Managers and Delivery Consultants, AWS account teams and Solutions Architects, AWS Specialists including the Generative AI Innovation Center, and AWS Partner Network (APN) partners. Together, this ecosystem turns architectures into measurable customer outcomes.  
  
As an industry subject matter expert, you will help define cloud operating models, drive strategic enterprise transformation, and set up Cloud Centers of Excellence. We are building an inclusive team culture where knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning are part of everyday work. If you want to help shape how India's largest enterprises innovate with the cloud, we would love to hear from you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 10+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience
* 3+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
* Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences in pre-sales environments
* Experience in database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis)
* Experience communicating technical concepts to diverse audiences in pre-sales environments

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Associate's degree or above
* Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
* Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders
* Experience with broad enterprise systems work including SAP, Oracle, and custom applications
* Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks (like TOGAF, Zachman) and identifying the relationships between business services, information, applications and global infrastructure assets
* Knowledge of compliance and security standards across the enterprise IT landscape
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Product Management, Customer Service, Operations, Legal, Finance, and Senior Leadership

title: Software Dev Engineer II, Profit Intelligence
description:
**Description**
Are you interested in building intelligence systems from the ground up?
  
  
Are you interested in working with Applied Scientists, Big Data Engineers and Software Development Engineers to build large-scale data intelligence systems?
  
  
Are you interested to work in a team that positively impacts different key pillars of Amazon like Pricing, Promotions, Advertising, Auto inventory purchasing, Auto inventory removal, Inventory placement?
  
  
Are you interested in working for a team that builds cool systems yet has great work-life balance?
  
  
Profit intelligence systems measures, predicts true profit(/loss) for each item as a result of a specific shipment to an Amazon customer.
  
  
Prot Intelligence is all about providing intelligent ways for Amazon to understand profitability across retail business. What are the hidden factors driving the growth or profitability across millions of shipments each day?
  
  
Profit Intelligence provides these answers.
  
  
We compute the profitability of each and every shipment that gets shipped out of Amazon. Guess what, we predict the profitability of future possible shipments too. We are a team of agile, can-do engineers, who believe that not only are moon shots possible but that they can be done before lunch. All it takes is finding new ideas that challenge our preconceived notions of how things should be done. Process and procedure matter less than ideas and the practical work of getting stuff done. This is a place for exploring the new and taking risks.
  
  
We push the envelope in using cloud services in AWS as well as the latest in distributed systems, forecasting algorithms, and data mining.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to design and build AI-powered data platforms that transform large-scale business data into actionable insights. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and data engineering — owning end-to-end development of tools that help business leaders make faster, better decisions.
  
  
This is a high-impact role on a team where the software you ship directly shapes financial and operational strategy across Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Architect and build scalable platforms that ingest, process, and serve insights from petabyte-scale datasets
  
  
Integrate large language models and generative AI capabilities into internal analytics tools — enabling natural language querying, anomaly explanation, and automated reporting
  
  
Design ML pipelines for anomaly detection, forecasting, and trend analysis over structured and semi-structured business data
  
  
Partner with scientists, analysts, and PMs to translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped technical solutions
  
  
Drive engineering excellence: define coding standards, lead design reviews, and set the bar for operational health (monitoring, oncall, runbooks)
  
  
Mentor junior engineers; raise the technical capability of the team through clear documentation and code review
  
  
Own your services in production — you build it, you run it
  
  
Build and operate our foundational data infrastructure comprising of the entire spectrum of AWS Services - Storage (Redshift Data Shares, s3 data lakes), Orchestration (Step Functions, Glue and Internal Java Based Orchestration Tools), Processing (Spark & Flink - KDA), Streaming services (AWS Kinesis) and real-time large scale event aggregation stores.
  
  
Making it fully configurable and self-service for non-engineers.
  
  
Build and evolve tools that empower Amazonians to access data and build reliable, scalable and configurable way to generate Unit Economics for all Amazon Businesses. This includes UIs and frameworks for configuring rules, simulating their application, approval workows for rule changes, APIs and caching layers for high-throughput serving of Unit Economics Historicals and Predictions.
  
  
Build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like inhouse Reporting Applications and BI tools), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for designing and building platforms for crunching 100s of TB of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Your team

The team integrates portfolio management, risk management, and quantitative workflows with advanced engineering, artificial intelligence, and data capabilities, making technology a strategic driver of investment and risk outcomes.
  
  
Risk and Quantitative Analysis (RQA) provides independent oversight of BlackRock’s investment and enterprise risks through quantitative analysis, risk expertise, and evidence-based insights. In partnership with PMG Tech, RQA uses advanced engineering, artificial intelligence, and data platforms to enhance decision-making, strengthen risk management capabilities, and scale innovative solutions across investment, operational, technology, and enterprise risk domains.
  
  
Your role and impact
  
  
As a Research (AI) Engineer, you will partner with RQA, PMG Tech, and business stakeholders to develop data workflows, analytics solutions, and artificial intelligence-assisted capabilities that transform risk and quantitative challenges into actionable insights.
  
  
Embedded within a PMG Tech Pod, a business-focused, cross-functional team, you will collaborate with risk managers, quantitative analysts, artificial intelligence leads, and engineers. You will deliver high-quality data assets, analytical tools, and technology solutions that support risk management and informed decision-making.
  
  
This role requires an understanding of business problems and risk workflows, along with the ability to translate requirements into scalable data solutions. You will use Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), cloud data platforms, workflow orchestration, and visualization tools to develop and operate data-intensive applications. You will also apply data quality practices, continuous integration and continuous delivery processes, and data operations to create reliable, production-grade solutions.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Build and maintain web-harvesting processes, data pipelines, transformations, and workflows that support research hypotheses and data analysis.
* Develop platform capabilities that source high-quality data and create scalable, reliable, and maintainable data solutions.
* Create research utilities, prototypes, dashboards, and exploratory tools that support insight generation and research workflows.
* Engage with investors, researchers, risk managers, and quantitative analysts to understand their workflows and translate business requirements into effective data solutions.
* Collaborate with core engineering teams to adopt data-extraction and data-management capabilities that accelerate investment research.
* Partner with artificial intelligence leads to source data and build applications that supplement research with artificial intelligence-assisted insights.

Your experience
  
  

* Strong programming capabilities in Python and Structured Query Language, supported by analytical thinking and effective problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated experience in data engineering, data analytics, or the development of data-intensive applications.
* Knowledge of, or curiosity about, investment research and risk-management workflows or similar domains.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, research, and business teams and translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.

Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

title: Head - Technology & AI | E-Commerce | AI Agents | Engineering & Automations
description:
**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Ergode builds and scales digital-first businesses across global marketplaces.

We have made a clear strategic choice: **Technology, Artificial Intelligence and automation will sit at the core of how we scale revenue, improve margins and increase productivity.**

We are looking for a **hands-on Technology & AI leader** who can convert business problems into working, adopted systems — quickly.

This is not a traditional IT leadership role.

You will own the intersection of **business, engineering, AI, automation, data, integrations, infrastructure and security**. You will work directly with the CEO and business leaders to identify high-impact problems, decide what should be built internally versus externally, and ensure solutions move from idea production adoption measurable business outcome.

Some of our systems need modernization. Some need stronger ownership and architecture. Others need to be replaced or rebuilt. We would rather be transparent about that upfront.

We need someone who enjoys that challenge.

**What You Will Own**
=====================

**1. Technology Execution & Delivery**
--------------------------------------

You will create an execution culture where technology commitments translate into shipped outcomes.

You will:

* Run Technology on clear weekly priorities with an owner, deadline and measurable outcome for every major initiative.
* Establish strong engineering execution across product development, integrations, automation, infrastructure and AI.
* Track commitments through completion — not merely development activity.
* Identify blockers early and make fast build/buy/outsource decisions.
* Hold internal teams and external partners accountable for scope, timelines, quality and business outcomes.
* Build clear visibility from:

**Business Requirement**  **Development**  **Production**  **Adoption**  **Business Impact**

* Develop engineers and technology managers into stronger owners and future leaders.
* Create sufficient documentation, architecture standards and ownership so no critical system depends on one employee or vendor.

### **Success means:**

Leadership should never need to repeatedly ask, **“Where is this project stuck and who owns it?”**

**2. Business-First Technology Strategy**
=========================================

Technology exists to improve business outcomes.

You will:

* Deeply understand how Ergode makes money across marketplaces, brands and channels.
* Understand marketplace fees, margins, inventory, pricing, advertising, catalogue operations, fulfilment and customer experience.
* Own the Technology & AI roadmap based on impact on:
  + Revenue
  + Gross margin
  + Productivity
  + Operating cost
  + Speed
  + Customer/vendor experience
* Work directly with business heads to identify operational bottlenecks.
* Challenge processes that should be eliminated or simplified before automating them.
* Translate business problems into scalable technology solutions.
* Own technology economics including cloud, AI/token usage, software licences, development and outsourcing.
* Report technology performance to leadership in **business outcomes rather than project activity**.

**3. AI, Agents & Intelligent Automation**
==========================================

AI is not an innovation project at Ergode. It is becoming part of how the company operates.

You will:

* Identify high-volume and high-value manual work suitable for AI or automation.
* Build and deploy AI agents and GenAI workflows into **real production environments**.
* Develop reusable AI architecture rather than disconnected experiments.
* Integrate AI into areas including:
  + Catalogue and content
  + Marketplace listings
  + Pricing
  + Inventory
  + Customer support
  + Sales
  + Finance
  + HR
  + Reporting and decision support
* Build with LLM APIs, RAG, agentic workflows, orchestration frameworks and workflow automation.
* Establish before/after baselines for every major automation.
* Measure:
  + hours/FTE capacity saved
  + cycle-time reduction
  + cost reduction
  + quality improvement
  + revenue/margin impact
  + user adoption
* Kill pilots that do not produce value and scale the ones that do.
* Ensure business teams actually adopt what Technology builds.

### **We are not looking for:**

Someone who has attended AI courses or built demos.

### **We are looking for:**

Someone who has **put AI into production and can show what changed because of it.**

**4. E-commerce Platforms & Marketplace Technology**
====================================================

Our technology must support a complex global marketplace operation.

You will own and strengthen:

* Marketplace integrations including Amazon SP-API, Walmart, eBay and other channels.
* Catalogue and listing infrastructure.
* Pricing and quantity synchronization.
* Order processing.
* Inventory and warehouse integrations.
* Returns, refunds and reconciliation workflows.
* Marketplace reporting and operational intelligence.
* API reliability and monitoring.

You will build toward a connected architecture where catalogue, inventory, order and marketplace information flows reliably across systems.

The goal is not simply integration.

The goal is **reliable commerce at scale**.

**5. Product & Platform Ownership**
===================================

You will take ownership of Ergode’s core internal technology platforms and ensure they become dependable business systems.

This includes:

* evaluating existing architecture,
* identifying technical debt,
* establishing clear module ownership,
* improving reliability and usability,
* prioritising development based on business value,
* and driving adoption after launch.

Technology is not complete when code is deployed.

**A feature is complete when the business can reliably use it and the expected outcome is visible.**

**6. Data Foundation & Decision Intelligence**
==============================================

AI is only as strong as the underlying data.

You will:

* Build reliable data flows across business systems.
* Establish clear sources of truth for critical business information.
* Reduce duplicate datasets and manual reconciliation.
* Improve data quality and ownership.
* Enable dashboards and AI systems to consume trustworthy business data.
* Build APIs and integration layers that allow new agents and applications to be deployed quickly.

**7. Architecture, Cloud & Engineering Quality**
================================================

You should be technically strong enough to challenge architecture and engineering decisions yourself.

You will:

* Review architecture for scalability, reliability, maintainability, security and cost.
* Establish coding, testing, documentation and deployment standards.
* Strengthen CI/CD and monitoring.
* Review estimates rather than blindly accepting them.
* Prototype when speed requires it.
* Make pragmatic technology choices rather than over-engineering.

We expect a leader who can move comfortably between a **CEO conversation about ROI and an engineering conversation about architecture.**

**8. Security, Reliability & AI Governance**
============================================

You will own the reliability and security of Ergode’s technology environment.

Responsibilities include:

* Cloud and infrastructure reliability
* Monitoring and uptime
* Incident management
* Root-cause analysis
* Backups and disaster recovery
* Identity and access management
* SSO
* Endpoint/device security
* Data protection

You will also establish practical AI governance covering:

* which company information can be shared with which AI systems,
* permissions available to AI agents,
* human review requirements for critical decisions,
* auditability,
* and acceptable AI use.

Compliance should appropriately address DPDP and relevant international privacy/security requirements.

**9. Build vs Buy vs Outsource**
================================

We do not believe everything must be built internally.

We do believe **Ergode must own the outcome.**

You will decide when to:

**BUILD** — when capability creates strategic advantage.

**BUY** — when a reliable product already solves the problem economically.

**OUTSOURCE** — when an external specialist can deliver faster.

For outsourced work, you will own:

* requirements,
* architecture,
* vendor selection,
* commercial evaluation,
* milestones,
* SLAs,
* quality,
* security,
* source code,
* documentation,
* handover.

No critical Ergode technology should become permanently dependent on one vendor or individual.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within the first 6–12 months, we expect visible movement across these areas:

### **Execution**

* Major technology initiatives have clear owners, deadlines and outcomes.
* Delivery predictability improves materially.
* Chronic technology bottlenecks reduce.

### **AI & Automation**

* Multiple AI agents/workflows are operating in production.
* Automation impact is quantified monthly.
* Manual workload is measurably reduced in targeted processes.
* Business adoption is visible rather than assumed.

### **Core Platforms**

* Critical marketplace and internal systems become more reliable.
* Technical ownership and documentation improve.
* Important business workflows no longer depend on fragile manual processes.

### **Data**

* Critical catalogue, inventory, order and operational data become more connected and trustworthy.

### **Business Partnership**

* Business leaders increasingly bring problems to Technology because they expect **working solutions, not project discussions**.

**Who We Are Looking For**
==========================

**Must-Haves**
--------------

* 10+ years of meaningful technology experience.
* 5+ years leading engineering/technology teams.
* Evidence of personally owning major technology delivery.
* Strong understanding of software engineering, architecture, APIs and integrations.
* AI/automation systems deployed into production with measurable impact.
* Practical experience with:
  + LLM APIs
  + RAG
  + AI agents / agentic workflows
  + Python
  + workflow automation platforms such as n8n/Make or equivalent
* Cloud experience across AWS, Azure or GCP.
* API/integration architecture experience.
* DevOps, deployment and monitoring understanding.
* Ability to evaluate architecture, code/design decisions and engineering estimates.
* Experience managing external technology partners.
* Experience owning meaningful technology budgets.
* Strong business and commercial orientation.

**Strongly Preferred**
----------------------

Experience in one or more of:

* E-commerce
* Marketplaces
* Retail technology
* D2C
* SaaS/platform businesses
* ERP/OMS/WMS
* Amazon SP-API or other marketplace integrations
* High-volume order/catalogue/inventory systems
* AI-first enterprise transformation

**Who Will NOT Fit This Role**
==============================

This role is probably not for you if:

* Your experience is predominantly IT infrastructure/helpdesk.
* Your leadership style is primarily delegation without technical depth.
* Your AI experience consists mainly of courses, certifications or prototypes.
* You measure success by projects delivered rather than business outcomes achieved.
* You require large teams before you can execute.
* You prefer lengthy planning cycles over shipping, learning and improving.
* You cannot challenge engineers, vendors and business leaders when necessary.

**The Person Behind the Resume**
================================

We care about experience, but we care equally about how you operate.

We value people who demonstrate:

**Ownership. Bias for action. Curiosity. Commercial thinking. High standards. Candour. Learning velocity.**

We would rather hire a builder who has repeatedly solved difficult problems than someone with the perfect title.

title: Senior Professional Services Cloud Architect, Professional Services, ProServe India
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services (ProServe) is looking for an experienced Senior Professional Services Cloud Architect to join our India team. As a key member of the strategic account team, you will lead technical sales engagements, shape solution architecture, and influence revenue throughout the sales cycle for some of the largest enterprises in Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail.  
  
You will act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers accelerate their cloud adoption — from migration and modernization to cloud-native applications and emerging technologies such as generative AI and agentic AI. You will create and lead the solution design that delivers each customer's business outcomes. Working as the link between ProServe Account Executives (PAEs) and our Delivery teams, you will make sure proposed solutions are realistic, achievable, and make the best use of ProServe and our partners. We are expanding our teams targeting Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail industry segments in India, and this is a compelling time to join and help shape how these customers build on AWS.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead cloud solution design during pre-sales engagements: run demonstrations, conduct initial scoping, and architect scalable, secure AWS solutions across Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail enterprises.
* Design complex AWS solutions, estimates, and proposals that deliver customer business outcomes, defining project scope and technical approaches for Statements of Work using ProServe offerings and delivery kits.
* Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, and proof-of-concept implementations while advising C-suite and senior technical stakeholders on cloud modernization, generative AI, and agentic AI strategies.
* Ensure smooth hand-offs to Delivery teams so that scope, architecture, and expected outcomes are fully understood at launch, and lead delivery of complex engagements as needed, including migrations, data and analytics, and application development.
* Share knowledge across the organization through mentoring, reusable artifacts, and contributions to ProServe best practices, and represent AWS ProServe at customer events and industry conferences across India.

  
A day in the life  
You might start your morning reviewing architecture designs for a customer's cloud migration, then join a working session with their engineering team to refine a data warehousing solution. After lunch, you could lead a stakeholder review presenting progress and recommendations to senior executives. Later, you collaborate with partners and internal teams to scope a new engagement, before wrapping up by documenting reusable patterns from a recently completed project to share across the organization.  
  
About the team  
Our ProServe team in {ADDRESS} works with some of the country's largest Financial Services, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Retail enterprises to help them realize their cloud ambitions on AWS. You will partner closely with PAEs who own the customer relationship, Delivery teams including Engagement Managers and Delivery Consultants, AWS account teams and Solutions Architects, AWS Specialists including the Generative AI Innovation Center, and AWS Partner Network (APN) partners. Together, this ecosystem turns architectures into measurable customer outcomes.  
  
As an industry subject matter expert, you will help define cloud operating models, drive strategic enterprise transformation, and set up Cloud Centers of Excellence. We are building an inclusive team culture where knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning are part of everyday work. If you want to help shape how India's largest enterprises innovate with the cloud, we would love to hear from you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 10+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience
* 3+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
* Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences in pre-sales environments
* Experience in database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis)
* Experience communicating technical concepts to diverse audiences in pre-sales environments

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Associate's degree or above
* Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
* Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders
* Experience with broad enterprise systems work including SAP, Oracle, and custom applications
* Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks (like TOGAF, Zachman) and identifying the relationships between business services, information, applications and global infrastructure assets
* Knowledge of compliance and security standards across the enterprise IT landscape
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Product Management, Customer Service, Operations, Legal, Finance, and Senior Leadership
* Familiarity with the Indian market, digital transformation initiatives (for example Digital India and government cloud policies) and regional compliance requirements (for example RBI, SEBI and IRDAI guidelines, and the DPDP Act)

The AI Architect – Microsoft Foundry will be responsible for:

**Strategy & Planning:**

* Lead technical design reviews for Foundry agents, tools, knowledge bases, grounding data, model endpoints, evaluation workflows, monitoring, and release gates.

* Knowledge/Experience:10–12 years of overall IT experience in enterprise architecture, cloud architecture, data architecture, AI/ML engineering, application integration, or digital platforms.
* Minimum 4 years’ experience in architecture design across Azure, data platforms, APIs, cloud-native applications, analytics, or AI solutions.

title: Team Lead, Provider Data Operations
description:
**Our Mission**
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
**About The Role**
***We’re hiring an AI-first Operations Team Lead; an operations leader who uses AI to build better workflows, not just talk about its potential.***
As a Provider Data Operations Team Lead, you will lead and coach a team while owning productivity, quality, and SLA performance. You will bring clarity to ambiguous problems, remove workflow bottlenecks, and ensure the team executes consistently against operational goals.
  
  
You will also use AI hands-on in your daily work. You’ll identify repetitive or error-prone tasks, test AI-enabled approaches, balance speed with accuracy and human review, and turn successful experiments into repeatable workflows the broader team can adopt safely and effectively.
  
  
**A Day in the Life of a Provider Data Operations Team Lead:**

* Use AI to Improve Daily Operations: Use AI tools hands-on to analyze problems, accelerate routine work, summarize information, improve data quality, and support better decisions. Regularly ask where a manual workflow can be simplified, automated, or redesigned.
* Identify, Pilot & Scale AI-Enabled Solutions: Spot high-value opportunities to reduce repetitive work or prevent errors. Design practical pilots, define success measures, evaluate results, and partner with AI, Product, Systems, and Operations teams to turn proven ideas into sustainable workflows.
* Balance Speed, Accuracy & Human Review: Apply sound judgment to determine where AI can operate independently and where human validation is required. Monitor output quality, surface risks, and ensure AI-enabled processes remain accurate, explainable, and aligned with established guardrails.
* Lead Team Execution & Daily Operations: Oversee day-to-day operations for a team of 8-10 Researchers, Associates, and Senior Associates. Provide clear direction on case handling, workflow interpretation, and complex troubleshooting to deliver consistently against productivity, quality, and SLA targets.
* Manage Workflows & Drive Throughput: Own workload distribution, proactively identify bottlenecks, and reallocate work to maintain flow and meet operational goals. Independently manage complex workstreams with minimal supervision.
* Ensure Quality & Process Adherence: Provide quality oversight through case reviews, audits, and trend analysis. Ensure consistent application of SOPs and policies, address escalations, and maintain high standards across both human and AI-assisted outputs.
* Coach & Develop Team Members: Deliver coaching tailored to individual strengths and development areas. Support onboarding, training, and continuous skill-building, including helping team members use AI tools confidently, responsibly, and effectively.
* Lead Change & Drive Adoption: Translate new tools and pilots into clear operating guidance. Gather team feedback, address adoption barriers, and reinforce the behaviors needed to make improved workflows stick.
* Partner with Stakeholders in India and the US: Build strong cross-functional relationships, align on priorities and success measures, manage expectations, and escalate appropriately to ensure smooth execution across time zones.
* Navigate Ambiguity & Drive Continuous Improvement: Break ambiguous problems into clear next steps, use data and experimentation to learn quickly, and create repeatable processes from successful solutions.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in data operations, business operations, analytics, research, or customer service. People management experience is preferred; however, strong individual contributors with hands-on AI or automation experience and demonstrated readiness to transition into a leadership role will also be considered.
* An AI-native approach to problem-solving: you naturally explore whether manual work can be improved, automated, or supported by AI.
* Experience using Claude is a plus.
* Hands-on experience in building AI-enabled tools, agents, workflow automations, or data/process automation solutions to solve business or operational problems.
* Ability to evaluate AI output critically, recognize limitations, and design appropriate human-review checks to protect accuracy and data quality.
* Demonstrated ability to turn experiments into documented, measurable, repeatable workflows and coach others through change.
* Strong operations leadership, including workload management, performance coaching, SLA ownership, quality oversight, and escalation handling.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to use data to diagnose problems and measure impact.
* Curious, hands-on, and quick to learn new tools; comfortable experimenting within defined guardrails.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace applications, plus experience with tools such as Salesforce and Confluence and the ability to work with large data sets.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a track record of building engaged, adaptable, and high-performing teams.
* A Bachelor’s degree from a reputed institution with a strong academic record.
* Experience in US healthcare or healthcare technology is a plus.
* Experience working across global or cross-time-zone teams, particularly India and the US, is a plus.

**You do not need to be an engineer or an AI researcher.**
You should be excited to learn, willing to experiment hands-on, and motivated to use AI to make operations faster, more accurate, and easier to scale.
  
  
**Benefits**

* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare/creche facility for kids
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!

title: Agentic AI Engineering
description:
**Agentic AI- 8-15 Years**

**Location: Bangalore,Pune,Hyderabad,Chennai.**

**Engineering Foundation**

*Non-negotiable. This is what we screen on first, and there is no AI in it.*

* Data modelling across SQL and NoSQL, and a clear view of where each one breaks
* Event-driven architecture in production with Kafka, RabbitMQ or equivalent. Ordering, replay, idempotency, dead-letter handling
* Distributed systems failure modes: partial failure, retries, backpressure, timeouts, circuit breakers
* Caching strategy and invalidation, at a scale where getting it wrong hurt
* Observability. You have instrumented a system, not just read someone else's dashboard
* At least one cloud deeply. Not three superficially
* API and integration patterns against real enterprise surfaces such as ERPs, CRMs and data platforms
* CI/CD, containers, release engineering
* You have owned something in production. On-call, incidents, the whole thing

Agent systems are distributed systems with a non-deterministic component in the middle. If the fundamentals are not there, the AI layer does not survive contact with production.

**AI Engineering**

*Two capabilities that do not come free with an engineering background. These are the ones we probe hardest.*

**Evaluation and Error Analysis**

* You have built an eval set for a non-deterministic system and used it to make a decision
* You can decompose a failure: is this a model problem, a retrieval problem, a data problem or a product problem?
* You debug agent behaviour systematically, with traces and evidence, not by gut feel

**Context Engineering**

* Deliberate management of what enters the model on each turn, and why
* Memory strategy: what persists across steps, across sessions, and what should not
* Tool surface design: what the agent can reach, how it is scoped, what happens when a tool fails
* Cost and latency as first-class design constraints, not something discovered in the invoice

**Consulting and Client Leadership**

*Equal weight to the engineering. This is a client-facing role in a services business.*

* Carry a market point of view on models, tooling and delivery patterns, and translate it into what it means for a specific client, in their language
* Run discovery workshops, solution reviews and delivery cadences with client teams
* Advise clients on standing up their own AI capability: practice structure, operating model, skills, governance, build versus buy, and adoption across their engineering org
* Shape and defend technical proposals, PoC plans and roadmaps. Own the story end to end
* Translate business problems into architectures for CXO-level stakeholders without hiding behind jargon
* Say no when the answer is no. Tell a client when agents are the wrong tool, and be able to explain why

**Delivery and Architecture**

*The work itself.*

* Own end-to-end delivery of AI-native programs, from architecture through production
* Design multi-agent orchestration using LangGraph, CrewAI or equivalent. Agent topology, tool routing, memory, state, fallback and recovery paths
* Integrate agent systems with enterprise systems of record, not toy datasets
* Build RAG where RAG is the right answer, from chunking through retrieval, re-ranking and evaluation
* Run agentic coding workflows with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or equivalent, and lead projects where AI writes significant portions of the codebase while you guide, review and ship it
* Work with MCP and shared-context tooling. Design what agents are permitted to reach and under what controls
* Bring governance into the design from day one: agent identity, privilege scoping, audit, human-in-the-loop, kill switches
* Contribute to reusable frameworks and accelerators the wider practice can use

**Team and Practice**

* Build AI engineering capability across the delivery organisation through mentoring, standards and review quality
* Evaluate new models, frameworks and tooling before the hype catches up, and kill the ones that do not earn their place
* Contribute to internal knowledge bases and practice assets

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Delhi
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**
Experience: 4-6 Years
  
  
**About the Company:**
Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic
* Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems
* AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows
* System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines
* Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence
* Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews

**What We Look For**

* Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus)
* Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work
* Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT)
* Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets
* Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms
* Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona)
* Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

title: AI Video Editor (VSL Focus)
description:
**KittySpout / DoggySpout** is looking for a **Direct Response Video Editor** to join our team! As our video editor, you will be responsible for editing, producing, and managing multiple creative projects with a heavy focus on paid ad creatives for Meta Platforms - VSLs, short and long form. You'll take raw UGC and transform it into high-converting direct response ads that scale across our paid channels. We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta. We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has deep DTC experience editing paid ads, understands direct response principles, runs a current AI stack in production, and delivers volume and quality in the same week without being chased.

**Who are we?**

KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters, and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon, and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space — $22M+ in revenue and targeting $45-50M in 2026. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're lean, we move fast, and every person on this team has a massive impact on the business.

**What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values: work smart, overdeliver, speed is king, and better everyday. We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow.

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.**

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders, and see huge career growth by playing a big role in scaling it to $100m+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, work in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, and play a big part in our growth being hands-on and active, all while having a **generous performance bonus structure** — then you've come to the right place.

**Key Objectives**

* Consistent output of **8 ad briefs per week,** maintaining volume and quality simultaneously.
* Increase your performance bonus by analyzing prior video metrics to increase views and conversions.
* Apply direct-response copywriting principles to review scripts.
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy, managing your daily workload efficiently to meet deadlines without needing hand-holding or frequent check-ins.
* Quickly learn and master new tools and software, and editing techniques as social media trends evolve, often with less than a day's notice.
* Ensure every video meets our exacting quality standards and perfectly matches the provided instructions, minimizing the need for revisions.
* Maintain clear, proactive communication with the company founders and executive team, providing updates when necessary.
* Create ad variations and iterations to scale winning ads and improve performance.
* Collaborate with the creative strategy team to bring ad concepts to life.
* Apply direct response marketing principles to editing (hooks, problem/solution flow, testimonials, CTAs).
* Stay up to date on internet trends and editing styles to ensure our ads feel native and engaging.

  
**Requirements**  

* Fully remote.
* Fluent in English.
* Proven experience creating short-form direct-response videos for DTC brands.
* Proven experience with professional video-editing software is required. We have a strong preference for Adobe Premiere Pro
* Paid Ad Focus: Proven experience editing Meta/Facebook paid ads that convert.
* Volume: Comfortable producing **8 ad briefs per week.**
* Tools: Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro
* Creative & Analytical Mindset: Ability to combine storytelling with data-driven feedback to refine and improve ads.
* No issue working overtime or on weekends if needed. You're passionate about your work and excited by the idea of producing ads that millions will see.
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
* **Deep DTC Experience**: You can name the brands and the spend levels behind your work — not just categories.
* Meta VSLs: Proven experience with short and long form Meta VSLs. Long form is the bulk of what we run.
* **AI Stack**: You run a current AI stack in production, not one you tried once.
* Output: You deliver volume and quality in the same week, without being chased.

**KPI'S you will own**

* **8 ad briefs per week** Quota
* 80% First-Pass Approval Rate: At least 80% of submissions require no revisions.

**Accountabilities**

* Deliver 8 ad briefs per week
* Edit VSLs and DR video ads with AI-first workflows
* Weekly iterations on top-performing ads to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure ads are visually compelling, on-brand, and optimized for performance.
* Stay plugged into social media/UGC trends to keep our creatives fresh and competitive.
* Troubleshoot underperforming campaigns by testing different edits, structures, and hooks.
* Work fluently across AI video and UGC tools (Higgsfield, and similar)
* Collaborate closely with strategists, copywriters, and performance teams

**This Role Is Not For You If**

* You are a meticulous video perfectionist who will spend hours refining a single transition or effect. With a high daily quota, success in this role demands efficiency. Adhering perfectly to the video template at speed is valued over spending extra time on minor details that don't contribute to views or conversions.
* You thrive in highly collaborative, team-oriented environments with frequent meetings and brainstorming sessions. This is a high-autonomy, "heads-down" role where you will be working independently the majority of the time to meet your individual production goals.
* You are a methodical planner who prefers stable, long-term projects and predictable workflows. Our environment is inherently dynamic. The tools, guidelines, and video styles can change overnight, and you must be able to pivot instantly without frustration.

**How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

We review applications on a rolling basis. If you're a great fit and the timing isn't right immediately, you'll be first in line when a spot opens up, exceptional candidates may be hired immediately.
  
Our process has three stages:  
(1) Application Review + Screening - we assess your background and experience to confirm mutual fit.
  
(2) Technical Interview + Creative Brief - a short practical exercise so we can see how you think and work.
  
(3) Culture Fit Interview - a final conversation with the founder to make sure this is the right team for you and you're the right person for us.
  
KPIs and performance targets will be defined together before your start date so expectations are crystal clear from day one.

For this role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business — and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed.

**Salary Expectation**

USD $1,000 - $1,500 per month (based on experience and expertise) + percentage of ad spend bonus structure.

**We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta only.**

* Establish deployment, rollback, monitoring and incident-response procedures.
* Implement application logging, alerting, performance monitoring and automated testing.
* Coordinate database migrations, upgrades and production releases.

* Build reusable connectors and configurable client-specific workflows.
* Maintain secure multi-tenant architecture with appropriate customer-data isolation.
* Manage technical performance, integration reliability and API security.

**Client Implementation**

* Lead client discovery, technical solutioning and implementation planning.
* Own deployment, integration, testing, user acceptance and go-live.
* Conduct technical demonstrations and client progress meetings.
* Manage developers, external contractors and implementation dependencies.
* Provide post-launch technical support and continuous improvement.

**Hands-On Engineering & Leadership**

* Personally develop and review production-quality Python/backend and agentic AI code.
* Lead technical architecture, code reviews and engineering standards.
* Manage junior developers, analysts and implementation resources.
* Make build-versus-buy decisions for AI models, infrastructure, orchestration and integrations.

**Required Experience:** 4–6 years in software/backend/AI engineering, including hands-on AWS deployment experience, production coding, API integrations and technical project ownership.

Data Platform Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Architects the data platform blueprint and implements the design, encompassing the relevant data platform components. Collaborates with the Integration Architects and Data Architects to ensure cohesive integration between systems and data models.
  
  
**Must have skills :**

15 years full time education
  
  
**Role Summary / Description**
AI Powered Tech Talent
  
  
As a Senior Engineer in AI Infrastructure Architecture for Snowflake, you will own significant portions of the end-to-end architecture and engineering of optimized data and AI infrastructure for production machine learning and AI-enabled applications. You will design scalable warehouses, Snowpark workloads, AI-ready data/feature pipelines, model-enablement patterns, automation and operational controls that align with client standards, SLAs, security, compliance and cost-efficiency expectations. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, platform modernization, regulated data workloads, FinOps and production reliability, while mentoring engineers and partnering with architects to translate business requirements into robust Snowflake-based AI infrastructure solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Own end-to-end architecture and design of optimized Snowflake data and AI infrastructure, including warehouses, Snowpark workloads, secure data architecture, AI-ready feature/data pipelines, model integration and AI application enablement.
  
  
Design and tune scalable Snowflake warehouses, tasks, streams, Snowpark services, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streamlit applications and cloud integrations, including compute sizing, query optimization, governance, access controls and high-throughput data access design.
  
  
Serve as an authoritative AI infrastructure expert on Snowflake, applying deep knowledge of Snowflake Data Cloud capabilities, data/AI application patterns, governance, security and cost levers.
  
  
Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security, compliance, cost and operational complexity.
  
  
Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation actions.
  
  
Drive architecture decision-making by documenting rationale, trade-offs, assumptions and dependencies so decisions are transparent, defensible and aligned with business SLAs and standards.
  
  
Define and maintain AI infrastructure roadmap inputs, capacity planning models, scaling strategies, cost forecasts and performance improvement opportunities.
  
  
Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization.
  
  
Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards.
  
  
Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with business outcomes and translate requirements into actionable architecture standards.
  
  
Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large-scale engineering solutions.
  
  
Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C++, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages.
  
  
Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform-native workflow tooling.
  
  
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced engineering or client delivery environment.
  
  
Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large-scale solutions.
  
  
Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.
  
  
Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns.
  
  
**Required Skills/ Experience**
Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake warehouses, databases, schemas, secure data sharing/access controls, Snowpark, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streams/Tasks, Streamlit and cloud ecosystem integrations.
  
  
Experience architecting scalable data and feature pipelines, AI application integrations, model-enablement patterns, governance, query/warehouse optimization and secure data access.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python, dbt/Terraform, CI/CD, DataOps, MLOps/AI enablement patterns, observability and incident response practices.
  
  
Ability to optimize Snowflake AI infrastructure for performance, cost, scalability, security, reliability and compliance.
  
  
Experience producing architecture decision records, reference implementations, standards, runbooks and reusable platform patterns.
  
  
Good to Have Skills
  
  
Snowflake certifications such as SnowPro Advanced Architect, SnowPro Advanced Data Engineer or related AI/data platform credentials.
  
  
Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail/e-commerce, telecom, manufacturing, energy or public sector environments where data/AI platforms must meet compliance, security, reliability and cost-control requirements.
  
  
Exposure to Snowpark, Cortex/AI features, vector search, retrieval pipelines, feature engineering, model enablement and AI application architecture.
  
  
Knowledge of Snowflake governance, secure data sharing, FinOps, infrastructure partner/vendor collaboration and production support operating models.

title: Senior Manager - Software Development
description:
**Location Details:**
Gurugram, India

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

This is a hybrid position. You’ll divide your time between working remotely from your home and an office, so you should live within commuting distance. Hybrid teams may work in-office as much as a few times a week or as little as once a month or quarter, as decided by leadership. The hiring manager can share more about what hybrid work might look like for this team.

**Join our Team**

Data is the most valuable asset in GoDaddy, and our FORGE team is at the center of building an enriched and valuable ecosystem of AI-based data products and services that drives innovation for our partners and clients, serving as integral platforms for generating revenue and competitive advantages within GoDaddy and globally!

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager who is excited about applying AI to complex data challenges! You'll bring strong experience in Agentic AI, workflow automation, and modern data engineering, while helping shape scalable data platforms and AI-powered solutions. This role requires a balance of hands-on technical depth, long-term thinking, and collaboration across teams to drive adoption of data and AI capabilities. If you enjoy solving ambiguous problems, working with large-scale data systems, and building technology that has real business outcomes, we'd love to hear from you!

**What you'll get to do...**

* Lead, coach, grow, and retain a multidisciplinary team of AI and Data Engineers, providing technical leadership and people management across AI/ML, agentic systems, and platform development

* Partner closely with Product, Business Analysis, Data Science, Security, Privacy, Legal, and peer teams in the US region to understand data challenges and deliver scalable, compliant solutions aligned with GoDaddy security and privacy policies

**Your experience should include...**

* 10+ years of experience in data architecture and building data ecosystems, including 5+ years developing big data solutions and deep expertise in optimising distributed computing systems
* 2+ years of strong experience in Agentic AI development, building and deploying autonomous agents across complex data ecosystems, with expertise in data modelling, metadata management, and data quality
* 5+ years of experience leading, managing, and developing diverse, highly motivated engineering teams
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and multitasking skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with both business and technical stakeholders while balancing competing priorities
* Demonstrated ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where continuous innovation is occurring

**You might also have...**

* A Bachelor’s degree in CS or related technical field
* Proficient in Python, Scala, and Java, with strong experience building Agentic AI systems, including autonomous workflows, agent harnesses, memory management, and orchestration frameworks
* Strong understanding of the modern AI stack, including LLM architectures, frontier and open-source models, prompt engineering, token economy, embeddings, and RAG patterns
* Strong experience developing big data solutions using Apache Spark, EMR, and Databricks for batch and stream processing, with a proven track record of delivering end-to-end analytics solutions on AWS (S3, Athena, Kinesis, Redshift, EMR, MWAA, Bedrock)
* Good knowledge of standard machine learning techniques, including Regression, Classification, Anomaly Detection, and Forecasting, using Spark, Python, and related ML libraries

*We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.*

**We've got your back...**

GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. .

.

We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups (
Culture

title: Senior Data Engineering Manager - T&T
description:
You may know McCormick as a leader in herbs, spices, seasonings, and condiments – and we’re only getting started. At McCormick, we’re always looking for new people to bring their unique flavor to our team.
  
  
McCormick employees – all 14,000 of us across the world – are what makes this company a great place to work.
  
  
**Position Summary**
As a Data Engineering Manager at McCormick, you will play a pivotal role in the build and delivery of data products from simple to complex and supporting McCormick business units with their data and analytics needs.
  
  
Your responsibilities will include leading a team that delivers and supports data for existing analytics solutions, tooling, and solutions, researching new features and implementing automations. You will support business users, Data Scientists and Data Analysts to convert business expectations into data products and data models usable by business to deliver AI, analysis, reporting, and data-driven recommendations to stakeholders and executives.
  
  
This role will be accountable for building and maintaining scalable data pipelines from source systems. The Data Engineering Manager will ensure the availability, reliability, and performance of data products by integrating raw data from various sources. Key responsibilities include data modeling, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) development, and ensuring data quality and security. This role will be accountable for data coming in from 5+ source systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Plan and Design**

* Collaborate with data product managers to gather data product requirements.
* Design end-to-end solutions including data security, data quality and performance requirements.
* Prepare documentation and with data product managers to define the implementation plan.

**Data Extraction, Load and Transformation**

* Implement ELT pipelines to efficiently ingest and transform data from a wide variety of data sources and deliver datasets that meet business requirements.
* Ensure efficient and reliable data mapping to support business needs.
* Deliver complete documentation and knowledge transfer sessions for the Team and business partners.
* Maintain existing solutions, implement optimizations and enhancements, monitor data quality.
* Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines leveraging Azure Synapse, PySpark, APIs, and SQL & performing advanced data cleaning, transformation, and manipulation to ensure high-quality, and reliable data flows.

**Process Improvement, Performance and Cost optimization tuning**

* Collaborate with Data Science, Machine Learning and Business Analytics teams to optimize performance and cost effectiveness of their analytics solutions.
* Identify and design internal process improvements, including automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, and redesigning solutions for enhanced scalability. Work with Azure Analytics Product Owner to prioritize and schedule implementation.
* Design and implement existing solution adjustments to improve performance and cost-effectiveness.
* Suggest and introduce best practices for Data and AI engineering.

**Issue Resolution and Support**

* Assist stakeholders with data-related technical issues and support their data needs. Work with the Analytics Operational Support team to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve data errors / discrepancies.
* Provide expert-level support and guidance to data teams across the Enterprise.

**People Leadership & Capability Building**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of 8-10 data engineers.
* Define technical standards, code review practices, and engineering excellence frameworks.
* Build career paths, upskilling programs, and succession plans within data engineering.
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Be accountable for building a winning data engineering team – driven by making data a core asset for McCormick.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics/Science, or related field; Masters in technical field or MBA a plus
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer (DP203+AZ305)
* or Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate or related cloud technologies, Fabric IQ/databricks certifications a plus
* 12+ years of data engineering experience.
* Demonstrated ability coding in one or more languages (PySpark preferred).
* Experience with data visualization software (Power BI preferred).
* Experience with building data pipelines.
* Experience with knowledge graphs.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Knowledge of data analysis, visualization techniques, and frameworks.
* Experience performing root cause analysis on internal and external data and processes to answer specific business questions and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Experience with the following tooling:
* SQL, Fabric, Databricks, Synapse, Azure Data Factory, Azure ML, Azure DevOps (for CI/CD),
* OR
* GCP BigQuery, FiveTran, GCP Cloud Composer, GCP DLP (Data Loss Prevention), GCP Cloud Run, Vertex AI etc

At McCormick, we have over a 100-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value

**What you should bring:**

* **Bring practical experience building with AI and strong engineering judgment**
  . You understand how models, agents, data and conventional software fit together, can evaluate their limitations, and can guide teams from promising prototypes to dependable production systems.

* **People leadership**

* **Clear communication and influence**

Experience building shared platforms, scaling software products or improving complex production systems is particularly relevant. We welcome technical founders, early engineering leaders and operators from established companies who bring sustained ownership and measurable engineering impact.

AI-native workflows and shared capabilities that teams adopt; faster delivery with better quality; less repeated work and manual intervention; reliable, secure systems; and stronger technical leaders. Noida Sector 135
