title: Synthetic Data & Teleoperation Engineer (Robotics)
description:
**About Asiacruit**
At Asiacruit, we connect top talent with forward-thinking organizations across industries. Our mission is to help businesses grow through smart, strategic, and people-focused solutions. We support companies by providing high-quality talent for local and global markets.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a
**Synthetic Data & Teleoperation Engineer**
to build simulation environments, synthetic data pipelines, and teleoperation systems that support the development of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and robotic learning.
  
  
You will create realistic virtual environments for diverse security scenarios, develop systems for capturing robotic demonstrations, and manage datasets used to train and evaluate AI models. This role combines robotics simulation, 3D environment development, teleoperation hardware, and data engineering to help bridge the gap between simulated training and real-world robotic applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build synthetic data generation pipelines using NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Omniverse for diverse scenarios, including night vision, perimeter breaches, and adverse weather conditions.
* Develop and maintain simulation environments that support robotic perception, planning, and manipulation tasks.
* Design, configure, and maintain VR-based teleoperation systems and hardware setups to capture high-quality demonstration trajectories for imitation learning.
* Integrate teleoperation interfaces and robotics simulation workflows using OpenXR and related technologies.
* Develop and maintain dataset curation, automated labeling, and data processing pipelines for robotic foundation model training.
* Organize and maintain structured, tokenized repositories of robotic demonstrations for training and evaluation.
* Use tools such as Blender and Unreal Engine to develop and refine realistic 3D environments and simulation assets.
* Evaluate simulation realism and identify visual discrepancies between simulated environments and real-world conditions.
* Benchmark and reduce Sim-to-Real domain gaps to improve the reliability of models trained on synthetic data.
* Collaborate with AI researchers and robotics engineers to support VLA model development, imitation learning, and simulation-based experimentation.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Graphics, or a related field.
* Approximately 2–4 years of relevant experience in robotics simulation, synthetic data generation, teleoperation, 3D environment development, or related areas.
* Proficiency in Python and familiarity with C++.
* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Omniverse, or other robotics simulation platforms.
* Understanding of USD (Universal Scene Description) and simulation asset workflows.
* Experience with VR-based teleoperation, OpenXR, or hardware interfaces is an advantage.
* Familiarity with Blender, Unreal Engine, or other 3D content creation tools.
* Understanding of robotic demonstration collection, imitation learning, or robotics dataset preparation.
* Knowledge of synthetic data generation, automated labeling, domain randomization, or Sim-to-Real evaluation is a plus.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to build practical simulation and data pipelines.

**Why Join?**

* Work at the intersection of robotics simulation, synthetic data, and embodied AI.
* Build virtual environments and teleoperation systems that support real-world robotic learning.
* Contribute to the development of advanced AI systems using simulation-driven training and evaluation.

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams working on robotics, foundation models, and intelligent perception.

title: Commodity Research Analyst - Demand
description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
The Commodity Research Analyst (Demand) will conduct complex trading analytics efforts focused on Grains and Oilseeds Markets with specific focus on the livestock and feed markets. In this role, you will analyse short- and long-term livestock growth trends, margins, inventory, supply and demand fundamentals, industry developments, and government policy changes, with a particular focus on the dairy and poultry sectors in India.
  
  
You will translate livestock market insights into feed-volume forecasts, assess industrialization in the feed sector as a driver of growth, and combine feed-formulation models with industry intelligence to develop dynamic, tradable demand forecasts. The role will support trading, risk management, and asset-utilization decisions across global and local markets.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Develop and execute models and tools to forecast prices, demand, relative value, and global market trends.
* Analyse short- and long-term livestock growth, margins, and inventory, with a focus on the dairy and poultry sectors.
* Translate livestock and feed-formulation insights into dynamic, tradable feed-volume and commodity-demand forecasts, considering feed-sector industrialization.
* Analyse demand, pricing, and supply fundamentals across Corn, wheat, oilseeds, DDGS, and other grain and oilseed by-products.
* Produce weekly supply-and-demand and price updates; assess India’s government policies, industry developments, capacity expansion, and competitive dynamics.
* Partner with traders, commercial teams, analysts, and stakeholders to develop market scenarios, provide actionable insights, support data and technology initiatives, and resolve issues independently.

**Qualifications**
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience, with a minimum of three years of relevant work experience.
* Knowledge of trading, risk management, economics, and commodity supply-and-demand fundamentals, including agricultural commodity markets.
* Strong analytical reasoning and collaboration skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information, derive accurate insights, and build consensus with global teams and local stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree with proficiency in modelling, coding, data science, and big data management, including experience developing supply-and-demand forecasts, price models, scenario analyses, or other trading analytics.
* Knowledge or experience in feed formulation, feed-sector industrialization, particularly in India.

title: Director- Revenue Operations & Intelligence
description:

Algoworks is an award-winning artificial intelligence, engineering services and experience transformation firm with offices across the United States, Europe, South America and India. We bring together a global team of engineers, architects, designers, researchers and operators united by rigor, accountability and a commitment to delivering measurable results.

For over 20 years, Algoworks has partnered with Fortune 500 organizations across the Americas, Europe and Asia to define, build and run technology that drives meaningful business outcomes. Innovation, particularly in the responsible application of AI, is embedded in how teams approach problem-solving and continuous improvement.

At Algoworks, growth is continuous and closely tied to impact. Teams collaborate across geographies and disciplines, strengthening outcomes through shared insight and collective expertise. The culture values transparency, open dialogue and an environment where every voice is heard and contribution is recognized.

Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact.

Follow the video below to know about us!
Clipchamp

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a world-class, experienced, and proven Revenue Operations leader to strengthen how Algoworks understands, manages, and improves commercial performance. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer and working closely with senior leadership across Sales, Marketing, Delivery, and Technology, this role will be responsible for making the go-to-market (GTM) operating model work better, not simply reporting on its performance.

The position combines revenue intelligence with process design, data governance, systems effectiveness, and adoption to create a trusted, forward-looking view of the revenue engine. The role will improve how teams operate from lead generation through revenue realization.

This is not a Salesforce architect or engineering role. The successful candidate must understand GTM systems deeply enough to define how they should support the business, identify where processes or data are failing, and work hand-in-hand with technical
specialists to implement scalable improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Executive Revenue Intelligence**

* Create integrated, forward-looking views of pipeline, bookings, backlog, forecast, revenue, and customer growth.
* Explain material movements, underlying drivers, emerging risks, and growth opportunities in concise, executive-ready terms.
* Ensure leadership receives actionable insights and recommendations rather than simply reports and dashboards.

**2. Commercial Performance & Predictability**

* Evaluate pipeline health, coverage, movement, conversion, sales velocity, deal slippage, and forecast risk.
* Analyze performance across customers, service lines, markets, geographies, and revenue streams.
* Recommend focused interventions to improve commercial performance and revenue predictability.

**3. Revenue Operating Model**

* Establish clear business definitions for pipeline stages, opportunity categories, forecast classifications, and critical revenue measures.
* Identify broken handoffs, recurring exceptions, duplicated effort, and unnecessary manual work across the revenue lifecycle.
* Redesign high-value processes, define required business rules and controls, and drive adoption of the improved operating model.

**4. Marketing, Sales & Finance Alignment**

* Connect Marketing activity to qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes, including funnel conversion, lead quality, attribution, and channel effectiveness.
* Support Sales with pipeline, forecast, conversion, and account insights.
* Help Finance connect commercial expectations with bookings, backlog, and revenue realization.
* Create a consistent and trusted fact base across Sales, Marketing, Alliances, Finance, and leadership while respecting each function's responsibilities and decision rights
  **.**

**5. GTM Systems Effectiveness, Data & CRM Governance**

* Be accountable for the business effectiveness, data quality, governance, and adoption of the GTM technology ecosystem, with Salesforce serving as the primary commercial source of truth.
* Define business requirements and operating standards for opportunity hygiene, field consistency, close dates, lead and campaign data, source attribution, metric definitions, workflows, reporting discipline, and user adoption.
* Work hand-in-hand with Salesforce, BI, data, and technology specialists to translate GTM requirements into scalable architecture, integrations, automation, and system improvements.
* Ensure business outcomes and user adoption remain the primary focus of technology improvements.

**6. Strategic Revenue Initiatives, Automation & AI**

* Lead a focused portfolio of initiatives that materially improve revenue visibility, predictability, or operating effectiveness.
* Frame complex commercial problems, prioritize opportunities by business impact and feasibility, and define the desired operating outcomes.
* Coordinate implementation with relevant functional and technical specialists.
* Identify practical applications of analytics, automation, and AI to improve forecasting, data quality, decision support, and recurring revenue processes.

**Required Technical Skills & Competencies**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Revenue Intelligence, or Commercial Strategy.
* At least 5 years in senior roles involving revenue analysis, commercial operations, or cross-functional revenue management.
* Strong understanding of complex B2B revenue models, including pipeline, forecasting, bookings, backlog, revenue realization, and customer growth.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to connect revenue expectations to operational and financial outcomes.
* Deep working knowledge of Salesforce from a Revenue Operations perspective, including data model concepts, workflows, governance, adoption, and integration patterns. Hands-on development is not required.
* Experience with marketing automation and GTM platforms such as Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, Amplemarket, or comparable tools.
* Advanced Excel capabilities and experience with BI platforms such as Power BI.
* Experience defining metrics, analytical frameworks, business requirements, GTM processes, data standards, system adoption measures, and executive reporting.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive cross-functional outcomes without relying on direct authority.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Substantial experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Revenue Intelligence, or Commercial Strategy.
* Experience in senior roles involving revenue analysis, commercial operations, or cross-functional revenue management.
* Strong understanding of B2B revenue models, pipeline management, forecasting, bookings, backlog, and revenue realization.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen.

title: Responsible AI Governance &
description:
Greeting from TCS!!

We are looking for
**Data Quality & Responsible AI Control Operations**

**Role: Specialist**
, Data Quality & Responsible AI Control Operations

**Location**
-Noida

**Experience range**
-8+

**Role Summary**

The Specialist, Data Quality & Responsible AI Control Operations is a hands-on role responsible for implementing, maintaining, and improving data quality and AI data readiness controls across authorized data sources, data products, and AI use cases. This role supports the connection between data architecture, hands-on data modeling, data management, Responsible AI, and control operations to help ensure AI products consume governed, traceable, fit-for-purpose, and high-quality data. The ideal candidate brings practical experience in data quality engineering, data modeling, data governance, metadata, lineage, control execution, and automation, with the ability to work closely with domain, technology, risk, compliance, audit, and AI governance stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

* Implement data quality and AI data readiness controls across authorized data sources, data products, semantic products, and AI use cases.
* Support definition and application of AI-ready data criteria, including quality thresholds, lineage completeness, metadata completeness, source authorization, classification, access controls, issue history, freshness, and remediation expectations.
* Translate Responsible AI control requirements into practical data control tasks, test cases, rule logic, evidence requirements, and implementation steps.
* Partner with data architects, data engineering, platform, and domain teams to implement controls across ingestion, transformation, publication, semantic access, AI consumption, and runtime monitoring.
* Perform hands-on data modeling across conceptual, logical, physical, canonical, and semantic models to support trusted data products, ADS certification, AI consumption patterns, and downstream DQ control design.
* Configure and maintain DQ rules, thresholds, evidence payloads, control templates, metadata mappings, and implementation artifacts using approved patterns.
* Work with domain teams to define DQ rules, set thresholds, emit raw DQ metrics, manage exceptions, remediate issues, and provide evidence in alignment with central governance expectations.
* Execute recurring data profiling, rule runs, exception reviews, issue triage, root-cause analysis support, remediation tracking, retesting, recertification, and closure evidence.
* Support integration of data quality controls into AI lifecycle gates so AI products use fit-for-purpose, authorized, governed, traceable, and appropriately controlled data sources.
* Maintain control library entries for data quality, AI data readiness, metadata, lineage, access, privacy, monitoring, certification, and lifecycle governance.
* Identify and implement automation opportunities that reduce manual governance effort while improving traceability, repeatability, defensibility, and audit readiness.
* Build and maintain monitoring thresholds, alerts, KRIs, KPIs, control effectiveness measures, dashboards, and reports that show data quality health, AI data readiness, exceptions, and remediation progress.
* Coordinate with business owners, product teams, data domains, platform engineering, architecture, security, privacy, legal, compliance, risk, model risk, and audit to support execution of control requirements.
* Maintain audit-ready documentation, including control mappings, rule logic, test results, workflow decisions, approvals, exceptions, incident records, remediation evidence, and management reporting inputs.
* Contribute to playbooks, standards, implementation guidance, training, and enablement materials that help business and technology teams adopt DQ and RAI control practices.

Required Skills and Experience

* Practical experience in enterprise data quality, data governance, data management, data architecture, technology controls, Responsible AI operations, or a closely related discipline within a complex enterprise environment.
* Good understanding of enterprise data architecture, hands-on data modeling, authorized data sources, data products, data contracts, metadata, lineage, semantic layers, access controls, and governed lakehouse or cloud data platform patterns.
* Hands-on experience designing, reviewing, or maintaining conceptual, logical, physical, canonical, dimensional, domain, and semantic data models, including entity relationships, critical data elements, business definitions, data contracts, and AI-consumable semantic structures.
* Hands-on knowledge of data quality practices, including rule design, profiling, thresholds, data observability, reconciliation, anomaly detection, issue management, remediation, and quality scorecards.
* Ability to connect data quality outcomes to Responsible AI control needs, including traceability, data suitability, representativeness, bias/proxy-risk considerations, privacy constraints, monitoring, and lifecycle governance.
* Experience implementing controls in pipelines, workflows, platforms, certification routines, metadata systems, or CI/CD processes rather than relying solely on manual review.
* Familiarity with AI/ML, generative AI, agentic AI, model lifecycle management, model registries, evaluation workflows, monitoring, and production release controls.
* Ability to convert policy, regulatory, and control expectations into practical tasks, acceptance criteria, testing steps, operating routines, and evidence artifacts.
* Experience working with cross-functional control partners such as risk, compliance, legal, privacy, information security, model risk, internal audit, and business control teams.
* Ability to support metrics and dashboards that communicate control coverage, control effectiveness, exceptions, incidents, data quality health, AI data readiness, and remediation progress.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical and governance concepts clearly to practitioners, stakeholders, and control partners.
* Strong execution skills, including backlog support, stakeholder follow-up, decision documentation, issue tracking, control testing, and delivery against milestones.

Relevant Tools and Technology Exposure

* **Data quality and data observability tools:**
  Experience with platforms that support profiling, rule management, quality thresholds, anomaly detection, freshness monitoring, reconciliation, schema drift detection, issue management, and quality dashboards; examples include Ataccama ONE Data Quality, Informatica Data Quality, Collibra Data Quality, Soda, Monte Carlo, and Great Expectations or equivalent tools.
* **Metadata, catalog, lineage, and data governance platforms:**
  Working knowledge of cataloging, glossary management, metadata harvesting, lineage mapping, data ownership, stewardship workflows, data product certification, and policy mapping capabilities; examples include Informatica CDGC, Collibra, Microsoft Purview, Alation, OpenLineage, and related catalog or governance platforms.
* **Responsible AI, AI governance, agentic AI, and ModelOps platforms:**
  Familiarity with AI use case intake, model or agent registries, model risk workflows, evaluation tooling, monitoring, lifecycle governance, runtime guardrails, and AI control evidence; examples include IBM watsonx.governance, AWS AgentCore, AWS Guardrails, Azure AI Studio, Azure Machine Learning, MLflow, Databricks Mosaic AI, and model registry or monitoring platforms.
* **Cloud, data platform, and lakehouse technologies:**
  Familiarity with enterprise data and AI environments across modern cloud platforms, governed lakehouse architectures, warehouses, object storage, semantic layers, and pipeline-based data delivery; examples include AWS, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and similar enterprise data platforms.
* **Pipeline, orchestration, and automation tooling:**
  Experience embedding governance and quality checks into data pipelines, workflow orchestration, CI/CD, monitoring routines, and automated evidence generation; examples include Airflow, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, dbt, GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, and equivalent orchestration or DevOps tooling.
* **Workflow, issue management, and reporting tools:**
  Ability to use or partner on workflows, dashboards, scorecards, exception reporting, remediation tracking, and executive reporting to communicate control health and adoption progress; examples include ServiceNow, Jira, Power BI, Tableau, and similar workflow or reporting platforms.
* **Technical languages, modeling, and configuration skills:**
  Practical fluency with SQL and Python, hands-on data modeling, plus comfort reading or writing APIs, YAML, JSON, Git-based configuration, rule logic, metadata definitions, semantic definitions, and reusable control templates.

title: Senior Consultant - Resource Geology
description: Job DescriptionWSP is seeking a Senior Consultant - Resource Geology to join the GCC Specialist Mining Services team, delivering resource geology services to our global mining business. Reporting to the Mining Team Leader, the successful candidate will lead and deliver geological interpretation, three-dimensional geological modelling, mineral resource estimation, and technical reporting for open-pit and underground mining projects worldwide.This is a senior technical role that combines hands-on delivery with technical leadership. The Senior Consultant will take ownership of assigned resource geology scopes, provide guidance and review for junior geologists, engage directly with WSP global mining leaders and clients, and ensure that geological models and mineral resource estimates are technically defensible, well documented, and consistent with recognised reporting standards such as JORC, NI 43-101, and S-K 1300.ResponsibilitiesGeological Data Management and Validation Lead the compilation, validation, and management of exploration and resource datasets, including collar, survey, lithology, alteration, mineralisation, density, geotechnical, and assay information. Review sampling, QA/QC, and laboratory data, assess data quality and fitness for use in mineral resource estimation, and document findings and corrective actions. Oversee database preparation, data import, coding, compositing, and reconciliation activities in accordance with project and WSP procedures. Maintain rigorous data lineage, assumptions registers, and version control for geological models and estimation inputs.Geological Interpretation and 3D Modelling Lead the interpretation of orebody geometry, lithology, stratigraphy, weathering, alteration, mineralisation, and structural controls using drilling, mapping, geophysical, and other datasets. Develop, update, and review three-dimensional geological, domain, and mineralisation models for open-pit and underground deposits. Produce and review geological sections, plans, wireframes, surfaces, solids, and supporting visualisations for technical review and client communication. Work with geotechnical, hydrogeological, mine planning, and engineering disciplines to ensure geological interpretations support wider project objectives.Mineral Resource Estimation Lead exploratory data analysis, domaining, compositing, top-cut assessment, declustering, variography, density assignment, and selection of estimation parameters. Build, review, and validate block models using appropriate estimation techniques, and support Competent or Qualified Persons in resource sign-off. Undertake model validation using visual, statistical, and spatial comparison methods, and clearly document results and limitations. Lead mineral resource classification, reporting, reconciliation, risk, and sensitivity assessments in line with applicable project and reporting requirements.Technical Reporting and Compliance Author and review technical reports, memoranda, presentations, model documentation, data-room reviews, and due-diligence deliverables. Deliver work aligned with recognised mineral resource reporting frameworks, including JORC, NI 43-101, and S-K 1300, as applicable to the assignment. Prepare clear descriptions of data, methods, assumptions, limitations, risks, and recommendations for internal, client, and public-reporting audiences. Ensure calculations, figures, tables, and model outputs are technically consistent, traceable, and suitable for independent review or audit. Apply and uphold WSP quality-management, checking, review, document-control, health, safety, and environmental requirements.Exploration and Field Support Plan, review, and provide technical oversight of exploration, drilling, logging, sampling, QA/QC, density, mapping, and field data-collection programmes. Undertake or supervise geological core logging, field mapping, sampling oversight, and contractor coordination during site assignments. Assess the adequacy and spatial distribution of geological information and recommend additional data collection where required. Comply with project and site health, safety, environmental, and operational requirements during all field activities.Project Delivery, Leadership, and Collaboration Deliver assigned resource geology scopes across WSP's global mining business as part of the GCC Specialist Mining Services team. Work closely with the Mining Team Leader on resourcing, planning, scheduling, budgets, quality expectations, and delivery of project commitments. Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and review for junior and intermediate geologists, and support their technical development. Engage directly with WSP global mining leaders, project managers, and clients to clarify requirements, present findings, and provide expert recommendations. Participate in the full project lifecycle, including proposals, scopes of work, contract inputs, technical quality, and senior review. Communicate progress, data limitations, technical risks, and required decisions promptly and clearly across regions and time zones. Support business development through technical input into proposals, client meetings, and presentations. Contribute to standard methods, templates, reusable workflows, lessons learned, knowledge sharing, and capability building within the team.QualificationsEducation and Experience Master's degree in Geology, Applied Geology, Engineering Geology, Mining Geology, Earth Sciences, or a related discipline. A Bachelor's degree with strong relevant experience will also be considered. Approximately 6 to 10 years of relevant experience in resource geology, exploration geology, or mining consulting, covering open-pit and/or underground projects. Demonstrated experience delivering geological models and mineral resource estimates as part of studies, operations, or independent reviews.Technical Skills Strong capability in geological interpretation, three-dimensional wireframing, domaining, block modelling, and resource model validation. Sound understanding of sampling theory, QA/QC, descriptive statistics, geostatistics, variography, and common estimation methods. Working knowledge of mineral resource reporting frameworks, including JORC, NI 43-101, and S-K 1300. Proficiency in relevant geological and mining software such as Leapfrog Geo / Edge, Datamine, Surpac, Vulcan, Micromine, Maptek, Deswik, AutoCAD, ArcGIS, or QGIS. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and confidence working with large, complex technical datasets. Ability to prepare and review clear figures, plans, sections, tables, model documentation, and technical reports in English. Understanding of quality assurance, technical checking, data governance, and version control for geological deliverables.Mining and Consulting Knowledge Solid understanding of open-pit and underground mining workflows and how geological models inform mine planning, evaluation, and investment decisions. Ability to identify geological uncertainties and clearly communicate their implications for resource confidence and project outcomes. Awareness of multidisciplinary interfaces with geotechnical engineering, hydrogeology, metallurgy, mine planning, environment, and closure. Proven ability to deliver technically appropriate, cost-effective solutions within scope, schedule, budget, quality, and safety requirements. Proficiency in spoken and written English; proficiency in French is considered an advantage, although not mandatory.Preferred Qualifications Experience leading mineral resource estimates for open-pit or underground hard-rock mining projects. Exposure to multiple commodities, deposit styles, and stages of study or operation. Experience with database systems, scripting, workflow automation, Python, R, SQL, or data visualisation tools. Experience contributing to technical studies, due diligence, audits, independent reviews, or public-reporting documentation. Field experience in geological mapping, drilling supervision, core logging, sampling, or explorationprogramme management. Familiarity with reconciliation, grade control, short-term modelling, or operational geology workflows. Experience working within distributed, multidisciplinary, or global project teams. Professional registration, or eligibility for registration, with a recognised professional geoscience body, with progress toward Competent or Qualified Person status considered an advantage.Key CompetenciesGeological judgement Develops and defends sound interpretations from available evidence and clearly communicates uncertainty and limitations.Technical leadership Takes ownership of assigned scopes, guides junior staff, and provides constructive technical review.Technical accuracy Applies rigorous checking, consistent methods, and strong attention to detail across datasets, models, and reports.Problem solving Investigates data and modelling issues systematically and develops practical, defensible solutions.Client focus Understands client and project needs and delivers responsive, value-adding technical advice.Communication Presents technical findings clearly through concise writing, effective graphics, and confident discussion.Delivery focus Plans work, meets commitments, raises risks early, and supports safe, high-quality project outcomes.Continuous learning Builds capability in geological methods, software, reporting standards, and emerging industry practice.BGV:Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.About UsWSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones: Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise. www.wsp.com We arePassionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.Working with UsAt WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.Our Hybrid Working ModuleWith us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model.Maximize collaboration.Maintain product quality and cultural integrity.Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency.Health, Safety and WellbeingOur people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. title: Sales Compensation Analyst (Compensation & Payroll Operations)
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
10
  
  
**The Role**
The
**Sales Compensation Analyst (Compensation & Payroll Operations)**
is a critical technical and operational position within the global Sales Compensation team.
  
  
**The Team**
You will join the global Sales Compensation team — a high-impact, technically sophisticated group at the operational heart of S&P Global's commercial engine. Spanning time zones and geographies, we combine enterprise system precision with financial rigor to ensure 1,500+ salespeople worldwide are paid accurately and on time, every single cycle. We are a team that values methodical problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and an unwavering commitment to scalable, auditable, and compliant operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Impact**

* Drive end-to-end commission calculation cycles for 1,500+ global payees across all commercial business units — delivering 100% mathematically precise, on-time payroll files to regional Finance and Payroll teams across the US, EMEA, and APAC.
* Administer and configure the enterprise Xactly platform (Incent, Connect & Analytics) — owning crediting rule setup, tiered accelerator matrices, split-crediting algorithms, batch ETL pipeline monitoring, and participant security profiles that directly reflect published annual compensation plans.
* Execute the full payee lifecycle — from configuring new hire profiles and quota ramp models, to implementing mid-period role transitions, LOA credit adjustments, and producing audit-ready departure settlement calculations.
* Build and optimize advanced SQL queries and Python/Alteryx automation scripts to perform high-volume ledger-to-payout reconciliations, pre-payroll sanity checks, distribution curve analyses, and root-cause remediation of calculation anomalies before file delivery.
* Lead annual platform readiness activities — authoring UAT test scripts, executing calculation logic change validation, managing plan roll-forwards, and maintaining comprehensive SOPs and runbooks that keep operational cycles repeatable and defensible.
* Serve as the frontline operational liaison to the Central Governance & Compliance team — delivering automated calculation logs, approval artifacts, and clear mathematical payout explanations to global sales leaders, managers, and representatives across multiple time zones.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Xactly System Administration & Configuration Management**

* Serve as the core hands-on administrator for Xactly Incent, Xactly Connect, and Xactly Analytics, overseeing rule configurations, crediting logic, participant hierarchies, and payout rate tables.
* Configure and maintain crediting rules, plan logic, tiered accelerator matrices, and split-crediting algorithms inside Xactly to reflect published annual compensation plans.
* Manage batch ETL integrations and data sync pipelines between upstream CRM/data warehouse platforms and Xactly Connect, proactively monitoring API sync jobs and resolving ingestion failures.
* Lead platform readiness for annual plan roll-forwards, plan parameter cutovers, and system testing; author test scripts and perform User Acceptance Testing for calculation logic changes.
* Administer participant security profiles, statement release workflows, and audit tracking within Xactly to ensure strict data privacy and system integrity.

**End-to-End Commission Calculation & Payroll Execution**

* Own and execute the monthly and quarterly commission calculation process across all global commercial business units, ensuring 100% timeliness and mathematical precision.
* Lead high-pressure calculation cycles against strict monthly payroll cutoffs, coordinating data freezes, calculation runs, manual adjustment validations, and final payroll sign-offs.
* Generate, reconcile, and format gross-to-net payroll transmission files, ensuring seamless handoffs to regional Payroll and Finance teams in the US, EMEA, and APAC.
* Perform automated pre-payroll sanity checks, distribution curve analyses, and historical variance spot-checks to catch calculation spikes, zero-payout outliers, and crediting bugs before file delivery.
* Execute calculation reruns, retroactive plan corrections, and adjustment batches within established cutover windows.

**Payee Lifecycle Operational Execution**

* New Hires & Onboarding: Configure new payee profiles in Xactly, assign plan rules, set up draw and guarantee schedules, and apply effective-dated quota ramp models based on start dates.
* Mid-Period Role Changes & Promotions: Implement plan transitions, target prorations, and crediting split adjustments for internal transfers and commercial promotions.
* Leaves of Absence (LOA): Adjust quota relief parameters, freeze crediting timelines, and prorate plan targets according to regional statutory and corporate policy guidelines.
* Departures & Offboarding: Calculate final commission settlements, review trailing pipeline revenues, verify recovery and clawback schedules, and deliver audit-ready exit calculations.
* HRIS-to-Engine Roster Reconciliation: Run scheduled automated reconciliations between Workday/HRIS and Xactly to identify roster deltas, missing employee IDs, and effective-date mismatches before payroll lock.

**Advanced Data Reconciliations, Automation & Quality Assurance**

* Build, maintain, and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, join, and audit high-volume transaction datasets across enterprise databases and calculation engines.
* Develop automated data reconciliation scripts using Python (Pandas), Alteryx, or advanced script-based tools to perform automated ledgers-to-payout reconciliations.
* Identify, isolate, and remediate root causes of data anomalies, including duplicate deal bookings, mismatched currency conversions, orphan transactions, and misaligned territory mapping.
* Maintain comprehensive calculation runbooks, process maps, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure repeatable, documented operational cycles.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance Liaison**

description:

The
**Sales Compensation Analyst (Compensation & Payroll Operations)**

You will join the global Sales Compensation team — a high-impact, technically sophisticated group at the operational heart of S&P Global's commercial engine. * SQL Proficiency: Demonstrated experience writing complex multi-table JOIN queries, subqueries, indexing, and aggregation scripts to validate high-volume financial transaction datasets.
* Data Automation: Proven experience building automated data validation or reconciliation pipelines using Python (Pandas), Alteryx, or VBA/Power Query in a financial operations context.

**Additional Preferred Qualifications**

* Xactly Certification: Xactly Certified Administrator credential; or equivalent platform certification in Varicent, Anaplan, or SAP Commissions.
* HRIS & CRM: Demonstrated experience using Workday for HRIS roster management and Salesforce for CRM data structures and effective-dating logic in a compensation operations context.
* Advanced Excel: Proven use of dynamic arrays, Power Pivot, nested logic formulas, and complex lookup models for financial reconciliation and compensation modeling.
* Global Payroll Operations: Experience generating, reconciling, and formatting gross-to-net payroll transmission files across multiple regional Finance and Payroll teams.
* Power BI Reporting: Experience reviewing and interpreting Power BI dashboards in a compensation analytics or financial operations environment.
* Audit & Compliance Support: Experience producing calculation logs, change control artifacts, and audit evidence packages for internal or external compliance reviews.
* Stakeholder Communication: Demonstrated ability to communicate complex payout mechanics and calculation adjustments clearly in written and spoken English to international stakeholders across multiple time zones.

title: Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineer – Privacy-Preserving Data Platform
description:
We are looking for skilled Data Engineers at mid-level and senior levels to build, maintain, and operate reliable, scalable, and privacy-preserving data pipelines on AWS. The ideal candidates will have strong expertise in Python, SQL, distributed data processing, and production-grade ETL pipelines, along with experience in data orchestration, data quality, and CI/CD practices.

The role involves extracting data from transactional systems and Amazon Athena, transforming it into curated Parquet datasets, and implementing robust de-identification processes to ensure appropriate handling of sensitive data.

Key Responsibilities

* Build data extraction pipelines from transactional systems and Amazon Athena-based data lakes.
* Develop, transform, and maintain curated datasets in Parquet format.
* Implement data de-identification and privacy-preserving transformations, with automated tests to validate the handling classification of every data column.
* Manage data pipeline orchestration, scheduling, retries, backfills, monitoring, alerting, and data quality checks.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in collaboration with the platform team.
* Maintain data catalogs, lineage information, and documentation for all datasets produced.
* Monitor and support production data pipelines, troubleshoot failures, and manage schema changes in upstream systems.
* Ensure pipeline reliability, scalability, maintainability, and consistency through sound software engineering practices.

Mandatory Skills and Qualifications

* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Python and SQL**
  .
* Experience with
  **Apache Spark or equivalent distributed data processing technologies**
  .
* Proven experience building and operating production-grade batch data pipelines on
  **AWS**
  .
* Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as
  **Apache Airflow, Dagster, AWS Step Functions, or similar**
  .
* Working knowledge of ETL/ELT processes and data lake architectures.
* Experience with version control, code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD practices.
* Strong understanding of idempotency, pipeline recovery, backfills, and production troubleshooting.
* Ability to follow written technical standards and engineering specifications.

Additional Skills – Good to Have

* Experience with Change Data Capture (CDC) tools such as Debezium or AWS DMS.
* Familiarity with Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi.
* Exposure to data masking, tokenization, de-identification, or other privacy-enhancing technologies.
* Experience with dbt or comparable data transformation frameworks.
* Experience building datasets for machine learning model training and understanding how their requirements differ from reporting datasets.

Additional Requirements for the Senior Data Engineer

* Experience mentoring engineers and providing technical guidance.
* Proven ownership of data systems from design and implementation through production operations.
* Experience managing on-call responsibilities and resolving production incidents.
* Ability to evaluate architectural decisions, challenge unsuitable designs, and drive engineering best practices.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Data Engineer who combines strong coding skills with practical experience operating production data platforms. Candidates should be comfortable troubleshooting real-world pipeline failures, maintaining data quality, and implementing reliable data processing workflows with appropriate privacy controls.

* Innovation and Research:

* Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices, such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Docker.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field (Ph.D. preferred).
* 8+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with 2+ years specifically in Generative AI.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in building Conversational AI applications using cloud-based services and in orchestrating AI/ML services for building a complete solution

description:

You will design and operate high-scale Java services on AWS-native infrastructure (Spark, EMR Serverless, Kinesis, Step Functions), processing petabytes of data daily at 99.9% availability. **Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Research, develop, implement and monitor inventory management and distribution logistics systems, concepts and procedures for worldwide parts inventory and operations management.
  
  
The primary goal is to support the Product Support & Logistics (PSLD) division’s effort in achieving the inventory and customer service objectives. As an Inventory Analyst, you will have responsibility for ensuring the complete and successful testing and conversion planning of all PIC functions in dealers’ ERP conversion projects, and contribute to design, development, and deployment of the new PIC Data Analytics Suite (DAS).
  
  
****What You Will Do****

* Develop automated processes to aid in data cleansing and maintenance using analytical tools (SQL, SAS, Python, PowerBI).
* Develop and test new reporting tools, following standards and best practices.
* Support 24x7 PIC systems for dealer order recommendations, willing to work in Europe / US time zone.
* Performing work to achieve corporate supply chain performance targets focused on inventory reduction, increased inventory turns and improved parts availability.
* Working effectively with diverse, multi-functional teams to apply the supply chain logistics process and leading team efforts to develop a lean parts distribution network.

**Degree Requirement**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering / Math’s / Science / Commerce.
* 2 to 3 years’ relevant experience in data analytics and visualization tools.

****What You Have****
**Business Acumen:**
Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations.

**Effective Communications:**
Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
  
  
****Level Working Knowledge:****

* Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
* Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
* Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
* Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
* Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

**Problem Solving:**
Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  
  
****Level Working Knowledge:****

* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
* Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
* Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
* Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

**Data Gathering and Reporting:**
Knowledge of tools, techniques and processes for gathering and reporting data; ability to practice them in a particular department or division of a company.
  
  
****Level Working Knowledge:****

* Detects and summarizes patterns in data and findings by producing simple reports.
* Assesses common problems and obstacles surrounding data-gathering.
* Customizes data fields to meet clients' needs.
* Interprets and explains results of a data-gathering initiative.
* Participates in projects to gather data for needs analysis.

**Data Visualization:**
Knowledge of principles, techniques and processes of data visualization; ability to create high quality figures effectively for various business scenarios and storytelling.
  
  
****Level Working Knowledge:****

* Creates figures for regular data visualization tasks in an honest and compelling way.
* Develops or uses appropriate tools and software, such as Tableau and Data wrapper, to generate different types of data visualization.
* Follows established standards and procedures to obtain, aggregate and analyze data for visualization.
* Outputs statistical models into charts, graphs and maps to demonstrate outliers, patterns and trends of data.
* Employs data visualization in documents or reports to tell informative and compelling stories.

**Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Tools:**
Knowledge of electronic data interchange tools; ability to design, implement and maintain tools and facilities in order to establish a computer-to-computer interchange of electronic data among organizations.
  
  
****Level Working Knowledge:****

* Maps EDI data within appropriate applications; develops and test new maps.
* Assists in the development of tools and techniques for electronic data interchange.
* Adheres to electronic data interchange standards, policies and guidelines.
* Operates main functions of electronic data interchange tools and facilities.
* Compares different applications for use in different electronic data interchange situations.

Knowledge of processes and methods of inventory management; ability to effectively manage local or distributed inventories of raw materials, work-in-progress and finished goods.

**Job Profile:**

Amagi is hiring a Marketing Operations Lead to own the systems, data, and automation that power our GTM engine. This is not a traditional MOps seat - it sits at the intersection of marketing operations and GTM engineering. You’ll run the full marketing-ops backbone (campaign ops, lead lifecycle, attribution, database hygiene) while building AI-native automations that eliminate manual work across Sales, Marketing, and RevOps. If you instinctively reach for a Claude + Clay workflow before a spreadsheet, this is your playground - and you’ll own the reporting layer leadership runs on, accountable for turning dashboards into decisions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Marketing Operations Ownership**

Own the marketing-ops backbone: campaign operations, lead lifecycle, scoring/routing, attribution, and database hygiene across the funnel.

Administer HubSpot and Salesforce hands-on — objects, workflows, fields, and integration — keeping Salesforce as the single source of truth.

**AI-Native Automation & GTM Engineering**

Build end-to-end automations using a Claude + Clay combination plus n8n / Make to enrich, research, and act on data with minimal human overhead.

Stand up advanced enrichment and account-intelligence pipelines (ICP matching, contact/title enrichment, ABM, outreach automation).

Proactively identify automation opportunities; ensure workflows are scalable, fail-safe, and maintainable.

Translate pipeline, campaign, and funnel data into actionable recommendations — and own the follow-through.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

Partner with Sales, SalesOps, BDRs, PMM, and Leadership to turn business needs into scalable systems.

Document workflows and data flows, train the team, and support rapid deploy-measure-iterate experiments.

**Skills and Expertise Required:**

AI-native operator: fluent in applying LLMs (Claude in particular) to design and ship real workflows — not just prompt occasionally.

Hands-on, advanced proficiency with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Clay (all must-have).

Proven ability to build automations with Claude + Clay and orchestration tools (n8n / Make); SQL for querying GTM data.

Reporting and dashboarding, with the judgment to turn data into action.

Strong grasp of GTM workflows: lead routing, scoring, ICP matching, ABM automation, attribution, and pipeline hygiene.

**Competencies**

Funnel & lifecycle ownership: govern lead lifecycle and stage definitions (Inquiry → MQL → SQL → Opportunity), scoring models, and routing rules.

Martech stack ownership: administer, evaluate, and rationalize the stack; manage vendors, renewals, integrations, and license/credit utilization.

Planning & stakeholder leadership: partner on target-setting and multi-BU campaign governance; drive cross-functional alignment on process, SLAs, and a single source of truth.

Python; warehouse / BI exposure (Databricks, Looker / LookML basics).

B2B SaaS GTM experience (post-IPO / high-growth); familiarity with Gong Engage, Outreach, or Swoogo.

**Who You Are**

AI-first by default: you reach for a Claude-powered workflow before a manual process and treat LLMs as core to how you operate.

Hands-on operator: equally at home building enrichment in Clay, configuring Salesforce and HubSpot, and reviewing pipeline with leadership.

A systems thinker with a bias for automation, strong ownership, and a builder’s instinct in high-growth environments.

You flag data-quality issues honestly rather than shipping polished-but-wrong output.

﻿

You and your loved ones have access to comprehensive health insurance and our Employee Assistance Program, which covers mental health counselling, financial and legal guidance, and diet and nutrition support. As a senior individual contributor and hands-on technical leader, you will design and build scalable data software infrastructure and analytics platforms that enable high-quality data products, advanced analytics, and client-facing solutions. Working closely with business stakeholders and product partners, you will translate strategic priorities and user needs into robust technical architectures and delivery plans. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, owning technical design and outcomes across complex initiatives.
  
  
Your work will directly enhance transparency, operational efficiency, and data-driven decision-making for institutional investors, fund managers, and service providers. In doing so, you will help position BlackRock as the leading technology and data provider in private markets.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who is excited by the challenges of innovating in private markets data, and combines deep technical expertise with the ability to clearly articulate value to both business stakeholders and clients.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and build scalable, reliable data pipelines and platformssoftware solutions for data products, ensuring performance, quality, and long-term sustainability.

* Lead architectural decisions and influence technical prioritisation, partnering closely with product and delivery teams to align engineering effort with business impact.
* Act as a technical authority within the team, elevating engineering standards and driving best practices in data management, governance, and cloud-native development.
* Engage senior stakeholders, clearly communicating complex technical trade-offs and recommendations in business-relevant terms.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with engineers, data scientists, analysts, and product leaders to deliver high-impact solutions for institutional investors and private markets clients.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Proven experience building and operating scalable software systems for data processing workflows and platforms, with deep expertise in Python and SQL across databases such as Snowflake and Postgres.
* Hands-on experience with modern software engineering practices, including version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience working in cloud environments (AWS or Azure), including infrastructure provisioning and automation using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform).
* Demonstrated ability to design production-grade systems that balance performance, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Experience enabling or supporting advanced analytics and AI/ML use cases in production environments.
* A rigorous, data-driven mindset – comfortable using analysis, benchmarking, and experimentation to guide technical decisions and architectural trade-offs.

* Ability to operate autonomously and drive technical solution design end-to-end, taking ownership of outcomes.
* Experience collaborating effectively across engineering, data science, product, and design teams to deliver high-impact solutions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels and translate complex technical concepts into clear, business-relevant language.
* A proactive, curious, and resilient mindset — motivated to explore new technologies, tackle ambiguous problems, and continuously improve systems and ways of working.

* Experience designing and building data platformssoftware and/or data platforms in regulated or financial services environments.
* Experience supporting ML lifecycle management (model versioning, experiment tracking, model deployment pipelines); familiarity with tools such as MLflow, feature stores, or model serving frameworks.
* Experience productionising statistical or quantitative models.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. As a Business Intelligence Engineer on the WW EPR team, you will own the design, build, and scaling of data infrastructure and BI solutions that power our Worldwide EPR compliance and circularity programs. You will tackle complex, ambiguous problems with high autonomy — building data solutions that inform cross-functional decisions across multiple teams and regions. Key job responsibilities
  
  
Data Architecture & BI Solutions
  
  

* Lead design and delivery of BI solutions spanning EPR compliance, recycling fee analytics, regulatory tracking, and circular economy metrics across worldwide jurisdictions (NA, EU, APAC, emerging markets)
* Define the team's BI architecture strategy — ensuring pipelines, models, and reporting are scalable, extensible, and aligned with organizational standards
* Architect end-to-end solutions: ETL/ELT pipelines, dimensional models, and self-service analytics enabling real-time decision support across geographies
* Harmonize multi-jurisdictional regulatory data — normalizing diverse reporting requirements, fee structures, and compliance timelines across global EPR regimes
* Proactively resolve architecture deficiencies; drive simplification and cross-team integration

Advanced Analytics & Decision Support
  
  

* Build automated frameworks that surface cost-saving opportunities within EPR fee structures, eco-modulation incentives, and take-back economics globally
* Integrate EPR cost signals into upstream business decisions — enabling retail and Selling Partner teams to assess cost impact during product selection, design, and pricing
* Develop statistical models and KPI calibration (anomaly detection, regression, confidence intervals) to monitor compliance health and fee trends across WW programs
* Deliver executive-facing narratives, MBR/QBR inputs, and data-driven recommendations for senior leadership

Generative AI & Automation
  
  

* Leverage GenAI and LLMs to enhance regulatory data extraction, classification, and reporting workflows
* Design AI-augmented solutions (automated regulatory change detection, intelligent fee categorization, natural language querying of compliance datasets)
* Evaluate and implement AI/ML technologies to improve data quality, accelerate insights, and reduce manual overhead

Technical Leadership & Mentorship
  
  

* Set engineering standards, drive code quality, conduct design reviews, and establish operational excellence best practices for the EPR BI function
* Mentor BIE I/II team members; provide technical assessments for promotions and hiring loops
* Influence cross-functional technical decisions by driving BI best practices across partner teams
* Lead the hiring bar for BI roles — recruit, design interview loops, and assess candidates

**About The Team**
Our Worldwide EPR team owns Amazon's global compliance strategy for Extended Producer Responsibility — ensuring adherence to post-consumer waste regulations across packaging, electronics, batteries, and textiles in all operating regions. We work cross-functionally with Legal, Business, Product, and Data Science/Engineering teams across NA, EU, APAC, and emerging markets to deliver compliance programs at scale.
  
  
EPR shifts post-consumer waste management costs from municipalities to producers — requiring all Selling Partners on Amazon's marketplace to register, report product data, pay recycling fees to PROs, and establish take-back systems. This incentivizes environmentally friendly product and packaging design.
  
  
EPR is part of the Regulatory Intelligence, Safety and Compliance (RISC) organization, dedicated to protecting Amazon customers from products that are illegal, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited

* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs

Responsibilities include integrating multiple data sources (e.g., Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, Matrix42 ITSM database, Nexthink) into a central database, defining data standards and quality controls, and enabling customized queries and Power BI dashboards for operational and management reporting. In close collaboration with MIT colleagues and Divisional IT, the position drives compliance governance, proactively identifies trends and risks, and leads remediation activities to restore and sustain device compliance.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, implementation and operation of a centralized data platform for Modern Workplace reporting (Intune Data Warehouse as core, plus additional sources as required), including architecture decisions and long-term roadmap
* Design robust integration patterns and harmonize data from Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, Matrix42 ITSM DB, Nexthink and other relevant systems into a central database (ETL/ELT), ensuring scalability and maintainability
* Develop and maintain enterprise-grade data pipelines using Azure Data Factory (or comparable tooling) including scheduling, error handling, monitoring/alerting, and performance/cost optimization
* Own SQL-based data modeling (schema design, views, performance tuning/indexing) and deliver high-quality custom queries for operational reporting and analytics
* Build secure and reliable automation for data extraction and operations using Microsoft Graph API and Entra ID (app registrations, permissions, authentication patterns) with PowerShell/Python
* Build and govern Power BI semantic models, datasets and dashboards (KPI definitions, refresh strategy, access management/RLS, documentation) for different stakeholder groups
* Own device compliance monitoring and governance (e.g., free disk space, BitLocker status, anti-virus, M365 Apps versions, patch/health indicators) across all Intune managed devices; define thresholds, metrics, and reporting standards
* Lead cross-team remediation with MIT and Divisional IT to restore compliance (runbooks, escalation paths, root cause analysis, follow-up, and reporting), driving measurable improvements
* Establish data governance and quality management (data definitions, validation checks, documentation, lineage, and auditability of metrics)
* Act as technical lead for reporting, automation and compliance monitoring topics (2nd/3rd level), advise stakeholders, and mentor colleagues on best practices
* Participation in on-call rotation for the reporting/compliance monitoring service (as required) including incident triage and coordination of problem resolution

**Knowledge and Education**

* Preferably Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a relevant field.
* Completed education of a technical college.

**Work Experience And Skills**

* 5+ years of experience in endpoint management analytics / reporting and/or data integration in an enterprise environment (Intune strongly preferred)
* Expert-level SQL skills (data modeling, query optimization, indexing principles, troubleshooting performance issues; building views/stored procedures is a plus)
* Advanced experience with Microsoft Graph API and Entra ID (device/identity objects, permissions, app registrations, authentication flows, least-privilege design)
* Strong hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory (or equivalent) and operating ETL/ELT pipelines with monitoring/alerting and operational readiness (SLAs, runbooks)
* Strong Power BI skills (semantic data modeling, DAX, performance optimization, dashboard design, row-level security, and governance/lifecycle management)
* Strong scripting/automation skills in PowerShell and/or Python (APIs, scheduling, logging, error handling) with focus on maintainability (modular code, documentation, testing mindset)
* Experience with source control and deployment practices (e.g., Git, release/change management; CI/CD for data pipelines/reporting is a plus)
* Deep understanding of endpoint compliance concepts and telemetry and how to operationalize them (KPIs, alerting, remediation workflows; e.g., Intune compliance, BitLocker, AV/Defender signals, application versioning, device health indicators; Nexthink is a plus)

**Other Competencies**

* Positive attitude and a strong commitment to delivering quality work and operational excellence.
* Knowledge of client lifecycle management systems and current computing trends.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills (written and verbal) to translate complex technical topics into actionable insights for management, IT partners and end users
* Can work independently or part of a team.
* Conform with and abide by all Company codes, regulations, policies, values, work procedures and instructions.
* Must be an independent problem solver with troubleshooting, decision-making and analytical skills.
* Excellent customer service skills.

**Awareness, Unity, Empowerment**
At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. OR

title: Senior Associate Technology L1_Python
description:
**Job Description**
Publicis Sapient is looking for Python Developers to join our team of bright thinkers and enablers. You will use your problem-solving skills, craft, and creativity to design and develop infrastructure interfaces for complex business applications. You will build and orchestrate agentic, GenAI-powered workflows that transform how our clients operate – from data ingestion and enrichment to intelligent, LLM-driven automation. We are on a mission to transform the world, and you will be instrumental in shaping how we do it with your ideas, thoughts, and solutions.
  
  
**Your Impact:**

* Build and orchestrate agentic workflows using LangChain and LangGraph to power scalable, production-ready GenAI solutions.
* Develop reusable components for data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and validation that accelerate delivery across projects.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and traceability across agent workflows to support dependable, enterprise-grade AI applications.
* Implement performance monitoring with tools like LangSmith and apply tuning mechanisms to continuously improve agent accuracy and efficiency.
* Deploy and maintain Python-based GenAI services in production, leveraging Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools for reliable releases.
* Architect secure API communication and access management, using JWT, OAuth, and RBAC, to safeguard sensitive client data.
* Apply NLP, LLM, and retrieval techniques, including vector stores and embeddings, to build context-aware, intelligent solutions for clients.

**Qualifications**
**Your Skills & Experience:**

* Strong Python fundamentals (OOP, data structures, error handling) with hands-on experience using Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, or Dask.
* Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and Semantic Kernel, building agent orchestration, memory, and tool-use workflows.
* Proficiency in Python API frameworks (Flask/FastAPI), with experience using IDEs such as VSCode and PyCharm.
* Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases, time-series data, and data modeling and schema design.
* Basic integration experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch, plus exposure to vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Chroma) and embedding-based retrieval.
* Proficiency with AWS Cloud Services and production deployment practices, including Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools.
* Strong understanding of security & access management – JWT, OAuth, RBAC – and secure API communication.

**Additional Information**
**Set Yourself Apart With:**

* Prior work on GenAI, CoPilot, or RAG-based systems.
* Familiarity with marketing data models and real-time customer journeys.
* Exposure to NLP, LLMs, and retrieval frameworks beyond the core requirements above.

**A Tip from the Hiring Manager:**
“AI is evolving fast – join us to work hands-on with big clients, sharpen your skills, and stay future-ready.
  
  
**Benefits of Working Here:**

* Gender-Neutral Policy
* 18 paid holidays throughout the year.
* Generous parental leave and new parent transition program
* Flexible work arrangements
* Employee Assistance Programs to help you in wellness and well-being.

**Company Description**
Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.
