title: Enterprise Systems Analyst, Advisor
description:
**Overview**
At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.
  
  
Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.
  
  
You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.
  
  
Come make an impact every day at Zebra.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**
This role is responsible for the leadership, design, implementation, and ongoing support of Zebra's Customer Master Data Management (CMDM) ecosystem and its connected Salesforce (SFDC) platform. The ideal candidate will serve as a subject matter expert across the CMDM agile delivery track, Salesforce development and implementation, and the integration landscape connecting SFDC with Oracle Commerce Cloud, Siebel, Oracle ERP Cloud, and Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), and will drive the adoption of AI-based solutions to modernize and automate customer master data processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage the CMDM agile delivery track, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, prioritization, and coordination across business and technical teams.
* Provide expert guidance on Salesforce (SFDC) development, configuration, and implementation, ensuring solutions align with CMDM strategy and enterprise architecture standards.
* Apply deep knowledge of SFDC technologies (Apex, Lightning, Flows, APIs, and the Salesforce data model) to design scalable and maintainable customer data solutions.
* Analyze, design, and implement robust integrations between Salesforce and Oracle Commerce Cloud, Siebel, Oracle ERP Cloud, and Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS).
* Define and govern customer master data standards, including data quality rules, matching/deduplication, survivorship, and stewardship processes within the CMDM platform.
* Identify, evaluate, and implement AI/ML-driven solutions in the CMDM space, such as intelligent data matching, enrichment, anomaly detection, and automation of stewardship tasks.
* Lead requirements gathering, process mapping, solution design, and the creation of functional and technical specifications.
* Coordinate and oversee testing cycles, including analyzing and researching defects and working with business and technical teams to ensure resolution.
* Facilitate activities related to system enhancements, bug fixes, patches, and major upgrades across the CMDM and SFDC landscape.
* Act as a liaison with Salesforce and Oracle support partners by creating and managing service requests and escalations.
* Collaborate closely with the PMO, QA, and Operations teams to ensure successful delivery of CMDM initiatives.

**Qualifications**
**Required Experience & Skills:**

* A Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience is required.
* A minimum of 8-10 years of professional experience, with at least 5 years of hands-on experience in customer master data management and/or Salesforce platforms.
* Proven experience managing an agile delivery track, including backlog and sprint management.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Salesforce development and implementation, including Apex, Lightning, Flows, and the SFDC data model.
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems such as Oracle Commerce Cloud, Siebel, Oracle ERP Cloud, and Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS).
* Solid understanding of customer master data concepts, including data governance, data quality, matching/deduplication, and stewardship.
* Experience designing and implementing AI/ML-based solutions to automate or enhance master data processes.
* Proven experience with 3 to 5 full project lifecycle implementations involving CMDM and/or Salesforce.
* Proactive, self-motivated, and solutions-oriented with the ability to manage multiple tasks and execute effectively under pressure.
* Demonstrates ownership and accountability for deliverables with a strong focus on achieving goals.
* Highly collaborative with strong intellectual curiosity and a forward-thinking mindset.
* Excellent oral, written, and listening skills with the ability to articulate complex information clearly.
* Agile and adaptable, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic, challenging environment and work flexibly with team members across different time zones.

**Preferred Experience & Skills**

* An advanced degree is preferred.
* Salesforce certifications (e.g., Platform Developer, Application Architect, or Data Architect) are highly desirable.
* Experience with Oracle Commerce Cloud, Siebel, and Oracle ERP Cloud implementations is highly desirable.
* Experience applying generative AI or machine learning in a master data or CRM context is a plus.

**Benefits**
We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.
  
  
**Job Posting Statement**

title: Principal Data Systems Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Build the next generation of Oracle Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA) software, helping fortune 500 enterprises protect and recover their business-critical Oracle databases. Work on software where data integrity, recoverability, cyber resilience, and performance at scale directly affect customers' most important operations.
  
  
Join our growing engineering team in Bengaluru and collaborate with experienced ZDLRA engineers in India and the US. You will contribute to shared product priorities, deliver new features and projects, and help evolve an enterprise data protection platform. This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team while building deep product expertise within an established global engineering organization.
  
  
The work spans Oracle database kernel development and systems programming, primarily in C and PL/SQL on Linux. You will tackle engineering problems involving buffers and caches, memory management, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, concurrency, and distributed systems. Strong algorithms, thoughtful design, and an understanding of how these components interact will be central to delivering correct, efficient, and maintainable software.
  
  
You will participate throughout the development lifecycle: understanding problems, exploring the codebase, identifying root causes, designing solutions, implementing changes, writing tests, and validating results. The work combines new development and enhancements with complex defect resolution, including issues encountered in customer environments. As your product knowledge grows, you will take increasing technical ownership of assigned features and components, contributing to design decisions, code reviews, ongoing maintenance, and knowledge sharing.
  
  
We value engineers who investigate problems systematically, use documentation and diagnostic tools resourcefully, communicate clearly, and help colleagues succeed. You will use modern engineering tools, including LLMs and AI coding agents, to accelerate code exploration, development, and testing while applying independent judgment and rigorous validation to the resulting designs and code.
  
  
We welcome experienced developers with strong C, Linux, system programming skills and practical knowledge of database internals, storage, distributed systems, or other demanding enterprise software. Prior Oracle Database, RMAN, PL/SQL, or backup and recovery product experience is an advantage. Strong systems fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to translate complex requirements into reliable production software are essential.
  
  
This position is based in Bengaluru, India.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Product development and technical ownership**

* Design, implement, and maintain ZDLRA features and enhancements in C and PL/SQL on Linux, contributing to Oracle database kernel and systems software development.
* Translate requirements and technical problems into clear designs, manageable tasks, and deliverable milestones. Evaluate alternatives and document trade-offs involving correctness, performance, scalability, compatibility, and maintainability.
* Apply appropriate algorithms and data structures to build efficient, reliable software. Reason about memory use, concurrency, synchronization, and behavior under demanding workloads.
* Develop and improve assigned components involving buffers, caches, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, and distributed processing, with careful attention to data integrity and recovery behavior.
* Build product expertise through code exploration, technical documentation, collaboration, and delivery of fixes and enhancements. Progress toward ownership of assigned features and projects, including subsequent development, maintenance, and defect resolution.

**Investigation, performance, and quality**

* Investigate complex defects, including issues reported from customer deployments. Reproduce failures, trace relevant code paths, establish root causes, and implement durable fixes.
* Use GDB, core dumps, logs, traces, profiling tools, and Linux utilities to gather evidence and understand software behavior across interacting components.
* Diagnose performance and scalability bottlenecks involving CPU, memory, storage, I/O, and networking. Establish useful measurements and validate the impact of changes against representative workloads.
* Design and implement tests alongside production code. Cover functional behavior, boundary conditions, regressions, concurrency, and relevant failure and recovery scenarios using the team's engineering and test frameworks.
* Use shell scripting and automation to improve diagnostic data collection, issue reproduction, testing, and other repeatable development tasks.
* Follow secure coding practices and engineering standards. Evaluate error handling, resource management, backward compatibility, and versioning implications when modifying existing code or interfaces.

**Engineering execution and collaboration**

* Take assigned work through the software development lifecycle, from analysis and design through implementation, review, testing, integration, and maintenance.
* Plan work realistically, identify dependencies, and communicate progress, design decisions, risks, and blockers. Coordinate with the engineering team to deliver agreed project milestones.
* Collaborate closely with ZDLRA engineers in India and the US and with relevant database engineering teams to resolve cross-component issues and deliver shared product objectives.
* Participate in design and code reviews, providing constructive feedback on correctness, clarity, performance, security, test coverage, and long-term maintainability.
* Write and maintain useful design notes, implementation documentation, and troubleshooting guidance. Share findings so that investigations and engineering decisions benefit the wider team.
* Use internal documentation, specifications, and existing code resourcefully to understand unfamiliar areas. Ask focused questions, seek timely feedback, and help colleagues solve technical problems.
* As product expertise grows, provide technical guidance, mentor colleagues, and contribute to improvements in the team's development practices and engineering quality.

**AI-assisted engineering**

* Use LLMs and AI coding agents to accelerate code exploration, problem analysis, implementation, test development, and documentation where they are useful.
* Critically review AI-generated suggestions and verify them against the actual codebase, requirements, and observed behavior. Validate changes through appropriate reviews and tests, and remain accountable for the correctness, security, performance, and maintainability of delivered software.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.

**What We Look For**

* Expand regression coverage and quality gates within CI pipelines to continuously validate changes.

**What You Bring**

  

* Prior fintech or capital-markets experience in quality engineering for pre-trade or post-trade equity systems within a hedge fund, investment bank, asset manager, or fintech organization.
* 5+ years of experience in software quality engineering and test automation.
* Hands-on knowledge of corporate actions and option expiry, including their impact on positions and P&L.
* Strong Java test-automation skills, including JUnit or TestNG, REST Assured, Spring Boot Test, and Mockito.
* Experience testing REST and GraphQL APIs, including contract, schema, authentication, and entitlement validation.

* A precise, analytical approach; strong written and verbal communication skills; sound judgment when using AI coding assistants; and the ability to collaborate effectively with developers, Middle Office, and Operations.

title: Senior Postgres Platform Engineer
description:

Determines appropriateness of data for storage and optimum storage organization. Creates sustainable and maintainable tools to automate database provisioning, patching, monitoring, metrics, maintenance, and administration.

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a **Senior Postgres Platform Engineer** on our **Database Platform** team.

**You will:**

* Design and operate PostgreSQL clusters at scale - replication, partitioning, connection pooling, VACUUM tuning, WAL management - for a fleet supporting billions of transactions monthly
* Deploy and manage PostgreSQL on Kubernetes using operators (CloudNativePG, Patroni) with automated failover, persistent storage optimization, and pod disruption budgets
* Build Ansible-based automation for provisioning, patching, upgrades and disaster recovery
* Optimize pgVector workloads - IVFFlat/HNSW index tuning, dimensionality planning, ANN search performance - for AI/ML embedding pipelines

**Essential Requirements**

* 10–14 years of database administration and platform engineering experience

* 3+ years of Kubernetes for stateful workloads - operators, persistent storage design, backup/restore in K8s, multi-cluster patterns
* 3+ years building automation frameworks in Python, Bash, Ansible - authoring infrastructure, not just using playbooks
* Proven track record of designing self-service infrastructure

**Desirable Requirements**

* pgVector production experience with high-dimension embedding workloads (RAG, semantic search)
* Agentic coding or LLM-augmented operations - self-healing scripts, natural-language-to-query interfaces, or autonomous remediation. Open source contribution and experience with Go lang

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.

title: Senior Engineering Manager - Benefits
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, **Rippling has raised $1.85B+** from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a high-impact platform engineering team responsible for core infrastructure and product foundations used across Rippling. This role owns multiple horizontal charters, including Data Deletion, Webscripts, Internationalisation, and Rippling Config Service. These systems sit at the intersection of platform scalability, developer productivity, compliance, configuration management, and customer-facing product quality. The ideal candidate is a strong engineering leader who can operate across ambiguous problem spaces, partner deeply with product and infrastructure teams, and build durable systems that scale with Rippling’s product surface.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Lead and grow a team of engineers working on critical platform charters.
* Own technical strategy and execution for Data Deletion, Webscripts, Internationalisation, and Rippling Config Service.
* Partner with product, design, compliance, security, and infrastructure teams to define roadmaps and delivery plans.
* Drive architecture reviews and ensure systems are reliable, scalable, maintainable, and secure.
* Establish clear ownership, operational excellence, and engineering quality across multiple platform surfaces.
* Balance short-term product needs with long-term platform investments.
* Mentor senior engineers and engineering leads, helping them grow their technical judgment and leadership.
* Improve execution rigor through planning, prioritization, metrics, incident reviews, and continuous process improvement.
* Represent the team in cross-functional forums and communicate tradeoffs clearly to senior leadership.

### **What We’re Looking For**

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, with 3+ years managing engineering teams.
* Experience leading platform, infrastructure, developer productivity, or shared product-surface teams.
* Strong technical judgment and ability to reason about distributed systems, data models, APIs, reliability, and scale.
* Proven ability to lead ambiguous, cross-functional charters with multiple stakeholders.
* Experience managing senior engineers and driving alignment across teams.
* Strong execution discipline: roadmap planning, project delivery, operational metrics, and incident follow-through.
* Ability to balance product velocity with long-term platform quality.
* Clear written and verbal communication, especially around tradeoffs and technical strategy.

### **Nice To Have**

* Experience with privacy, compliance, data lifecycle, or data deletion systems(GDPR, CCPA).
* Experience building internal platforms or frameworks used by many product teams.
* Experience with internationalisation/localisation systems.
* Experience with configuration platforms, feature/config rollout systems, or policy/config management.
* Experience with low-code, scripting, workflow, or extensibility platforms.

### **Why This Role Matters**

This team builds foundational systems that many Rippling products depend on. The role requires someone who can think like a platform owner: creating leverage for other teams, reducing duplication, improving reliability, and ensuring that core systems continue to scale as Rippling grows across products, countries, and customer segments.

### **About You**

You are a hands-on engineering leader who enjoys operating at both technical and organizational levels. You can dive into architecture when needed, but your real strength is creating clarity, building strong teams, and helping engineers deliver high-quality systems in complex environments.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

Experience with Ansible automation

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
**Career Area:**

Technology, Digital and Data

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**JOB PURPOSE:**
  
The Software Engineering Manager would provide leadership in the design, development, and deployment of Caterpillar’s state-of-the-art digital products within the areas of e-commerce. This position is accountable for hiring, managing, and mentoring multiple software engineers and pod leads who are transforming and building a world-class eCommerce application, in line with the CAT Digital Strategy.

We are looking for a Software Engineering Manager with expertise and passion to imagine, build and develop innovative products. This is a high growth space and a big opportunity that needs a dynamic product creator. The ideal candidate will be curious, have attention to detail, be energized by a dynamic environment, be comfortable with strategic thinking while also diving deep.

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead strong development teams and build creative technology solutions that positively impact international customers, relish large ownership and diverse technologies, join our team today!

As a Software Engineering Manager, you will identify, hire, and build world-class teams of Software Engineers to define, drive, and execute on our strategic vision. You will improve/initiate processes that allow these teams to collaborate with local as well as global teams with a high degree of efficiency. You will develop teams of highly motivated and talented individuals that can collaborate with Project Managers, Product Managers and Software Engineers across the company on a high impact initiative. You will design, build and own features and programs that will delight our dealers / customers.

This key role is expected to establish and mature product software engineering capability in India. The role will report to CAT Digital India Senior Engineering Manager.

**JOB DUTIES:**

* The position supports the CAT Digital strategy, recognizes the service requirements/needs of dealers and customers, corporate and business unit goals, and gives input to leadership in formulating global concepts, strategies and plans to deliver service solutions.
* Typical internal customers include various contacts throughout Caterpillar worldwide and its subsidiaries. External contacts include various customers, dealers, and vendors throughout worldwide markets.
* The role is responsible for the overall development life cycle of the solution and manage complex projects with significant impact.
* Responsibilities include supervising a team and a project related to developing business and technical solutions.
* Work with product managers in developing a strategy and road map to provide compelling capabilities that helps them succeed in their business goals.
* Work closely with senior engineers to develop the best technical design and approach for new product development.
* Continuously improve and drive engineering best practices around software engineering & lead the craftsmanship, resilience, and scalability of our solutions. Establish durable ways of working with product peers and other internal engineering teams.
* Encourage innovation, implementation of cutting-edge technologies, including outside-of-the-box thinking, teamwork, self-organization, and diversity.
* Project management - prioritization, planning of features, Stakeholder management and tracking of commitments. Develops detailed work plans, project estimates, resource plans, and status reports. Monitors and troubleshoots performance and schedule issues.
* Career management and development of direct reports: The position is responsible for all personnel issues and performance evaluation of subordinates, as well as overall employee satisfaction for the division.
* Provides technical support, and direction to teams and pod leads. Acquires resources necessary to accomplish work on time.
* Coordinates walkthroughs and reviews; ensures conformance to standards and adherence to design specifications.
* The position is challenged to carefully evaluate problems and provide input into many possible solutions before selecting one option. Problems may be complex and can require developing and monetize new solutions.
* The leader follows general policies and guidelines for projects under his/her control to ensure specific, management goals are met and desired results are achieved. Impacts key quality goals including Customer Satisfaction, Continuous Improvement, and Reoccurring Revenue, Timeliness, Accuracy, Efficiency, Cost Savings, Process Quality, etc.
* S/he should be able to operate in a very fast paced environment where time to hit market is super critical. S/he would need to also balance technical leadership with savvy business judgment to make the right decisions about technology choices.
* Employee is also responsible for performing other job duties as assigned by Caterpillar management from time to time.

**Basic Qualifications:**
  

* Position requires a four-year degree from an accredited college or university.
* Fifteen + years or more of experience in designing and developing software applications in Java or Scala or at least ten years of experience in Java with master’s degree in computer science or related field.
* Three years or more of experience in managing 8 to 14 member cross functional team.
* Five years or more of experience in public cloud technologies such as AWS or Azure.

**Top candidates will also have:**

* Demonstrated leadership on medium to large-scale projects impacting strategic priorities.
* Ability to cope with shifting priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to effectively prioritize, delegate responsibilities and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.
* Oversees performance of individual team members and team as whole. Identifies and addresses staff training and development needs.
* Develops detailed work plans, project estimates, resource plans, and status reports. Monitors and troubleshoots performance and schedule issues.
* Ability to work under pressure and within time constraints.
    
  Passion for technology and innovation.
* Ability to provide guidance in applying the right architectural design pattern for the modernization of the applications by analysing the gaps between existing architecture and new business requirements.

**Proven experience in many of the following:**  

* Designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining software at scale.
* Application architectural patterns, such as MVC, Microservices, Event-driven, etc.
* Technical expertise in building a complex open-stack, microservices-based platform or product that is highly reliable, and scalable.
* Message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, AWS SNS, Apache ActiveMQ, Kinesis.
* Datastores such as MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis, Elasticsearch, MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL.
* Developing software applications using relational and NoSQL databases.
* Deploying software using CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GoCD, Azure Devops etc.
* Working within an Agile framework (ideally Scrum).
* Researching data to support design decisions.
* Must demonstrate solid knowledge of computer science fundamentals like data structures and Algorithms.
* Preference will be given to candidates having knowledge of ecommerce platforms like HCL Commerce (WCS) Version 8.0+ or equivalent; WebSphere Commerce subsystems - Trading, Catalog Management, Order Management, Member Management Sub-system, etc

* Must Have - Deep hands-on expertise in Java/J2EE, Spring Boot.
* Nice to Have - Certifications in AWS/Azure, MongoDB/Redis.
* Nice to Have - Hands-on experience on React, Typescript, JavaScript frameworks.
* Nice to Have – BPMN/Workflow/Rules Engine technology like Camunda, Temporal, Drools.

title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Advertising Core Infra
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Would you like to build highly available, scalable and distributed engineering systems for one of the largest data lakes in Amazon? Does Petabyte scale excite you?  
  
Spektr is Amazon Ads' exabyte-scale central data lake: the unified catalog for petabytes of campaign, ad-serving, billing, and measurement data. Hundreds of teams and Amazon's advertiser-facing AI agents depend on it for discovery, ingestion, transformation, and querying at scale. If you want large-scale engineering with tangible business impact, this is the team.  
  
We're rebuilding Spektr ground-up with an AI-first architecture, and building fully-automated domain agents that let customers manage their big data lifecycle in a single click. In parallel, we're adopting Apache Iceberg / S3 Tables with serverless compute, scaling horizontally via a data mesh pattern for 5 growth in volume and demand. If you thrive on greenfield experimentation and shipping things that matter to the business, keep reading.  
  
As a Sr SDE on this team, you will own the core platform services that power Amazon Ads data infrastructure, consolidating legacy systems into clean, API-first services that cut job creation time from weeks to less than a day. You will build MCP-enabled AI interfaces that let AI agents create and run data pipelines on Spektr at 99%+ success rate, directly shaping how GenAI discovers and consumes data across Amazon Ads. You will design and operate high-scale Java services on AWS-native infrastructure (Spark, EMR Serverless, Kinesis, Step Functions), processing petabytes of data daily at 99.9% availability. You will also drive deployment automation, replacing manual release cycles with CI/CD pipelines that accelerate delivery velocity for a platform serving Tier-1 advertising data systems.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Engage with key decision makers such as Product & Program Managers to understand customer requirements and brainstorm on solutions
* Design, code and deploy components and micro-services for the core job management pipeline
* Ensure testability, maintanability and low operational footprint for your code
* Participate in operational responsibilities with your team
* Innovate on AWS technology to improve latency, reduce cost and operations

  
A day in the life  

* Focus on core engineering opportunities to guarantee system availability that matches our data growth
* Work with a skilled team of engineers, managers and decision makers to consistently meet customer demand
* Automate monitoring of data availability, quality and usability via simplified metrics and drive innovations to improve guarantees for our customers

  
About the team  
The mission of the Ads Datalake team is to provide data that helps the advertising organization make informed analyses and decisions for our customers and to determine and deploy investments for future growth via a set of central and unified products and services.  
  
Our team focuses on simplicity, usability, speed, compliance, cost efficiency and enabling high-velocity decision making so our customers can generate high quality insights faster.  
  
We are a global team with presence across India and North America.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Sr. Product Manager, Progression Intelligence
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As a Senior Product Manager on the Lifecycle Experiences team, you will own the product vision and execution roadmap for our Progression Intelligence charter. This charter sits at the intersection of machine learning, real-time decisioning, and customer lifecycle strategy - and is responsible for determining which customers to engage, with what action, at what moment, and through which channel.  
  
You will lead the technical integration of our rewards optimization, causal measurement, and action intelligence systems onto a unified agentic orchestration platform - enabling faster experimentation, more personalized interventions, and greater operational efficiency across all our emerging locales.  
  
This is a deeply technical role that requires equal comfort with ML systems, API architecture, and product strategy. You will work closely with applied scientists, software engineers, and marketing stakeholders to ship systems that directly delight millions of customers.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own the multi-year product roadmap for Progression Intelligence, including the phased migration of core ML models and decisioning systems onto a unified orchestration platform
* Define technical requirements and integration specifications for connecting rewards optimization, propensity modeling, causal incrementality measurement, and promotion configuration systems into a cohesive, real-time decisioning layer

- Partner with applied scientists to translate model outputs into actionable product features - including reward denomination optimization, next-best-action recommendations, and personalized campaign triggers  

* Drive quarterly planning and prioritization across a portfolio of integrations, balancing technical debt, engineering capacity, and business impact

- Define and own success metrics for the Progression Intelligence platform - including model coverage, decisioning latency, incremental lift, and customer settlement outcomes  

* Write product requirement documents and participate in technical design reviews, and lead alignment across engineering, science, and business stakeholders
* Represent the Progression Intelligence charter in senior leadership reviews, including weekly business reviews and annual planning cycles
* Identify and resolve technical dependencies and cross-team blockers to keep the integration roadmap on track

  
About the team  
The Lifecycle Experiences team is on a mission to deepen customer engagement across Amazon's fastest-growing marketplaces. We own the end-to-end customer lifecycle - from first purchase to habitual shopping - across India, Mexico, Brazil, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Australia, Singapore, and South Africa. Our north star is moving customers from occasional buyers to loyal, high-frequency shoppers.  
  
We build and scale programs including Gamified Experiences, Rewards, Promotions Orchestration, and Personalization - reaching millions of customers across our fast growing marketplaces. We operate at the intersection of product, marketing, and data science, and we move fast.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

title: Software Dev Engineer II, Profit Intelligence
description:
**Description**
Are you interested in building intelligence systems from the ground up?
  
  
Are you interested in working with Applied Scientists, Big Data Engineers and Software Development Engineers to build large-scale data intelligence systems?
  
  
Are you interested to work in a team that positively impacts different key pillars of Amazon like Pricing, Promotions, Advertising, Auto inventory purchasing, Auto inventory removal, Inventory placement?
  
  
Are you interested in working for a team that builds cool systems yet has great work-life balance?
  
  
Profit intelligence systems measures, predicts true profit(/loss) for each item as a result of a specific shipment to an Amazon customer.
  
  
Prot Intelligence is all about providing intelligent ways for Amazon to understand profitability across retail business. What are the hidden factors driving the growth or profitability across millions of shipments each day?
  
  
Profit Intelligence provides these answers.
  
  
We compute the profitability of each and every shipment that gets shipped out of Amazon. Guess what, we predict the profitability of future possible shipments too. We are a team of agile, can-do engineers, who believe that not only are moon shots possible but that they can be done before lunch. All it takes is finding new ideas that challenge our preconceived notions of how things should be done. Process and procedure matter less than ideas and the practical work of getting stuff done. This is a place for exploring the new and taking risks.
  
  
We push the envelope in using cloud services in AWS as well as the latest in distributed systems, forecasting algorithms, and data mining.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to design and build AI-powered data platforms that transform large-scale business data into actionable insights. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and data engineering — owning end-to-end development of tools that help business leaders make faster, better decisions.
  
  
This is a high-impact role on a team where the software you ship directly shapes financial and operational strategy across Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Architect and build scalable platforms that ingest, process, and serve insights from petabyte-scale datasets
  
  
Integrate large language models and generative AI capabilities into internal analytics tools — enabling natural language querying, anomaly explanation, and automated reporting
  
  
Design ML pipelines for anomaly detection, forecasting, and trend analysis over structured and semi-structured business data
  
  
Partner with scientists, analysts, and PMs to translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped technical solutions
  
  
Drive engineering excellence: define coding standards, lead design reviews, and set the bar for operational health (monitoring, oncall, runbooks)
  
  
Mentor junior engineers; raise the technical capability of the team through clear documentation and code review
  
  
Own your services in production — you build it, you run it
  
  
Build and operate our foundational data infrastructure comprising of the entire spectrum of AWS Services - Storage (Redshift Data Shares, s3 data lakes), Orchestration (Step Functions, Glue and Internal Java Based Orchestration Tools), Processing (Spark & Flink - KDA), Streaming services (AWS Kinesis) and real-time large scale event aggregation stores.
  
  
Making it fully configurable and self-service for non-engineers.
  
  
Build and evolve tools that empower Amazonians to access data and build reliable, scalable and configurable way to generate Unit Economics for all Amazon Businesses. This includes UIs and frameworks for configuring rules, simulating their application, approval workows for rule changes, APIs and caching layers for high-throughput serving of Unit Economics Historicals and Predictions.
  
  
Build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like inhouse Reporting Applications and BI tools), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for designing and building platforms for crunching 100s of TB of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

description:
**Director - Cell Therapy IT, Software Engineering - Salesforce**
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to build the digital backbone that delivers next‑generation cell therapies to patients at scale?In this role, you will build and deliver the software platforms that power end‑to‑end activities related to cell therapy across development, manufacturing, and supply. Your work will directly influence how quickly and safely therapies move from treatment sites to manufacturing lines and back to patients.
  
  
You will lead a global engineering organization to compose, build, and industrialize enterprise-grade systems—spanning a Cell Orchestration platform built on Salesforce, AWS- services, and agentic AI automation. Partnering closely with operational and technology leaders, you will define a modern, scalable stack and translate strategy into robust, compliant solutions that drive speed, quality, and reliability. Based in Chennai, India, you will be at the center of a high-impact mission with global reach. How will you scale intelligent automation to orchestrate one of the most complex supply chains in healthcare?
  
  

* Accountabilities:
* Technology Planning and Architecture: Define and evolve a scalable technology strategy and reference architecture that underpins cell therapy operations from vein-to-vein, aligning platform choices with business outcomes.
* Platform Leadership: Lead the build and delivery of the Salesforce-based cellular coordination system, ensuring it is robust, scalable, secure, and fit for regulated environments.
* SDLC Ownership and DevSecOps: Own end-to-end software delivery from design to deployment and support, embedding DevSecOps, automation, and built-in quality to accelerate releases and reduce risk.
* Integration and Interoperability: Orchestrate integrations across Salesforce Service & Life Sciences -Cloud, MuleSoft, mobile-first apps, AWS services, and event streaming (e.g., Kafka) to enable seamless data and workflow continuity.
* Regulatory and Compliance Readiness: Bake compliance into every phase (GxP, HIPAA, FDA, GDPR), establishing traceability, validation, and auditability without slowing down delivery.
* Agentic AI Development or similar Automation experience is essential. Support advancing agentic AI to build autonomous software agents. They complete complex operational tasks and make decisions safely and at scale.
* Technical Roadmap: Life Sciences Cloud: Guide the industrialization of Agent-force Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud and the Advanced Therapy Module to enable next-generation cell therapy delivery.
* Engineering Excellence and GenAI-Enabled SDLC: Establish best- practices for full-stack engineering and leverage GenAI for code generation, testing, and SDLC automation to boost productivity and quality.
* Talent Leadership and Culture: Build and mentor a high-performing global-team of engineers and solution architects, cultivating innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Vendor and Partner Management: Manage external partners to deliver quality, secure, and compliant solutions, optimizing for value and speed.
* Innovation and Future-Readiness: Stay ahead of LLMs, autonomous agents, and cloud-native advances; translate emerging tech into practical upgrades that modernize systems and unlock new capabilities.
* Essential Skills/Experience:
* Bachelor's - degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 12+ years of software development experience, including 5+ years in a leadership role within life sciences, biotech, or manufacturing IT environments.
* Experience managing sophisticated Salesforce environments and multi-cloud implementations.
* Experience in leading multiple Product Development teams globally with engineering and delivery ownership
* Experience building and deploying software solutions in regulated environments (GxP , HIPAA, FDA).
* Expertise in modern development tools and platforms: AWS, Azure, Python, Salesforce (Service Cloud and Life Sciences), MuleSoft, Confluent / Kafka.
* Expertise delivering digital solutions across patient engagement, R&D, and product commercialization.

* Salesforce certifications (e.g., Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, Platform Developer II).
* Familiarity with AI/ML features within Salesforce ecosystem (Einstein, predictive analytics).
* Understanding of GenAI use cases in software development and automated testing.
* Hands-on experience with Agentic AI tools and frameworks
* Solid background in system architecture, secure coding practices, and cloud-native design.
* Why AstraZeneca:

Join a purpose-led team where advanced technology meets scientific ambition to change what’s possible for patients. Here, unexpected teams—engineers, data scientists, and operational leaders—get in the same room to tackle problems that matter, with the investment and freedom to experiment through hackathons, prototypes, and scaled delivery. You will help build the digital capabilities that accelerate medicines to those who need them, supported by a collaborative culture that values kindness alongside ambition, rigorous standards alongside creativity, and continuous learning at every step.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The AI Tech Lead serves as a key technical resource for the ZenAI platform and a critical escalation point for complex platform, integration, and engineering issues. The role requires deep platform expertise and is responsible for feature evaluation, advanced technical consulting, and development of the internal tools on which the team depends. The AI Tech Lead ensures that solutions deployed on ZenAI are optimized for performance, cost efficiency, and model selection; advises power users and technical audiences on advanced platform capabilities; and serves as the technical liaison to vendor engineering and support teams. This role will initially operate as an individual contributor and is expected to evolve into a people-leadership position with one to three direct reports as the team grows. The role also provides complementary coverage across time zones in partnership with the global AI Capabilities & Governance team.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Master Data and Capacity Model Ownership:**
  Own the capacity model and related planning master data in SAP IBP. Use the master data dashboard to identify gaps or inaccuracies in production run rates, changeover constraints, material lead times, resource calendars and other planning parameters. Coordinate corrections with the relevant supply planners and master data stewards responsible for maintaining the source data in ECC/S/4HANA.

* **Constraint Identification and Alert Generation:**
  Run SAP IBP heuristics and planning algorithms to identify constraints across the supply network. Generate system alerts for capacity bottlenecks, material shortages, safety stock violations, and demand-supply imbalances.

* **Scenario Building:**
  Build comparable scenarios with consistent assumptions that enable the Supply Planers in both the Mid-Term and Short-Term to evaluate alternatives. Ensure scenarios are structured, repeatable, and documented so that leadership can compare options on a level playing field.

* **Resolution Modelling:**
  Execute resolution modelling in SAP S4 ePPDS and SAP IBP to test proposed solutions before they are committed. Validate feasibility of allocation changes, schedule adjustments, and capacity rebalancing options.

* **Digital Twin Development:**
  Drive digital twin development as organizational maturity evolves. Progress the modelling capability through maturity stages: heuristic-based planning, optimizer-driven planning, and ultimately AI/Joule-enabled autonomous planning.

* **Data and Parameter Stewardship:**
  Serve as the owner of planning parameters, ensuring that safety stock targets, lot sizes, planning horizons, and aggregation rules are correctly configured and regularly reviewed for accuracy. Ensure issues identified through modelling or business plan validation are escalated and corrected at source where required.

**Lead Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer**
to spearhead the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI-powered solutions. This role combines deep technical expertise, leadership, and a strong understanding of AI trends and tools.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Technical Leadership:

+ Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of Generative AI solutions.
+ Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and data scientists working on GenAI projects.
+ Stay updated with the latest trends, research, and advancements in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).

+ Architect, train, and fine-tune state-of-the-art LLMs and generative AI models
+ Develop and optimize pipelines for prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and domain-specific fine-tuning.

+ Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate GenAI solutions into enterprise applications and services.

+ Leverage MLOps practices for continuous model monitoring, retraining, and improvement.

* Data Strategy and Preparation:

+ Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure high-quality data acquisition, preprocessing, and augmentation for model training and fine-tuning.
+ Implement data governance and privacy practices in line with organizational policies.

* Innovation and Research:

+ Experiment with new generative AI techniques, such as multimodal AI, reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and active learning.
+ Evaluate and recommend AI frameworks, libraries, and platforms for project requirements.

* Stakeholder Collaboration:

+ Work closely with product managers, business stakeholders, and UX designers to define AI-powered product features and use cases.

**Key Requirements**

* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms and services for AI/ML, such as Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.

* Hands on experience in any of the agentic frameworks like LangChain, Semantic kernel, AutoGen, CrewAi
* Hands on experience using any of vector database like Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate, Faiss
* Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF)
* Strong expertise in LLMs and generative AI frameworks like OpenAI, Hugging Face Transformers, or similar platforms.
* Deep understanding of natural language processing (NLP) concepts, including tokenization, embeddings, and sequence-to-sequence models.
* Proficiency in Python and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn.
* Experience in CI/CD pipeline management and automation tools, particularly within the Azure DevOps environment. Knowledge of containerization (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools is also important
* Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices, such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Docker.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field (Ph.D. preferred).
* 8+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with 2+ years specifically in Generative AI.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in building Conversational AI applications using cloud-based services and in orchestrating AI/ML services for building a complete solution
* Minimum of 6 years of extensive full-time experience in Data Analysis, Statistics, Machine Learning, or Computer Science

title: AI Foundry BU deployed Engineer
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
  
  
At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
  
  
**Your Team's Impact**
**AI Foundry - BU Deployed Engineer**
****Role Overview****
The AI Foundry Forward Deployed SBU Engineer serves as the bridge between AI platform capabilities and real-world financial workflows. This role combines deep domain expertise in capital markets with strong AI engineering skills to rapidly design, prototype, deploy, and scale AI-native solutions for specific business units and strategic client opportunities.
  
  
Unlike a traditional software engineer, this individual is expected to operate at the intersection of product, engineering, consulting, and financial workflows. They must understand how investment professionals, advisors, bankers, analysts, portfolio managers, and relationship managers work, and be capable of helping existing teams translate their applications from legacy systems to modern AI-native designs. The ideal candidate is comfortable with tackling large open-ended problems, designing agent workflows with product teams, integrating APIs and MCPs with engineers, and demonstrating solutions directly to clients.
  
  
****What You'll Do****
**Business Unit Solution Ownership**

* Partner directly with Banking, Wealth, Buy-Side, and Research teams to identify high-value AI opportunities.
* Design AI-native workflows that solve real user problems rather than simply embedding AI into existing products.
* Deconstruct existing products and applications into key high-value primitives to fuel AI agents and workflows (APIs, MCPs / Tools, Agents, and more).
* Serve as the technical lead for strategic pilots, proofs of concept, and forward-deployed engagements.
* Develop reusable patterns that can transition from custom solutions into scalable platform capabilities.

**AI Solution Development**

* Build agentic workflows using Foundry platforms, APIs, MCPs, evaluation frameworks, and agent infrastructure.
* Design prompt, tool, memory, and workflow architectures.
* Create deterministic, auditable workflows suitable for institutional financial clients.
* Leverage evaluation frameworks to improve quality, repeatability, and trustworthiness.
* Prototype and validate new solutions rapidly with end users.

****What We're Looking For****
**Financial Markets Expertise**
5+ Years experience building applications in Finance.
  
  
**Strong Understanding Of At Least One:**

* Wealth Management
* Investment Banking
* Asset Management
* Buy-Side Research
* Institutional Portfolio Management

**Preferred Understanding Of:**

* Securities
* Equities
* Fixed income
* ETFs
* Mutual funds
* Alternative investments
* Portfolio analytics
* Risk analytics
* Benchmarks
* Performance attribution

****AI And Technical Skills****
1+ Years experience building AI-based applications.
  
  
**Required:**

* Web Development or Python
* APIs, MCP Implementations, and Tool Calling Architectures
* LLMs
* Prompt engineering
* Agent architectures
* Vector search / RAG
* Evaluation frameworks
* Workflow orchestration
* Cloud-native development

**Preferred:**

* Multi-agent systems
* Knowledge graphs
* Retrieval systems
* Fine-tuning concepts
* Agent memory systems
* AI governance frameworks

**Engineering Fundamentals**
10+ Years experience building software applications.
  
  
**Required:**

* Solution architecture
* Security and governance
* Software development lifecycle
* Production deployment experience
* CI/CD
* Containerization

**Product Builder Mindset**
Enjoys creating ambiguous zero-to-one solutions.
  
  
****What's In It For You****

* At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:

+ The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
+ Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
+ Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
+ A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
+ Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
+ Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

* Learn more about our benefits here. Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.

****Company Overview:****
FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. * Strong knowledge of AI & data governance, secure/trusted AI adoption assessments, and data platform modernization on cloud
* Demonstrated experience leading technology-led sales pursuits, proposal development, and client pitches.

description:
**What you will do on your journey with WebBeds.**

As an SAP Consultant Lead / SAP ABAP Developer Lead, you will join the growing global SAP team at WebBeds and play a key role in our SAP S/4HANA and RISE with SAP transformation journey.

**\***
These roles are based in Hyderabad and can also be considered in Bangalore, Pune, Chennai or Noida. We are building an internal SAP capability to drive innovation, reduce reliance on external partners and establish long-term ownership of our business processes and SAP solutions.'

Each successful candidate will lead delivery and solution ownership within their area of expertise. Functional Leads will collaborate with Finance, Procurement, Commercial and Operations teams to translate business requirements into scalable SAP solutions, while the SAP ABAP Developer Lead will partner with Functional Leads, Global Process Owners and technical teams to deliver Clean Core-aligned developments, integrations, analytics and automation.

All roles will contribute to process standardisation, innovation, compliance, operational excellence and measurable business value.

  provide leadership within your specialist area through design assurance, quality oversight, knowledge transfer and effective collaboration with internal and external teams.

  own end-to-end R2R processes within SAP S/4HANA, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Tax, Financial Close, Statutory and Management Reporting, Profitability Analysis (CO-PA), Bank Reconciliations and Finance Controls, and partner with O2C and P2P process owners to support an integrated Finance operating model across the WebBeds SAP landscape.

Are you passionate about leveraging cutting-edge AI/ML techniques, including Large Language Models, to solve complex, mission-critical problems in a dynamic environment? Do you want to contribute to safeguarding a leading global financial institution?

Within Compliance Engineering, we are seeking an experienced AI/ML Engineer to join our Engineering team. This role will focus on solving highly complex business problems using AI/ML techniques, incorporating latest emerging trends om building out vertical AI agents to run on data at massive scale.

* Stay current with the latest advancements in AI/ML platforms, tools, and techniques to solve business problems.

* A Bachelor's, master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, or a similar field of study.
* Preferably 3+ years AI/ML industry experience for Bachelor’s/Masters, 1 year for PhD with a focus on Language Models.
* Strong foundation in machine learning algorithms, including deep learning architectures (e.g., transformers, RNNs, CNNs)
* Proficiency in Python and relevant libraries/frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, scikit-learn.
* Demonstrated expertise in GenAI techniques, including but not limited to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model fine-tuning, prompt engineering, AI agents, and evaluation techniques.
* Experience working with embedding models and vector databases.
* Experience with MLOps practices, including model deployment, containerization (Docker, kubernetes), CI/CD, and model monitoring.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Curiosity, ownership and willingness to work in a collaborative environment.

* Experience with Agentic Frameworks (e.g., Langchain, AutoGen) and their application to real-world problems.

* Experience with model interpretability techniques.

title: Yield Analysis, Staff/Principal Lead Engineer
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for
*all*
.**
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
  
  
**As a Yield Analysis Module Lead, you will leverage advanced data analytics and deep process knowledge to identify, characterize, and quantify key yield limiters within assigned fab modules. You will lead rigorous investigative efforts to determine root causes of yield excursions, develop and publish actionable yield paretos, and translate complex data into clear technical direction for improvement. Working closely with the YA PTO team, Process Integration, and Process Engineering, you will provide accurate, data-driven guidance to the fab, influence corrective action strategies, and drive sustainable yield improvements. This role offers direct ownership of yield performance and a critical opportunity to impact continuous improvement across the manufacturing line.**

* Lead and maintain an effective training and development program, providing coaching and mentorship to elevate team proficiency and support growth of direct reports.
* Proficient in Module based Data Analysis, Part Type Ownership Analysis and new part setup activities
* Track probe yield performance and trends to identify, characterize, and explain gaps between target and actual yields.
* Perform advanced data analysis to quantify yield issues and generate accurate yield paretos that guide fab priorities and improvement efforts.
* Apply statistical and data‑mining techniques to identify root causes and uncover opportunities for sustainable yield improvement.
* Collaborate closely with PI, Probe, PE, EFA, and PFA teams to correlate electrical signals, probe signatures, and physical findings into actionable insights for process teams.
* Partner with module, inline monitoring, and global teams to implement, monitor, and standardize yield fixes, leveraging strong semiconductor process, defect, and metrology knowledge.
* Discover yield issues in NAND development and identify unique metric or combination of metrics, such as wafer/dice/tile shading, ECATS or other custom metric for issues quantification
* Interact with process area, process integration, yield, failure analysis, product engineering, design, and layout teams to drive clear definition of yield, cell, CMOS, qual, and reliability issues and pareto and derive improvement actions needed across tech-nodes and designs
* Own and drive non-standard deep dive statistical analysis of inline, probe, cell, and other critical metrics to define issues/problems, enable early inline detection, and improve the product yield and quality. Quantify and track progress on the issue hit hate, line impact, gap to program goal. Quantify yield improvement/downside seen based on process/probe changes
* Initiate data mining and correlation study on new issue seen. Initiate PFA request to identify root cause of yield issue. Perform inline correlation study to establish inline prediction to yield issue. Make yield projections based on expected improvement/downside. Conduct yield trend analysis, identify root causes in process step, conversion, algorithm change, and design, for yield shift
* Continuously develop/re-define inline detection in collaboration with metrology and RDA team
* Identify and define gaps with current test and co-develop (with product, probe, param engineering) unique parametric/probe bins to detect new fail modes as well as validate new program release
* Collaborate with module owners to identify, quantify key module deficiencies/technology gaps, and drive cross-functional teams to address. Optimize existing layout, conceptualize, and develop innovative solutions to meet product requirements and manufacturability
* Develop and innovate techniques in extracting data from different databases through various query languages and automate through scripting to improve work efficiency
* Assist and support the transfer documentation of layout/architecture fundamentals of new technology from R&D to manufacturing fab.
* Integrates AI-assisted tools and insights into daily work to improve efficiency, quality, or effectiveness, exercising sound judgment and complying with organizational standards and legal requirements.
* Contributes to a culture of continuous improvement by identifying, testing, and sharing AI-enabled enhancements within one’s scope of work.
* Ability to apply baseline digital fluency and role‑appropriate AI literacy to use AI‑enabled tools responsibly and effectively for research, analysis, content creation, problem‑solving, operational tasks, and achieving business

title: AI Engr II
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a highly skilled AI Engineer to design, build, deploy, and scale next-generation Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions for enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic frameworks, and AI-driven workflow automation. This role will contribute to the development of intelligent AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, collaborating, and operating within complex enterprise environments.
  
  
Your role will also include overseeing, supervising and reviewing tasks performed by team members to ensure effective execution of work; managing end‑to‑end processes and projects for both internal and external clients with responsibility for timely and accurate delivery; issuing clear instructions and directions to team members on tasks to be performed; and mentoring and guiding junior colleagues to support their skill development, professional growth, and overall success
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop production-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI applications.
* Build autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents that can reason, plan, use tools, and collaborate with other agents.
* Develop advanced RAG pipelines leveraging vector databases, embeddings, and enterprise data sources.
* Create multi-step reasoning workflows combining deterministic business logic with LLM-generated reasoning.
* Implement short-term and long-term memory architectures for persistent contextual interactions.
* Design and maintain resilient AI workflows incorporating self-correction, failure recovery, debugging loops, and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) controls.
* Integrate LLMs, VLMs, enterprise APIs, databases, and external tools into agent ecosystems.
* Deploy and manage AI applications across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and domain experts to translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions.
* Ensure production readiness through monitoring, testing, performance optimization, and governance controls.

* Strong proficiency in Python.
* Experience designing and implementing enterprise-grade software solutions.
* Familiarity with software engineering best practices, version control, testing, and CI/CD pipelines.

**Generative AI & Agentic AI**

* Hands-on production experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, or equivalent.

+ Reflection
+ Tool Use
+ Planning
+ Multi-Agent Collaboration

* Practical experience with:

+ Function calling
+ Structured outputs
+ Prompt engineering
+ Context window management

**LLMs & Foundation Models**

+ Large Language Models (LLMs)
+ Vision Language Models (VLMs)
+ Embedding models

* Strong understanding of model capabilities, limitations, and optimization techniques.

**Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**

* Experience designing and implementing advanced RAG architectures.
* Hands-on experience with:

+ Vector databases
+ Embeddings
+ Semantic search
+ Enterprise knowledge retrieval systems

**AI Workflow Orchestration**

* Proven ability to develop:

+ Self-healing workflows
+ Automated debugging mechanisms
+ Human-in-the-Loop approval processes
+ Quality assurance and audit checkpoints

**Cloud & Deployment**

* Experience deploying Generative AI solutions in:

+ On-premises environments
+ Hybrid architectures
+ Public cloud environments

* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as:

+ Microsoft Azure
+ AWS
+ Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

**Infrastructure & Platforms**

* Experience with:

+ Docker
+ Kubernetes
+ Containerized deployments

* Understanding of scalable AI infrastructure and distributed systems.

**Data Science & Machine Learning**

* Experience applying data mining and machine learning techniques, including:

+ Classification
+ Regression
+ Clustering
+ Decision Trees
+ Neural Networks
+ Support Vector Machines (SVM)
+ Anomaly Detection
+ Recommender Systems
+ Pattern Discovery
+ Text Mining

We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. **Company: FIXLY Services Pvt. Ltd.**

**Job Type**: On-Site / Field-Based

**Location**: Hyderabad, Telangana

**Compensation**: Based on technical expertise, project complexity, and assigned workload.

**Job Overview**

FIXLY Services Pvt. Ltd. is hiring skilled technicians for data centre installation, IT infrastructure deployment, commissioning, testing, and migration. Candidates will work with server racks, network equipment, storage systems, cabling infrastructure, and data centre relocation projects at client locations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install data centre infrastructure, server racks, network racks, servers, switches, routers, firewalls, storage systems, blade chassis, PDUs, and KVM equipment.
* Set up consoles and perform fibre installation, copper cabling, patch-panel installation, rack dressing, cable management, and equipment labelling.
* Perform data centre, server, and network commissioning.
* Conduct hardware testing, connectivity testing, power testing, redundancy testing, RAID validation, firmware validation, and hardware health checks.
* Prepare technical documentation, service reports, and as-built documentation.
* Support data centre migration, server relocation, rack relocation, and complete data centre moves.
* Perform hardware de-racking and re-racking during relocation projects.
* Assist with branch and data centre (DC) migration activities.
* Coordinate equipment transportation and support planned shutdowns, startups, equipment reconnection, and migration activities.
* Verify equipment installation and connectivity following commissioning or migration.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Knowledge of server racks, data centre infrastructure, networking equipment, and storage systems.
* Understanding of structured cabling, fibre optics, copper cabling, power connections, and cable management.
* Ability to perform equipment installation, hardware testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with RAID, firmware validation, redundancy, and hardware health checks.
* Ability to follow technical documentation, labelling standards, and data centre safety procedures.
* Willingness to travel to client locations and perform on-site assignments.
* ITI, Diploma, or degree in Computer Hardware, IT, Electronics, Networking, or a related field is preferred. Relevant hands-on experience is also valued.

**Compensation & Application**

Compensation depends on technical skills, assignment complexity, and the volume of work completed.

Interested technicians can apply to join the FIXLY Services Pvt.
