title: Engineer II, Data Warehouse
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview:**

As an **Engineer II in Data Warehousing & Automation Engineering**, you will partner with a team of data professionals to deliver data warehousing initiatives across the LPL Financial. This role is pivotal in leveraging data as a strategic asset to enhance decision-making, drive innovation, and ensure data quality and governance.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop solutions to deliver on the data warehousing strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives and driving data-driven decision-making across the organization
* Oversee the integration of data products in Snowflake and dbt, ensuring seamless data flow, quality and accessibility
* Design and develop data replication and transformation pipelines leveraging solutions such as HVR. Configure and manage HVR instances for optimal performance and scalability
* Develop, automate and implement data quality checks and monitoring procedures
* Manage and optimize Snowflake data warehouse, data mart and application-based solutions to ensure high performance, scalability, and reliability
* Implement cost management strategies to optimize data warehousing expenses while maintaining high service levels
* Ensure data security, compliance, and governance are integrated into all data warehousing processes to meet regulatory and organizational standards
* Establish and maintain robust metadata management practices to ensure data quality and accessibility
* Work closely with cross-functional teams, including IT, marketing, and customer service, to ensure data warehousing initiatives support business goals
* Emphasize rapid prototyping and continuous process improvement to enhance data warehousing capabilities and drive innovation
* Stay up-to-date on the latest advancements in industry and technology solutions, bringing insights to the team for continuous development of our stack, solutions and ways of working

**What are we looking for?**

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

**Requirements:**

* 7+ years of experience in both on-prem and cloud-based data warehousing and data marts, with at least 4 years focused on leadership of warehousing team(s)
* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer science or related field; Master’s degree preferred
* Demonstrable hands-on experience with:

  + Snowflake, AWS S3 at minimum.
  + Data governance and cataloging
  + Programming: Python and/or SQL (production code, reusable libraries, tests)
  + Pipeline development and orchestration: HVR, Airflow, Step Functions, dbt and others
  + DevOps for data: Terraform/CloudFormation, CI/CD, monitoring, and runbook creation
  + Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, and secure data onboarding/governance
  + Experience with both batch and real-time data processing

**Core Competencies****:**

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

**Preferences:**

* Snowflake developer certifications
* AI Engineering: Snowflake Coretex, AWS Bedrock, etc.
* Demonstrated use of AI/ML tools to augment engineering productivity (prompting for code generation, LLMs for docs/tests, query optimization)

**Skills & Tools**

* AWS (S3, Glue, Lake Formation, IAM), Snowflake
* SQL, Python
* HVR, dbt, Airflow, Step Functions
* Terraform/CloudFormation, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins)
* Observability (Dynatrace preferred, Datadog, Prometheus)
* Data governance & security (Unity Catalog, Collibra, Atlan)

title: Lead Service Operations Engineer
description:
**About Providence**
--------------------

Providence, one of the US’s largest not-for-profit healthcare systems, is committed to high quality, compassionate healthcare for all. Driven by the belief that health is a human right and the vision, ‘Health for a better world’, Providence and its 121,000 caregivers strive to provide everyone access to affordable quality care and services.

Providence has a network of 51 hospitals, 1,000+ care clinics, senior services, supportive housing, and other health and educational services in the US.

Providence India is bringing to fruition the transformational shift of the healthcare ecosystem to Health 2.0. The India center will have focused efforts around healthcare technology and innovation, and play a vital role in driving digital transformation of health systems for improved patient outcomes and experiences, caregiver efficiency, and running the business of Providence at scale.

  

**Why Us?**
-----------

* Best In-class Benefits
* Inclusive Leadership
* Reimagining Healthcare
* Competitive Pay
* Supportive Reporting Relation

About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled and customer-focused Tier 1.5 Support Engineer to join our team. The Tier 1.5 Engineer is responsible for handling advanced support issues, resolving escalated technical problems, and serving as the point of contact between Tier 1 support and specialized IT teams. This role requires strong troubleshooting capabilities, excellent communication, and a deep understanding of IT infrastructure and end-user technologies

Our Team culture

* Work environment, which is collaborative and driven by learning, attention to details & empathy towards our caregivers
* Empowering & enabling individuals and teams to realize their full potential
* Focus on outcomes, solving our caregivers’ pain points & predictable delivery
* Data driven decision making on vision & roadmap of the Service Desk
  

What will you be responsible for

The ideal candidate will have a blend of technical, process & operational skills in service desk management, operations, customer interactions, call handling. The candidate should be skilled at applying her/ his experience with a focus on problem solving, supporting systems, operational excellence, service quality, reduction of manual toil with focus on End User experience. The candidate should be highly collaborative and has good working experience in Global operating setups.

  

Key Responsibilities

* **Customer Service**: Personal responsibility for customer satisfaction. Professionally represents the ‘Face and Voice of IT’ in difficult situations, consistently strives to listen, understand, and support the needs of others in a sensitive manner.
* **Quality**: Performs challenging tasks efficiently and effectively. Anticipates problems and takes corrective action prior to completing the task. Sets challenging objectives and works against self-defined standards of excellence to continually improve personal performance.
* **Problem Solving**: Strong attention to detail and outstanding analytical skills.
* **Collaboration**: Ability to work effectively to build relationships with colleagues, customers, and management through positive interaction.
* **Flexibility and response to change**: Proven ability to organize multiple efforts and to respond to shifting priorities. Demonstrated ability to study, understand, adapt, and respond effectively to a constantly changing environment
* **Communications**: Listens with sensitivity and openness. Actively seeks constructive feedback and remains open and receptive to it. Anticipates the information needs of others. Proven skills in communicating with clinical and technical customers.

What would your day look like?

* Handle incidents and service requests escalated from Tier 1 support via ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow)
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and network issues for end users.
* Provide support for Windows/Mac OS, Microsoft 365, VPN, printers, mobile devices, and collaboration tools.
* Identify area of opportunity for latest Knowledge Articles towards enhanced FCR (First Call Resolution) and supportability.
* Ensure production solutions are reliable, secure, and effective and that implemented solutions are continuously monitored and documented. Look for opportunities to Left Shift and Right Shift tickets to reduce overall customer pain points, manual toil, and cost per ticket.
* Execute operational excellence, tracking metrics and KPIs to drive governance, quality, and efficiency. Influence and improve existing processes through innovative behaviors and effective change management.
* Perform Data Quality Audit on Incident logging. Suggest required changes towards deriving incident patterns and trends.
* Perform monthly Incident Pattern and Theme analysis.
* Execute opportunities and drive automation to improve KPIs on ticket reduction, ticket cycle time and resolution rate.
* Perform administrative tasks and troubleshooting in the following environments including Citrix, Active Directory, Single Sign-On services, E-mail Exchange, Patient electronic health records and other applications as needed.
* Support Active Directory tasks: password resets, user account management, group policy troubleshooting.
* Manage remote access and connectivity issues (e.g., Citrix, VPN, RDP).
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and document resolutions.
* Escalate unresolved incidents to Tier 3 or specialized teams with detailed documentation.
* Follow ITIL best practices for incident, problem, and change management.
* Support software deployments, updates, patching, and imaging of systems.

Who are we looking for?

* 5-8 years of Industry experience in Service Management, Service Desk Operations
* Good Communications skills (Fluent English)
* Flexibility to work in 24\*7 work environment
* ITIL v4/v5 Foundation certification (Preferred)
* Required Skills: MS Outlook, Word, Excel, Internet, Power BI, SQL
* Experience with Active Directory, M365 and ITSM
* Experience working with ServiceNow (Preferred)
* BE/B-Tech or Equivalent degree

Providence’s vision to create ‘Health for a Better World’ aids us to provide a fair and equitable workplace for all in our employment, whether temporary, part-time or full time, and to promote individuality and diversity of thought and background, and acknowledge its role in the organization’s success. This makes us committed towards equal employment opportunities, regardless of race, religion or belief, color, ancestry, disability, marital status, gender, sexual orientation, age, nationality, ethnic origin, pregnancy, or related needs, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, or any other category protected by applicable law. In furtherance to our mission in building a more inclusive and equitable environment, we shall, from time to time, undertake programs to assist, uplift and empower underrepresented groups including but not limited to Women, PWD (Persons with Disabilities), LGTBQ+ (Lesbian, Gay, Transgender, Bisexual or Queer), Veterans and others. We strive to address all forms of discrimination or harassment and provide a safe and confidential process to report any misconduct.

Contact our Integrity hotline also, read our Code of Conduct.

The India center will have focused efforts around healthcare technology and innovation, and play a vital role in driving digital transformation of health systems for improved patient outcomes and experiences, caregiver efficiency, and running the business of Providence at scale.

  

**Why Us?**
-----------

* Best In-class Benefits
* Inclusive Leadership
* Reimagining Healthcare
* Competitive Pay
* Supportive Reporting Relation

About Providence

At Providence, we are grounded in our goal to serve all as we engineer the future of healthcare. Providence Global Innovation Center, launched in February 2020, is the first development and innovation center of Providence outside the United States. Providence is a $26B non-profit organization and one of the largest health systems in the United States.

Why Providence?

* Best-in-class benefits and employee-friendly policies

* Inclusive leadership and a collaborative culture

* Challenging, purpose-driven work supporting healthcare

* Opportunities to engineer secure and modern caregiver experiences

Role Summary

The Lead Service Engineer – Endpoint Platform Management will lead the engineering, administration, governance and continuous improvement of enterprise endpoint services across Windows, macOS, iOS and Android. The role combines Microsoft Intune administration, MECM/SCCM, MDM, MAM, Apple device management, application packaging, endpoint security, automation and operational service ownership.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Platform Engineering and Administration

* Administer Microsoft Intune, MECM/SCCM, Windows Autopilot and co-management services.

* Design and maintain configuration profiles, compliance policies, security baselines, endpoint protection policies, update rings and enrollment restrictions.

* Monitor service health, inventory, deployments, compliance and platform capacity; define corrective actions.

* Maintain role-based access, administrative scopes, governance standards and operating procedures.

MDM and MAM

* Manage MDM and MAM policies for corporate-owned and personally owned devices.

* Implement app protection, selective wipe, data-transfer controls and secure access requirements.

* Align device compliance and Conditional Access with identity and security teams.

* Troubleshoot enrollment, synchronization, policy evaluation and application protection issues.

Apple and Mobile Device Management

* Administer Apple Business Manager integration, APNS certificates, Automated Device Enrollment and Apps and Books tokens.

* Manage enrollment, compliance, configuration and application deployment for iOS, iPadOS and macOS.

* Coordinate certificate and token renewals without service disruption.

* Manage Android Enterprise enrollment and application controls.

Application Packaging and Lifecycle Management

* Package, test, deploy and maintain applications using Intune Win32, MECM/SCCM and AdminStudio or equivalent tools.

* Define installation commands, detection methods, requirement rules, dependencies, supersedence and assignments.

* Coordinate validation, pilot, release, upgrade and retirement activities with application owners.

* Develop PowerShell-based deployment, validation and remediation solutions.

* Maintain packaging standards, source control and deployment documentation.

Patching, Compliance and Endpoint Security

* Configure and monitor Windows updates, feature updates, quality updates and patch compliance.

* Identify non-compliant, unhealthy or vulnerable devices and coordinate remediation.

* Produce reporting for device health, compliance, patching and deployment performance.

* Maintain evidence, change records and procedures supporting audit, risk and security requirements.

Automation, Operations and Service Leadership

* Develop PowerShell automation for provisioning, reporting, remediation and administration.

* Lead complex incident and problem investigations, root-cause analysis and preventive actions.

* Create SOPs, knowledge articles, runbooks and transition documentation.

* Mentor engineers, review technical solutions and drive continuous improvement.

* Collaborate across security, identity, network, infrastructure, service desk and application teams.

What Your Day Could Look Like

* Review service health, compliance trends, application deployments and operational alerts.

* Engineer and test Intune, MDM, MAM, Autopilot, Apple enrollment and security configurations.

* Package and validate applications and coordinate staged deployments.

* Troubleshoot complex enrollment, policy, patching and software-delivery issues.

* Automate operations and improve reporting, governance and service reliability.

* Participate in Agile ceremonies, change reviews and technical design discussions.

Required Qualifications and Experience

* 6–9 years of experience in endpoint management, digital workplace, client engineering or unified endpoint management.

* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and MECM/SCCM in a large enterprise environment.

* Practical experience with MDM, MAM, Windows Autopilot, co-management and application deployment.

* Experience managing Apple devices through Apple Business Manager, ADE, APNS and Apps and Books.

* 3+ years of application packaging experience using Intune Win32, MECM/SCCM or AdminStudio.

* Strong PowerShell scripting, troubleshooting and automation skills.

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, endpoint security and Group Policy.

* Experience with patching, compliance reporting, incident/problem management and change governance.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Management or a related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

* Microsoft certification aligned to Endpoint Administrator, Microsoft 365 or security technologies.

* Experience with PKI, certificates, VPN, Wi-Fi and endpoint security integrations.

* Knowledge of ITIL, service management, operational KPIs and continuous improvement.

* Experience supporting regulated, healthcare or other security-sensitive environments.

Core Competencies

* Engineering Excellence: structured design, testing, automation and documentation.

* Service Ownership: accountability for reliability, compliance, risk and user experience.

* Problem Solving: data-led troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.

* Collaboration: clear communication across technical and business stakeholders.

* Leadership: mentoring, influencing standards and leading through change.

title: IT&D Senior Cyber Analyst-Security Monitoring & Threat Response
description:
**We are Reckitt**
------------------

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

**Information Technology & Digital**
------------------------------------

In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.  
  
Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.

**About the role**
------------------

Are you passionate about leveraging technology to drive business excellence? We are seeking a highly skilled IT&D Senior Cyber Analyst specializing in Security Monitoring & Threat Response to join our dynamic team. This role offers the opportunity to innovate and implement cutting-edge security solutions, ensuring our business remains agile, secure, and ahead of emerging threats.  
  
As an IT&D Senior Cyber Analyst, you will be instrumental in detecting and responding to security incidents, conducting in-depth post-incident technical analysis, and managing security alerts across both IT and OT environments. You will collaborate closely with the Security Engineering Team to refine requirements, develop advanced threat detection mechanisms, create robust incident response playbooks, and implement automation strategies. Furthermore, you will actively participate in threat hunting exercises and contribute to the enhancement of our SIEM and EDR platforms.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

Respond to, resolve, and escalate security incidents as required.  

* Contribute to the development and refinement of the IT security incident response process and supporting materials.
* Conduct threat hunting activities to identify threat actor groups and their tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Capture threat intelligence on actor TTPs and develop appropriate countermeasures.
* Participate in post-incident reviews and deliver presentations to senior management.
* Engage in security incident tabletop exercises.
* Assist in developing processes and procedures to optimize incident response times, incident analysis, and overall, global CSIRT operations

**The experience we're looking for**
------------------------------------

Minimum of 5 years of experience in responding to cyber incidents.  

* Technical expertise in security-related systems and applications such as EDR, IDS/IPS, Proxy, SIEM, WAF, and SOAR.
* Proven experience in developing, documenting, and maintaining security procedures.
* Strong understanding of network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls.
* Proficiency in TCP/IP and network administration/protocols.
* Understanding of how Operating Systems works (Windows, Linux)
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills for effective security incident resolution.
* Relevant certifications such as Security+, Network+, GCIA, GCIH, CISP, GMON, etc.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Experience with scripting languages (Bash, PowerShell, Python) is advantageous.
* Solid knowledge of software engineering, information risk, security guidelines, and architecture standards.

title: Hiring Data Migration Specialist
description:
Job Title: Data Migration Specialist

**Experience:** 5+ Years  
**Location:** Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Gurgaon  
**Work Mode:** Hybrid – 3 Days Work from Office  
**Budget:** Up to ₹1.70 LPM  
**Payroll:** Haparz  
**Notice Period:** Immediate Joiners Preferred

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Data Migration Specialist with strong expertise in migration strategy, ETL processes, data mapping, migration automation, and large-scale data transfers. The ideal candidate should be capable of planning and executing end-to-end data migration from legacy systems to modern SaaS platforms, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, security, and minimal business disruption.

The candidate will be responsible for developing migration strategies, validating data transformations, automating migration workflows, and supporting cutover activities. Experience with Snowflake, high-volume data processing, and PII data protection will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and execute end-to-end data migration strategies, including source analysis, target data modelling, migration planning, and validation.
* Analyse legacy databases and applications to understand data structures, dependencies, relationships, and migration requirements.
* Develop source-to-target data mappings, transformation rules, and data cleansing processes to ensure data consistency.
* Build, configure, and optimise ETL/ELT pipelines for extracting, transforming, validating, and loading data into target platforms.
* Automate migration workflows, reconciliation processes, and data validation checks to reduce manual effort and migration errors.
* Execute full, incremental, and delta data loads based on migration requirements.
* Plan and execute cutover activities, including final data loads, reconciliation, issue resolution, and post-migration validation.
* Perform data quality checks to identify duplicates, missing records, invalid values, and inconsistencies between source and target systems.
* Conduct performance and volume testing to validate migration throughput, processing time, and scalability for large datasets.
* Troubleshoot migration failures, transformation defects, data mismatches, and ETL pipeline performance issues.
* Ensure secure handling of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) through appropriate masking, access controls, encryption, and data protection practices.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, application teams, data engineers, and QA teams to ensure successful migration delivery.
* Maintain migration documentation, mapping specifications, validation reports, reconciliation results, and cutover plans.

Required Experience

* 5+ years of experience in data migration, data integration, ETL/ELT, or related data engineering activities.
* Hands-on experience with data migration strategy, source-to-target mapping, transformation logic, and data validation.
* Practical experience migrating data from legacy systems to SaaS applications or modern cloud platforms.
* Experience developing or automating ETL pipelines, migration scripts, and reconciliation processes.
* Knowledge of full, incremental, and delta data loading techniques.
* Experience with cutover planning, migration execution, data reconciliation, and post-migration verification.
* Experience handling large datasets and performing performance and volume testing.
* Strong SQL skills for data profiling, transformation validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting.

Good to Have

* Experience with Snowflake, including data loading, SQL queries, and data validation.
* Exposure to cloud-based data migration and integration platforms.
* Understanding of PII handling, data masking, encryption, and data security controls.
* Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, Talend, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, or similar platforms.
* Experience with Python or scripting for migration automation.
* Familiarity with migration runbooks, rollback planning, and production cutover procedures.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana

We know that employing a diverse team and valuing the unique perspectives of our people allows us to better understand and serve the needs of our clients.
  
  
Lincoln International is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We encourage you to read more about our commitment to diversity and Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG) efforts.
  
  
**Lincoln International follows a hybrid work structure with an emphasis on in office collaboration.
  
  
Our employees work in our offices Monday through Thursday each week, with the option to work remotely or from the office on Fridays.**
The Senior Data Coordinator will serve as the day-to-day lead for a team of Data Specialists supporting strategic data, technology, and operational initiatives across Lincoln International's Valuations & Opinions Group. This is a hands-on working-lead role. In addition to setting daily priorities, coordinating workloads, coaching early-career team members, and reviewing work quality, this individual will be expected to perform the team’s core data and operational responsibilities as needed, particularly during periods of high volume, complex assignments, or limited team capacity.
  
  
The role will support client onboarding to Lincoln's next-generation valuation platform (Anaplan), private-market data collection and reporting, functional testing of new platform capabilities, ongoing support for valuation technology platforms, and continuous improvement initiatives, including emerging AI and data-extraction solutions.
  
  
The successful candidate will work closely with the Anaplan Technology team, Data & Analytics, the Salesforce Data team, Product teams, and valuation professionals. The role requires strong operational discipline, financial acumen, project coordination skills, and the ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders while keeping the team focused, organized, and accountable.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities:**
Team Leadership & Daily Operations
  
  

* Provide day-to-day direction, coaching, and support to a team of Data Specialists, serving as the primary point of coordination for daily activities.
* Set priorities, assign work, and balance team capacity across multiple onboarding, data, testing, and support workstreams.
* Review team output for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness, reinforcing clear quality standards and expectations.
* Monitor productivity, turnaround times, and workflow bottlenecks; proactively adjust assignments and escalate risks when needed.
* Promote knowledge sharing, cross-training, and consistent documentation to strengthen team coverage and reduce key-person dependencies.
* Support the onboarding and development of new team members through structured guidance, feedback, and hands-on coaching.
* Remain actively involved in day-to-day execution and perform the core responsibilities of the Data Specialist team as needed, including completing complex or time-sensitive assignments, addressing capacity constraints, and modeling expected quality standards.

Client Onboarding & Project Coordination
  
  

* Coordinate the onboarding of valuation clients onto Lincoln's Anaplan platform, ensuring required data, activities, and stakeholders are aligned.
* Manage multiple concurrent onboarding, testing, and operational initiatives.
* Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, dependencies, issue logs, and status updates.
* Identify delivery risks and resource constraints early, communicate impacts clearly, and coordinate appropriate next steps.
* Facilitate cross-functional execution across Data & Analytics, the Anaplan Technology team, the Salesforce Data team, Product teams, and other Business Enablement partners.

Data Quality, Governance & Reporting
  
  

* Oversee the collection, validation, maintenance, and reporting of private-market data.
* Establish and reinforce quality-control procedures that improve data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness.
* Investigate data exceptions and recurring issues, coordinate resolution, and recommend sustainable process improvements.
* Maintain clear process documentation, operating procedures, and ownership standards to support scalable execution.
* Provide stakeholders with visibility into work status, data-quality issues, and outstanding dependencies.

Product & Technology Support
  
  

* Partner with the Anaplan Technology team on new platform capabilities and enhancements, including requirements clarification, functional testing, issue documentation, and validation of fixes.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing and ensure test scenarios, results, defects, and follow-up actions are documented clearly.
* Support valuation technology platforms by triaging user questions, coordinating issue resolution, and identifying recurring support needs.
* Support the evaluation and responsible adoption of emerging AI and data-extraction solutions that improve team productivity and data-processing capabilities.

**Qualifications:**
Interested candidates should demonstrate the following experience and capabilities:
  
  
**Required Experience & Skills**

* Approximately 7-8 years of relevant experience in data operations, financial analysis, valuation, financial reporting, or a related field.
* Experience providing day-to-day leadership, coaching, or work coordination for junior or early-career team members.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong project coordination skills, including planning, milestone tracking, risk identification, issue management, and status communication.
* Analytical foundation with an understanding of financial statements and strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Strong working knowledge of the team’s core data, financial analysis, and operational processes, with the ability and willingness to independently complete, troubleshoot, and provide guidance on the work performed by Data Specialists.
* Experience analyzing or preparing company financials, financial models, valuation analyses, or related reporting.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with close attention to detail and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and build productive working relationships across levels and functions.
* Ability to periodically work extended hours, in the office or remotely, as required to support business deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CFA designation completed or actively being pursued.
* Experience with Anaplan or another enterprise planning or workflow platform.
* Experience with SQL, Power BI, or other data and reporting tools.
* Experience supporting technology implementations, functional testing, or user acceptance testing.
* Experience in financial services, investment banking, valuation, or a related professional-services environment.

Professional & Cultural Characteristics
  
  

* High integrity and personal values consistent with Lincoln's Culture Statement: Excellence, Entrepreneurship, Integration, Collaboration, and Integrity.
* Proactive, organized, and self-motivated, with the judgment to identify priorities and move work forward with limited supervision.
* Resourceful problem solver who can identify root causes, recommend practical solutions, and follow through on execution.
* Confident and articulate communicator who provides clear direction and escalates issues constructively.
* Collaborative, team-oriented, and comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment with evolving priorities.
* Committed to developing others while remaining willing to work hands-on alongside the team.
* Curious and adaptable, with a strong interest in learning new financial concepts, technologies, and operating processes.
* Driven by high-quality outcomes and motivated by achieving both individual and team goals.

title: Solution Engineer : Mumbai
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for
**domain-first, systems-oriented engineers**
who understand how real-world systems (in renewable energy
**,**
automotive, manufacturing, IoT, etc.) generate and use data — and can translate that into meaningful AI-driven workflows using DevRev.
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer, you will act as a
**trusted advisor**
, combining
**domain expertise, engineering depth, and problem-solving**
to help customers unlock value from their data through DevRev’s AI platform.
  
  
You will work closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to design solutions that go beyond demos — enabling
**real-world automation, intelligence, and agentic workflows**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with customers to deeply understand domain workflows, systems, and data flows (e.g., connected vehicles, factory systems, IoT environments)
* Translate real-world signals (sensor data, logs, events) into insights, workflows, and automated actions
* Build and showcase AI-driven workflows, automations, and agentic use cases
* Design and articulate end-to-end solutions (data ingestion → processing → decision → action)
* Act as a technical advisor, guiding customers on how DevRev can integrate into and enhance their existing systems
* Deliver tailored demos, PoCs, and solution walkthroughs grounded in real-world use cases (not generic SaaS demos)
* Support integrations with external systems via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines
* Contribute to technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and solution architectures
* Stay current on industry trends (renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, IoT, AI) and bring insights into customer conversations

**Qualifications & Skills**
**Domain Expertise**

* Experience in renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, industrial systems, or IoT environments
* Strong understanding of:
* Connected systems (vehicles, machines, robotics, embedded systems)
* Sensor ecosystems (CAN, telemetry, vision systems, IoT devices)
* Real-world data (signals, logs, time-series)
* Familiarity with manufacturing workflows (inspection, defect detection, production cycles).
* Ability to explain data flow from system → processing → business outcomes

**Engineering Depth**

* Strong system-level thinking
* Experience with:
* Data pipelines, APIs, integrations, distributed systems
* Experience in Python / TypeScript / JavaScript (or similar)
* Understanding of system design, reliability, and failure handling
* Exposure to AI/ML in industrial use cases (vision systems, predictive maintenance, log-stream analysis, etc.)

**Problem Solving & Use Case Thinking**

* Ability to translate data → insights → workflows → actions
* Experience designing end-to-end systems
* Strong analytical mindset to identify automation opportunities from real-world signals

**AI & Tools**

* Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents
* Familiarity with prompt design and AI workflows
* Tools: Postman, GitHub, Jira, Cursor, Claude Code

**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

title: Head - Technology & AI | E-Commerce | AI Agents | Engineering & Automations
description:
**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Ergode builds and scales digital-first businesses across global marketplaces.

We have made a clear strategic choice: **Technology, Artificial Intelligence and automation will sit at the core of how we scale revenue, improve margins and increase productivity.**

We are looking for a **hands-on Technology & AI leader** who can convert business problems into working, adopted systems — quickly.

This is not a traditional IT leadership role.

You will own the intersection of **business, engineering, AI, automation, data, integrations, infrastructure and security**. You will work directly with the CEO and business leaders to identify high-impact problems, decide what should be built internally versus externally, and ensure solutions move from idea production adoption measurable business outcome.

Some of our systems need modernization. Some need stronger ownership and architecture. Others need to be replaced or rebuilt. We would rather be transparent about that upfront.

We need someone who enjoys that challenge.

**What You Will Own**
=====================

**1. Technology Execution & Delivery**
--------------------------------------

You will create an execution culture where technology commitments translate into shipped outcomes.

You will:

* Run Technology on clear weekly priorities with an owner, deadline and measurable outcome for every major initiative.
* Establish strong engineering execution across product development, integrations, automation, infrastructure and AI.
* Track commitments through completion — not merely development activity.
* Identify blockers early and make fast build/buy/outsource decisions.
* Hold internal teams and external partners accountable for scope, timelines, quality and business outcomes.
* Build clear visibility from:

**Business Requirement**  **Development**  **Production**  **Adoption**  **Business Impact**

* Develop engineers and technology managers into stronger owners and future leaders.
* Create sufficient documentation, architecture standards and ownership so no critical system depends on one employee or vendor.

### **Success means:**

Leadership should never need to repeatedly ask, **“Where is this project stuck and who owns it?”**

**2. Business-First Technology Strategy**
=========================================

Technology exists to improve business outcomes.

You will:

* Deeply understand how Ergode makes money across marketplaces, brands and channels.
* Understand marketplace fees, margins, inventory, pricing, advertising, catalogue operations, fulfilment and customer experience.
* Own the Technology & AI roadmap based on impact on:
  + Revenue
  + Gross margin
  + Productivity
  + Operating cost
  + Speed
  + Customer/vendor experience
* Work directly with business heads to identify operational bottlenecks.
* Challenge processes that should be eliminated or simplified before automating them.
* Translate business problems into scalable technology solutions.
* Own technology economics including cloud, AI/token usage, software licences, development and outsourcing.
* Report technology performance to leadership in **business outcomes rather than project activity**.

**3. AI, Agents & Intelligent Automation**
==========================================

AI is not an innovation project at Ergode. It is becoming part of how the company operates.

You will:

* Identify high-volume and high-value manual work suitable for AI or automation.
* Build and deploy AI agents and GenAI workflows into **real production environments**.
* Develop reusable AI architecture rather than disconnected experiments.
* Integrate AI into areas including:
  + Catalogue and content
  + Marketplace listings
  + Pricing
  + Inventory
  + Customer support
  + Sales
  + Finance
  + HR
  + Reporting and decision support
* Build with LLM APIs, RAG, agentic workflows, orchestration frameworks and workflow automation.
* Establish before/after baselines for every major automation.
* Measure:
  + hours/FTE capacity saved
  + cycle-time reduction
  + cost reduction
  + quality improvement
  + revenue/margin impact
  + user adoption
* Kill pilots that do not produce value and scale the ones that do.
* Ensure business teams actually adopt what Technology builds.

### **We are not looking for:**

Someone who has attended AI courses or built demos.

### **We are looking for:**

Someone who has **put AI into production and can show what changed because of it.**

**4. E-commerce Platforms & Marketplace Technology**
====================================================

Our technology must support a complex global marketplace operation.

You will own and strengthen:

* Marketplace integrations including Amazon SP-API, Walmart, eBay and other channels.
* Catalogue and listing infrastructure.
* Pricing and quantity synchronization.
* Order processing.
* Inventory and warehouse integrations.
* Returns, refunds and reconciliation workflows.
* Marketplace reporting and operational intelligence.
* API reliability and monitoring.

You will build toward a connected architecture where catalogue, inventory, order and marketplace information flows reliably across systems.

The goal is not simply integration.

The goal is **reliable commerce at scale**.

**5. Product & Platform Ownership**
===================================

You will take ownership of Ergode’s core internal technology platforms and ensure they become dependable business systems.

This includes:

* evaluating existing architecture,
* identifying technical debt,
* establishing clear module ownership,
* improving reliability and usability,
* prioritising development based on business value,
* and driving adoption after launch.

Technology is not complete when code is deployed.

**A feature is complete when the business can reliably use it and the expected outcome is visible.**

**6. Data Foundation & Decision Intelligence**
==============================================

AI is only as strong as the underlying data.

You will:

* Build reliable data flows across business systems.
* Establish clear sources of truth for critical business information.
* Reduce duplicate datasets and manual reconciliation.
* Improve data quality and ownership.
* Enable dashboards and AI systems to consume trustworthy business data.
* Build APIs and integration layers that allow new agents and applications to be deployed quickly.

**7. Architecture, Cloud & Engineering Quality**
================================================

You should be technically strong enough to challenge architecture and engineering decisions yourself.

You will:

* Review architecture for scalability, reliability, maintainability, security and cost.
* Establish coding, testing, documentation and deployment standards.
* Strengthen CI/CD and monitoring.
* Review estimates rather than blindly accepting them.
* Prototype when speed requires it.
* Make pragmatic technology choices rather than over-engineering.

We expect a leader who can move comfortably between a **CEO conversation about ROI and an engineering conversation about architecture.**

**8. Security, Reliability & AI Governance**
============================================

You will own the reliability and security of Ergode’s technology environment.

Responsibilities include:

* Cloud and infrastructure reliability
* Monitoring and uptime
* Incident management
* Root-cause analysis
* Backups and disaster recovery
* Identity and access management
* SSO
* Endpoint/device security
* Data protection

You will also establish practical AI governance covering:

* which company information can be shared with which AI systems,
* permissions available to AI agents,
* human review requirements for critical decisions,
* auditability,
* and acceptable AI use.

Compliance should appropriately address DPDP and relevant international privacy/security requirements.

**9. Build vs Buy vs Outsource**
================================

We do not believe everything must be built internally.

We do believe **Ergode must own the outcome.**

You will decide when to:

**BUILD** — when capability creates strategic advantage.

**BUY** — when a reliable product already solves the problem economically.

**OUTSOURCE** — when an external specialist can deliver faster.

For outsourced work, you will own:

* requirements,
* architecture,
* vendor selection,
* commercial evaluation,
* milestones,
* SLAs,
* quality,
* security,
* source code,
* documentation,
* handover.

No critical Ergode technology should become permanently dependent on one vendor or individual.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within the first 6–12 months, we expect visible movement across these areas:

### **Execution**

* Major technology initiatives have clear owners, deadlines and outcomes.
* Delivery predictability improves materially.
* Chronic technology bottlenecks reduce.

### **AI & Automation**

* Multiple AI agents/workflows are operating in production.
* Automation impact is quantified monthly.
* Manual workload is measurably reduced in targeted processes.
* Business adoption is visible rather than assumed.

### **Core Platforms**

* Critical marketplace and internal systems become more reliable.
* Technical ownership and documentation improve.
* Important business workflows no longer depend on fragile manual processes.

### **Data**

* Critical catalogue, inventory, order and operational data become more connected and trustworthy.

### **Business Partnership**

* Business leaders increasingly bring problems to Technology because they expect **working solutions, not project discussions**.

**Who We Are Looking For**
==========================

**Must-Haves**
--------------

* 10+ years of meaningful technology experience.
* 5+ years leading engineering/technology teams.
* Evidence of personally owning major technology delivery.
* Strong understanding of software engineering, architecture, APIs and integrations.
* AI/automation systems deployed into production with measurable impact.
* Practical experience with:
  + LLM APIs
  + RAG
  + AI agents / agentic workflows
  + Python
  + workflow automation platforms such as n8n/Make or equivalent
* Cloud experience across AWS, Azure or GCP.
* API/integration architecture experience.
* DevOps, deployment and monitoring understanding.
* Ability to evaluate architecture, code/design decisions and engineering estimates.
* Experience managing external technology partners.
* Experience owning meaningful technology budgets.
* Strong business and commercial orientation.

**Strongly Preferred**
----------------------

Experience in one or more of:

* E-commerce
* Marketplaces
* Retail technology
* D2C
* SaaS/platform businesses
* ERP/OMS/WMS
* Amazon SP-API or other marketplace integrations
* High-volume order/catalogue/inventory systems
* AI-first enterprise transformation

**Who Will NOT Fit This Role**
==============================

This role is probably not for you if:

* Your experience is predominantly IT infrastructure/helpdesk.
* Your leadership style is primarily delegation without technical depth.
* Your AI experience consists mainly of courses, certifications or prototypes.
* You measure success by projects delivered rather than business outcomes achieved.
* You require large teams before you can execute.
* You prefer lengthy planning cycles over shipping, learning and improving.
* You cannot challenge engineers, vendors and business leaders when necessary.

**The Person Behind the Resume**
================================

We care about experience, but we care equally about how you operate.

We value people who demonstrate:

**Ownership. Bias for action. Curiosity. Commercial thinking. High standards. Candour. Learning velocity.**

We would rather hire a builder who has repeatedly solved difficult problems than someone with the perfect title.

title: Team Lead, Provider Data Operations
description:
**Our Mission**
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
**About The Role**
***We’re hiring an AI-first Operations Team Lead; an operations leader who uses AI to build better workflows, not just talk about its potential.***
As a Provider Data Operations Team Lead, you will lead and coach a team while owning productivity, quality, and SLA performance. You will bring clarity to ambiguous problems, remove workflow bottlenecks, and ensure the team executes consistently against operational goals.
  
  
You will also use AI hands-on in your daily work. You’ll identify repetitive or error-prone tasks, test AI-enabled approaches, balance speed with accuracy and human review, and turn successful experiments into repeatable workflows the broader team can adopt safely and effectively.
  
  
**A Day in the Life of a Provider Data Operations Team Lead:**

* Use AI to Improve Daily Operations: Use AI tools hands-on to analyze problems, accelerate routine work, summarize information, improve data quality, and support better decisions. Regularly ask where a manual workflow can be simplified, automated, or redesigned.
* Identify, Pilot & Scale AI-Enabled Solutions: Spot high-value opportunities to reduce repetitive work or prevent errors. Design practical pilots, define success measures, evaluate results, and partner with AI, Product, Systems, and Operations teams to turn proven ideas into sustainable workflows.
* Balance Speed, Accuracy & Human Review: Apply sound judgment to determine where AI can operate independently and where human validation is required. Monitor output quality, surface risks, and ensure AI-enabled processes remain accurate, explainable, and aligned with established guardrails.
* Lead Team Execution & Daily Operations: Oversee day-to-day operations for a team of 8-10 Researchers, Associates, and Senior Associates. Provide clear direction on case handling, workflow interpretation, and complex troubleshooting to deliver consistently against productivity, quality, and SLA targets.
* Manage Workflows & Drive Throughput: Own workload distribution, proactively identify bottlenecks, and reallocate work to maintain flow and meet operational goals. Independently manage complex workstreams with minimal supervision.
* Ensure Quality & Process Adherence: Provide quality oversight through case reviews, audits, and trend analysis. Ensure consistent application of SOPs and policies, address escalations, and maintain high standards across both human and AI-assisted outputs.
* Coach & Develop Team Members: Deliver coaching tailored to individual strengths and development areas. Support onboarding, training, and continuous skill-building, including helping team members use AI tools confidently, responsibly, and effectively.
* Lead Change & Drive Adoption: Translate new tools and pilots into clear operating guidance. Gather team feedback, address adoption barriers, and reinforce the behaviors needed to make improved workflows stick.
* Partner with Stakeholders in India and the US: Build strong cross-functional relationships, align on priorities and success measures, manage expectations, and escalate appropriately to ensure smooth execution across time zones.
* Navigate Ambiguity & Drive Continuous Improvement: Break ambiguous problems into clear next steps, use data and experimentation to learn quickly, and create repeatable processes from successful solutions.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in data operations, business operations, analytics, research, or customer service. People management experience is preferred; however, strong individual contributors with hands-on AI or automation experience and demonstrated readiness to transition into a leadership role will also be considered.
* An AI-native approach to problem-solving: you naturally explore whether manual work can be improved, automated, or supported by AI.
* Experience using Claude is a plus.
* Hands-on experience in building AI-enabled tools, agents, workflow automations, or data/process automation solutions to solve business or operational problems.
* Ability to evaluate AI output critically, recognize limitations, and design appropriate human-review checks to protect accuracy and data quality.
* Demonstrated ability to turn experiments into documented, measurable, repeatable workflows and coach others through change.
* Strong operations leadership, including workload management, performance coaching, SLA ownership, quality oversight, and escalation handling.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to use data to diagnose problems and measure impact.
* Curious, hands-on, and quick to learn new tools; comfortable experimenting within defined guardrails.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace applications, plus experience with tools such as Salesforce and Confluence and the ability to work with large data sets.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a track record of building engaged, adaptable, and high-performing teams.
* A Bachelor’s degree from a reputed institution with a strong academic record.
* Experience in US healthcare or healthcare technology is a plus.
* Experience working across global or cross-time-zone teams, particularly India and the US, is a plus.

**You do not need to be an engineer or an AI researcher.**
You should be excited to learn, willing to experiment hands-on, and motivated to use AI to make operations faster, more accurate, and easier to scale.
  
  
**Benefits**

* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare/creche facility for kids
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check-ups
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2025-2026

**About Us**
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.
  
  
Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values -

title: Agentic AI Engineering
description:
**Agentic AI- 8-15 Years**

**Location: Bangalore,Pune,Hyderabad,Chennai.**

**Engineering Foundation**

*Non-negotiable. This is what we screen on first, and there is no AI in it.*

* Data modelling across SQL and NoSQL, and a clear view of where each one breaks
* Event-driven architecture in production with Kafka, RabbitMQ or equivalent. Ordering, replay, idempotency, dead-letter handling
* Distributed systems failure modes: partial failure, retries, backpressure, timeouts, circuit breakers
* Caching strategy and invalidation, at a scale where getting it wrong hurt
* Observability. You have instrumented a system, not just read someone else's dashboard
* At least one cloud deeply. Not three superficially
* API and integration patterns against real enterprise surfaces such as ERPs, CRMs and data platforms
* CI/CD, containers, release engineering
* You have owned something in production. On-call, incidents, the whole thing

Agent systems are distributed systems with a non-deterministic component in the middle. If the fundamentals are not there, the AI layer does not survive contact with production.

**AI Engineering**

*Two capabilities that do not come free with an engineering background. These are the ones we probe hardest.*

**Evaluation and Error Analysis**

* You have built an eval set for a non-deterministic system and used it to make a decision
* You can decompose a failure: is this a model problem, a retrieval problem, a data problem or a product problem?
* You debug agent behaviour systematically, with traces and evidence, not by gut feel

**Context Engineering**

* Deliberate management of what enters the model on each turn, and why
* Memory strategy: what persists across steps, across sessions, and what should not
* Tool surface design: what the agent can reach, how it is scoped, what happens when a tool fails
* Cost and latency as first-class design constraints, not something discovered in the invoice

**Consulting and Client Leadership**

*Equal weight to the engineering. This is a client-facing role in a services business.*

* Carry a market point of view on models, tooling and delivery patterns, and translate it into what it means for a specific client, in their language
* Run discovery workshops, solution reviews and delivery cadences with client teams
* Advise clients on standing up their own AI capability: practice structure, operating model, skills, governance, build versus buy, and adoption across their engineering org
* Shape and defend technical proposals, PoC plans and roadmaps. Own the story end to end
* Translate business problems into architectures for CXO-level stakeholders without hiding behind jargon
* Say no when the answer is no. Tell a client when agents are the wrong tool, and be able to explain why

**Delivery and Architecture**

*The work itself.*

* Own end-to-end delivery of AI-native programs, from architecture through production
* Design multi-agent orchestration using LangGraph, CrewAI or equivalent. Agent topology, tool routing, memory, state, fallback and recovery paths
* Integrate agent systems with enterprise systems of record, not toy datasets
* Build RAG where RAG is the right answer, from chunking through retrieval, re-ranking and evaluation
* Run agentic coding workflows with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or equivalent, and lead projects where AI writes significant portions of the codebase while you guide, review and ship it
* Work with MCP and shared-context tooling. Design what agents are permitted to reach and under what controls
* Bring governance into the design from day one: agent identity, privilege scoping, audit, human-in-the-loop, kill switches
* Contribute to reusable frameworks and accelerators the wider practice can use

**Team and Practice**

* Build AI engineering capability across the delivery organisation through mentoring, standards and review quality
* Evaluate new models, frameworks and tooling before the hype catches up, and kill the ones that do not earn their place
* Contribute to internal knowledge bases and practice assets

title: Lead Data Warehouse Engineer
description:
FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures. FairMoney maintains a strong international presence, with offices in several countries, including France, Nigeria, Germany, Latvia, the UK, Türkiye, and India.
  
  
In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point-of-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices. Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state-of-the-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents.

To gain deeper insights into FairMoney's pivotal role in reshaping Africa's financial landscape, we invite you to watch this informative video.

We are looking for a
**Lead Data Warehouse Engineer**
to own FairMoney's data warehouse and lead the team that builds it. You will set the architecture, the modelling and quality standards, and the delivery roadmap for the data our lending, banking, risk and finance teams depend on. You will stay hands-on in architecture, design reviews and critical models while you lead and grow a team of data engineers.

1.
**Data Platform and Architecture**

* Own the architecture of the cloud data warehouse, from ingestion to the published datasets used by analysts, BI tools and downstream systems.
* Lead the modernisation of the data platform, including the move to CDC and streaming ingestion.
* Decide which layer each piece of business logic belongs in, and keep published datasets stable for the teams that use them.
* Manage compute and storage cost and deliver measurable efficiency gains.

2.
**Data Modelling and Engineering Standards**

* Set and enforce standards for data modelling, transformation patterns, testing, documentation and code review.
* Build data quality and observability practices that catch issues before consumers find them. ●
* Run a clear change process, with design review, QC evidence and peer review, before changes reach production.
* Drive automation and CI/CD across the data stack.

3.
**Reliability and Operations**

* Own freshness, accuracy and availability SLAs for business-critical datasets, and the on-call and incident response behind them
* Guide the team through complex issues in distributed data pipelines.

4.
**Team Leadership**

* Lead, hire, coach and grow a team of data engineers
* Set the team's working rhythm: intake and triage, sprint planning, design reviews and stakeholder reporting.

5.
**Stakeholder Partnership**

* Be the main engineering partner to business, product, risk and finance leaders.
* Turn business requirements into reliable data products, explain trade-offs clearly and deliver on predictable timelines
* Make sure data handling meets financial regulatory, governance and security requirements.

6.
**AI and Self-Serve**

* Prepare the warehouse for AI use cases with documented models, consistent metric definitions and a semantic layer.
* Bring AI-assisted engineering and analytics into the team's daily work.

**Requirements**

**Must-Haves**

* 10+ years in data engineering, data warehousing or analytics engineering, including 3+ years directly managing engineers.
* Expert SQL and strong Python.
* Deep data modelling experience: dimensional modelling, slowly changing dimensions, and incremental and idempotent transformations.
* Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift.
* Production experience with dbt and a workflow orchestrator such as Airflow.
* End-to-end ownership of business-critical datasets, with accountability for freshness, correctness and SLAs
* Experience in fintech, banking or financial services.
* A record of hiring, retaining and growing strong engineers.
* Strong stakeholder management, including the ability to say no and explain why

**Nice-To-Haves**

* Experience working with Google Cloud Platform
* Experience working with CDC or streaming ingestion (Kafka, Debezium or similar)
* Experience with data governance, data contracts and lineage
* Indepth knowledge on data quality and observability tooling
* Semantic layers and GenAI / LLM tooling on structured data
* Leading teams across time zones

**Benefits**

* Training & Development

* Performance Bonus

**Recruitment Process**

* A screening call with the Recruiter for 30 minutes
* Technical interview with the Hiring Manager for 45 minutes

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Delhi
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**
Experience: 4-6 Years
  
  
**About the Company:**
Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic
* Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems
* AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows
* System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines
* Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence
* Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews

**What We Look For**

* Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus)
* Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work
* Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT)
* Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets
* Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms
* Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona)
* Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

title: Senior Engineer
description:
WorldQuant develops and deploys systematic financial strategies across a broad range of asset classes and global markets. We seek to produce high-quality predictive signals (alphas) through our proprietary research platform to employ financial strategies focused on market inefficiencies. Our teams work collaboratively to drive the production of alphas and financial strategies – the foundation of a balanced, global investment platform.
  
  
WorldQuant is built on a culture that pairs academic sensibility with accountability for results. Employees are encouraged to think openly about problems, balancing intellectualism and practicality. Excellent ideas come from anyone, anywhere. Employees are encouraged to challenge conventional thinking and possess an attitude of continuous improvement.
  
  
Our goal is to hire the best and the brightest. We value intellectual horsepower first and foremost, and people who demonstrate an outstanding talent. There is no roadmap to future success, so we need people who can help us build it.
  
  
Technologists on this team research, design, code, test, and deploy solutions that enable the firm’s front-office quant teams to make effective use of the our framework. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with researchers, embedded technology teams, and platform stakeholders to build scalable tools, APIs, services, and workflows that improve adoption and support the continued evolution of the firm’s ecosystem. title: Senior Data Engineering Manager - T&T
description:
You may know McCormick as a leader in herbs, spices, seasonings, and condiments – and we’re only getting started. At McCormick, we’re always looking for new people to bring their unique flavor to our team.
  
  
McCormick employees – all 14,000 of us across the world – are what makes this company a great place to work.
  
  
**Position Summary**
As a Data Engineering Manager at McCormick, you will play a pivotal role in the build and delivery of data products from simple to complex and supporting McCormick business units with their data and analytics needs.
  
  
Your responsibilities will include leading a team that delivers and supports data for existing analytics solutions, tooling, and solutions, researching new features and implementing automations. You will support business users, Data Scientists and Data Analysts to convert business expectations into data products and data models usable by business to deliver AI, analysis, reporting, and data-driven recommendations to stakeholders and executives.
  
  
This role will be accountable for building and maintaining scalable data pipelines from source systems. The Data Engineering Manager will ensure the availability, reliability, and performance of data products by integrating raw data from various sources. Key responsibilities include data modeling, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) development, and ensuring data quality and security. This role will be accountable for data coming in from 5+ source systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Plan and Design**

* Collaborate with data product managers to gather data product requirements.
* Design end-to-end solutions including data security, data quality and performance requirements.
* Prepare documentation and with data product managers to define the implementation plan.

**Data Extraction, Load and Transformation**

* Implement ELT pipelines to efficiently ingest and transform data from a wide variety of data sources and deliver datasets that meet business requirements.
* Ensure efficient and reliable data mapping to support business needs.
* Deliver complete documentation and knowledge transfer sessions for the Team and business partners.
* Maintain existing solutions, implement optimizations and enhancements, monitor data quality.
* Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines leveraging Azure Synapse, PySpark, APIs, and SQL & performing advanced data cleaning, transformation, and manipulation to ensure high-quality, and reliable data flows.

**Process Improvement, Performance and Cost optimization tuning**

* Collaborate with Data Science, Machine Learning and Business Analytics teams to optimize performance and cost effectiveness of their analytics solutions.
* Identify and design internal process improvements, including automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, and redesigning solutions for enhanced scalability. Work with Azure Analytics Product Owner to prioritize and schedule implementation.
* Design and implement existing solution adjustments to improve performance and cost-effectiveness.
* Suggest and introduce best practices for Data and AI engineering.

**Issue Resolution and Support**

* Assist stakeholders with data-related technical issues and support their data needs. Work with the Analytics Operational Support team to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve data errors / discrepancies.
* Provide expert-level support and guidance to data teams across the Enterprise.

**People Leadership & Capability Building**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of 8-10 data engineers.
* Define technical standards, code review practices, and engineering excellence frameworks.
* Build career paths, upskilling programs, and succession plans within data engineering.
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Be accountable for building a winning data engineering team – driven by making data a core asset for McCormick.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics/Science, or related field; Masters in technical field or MBA a plus
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer (DP203+AZ305)
* or Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate or related cloud technologies, Fabric IQ/databricks certifications a plus
* 12+ years of data engineering experience.
* Demonstrated ability coding in one or more languages (PySpark preferred).
* Experience with data visualization software (Power BI preferred).
* Experience with building data pipelines.
* Experience with knowledge graphs.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Knowledge of data analysis, visualization techniques, and frameworks.
* Experience performing root cause analysis on internal and external data and processes to answer specific business questions and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Experience with the following tooling:
* SQL, Fabric, Databricks, Synapse, Azure Data Factory, Azure ML, Azure DevOps (for CI/CD),
* OR
* GCP BigQuery, FiveTran, GCP Cloud Composer, GCP DLP (Data Loss Prevention), GCP Cloud Run, Vertex AI etc

At McCormick, we have over a 100-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value
