15 years full time education
  
  
**Role Summary / Description**
AI Powered Tech Talent
  
  
As a Senior Engineer in AI Infrastructure Architecture for Snowflake, you will own significant portions of the end-to-end architecture and engineering of optimized data and AI infrastructure for production machine learning and AI-enabled applications. You will design scalable warehouses, Snowpark workloads, AI-ready data/feature pipelines, model-enablement patterns, automation and operational controls that align with client standards, SLAs, security, compliance and cost-efficiency expectations. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, platform modernization, regulated data workloads, FinOps and production reliability, while mentoring engineers and partnering with architects to translate business requirements into robust Snowflake-based AI infrastructure solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Own end-to-end architecture and design of optimized Snowflake data and AI infrastructure, including warehouses, Snowpark workloads, secure data architecture, AI-ready feature/data pipelines, model integration and AI application enablement.
  
  
Design and tune scalable Snowflake warehouses, tasks, streams, Snowpark services, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streamlit applications and cloud integrations, including compute sizing, query optimization, governance, access controls and high-throughput data access design.
  
  
Serve as an authoritative AI infrastructure expert on Snowflake, applying deep knowledge of Snowflake Data Cloud capabilities, data/AI application patterns, governance, security and cost levers.
  
  
Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security, compliance, cost and operational complexity.
  
  
Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation actions.
  
  
Drive architecture decision-making by documenting rationale, trade-offs, assumptions and dependencies so decisions are transparent, defensible and aligned with business SLAs and standards.
  
  
Define and maintain AI infrastructure roadmap inputs, capacity planning models, scaling strategies, cost forecasts and performance improvement opportunities.
  
  
Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization.
  
  
Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards.
  
  
Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with business outcomes and translate requirements into actionable architecture standards.
  
  
Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large-scale engineering solutions.
  
  
Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C++, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages.
  
  
Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform-native workflow tooling.
  
  
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced engineering or client delivery environment.
  
  
Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large-scale solutions.
  
  
Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.
  
  
Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns.
  
  
**Required Skills/ Experience**
Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake warehouses, databases, schemas, secure data sharing/access controls, Snowpark, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streams/Tasks, Streamlit and cloud ecosystem integrations.
  
  
Experience architecting scalable data and feature pipelines, AI application integrations, model-enablement patterns, governance, query/warehouse optimization and secure data access.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python, dbt/Terraform, CI/CD, DataOps, MLOps/AI enablement patterns, observability and incident response practices.
  
  
Ability to optimize Snowflake AI infrastructure for performance, cost, scalability, security, reliability and compliance.
  
  
Experience producing architecture decision records, reference implementations, standards, runbooks and reusable platform patterns.
  
  
Good to Have Skills
  
  
Snowflake certifications such as SnowPro Advanced Architect, SnowPro Advanced Data Engineer or related AI/data platform credentials.
  
  
Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail/e-commerce, telecom, manufacturing, energy or public sector environments where data/AI platforms must meet compliance, security, reliability and cost-control requirements.
  
  
Exposure to Snowpark, Cortex/AI features, vector search, retrieval pipelines, feature engineering, model enablement and AI application architecture.
  
  
Knowledge of Snowflake governance, secure data sharing, FinOps, infrastructure partner/vendor collaboration and production support operating models.

title: QA Test Engineer
description:
Key Responsibilities

● Test complete customer journeys: Validate registration, OTP, eligibility checks,

loan applications, offer displays, document uploads, KYC, application status, and

disbursement tracking.

● Test websites and mobile apps: Check functionality, usability, responsiveness, and

compatibility across browsers, Android, and iOS devices.

● Validate APIs and integrations: Test requests, responses, data mapping,

authentication, error handling, timeouts, and third-party or lender integrations.

● Create practical test coverage: Prepare test scenarios, test cases, checklists, and test

data from requirements, designs, and business rules.

● Find and track defects: Report bugs with clear reproduction steps, screenshots, logs,

severity, and expected versus actual results. Retest fixes and track issues to closure.

● Verify business rules and data: Check eligibility logic, calculations, customer

records, application statuses, and data consistency across connected systems.

● Run regression and release testing: Verify that new changes work correctly and

existing features continue to function before each release.

● Build useful automation: Create and maintain automated tests for stable, repetitive,

and critical workflows.

● Check performance and security: Identify slow journeys, access-control gaps,

exposed sensitive information, and other issues requiring developer investigation.

● Collaborate closely: Work with product owners, designers, developers, and business

teams to clarify requirements and resolve issues early.

What We Expect From You

● Take ownership of testing from requirement review through release verification.

● Think beyond the happy path—test invalid inputs, interrupted journeys, duplicate

submissions, failed APIs, and recovery scenarios.

● Understand how a defect affects the customer, business operations, and data accuracy.

● Communicate release readiness clearly, including unresolved defects and their impact.

● Prioritise critical issues and maintain quality while working towards delivery deadlines.

● Suggest improvements that make our products simpler, more dependable, and easier to

test.

Knowledge and Skills Required

● Strong understanding of manual testing, the software development lifecycle, and the

defect lifecycle.

● Practical knowledge of functional, integration, regression, smoke, exploratory, and user

acceptance testing.

● Experience testing web applications and Android/iOS mobile apps.

● Working knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP status codes, JSON, and Postman or

similar tools.

● Ability to use SQL to validate records and investigate data discrepancies.

● Familiarity with browser developer tools, application logs, and bug-tracking tools such as

Jira.

● Understanding of test automation using tools such as Playwright, Selenium,

Cypress, or Appium, with relevant scripting knowledge.

● Awareness of authentication, authorisation, session management, sensitive-data

handling, and basic application security.

● Strong attention to detail, logical thinking, clear documentation, and confident

communication with developers and business teams.

Good to Have

● Experience with fintech, lending, banking, CRM, or loan management systems.

● Exposure to lender APIs, KYC, credit bureau integrations, payments, or loan application

workflows.

● Familiarity with performance testing tools such as JMeter and automated testing within

CI/CD pipelines.

* Technical Skills: Hands-on experience with Planning modules, business rules, forms, task lists, and reports.

title: Team Assistant
description:
**Job Description**
This role is part of the Independent Compliance Testing (ICT) team within the second-line Global Risk and Compliance (GRC) function. The ICT team conducts risk-based compliance testing across American Express products and portfolio segments to assess adherence to applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies.
  
  
This position is responsible for fulfilling ICT data requests in accordance with the annual periodic ICT testing plan, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of data required for AML, sanctions, and other compliance reviews. The successful candidate will support recurring and ad hoc regulatory requests by sourcing, validating, and delivering data to regulatory, audit, risk, and compliance stakeholders. In order to ensure data quality, this position will partner with compliance, risk, technology, and business teams to provide proper lineage, governance, and traceability of data with approvals from relevant data stewards and custodians.
  
  
The Global Risk & Compliance (GRC) organization serves as American Express’ independent risk management function. GRC maintains the enterprise risk framework, provides oversight and challenge, and monitors key risks. By embedding risk discipline into strategy and operations, GRC enables responsible growth, innovation, and long-term value creation while protecting customers and shareholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Working with business partners to identify and evaluate means of new system-assisted testing for ICT reviews
* Maintain necessary records and files to assure efficient and consistent reporting of compliance efforts.
* Collaborating with risk, compliance, and business partners across multiple groups to ensure adherence to Bank policy and banking laws and regulations.

**Qualifications**

* The qualified individual will have minimum 3-4 years of experience
* Demonstrated proficiency using SQL, a variety of databases, and comfort and ease in accurately manipulating large datasets
* Proficiency Python, Jupyter notebooks, Google Big Query, and AI Language models such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot.
* Strong analytical skills, with a track record of driving results and problem solving.
* Excellent organization, prioritization and collaboration skills are a must.
* The candidate should be a highly motivated self-starter able to operate on multiple fronts with careful attention to detail
* Undergraduate Degree in a quantitative field or equivalent work experience is required.
* Be self-motivated, dependable, adaptable and detail oriented with a proven ability to work independently or within a team environment as required
* Have a demonstrated ability to think conceptually, using strong analytical skills
* Be able to explore and deduce comprehension of new unfamiliar datasets, and generate regulatory insights and patterns from big data.
* Possess a strong understanding of bank systems and processes; banking products, strong computer knowledge; excellent MS 365 skills
* Experience with machine learning algorithms preferred
* Shift timings would be 9:00am - 6:00pm but based on the business requirements candidate can be asked to work in 1:00pm - 10:00pm shift as well. Therefore, candidate must be flexible with the timings.

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. description:

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.

  
  

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

  
  

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

  
  

**About the Role**

  

We are hiring a GTM Engineer to own our lead and account data pipeline end to end, keep our email sending infrastructure healthy, and build scalable GTM workflows. This person will ensure our CRM and outbound systems run on clean, enriched, deduped, and usable data, while building automations in n8n and Clay, and using tools like HubSpot, Apollo, Cognism, Lemlist, NeverBounce, and Bright Data.

  

This role is a mix of data hygiene, GTM engineering, email deliverability and domain management, and scraping and enrichment operations.

  

**Responsibilities**

  
* Own CRM data hygiene and maintain high-quality contact and account data
  
* Audit and optimise CRM properties, lifecycle stages, and deduplication processes
  
* Build and maintain scalable enrichment workflows in Clay
  
* Run enrichment waterfalls (email, phone, LinkedIn, firmographics)
  
* Manage scraping workflows using Bright Data and Apollo exports
  
* Prepare outbound lists and ensure they are campaign-ready with low bounce rates
  
* Reduce duplicate and stale records across CRM and data sources
  
* Implement and manage email validation workflows
  
* Maintain reporting on list health, data completeness, and coverage metrics
  
* Document workflows and create repeatable, scalable processes
  
* Run light scripts or technical executions where needed
  
  

**Requirements**

  
* 3+ years in RevOps/Sales Ops/GTM Ops/Data Ops
  
* Strong hands-on HubSpot CRM
  
* Strong hands-on n8n
  
* Strong hands-on Clay
  
* Experience with data enrichment tools (Lusha, Apollo, etc.)
  
* Experience with Smartlead
  
* Understanding of email deliverability (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warm-up)
  
* Ability to troubleshoot automation workflows and light scripting
  
  

**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Bounce rate consistently under target (for example, under 2%)
  
* Domain and inbox health stable, with no deliverability incidents (blacklisting, spam flags)
  
* CRM data completeness improved (email, LinkedIn, and firmographics)
  
* Reduced duplicates and stale records
  
* Reliable, repeatable n8n and Clay workflows for list building, enrichment, and segmentation
  
* Faster turnaround time on outbound ready lists
  
  

  
**Benefits**

  
* Fixed Shifts: 12:00 PM - 9:30 PM IST (Summer) | 1:00 PM - 10:30 PM IST (Winter)

* Day 1 Benefits: Laptop and full medical insurance provided
  
* Support That Matters:Mentorship, community, and forums where ideas are shared
  
* True Belonging: A long-term career where your contributions are valued

title: Senior IT Pillar Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Overview:**
The JDE Technical Specialist designs, develops, supports and improves technical solutions within JD Edwards EnterpriseOne. The role delivers reliable applications, reports, batch processes, integrations, orchestrations and data solutions while protecting production stability, security and auditability. Working closely with JDE functional consultants, business teams, CNC administrators, database specialists and external partners, the specialist converts functional requirements into maintainable technical solutions and provides advanced production support.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, unit test, deploy and support JD Edwards EnterpriseOne custom applications, reports, batch applications, business functions and integrations.
* Work with functional consultants and business stakeholders to review requirements, identify standard capabilities, estimate effort and produce technical designs.
* Develop and maintain objects using the JDE EnterpriseOne toolset, including Object Management Workbench, FDA, RDA, NER, business functions, data structures, tables, views and processing options.
* Build and support integrations using Orchestrator, REST or SOAP services, Business Services, EDI, flat files, database interfaces, middleware and scheduled jobs as applicable.
* Investigate complex production incidents involving application logic, batch processing, data integrity, interfaces, performance or environment-specific behavior.
* Perform root-cause analysis and deliver sustainable corrective actions rather than repeated data fixes or manual workarounds.
* Create technical specifications, object inventories, deployment instructions, rollback plans, unit-test evidence, support documentation and knowledge articles.
* Follow Object Management Workbench, package, promotion and change-management standards across development, test and production environments.
* Partner with CNC and infrastructure teams on package builds, deployments, server processes, logs, kernels, environment issues, tools releases and performance diagnostics.
* Analyze JDE tables and transaction relationships using SQL while following approved access, privacy and production-data controls.
* Review custom code for quality, security, performance, reusability and upgrade compatibility; reduce unnecessary customization where a standard option is viable.
* Support upgrades, tools releases, platform or cloud migrations, environment refreshes, disaster-recovery exercises and cutover activities.
* Monitor recurring failures and technical debt; recommend automation, observability, simplification and modernization opportunities.
* Mentor developers and support analysts, conduct peer reviews and improve shared technical knowledge across the support team.
* Liase with other support leads to troubleshoot integration issues including Boomi Cloud support team and external vendors.
* Oversee the resolution of incidents related to JDE/One World applications, ensuring timely response, escalation, and resolution according to established SLAs / KPIs.
* Lead the change management efforts, including training and communication plans, to ensure smooth adoption of new processes and features.
* Participate and contribute to Audit requirements.

**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications and Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 8+ years of hands-on JD Edwards EnterpriseOne technical development and support experience.
* Strong working knowledge of EnterpriseOne development tools and object types, including OMW, FDA, RDA, NER, business functions, data structures, tables, views, versions and processing options.
* Exposure with JDE on OCI , Windows, Oracle Database environments..
* Experience developing or supporting interfaces, batch applications, reports and custom applications in a production ERP environment.
* Experience with JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Applications 9.2 and current EnterpriseOne Tools releases.
* Hands-on exposure to JDE Orchestrator, AIS, REST services, notifications, form extensions or other extensibility capabilities.
* Experience with Java, C, C++, JavaScript, XML, JSON, web services, SFTP, middleware or enterprise scheduling tools.

title: Cyber Security & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive Cyber Security & Infrastructure Engineer with 1.5 years or more of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, cybersecurity operations, network security, system administration, and security monitoring. The candidate will help maintain a secure and reliable technology environment by implementing security controls, monitoring infrastructure, managing vulnerabilities, and supporting applicable regulatory and audit requirements.

**Key ResponsibilitiesCybersecurity Operations**

* Monitor security alerts, system logs, and suspicious activities to identify potential threats.
* Support vulnerability assessments, penetration testing coordination, and remediation tracking.
* Help protect sensitive customer information, personally identifiable information (PII), and financial data.
* Support endpoint protection (antivirus/EDR), firewall, and intrusion detection/prevention controls.
* Assist with security incident investigation, documentation, escalation, and root cause analysis.
* Support Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls to reduce unauthorized data sharing or transfers.

**IT Infrastructure & Network Security**

* Administer and monitor servers, operating systems, network devices, and cloud infrastructure.
* Support firewall rules, VPNs, access controls, network segmentation, and secure remote access.
* Perform system hardening, security patching, and operating system updates.
* Monitor infrastructure availability, performance, backups, and security configurations.
* Support cloud security and identity/access management in platforms such as Oracle Cloud, AWS, or Azure.
* Assist with backup, disaster recovery (DR), and business continuity (BCP) activities.

**Identity & Access Management**

* Manage user access provisioning, modification, and deactivation based on approved requests.
* Support role-based access control (RBAC), least privilege, and multi-factor authentication (MFA).
* Conduct periodic access reviews and identify inactive, excessive, or privileged access.

**Security Compliance & Audit**

* Support cybersecurity and IT control requirements applicable to an RBI-regulated NBFC.
* Assist with internal/external audits, VAPT, evidence collection, and audit response.
* Maintain asset inventories, access review records, patch reports, incident logs, and security documentation.
* Track audit observations and coordinate timely remediation with relevant teams and vendors.

**Monitoring, Reporting & Incident Response**

* Monitor events using available SIEM, EDR, firewall, and infrastructure monitoring tools.
* Escalate critical security incidents and infrastructure issues promptly.
* Prepare periodic reports on vulnerabilities, patch compliance, access reviews, security alerts, and infrastructure health.
* Coordinate with development, infrastructure, and third-party vendor teams to resolve security issues.

**Required Technical Skills**

* **Networking:** TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, routing, and firewall fundamentals.
* **Operating Systems:** Windows Server and Linux administration.
* **Security Tools:** Exposure to firewalls, antivirus/EDR, vulnerability scanners, and SIEM platforms.
* **Infrastructure:** Server administration, patch management, backup solutions, and basic cloud security.
* **Security Fundamentals:** Vulnerability management, system hardening, access control, incident response, and log analysis.
* **Cloud Platforms:** Basic knowledge of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), AWS, or Microsoft Azure.
* **Scripting:** Basic Python, PowerShell, or Bash scripting is an advantage.
* **Documentation:** Ability to maintain technical documentation, security reports, and audit evidence.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Minimum 1.5 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, IT infrastructure, network administration, or information security operations.
* Certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CCNA, Microsoft Security, or cloud security certifications are preferred, not mandatory.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Understanding of confidentiality and secure handling of customer information.
* Ability to coordinate with internal teams, auditors, and external technology vendors.
* Proactive approach to identifying and resolving security risks.
* Good communication, documentation, and incident reporting skills.

The role involves hands-on management of Microsoft ADCS components such as NDES (SCEP), CEP/CES services, and integration with Active Directory for auto-enrollment and authentication.

* The role involves supporting SSL/TLS certificates across internal and external applications and ensuring adherence to industry standards like X.509 and TLS protocols. Strong troubleshooting skills are required for resolving issues related to certificate enrollment, chain errors, CRL accessibility, and authentication failures.
* The candidate must have good understanding of Active Directory including Group Policy, auto-enrollment configuration, and integration with PKI services for enterprise identity and access management.
* The role includes ensuring PKI high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery by implementing proper backup, restore, and redundancy mechanisms across CA servers and related infrastructure.
* The engineer should work on operational support, monitoring PKI health, performing RCA for incidents, and maintaining documentation for PKI processes and environments.

Optional skills include experience with Linux-based certificate management, OpenSSL tools, cloud PKI platforms (Azure/AWS), and HSM integration for secure key management.

We are seeking an innovative and highly skilled
**Lead Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer**

+ Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure high-quality data acquisition, preprocessing, and augmentation for model training and fine-tuning.
+ Implement data governance and privacy practices in line with organizational policies.

* Innovation and Research:

+ Experiment with new generative AI techniques, such as multimodal AI, reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and active learning.

* Proficiency in Python and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn.

* Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices, such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Docker.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field (Ph.D. preferred).
* 8+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with 2+ years specifically in Generative AI.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in building Conversational AI applications using cloud-based services and in orchestrating AI/ML services for building a complete solution

title: Manager - RevOps & GTM Engineering: 371
description:
**Born in India, Built for the World**

Amagi is an Emmy®-winning, agentic industry cloud platform powering the modern video economy. We help media companies unify streaming and broadcast workflows, modernize operations, and maximize monetization—from live remote production and real-time ad decisioning to automated playout and global content syndication.

Trusted by a majority of the world's top 50 listed media companies, Amagi delivers:

* 9,000+ channels across 300+ content distributors
* 500,000+ hours of content processed
* 26 billion+ monetized ad impressions

﻿﻿﻿

We power marquee brands including CBS, BBC, Warner Bros. Discovery, NBC, NBA, and DAZN—and the world's biggest events: The Olympics, Super Bowl, The Grammys, and the US Presidential Debate.

Amagi is built on the belief that freedom and happiness are essential for people to do their best work. We call it the Amagi Way: a unique DNA of goodness, purpose, and innovation that shapes how we work, the teams we build, and the impact we want to make together. Over the last two decades, it has been the driving force behind how we have redefined the video economy while contributing to the communities around us.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and listed on the BSE and NSE, Amagi is a global team of 1,000+ people spread across offices in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.

To learn more about our impact, we invite you to explore here.

**Work Mode                   : In-Office**

**Location                        : Bengaluru (Bannerghatta Road)**

**Job Profile:**

Amagi is hiring a Marketing Operations Lead to own the systems, data, and automation that power our GTM engine. This is not a traditional MOps seat - it sits at the intersection of marketing operations and GTM engineering. You’ll run the full marketing-ops backbone (campaign ops, lead lifecycle, attribution, database hygiene) while building AI-native automations that eliminate manual work across Sales, Marketing, and RevOps. If you instinctively reach for a Claude + Clay workflow before a spreadsheet, this is your playground - and you’ll own the reporting layer leadership runs on, accountable for turning dashboards into decisions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Marketing Operations Ownership**

Own the marketing-ops backbone: campaign operations, lead lifecycle, scoring/routing, attribution, and database hygiene across the funnel.

Administer HubSpot and Salesforce hands-on — objects, workflows, fields, and integration — keeping Salesforce as the single source of truth.

Drive SLA adherence and clean handoffs between Marketing, BDR/SDR, and Sales.

**AI-Native Automation & GTM Engineering**

Build end-to-end automations using a Claude + Clay combination plus n8n / Make to enrich, research, and act on data with minimal human overhead.

Stand up advanced enrichment and account-intelligence pipelines (ICP matching, contact/title enrichment, ABM, outreach automation).

Proactively identify automation opportunities; ensure workflows are scalable, fail-safe, and maintainable.

**Reporting That Drives Outcomes**

Own reporting and dashboards across HubSpot, Salesforce, and the GTM stack for stakeholders up to leadership.

Translate pipeline, campaign, and funnel data into actionable recommendations — and own the follow-through.

Use SQL (and Python where useful) to extract, transform, and analyze data across systems; run a 30-60-90 reporting cadence.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

Partner with Sales, SalesOps, BDRs, PMM, and Leadership to turn business needs into scalable systems.

Document workflows and data flows, train the team, and support rapid deploy-measure-iterate experiments.

**Skills and Expertise Required:**

AI-native operator: fluent in applying LLMs (Claude in particular) to design and ship real workflows — not just prompt occasionally.

Hands-on, advanced proficiency with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Clay (all must-have).

Proven ability to build automations with Claude + Clay and orchestration tools (n8n / Make); SQL for querying GTM data.

Reporting and dashboarding, with the judgment to turn data into action.

Strong grasp of GTM workflows: lead routing, scoring, ICP matching, ABM automation, attribution, and pipeline hygiene.

**Competencies**

Funnel & lifecycle ownership: govern lead lifecycle and stage definitions (Inquiry → MQL → SQL → Opportunity), scoring models, and routing rules.

Attribution & measurement: stand up and defend a campaign measurement and multi-touch attribution methodology tying activity to pipeline and revenue.

Campaign ops & data governance: own campaign setup, UTM/taxonomy, segmentation, QA, and database health (dedupe, normalization, enrichment, compliance).

Martech stack ownership: administer, evaluate, and rationalize the stack; manage vendors, renewals, integrations, and license/credit utilization.

Planning & stakeholder leadership: partner on target-setting and multi-BU campaign governance; drive cross-functional alignment on process, SLAs, and a single source of truth.

**Good-to-Have**

Python; warehouse / BI exposure (Databricks, Looker / LookML basics).

B2B SaaS GTM experience (post-IPO / high-growth); familiarity with Gong Engage, Outreach, or Swoogo.

**Who You Are**

AI-first by default: you reach for a Claude-powered workflow before a manual process and treat LLMs as core to how you operate.

Hands-on operator: equally at home building enrichment in Clay, configuring Salesforce and HubSpot, and reviewing pipeline with leadership.

A systems thinker with a bias for automation, strong ownership, and a builder’s instinct in high-growth environments.

You flag data-quality issues honestly rather than shipping polished-but-wrong output.

**Life at Amagi:**

Amagi is an equal opportunity employer. Our culture is built around four values that show up in how we work every day.

* **Be Vulnerable, Be You.**
  Authenticity is our baseline.
* **Goodness Wins.**
  We always lead with integrity.
* **Have Fun with Challenges.**
  We see obstacles as opportunities, not roadblocks.
* **Think Macro, Do Micro.**
  We dream big but execute with relentless precision.

﻿

**A Place That Takes Care of You:**

We care about you as a whole person, and our offerings reflect that. You and your loved ones have access to comprehensive health insurance and our Employee Assistance Program, which covers mental health counselling, financial and legal guidance, and diet and nutrition support. Our office spaces are naturally lit and ventilated, with nutritious meals available every day. An on-site gym and wellness rooms are available for you to rejuvenate. We believe good work should transcend building a great product. Our Employee Resource Group gives you a community within the company. Our volunteering programs and community initiatives give you ways to contribute to the world outside of it.

title: Growth Associate (1-3 yrs exp)
description:
At MySivi, we're building India's first AI Tutor that's transforming how people learn spoken English. Our AI provides instant feedback on grammar, pronunciation, and fluency, helping users improve faster than ever before. Today, we've already helped
**2Cr+ users**
, and we're just getting started.

Our goal?
**Scale MySivi to ₹500Cr+ ARR in the next 6-8 months.**
We're looking for someone who wants to build, experiment, fail fast, learn faster, and drive massive growth alongside the founders.

We spend more than ₹20 lakhs per day on user acquisition. But growth isn't just about getting more installs, it's about converting those users into paying customers and building a profitable business.

We're looking for a
**Growth Associate who will own the entire funnel, from acquisition to purchase.**
You'll work closely with performance marketing, product, engineering, and creative teams to identify growth opportunities and turn them into measurable business results.

We've raised minimal funding, don't believe in burning money, and love to operate profitably.

**What will you do?**

🚀
**Own full-funnel growth:**
Take complete ownership of the user journey, from ad impressions and installs to activation, trial starts, purchases, and revenue.

📊
**Find growth opportunities:**
Analyse funnel data, cohort behaviour, CAC, ROAS, conversion rates, and retention to identify the biggest bottlenecks and opportunities.

🎯
**Drive acquisition:**
Work closely with performance marketers to scale Google and Meta campaigns, improve user acquisition efficiency, and attract high-quality users. Experiment on new channels.

🧪
**Run growth experiments:**
Form hypotheses, prioritise experiments, and test new ideas across creatives, onboarding, user activation, trial conversion, paywalls, pricing, and offers.

📱
**Improve product conversion:**
Work closely with product and engineering teams to ship experiments that improve activation, engagement, trial-to-purchase conversion, and revenue.

💰
**Own growth economics:**
Improve purchase revenue and ROAS while balancing acquisition costs, conversion rates, average order value, and retention.

🤝
**Break team silos:**
Bring marketing and product teams together around shared goals, clear metrics, and data-backed decisions. Take ownership of outcomes instead of passing problems between teams.

⚡
**Build a growth engine:**
Establish a systematic process for tracking metrics, running experiments, documenting learnings, and scaling successful initiatives.

**You will be a great fit if you:**

✔️ Have 1-3 years of experience in growth, growth marketing, product growth, or consumer internet businesses.

✔️ Have hands-on experience working across both paid acquisition and post-install conversion funnels.

✔️ Understand CAC, ROAS, LTV, retention, activation, trial-to-purchase conversion, and subscription economics.

✔️ Can independently analyse data, identify bottlenecks, form hypotheses, and turn insights into experiments.

✔️ Have worked closely with product and engineering teams to improve user journeys and conversion rates.

✔️ Take complete ownership of outcomes instead of waiting for instructions or blaming other teams.

✔️ Are comfortable getting your hands dirty: analysing data, building reports, setting up experiments, and following through until results are measured.

✔️ Thrive in a fast-moving startup where speed, execution, and measurable impact matter more than presentations.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience scaling consumer mobile apps with subscription or in-app purchase models.
* Experience with Google UAC (App Campaigns), Meta Ads, and mobile attribution tools such as Adjust or AppsFlyer.
* Experience with WebEngage, Amplitude, GA4, or other analytics and lifecycle marketing tools.
* Experience improving onboarding, activation, paywalls, pricing, and trial-to-paid conversion.
* Strong analytical skills, including SQL or the ability to independently investigate large datasets.
* Experience building growth processes or working across marketing and product teams.

**Why join MySivi?**

* Work directly with the founders on a high-impact business problem.
* Own a critical growth function with direct influence on revenue and profitability.
* Get the freedom to experiment, make decisions, and implement your ideas.
* Work with significant acquisition budgets and a team focused on measurable results.
* Help build a repeatable growth engine that can scale across multiple products.'

**This is not a traditional marketing role.**
We're looking for someone who can connect acquisition, product, and monetisation and take ownership of turning users into paying customers.

Please apply only if you enjoy solving growth problems hands-on, working with data, and taking ownership of business outcomes.

Feel free to send an email at hiring@mysivi.ai with the subject "Growth Associate at MySivi - NAME" if you think you would be an amazing fit. Do mention why you would be an amazing fit. This is the fastest way to get noticed :)

We are fast and will complete the process within few days.

title: Credit Controller
description:
**About The Role**
This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing operations team where your analytical mindset, financial acumen, and collaborative energy will directly contribute to the success of Swiss Re's Direct/Primary insurance business. Based in Bangalore, you'll work across time zones and functions, supporting everything from cash flow management to regulatory reporting — all while building meaningful relationships with stakeholders around the globe.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Timely cash flow management from/to external parties
* Collaborate with external service providers on daily operational activities, ensuring adherence to SLAs and consistently meeting or exceeding KPIs
* Manage stakeholder relationships and deliver global reporting with clarity and precision
* Ensure the effectiveness of audit and quality control frameworks, promoting compliance with the Division's control standards
* Portfolio analysis to Underwriting & Actuary
* Support internal requirements for financial closings and reporting
* Enable Corporate Solutions' regulatory reporting
* Support audit activities by preparing and presenting requested information to auditors in a timely and accurate manner

* Support UAT planning and execution
* Support implementation of regional/global project deployments
* Support the yearly Business Continuity exercise
* Adhoc reporting requirements

**About The Team**
You'll be joining the CorSo Central Operations APAC team — a dynamic group sitting at the core of Swiss Re's Direct/Primary insurance operations across the Asia & Pacific region. Our team plays a vital role in anticipating and managing a wide variety of risks — from natural catastrophes to cybercrime. We combine deep operational expertise with creative thinking and a pioneering spirit to deliver solutions that make a real difference for our clients and the world. You'll work in a truly collaborative, cross-cultural environment where your contributions are valued, your ideas are heard, and your growth is supported.
  
  
**About You**
You are a detail-oriented, analytically minded professional who brings a strong sense of ownership and accountability to everything you do. You thrive in complex, fast-paced environments, communicate with confidence across cultures and seniority levels, and are energized by the challenge of turning data into actionable insights. You bring a collaborative spirit, a customer-first mindset, and the agility to adapt as priorities evolve.
  
  
**We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements**

* University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field
* Complete understanding of accounting concepts and financial reporting
* Strong data analytics capabilities with hands-on proficiency in tools such as Excel, Power BI, Python, or equivalent platforms
* Excellent business communication and cross-cultural skills, both verbal and written
* Ability to adapt and learn in a multifaceted environment by demonstrating a strong team player skill sets
* Strong attention to detail and willingness to work with data, trackers, and reports
* Ability to follow instructions, ask questions, and learn structured processes
* Good ownership mindset, learning agility, and ability to manage assigned tasks within timelines
* Interest in finance operations, insurance/reinsurance, credit control, or business operations

**Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.**
**About Swiss Re**
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
  
  
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
  
  
If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

title: Senior Financial Analyst_OPEX
description:
**Work Location: Bengaluru**

**Short Description:**

Oracle’s Finance organization supports financial planning, performance management, and business decision-making through financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting. The CGOT team delivers centralized finance support to CSS through OPEX planning, forecasting, reporting, and business partnering.

The Specialist Financial Analyst (IC3) is a high-impact individual contributor responsible for end-to-end ownership of Operating Expense forecasting and management for assigned Lines of Business (LOBs) and regions.

**Job Title: Specialist Financial Analyst – Central Global Opex management Team (IC3)**

**Role Summary**

The Specialist Financial Analyst (IC3) is a high-impact individual contributor responsible for end-to-end ownership of Operating Expense forecasting and management for assigned Lines of Business (LOBs) and regions.

This role drives forecasting accuracy, leveraging automation and strategic insights through advanced use of Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) systems, analytics and AI-driven tools. The individual acts as a trusted finance partner to business stakeholders and plays a key role in improving forecasting accuracy and operational efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Forecasting & Financial Ownership**

Own OPEX forecasting process for assigned LOBs/regions.

Develop accurate run-rate models and driver-based forecasts.

Lead annual budget cycles.

Analyze variances vs Forecast and Prior Year

Provide actionable insights to business leaders.

**2. Business Partnering**

Partner with business leaders to understand cost drivers and strategic initiatives.

Challenge assumptions constructively and provide financial guidance

Translate financial data into business language for decision-making.

**3. Automation & Process Excellence**

Leverage automation tools to streamline forecasting processes.

Drive standardization across LOBs/regions.

Identify efficiency opportunities and eliminate manual work.

Support continuous improvement initiatives across the OPEX function.

**4. Analytics & AI Enablement**

Utilize advanced analytics to detect trends, anomalies, and risk areas.

Leverage AI-powered forecasting tools to improve accuracy.

Support predictive modeling and scenario planning.

**Required Technical Skills**

1. **Financial & Analytical Skills**

Strong understanding of FP&A principles and OPEX management

Advanced variance analysis and driver-based forecasting

Scenario modeling and sensitivity analysis

Strong Excel skills (advanced formulas, pivot tables, modeling)

1. **Systems Expertise**

Hands-on experience with Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) tools

Oracle EPM / Hyperion / Planning

Experience with Business Intelligence & Analytics tools - Power BI / Tableau / similar

Familiarity with AI-driven forecasting or predictive analytics tools

**Behavioral & Personality Traits**

We are looking for someone who demonstrates:

1. **Ownership Mindset**
2. **Analytical Curiosity**
3. **Structured & Detail-Oriented**
4. **Influencing & Communication Skills**
5. **Continuous Improvement Orientation**
6. **Collaborative & Supportive**

Takes full accountability for numbers

Proactively identifies risks and proposes solutions

Naturally questions trends and anomalies

Goes beyond reporting to uncover insights

High accuracy in financial analysis

Strong discipline in data validation

Confident in engaging with senior stakeholders

Ability to simplify complex financial topics

Passionate about automation and efficiency

Embraces technology and AI adoption

Works effectively in cross-functional teams

Shares knowledge and best practices

**Experience & Qualifications**

1. 6–9 years of experience in FP&A or OPEX management
2. Experience in a multinational / matrixed organization preferred
3. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field
4. MBA / CA / CPA (preferred but not mandatory)

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

1. High forecast accuracy and reduced variance volatility
2. Increased automation and reduced manual effort
3. Strong stakeholder confidence and trust
4. Improved transparency through dashboards and analytics
5. Active contribution to AI-enabled forecasting maturity #LI-DNI

**Responsibilities**

As a member of Oracle's finance organization, you will be responsible for providing all aspects of financial support for planning and control. Assist in consolidation and reporting of financial results; preparation of annual budget. Gather, model, analyze, prepare, and summarize information for financial plans, operating forecasts, trended future specifications, etc.; on a weekly, monthly, or quarterly basis. Prepares recommendations based on analyzes. May perform revenue and expense analysis, headcount and headcount driven expense analysis at cost center level, tracking of product and product line revenue, reconciliation of accounts receivable, variance analysis and ad-hoc analysis as needed. You may participate in cross functional programs and projects.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer III, RISC - Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)
description:
**Description**
Are you passionate about transforming complex data challenges into scalable analytics solutions that drive business strategy at Amazon scale? If so, we'd like to talk to you.
  
  
As a Business Intelligence Engineer on the WW EPR team, you will own the design, build, and scaling of data infrastructure and BI solutions that power our Worldwide EPR compliance and circularity programs. You will tackle complex, ambiguous problems with high autonomy — building data solutions that inform cross-functional decisions across multiple teams and regions. You will define the team's BI architecture strategy, leverage emerging technologies including Generative AI, and drive innovation in regulatory intelligence, reporting, and cost optimization across global markets.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Data Architecture & BI Solutions
  
  

* Lead design and delivery of BI solutions spanning EPR compliance, recycling fee analytics, regulatory tracking, and circular economy metrics across worldwide jurisdictions (NA, EU, APAC, emerging markets)
* Define the team's BI architecture strategy — ensuring pipelines, models, and reporting are scalable, extensible, and aligned with organizational standards
* Architect end-to-end solutions: ETL/ELT pipelines, dimensional models, and self-service analytics enabling real-time decision support across geographies
* Harmonize multi-jurisdictional regulatory data — normalizing diverse reporting requirements, fee structures, and compliance timelines across global EPR regimes
* Proactively resolve architecture deficiencies; drive simplification and cross-team integration

Advanced Analytics & Decision Support
  
  

* Build automated frameworks that surface cost-saving opportunities within EPR fee structures, eco-modulation incentives, and take-back economics globally
* Integrate EPR cost signals into upstream business decisions — enabling retail and Selling Partner teams to assess cost impact during product selection, design, and pricing
* Develop statistical models and KPI calibration (anomaly detection, regression, confidence intervals) to monitor compliance health and fee trends across WW programs
* Deliver executive-facing narratives, MBR/QBR inputs, and data-driven recommendations for senior leadership

Generative AI & Automation
  
  

* Leverage GenAI and LLMs to enhance regulatory data extraction, classification, and reporting workflows
* Design AI-augmented solutions (automated regulatory change detection, intelligent fee categorization, natural language querying of compliance datasets)
* Evaluate and implement AI/ML technologies to improve data quality, accelerate insights, and reduce manual overhead

Technical Leadership & Mentorship
  
  

* Set engineering standards, drive code quality, conduct design reviews, and establish operational excellence best practices for the EPR BI function
* Mentor BIE I/II team members; provide technical assessments for promotions and hiring loops
* Influence cross-functional technical decisions by driving BI best practices across partner teams
* Lead the hiring bar for BI roles — recruit, design interview loops, and assess candidates

**About The Team**
Our Worldwide EPR team owns Amazon's global compliance strategy for Extended Producer Responsibility — ensuring adherence to post-consumer waste regulations across packaging, electronics, batteries, and textiles in all operating regions. We enable circular economy value for Selling Partners, Vendors, and customers by connecting every product sold to verified recovery outcomes with auditable results. We work cross-functionally with Legal, Business, Product, and Data Science/Engineering teams across NA, EU, APAC, and emerging markets to deliver compliance programs at scale.
  
  
EPR shifts post-consumer waste management costs from municipalities to producers — requiring all Selling Partners on Amazon's marketplace to register, report product data, pay recycling fees to PROs, and establish take-back systems. This incentivizes environmentally friendly product and packaging design.
  
  
EPR is part of the Regulatory Intelligence, Safety and Compliance (RISC) organization, dedicated to protecting Amazon customers from products that are illegal, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of professional or military experience
* 5+ years of as a Data Analyst, Data Engineer, Business Intelligence Analyst, or a related occupation experience
* 5+ years of SQL experience
* Experience programming to extract, transform and clean large (multi-TB) data sets
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs
* Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
* Experience with theory and practice of information retrieval, data science, machine learning and data mining

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in statistics, data science, or an equivalent quantitative field
* Knowledge of data warehousing and data modeling
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience using Cloud Storage and Computing technologies such as AWS Redshift, S3, Hadoop, etc.

title: Enterprise Systems Analyst, Advisor
description:
**Overview**
At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.
  
  
Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.
  
  
You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.
  
  
Come make an impact every day at Zebra.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**
This role is responsible for the leadership, design, implementation, and ongoing support of Zebra's Customer Master Data Management (CMDM) ecosystem and its connected Salesforce (SFDC) platform. The ideal candidate will serve as a subject matter expert across the CMDM agile delivery track, Salesforce development and implementation, and the integration landscape connecting SFDC with Oracle Commerce Cloud, Siebel, Oracle ERP Cloud, and Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), and will drive the adoption of AI-based solutions to modernize and automate customer master data processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage the CMDM agile delivery track, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, prioritization, and coordination across business and technical teams.
* Provide expert guidance on Salesforce (SFDC) development, configuration, and implementation, ensuring solutions align with CMDM strategy and enterprise architecture standards.
* Apply deep knowledge of SFDC technologies (Apex, Lightning, Flows, APIs, and the Salesforce data model) to design scalable and maintainable customer data solutions.
* Analyze, design, and implement robust integrations between Salesforce and Oracle Commerce Cloud, Siebel, Oracle ERP Cloud, and Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS).
* Define and govern customer master data standards, including data quality rules, matching/deduplication, survivorship, and stewardship processes within the CMDM platform.
* Identify, evaluate, and implement AI/ML-driven solutions in the CMDM space, such as intelligent data matching, enrichment, anomaly detection, and automation of stewardship tasks.
* Lead requirements gathering, process mapping, solution design, and the creation of functional and technical specifications.
* Coordinate and oversee testing cycles, including analyzing and researching defects and working with business and technical teams to ensure resolution.
* Facilitate activities related to system enhancements, bug fixes, patches, and major upgrades across the CMDM and SFDC landscape.
* Act as a liaison with Salesforce and Oracle support partners by creating and managing service requests and escalations.
* Collaborate closely with the PMO, QA, and Operations teams to ensure successful delivery of CMDM initiatives.

**Qualifications**
**Required Experience & Skills:**

* A Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience is required.
* A minimum of 8-10 years of professional experience, with at least 5 years of hands-on experience in customer master data management and/or Salesforce platforms.
* Proven experience managing an agile delivery track, including backlog and sprint management.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Salesforce development and implementation, including Apex, Lightning, Flows, and the SFDC data model.
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems such as Oracle Commerce Cloud, Siebel, Oracle ERP Cloud, and Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS).
* Solid understanding of customer master data concepts, including data governance, data quality, matching/deduplication, and stewardship.
* Experience designing and implementing AI/ML-based solutions to automate or enhance master data processes.
* Proven experience with 3 to 5 full project lifecycle implementations involving CMDM and/or Salesforce.
* Proactive, self-motivated, and solutions-oriented with the ability to manage multiple tasks and execute effectively under pressure.
* Demonstrates ownership and accountability for deliverables with a strong focus on achieving goals.
* Highly collaborative with strong intellectual curiosity and a forward-thinking mindset.
* Excellent oral, written, and listening skills with the ability to articulate complex information clearly.
* Agile and adaptable, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic, challenging environment and work flexibly with team members across different time zones.

**Preferred Experience & Skills**

* An advanced degree is preferred.
* Salesforce certifications (e.g., Platform Developer, Application Architect, or Data Architect) are highly desirable.
* Experience with Oracle Commerce Cloud, Siebel, and Oracle ERP Cloud implementations is highly desirable.
* Experience applying generative AI or machine learning in a master data or CRM context is a plus.

**Benefits**
We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.
  
  
**Job Posting Statement**
To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.
  
  
**AI Technology Statement**
Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

title: Assistant Manager Controlling
description:
****About SKF****

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com /in

**SKF Purpose Statement**

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

****JOB**
**DESCRIPTION****

**Position Title:**
Assistant Manager – Controlling

**Reports To:**
Deputy General Manager- Controlling Lubrication India

**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**Purpose of the role**

A Finance Controlling role responsible for leading Controlling and Reporting activities to support financial planning, analysis, and decision-making for LLS India. This position serves as a bridge between finance and operations, ensuring that cost optimization initiatives are aligned with business objectives and drive operational efficiency.

**Profile of the job holder/key requirements**

* CA / CA- Inter / ICWA / CMA with 4 to 8 years of post-qualification experience.
* Hands-on experience in Financial Planning and Global reporting
* Strong working experience on MS Office and good understanding of SAP ERP - FICO, Sound knowledge in Power BI .
* Good communication skills, verbal and written
* Strong collaboration with stakeholders across Cross Functional Teams
* Ability to independently handle / manage day-to-day tasks

****Key Responsibilities****

**An individual contributor role to manage day-to-day Controlling and Reporting Responsibilities of all Manufacturing activities in line with India and Corporate (SKF Group) requirements.**

****Controlling Responsibilities****

* Partner with Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Logistic and Operations teams to provide financial insights and recommendations.
* Operating profit analysis for Manufacturing unit which includes material cost variance analysis, plus Fixed and variable cost analysis.
* Primarily responsible for updating standard costs annually in the PC Tool; analyzing the deviations of standard costs, ensure proper evaluation, and timely reporting.
* Assess proposed capital investments by analyzing financial viability, ROI, payback period, and alignment with Business plan . Track expenditure against approved IRE.
* Monitor inventory to identify opportunities for optimization. Analyse slow-moving and obsolete inventories, discards / write-offs; monitor and analyse inventory count results.
* Provide clear insights into various cost drivers and continuously monitor to ensure overall cost is minimized.
* Strong expertise in SAP-ERP (FICO) Product Costing functionalities, including Cost Component Structure, Routing, Costing Variant configuration, Parallel Valuation, and Settlement Structure.
* Carry out cost-level analysis for the manufacturing unit to deliver a comprehensive overview of operations, including tracking actual cost developments at the operational level on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis.
* Actual vs Forecast Analysis showing comparison on month/quarter vs Forecast
* Ensure compliance with SKF financial policies, internal controls and audit plan for the year
* Controlling Governance - Respond to queries from Group and other stakeholders and provide timely and accurate information
* Cost Project Validation & Controls - Streamline activities and work on improvement projects in line with required KPIs

****Accounting And Reporting Responsibilities****

* Costing Power BI Ownership - Support the LLS. Business teams including Factory, in all necessary activities and provide costing related data as required from time to time.
* Financial Reporting - Lead the month-end activities related to financial reviews, accruals and data submission to Finance Accounting teams.
* Data Analysis and Expense Validation - Responsible for driving data validation, timely processing of all Expenses /Purchase requisitions
* Cost Bucketing and Apportionment - Timely and accurate allocation of all costs; Share information to all stakeholders within Business units and factories
* Periodic Reporting - Update specified modules in SKF systems, both monthly and periodic modules as per the India and Group timelines

**Key interfaces**

* Sales & Application Team
* Purchase & Supply Chain Team
* Factory Operations Team
* Controlling India & Global and FOC, Taxation

****About SKF****

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

title: Control Manager - Sr Associate
description:
**Job Description**
As part of RM&C, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks, and using your expert judgement to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo and striving to be best-in-class.
  
  
Within RM&C, Control Management plays a critical role in maintaining a strong and consistent control environment through a joint accountability model that aligns managers with each function and region to mitigate operational risk. This role is focused on Risk Identification and Assessment, Control Design and Evaluation, Issue Management, Control Governance and Reporting, and Automation and Process Improvement.
  
  
This Position Requires a Candidate Who Has Or Will Develop Knowledge And Technical Expertise Related To Implementing And Maintaining a Comprehensive Control Environment, Including Support For Sarbanes Oxley And Comprehensive Capital Analysis And Review Deliverables, And For Delivering Process Automation. With This Expertise You Will Have The Opportunity To
  
  

* Be a part of a diverse and talented team of Control Managers committed to maintaining a comprehensive control environment
* Work on regulatory driven initiatives and deliverables in a global bank that is systemically important to US economy and beyond
* Automate and improve control analyses and reporting by leveraging technical solutions that the Firm has adopted such as Alteryx, Databricks, LLM Suite.

**Key Responsibilities**

* In partnership with stakeholders, evaluate and perform an end-to-end analysis of the business' risk and control environment to identify significant gaps and weaknesses, determine root cause of control breaks, and review actions taken to remediate issues.
* Manage the external financial reporting (e.g., 10-K/Q, FR Y-14) control programs, such as issue management, attestation and control gap analysis by partnering with Risk and Finance stakeholders
* Report the external financial reporting related information to senior management in Risk Control Management organization and support the quarterly 10-K/Q and FR Y-14 senior management attestation processes
* Coordinate the SOX and CCAP compliance programs for Risk Management and Compliance organization and drive the initiatives related to the programs
* Maintain accurate and comprehensive records of internal controls, audits, compliance activities, and risk assessments, confirming proper documentation and easy retrieval.
* Perform ongoing analysis of program related data and develop ad-hoc reports as requested to support business-related programs and strategies.
* Identify opportunities of automating manual processes, implement and maintain these solutions ongoingly

**Minimum Skills, Experience And Qualifications**
We are looking for someone excited to join our organization. If you meet the minimum requirements below, you are encouraged to apply to be considered for this role.
  
  
**Experience**

* Bachelor's degree
* 5 – 7 years of experience in Risk Management, Control Management, Internal Audit, Financial Reporting, Computer Science, or a related field
* Experience with Process Automation / Digital Enablement, specifically with AI/ML based methods.

**Soft Skills**

* Demonstrated ability to work across diverse groups to understand issue drivers and business requirements while collaborating with partners to build consensus and execute the agreed plans
* Highly analytical and inquisitive in nature with a desire to understand the “why”
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple streams of work concurrently in a flexible, fast paced, and exciting environment
* Independent, motivated, detail oriented and robust sense of personal responsibility
* Excellent written and oral communication skills to present analytical findings

**Technical Skills**

* Excellent MS Office skills including Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, etc.
* Technical experience is a huge plus, including knowledge of intelligent solutions, computer programing, LLM prompt engineering
* Control background is a huge plus - knowledge of processes to develop and maintain a strong control environment, including the ability to analyze problems and find solutions

**ABOUT US**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.
  
  
Control Management maintains a strong and consistent control environment through a joint accountability model that aligns managers with each function and region to mitigate operational risk. The team focuses on four areas: Control Design & Expertise, Risks & Controls Identification/Assessment, Issues & Control Deficiencies and Control Governance & Reporting.
