title: Sales Compensation Analyst (Compensation & Payroll Operations)
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
10
  
  
**The Role**
The
**Sales Compensation Analyst (Compensation & Payroll Operations)**
is a critical technical and operational position within the global Sales Compensation team.
  
  
**The Team**
You will join the global Sales Compensation team — a high-impact, technically sophisticated group at the operational heart of S&P Global's commercial engine. Spanning time zones and geographies, we combine enterprise system precision with financial rigor to ensure 1,500+ salespeople worldwide are paid accurately and on time, every single cycle. We are a team that values methodical problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and an unwavering commitment to scalable, auditable, and compliant operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Impact**

* Drive end-to-end commission calculation cycles for 1,500+ global payees across all commercial business units — delivering 100% mathematically precise, on-time payroll files to regional Finance and Payroll teams across the US, EMEA, and APAC.
* Administer and configure the enterprise Xactly platform (Incent, Connect & Analytics) — owning crediting rule setup, tiered accelerator matrices, split-crediting algorithms, batch ETL pipeline monitoring, and participant security profiles that directly reflect published annual compensation plans.
* Execute the full payee lifecycle — from configuring new hire profiles and quota ramp models, to implementing mid-period role transitions, LOA credit adjustments, and producing audit-ready departure settlement calculations.
* Build and optimize advanced SQL queries and Python/Alteryx automation scripts to perform high-volume ledger-to-payout reconciliations, pre-payroll sanity checks, distribution curve analyses, and root-cause remediation of calculation anomalies before file delivery.
* Lead annual platform readiness activities — authoring UAT test scripts, executing calculation logic change validation, managing plan roll-forwards, and maintaining comprehensive SOPs and runbooks that keep operational cycles repeatable and defensible.
* Serve as the frontline operational liaison to the Central Governance & Compliance team — delivering automated calculation logs, approval artifacts, and clear mathematical payout explanations to global sales leaders, managers, and representatives across multiple time zones.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Xactly System Administration & Configuration Management**

* Serve as the core hands-on administrator for Xactly Incent, Xactly Connect, and Xactly Analytics, overseeing rule configurations, crediting logic, participant hierarchies, and payout rate tables.
* Configure and maintain crediting rules, plan logic, tiered accelerator matrices, and split-crediting algorithms inside Xactly to reflect published annual compensation plans.
* Manage batch ETL integrations and data sync pipelines between upstream CRM/data warehouse platforms and Xactly Connect, proactively monitoring API sync jobs and resolving ingestion failures.
* Lead platform readiness for annual plan roll-forwards, plan parameter cutovers, and system testing; author test scripts and perform User Acceptance Testing for calculation logic changes.
* Administer participant security profiles, statement release workflows, and audit tracking within Xactly to ensure strict data privacy and system integrity.

**End-to-End Commission Calculation & Payroll Execution**

* Own and execute the monthly and quarterly commission calculation process across all global commercial business units, ensuring 100% timeliness and mathematical precision.
* Lead high-pressure calculation cycles against strict monthly payroll cutoffs, coordinating data freezes, calculation runs, manual adjustment validations, and final payroll sign-offs.
* Generate, reconcile, and format gross-to-net payroll transmission files, ensuring seamless handoffs to regional Payroll and Finance teams in the US, EMEA, and APAC.
* Perform automated pre-payroll sanity checks, distribution curve analyses, and historical variance spot-checks to catch calculation spikes, zero-payout outliers, and crediting bugs before file delivery.
* Execute calculation reruns, retroactive plan corrections, and adjustment batches within established cutover windows.

**Payee Lifecycle Operational Execution**

* New Hires & Onboarding: Configure new payee profiles in Xactly, assign plan rules, set up draw and guarantee schedules, and apply effective-dated quota ramp models based on start dates.
* Mid-Period Role Changes & Promotions: Implement plan transitions, target prorations, and crediting split adjustments for internal transfers and commercial promotions.
* Leaves of Absence (LOA): Adjust quota relief parameters, freeze crediting timelines, and prorate plan targets according to regional statutory and corporate policy guidelines.
* Departures & Offboarding: Calculate final commission settlements, review trailing pipeline revenues, verify recovery and clawback schedules, and deliver audit-ready exit calculations.
* HRIS-to-Engine Roster Reconciliation: Run scheduled automated reconciliations between Workday/HRIS and Xactly to identify roster deltas, missing employee IDs, and effective-date mismatches before payroll lock.

**Advanced Data Reconciliations, Automation & Quality Assurance**

* Build, maintain, and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, join, and audit high-volume transaction datasets across enterprise databases and calculation engines.
* Develop automated data reconciliation scripts using Python (Pandas), Alteryx, or advanced script-based tools to perform automated ledgers-to-payout reconciliations.
* Identify, isolate, and remediate root causes of data anomalies, including duplicate deal bookings, mismatched currency conversions, orphan transactions, and misaligned territory mapping.
* Maintain comprehensive calculation runbooks, process maps, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure repeatable, documented operational cycles.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance Liaison**

* Partner with regional Payroll teams to investigate post-payroll discrepancies, off-cycle payment adjustments, and tax or deduction inquiries.
* Collaborate with the global Modeling and Strategic Programs analysts to transition new incentive rules and SPIFF structures into scalable Xactly calculation logic.
* Act as the frontline operational execution partner to the dedicated Central Governance & Compliance team, providing automated calculation logs, approval artifacts, and audit evidence for internal and external reviews.
* Provide clear, step-by-step mathematical explanations to sales managers and representatives regarding payout mechanics, adjustment deductions, and statement reporting.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience: 5+ years of technical sales compensation operations, financial systems administration, or payroll calculation experience in a complex, multi-national corporate environment.
* Xactly Platform: Minimum 2 years of hands-on administration and configuration experience with Xactly Incent and Xactly Connect, including crediting rule configuration, plan logic setup, and payout rate table management.
* SQL Proficiency: Demonstrated experience writing complex multi-table JOIN queries, subqueries, indexing, and aggregation scripts to validate high-volume financial transaction datasets.
* Data Automation: Proven experience building automated data validation or reconciliation pipelines using Python (Pandas), Alteryx, or VBA/Power Query in a financial operations context.

**Additional Preferred Qualifications**

* Xactly Certification: Xactly Certified Administrator credential; or equivalent platform certification in Varicent, Anaplan, or SAP Commissions.
* HRIS & CRM: Demonstrated experience using Workday for HRIS roster management and Salesforce for CRM data structures and effective-dating logic in a compensation operations context.
* Advanced Excel: Proven use of dynamic arrays, Power Pivot, nested logic formulas, and complex lookup models for financial reconciliation and compensation modeling.
* Global Payroll Operations: Experience generating, reconciling, and formatting gross-to-net payroll transmission files across multiple regional Finance and Payroll teams.
* Power BI Reporting: Experience reviewing and interpreting Power BI dashboards in a compensation analytics or financial operations environment.
* Audit & Compliance Support: Experience producing calculation logs, change control artifacts, and audit evidence packages for internal or external compliance reviews.
* Stakeholder Communication: Demonstrated ability to communicate complex payout mechanics and calculation adjustments clearly in written and spoken English to international stakeholders across multiple time zones.

title: Program Manager II, Transportation Long Term Capacity Planning
description:
**Description**
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
  
  
We are looking for a good fit to join our Transportation Long Term Capacity Planning Team, part of the larger Supply Chain Team. This team plays a crucial role in strategically planning and executing Amazon's Transportation network topology over a 1-3 year horizon. As a Middle Mile Program Manager, you will be at the forefront of uniting cross-functional teams to evolve our network, continuously optimizing for cost, speed, and reliability while maintaining a strong customer focus.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for developing capacity solutions that address both current and future demands, ensuring business continuity even through peak periods. Your work will directly contribute to our long-term strategy programs, preparing Amazon's logistics network for sustained growth while striking the delicate balance between delivery speed, operational efficiency, and cost-effectiveness.
  
  
You will leverage your expertise in long-term forecasting and capacity planning to make data-driven decisions that shape the future of our Middle Mile operations. This position requires a strategic mindset, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams across the organization. Your insights and recommendations will be instrumental in guiding senior leadership decisions and driving the continuous improvement of our vast logistics network.
  
  
As a key member of this team, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact on Amazon's ability to meet and exceed customer expectations in the years to come, playing a vital role in our mission to be Earth's most customer-centric company.
  
  
You are expected to have exceptional analytical, planning, and written/verbal communication skills. You know and love working with business intelligence tools, are comfortable accessing and working with big data from multiple sources, and are enthusiastic about partnering with the business to deliver results. You are a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, able to think big, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Join our team and help shape the future of Amazon's logistics network, contributing to our mission of becoming Earth's most customer-centric company while balancing delivery speed with efficiency and cost-effectiveness!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead long-term forecasting efforts for the Middle Mile network, focusing on Quarterly Guidance Numbers Validation
* Run and maintain complex forecasting models to predict network capacity requirements 1-3 years in advance
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather data and insights for accurate long-term forecasting
* Analyze historical data, market trends, and business strategies to refine long-term forecasting methodologies
* Present forecasts and recommendations to senior leadership, supporting strategic decision-making
* Oversee the Plan of Record (POR) planning process, ensuring alignment with company objectives and financial targets
* Identify opportunities for network improvements and cost optimizations based on long-term forecasting insights
* Manage a team of analysts, providing guidance and mentorship to enhance forecasting capabilities
* Develop capacity solutions for current and future demands, ensuring business continuity through peak periods
* Contribute to long-term strategy programs that prepare Amazon's logistics for growth, balancing delivery speed with efficiency and cost-effectiveness

**About The Team**
The Long Term Middle and Last Mile Capacity Planning Team strategically plans and executes Transportation network topology over a 1-3 year horizon. We unite teams to evolve the network, optimizing cost, speed, and reliability with customer focus. We develop capacity solutions for current and future demands, ensuring business continuity through peak periods. Our long-term strategy programs prepare Amazon's logistics for growth, balancing delivery speed with efficiency and cost-effectiveness.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

### **Description**

The Support Analyst provides technical support to Infor customers in the United States using Infor Restaurants Point of Sale (POS) products. The role requires strong technical aptitude, excellent verbal and written English communication, strong customer service skills, and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

title: Lead Business Analyst
description:

Location:

**Department:** Customer Engagement Technologies (CET)

**Location:** Bengaluru, India

  

**Your impact begins here**

As Lead Business Analyst, you will be the primary bridge between Commercial, Medical and Customer Engagement stakeholders and IT delivery teams. You will lead requirements management, business process optimisation, solution design and stakeholder alignment, turning business needs into compliant, scalable capabilities across Veeva Vault CRM, Salesforce, marketing automation and connected engagement platforms. Your impact shows up in stronger healthcare professional (HCP) engagement, better field force effectiveness and a sharper customer experience.

  

**What you’ll bring**

You know the pharmaceutical commercial landscape, you are confident in Agile delivery and you enjoy bringing business and IT to a clear, shared answer.

* At least 5 years of hands-on Business Analyst experience in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry, with a track record of delivering technology-enabled business capabilities.
* Strong business acumen across Sales, Medical Affairs, Key Account Management (KAM), Marketing, Compliance and Content Management, and the ability to translate business needs into scalable digital capabilities.
* Strong ability to translate business needs into epics, features, user stories, detailed acceptance criteria, process flows and functional specifications within Agile delivery frameworks.
* Hands-on Agile and hybrid delivery experience, including backlog grooming, release planning, acceptance testing to determine whether it meets its business requirements, user needs, and design specifications before being approved for production deployment or customer handoff and change management.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven ability to engage stakeholders across business and IT, explain technical concepts plainly and build alignment.
* Experience supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect triage, training and business adoption.
* Understanding of pharmaceutical regulatory, validation and data privacy requirements, and a safe, ethical approach to AI.
* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
  

**Useful, but not essential:**

* Hands-on experience with Veeva Vault CRM, Salesforce, marketing automation or similar customer engagement platforms, plus familiarity with data, analytics and system integration landscapes.
  

**What you’ll do**

You will lead requirements and backlog grooming for customer engagement capabilities, working within the governance set by Product Management, Business Owners and Enterprise IT leadership.

* Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and IT delivery teams, leading requirements elicitation and translating needs into clear, testable epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows and functional specifications.
* Define, refine and prioritise the product backlog with Product Owners, and facilitate decisions on scope and priorities so delivery keeps moving.
* Optimise business processes by identifying root causes, risks and dependencies, and recommend solution designs based on business value, feasibility and compliance.
* Ensure traceability from business objectives through design, development, testing and deployment, and govern the quality of requirements throughout.
* Coordinate release planning, testing and UAT with architects, developers and QA, and lead change management, training and adoption so new capabilities are used in real life.
  

**Who you’ll work with**

In Enterprise IT & Quality, colleagues work across the full Novo value chain, staying close to stakeholders in the business and helping deliver high quality, trusted technology and environmentally responsible ways of working.

You will join Customer Engagement Technologies (CET), part of Enterprise IT – Veeva & Ecosystem. CET drives the strategy, development and delivery of connected, data-driven commercial capabilities, partnering with Customer Engagement and Medical stakeholders to orchestrate HCP engagement and support data-informed decisions.

Your closest partners will be Product Managers, Product Owners, Solution Architects, developers, QA and operations teams. You will also work with International Operations affiliates and end users, Global Business Services, Novo management.

These relationships are where the role creates momentum: you bring clarity when priorities compete, speak up when things stall, and help business and IT decide, own it and follow through.

  

**What you can expect here**

You will be trusted to work with a high degree of independence and to make your voice heard in decisions that shape products used across markets. Working across commercial, medical and technology teams, you will broaden your perspective and build new skills on the job and through relevant learning offerings.

As Novo upskills its entire workforce to advance AI as a driver of innovation, you can apply new technology responsibly in your daily work. Expectations are clear, results are recognised and honest feedback helps everyone raise the bar.

  

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn business needs into connected, compliant capabilities that help Novo engage healthcare professionals better, apply for the Lead Business Analyst role by 9 Nov 2026.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

title: Inventory Analyst
description:
**Career Area:**

Supply Chain and Logistics

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Job Summary**

Research, develop, implement and monitor inventory management and distribution logistics systems, concepts and procedures for worldwide parts inventory and operations management.

The primary goal is to support the Product Support & Logistics (PSLD) division’s effort in achieving the inventory and customer service objectives. As an Inventory Analyst, you will have responsibility for ensuring the complete and successful testing and conversion planning of all PIC functions in dealers’ ERP conversion projects, and contribute to design, development, and deployment of the new PIC Data Analytics Suite (DAS).

**What You Will Do**  

* Develop automated processes to aid in data cleansing and maintenance using analytical tools (SQL, SAS, Python, PowerBI).
* Develop and test new reporting tools, following standards and best practices.
* Support 24x7 PIC systems for dealer order recommendations, willing to work in Europe / US time zone.
* Performing work to achieve corporate supply chain performance targets focused on inventory reduction, increased inventory turns and improved parts availability.
* Working effectively with diverse, multi-functional teams to apply the supply chain logistics process and leading team efforts to develop a lean parts distribution network.

**Degree Requirement**  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering / Math’s / Science / Commerce.
* 2 to 3 years’ relevant experience in data analytics and visualization tools.

**What You Have**  
**Business Acumen:** Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations.  
**Level Working Knowledge:**  

* Comments on the organization's business model and financial goals.
* Communicates key considerations for business decision making process.
* Cites examples of types of information needed to make sound business decisions.
* Participates in business task to get things done in own unit or area.
* Caters to key stakeholders and their priorities.

**Standard Operating Procedures:** Knowledge of established standard operating procedures (SOP); ability to design, implement and evaluate standard operating procedures affecting daily and strategic business operations in order to increase operational efficiency.  
**Level Basic Understanding:**  

* Compiles current research relevant to standard operating procedures.
* Explains usage of standard operating procedures in business operations.
* Describes main issues and considerations when using standard operating procedures.
* Identifies key features and functions of standard operating procedures.

**Effective Communications:** Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.  
**Level Working Knowledge:**  

* Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
* Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
* Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
* Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
* Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

**Problem Solving:** Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.  
**Level Working Knowledge:**  

* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
* Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
* Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
* Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

**Data Gathering and Reporting:** Knowledge of tools, techniques and processes for gathering and reporting data; ability to practice them in a particular department or division of a company.  
**Level Working Knowledge:**  

* Detects and summarizes patterns in data and findings by producing simple reports.
* Assesses common problems and obstacles surrounding data-gathering.
* Customizes data fields to meet clients' needs.
* Interprets and explains results of a data-gathering initiative.
* Participates in projects to gather data for needs analysis.

**Data Visualization:** Knowledge of principles, techniques and processes of data visualization; ability to create high quality figures effectively for various business scenarios and storytelling.  
**Level Working Knowledge:**  

* Creates figures for regular data visualization tasks in an honest and compelling way.
* Develops or uses appropriate tools and software, such as Tableau and Data wrapper, to generate different types of data visualization.
* Follows established standards and procedures to obtain, aggregate and analyze data for visualization.
* Outputs statistical models into charts, graphs and maps to demonstrate outliers, patterns and trends of data.
* Employs data visualization in documents or reports to tell informative and compelling stories.

**Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Tools:** Knowledge of electronic data interchange tools; ability to design, implement and maintain tools and facilities in order to establish a computer-to-computer interchange of electronic data among organizations.  
**Level Working Knowledge:**  

* Maps EDI data within appropriate applications; develops and test new maps.
* Assists in the development of tools and techniques for electronic data interchange.
* Adheres to electronic data interchange standards, policies and guidelines.
* Operates main functions of electronic data interchange tools and facilities.
* Compares different applications for use in different electronic data interchange situations.

**Inventory Management - MFG:** Knowledge of processes and methods of inventory management; ability to effectively manage local or distributed inventories of raw materials, work-in-progress and finished goods.  
**Level Working Knowledge:**  

* Follows processes to take stock, release inventory or return into processing; resolves discrepancies.
* Tracks inventory information for a specific product group or location.
* Works with basic tasks of inventory management for a specific location.
* Produces basic inventory management reports for senior staff to reconcile the inventory balances.
* Performs the receiving, ticketing, checking in and distributing of inventory items for a specific location.

title: Financial Business Analyst 01– Order Management / Quote-to-Order
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Business Analyst 1 to support Oracle Health Customer Entitlement Services.

In this role, you will research customer inventories, validate license entitlements, support license migration activities, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure accurate and timely customer entitlement delivery.

You will also analyze operational trends, resolve process-related inquiries, and identify opportunities to simplify workflows and improve efficiency through automation.

This position offers exposure to Oracle's licensing processes, internal business systems, and revenue-related operations.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Customer Entitlement Analysis: Research and validate customer licensing information using Oracle internal applications, including Asset Report, PeopleSoft (HAT), and ROSIE, to maintain accurate entitlement records.

* License Migration Support: Support accurate and timely migration of existing customer licenses in accordance with Oracle policies and established procedures.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Sales, Deal Management, Pricing, Finance, and Data Migration teams to resolve entitlement discrepancies and facilitate efficient order processing.

* Customer Request Management: Understand internal and external customer requirements, prepare accurate entitlement summaries, and deliver requested information within agreed timelines.

* Workflow Coordination: Manage queue workflows and support allocation of requests based on resource capabilities, priorities, and operational requirements.

* Reporting and Analysis: Monitor request volumes, identify trends, and provide operational insights to support management decisions.

* Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce manual effort, and improve operational efficiency through automation.

* Policy Compliance and Knowledge Development: Maintain working knowledge of Oracle policies, internal systems, and related business processes, including pricing, quoting, booking, billing, revenue recognition, and invoicing. Complete required process certifications.

**Qualifications & Skills**
---------------------------

### **Mandatory**

The original JD does not specify education, years of experience, or formal entry qualifications. The following requirements are supported by its stated responsibilities and capabilities.

* Analytical and problem-solving skills: Ability to research information, analyze customer records, identify discrepancies, and develop accurate conclusions.
* Attention to detail: Ability to maintain accuracy when reviewing licensing information, preparing entitlement summaries, and processing requests.
* Communication skills: Ability to understand requester requirements, communicate findings, and respond clearly to process-related inquiries.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple stakeholders to resolve issues and complete operational activities.
* Independent execution: Ability to manage assigned work, investigate issues, and meet timelines with limited direct supervision.
* Process and policy adherence: Ability to learn and apply established business policies, workflows, and quality standards.
* Reporting and analytical reasoning: Ability to analyze operational volumes and trends and communicate insights that support business decisions.

### **Good-to-Have**

These are differentiators aligned with the responsibilities, not confirmed hiring prerequisites.

* Exposure to customer entitlement management, software licensing, or license migration processes.
* Familiarity with enterprise business systems or Oracle applications, such as Asset Report, PeopleSoft (HAT), or ROSIE.
* Understanding of pricing, quoting, booking, billing, revenue recognition, or invoicing processes.
* Experience identifying process improvements, workflow simplification, or automation opportunities.
* Exposure to queue management, operational reporting, or resource allocation workflows.
* Familiarity with sales operations, deal management, finance operations, or customer support processes.

**Self-Assessment Questions**
-----------------------------

* Am I confident researching business records, identifying discrepancies, and producing accurate findings?

* Can I communicate effectively with different stakeholders to understand requests and resolve operational issues?

* Am I comfortable working independently, following established policies, and delivering accurate work within deadlines?

* Can I analyze operational data, identify trends, and communicate useful insights?

* Do I consistently demonstrate attention to detail when handling complex information and business processes?

title: Assistant Vice President - Management Reporting
description:
**Some careers shine brighter than others**
.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**Assistant Vice President - Management Reporting.**
**Purpose of the role**
The role sits within Global Functions and partners closely with the In-country stakeholders to drive cost performance goals across the regional and global teams, including delivery of Group cost saves. It provides end-to-end oversight of cost reporting (Actuals, Forecast, FRP, Budget, Target), governance and execution of boundary changes, and strong control over month-end close and submissions to ensure minimal unreconciled gaps. The role also supporting cost Optimisation initiatives, resolving system/reporting issues in collaboration with other relevant Finance/Systems teams, and delivering ad-hoc analysis for Functional CFOs and senior leadership, including value-hunting and automation/streamlining projects
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Drive cost performance tracking and reporting across Global Business / Global Functions (GB/GI) for Actuals, Forecast, FRP, Budget, Target and savings delivery.
* Perform monthly Ledger reviews, highlighting key movements and tracking performance vs Budget/Forecast; flag WD2/WD3 anomalies across other GB/GIs for timely correction.
* Monitor budget compliance for retained costs across GB/GIs and provide clear MI and insights on variances and trends. Own end-to-end compliance with Cost Policies and partner with GB/GI leads to ensure adherence to policy requirements.
* Liaise with Group Tax and the Financial Controllers team to resolve queries and investigate cost movements vs forecast. Lead FRP/budget reviews across GB/GIs, including preparation of budget templates and support for TM1 uploads; obtain post-cycle confirmations.
* Manage internal, assurance and external audits relating to Controls for Policy, ensuring controls are evidenced and kept current in the system. Identify system/process issues impacting Group cost reporting and drive resolution, ensuring minimal unreconciled gaps.
* Lead the team to ensure ongoing service delivery, stakeholder communication, and continuous improvement.
* Leverage AI and automation tools to streamline cost data collection, validation and reporting, improving accuracy, timeliness and transparency
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring processes and develop insightful dashboards that support effective cost control and decision-making. Collaborate with Finance and technology teams to implement scalable solutions while maintaining appropriate data governance and controls.
* Support ad-hoc projects for Functional CFOs/senior leadership, including cost optimisation deep-dives, digital analytics/value-hunting, and automation/streamlining initiatives.

**To Be Successful You Will**

* Have 13+ years’ experience (BCom/MCom/ CA-Inter/CWA-Inter/ CA/CWA/MBA) in Finance, Cost reporting, performance management and/or finance controlling.
* Demonstrate strong TM1 proficiency and experience supporting FRP/budget/forecast cycles and month-end close deliverables.
* Proficiency in excel, experience with Power BI, familiarity with AI and automation technologies, ability to transform complex data into clear insights.
* Show strong understanding of accrual processes to ensure costs are recorded in the correct financial year and appropriately analysed.
* Have working knowledge of General Ledger to identify, analyse and explain cost and accrual postings.
* Apply cost-driver level variance analysis (vs Forecast & trends) to flag anomalies, estimate year-end outcomes, and support cost optimization decisions.
* Partner effectively with relevant Finance Teams to minimize reconciliations and ensure submission integrity.
* Demonstrate strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including confidence engaging senior leadership and handling policy/control discussions (retained cost methodology, intercompany charging, recoveries).

title: PMS Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION – PMS ENGINEER**

**Role - Executive PMS Engineer**

Location - Chennai, Tamil Nadu (Work from Office)

**Shift: 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM**

**Job Summary**

The PMS Engineer is responsible for developing, maintaining, standardizing, and optimizing Planned Maintenance System (PMS) databases across the managed fleet. The role involves maintaining vessel machinery and equipment structures, maintenance job plans, spare parts, running-hour counters, and compliance-related maintenance requirements. The PMS Engineer will work closely with technical teams, vessel personnel, internal stakeholders, and software providers to ensure data accuracy, regulatory readiness, consistent fleet standards, and effective technical reporting.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. PMS Database Management & Data Quality Assurance**

* Build, update, and maintain vessel equipment hierarchies using SFI coding and company-defined standards.
* Develop and maintain PMS databases for new vessel takeovers, existing fleet vessels, fleet acquisitions, and system migrations.
* Review machinery and equipment details, including maker, model, specifications, component relationships, and associated records.
* Configure and update maintenance job plans, including job descriptions, calendar-based and running-hour intervals, and work instructions.
* Incorporate maker-recommended jobs, company-standard maintenance jobs, compliance jobs, and spare parts into the PMS database.
* Validate PMS data against maker manuals, machinery particulars, equipment lists, drawings, and other technical documents.
* Identify and resolve missing, duplicate, incorrect, or inconsistent components, jobs, spare parts, and counters.
* Support data migration, reconciliation, and validation between PMS platforms while preserving available historical maintenance records.
* Maintain standardized naming conventions, data-entry protocols, version control, and records of database changes.

**2. Maintenance Optimization & Compliance Monitoring**

* Ensure PMS maintenance jobs are aligned with maker recommendations, company SMS requirements, applicable statutory requirements, and class survey schedules.
* Verify that safety-critical, compliance-critical, and business-sensitive equipment is correctly classified and mapped in the PMS.
* Monitor maintenance intervals, running-hour counters, overdue jobs, and other compliance-related parameters.
* Review PMS data and maintenance records to identify gaps that may affect inspections, audits, vetting, or vessel maintenance.
* Support corrective and preventive actions arising from PMS reviews, vessel inspections, audits, and vetting observations.
* Assist with PMS-related requirements under ISM, SIRE, CDI, and TMSA, including relevant maintenance-management and data-governance activities.

**3. Reporting, Data Analysis & Inventory Control**

* Prepare reports on PMS database status, data quality, overdue maintenance, compliance gaps, and implementation progress.
* Use Microsoft Excel formulas, lookup functions, data-cleaning techniques, PivotTables, conditional formatting, and charts to generate reports.
* Develop and maintain reusable Excel templates and dashboards for recurring PMS reporting requirements.
* Review spare-parts mapping and identify discrepancies between equipment records, PMS data, and available inventory information.
* Analyze PMS datasets to identify recurring errors, data inconsistencies, and opportunities to improve maintenance processes.
* Collaborate with BI and data teams to improve reporting, data integration, automation, and management visibility.

**4. Fleet PMS Support & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Provide PMS database support to vessel teams, Technical Superintendents, and shore-based technical departments.
* Coordinate with vessel personnel to obtain missing machinery particulars, maker manuals, equipment details, and maintenance information.
* Liaise with PMS software providers and internal IT or technical teams to resolve application issues, data discrepancies, and system enhancement requests.
* Track issues, action items, implementation timelines, and closure status to ensure timely resolution.
* Support consistent implementation of PMS standards across new takeovers and the existing fleet.
* Participate in PMS reviews, technical meetings, familiarization sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**5. Audit Readiness & PMS Governance**

* Support internal and external audits and inspections within the scope of PMS data, maintenance jobs, and maintenance records.
* Review PMS-related observations and assist in implementing corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain PMS data standards, audit trails, database documentation, and quality-control procedures.
* Support relevant TMSA Element 4 and 4A requirements relating to maintenance management, equipment reliability, and PMS data governance.
* Ensure assigned PMS action items are completed within agreed timelines and supporting records are maintained.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marine Engineering or an equivalent marine engineering qualification.
* Typically 3–5 years of relevant experience in marine engineering, preferably including sea-going experience and hands-on shore-based PMS database management.
* Experience in a ship management company, vessel operator, or maritime technical management environment is preferred.
* Practical understanding of marine machinery, maintenance practices, maker manuals, spare parts, and technical documentation.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including lookup functions, formulas, data cleaning, PivotTables, and charts.
* High attention to detail, good organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with shipboard and shore-based stakeholders.

**Technical Skills**

* Hands-on experience with maritime PMS applications such as ShipPalm, SmartPAL, ShipNet, AMOS, BASSnet, Danaos, or Sertica is an advantage.
* Knowledge of SFI coding, equipment hierarchies, component structures, maintenance job configuration, and spare-parts mapping.
* Ability to interpret machinery particulars, maker manuals, equipment specifications, and maintenance instructions.
* Experience with PMS data migration, data reconciliation, validation, and quality assurance.
* Knowledge of Power Query and Power BI or other reporting and visualization tools is desirable.

**Soft Skills & Core Competencies**

* Meticulous attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate, standardized data.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to translate technical requirements into clear data structures and reports.
* Good time management, prioritization, and follow-up skills.
* Willingness to learn new PMS platforms, reporting tools, and automation solutions.

**Experience & Qualifications**

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marine Engineering or an equivalent marine engineering qualification.

Experience: 3–5 years of relevant experience, preferably combining sea-going exposure with shore-based PMS work in a ship management company or fleet operator.

**Alternative:**
Ex-seafarers and junior engineering officers seeking to transition ashore into technical data management may be considered, particularly where they demonstrate sound knowledge of marine machinery, maintenance practices, and strong data-handling skills.

**Key Performance Expectations**

* Accurate, standardized, and up-to-date PMS databases for assigned vessels.
* Timely completion of PMS database development, updates, and migration activities.
* Reduction in missing data, duplicate records, and maintenance-job mapping discrepancies.
* Reliable mapping and monitoring of critical equipment, maintenance jobs, counters, and spare parts.
* Timely resolution and tracking of PMS data issues and support requests.
* Improved reporting, compliance visibility, and audit readiness through consistent data quality and process improvement.

**Overall Role Objective**

To ensure that PMS databases across the fleet remain accurate, standardized, compliant, and operationally effective, supporting reliable vessel maintenance, regulatory readiness, and continuous improvement in technical fleet management.

title: Software Dev Engineer II, Profit Intelligence
description:
**Description**
Are you interested in building intelligence systems from the ground up?
  
  
Are you interested in working with Applied Scientists, Big Data Engineers and Software Development Engineers to build large-scale data intelligence systems?
  
  
Are you interested to work in a team that positively impacts different key pillars of Amazon like Pricing, Promotions, Advertising, Auto inventory purchasing, Auto inventory removal, Inventory placement?
  
  
Are you interested in working for a team that builds cool systems yet has great work-life balance?
  
  
Profit intelligence systems measures, predicts true profit(/loss) for each item as a result of a specific shipment to an Amazon customer.
  
  
Prot Intelligence is all about providing intelligent ways for Amazon to understand profitability across retail business. What are the hidden factors driving the growth or profitability across millions of shipments each day?
  
  
Profit Intelligence provides these answers.
  
  
We compute the profitability of each and every shipment that gets shipped out of Amazon. Guess what, we predict the profitability of future possible shipments too. We are a team of agile, can-do engineers, who believe that not only are moon shots possible but that they can be done before lunch. All it takes is finding new ideas that challenge our preconceived notions of how things should be done. Process and procedure matter less than ideas and the practical work of getting stuff done. This is a place for exploring the new and taking risks.
  
  
We push the envelope in using cloud services in AWS as well as the latest in distributed systems, forecasting algorithms, and data mining.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to design and build AI-powered data platforms that transform large-scale business data into actionable insights. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and data engineering — owning end-to-end development of tools that help business leaders make faster, better decisions.
  
  
This is a high-impact role on a team where the software you ship directly shapes financial and operational strategy across Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Architect and build scalable platforms that ingest, process, and serve insights from petabyte-scale datasets
  
  
Integrate large language models and generative AI capabilities into internal analytics tools — enabling natural language querying, anomaly explanation, and automated reporting
  
  
Design ML pipelines for anomaly detection, forecasting, and trend analysis over structured and semi-structured business data
  
  
Partner with scientists, analysts, and PMs to translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped technical solutions
  
  
Drive engineering excellence: define coding standards, lead design reviews, and set the bar for operational health (monitoring, oncall, runbooks)
  
  
Mentor junior engineers; raise the technical capability of the team through clear documentation and code review
  
  
Own your services in production — you build it, you run it
  
  
Build and operate our foundational data infrastructure comprising of the entire spectrum of AWS Services - Storage (Redshift Data Shares, s3 data lakes), Orchestration (Step Functions, Glue and Internal Java Based Orchestration Tools), Processing (Spark & Flink - KDA), Streaming services (AWS Kinesis) and real-time large scale event aggregation stores.
  
  
Making it fully configurable and self-service for non-engineers.
  
  
Build and evolve tools that empower Amazonians to access data and build reliable, scalable and configurable way to generate Unit Economics for all Amazon Businesses. This includes UIs and frameworks for configuring rules, simulating their application, approval workows for rule changes, APIs and caching layers for high-throughput serving of Unit Economics Historicals and Predictions.
  
  
Build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like inhouse Reporting Applications and BI tools), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for designing and building platforms for crunching 100s of TB of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: AI Tech lead
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The AI Tech Lead serves as a key technical resource for the ZenAI platform and a critical escalation point for complex platform, integration, and engineering issues. The role requires deep platform expertise and is responsible for feature evaluation, advanced technical consulting, and development of the internal tools on which the team depends. The AI Tech Lead ensures that solutions deployed on ZenAI are optimized for performance, cost efficiency, and model selection; advises power users and technical audiences on advanced platform capabilities; and serves as the technical liaison to vendor engineering and support teams. This role will initially operate as an individual contributor and is expected to evolve into a people-leadership position with one to three direct reports as the team grows. The role also provides complementary coverage across time zones in partnership with the global AI Capabilities & Governance team.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Master Data and Capacity Model Ownership:**
  Own the capacity model and related planning master data in SAP IBP. Use the master data dashboard to identify gaps or inaccuracies in production run rates, changeover constraints, material lead times, resource calendars and other planning parameters. Coordinate corrections with the relevant supply planners and master data stewards responsible for maintaining the source data in ECC/S/4HANA.

* **Constraint Identification and Alert Generation:**
  Run SAP IBP heuristics and planning algorithms to identify constraints across the supply network. Generate system alerts for capacity bottlenecks, material shortages, safety stock violations, and demand-supply imbalances.

* **Scenario Building:**
  Build comparable scenarios with consistent assumptions that enable the Supply Planers in both the Mid-Term and Short-Term to evaluate alternatives. Ensure scenarios are structured, repeatable, and documented so that leadership can compare options on a level playing field.

* **Resolution Modelling:**
  Execute resolution modelling in SAP S4 ePPDS and SAP IBP to test proposed solutions before they are committed. Validate feasibility of allocation changes, schedule adjustments, and capacity rebalancing options.

* **Digital Twin Development:**
  Drive digital twin development as organizational maturity evolves. Progress the modelling capability through maturity stages: heuristic-based planning, optimizer-driven planning, and ultimately AI/Joule-enabled autonomous planning.

* **Data and Parameter Stewardship:**
  Serve as the owner of planning parameters, ensuring that safety stock targets, lot sizes, planning horizons, and aggregation rules are correctly configured and regularly reviewed for accuracy. Ensure issues identified through modelling or business plan validation are escalated and corrected at source where required.

**RESOURCES MANAGED**

***Financial Accountability***

None.

***Supervision***

Initially an individual contributor role. Expected to supervise one to three ZICC-based direct reports (AI Tech Analysts) over time as the team grows.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

The following education and experience qualifications are required or preferred:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field required; advanced degree preferred
* 8+ years of professional experience in technical roles such as software engineering, platform engineering, or solution architecture
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with API integrations, enterprise system connections, and automation platforms
* Demonstrated expertise with AI platforms and technologies, including agentic and generative AI
* Experience evaluating, testing, and rolling out new platform features in an enterprise environment
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues across multiple systems
* Experience building internal tooling, dashboards, and automation solutions
* Prior people leadership or team lead experience preferred
* Experience in the pharmaceutical, life sciences, or regulated industry preferred

**TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIREMENTS**

The following technical skills are required or preferred:

* Deep expertise with enterprise AI platforms and technologies, including agents, workflows, skills, integrations, and agentic AI; experience with Langdock, OpenAI, or similar platforms preferred.
* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) services and MCP gateways; experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and event-driven architectures

title: Senior Associate Workforce Planning
description:
**About the Role**
Support Operations is one of our core operations teams, responsible for making sure that when things go wrong, there's always someone there to make it right. The team designs, manages, and operates a large and growing global network of support centers, with the goal of delivering a world-class customer experience every time.
  
  
We're looking for an experienced Workforce Planner to help develop and scale our support lines of business. This role is central to planning monthly, daily, and hourly staffing levels, and to keeping hiring plans current so we consistently deliver best-in-class service. You'll play a key part in improving forecast accuracy, reporting, and how we plan around floor staff utilization and efficiency — for a 24/7/365 organization, wherever it operates.
  
  
**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
**Capacity planning**

* Build and maintain support capacity plan models at the monthly, weekly, and interval level, using a quantitative model to determine the staff required to service forecasted volumes
* Match staffing supply to required staff to ensure efficient service level attainment, and make hiring, ramp, and staff-reduction recommendations
* Keep capacity plans and assumptions accurate, current, and aligned to source-of-truth headcount data, auditing regularly for accuracy
* Ensure alignment from the smallest site/team level of detail up through the broader org-wide capacity plan
* Maintain documentation of planning methodology, assumptions, and processes, and continually improve the planning tools, models, and templates themselves

**Forecasting & scenario planning**

* Forecast incoming contact volume using historical and benchmark data, tracking deviations between forecast and actuals on a regular cadence
* Build, update, and present "what-if" scenarios to evaluate potential changes and support upcoming initiatives, as well as annual, half-year, and quarterly planning scenarios for long-range and financial planning
* Build and validate capacity models for new lines of business, queues, or markets, and identify overtime activation needs while ensuring compliance with local labor regulations in each region you support
* Build out and report on seasonality trends for a complex, growing organization

**Performance & insights**

* Dig into historical data to surface insights that improve support operations, speed, quality, and customer experience
* Monitor service level performance, perform SL-miss analysis, and feed those insights back into planning

**Staffing & headcount**

* Guide short-term staffing adjustments to close current gaps, and partner with Operations to track how staffing is implemented and optimized, driving proactive and corrective improvements
* Reconcile planned vs. actual headcount and budget with Finance/HR, monitor the hiring pipeline against plan, and track new-hire ramp against expected productivity curves
* Maintain a risk register or contingency plan for capacity gaps such as surges, outages, or attrition spikes, and incorporate attrition, absenteeism, and other shrinkage assumptions into the model

**Cross-functional partnership**

* Partner with Real Time Analysts for demand insight and outage reporting
* Partner with teams across operations, customer experience, product, engineering, and tools to improve processes and the resulting experience for customers and partners
* Hold regular capacity plan reviews with leadership, and flag service level risks — with supporting analysis and a recommended mitigation plan — for upcoming projects and initiatives
* Own your recommendations end-to-end: dig into the data, build the model, set implementation timelines, align partners, test ideas, and measure results

**We're excited about you because…**

* You're analytical and data-driven — you love getting into the weeds, and you let data win arguments
* You enjoy tackling complex problems and building something that hasn't existed before
* You're well-organized and detail-oriented, with excellent written and verbal communication skills
* You follow up and follow through — you execute and get the job done
* You're comfortable in a fast-paced, constantly changing, team-oriented environment, and can manage multiple deadlines at once
* You have an owner mentality: quality-focused, output-driven, proactive, and always pushing yourself to do better
* You bring creative solutions to big challenges
* You're comfortable operating at the lowest level of detail while also thinking long-term and inspiring a team
* You're energized by rapid change and constant learning
* You're comfortable pulling data or modeling in Excel/Google Sheets
* You don't give up — if your first plan doesn't work, you have a few more in your back pocket
* You have 4-6 years of relevant experience, having succeeded in diverse environments (tech, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, or similar)
* You have a Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
* You bring hands-on experience with workforce management software (e.g., NICE, Verint, Genesys, or Aspect) and advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets; SQL experience is a plus

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. title: Sr. Associate, observational research
description:
Job Description:
  
  
Amgen focuses on areas of high unmet medical need and leverages its expertise to strive for solutions that improve health outcomes and dramatically improve people’s lives. A biotechnology pioneer since 1980, Amgen has grown to be one of the world’s leading independent biotechnology companies, has reached millions of patients around the world, and is developing a pipeline of medicines with breakaway potential.
  
  
Observational Research is an increasingly important component in drug development and commercialization. There is increased demand for information from Real-World Data (RWD) studies for regulatory and reimbursement authorities. The Center for Observational Research (CfOR) at Amgen partners with teams to generate real world evidence for multiple stakeholders across the product lifecycle. CfOR studies include but are not limited to evidence generation regarding the frequency and distribution of disease, the clinical burden of disease, the natural history or clinical course of disease, the design of clinical trials, treatment cost and utilization patterns, and the safety and effectiveness of therapeutic interventions.
  
  
Amgen is seeking an Epidemiology Analyst (RWD researcher) to join our CfOR organization based in Hyderabad, India. In this role, the individual will contribute to research activities in the Data and Analytics Center (DAC) on functionally aligned teams. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of observational research methodology, excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work across various therapeutic areas and regions. The Epidemiology Analyst is recognized as a strong scientific contributor and is a first or contributing author for papers in peer-reviewed journals, abstracts for scientific congresses or for internal reports that enhance the company’s mission.
  
  
**Key Activities include:**

* Contribute to global observational research activities for CfOR in support of drug development, registration, and commercialization across Amgen’s portfolio of products
* Contribute to the implementation and conduct of observational studies to support the product lifecycle using real world databases and analytics platforms (e.g., Atlas, Aetion, and other internal/external RWD tools)
* Develop, review, and maintain high-quality medical codelists for exposures, outcomes, covariates, and safety endpoints using standard coding systems (e.g., ICD, MedDRA, SNOMED, RxNorm), ensuring clinical validity and regulatory readiness
* Partner with study team members to ensure codelists are fit-for-purpose, transparent, and reproducible across studies
* Executes/manages descriptive epidemiologic studies to characterize the incidence/prevalence of disease in US, EU, Asia, and emerging market countries
* Executes/manages research projects involving the analysis of multiple types of data including medical claims, electronic health records, and prospective observational cohort studies
* Provides safety research support across the life cycle of Amgen products, supports the development of risk management plans, and executes pharmacovigilance studies
* Conducts literature reviews and prepares research reports and scientific manuscripts
* Stays abreast of the latest developments in the field of observational research and drug development
* Promotes awareness, understanding, and use of observational research methods
* Communicates significant scientific information to a variety of audiences

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* MBBS (or equivalent) and/or PhD training in Epidemiology or other subject with high observational research content
* Experience in the design, execution, and analysis of observational research studies within Pharmaceutical or Public Health setting
* Advanced expertise in medical codelist construction, maintenance, and quality assurance across standard clinical coding systems (e.g., ICD, MedDRA, SNOMED)
* Experience in research to support drug development
* Experience working with secondary data systems, including administrative claims, EMR, registries
* Experience in observational research project planning and management
* Excellent verbal and writing communication and interpersonal skills
* Experience working in multi-disciplinary teams

Basic Qualifications:
  
  
Doctorate/ PhD degree in a relevant discipline, or an MBBS (or equivalent clinical medical degree)OR
  
  
Master's degree and 3 years of scientific experience
  
  
OR
  
  
Bachelor's Degree and 5 years of scientific experience

title: Manager, Workforce Planning
description:
**About the Team**
Our Workforce Management team's primary focus is to ensure we have the right people in the right place at the right time, so customers, merchants, and delivery partners get help as quickly and reliably as possible. The team brings a people-first mindset paired with strategy and operations to achieve its goals, moving quickly, applying first-principles thinking, and focusing on problem-solving to ensure seamless execution. The team manages workforce capacity planning, scheduling, and real-time operations for a large and growing global network of in-house and outsourced support centers, with the goal of delivering an outstanding customer experience reliably, at scale.
  
  
**About the Role**
As a Manager, Workforce Planning, you will lead a team of Workforce Planners, Schedulers, and Real Time Analysts (typically 5-7 direct reports), owning workforce planning and performance across an integrated scope that spans in-house and outsourced/vendor sites. You'll set direction for your team, own KPI performance, and partner cross-functionally to keep staffing supply aligned with business priorities.
  
  
This role flexes across two tracks depending on team needs and where your strengths lie: an Audience-facing track, where you act as the primary bridge between a specific line of business and the Workforce Management function, translating business goals into capacity plans and performance reporting; and a Technical track, where you directly supervise the team of planners who build the forecasts and schedules for all in-house and outsourced sites, focusing on the technical accuracy of capacity models and the tools behind them. Both tracks require a leader who can navigate ambiguity, identify root causes through data, and manage up and across with clarity and confidence.
  
  
**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**

* Manage and develop a team of Workforce Planners, Schedulers, and Real Time Analysts (typically 5-7 direct reports), setting clear priorities and holding the team accountable to results
* Own capacity plans and scheduling coverage across an integrated scope spanning in-house and outsourced/vendor sites
* Own KPI performance — service level, occupancy, over/under staffing, and quality — and lead root-cause analysis and recovery planning when performance slips
* Anticipate staffing risks and deviations before they affect service, and put proactive mitigation plans in place
* Lead goal-setting for your area and track progress, translating results into clear updates for leadership
* Partner cross-functionally to align staffing supply with evolving business priorities, and drive process and efficiency improvements
* Communicate performance, blockers, and root causes clearly to leadership while maintaining strong cross-functional relationships
* Act as the primary bridge between your assigned line of business and the Workforce Management function
* Translate business goals into capacity plans and performance reporting that keep service levels on track
* Manage outsourced/vendor relationships tied to your audience, holding partners accountable to staffing commitments and service level targets
* Build trust and influence with business stakeholders, surfacing trade-offs and risks clearly and proactively
* Directly supervise the team of planners building forecasts and schedules for all in-house and outsourced sites
* Own the technical accuracy of capacity models, forecasting methodology, and underlying assumptions
* Ensure planning tools and systems are used to their full potential, and lead improvements to the models, templates, and tools themselves
* Translate high-level goals into precise, data-driven staffing blueprints the broader team can execute against

**We're excited about you because…**

* You have 5-7 years of experience in workforce management, capacity planning, or operations, including experience leading or directly managing a team
* You're fluent in workforce management fundamentals: capacity planning, forecasting, scheduling, shrinkage, and occupancy
* You bring strong analytical rigor and are comfortable with data tools such as SQL, Excel, and Tableau
* You have a track record of driving measurable performance improvements across cross-functional teams
* You're a confident, clear communicator, able to influence and align stakeholders across functions and levels
* You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and enjoy solving complex problems
* You're a people leader at heart — skilled at coaching and developing others while staying close to the work
* You have a Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
* You have experience managing outsourced/vendor relationships, including staffing commitments and service level accountability
* You're a skilled business partner, comfortable owning KPI outcomes and communicating trade-offs to stakeholders outside of WFM
* You bring hands-on experience with workforce management software (e.g., NICE, Verint, Genesys, or Aspect) and forecasting/capacity modeling methodology
* You've improved planning tools, models, or templates, and enjoy going deep on the technical mechanics behind a capacity plan

**About DoorDash**
At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
  
  
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. title: Enterprise Planning Manager
description:
**Company**
Qualcomm India Private Limited
  
  
**Job Area**
Information Technology Group, Information Technology Group > IT Management
  
  
**General Summary**
We are seeking a Manager to lead the design, build, and ongoing management of enterprise planning and forecasting models supporting actuals, forecast, budget, long-range planning, and scenario modeling. This role partners closely with Finance (FP&A), Accounting, Business Unit leaders, and IT to deliver scalable, governed, high-performing planning solutions using TM1 / IBM Planning Analytics or modern EPM tools such as OneStream, Anaplan, and Hyperion Essbase. The ideal candidate combines deep financial modeling expertise with strong EPM platform knowledge, data integration experience, and stakeholder management skills to deliver reliable planning outcomes with measurable business impact.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Enterprise Planning Model Strategy & Delivery**
Own end-to-end delivery of planning models including Actuals, Forecast, Budget, LRP, and what-if / scenario simulations across P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, CapEx, Headcount, Opex, Revenue, and cost allocations.
  
  
Define and maintain the planning model architecture (dimensions, hierarchies, versioning, calendars, drivers, measures, metadata strategy).
  
  
Lead model build activities: calculations, rules/scripts, driver-based planning, allocations, intercompany logic, and rolling forecast methods.
  
  
Drive standardization and reusability of model components (common dimensions, reference data, shared business rules).
  
  
**Business Partnership (FP&A / Accounting / BU Finance)**
Translate finance and business requirements into scalable EPM solutions; act as a trusted partner to FP&A leaders and finance stakeholders.
  
  
Facilitate design workshops to define driver trees, planning assumptions, scenario levers, and reporting outputs.
  
  
Ensure alignment with accounting close, actuals loads, and reconciliation processes (actuals vs plan vs forecast variance).
  
  
**Data Integration, Automation & Controls**
Own integration of data between EPM tool(s) and upstream/downstream systems (ERP/GL, Data Warehouse/Lake, BI).
  
  
Oversee ETL/ELT processes, scheduling, automation, and monitoring for data loads (actuals, master data, rates, assumptions).
  
  
Implement strong reconciliation and auditability: balancing checks, variance thresholds, data validation rules, and end-user signoffs.
  
  
**Performance, Scalability & Reliability**
Optimize model performance (calculation efficiency, cube design, aggregation strategy, partitioning, indexing, caching).
  
  
Maintain high system availability during planning cycles; manage release schedules and deployment procedures.
  
  
Establish monitoring, issue triage, and root-cause analysis for production incidents and user issues.
  
  
**Governance, Security & Compliance**
Establish governance for metadata changes, model changes, roles/access controls, workflow, approvals, and audit trails.
  
  
Manage SDLC best practices: environments (prod, non-prod), version control, testing, deployment, and documentation.
  
  
Define and enforce standards for model documentation, naming conventions, and change management.
  
  
**Reporting, Analytics & End-User Enablement**
Deliver dashboards and outputs for management reporting, variance analysis, and executive review packages.
  
  
Partner with BI tools (Power BI/Tableau/Databricks AI-BI) and reporting modules to publish trusted KPIs.
  
  
Train end users and power users; create runbooks, guides, and enablement sessions during planning cycles.
  
  
**Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management**
Lead and mentor EPM developers/analysts/modelers
  
  
Drive cross-functional alignment across IT, Finance, Accounting, and business teams.
  
  
Communicate status, risks, and trade-offs to senior stakeholders; manage roadmap and prioritization.
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline.
  
  
14+ years of hands-on experience in FP&A systems / EPM / financial modeling / planning solutions.
  
  
5+ years managing projects and/or leading teams
  
  
Experience in leading the Enterprise Planning transformation to modern planning solutions
  
  
Hands-on experience building planning models in TM1/IBM Planning Analytics and/or OneStream / Anaplan / Hyperion Essbase.
  
  
Strong understanding of financial statements and planning processes: P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, headcount planning, allocations.
  
  
Experience with data integrations: ERP (SAP/Oracle), data warehouse/lake, ETL tools, APIs, flat files, scheduling.
  
  
Strong analytical skills, structured problem-solving, and stakeholder communication.
  
  
Accountability and Ownership of the delivery in driving the projects to completion
  
  
Ability to work independently and collaborate with business and cross functional teams
  
  
Prior experience establishing an EPM COE (Center of Excellence) or leading enterprise planning transformations.
  
  
Exposure to planning workflow / approvals / task management (OneStream workflows, Anaplan processes, TM1 processes, Hyperion Planning workflows).
  
  
Experience with scripting/rules: TM1 rules/ti processes, Essbase calc scripts / MaxL, OneStream business rules, Anaplan formulas / actions / integrations
  
  
Knowledge of master data management (MDM), dimensional modeling, and data quality frameworks.
  
  
Certifications: IBM Planning Analytics, OneStream, Anaplan, Oracle Hyperion/EPM
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* 6+ years of IT-related work experience with a Bachelor's degree.

OR
  
  
8+ years of IT-related work experience without a Bachelor’s degree.
