title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
TripleLift is the Creative SSP powered by TL Spark, our agentic intelligence layer. We orchestrate creative, supply, audience, and measurement into a single outcome-driven system across the open internet, retail media, and CTV. Our platform enables brands and agencies to drive measurable performance while helping publishers maximize yield and preserve high-quality user experiences.
  
  
**Overview**
The Senior Application Security Engineer plays a critical role in driving secure software development and application security maturity within TripleLift's Engineering and Security organization, directly influencing how we protect our advertising platforms and the trust our publishers and advertisers place in us. In this position, you will partner closely with Engineering, Platform, Cloud Infrastructure, and Security teams to shape secure coding practices, application security tooling, vulnerability remediation, and CI/CD security, ensuring security is embedded into how we design, build, deploy, and operate our products.This is an exciting opportunity for someone who wants to build and scale an application security program at a company operating at the center of a rapidly evolving, high-stakes ad-tech landscape, while contributing meaningfully to the long-term security posture and resilience of the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Play a critical role in building and maintaining a global security compliance program based on NIST CSF.
* Scale application security by developing automated security testing utilizing enterprise SAST, DAST, and code-review tools.
* Champion SDLC to promote secure application development and infrastructure deployment and facilitate secure coding remediation activities.
* Automate security testing in CI/CD pipelines to detect vulnerabilities early, including building and maintaining the pipeline integrations themselves.
* Administer and drive adoption of GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS) : code scanning, secret scanning, and dependency review across engineering repositories.
* Participate in threat modeling and design/architecture spec reviews to identify and mitigate security risks early in the SDLC.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to develop and implement a vulnerability management program and to perform threat-hunting activities.
* Own and conduct internal penetration testing and vulnerability assessments of applications and infrastructure, and validate findings from third-party pentest engagements.
* Monitor and respond to application-layer security threats like API abuses, business logic flaws, and common web vulnerabilities.
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure security is a key consideration in software design and architecture.
* Enhance application security posture by working with cross-functional teams to implement proper authentication, authorization, and data protection mechanisms.
* Enhance and facilitate security incident handling activities.
* Evangelize security best practices and provide education and awareness to company employees. Develop and implement secure coding guidelines and conduct secure development training for engineers.
* Evaluate and continuously improve the maturity of the security program through the deployment and management of various security tools and processes.

**Education & Requirements**

* 5 years minimum of experience in application security, secure software development, security engineering, or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of secure coding practices and ability to guide developers on remediation strategies.
* Experience with GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS), including Code Scanning (SAST), Secret Scanning, and Dependency Review.
* Proficiency in SAST, DAST, and SCA tools (e.g., CodeQL, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, Checkmarx, Veracode).
* Hands-on experience integrating security testing tools into CI/CD pipelines for automated security scanning, including designing and building pipeline workflows.
* Hands-on penetration testing / offensive security experience across web applications, APIs, or cloud infrastructure.
* Knowledge of common application security vulnerabilities and mitigations (OWASP Top 10, CWE, business logic flaws, API security).
* Ability to perform threat modeling and participate in design/architecture spec reviews to assess security risks in applications and services.
* Experience conducting security code reviews across various programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, TypeScript, Go).
* Understanding of security fundamentals with relation to various cybersecurity and compliance frameworks, particularly NIST CSF, but any of PCI, SOC2, HITRUST, ISO 27001/2, or similar.
* Strong understanding of AWS security services and controls (IAM, VPC, KMS, GuardDuty, CloudTrail) and experience securing cloud-native environments and workloads, with the ability to deploy security tools within them.
* Takes ownership of projects, works independently with minimal oversight, and delivers results in a fast-paced environment while balancing multiple priorities.
* Continuously learns, adapts, and values correctness, efficiency, and constructive feedback.

**Preferred**

* Experience in the ad-tech / programmatic advertising industry, or another high-scale, real-time environment.
* Preferred: Familiarity with using AI/LLM-based tools (e.g., Claude or similar) for threat intelligence, alert triage, or security automation.
* Holds a cybersecurity certification, e.g., OSCP, GWAPT, CISSP, CISA, etc.

Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to experience and performance. * Medical, Dental & Vision Plans

We move with urgency, challenge convention, and continuously innovate to elevate digital advertising. title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Delhi
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**
Experience: 4-6 Years
  
  
**About the Company:**
Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic
* Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems
* AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows
* System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines
* Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence
* Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews

**What We Look For**

* Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus)
* Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work
* Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT)
* Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets
* Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms
* Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona)
* Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

title: Lead Data Warehouse Engineer
description:
FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures. FairMoney maintains a strong international presence, with offices in several countries, including France, Nigeria, Germany, Latvia, the UK, Türkiye, and India.
  
  
In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point-of-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices. Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state-of-the-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents.

To gain deeper insights into FairMoney's pivotal role in reshaping Africa's financial landscape, we invite you to watch this informative video.

We are looking for a
**Lead Data Warehouse Engineer**
to own FairMoney's data warehouse and lead the team that builds it. You will set the architecture, the modelling and quality standards, and the delivery roadmap for the data our lending, banking, risk and finance teams depend on. You will stay hands-on in architecture, design reviews and critical models while you lead and grow a team of data engineers.

1.
**Data Platform and Architecture**

* Own the architecture of the cloud data warehouse, from ingestion to the published datasets used by analysts, BI tools and downstream systems.
* Lead the modernisation of the data platform, including the move to CDC and streaming ingestion.
* Decide which layer each piece of business logic belongs in, and keep published datasets stable for the teams that use them.
* Manage compute and storage cost and deliver measurable efficiency gains.

2.
**Data Modelling and Engineering Standards**

* Set and enforce standards for data modelling, transformation patterns, testing, documentation and code review.
* Build data quality and observability practices that catch issues before consumers find them. ●
* Run a clear change process, with design review, QC evidence and peer review, before changes reach production.
* Drive automation and CI/CD across the data stack.

3.
**Reliability and Operations**

* Own freshness, accuracy and availability SLAs for business-critical datasets, and the on-call and incident response behind them
* Guide the team through complex issues in distributed data pipelines.

4.
**Team Leadership**

* Lead, hire, coach and grow a team of data engineers
* Set the team's working rhythm: intake and triage, sprint planning, design reviews and stakeholder reporting.

5.
**Stakeholder Partnership**

* Be the main engineering partner to business, product, risk and finance leaders.
* Turn business requirements into reliable data products, explain trade-offs clearly and deliver on predictable timelines
* Make sure data handling meets financial regulatory, governance and security requirements.

6.
**AI and Self-Serve**

* Prepare the warehouse for AI use cases with documented models, consistent metric definitions and a semantic layer.
* Bring AI-assisted engineering and analytics into the team's daily work.

**Requirements**

**Must-Haves**

* 10+ years in data engineering, data warehousing or analytics engineering, including 3+ years directly managing engineers.
* Expert SQL and strong Python.
* Deep data modelling experience: dimensional modelling, slowly changing dimensions, and incremental and idempotent transformations.
* Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift.
* Production experience with dbt and a workflow orchestrator such as Airflow.
* End-to-end ownership of business-critical datasets, with accountability for freshness, correctness and SLAs
* Experience in fintech, banking or financial services.
* A record of hiring, retaining and growing strong engineers.
* Strong stakeholder management, including the ability to say no and explain why

**Nice-To-Haves**

* Experience working with Google Cloud Platform
* Experience working with CDC or streaming ingestion (Kafka, Debezium or similar)
* Experience with data governance, data contracts and lineage
* Indepth knowledge on data quality and observability tooling
* Semantic layers and GenAI / LLM tooling on structured data
* Leading teams across time zones

**Benefits**

* Training & Development

* Performance Bonus

**Recruitment Process**

* A screening call with the Recruiter for 30 minutes
* Technical interview with the Hiring Manager for 45 minutes

title: Senior Engineer
description:
WorldQuant develops and deploys systematic financial strategies across a broad range of asset classes and global markets. We seek to produce high-quality predictive signals (alphas) through our proprietary research platform to employ financial strategies focused on market inefficiencies. Our teams work collaboratively to drive the production of alphas and financial strategies – the foundation of a balanced, global investment platform.
  
  
WorldQuant is built on a culture that pairs academic sensibility with accountability for results. Employees are encouraged to think openly about problems, balancing intellectualism and practicality. Excellent ideas come from anyone, anywhere. Employees are encouraged to challenge conventional thinking and possess an attitude of continuous improvement.
  
  
Our goal is to hire the best and the brightest. We value intellectual horsepower first and foremost, and people who demonstrate an outstanding talent. There is no roadmap to future success, so we need people who can help us build it.
  
  
Technologists on this team research, design, code, test, and deploy solutions that enable the firm’s front-office quant teams to make effective use of the our framework. Our environment is relaxed yet intellectually driven, and we seek people who think in code, enjoy solving complex engineering problems, and are motivated by working closely with like-minded researchers, engineers, and business stakeholders. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, solution delivery, and quant research enablement. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with researchers, embedded technology teams, and platform stakeholders to build scalable tools, APIs, services, and workflows that improve adoption and support the continued evolution of the firm’s ecosystem. We are looking for a hands-on technologist who enjoys building robust systems, working closely with users, and solving intellectually challenging problems. The ideal candidate is practical, curious, collaborative, and motivated by delivering tools and platforms that help researchers and investment professionals work more effectively.

* Participate in the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of solutions
* Build and maintain APIs, services, tools, and platform components that enable seamless integration with front-office quant workflows.
* Interface with users of the platform to understand their use cases and help them make effective use of available tools and services.

* Contribute to scalable platform capabilities, including workflow tooling, metadata management, distributed storage, and integration services.
* Research best practices and propose feature specifications and enhancements for the platform roadmap.
* Develop and maintain tools that complement the core platform offering and improve usability, adoption, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure solutions are reliable, secure, scalable, and aligned with firmwide engineering standards.
* Produce clear documentation, user guides, and technical materials to support adoption and long-term maintainability.
* Collaborate with global teams in an open, intellectually curious, and delivery-focused environment.

**What You’ll Bring**

* University degree, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
* At least 5 years of professional software engineering experience.
* Strong English communication skills and experience working in a global environment.
* Expertise in software lifecycle management methodologies and tools, including Git and JIRA.
* Strong programming expertise in at least one of the following: Python, Go, C, or C++.
* Strong working knowledge of UNIX/Linux.
* Experience designing, developing, testing, and supporting production-quality software systems.
* Ability to work directly with technical and non-technical users to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
* Knowledge of the design and development of large-scale distributed systems, distributed storage platforms, workflow platforms, or data-intensive systems.
* Experience building APIs, backend services, platform tooling, or developer enablement solutions.
* Familiarity with quant research workflows, investment technology platforms, data pipelines, or front-office systems.
* Exposure to CI/CD, observability, containerization, orchestration, or cloud-native development practices.
* Interest in open architecture, graph-based frameworks, metadata-driven systems, and extensible platform design.

title: Manager Software Development
description:
**Overview**
WELCOME TO SITA
  
  
At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
  
  
You’ll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don’t just move the world forward—we’re proud to be recognized as a
**Great Place to Work®**
by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
  
  
Are you ready to love your job?
  
  
The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA
  
  
**PURPOSE**
We are seeking a highly technical Engineering Manager who has progressed from a Software Developer to Technical Lead and ultimately into Engineering Management.
  
  
This role is not a traditional Project Manager or Scrum Master position. The successful candidate will be expected to actively participate in architecture discussions, influence technical decisions, guide solution design, and lead software engineering teams in delivering high-quality products.
  
  
The Engineering Manager will serve as the technical bridge between Architects, Product Owners, Development Teams, QA, DevOps, and Senior Leadership, ensuring business objectives are translated into scalable and sustainable technical solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep software engineering expertise with strong people leadership capabilities and is comfortable challenging technical assumptions, driving technical roadmaps, and influencing architecture decisions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership & Architecture**

* Actively participate in architecture and solution design discussions alongside Enterprise Architects and Technical Architects.
* Drive technical decision-making and ensure architectural choices align with product strategy and long-term business objectives.
* Review and challenge proposed designs to ensure scalability, maintainability, performance, security, and operational excellence.
* Lead technical roadmap definition and execution.
* Guide teams in adopting engineering best practices, coding standards, design patterns, and modern development methodologies.
* Assess technical feasibility, technical debt, and implementation complexity during planning exercises.

**Engineering Leadership**

* Lead and manage cross-functional software engineering teams including Developers, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers, Technical Leads, and Contractors.
* Mentor Technical Leads and Senior Developers on architecture, design, and engineering excellence.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, continuous improvement, and technical ownership.
* Drive engineering effectiveness through metrics and data-driven decision making.

**Product & Delivery Ownership**

* Collaborate closely with Product Owners to translate business goals into technical solutions.
* Break product roadmaps into technical epics, features, and user stories.
* Ensure user stories are technically sound, properly estimated, and aligned with architectural principles.
* Support backlog refinement, sprint planning, PI planning, and prioritization activities.
* Drive predictable delivery without compromising technical quality.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary technical escalation point for complex solution and delivery challenges.
* Influence and collaborate with Architects, Product Management, Engineering Leadership, and other stakeholders.
* Communicate technical strategies, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Build alignment across globally distributed teams.

**Technology & Innovation**

* Stay current with emerging technologies, AI-assisted development, cloud-native architectures, and modern engineering practices.
* Drive adoption of automation, DevOps, observability, and AI engineering tools including GitHub Copilot.
* Champion continuous improvement initiatives across development lifecycle processes.

**Qualifications**
**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE**
**Essential**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience with at least:
* 4+ years as a Software Developer / Senior Software Engineer / Technical Lead.
* 3+ years leading software engineering teams.
* Demonstrated career progression from Software Engineer → Technical Lead → Engineering Manager.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale software products.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications.
* Experience leading architecture reviews and technical design workshops.
* Hands-on software development background in:
* Java and/or .NET ecosystems
* REST APIs and Microservices
* Event-driven architectures
* Cloud Platforms (Azure preferred)
* Experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices.

**Highly Desirable**

* Experience with:
* Kubernetes
* Docker
* Azure Services
* Kafka/RabbitMQ
* API-led integrations
* React/Angular front-end architectures
* AI-assisted software development tools (GitHub Copilot)

**MUST-HAVE TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES**

* Software Architecture
* Technical Solution Design
* Domain Driven Design (DDD)
* Cloud-Native Architecture
* Microservices Architecture
* System Integration
* API Design and Governance
* DevOps & CI/CD
* Security by Design
* Performance & Scalability Engineering
* Technical Risk Management
* Engineering Estimation & Planning
* Technology Roadmap Development

**PEOPLE LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

* Coaching and Mentoring
* Talent Development
* Technical Leadership
* Stakeholder Influence
* Strategic Thinking
* Decision Making
* Communication
* Conflict Resolution
* Cross-functional Collaboration

**EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
* Cloud certification (Azure/AWS/GCP) , Nice to Have.
* TOGAF, Azure Architect, or equivalent architecture certification is nice to have.

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

title: Infrastructure & Asset Management Specialist
description:
**Position Overview**
: As our Founding IT Systems,
***Infrastructure & Asset Management Specialist***
, you will wear multiple hats to own, scale, and secure our entire operational footprint. You will bridge the gap between day-to-day corporate IT logistics and high-performance GPU computing.

In this role, you will balance tracking high-value physical and software assets with deep hands-on infrastructure tasks like configuring network fabrics, tuning Linux kernels, and ensuring our core GPU stacks run at maximum utilization. This is an autonomous role built for a highly organized, technical problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Asset Management, Procurement & Logistics (35%)***

* **Hardware Lifecycle Management:**
  Track, audit, and manage the full lifecycle of high-value physical hardware, including GPU server nodes, development laptops, switches, and peripheral accessories.
* **Vendor & RMA Logistics:**
  Own vendor relationships, negotiate procurement pricing, handle international/domestic shipping logistics, and manage RMA processes for faulty hardware component replacements.
* **SaaS & License Governance:**
  Audit and optimize enterprise software usage (e.g., Slack, GitHub, IDE licenses, Cloud compute credits) to eliminate cost inefficiencies and maximize seats.
* **Compliance & Inventory Audits:**
  Maintain precise infrastructure inventories and hardware asset registers, preparing the company for imminent security compliance benchmarks (such as SOC 2 Readiness).

***Startup IT & Network Operations (35%)***

* **Identity & Access Control:**
  Provision, manage, and deprovision secure user access frameworks across Google Workspace, Okta, Microsoft 365, and localized SSH keys.
* **Office & Lab Networking:**
  Set up, secure, and monitor office/lab local networks, managing Wi-Fi access points, physical routers, firewalls, and reliable VPN networks for remote engineers.
* **Device Deployment:**
  Deploy and maintain Mobile Device Management (MDM) setups to automatically configure, encrypt, and secure employee endpoints (Mac, Linux, Windows).

***GPU Server & Linux System Administration (30%)***

* **GPU Environment Isolation:**
  Maintain host OS layers (Ubuntu Server, Rocky Linux) and manage the core AI compute runtime stack, including NVIDIA base drivers, CUDA toolkits, and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit via Docker.
* **High-Performance Storage:**
  Configure and manage local network storage (NAS/NFS solutions) to reliably feed training datasets to GPU infrastructure without bottlenecks.
* **Telemetry & Alerts:**
  Deploy simple, lightweight monitoring hooks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Node Exporter) to track critical hardware health metrics, preventing data corruption or server thermal throttling.

**Required Qualifications & Skills:**

* **The Ultimate Generalist:**
  3-5+ years of combined experience spanning enterprise IT support, Linux systems administration, and basic hardware asset/inventory tracking.
* **Linux Proficiency:**
  High comfort operating inside a Linux shell environment (SSH, package management, bash automation scripting).
* **GPU Awareness:**
  Hands-on experience resolving dependencies, broken driver paths, or container device mappings for NVIDIA hardware runtimes.
* **Organizational Skills:**
  Meticulous tracking habits. You enjoy creating a clean inventory out of chaos and implementing organized operational systems.
* **Startup Mentality:**
  Extreme autonomy. You are comfortable running point on critical physical/virtual tasks without an existing employee manual.

**Preferred & Bonus Assets:**

* Prior experience designing asset registers for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 standard approvals.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) or Configuration Management tools (Ansible).
* Experience configuring shared clusters via lightweight job schedulers (such as Slurm)

Band B3

An L3 resource must possess in-depth knowledge of the following skills to meet customer expectations: -Thales Luna SA HSM -Thales CiphertrustManager KMS -Microsoft ADCS PKI

-A PKI / ADCS Engineer is responsible for designing, deploying, and managing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure including Root CA, Intermediate CA, and Issuing CA servers while ensuring secure certificate issuance and validation processes. The role involves hands-on management of Microsoft ADCS components such as NDES (SCEP), CEP/CES services, and integration with Active Directory for auto-enrollment and authentication.

-The role requires implementation and maintenance of Certificate Policy (CP) and Certification Practice Statement (CPS) aligned to organizational security standards and compliance requirements. The candidate should also manage CRL infrastructure including base CRL and delta CRL, ensuring proper publication and accessibility via CDP and AIA locations.
  
-The engineer should possess strong knowledge of cryptographic principles including asymmetric and symmetric encryption, hashing, and digital signatures along with practical understanding of PKCS standards, Cryptographic Service Providers (CSP), and Key Storage Providers (KSP).
  
-The role involves supporting SSL/TLS certificates across internal and external applications and ensuring adherence to industry standards like X.509 and TLS protocols. Strong troubleshooting skills are required for resolving issues related to certificate enrollment, chain errors, CRL accessibility, and authentication failures.
  
-The candidate must have good understanding of Active Directory including Group Policy, auto-enrollment configuration, and integration with PKI services for enterprise identity and access management.
  
-The role includes ensuring PKI high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery by implementing proper backup, restore, and redundancy mechanisms across CA servers and related infrastructure.
  
-The engineer should work on operational support, monitoring PKI health, performing RCA for incidents, and maintaining documentation for PKI processes and environments.
  
Optional skills include experience with Linux-based certificate management, OpenSSL tools, cloud PKI platforms (Azure/AWS), and HSM integration for secure key management.

title: Staff Cloud Solutions Engineer - Azure
description:
**Role Overview**

The Staff Cloud Engineer - Azure FinOps is the FinOps subject-matter expert embedded with Product and Engineering. You own how Azure billing actually works across every commercial construct Microsoft sells through — and how cost gets allocated, recovered, and reduced on top of it.

Azure billing is not one system. An EA enrollment, an MCA billing account, a CSP/partner-managed tenant, and an MSP-resold estate expose different hierarchies, data shapes, and discount mechanics. Someone who has only rightsized VMs has not done this job. We need someone who has stood inside these billing models, reconciled them against invoices, and built showback and chargeback a finance team accepted.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Azure Billing and Commercial Models (Primary)***

* Own the product's model of Azure billing across EA, MCA, CSP/Partner-led, and MSP-resold estates — including where each behaves differently and what breaks when you assume they don't
* Define how the platform represents the billing hierarchy: EA enrollment → departments → accounts, and MCA billing account → billing profiles → invoice sections → subscriptions
* Specify handling for discounts, credits, refunds, and adjustments — negotiated pricing, partner earned credit, promotional and sponsorship credits, commitment drawdown, service credits, mid-cycle corrections
* Reconcile usage data against invoices; define product behavior when they disagree, and where amortized, actual, and effective cost must be reported separately
* Map billing roles (Enterprise Admin, Billing Profile Owner/Contributor, Invoice Section Reader, Partner Center roles) to what the product can see at each tier

***Allocation, Showback, Chargeback, and Budgets***

* Design allocation models that survive real estates — tag, subscription, and management-group driven — with a defensible method for shared and unallocatable cost
* Define showback and chargeback as separate product behaviors with different accuracy and auditability bars; specify markup and margin handling for MSP/CSP resale
* Own reservation and Savings Plan benefit attribution and amortization presentation
* Own budget design across all Azure scopes, with actual vs. forecasted alerts, action groups, and automated response; set a real signal-to-noise bar for anomaly detection

***Cost Optimization***

* Define and validate optimization recommendations — rightsizing, idle and orphaned resources, disk and snapshot cleanup, SKU upgrades, storage tiering, Log Analytics ingestion, egress
* Own commitment strategy: RI and Savings Plan coverage, utilization, breakeven, scope choice, exchange and refund rules, Azure Hybrid Benefit
* Set the accuracy bar for every savings claim the product makes — the calculation, the assumptions, and what makes it defensible to a CFO

***Product Partnership and Engineering***

* Act as the technical authority on Azure cost and billing behavior for PM and engineering; turn Cost Management, Consumption, Billing, Partner Center, and Retail Prices API behavior into implementable requirements
* Pressure-test proposed features against how practitioners work; validate shipped capability against live estates and report gaps honestly
* Automate billing data collection, normalization, and reconciliation; build reference environments across billing models
* Produce enablement material for Sales, CS, and Support; support high-stakes customer conversations; mentor engineers and PMs on Azure cost fundamentals

**Desired Skills and Requirements**

***Must Have***

* Hands-on experience across at least three of: EA, MCA, CSP/Partner-led, MSP-resold billing — with a clear account of how they differ
* Demonstrated understanding of billing accounts, billing profiles, invoice sections, and billing groups, and how EA departments/accounts differ from the MCA model
* Practical experience with discounts, credits, refunds, and adjustments — and how each surfaces, or fails to surface, in usage data
* Built or operated a showback and chargeback model that a finance function accepted
* Hands-on cost allocation design, including shared-cost treatment and commitment benefit attribution

title: Senior Principal Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Cloud Platform team owns the production inferencing service that serves SambaNova's models to customers on RDU accelerators, including capacity planning, deployment, monitoring, and incident response across regions in the United States, Asia, Europe, and Latin America.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Principal Cloud Platform Engineer you'll keep our AI inferencing platform reliable, fast, and scalable. Your focus is uptime, latency, and resource utilization on the inference endpoints customers depend on. The work spans monitoring, deployment, capacity planning, and incident response, and includes a shared on-call rotation covering 24/7 coverage.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Owning the availability, latency, and efficiency of the production inferencing service, including change management, emergency response, and standing up AI infrastructure in new regions
* Building and maintaining monitoring, alerting, and dashboards in Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog covering service health, model latency and throughput, and RDU utilization
* Leading incident response, running blameless post-mortems, and automating the toil those incidents expose
* Finding and fixing performance bottlenecks, and designing auto-scaling policies that handle variable inference load without overspending
* Managing cloud and on-prem infrastructure as code in Terraform and Ansible, and building the CI/CD pipelines that deploy new model versions and service updates

**Required Qualifications**

* B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 3+ years in a Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or related role supporting a large-scale, customer-facing service in a public cloud environment (AWS, GCP, Azure)
* Strong programming and scripting skills in Python, Go, or Java
* Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes
* Deep understanding of monitoring and observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or the ELK Stack
* Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform or CloudFormation
* Experience with CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or ArgoCD
* Strong Linux system administration fundamentals

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a hybrid environment spanning cloud and on-premise data center infrastructure

* Familiarity with GPU-accelerated computing and optimizing workloads for NVIDIA GPUs, for purposes of mapping to RDUs

title: Security Architect
description:
**Job Description**
As an Enterprise Security Architect, you will be a recognized thought leader, setting the direction for Nokia's security architecture across Business Groups, Central Functions, and strategic technology programs. You will simultaneously lead and influence multiple complex, cross-functional security initiatives — from cloud transformation and Zero Trust adoption to M&A security assessments and AI-driven security automation. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role is for a security professional who leads with vision, executes with precision, and is energized by the complexity of managing multiple high-priority initiatives at once.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Nokia's enterprise by defining forward-looking security architecture strategies, influencing the company's security roadmap, and establishing security best practices that set the standard across Business Groups, Finance & IT (FIT), and Central Functions.
* Including IT & Business Digitalization initiatives, Nokia Solution Offering assessments (USIT programs, NESC Initiatives securization, UK TSA Privileged Access Workstation…), and corporate infrastructure security transformations from strategic conception through delivery and validation.
* Architect and validate end-to-end security solutions spanning Zero Trust Network Architecture, IAM, multi-cloud security (Azure, GCP, AWS), network and application segmentation, AI security, data protection, and BC/DR cyber resiliency — ensuring seamless integration across DevOps and Agile delivery pipelines.
* Serve as Nokia's Trusted Security Advisor to senior stakeholders across BGs and Central Functions, providing authoritative guidance on security strategy, supplier contract risk, M&A security due diligence, and regulatory interactions with government bodies.
* Proactively identify and remediate security vulnerabilities in existing and emerging digital solutions through rigorous security architecture assessments, penetration testing insights, and cost-efficient hardening recommendations — always staying ahead of evolving attack tactics.
* Champion innovation by defining, budgeting, presenting, and delivering new security solutions into Nokia's corporate infrastructure, bridging strategic vision with technical execution in a cloud-first, transformation-driven environment.

**Key Skills And Experience**
**Must-Have:**

* Bachelor's degree with 5+ years of enterprise security architecture experience with a demonstrated track record of simultaneously leading multiple complex, cross-functional security programs balancing strategic vision with hands-on technical execution across diverse stakeholder groups.
* Deep, broad security architecture expertise: Mastery of modern security domains including Zero Trust, IAM, multi-cloud security (Azure/GCP/AWS), application and network security, AI security, and Software Security — combined with strong fluency in threat modeling frameworks (MITRE, STRIDE, Kill-Chain) and standards such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and DevSecOps methodologies.
* Executive-level communication and stakeholder influence: Exceptional ability to articulate complex security concepts and architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences — including C-suite, BG leadership, government entities, and remote global teams — with outstanding written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Technical depth with an automation mindset: Hands-on experience designing and implementing multi-cloud security environments, supported by solid scripting proficiency (Python, PowerShell, Ansible, Java/C) and a security automation-first approach; relevant certifications (CISSP, CISM, OSCP, CEH) are a strong differentiator.

**Nice-to-Have:**

* Strategic agility in ambiguous environments: Demonstrated ability to rapidly translate complex, evolving threat landscapes and organizational ambiguities into clear, structured, and executable security strategies — thriving in fast-paced, transformational settings.
* Proactive security innovation mindset: A natural inclination to anticipate security gaps before they become incidents, with a passion for researching emerging attack techniques, new defensive technologies, and industry-shaping security trends.
* Collaborative influence across virtual teams: A strong team player who leads by example and builds consensus across geographically distributed, cross-functional teams — convincing stakeholders through data-driven insights and trusted advisory relationships.
* Customer and business-centric security focus: Ability to balance rigorous security requirements with business enablement objectives, ensuring security architecture decisions are pragmatic, cost-efficient, and aligned with Nokia's commercial and strategic goals.

**About This Role**
We are looking for a data-savvy Software Engineer to help us build scalable, production-grade systems for researching, experimenting and developing cutting-edge data products in the private markets space.
  
  
This role sits within the Private Markets Data Engineering (PMDE) team at Preqin, part of BlackRock. Preqin is central to BlackRock’s ambition to transform private markets data and technology, complementing the Aladdin platform to deliver integrated public and private market solutions across the whole portfolio.
  
  
As a senior individual contributor and hands-on technical leader, you will design and build scalable data software infrastructure and analytics platforms that enable high-quality data products, advanced analytics, and client-facing solutions. Working closely with business stakeholders and product partners, you will translate strategic priorities and user needs into robust technical architectures and delivery plans. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, owning technical design and outcomes across complex initiatives.
  
  
Your work will directly enhance transparency, operational efficiency, and data-driven decision-making for institutional investors, fund managers, and service providers. In doing so, you will help position BlackRock as the leading technology and data provider in private markets.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who is excited by the challenges of innovating in private markets data, and combines deep technical expertise with the ability to clearly articulate value to both business stakeholders and clients.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and build scalable, reliable data pipelines and platformssoftware solutions for data products, ensuring performance, quality, and long-term sustainability.
* Own data solutions end-to-end — from translating business objectives into technical designs through implementation, deployment, and production support.
* Design and implement data workflows that are reproducible, testable, and scientifically rigorous, embedding validation frameworks, monitoring, lineage, and observability into every stage.
* Enable advanced analytics and AI/ML use cases by building software solutions infrastructure that supports experimentation, versioning, and production-grade pipeline and model deployment.
* Lead architectural decisions and influence technical prioritisation, partnering closely with product and delivery teams to align engineering effort with business impact.
* Act as a technical authority within the team, elevating engineering standards and driving best practices in data management, governance, and cloud-native development.
* Engage senior stakeholders, clearly communicating complex technical trade-offs and recommendations in business-relevant terms.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with engineers, data scientists, analysts, and product leaders to deliver high-impact solutions for institutional investors and private markets clients.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Proven experience building and operating scalable software systems for data processing workflows and platforms, with deep expertise in Python and SQL across databases such as Snowflake and Postgres.
* Hands-on experience with modern software engineering practices, including version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience working in cloud environments (AWS or Azure), including infrastructure provisioning and automation using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform).
* Demonstrated ability to design production-grade systems that balance performance, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Experience enabling or supporting advanced analytics and AI/ML use cases in production environments.
* A rigorous, data-driven mindset – comfortable using analysis, benchmarking, and experimentation to guide technical decisions and architectural trade-offs.
* Strong understanding of data validation, testing strategies, and code quality practices, with confidence applying diverse code and data testing techniques across data and application layers.
* Ability to operate autonomously and drive technical solution design end-to-end, taking ownership of outcomes.
* Experience collaborating effectively across engineering, data science, product, and design teams to deliver high-impact solutions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels and translate complex technical concepts into clear, business-relevant language.
* A proactive, curious, and resilient mindset — motivated to explore new technologies, tackle ambiguous problems, and continuously improve systems and ways of working.

**Desirable Skills Include**

* Experience with AI-related technologies and products; familiarity with using AI coding assistants.
* Experience working with financial market data, investment analytics, or private markets datasets.
* Experience designing and building data platformssoftware and/or data platforms in regulated or financial services environments.
* Experience supporting ML lifecycle management (model versioning, experiment tracking, model deployment pipelines); familiarity with tools such as MLflow, feature stores, or model serving frameworks.
* Experience productionising statistical or quantitative models.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Data Analytics Customer Engineer, Google Cloud (English)
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience as a data or systems engineer, solutions architect, or pre-sales consultant.
* Experience delivering demos, workshops, or architect overviews to business leaders.
* Experience migrating, refactoring, or debugging proprietary or open source workloads.
* Experience building data platforms, warehouses, or data lakes, and experience with data programming languages and leveraging agentic platforms.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to manage stakeholder relationships.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience designing and deploying enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, Large Language Model (LLM) application integrations, or context orchestration frameworks.
* Experience implementing enterprise data/AI governance, metadata management, access control, or lineage tracking across modern catalogs.
* Experience with developer advocacy, building internal technical programs, delivering technical enablement, or contributing to open-source data/AI communities.
* Experience in core data science workflows, including proficiency with data manipulation libraries and integrating data pipelines with ML platforms.
* Experience applying value-selling principles to align technical architectures with business outcomes.

**About The Job**
As an Agentic Data Cloud Customer Engineer, you are the premier technical subject matter expert in your territory. You will partner with Sales Specialists to execute the technical pre-sales strategy for customers, serving as the trusted technical advisor to CDOs, CTOs, Lead Architects, and developers. You will lead proactive discoveries to map complex, legacy customer data estates and qualify them for migration to Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  
  
You are a builder and architect that designs, codes, and deploys production-grade, end-to-end Data + AI pipelines that solve real-world enterprise problems. You will whiteboard modern open lakehouse architectures and run code demonstrations showing how unified data foundations power deterministic, hallucination-free conversational AI.
  
  
Leveraging a background in value-selling, you will conduct detailed Total Cost of Ownership analyses and optimize architectures to prevent runaway spend. You will help customers adopt modern data engineering practices that securely unify data, analytics, and AI. If you possess deep expertise in Python, PySpark, and distributed data systems, and can translate technical excellence into business-transforming migrations, you will grow in this highly technical role.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define technical strategy for large accounts, engaging C-level executives via live demonstrations to solve business problems using the Agentic Data Cloud.
* Design, code, and deploy production-grade Data + AI pipelines (e.g., fraud detection, recommendation engines) and map legacy data estates to open-format architectures (Apache Iceberg).
* Orchestrate Intent-Driven data engineering to autonomously deploy PySpark pipelines using the Data Agent Kit, Antigravity, and Model Context Protocol.
* Lead high-impact showcases and technical value validations using BigQuery, Borderless Lakehouse, Knowledge Catalog, Spark, and Vertex AI to prove business outcomes.
* Conduct detailed Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analyses and optimize architectures (such as balancing DRAM/SSD, compute shapes, and token spend) to prevent runaway costs on the Lightning Engine.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Senior Manager, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.
  
  
Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.
  
  
It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.
  
  
Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.
  
  
In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.
  
  
**The Role**
Nium is looking for a Senior Manager, Site Reliability Engineering to lead the teams responsible for the availability, performance, scalability, and operational excellence of our global payments platform. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will build and grow a team of SREs, define the reliability roadmap, and partner closely with product engineering, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure Nium's systems meet the always-on expectations of a regulated financial platform operating across 100+ markets.
  
  
You will own incident management, observability, capacity planning, and production readiness practices, while championing a culture of blameless postmortems, proactive risk reduction, and engineering-driven automation. This role sits at the intersection of engineering leadership and operational rigor, and reports into Nium's engineering leadership.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of SREs and reliability engineers across multiple time zones, setting clear goals, career paths, and performance expectations.
* Own Nium's reliability strategy — defining and driving SLIs/SLOs/error budgets across critical payment, card issuance, and compliance services.
* Drive incident management end-to-end: on-call structure, escalation paths, major incident response, and blameless postmortems that produce durable fixes, not just tickets.
* Partner with product engineering leaders to embed reliability, scalability, and operational readiness into the software development lifecycle from design through launch.
* Build and scale observability (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting) so that issues are detected and diagnosed before they impact customers or partner banks.
* Lead capacity planning and performance engineering for systems processing high-volume, real-time financial transactions across a global, multi-region infrastructure.
* Champion automation and self-healing systems to reduce toil, eliminate manual runbooks, and improve mean-time-to-detect and mean-time-to-resolve.
* Own disaster recovery, business continuity, and chaos engineering practices, running regular game days to validate resilience assumptions.
* Collaborate with Security and Compliance teams to ensure infrastructure practices meet regulatory and audit requirements (PCI-DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and regional financial regulations).
* Manage the reliability budget: tooling investments, cloud cost/performance trade-offs, and staffing plans, in partnership with finance and engineering leadership.
* Represent SRE in executive reviews, translating technical risk and system health into business-relevant reporting for leadership and the board.
* Establish and continuously refine production readiness reviews, runbooks, and operational standards across all engineering teams.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in software engineering, infrastructure, or site reliability engineering, with 4+ years in a people-management or technical leadership role leading SRE/DevOps/Infrastructure teams.
* Proven track record operating and scaling production systems for a high-availability, transaction-heavy platform — fintech, payments, banking, or e-commerce experience strongly preferred.
* Deep hands-on expertise with cloud infrastructure (AWS) Kubernetes, container orchestration, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
* Strong background in observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK/OpenSearch, or equivalent) and building alerting that reduces noise while catching real issues.
* Demonstrated experience defining and operationalizing SLOs/error budgets, and using them to drive engineering prioritization.
* Solid understanding of distributed systems, databases, caching, messaging queues, and API-driven microservice architectures at scale.
* Experience leading major incident response for critical, customer-facing systems, including postmortem processes that drive real change.
* Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks relevant to financial services (PCI-DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001) and how they shape infrastructure and access practices.
* Excellent communication skills — able to translate technical reliability concepts for engineering peers, product leaders, and executives alike.
* A pragmatic, metrics-driven approach to engineering decisions: you measure before you optimize, and you test assumptions in production rather than in theory.
* Experience with scripting/automation (Python, Go, or Bash) and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, ArgoCD, GitLab CI, or similar).

**Nice to Have**

* Experience operating systems subject to real-time payment rails, card networks, or banking core integrations.
* Prior experience running SRE or infrastructure functions through hypergrowth or rapid international expansion.
* Exposure to FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization at scale.
* Experience building or scaling an SRE function from the ground up within an existing engineering organization.

**What We Offer At Nium**
**We Value Performance:**
Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.
  
  
**We Care for Our Employees:**
The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our year-end shut down. We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).
  
  
**We Upskill Ourselves:**
We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.
  
  
**We Celebrate Together:**
We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!
  
  
**We Thrive with Diversity:**
Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.
  
  
**Beware of recruitment scams:**
Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites.
**Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments**
. Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

By implementing modern DevOps and Platform Engineering practices, this role will help reduce deployment times, improve platform stability, enhance user experience, and strengthen operational resilience. ---------------------------------

* Ability to understand end-to-end application architecture and support services throughout the application lifecycle.

BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.

BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.

Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.

We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
**About the role**  

**Job Summary:**

As an Enterprise Architect at Tesco you lead the formulation, development and alignment of new and existing Technology with the Tesco Business Strategy to collectively deliver a simpler, flexible & sustainable architecture. You define, communicate and govern the enterprise architecture for Tesco by creating standards and guidance for Technology programmes and solutions in order to ensure  
it enables and delivers the Tesco Business Strategy.

**You will be responsible for**  

**In this job, I am accountable for:**

Following our Business Code of Conduct and always acting with integrity and due diligence and have these specific risk responsibilities:

* Fostering understanding of the current technology landscape and its impact on stakeholders:
* + Ensure we have models and materials that describe the landscape at a high-level and how it supports the business
  + Help colleagues of all levels to understand the bigger picture and their role / activities within it to aid decision making
* Evolving and embedding Technology strategy across Tesco Technology's functions:
* + Partnering technology engineering and product leadership to define target enterprise architecture that will improve our business for customers and colleagues in line with
* our business and Technology strategy and plans
* + Identify organisational requirements for the resources, structures and cultural changes necessary to support the delivery of the enterprise architecture
  + Identify the optimal approach to delivering Tesco business strategy while increasing agility and driving simplicity / cost efficiency over the short, medium and long-term.
  + Supporting portfolio and programme teams to contribute to planning activities utilising our broad understanding of Tesco, its technology landscape and broader industry /
* technology trends
* Guiding high-level delivery planning and solution design to deliver our strategic goals whilst ensuring we continuously deliver business value
* + Work in collaboration other teams to help ensure we design flexible, efficient and secure solutions
  + Lead and facilitate the creation of governing principles, policies, standards etc. to guide solution decision making for architecturally significant initiatives
  + Operate the architecture review, governance and exception processes
* Supporting successful delivery through the technology lifecycle, delivering business value and realising strategic goals.
* + On occasion, provide targeted support for initiatives with technical challenges during their delivery
* Evolving our federated architecture and design framework as part of the Technology delivery model

  
**You will need**  

**Key people and teams I work with in and outside of Tesco:**  

* + Build architecture capability and competency within Tesco in keeping with our emphasis on agile, DevOps and 'architecture is everyone's role' principles.
  + Create and operate an effective community to engage and educate Technology colleagues in enterprise and solution architecture topics
  + Proactively collaborate and communicate with Technology colleagues and delivery partners to drive awareness and interest
  + Build effective relationships with our Stores business and PLC group colleagues, and valued 3rd party partners.
* Head of Enterprise Architecture
* N/A (direct influence on major strategic investments as part of role)
* Day-to-day engagement with Engineering teams and directors
* Regular engagement with Product, Programme and Software Development
* principals and managers
* Colleagues and business stakeholders across Tesco
* Suppliers and 3rd parties

**Experience relevant for this job:**  

* Technology understanding across Software, Infrastructure, Security and Data
* Proven record of Technology delivery at Tesco scale
* Solution Shaping & Problem-Solving
* Successful use of Enterprise Architecture to shape strategic priorities
* Technology Strategy and Portfolio Steering
* Solution Architecture experience on major programmes
* Architecture Modelling
* Creation, communication and embedding of Technology strategy
* Technical Writing (Standards, Whitepapers & Cookbooks)
* Leading solution architecture governance / assurance
* Proficient Software and System Engineering (incl. Cloud)
* Hands on engineering experience
* Core Technology
* Development Lifcycle
* Product Methodologies
* Retail Technology Awareness
* Communication & Influencing
* Data Analytics & Insights
* Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving
* Finance & Procurement
* Curiosity & Learning
* Embracing and Enabling Change

**Whats in it for you?**  

At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you.

As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day.

Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.

Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles -simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable.

**Salary** - Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment.

**Annual Bonus** - Opportunity to earn additional bonus, distributed as 2/3rd in compensation and 1/3rd in shares.

**Leave & Time-off** - Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy.

**Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary** - In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF.

**Health is Wealth** - Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws.

**Mental Wellbeing** - We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.

**Financial Wellbeing** - Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.

**Save As You Earn (SAYE)** - Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3-year savings plan.

**Physical Wellbeing** - Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle.

**About Us**  

At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve.

At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed.

We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.

When you join Tesco Bengaluru in this role, you'll be employed by Tesco Bengaluru Private Limited, the Tesco legal entity responsible for your employment.

title: Tech Head
description:
Job Description: Head of Technology / Tech Head

Company**:** Inmogic Technologies Pvt Ltd  
**Role:** Tech Head / Head of Technology  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, On-Site  
**Location:** BTM Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka  
**Experience Required:** Minimum 6+ years  
About the Role: Inmogic Technologies is seeking an experienced, visionary, and hands-on **Tech Head** to drive our engineering strategy, architect scalable systems, and lead our software development team. In this leadership role, you will bridge business goals with technical execution, steering end-to-end product architecture, platform reliability, code quality, and technical delivery.  
Key ResponsibilitiesTechnical Leadership & Architecture

* Define the overall technology roadmap, architecture, and technology stack aligned with company business objectives.
* Architect robust, secure, scalable, and high-performance web and cloud-based applications.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and establish engineering best practices, design patterns, and coding standards.
* Oversee DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, system reliability, and cloud infrastructure management (AWS/GCP/Azure).

Team Mentorship & Project Delivery

* Lead, mentor, and scale an agile team of frontend, backend, QA, and mobile developers.
* Partner with product management and leadership to translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications and sprint deliverables.
* Ensure sprint milestones, release cycles, and deliverable deadlines are met with high code quality and minimal technical debt.
* Supervise security standards, data privacy compliance, and system vulnerability assessments.

Strategic Innovation

* Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and modern tools to keep the technology stack competitive and efficient.
* Resolve complex technical bottlenecks, mission-critical production issues, and scalability challenges.

Key Requirements & Qualifications

* **Experience:** Minimum 6+ years of full-stack or backend software engineering experience, with at least 2–3 years in a technical lead, engineering manager, or architect capacity.

title: Lead II, Infrastructure/Network Architect
description:
**Who We Are**

Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the technical authority and trusted advisor for clients, engaging with stakeholders, governance teams, project executives, delivery teams, and technology vendors to define and drive infrastructure strategy and solutions.
* Lead the end-to-end architecture lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution definition through design, implementation, and successful delivery, ensuring solutions meet business objectives, timelines, and budget expectations.
