title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Delhi
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 4-6 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

● End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.

● Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.

● AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.

● System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.

● Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.

● Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.

**What We Look For**

● Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).

● Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.

● Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).

● Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.

● Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.

● Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

● Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).

● Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

* Champion continuous improvement initiatives across development lifecycle processes.

* 10+ years of software engineering experience with at least:
* 4+ years as a Software Developer / Senior Software Engineer / Technical Lead.

* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale software products.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications.
* Experience leading architecture reviews and technical design workshops.
* Hands-on software development background in:
* Java and/or .NET ecosystems

The position will provide centralized governance while enabling effective support to distributed station-level IT teams, ensuring high availability, performance, security, scalability and operational continuity for business-critical technology services.

* Administer virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or equivalent technologies.

title: R&D Engineer 3, Software
description:
**Overview**
Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
  
  
Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Observability Engineer to design, build, and continuously improve monitoring and observability for our enterprise environment. Most of the work focuses on on-premises systems: physical servers, virtualized infrastructure, and on-prem Kubernetes clusters, along with the infrastructure layers underneath them. Some cloud use cases are also in scope. Your goal is to give system owners and business stakeholders an accurate, actionable view of the health and uptime of the systems they depend on.
  
  
You will also help shape how we apply agentic AI to observability, moving from dashboards and alerts toward intelligent triage, correlation, and assisted remediation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Architecture and Design
  
  

* Design end-to-end monitoring and observability solutions for enterprise applications running on VMs, Kubernetes, and bare-metal servers, and extend them to cloud workloads where needed.
* Define a layered monitoring strategy that covers hardware, OS, virtualization, network, storage, platform services, and applications.
* Set standards for metrics, logs, alerting, dashboards, and service health models, including SLIs and SLOs where they apply.
* Make sound architectural decisions on tool roles, data flows, retention, scalability, and high availability across the observability stack.
* Define alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability.
* Design service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers.
* Secure observability platforms and integrations through access controls, authentication, encryption, and vulnerability remediation. Maintain compliance with enterprise security standards through platform hardening, audit readiness, and regular security reviews.

Implementation
  
  

* Build and maintain monitoring with Zabbix, covering templates, discovery, triggers, proxies, and integrations.
* Design and maintain log collection, parsing, enrichment, and routing pipelines into Splunk, including forwarders, sourcetypes, field extractions, indexes, and searches.
* Contribute to metrics and visualization with Prometheus and Grafana, particularly for Kubernetes workloads and unified dashboards.
* Automate the configuration and onboarding of monitoring using infrastructure-as-code and APIs.

Agentic AI for Observability
  
  

* Design and implement AI agents that support observability workflows. Examples include alert triage and deduplication, cross-source event correlation, root-cause hypotheses, incident summarization, and runbook-driven remediation with human-in-the-loop approval.
* Integrate LLM-based agents with monitoring and logging platforms through APIs and tool protocols such as MCP.
* Define guardrails, permission boundaries, and auditability for AI-driven actions on production systems.
* Measure the real impact of these agents on operations, for example on MTTD, MTTR, alert noise, and on-call load.

Collaboration
  
  

* Work closely with system owners to understand architecture, failure modes, and dependencies, and to translate them into meaningful monitoring.
* Partner with consumers and stakeholders of those systems to define what “healthy” and “available” mean to them, and to make sure observability gives them the visibility they need.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring, and run knowledge sharing across operations, infrastructure, and development teams.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Regularly review alert quality, coverage gaps, and signal-to-noise ratio, and tune or retire monitoring accordingly.
* Use incidents and post-mortems as input to improve detection and response.
* Track the evolution of the observability toolset and the wider technology landscape.

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 7+ years in infrastructure, operations, or observability engineering, with at least 3 years focused on monitoring and observability, primarily in on-premises enterprise environments.
* Hands-on, production-level experience with Zabbix and Splunk.
* Proven experience monitoring physical servers, virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V, KVM), and Kubernetes clusters.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure layers: compute, OS (Linux and Windows), networking, storage, and the dependencies between them.
* Solid experience with log collection and processing at scale: parsing, normalization, enrichment, retention, and search optimization.
* Practical experience applying agentic AI (LLM agents, tool use, automation) to monitoring, operations, or incident management, along with a working understanding of how these systems behave and where their risks lie.
* Experience designing monitoring architecture, not only operating existing tools.
* Experience defining alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability.
* Experience designing service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers.
* Working knowledge of securing observability platforms, including access control, authentication, encryption, and hardening.
* Strong scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) and comfort working with REST APIs.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work with both technical owners and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with Prometheus (exporters, alerting rules, Alert manager, long-term storage).
* Experience with Grafana (dashboard design, multi-source visualization, alerting).
* Experience monitoring cloud workloads (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and hybrid environments.
* Software development experience, such as building integrations, tools, exporters, or services.

description:

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

 

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

 

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

**Job Summary**

The Staff Engineer I will work as an individual contributor and technical leader and will drive the development and execution of an infrastructure platform that delivers secure, reliable, and scalable services. They will leverage their deep expertise in private datacenter, public cloud providers, infrastructure such as code, automation, and data analytics to create modern, cloud-based solutions. The Staff Engineer I will collaborate with teams both within and outside of the organization to provide world-class services. They must be adaptable, eager to learn, and focused on delivering results. In addition to platform and solution delivery responsibilities, the Staff Engineer will also play a key role in identifying areas for continuous improvement and implementing best practices.

**Principle Accountabilities and % of the time**

**Platform & Solution Delivery (60%)**

* Help design, lead building and maintaining public and private infrastructure and solutions to support the availability, orchestration, configuration, maintenance and monitoring of infrastructure environments
* Develop blueprints or engineer new solutions as requirements dictate
* Make security a priority at every step of the infrastructure, application and product lifecycle
* Supervise code changes or major changes
* Mentor and coach junior team members
* Help define and advocate for effective development practices

  

**Continuous Improvement (40%)**

* Lead identifying issues with efficiency, stability, availability, and security of existing code and infrastructure, and bring new ideas to the table to improve overall delivery of services
* Help to establish, implement and adhere to the corporate technology standards and guidelines

 

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong in secure infrastructure frameworks and cloud security best practices
* Demonstrated excellence in applying automation to all aspects of technical operations
* Strong analytical, conceptual, and problem-solving abilities
* Strong ability to communicate at all levels of the entire organization and with customers
* Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies and processes
* Understanding of data visualization, data modeling, and compute scaling

**Knowledge of:**

* Multiple public cloud providers (AWS, Azure or GCP) or private datacenter management
* Scripting, infrastructure as code and automation languages and tools (Ansible, Terraform, Helm, GitHub Actions, PowerShell or Python)
* Developing and releasing production solutions leveraging public cloud and SaaS infrastructure or tools

 

**Experience**

* Experience with multiple cloud providers (AWS, Azure or GCP) or private datacenter management, familiar with other providers
* Experience with scripting, infrastructure as code and automation languages and tools (Ansible, Terraform, Helm, GitHub Actions, PowerShell and Python)
* Experience with CI/CD processes, code reviews, code deployments and pipelines
* Experience with logging and monitoring solutions such as Datadog, Grafana and Prometheus
* Experience with containers, Docker and Kubernetes
* Experience with identity solutions such as Active Directory, AzureAD, Okta or LDAP
* Experience with public cloud landing zone architectures

Minimum experience with

* Generative AI, Databases, data engineering, data science or business intelligence technology
* Experience with Go or Python for cloud platform and infrastructure API automation
* Experience with Hashicorp Cloud Platform (Terraform & Vault)

 

**Education OR equivalent combination of education, training, and experience**

• Associate's/Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.

**Recommended Years of Relevant Experience -**
5-8+

title: Cloud Migration Engineer
description:
**Project Role :**
Cloud Migration Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Provides assessment of existing solutions and infrastructure to migrate to the cloud. Plan, deliver, and implement application and data migration with scalable, high-performance solutions using private and public cloud technologies driving next-generation business outcomes.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Infrastructure As Code (IaC)
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
Equivalent education
  
  
**Summary**
As a Cloud Migration Engineer, a typical day involves evaluating current infrastructure and solutions to determine the best approach for transitioning to cloud environments. This role includes planning and executing the migration of applications and data, ensuring that the solutions implemented are scalable and high-performing. The position requires coordinating with various stakeholders to align migration strategies with business goals, while continuously monitoring progress and addressing any challenges that arise during the migration process. The engineer plays a key role in enabling organizations to leverage both private and public cloud technologies to achieve advanced business outcomes.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Lead the development and implementation of cloud migration strategies to ensure seamless transition.
* Facilitate communication and coordination between cross-functional teams to optimize migration efforts.
* Monitor migration progress and proactively identify risks or issues, proposing effective mitigation plans.

**Professional & Technical Skills**

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Infrastructure As Code (IaC).
* Experience with cloud platforms and automation tools related to Infrastructure As Code.
* Strong knowledge of cloud architecture principles and best practices for migration.
* Ability to design scalable and secure cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure As Code methodologies.
* Familiarity with scripting and configuration management to automate deployment processes.
* Understanding of network, storage, and security considerations in cloud environments.

**Additional Information**

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Infrastructure As Code (IaC).
* This position is based at our Gurugram office.
* Equivalent education is required.

title: Senior Associate Data Engineering L2
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Associate L2 – Data Engineering**
Publicis Sapient is seeking a Senior Associate L2 – Data Engineering to join our high performing engineering team. In this role, you will translate client requirements into scalable data solutions and drive technical design discussions to ensure robust and efficient architectures. You will leverage your expertise in big data, cloud platforms, and data integration to build end-to-end data pipelines that power analytics and business transformation. This role is critical in enabling clients to unlock value through modern data ecosystems and advanced engineering practices.
  
  
**Your Impact:**

* Design and deliver scalable data engineering solutions to address complex business requirements.
* Build and optimize data ingestion pipelines for batch and real-time processing from multiple data sources.
* Implement robust data processing, storage, and computation frameworks ensuring performance and scalability.
* Drive architecture discussions and ensure the overall health and efficiency of data solutions.
* Develop analytics, aggregation, and search capabilities to enable data-driven decision-making.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate data platforms with business applications.
* Implement cloud-based data solutions leveraging AWS, Azure, or GCP platforms.

**Qualifications**
**Your Skills & Experience**
**:**

* 6+ years of IT experience, with 3+ years in data engineering or related technologies.
* Hands-on experience with Big Data technologies and cloud platform Azure (Multi-cloud is added advantage)
* Strong programming expertise in Scala, or Python
* Experience with Hadoop ecosystem tools such as Spark, Hive, Kafka, Flink, NiFi, and Airflow.
* Working knowledge of NoSQL and MPP data platforms like MongoDB, Cassandra, Redshift, or BigQuery.
* Understanding of data integration, data wrangling, analytics pipelines, and cloud data services.
* Strong understanding of IAM, data security, and cloud-based data platform services.

**Additional Information**
**Set Yourself Apart With:**

* Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica or Talend and relational databases.
* Knowledge of data governance tools and processes (Collibra, Alation, lineage, cataloging).
* Exposure to messaging frameworks like ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, and microservices architecture.
* Experience in performance tuning and optimization of data pipelines
* CI/CD practices including cloud infrastructure provisioning and automated deployment pipelines.
* Relevant cloud or big data certifications along with Gen AI experience.

**Benefits of Working Here:**

* Gender-Neutral Policy
* 18 paid holidays throughout the year.
* Generous parental leave and new parent transition program
* Flexible work arrangements
* Employee Assistance Programs to help you in wellness and well-being.

**Company Description**
Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally-enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

title: Senior Data Engineering Manager - T&T
description:
You may know McCormick as a leader in herbs, spices, seasonings, and condiments – and we’re only getting started. At McCormick, we’re always looking for new people to bring their unique flavor to our team.
  
  
McCormick employees – all 14,000 of us across the world – are what makes this company a great place to work.
  
  
**Position Summary**
As a Data Engineering Manager at McCormick, you will play a pivotal role in the build and delivery of data products from simple to complex and supporting McCormick business units with their data and analytics needs.
  
  
Your responsibilities will include leading a team that delivers and supports data for existing analytics solutions, tooling, and solutions, researching new features and implementing automations. You will support business users, Data Scientists and Data Analysts to convert business expectations into data products and data models usable by business to deliver AI, analysis, reporting, and data-driven recommendations to stakeholders and executives.
  
  
This role will be accountable for building and maintaining scalable data pipelines from source systems. The Data Engineering Manager will ensure the availability, reliability, and performance of data products by integrating raw data from various sources. Key responsibilities include data modeling, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) development, and ensuring data quality and security. This role will be accountable for data coming in from 5+ source systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Plan and Design**

* Collaborate with data product managers to gather data product requirements.
* Design end-to-end solutions including data security, data quality and performance requirements.
* Prepare documentation and with data product managers to define the implementation plan.

**Data Extraction, Load and Transformation**

* Implement ELT pipelines to efficiently ingest and transform data from a wide variety of data sources and deliver datasets that meet business requirements.
* Ensure efficient and reliable data mapping to support business needs.
* Deliver complete documentation and knowledge transfer sessions for the Team and business partners.
* Maintain existing solutions, implement optimizations and enhancements, monitor data quality.
* Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines leveraging Azure Synapse, PySpark, APIs, and SQL & performing advanced data cleaning, transformation, and manipulation to ensure high-quality, and reliable data flows.

**Process Improvement, Performance and Cost optimization tuning**

* Collaborate with Data Science, Machine Learning and Business Analytics teams to optimize performance and cost effectiveness of their analytics solutions.
* Identify and design internal process improvements, including automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, and redesigning solutions for enhanced scalability. Work with Azure Analytics Product Owner to prioritize and schedule implementation.
* Design and implement existing solution adjustments to improve performance and cost-effectiveness.
* Suggest and introduce best practices for Data and AI engineering.

**Issue Resolution and Support**

* Assist stakeholders with data-related technical issues and support their data needs. Work with the Analytics Operational Support team to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve data errors / discrepancies.
* Provide expert-level support and guidance to data teams across the Enterprise.

**People Leadership & Capability Building**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of 8-10 data engineers.
* Define technical standards, code review practices, and engineering excellence frameworks.
* Build career paths, upskilling programs, and succession plans within data engineering.
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Be accountable for building a winning data engineering team – driven by making data a core asset for McCormick.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics/Science, or related field; Masters in technical field or MBA a plus
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer (DP203+AZ305)
* or Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate or related cloud technologies, Fabric IQ/databricks certifications a plus
* 12+ years of data engineering experience.
* Demonstrated ability coding in one or more languages (PySpark preferred).
* Experience with data visualization software (Power BI preferred).
* Experience with building data pipelines.
* Experience with knowledge graphs.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Knowledge of data analysis, visualization techniques, and frameworks.
* Experience performing root cause analysis on internal and external data and processes to answer specific business questions and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Experience with the following tooling:
* SQL, Fabric, Databricks, Synapse, Azure Data Factory, Azure ML, Azure DevOps (for CI/CD),
* OR
* GCP BigQuery, FiveTran, GCP Cloud Composer, GCP DLP (Data Loss Prevention), GCP Cloud Run, Vertex AI etc

At McCormick, we have over a 100-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value

title: Data Platform Architect
description:
**Project Role :**
Data Platform Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Architects the data platform blueprint and implements the design, encompassing the relevant data platform components. Collaborates with the Integration Architects and Data Architects to ensure cohesive integration between systems and data models.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Snowflake Data Warehouse
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
AI Agents & Workflow Integration
  
  
**Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
**Role Summary / Description**
AI Powered Tech Talent
  
  
As a Senior Engineer in AI Infrastructure Architecture for Snowflake, you will own significant portions of the end-to-end architecture and engineering of optimized data and AI infrastructure for production machine learning and AI-enabled applications. You will design scalable warehouses, Snowpark workloads, AI-ready data/feature pipelines, model-enablement patterns, automation and operational controls that align with client standards, SLAs, security, compliance and cost-efficiency expectations. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, platform modernization, regulated data workloads, FinOps and production reliability, while mentoring engineers and partnering with architects to translate business requirements into robust Snowflake-based AI infrastructure solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Own end-to-end architecture and design of optimized Snowflake data and AI infrastructure, including warehouses, Snowpark workloads, secure data architecture, AI-ready feature/data pipelines, model integration and AI application enablement.
  
  
Design and tune scalable Snowflake warehouses, tasks, streams, Snowpark services, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streamlit applications and cloud integrations, including compute sizing, query optimization, governance, access controls and high-throughput data access design.
  
  
Serve as an authoritative AI infrastructure expert on Snowflake, applying deep knowledge of Snowflake Data Cloud capabilities, data/AI application patterns, governance, security and cost levers.
  
  
Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security, compliance, cost and operational complexity.
  
  
Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation actions.
  
  
Drive architecture decision-making by documenting rationale, trade-offs, assumptions and dependencies so decisions are transparent, defensible and aligned with business SLAs and standards.
  
  
Define and maintain AI infrastructure roadmap inputs, capacity planning models, scaling strategies, cost forecasts and performance improvement opportunities.
  
  
Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization.
  
  
Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards.
  
  
Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with business outcomes and translate requirements into actionable architecture standards.
  
  
Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large-scale engineering solutions.
  
  
Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C++, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages.
  
  
Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform-native workflow tooling.
  
  
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced engineering or client delivery environment.
  
  
Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large-scale solutions.
  
  
Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.
  
  
Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns.
  
  
**Required Skills/ Experience**
Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake warehouses, databases, schemas, secure data sharing/access controls, Snowpark, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streams/Tasks, Streamlit and cloud ecosystem integrations.
  
  
Experience architecting scalable data and feature pipelines, AI application integrations, model-enablement patterns, governance, query/warehouse optimization and secure data access.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python, dbt/Terraform, CI/CD, DataOps, MLOps/AI enablement patterns, observability and incident response practices.
  
  
Ability to optimize Snowflake AI infrastructure for performance, cost, scalability, security, reliability and compliance.
  
  
Experience producing architecture decision records, reference implementations, standards, runbooks and reusable platform patterns.
  
  
Good to Have Skills
  
  
Snowflake certifications such as SnowPro Advanced Architect, SnowPro Advanced Data Engineer or related AI/data platform credentials.
  
  
Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail/e-commerce, telecom, manufacturing, energy or public sector environments where data/AI platforms must meet compliance, security, reliability and cost-control requirements.
  
  
Exposure to Snowpark, Cortex/AI features, vector search, retrieval pipelines, feature engineering, model enablement and AI application architecture.
  
  
Knowledge of Snowflake governance, secure data sharing, FinOps, infrastructure partner/vendor collaboration and production support operating models.

title: Enterprise Technology Architect
description:
**Project Role :**
Enterprise Technology Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Architect complex end-to-end IT solutions across the enterprise. Apply the latest technology and industry expertise to create better products and experiences.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Network Operations & Service Management
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 15 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
**Summary**
As a Network Architect, you will design, deploy and manage global enterprise networks, automation, observability, reliability engineering, and manage large-scale transformation programs. You will work within defined operating model and processes, implementing technology at the network level across data center, cloud and network areas. This role requires envisioning and articulating a clear and compelling architecture vision, establishing a target state for the enterprise, and developing a detailed transformation roadmap. The position demands continuous engagement with various stakeholders to ensure the architecture supports business objectives and adapts to evolving technological landscapes. The Network Architect plays a pivotal role in guiding the organization through complex changes by fostering innovation and ensuring cohesive integration across multiple domains.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Execution of the project setup (project scheduling, stakeholder analysis, risk assessment, etc.)
* Coordination of project resources.
* Project quality assurance.
* Monitoring of quality, time and costs in the project.
* Participation in project meetings and coordination.
* Advice and support of the responsible IT infrastructure managers or stakeholders of the client.
* Ensuring compliance with guidelines, e.g. documentation of the project.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Ensure timely resolution of technical issues.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot and resolve system issues.
* Document troubleshooting steps and solutions for future reference.
* Provide training and guidance to junior team members.
* Stay updated on industry trends and best practices.

**Professional & Technical Skills**

* Mandatory Basic Networking skills : Routing & Switching, Firewalls, Data Center & Cloud Networking (AWS/Azure) (CCNA, JNCIA & Cloud equivalent)
* Must Have Skills (Minimum 3): Enterprise Network Management (Solarwinds, HP NNM,etc), Observability & AIOps (Splunk, Grafana, Dynatrace/AppDynamics), Network Automation, RCA, Incident & Problem Management
* Good to have Skills : Python, Ansible, Terraform, Git, REST APIs, CI/CD
* Good to have knowledge on Skills : Wireless, SDWAN, SDN
* Proficiency in designing and deployment of Network Management, Observability tools and Log Management. Customizing metrics/ alerts/ log analysis.
* Strong understanding of network management protocols and technologies.

title: Head of Engineering (Technical Leadership)
description:
**About IndiaMART:**

IndiaMART is an online B2B marketplace connecting buyers and suppliers. Our mission is to make doing business easy. We are investing in the technology, platforms and engineering capabilities that help businesses discover, connect and grow.

**About the role:**

We are looking for a hands-on engineering leader to build an AI-native engineering organisation at IndiaMART. You will shape technical direction and make AI an integral part of how teams design, build, test and operate software, while strengthening the platforms and production systems our business depends on.

This role combines current, personal AI practice with broad systems judgment and the ability to lead people and change. You will work across product engineering, data, infrastructure and security, build the AI infrastructure and developer tools teams need, and turn new capabilities into dependable engineering outcomes.

**Key responsibilities:**

* **Build an AI-native engineering organisation**
  . Shape how teams design, build, test and operate software using AI. Establish shared platforms, developer tools and reusable patterns that help teams turn ideas into reliable products faster, and measure success through adoption, quality and business impact.
* **Build the AI foundations teams need**
  . Establish model and data access, developer tools, evaluation, observability, permissions and cost controls. Help teams adopt effective workflows and improve them as model capabilities evolve.
* **Lead technology and engineering**
  . Set technical direction and priorities, own delivery, develop managers and senior engineers, and build a culture of sound engineering judgment and accountability.
* **Build capabilities teams want to use**
  . Create practical, reusable paths for APIs, frontends, data, testing, deployment and operations. Treat shared services as internal products, with clear interfaces, support and migration plans.
* **Improve the existing estate**
  . Connect decisions across applications, databases, messaging, cloud and security. Simplify or retire systems in stages, informed by reliability, customer outcomes and operating cost.
* **Make safe delivery routine**
  . Embed security, testing, observability and recovery into everyday work. Reduce repeated manual intervention and approvals through effective controls and clear accountability.

**What you should bring:**

* **Bring practical experience building with AI and strong engineering judgment**
  . You understand how models, agents, data and conventional software fit together, can evaluate their limitations, and can guide teams from promising prototypes to dependable production systems.
* **Personal technical depth**
  : consequential software or platforms you helped build, with decisions, mistakes and results you can explain in detail.
* **Technical breadth**
  : judgment across applications and frontends, APIs, data, infrastructure, reliability, security and AI. You understand how choices interact and when to involve specialists.
* **Delivery ownership**
  : a record of delivering engineering outcomes across teams, resolving obstacles and staying accountable through adoption, maintenance and later consequences.
* **People leadership**
  : experience leading through managers, developing technical leaders and owning organisation outcomes, with the judgment to integrate specialist teams and operate at substantial scale.
* **Clear communication and influence**
  : explain choices to technical, product and business audiences, work through disagreement and secure adoption across reporting lines.

**Relevant experience:**

Experience building shared platforms, scaling software products or improving complex production systems is particularly relevant. We welcome technical founders, early engineering leaders and operators from established companies who bring sustained ownership and measurable engineering impact.

**What success looks like:**

AI-native workflows and shared capabilities that teams adopt; faster delivery with better quality; less repeated work and manual intervention; reliable, secure systems; and stronger technical leaders. Establish baselines and demonstrate improvements in delivery effort, reliability and operating cost.

**Reporting to**
: Chief Product Officer

Noida Sector 135

This is an exciting opportunity for a Solution Architect-Packet Core within the Ericsson, S&R Packet Core Sub-Domain. In this role, you will be part of a dedicated team responsible for supporting Ericsson's customers across various network solutions.  
The S&R Solution Architect-Packet Core is part of a CNS (Customer Network Support) team supporting the customer and shall deliver in-service Support services according to the contracted agreements by means of established processes.  
As telecom networks increasingly adopt cloud-based and virtualized infrastructure, this role plays a critical part in navigating the complexities of modern operations, fault isolation, and customer service requests (CSRs).

* Develop Network Recovery Procedures: Own and enhance recovery procedures for issues like signaling storms, traffic rerouting, and other network recovery activities.
* Support Product-Specific Requests: Provide technical support for product-specific CSRs when needed, contributing to a smooth, end-to-end support process.
* Collaborate with Customer Operations Teams: Work on-site with customer teams, acting as the technical interface for complex network troubleshooting and recovery efforts.

* Customer consultation handling on Solution level
* On-site (Customer Office) working embedded within customer Operations team.

-------------------------

* 12-15 years of experience
* Education: A first academic degree or equivalent qualification
* 4G/5G Packet Core, SAPC/CCPC, PCG, NRF, CCRC, SC and cloud infrastructure.
* Technical Expertise in Cloud and Packet Core Networks: You possess deep technical knowledge of Packet core network components
* Solution-Level Competence: Strong understanding of solution-level support that goes beyond node-based operations, including expertise in virtualization and cloud environments.
* Fault Isolation & Troubleshooting: Demonstrated leadership in fault isolation, developing recovery methods, and minimizing CSR turnaround time.
* Change Management: Hands-on experience in managing change control processes within customer support, especially during solution handover and deployment.
* Customer-Centric Focus: Excellent customer consultation and relationship management skills, ensuring continuous engagement and satisfaction.
* Business Acumen: Proven ability to identify business opportunities and promote additional Ericsson solutions to customers.
* Network level competence
* Knowledge of the 3GPP or any other relevant standard for his/her area
* Ability to learn Ericsson Portfolio.
* Service Delivery Process.
* Negotiation & argumentation skills.
* Presentation skills (oral and written).
* Software Update Management.
* Software Support.
* Delivering Results & Meeting Customer Expectation

title: Infrastructure & Asset Management Specialist
description:
**Position Overview**
: As our Founding IT Systems,
***Infrastructure & Asset Management Specialist***
, you will wear multiple hats to own, scale, and secure our entire operational footprint. You will bridge the gap between day-to-day corporate IT logistics and high-performance GPU computing.

In this role, you will balance tracking high-value physical and software assets with deep hands-on infrastructure tasks like configuring network fabrics, tuning Linux kernels, and ensuring our core GPU stacks run at maximum utilization. This is an autonomous role built for a highly organized, technical problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Asset Management, Procurement & Logistics (35%)***

* **Hardware Lifecycle Management:**
  Track, audit, and manage the full lifecycle of high-value physical hardware, including GPU server nodes, development laptops, switches, and peripheral accessories.
* **Vendor & RMA Logistics:**
  Own vendor relationships, negotiate procurement pricing, handle international/domestic shipping logistics, and manage RMA processes for faulty hardware component replacements.
* **SaaS & License Governance:**
  Audit and optimize enterprise software usage (e.g., Slack, GitHub, IDE licenses, Cloud compute credits) to eliminate cost inefficiencies and maximize seats.
* **Compliance & Inventory Audits:**
  Maintain precise infrastructure inventories and hardware asset registers, preparing the company for imminent security compliance benchmarks (such as SOC 2 Readiness).

***Startup IT & Network Operations (35%)***

* **Identity & Access Control:**
  Provision, manage, and deprovision secure user access frameworks across Google Workspace, Okta, Microsoft 365, and localized SSH keys.
* **Office & Lab Networking:**
  Set up, secure, and monitor office/lab local networks, managing Wi-Fi access points, physical routers, firewalls, and reliable VPN networks for remote engineers.
* **Device Deployment:**
  Deploy and maintain Mobile Device Management (MDM) setups to automatically configure, encrypt, and secure employee endpoints (Mac, Linux, Windows).

***GPU Server & Linux System Administration (30%)***

* **GPU Environment Isolation:**
  Maintain host OS layers (Ubuntu Server, Rocky Linux) and manage the core AI compute runtime stack, including NVIDIA base drivers, CUDA toolkits, and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit via Docker.
* **High-Performance Storage:**
  Configure and manage local network storage (NAS/NFS solutions) to reliably feed training datasets to GPU infrastructure without bottlenecks.
* **Telemetry & Alerts:**
  Deploy simple, lightweight monitoring hooks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Node Exporter) to track critical hardware health metrics, preventing data corruption or server thermal throttling.

**Required Qualifications & Skills:**

* **The Ultimate Generalist:**
  3-5+ years of combined experience spanning enterprise IT support, Linux systems administration, and basic hardware asset/inventory tracking.
* **Linux Proficiency:**
  High comfort operating inside a Linux shell environment (SSH, package management, bash automation scripting).
* **GPU Awareness:**
  Hands-on experience resolving dependencies, broken driver paths, or container device mappings for NVIDIA hardware runtimes.
* **Organizational Skills:**
  Meticulous tracking habits. You enjoy creating a clean inventory out of chaos and implementing organized operational systems.
* **Startup Mentality:**
  Extreme autonomy. You are comfortable running point on critical physical/virtual tasks without an existing employee manual.

**Preferred & Bonus Assets:**

* Prior experience designing asset registers for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 standard approvals.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) or Configuration Management tools (Ansible).

**Company Description**

Incede Technologies Private Limited is a product engineering company founded by seasoned banking technology professionals with deep experience in the BFSI sector. The organization focuses on building innovative, scalable, and high-quality software products and solutions for financial services. Incede aims to transform how financial institutions operate by delivering robust technology that supports growth and adaptability in a rapidly changing market. The company is dedicated to providing cutting-edge yet cost-effective solutions that help partners remain competitive and future-ready. Team members collaborate closely with clients to address complex business challenges through modern technology architectures and practices.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site Java Architect role based in Kochi. The Java Architect will design and oversee end-to-end application architectures, with an emphasis on scalable, secure, and maintainable Java-based solutions. Daily responsibilities include defining technical standards, selecting appropriate frameworks, and guiding implementation of microservices and Jakarta EE-based applications. The role involves collaborating with product owners and development teams to translate business requirements into technical designs, performing code and design reviews, and resolving complex technical issues. The Java Architect will also mentor engineers, optimize system performance, and ensure alignment with best practices and design patterns across projects.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Java-based Software Development skills, including experience building enterprise applications and services.
* Proficiency in Architecture and system design, with the ability to define scalable, secure, and modular solutions.
* Hands-on experience with Microservices design and implementation, including service decomposition and integration.
* Knowledge of Jakarta EE and related frameworks for building robust, transactional, and distributed applications.
* Applied understanding of Design Patterns and best practices in object-oriented and distributed system design.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience in BFSI or financial services domains is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor developers, and communicate complex technical concepts clearly.
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and commitment to producing high-quality, well-tested software.

title: GenAI Lead
description:
Orion Innovation is a premier, award-winning, global business and technology services firm. Orion delivers game-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity. We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education.

  

**Job Overview:**

We are seeking an innovative and highly skilled **Lead Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer** to spearhead the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI-powered solutions. In this role, you will lead a team of engineers and data scientists to harness cutting-edge Generative AI technologies and implement them to solve complex business problems, enhance user experiences, and drive innovation. This role combines deep technical expertise, leadership, and a strong understanding of AI trends and tools.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Technical Leadership:
  + Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of Generative AI solutions.
  + Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and data scientists working on GenAI projects.
  + Stay updated with the latest trends, research, and advancements in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Solution Development:
  + Architect, train, and fine-tune state-of-the-art LLMs and generative AI models
  + Develop and optimize pipelines for prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and domain-specific fine-tuning.
  + Develop and deploy generative AI models, particularly focusing on ChatGPT, using Python on Azure or AWS Platform or .Net on Azure platform
  + Ensure scalability, performance, and security of AI solutions deployed in production.
  + Integration and Deployment:
* API Development:
  + Ability to define and deliver API access for GenAI services, facilitating integration with other systems and applications.
  + Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate GenAI solutions into enterprise applications and services.
  + Utilize cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP) to deploy and manage AI models and APIs.
  + Leverage MLOps practices for continuous model monitoring, retraining, and improvement.
* Data Strategy and Preparation:
  + Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure high-quality data acquisition, preprocessing, and augmentation for model training and fine-tuning.
  + Implement data governance and privacy practices in line with organizational policies.
* Innovation and Research:
  + Experiment with new generative AI techniques, such as multimodal AI, reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and active learning.
  + Evaluate and recommend AI frameworks, libraries, and platforms for project requirements.
* Stakeholder Collaboration:
  + Work closely with product managers, business stakeholders, and UX designers to define AI-powered product features and use cases.
  + Present technical concepts, project progress, and AI capabilities to non-technical audiences.

**Key Requirements**

* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms and services for AI/ML, such as Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
* Hands on experience in any of LLMs such as OpenAI's ChatGPT Models , Gemini, Llama 2 ,Claude 2 ,Grok
* Hands on experience in any of the agentic frameworks like LangChain, Semantic kernel, AutoGen, CrewAi
* Hands on experience using any of vector database like Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate, Faiss
* Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF)
* Strong expertise in LLMs and generative AI frameworks like OpenAI, Hugging Face Transformers, or similar platforms.
* Deep understanding of natural language processing (NLP) concepts, including tokenization, embeddings, and sequence-to-sequence models.
* Proficiency in Python and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn.
* Experience in CI/CD pipeline management and automation tools, particularly within the Azure DevOps environment. Knowledge of containerization (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools is also important
* Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices, such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Docker.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field (Ph.D. preferred).
* 8+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with 2+ years specifically in Generative AI.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in building Conversational AI applications using cloud-based services and in orchestrating AI/ML services for building a complete solution
* Minimum of 6 years of extensive full-time experience in Data Analysis, Statistics, Machine Learning, or Computer Science
* Proven track record of leading AI projects from inception to production.
* Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF).
* Certifications in AI/ML or cloud platforms (e.g., Azure AI Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning).

Orion is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Candidate Privacy Policy

Orion Systems Integrators, LLC and its subsidiaries and its affiliates (collectively, "Orion," "we" or "us") are committed to protecting your privacy. This Candidate Privacy Policy (orioninc.com) ("Notice") explains:

* What information we collect during our application and recruitment process and why we collect it;
* How we handle that information; and
* How to access and update that information.

Your use of Orion services is governed by any applicable terms in this notice and our general Privacy Policy.

title: Senior System Engineer
description:
**Senior System Engineer**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a skilled Senior System Administrator to manage, maintain, and optimize our IT infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in system administration, server management, network troubleshooting, and IT security, ensuring high availability and smooth functioning of IT systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, manage, and maintain Windows/Linux servers and enterprise IT infrastructure.
* Monitor system performance, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure high availability of servers and services.
* Manage Active Directory, user accounts, access permissions, group policies, and authentication.
* Implement and maintain system security, patch management, antivirus solutions, and vulnerability remediation.
* Manage backups, disaster recovery, and business continuity processes.
* Troubleshoot network connectivity, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and other infrastructure-related issues.
* Manage virtualization platforms, such as VMware or Hyper-V, and support cloud infrastructure wherever applicable.
* Maintain system documentation, IT asset inventory, and standard operating procedures.
* Coordinate with internal teams and vendors to resolve infrastructure issues and improve IT operations.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
* 4–6 years of hands-on experience in system administration or IT infrastructure management.
* Strong knowledge of Windows Server and/or Linux administration.
* Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and user access management.
* Knowledge of server monitoring, backup solutions, patch management, and IT security best practices.
* Hands-on experience with virtualization technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V.
* Good troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

title: FMS Engineer – Storage & Linux
description:
**Role: FMS Engineer – Storage & Linux**

**Openings: 2**

**Experience: 2+ years**

**Location: Bangalore, Gurugram**

**Education: Minimum 15 years of full-time education**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a certified and experienced Windows, Linux & Storage Administrator to manage, maintain, configure, and enhance our IT infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise across Windows and Linux operating systems, enterprise storage, backup, and virtualization environments, with responsibility for ensuring system availability, performance, security, and data protection across diverse platforms. Certification in Windows/Linux and/or relevant storage technologies is preferred

**Key Responsibilities**

• Install, configure, administer, monitor, and troubleshoot HPE enterprise storage platforms, including HPE 3PAR, HPE Primera, and HPE Alletra.

• Perform day-to-day administration of storage arrays, including storage pools, disk groups, RAID levels, volumes, LUNs, host groups, initiators, and storage policies.

• Perform storage provisioning and de-provisioning for physical and virtual servers based on application and business requirements.

• Configure and manage SAN storage connectivity, including Fibre Channel (FC), SAN switches, zoning, host connectivity, and multipathing/MPIO.

• Configure and manage LUN masking, host mapping, VLUNs, initiator/target relationships, and access permissions.

• Manage RAID configurations, disk failures, spare disks, disk replacement, rebuild activities, and storage hardware health.

• Monitor storage infrastructure for capacity, IOPS, latency, throughput, disk utilization, controller health, cache utilization, and overall performance.

• Perform storage performance analysis and tuning to identify and resolve I/O bottlenecks, latency issues, and performance degradation.

• Manage snapshots, clones, remote copy/replication, and synchronous/asynchronous replication and other data-protection capabilities on HPE storage platforms.

• Support backup and recovery operations, including coordination with backup teams, storage-based backups, restores, replication, and recovery activities.

• Perform capacity planning and forecasting, monitor storage growth, identify capacity risks, and recommend expansion or optimization.

• Manage storage firmware, controller updates, disk firmware, patches, and lifecycle activities per vendor recommendations and change-management procedures.

• Troubleshoot and resolve storage, SAN, host connectivity, multipathing, disk, controller, and performance-related incidents.

• Analyze storage alerts and logs, and proactively identify hardware failures, degraded components, capacity issues, and performance anomalies.

• Coordinate with HPE/OEM support teams and vendors for hardware failures, replacement of faulty components, firmware issues, and critical technical escalations.

• Maintain accurate storage configuration documentation, SAN diagrams, LUN allocation records, capacity reports, asset information, and operational SOPs.

• Ensure storage configurations follow security, availability, redundancy, and businesscontinuity requirements.

• Participate in storage migration, data migration, technology refresh, storage expansion, and infrastructure upgrade projects.

• Support virtualization environments such as VMware, Hyper-V, and KVM from a storage perspective, including datastore/LUN provisioning and troubleshooting.

• Work closely with Windows, Linux, VMware, Network, Database, Backup, Application, and Security teams to resolve end-to-end infrastructure issues.

• Participate in incident, problem, change, and service-request management, including RCA for recurring or critical storage incidents.

• Ensure appropriate high availability, redundancy, replication, and disaster-recovery configurations are maintained and periodically validated.

• Conduct and support DR drills, failover/failback activities, storage replication testing, and recovery validation as required.

• Ensure compliance with defined storage operational standards, security policies, and backup/retention requirements.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• 3–7 years of experience as a Windows, Linux, Storage, or Infrastructure Administrator.

• Certification in Microsoft (e.g., MCSA, MCSE) and/or Linux (e.g., RHCSA, RHCE, LFCS) is preferred.

• Hands-on experience with HPE 3PAR / Primera / Alletra storage.

• Knowledge of HPE Smart Array controllers.

• Strong knowledge of SAN/NAS, Fibre Channel, LUNs, RAID, storage pools, snapshots, replication, and multipathing.

• Strong knowledge of system internals, boot processes, file systems, and storage management.

• Experience with LVM, NFS, filesystem management, permissions, and Linux troubleshooting.

• Understanding of IT security practices and tools (antivirus, firewalls, patching). Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working in 24x7 production / data-center environments.

• OEM/vendor certification in HPE Storage or equivalent is an advantage. Soft Skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Effective communication and collaboration across teams.

• Self-motivated, with a proactive approach to system improvements.

• Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.

• Ability to handle critical infrastructure incidents and coordinate with multiple technical teams.

**Additional Technical Expertise — NVIDIA GPU Virtualization**

• Hands-on experience with NVIDIA GPU virtualization technologies (vGPU) on both Windows and Linux platforms.

• Install and configure NVIDIA drivers and licensing for virtual GPU use.

• Manage GPU resources for virtual desktops (VDI) and high-performance workloads in VMware, Hyper-V, or KVM environments.

• Optimize performance and troubleshoot GPU passthrough or shared configurations in enterprise virtual environments.

• Ensure compliance with NVIDIA licensing and compatibility matrices.

**Job Profile:**

Familiarity with Databricks and ClickHouse is a strong advantage.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. INFRASTRUCTURE & WORKSPACE MANAGEMENT**

* Set up and manage workspaces, storage buckets, networking, and lifecycle configurations.

* Manage role assignments and keep IAM and SSO configurations in sync.

* Streamline deployment workflows for platform assets across environments.
* Maintain CI/CD pipelines for configuration changes — repeatable and auditable.

* Implement monitoring and alerting for cluster health, job status, and platform reliability.
* Proactively identify and resolve platform incidents and bottlenecks.
* Define SLOs and dashboards for observability into platform performance.

**5. FINANCIAL REPORTING & COST MANAGEMENT**

* Generate billing and cost reports, tracking consumption and cost allocation by team or project.
* Monitor cost impact of platform changes and communicate trends to stakeholders.
* Identify and implement cost optimisation opportunities.

* Manage data ingestion pipelines and permission configurations for source systems.
* Support and onboard internal data consumers and engineering teams.
* Collaborate with data engineers and analysts to resolve access and workflow issues.

description:

Full time

title: Senior System Engineer
description:
VergeCloud is looking for a hands-on System Engineer to work on the core of our CDN and edge infrastructure platform. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys building high-performance, low-latency, secure systems close to the network, operating system, and runtime layer.

You will contribute directly to VergeCloud’s CDN core, including request processing, caching, reverse proxying, traffic routing, TLS handling, DNS integration, observability, WAF, rate limiting, bot mitigation, and DDoS protection capabilities.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable writing production-grade Rust code and working with distributed infrastructure that handles high-volume internet traffic across edge locations.

Key responsibilities include:

* Develop and maintain CDN core services using Rust.
* Build high-performance caching, proxying, routing, and traffic management components.
* Work on HTTP, HTTPS, TLS, TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, and edge networking systems.
* Improve CDN performance, reliability, scalability, and resource efficiency.
* Contribute to WAF, rate limiting, bot mitigation, and DDoS protection features.
* Debug production issues across CDN edge nodes, origin connectivity, cache behavior, DNS, TLS, and network paths.
* Work closely with SRE, security, and platform teams to build reliable edge infrastructure.

Requirements
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, or backend engineering.
* Strong production-level programming experience in
  **Rust or C**
  .
* Strong understanding of Linux systems, networking, processes, memory, filesystems, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Deep knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP, HTTPS, TLS/SSL, and DNS.
* Experience building high-performance, concurrent, asynchronous, or event-driven systems.
* Understanding of caching, reverse proxying, load balancing, request routing, and traffic management.
* Experience debugging complex production issues across application, network, operating system, and infrastructure layers.
* Good understanding of distributed systems, high availability, fault tolerance, and scalable service design.
* Experience with logs, metrics, tracing, monitoring, and production observability.

Preferred skills:

* Experience with CDN, edge computing, WAF, API gateway, reverse proxy, load balancer, or DDoS protection platforms.
* Familiarity with Tokio or other async Rust runtimes.
* Knowledge of NGINX, Envoy, HAProxy, Varnish, OpenResty, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of BGP, Anycast, traffic engineering, and global routing.
* Experience with eBPF, XDP, DPDK, or kernel-level networking.
* Familiarity with Kafka, ClickHouse, Redis, object storage, and large-scale log pipelines.
* Understanding of OWASP CRS, ModSecurity concepts, bot mitigation, rate limiting, and API security.
* Exposure to WebAssembly, V8, or edge function runtimes.

Benefits
  
  

* Opportunity to work on the core technology of a deep-tech edge cloud platform.
* Build CDN, DNS, WAF, DDoS protection, video delivery, and edge computing infrastructure from India for global customers.
* High ownership role with direct impact on platform architecture, performance, reliability, and security.
* Work on challenging systems engineering problems involving Rust, Linux, networking, distributed systems, and high-scale traffic.
* Collaborate with a strong technical team across platform engineering, SRE, security, and product.
* Exposure to production-scale internet infrastructure, edge networking, caching, traffic routing, and security systems.
* Opportunity to grow into senior engineering, platform architecture, or infrastructure leadership roles.
* Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
* On-site collaboration in Bangalore with a fast-moving engineering team.

title: Digital Workplace Operations Lead
description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
As an Advisor, Operations Lead within the Digital Workplace team, you will serve as a senior individual contributor responsible for the operational health, governance, and continuous improvement of Cargill's endpoint and collaboration environment. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution — you will translate roadmap priorities into operationally sound, day-to-day practices while acting as a trusted subject matter expert across engineering teams, business stakeholders, and global service partners.
  
  
You will bring structure to complexity, data to decisions, and clarity to a fast-moving transformation — all without direct reports, but with significant influence across the teams and leaders you partner with.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Operational Excellence

+ Own and improve Digital Workplace operations, covering device lifecycle, provisioning, depot management, endpoint governance, and collaboration platforms.
+ Track KPIs and SLAs, identify risks, and drive improvements with cross-functional teams.
+ Maintain standardized procedures and act as an escalation point, ensuring timely, accountable resolution of complex operational issues across stakeholders.

* Collaboration Platform Governance

+ Support governance of the Microsoft 365 environment, including SharePoint permissions, OneDrive, Teams lifecycle, and security groups.
+ Collaborate with Security and IAM teams to ensure data protection and access control.
+ Drive attestation, automation, and audits, while aligning with Entra ID and HR systems to ensure accurate, compliant access governance.

* Governance & Compliance

+ Support the design and execution of governance frameworks for endpoint access, device compliance, collaboration platform policies, and Digital Workplace standards in alignment with Cargill's security and IT requirements.
+ Partner with Information Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure operational practices meet internal policy and external regulatory requirements across a global footprint.

* Program & Stakeholder Support

+ Collaborate with program teams to ensure operational readiness and seamless transition to steady-state operations.
+ Advise leadership with data-driven insights on service health and transformation progress.
+ Engage stakeholders and end users to gather feedback, drive change, and promote adoption of modern workplace tools across a global workforce.

* Continuous Improvement

+ Lead operational improvement initiatives using structured problem-solving to enhance efficiency and service quality.
+ Identify and implement automation opportunities across workflows in partnership with engineering teams.
+ Stay updated on Microsoft 365, Nexthink, and PCaaS trends, translating emerging capabilities into actionable operational recommendations for leadership.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field — or equivalent work experience.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT operations, Digital Workplace, or endpoint management in a large enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing device lifecycle, provisioning processes, and endpoint governance at scale (10,000+ devices preferred).
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 platform operations, including SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Exchange/mail governance.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to synthesize operational data into actionable insights and executive-ready communications.
* Proven ability to work effectively across matrixed, global organizations and manage multiple priorities without direct authority.
* Experience with ITSM frameworks (ITIL or equivalent) and operational reporting tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, Windows 365 (W365), Entra ID (Azure AD), and/or Nexthink.
* Familiarity with PCaaS (PC as a Service) operating models and global vendor management.
* Experience designing or operating SharePoint permissions governance programs, including oversharing remediation, attestation workflows, and automated access controls.
* Experience supporting large-scale technology transformation programs, particularly mid-flight rather than greenfield.
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent.
* Microsoft 365 certifications (e.g., MS-700, MS-900, or equivalent) a plus.
* Demonstrated experience with process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent).

**Competencies for Success**

* Operational Rigor — You bring discipline and structure to ambiguous environments, translating strategy into repeatable, scalable processes that hold up across a global, multi-industry organization.
* Stakeholder Influence — As a senior IC, you earn trust and drive alignment without formal authority, communicating clearly across engineering teams, business leaders, and end users alike.
* Breadth & Curiosity — You're comfortable owning both device operations and collaboration platform governance — and you actively seek to connect the dots between them.
* Ownership Mindset — You take accountability for outcomes, follow through on commitments, and proactively surface issues before they become problems.
* Data-Driven Thinking — You use metrics and evidence to drive decisions, tell compelling stories, and demonstrate operational value to leadership.

**Group Summary**
Magna is more than one of the world’s largest suppliers in the automotive space. We are a mobility technology company built to innovate, with a global, entrepreneurial-minded team. With 65+ years of expertise, our ecosystem of interconnected products combined with our complete vehicle expertise uniquely positions us to advance mobility in an expanded transportation landscape.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
Magna IT is looking for a Senior System Engineer with a strong focus on building and operating a centralized Intune Data Warehouse and establishing reliable device compliance monitoring at scale. This role takes end-to-end ownership for the solution design, implementation, operational stability, and continuous improvement of the reporting and compliance monitoring service. Responsibilities include integrating multiple data sources (e.g., Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, Matrix42 ITSM database, Nexthink) into a central database, defining data standards and quality controls, and enabling customized queries and Power BI dashboards for operational and management reporting. In close collaboration with MIT colleagues and Divisional IT, the position drives compliance governance, proactively identifies trends and risks, and leads remediation activities to restore and sustain device compliance.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, implementation and operation of a centralized data platform for Modern Workplace reporting (Intune Data Warehouse as core, plus additional sources as required), including architecture decisions and long-term roadmap
* Design robust integration patterns and harmonize data from Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, Matrix42 ITSM DB, Nexthink and other relevant systems into a central database (ETL/ELT), ensuring scalability and maintainability
