* Build and govern Power BI semantic models, datasets and dashboards (KPI definitions, refresh strategy, access management/RLS, documentation) for different stakeholder groups
* Own device compliance monitoring and governance (e.g., free disk space, BitLocker status, anti-virus, M365 Apps versions, patch/health indicators) across all Intune managed devices; define thresholds, metrics, and reporting standards
* Lead cross-team remediation with MIT and Divisional IT to restore compliance (runbooks, escalation paths, root cause analysis, follow-up, and reporting), driving measurable improvements
* Establish data governance and quality management (data definitions, validation checks, documentation, lineage, and auditability of metrics)
* Act as technical lead for reporting, automation and compliance monitoring topics (2nd/3rd level), advise stakeholders, and mentor colleagues on best practices
* Participation in on-call rotation for the reporting/compliance monitoring service (as required) including incident triage and coordination of problem resolution

**Knowledge and Education**

* Preferably Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a relevant field.

**Work Experience And Skills**

* 5+ years of experience in endpoint management analytics / reporting and/or data integration in an enterprise environment (Intune strongly preferred)
* Expert-level SQL skills (data modeling, query optimization, indexing principles, troubleshooting performance issues; building views/stored procedures is a plus)
* Advanced experience with Microsoft Graph API and Entra ID (device/identity objects, permissions, app registrations, authentication flows, least-privilege design)

* Strong Power BI skills (semantic data modeling, DAX, performance optimization, dashboard design, row-level security, and governance/lifecycle management)
* Strong scripting/automation skills in PowerShell and/or Python (APIs, scheduling, logging, error handling) with focus on maintainability (modular code, documentation, testing mindset)

* Deep understanding of endpoint compliance concepts and telemetry and how to operationalize them (KPIs, alerting, remediation workflows; e.g., Intune compliance, BitLocker, AV/Defender signals, application versioning, device health indicators; Nexthink is a plus)

description:

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.
  
  
As a Senior Technical Support Engineer, you will be tasked with handling incoming customer cases submitted through the support portal, actively managing the inbound support queue, and providing real-time assistance via inbound customer chat. This role requires strong Linux and cybersecurity fundamentals along with working knowledge of cloud environments to troubleshoot and resolve customer issues efficiently while delivering a high-quality support experience.
  
  
This role requires working shift-based schedules to ensure coverage of the inbound queue and customer chat.
  
  
What Will You Do?
  
  
Primary responsibilities include:
  
  

* Monitor and respond to incoming customer cases submitted through the support portal within defined SLA targets.
* Log in to and actively manage the inbound support queue, picking up and triaging new cases as they arrive.
* Be available and responsive on inbound customer chat to provide real-time technical assistance and guidance.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across endpoint, cloud, and cybersecurity-related product areas.
* Accurately document case details, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions in the case management system.
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to senior engineers or relevant teams while retaining case ownership and customer communication.
* Identify recurring issues and contribute to knowledge base articles to support team efficiency and self-service.
* Maintain professional, clear, and courteous communication with customers across chat and case correspondence.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?
  
  
Ideal candidates will have:
  
  

* Strong working knowledge of Linux operating systems, including administration, command line, and troubleshooting.
* Solid understanding of cybersecurity concepts and practices (endpoint security, threat detection, incident response fundamentals).
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms and cloud security concepts, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* 4 or more years of experience in cybersecurity or a related technical field, or demonstrated strong Linux expertise in place of formal cybersecurity experience.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to customers.
* Ability to manage competing priorities across queue monitoring, live chat, and case work in a fast-paced environment.
* Prior experience with SentinelOne or similar EDR/XDR and endpoint security platforms is preferred.
* Relevant certifications, such as CompTIA Security+, Linux+/RHCSA, or a cloud provider certification, are preferred.
* Previous experience in a customer-facing technical support or helpdesk role is preferred.

Why SentinelOne?
  
  
AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

title: Senior Principal Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Cloud Platform team owns the production inferencing service that serves SambaNova's models to customers on RDU accelerators, including capacity planning, deployment, monitoring, and incident response across regions in the United States, Asia, Europe, and Latin America.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Principal Cloud Platform Engineer you'll keep our AI inferencing platform reliable, fast, and scalable. Your focus is uptime, latency, and resource utilization on the inference endpoints customers depend on. The work spans monitoring, deployment, capacity planning, and incident response, and includes a shared on-call rotation covering 24/7 coverage.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Owning the availability, latency, and efficiency of the production inferencing service, including change management, emergency response, and standing up AI infrastructure in new regions
* Building and maintaining monitoring, alerting, and dashboards in Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog covering service health, model latency and throughput, and RDU utilization
* Leading incident response, running blameless post-mortems, and automating the toil those incidents expose
* Finding and fixing performance bottlenecks, and designing auto-scaling policies that handle variable inference load without overspending
* Managing cloud and on-prem infrastructure as code in Terraform and Ansible, and building the CI/CD pipelines that deploy new model versions and service updates

**Required Qualifications**

* B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 3+ years in a Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or related role supporting a large-scale, customer-facing service in a public cloud environment (AWS, GCP, Azure)
* Strong programming and scripting skills in Python, Go, or Java
* Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes
* Deep understanding of monitoring and observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or the ELK Stack
* Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform or CloudFormation
* Experience with CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or ArgoCD
* Strong Linux system administration fundamentals

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a hybrid environment spanning cloud and on-premise data center infrastructure
* Experience supporting ML or AI inferencing services in production
* Familiarity with GPU-accelerated computing and optimizing workloads for NVIDIA GPUs, for purposes of mapping to RDUs
* Knowledge of model serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, or Ray
* Experience managing and tuning databases (SQL or NoSQL) and caching systems such as Redis or Memcached

Base Pay Range
  
  
₹8,900,000—₹10,800,000 INR

The Senior Mobility Telecom, Network Operations & Major Incident Lead will provide end-to-end technical and operational leadership for a global retail telecom and network environment supporting Mobility and E-Mobility services.
  
  
The role will act as a senior technical authority and operational integrator across internal support teams, network and telecom suppliers, application teams, service providers, business stakeholders and incident-management functions. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining network stability, leading the resolution of complex incidents, coordinating major incidents, overseeing infrastructure changes, driving root-cause analysis and improving the overall reliability, security and performance of the service.
  
  
The role requires strong ownership across a highly integrated support landscape where telecom, network, payment, loyalty, site systems and central applications cannot be managed as isolated service components.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Accountabilities**
**1. Global Telecom and Network Operations**

* Provide senior technical and operational leadership for global Mobility and E-Mobility telecom infrastructure.
* Maintain end-to-end oversight of network connectivity and associated infrastructure across retail sites, backbone services, data centres, third-party networks and externally managed connectivity services.
* Monitor the health, availability, performance and security of the telecom environment using enterprise and vendor monitoring platforms.
* Analyse monitoring alerts, operational events and service degradation indicators to determine business impact and initiate the appropriate response.
* Ensure incidents affecting routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN tunnels and associated connectivity components are correctly triaged and assigned.
* Maintain ownership of complex operational issues until resolution or until a complete and formally accepted handover has been performed.
* Support a global, follow-the-sun operating model, including participation in on-call, weekend and public-holiday support arrangements.
* Provide technical guidance to operations teams handling site-level, multi-site and infrastructure-wide disruptions.

The contract identifies global telecom monitoring, real-time infrastructure visibility, incident notification and escalation as core components of the service. It also covers routers, switches, firewalls, VPN tunnels, load balancers, backbone infrastructure and vendor-managed telecom services.
  
  

* Incident and Major Incident Management
* Lead the technical response for high-impact single-site, multi-site and global service incidents.
* Coordinate incident bridges involving network suppliers, telecom providers, application teams, site-support teams, service managers and business stakeholders.
* Perform initial and advanced technical triage to establish incident scope, affected services, market impact, urgency and priority.
* Ensure incidents contain sufficient diagnostic and business-impact information before escalation.
* Coordinate the creation and progression of incident and major-incident records in the relevant service-management platform.
* Manage P3 and P4 major incidents and support the designated incident-command function during P1 and P2 major incidents.
* Establish clear ownership across resolver groups and ensure suppliers engage within their contractual responsibilities.
* Schedule and lead technical calls when required to accelerate investigation and recovery.
* Maintain an accurate incident chronology, including decisions, actions, ownership, dependencies and restoration progress.
* Confirm service restoration through monitoring tools, resolver-group evidence or confirmation from the reporting party before closure.
* Ensure incident, recovery and closure communications are distributed to the appropriate internal and external stakeholders.
* Support incident managers by translating complex technical findings into clear operational and business-impact statements.

The scope requires first-level incident management, major incident management, prioritisation, ticket creation, supplier escalation, technical-call coordination, service-restoration confirmation and communications throughout the incident lifecycle.
  
  

* Advanced Troubleshooting and Technical Investigation
* Lead technical investigation of complex, recurring or high-impact telecom and network issues.
* Perform full-stack troubleshooting across the network path, including routing, switching, firewall policies, VPN connectivity, traffic flows, network security controls and dependent services.
* Use packet-capture and network-analysis tools to isolate faults at packet and protocol level.
* Analyse network traffic, device events, application logs, site-system logs and monitoring data to identify hard-to-detect issues.
* Develop and test technical hypotheses using available operational evidence.
* Coordinate cross-supplier troubleshooting where ownership or fault location is unclear.
* Determine whether failures originate within site infrastructure, telecom connectivity, network backbone, security services, vendor platforms, application services or third-party interfaces.
* Produce clear technical findings, recommended remediation actions and risk assessments.
* Provide technical direction to less-experienced engineers and operations analysts during critical incidents.

The contract specifically requires advanced troubleshooting, traffic analysis, packet-level investigation, knowledge of multiple routing protocols, network design expertise and analysis of site-system and application logs.
  
  

* Root-Cause and Problem Management
* Lead Root Cause Analysis for significant telecom, network and third-party incidents.
* Ensure root-cause documentation clearly describes the failure, contributing factors, business impact, recovery actions and preventive measures.
* Challenge incomplete or unsupported root-cause statements provided by suppliers.
* Track corrective and preventive actions through to verified completion.
* Raise and coordinate problem records for recurring or systemic issues.
* Use incident trends, operational data and recurring alert patterns to identify candidates for problem management.
* Facilitate technical reviews involving internal teams and external service providers.
* Ensure RCA documentation is completed within applicable operational timelines.
* Maintain traceability between incidents, problems, known errors, changes and improvement activities.
* Share lessons learned and incorporate agreed improvements into support procedures, monitoring rules and operational documentation.

The SWAT scope assigns responsibility for RCA leadership, documentation completion, supplier engagement, root-cause validation and accountability. The administrative support scope also includes problem management for supported operational platforms.
  
  

* Change, Migration and Implementation Support
* Assess telecom and network changes for technical risk, operational impact and business impact.
* Coordinate network changes, migrations and implementations with suppliers and delivery teams.
* Evaluate third-party changes that may affect Mobility services.
* Ensure relevant stakeholders review and approve changes before implementation.
* Create and distribute change notifications to internal and external stakeholders.
* Monitor the implementation of high-risk or business-critical changes.
* Coordinate technical support during change implementation and post-change validation.
* Verify that changes achieve the intended outcome without creating unacceptable service degradation.
* Support recovery or rollback activities when a change is unsuccessful.
* Ensure network, firewall, configuration, support and operational documentation is updated following implementation.
* Review project implementation plans for operational readiness, supportability and alignment with the existing environment.

The contract includes change coordination, third-party change-impact assessment, stakeholder approval, Change Notification Letters, implementation monitoring and technical support for network changes and migrations.
  
  

* Network Architecture and Design Assurance
* Act as a senior technical authority for the end-to-end Mobility telecom and network architecture.
* Review solution and network designs for reliability, availability, security, scalability, operability and supportability.
* Provide technical recommendations to project and delivery teams.
* Assess proposed changes against the existing telecom environment and relevant service dependencies.
* Architect, review or approve network designs within the candidate’s delegated authority.
* Identify operational risks, integration gaps, monitoring requirements and support-model deficiencies before production deployment.
* Ensure designs include appropriate diagnostic, failover, security, documentation and operational-support provisions.
* Support implementation teams during deployment, transition and early-life support.
* Ensure integration requirements across multiple suppliers and business partners are understood and coordinated.
* Promote standardisation and reduction of unnecessary technical complexity across the network landscape.

The SWAT team is defined as responsible for end-to-end technical architecture, multi-supplier process integration, project-impact assessment, technical recommendations, design review or approval and implementation support.
  
  

* Firewall, Security and Access Governance
* Provide senior oversight of firewall rules supporting the Mobility environment.
* Review firewall-rule changes for technical validity, security risk, business justification and implementation impact.
* Ensure access and infrastructure requests follow the required approval and governance processes.
* Review and manage third-party access requests relating to infrastructure, data-centre or service-support activities.
* Support access-control processes and periodic access reviews for relevant operational platforms.
* Coordinate with security, risk, infrastructure and supplier teams to resolve security-related network issues.
* Support compliance activities associated with Information Risk Management and Payment Card Industry requirements.
* Maintain appropriate records and technical documentation to support audit and compliance activities.
* Escalate non-compliance, uncontrolled access, unsupported connectivity or material security risks to the relevant stakeholders.
* Balance operational recovery requirements with security and access-control obligations during critical incidents.

The contract includes ownership of a significant portion of the firewall rule sets, third-party access management, infrastructure change requests and support for Information Risk Management and PCI compliance activities.
  
  

* Supplier and Stakeholder Management
* Act as the senior technical liaison between internal teams, business stakeholders, telecom providers, technology suppliers and third-party service providers.
* Establish clear technical and operational ownership across multi-supplier incidents.
* Hold suppliers accountable for investigation quality, contractual service obligations, recovery actions and root-cause deliverables.
* Escalate supplier-performance concerns through the appropriate operational and commercial channels.
* Obtain technical evidence from suppliers following incidents and changes.
* Challenge delays, unsupported conclusions and incomplete remediation plans.
* Coordinate dependencies between connectivity providers, managed-service suppliers, application teams and site-support teams.
* Provide concise updates to service management and business leadership.
* Maintain professional working relationships across geographically distributed and culturally diverse teams.
* Represent the telecom and network operations function in service reviews, project meetings, change reviews, incident reviews and technical governance forums.

The role descriptions require working across international teams, leading meetings, coordinating internal and external support entities and ensuring suppliers and vendors perform as required under their contracts.
  
  

* Monitoring and Service Improvement
* Drive proactive monitoring and early identification of telecom and service degradation.
* Review alerts, dashboards, thresholds and escalation paths to improve incident detection and response quality.
* Identify monitoring gaps across network, site, application and third-party services.
* Work with monitoring-service owners and suppliers to implement actionable alerts.
* Reduce alert noise, duplicate notifications and non-actionable events.
* Use operational data to identify reliability, performance and service-improvement opportunities.
* Lead network optimisation and continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Recommend automation opportunities for repetitive triage, notification, reporting and evidence-gathering activities.
* Track the effectiveness of implemented improvements through operational measures and incident trends.
* Ensure monitoring procedures remain aligned with changes to technology, business services and supplier arrangements.

The scope references proactive monitoring through tools and vendors, operational-data analysis, corrective actions, network optimisation and continuous service improvement.
  
  

* Documentation and Operational Readiness
* Create, maintain and continuously improve end-to-end technical and operational documentation.
* Develop network diagrams, support procedures, troubleshooting guides, escalation matrices, process flows and incident-response playbooks.
* Maintain accurate records of network circuits, racks, devices, configurations, inventory, contacts and service dependencies where applicable.
* Ensure documentation supports rapid triage within demanding incident-response timelines.
* Review project support models, support decks and operational-readiness documentation.
* Validate that new services have complete monitoring, ticketing, access, contact, escalation and Minimum Data Set information before operational handover.
* Establish documentation standards and quality controls for the support organisation.
* Conduct periodic reviews to identify outdated business-critical information.
* Ensure changes to applications, infrastructure, suppliers and contacts are reflected promptly in operational documentation.
* Train team members in the effective use of documentation and service-management tools.

The contract requires standardised network and process documentation, project-onboarding documentation, escalation information, support-model review, and maintenance of network infrastructure and inventory records.
  
  

* Team Leadership and Capability Development
* Provide technical leadership, coaching and guidance to network engineers, incident analysts and operations personnel.
* Define expected quality standards for incident handling, communications, ticket updates, documentation and technical investigation.
* Review the quality of team deliverables and provide constructive feedback.
* Lead technical knowledge-sharing sessions and post-incident learning reviews.
* Develop team capability in troubleshooting, service management, network analysis and stakeholder communication.
* Support workload prioritisation during periods of high incident demand.
* Delegate activities based on risk, complexity, urgency and engineer capability.
* Encourage ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement across integrated support teams.
* Act as an escalation point for technical, process and supplier-related issues.
* Support service leadership with resource planning, operational reporting and resolution of day-to-day delivery concerns.

The contract’s supervisor and service-manager descriptions include team guidance, delivery standards, training, workload management, status reporting, process development and escalation of critical issues.
  
  

* Reporting and Executive Communication
* Prepare monthly service reports covering incidents, recurring issues, improvement activities, technical achievements, risks and upcoming changes.
* Communicate the value delivered by the telecom and network operations team.
* Provide clear updates during high-impact incidents without unnecessary technical jargon.
* Produce technical call summaries, incident recaps, change notices and stakeholder notifications.
* Translate technical events into business-impact statements suitable for senior stakeholders.
* Report material operational risks and unresolved supplier dependencies.
* Ensure reports are accurate, evidence-based and suitable for governance review.
* Maintain action logs and follow up outstanding commitments with internal teams and suppliers.

Monthly reporting of achievements, value-added contributions and upcoming Mobility activities is explicitly included in the SWAT responsibilities. Incident, major-incident and change communications are also included throughout the support scope
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Education and Certifications**
**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Electronics, Engineering or an equivalent technical discipline.
* Equivalent significant professional experience may be considered where permitted by the organisation’s recruitment policy.

**Preferred**

* Cisco professional-level certification or comparable enterprise networking certification.
* ITIL Foundation or higher mandatory.
* Network-security or firewall certification.
* Cloud networking certification.
* Project management or Agile delivery certification.

The source identifies professional certifications as advantageous but does not mandate a specific certification.
  
  
**About Us**
At Zensar, we’re
*“experience-led everything”*
. We are committed to conceptualizing, designing, engineering, marketing, and managing digital solutions and experiences for over 130 leading enterprises. We are a company driven by a bold purpose:
*Together, we shape experiences for better futures*
. Whether for our clients, our people, or the world around us, this belief powers everything we do. At the heart of our culture is
*ONE with Client*
- a set of four core values that reflect who we are and how we work:
*One Zensar, Nurturing, Empowering, and Client Focus*
.
  
  
Part of the $4.8 billion RPG Group, we’re a community of 10,000+ innovators across 30+ global locations, including Milpitas, Seattle, Princeton, Cape Town, London, Zurich, Singapore, and Mexico City. Explore Life at Zensar and join us to Grow. Own. Achieve. Learn. to be the best version of yourself.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when individuality is celebrated, growth is encouraged, and well-being is prioritized. We are an equal employment opportunity (EEO) and affirmative action employer, committed to creating an inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, marital status, family medical leave status, or protected veteran status.

title: Designated Support Engineer III
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a Designated Support Engineer III to join our team in a hybrid capacity based in Bangalore, reporting to the Manager, Global Focal Support within our Support department. You will function as the highest level of technical support within the TAC, responsible for resolving the most complex and critical issues escalated from Level I and Level II support engineers.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**

* Provide second line phone/email consultation to independently debug complex security/network problems
* Interface with Engineering and assist the customer with testing or troubleshooting
* Reproduce customer issues to verify problems and provide feedback to Engineering and Operations teams
* Create entries in our technical support online database to accurately document any incident resolution that is not found in our knowledge base
* Understand the product direction and customer use-cases and provide input on product and code changes through all points of the product cycle

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. You adapt to what’s needed, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
* You are a problem-solver. You seek out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are customer-obsessed. You build deep empathy for the customer—both internal and external—and anchor your decisions in solving their real-world problems. You champion their needs from start to finish, knowing their success is our success.
* You operate with urgency. You understand that in a high-growth environment, speed and quality are not mutually exclusive. You have a relentless focus on execution and a bias for action, delivering high-impact results quickly to win for the customer and the team.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
* 5+ years of support and networking experience, including general firewalls and packet filtering troubleshooting
* Proficient in using Wireshark, Fiddler, MTR, and traceroute to analyze network and application protocols, isolate faults, diagnose packet loss, and resolve unexpected session resets.
* Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting GRE and IPSec VPN tunnels, combined with leveraging PAC files to optimize network pathing and traffic flow
* Deep expertise in enterprise authentication (SAML, Kerberos), application-layer mechanics (HTTP methods), IPv4/IPv6 routing, and DNS administration

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Demonstrate a proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
* Prior knowledge of Forward Proxy and cloud environments like AWS and Azure
* Direct experience working in Firewall and VPN/Zero Trust environments

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.
  
  
**Benefits**
Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:
  
  

* Various health plans
* Time off plans for vacation and sick time
* Parental leave options
* Retirement options
* Education reimbursement
* In-office perks, and more!

Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here.
  
  
By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.
  
  
Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

*link.*
Pay Transparency
  
  
Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules.

title: Customer Support Engineer
description:
**Customer Support Engineer**

Bengaluru, India | Full-Time | Hybrid | UK Shift (2:30 PM - 11:30 PM IST)

**Who We Are**

At Hakimo, we are transforming the physical security industry with AI-powered solutions that help organizations seamlessly monitor, manage, and respond to security events. Our platform integrates advanced machine learning and analytics to modernize traditional security operations into intelligent, proactive systems.

Backed by $32M in total funding from Vertex Ventures, Zigg Capital, Neotribe Ventures, Rocketship.vc, and Carrier Ventures, Hakimo has tripled its customer base across multifamily apartments, car dealerships, construction sites and Fortune 500 enterprises.

**About the Role**

Hakimo is seeking a
***Customer Support Engineer***
to be the primary point of contact for technical inquiries, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for our customers. This individual will manage and resolve technical support cases related to the Hakimo AI SaaS platform and its integration with customer’s physical security systems. You will work closely with Engineering, Sales - AEs, CSMs teams to ensure customer satisfaction and product improvement.

A Customer Support Engineer at Hakimo is a hands-on individual with strong problem-solving skills and knowledge of networking concepts and physical security. We are looking for individuals who can match our fast-paced environment and learn quickly! You will join a team of highly motivated individuals delivering impactful results for the company using the latest cutting-edge computer vision AI technology.

**What You'll Do**

* Triage, manage, and resolve incoming technical support cases via phone, email, and chat, ensuring timely and effective resolution.
* Troubleshoot and diagnose complex technical issues related to the Hakimo AI SaaS platform, on-premise components, networking, and physical security devices (IP Cameras, NVRs, Access Control Systems).
* Document and track all customer interactions, technical issues, and resolutions in our ticketing system.
* Escalate high-priority or unresolved issues to the Product Engineering team, providing clear and detailed technical descriptions and context.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis, Short Term Fix and Long Term Fix with formal report creations.
* Create and maintain knowledge base articles, technical documentation, and FAQs to empower customers for self-service.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering to advocate for the customer and drive product improvements.
* You will be working in coordination with a US based point of contact on a daily basis.

**What You'll Bring**

* 2-4 years of experience with a Bachelor's degree in Information and Computer Technology, Cybersecurity, Networking, IT Security, Computer Engineering or related degree from an accredited university.
* Demonstrate a solid understanding of TCP/IP, UDP, TLS, DNS, HTTP, DHCP, Routers, Switches, NAT, VLANs and L2 devices.
* Understanding about IP Cameras, NVRs, Video Resolutions, ONVIF, RTSP etc.
* Functional knowledge of SaaS and Cloud environments is desired.
* Exhibit outstanding written and verbal communication skills, along with effective presentation abilities.
* Excellent account management, follow-through, and attention to detail.
* Familiarity with ticketing systems such as Zendesk or similar.
* Flexible mindset and positive attitude with a strong desire to learn.
* Experience working with IT infrastructure, Linux operating systems, Virtual Machines, APIs, HTTP Servers, VLC players etc.
* Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python, Shell etc. is a plus for troubleshooting and automation.
* Industry certifications are a plus: Network, Security, CCNA, AWS Solutions Architect, etc.

**What we offer**

* Competitive salary
* Health plans similar to large SaaS companies
* An output-first, high-trust, flexible work environment where impact matters far more than rigid hours or face time.
* A steep, compounding growth trajectory with real stakes.

title: System Admin
description:
Astrome Technologies builds wireless communication hardware for both space and terrestrial applications. We're looking for a self-motivated system administrator who enjoys open-source tooling and wants to keep the infrastructure behind that work reliable, secure, and well documented. If you want to help others and contribute to Astrome's vision, join us.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Administer the health of all computing and networking assets, including laptops, desktops, on-premises servers, remote servers, routers, switches, and other networking equipments
* Maintain high uptime for all servers and services, with monitoring and alerting in place
* Manage Ubuntu Server deployments and Linux laptops, including provisioning, patching and lifecycle management
* Support and maintain the CI/CD infrastructure, including GitHub/GitLab and Docker/Podman-based pipelines and runners
* Administer and back up SQL databases and other production data stores
* Perform periodic security audits, manage access control, and apply hardening best practices across all systems
* Maintain secure remote access to all necessary out-of-office services (VPN, SSH, etc.)
* Automate periodic tasks, updates, and provisioning wherever possible (Bash, Python, Ansible or similar)
* Document and keep current the network topology, configurations, and IP/VLAN plans
* Create, maintain, and regularly test the backup and disaster recovery policy
* Document your work, covering reasoning, outcomes, and references, so that anyone with reasonable domain knowledge can understand and reproduce it
* Coordinate with engineering and other teams to support their IT infrastructure needs
* Coordinate with vendors to procure and repair all IT-related requirements
* Manage IT infrastructure at the second office, located about 3 km from the main office, which involves occasional travel between the two sites
* Participate in field deployments of products at customer premises
* Be available for on-call duty to respond to critical incidents and outages
* Astrome reserves the right to reassign the employee to other roles as business requirements change

**Requirements**

* Must have 2-3+ years of experience
* Qualification - BSc, B.E, B.Tech or any other related field
* A very good understanding of Linux and basics of Networking & Security is a must
* Knowledge of setting up and deploying apps in AWS, GCP, Azure or DigitalOcean
* Knowledge of LXC/LXD, Podman or Docker
* Knowledge on scripting skills in Bash and Python
* Knowledge of troubleshooting and replacing part of desktops and laptops
* Basic knowledge of HTML,CSS and JS is an added advantage
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently with minimal direction from the manager

title: Senior Systems Engineer - SuccessFactor Compensation
description:
**WHO YOU ARE**

We are looking for a Senior System Engineer to join us in developing ways for IKEA to stay relevant for our customers.
  
  
Our diverse team is growing, and we would love to talk with you, if you recognize yourself in some of the following:
  
  
• Has a passion for understanding the end-to-end Compensation and Total Rewards lifecycle, combined with solid HR domain expertise.
  
• Takes a solution-focused approach and demonstrates creativity in solving problems and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  
• Shows strong ownership, proactively drives initiatives to completion, and simplifies complex processes to achieve business outcomes.
  
• Possesses a solid understanding of SuccessFactors Compensation, system integrations, interfaces, and process development.
  
• Brings hands-on experience with SuccessFactors Compensation and Employee Central (EC) modules.
  
• Works effectively across diverse teams, fostering collaboration, knowledge sharing, and collective success.
  
• Engages and manages stakeholders across HR, People & Culture, Global Business Operations, Data, Security, and external vendors to ensure seamless alignment between business and technology.
  
• Maintains a growth mindset and actively explores AI-driven opportunities to improve HR efficiency, reporting, and decision-making.
  
  
  
This is our wish list! If you don’t recognize yourself in all these points, you might still be an excellent candidate for the role.
  
  
The must-haves we see for this role is though:
  
• Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Science, Human Resources, Information Systems, or a related field.
  
• Minimum 8+ years of hands-on experience configuring and administering SAP SuccessFactors Compensation, preferably within complex multinational HCM environments.
  
• SAP SuccessFactors’ Compensation Certification is required or highly preferred.
  
• Additional experience with and certification in SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central are considered an advantage.
  
• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, with the ability to analyze, validate, and present compensation-related data effectively.
  
• Solid understanding of SAP SuccessFactors data architecture, interfaces, integrations, and data flows, including inbound and outbound integrations with third-party systems.
  
• Experience supporting compensation structures, merit planning cycles, long-term incentive processes, and related business operations.
  
• Ability to troubleshoot configuration, integration, and data quality issues while ensuring compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
  
• Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the capability to translate business requirements into scalable system solutions.
  
  
The IKEA culture and values are very much a part of our business and day-to-day work life. For you to thrive and grow with IKEA it’s important for us that you share our values! You can read more about our values and life at IKEA on our website www.ikea.com.

**A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US**

You’ll be a vital part in the transformation of IKEA into a more front-line obsessed company by ensuring that we constantly understand what our co-workers are telling us
  
  
This means that you will:
  
  
• Work within a global digital team to gather business requirements, configure, support, and enhance the SuccessFactors Compensation & Employee Central modules, while delivering effective solutions for SAP SuccessFactors integrations.
  
• Oversee and manage change requests, incidents, and enhancement activities related to SuccessFactors Compensation & Employee Central, ensuring timely resolution, system stability, and minimal impact on business operations.
  
• Collaborate closely with Global Business Operations (GBO), HR stakeholders, and country teams to review services delivered by vendors, ensuring compliance with agreed service levels, KPIs, and governance standards.

**TOGETHER AS A TEAM**

You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingkas global organisation.
  
  
• We are the Digital Compensation team within Total Rewards subdomain, dedicated to ensuring seamless system for compensation for our P&C stakeholders in the Ingka digital landscape.
  
• We are committed to providing efficient and reliable services, leveraging both our existing systems and new technologies to meet the needs of our global workforce.
  
  
IKEA has long been a global leader in home furnishing. We are proud of our vision to improve the everyday life of many people. But our industry is quickly changing, and we need to adapt to stay competitive.
  
  
We see so many opportunities for what we can accomplish and have the ambition to be a world-class team. At the same time, we believe that our work is not just about building models, but also about learning and having fun together.
  
  
We can offer you:
  
  
• Work on challenging and meaningful problems in the Compensation and HR domain, contributing to the design and evolution of future-ready processes for co-workers.
  
• Opportunity to make a global impact, influencing HR solutions across multiple countries and business units.
  
• Be part of a team of highly skilled and collaborative colleagues, with world-class expertise across diverse areas of technology.
  
• Enjoy a flexible, inclusive, and friendly work environment that supports collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.

.

The IKEA culture and values are very much a part of our business and day-to-day work life. For you to thrive and grow with IKEA it’s important for us that you share our values! You can read more about our values and life at IKEA on our website www.ikea.com.

title: Sr. Cloud Network Engineer
description:
**Who We Are:**
Aviatrix® is pioneering the Cloud Native Security Fabric — the architecture the Containment Era requires. The Cloud Native Security Fabric governs every workload communication path across every cloud, every VPC, every Kubernetes cluster, and every serverless function, from a single policy plane. One rule. Universal propagation. Enforced at the workload, not at a chokepoint. Trusted by more than 500 of the world's leading enterprises. For more information, visit aviatrix.ai
  
  
**About the role:**
As a Sr. Cloud Network Engineer, you will be a part of Aviatrix's Customer Support team. This position is a critical organization as a part of our customers’ adoption of Aviatrix's enterprise multi-cloud Networking and Security Services Software.
  
  
You'll guide our customers for quick and consistent adoption, accelerated integrations with our multi-cloud software products, and real-time support and strategy to ensure our customers are satisfied with Aviatrix's products.
  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Serve as a technical escalation point for complex customer issues involving cloud networking, connectivity, security, and performance across multi-cloud environments.
* Work closely with Sales, Solution Engineering, and Product Engineering teams to manage, troubleshoot, and resolve advanced technical issues for Aviatrix enterprise customers.
* Lead the end-to-end resolution of complex customer problems related to deployment, integration, optimization, and upgrades of Aviatrix solutions.
* Provide hands-on, production-level support, including live troubleshooting sessions, packet analysis, and root cause analysis (RCA) for critical customer incidents.
* Act as the first line of defense for high-priority and escalated cases, coordinating with Engineering and Solution Engineering teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Proactively identify, document, and report product defects, and advocate on behalf of customers to drive product quality improvements.
* Collaborate closely with Senior Engineering and Support Leads on customer-reported bugs, reproduction steps, and validation of fixes.
* Develop and maintain knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, best practices, and internal runbooks for complex scenarios.
* Provide technical feedback to leadership on recurring issues, customer pain points, and recommended improvements to product and support processes.
* Advise customers on cloud networking best practices and architectures when integrating Aviatrix with their existing cloud and on-premises environments.
* Participate in post-incident reviews, RCA discussions, and contribute to long-term preventive solutions.
* Identify and drive process improvements to enhance support efficiency, case handling quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Mentor and guide junior cloud engineers, providing technical leadership, knowledge transfer, and career development support.
* Participate in on-call rotations and provide after-hours support on a scheduled and non-scheduled basis as required.

**KEY REQUIREMENTS:**

* 5+ years of experience in customer success, technical support, resident engineer, network engineer, or similar customer-facing technical roles.
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including:
* Routing and switching
* BGP, OSPF
* TCP/IP, DNS, NAT
* IPsec VPN, SSL VPN
* Network troubleshooting and packet flow analysis
* Hands-on experience with cloud networking architectures across:
* Amazon Web Services (AWS) (VPC, TGW, ENI, routing tables, security groups)
* Microsoft Azure (VNETs, VNets peering, Azure Firewall, Load Balancers)
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (VPCs, Cloud Router, VPN, Interconnect)
* Strong experience in configuring, testing, and troubleshooting network and security products, such as:
* Cisco ISR / ASA
* Palo Alto, Check Point, Fortinet
* Juniper, Meraki
* Riverbed, Barracuda, SonicWall, Aruba, Sophos
* Solid understanding of virtualization, Linux internals, and infrastructure software.
* Experience with Python, shell scripting, and automation, including log analysis and troubleshooting automation.
* Familiarity with security concepts and products (firewalls, IPS/IDS, segmentation, zero-trust) is a strong plus.
* Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and traces to diagnose complex distributed system issues.
* Strong communication skills to explain complex technical issues clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and work effectively in a fast-paced, customer-driven environment.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.

**Benefits**
**US**
: We cover 100% of employee premiums and 88% of dependent(s) premiums for medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) match, short and long-term disability, life/AD&D insurance, $1,000/year education reimbursement, and a flexible vacation policy.
  
  
**Outside the US:**
We offer a comprehensive benefits package which, (subject to regional variations) could include pension, private medical for you and dependents, generous holiday allowance, life assurance, long-term disability, annual wellbeing stipend
  
  
Your total compensation package will be based on job-related knowledge, education, certifications and location, per our aligned ranges.
  
  
**About Aviatrix**
**Aviatrix®**
is the cloud network security company trusted by more than 500 of the world’s leading enterprises. As cloud infrastructures become more complex and costly, the Aviatrix Cloud Network Security platform gives companies back the power, control, security, and simplicity they need to modernize their cloud strategies. Aviatrix is the only secure networking solution built specifically for the cloud, that ensures companies are ready for AI and what’s next. Combined with the Aviatrix Certified Engineer (ACE) Program, the industry’s leading secure multicloud networking certification, Aviatrix unifies cloud, networking, and security teams and unlocks greater potential across any cloud.
  
  
**WE WANT TO INCLUDE YOU**
We embrace the fact that not everyone’s journey took the same route or started at the same place. If your experience doesn’t quite meet the requirements but the opportunity excites you and you believe you could be great, don’t let that hold you back from applying. The NetSuite Business Systems Analyst – Order to Cash (O2C) is a techno-functional role focused on the configuration, development, support, and optimization of Flexera’s NetSuite Order-to-Cash processes. This position serves as a key resource for designing and implementing system solutions across NetSuite, with responsibility for workflows, integrations, reporting, troubleshooting, and ongoing platform improvements.

  

The ideal candidate has a strong technical understanding of NetSuite and knows how to translate business needs into effective system configurations and enhancements. This is not an accounting role. It is a business systems position for someone who can work hands-on in NetSuite to improve automation, scalability, data quality, and operational effectiveness across the O2C cycle.

  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

NetSuite O2C & Optimization

Configure, enhance, and support NetSuite functionality across the Order-to-Cash process, including customer setup, order management, billing, collections, and revenue-related workflows.

Design, build, and maintain NetSuite configurations such as custom fields, forms, records, roles, permissions, workflows, and page layouts aligned to business requirements and internal controls.

Develop and support automation using SuiteFlow and, where applicable, SuiteScript to improve process efficiency and reduce manual work.

Optimize NetSuite modules and capabilities relevant to O2C, including SuiteBilling, Dunning, and Advanced Revenue Management.

Identify system gaps, process bottlenecks, control weaknesses, and data quality issues, and implement scalable improvements.

Support month-end and year-end close activities

  

Technical Support, Troubleshooting, and System Maintenance

Serve as a technical resource for diagnosing and resolving NetSuite issues related to O2C workflows, configurations, scripts, integrations, and transactional data.

Perform root-cause analysis on system issues and recommend durable corrective actions.

Help maintain overall system health through periodic reviews, testing, cleanup, and performance monitoring.

Perform system administration activities including user roles / permissions, configuration and ongoing platform maintenance

  

Reporting, Analytics & Integrations

Build and maintain saved searches, dashboards, and custom reports, , and other analytics to support operational visibility and business decision-making.

Support and monitor integrations between NetSuite and upstream/downstream business systems, including Salesforce and other connected platforms, using Boomi.

Troubleshoot integration issues, monitor exception handling, and help ensure reliable and accurate data flow across systems.

Document integration specifications, field mappings, technical dependencies and support procedures

  

Stakeholder Collaboration & Projects

Lead UAT, change management, and training for system enhancements and new rollouts.

Act as a key resource during internal and external audits related to O2C controls.

  

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

2-5 years of hands-on NetSuite administration or business systems analyst experience.

Demonstrated expertise with NetSuite O2C modules: Advanced Revenue, Billing, Suitebilling, and Dunning

Proficiency in NetSuite SuiteFlow, saved searches, custom records, suite analytics and reporting.

Experience managing or contributing to system integrations (Celigo, or Boomi preferred).

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a process-improvement mindset.

Strong communication skills; ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

  

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

NetSuite Administrator or SuiteFoundation certification.

Experience with Boomi and/or Celigo

SuiteScript 1.0/2.x development experience.

Prior experience in a high-growth technology or SaaS company.

Experience supporting NetSuite OneWorld multi-subsidiary environments.

title: Support Team Lead
description:
**Company Description**
Pulse Telesystems is a leading telecom solution provider in India, delivering personalized telecom services that support evolving business needs. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Chennai, the company has expanded into multiple major metropolitan cities, serving over 4,000 clients across diverse industries. Its offerings include Internet Leased Lines, VoIP Solutions, Cloud Telephony, Virtual Numbers, SIP Internet Calling, custom CRM integrations, and advanced spam monitoring and CNAM services. Pulse Telesystems is a trusted telecom partner for top enterprises such as Zoho, MGM Healthcare, Larsen & Toubro, CEAT, India Cements Ltd., and PVR Cinemas, helping them improve performance and reliability. Team members join a growing organization focused on innovation, service quality, and long-term client relationships.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly proactive, disciplined and accountable Support Shift Lead to own day-to-day support operations during an assigned shift. The person will actively monitor tickets and incidents from logging through resolution, enforce response and resolution SLAs, coordinate the team, and communicate clearly with stakeholders. This role requires a hands-on leader who follows up relentlessly, escalates risks early, maintains accurate updates, and holds the team to agreed processes and commitments.

**Key Responsibilities**

1.  Support Ticket & Incident Ownership

●      Monitor the support queue continuously and ensure every issue has a clear owner, priority, next action and target time.

●      Track tickets end-to-end—from acknowledgement and triage to troubleshooting, resolution, validation and closure.

●      Review ageing, overdue, stalled, reopened and high-priority tickets; drive action plans to prevent avoidable delays.

●      Enforce response, update and resolution SLAs; escalate potential breaches before they occur.

●      Coordinate major incidents, ensure timely technical escalation, and maintain an accurate incident timeline and handover notes.

2.  Team Leadership & Performance

●      Allocate and rebalance work based on severity, skills, workload and urgency; confirm ownership of every active issue.

●      Run shift kick-offs, periodic queue reviews and end-of-shift handovers.

●      Set clear expectations, monitor productivity and quality, and address missed commitments promptly and fairly.

●      Coach team members on troubleshooting, ticket hygiene, customer handling and escalation discipline.

●      Identify repeated performance gaps, document facts, and raise persistent issues to the Support Manager.

3.  Proactive Communication & Stakeholder Management

●      Provide timely, concise and factual updates to customers, internal teams, management and relevant stakeholders.

●      Communicate impact, current status, actions underway, blockers, ownership and the next update time—without waiting to be chased.

●      Alert stakeholders early when an issue risks breaching SLA or affecting business operations.

●      Coordinate with engineering, infrastructure, vendors and other teams until dependencies are resolved.

●      Ensure no critical issue goes silent and no shift ends without a documented handover of open risks.

4.  Process, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

●      Maintain accurate ticket records, incident notes, escalation details, workaround steps and resolution summaries.

●      Prepare shift reports covering ticket volumes, SLA performance, open/overdue incidents, major risks and follow-up owners.

●      Identify recurring incidents and recommend problem-management actions, knowledge-base updates and process improvements.

●      Follow support procedures, access controls, customer communication standards and incident-management policies.

●      Use ticketing and monitoring tools consistently; keep dashboards and operational trackers current.

Required Skills & Competencies

●      Strong ownership, urgency, discipline and follow-through; comfortable enforcing standards and holding people accountable.

●      Excellent written and verbal communication; able to provide clear updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

●      Sound incident triage, prioritisation, escalation and problem-solving skills.

●      Experience coordinating a support/helpdesk/service desk/NOC/application support team.

●      Strong organisation skills, attention to detail and confidence handling competing priorities.

●      Ability to remain calm, firm and professional during high-severity incidents or customer escalations.

●      Working knowledge of SLAs, ticket lifecycle, incident management, shift handovers and operational reporting.

Experience & Qualifications

●      Typically 3–6 years of experience in technical support, IT operations, service desk, application support or a related environment.

●      At least 1–2 years in a team-lead, shift-lead, senior support or incident-coordination capacity preferred.

●      Experience with ticketing tools such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Freshservice or similar.

●      Exposure to monitoring dashboards, SLA reports, escalation matrices and knowledge-base processes.

●      ITIL Foundation or equivalent incident/service-management training is an advantage.

Success Measures (KPIs)

●      SLA compliance for first response, stakeholder updates and resolution.

●      Reduction in overdue, ageing and unassigned tickets.

●      Quality and timeliness of incident communications and shift handovers.

●      Ticket documentation completeness and resolution quality.

●      Escalation timeliness, repeat-incident trends and customer/stakeholder feedback.

●      Team adherence to process, ownership and agreed action deadlines.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is firm but fair, highly visible in the support queue, and proactive by default. They do not wait for reminders, allow issues to drift, or accept vague status updates. They establish clear owners and deadlines, communicate risks early, verify that actions are completed, and maintain professional accountability without resorting to disrespectful or aggressive behaviour.

Application Note

* Applicants should highlight examples where they improved SLA performance, managed critical incidents, coordinated a support team, prevented escalations through proactive communication, or reduced ticket backlog.
* Please share the resume to hr@pulse.in/ samuel@pulse.in

title: Network Security Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Network Security Engineer(Zscaler)**

**Job Purpose:**

100% customer-facing position. The primary purpose is to provide day-to-day operations support of the client's security infrastructure or day-to-day monitoring, management, and response to security events.

**Essential Functions:**

75% - Perform day-to-day management of the security infrastructure within their area of expertise and/or Perform incident/event/detection response and analysis of security events in the enterprise. 10% - Participate and/or ownership of project improvement efforts including infrastructure upgrades, automation development, implementation/testing of new systems. Processes, or techniques, documentations, etc. directly related to the team's goals and effectiveness. 10% - Interact routinely with technology team leadership (i.e. senior security engineer and/or Team Lead) 5% - Assist with the documentation of procedures for security infrastructure within their area of expertise

**Position Description:**

The Network Security Engineer with Zscaler Exp (Level 2) is responsible for analyzing, designing, installing, configuring, and supporting network security infrastructure and application components.

\* Designing, deploying and supporting Zscaler Cloud based Infrastructure across various environments

\* Manage and configure ZScaler proxy devices

\* Support Zscaler Internet Access (“ZIA”) and Zscaler Private Access (“ZPA”)

\* Configure policies on Cloud Based Zscaler Proxy service in tandem with various application owners.

\* Whitelisting IP space for various Project team to access external vendors access to ensure safe and secure connectivity.

\* Work on Cisco, Checkpoint, & Palo Alto Zone based Firewalls to create Zones and Policies for various segment of the network and accordingly troubleshoot any connectivity issues thereof across various Security Zones.

\* Provides network systems Engineering support to users for: Cisco ASA, Checkpoint and Palo Alto Firewalls, F5 Big IP load Balancers.

\* Managing assigned projects and program components to deliver services in accordance with established objectives.

\* Administer web policies using Zscaler Admin Portal according to customer guidelines

\* Work with internal applications teams and design and implement appropriate network solutions

\* Provide Technical Support for issues escalated by Level 1 Operations

\* Maintain a thorough understanding of the basics behind the Internet and its workings (DNS, Security, IP Routing, HTTPS, VPN, SSL Certificates, SSL Cipher Suites.

\* Coordinates activities with other system areas and vendors, and deals with network security systems planning, upgrading, monitoring, testing and servicing.

**Experience:**

4+ years of experience as IT Security Engineer Cyber-Security Analyst, Cyber-Intelligence Analyst Security Systems Engineer Security Analyst

Wireshark, HTTP Header Traces, PAC file configuration, Fiddler

Rotational shift(24/7)

Interested candidates with short notice or immediate joiners share your updated resume @ geetha.jeyabalan@cbts.com

title: Senior Analyst - IT Infrastructure
description:
The Senior Analyst IT Infrastructure will be responsible for assisting with day-to-day IT support for local end-users while coordinating seamlessly with our global IT framework. Managing a highly technical environment of approximately 150 developers, 300 endpoints (mixed Mac and Windows), and corporate conference rooms, this role focuses on maintaining strict SLAs, elevating the customer service experience, and driving hands-on deskside support.
  
  
This is a 100% on-site, highly hands-on role designed for a professional capable of understanding complex infrastructure, working with global teams, managing asset lifecycles under local regulatory frameworks, and acting as the operational anchor for the site.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* SLA & Ticket Management: Responsible for supporting all incidents and service requests within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs), while assisting the Manager with escalations.
* Service Management Platforms: Fully understand, leverage, and demonstrate strong working knowledge of ServiceNow and Jira Service Management to track, manage, and optimize ticketing, customer-friendly support methods, and developer workflows.
* Asset & CMDB Governance: Own the local IT lifecycle from procurement to disposal. Ensure absolute integrity of the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) by meticulously tracking, auditing, and updating configurations and status changes for all local hardware and software assets.
* SEZ Regulatory Compliance: Direct and manage the movement of IT assets in strict accordance with Special Economic Zone (SEZ) regulations and STPI guidelines. Handle the end-to-end documentation for procurement, local clearances, and the formal bonding and de-bonding of infrastructure assets.
* Endpoint & Identity Governance: Execute operating system deployments, manage device compliance initiatives, and oversee identity/access management processes to ensure all local endpoints strictly align with global IT and security standards.
* Global Collaboration & Infrastructure: Partner seamlessly with IT infrastructure teams across the globe; maintain a deep understanding of corporate infrastructure architecture to ensure local systems align perfectly with global standards.
* Cross-Functional Engagement: Proactively interface with regional and global functional heads to understand local business needs, deliver technical solutions, maintain mutual expectation levels for service delivery, and manage customer satisfaction.
* Deskside & Platform Support: Provide consistent, expert-level delivery of team support services for software, hardware, and performance-related issues across a mixed environment of Microsoft Windows and Mac OSX personal computers, peripherals, and mobile devices (iOS/Android).
* AV & Collaboration Spaces: Take full hands-on ownership of corporate conference rooms, including the support of Video/Audio conferencing technologies and the physical/software integration of Shure products. Root Cause Analysis: Evaluate complex engineering issues and identify root-cause problems/solutions to prevent future service delivery quality issues.
* Global Project Support: Support the successful execution (on-time and within budget) of IT Infrastructure projects in the region, assisting with project planning and execution across varying Projects.
* Procedures & Documentation: Follow and execute internal procedures, ticketing, and escalation standards. Identify, recommend, and implement programs to advance user adoption, training, and knowledge management.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree or similar level education in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience: Minimum of 6 to 8 years of experience working in a technical infrastructure discipline (i.e. desktop support).
* Compliance & Systems Management: Direct, hands-on experience handling IT infrastructure tracking within an SEZ/STPI environment. Demonstrated experience managing device compliance, endpoint security policies, and modern identity/access management workflows (Okta or similar).
* Deployment Architecture: Proven experience handling enterprise operating system deployments (OSD) and automated provisioning tools for mixed environments (Windows & Mac).
* Engineering Alignment: Demonstrated experience providing IT service delivery and customer support in a technical, engineering, or software development center capacity.
* Technical Environment Mastery: Broad knowledge of personal computers and peripherals, latest Microsoft Windows and Mac OSX operating systems, Microsoft Office suites including Office 365, corporate Microsoft Active Directory, and Exchange environments.
* Network & Infrastructure: Solid foundational knowledge of enterprise voice and data networking (LAN/WAN) services. Core Soft Skills: Good English communication skills (written and verbal), a highly structured work style, and the ability to exercise judgment within defined practices to prioritize workload independently.
* Process Framework: Demonstrated knowledge and practical experience with the ITIL framework required.

**Who We Are**
Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.
  
  
Shure is headquartered in United States. We have more than 35 regional sales offices, engineering hubs, distribution centers and manufacturing facilities throughout the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.
  
  
Join Shure and
**Amplify Your Impact.**
Explore our unique culture and learn the key pillars that define our legacy of excellence.
  
  
**THE MIX MATTERS**
Don’t check off every box in the job requirements? No problem! We recognize that every professional journey is unique and are committed to providing an equitable candidate experience for all prospective Shure Associates. If you’re excited about this role, believe you’ve got the skills to be successful, and share our passion for creating an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible work environment, then apply!

**Key skills required:**

* Strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Intune, including device enrolment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, application deployment, endpoint security policies, remediation, troubleshooting and device lifecycle management.
* Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft SCCM/MECM, including application/package deployment, software distribution, collections, compliance, patching, client troubleshooting and operating system deployment.
* Strong understanding of Windows Endpoint engineering, including Windows 11 administration, Group Policy, registry, PowerShell-based troubleshooting and enterprise workstation configurations.
* Hands-on experience with Windows Autopilot and modern endpoint provisioning, including troubleshooting enrolment and deployment-related issues.
* Strong experience with OS deployment and workstation imaging, including task sequences, driver management, image maintenance and deployment troubleshooting.
* Strong VDI expertise, preferably across technologies such as Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) and/or VMware Horizon, with hands-on experience supporting virtual desktop environments, application delivery, profile-related issues and performance troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), device identity, authentication and integration with endpoint management technologies.
* Practical experience with PowerShell scripting and automation for endpoint administration, remediation, configuration and operational efficiency.
* Strong troubleshooting capability across endpoints, VDI, network and infrastructure dependencies, with the ability to perform structured root-cause analysis rather than only first-level desktop support.
* Working knowledge of endpoint security and compliance, including Microsoft Defender-related controls, encryption, device compliance and vulnerability/remediation processes.
* Knowledge in IT asset management and end-to-end endpoint lifecycle management, including provisioning, refreshing, secure data wiping, decommissioning and disposal.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms, with experience in incident, service request, problem and change management.
* Ability to manage complex L2/L3 escalations, including collaboration with Microsoft, Citrix, VMware, OEMs and other technology vendors where applicable.
* Experience supporting VIP and business-critical users, with the ability to diagnose complex technical issues while maintaining strong communication and responsiveness.
* Experience with technical projects and enterprise endpoint transformations, such as Intune migration, SCCM/MECM modernisation, Windows upgrades, Autopilot adoption, VDI deployment or endpoint-security initiatives.
