description:
**Job Title:**
**Assistant Manager – Infrastructure & Network Management**

**Department: Information Technology**

**Location: Gurgaon**

**Reporting to: Head of Technology**

**About the Role**

The role is responsible for managing enterprise IT infrastructure, network operations, systems administration, cloud and hosting environments, security controls, Microsoft platform administration and API integration ecosystems across multiple locations. The position will provide centralized governance while enabling effective support to distributed station-level IT teams, ensuring high availability, performance, security, scalability and operational continuity for business-critical technology services.

The ideal candidate will be a mid-to-senior level professional with 7 - 10+ years of relevant experience in complex, multi-location IT environments, preferably in aviation, logistics, ground handling, transportation, or other distributed operational industries.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Infrastructure & Server Management**

* Design, implement, administer and maintain enterprise IT infrastructure including on-premise servers, cloud infrastructure, virtualization platforms, storage, backup and related systems.
* Manage Windows and Linux server environments, including deployment, configuration, monitoring, patching, performance optimization, hardening and lifecycle management.
* Administer virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or equivalent technologies.
* Ensure server availability, capacity planning, backup readiness and operational resilience across business-critical systems.

**Network Management**

* Manage multi-OEM network infrastructure across centralized and station-level environments, including LAN, WAN, wireless, VPN, routing, switching, routers, switches, load balancers, DNS, DHCP and connectivity services.
* Monitor network health, availability, capacity and performance using enterprise monitoring and alerting tools.
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across multiple stations and coordinate timely resolution with internal teams, OEMs, service providers and vendors.
* Support network optimization initiatives to improve reliability, performance and user experience across locations.

**Cloud & Hosting**

* Administer Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud environments, including cloud resources, hosting platforms, identity integrations, monitoring and governance controls.
* Support cloud infrastructure planning, migration, optimization, high availability, backup and disaster recovery requirements.
* Ensure cloud and hosted environments are aligned with organizational security, compliance, cost and performance expectations.

**Security & Firewall Management**

* Administer firewall configurations, rule changes, access policies, VPNs and network security controls in line with organizational governance standards.
* Perform infrastructure hardening, patch management, vulnerability remediation, audit support and compliance-related activities.
* Coordinate with information security teams to implement security controls, monitor risks and support incident response for infrastructure and network environments.

**API Integration & Management**

* Manage and support enterprise integration services including REST APIs, SOAP web services, API gateways, middleware, managed file transfer, messaging platforms and event-driven integrations.
* Oversee API lifecycle activities including integration design support, deployment coordination, monitoring, performance optimization, troubleshooting and governance.
* Support secure and reliable integration between enterprise applications, operational systems, cloud platforms and third-party systems.
* Coordinate with application, security, cloud and development teams to ensure API availability, security, scalability and compliance.

**Microsoft Ecosystem Administration**

* Administer Microsoft platforms including Azure Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Intune, endpoint management, identity and access management and related policy controls.
* Support user access governance, device compliance, endpoint security policies, licensing coordination and Microsoft platform operational support.
* Ensure Microsoft ecosystem administration is aligned with enterprise security, productivity and governance requirements.

**Multi-Location Operations Support**

* Provide centralized infrastructure and network governance for distributed operations across multiple stations or business locations.
* Support station-level IT teams in troubleshooting, escalations, technology rollouts, documentation and operational issue resolution.
* Ensure standardization of infrastructure processes, monitoring, change control, compliance, documentation and support practices across locations.

**Team, Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, IT teams, OEMs, telecom service providers, cloud partners and technology vendors for operational support and project delivery.
* Manage vendor performance, service reviews, SLA adherence, escalation tracking and technology upgrade planning.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on availability, service quality, automation, risk reduction and operational efficiency.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, SOPs, inventory records, escalation matrices and operational runbooks.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* 7 - 10+ years of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, network administration, systems management, cloud operations, security controls and enterprise integration support.
* Experience in multi-location organizations with distributed IT operations and business-critical infrastructure environments.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong administration experience in Windows Server and Linux environments.
* Hands-on knowledge of virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of network technologies including LAN, WAN, routing, switching, VPN, firewalls, DNS, DHCP, load balancing and wireless infrastructure.
* Experience with multi-OEM network environments and vendor-supported technology landscapes.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience in firewall governance, network security controls, vulnerability remediation, patching and infrastructure hardening.
* Knowledge of API integrations, middleware, API gateways, REST/SOAP services, managed file transfers and messaging platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, ActiveMQ, or Azure Service Bus.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, backup, disaster recovery and troubleshooting tools.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft administration including Azure AD, Microsoft 365, Intune, identity, access, endpoint and policy management.
* Exposure to scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar tools will be an advantage.

**Functional Skills**

* Strong understanding of incident management, change management, problem management and service request fulfilment.
* Ability to develop and maintain documentation, SOPs, governance processes, audit evidence and operational controls.
* Strong troubleshooting skills in distributed, high-availability and operationally sensitive environments.
* Ability to manage priorities, escalations, dependencies and vendor deliverables in a time-bound manner.

**Preferred Experience**

* Prior experience in aviation, airport operations, ground handling, logistics, transportation, manufacturing, or other multi-location operational environments.
* Experience supporting infrastructure for mission-critical applications and 24x7 business operations.
* Experience with hybrid cloud, disaster recovery planning, infrastructure modernization, automation and technology standardization initiatives.
* Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect, CCNA, CCNP, VMware Certified Professional, ITIL Foundation, RHCSA, RHCE, or equivalent will be preferred.

**Key Competencies**

* Ownership mindset with strong accountability for infrastructure availability and operational continuity.
* Leadership capability to manage teams, vendors, escalations and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and decision-making skills.
* Clear communication and documentation skills for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a dynamic, distributed and time-sensitive operational environment.
* Proactive approach to risk identification, service improvement, security and compliance.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to partner with application, security, cloud, operations and business teams.

**Reporting Structure**

* The role will report to the Infrastructure Lead / Head of Technology.
* The role will work closely with application teams, Information security teams, station IT teams, business operations teams, service providers, OEMs and external technology partners.

**Location / Work Environment**

* The role will operate in a multi-location environment with centralized governance and distributed station-level support.
* The position may require coordination across corporate offices, operational stations, data centers, cloud environments, vendors and field IT teams.
* The candidate should be comfortable supporting business-critical operations, managing escalations and participating in planned maintenance, technology rollouts and incident response activities as required.

title: R&D Engineer 3, Software
description:
**Overview**
Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
  
  
Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Observability Engineer to design, build, and continuously improve monitoring and observability for our enterprise environment. Most of the work focuses on on-premises systems: physical servers, virtualized infrastructure, and on-prem Kubernetes clusters, along with the infrastructure layers underneath them. Some cloud use cases are also in scope. Your goal is to give system owners and business stakeholders an accurate, actionable view of the health and uptime of the systems they depend on.
  
  
You will also help shape how we apply agentic AI to observability, moving from dashboards and alerts toward intelligent triage, correlation, and assisted remediation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Architecture and Design
  
  

* Design end-to-end monitoring and observability solutions for enterprise applications running on VMs, Kubernetes, and bare-metal servers, and extend them to cloud workloads where needed.
* Define a layered monitoring strategy that covers hardware, OS, virtualization, network, storage, platform services, and applications.
* Set standards for metrics, logs, alerting, dashboards, and service health models, including SLIs and SLOs where they apply.
* Make sound architectural decisions on tool roles, data flows, retention, scalability, and high availability across the observability stack.
* Define alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability.
* Design service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers.
* Secure observability platforms and integrations through access controls, authentication, encryption, and vulnerability remediation. Maintain compliance with enterprise security standards through platform hardening, audit readiness, and regular security reviews.

Implementation
  
  

* Build and maintain monitoring with Zabbix, covering templates, discovery, triggers, proxies, and integrations.
* Design and maintain log collection, parsing, enrichment, and routing pipelines into Splunk, including forwarders, sourcetypes, field extractions, indexes, and searches.
* Contribute to metrics and visualization with Prometheus and Grafana, particularly for Kubernetes workloads and unified dashboards.
* Automate the configuration and onboarding of monitoring using infrastructure-as-code and APIs.

Agentic AI for Observability
  
  

* Design and implement AI agents that support observability workflows. Examples include alert triage and deduplication, cross-source event correlation, root-cause hypotheses, incident summarization, and runbook-driven remediation with human-in-the-loop approval.
* Integrate LLM-based agents with monitoring and logging platforms through APIs and tool protocols such as MCP.
* Define guardrails, permission boundaries, and auditability for AI-driven actions on production systems.
* Measure the real impact of these agents on operations, for example on MTTD, MTTR, alert noise, and on-call load.

Collaboration
  
  

* Work closely with system owners to understand architecture, failure modes, and dependencies, and to translate them into meaningful monitoring.
* Partner with consumers and stakeholders of those systems to define what “healthy” and “available” mean to them, and to make sure observability gives them the visibility they need.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring, and run knowledge sharing across operations, infrastructure, and development teams.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Regularly review alert quality, coverage gaps, and signal-to-noise ratio, and tune or retire monitoring accordingly.
* Use incidents and post-mortems as input to improve detection and response.
* Track the evolution of the observability toolset and the wider technology landscape.

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 7+ years in infrastructure, operations, or observability engineering, with at least 3 years focused on monitoring and observability, primarily in on-premises enterprise environments.
* Hands-on, production-level experience with Zabbix and Splunk.
* Proven experience monitoring physical servers, virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V, KVM), and Kubernetes clusters.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure layers: compute, OS (Linux and Windows), networking, storage, and the dependencies between them.
* Solid experience with log collection and processing at scale: parsing, normalization, enrichment, retention, and search optimization.
* Practical experience applying agentic AI (LLM agents, tool use, automation) to monitoring, operations, or incident management, along with a working understanding of how these systems behave and where their risks lie.
* Experience designing monitoring architecture, not only operating existing tools.
* Experience defining alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability.
* Experience designing service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers.
* Working knowledge of securing observability platforms, including access control, authentication, encryption, and hardening.
* Strong scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) and comfort working with REST APIs.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work with both technical owners and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with Prometheus (exporters, alerting rules, Alert manager, long-term storage).
* Experience with Grafana (dashboard design, multi-source visualization, alerting).
* Experience monitoring cloud workloads (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and hybrid environments.
* Software development experience, such as building integrations, tools, exporters, or services.

title: D365 Functional Consultant
description:
**Role purpose:**

Provide hands-on D365 Finance & Operations functional support and delivery capability, helping the D365 Functional Lead maintain a stable, controlled and continuously improving global finance platform.

**Working Pattern**

India-based role with regular UK/EU hours overlap for global collaboration

**Purpose and Context**

FNZ has deployed Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations as a core global finance platform. Following global go-live, the Finance Systems team is strengthening permanent in-house capability to stabilise the platform, support Finance operations, deliver controlled improvements and prepare for future modules and entity deployments.

This is a hands-on functional role reporting to the Finance Systems Functional Lead - Finance & Operations. The role holder will configure and support D365, investigate issues, translate Finance requirements into workable solutions, produce documentation and test evidence, and contribute to controlled releases and continuous improvement.

The position requires practical D365 Finance experience. It is not a coordination-only or general business analyst role. The successful candidate must be comfortable working directly in the application, partnering with Finance users and technical teams, and taking assigned work through to a documented and supportable outcome.

**Key Responsibilities**

D365 Functional Support and Configuration

* Provide hands-on functional support across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash and Bank, Fixed Assets, Expense Management, Project Accounting and Financial Reporting.
* Configure approved changes in D365 under the direction and design authority of the D365 Functional Lead.
* Analyse business requirements, current processes and system behaviour; document solution options, functional requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain accurate configuration, process and support documentation so that knowledge is retained within FNZ.

Incident, Close and Operational Support

* Investigate functional incidents and service requests, reproduce issues, identify root causes and coordinate resolution with Finance users, technical teams and vendors.
* Support month-end and year-end close activities, reconciliations and business-critical finance processing, including agreed out-of-hours support where required.
* Distinguish defects, data issues, training needs and enhancement requests, ensuring each is progressed through the appropriate support or change process.
* Contribute to the upkeep of known-error records, support procedures, knowledge articles and recurring-issue analysis.

Change, Testing and Release Delivery

* Prepare functional specifications, process flows, test scenarios, test data and expected results for approved changes.
* Execute system, integration and regression testing; support business users with user acceptance testing and evidence capture.
* Assess the impact of proposed changes on modules, integrations, reporting, data, security and financial controls.
* Support release planning, deployment readiness, post-release validation and early-life support.

Data, Integrations and Reporting

* Support finance master data, financial dimensions, posting profiles, workflows, opening balances, sub-ledger data and intercompany processing.
* Investigate functional issues affecting interfaces with banking, payments, expense, tax, consolidation and reporting platforms.
* Work with Data and Reporting teams to validate D365 outputs and support reconciliation of reports to the general ledger.
* Assist with data migration, cleansing, mapping, validation and reconciliation for future deployments and entity onboarding.

Controls, Documentation and Governance

* Follow Finance Systems governance for demand intake, design approval, environments, testing, release and production change.
* Produce clear and complete evidence for configuration changes, testing, approvals and deployments.
* Support segregation-of-duties reviews, access-control testing, ITGC evidence and audit requests relating to assigned areas.
* Escalate control, data-integrity and operational risks promptly to the D365 Functional Lead.

Continuous Improvement and Knowledge Transfer

* Identify opportunities to use standard D365 capability, simplify processes, reduce manual work and improve user experience.
* Contribute to the prioritised D365 backlog with evidence on business impact, risk, urgency and delivery effort.
* Provide guidance and knowledge transfer to Finance users and Finance Systems colleagues.
* Develop broader cross-module capability while maintaining deeper expertise in allocated functional areas.

**Required Skills and Experience**

Essential

* 5+ years of hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations / Dynamics AX functional experience, with substantial exposure to finance modules.
* Practical configuration experience in at least three core areas such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash and Bank, Fixed Assets, Expense Management or Project Accounting.
* Good understanding of Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash processes, including close, reconciliation and financial-control requirements.
* Experience creating functional requirements, solution documentation, test scripts, test evidence and user guidance.
* Experience investigating production issues and working with technical teams on integrations, data fixes and extensions.
* Experience of system, integration, regression and user acceptance testing, together with controlled release and post-deployment validation.
* Ability to work directly in D365, analyse system behaviour and progress assigned work independently within agreed design and governance standards.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to work effectively with Finance users, global colleagues and external delivery partners.
* Disciplined approach to documentation, knowledge sharing, prioritisation and escalation.

**Preferred**

* Finance or accounting qualification, or equivalent practical experience in a Finance Systems environment.
* Experience in financial services, fintech, asset servicing or another regulated, multi-entity environment.
* Knowledge of IFRS, statutory reporting, segregation of duties and ITGC requirements.
* Experience with D365 Consolidation, Treasury and Cash Management, Project Accounting, Subscription Billing or Revenue Recognition.
* Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Workiva, Azure DevOps or finance-data integrations.
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant Associate certification or equivalent evidence of current D365 Finance capability.

**Success Measures**

* Assigned incidents and service requests are investigated thoroughly, documented clearly and resolved or escalated within agreed priorities.
* Configuration and change deliverables are accurate, supportable and aligned with approved functional designs.
* Testing is comprehensive, with traceable scenarios, results, defects and evidence.
* Month-end, year-end and business-critical processing receive reliable functional support.
* Documentation and knowledge transfer reduce reliance on individual contractors and external partners.
* Continuous-improvement items deliver measurable operational, control or user-experience benefits.
* Finance stakeholders and Finance Systems colleagues experience responsive, practical and dependable support.

**Employment Terms and Ways of Working**

* Permanent, full-time appointment into FNZ Technology (India) Private Limited [legal employing entity to be confirmed by HR].
* Direct reporting line to the Finance Systems Functional Lead - Finance & Operations and integration into the global Finance Systems team.
* Standard FNZ India employment terms, benefits, leave, probation and notice provisions apply, subject to HR confirmation.

* UK/EU hours overlap is expected for regular collaboration, with flexibility around critical close, release and incident periods.
* All work must comply with FNZ information-security, data-protection, acceptable-use, change-control and records-management requirements.

title: AI Infrastructure Architect
description:
**Project Role :**
AI Infrastructure Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Architect and build custom Artificial Intelligence (AI) infrastructure/hardware solutions. Optimize AI infrastructure/hardware performance, power consumption, cost and scalability of computational stack. Advise on AI infrastructure technology and vendor evaluation, selection and full stack integration.

Large Language Models (LLMs)
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
Amazon Web Services (AWS)
  
  
**Minimum 15 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As an AI Infrastructure Architect, a typical day involves designing and constructing tailored artificial intelligence infrastructure and hardware solutions that meet organizational needs. This role requires continuous evaluation and enhancement of system performance, power efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and scalability across the computational stack. The position also includes providing expert advice on emerging AI infrastructure technologies, assessing vendor offerings, and overseeing the seamless integration of full-stack solutions to support advanced AI applications. Collaboration with various teams to align infrastructure capabilities with strategic objectives is a key aspect of daily activities.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Expected to be a SME with deep knowledge and experience.
* Should have Influencing and Advisory skills.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams.
* Lead the evaluation and selection of AI infrastructure technologies and vendors to ensure optimal alignment with project goals.
* Drive innovation by identifying opportunities to enhance infrastructure efficiency and scalability through emerging technologies.

Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Good To Have Skills: Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Strong understanding of AI infrastructure design principles including hardware optimization and computational resource management.
* Experience in performance tuning and power consumption optimization for large-scale AI systems.
* Ability to integrate complex AI hardware and software stacks to achieve scalable and cost-effective solutions.
* Familiarity with vendor evaluation processes and full-stack AI infrastructure integration.

Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have minimum 15 years of experience in Large Language Models (LLMs).
* This position is based at our Kolkata office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

* Knowledge of Oracle GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) & Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC) is highly desirable.
* Working knowledge on Peoplesoft, NetSuite, MS Dynamics and Workday would be an added advantage.
* Willing to learn and work on different ERPs and CRM solutions

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Senior Sql Database Administrator
description:
**Job Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced
**Senior SQL Server Database Administrator (DBA)**
. The role involves managing enterprise SQL Server environments, ensuring database availability and performance, handling production incidents, and maintaining database security, backup, and recovery processes.

The selected candidate will also take ownership of existing PowerShell automation scripts, troubleshoot and enhance automation workflows, and document solutions to support knowledge transfer and operational continuity.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and support enterprise SQL Server environments (2016–2025).
* Perform SQL Server installation, configuration, upgrades, patching, migration, backup, and recovery.
* Administer Always On Availability Groups and Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC).
* Troubleshoot database performance issues and optimize T-SQL queries and workloads.
* Manage database security, access controls, and routine maintenance activities.
* Take ownership of existing PowerShell automation scripts, troubleshoot issues, and enhance scripts to improve operational efficiency.
* Develop and maintain production-grade PowerShell scripts using functions, parameters, error handling, logging, and remoting.
* Build and maintain Grafana dashboards, monitoring panels, and alert rules.
* Develop Power BI reports and dashboards for operational monitoring and management reporting.
* Handle production incidents, service requests, changes, and maintenance activities within defined SLAs.
* Participate in major incident management, communicate status updates, and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
* Maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and runbooks, and conduct knowledge transfer sessions.
* Provide operational cover during planned absences of the client's DBA team to ensure service continuity.

**Required Skills**

**1. Microsoft SQL Server**

* Hands-on experience with SQL Server 2016, 2017, 2019, 2022 and 2025.
* Installation, configuration, administration, and maintenance.
* SQL Server upgrade, migration and patching.
* Database security and access management.
* Backup, recovery, and disaster recovery fundamentals.
* Performance tuning, query optimization, and troubleshooting.
* Strong T-SQL development and troubleshooting skills.
* Always On Availability Groups.
* Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC) and high-availability solutions.

**2. PowerShell Scripting**

* Hands-on experience developing and maintaining PowerShell scripts for database administration and automation.
* Strong understanding of functions, parameters, error handling, and logging.
* Experience with PowerShell remoting.
* Hands-on experience with the SqlServer PowerShell module or dbatools module.
* Ability to read, troubleshoot, maintain, and enhance scripts developed by other team members.
* Experience documenting scripts, dependencies, execution procedures, and error-handling processes.

**3. Monitoring and Reporting**

* Grafana dashboard and panel development.
* Configuration of monitoring alerts and alert rules.
* Power BI report and dashboard development.
* Basic knowledge of data modelling and DAX.
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting scheduled dataset refreshes.

**4. Production Support**

* Experience in enterprise database operations or managed services environments.
* Incident, change, and problem management.
* Database patching and planned maintenance.
* Root cause analysis and production troubleshooting.
* Working within defined service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Major incident coordination and stakeholder communication.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical issues clearly to technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.
* Confidence in client-facing meetings and critical incident calls.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of operational responsibilities.
* Strong documentation, collaboration, and knowledge-sharing skills.
* Ability to work effectively with distributed teams and across time zones.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Exposure to Azure SQL Database or Azure SQL Managed Instance.
* Experience with Python, Bash, or other scripting languages.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow for incident, problem, and change management.
* Experience with Tenable for vulnerabilities management.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate (DP-300).

**Key Expectations**

The successful candidate will independently manage day-to-day SQL Server operations, take ownership of existing PowerShell automation, support high-availability environments, and contribute to monitoring, reporting, and continuous improvement. The candidate must be comfortable working in a client-facing production support environment and maintaining service continuity within agreed SLAs.

**Location:**
Bengaluru, India

**Experience:**
8-10 Years

**Joining:**
Immediate joiners or candidates with a notice period of up to 30 days

title: Lead Data Warehouse Engineer
description:
FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures. FairMoney maintains a strong international presence, with offices in several countries, including France, Nigeria, Germany, Latvia, the UK, Türkiye, and India.
  
  
In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point-of-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices. Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state-of-the-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents.

To gain deeper insights into FairMoney's pivotal role in reshaping Africa's financial landscape, we invite you to watch this informative video.

We are looking for a
**Lead Data Warehouse Engineer**
to own FairMoney's data warehouse and lead the team that builds it. You will set the architecture, the modelling and quality standards, and the delivery roadmap for the data our lending, banking, risk and finance teams depend on. You will stay hands-on in architecture, design reviews and critical models while you lead and grow a team of data engineers.

1.
**Data Platform and Architecture**

* Own the architecture of the cloud data warehouse, from ingestion to the published datasets used by analysts, BI tools and downstream systems.
* Lead the modernisation of the data platform, including the move to CDC and streaming ingestion.
* Decide which layer each piece of business logic belongs in, and keep published datasets stable for the teams that use them.
* Manage compute and storage cost and deliver measurable efficiency gains.

2.
**Data Modelling and Engineering Standards**

* Set and enforce standards for data modelling, transformation patterns, testing, documentation and code review.
* Build data quality and observability practices that catch issues before consumers find them. ●
* Run a clear change process, with design review, QC evidence and peer review, before changes reach production.
* Drive automation and CI/CD across the data stack.

3.
**Reliability and Operations**

* Own freshness, accuracy and availability SLAs for business-critical datasets, and the on-call and incident response behind them
* Guide the team through complex issues in distributed data pipelines.

4.
**Team Leadership**

* Lead, hire, coach and grow a team of data engineers
* Set the team's working rhythm: intake and triage, sprint planning, design reviews and stakeholder reporting.

5.
**Stakeholder Partnership**

* Be the main engineering partner to business, product, risk and finance leaders.
* Turn business requirements into reliable data products, explain trade-offs clearly and deliver on predictable timelines
* Make sure data handling meets financial regulatory, governance and security requirements.

6.
**AI and Self-Serve**

* Prepare the warehouse for AI use cases with documented models, consistent metric definitions and a semantic layer.
* Bring AI-assisted engineering and analytics into the team's daily work.

**Requirements**

**Must-Haves**

* 10+ years in data engineering, data warehousing or analytics engineering, including 3+ years directly managing engineers.
* Expert SQL and strong Python.
* Deep data modelling experience: dimensional modelling, slowly changing dimensions, and incremental and idempotent transformations.
* Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift.
* Production experience with dbt and a workflow orchestrator such as Airflow.
* End-to-end ownership of business-critical datasets, with accountability for freshness, correctness and SLAs
* Experience in fintech, banking or financial services.
* A record of hiring, retaining and growing strong engineers.
* Strong stakeholder management, including the ability to say no and explain why

**Nice-To-Haves**

* Experience working with Google Cloud Platform
* Experience working with CDC or streaming ingestion (Kafka, Debezium or similar)
* Experience with data governance, data contracts and lineage
* Indepth knowledge on data quality and observability tooling
* Semantic layers and GenAI / LLM tooling on structured data
* Leading teams across time zones

**Benefits**

* Training & Development

* Performance Bonus

**Recruitment Process**

* A screening call with the Recruiter for 30 minutes
* Technical interview with the Hiring Manager for 45 minutes

description:

Strong understanding of Delta Lake and Lakehouse architecture in Databricks.

Distributed Computing & Spark: Strong understanding of distributed computing concepts using Apache Spark and PySpark, including DAGs, stages, tasks, transformations, actions, shuffling, serialization, caching, partitioning, broadcast joins, and partition pruning. Ability to translate Retail business requirements into scalable analytical data models and Databricks pipelines.

Data Quality & Governance: Experience implementing data quality rules, validation frameworks, reconciliation, error handling, audit frameworks, and data lineage, with strong understanding of Unity Catalog, RBAC/ABAC, row-level and column-level security.

Production Engineering: Strong experience with Databricks Workflows, job orchestration, dependency management, monitoring, logging, retry mechanisms, CI/CD, Git, DAB, and production deployment practices.

title: Application Engineer, Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
We are looking for a data-savvy Software Engineer to help us build scalable, production-grade systems for researching, experimenting and developing cutting-edge data products in the private markets space.
  
  
This role sits within the Private Markets Data Engineering (PMDE) team at Preqin, part of BlackRock. Preqin is central to BlackRock’s ambition to transform private markets data and technology, complementing the Aladdin platform to deliver integrated public and private market solutions across the whole portfolio.
  
  
As a senior individual contributor and hands-on technical leader, you will design and build scalable data software infrastructure and analytics platforms that enable high-quality data products, advanced analytics, and client-facing solutions. Working closely with business stakeholders and product partners, you will translate strategic priorities and user needs into robust technical architectures and delivery plans. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, owning technical design and outcomes across complex initiatives.
  
  
Your work will directly enhance transparency, operational efficiency, and data-driven decision-making for institutional investors, fund managers, and service providers. In doing so, you will help position BlackRock as the leading technology and data provider in private markets.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who is excited by the challenges of innovating in private markets data, and combines deep technical expertise with the ability to clearly articulate value to both business stakeholders and clients.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and build scalable, reliable data pipelines and platformssoftware solutions for data products, ensuring performance, quality, and long-term sustainability.
* Own data solutions end-to-end — from translating business objectives into technical designs through implementation, deployment, and production support.
* Design and implement data workflows that are reproducible, testable, and scientifically rigorous, embedding validation frameworks, monitoring, lineage, and observability into every stage.
* Enable advanced analytics and AI/ML use cases by building software solutions infrastructure that supports experimentation, versioning, and production-grade pipeline and model deployment.
* Lead architectural decisions and influence technical prioritisation, partnering closely with product and delivery teams to align engineering effort with business impact.
* Act as a technical authority within the team, elevating engineering standards and driving best practices in data management, governance, and cloud-native development.
* Engage senior stakeholders, clearly communicating complex technical trade-offs and recommendations in business-relevant terms.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with engineers, data scientists, analysts, and product leaders to deliver high-impact solutions for institutional investors and private markets clients.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Proven experience building and operating scalable software systems for data processing workflows and platforms, with deep expertise in Python and SQL across databases such as Snowflake and Postgres.
* Hands-on experience with modern software engineering practices, including version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience working in cloud environments (AWS or Azure), including infrastructure provisioning and automation using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform).
* Demonstrated ability to design production-grade systems that balance performance, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Experience enabling or supporting advanced analytics and AI/ML use cases in production environments.
* A rigorous, data-driven mindset – comfortable using analysis, benchmarking, and experimentation to guide technical decisions and architectural trade-offs.
* Strong understanding of data validation, testing strategies, and code quality practices, with confidence applying diverse code and data testing techniques across data and application layers.
* Ability to operate autonomously and drive technical solution design end-to-end, taking ownership of outcomes.
* Experience collaborating effectively across engineering, data science, product, and design teams to deliver high-impact solutions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels and translate complex technical concepts into clear, business-relevant language.
* A proactive, curious, and resilient mindset — motivated to explore new technologies, tackle ambiguous problems, and continuously improve systems and ways of working.

**Desirable Skills Include**

* Experience with AI-related technologies and products; familiarity with using AI coding assistants.
* Experience working with financial market data, investment analytics, or private markets datasets.
* Experience designing and building data platformssoftware and/or data platforms in regulated or financial services environments.
* Experience supporting ML lifecycle management (model versioning, experiment tracking, model deployment pipelines); familiarity with tools such as MLflow, feature stores, or model serving frameworks.
* Experience productionising statistical or quantitative models.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Application Engineer
description:
MongoDB Professional Services (PS) works with customers of all shapes and sizes, in all verticals, from tier-1 banks to small web startups, on a variety of exciting use cases. This role solves technically sophisticated problems, gains incredible cross-stack experience, works with top-notch people in the business, networks with industry leaders, and sees new places - all in a day’s work!
  
  
MongoDB PS exists to support the development of our customers’ vision, accelerate customers’ time to value, and drive a multitude of customer adoption scenarios – from building new solutions to modernizing legacy applications or migrating to cloud. Our consulting solutions ensure that organizations get the best out of MongoDB.
  
  
Work as a software developer in a small Agile team delivering solutions onsite for customers focussed on migrating our customers’ legacy relational-based Java applications to a more modern cloud-based architecture running on MongoDB, leveraging the latest GenAI tools and approaches to accelerate this process. During each project, successful candidates will be required to innovate on potential new GenAI-based solutions for specific challenges in addition to applying existing playbooks and tooling for migration.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
As an Application Delivery Consultant, you will work closely with customers to deliver tailored solutions for modernizing their legacy SQL-based systems and applications. Your role will involve collaborating with bite-size Agile teams, applying best practices, and contributing to system redesigns that leverage MongoDB. This is an excellent opportunity for candidates with strong technical fundamentals and a passion for learning, as the role provides extensive training and exposure to modern technologies like MongoDB, GenAI, and cloud-native architectures
  
  
Position Expectations:
  
  

* Collaborate with project teams to deliver solutions for modernizing legacy SQL-based applications and migrating them to MongoDB
* Apply your knowledge of Java (or similar programming languages) and relational databases to support customer projects
* Follow and contribute to best practice playbooks for migrations and modern application development
* Continuously learn and adopt new technologies, especially MongoDB, GenAI tools, and cloud architectures, as projects demand
* Participate in sprint planning, grooming, and retrospectives to improve team processes and outputs
* Communicate progress, challenges, and ideas effectively within the team and to stakeholders
* Support debugging and performance optimization tasks during projects
* Be open to mentoring and guidance from senior team members while contributing to team discussions with a fresh perspective

**Key Qualifications**

* 4–7 years of experience in software development, with a strong foundation in
* Core programming concepts specific to JAVA
* Relational databases and SQL, including basic stored procedures
* Application debugging and performance tuning
* Exposure to one or more enterprise application architectures, such as Spring Boot or Hibernate
* Experience working in Agile teams, with a familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Git for version control
* Demonstrated curiosity and ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and best practices quickly
* Excellent problem-solving skills and a collaborative mindset
* Strong communication skills to engage effectively with team members and stakeholders
* Nice-to-Have Skills
* Familiarity with MongoDB or similar NoSQL databases
* Basic knowledge of GenAI tools and APIs (e.g., OpenAI GPT models)
* Exposure to Python and its application in scripting or data processing
* Basic understanding of cloud-native development concepts (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, or microservices)
* Hands-on experience with ORMs like Hibernate or JPA

Bonus Skills
  
  

* Prior experience with MongoDB and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes
* Hands-on experience with GenAI technologies (e.g., OpenAI API, GPT models) and the ability to innovate new use cases within migration projects

Key Competencies
  
  

* Strong team leadership and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to articulate technical solutions to non-technical audiences
* Exceptional problem-solving and debugging skills, applying creativity to complex challenges and GenAI innovations
* Adaptability and openness to evolving project needs, aligning with the latest industry trends and best practices

Additional Considerations
  
  
Due to the highly regulated nature of our industry, successful candidates may undergo enhanced background checks and security screenings. MongoDB is committed to providing a supportive, enriching work environment with a focus on employee wellbeing and growth.
  
  
Why MongoDB?
  
  
Join us in transforming the way enterprises manage and scale data. MongoDB provides a dynamic workplace culture with employee affinity groups, fertility assistance, and generous parental leave policies, ensuring an inclusive experience.
  
  
**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

description:
**Overview**
At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.
  
  
Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.
  
  
You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.
  
  
Come make an impact every day at Zebra.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**
This role is responsible for the leadership, design, implementation, and ongoing support of Zebra's Customer Master Data Management (CMDM) ecosystem and its connected Salesforce (SFDC) platform. The ideal candidate will serve as a subject matter expert across the CMDM agile delivery track, Salesforce development and implementation, and the integration landscape connecting SFDC with Oracle Commerce Cloud, Siebel, Oracle ERP Cloud, and Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), and will drive the adoption of AI-based solutions to modernize and automate customer master data processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage the CMDM agile delivery track, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, prioritization, and coordination across business and technical teams.
* Provide expert guidance on Salesforce (SFDC) development, configuration, and implementation, ensuring solutions align with CMDM strategy and enterprise architecture standards.
* Apply deep knowledge of SFDC technologies (Apex, Lightning, Flows, APIs, and the Salesforce data model) to design scalable and maintainable customer data solutions.
* Analyze, design, and implement robust integrations between Salesforce and Oracle Commerce Cloud, Siebel, Oracle ERP Cloud, and Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS).
* Define and govern customer master data standards, including data quality rules, matching/deduplication, survivorship, and stewardship processes within the CMDM platform.
* Identify, evaluate, and implement AI/ML-driven solutions in the CMDM space, such as intelligent data matching, enrichment, anomaly detection, and automation of stewardship tasks.
* Lead requirements gathering, process mapping, solution design, and the creation of functional and technical specifications.
* Coordinate and oversee testing cycles, including analyzing and researching defects and working with business and technical teams to ensure resolution.
* Facilitate activities related to system enhancements, bug fixes, patches, and major upgrades across the CMDM and SFDC landscape.
* Act as a liaison with Salesforce and Oracle support partners by creating and managing service requests and escalations.
* Collaborate closely with the PMO, QA, and Operations teams to ensure successful delivery of CMDM initiatives.

**Qualifications**
**Required Experience & Skills:**

* A Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience is required.
* A minimum of 8-10 years of professional experience, with at least 5 years of hands-on experience in customer master data management and/or Salesforce platforms.
* Proven experience managing an agile delivery track, including backlog and sprint management.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Salesforce development and implementation, including Apex, Lightning, Flows, and the SFDC data model.
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems such as Oracle Commerce Cloud, Siebel, Oracle ERP Cloud, and Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS).
* Solid understanding of customer master data concepts, including data governance, data quality, matching/deduplication, and stewardship.
* Experience designing and implementing AI/ML-based solutions to automate or enhance master data processes.
* Proven experience with 3 to 5 full project lifecycle implementations involving CMDM and/or Salesforce.
* Proactive, self-motivated, and solutions-oriented with the ability to manage multiple tasks and execute effectively under pressure.
* Demonstrates ownership and accountability for deliverables with a strong focus on achieving goals.
* Highly collaborative with strong intellectual curiosity and a forward-thinking mindset.
* Excellent oral, written, and listening skills with the ability to articulate complex information clearly.
* Agile and adaptable, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic, challenging environment and work flexibly with team members across different time zones.

**Preferred Experience & Skills**

* An advanced degree is preferred.
* Salesforce certifications (e.g., Platform Developer, Application Architect, or Data Architect) are highly desirable.
* Experience with Oracle Commerce Cloud, Siebel, and Oracle ERP Cloud implementations is highly desirable.
* Experience applying generative AI or machine learning in a master data or CRM context is a plus.

**Benefits**
We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test - Database Automation
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
  
  
**About Us**
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
  
  
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
  
  
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
  
  
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
  
  
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
  
  
**About The Role**
Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.
  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test with extensive industry experience to define and execute the design, development, and maintenance of Fivetran’s test automation tools and framework using reliable and scalable techniques.
  
  
As a Senior SDET, you will focus on solving complex testing difficulties by designing, developing and improving automation and reporting frameworks. You will invest in improving test stability and performance of the framework by developing innovative solutions to boost Fivetran’s testing efficiency. You will also coach Fivetran quality engineers to be the best in class automation engineers, and will continuously work with the team to ensure high standards for automation. The ideal candidate will be highly technical, detail-oriented, creative, motivated, and focused on achieving results.
  
  
In addition, this role emphasizes leveraging AI driven solutions to accelerate testing, enhance developer productivity, and improve operational insights, making Fivetran’s quality practices smarter, faster, and more scalable.
  
  
This is a full-time position based out of our Bangalore office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.
  
  
**Technologies You’ll Use**

* Languages & Frameworks: Java (17+), JUnit, REST Assured, Shell scripting; Python
* Infrastructure & Tooling: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Bazel, Buildkite
* Cloud & Platform: AWS, GCP, Azure
* Observability & Monitoring: Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog
* CI/CD & Automation: Jenkins, CircleCI, GitHub Actions
* Data & Testing:ELT pipelines, test automation utilities, whitebox testing strategies
* Databases: SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, SAP , Oracle, DB2 ertc)

**What You’ll Do**
  
  

* Review requirements, specifications and technical design documents to provide meaningful, risk-focused feedback.
* Design and evolve scalable automation frameworks in Java with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, and data correctness.
* Write high-signal test strategies for complex features and automate them across multiple environments.
* Improve CI/CD pipelines by building robust validation layers that prevent silent failures and regressions.

+ Build internal tools and proof-of-concepts using AI/LLM technologies to:
+ Accelerate debugging and failure triaging
+ Generate high-quality test scenarios
+ Detect flaky patterns or regression risks
+ Improve log analysis and root-cause identification
+ Enhance developer and QA productivity

* Design AI-assisted workflows that integrate seamlessly into the existing automation and release pipelines.
* Experiment with and implement agent-based systems or LLM-powered tooling that streamline development and testing processes.
* Actively measure and improve engineering impact through reliability metrics, automation efficiency, and defect prevention signals.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to drive a culture of quality ownership and automation-first thinking.
* Collaborate with engineering and product leaders to align testing priorities and business objectives.

**Skills We’re Looking For**

* 6+ years of experience in the software industry with strong passion for quality, automation, and engineering excellence.
* Deep understanding of OOP principles and strong proficiency in Java.
* Expertise in designing scalable automation frameworks and identifying negative, edge, and high-risk scenarios.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems risks such as schema drift, idempotency failures, data inconsistencies, and race conditions.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with tools such as Jenkins, Buildkite.
* Experience working with backend automation frameworks.
* Testing data pipeline or ELT platforms, with hands-on exposure to Change Data Capture (CDC) mechanisms, connector-based data ingestion, and validating data accuracy and consistency across source and destination systems at scale.
* Deep understanding of database internals
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI/LLM tools to significantly accelerate development, debugging, test design or automation activities.
* Experience building AI-assisted tools, workflows, or agents that integrate into engineering pipelines.

**Bonus Skills**

* Experience testing against cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) or CDC source databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
* Familiarity with log-based CDC mechanisms (binlog, WAL, ) and handling schema drift or evolution scenarios.
* Exposure to distributed systems testing, large-scale data reconciliation, and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) on cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* Familiarity with data extraction using API-based polling, batch/file ingestion, and query-based incremental syncs.

**Perks And Benefits**
100% employer-paid medical insurance- Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
- RSU stock grants\*
- Professional development and training opportunities
- Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
- Monthly cell phone stipend
- Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.
\*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.
  
  
Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Job Objective**

Your role as Software Engineer is to independently design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack software solutions across backend and frontend layers. You will own assigned features from requirement analysis through implementation, integration, QA handover, and production support, while ensuring solutions are reliable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with established engineering standards.

**Main Tasks**

* Design, develop, and maintain backend services, APIs, business logic, data processing, frontend applications, dashboards, portals, forms, reporting screens, internal tools, and reusable components.
* Own assigned features from requirement analysis through development, testing support, QA handover, defect resolution, and production support, with limited supervision.
* Implement complete end-to-end features covering frontend user interactions, backend processing, PostgreSQL data persistence, event queue processing, integrations, and final user or system responses.
* Design and consume REST APIs, including request and response models, validations, authentication, authorization, error handling, and appropriate integration behavior.
* Implement and maintain integration flows with internal services, operators, aggregators, third-party systems, callbacks, and webhooks, ensuring proper error handling and operational visibility.
* Develop and validate PostgreSQL queries and database interactions, including transaction behavior, indexing, constraints, data persistence, and consistency requirements for assigned features.
* Implement and support RabbitMQ and event-driven workflows, including event publishing, message consumption, payload validation, retries, dead-letter handling awareness, logging, and queue-processing monitoring.
* Implement and support asynchronous workflows such as notifications, billing triggers, delivery reports, background jobs, audit events, and integration callbacks according to system requirements.
* Analyze business and technical requirements, identify implementation gaps and dependencies, and propose appropriate technical approaches for assigned features before development.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across backend services, APIs, frontend behavior, PostgreSQL results, event queues, integrations, asynchronous processes, and end-to-end application flows.
* Perform unit testing, support integration and regression testing, resolve identified defects, and validate implemented changes before QA handover and release.
* Optimize standard application performance, including API response times, frontend rendering behavior, PostgreSQL queries, database interactions, and event-processing efficiency.
* Collaborate with QA, Product, DevOps, Support, Security, and other engineering teams to resolve dependencies and ensure smooth end-to-end delivery.
* Provide basic technical guidance to Junior Software Engineers when required and support them in resolving straightforward development and troubleshooting issues.
* Escalate complex architectural, scalability, security, performance, event-driven design, and production-critical concerns to Senior or Lead Software Engineers when required.
* Maintain technical documentation covering APIs, integrations, frontend components, database interactions, event flows, application workflows, configurations, and known technical limitations.
* Ensure development activities comply with Jira traceability, Git and branching practices, pull request and code review requirements, SonarQube validation, secure coding, documentation, and release standards.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 2+ years of experience in software development across backend and frontend applications.
* Hands-on experience developing and integrating APIs, databases, and full-stack application features.
* Experience with database-driven applications, event-driven or asynchronous processing, and system integrations.
* Exposure to messaging, real-time, high-volume, or integration-heavy platforms is considered an advantage.
* Professional proficiency in Local Language and English is required.
* Good hands-on knowledge of backend development using Java or C#.NET and frontend development using React and Next.js.
* Good understanding of REST APIs, authentication, authorization, integration patterns, callbacks, webhooks, and error handling.
* Good knowledge of PostgreSQL, SQL queries, transactions, indexing fundamentals, constraints, data persistence, and validation.
* Good understanding of RabbitMQ or similar event-queuing technologies, including producers, consumers, message handling, retries, dead-letter concepts, and asynchronous processing.
* Ability to independently develop and troubleshoot complete features across backend, frontend, database, integration, and event-processing layers.
* Good knowledge of Git workflows, branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, and development traceability.

title: Senior Postgres Platform Engineer
description:
**Senior Postgres Platform Engineer**

Evaluates new database technologies and tools in the industry. Sets database system administration and programming standards, applies database technology to business problems, manages development and production database environments with emphasis on security, availability, and performance. Determines appropriateness of data for storage and optimum storage organization. Creates sustainable and maintainable tools to automate database provisioning, patching, monitoring, metrics, maintenance, and administration.

**What you’ll achieve**

As a Senior Postgres Platform Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and operating production PostgreSQL clusters at scale, building the automation and platform capabilities that power Dell's Database Platform. You will work with a global database engineering team to deliver self-healing database infrastructure using Ansible, pgVector, Kubernetes and agentic coding patterns.

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a **Senior Postgres Platform Engineer** on our **Database Platform** team.

**You will:**

* Design and operate PostgreSQL clusters at scale - replication, partitioning, connection pooling, VACUUM tuning, WAL management - for a fleet supporting billions of transactions monthly
* Deploy and manage PostgreSQL on Kubernetes using operators (CloudNativePG, Patroni) with automated failover, persistent storage optimization, and pod disruption budgets
* Build Ansible-based automation for provisioning, patching, upgrades and disaster recovery
* Optimize pgVector workloads - IVFFlat/HNSW index tuning, dimensionality planning, ANN search performance - for AI/ML embedding pipelines
* Mentor engineers on Postgres internals and operational best practices

**Take the first step towards your dream career**  
Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:  
  
**Essential Requirements**

* 10–14 years of database administration and platform engineering experience
* 6-10+ years of production PostgreSQL at scale - partitioning, logical replication, connection pooling (PgBouncer), pgBackRest, WAL tuning
* 3+ years of Kubernetes for stateful workloads - operators, persistent storage design, backup/restore in K8s, multi-cluster patterns
* 3+ years building automation frameworks in Python, Bash, Ansible - authoring infrastructure, not just using playbooks
* Proven track record of designing self-service infrastructure

**Desirable Requirements**

* pgVector production experience with high-dimension embedding workloads (RAG, semantic search)
* Agentic coding or LLM-augmented operations - self-healing scripts, natural-language-to-query interfaces, or autonomous remediation. Open source contribution and experience with Go lang

**Who We Are**

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.
