Own the cloud-security remediation backlog: triage findings from CSPM, Security Hub / Defender, and CISO reviews, and drive them to closure within SLA.
  
  
Apply patching, hardening, and encryption/key-management routines across the estate.
  
  
Remediate vulnerabilities and misconfigurations across accounts/subscriptions; harden baselines and prevent regression.
  
  
Continuously monitor cloud posture (CSPM) and report remediation status, risk burn-down, and exceptions to the CISO office.
  
  
Ensure controls and remediation evidence are audit-ready (GxP, GDPR, HIPAA); support security reviews and audits.
  
  
**Scalability and Performance**
Optimise platform performance, scaling, and resource utilisation against SLOs.
  
  
Perform capacity planning and autoscaling configuration for cloud workloads.
  
  
Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks; right-size resources for cost and performance.
  
  
**DevSecOps Ownership, Adoption & Governance (~25%)**
Own the DevSecOps toolchain end-to-end and integrate security scanning (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets, IaC scanning) into CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
Embed image/container and Kubernetes security (registry scanning, admission controls, policy-as-code) into the delivery flow.
  
  
Define secure-pipeline standards and reusable templates; maintain release hygiene for continuous, safe delivery.
  
  
Drive DevSecOps adoption across delivery teams: onboard projects, run enablement, and track maturity uptake.

Own DevSecOps governance: define policy, standards, and gates in coordination with the CISO and EARB, and enforce them across teams.

description: Why Mizuho At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. The role will also contribute to playbooks, detection engineering, threat intelligence integration, post-incident reviews and management reporting.Duties and Responsibilities:Incident Detection, Triage and Response:• Monitor and analyze alerts from SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity, email, cloud, network and other security controls to identify suspicious or malicious activity.• Triage alerts, validate incidents, determine severity and business impact, and escalate in line with the incident response process and defined service levels.• Lead or support investigations into internal and external threats, including phishing, malware, account compromise, data loss, unauthorized access and suspicious network activity.• Coordinate containment, eradication and recovery activities with infrastructure, application, identity, cloud and business teams, maintaining clear ownership and decision records.• Maintain accurate incident case records, investigation timelines, evidence, actions, decisions and closure rationale from initial detection through to resolution.• Provide timely incident updates and concise technical and management reports, including material facts, impact, risk, actions, dependencies and next steps.Digital Forensics and Investigation:• Collect, preserve and analyze endpoint, server, identity, network, email and cloud artefacts in accordance with approved forensic and evidence-handling procedures.• Perform host and network analysis using logs, packet captures, forensic images and security telemetry to establish scope, root cause, attacker activity and affected assets.• Identify indicators of compromise, tactics, techniques and procedures, and map findings to MITRE ATT&CK where appropriate.• Support legally or regulatorily sensitive investigations by maintaining evidence integrity, chain of custody and appropriate access controls.• Engage specialist internal or external forensic support where the complexity, scale or sensitivity of an incident requires additional expertise.Threat Hunting and Detection Improvement:• Develop and execute hypothesis-led threat hunts using threat intelligence, environmental knowledge and observed attacker behaviors.• Create, tune and validate monitoring use cases, correlation rules, queries, custom indicators and detection content to improve coverage and reduce false positives.• Assess detection gaps identified during incidents and recommend enhancements to logging, telemetry, processes and security controls.• Contribute to purple-team, penetration-testing and control-validation activities and ensure relevant findings are converted into actionable detection or response improvements.Incident Response Capability and Governance:• Develop, maintain and exercise incident response plans, standard operating procedures, playbooks, call-out arrangements and stakeholder communication templates.• Conduct post-incident reviews and root-cause analysis, track lessons learned and ensure agreed corrective actions are assigned and monitored to closure.• Contribute to incident response metrics, key risk indicators, trend analysis and control-effectiveness reporting for management and governance forums.• Support cyber exercises and simulations to validate roles, escalation paths, communications and decision-making under realistic incident conditions.• Keep current with emerging threats, vulnerabilities, attack methods and changes to relevant industry frameworks and regulatory expectations.Skills and Experience:Essential:• Practical experience in cyber incident response, security monitoring or a Security Operations Centre environment.• Hands-on experience investigating security alerts and incidents using SIEM and EDR/XDR technologies.• Experience analyzing Windows and Linux host artefacts, authentication activity, security logs, network traffic and packet captures.• Working knowledge of incident response lifecycle activities including preparation, detection, analysis, containment, eradication, recovery and lessons learned.• Experience producing incident records, investigation reports, management updates and post-incident findings.• Understanding of attacker behaviors and frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain and NIST incident response guidance.• Knowledge of enterprise networking, identity and access management, cloud services, email security, endpoint security, vulnerability management and data loss prevention.• Ability to manage multiple priorities, exercise sound judgement under pressure and communicate clearly with technical and senior stakeholders.• Awareness of evidence handling, forensic integrity, confidentiality and regulatory considerations relevant to cyber investigations.Desirable:• Experience in banking, financial services or another regulated environment.• Experience with threat intelligence, malware analysis, scripting or automation using PowerShell, Python, KQL or similar languages.• Experience developing detection rules, response playbooks, threat hunts or security orchestration and automation workflows.• Knowledge of Microsoft security technologies such as Sentinel, Defender XDR, Defender for Identity and Defender for Cloud, or equivalent platforms.• Exposure to forensic tools such as EnCase, FTK, Velociraptor, Volatility, Wireshark or equivalent.• Understanding of cloud investigation techniques across Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365 or other major cloud platforms.Qualifications:• Relevant professional experience supported by a degree in cyber security, computer science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.• One or more relevant certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GNFA, SC-200, CySA+, CISSP or equivalent are desirable.• Sound knowledge of information security principles, recognised standards and regulatory expectations, including NIST, CIS Controls and relevant privacy requirements.Company Overview:Mizuho Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Based in India, Mizuho Pune supports Mizuho’s international businesses by delivering high-quality, scalable, and resilient services across multiple functions.Mizuho Pune plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, standardization, and innovation for Mizuho Americas. By combining deep domain expertise with strong process, technology, and analytical capabilities, it partners closely with regional and global teams to support corporate and investment banking, capital markets, and corporate services functions, while adhering to the highest standards of risk management, regulatory compliance, and control.Mizuho Pune offers competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with industry standards and local market practices.Mizuho Pune is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.Employment is subject to applicable background verification checks in accordance with Indian laws and company policies.https://www.mizuhogroup.com/asia-pacific/mizuho-global-services/careers

title: ServiceNow SecOps SIR - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber TechRisk - ServiceNow - SecOps – Security Incident Response — Consultant/Senior Consultant**
**Deloitte’s Cyber Risk Services**
help our clients to be secure, vigilant, and resilient in the face of an ever-increasing array of cyber threats and vulnerabilities. Our Cyber Risk practice helps organizations with the management of information and technology risks by delivering end-to-end solutions using proven methodologies and tools in a consistent manner. Our services help organizations address, in a timely manner, pervasive issues such as identity theft, data security breaches, data leakage, cyber security, and system outages across organizations of various sizes and industries with the goal of enabling ongoing, secure, and reliable operations across the enterprise.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Developer / Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in the Security Incident Response (SIR) module. The ideal candidate will have 3+ years of ServiceNow platform development experience, including at least 2 years focused specifically on implementing and managing Security Incident Response solutions. This role will be responsible for configuring, customizing, integrating, and automating the ServiceNow SIR lifecycle to support incident intake, triage, investigation, containment, remediation, and reporting.
  
  
**Work you will do**
As a
**Consultant / Senior Consultant**
, you would be expected to perform the following activities:
  
  

* Well versed with the application deployment and configuration baselines, and understanding of how the application environment operates in a secure environment and how exceptions are handled during operations.
* Facilitate use of technology-based tools or methodologies to continuously improve the monitoring, management, and reliability of the service.
* Define the architecture and design elements for the implementation of ServiceNow SecOps solution including design data/object models, technical workflow diagrams, access control models, and integration patterns.
* Understand the business requirement and define & document epics, user stories, create UI mock-ups, and have a roll-up-the-sleeves approach to make things happen.
* Facilitate ServiceNow training and support teams on complex system configuration.
* Collaborate with clients to resolve business problems by translating functional requirements into technical solutions.
* Be responsible for end-to-end application design, workflow configurations, and customizations.
* Demonstrate good judgment and a pragmatic approach to delivering a solution that optimizes architecture activities across company needs, business constraints, and technological realities.

**Key Responsibilities (Security Incident Response)**

* Configure and administer ServiceNow Security Incident Response including security incident categories, playbooks, assignment rules, severity/priority models, SLAs, notifications, and response tasking.
* Design and support incident intake and triage workflows from multiple security sources such as SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence, email security, EDR/XDR, vulnerability tools, and manual submissions.
* Integrate and maintain ingestion from security tools into the ServiceNow SIR application and validate data mapping, transformation logic, schedules, deduplication, and error handling.
* Build and maintain automations using Flow Designer / Integration Hub for enrichment, routing, approvals, escalations, containment support, evidence gathering, and closure activities.
* Configure incident lifecycle processes covering detection, analysis, triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
* Partner with SOC, IR, IT Ops, app owners, and resolver groups to coordinate response workflows, manage dependencies, and ensure timely incident remediation.
* Define and publish dashboards / KPIs in ServiceNow for incident aging, MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, incident trends, severity distribution, and analyst workload.
* Support governance through audit-ready evidence, documentation, runbooks, access controls, and change / release management.
* Enable linkage between security incidents, vulnerable items, change records, problems, and CMDB CIs to improve traceability and operational response.
* Support development of response playbooks and standard operating procedures aligned to enterprise incident management and cyber response requirements.

**Optional Responsibilities (Vulnerability Response)**
Support integration points between Vulnerability Response and SIR, including creation of security incidents from exploited or high-risk vulnerabilities when needed.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* 3-10 years of ServiceNow experience (Admin/Developer/Platform).
* Hands-on experience implementing or operating ServiceNow Security Incident Response.
* Strong understanding of the security incident management lifecycle and SOC / IR operating processes.
* Experience with CMDB / asset data concepts and how they affect SIR accuracy, ownership, prioritization, and routing.
* Working knowledge of integrations (REST / API; MID Server where applicable) and automation (Flow Designer).
* Understanding incident prioritization, case handling, escalation models, and response coordination across stakeholders.

* ServiceNow CSA (Mandatory), CAD and CIS-SIR/SecOps-related CIS-certifications.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with SIEM / SOAR / EDR platforms.
* Scripting (ServiceNow JavaScript), performance tuning, and large-scale data ingestion.

**Core Skills**
ServiceNow SIR, SecOps, CMDB, Flow Designer / Integration Hub, integrations, reporting / dashboards, security incident lifecycle, stakeholder coordination, communication, and presentation.

* Some stakeholder management experience.
* Ability to simplify data and explain trends through Excel spreadsheets, dashboards, power-point presentations is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of Oracle GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) & Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC) is highly desirable.
* Working knowledge on Peoplesoft, NetSuite, MS Dynamics and Workday would be an added advantage.
* Willing to learn and work on different ERPs and CRM solutions

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.

In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

* Provide continuous assessment and analysis of trends relating to risk, internal and external threats, control gaps, and unauthorized exposure of company assets to leadership. * Perform third-party risk assessments of our partners, vendors, and contractors

* Ensure all Cybersecurity programs and activities, to include but not limited to, Cyber Incident Response, Cyber Risk Management, Threat Management, Patch and Vulnerability Management, etc. meet or exceed best practice standards as outlined in IADC guidelines and standards, IEC 62443, NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), NIST SP 800-53, and other related or applicable documentation
* Work directly with Cybersecurity management in the development, tracking and reporting of Cybersecurity metrics and KPIs for IT Risk operational concerns, operational and risk tracking for management, and risk trending for Executive Leadership
* Work with management to develop and maintain policies to define governance for both information technology (IT) and operational technology (OT) assets.
* Experience with technical writing to document IT and OT processes within policies and standard operating procedures.
* Leverage metrics and KPIs, to provide leadership and cross-functional teams with actionable recommendations for improvements to systems, processes, and / or procedures that will reduce overall enterprise risk associated with computing or networking systems; and continue to drive overall behavioral changes that result in a “cyber aware” culture at H&P
* Assist, as necessary, in the development, maintenance, and oversight of Cybersecurity related policies, procedures, standards, and associated documentation
* Demonstrate the H&P Company Values: Actively C.A.R.E., Service Attitude, Innovative Spirit, and Teamwork

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 3+ years of experience in auditing, risk management, oversight and reporting, or related activities. Preferably in the IT or other technical space
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, MIS, Cybersecurity or Information Assurance or equivalent
* Experience and knowledge of common regulatory and risk related frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-171, NIST SP 800-39, ISO27001/2, SOX, COBIT, ITIL, CIS, IEC 62443 etc.
* Experience performing or directly supporting risk assessments (internal and external), threat and vulnerability assessments, and related activities

description:
**Job Title:**
**Assistant Manager – Infrastructure & Network Management**

**Department: Information Technology**

**Location: Gurgaon**

**Reporting to: Head of Technology**

**About the Role**

The role is responsible for managing enterprise IT infrastructure, network operations, systems administration, cloud and hosting environments, security controls, Microsoft platform administration and API integration ecosystems across multiple locations. The position will provide centralized governance while enabling effective support to distributed station-level IT teams, ensuring high availability, performance, security, scalability and operational continuity for business-critical technology services.

The ideal candidate will be a mid-to-senior level professional with 7 - 10+ years of relevant experience in complex, multi-location IT environments, preferably in aviation, logistics, ground handling, transportation, or other distributed operational industries.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Infrastructure & Server Management**

* Design, implement, administer and maintain enterprise IT infrastructure including on-premise servers, cloud infrastructure, virtualization platforms, storage, backup and related systems.
* Manage Windows and Linux server environments, including deployment, configuration, monitoring, patching, performance optimization, hardening and lifecycle management.
* Administer virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or equivalent technologies.
* Ensure server availability, capacity planning, backup readiness and operational resilience across business-critical systems.

**Network Management**

* Manage multi-OEM network infrastructure across centralized and station-level environments, including LAN, WAN, wireless, VPN, routing, switching, routers, switches, load balancers, DNS, DHCP and connectivity services.
* Monitor network health, availability, capacity and performance using enterprise monitoring and alerting tools.
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across multiple stations and coordinate timely resolution with internal teams, OEMs, service providers and vendors.
* Support network optimization initiatives to improve reliability, performance and user experience across locations.

**Cloud & Hosting**

* Administer Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud environments, including cloud resources, hosting platforms, identity integrations, monitoring and governance controls.
* Support cloud infrastructure planning, migration, optimization, high availability, backup and disaster recovery requirements.
* Ensure cloud and hosted environments are aligned with organizational security, compliance, cost and performance expectations.

**Security & Firewall Management**

* Administer firewall configurations, rule changes, access policies, VPNs and network security controls in line with organizational governance standards.
* Perform infrastructure hardening, patch management, vulnerability remediation, audit support and compliance-related activities.
* Coordinate with information security teams to implement security controls, monitor risks and support incident response for infrastructure and network environments.

**API Integration & Management**

* Manage and support enterprise integration services including REST APIs, SOAP web services, API gateways, middleware, managed file transfer, messaging platforms and event-driven integrations.
* Oversee API lifecycle activities including integration design support, deployment coordination, monitoring, performance optimization, troubleshooting and governance.
* Support secure and reliable integration between enterprise applications, operational systems, cloud platforms and third-party systems.
* Coordinate with application, security, cloud and development teams to ensure API availability, security, scalability and compliance.

**Microsoft Ecosystem Administration**

* Administer Microsoft platforms including Azure Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Intune, endpoint management, identity and access management and related policy controls.
* Support user access governance, device compliance, endpoint security policies, licensing coordination and Microsoft platform operational support.
* Ensure Microsoft ecosystem administration is aligned with enterprise security, productivity and governance requirements.

**Multi-Location Operations Support**

* Provide centralized infrastructure and network governance for distributed operations across multiple stations or business locations.
* Support station-level IT teams in troubleshooting, escalations, technology rollouts, documentation and operational issue resolution.
* Ensure standardization of infrastructure processes, monitoring, change control, compliance, documentation and support practices across locations.

**Team, Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, IT teams, OEMs, telecom service providers, cloud partners and technology vendors for operational support and project delivery.
* Manage vendor performance, service reviews, SLA adherence, escalation tracking and technology upgrade planning.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on availability, service quality, automation, risk reduction and operational efficiency.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, SOPs, inventory records, escalation matrices and operational runbooks.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* 7 - 10+ years of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, network administration, systems management, cloud operations, security controls and enterprise integration support.
* Experience in multi-location organizations with distributed IT operations and business-critical infrastructure environments.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong administration experience in Windows Server and Linux environments.
* Hands-on knowledge of virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of network technologies including LAN, WAN, routing, switching, VPN, firewalls, DNS, DHCP, load balancing and wireless infrastructure.
* Experience with multi-OEM network environments and vendor-supported technology landscapes.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience in firewall governance, network security controls, vulnerability remediation, patching and infrastructure hardening.
* Knowledge of API integrations, middleware, API gateways, REST/SOAP services, managed file transfers and messaging platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, ActiveMQ, or Azure Service Bus.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, backup, disaster recovery and troubleshooting tools.

* Exposure to scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar tools will be an advantage.

**Functional Skills**

* Strong understanding of incident management, change management, problem management and service request fulfilment.
* Ability to develop and maintain documentation, SOPs, governance processes, audit evidence and operational controls.
* Strong troubleshooting skills in distributed, high-availability and operationally sensitive environments.
* Ability to manage priorities, escalations, dependencies and vendor deliverables in a time-bound manner.

**Preferred Experience**

* Prior experience in aviation, airport operations, ground handling, logistics, transportation, manufacturing, or other multi-location operational environments.
* Experience supporting infrastructure for mission-critical applications and 24x7 business operations.
* Experience with hybrid cloud, disaster recovery planning, infrastructure modernization, automation and technology standardization initiatives.

title: R&D Engineer 3, Software
description:
**Overview**
Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
  
  
Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Observability Engineer to design, build, and continuously improve monitoring and observability for our enterprise environment. Most of the work focuses on on-premises systems: physical servers, virtualized infrastructure, and on-prem Kubernetes clusters, along with the infrastructure layers underneath them. Some cloud use cases are also in scope. Your goal is to give system owners and business stakeholders an accurate, actionable view of the health and uptime of the systems they depend on.
  
  
You will also help shape how we apply agentic AI to observability, moving from dashboards and alerts toward intelligent triage, correlation, and assisted remediation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Architecture and Design
  
  

* Design end-to-end monitoring and observability solutions for enterprise applications running on VMs, Kubernetes, and bare-metal servers, and extend them to cloud workloads where needed.
* Define a layered monitoring strategy that covers hardware, OS, virtualization, network, storage, platform services, and applications.
* Set standards for metrics, logs, alerting, dashboards, and service health models, including SLIs and SLOs where they apply.
* Make sound architectural decisions on tool roles, data flows, retention, scalability, and high availability across the observability stack.
* Define alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability.
* Design service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers.
* Secure observability platforms and integrations through access controls, authentication, encryption, and vulnerability remediation. Maintain compliance with enterprise security standards through platform hardening, audit readiness, and regular security reviews.

Implementation
  
  

* Build and maintain monitoring with Zabbix, covering templates, discovery, triggers, proxies, and integrations.
* Design and maintain log collection, parsing, enrichment, and routing pipelines into Splunk, including forwarders, sourcetypes, field extractions, indexes, and searches.
* Contribute to metrics and visualization with Prometheus and Grafana, particularly for Kubernetes workloads and unified dashboards.
* Automate the configuration and onboarding of monitoring using infrastructure-as-code and APIs.

Agentic AI for Observability
  
  

* Design and implement AI agents that support observability workflows. Examples include alert triage and deduplication, cross-source event correlation, root-cause hypotheses, incident summarization, and runbook-driven remediation with human-in-the-loop approval.
* Integrate LLM-based agents with monitoring and logging platforms through APIs and tool protocols such as MCP.
* Define guardrails, permission boundaries, and auditability for AI-driven actions on production systems.
* Measure the real impact of these agents on operations, for example on MTTD, MTTR, alert noise, and on-call load.

Collaboration
  
  

* Work closely with system owners to understand architecture, failure modes, and dependencies, and to translate them into meaningful monitoring.
* Partner with consumers and stakeholders of those systems to define what “healthy” and “available” mean to them, and to make sure observability gives them the visibility they need.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring, and run knowledge sharing across operations, infrastructure, and development teams.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Regularly review alert quality, coverage gaps, and signal-to-noise ratio, and tune or retire monitoring accordingly.
* Use incidents and post-mortems as input to improve detection and response.
* Track the evolution of the observability toolset and the wider technology landscape.

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 5+ years in infrastructure, operations, or observability engineering, with at least 3 years focused on monitoring and observability, primarily in on-premises enterprise environments.
* Hands-on, production-level experience with Zabbix and Splunk.
* Proven experience monitoring physical servers, virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V, KVM), and Kubernetes clusters.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure layers: compute, OS (Linux and Windows), networking, storage, and the dependencies between them.
* Solid experience with log collection and processing at scale: parsing, normalization, enrichment, retention, and search optimization.
* Practical experience applying agentic AI (LLM agents, tool use, automation) to monitoring, operations, or incident management, along with a working understanding of how these systems behave and where their risks lie.
* Experience designing monitoring architecture, not only operating existing tools.
* Experience defining alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability.
* Experience designing service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers.
* Working knowledge of securing observability platforms, including access control, authentication, encryption, and hardening.
* Strong scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) and comfort working with REST APIs.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work with both technical owners and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with Prometheus (exporters, alerting rules, Alert manager, long-term storage).
* Experience with Grafana (dashboard design, multi-source visualization, alerting).
* Experience monitoring cloud workloads (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and hybrid environments.
* Software development experience, such as building integrations, tools, exporters, or services.

The candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to build scalable and high-performance applications.

Design, develop, test, and deploy Java/J2EE applications.

Participate in application architecture, design reviews, and code reviews.

Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues.

Collaborate with business analysts, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.

Optimize application performance and ensure security best practices.

Strong experience in Core Java, Java 8/11/17

Expertise in J2EE technologies

Experience with Spring Framework

Spring Boot

Spring MVC

Spring Security

Spring Data JPA

Experience developing RESTful APIs and Microservices.

Strong knowledge of Hibernate.

**Job Description**

Team Leadership & People Management Lead and manage a team of master data associates/analysts ensuring high performance and adherence to SLAs. Coach, mentor, and develop team members to build strong expertise in master data processes. Conduct regular performance reviews, provide feedback, and identify training needs. 2. Master Data Governance Ensure strict adherence to master data governance policies and standards. Monitor and enforce data quality, accuracy, and completeness across master data domains (e.g., supplier, customer, product). Drive compliance with data management frameworks, ensuring all master data changes follow established procedures. 3. Data Quality Management Oversee data cleansing, validation, and enrichment activities to maintain high data quality. Process Ownership & Improvement Own end-to-end master data processes including creation, update, and deletion requests. description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- Saviynt Staff**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Ability to architect IGA solutions using Saviynt
* Ability to drive IGA projects including project management, team management, client management.
* Should have experience in implementing at least one complete IAM SDLC engagements projects. This must include activities such as requirements gathering, analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and application support
* Engineer, develop and maintain enterprise IAM solutions using Saviynt IGA tool
* Develop and Build new application Integration, Account and Entitlement Connectors and perform periodic certification reviews in the Saviynt Platform.
* Experience in development phase for Saviynt components - Build Warehouse, Access Request System (ARS), Rule Management, User Provisioning, Access Certification, Identity analytics, Segregation of Duties
* Good knowledge in the configuring of workflows in Saviynt IGA tool. Good knowledge of configuring birthright rules for the user onboarding workflows. Have involved in creation of XML jobs in Saviynt IGA tool.
* Experience in implementation process, built and deployment in Saviynt process.
* Should have good understanding of RDMS and SQL queries.
* Professional IT certifications are a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

title: Infrastructure & Asset Management Specialist
description:
**Position Overview**
: As our Founding IT Systems,
***Infrastructure & Asset Management Specialist***
, you will wear multiple hats to own, scale, and secure our entire operational footprint. You will bridge the gap between day-to-day corporate IT logistics and high-performance GPU computing.

In this role, you will balance tracking high-value physical and software assets with deep hands-on infrastructure tasks like configuring network fabrics, tuning Linux kernels, and ensuring our core GPU stacks run at maximum utilization. This is an autonomous role built for a highly organized, technical problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Asset Management, Procurement & Logistics (35%)***

* **Hardware Lifecycle Management:**
  Track, audit, and manage the full lifecycle of high-value physical hardware, including GPU server nodes, development laptops, switches, and peripheral accessories.
* **Vendor & RMA Logistics:**
  Own vendor relationships, negotiate procurement pricing, handle international/domestic shipping logistics, and manage RMA processes for faulty hardware component replacements.
* **SaaS & License Governance:**
  Audit and optimize enterprise software usage (e.g., Slack, GitHub, IDE licenses, Cloud compute credits) to eliminate cost inefficiencies and maximize seats.
* **Compliance & Inventory Audits:**
  Maintain precise infrastructure inventories and hardware asset registers, preparing the company for imminent security compliance benchmarks (such as SOC 2 Readiness).

***Startup IT & Network Operations (35%)***

* **Identity & Access Control:**
  Provision, manage, and deprovision secure user access frameworks across Google Workspace, Okta, Microsoft 365, and localized SSH keys.
* **Office & Lab Networking:**
  Set up, secure, and monitor office/lab local networks, managing Wi-Fi access points, physical routers, firewalls, and reliable VPN networks for remote engineers.
* **Device Deployment:**
  Deploy and maintain Mobile Device Management (MDM) setups to automatically configure, encrypt, and secure employee endpoints (Mac, Linux, Windows).

***GPU Server & Linux System Administration (30%)***

* **GPU Environment Isolation:**
  Maintain host OS layers (Ubuntu Server, Rocky Linux) and manage the core AI compute runtime stack, including NVIDIA base drivers, CUDA toolkits, and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit via Docker.
* **High-Performance Storage:**
  Configure and manage local network storage (NAS/NFS solutions) to reliably feed training datasets to GPU infrastructure without bottlenecks.
* **Telemetry & Alerts:**
  Deploy simple, lightweight monitoring hooks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Node Exporter) to track critical hardware health metrics, preventing data corruption or server thermal throttling.

**Required Qualifications & Skills:**

* **The Ultimate Generalist:**
  3-5+ years of combined experience spanning enterprise IT support, Linux systems administration, and basic hardware asset/inventory tracking.
* **Linux Proficiency:**
  High comfort operating inside a Linux shell environment (SSH, package management, bash automation scripting).
* **GPU Awareness:**
  Hands-on experience resolving dependencies, broken driver paths, or container device mappings for NVIDIA hardware runtimes.
* **Organizational Skills:**
  Meticulous tracking habits. You enjoy creating a clean inventory out of chaos and implementing organized operational systems.
* **Startup Mentality:**
  Extreme autonomy. You are comfortable running point on critical physical/virtual tasks without an existing employee manual.

**Preferred & Bonus Assets:**

* Prior experience designing asset registers for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 standard approvals.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) or Configuration Management tools (Ansible).
* Experience configuring shared clusters via lightweight job schedulers (such as Slurm)

title: MDR Team Lead (India)
description:
**Summary**
Data has never been more valuable and vulnerable. As cybercriminals become more sophisticated and regulations more strict, organizations struggle to answer one key question: “Is my data safe?"
  
  
At Varonis, we see the world of cybersecurity differently. Instead of chasing threats, we believe the most practical approach is protecting data from the inside out. We’ve built the industry’s first fully autonomous Data Security Platform to help our customers dramatically reduce risk with minimal human effort.
  
  
At Varonis, we move fast. We’re an ultra-collaborative company with brilliant people who care deeply about the details. Together, we’re solving interesting and complex puzzles to keep the world’s data safe.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
Varonis MDR team is at the forefront of worldwide data detection and response services. We lead and redefine how data should be monitored, and protected and how data breach incidents should be handled. It’s a 24/7 global security service assisting customers to investigate and respond to security incidents.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced MDR Team Lead who will oversee a team of MDR Security Analysts. This oversight includes training and developing the knowledge and skills needed to execute the MDR mission, ensuring adherence to all operating policies and procedures, ensuring the delivery of the MDR service within all SLAs, and serving as a point of technical and operational escalation for MDR analysts. Data is the #1 target of attackers, and Varonis' Managed Data Detection and Response (MDDR) customers entrust our team with the security of their data. MDR Team Leads are the lynchpin of MDR operations, ensuring the team is working 24x7 to monitor, triage, investigate, and escalate incidents where data is at risk and to ensure we meet operational SLAs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**:**
Technical and operational escalation point for investigations, incidents, and other elements of the MDR service.
  
  

* Validate findings and coordinate investigative efforts with customers and internal teams.
* Ensure all investigative findings are documented and communicated appropriately by the team, including tracking in CRM.
* Lead or attend customer calls and represent the MDR service when required.

Team Management:
  
  

* Lead the recruitment and onboarding of new team members.
* Continuously train the team so they are equipped with the required skills and knowledge to effectively execute the MDR service.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and quarterly SWOT analyses to drive team growth and development.
* Develop strong work relationships within the MDR Team as well as with other departments ex. Product Support, Product Management, Engineering.

Service Management:
  
  

* Assist in the development, documentation, analysis, testing, and modification of Varonis’ threat detection systems, playbooks, runbooks, and the MDR Team operations.
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of all aspects of the MDR service.
* Oversee and execute programs, projects, operational tasks, and responsibilities related to the MDR service.

**Requirements:**

* Proven success in leading and managing within a team-oriented environment.
* 4+ years of experience working in cybersecurity operations in a global cybersecurity company
* 2+ years of experience leading a team.
* Degree or certification(s) in cybersecurity and/or proven ability to execute across cybersecurity operations disciplines, including monitoring, detection, investigation, and incident response.
* Proven ability to deliver security operations service while meeting SLA and other operational requirements.
* Knowledge of common security technologies and tools including network-based (firewall and IDS), host-based (EDR and AV), data-based (DLP and DSPM), and identity-based (PAM and IAM).
* Proven ability to creatively problem-solve when handling complex issues.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent communication skills in English (written and oral) and interpersonal skills (direct reports, colleagues, and customers).
* Attention to detail and the capability to deliver outcomes autonomously.
* This role may require working either a morning shift (6:30 AM–3:30 PM IST) or an afternoon shift (2:00 PM–11:00 PM IST).

We invite you to check out our Instagram Page to gain further insight into the Varonis culture!
  
  
@VaronisLife
  
  
Varonis is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: A PKI / ADCS Engineer
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**

Band B3

An L3 resource must possess in-depth knowledge of the following skills to meet customer expectations: -Thales Luna SA HSM -Thales CiphertrustManager KMS -Microsoft ADCS PKI

-A PKI / ADCS Engineer is responsible for designing, deploying, and managing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure including Root CA, Intermediate CA, and Issuing CA servers while ensuring secure certificate issuance and validation processes. The role involves hands-on management of Microsoft ADCS components such as NDES (SCEP), CEP/CES services, and integration with Active Directory for auto-enrollment and authentication.
  
-The engineer must manage complete certificate lifecycle activities including certificate request, issuance, renewal, revocation, and troubleshooting of certificate-related issues across users, systems, and applications. Strong understanding of certificate store architecture and certificate chain validation is required to ensure trust relationships within enterprise environments.
  
-The role requires implementation and maintenance of Certificate Policy (CP) and Certification Practice Statement (CPS) aligned to organizational security standards and compliance requirements. The candidate should also manage CRL infrastructure including base CRL and delta CRL, ensuring proper publication and accessibility via CDP and AIA locations.
  
-The engineer should possess strong knowledge of cryptographic principles including asymmetric and symmetric encryption, hashing, and digital signatures along with practical understanding of PKCS standards, Cryptographic Service Providers (CSP), and Key Storage Providers (KSP).
  
-The role involves supporting SSL/TLS certificates across internal and external applications and ensuring adherence to industry standards like X.509 and TLS protocols. Strong troubleshooting skills are required for resolving issues related to certificate enrollment, chain errors, CRL accessibility, and authentication failures.
  
-The candidate must have good understanding of Active Directory including Group Policy, auto-enrollment configuration, and integration with PKI services for enterprise identity and access management.
  
-The role includes ensuring PKI high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery by implementing proper backup, restore, and redundancy mechanisms across CA servers and related infrastructure.
  
-The engineer should work on operational support, monitoring PKI health, performing RCA for incidents, and maintaining documentation for PKI processes and environments.
  
Optional skills include experience with Linux-based certificate management, OpenSSL tools, cloud PKI platforms (Azure/AWS), and HSM integration for secure key management.

title: Security Architect - Cryptography & HSM
description:
Position: Security Architect - Cryptography & HSM (Crypto Architect, Band 'F')

Location: UIDAI Technology Centre, Bengaluru | On-site | Full-time

UIDAI operates the world's largest biometric identity platform. The Crypto Architect owns the cryptographic backbone of that platform - key lifecycle, the HSM estate, and the security architecture of the applications built on top of it. This is a hands-on architecture role, not an audit or GRC role.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

1) Cryptographic and Security Architecture

• Design and implement enterprise-grade cryptographic architecture - encryption, digital signatures, tokenisation, key derivation and secure protocol design.

• Own the HSM architecture end to end: deployment, partitioning, high availability, firmware / FIPS compliance and application integration via PKCS#11, JCE / JCA and KMIP.

• Define the key management lifecycle - generation, distribution, rotation, escrow, archival and destruction - with supporting policy and procedure.

• Translate security requirements into application-level design, secure prototypes and reusable cryptographic libraries for engineering teams.

2) Secure Engineering and Implementation

• Hands-on implementation and code review of cryptographic modules in C, C++, Java, Go or Rust.

• Design secure network and application solutions; embed security into the SDLC and CI/CD pipeline.

• Drive secure code review, cryptographic validation and remediation of findings.

3) Risk, Threat Modelling and Assurance

• Identify threats, vulnerabilities and risks across the IT infrastructure and perform structured threat modelling.

• Plan and oversee security testing, VAPT and cryptographic assessments; track findings through to closure.

• Maintain security architecture documentation, standards and technical artefacts.

4) Compliance and Governance

• Align architecture with ISO/IEC 27001, ITIL, NIST, FIPS 140-2 / 140-3 and UIDAI's information security policy framework.

• Support audits, certification and regulatory reviews with evidence and design rationale.

ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS

• BE / B.Tech / ME / M.Tech / MS / MCA / M.Sc in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or a related discipline.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in IT security, with demonstrable depth in applied cryptography.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

• Excellent understanding of cryptographic algorithms (AES, RSA, ECC, SHA-2 / SHA-3, HMAC, TLS 1.3) with hands-on implementation experience, not theoretical knowledge alone.

• Knowledge of HSM architecture including application integration (Thales / Luna, Utimaco, Entrust or equivalent).

• Strong programming ability in at least one of: C, C++, Java, Go, Rust.

• Sound knowledge of IT security processes and best practices (ITIL, ISO 27001).

• PKI, certificate lifecycle management and key management systems.

DESIRABLE

• Exposure to large-scale, high-throughput national or BFSI-grade platforms.

• CISSP / CISSP-ISSAP / CCSP / CEH or equivalent certification.

• Post-quantum cryptography migration planning, secure enclaves or confidential computing.

• Familiarity with Aadhaar ecosystem security standards, the UIDAI Information Security Policy or CERT-In guidelines.

PLEASE NOTE: This is a cryptography and information security role. It is NOT a blockchain, cryptocurrency, Web3 or DeFi position.

Engagement is through GA Digital Web Word Pvt Ltd for deployment at UIDAI Technology Centre, Bengaluru.

description:

**Why We Do What We Do**
In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
  
  
Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award-winning culture.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a Senior WAF Engineer with 6–10 years of experience in securing web applications and APIs using Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and edge security controls. The ideal candidate will have at least 3+ years of hands-on experience with Imperva (preferred) or Cloudflare.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for the design, implementation, and optimization of WAF policies, including rule tuning, deployment automation, and real-time response to security threats such as OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, bot attacks, and Layer 7 DDoS incidents.
  
  
You will collaborate closely with DevOps, SRE, and application development teams to enhance security posture while ensuring minimal false positives and maintaining optimal application performance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and manage WAF policies for web applications and APIs across environments (dev/stage/prod).
* Configure and tune managed rules and custom rules to mitigate OWASP Top 10 (SQLi, XSS, CSRF, RCE, LFI/RFI, SSRF, etc.).
* Perform rule tuning and false-positive reduction using traffic baselining, exception handling, and staged enforcement (monitor → challenge → block).
* Implement rate limiting, IP reputation, geo/ASN controls, and bot mitigation strategies to reduce abuse and credential stuffing.
* Integrate WAF logs with SIEM/log platforms (Splunk, Sentinel, ELK, QRadar) and build dashboards/alerts for threat monitoring.
* Support incident response for active attacks (L7 DDoS, exploit attempts), including rapid mitigation and post-incident improvements.
* Automate deployments using IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation/ARM/Bicep) and integrate with CI/CD pipelines.
* Conduct periodic security reviews, reporting, and metrics tracking (blocked events, top attacks, FP rate, MTTR).
* Collaborate with app teams on secure configuration (headers, TLS, authentication flows) and compatibility testing.
* Demonstrated experience in automation using PowerShell or Python to integrate with Imperva APIs for scalable WAF policy deployment, configuration management, and operational efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years experience in WAF engineering and Implementation.
* Hands-on experience with at least one WAF platform: Imperva(preferred), Akamai, ModSecurity, AWS WAF, Azure WAF, Cloudflare, F5 ASM/Advanced WAF,
* Strong understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, web app architecture, REST APIs, and common attack patterns.
* Proven experience tuning WAF rules and balancing security vs. false positives.
* Experience with logging/monitoring and SIEM integrations.
* Scripting/automation skills: Powershell/Python/Bash (plus regex and JSON/YAML).
* Familiarity with CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code principles.
* Good troubleshooting and stakeholder communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with bot management and advanced detection techniques (behavioral, fingerprinting where supported).
* Experience with API gateways and API security controls (schema validation, auth hardening).
* Working knowledge of cloud networking/CDN/reverse proxy concepts.
* Security certifications: AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, CCSP, CEH, Security+ (nice to have).

**Tools & Technologies**
WAF (AWS/Azure/Cloudflare/F5/Imperva), CDN, TLS, SIEM (Splunk/Sentinel), Terraform, CI/CD (Jenkins/GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps), Python, Linux, Git.

We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. title: Infrastructure & Asset Management Specialist
description:
**Position Overview**
: As our Founding IT Systems,
***Infrastructure & Asset Management Specialist***
, you will wear multiple hats to own, scale, and secure our entire operational footprint. You will bridge the gap between day-to-day corporate IT logistics and high-performance GPU computing.

In this role, you will balance tracking high-value physical and software assets with deep hands-on infrastructure tasks like configuring network fabrics, tuning Linux kernels, and ensuring our core GPU stacks run at maximum utilization. This is an autonomous role built for a highly organized, technical problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Asset Management, Procurement & Logistics (35%)***

* **Hardware Lifecycle Management:**
  Track, audit, and manage the full lifecycle of high-value physical hardware, including GPU server nodes, development laptops, switches, and peripheral accessories.
* **Vendor & RMA Logistics:**
  Own vendor relationships, negotiate procurement pricing, handle international/domestic shipping logistics, and manage RMA processes for faulty hardware component replacements.
* **SaaS & License Governance:**
  Audit and optimize enterprise software usage (e.g., Slack, GitHub, IDE licenses, Cloud compute credits) to eliminate cost inefficiencies and maximize seats.
* **Compliance & Inventory Audits:**
  Maintain precise infrastructure inventories and hardware asset registers, preparing the company for imminent security compliance benchmarks (such as SOC 2 Readiness).

***Startup IT & Network Operations (35%)***

* **Identity & Access Control:**
  Provision, manage, and deprovision secure user access frameworks across Google Workspace, Okta, Microsoft 365, and localized SSH keys.
* **Office & Lab Networking:**
  Set up, secure, and monitor office/lab local networks, managing Wi-Fi access points, physical routers, firewalls, and reliable VPN networks for remote engineers.
* **Device Deployment:**
  Deploy and maintain Mobile Device Management (MDM) setups to automatically configure, encrypt, and secure employee endpoints (Mac, Linux, Windows).

***GPU Server & Linux System Administration (30%)***

* **GPU Environment Isolation:**
  Maintain host OS layers (Ubuntu Server, Rocky Linux) and manage the core AI compute runtime stack, including NVIDIA base drivers, CUDA toolkits, and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit via Docker.
* **High-Performance Storage:**
  Configure and manage local network storage (NAS/NFS solutions) to reliably feed training datasets to GPU infrastructure without bottlenecks.
* **Telemetry & Alerts:**
  Deploy simple, lightweight monitoring hooks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Node Exporter) to track critical hardware health metrics, preventing data corruption or server thermal throttling.

**Required Qualifications & Skills:**

* **The Ultimate Generalist:**
  3-5+ years of combined experience spanning enterprise IT support, Linux systems administration, and basic hardware asset/inventory tracking.
* **Linux Proficiency:**
  High comfort operating inside a Linux shell environment (SSH, package management, bash automation scripting).
* **GPU Awareness:**
  Hands-on experience resolving dependencies, broken driver paths, or container device mappings for NVIDIA hardware runtimes.
* **Organizational Skills:**
  Meticulous tracking habits. You enjoy creating a clean inventory out of chaos and implementing organized operational systems.
* **Startup Mentality:**
  Extreme autonomy. You are comfortable running point on critical physical/virtual tasks without an existing employee manual.

**Preferred & Bonus Assets:**

* Prior experience designing asset registers for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 standard approvals.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) or Configuration Management tools (Ansible).
* Experience configuring shared clusters via lightweight job schedulers (such as Slurm)

title: A PKI / ADCS Engineer
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**

Band B3

An L3 resource must possess in-depth knowledge of the following skills to meet customer expectations: -Thales Luna SA HSM -Thales CiphertrustManager KMS -Microsoft ADCS PKI

-A PKI / ADCS Engineer is responsible for designing, deploying, and managing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure including Root CA, Intermediate CA, and Issuing CA servers while ensuring secure certificate issuance and validation processes. The role involves hands-on management of Microsoft ADCS components such as NDES (SCEP), CEP/CES services, and integration with Active Directory for auto-enrollment and authentication.
  
-The engineer must manage complete certificate lifecycle activities including certificate request, issuance, renewal, revocation, and troubleshooting of certificate-related issues across users, systems, and applications. Strong understanding of certificate store architecture and certificate chain validation is required to ensure trust relationships within enterprise environments.
  
-The role requires implementation and maintenance of Certificate Policy (CP) and Certification Practice Statement (CPS) aligned to organizational security standards and compliance requirements. The candidate should also manage CRL infrastructure including base CRL and delta CRL, ensuring proper publication and accessibility via CDP and AIA locations.
  
-The engineer should possess strong knowledge of cryptographic principles including asymmetric and symmetric encryption, hashing, and digital signatures along with practical understanding of PKCS standards, Cryptographic Service Providers (CSP), and Key Storage Providers (KSP).
  
-The role involves supporting SSL/TLS certificates across internal and external applications and ensuring adherence to industry standards like X.509 and TLS protocols. Strong troubleshooting skills are required for resolving issues related to certificate enrollment, chain errors, CRL accessibility, and authentication failures.
  
-The candidate must have good understanding of Active Directory including Group Policy, auto-enrollment configuration, and integration with PKI services for enterprise identity and access management.
  
-The role includes ensuring PKI high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery by implementing proper backup, restore, and redundancy mechanisms across CA servers and related infrastructure.
  
-The engineer should work on operational support, monitoring PKI health, performing RCA for incidents, and maintaining documentation for PKI processes and environments.
  
Optional skills include experience with Linux-based certificate management, OpenSSL tools, cloud PKI platforms (Azure/AWS), and HSM integration for secure key management.

title: Platform Engineering Engineer 4
description:
**Job Title**
Platform Engineering Engineer 4
  
  
Summary of the Role
  
  
As a Platform Engineering Engineer 4, you'll help design, implement, maintain, and improve Wide Area Network (WAN) infrastructure across enterprise and data center environments. You will work with internal teams, technology partners, and stakeholders to deliver reliable networking solutions, support operational excellence, and contribute to automation and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
You'll play an important role in network engineering, project delivery, troubleshooting, cloud networking, and service optimization while helping ensure stable and secure network operations.
  
  
In This Role You'll / Your Main Responsibilities
  
  

* Coordinate network engineering projects from engineering acceptance through completion, including reviewing High-Level Designs (HLD), identifying risks, preparing Low-Level Designs (LLD), and supporting implementation activities.
* Design, configure, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise and data center network infrastructure using technologies from Cisco, Juniper, Arista, Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), and related platforms.
* Support Internet Protocol (IP) core networks, Multiprotocol Label Switching (MPLS) services, routing technologies, and Wide Area Network (WAN) solutions while performing monitoring, performance optimization, and issue resolution.
* Collaborate with vendors, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to deliver network solutions, resolve technical issues, and support operational services.
* Contribute to automation and continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to streamline processes using scripting, Infrastructure as Code, and modern engineering practices.

**About The Ideal Candidate**

* Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise WAN and data center network environments.
* Knowledge of networking technologies including Open Shortest Path First (OSPF), Intermediate System to Intermediate System (ISIS), Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), Multiprotocol Label Switching (MPLS), Quality of Service (QoS), and related networking concepts.
* Experience with Cisco, Juniper, Arista, or Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) networking platforms, along with familiarity with cloud networking concepts and automation tools such as Python or Ansible.
* Effective problem-solving, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and within diverse global teams.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical discipline or equivalent experience, along with approximately 6-9 years of experience in network engineering, WAN design, or network operations.

**Preferred Certifications And Skills**

* Certifications such as Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP), Juniper Networks Certified Internet Specialist (JNCIS), or Juniper Networks Certified Internet Professional (JNCIP).
* Knowledge of Agile and DevOps practices.
* Awareness of Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) processes and service-management practices.
* Experience with public or private cloud environments.
* Experience with network automation, infrastructure scripting, or operational process improvements.

title: Principal Network Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Designs, implements, and operates resilient L3/L4 network services across data centers and cloud environments with broader influence beyond the immediate team. Leads moderately complex projects, drives automation and observability at scale, and contributes to standards and architectures. Mentors junior engineers, provides input on team decisions, and collaborates with SRE, platform, and security partners to deliver secure, compliant, and highly available network services with measurable impact on both team and group outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**L3/L4 Network Topologies and Overlays:**

* Lead designs for IP addressing, routing policies (BGP/OSPF/IS-IS), EVPN/VXLAN fabrics, and SDN overlays spanning on-prem and cloud.
* Define HA, ECMP, and traffic-engineering patterns; validate through lab/sandbox testing, failure modeling, and staged rollouts.
* Author design docs and drive reviews involving related teams; de-risk changes with method-of-procedure (MOP), rollback, and verification plans.

**Cloud Networking Implementation and Operations:**

* Implement and operate VPC/VNet topologies, subnets, routing tables, NAT, Transit/Hub-and-Spoke (e.g., TGW/VCN), PrivateLink/service endpoints, and inter-cloud connectivity.
* Design and tune L4/L7 load balancing and service insertion (proxies, firewalls) to meet defined SLOs and cost targets.
* Ensure consistent network policy and connectivity across environments using standard blueprints and golden configs.

**Network Security Controls and Compliance Guardrails:**

* Engineer segmentation (VRFs/security zones), ACLs/policies, encryption (IPsec/TLS), and DDoS/WAF integrations aligned to zero-trust.
* Embed compliance guardrails (change control, access least privilege, evidence collection) and partner with security/GRC to pass audits.
* Periodically review rulebases and routing policies; eliminate shadow/duplicate rules and reduce attack surface.

**Automation, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code:**

* Develop reusable Terraform modules and Ansible playbooks; enforce code reviews, linting, policy-as-code, and test gates in pipelines.
* Build validation and drift-detection tooling using APIs and scripting (e.g., Python); integrate automated rollbacks and canary changes.
* Champion GitOps practices, configuration data modeling, and inventory source of truth.

**Monitoring, Telemetry, and SLOs:**

* Implement SNMP/streaming telemetry, NetFlow/IPFIX, and flow logs for health, capacity, and security analytics.
* Define SLIs/SLOs (availability, latency, loss, jitter) and build dashboards/alerts/runbooks; lead capacity/perf reviews and right-sizing actions.
* Correlate telemetry with incidents; drive problem management and reduction of repeat issues.

**Cross-Team Collaboration and Operations Excellence:**

* Partner with SRE, platform, and security teams on architecture reviews, incident response, post-incident remediation, and capacity planning.
* Lead portions of on-call response and complex change events; coordinate with related teams to minimize risk and downtime.
* Contribute to cross-LOB standards, reference architectures, and service onboarding patterns.

**Documentation, Reviews, and Standards:**

* Produce and maintain high-quality design docs, network diagrams, runbooks, and inventories; ensure traceability to requirements and controls.
* Facilitate and participate in design/change reviews; capture decisions and lessons learned; evolve patterns and modules accordingly.
* Mentor junior engineers via code/document reviews, pairing, and knowledge shares.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

**Problem Solving:**

* Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

**Performance and Development:**

* Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.
