title: Senior System Engineer
description:
VergeCloud is looking for a hands-on System Engineer to work on the core of our CDN and edge infrastructure platform. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys building high-performance, low-latency, secure systems close to the network, operating system, and runtime layer.

You will contribute directly to VergeCloud’s CDN core, including request processing, caching, reverse proxying, traffic routing, TLS handling, DNS integration, observability, WAF, rate limiting, bot mitigation, and DDoS protection capabilities.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable writing production-grade Rust code and working with distributed infrastructure that handles high-volume internet traffic across edge locations.

Key responsibilities include:

* Develop and maintain CDN core services using Rust.
* Build high-performance caching, proxying, routing, and traffic management components.
* Work on HTTP, HTTPS, TLS, TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, and edge networking systems.
* Improve CDN performance, reliability, scalability, and resource efficiency.
* Contribute to WAF, rate limiting, bot mitigation, and DDoS protection features.
* Debug production issues across CDN edge nodes, origin connectivity, cache behavior, DNS, TLS, and network paths.
* Work closely with SRE, security, and platform teams to build reliable edge infrastructure.

Requirements
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, or backend engineering.
* Strong production-level programming experience in
  **Rust or C**
  .
* Strong understanding of Linux systems, networking, processes, memory, filesystems, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Deep knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP, HTTPS, TLS/SSL, and DNS.
* Experience building high-performance, concurrent, asynchronous, or event-driven systems.
* Understanding of caching, reverse proxying, load balancing, request routing, and traffic management.
* Experience debugging complex production issues across application, network, operating system, and infrastructure layers.
* Good understanding of distributed systems, high availability, fault tolerance, and scalable service design.
* Experience with logs, metrics, tracing, monitoring, and production observability.

Preferred skills:

* Experience with CDN, edge computing, WAF, API gateway, reverse proxy, load balancer, or DDoS protection platforms.
* Familiarity with Tokio or other async Rust runtimes.
* Knowledge of NGINX, Envoy, HAProxy, Varnish, OpenResty, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of BGP, Anycast, traffic engineering, and global routing.
* Experience with eBPF, XDP, DPDK, or kernel-level networking.
* Familiarity with Kafka, ClickHouse, Redis, object storage, and large-scale log pipelines.
* Understanding of OWASP CRS, ModSecurity concepts, bot mitigation, rate limiting, and API security.
* Exposure to WebAssembly, V8, or edge function runtimes.

Benefits
  
  

* Opportunity to work on the core technology of a deep-tech edge cloud platform.
* Build CDN, DNS, WAF, DDoS protection, video delivery, and edge computing infrastructure from India for global customers.
* High ownership role with direct impact on platform architecture, performance, reliability, and security.
* Work on challenging systems engineering problems involving Rust, Linux, networking, distributed systems, and high-scale traffic.
* Collaborate with a strong technical team across platform engineering, SRE, security, and product.
* Exposure to production-scale internet infrastructure, edge networking, caching, traffic routing, and security systems.
* Opportunity to grow into senior engineering, platform architecture, or infrastructure leadership roles.
* Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
* On-site collaboration in Bangalore with a fast-moving engineering team.

title: Platform Engineer Il
description:

We help media companies unify streaming and broadcast workflows, modernize operations, and maximize monetization—from live remote production and real-time ad decisioning to automated playout and global content syndication.

Trusted by a majority of the world's top 50 listed media companies, Amagi delivers:

* 26 billion+ monetized ad impressions

We power marquee brands including CBS, BBC, Warner Bros. Discovery, NBC, NBA, and DAZN—and the world's biggest events: The Olympics, Super Bowl, The Grammys, and the US Presidential Debate.

Amagi is built on the belief that freedom and happiness are essential for people to do their best work. We call it the Amagi Way: a unique DNA of goodness, purpose, and innovation that shapes how we work, the teams we build, and the impact we want to make together. Over the last two decades, it has been the driving force behind how we have redefined the video economy while contributing to the communities around us.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and listed on the BSE and NSE, Amagi is a global team of 1,000+ people spread across offices in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.

To learn more about our impact, we invite you to explore here.

**Work Mode : In-Office**

**Location : Bengaluru (Bannerghatta Road)**

**Job Profile:**

We are looking for a hands-on Platform Engineer to join our Core Platform team. Your core responsibility will be owning the operational health of our multi-cloud data platform — provisioning, automating, monitoring, and securing infrastructure across AWS and GCP environments. Familiarity with Databricks and ClickHouse is a strong advantage.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. INFRASTRUCTURE & WORKSPACE MANAGEMENT**

* Provision and maintain platform infrastructure across AWS and GCP following governance standards.
* Set up and manage workspaces, storage buckets, networking, and lifecycle configurations.
* Maintain consistent operational standards across multi-cloud environments.

**2. ACCESS CONTROL & IDENTITY MANAGEMENT**

* Administer permission sets, workspace roles, and access policies across all environments.
* Manage role assignments and keep IAM and SSO configurations in sync.
* Enforce least-privilege principles and audit permissions against compliance requirements.

**3. AUTOMATION & DEPLOYMENTS**

* 2 to 3 years of experience in platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, or data engineering.

* Experience with IAM concepts and SSO providers such as OneLogin, Okta, or Azure AD.
* Proficiency in Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform or Pulumi.

**Life at Amagi:**

Amagi is an equal opportunity employer. Our culture is built around four values that show up in how we work every day.

* **Be Vulnerable, Be You.**
  Authenticity is our baseline.
* **Goodness Wins.**
  We always lead with integrity.

**A Place That Takes Care of You:**

You and your loved ones have access to comprehensive health insurance and our Employee Assistance Program, which covers mental health counselling, financial and legal guidance, and diet and nutrition support. Our office spaces are naturally lit and ventilated, with nutritious meals available every day. An on-site gym and wellness rooms are available for you to rejuvenate. We believe good work should transcend building a great product. Our Employee Resource Group gives you a community within the company. Our volunteering programs and community initiatives give you ways to contribute to the world outside of it.

title: Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is expanding across existing and new regions. Our Networking organization builds systems that manage Internet and backbone traffic, mitigate congestion, and reduce customer impact while enabling network operations to scale efficiently.
  
  
The Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer mentors engineering teams and leads the architecture of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems. This role identifies and eliminates performance and scalability bottlenecks for hyperscale workloads, defines scalability requirements with stakeholders, and designs elastic, high-impact systems while driving innovation in data plane platforms.
  
  
We are seeking a Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer to define technical direction and lead the development of highly available, scalable network control, intelligent routing and automation systems. You will combine deep networking knowledge with software and distributed systems expertise to connect real-time observability with safe, automated routing decisions.
  
  
Your work will span autonomous traffic management, policy-driven network optimization, and software-based routing infrastructure. You will identify performance and scalability bottlenecks, define requirements with stakeholders, and design resilient services that protect customer connectivity during growth, failures, and infrastructure changes.
  
  
This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad architectural influence. Based in IDC alongside the engineering team, you will lead initiatives from design through production operations, contribute to critical implementations, and establish standards for availability, security, observability, and safe deployment. You will collaborate across engineering and operations teams while mentoring senior engineers and developing technical leadership.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Define technical strategy and architecture for scalable routing, network control, and automation systems.
* Design algorithms and distributed services for route computation, congestion management, traffic steering, fault isolation, and recovery.
* Correlate network and infrastructure signals to assess customer impact and enable safe automated responses.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and optimize capacity, resource utilization, routing convergence, and behavior under heavy load.
* Architect and build highly available, fault-tolerant systems with reliable state management, replication, automated failover, and recovery.
* Define service-level objectives, operational KPIs, telemetry, monitoring, and alerting for service health and routing outcomes.
* Establish simulation, scale testing, phased migrations, in-service upgrades, verification, and rollback practices.
* Lead production troubleshooting, incident response, and root-cause analysis; establish runbooks and drive reliability improvements.
* Integrate security controls, auditability, infrastructure as code, and automated deployment, patching, and lifecycle management.
* Contribute production-quality code, review designs and implementations, and maintain architecture and operational documentation.
* Partner with cross-functional engineering, product, and business stakeholders to define technical strategy and deliver high-impact initiatives.
* Mentor senior engineers, influence architectural direction, and promote engineering excellence through technical leadership, hiring, and knowledge sharing.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of relevant experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, network control planes, or network automation platforms.
* Strong Linux systems and networking knowledge, including containers, process and memory behavior, network namespaces, resource isolation, and packet-level troubleshooting.
* Experience designing highly available distributed services with reliable state management, observability, overload protection, and failure recovery.
* Demonstrated ability to lead architecture and delivery across teams, resolve ambiguous requirements, communicate technical trade-offs, and mentor senior engineers.
* Deep knowledge of L2/L3 networking, routing and switching, software-defined networking, traffic engineering, and WAN technologies.
* Strong expertise in BGP and MP-BGP, IPv4/IPv6, route reflection, routing policy, and VPN address families, including practical experience with convergence and reachability troubleshooting.
* Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Python, Java, or C++, with experience in API design, concurrency, automated testing, and production debugging.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Production expertise with Junos and Juniper cRPD or comparable virtualized routing platforms.
* Experience with BGP Add-Path, Optimal Route Reflection (ORR), Prefix Independent Convergence (BGP-PIC), route-flap damping, and large-scale routing tables.
* Knowledge of MPLS, RSVP-TE, PCEP, bandwidth reservation, latency-aware routing, and shared-risk link groups.
* Experience with NETCONF, Junos XML APIs, gRPC, OpenConfig, and model-driven network automation.
* Experience tuning containerized networking workloads, including cgroups, socket buffers, veth, and SR-IOV.
* Experience with infrastructure as code, automated lifecycle orchestration, and rolling upgrades for stateful services.
* Understanding of Clos fabrics, overlay/underlay integration, ECMP behavior, and backbone transit.
* Experience building distributed active measurement and telemetry systems.
* Experience with simulation, failure injection, or formal methods to validate complex distributed-system behavior.
* Experience applying traffic prediction, machine learning, or AI techniques to network optimization, anomaly detection, or operational intelligence.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Senior Network Engineer – Industrial Network
description:
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.
  
  
Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.
  
  
**About The Position**
The Chevron ENGINE – Senior Industrial Network Engineer is responsible for consulting, designing and deploying networking technologies and solutions for the enterprise and its business partners. As a team member, you will use your infrastructure experience and network knowledge to serve as a subject matter expert and project consultant, improving or introducing network capabilities that enable business outcomes while protecting Chevron from external and internal threats. You will work closely with architects, business partners, managed service partners, vendors, cybersecurity teams, infrastructure teams and digital platforms to solve difficult and rapidly changing technical challenges. Where new technologies are introduced, you will partner with Operations to ensure a successful transition.
  
  
The Senior Industrial Network Engineer will work with modern technologies and engage in global projects and initiatives across business, industrial and process control networks. The role requires strong knowledge of industrial routing and switching, Cisco SD-WAN and Cisco DNA Center/Catalyst Center, industrial wireless, network access control using Cisco ISE or Aruba ClearPass, and industrial asset visibility using Cisco Cyber Vision. The successful candidate will identify appropriate network solutions, implement resilient and secure infrastructure in accordance with engineering standards and company security policies, demonstrate strong troubleshooting skills, follow industry developments and collaborate effectively across global teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement and maintain resilient business and industrial LAN, WAN, routing and switching solutions across plant and enterprise environments.
* Develop network architecture standards for IP addressing, VLANs, VRFs, routing protocols, QoS, redundancy and high availability.
* Design and govern Cisco SD-WAN architecture, policy, path selection, resilience, failover testing and multi-site lifecycle management.
* Catalyst Center for network assurance, automation, visibility and operational governance.
* Design, review and troubleshoot industrial wireless solutions, including coverage, roaming, redundancy, interference, security and integration with plant networks.
* Validate and maintain device authentication, authorization and access policies using Cisco ISE, Aruba ClearPass or equivalent network access control platforms.
* Deploy and operate Cisco Cyber Vision capabilities, including sensor integration, industrial asset visibility, baselining and security-event investigation.
* Gather requirements and work with internal stakeholders to design network infrastructure that supports secure and reliable industrial operations.
* Create technical design documentation, implementation plans, test plans, operational standards and recovery procedures.
* Provide Tier 3 support for major incidents using packet captures, route analysis, device logs and end-to-end path validation, coordinating vendors and service providers when required.
* Follow standard change-management processes and participate in business continuity and disaster-recovery exercises supporting the network environment.
* Work with team, architects, operations, cybersecurity teams and business stakeholders to deliver solutions, improve processes and transition new technologies into operational support.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.
* 10–15 years of network engineerin experience, including significant experience supporting industrial, manufacturing, energy or critical-infrastructure environments.
* Advanced English-language communication skills.
* CCNP or an equivalent advanced networking certification.
* Expert knowledge of advanced routing and switching, including VLANs, VRFs, STP, OSPF, BGP, QoS, multicast, redundancy, high availability and complex industrial network troubleshooting.
* Strong Cisco SD-WAN and Cisco Catalyst Center experience covering architecture, policy, assurance, automation, resilience and multi-site governance.
* Hands-on industrial wireless experience covering design review, survey interpretation, coverage, roaming, redundancy, security and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge Cisco ISE or Aruba ClearPass experience for device authentication, authorization and network access policy.
* Knowledge Cisco Cyber Vision experience covering deployment, sensor integration, industrial asset visibility, baselining and security-event investigation.
* Strong technical documentation, change control, incident leadership and stakeholder communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing and supporting industrial networks across brownfield and greenfield sites.
* Experience integrating routing, switching, SD-WAN, network access control, wireless and Cisco Cyber Vision within secure and resilient plant environments.
* Relevant certifications in Cisco Enterprise, Security, Wireless, SD-WAN or industrial cybersecurity.
* Strong written and verbal communication, business negotiation, influencing, conflict-resolution and technical decision-making skills.

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, supporting business requirements across the world. Accordingly, the work hours for employees will be aligned to support business requirements. The standard work week will be Monday to Friday. Working hours are 8:00am to 5:00pm or 1.30pm to 10.30pm.
  
  
**What We Can Offer You**
Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.
  
  
Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.
  
  

* Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.
* Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
* Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.
* Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well-being, and work-life balance.
* Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise.

**How To Apply**
To be a part of our success, click
**APPLY**
to submit your application. Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position.
  
  
**Privacy and Terms and Conditions**
We respect the privacy of candidates for employment. This Privacy Notice sets forth how we will use the information we obtain when you apply for a position through this career site. If you do not consent to the terms of this Privacy Notice, please do not submit information to us.
  
  
Please access the Global Application Statements, select the country where you are applying for employment. By applying, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to the country specific statement.
  
  
Terms of Use
  
  
“ENGINE” refers to the Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center, which operates under Chevron Global Technology and Services Private Limited, an affiliate of Chevron Corporation. References to ENGINE in this document are for convenience only and do not denote a separate legal entity.

title: Global Telecom Support
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior Mobility Telecom, Network Operations & Major Incident Lead will provide end-to-end technical and operational leadership for a global retail telecom and network environment supporting Mobility and E-Mobility services.
  
  
The role will act as a senior technical authority and operational integrator across internal support teams, network and telecom suppliers, application teams, service providers, business stakeholders and incident-management functions. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining network stability, leading the resolution of complex incidents, coordinating major incidents, overseeing infrastructure changes, driving root-cause analysis and improving the overall reliability, security and performance of the service.
  
  
The role requires strong ownership across a highly integrated support landscape where telecom, network, payment, loyalty, site systems and central applications cannot be managed as isolated service components.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Accountabilities**
**1. Global Telecom and Network Operations**

* Provide senior technical and operational leadership for global Mobility and E-Mobility telecom infrastructure.
* Maintain end-to-end oversight of network connectivity and associated infrastructure across retail sites, backbone services, data centres, third-party networks and externally managed connectivity services.
* Monitor the health, availability, performance and security of the telecom environment using enterprise and vendor monitoring platforms.
* Analyse monitoring alerts, operational events and service degradation indicators to determine business impact and initiate the appropriate response.
* Ensure incidents affecting routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN tunnels and associated connectivity components are correctly triaged and assigned.
* Maintain ownership of complex operational issues until resolution or until a complete and formally accepted handover has been performed.
* Support a global, follow-the-sun operating model, including participation in on-call, weekend and public-holiday support arrangements.
* Provide technical guidance to operations teams handling site-level, multi-site and infrastructure-wide disruptions.

The contract identifies global telecom monitoring, real-time infrastructure visibility, incident notification and escalation as core components of the service. It also covers routers, switches, firewalls, VPN tunnels, load balancers, backbone infrastructure and vendor-managed telecom services.
  
  

* Incident and Major Incident Management
* Lead the technical response for high-impact single-site, multi-site and global service incidents.
* Coordinate incident bridges involving network suppliers, telecom providers, application teams, site-support teams, service managers and business stakeholders.
* Perform initial and advanced technical triage to establish incident scope, affected services, market impact, urgency and priority.
* Ensure incidents contain sufficient diagnostic and business-impact information before escalation.
* Coordinate the creation and progression of incident and major-incident records in the relevant service-management platform.
* Manage P3 and P4 major incidents and support the designated incident-command function during P1 and P2 major incidents.
* Establish clear ownership across resolver groups and ensure suppliers engage within their contractual responsibilities.
* Schedule and lead technical calls when required to accelerate investigation and recovery.
* Maintain an accurate incident chronology, including decisions, actions, ownership, dependencies and restoration progress.
* Confirm service restoration through monitoring tools, resolver-group evidence or confirmation from the reporting party before closure.
* Ensure incident, recovery and closure communications are distributed to the appropriate internal and external stakeholders.
* Support incident managers by translating complex technical findings into clear operational and business-impact statements.

The scope requires first-level incident management, major incident management, prioritisation, ticket creation, supplier escalation, technical-call coordination, service-restoration confirmation and communications throughout the incident lifecycle.
  
  

* Advanced Troubleshooting and Technical Investigation
* Lead technical investigation of complex, recurring or high-impact telecom and network issues.
* Perform full-stack troubleshooting across the network path, including routing, switching, firewall policies, VPN connectivity, traffic flows, network security controls and dependent services.
* Use packet-capture and network-analysis tools to isolate faults at packet and protocol level.
* Analyse network traffic, device events, application logs, site-system logs and monitoring data to identify hard-to-detect issues.
* Develop and test technical hypotheses using available operational evidence.
* Coordinate cross-supplier troubleshooting where ownership or fault location is unclear.
* Determine whether failures originate within site infrastructure, telecom connectivity, network backbone, security services, vendor platforms, application services or third-party interfaces.
* Produce clear technical findings, recommended remediation actions and risk assessments.
* Provide technical direction to less-experienced engineers and operations analysts during critical incidents.

The contract specifically requires advanced troubleshooting, traffic analysis, packet-level investigation, knowledge of multiple routing protocols, network design expertise and analysis of site-system and application logs.
  
  

* Root-Cause and Problem Management
* Lead Root Cause Analysis for significant telecom, network and third-party incidents.
* Ensure root-cause documentation clearly describes the failure, contributing factors, business impact, recovery actions and preventive measures.
* Challenge incomplete or unsupported root-cause statements provided by suppliers.
* Track corrective and preventive actions through to verified completion.
* Raise and coordinate problem records for recurring or systemic issues.
* Use incident trends, operational data and recurring alert patterns to identify candidates for problem management.
* Facilitate technical reviews involving internal teams and external service providers.
* Ensure RCA documentation is completed within applicable operational timelines.
* Maintain traceability between incidents, problems, known errors, changes and improvement activities.
* Share lessons learned and incorporate agreed improvements into support procedures, monitoring rules and operational documentation.

The SWAT scope assigns responsibility for RCA leadership, documentation completion, supplier engagement, root-cause validation and accountability. The administrative support scope also includes problem management for supported operational platforms.
  
  

* Change, Migration and Implementation Support
* Assess telecom and network changes for technical risk, operational impact and business impact.
* Coordinate network changes, migrations and implementations with suppliers and delivery teams.
* Evaluate third-party changes that may affect Mobility services.
* Ensure relevant stakeholders review and approve changes before implementation.
* Create and distribute change notifications to internal and external stakeholders.
* Monitor the implementation of high-risk or business-critical changes.
* Coordinate technical support during change implementation and post-change validation.
* Verify that changes achieve the intended outcome without creating unacceptable service degradation.
* Support recovery or rollback activities when a change is unsuccessful.
* Ensure network, firewall, configuration, support and operational documentation is updated following implementation.
* Review project implementation plans for operational readiness, supportability and alignment with the existing environment.

The contract includes change coordination, third-party change-impact assessment, stakeholder approval, Change Notification Letters, implementation monitoring and technical support for network changes and migrations.
  
  

* Network Architecture and Design Assurance
* Act as a senior technical authority for the end-to-end Mobility telecom and network architecture.
* Review solution and network designs for reliability, availability, security, scalability, operability and supportability.
* Provide technical recommendations to project and delivery teams.
* Assess proposed changes against the existing telecom environment and relevant service dependencies.
* Architect, review or approve network designs within the candidate’s delegated authority.
* Identify operational risks, integration gaps, monitoring requirements and support-model deficiencies before production deployment.
* Ensure designs include appropriate diagnostic, failover, security, documentation and operational-support provisions.
* Support implementation teams during deployment, transition and early-life support.
* Ensure integration requirements across multiple suppliers and business partners are understood and coordinated.
* Promote standardisation and reduction of unnecessary technical complexity across the network landscape.

The SWAT team is defined as responsible for end-to-end technical architecture, multi-supplier process integration, project-impact assessment, technical recommendations, design review or approval and implementation support.
  
  

* Firewall, Security and Access Governance
* Provide senior oversight of firewall rules supporting the Mobility environment.
* Review firewall-rule changes for technical validity, security risk, business justification and implementation impact.
* Ensure access and infrastructure requests follow the required approval and governance processes.
* Review and manage third-party access requests relating to infrastructure, data-centre or service-support activities.
* Support access-control processes and periodic access reviews for relevant operational platforms.
* Coordinate with security, risk, infrastructure and supplier teams to resolve security-related network issues.
* Support compliance activities associated with Information Risk Management and Payment Card Industry requirements.
* Maintain appropriate records and technical documentation to support audit and compliance activities.
* Escalate non-compliance, uncontrolled access, unsupported connectivity or material security risks to the relevant stakeholders.
* Balance operational recovery requirements with security and access-control obligations during critical incidents.

The contract includes ownership of a significant portion of the firewall rule sets, third-party access management, infrastructure change requests and support for Information Risk Management and PCI compliance activities.
  
  

* Supplier and Stakeholder Management
* Act as the senior technical liaison between internal teams, business stakeholders, telecom providers, technology suppliers and third-party service providers.
* Establish clear technical and operational ownership across multi-supplier incidents.
* Hold suppliers accountable for investigation quality, contractual service obligations, recovery actions and root-cause deliverables.
* Escalate supplier-performance concerns through the appropriate operational and commercial channels.
* Obtain technical evidence from suppliers following incidents and changes.
* Challenge delays, unsupported conclusions and incomplete remediation plans.
* Coordinate dependencies between connectivity providers, managed-service suppliers, application teams and site-support teams.
* Provide concise updates to service management and business leadership.
* Maintain professional working relationships across geographically distributed and culturally diverse teams.
* Represent the telecom and network operations function in service reviews, project meetings, change reviews, incident reviews and technical governance forums.

The role descriptions require working across international teams, leading meetings, coordinating internal and external support entities and ensuring suppliers and vendors perform as required under their contracts.
  
  

* Monitoring and Service Improvement
* Drive proactive monitoring and early identification of telecom and service degradation.
* Review alerts, dashboards, thresholds and escalation paths to improve incident detection and response quality.
* Identify monitoring gaps across network, site, application and third-party services.
* Work with monitoring-service owners and suppliers to implement actionable alerts.
* Reduce alert noise, duplicate notifications and non-actionable events.
* Use operational data to identify reliability, performance and service-improvement opportunities.
* Lead network optimisation and continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Recommend automation opportunities for repetitive triage, notification, reporting and evidence-gathering activities.
* Track the effectiveness of implemented improvements through operational measures and incident trends.
* Ensure monitoring procedures remain aligned with changes to technology, business services and supplier arrangements.

title: Security Architect - Cryptography & HSM
description:
Position: Security Architect - Cryptography & HSM (Crypto Architect, Band 'F')

Location: UIDAI Technology Centre, Bengaluru | On-site | Full-time

UIDAI operates the world's largest biometric identity platform. The Crypto Architect owns the cryptographic backbone of that platform - key lifecycle, the HSM estate, and the security architecture of the applications built on top of it. This is a hands-on architecture role, not an audit or GRC role.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

1) Cryptographic and Security Architecture

• Design and implement enterprise-grade cryptographic architecture - encryption, digital signatures, tokenisation, key derivation and secure protocol design.

• Own the HSM architecture end to end: deployment, partitioning, high availability, firmware / FIPS compliance and application integration via PKCS#11, JCE / JCA and KMIP.

• Define the key management lifecycle - generation, distribution, rotation, escrow, archival and destruction - with supporting policy and procedure.

• Translate security requirements into application-level design, secure prototypes and reusable cryptographic libraries for engineering teams.

2) Secure Engineering and Implementation

• Hands-on implementation and code review of cryptographic modules in C, C++, Java, Go or Rust.

• Design secure network and application solutions; embed security into the SDLC and CI/CD pipeline.

• Drive secure code review, cryptographic validation and remediation of findings.

3) Risk, Threat Modelling and Assurance

• Identify threats, vulnerabilities and risks across the IT infrastructure and perform structured threat modelling.

• Plan and oversee security testing, VAPT and cryptographic assessments; track findings through to closure.

• Maintain security architecture documentation, standards and technical artefacts.

4) Compliance and Governance

• Align architecture with ISO/IEC 27001, ITIL, NIST, FIPS 140-2 / 140-3 and UIDAI's information security policy framework.

• Support audits, certification and regulatory reviews with evidence and design rationale.

ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS

• BE / B.Tech / ME / M.Tech / MS / MCA / M.Sc in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or a related discipline.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in IT security, with demonstrable depth in applied cryptography.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

• Excellent understanding of cryptographic algorithms (AES, RSA, ECC, SHA-2 / SHA-3, HMAC, TLS 1.3) with hands-on implementation experience, not theoretical knowledge alone.

• Knowledge of HSM architecture including application integration (Thales / Luna, Utimaco, Entrust or equivalent).

• Strong programming ability in at least one of: C, C++, Java, Go, Rust.

• Sound knowledge of IT security processes and best practices (ITIL, ISO 27001).

• PKI, certificate lifecycle management and key management systems.

DESIRABLE

• Exposure to large-scale, high-throughput national or BFSI-grade platforms.

• CISSP / CISSP-ISSAP / CCSP / CEH or equivalent certification.

• Post-quantum cryptography migration planning, secure enclaves or confidential computing.

• Familiarity with Aadhaar ecosystem security standards, the UIDAI Information Security Policy or CERT-In guidelines.

PLEASE NOTE: This is a cryptography and information security role. It is NOT a blockchain, cryptocurrency, Web3 or DeFi position.

Engagement is through GA Digital Web Word Pvt Ltd for deployment at UIDAI Technology Centre, Bengaluru.

description:

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.  
  
Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

**About the Position**

The Chevron ENGINE – Senior Industrial Network Engineer is responsible for consulting, designing and deploying networking technologies and solutions for the enterprise and its business partners. As a team member, you will use your infrastructure experience and network knowledge to serve as a subject matter expert and project consultant, improving or introducing network capabilities that enable business outcomes while protecting Chevron from external and internal threats. You will work closely with architects, business partners, managed service partners, vendors, cybersecurity teams, infrastructure teams and digital platforms to solve difficult and rapidly changing technical challenges. Where new technologies are introduced, you will partner with Operations to ensure a successful transition.

The Senior Industrial Network Engineer will work with modern technologies and engage in global projects and initiatives across business, industrial and process control networks. The role requires strong knowledge of industrial routing and switching, Cisco SD-WAN and Cisco DNA Center/Catalyst Center, industrial wireless, network access control using Cisco ISE or Aruba ClearPass, and industrial asset visibility using Cisco Cyber Vision. The successful candidate will identify appropriate network solutions, implement resilient and secure infrastructure in accordance with engineering standards and company security policies, demonstrate strong troubleshooting skills, follow industry developments and collaborate effectively across global teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Design, implement and maintain resilient business and industrial LAN, WAN, routing and switching solutions across plant and enterprise environments.
* Develop network architecture standards for IP addressing, VLANs, VRFs, routing protocols, QoS, redundancy and high availability.
* Design and govern Cisco SD-WAN architecture, policy, path selection, resilience, failover testing and multi-site lifecycle management.
* Catalyst Center for network assurance, automation, visibility and operational governance.
* Design, review and troubleshoot industrial wireless solutions, including coverage, roaming, redundancy, interference, security and integration with plant networks.
* Validate and maintain device authentication, authorization and access policies using Cisco ISE, Aruba ClearPass or equivalent network access control platforms.
* Deploy and operate Cisco Cyber Vision capabilities, including sensor integration, industrial asset visibility, baselining and security-event investigation.
* Gather requirements and work with internal stakeholders to design network infrastructure that supports secure and reliable industrial operations.
* Create technical design documentation, implementation plans, test plans, operational standards and recovery procedures.
* Provide Tier 3 support for major incidents using packet captures, route analysis, device logs and end-to-end path validation, coordinating vendors and service providers when required.
* Follow standard change-management processes and participate in business continuity and disaster-recovery exercises supporting the network environment.
* Work with team, architects, operations, cybersecurity teams and business stakeholders to deliver solutions, improve processes and transition new technologies into operational support.

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.
* 10–15 years of network engineerin experience, including significant experience supporting industrial, manufacturing, energy or critical-infrastructure environments.
* Advanced English-language communication skills.
* CCNP or an equivalent advanced networking certification.
* Expert knowledge of advanced routing and switching, including VLANs, VRFs, STP, OSPF, BGP, QoS, multicast, redundancy, high availability and complex industrial network troubleshooting.
* Strong Cisco SD-WAN and Cisco Catalyst Center experience covering architecture, policy, assurance, automation, resilience and multi-site governance.
* Hands-on industrial wireless experience covering design review, survey interpretation, coverage, roaming, redundancy, security and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge Cisco ISE or Aruba ClearPass experience for device authentication, authorization and network access policy.
* Knowledge Cisco Cyber Vision experience covering deployment, sensor integration, industrial asset visibility, baselining and security-event investigation.
* Strong technical documentation, change control, incident leadership and stakeholder communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience designing and supporting industrial networks across brownfield and greenfield sites.
* Experience integrating routing, switching, SD-WAN, network access control, wireless and Cisco Cyber Vision within secure and resilient plant environments.
* Relevant certifications in Cisco Enterprise, Security, Wireless, SD-WAN or industrial cybersecurity.
* Strong written and verbal communication, business negotiation, influencing, conflict-resolution and technical decision-making skills.

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, supporting business requirements across the world. Accordingly, the work hours for employees will be aligned to support business requirements. The standard work week will be Monday to Friday. Working hours are 8:00am to 5:00pm or 1.30pm to 10.30pm.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About the team**

Sarvam builds Indic-language AI used at population scale. The CPU Infrastructure team runs everything outside the GPU fleet: Kubernetes across Azure, AWS, GCP and Indian sovereign clouds, the network between them, Cloudflare, identity, secrets, observability, cost and the delivery pipeline every product ships through.

The team builds and runs what it builds. Engineers own real systems end to end, and every repeated piece of manual work is a candidate for automation. As an AI company, we are building AI agents into our own operations, to plan and review infrastructure changes, triage alerts and handle routine issues, with engineers setting the guardrails.

**About the role**

You keep the infrastructure behind Sarvam’s products running. You handle day-to-day operations — deployments, provisioning, access, incidents and cost questions — and you are expected to automate that work away.

We hire for one instinct above everything else: you notice something done by hand every day, ask why it can’t run itself, and build the thing that removes it — a script, a pipeline step, a bot, a small Kubernetes operator, or an AI agent that does the work. Operations is a large part of this role, and it is where you find what is worth automating.

As you automate your own toil away, more of your time goes into platform and automation work.

**Products you may work on**

Sarvam builds across a broad range of AI products: voice agents, coding agents, coworker agents, dubbing, our API platform, and the real-time voice and WebRTC infrastructure underneath them, among many others. You will work on the infrastructure behind them.

**Responsibilities**

* Own infrastructure operations across Sarvam’s products: deployments, provisioning requests, access, environment issues, cost questions
* Respond to incidents, write the runbook or postmortem afterwards, and fix the cause
* Automate repeated work: turn manual steps into pipeline jobs, Terraform modules, templates or self-service for product teams
* Build AI-assisted automations: agents that triage alerts, summarise incidents, review routine changes or answer product teams’ infrastructure questions, with a human approving anything risky
* Security basics: keep images and dependencies patched, rotate credentials, keep secrets out of code, fix security findings
* Reliability basics: keep dashboards and alerts accurate, track SLOs and cost, delete noisy alerts
* Take part in on-call

**Requirements**

* 2–5 years in DevOps, SRE, infrastructure or backend engineering
* Has built infrastructure outside a ticket: a homelab, an open-source contribution, a side project, or an internal tool nobody asked for — and can show the code (GitHub, a blog post or a demo)
* Comfortable on the Linux command line: processes, networking basics, logs, systemd
* Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes; has deployed and debugged something running on a cluster
* Scripting in Python, Go or Bash
* Basic Git and CI/CD experience
* Has spotted a repeated manual task — a daily review, a recurring fix, a routine request — and built something that removed it: a script, a CI job, a bot or a Kubernetes operator. You can walk us through what you noticed, why it mattered, what you built and what it saved
* Has used LLMs or AI agents to automate real work, not only for writing code
* Fixes causes rather than the same symptom twice; asks “why is this manual?” before doing it again
* Curious, takes ownership, wants to grow into platform engineering
* Nice to have: Terraform, a public cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP), Prometheus / Grafana, exposure to SIP, WebRTC or real-time media, any cloud or Kubernetes certification

Please find the attached below summary for job vacancy in Nelmangala Plant.

We are seeking a safety-first Electrical Maintenance Engineer / Technician (ITI & Diploma holders) specializing in industrial heating systems to join our furnace manufacturing unit. You will be responsible for ensuring maximum uptime of our induction/arc furnaces, high-power transformers, automated charging systems, and critical water-cooling loops while strictly adhering to high-voltage industrial safety protocols.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Core Roles & Responsibilities

For ITI Candidates (Role: Furnace Maintenance Electrician / Technician)

* Furnace Component Upkeep: Perform routine maintenance on furnace coils, busbars, high-current water-cooled cables, and capacitor banks.

* Thermal & Sensor Calibration: Regularly inspect and replace high-temperature thermocouples, RTDs, infrared sensors, and proximity switches.

* Refractory & Lining Support: Assist the mechanical team in monitoring furnace lining wear and maintaining patching/ramming equipment electrics.

* Cooling Loop Maintenance: Monitor and maintain the electrical pumps, valves, and flow switches for the furnace’s critical water-cooling emergency systems.

* Heavy Panel Dressing: Clean and inspect high-voltage control panels, Thyristor switchgears, and power distribution boards (DBs) for overheating.

* High-Risk Safety (LOTO): Strictly apply Lockout-Tagout (LOTO) and wear arc-flash PPE before entering high-voltage furnace zones.

For Diploma Candidates (Role: Junior Furnace Maintenance Engineer / Supervisor)

* HT / LT Power Distribution: Manage the operations of heavy-duty HT/LT substations, furnace transformers, Air Circuit Breakers (ACBs), and Vacuum Circuit Breakers (VCBs).

* Automation & Thyristor Tuning: Troubleshoot and fine-tune PLC/SCADA control networks (Siemens, Rockwell, etc.) and Thyristor power controllers managing the furnace heating cycles.

* Predictive & Preventive Maintenance: Draft and manage the daily, weekly, and monthly PM schedules specifically tailored for furnace power factor optimization (APFC panels) and harmonic filters.

* Emergency Interlock Management: Ensure all safety interlocks (water flow, pressure, over-temperature trips, and earth-leakage relays) are fully operational and regularly tested.

* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Diagnose structural failures in furnace coils or power surges to continuously reduce MTTR (Mean Time to Repair) and optimize energy consumption.

* Team & Logbook Supervision: Allocate tasks to a shift team of ITI technicians, maintain legal breakdown registers, and manage high-value electrical spares (thyristors, diodes, cards). \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Key Technical Competencies

* For ITI Candidates:

o Proficient in using heavy insulation testers (Megger) to check furnace coil grounding.

o Sound knowledge of hydraulic/pneumatic valves linked to furnace tilting mechanisms.

o Expertise in industrial cable crimping and dealing with flexible copper braided wires.

* For Diploma Candidates:

o Ability to interpret advanced multi-page Electrical Schematics and Control Circuit Blueprints.

o Deep understanding of PLC logic handling multi-zone temperature profiling and cooling loop automated loops.

o Power quality monitoring (handling harmonics, voltage dips, and maintaining a high Power Factor).

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Work Environment & Eligibility

* Education:

o ITI in Electrician / Wireman / Power Electronics trade.

o Diploma (Polytechnic) in Electrical Engineering / Electrical & Electronics.

* Experience: 1 to 5+ years of core maintenance experience in an induction furnace plant, foundry, steel melting shop (SMS), or glass manufacturing factory.

Here you set what “secure” means across Sarvam’s infrastructure and build the automation that enforces it, so security is a property of the pipeline rather than a review step. You work closely with the compliance team.

This is a hands-on role: most of your time goes into building, and you guide engineering teams across Sarvam on security — setting standards, reviewing security-relevant work and mentoring engineers.

**Responsibilities**

* Define and enforce security baselines for Kubernetes, cloud accounts, container images and CI/CD across all clouds
* Write the policy gates in the delivery pipeline (OPA / Conftest, Kyverno or equivalent): network exposure, IAM, image provenance, secrets, data residency
* Own secrets and workload identity: Vault or cloud-native equivalents, rotation, short-lived and scoped credentials, no long-lived keys
* Build detection and response: runtime security (Falco / Tetragon or equivalent), log-based detections, alerting and playbooks
* Run the finding-to-fix loop for security findings: triage, assign, fix, add a detection, retest
* Use LLMs and AI agents in security work: triaging findings, reviewing infrastructure changes, tuning detections, drafting incident timelines — and secure the agents themselves with scoped, short-lived permissions and audit trails
* Harden the supply chain: image signing and scanning, dependency policy, SBOMs
* Automate compliance evidence (CERT-In, ISO 27001, SOC 2, DPDP) together with the compliance team
* Set the security standards other engineers follow and review security-relevant changes
* Take part in on-call and lead security incidents

**Requirements**

* 5–9 years in DevOps, platform or security engineering, with at least 2 in a bank, fintech, payments company or other regulated environment
* Strong Kubernetes and Linux fundamentals; has run production clusters on at least one major cloud
* Hands-on with Terraform / OpenTofu and GitOps (ArgoCD or Flux)
* Has built security automation, not only operated tools: policy-as-code, secrets rotation, CI/CD security gates or detection pipelines
* Working knowledge of IAM, network security, TLS and secrets management across clouds
* Scripting and tooling in Python or Go
* Has been through security audits and knows what evidence auditors need
* Has built or used AI-based automation in infrastructure or security work, and understands the risks of AI agents: prompt injection, over-broad permissions, unreviewed actions
* Nice to have: Vault, SPIFFE / SPIRE, Falco or Tetragon, Cloudflare WAF, incident response lead experience, multi-cloud experience

description:
**Location**

**Type**
: Full-Time

**Reports To**
: Founder

**About PHNX Securities**

https://www.phnxsecurities.com/

PHNX Securities is a next-generation quantitative trading firm, focused on systematic, research-driven strategies. Our approach combines deep market understanding with robust engineering — emphasizing clean execution infrastructure, rigorous backtesting, strict risk controls, and full regulatory readiness.

**Our Mission**

To combine advanced research, automation, and disciplined risk management to create scalable, repeatable, high-conviction quantitative strategies across global markets.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a skilled Network Engineer to design, build, and maintain the low-latency network infrastructure connecting our trading systems to exchange colocation environments (including NSE colocation).

This role operates at the intersection of exchange connectivity, network architecture, and production infrastructure reliability, with a strong emphasis on low-latency design, multicast market data delivery, and hands-on ownership of our colocation rack. You will work closely with our trading infrastructure team to ensure our systems have fast, reliable, and resilient connectivity to the exchange.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, deploy, and maintain network connectivity between our colocation rack and NSE trading systems
* Configure and manage BGP (unicast routing) and PIM-SM (multicast routing) for order entry and market data connectivity
* Troubleshoot and resolve network-related latency and performance issues across production trading infrastructure
* Own physical layer setup and compliance — fiber handoffs, patch cords, switch/transceiver configuration, and NSE audit readiness
* Manage out-of-band hardware management (IPMI/BMC) for remote server administration in the colo environment
* Coordinate with NSE colocation support and remote-hands teams for troubleshooting, circuit migrations, and hardware issues
* Collaborate with the trading/quant dev team on network-level latency optimization (NIC tuning, kernel bypass considerations, etc.)
* Maintain documentation of network topology, configurations, and connectivity architecture for internal reference

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Experience in network engineering, ideally in a trading, fintech, or low-latency environment
* Strong knowledge of routing protocols — BGP (eBGP), and multicast routing (PIM-SM, IGMP)
* Solid understanding of L2/L3 network design and client-server network architectures
* Hands-on experience with Cisco IOS/NX-OS or equivalent network operating systems
* Experience with datacenter/colocation network setups — fiber connectivity, patch panels, SFP/SFP+ transceivers
* Familiarity with IPMI/BMC and out-of-band server management
* Working knowledge of Linux/Unix systems administration
* Understanding of exchange connectivity concepts (market data feeds, order entry, redundancy design) — NSE experience strongly preferred

**Preferred (Nice to Have)**

* Direct experience with NSE colocation infrastructure or Indian exchange connectivity
* Experience with multicast market data distribution in a trading environment
* Exposure to time synchronization (NTP/PTP)
* CCNA or higher certification
* Familiarity with low-latency network tuning (kernel bypass, NIC offloading) — DPDK/Solarflare exposure a plus

**Candidate Profile**

* Strong systems thinker with attention to detail and reliability
* Able to work closely with trading/dev teams and leadership in a small, high-ownership environment
* Calm and methodical under pressure — network issues during market hours require fast, precise troubleshooting
* Willing to be hands-on with physical infrastructure (rack visits, cabling, hardware troubleshooting) when needed

**Why Join PHNX Securities**

* Build and own critical trading infrastructure from the ground up
* Work directly with the Founder and core trading infrastructure team
* Exposure to real exchange colocation environments and low-latency systems
* Opportunity to shape the firm's network and infrastructure foundation

title: Manager, Core Infrastructure Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
For a single team delivering components of distributed systems. Translates goals into a 1–2 quarter execution plan, sets coding, testing, and scalability practices, and provides hands-on oversight of performance tuning and load/perf testing. Guides the team in building fault-tolerant, in-service-upgradable components (redundancy, replication, failover) and in applying resiliency patterns (retries, circuit breakers, timeouts). Ensures robust observability (tests, alarms, dashboards, telemetry) and operational readiness via reviewed runbooks and standard procedures. Manages delivery of scoped features and correctness testing (including fault-injection/brownouts), and directs implementation of data replication/synchronization to maintain integrity and availability. Leads team incident response and root-cause efforts, enforces no-customer-downtime practices, and drives use of automation/IaC for troubleshooting. Oversees team security implementation (encryption, access controls), tracks remediation plans, verifies compliance documentation, and coaches adherence to change-management plans for safe patching, updates, and rollbacks.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**System Design & Architecture – System Scalability:**

* Provides oversight to the team on the development of components of distributed systems, including the use of distributed state management tools.
* Monitors and enables optimization of code and/or systems for large-scale data processing.
* Guides team to implement scalability requirements for assigned components.
* Coaches team to leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
* Ensures team accurately implements and executes performance and load testing.

**System Design & Architecture – System Reliability Design:**

* Provides guidance to the team in building fault-tolerant systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by leading the implementation of redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
* Guides the design of components to effectively handle service disruptions.
* Coaches team on various approaches to handle network unreliability, including retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts.

**System Design & Architecture – System Reliability Performance:**

* Guides team to implement testing and alarming configurations for detecting and addressing issues/failures.
* Ensures team effectively supports recovery efforts by reviewing and aligning on runbooks and operational procedures.
* Coaches team on building and customizing dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

**System Design & Architecture – Correctness / Availability:**

* Manages the implementation and design of functional requirements and testing for features within an existing system.
* Coaches team on implementing test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
* Guides the implementation of data replication and synchronization techniques within the team to maintain data integrity and availability.

**Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:**

* Leads team efforts in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in system components to support ongoing operation.
* Ensures teams are following protocols for preventing interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
* Manages team in effectively implementing automation scripts and tooling when troubleshooting operational issues.
* Creates schedules and manages operational support rotations.

**Compliance & Security:**

* Manages team implementation of robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, overseeing encryption techniques and access controls.
* Manages execution of remediation plans to address identified security gaps, ensuring continuous improvement of security measures.

title: Endpoint Engineering
description:

* Lead and provide

  across Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, Windows 10/11 and enterprise workplace technologies.
* Troubleshoot
  **Microsoft Intune and SCCM/MECM**
  , covering device enrolment, configuration and compliance policies, application deployment, patching, client health and software distribution.
* Engineer and support
  **Windows Autopilot, Operating System Deployment (OSD) and workstation imaging**
  , including task sequences, drivers, enterprise builds and modern device provisioning.
* Provide advanced technical support for
  **VDI environments**
  , preferably Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) and/or VMware Horizon, including application delivery, user-profile and performance troubleshooting.
* Troubleshoot
  **Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)**
  device identity, authentication, registration and endpoint-management integration, along with endpoint security and compliance issues.
* Own
  **complex endpoint and VDI incidents**
  , performing root-cause analysis, driving permanent technical fixes and coordinating L2/L3 escalations with infrastructure teams and technology vendors.
* Lead technical delivery for
  **Windows upgrades, Intune/SCCM migrations, Autopilot adoption, application deployments, VDI initiatives and endpoint-security improvements**
  .
* Monitor
  **endpoint health, patching, deployment and compliance**
  , using ServiceNow/ITSM processes for incident, problem, request and change management while maintaining appropriate technical documentation and reporting.

**Key responsibilities skills required:**

* Lead endpoint engineering and workplace technology operations, with primary responsibility for Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, Windows endpoints and VDI environments.
* Provide hands-on L2 technical support and engineering for complex endpoint issues, including Windows 11, device configuration, application deployment, patching, performance, compliance and provisioning failures.
* Troubleshoot Microsoft Intune, including device enrolment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, application deployment, endpoint security policies and remediation.
* Manage and troubleshoot SCCM/MECM services, including software distribution, application/package deployment, collections, client health, patching, compliance and Operating System Deployment (OSD).
* Engineer and support Windows Autopilot and modern device provisioning, including enrolment profiles, deployment troubleshooting and transition towards modern endpoint management.
* Manage and troubleshoot Windows workstation imaging and deployment infrastructure, including task sequences, drivers, operating system builds and image lifecycle management.
* Provide hands-on technical support and engineering for VDI platforms, preferably Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) and/or VMware Horizon, including desktop delivery, application access, user-profile and performance-related issues.
* Troubleshoot Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) device identity, authentication, device registration and endpoint-management integration issues.
* Knowledge of PowerShell scripts and automation for endpoint configuration, deployment, remediation, health checks, reporting and repetitive administrative activities.
* Analyse recurring endpoint and VDI incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and implement permanent technical fixes and preventive improvements rather than relying solely on incident resolution.
* Lead technical activities for Windows upgrades, Intune/SCCM migrations, Autopilot adoption, VDI initiatives, application deployments, endpoint-security changes and workplace technology transformations.
* Monitor and improve endpoint health, deployment success, patch compliance, configuration compliance and VDI service performance, producing actionable technical and management reporting.
* Own and coordinate L2/L3 technical escalations involving endpoint, VDI and associated infrastructure dependencies, engaging Microsoft, Citrix, VMware, OEM and other technology vendors where required.
* Provide advanced support for VIP and business-critical users, combining deep technical troubleshooting with discretion, responsiveness and clear communication.
* Maintain endpoint-related technical documentation, SOPs, engineering standards, knowledge articles, build documentation and troubleshooting guides.
* Support basic troubleshooting of network, server, Cisco and Azure dependencies affecting endpoint and VDI services, engaging specialist infrastructure teams for deeper resolution where necessary.
* Apply ITIL and project-management practices to endpoint and workplace technology initiatives while maintaining a strong focus on hands-on engineering, automation and continuous technical improvement.

**Key skills required:**

* BTech/BE in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, with 3–4 years of relevant experience in endpoint engineering, workplace technology, EUC, or infrastructure operations.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Intune, including device enrolment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, application deployment, endpoint security policies, remediation, troubleshooting and device lifecycle management.
* Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft SCCM/MECM, including application/package deployment, software distribution, collections, compliance, patching, client troubleshooting and operating system deployment.
* Strong understanding of Windows Endpoint engineering, including Windows 11 administration, Group Policy, registry, PowerShell-based troubleshooting and enterprise workstation configurations.
* Hands-on experience with Windows Autopilot and modern endpoint provisioning, including troubleshooting enrolment and deployment-related issues.
* Strong experience with OS deployment and workstation imaging, including task sequences, driver management, image maintenance and deployment troubleshooting.
* Strong VDI expertise, preferably across technologies such as Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) and/or VMware Horizon, with hands-on experience supporting virtual desktop environments, application delivery, profile-related issues and performance troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), device identity, authentication and integration with endpoint management technologies.
* Practical experience with PowerShell scripting and automation for endpoint administration, remediation, configuration and operational efficiency.
* Strong troubleshooting capability across endpoints, VDI, network and infrastructure dependencies, with the ability to perform structured root-cause analysis rather than only first-level desktop support.
* Working knowledge of endpoint security and compliance, including Microsoft Defender-related controls, encryption, device compliance and vulnerability/remediation processes.
* Knowledge in IT asset management and end-to-end endpoint lifecycle management, including provisioning, refreshing, secure data wiping, decommissioning and disposal.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms, with experience in incident, service request, problem and change management.
* Ability to manage complex L2/L3 escalations, including collaboration with Microsoft, Citrix, VMware, OEMs and other technology vendors where applicable.
* Experience supporting VIP and business-critical users, with the ability to diagnose complex technical issues while maintaining strong communication and responsiveness.
* Experience with technical projects and enterprise endpoint transformations, such as Intune migration, SCCM/MECM modernisation, Windows upgrades, Autopilot adoption, VDI deployment or endpoint-security initiatives.
* Strong analytical capability in endpoint compliance reporting, patching, deployment success/failure analysis, service health and continuous improvement.
* Good understanding of ITIL practices and enterprise service-management principles.

**Location and way of working**

* Base location: Hyderabad

Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies - all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows including Amazon Originals and exclusive licensed content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add-on channels which they can cancel at anytime and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business - available in over 200 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.
  
  
Our Playback Operations Systems Group is looking for a motivated, results-oriented, dedicated and operationally focused System Development Engineer to support the fast-evolving and expanding device automation systems, that support our live events and 24/7 linear operations. You will have an enormous opportunity to work within multiple systems analyzing and identifying the common issues, and driving the teams towards resolution to have a positive impact on customer experience. This job requires you to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and deliver systems and automation that scale Prime Video's Live OTT delivery and 24/7 linear operations
* Own the operational health of device automation and monitoring systems — identify resilience risks and deliver solutions that eliminate them
* Improve monitoring capabilities and system reliability, reducing manual operational load across the team
* Define and maintain operational metrics and service level objectives, with alarming based on service health
* Drive resolution of difficult performance, reliability, and availability issues, leaving systems better than you found them
* Partner with adjacent Live Ops engineering teams to improve how systems interact and integrate

A day in the life
  
  
Your morning starts by reviewing operational dashboards and alerts, ensuring live services are healthy. When issues arise—latency spikes, availability drops—you collaborate with the team to diagnose and resolve them quickly.
  
  
Mid-morning shifts to development: enhancing automation scripts, improving device monitoring workflows, and testing changes in staging environments to reduce manual intervention during live events.
  
  
Afternoons bring cross-team collaboration—troubleshooting priority tickets with encoding and operations engineers, deploying fixes before high-profile events go live, and designing monitoring solutions that scale with Prime Video's growing live sports portfolio.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Playback Ops Systems Group build and maintain reliable, high performance customer experience monitoring tooling and infrastructure. We take ownership of the end-to-end live monitoring experience -- from a Living Room device, through our encoding and analysis platform, out through to our Live Ops AVOCs (Amazon Video Operation Centres). Our team makes a big impact because nothing is more important to us than delighting our customers, continually earning their trust, and thinking long term. If you crave a sense of ownership, this is the place to be.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
* Experience with distributed systems at scale

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience utilizing AWS cloud solutions in a DevOps environment
* Experience establishing metrics for measurement of engineering and operational excellence
* Experience in major facilities incident management
* Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience working in a large team or fast-paced corporate environment
* supporting or automating physical device fleets, encoding appliances, or hardware infrastructure

description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll work closely with our clients and internal teams to ensure that services are restored swiftly, in line with our service level agreements (SLAs).
  
  
Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests and tickets, applying your technical expertise to resolve them efficiently and effectively. You'll be the go-to person for second-line support, handling incidents and requests of medium complexity. In addition to your daily tasks, you'll have opportunities to contribute to exciting project work from time to time.
  
  
You'll proactively monitor work queues, execute operational tasks, and update tickets with the actions you've taken. Identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate will be a key part of your role.
