title: Manager - Cloud Operations Lead
description:
****Job Summary****
At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you “
**Create your own sunshine**
”— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.
  
  
****Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?****
As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”
  
  
****Job Summary:****
We are looking for a hands-on Cloud Operations Lead to run the day-to-day operations of our AWS-primary cloud estate (with a fast-growing Azure footprint) and to own and drive DevSecOps across the organisation. Reporting to the Cloud Architect within the Cloud CoE, the role spans three areas: cloud operations (about half the role), cloud-security remediation (about a quarter), and DevSecOps ownership, adoption and governance (about a quarter). In practice that means running the reliability and cost-efficiency of the cloud estate, closing security findings and hardening the environment, and owning the DevSecOps toolchain while driving its adoption and governance across delivery teams. It is a deeply technical, execution-focused role for an engineer equally comfortable in infrastructure-as-code, pipeline security, incident response, and directing a managed-services partner pool.
  
  
On the operations side, you will operate and continuously improve the landing zones, networking, and platform services designed by the Cloud Architect — primarily on AWS, and increasingly on Azure as that estate grows. You will run monitoring and observability, drive incident, problem, and change management to resolution, and enforce operational guardrails, patching, and backup/DR routines across environments. You will act as the operational owner of the NTT DATA cloud and DevSecOps managed-services pool, holding the partner to SLAs and quality standards.
  
  
On the security and DevSecOps side, you will remediate cloud-security findings and harden the estate, and own the DevSecOps toolchain and practice end-to-end — building and maintaining secure CI/CD pipelines, integrating SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets-scanning, and image/container security into the delivery flow, and shifting security left. You will define secure-pipeline standards, onboard and enable delivery teams, and actively drive DevSecOps adoption and maturity across the organisation, in line with CISO requirements. Across both halves of the role you will maintain infrastructure-as-code, automate operational toil, support cloud cost/FinOps optimisation, and work within the architecture standards and guardrails set by the Cloud Architect and the Enterprise Architecture Review Board (EARB), escalating design changes rather than making them unilaterally.
  
  
**Areas Of Responsibility**
**Area of Responsibility**
****Responsibilities****
**Cloud Operations & Reliability (~50%)**
Operate and maintain the AWS-primary cloud estate (and growing Azure footprint) for reliability and availability against agreed SLOs.
  
  
Own monitoring, alerting, and observability across infrastructure and platform services.
  
  
Drive incident, problem, and change management to timely resolution, including on-call/major-incident response.
  
  
Operate landing zones, networking, and platform services within the guardrails set by the Cloud Architect.
  
  
Maintain infrastructure-as-code (Terraform primary; CloudFormation / Bicep / ARM) to provision and change environments consistently.
  
  
**Automation & Platform Engineering**
Automate operational toil across provisioning, monitoring, and scaling.
  
  
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and platform deployments in collaboration with DevOps/DevSecOps.
  
  
Perform operational debugging, root-cause analysis, and performance tuning; document runbooks and share operational knowledge.
  
  
Operate backup, restore, and disaster-recovery routines; verify recoverability and data availability.
  
  
Implement and maintain configuration management and environment consistency across dev, test, and production.
  
  
Maintain platform health across integrated components and dependencies.
  
  
Track operational metrics and keep stakeholders informed of service health and incidents.
  
  
**Cloud Security Remediation & Hardening (~25%)**
Implement and operate cloud security and DevSecOps controls in line with CISO requirements.
  
  
Own the cloud-security remediation backlog: triage findings from CSPM, Security Hub / Defender, and CISO reviews, and drive them to closure within SLA.
  
  
Apply patching, hardening, and encryption/key-management routines across the estate.
  
  
Remediate vulnerabilities and misconfigurations across accounts/subscriptions; harden baselines and prevent regression.
  
  
Continuously monitor cloud posture (CSPM) and report remediation status, risk burn-down, and exceptions to the CISO office.
  
  
Ensure controls and remediation evidence are audit-ready (GxP, GDPR, HIPAA); support security reviews and audits.
  
  
**Scalability and Performance**
Optimise platform performance, scaling, and resource utilisation against SLOs.
  
  
Perform capacity planning and autoscaling configuration for cloud workloads.
  
  
Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks; right-size resources for cost and performance.
  
  
**DevSecOps Ownership, Adoption & Governance (~25%)**
Own the DevSecOps toolchain end-to-end and integrate security scanning (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets, IaC scanning) into CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
Embed image/container and Kubernetes security (registry scanning, admission controls, policy-as-code) into the delivery flow.
  
  
Define secure-pipeline standards and reusable templates; maintain release hygiene for continuous, safe delivery.
  
  
Drive DevSecOps adoption across delivery teams: onboard projects, run enablement, and track maturity uptake.
  
  
Establish and report DevSecOps KPIs (pipeline coverage, scan pass rates, mean-time-to-remediate, adoption %).
  
  
Manage secrets, keys, and certificates and enforce supply-chain security (SBOM, dependency and artifact integrity).
  
  
Own DevSecOps governance: define policy, standards, and gates in coordination with the CISO and EARB, and enforce them across teams.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement & Vendor Oversight**
Own the NTT DATA cloud managed-services pool: assign work, hold to SLAs, and review quality.

title: ID - Rack Lifecycle Tech, Rack Lifecycle Team
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You'll join a diverse team of hardware and network engineers, logistics specialists, security and safety experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
We are looking for a detail-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.
  
  
As an Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers, prepare SOP’s with new processes, stake holder management with cross functional teams. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
🔷 Rack Installation & Cabling
  
  

* Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
* Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
* Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self-resolving outside approved procedures
* Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities

🔷 Rack Lifecycle Operations
  
  

* Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
* Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
* Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self-resolve outside approved procedures
* Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation

🔷 Material Handling & Supply Chain Support
  
  

* Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
* Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
* Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines

🔷 Handover & Documentation
  
  

* Complete all required as-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
* Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
* Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase

🔷 Rack Decommissioning
  
  

* Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de-tagging, and rack extraction
* Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
* Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
* Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
* Validate that reclaimed U-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool

🔷 Quality, Safety & Compliance
  
  

* Adhere to all site-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
* Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
* Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity

🔷 Cross-Team Coordination
  
  

* Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
* Participate in daily stand-ups and pre-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
* Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately

🔷 Continuous Learning & Development
  
  

* Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
* Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team-specific technical programs
* Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
* Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
* Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team

A day in the life
  
  
As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and Amazon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 1+ years of computer networking experience
* 1+ years of Linux operating systems experience
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* Experience in computer networking
* Experience working with Linux operating systems
* Can lift and rack equipment up to 40 pounds
* Experience with computer hardware troubleshooting and repair

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines
* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
* Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
* Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
* Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)
* Familiarity with rack decommissioning including device wipe, media destruction, and asset recovery procedures

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Oracle SOA Suite, Oracle Service Bus (OSB), Oracle Application Integration Architecture (AIA) and Oracle WebLogic Server**
environments that underpin Telecom BSS, OSS and enterprise application flows.
  
  
This is an
**Application Operations and production-support role rather than an application development role**
. You will combine in-depth technical troubleshooting with incident and problem management, SLA/KPI ownership, production-change readiness, automation, observability and continual service improvement.
  
  
The role requires
**4–7 years of relevant experience**
in Telecom IT, Middleware, Integration or Enterprise Application Operations, including significant hands-on responsibility for Oracle FMW production environments. There are no direct or dotted-line reports.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
Middleware technical operations
  
  

* Lead day-to-day technical operations across Oracle FMW, SOA Suite, OSB, AIA and WebLogic production environments
* Investigate and resolve complex integration failures involving SOA composites, BPEL, Mediators, Adapters, OSB services, JMS/JDBC resources, web services, APIs and dependent BSS/OSS systems
* Administer and support WebLogic domains, clusters, Admin and Managed Servers, data sources, JMS components, deployments, JVM health and runtime logs
* Support AIA integration flows and frameworks, including end-to-end transaction tracing, orchestration, interface dependencies, error recovery and production diagnostics
* Perform log, thread, heap/JVM, connection, socket, queue/backlog and performance analysis to identify platform and integration issues

Incident, problem and service management
  
  

* Take ownership of the technical quality of root-cause analysis, corrective actions and known-error tracking, helping reduce recurring middleware incidents
* Deliver agreed SLA/KPI commitments across Incident, Problem, Change and Service Request processes and highlight service risks early
* Analyse MTTR, recurring incidents, failure patterns, backlog and availability trends to prioritise technical improvements
* Support P1/P2 service restoration and coordinate technical activities across application, infrastructure, database, network, security and vendor teams

Change, release and operational readiness
  
  

* Support production change and release readiness, implementation validation, rollback planning, pre/post checks and post-release stabilisation
* Ensure new and changed middleware services are operationally ready through appropriate documentation, monitoring, runbooks, access, escalation paths and knowledge transfer
* Help ensure middleware services meet availability, resilience, disaster-recovery and operational-readiness expectations

Automation, observability and continual improvement
  
  

* Automate health checks, pre/post validations, recurring operational activities, queue and service checks, housekeeping and reporting using Shell, WLST, SQL and approved automation tooling
* Improve monitoring and observability through dashboards, alert tuning, transaction monitoring and log/event correlation
* Use AI/AIOps capabilities, where available, to support anomaly detection, event correlation, triage, root-cause isolation and knowledge-assisted resolution, with appropriate human review
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual operational effort and improve service reliability

Governance and collaboration
  
  

* Participate in operational service reviews and provide concise technical updates covering service stability, SLA/KPI risks, P1/P2 actions, capacity, automation and the improvement backlog
* Collaborate across middleware, application, database, infrastructure and vendor teams within the assigned service or market
* Apply independent technical judgement to troubleshooting, service restoration, RCA and improvement activities, escalating significant service or strategic decisions through the appropriate service leadership

Who you are
  
  
You have:
  
  

* 4+ years' experience in Telecom IT, Middleware, Integration or Enterprise Application Operations
* Strong hands-on production-support experience with Oracle Fusion Middleware, Oracle SOA Suite, OSB, AIA and WebLogic Server
* Experience troubleshooting SOA composites, BPEL, Mediators, Adapters, proxy and business services, pipelines, routing, transformations and service errors
* Practical knowledge of WebLogic domains and clusters, Admin/Managed Servers, JVM, JDBC, JMS, security, deployments and performance troubleshooting
* Experience with SOAP/REST integrations, APIs, XML, XSD, XSLT and message-based integration
* Strong Unix/Linux troubleshooting and Shell scripting capability
* Working knowledge of Oracle SQL/PLSQL and WebLogic Scripting Tool (WLST)
* Experience diagnosing incidents using application and middleware logs, JVM/runtime analysis, SQL, queues and end-to-end transaction tracing
* Experience with P1/P2 restoration, RCA, Problem Management and SLA/KPI-led production support
* Knowledge of High Availability, resilience and Disaster Recovery in middleware environments
* Hands-on exposure to one or more observability technologies such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Splunk, Kibana, Grafana or Zabbix
* Experience implementing practical operational automation and improving monitoring and alert quality
* Knowledge of ITIL-aligned Incident, Problem, Change and Service Request processes
* The ability to collaborate effectively across application, infrastructure, database, network, security and vendor teams
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience. ITIL Foundation is preferred

Exposure to
**OCI/cloud operations, containers, Kubernetes/OKE, Oracle API Gateway, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kafka, CI/CD, DevOps, SRE practices, AI/AIOps or Telecom CRM, Billing, Order Management and Provisioning ecosystems**
would be beneficial.
  
  
Not a Perfect Fit?
  
  
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**
This role provides the opportunity to:
  
  

* Work hands-on with business-critical Oracle middleware and integration environments supporting Telecom BSS, OSS and enterprise services
* Build experience in large-scale production operations spanning service reliability, incident recovery and operational readiness
* Contribute to automation and observability initiatives that reduce manual operational effort and improve service stability
* Apply AI/AIOps capabilities to practical production use cases such as anomaly detection, event correlation and accelerated technical triage
* Collaborate across application, database, infrastructure, network, security and vendor teams to resolve complex end-to-end service issues
* Contribute directly to measurable improvements in availability, MTTR, integration reliability and operational quality

**What Skills You Will Learn**
Through the scope of this role, you can further develop your skills in:
  
  

* Advanced Oracle FMW, SOA Suite, OSB, AIA and WebLogic production troubleshooting
* End-to-end transaction tracing and integration-flow diagnostics
* JVM, queue, connection, performance and capacity analysis
* Operational automation using Shell, WLST and SQL

title: Project Engineer
description:
Requisition Number: 79131

**The company built on breakthroughs.**  
**Join us.**

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.

Come break through with us.

  

Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use.

  

**Function/Dept Purpose Statement**

The Plant Engineering organization is the steward of our equipment and process. We maintain the equipment; conduct advanced troubleshooting; monitor equipment and process performance; and develop and implement process/equipment/procedure adjustments.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Supports drive to fundamental process understanding and lowest cost producer objectives.
* Supports the development and execution of plans to evaluate improvements in existing technology resulting in a superior product in terms of quality and/or cost.
* Supports and/or leads sub-teams on new equipment installation, process certification, documentation and training.
* Works with other team members to solve difficult technical, engineering related problems.
* Supports or leads small project teams to focus on continuous improvement activities, new product or process introductions, and cost reduction projects.
* Executes cost reduction and improvement (DMAIC) projects in line with business objectives.
* Trains operators and trades personnel on new equipment and processes.
* Troubleshoots material, process and equipment issues, identifies root cause and implements corrective action.
* Implements and documents material, process and/or equipment changes.
* Identifies and supports evaluation of equipment, process and cost-improvement opportunities for upcoming projects.
* Assists in developing preliminary project scope, technical requirements, cost estimates, and justification for equipment or process-improvement projects.

  

***Project state***

* Training program will be “on the job” and will be results oriented, practical training.
* During training program, assists with the installation, start-up, troubleshooting, and operation of manufacturing equipment and learns our safety protocol, equipment, process, and culture/values.
* Leverages training program to assist in the installation, start-up, debugging, and operationalization of our process equipment in the Indian GF.
* Works with other team members to ensure quality operations are occurring.
* Validates training and other installation/process support processes and helps to train new personnel.
* Supports the review of engineering drawings, equipment layouts, installation and commissioning documents.
* Coordinates installation readiness, including site access, utility availability, contractor mobilization, material availability and safety requirements.
* Oversees and coordinates on-site activities for the installation, start-up, troubleshooting and commissioning of equipment and related systems
* Maintains project schedules, milestone plans, action trackers, and periodic progress/status reports.
* Tracks project risks, issues, dependencies and roadblocks; escalate potential impact on scope, schedule, cost or quality.
* Supports in equipment acceptance, performance trials, and handover to operations and maintenance.

**Required Experience:**

* 4-7 years’ experience in process engineering Projects in manufacturing environment
* Exposure to industrial safety practices
* Demonstrated ability to deliver results while managing multiple tasks and issues effectively

**Required Knowledge:**

* B.E. in Mechanical/Mechatronics
* Experience in Project Management/Project Execution
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Strong Data Analysis skills (Control Charts, Pareto Analysis, Pivot Table) and Analytical mindset
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and/or as a team leader
* Technical aptitude conducive to building proficiency in troubleshooting manufacturing equipment and evaluating manufacturing data.
* Experience with MS-office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and MS Access.
* Six Sigma Green Belt or DMAIC project experience preferred
* Basic understanding of project scheduling, project documentation, action/risk tracking, and progress reporting.
* Familiarity with MS Project or other project-planning/tracking tools is preferred.

**Job Title:**
**Assistant Manager – Infrastructure & Network Management**

**Department: Information Technology**

**Location: Gurgaon**

**Reporting to: Head of Technology**

**About the Role**

The role is responsible for managing enterprise IT infrastructure, network operations, systems administration, cloud and hosting environments, security controls, Microsoft platform administration and API integration ecosystems across multiple locations. The position will provide centralized governance while enabling effective support to distributed station-level IT teams, ensuring high availability, performance, security, scalability and operational continuity for business-critical technology services.

The ideal candidate will be a mid-to-senior level professional with 7 - 10+ years of relevant experience in complex, multi-location IT environments, preferably in aviation, logistics, ground handling, transportation, or other distributed operational industries.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Infrastructure & Server Management**

* Design, implement, administer and maintain enterprise IT infrastructure including on-premise servers, cloud infrastructure, virtualization platforms, storage, backup and related systems.
* Manage Windows and Linux server environments, including deployment, configuration, monitoring, patching, performance optimization, hardening and lifecycle management.
* Administer virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or equivalent technologies.
* Ensure server availability, capacity planning, backup readiness and operational resilience across business-critical systems.

**Network Management**

* Manage multi-OEM network infrastructure across centralized and station-level environments, including LAN, WAN, wireless, VPN, routing, switching, routers, switches, load balancers, DNS, DHCP and connectivity services.
* Monitor network health, availability, capacity and performance using enterprise monitoring and alerting tools.
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across multiple stations and coordinate timely resolution with internal teams, OEMs, service providers and vendors.
* Support network optimization initiatives to improve reliability, performance and user experience across locations.

**Cloud & Hosting**

* Administer Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud environments, including cloud resources, hosting platforms, identity integrations, monitoring and governance controls.
* Support cloud infrastructure planning, migration, optimization, high availability, backup and disaster recovery requirements.
* Ensure cloud and hosted environments are aligned with organizational security, compliance, cost and performance expectations.

**Security & Firewall Management**

* Administer firewall configurations, rule changes, access policies, VPNs and network security controls in line with organizational governance standards.
* Perform infrastructure hardening, patch management, vulnerability remediation, audit support and compliance-related activities.
* Coordinate with information security teams to implement security controls, monitor risks and support incident response for infrastructure and network environments.

**API Integration & Management**

* Manage and support enterprise integration services including REST APIs, SOAP web services, API gateways, middleware, managed file transfer, messaging platforms and event-driven integrations.
* Oversee API lifecycle activities including integration design support, deployment coordination, monitoring, performance optimization, troubleshooting and governance.
* Support secure and reliable integration between enterprise applications, operational systems, cloud platforms and third-party systems.
* Coordinate with application, security, cloud and development teams to ensure API availability, security, scalability and compliance.

**Microsoft Ecosystem Administration**

* Administer Microsoft platforms including Azure Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Intune, endpoint management, identity and access management and related policy controls.
* Support user access governance, device compliance, endpoint security policies, licensing coordination and Microsoft platform operational support.
* Ensure Microsoft ecosystem administration is aligned with enterprise security, productivity and governance requirements.

**Multi-Location Operations Support**

* Provide centralized infrastructure and network governance for distributed operations across multiple stations or business locations.
* Support station-level IT teams in troubleshooting, escalations, technology rollouts, documentation and operational issue resolution.
* Ensure standardization of infrastructure processes, monitoring, change control, compliance, documentation and support practices across locations.

**Team, Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, IT teams, OEMs, telecom service providers, cloud partners and technology vendors for operational support and project delivery.
* Manage vendor performance, service reviews, SLA adherence, escalation tracking and technology upgrade planning.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on availability, service quality, automation, risk reduction and operational efficiency.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, SOPs, inventory records, escalation matrices and operational runbooks.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* 7 - 10+ years of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, network administration, systems management, cloud operations, security controls and enterprise integration support.
* Experience in multi-location organizations with distributed IT operations and business-critical infrastructure environments.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong administration experience in Windows Server and Linux environments.
* Hands-on knowledge of virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of network technologies including LAN, WAN, routing, switching, VPN, firewalls, DNS, DHCP, load balancing and wireless infrastructure.
* Experience with multi-OEM network environments and vendor-supported technology landscapes.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience in firewall governance, network security controls, vulnerability remediation, patching and infrastructure hardening.
* Knowledge of API integrations, middleware, API gateways, REST/SOAP services, managed file transfers and messaging platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, ActiveMQ, or Azure Service Bus.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, backup, disaster recovery and troubleshooting tools.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft administration including Azure AD, Microsoft 365, Intune, identity, access, endpoint and policy management.
* Exposure to scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar tools will be an advantage.

**Functional Skills**

* Strong understanding of incident management, change management, problem management and service request fulfilment.
* Ability to develop and maintain documentation, SOPs, governance processes, audit evidence and operational controls.
* Strong troubleshooting skills in distributed, high-availability and operationally sensitive environments.
* Ability to manage priorities, escalations, dependencies and vendor deliverables in a time-bound manner.

**Preferred Experience**

* Prior experience in aviation, airport operations, ground handling, logistics, transportation, manufacturing, or other multi-location operational environments.
* Experience supporting infrastructure for mission-critical applications and 24x7 business operations.
* Experience with hybrid cloud, disaster recovery planning, infrastructure modernization, automation and technology standardization initiatives.
* Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect, CCNA, CCNP, VMware Certified Professional, ITIL Foundation, RHCSA, RHCE, or equivalent will be preferred.

**Key Competencies**

* Ownership mindset with strong accountability for infrastructure availability and operational continuity.
* Leadership capability to manage teams, vendors, escalations and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and decision-making skills.
* Clear communication and documentation skills for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a dynamic, distributed and time-sensitive operational environment.
* Proactive approach to risk identification, service improvement, security and compliance.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to partner with application, security, cloud, operations and business teams.

**Reporting Structure**

* The role will report to the Infrastructure Lead / Head of Technology.
* The role will work closely with application teams, Information security teams, station IT teams, business operations teams, service providers, OEMs and external technology partners.

**Location / Work Environment**

* The role will operate in a multi-location environment with centralized governance and distributed station-level support.
* The position may require coordination across corporate offices, operational stations, data centers, cloud environments, vendors and field IT teams.
* The candidate should be comfortable supporting business-critical operations, managing escalations and participating in planned maintenance, technology rollouts and incident response activities as required.

  Deploy and maintain Mobile Device Management (MDM) setups to automatically configure, encrypt, and secure employee endpoints (Mac, Linux, Windows).

***GPU Server & Linux System Administration (30%)***

* **GPU Environment Isolation:**
  Maintain host OS layers (Ubuntu Server, Rocky Linux) and manage the core AI compute runtime stack, including NVIDIA base drivers, CUDA toolkits, and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit via Docker.
* **High-Performance Storage:**
  Configure and manage local network storage (NAS/NFS solutions) to reliably feed training datasets to GPU infrastructure without bottlenecks.

  Deploy simple, lightweight monitoring hooks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Node Exporter) to track critical hardware health metrics, preventing data corruption or server thermal throttling.

* **The Ultimate Generalist:**
  3-5+ years of combined experience spanning enterprise IT support, Linux systems administration, and basic hardware asset/inventory tracking.

  High comfort operating inside a Linux shell environment (SSH, package management, bash automation scripting).
* **GPU Awareness:**
  Hands-on experience resolving dependencies, broken driver paths, or container device mappings for NVIDIA hardware runtimes.
* **Organizational Skills:**
  Meticulous tracking habits. You enjoy creating a clean inventory out of chaos and implementing organized operational systems.
* **Startup Mentality:**
  Extreme autonomy. You are comfortable running point on critical physical/virtual tasks without an existing employee manual.

**Preferred & Bonus Assets:**

* Prior experience designing asset registers for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 standard approvals.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) or Configuration Management tools (Ansible).

title: A PKI / ADCS Engineer
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**

Band B3

An L3 resource must possess in-depth knowledge of the following skills to meet customer expectations: -Thales Luna SA HSM -Thales CiphertrustManager KMS -Microsoft ADCS PKI

-A PKI / ADCS Engineer is responsible for designing, deploying, and managing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure including Root CA, Intermediate CA, and Issuing CA servers while ensuring secure certificate issuance and validation processes. The role involves hands-on management of Microsoft ADCS components such as NDES (SCEP), CEP/CES services, and integration with Active Directory for auto-enrollment and authentication.
  
-The engineer must manage complete certificate lifecycle activities including certificate request, issuance, renewal, revocation, and troubleshooting of certificate-related issues across users, systems, and applications. Strong understanding of certificate store architecture and certificate chain validation is required to ensure trust relationships within enterprise environments.
  
-The role requires implementation and maintenance of Certificate Policy (CP) and Certification Practice Statement (CPS) aligned to organizational security standards and compliance requirements. The candidate should also manage CRL infrastructure including base CRL and delta CRL, ensuring proper publication and accessibility via CDP and AIA locations.
  
-The engineer should possess strong knowledge of cryptographic principles including asymmetric and symmetric encryption, hashing, and digital signatures along with practical understanding of PKCS standards, Cryptographic Service Providers (CSP), and Key Storage Providers (KSP).
  
-The role involves supporting SSL/TLS certificates across internal and external applications and ensuring adherence to industry standards like X.509 and TLS protocols. Strong troubleshooting skills are required for resolving issues related to certificate enrollment, chain errors, CRL accessibility, and authentication failures.
  
-The candidate must have good understanding of Active Directory including Group Policy, auto-enrollment configuration, and integration with PKI services for enterprise identity and access management.
  
-The role includes ensuring PKI high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery by implementing proper backup, restore, and redundancy mechanisms across CA servers and related infrastructure.
  
-The engineer should work on operational support, monitoring PKI health, performing RCA for incidents, and maintaining documentation for PKI processes and environments.
  
Optional skills include experience with Linux-based certificate management, OpenSSL tools, cloud PKI platforms (Azure/AWS), and HSM integration for secure key management.

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
  
  
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
  
  
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
  
  
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
  
  
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
  
  
**About The Role**
Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.
  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test with extensive industry experience to define and execute the design, development, and maintenance of Fivetran’s test automation tools and framework using reliable and scalable techniques.
  
  
As a Senior SDET, you will focus on solving complex testing difficulties by designing, developing and improving automation and reporting frameworks. You will invest in improving test stability and performance of the framework by developing innovative solutions to boost Fivetran’s testing efficiency. You will also coach Fivetran quality engineers to be the best in class automation engineers, and will continuously work with the team to ensure high standards for automation. title: Sr. Supplier Development Engineer (RF Integration)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.
  
  
**SR. SUPPLIER DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER (RF INTEGRATION)**
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.
  
  
SpaceX is developing a low latency, broadband internet system to meet the needs of consumers across the globe. Enabled by a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites, Starlink will provide fast, reliable internet to populations with little or no connectivity, including those in rural communities and places where existing services are too expensive or unreliable. We are looking for talented, creative, and driven engineers to develop, drive, and maintain suppliers, from initial concept development to full scale production.
  
  
This is a high-profile, cross functional position that plays a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and scalability of the user terminal manufacturing at our global suppliers. You will work in close coordination with internal engineering and manufacturing departments as well as with global base of suppliers to execute effective, creative and smart supply chain strategies to achieve production goals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement RF test cases and calibration procedures for Starlink user terminals at external suppliers
* Working in close collaboration with hardware and software engineers rapidly develop design validation and production test solutions for our high-volume consumer products
* Establish strong linkages between assembly data and final RF test performance, driving root cause analysis of yield limiters
* Use statistical tools such as SPC and DOE to monitor, and JMP to analyze, control, and improve yield across the manufacturing line
* Develop and maintain risk models to evaluate RF test strategies and ensure effective test coverage across corner cases in individual manufacturing processes
* Sustain and optimize RF integration workflow and throughput in a high-mix assembly configuration environment, driving continuous improvements in cycle time and cost
* Collaborate with design teams to provide feedback on DFM (Design for Manufacturability) and yield optimization opportunities with focus on RF integration
* Support installation and qualification of new RF test tools, including both capability enhancements and capacity expansions

title: Test Architect
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on Test Automation Architect with strong expertise in Tricentis Tosca, Java, Selenium WebDriver, and Cucumber/BDD frameworks. The candidate will be responsible for designing and scaling automation frameworks, integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, and leading a team of automation engineers to improve test coverage, quality, and execution efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Test Automation Framework Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks using Tricentis Tosca, Java, Selenium WebDriver, and Cucumber/BDD.
* Develop reusable, maintainable, and modular test cases and automation components.
* Establish coding standards, review automation scripts, and promote automation best practices.
* Implement Tosca-based automation solutions for enterprise applications.

**2. Test Automation & Functional Validation**

* Translate business requirements into executable test scenarios and test cases.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* Validate application workflows, integrations, reports, and user roles.
* Support release validation, patch testing, and regression cycles.

**3. CI/CD Integration**

* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions.
* Configure parallel execution, scheduled runs, and headless testing where applicable.
* Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot failures, and implement quality gates and test reporting dashboards.

**4. Quality Engineering**

* Apply BDD/TDD, risk-based testing, test data management, and end-to-end traceability.
* Perform API testing using Postman, REST Assured, or SoapUI.
* Support cross-browser testing, data validation, accessibility testing, and basic performance testing.
* Analyze test failures, perform root cause analysis, and continuously improve automation stability.

**5. Team Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of 4–6 automation engineers.
* Plan sprints, allocate tasks, and track delivery in Agile Scrum/Kanban environments.
* Collaborate with developers, architects, product owners, and business stakeholders.
* Communicate automation progress, quality metrics, risks, and status updates to leadership.

**Mandatory Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong hands-on experience with Tricentis Tosca.
* Tricentis Tosca certification (AS1/AS2 or higher).
* Proficiency in Java, Selenium WebDriver, and Cucumber/BDD.
* Experience designing and maintaining scalable test automation frameworks.
* Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions.
* Knowledge of Tosca TestCase Design (TCD) and Test Data Service (TDS).
* Experience with JIRA and/or Azure DevOps for defect tracking and requirements traceability.
* Strong understanding of functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* Experience in team leadership, mentoring, and Agile delivery.

Good-to-Have Skills

* API test automation using Postman, REST Assured, or SoapUI.
* Exposure to service virtualization and data modeling.
* Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes fundamentals.
* Knowledge of accessibility and security testing.
* Understanding of performance testing fundamentals and test execution optimization.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Proven ability to improve automation coverage, framework reusability, and test execution efficiency.

title: Software Test Engineer [Manual + Automation]
description:
**QA Engineer - Manual + Automation**

**Roles & Responsibilities | 4+ Years Experience**

**Core Responsibilities**

* Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and technical documents to design effective test cases.
* Develop, maintain, and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for functional, integration, regression, system, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Perform manual testing across web applications and mobile apps on Android and iOS, including functional, regression, compatibility, usability, installation/update, and device/OS-specific scenarios.
* Validate mobile-specific scenarios such as installation/upgrade, permissions, notifications, deep links, orientation, background/foreground behavior, offline/poor-network conditions, and different screen sizes.
* Perform testing on physical devices and emulators/simulators across representative Android and iOS versions, and capture device logs/crash details when troubleshooting issues.
* Identify, log, track, and retest defects using tools such as JIRA, Bugzilla, or similar.
* Ensure comprehensive test coverage and maintain traceability between requirements and test cases.
* Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives in an Agile/Scrum environment.

**Automation Testing Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts for web applications and, where applicable, mobile applications.
* Hands-on experience with Playwright or Selenium for web UI automation testing; exposure to Appium or a similar mobile automation framework is preferred.
* Candidate should have used Playwright and/or Selenium in previous projects and should be able to create and maintain automation test suites independently. Experience testing Android and/or iOS applications in real projects is also expected.
* Identify suitable manual test cases for automation and improve smoke and regression coverage through automation.
* Analyze automation failures and identify whether issues are related to application defects, test scripts, test data, or environment/configuration.
* Maintain reusable automation components, page objects, test fixtures, test data, and utilities.
* Integrate automated tests with CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar.
* Generate and review automation execution reports and communicate failures clearly to the development team.

**Collaboration & Reporting**

* Work closely with developers, product managers, and business analysts to clarify requirements and resolve issues.
* Provide timely and detailed test execution status reports to the QA Lead / Project Manager.
* Support UAT by assisting business users and validating fixes.
* Work with developers to improve application testability and contribute to continuous testing practices.

**Quality Assurance Practices**

* Follow industry best practices for QA, including risk-based testing and defect management.
* Ensure compliance with organizational quality standards and processes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing practices, automation coverage, and methodologies.

**Additional Expectations**

* Mentor junior testers by sharing knowledge and reviewing test cases and automation scripts.
* Take ownership of testing for assigned modules or projects with minimal supervision.
* Provide input for test effort estimation and project planning.
* Identify opportunities for test optimization and improvements in QA processes.
* Be able to explain automation framework design, locator strategy, waits, assertions, reporting, test data management, and troubleshooting of flaky tests.

**Key Skills Required**

* Strong knowledge of STLC (Software Testing Life Cycle) and SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle).
* Proficiency in writing test cases, test scenarios, and clear bug reports.
* Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA, Bugzilla, Mantis, or similar.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology.
* Good understanding of functional, regression, integration, UAT, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing.
* Basic knowledge of SQL for backend data validation.
* Practical experience with Playwright or Selenium WebDriver.
* Hands-on mobile app testing experience on Android and/or iOS; familiarity with Appium or a similar mobile automation framework is an added advantage.
* Good understanding of Page Object Model (POM), reusable components, assertions, waits, test fixtures, and data-driven testing.
* Experience with at least one programming/scripting language such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Python.
* Basic understanding of API testing and API automation using Postman, REST Assured, Playwright API testing, or similar.
* Familiarity with Git/version control and basic CI/CD concepts.
* Ability to troubleshoot flaky tests and improve automation reliability.
* Understanding of when a test case should be automated versus kept as a manual test.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Experience testing across multiple browsers such as Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari/WebKit, and across representative Android/iOS devices and OS versions.
* Experience with mobile app testing, including native/hybrid apps, WebView flows, device permissions, network conditions, app lifecycle, and release validation, is preferred.
* Familiarity with Android Studio/ADB, Xcode device logs, crash logs, or similar mobile debugging tools is an advantage.
* Experience running automation tests in CI/CD pipelines and generating test reports.
* Basic knowledge of performance, accessibility, or security testing is an added advantage.

**Description**
As a Automation Engineer, you will be involved throughout the development lifecycle of Infor Birst development team with responsibility in the quality assurance of software development and deployment with emphasis on development and implementation of test automation. During testing you will be thinking "outside of the box" to understand the various scenarios and configurations that customers use to ensure customer quality is maintained and through doing so drive regression testing across the products. You will be responsible for defining and driving innovative automated testing strategies and toolsets into our overall development processes that support and enhance the current Quality Assurance processes within Birst.
  
  
We are seeking exceptional QA automation engineers to join our team in Ahmedabad, India to design and execute test suites for our Business Intelligence and Analytics products. **Role: TSEC & Liaison**

**Position Summary**

Assistant Manager or Deputy Manager in Hyderabad to handle technical liaison with government telecom customers for our Lithium-Ion battery and SMPS power plant products.

**Role Purpose**

The role is the company's technical face to government telecom customers in the region. The incumbent ensures our Lithium-Ion battery packs and SMPS power plants meet customer technical specifications, and approvals.

1. Act as the single technical point of contact for government and PSU telecom customers (e.g., BSNL).

3. Coordinate type testing, product approvals, pre-dispatch inspections and customer witness tests.

5. Follow up on approvals, inspection certificates, documentation and related clearances with customer offices.
6. Build and maintain working relationships with customer and officials at circle and corporate levels.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* Experience: 6–7 years overall, including at least 3–4 years in the electrical industry.

* Government liaison: Proven experience liaising with government or PSU customers to meet their technical requirements, including specifications, approvals, inspections and documentation.
* Technical understanding: Working knowledge of power electronics basics, battery technology and site power requirements.
* Travel: Willing to travel to customer offices and sites as required.

**Added Advantage**

* Prior work experience with BSNL (as an employee, vendor, or channel partner), including familiarity with its inspection and approval processes.
* Exposure to TEC/GR specifications and type-approval processes.
* Knowledge of Telugu, plus Hindi and English, for regional customer interaction.

**Education and General Skills**

**Education**

* B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Electrical, Electronics or EEE.

**Computer skills**

* MS Excel: Pivot tables, charts and data analysis for MIS and trackers.
* MS Word: Technical letters, compliance statements and reports.
* MS PowerPoint: Customer and management presentations.
* Comfortable with email, ERP/portal-based documentation.

**Quality**

* Working knowledge of ISO 9001 quality systems and documentation.
* Familiarity with inspection procedures, test reports and customer quality requirements.
* Ability to apply root-cause analysis tools (5-Why, Fishbone, 8D) to field complaints.

**Managerial and soft skills**

* Clear written and spoken communication in English and Hindi.
* Strong follow-up, documentation discipline and ownership.
* Ability to coordinate across internal teams and handle customer escalations professionally.

title: Playback Ops Sys Dev Engineer, Playback Operations Systems Group
description:
**Description**
Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in shaping the future of movies and television? Do you want to define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?
  
  
Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies - all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows including Amazon Originals and exclusive licensed content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add-on channels which they can cancel at anytime and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business - available in over 200 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.
  
  
Our Playback Operations Systems Group is looking for a motivated, results-oriented, dedicated and operationally focused System Development Engineer to support the fast-evolving and expanding device automation systems, that support our live events and 24/7 linear operations. You will have an enormous opportunity to work within multiple systems analyzing and identifying the common issues, and driving the teams towards resolution to have a positive impact on customer experience. This job requires you to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and deliver systems and automation that scale Prime Video's Live OTT delivery and 24/7 linear operations
* Own the operational health of device automation and monitoring systems — identify resilience risks and deliver solutions that eliminate them
* Improve monitoring capabilities and system reliability, reducing manual operational load across the team
* Define and maintain operational metrics and service level objectives, with alarming based on service health
* Drive resolution of difficult performance, reliability, and availability issues, leaving systems better than you found them
* Partner with adjacent Live Ops engineering teams to improve how systems interact and integrate

A day in the life
  
  
Your morning starts by reviewing operational dashboards and alerts, ensuring live services are healthy. When issues arise—latency spikes, availability drops—you collaborate with the team to diagnose and resolve them quickly.
  
  
Mid-morning shifts to development: enhancing automation scripts, improving device monitoring workflows, and testing changes in staging environments to reduce manual intervention during live events.
  
  
Afternoons bring cross-team collaboration—troubleshooting priority tickets with encoding and operations engineers, deploying fixes before high-profile events go live, and designing monitoring solutions that scale with Prime Video's growing live sports portfolio.

title: AML QA Specialist, Swedish, Account Compliance Quality
description:
**Description**
The Compliance Quality team is looking for a Swedish speaking quality control specialist to join a team of quality specialists covering the Know Your Customers program. The role is critical to ensure that Amazon’s payments businesses expand with appropriate controls and quality processes in place, minimizing risks and identifying opportunities for process improvement.
  
  
This quality control specialist role will join a team, who are responsible for auditing and reporting of "high-complexity" AML operational work across Amazon's payment entities and licenses. The Account Compliance Quality Auditor will work closely with operations teams and the AML program teams (both first line of defense teams) as well as occasionally with the compliance officers of the various entities (second line of defense).
  
  
The role will require performing AML quality audits on behalf of the Account Compliance Quality team, as well as delivering coaching and training to the operations teams.
  
  
The quality control specialist will be an independent individual contributor, with effective problem-solving skills.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Perform AML quality audits on behalf of the Quality Assurance Team.
* Partner with operational teams to deliver quality findings and support ongoing improvement opportunities.
* Provide AML quality audit subject matter expertise to business and operations teams during meetings, workshops, and leadership reviews.
* Create and update guidance and program documents.
* Conduct a variety of investigation and audit types including suspicious activity, sanctions, and enhanced due diligence.
* Share industry expertise through audits and provide written, professional feedback.
* Apply an analytical and detailed thought process to various product types and services within an AML construct.
* Assist with linking policies, standard operating procedures, internal controls, monitoring, and reporting with the goal of improving operations, compliance policies, and risk management

**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of previous AML or Compliance experience
* Knowledge of compliance, EU AML and KYC-related laws, and other relevant regulations
* Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related field
* Professional auditing qualification, or similar risk or compliance credentials
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* Speak, write, and read fluently in Swedish
* Experience handling confidential information

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional certification such as CAMS, CRCM, or CRP
* Language certification from internationally recognised institution
* Master's degree in Compliance, Risk or Business

description:
Job Title: Quality Executive

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and results-driven
**Quality Executive**
to monitor, maintain, and improve quality standards across organizational processes. The ideal candidate will have experience in quality audits, compliance monitoring, documentation, root cause analysis, and continuous process improvement.

* Maintain accurate documentation for audits and compliance requirements.

* Identify opportunities to improve quality, operational efficiency, and organizational processes.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to resolve quality-related issues.
* Conduct awareness and training sessions on quality standards, procedures, and processes.
* Support management in implementing quality assurance and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Quality Management System (QMS)
* Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC)
* Internal Auditing and Compliance
* ISO 9001 Standards
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA)
* 5 Why Analysis and Fishbone Analysis
* SOP Preparation and Documentation
* Quality Reporting and KPI Monitoring
* Problem-Solving and Analytical Skills
* Communication and Cross-Functional Coordination

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience in quality assurance, internal auditing, compliance, or process improvement.
* Strong understanding of audit procedures, quality documentation, and corrective action processes.
* Attention to detail with strong analytical and reporting skills.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments and drive process improvements.

Manastu Space operates at the frontier of space propulsion, where quality failures are not an option.

As we transition from outsourced manufacturing to in-house machining capabilities, this role becomes the
**quality gate between our engineering designs and flight-ready hardware**
.

The QA/QC Engineer will be the first person to own end-to-end manufacturing quality—a foundational hire who will shape our quality culture for years to come.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Quality Management System (QMS)**

* Implement and maintain the QMS for all manufacturing activities in line with AS9100D.
* Define inspection, testing, and acceptance criteria for all components and subsystems.

**2. Vendor Quality Management**

* Qualify vendors, conduct audits, and develop the Approved Vendor List (AVL).
* Define vendor quality requirements and monitor performance, including acceptance rates and rejection trends.
* Drive corrective actions for recurring vendor quality issues.

**3. Incoming, In-Process & Final Inspection**

* Establish and execute inspections at all stages: incoming materials, in-process manufacturing, and final release.
* Ensure the correct inspection tools and measurement methods are applied at each stage.

**4. Special Process Quality Control**

* Define and monitor quality for critical processes, including welding (WPS and welder qualification), precision machining, and leak-tight assemblies.
* Maintain process qualification records and ensure repeatability.

**5. Testing & Validation**

* Define and oversee testing protocols, including helium leak tests, proof/hydrostatic pressure tests, and functional checks.
* Verify that all test results meet acceptance criteria before hardware release.

**6. Non-Conformance & Corrective Actions**

* Own the NCR system and lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for quality failures.
* Drive timely closure of Corrective Actions (CA) and Preventive Actions (PA), and track their effectiveness.

**7. Documentation & Traceability**

* Maintain complete, controlled documentation, including inspection reports, material certificates, and process sheets.
* Ensure full traceability for critical propulsion components, pressure parts, and welded assemblies.

**8. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with Manufacturing, Design/R&D, Procurement, and Testing teams on quality matters.
* Serve as the final quality gate before hardware moves to testing or integration.

**9. In-House Manufacturing Quality Setup**

* Set up quality systems for in-house VMC and CNC operations, including First Article Inspection (FAI) and calibration management.
* Establish inspection infrastructure and measurement capability for machined components.

**10. Continuous Improvement**

* Analyse quality data and defect trends to identify systemic gaps in processes and vendor performance.
* Drive measurable improvements in quality outcomes and internal quality culture.

**11. Audit & Compliance**

* Conduct internal audits for AS9100D process and documentation compliance.
* Prepare the organisation for external audits and future quality certifications.

**12. SOP Development & Maintenance**

* Author and maintain SOPs for all manufacturing processes, inspection activities, and testing protocols, including leak tests, pressure tests, and functional checks.
* Ensure SOPs are version-controlled, reviewed periodically, and accessible to relevant team members in line with AS9100D document control requirements.

**13. Team Leadership**

* Recruit, train, and manage QA/QC inspectors and technicians as the team scales.
* Build a culture of quality ownership and accountability across manufacturing operations.

**Experience & Background**

* 4–10 years of hands-on experience in manufacturing quality within an aerospace, defence, or precision engineering environment.
* Demonstrated experience in:
* Machined component inspection (GD&T, CMM, gauges, and surface roughness measurement).
* Welding quality control (WPS, welder qualification, and weld inspection).
* Vendor quality management and supplier audits.
* Non-conformance management and root cause analysis (8D, 5-Why, and Fishbone).
* Pressure system testing, including helium leak tests, hydrostatic tests, and proof pressure testing.
* Experience setting up a QMS from scratch or significantly improving existing systems is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with AS9100D or equivalent aerospace quality standards (NADCAP, MIL-SPEC) is highly desirable.
* **Education:**
  B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Detail-oriented, systematic, and process-driven—someone who believes quality is built in, not inspected in.
* Strong ownership mindset, comfortable owning the quality function independently with minimal supervision.
* Effective communicator who can work constructively with vendors, manufacturing teams, and design engineers.
* Adaptable and hands-on, ready to work in a fast-paced startup environment where processes are still being established.
* Passionate about aerospace and space technology and motivated by the mission of Manastu Space.

**:**

* Executing and/or leading Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) and associated testing across credit lifecycle activities

* Proven capability to review and challenge credit work products, including credit analysis, underwriting rationale, risk identification, and monitoring approach, with clear documentation of QA conclusions

We are seeking a hands-on Firmware Design Engineer with 3-7 years of experience to implement, integrate, verify, and support embedded firmware for Client's fire and life-safety portfolio. The role supports new product development, product enhancements, platform updates, value engineering, component changes, compliance, and production support. Working with the Firmware Engineering Manager and experienced engineers, the candidate will own defined modules or features, develop drivers and product logic, support hardware bring-up, investigate defects, execute tests, and maintain controlled technical records. Assignments may include new implementations, legacy-code improvements, hardware or toolchain migrations, and changes driven by quality, cost, availability, or field performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Firmware Development and Implementation**

• Implement firmware work packages for new products, product enhancements, redesigns, sustenance, and value-engineering initiatives.

• Review software requirements, hardware interfaces, schematics, datasheets, existing source code, product documentation, and test procedures for assigned work.

• Develop or update startup, BSP, HAL, and driver modules for GPIO, timers, interrupts, ADC, PWM, serial interfaces, flash, non-volatile memory, watchdogs, and debug functions.

• Implement application logic for control, communication, indication, relays, supervised I/O, configuration, diagnostics, trouble reporting, and power-state behaviour as required.

• Maintain clear separation between reusable platform software and product configuration to reduce duplication and simplify regression.

• Support microcontroller, compiler, IDE, or hardware-platform migrations when included in an assigned project.

Integration Debugging and Verification

• Support board bring-up, peripheral validation, signal-level debugging, and hardware-firmware fault isolation with hardware engineers.

• Create and execute unit, module, integration, protocol, timing, fault-injection, regression, and system-integration tests for assigned features.

• Reproduce defects, collect logs and measurements, identify root cause, implement corrections, and verify that changes do not disturb existing behaviour.

• Use embedded IDEs, compilers, debuggers, JTAG or SWD probes, oscilloscopes, logic analysers, serial terminals, and protocol tools during implementation and debugging.

• Maintain requirements traceability, design notes, code-review records, test results, defect status, and release documentation for completed work.

**Product Lifecycle Compliance and Release Support**

• Implement firmware changes required by alternate components, hardware revisions, calibration updates, performance improvements, and cost-down initiatives.

• Support controlled test firmware and operating modes for transient, EMC, UL, FM, FCC, and other applicable compliance or certification testing.

• Prepare reproducible builds, binaries, maps, checksums, release notes, and configuration records and support production programming, ICT or FCT, pilot builds, and phase-in.

• Assist with production and field issue investigation and document corrective actions and regression evidence.

**Team Collaboration**

• Work with firmware, hardware, validation, compliance, manufacturing, product, and Client's US stakeholders to complete assigned work.

• Participate in design and code reviews, raise unclear requirements and technical risks early, and close assigned actions with objective evidence.

• Contribute reusable drivers, diagnostic utilities, test tools, documentation, and lessons learned for future development work.

**Qualifications**

• 3-7 years of hands-on embedded firmware-development experience, including coding, hardware integration, debugging, testing, and controlled release support.
