title: Senior Tools Development Engineer
description:
We are seeking a qualified Sr. Software Tools Development Engineer to join our GPU SWQA team. The successful candidate will demonstrate substantial experience with AI technologies for automation of test cases, as well as an in-depth understanding of Linux operating systems. Comprehensive knowledge of system architecture is essential, along with a strong command of PC I/O architecture and common bus interfaces, including PCI-E, USB, and SATA. Familiarity with specifications pertaining to general PC-Architecture components will be regarded as a valuable asset.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Design and implement automated tests incorporating AI technologies for NVIDIA's device driver software and SDKs on various Linux operating systems.
* Build tools/utility/framework in Python or equivalent which would help automate and optimize the testing workflows in GPU domain . Develop and implement automated and manual tests, analyze results, identify and report defects.
* Rigorously drive test automation initiative. Build innovative ways to automate and expand our software testing.
* Expose defects and constraints; Isolate and debug the issue(s) and find the root cause; Contribute to the solution and drive to closure. Measure code coverage for the software under test, analyze and drive code coverage enhancements.
* Develop applications and tools that accelerate development and test workflows and write fast, effective, maintainable, reliable and well documented code. Generate and test compatibility across a range of products and interfaces and validate different key software applications across a test matrix designed to test both breadth and depth.
* Provide peer code reviews including feedback on performance, scalability and correctness.
* Effectively estimate and prioritize tasks in order to create a realistic delivery schedule.
* You will have the opportunity to work on challenging technical and process issues and work closely with leadership to report progress, generating effective and actionable reports.
* This is a fully onsite position.

**What We Need To See**

* B.S / B.Tech/M.S in Computer Science / Electronics & Telecommunication with strong academics or equivalent experience.
* 4+ years of programming experience in Python or equivalent with experience in applying Object-Oriented Programming concepts.
* Hands-on knowledge of developing Python scripts with application development concepts like dictionaries, tuples, RegEx, PIP etc.
* Working experience with databases and storage technologies like SQL, MongoDB and Elasticsearch.
* Good understanding of OS fundamentals, PC Hardware fine-tuning in those areas (Linux, Unix, Windows)
* Experience using AI tools to automate test cases as well as end-to-end QA workflow.
* Good Communication skills (interpersonal and across teams).
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Very organized, proactive, and has good learning ability.
* The ability to work with a team of engineers in a fast-paced environment

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Good problem-solving skills (solid logic to apply in isolation and regression of issues found) and good written communications skills
* Substantial experience with AI-driven automation
* Ability to work in a distributed team environment
* Development experience capable of fixing regression bugs , implementing/enabling test for CI/CD

description:
* MISSION

* Participating in periodic quality briefing meetings.
* Periodically distributing briefing notes to the Group.

* Key point for the customer: ensure normal flow very quickly.

title: IQC/IQA Associate Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose**
Responsible for performing incoming material inspection activities as per approved sampling plans in SAP, customer
  
  
requirements, and Jabil IQC procedures. Ensure only conforming materials are released for production through e􀆯ective
  
  
inspection, documentation, material handling, defect reporting, and timely closure of quality issues.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Incoming Inspection
  
  
 Perform incoming inspection of raw materials, electronic components, SMT-related materials, mechanical
  
  
parts, and assemblies as per SAP sampling plans and customer requirements.
  
  
 Verify material conformity against drawings, specifications, approved samples, quality plans, and customer
  
  
documentation.
  
  
 Ensure inspection activities are conducted in accordance with Jabil IQC procedures and applicable quality
  
  
standards.
  
  
 Identify Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) characteristics and perform inspections as per defined requirements.
  
  
SAP & Quality Documentation
  
  
 Execute inspection lots and record inspection results in SAP accurately and timely.
  
  
 Perform Usage Decision (UD) in SAP based on inspection outcomes.
  
  
 Create and maintain e-IQA inspection records and quality documentation.
  
  
 Ensure traceability and retention of inspection records in line with company procedures.
  
  
Defect Management
  
  
 Raise SAP Quality Notifications (QN) for all detected non-conformities during incoming inspection.
  
  
 Clearly document defect details, quantity a􀆯ected, evidence, and disposition requirements.
  
  
 Coordinate with Buyers, SQE/IQA Engineers, and relevant stakeholders for issue resolution.
  
  
 Verify e􀆯ectiveness of corrective actions implemented by suppliers or internal teams.
  
  
 Ensure timely verification and closure of Quality Notifications.
  
  
Material Handling & Disposition
  
  
 Segregate, identify, and control non-conforming materials.
  
  
 Ensure proper stamping, labeling, and material status identification.
  
  
 Support material movement and disposition processes in coordination with Stores and Procurement teams.
  
  
 Prevent unintended use of non-conforming materials on the production floor.
  
  
Compliance & Continuous Improvement
  
  
 Adhere to EHS, quality, and customer-specific requirements.
  
  
 Participate in quality improvement initiatives and problem-solving activities.
  
  
 Support audits and provide inspection-related records when required.
  
  
 Maintain good housekeeping and 5S practices within the inspection area.
  
  
Qualification
  
  
 ITI / Diploma in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, or related discipline.
  
  
**Experience**
 2-6 years of experience in Incoming Quality Inspection, IQA, IQC, or Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS)
  
  
environment.
  
  
 Experience in inspection of:
  
  

* SMT components
* Electronic components
* Mechanical parts
* Sheet metal, plastic, and electromechanical assemblies

** Experience In SAP-based Incoming Inspection Processes Preferred.**
Technical Competencies
  
  
 Knowledge of IQCprocesses, procedures and incoming inspection requirements.
  
  
 Understanding of electronic components, SMT processes, and mechanical part inspection.
  
  
 Ability to read engineering drawings and identify CTQ characteristics.
  
  
 Knowledge of inspection methodologies, sampling plans, and acceptance criteria.
  
  
 Familiarity with quality tools such as:
  
  

* AQL Sampling
* 7 QC Tools
* 5 Why Analysis
* Basic Problem Solving Techniques

 Hands-on experience with measuring instruments such as:
  
  

* Vernier Caliper
* Micrometer
* Height Gauge
* Multimeter
* Basic Electronic Test Equipment

PC Skills
  
  
 Proficient in MS O􀆯ice (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  
  
 Experience working with SAP ERP, especially Quality Management (QM) module.
  
  
 Ability to update electronic inspection records and generate quality reports.
  
  
 Good data entry accuracy and documentation skills.
  
  
 Knowledge of Excel functions, data analysis, and report preparation.
  
  
Behavioral Competencies
  
  
 Attention to detail.
  
  
 Strong analytical and observation skills.
  
  
 Effective communication and coordination skills.
  
  
 Problem-solving mindset.
  
  
 Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
  
  
 High level of integrity and ownership.
  
  
**Preferred Requirements**
 Experience in EMS/Automotive/Electronics manufacturing environment.
  
  
 Knowledge of IPC standards and component identification.
  
  
 Exposure to customer-specific quality requirements and supplier quality processes.

title: Mulesoft-Integration Engineer II
description:

**Position Summary**

These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.
  
  
Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.
  
  
**Level: Integration Engineer I**
**I**
Deloitte Consulting is seeking an experienced
**Integration Engineer II**
to design, build, and support enterprise integration solutions using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform. In this role, you will translate business and technical requirements into scalable APIs and integration services across the full software development lifecycle. You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality outcomes, contribute to Agile delivery, and support continuous improvement through automation and engineering best practices.

* Gather, analyze, and translate business and technical requirements into integration solutions aligned to industry and client needs.
* Design, develop, deploy, and support APIs and integration services using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, DataWeave, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Collaborate with stakeholders and delivery teams across the software development lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, deployment, and defect resolution.
* Participate in Agile delivery activities, including sprint planning, retrospectives, estimation, and peer reviews to support quality and timely delivery.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing, process improvements, automation initiatives, and engineering best practices that enhance project outcomes and client value.

**The team**
Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST, as per business requirements
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 3-6 years of hands-on experience in Anypoint Platform API development and management
* Experience with Anypoint Platform, DataWeave transformation, enterprise integration patterns, and enterprise service bus (ESB) concepts

title: Business Analyst (US Mortgage)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst with strong expertise in the US Mortgage domain to work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, technology teams, and QA teams to analyze business requirements and translate them into functional specifications. The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of the US mortgage lifecycle, including loan origination, underwriting, processing, closing, and servicing.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Engage with business stakeholders, mortgage operations teams, product owners, and technology teams to gather, analyze, and document business requirements.
* Develop Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), user stories, process flows, use cases, and acceptance criteria.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of the US mortgage lifecycle, including:
* Loan Origination System (LOS)
* Loan processing and underwriting
* Income, asset, and employment verification
* Credit assessment and property appraisal
* Closing, funding, and post-closing activities
* Mortgage servicing, escrow, and payment processing
* Understand conventional and government-backed mortgage products, including Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA, and USDA loans. – Preferred but not mandatory
* Work with business teams to identify process gaps, bottlenecks, risks, and opportunities for process optimization and automation.
* Collaborate with development and QA teams to clarify requirements, validate solutions, and support functional and user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Prepare test scenarios, review test cases, validate test results, and coordinate defect resolution.
* Conduct impact analysis for business and system changes and ensure requirements traceability throughout the project lifecycle.
* Facilitate stakeholder meetings, requirement walkthroughs, sprint planning, and solution reviews.
* Support regulatory and compliance requirements applicable to US mortgage operations, including RESPA, TILA, TRID, and applicable investor guidelines. Preferred but not mandatory
* Maintain process documentation, business rules, and standard operating procedures.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 10–12 years of overall experience as a Business Analyst, preferably in banking, financial services, or mortgage technology.
* At least 3–5 years of hands-on experience in the US Mortgage domain.
* Strong understanding of mortgage origination, processing, underwriting, closing, and/or servicing.
* Experience in requirement elicitation, stakeholder management, process mapping, and functional documentation.
* Proficiency in creating BRDs, FRDs, user stories, use cases, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum and/or Waterfall delivery models.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Visio, and Microsoft Excel.
* Ability to coordinate with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams, including US-based stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with mortgage platforms such as Encompass, ICE Mortgage Technology, Empower, MSP, or equivalent systems. Preferred but not mandatory
* Knowledge of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac guidelines, Desktop Underwriter (DU), and Loan Product Advisor (LPA).
* Familiarity with mortgage data, loan documents, disclosures, and document validation processes.
* Exposure to SQL, data analysis, reporting, and system integration.
* Relevant Business Analysis certification or Agile certification is an advantage.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong stakeholder communication and facilitation skills.
* Ability to translate complex business needs into clear functional requirements.
* Attention to detail and understanding of mortgage compliance requirements.
* Strong documentation, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within agreed timelines.

**Expected Deliverables**

* Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs).
* User stories, use cases, and acceptance criteria.
* Current-state and future-state process maps.
* Business rules and functional specifications.
* UAT scenarios, test cases, and sign-off documentation.
* Requirement traceability matrix and process improvement recommendations.

title: D365 Functional Consultant
description:
**Role purpose:**

Provide hands-on D365 Finance & Operations functional support and delivery capability, helping the D365 Functional Lead maintain a stable, controlled and continuously improving global finance platform.

**Working Pattern**

India-based role with regular UK/EU hours overlap for global collaboration

**Purpose and Context**

FNZ has deployed Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations as a core global finance platform. Following global go-live, the Finance Systems team is strengthening permanent in-house capability to stabilise the platform, support Finance operations, deliver controlled improvements and prepare for future modules and entity deployments.

This is a hands-on functional role reporting to the Finance Systems Functional Lead - Finance & Operations. The role holder will configure and support D365, investigate issues, translate Finance requirements into workable solutions, produce documentation and test evidence, and contribute to controlled releases and continuous improvement.

The position requires practical D365 Finance experience. It is not a coordination-only or general business analyst role. The successful candidate must be comfortable working directly in the application, partnering with Finance users and technical teams, and taking assigned work through to a documented and supportable outcome.

**Key Responsibilities**

D365 Functional Support and Configuration

* Provide hands-on functional support across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash and Bank, Fixed Assets, Expense Management, Project Accounting and Financial Reporting.
* Configure approved changes in D365 under the direction and design authority of the D365 Functional Lead.
* Analyse business requirements, current processes and system behaviour; document solution options, functional requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain accurate configuration, process and support documentation so that knowledge is retained within FNZ.

Incident, Close and Operational Support

* Investigate functional incidents and service requests, reproduce issues, identify root causes and coordinate resolution with Finance users, technical teams and vendors.
* Support month-end and year-end close activities, reconciliations and business-critical finance processing, including agreed out-of-hours support where required.
* Distinguish defects, data issues, training needs and enhancement requests, ensuring each is progressed through the appropriate support or change process.
* Contribute to the upkeep of known-error records, support procedures, knowledge articles and recurring-issue analysis.

Change, Testing and Release Delivery

* Prepare functional specifications, process flows, test scenarios, test data and expected results for approved changes.
* Execute system, integration and regression testing; support business users with user acceptance testing and evidence capture.
* Assess the impact of proposed changes on modules, integrations, reporting, data, security and financial controls.
* Support release planning, deployment readiness, post-release validation and early-life support.

Data, Integrations and Reporting

* Support finance master data, financial dimensions, posting profiles, workflows, opening balances, sub-ledger data and intercompany processing.
* Investigate functional issues affecting interfaces with banking, payments, expense, tax, consolidation and reporting platforms.
* Work with Data and Reporting teams to validate D365 outputs and support reconciliation of reports to the general ledger.
* Assist with data migration, cleansing, mapping, validation and reconciliation for future deployments and entity onboarding.

Controls, Documentation and Governance

* Follow Finance Systems governance for demand intake, design approval, environments, testing, release and production change.
* Produce clear and complete evidence for configuration changes, testing, approvals and deployments.
* Support segregation-of-duties reviews, access-control testing, ITGC evidence and audit requests relating to assigned areas.
* Escalate control, data-integrity and operational risks promptly to the D365 Functional Lead.

Continuous Improvement and Knowledge Transfer

* Identify opportunities to use standard D365 capability, simplify processes, reduce manual work and improve user experience.
* Contribute to the prioritised D365 backlog with evidence on business impact, risk, urgency and delivery effort.
* Provide guidance and knowledge transfer to Finance users and Finance Systems colleagues.
* Develop broader cross-module capability while maintaining deeper expertise in allocated functional areas.

**Required Skills and Experience**

Essential

* 5+ years of hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations / Dynamics AX functional experience, with substantial exposure to finance modules.
* Practical configuration experience in at least three core areas such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash and Bank, Fixed Assets, Expense Management or Project Accounting.
* Good understanding of Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash processes, including close, reconciliation and financial-control requirements.
* Experience creating functional requirements, solution documentation, test scripts, test evidence and user guidance.
* Experience investigating production issues and working with technical teams on integrations, data fixes and extensions.
* Experience of system, integration, regression and user acceptance testing, together with controlled release and post-deployment validation.
* Ability to work directly in D365, analyse system behaviour and progress assigned work independently within agreed design and governance standards.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to work effectively with Finance users, global colleagues and external delivery partners.
* Disciplined approach to documentation, knowledge sharing, prioritisation and escalation.

**Preferred**

* Finance or accounting qualification, or equivalent practical experience in a Finance Systems environment.
* Experience in financial services, fintech, asset servicing or another regulated, multi-entity environment.
* Knowledge of IFRS, statutory reporting, segregation of duties and ITGC requirements.
* Experience with D365 Consolidation, Treasury and Cash Management, Project Accounting, Subscription Billing or Revenue Recognition.
* Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Workiva, Azure DevOps or finance-data integrations.
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant Associate certification or equivalent evidence of current D365 Finance capability.

**Success Measures**

* Assigned incidents and service requests are investigated thoroughly, documented clearly and resolved or escalated within agreed priorities.
* Configuration and change deliverables are accurate, supportable and aligned with approved functional designs.
* Testing is comprehensive, with traceable scenarios, results, defects and evidence.
* Month-end, year-end and business-critical processing receive reliable functional support.
* Documentation and knowledge transfer reduce reliance on individual contractors and external partners.
* Continuous-improvement items deliver measurable operational, control or user-experience benefits.
* Finance stakeholders and Finance Systems colleagues experience responsive, practical and dependable support.

**Employment Terms and Ways of Working**

* Permanent, full-time appointment into FNZ Technology (India) Private Limited [legal employing entity to be confirmed by HR].
* Direct reporting line to the Finance Systems Functional Lead - Finance & Operations and integration into the global Finance Systems team.
* Standard FNZ India employment terms, benefits, leave, probation and notice provisions apply, subject to HR confirmation.
* Appointment is subject to satisfactory pre-employment checks, right-to-work verification and any role-specific screening.
* UK/EU hours overlap is expected for regular collaboration, with flexibility around critical close, release and incident periods.
* All work must comply with FNZ information-security, data-protection, acceptable-use, change-control and records-management requirements.

title: Quality Assurance Tester
description:
About the role

We are hiring a QA Engineer with at least 2 years of experience to own quality across our SaaS web application and React Native mobile apps: combining test automation with manual and exploratory testing, knowing when each is the right tool, and reporting and prioritizing bugs.

Responsibilities

• Write and maintain automated tests for web UI (cross-browser), APIs and mobile; build regression and smoke suites that run in CI/CD

• Test React Native apps on iOS and Android (real devices, simulators, emulators), covering screen sizes, OS versions, permissions, push notifications and offline mode

• Write test plans and test cases; run functional, regression and exploratory testing

• Log clear, reproducible bug reports with steps, expected vs. actual results, environment and screenshots/logs

• Set bug severity and priority with product and engineering, and track bugs to resolution

• Test alongside developers within each sprint, catching issues early rather than just before release Requirements

• Minimum 2 years of experience in software QA, ideally on a SaaS product

• Test automation scripting in any common language (e.g. JavaScript/TypeScript or Python)

• Sound judgment on when to automate a test and when manual testing is the better choice

• Web automation with Playwright, Cypress or Selenium

• Mobile testing of React Native apps, with Appium or Detox

• API testing with Postman or similar tools

• Experience with issue-tracking tools, Git and CI/CD pipelines in an Agile/Scrum team

• Solid testing fundamentals: test design techniques, regression strategy, the test pyramid

• Good written and spoken English

Nice to have

• Cloud device testing with BrowserStack

• Performance testing (JMeter), security basics (OWASP Top 10) and SQL

• TestFlight and Google Play internal testing

• ISTQB Foundation certification

title: Test Automation Engineer
description:
**Project Role :**
Test Automation Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Use quality processes, automation tools, and methodologies to transform testing products and solutions. Run end-to-end quality engineering function with a focus on automation to improve control, accuracy and integrity.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Veeva CRM testing
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
Salesforce CRM Analytics, Veeva CRM
  
  
**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
**Summary**
As a Veeva CRM Senior Tester, a typical day involves designing and executing testing for implementations, integrations, and releases in a regulated life sciences environment. The role owns test preparation, execution, defect investigation, validation evidence, and delivery of high-quality results. This position focuses on ensuring quality, compliance, traceability, and release readiness across Veeva CRM programs while collaborating with cross-functional teams, supporting testing best practices, and contributing to continuous improvement in testing processes and automation.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Analyze requirements and prepare test scenarios, cases, data, and traceability.
* Execute functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, mobile, data migration, and UAT testing.
* Validate Veeva CRM commercial processes, Salesforce configurations, integrations, and offline scenarios.
* Record clear evidence, identify and report defects, perform retesting, and support root-cause analysis.
* Maintain GxP, CSV, data integrity, privacy, security, and audit-ready documentation.
* Coordinate with business, development, validation, and support teams to resolve issues.
* Report progress, risks, blockers, and test results to the Test Lead.
* Support junior testers, peer reviews, automation, regression optimization, and reusable assets.
* Own test execution activities with a strong focus on accuracy, risk awareness, and quality outcomes.
* Support defect analysis, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure on-time completion of assigned testing, validation evidence, timely identification and communication of issues, and effective retesting activities.
* Deliver strong coverage, traceability, defect quality, reduced escaped defects, and improved regression efficiency.

**Professional & Technical Skills**

* Must Have Skills: Hands-on Veeva CRM testing experience in a life sciences environment.
* Secondary skills include Veeva CRM, Salesforce, ISTQB, or Agile certification.
* Experience testing Veeva CRM in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical-device, or life sciences environments.
* Good knowledge of accounts, calls, consent, Approved Email, CLM, events, samples, territories, and mobile/offline functionality.
* Experience in test analysis, design, execution, defect management, traceability, data validation, integration testing, and UAT support.
* Ability to write clear test cases, query data, validate interfaces, analyze defects, and produce audit-ready evidence.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, ALM/Quality Center, Zephyr, or equivalent tools.
* Exposure to Selenium, Cucumber, Tosca, or similar automation tools.
* Understanding of Agile delivery, GxP, CSV, ALCOA+, data integrity, and validation controls.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, collaboration, and communication skills.
* Strong learning agility, stakeholder collaboration, and effective communication skills.
* Experience with Veeva Commercial Cloud, CLM, Approved Email, Align, MyInsights, or iOS offline testing is preferred.
* Exposure to API, database, automation, performance, accessibility, and security testing is preferred.

**Additional Information**

* The candidate should have 4–6 years of software testing or quality engineering experience, including at least 2 years of hands-on Veeva CRM testing.
* Bachelor s degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent experience.
* This is based at our Accenture Office

title: Quality Assurance Rater - English speakers in India
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

**A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater**

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
* Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
* Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
* Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
* Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
* Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
* Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

**TELUS Digital AI Community**

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.

Qualification path

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

**Basic Requirements**

* **Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in English.**
* **Resident in India for the last 5 consecutive years.**
* Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
* Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
* Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
* Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
* Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
* High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
* Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
* Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
* Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

**Equal Opportunity**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. * Facilitate defect triage, prioritization, and resolution processes.

* Enjoy mentoring teams and driving continuous improvement.
* Have excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Champion quality engineering and innovation.
* Are passionate about Salesforce, Agentforce, AI, and Enterprise Service Management.

* Influence testing strategy, governance, and quality engineering practices across projects.

**Lead Quality Analyst**

**Salesforce-powered Conversational ITSM and Agentic Service Platforms**

title: Software Test Engineer [Manual + Automation]
description:
**QA Engineer - Manual + Automation**

**Roles & Responsibilities | 4+ Years Experience**

**Core Responsibilities**

* Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and technical documents to design effective test cases.
* Develop, maintain, and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for functional, integration, regression, system, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Perform manual testing across web applications and mobile apps on Android and iOS, including functional, regression, compatibility, usability, installation/update, and device/OS-specific scenarios.
* Validate mobile-specific scenarios such as installation/upgrade, permissions, notifications, deep links, orientation, background/foreground behavior, offline/poor-network conditions, and different screen sizes.
* Perform testing on physical devices and emulators/simulators across representative Android and iOS versions, and capture device logs/crash details when troubleshooting issues.
* Identify, log, track, and retest defects using tools such as JIRA, Bugzilla, or similar.
* Ensure comprehensive test coverage and maintain traceability between requirements and test cases.
* Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives in an Agile/Scrum environment.

**Automation Testing Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts for web applications and, where applicable, mobile applications.
* Hands-on experience with Playwright or Selenium for web UI automation testing; exposure to Appium or a similar mobile automation framework is preferred.
* Candidate should have used Playwright and/or Selenium in previous projects and should be able to create and maintain automation test suites independently. Experience testing Android and/or iOS applications in real projects is also expected.
* Identify suitable manual test cases for automation and improve smoke and regression coverage through automation.
* Analyze automation failures and identify whether issues are related to application defects, test scripts, test data, or environment/configuration.
* Maintain reusable automation components, page objects, test fixtures, test data, and utilities.
* Integrate automated tests with CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar.
* Generate and review automation execution reports and communicate failures clearly to the development team.

**Collaboration & Reporting**

* Work closely with developers, product managers, and business analysts to clarify requirements and resolve issues.
* Provide timely and detailed test execution status reports to the QA Lead / Project Manager.
* Support UAT by assisting business users and validating fixes.
* Work with developers to improve application testability and contribute to continuous testing practices.

**Quality Assurance Practices**

* Follow industry best practices for QA, including risk-based testing and defect management.
* Ensure compliance with organizational quality standards and processes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing practices, automation coverage, and methodologies.

**Additional Expectations**

* Mentor junior testers by sharing knowledge and reviewing test cases and automation scripts.
* Take ownership of testing for assigned modules or projects with minimal supervision.
* Provide input for test effort estimation and project planning.
* Identify opportunities for test optimization and improvements in QA processes.
* Be able to explain automation framework design, locator strategy, waits, assertions, reporting, test data management, and troubleshooting of flaky tests.

**Key Skills Required**

* Strong knowledge of STLC (Software Testing Life Cycle) and SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle).
* Proficiency in writing test cases, test scenarios, and clear bug reports.
* Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA, Bugzilla, Mantis, or similar.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology.
* Good understanding of functional, regression, integration, UAT, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing.
* Basic knowledge of SQL for backend data validation.
* Practical experience with Playwright or Selenium WebDriver.
* Hands-on mobile app testing experience on Android and/or iOS; familiarity with Appium or a similar mobile automation framework is an added advantage.
* Good understanding of Page Object Model (POM), reusable components, assertions, waits, test fixtures, and data-driven testing.
* Experience with at least one programming/scripting language such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Python.
* Basic understanding of API testing and API automation using Postman, REST Assured, Playwright API testing, or similar.
* Familiarity with Git/version control and basic CI/CD concepts.
* Ability to troubleshoot flaky tests and improve automation reliability.
* Understanding of when a test case should be automated versus kept as a manual test.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Experience testing across multiple browsers such as Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari/WebKit, and across representative Android/iOS devices and OS versions.
* Experience with mobile app testing, including native/hybrid apps, WebView flows, device permissions, network conditions, app lifecycle, and release validation, is preferred.
* Familiarity with Android Studio/ADB, Xcode device logs, crash logs, or similar mobile debugging tools is an advantage.
* Experience running automation tests in CI/CD pipelines and generating test reports.
* Basic knowledge of performance, accessibility, or security testing is an added advantage.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**Who Are We?**

ADB Safegate is the market leader in Airfield Solutions, with a presence in 2,700 airports and 40 offices worldwide. We are building ADB Safegate Labs in Hyderabad, India – our latest software development hub. This is an opportunity to join a truly global company, working on innovative software solutions that support airport operations across Airfield, Apron, Terminal, Tower, and Weather solutions.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain secure CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, container, Kubernetes, cloud, on-premises, and edge-deployment solutions.
* Implement automated validation, approval gates, controlled rollout, rollback, recovery, and deployment auditability.
* Configure observability, high availability, backup, disaster recovery, and operational-readiness capabilities.
* Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, container scanning, IaC scanning, and policy-as-code into pipelines.

* Strong systems thinking across software, infrastructure, security, and operations.

title: Playback Ops Sys Dev Engineer, Playback Operations Systems Group
description:
**Description**
Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in shaping the future of movies and television? Do you want to define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?
  
  
Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies - all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows including Amazon Originals and exclusive licensed content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add-on channels which they can cancel at anytime and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business - available in over 200 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.
  
  
Our Playback Operations Systems Group is looking for a motivated, results-oriented, dedicated and operationally focused System Development Engineer to support the fast-evolving and expanding device automation systems, that support our live events and 24/7 linear operations. You will have an enormous opportunity to work within multiple systems analyzing and identifying the common issues, and driving the teams towards resolution to have a positive impact on customer experience. This job requires you to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and deliver systems and automation that scale Prime Video's Live OTT delivery and 24/7 linear operations
* Own the operational health of device automation and monitoring systems — identify resilience risks and deliver solutions that eliminate them
* Improve monitoring capabilities and system reliability, reducing manual operational load across the team
* Define and maintain operational metrics and service level objectives, with alarming based on service health
* Drive resolution of difficult performance, reliability, and availability issues, leaving systems better than you found them
* Partner with adjacent Live Ops engineering teams to improve how systems interact and integrate

A day in the life
  
  
Your morning starts by reviewing operational dashboards and alerts, ensuring live services are healthy. When issues arise—latency spikes, availability drops—you collaborate with the team to diagnose and resolve them quickly.
  
  
Mid-morning shifts to development: enhancing automation scripts, improving device monitoring workflows, and testing changes in staging environments to reduce manual intervention during live events.
  
  
Afternoons bring cross-team collaboration—troubleshooting priority tickets with encoding and operations engineers, deploying fixes before high-profile events go live, and designing monitoring solutions that scale with Prime Video's growing live sports portfolio.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Playback Ops Systems Group build and maintain reliable, high performance customer experience monitoring tooling and infrastructure. We take ownership of the end-to-end live monitoring experience -- from a Living Room device, through our encoding and analysis platform, out through to our Live Ops AVOCs (Amazon Video Operation Centres). Our team makes a big impact because nothing is more important to us than delighting our customers, continually earning their trust, and thinking long term. If you crave a sense of ownership, this is the place to be.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
* Experience with distributed systems at scale

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience utilizing AWS cloud solutions in a DevOps environment
* Experience establishing metrics for measurement of engineering and operational excellence
* Experience in major facilities incident management
* Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience working in a large team or fast-paced corporate environment
* supporting or automating physical device fleets, encoding appliances, or hardware infrastructure

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- Amazon Dev Center India - Hyderabad

title: IT&D Test Manager, PLM
description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Information Technology & Digital
  
  
In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
  
  
Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
  
  
**About The Role**
The IT&D Test Manager, PLM will be part of the team that is responsible for delivering the digital pillar of the PLM Transformation.
  
  
The Test Manager ensures the quality of our SAP PLM system through GxP testing and is responsible for defining and executing the GxP compliant test strategy. Our focus is on test automation to support the program roll out and regular released.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Define the overall Test Strategy, ensuring the quality and GxP compliance of the solution
* Increase Test efficiency and effectiveness through automation (TOSCA) and AI opportunities
* Build a cohesive team (combination of vendor teams and contractors) to deliver against the Test Strategy
* Estimate and obtain management support for the time, resources and budget required to perform the testing
* Work with Project Managers, Release Management Lead, Business Process owners, Technical & Functional managers and develop the test execution plan with tasks, dependencies and participants required to mitigate the risks to system quality and obtain stakeholder support
* Define and lead the test automation strategies, framework, test case automation to support ongoing product lifecycle management
* Track and prepare the report of testing activities like test testing results, test case coverage, required resources, defects discovered and status, performance baselines etc
* Review and signoff the Test deliverables. Ensure good documentation practices are adopted

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* 12 - 15 years of experience in managing and delivering large and complex testing projects, including test automation projects, in a GxP environment.
* Creative approach to using technology (Automation and AI) to improve test efficiency and outcomes.
* Experience managing the end-to-end test engineering life cycle for major global GxP programs, covering all types of testing and associated activities. E.g., Test Strategies, Test Execution, Test automation, defect management, tools
* Extensive experience in TOSCA Test automation tool
* Strong collaboration skills and experience with global cross functional teams for effective testing of the product releases
* Track multiple project streams to ensure regular progress, identify issues / challenges and remediate them
* Critical thinker and ability to demonstrate logical approach to problem solving
* Excellent verbal communications with strong written skills and ability to present to all levels of the stakeholders

The skills for success
  
  
TOSCA Test Automation, Test Automation, PLM, GxP
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Operating System Engineer
description:
Required Background and Prior Experience

We are seeking a hands-on engineer who has previously built and supported production healthcare software comparable to VerityOS.

1. Relevant healthcare product experience — mandatory

The candidate must have personally developed substantial components of a live U.S. healthcare product involving one or more of the following:

\* Practice management.

\* Medical billing and revenue cycle management.

\* EHR-connected patient engagement and operational workflows.

The product must have been used by real healthcare organizations. Coursework, prototypes, chatbot demonstrations, and internal proof-of-concept projects alone do not qualify.

2. Billing and RCM engineering experience — mandatory

The candidate must have hands-on experience implementing healthcare billing workflows, including:

\* Claim creation/submission and acknowledgment or rejection handling.

\* Electronic remittance or EOB processing and payment posting.

\* Denial management and accounts-receivable workflows.

\* Patient balances, adjustments, and reconciliation.

They must understand the distinction between charges, claims, payments, adjustments, and patient responsibility, and explain how their system prevented duplicate transactions and preserved financial history.

They do not need to have built every billing component independently, but must clearly identify the components they personally implemented.

3. EHR or healthcare-system integration experience — mandatory

The candidate must have delivered at least one production integration with an EHR, practice-management system, or healthcare clearinghouse.

Relevant experience includes approved APIs, FHIR, HL7, healthcare transaction interfaces, or secure data exchanges.

They must demonstrate experience with patient matching, synchronization, conflicting updates, failed transactions, and reconciliation. General API experience alone is insufficient.

4. Secure application architecture — mandatory

The candidate must have implemented:

\* Role-based permissions and server-side access controls.

\* Audit trails and sensitive-data protection.

\* Separation of customer organizations’ data.

\* Secure credential management.

\* Backup, recovery, monitoring, and incident handling.

Experience with a platform serving multiple independent practices or customer organizations is strongly preferred.

5. Hands-on full-stack development — mandatory

The candidate must be able to personally design databases, develop backend services and user interfaces, write meaningful tests, deploy applications, and troubleshoot production issues.

This is a building role, not solely a project-management, consulting, or architecture role.

6. Production ownership — mandatory

The candidate must have supported a product after launch, including resolving incidents, releasing upgrades, managing database changes, and maintaining integrations.

They should be able to describe a significant production failure, its impact, how it was resolved, and what was changed to prevent recurrence.

7. Workflow automation experience — mandatory

The candidate must have built workflows involving task assignment, statuses, deadlines, escalation, document handling, and external-system events.

They must understand how to handle retries, duplicate events, incomplete information, and human review.

8. AI and communications experience — strongly preferred

Preference will be given to candidates who have deployed:

\* AI document extraction with validation.

\* Tool-using AI agents with defined permissions and human handoff.

\* Voice agents or telephony integrations.

\* Two-way SMS, e-fax, or secure patient messaging.

Candidates must distinguish production deployments from experimental projects.

9. Patient-facing and specialty experience — preferred

Relevant additional experience includes patient portals, caregiver access, scheduling, authorization workflows, procedure-resource scheduling, infusions, or other specialty-practice operations.

Neurology experience is valuable but not mandatory.

Evidence required with the application

Please provide two relevant project examples. For each, describe:

\* The product and type of healthcare organization it served.

\* Whether it reached production and how long you supported it.

\* Your exact role and the components you personally built.

description:
**Lead QA – Release & Automation**

**About Williams-Sonoma, Inc.**

Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer. Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play. We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond. Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. We are committed to sustainability, continuously working to protect our planet, while building an open and collaborative culture across our organization.

With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide.

Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide.

**Role Overview**

Williams-Sonoma is seeking a Lead QA – Release & Automation to lead end-to-end mobile QA activities across iOS and Android releases, with strong hands-on experience in mobile testing and automation.

This role will own QA release sign-off, coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders, drive release regression, and continuously improve QA processes through automation and AI-enabled testing. Exposure to Web, API, and Microservices testing will be an added advantage.

The ideal candidate will help accelerate release velocity while ensuring high quality across multiple engineering teams contributing to shared releases.

**Impact of the Role**

• Accelerate release velocity while ensuring high quality across multiple engineering teams contributing to shared releases.

• Improve QA processes through automation and AI-enabled testing.

• Reduce release timelines and improve deployment frequency through optimized QA validation and regression processes.

• Drive continuous improvements in automation coverage, pipeline health, defect leakage, and release readiness.

Technology Platforms You Will Work On

• iOS and Android mobile applications

• Mobile automation frameworks such as Appium or equivalent tools

• Mabl, Selenium, and Playwright

• Web, API, and Microservices testing

• CI/CD platforms including Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms

• AI-powered testing solutions, AI-assisted test generation, self-healing automation, and intelligent test selection

**Key Responsibilities**

• Own end-to-end QA release sign-off for mobile applications across iOS and Android.

• Lead release regression testing and ensure production readiness across multiple engineering teams.

• Partner with Engineering, Product, DevOps, Release Management, and Vendor QA teams to plan, coordinate, and execute successful releases.

• Define and standardize QA release processes, quality gates, and release sign-off criteria.

• Drive mobile automation strategy across iOS and Android to maximize automation coverage and reduce manual regression effort.

• Ensure automation suites are stable, maintain high pipeline pass rates, minimize flaky tests, and support reliable CI/CD execution.

• Continuously optimize QA validation and regression processes to reduce release timelines and improve deployment frequency.

• Champion AI-powered testing solutions, AI-assisted test generation, self-healing automation, and intelligent test selection.

• Monitor QA metrics such as automation coverage, execution success rate, pipeline health, defect leakage, and release readiness, driving continuous improvements.

• Coordinate with multiple engineering teams to streamline testing activities and remove bottlenecks in the release process.

• Mentor QA engineers and promote best practices in automation, quality engineering, and release management.

**Qualifications**

• 10–12+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, QA Automation, or Release QA for enterprise applications, including 4+ years of hands-on mobile testing and automation experience.

• 3+ years of experience leading QA release management or centralized regression testing teams.

• Must have strong experience in Mobile QA across iOS and Android, including functional, regression, release, and automation testing.

• Must have hands-on experience with mobile automation frameworks such as Appium or equivalent mobile automation tools.

• Exposure to Mabl, Selenium, Playwright, Web testing, and API testing is good to have.

• Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.

• Experience working in Agile environments with multiple teams contributing to shared releases.

• Must have a strong understanding of release management, quality governance, and regression optimization.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in large-scale retail/eCommerce organizations.

• Experience leading QA transformation initiatives.

• Exposure to Web and API testing.

• Experience leveraging AI-enabled testing to accelerate software delivery.

**Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center**

• Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family.

• Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact.

• Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale.

• Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges.

• Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement.

We are seeking a hands-on Firmware Design Engineer with 3-7 years of experience to implement, integrate, verify, and support embedded firmware for Client's fire and life-safety portfolio. The role supports new product development, product enhancements, platform updates, value engineering, component changes, compliance, and production support. Working with the Firmware Engineering Manager and experienced engineers, the candidate will own defined modules or features, develop drivers and product logic, support hardware bring-up, investigate defects, execute tests, and maintain controlled technical records. Assignments may include new implementations, legacy-code improvements, hardware or toolchain migrations, and changes driven by quality, cost, availability, or field performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Firmware Development and Implementation**

• Implement firmware work packages for new products, product enhancements, redesigns, sustenance, and value-engineering initiatives.

• Review software requirements, hardware interfaces, schematics, datasheets, existing source code, product documentation, and test procedures for assigned work.

• Develop or update startup, BSP, HAL, and driver modules for GPIO, timers, interrupts, ADC, PWM, serial interfaces, flash, non-volatile memory, watchdogs, and debug functions.

• Implement application logic for control, communication, indication, relays, supervised I/O, configuration, diagnostics, trouble reporting, and power-state behaviour as required.

• Maintain clear separation between reusable platform software and product configuration to reduce duplication and simplify regression.

• Support microcontroller, compiler, IDE, or hardware-platform migrations when included in an assigned project.

Integration Debugging and Verification

• Support board bring-up, peripheral validation, signal-level debugging, and hardware-firmware fault isolation with hardware engineers.

• Create and execute unit, module, integration, protocol, timing, fault-injection, regression, and system-integration tests for assigned features.

• Reproduce defects, collect logs and measurements, identify root cause, implement corrections, and verify that changes do not disturb existing behaviour.

• Use embedded IDEs, compilers, debuggers, JTAG or SWD probes, oscilloscopes, logic analysers, serial terminals, and protocol tools during implementation and debugging.

• Maintain requirements traceability, design notes, code-review records, test results, defect status, and release documentation for completed work.

**Product Lifecycle Compliance and Release Support**

• Implement firmware changes required by alternate components, hardware revisions, calibration updates, performance improvements, and cost-down initiatives.

• Support controlled test firmware and operating modes for transient, EMC, UL, FM, FCC, and other applicable compliance or certification testing.

• Prepare reproducible builds, binaries, maps, checksums, release notes, and configuration records and support production programming, ICT or FCT, pilot builds, and phase-in.

• Assist with production and field issue investigation and document corrective actions and regression evidence.

**Team Collaboration**

• Work with firmware, hardware, validation, compliance, manufacturing, product, and Client's US stakeholders to complete assigned work.

• Participate in design and code reviews, raise unclear requirements and technical risks early, and close assigned actions with objective evidence.

• Contribute reusable drivers, diagnostic utilities, test tools, documentation, and lessons learned for future development work.

**Qualifications**

• 3-7 years of hands-on embedded firmware-development experience, including coding, hardware integration, debugging, testing, and controlled release support.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Telecommunication, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline.

• Strong Embedded C fundamentals and practical experience with microcontrollers, interrupts, timers, GPIO, ADC, serial communications, watchdogs, and non-volatile memory.

• Experience with bare-metal or RTOS-based embedded systems, modular drivers, state machines, error handling, and resource-constrained products.

• Ability to read schematics, datasheets, interface specifications, existing source code, system requirements, and test procedures and convert them into working firmware.

• Hands-on experience with embedded IDEs, compilers, debuggers, JTAG or SWD, common laboratory tools, version control, and defect tracking.

• A disciplined approach to coding, peer review, test evidence, root-cause analysis, regression testing, configuration management, and documentation.

**Preferred Experience**

• Prior experience with fire alarm, fire and life-safety, emergency communication, building-automation, or another regulated embedded product is strongly preferred.

• Participation in UL and FCC compliance or certification programs is strongly preferred; exposure to UL 864 or FM Approvals is an advantage.

• Experience with Renesas or similar microcontrollers, IAR or comparable toolchains, processor migration, or legacy-code modernisation is preferred.

• Exposure to fire-alarm communication loops, notification circuits, RS-485 or proprietary protocols, supervised I/O, annunciation, relay control, or networked power products is advantageous.

**Core Competencies**

Ownership Mindset | Embedded C | Firmware Implementation | MCU Peripherals | Hardware Debugging | Test Discipline | Product Lifecycle | Root-Cause Analysis | Documentation | Collaboration

**About the Company:**
Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic
* Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems
* AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows
* System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines
* Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence
* Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews

**What We Look For**

* Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus)
* Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work
* Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT)

title: Lead Quality Analyst
description:

Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
**About the Role**
We are seeking an experienced and quality-driven
**Lead Quality Analyst**
to lead quality assurance and testing activities for large-scale Salesforce-powered Enterprise Service Management (ESM), IT Service Management (ITSM), and Conversational Agentic Platform initiatives.
  
  
The Lead Quality Analyst will be responsible for defining quality strategy, governing testing practices, mentoring Quality Analysts, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet business, functional, security, integration, and user experience expectations.
  
  
This role requires a strong combination of quality leadership, business process understanding, stakeholder management, and hands-on testing expertise. The ideal candidate will work closely with Business Analysts, Architects, Salesforce Leads, Product Owners, and customer stakeholders to establish a quality-first culture across all delivery teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Leadership & Governance**

* Lead quality assurance activities across multiple Salesforce and ITSM workstreams.
* Define quality strategies, test governance processes, standards, and best practices.
* Establish testing frameworks, review processes, quality metrics, and release readiness criteria.
* Act as the primary quality escalation point for delivery teams.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across quality engineering practices.
* Ensure quality standards are consistently applied across all project phases.

**Test Strategy & Planning**

* Define comprehensive testing strategies covering:

+ Functional Testing
+ Integration Testing
+ End-to-End Testing
+ Regression Testing
+ User Acceptance Testing
+ Release Validation

* Review and approve test plans, test scenarios, test cases, and test execution results.
* Ensure complete traceability between requirements and testing outcomes.
* Drive risk-based testing approaches for complex enterprise implementations.

**Salesforce & ITSM Solution Validation**

* Lead validation activities for solutions involving:

+ Salesforce Service Cloud
+ Experience Cloud
+ Agentforce
+ Enterprise Service Management
+ ITSM Platforms

* Validate business processes including:

+ Incident Management
+ Service Request Management
+ Change Management
+ Problem Management
+ Knowledge Management
+ CMDB
+ IT Asset Management
+ Service Catalog Management
+ Employee Service Delivery

* Ensure solutions meet business objectives, customer requirements, and compliance expectations.

**Integration & Enterprise Testing**

* Lead testing of enterprise integrations involving Salesforce, MuleSoft, APIs, ERP, HR, Monitoring, and third-party applications.
* Establish integration testing standards and validation approaches.
* Ensure data integrity, synchronization, security, and business continuity across connected platforms.
* Oversee complex end-to-end business process validation.

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**

* Lead and mentor Quality Analysts across multiple projects.
* Review and approve testing deliverables.
* Provide coaching on testing methodologies, automation adoption, and quality best practices.
* Support capability development and certification initiatives.
* Foster a quality-first mindset across business and technical teams.

**UAT & Release Management**

* Guide UAT planning and business validation activities.
* Facilitate defect triage, prioritization, and resolution processes.
* Participate in release governance and production readiness reviews.
* Ensure quality criteria are achieved prior to production deployments.

**AI & Innovation**

* Define testing approaches for Agentforce, Conversational AI, and AI-powered service experiences.
* Validate intelligent workflows, autonomous service processes, and automation capabilities.
* Support adoption of quality engineering and test automation best practices.

**Required Qualifications**
**Must Have**

* 7–10 years of Quality Assurance and Testing experience in enterprise environments.
* Minimum 2–3 years leading QA teams or testing workstreams.
* Strong experience testing Salesforce and/or Enterprise Service Management platforms.
* Experience developing enterprise test strategies and governance frameworks.
* Deep understanding of:

+ Functional Testing
+ Integration Testing
+ End-to-End Testing
+ UAT
+ Defect Management
+ Quality Metrics
+ Root Cause Analysis

* Experience managing stakeholder expectations and quality reporting.
* Experience working within Agile, Scrum, and DevOps delivery models.
* Strong communication, leadership, and mentoring skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience testing Salesforce transformation programs.
* Experience validating ITSM, CMDB, or IT Asset Management implementations.
* Experience with API and MuleSoft integration testing.
* Exposure to automated testing frameworks and test automation strategies.
* Salesforce, ISTQB, Quality Engineering, or related certifications.

**Added Advantage**

* Experience testing Agentforce implementations.
* Exposure to Conversational AI and Generative AI platforms.
* Knowledge of Enterprise Service Management operating models.
* ITIL Foundation Certification.

**What We Are Looking For**
We are looking for professionals who:
  
  

* Think beyond defect identification and focus on business outcomes.
* Can lead quality governance across enterprise programs.
* Enjoy mentoring teams and driving continuous improvement.
* Have excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Champion quality engineering and innovation.
* Are passionate about Salesforce, Agentforce, AI, and Enterprise Service Management.

**Why Join Us?**

* Lead quality assurance efforts for strategic Salesforce-powered Conversational ITSM and Enterprise Service Management initiatives.
* Work with cutting-edge technologies including Agentforce, AI, MuleSoft, Salesforce, and Enterprise Automation platforms.
* Influence testing strategy, governance, and quality engineering practices across projects.
* Mentor and develop future quality leaders within the organization.
* Collaborate with business leaders, architects, developers, and product teams driving enterprise transformation.
* Join a high-growth organization where quality, innovation, and customer experience are central to success.
* Enjoy a flexible hybrid work model across Kochi, Bangalore, and Hyderabad.

**Join Us**
If you are an experienced
**Lead Quality Analyst**
who combines strong testing expertise with leadership, governance, and mentoring capabilities, we would love to hear from you. Join us in delivering next-generation
**Salesforce-powered Conversational ITSM and Agentic Service Platforms**
, ensuring exceptional quality, business value, and customer experience at every stage of the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**Compensation**
Estimated Pay Range:
  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.
  
  
****Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion****
At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.
  
  
Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.
