title: Principal Product Manager (CMK/Encryption Platform)
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
Atlassian is looking for a product leader to own the strategy, delivery, and operating model for our Customer Managed Keys (CMK) and encryption platform portfolio. This role will lead a high-impact area at the intersection of enterprise trust, platform capability, regulatory readiness, and customer value. The Product Lead will define how encryption capabilities scale across Atlassian Cloud, clarify product and platform scope, and drive outcomes across CMK, encryption platform, bring-your-own-key patterns, and adjacent encryption services.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The CMK/Encryption Platform Product Lead is responsible for product strategy, roadmap definition, and cross-functional execution for Atlassian’s encryption platform work. The role spans both customer-facing capabilities and foundational platform services, requiring strong judgment on where to standardize, where to differentiate, and how to sequence investments across security, scale, and commercial impact.
  
  
This leader will work across product, engineering, security, go-to-market, legal, compliance, and customer-facing teams to ensure Atlassian’s encryption capabilities meet enterprise expectations while remaining durable, usable, and economically sound.
  
  
**The Team’s Scope Includes**

* Customer Managed Keys strategy, roadmap, packaging, and lifecycle
* Cryptor and related encryption platform capabilities used across Atlassian Cloud
* Bring Your Own Key and external key management patterns, including future-facing options where relevant
* Encryption standards, architecture direction, and platform consistency across products and cells
* Enterprise customer requirements related to trust, control, compliance, and key management
* Prioritization of investments that balance customer demand, risk reduction, platform leverage, and revenue influence

**What you’ll do**

* Own the product vision and roadmap for CMK and encryption platform capabilities across Atlassian Cloud
* Clarify product scope and platform boundaries across CMK, Encryption Platfrom, and adjacent encryption services so teams can execute with clear accountability
* Drive roadmap decisions across customer commitments, enterprise needs, architecture constraints, and commercial priorities
* Partner closely with engineering and security leaders on encryption architecture, technical direction, delivery sequencing, and operational readiness
* Lead planning for key initiatives such as CMK expansion, platform standardization, key management evolution, cell-scoped capabilities, and efficiency improvements
* Represent the product area in executive, cross-functional, and customer settings with clear narrative, strong judgment, and crisp tradeoff framing
* Work with field, support, and customer-facing teams to understand enterprise demand, shape adoption strategy, and unblock strategic opportunities
* Ensure roadmap choices reflect security, compliance, resilience, scale, and usability expectations for a critical trust capability
* Create alignment across product, platform, and go-to-market teams on what is being built, why it matters, and how success will be measured
* Maintain continuity on in-flight work while improving role clarity, planning quality, and long-term portfolio coherence

**Qualifications**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
**This Role Requires**

* Significant product management experience leading complex platform or enterprise product areas with broad cross-functional dependency
* Deep expertise in encryption, key management, and security product domains, with the ability to engage credibly on architecture, threat considerations, control models, operational risk, and customer trust requirements
* Strong command of cloud security and data protection concepts, including how encryption capabilities are designed, operated, and scaled in large multi-tenant environments
* Demonstrated ability to lead security- or infrastructure-intensive product spaces where correctness, resilience, and risk management are central to product success
* Experience translating highly technical platform investments into clear product strategy, roadmap choices, and customer value
* Track record of driving alignment across engineering, security, legal, compliance, support, sales, and executive stakeholders
* Ability to make high-quality prioritization decisions with incomplete information and competing demands
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify technical complexity without losing precision
* Strong customer empathy and enterprise judgment, especially for regulated, security-conscious, or large-scale customers
* Experience owning roadmap commitments and execution in areas with material business, trust, or strategic impact

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience with customer-managed keys, external key services, HSM-related systems, or cloud-native key management ecosystems
* Familiarity with enterprise compliance landscapes and trust programs that shape encryption expectations
* Experience in pricing, packaging, or commercialization of advanced enterprise platform capabilities
* Background working across both foundational platform teams and customer-facing product organizations
* Understanding of large-scale migration, re-encryption, or cryptographic lifecycle programs

**Benefits & Perks**
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**
**.**
**About Atlassian**
At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
  
  
To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
**go.atlassian.com/crh**
**.**
In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

title: Product Manager - Ansible & Terraform
description:
**Job Description**
At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold
**“what if.”**
  
  
**What if**
your ideas could ignite global innovation?
  
  
**What if**
your curiosity could redefine the future?

**your**
career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it’s like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. Our cloud-first networking and security solutions already protect
**70% of the Fortune 500**
, and we’re looking for creative thinkers ready to push that influence even further. Join us and discover how far your bold “what if” can take the world, your community, and your career.
  
  
Here, how we empower our people is extraordinary:
**Glassdoor Best Places to Work 2025, Great Place to Work-Certified in five countries, and Cigna Healthy Workforce honours three years running**
— and what we build is world-class:  recognized  as
**CybersecAsia’s Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024**
— evidence that when first-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So,
**what if**
the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next”.
  
  
In a world where you can be anything,
**Be Infoblox**
.
  
  
**Product Manager**
We have an opportunity for a
**Product Manager**
to join our Products team in Bangalore, reporting to our Director, Product Management. In this role, you will help shape the automation and cloud operations experience across the Infoblox product portfolio. You will focus on capabilities that help customers automate deployment, configuration, integration, and lifecycle operations using modern infrastructure and automation tools such as REST APIs, Ansible, Terraform, AI-driven workflows, and public cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, and GCP.
  
  
This role is ideal for a product manager who is passionate about DevOps, CloudOps, platform automation, AI-enabled operations, and improving how customers operationalize products at scale. You will partner with other Product Managers and cross-functional teams to identify automation and AI-related needs, define requirements, and help deliver capabilities that improve customer efficiency, consistency, intelligence, and time to value.
  
  
You are also expected to actively leverage AI tools and AI-driven workflows as part of your day-to-day product management practice, including research, synthesis, requirements development, prioritization, and cross-functional execution.
  
  
**Be a Contributor — What**
**You’ll Do**

* Help define and execute the roadmap for DevOps / CloudOps automation capabilities across the Infoblox portfolio.
* Work with other Product Managers to identify common automation needs and translate them into scalable platform capabilities.
* Partner closely with engineering and UX to define, refine, and deliver automation-focused features and workflows.
* Support product requirements for REST APIs, infrastructure-as-code integrations, and automation frameworks including Ansible and Terraform.
* Help drive capabilities that simplify deployment, provisioning, configuration management, and day-2 operations across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Collaborate with Product Marketing on technical positioning, enablement content, and customer-facing materials that support adoption.
* Understand how automation requirements intersect with the broader product portfolio and help drive a consistent customer experience across products.
* Contribute to product specifications, user stories, use cases, and backlog prioritization for automation-related initiatives.
* Leverage AI tools and AI-driven workflows in day-to-day product management activities, including market and customer research, synthesis, drafting requirements, prioritization support, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Own the success of the features and capabilities you help build, maintain, and deliver.

**Be Prepared — What You Bring**

* 1–3 years of related product management experience, or equivalent experience in technical product ownership, solutions engineering, DevOps, CloudOps, AI-enabled platform operations, or technical program roles.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, or a related technical field.
* Familiarity with SaaS products, cloud-managed platforms, and AI-enabled product capabilities is a plus.
* Working knowledge of automation and infrastructure technologies such as REST APIs, Ansible, Terraform, CI/CD workflows, scripting-driven operational models, and practical AI applications such as copilots, intelligent workflow automation, or LLM-powered operational use cases.
* Familiarity with public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, including awareness of their evolving AI service ecosystems.
* Demonstrated willingness and ability to use AI tools and AI-assisted workflows as part of everyday work.
* Understanding of how customers deploy, integrate, and operate infrastructure and services in enterprise, hybrid, and cloud environments.
* Ability to actively listen to customers, identify root problems, and make data-informed decisions, even when data is incomplete.
* Ability to partner with cross-functional teams such as engineering, marketing, UX, support, and architecture across the full product lifecycle.
* Ability to capture and clearly articulate customer problems, then translate those into product strategy, requirements, and prioritization.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong initiative, comfort working independently, and willingness to learn quickly in a fast-moving environment.
* Passion for ownership, innovation, and improving the customer experience through automation and operational simplicity.

**Be Successful — Your Path**
  
  
**First 90 Days:**

* Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long term goals.

**Six Months:**

* Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Infoblox products, their features, and how customers automate and operate them.
* Deliver clear product specifications, user stories, and scenarios that define customer needs and automation requirements.
* Participate in user-centric design and agile planning processes.
* Become a fully engaged member of the Product Management, UX, Architecture, and Engineering teams.
* Help drive backlog definition and prioritization for automation and CloudOps capabilities.

**One Year:**

* Be a key contributor to the roadmap and strategy for DevOps / CloudOps automation initiatives across the portfolio.
* Help drive the creation and prioritization of product requirements in partnership with other Product Managers and cross-functional teams.
* Contribute meaningfully to agile release planning and execution for automation-related product investments.
* Establish yourself as a go-to product partner for cross-portfolio automation needs.

**Belong—**
**Your Community**
Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.
  
  
**Be Rewarded —**
**Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong**

* Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
* Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops
* Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy
* Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks (and the occasional cupcake), plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations
* Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match
* We practice pay transparency and reward performance. Offers reflect role location, internal equity, experience, skills, education, and certifications

**Ready to Be the Difference?**
  
  
*Infoblox is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis*

title: Product Management Specialist - Fintech
description:
**Company Description**

FastFlowPe is a two-year-old, bootstrapped payment technology company building smarter payment infrastructure for businesses, with a focus on D2C brands and SaaS companies.

Our flagship product, Fast Checkout, is designed to help businesses improve payment success rates and optimise payment processing through intelligent payment gateway orchestration. By bringing multiple payment gateways together through a unified infrastructure, FastFlowPe helps businesses streamline payment collections, optimise transaction routing, simplify payouts and reconciliation, and deliver a smoother checkout experience.

Our platform combines payment gateway orchestration, smart routing, payment collection infrastructure and operational visibility to help businesses build more efficient and scalable payment operations.

As an early-stage company, we are focused on product innovation, merchant acquisition and building a scalable business. We are looking for entrepreneurial talent ready to take ownership, create new revenue opportunities and help shape FastFlowPe's next phase of growth.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an engineering-first Product Lead to own Fast Checkout's development and user experience, working closely with engineering, design, and business teams.

The ideal candidate combines software engineering experience with strong fintech domain knowledge, an understanding of market dynamics and user behaviour, and proven product execution skills.

You will manage the complete product lifecycle and progressively lead the development of new products, with a growth path toward
**Head of Product**
.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Product Ownership:**
  Manage product roadmaps, requirements, priorities, and feature development.
* **Engineering Collaboration:**

* **UI/UX:**

* **Execution:**

* **Cross-functional Coordination:**
  Align engineering, design, sales, and operations teams.
* **Product Optimisation:**
  Use customer feedback, user behaviour, and product metrics to improve checkout conversion and payment success.
* **Fintech & Market Insights:**
  Understand fintech trends, competitive offerings, merchant needs, and evolving payment behaviours.
* **New Product Development:**
  Identify market opportunities and lead the development and launch of new products.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* **3–4 years of software engineering/development experience**
  and
  **1–2 years in Product Management/Product Ownership**
  .
* **At least 2–3 years of experience working in the fintech industry**
  , preferably in payments, payment gateways, payment orchestration, or checkout products.
* Strong understanding of the fintech ecosystem, market trends, merchant needs, and user behaviour.

title: Founder's Office
description:
**About Wingy**

Love and dating should feel exciting. For most of us, they come with a lot of anxiety too. Wingy is an emotionally-intelligent wingwoman who works alongside you through every part of your love life, helping make modern dating a lot less anxiety-inducing.

We are backed by Gruhas Collective Consumer Fund, ajvc, Anupam Mittal and other leading consumer-tech founders.

**First, about this JD**

You’re expected to work without one.

This is what we’re doing today and where we need help today. It will change, probably by the time you finish onboarding. If you need a fixed scope, this will be a rough ride. If a shifting one sounds like the fun part, read on.

**Two north stars: user growth and retention**

You and the founders own these together. Everything else is negotiable.

**For growth, you’ll:**

* Run our UGC engine: creators, concepts, briefs, output and iteration
* Find the channels we haven’t discovered yet
* Learn and run Meta ads. You don’t need to know how today, but you’ll need to in six weeks.
* Dig out the user insights behind winning hooks: the line that makes someone stop scrolling because it’s uncomfortably about them

**For retention, you’ll:**

* Uncover why some users stay and others disappear, and shape the product journey so more of them stick
* Optimize the whole funnel, from channels, messages and hooks that bring in the right people to the product flow itself

**You’ll probably do well here if you:**

* Are curious about people and always ask the next question
* Can take a user call in the morning, look at a retention cohort in the afternoon, and see how the two connect
* Have made something with a measurable result: content, ads, a product or a community
* Understand hooks, storytelling and internet culture, and can explain why something worked
* Start without a brief, a team or permission
* Hold strong opinions and drop them when the data disagrees

You don’t need a PM title or dating-app experience. Experience with consumer social, marketplaces or Gen Z products helps, but we care far more about how you think and how fast you move.

**What you’re signing up for**

A seat next to the founders for everything: product, users and the messy middle. You’ll learn how a consumer company gets built by building one.

In exchange, you get ambiguity, pace and real ownership, plus a healthy amount of ESOPs and skin in the game.

**How to apply**

Write to priyansha@meetwingy.com about the cool things you’ve done and include a link to your resume or LinkedIn.

title: Head of Digital Omnichannel
description:
**INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT**
Chalhoub Group’s Capability Hub is our technology and innovation hub set up with the vision to unite exceptional talent to build technology and capabilities that elevate luxury experiences and define the future of luxury retail.
  
  
For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.
  
  
Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.
  
  
Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.
  
  
Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
Lead the Digital Delivery function across the digital commerce portfolio, translating business requirements into clearly defined features and delivery outcomes that enhance customer journeys across the Group’s digital platforms. Oversee delivery across core commerce (checkout and payments), product discovery, mobile apps, digital commerce platforms, and projects, ensuring priorities are translated into executable plans and delivered consistently. Drive strong delivery discipline, cross-functional alignment, and high-quality digital experiences for the Group’s brands.
  
  

* Translate the global digital commerce roadmap into a high-velocity delivery portfolio, partner with Dubai to align multi-squad capacity with brand priorities, ensuring predictable, high-quality execution.
* Direct complex delivery initiatives in collaboration with the CPO office, regional brand heads, and joint-venture partners.
* Drive value realization and business outcomes (conversion, AOV, adoption) by optimizing cross-omni dependency matrices, mitigating risks, and ensuring cohesive customer experiences.
* Champion Agile maturity and delivery excellence across the Omnichannel domain.
* Cultivate a high-performing guild of Capability Analysts and Leads, driving continuous improvement in delivery metrics (Sprint Velocity, Predictability Score, Cycle Time) while establishing rigorous Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) standards to eliminate defect escape.
* Responsible for developing the SLA report monthly and presenting this back to the brands to ensure Quality and product SLAs are met on a monthly basis.
* Responsible for billing across all the digital squads, ensuring that development and associated costs are billed to the business teams.
* Manage delivery demand versus squad capacity, ensuring commitments are realistic and dependencies across squads are understood before work is planned.
* Ensure the team of Analysts are focused on business requirements being translated into well-defined features, functional requirements, acceptance criteria and executable delivery outcomes before they enter development.
* Lead PI planning and delivery governance across the digital squads, maintaining objectives, risks, decisions and dependencies in Confluence.

**What You’ll Need To Succeed**

* 12 to 15 years in digital commerce, and at least 10 years of experience in digital development including leading multi-squad delivery and managing teams.
* Experience delivering digital commerce capabilities across end-to-end e-commerce journeys, including site redesigns, checkout enhancements, core commerce flows, cart and shopping bag management, promotions and pricing, payments, order tracking, mobile apps, product discovery, search, recommendations, and browse-to-buy journey optimization.
* Experience of agile delivery at scale, including PI planning, capacity planning, and delivery governance.
* Experience partnering with senior business stakeholders to agree delivery commitments, SLAs, and priorities.
* Usage proficiency in Jira and Confluence for planning, documentation, and reporting.
* Experience with digital commerce platforms such as Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Shopify.
* Experience of billing, cost recovery, or commercial governance within an internal agency or shared services model.
* Certification in agile delivery, such as Scrum Master or SAFe, is nice to have.
* Preferred Profile: Retail or e-commerce domain experience. Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution. Profiles such as Head of Digital, Digital Lead, Lead Omnichannel Digital, or Lead of E-commerce.

**What We Can Offer You**
With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.
  
  
We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.
  
  
**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**
To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.
  
  
**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**
It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.
  
  
We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

Join Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice as a Manager, Coupa, where you will support digital procurement transformation initiatives across source-to-pay environments. In this role, you will contribute to discovery, solution design, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and support activities for Coupa solutions across procurement, sourcing, contracts, supplier management, invoicing, and related modules. You will work with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, deliver quality work products within project timelines, and support implementation and post-go-live activities across the solution lifecycle.

As a Manager, Coupa on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for supporting source-to-pay transformation initiatives across client environments.
  
  

* Lead discovery workshops, document business requirements, map current-state processes, identify process gaps, and design future-state workflows aligned to Coupa capabilities.
* Configure and support Coupa modules based on project scope, including Procurement, Sourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management, Supplier Information Management, Invoicing, Expenses, Coupa Pay, and Spend Analytics.
* Support integration design and execution between Coupa and enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, and Workday Financials, including connectors, flat-file integrations, and related data flows.
* Set up master data, catalogs, approval workflows, buying channels, coding rules, supplier onboarding forms, and other components required for end-to-end source-to-pay operations.
* Support testing, defect triage, deployment, user training, hypercare, release updates, post-go-live optimization, and coordination with onsite and offshore teams across the implementation lifecycle.

Enterprise Performance

title: Senior Product Manager - Tech, Alexa Ads
description:
**Description**
Alexa+ is the world's best Generative AI powered personal assistant / agent for consumers. We are seeking an experienced and entrepreneurial Senior Product Manager – Technical to lead key monetization initiatives for Amazon Alexa+. This is primarily a technical product management role, with a secondary go-to-market and product marketing responsibility (approximately 80% product management, 20% product marketing).
  
  
This product leader owns what we build and why. They have a successful track record of leading product initiatives from concept to launch, working backwards from customers, and making product decisions grounded in direct customer understanding and data. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with excellent product management skills, a strategic thinker who engages deeply with engineering on architecture and technical tradeoffs, and a strong communicator with excellent cross-org collaboration skills. Experience in the following domains is preferred: e-commerce, online advertising, search, AI powered personal assistants, personalization, and generative AI powered products.
  
  
As a Senior Product Manager – Technical for Alexa+ Monetization, you will drive product strategy, product definition, design, launch, and product decision-making for mission-critical monetization initiatives. You will own the product roadmap and the input and output metrics that define success. You will spend the majority of your time on core product management, and you will additionally own the go-to-market and product marketing motion — positioning, messaging, and sales enablement — required to bring your products to internal ad sales teams and external advertiser/agency customers. You will maintain ownership across the full product life-cycle. Your work will impact hundreds of millions of customers worldwide and drive significant growth for Alexa+.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Product management (primary, ~80%)
  
  
Own product decisions for Alexa+ Monetization initiatives — deciding what to build and why, and holding decision authority across the product life-cycle.
  
  
Drive the development of product strategy and create buy-in for the plan across the Alexa organization and partner teams in Amazon.
  
  
Create and own product roadmaps for the key areas you are leading.
  
  
Work backwards from customers: conduct and synthesize direct customer research, observe consumer behavior, and use customer and market data to define product direction.
  
  
Engage deeply with engineering on system architecture and technical tradeoffs, influencing technical design decisions to meet customer and business goals.
  
  
Define, instrument, and own both input metrics (the levers you control) and output metrics (business outcomes) for the products you lead.
  
  
Develop detailed business requirements, user stories, and product specifications.
  
  
Partner with engineering and partner teams to drive product launch and business growth.
  
  
Product marketing / go-to-market (secondary, ~20%)
  
  
Own product positioning and messaging for the products you lead, and partner on go-to-market collateral and sales enablement for internal ad sales teams and external advertiser/agency customers.
  
  
Support go-to-market execution for launches and help create buy-in for the GTM plan across Alexa Ads and Amazon Ads sales teams.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or above in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* 7+ years of technical product management experience, leading products from concept to launch.
* Track record of making product decisions grounded in direct customer understanding and data.
* Demonstrated ability to engage with engineering on architecture and technical design tradeoffs.
* Experience defining and owning input and output metrics for a product.
* Experience leading teams and cross-org stakeholders through influence rather than authority.
* Outstanding written and oral communication skills.
* Strong quantitative data analysis and critical thinking skills.
* History of teamwork and willingness to roll up one's sleeves to get the job done.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
* Experience in e-commerce, online advertising, search, AI powered personal assistants, personalization, or generative AI powered products.
* Experience owning or contributing to go-to-market, product positioning, and sales enablement for advertising or software products.

description:

Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows.

If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**About Availity**
Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity, so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.

Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.

**Product Manager**
to drive the vision, strategy, and execution of the
**Availity Essentials Portal**

* Strong understanding of Agile product development practices and experience collaborating with Engineering, UX, Analytics, and cross-functional business teams.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and prioritization skills with the ability to make data-driven decisions based on customer value and business impact.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building or managing provider-facing healthcare applications, multi-payer portals, or provider engagement platforms.
* Strong knowledge of healthcare workflows including Eligibility, Claims, Claim Status, Prior Authorization, Remittance, and Provider Administration.
* Experience using Generative AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Lovable, or Figma AI for product discovery, research, and rapid prototyping.
* Familiarity with product analytics, experimentation frameworks, APIs, platform products, and SaaS business models.
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Aha! Product board, Amplitude, Pendo, or Mixpanel; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.

**Why Join Availity India?**

* Meaningful impact: Work on solutions that help simplify healthcare administration and support better provider and patient experiences.
* Global exposure: Partner with U.S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities.
* Learning and growth: Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development.
* Flexible work experience: Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office-based models.
* Holistic rewards: Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs.
* Inclusive workplace: Join a casual, collaborative, and inclusive environment where associates are encouraged to bring ideas forward.
* Office experience: For office-based associates, Availity India provides amenities such as coffee and tea, subsidized meals, recreation areas, and eligible night-shift transportation support.

**What To Expect From The Hiring Process**
Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and engaging. Depending on the role, it may include application review, recruiter discussion, technical or functional assessment, hiring manager interviews, team or leadership conversations, offering discussion, background verification, and onboarding support.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Statement**
Availity is committed to building an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage individuals who are excited by collaboration, innovation, and meaningful impact to apply.
  
  
**Eligibility**
**Video Camera Usage**
*Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.*

The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non-participants.*

title: Director of AI Labs Business Unit
description:
**🚀 About Joveo**

Joveo builds AI-powered recruiting technology. We are building a team to deliver specialist human data and AI evaluation programs, with expert judgment at the centre of the work.

We are hiring a director to shape this capability and build the organisation that delivers it.

**🌟 About the role**

Build the function that turns specialist human expertise into AI data and evaluations customers can rely on.

You will work with Joveo leadership to shape the offering, hire the managers who deliver it and establish the standards we commit to. Your remit includes customer delivery and portfolio economics, with influence over the tools and capabilities we develop.

For someone who has already led complex AI programs, this is an opportunity to put that experience to work across an entire function. You will help decide which opportunities we pursue, what a successful pilot must demonstrate and how we grow without losing control of quality or cost.

**🧠 What you’ll do**

* Shape the offering with leadership. Identify the customer problems we can solve well, define the deliverables and acceptance standards, and establish what we need to prove before expanding a service.
* Build the delivery leadership team. Hire and develop program managers and specialist leads. Give them clear accountability and decision rights, and plan expert capacity around qualified demand.
* Establish quality standards across programs. Set expectations for expert qualification, calibration, adjudication and measurement. Work with technical specialists to challenge weak metrics and keep evaluation conclusions defensible.
* Lead senior customer conversations. Translate technical needs into realistic commitments, resolve difficult escalations and use customer feedback to improve the offering. Help turn successful pilots into repeat programs.
* Own delivery economics across the portfolio. Understand the full cost of expert supply, technical integration and rework. Partner with commercial teams on pricing, scope changes and capacity decisions.
* Shape tooling priorities with engineering. Turn recurring delivery problems into reusable capabilities, make deliberate choices about automation and maintain strong practices for customer data protection and traceability.

**🎯 What we’re looking for**

* You have built or led a delivery, operations or technical program function in AI data, evaluation, applied AI or a closely related field.
* You have hired or developed managers and held responsibility for complex customer outcomes. You can build a team that makes good decisions without every issue reaching you.
* You are credible in both a technical review and a commercial discussion. You can challenge an evaluation design, identify weak acceptance criteria and work through the implications for delivery and cost.
* You have made consequential operating decisions: narrowing an offering, resetting a customer commitment, changing a quality system or rebuilding a team. You can explain your reasoning and the results.
* Experience launching a service, turning pilots into repeat programs or operating expert contributor networks is especially relevant.

We will look at the scope you have carried and the judgment you have developed. Your record of building a function matters more than the title you currently hold.

**✨ Why join Joveo**

You will help shape this capability while its operating choices are still taking form. Your decisions will influence the work we pursue, the leaders we hire and the standards customers experience.

This role brings technical delivery and commercial responsibility together. If you have strong convictions about how complex AI programs should run, you will have the scope to build an organisation around them.

Product Architect – Enterprise Analytics Services
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Technical architecture leader for a product squad responsible for translating product vision into executable architecture and production software.
  
  
Build the Future of Enterprise Analytics
  
  
Qualitrol's Enterprise Analytics Services organization develops AI-native, cloud-agnostic enterprise software that powers advanced analytics for critical electrical infrastructure. Engineers follow a Specification-Driven Agentic SDLC, collaborating with AI throughout architecture, implementation, testing, documentation, and validation while retaining full engineering accountability.

* Use AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate production-quality software delivery while maintaining human accountability.

title: Manager, Engineering
description:
**Our Mission:**
6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.
  
  
**Our People:**
People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Delivery**

* Lead sprint delivery for a team of 6–12 engineers: planning, dependencies, risks, release readiness.
* Think about how work gets sequenced across people and AI-assisted workflows, not just story points.
* Keep JIRA, ProductBoard, and the dependency tracker current. No stale tickets, no surprises at SoS.
* Track cycle time and escaped defects; own the trend, not just the number.

**Technical**

* Review code and AI-generated output for whether it solves the right problem. Clean tests aren't enough.
* Define what needs human sign-off, what can be spot-checked, and what warrants a second pass.
* Write specs that work as contracts: clear scope, explicit constraints, stated boundaries.
* Stay close to architecture decisions, tech debt, and incident response.
* Contribute to software architecture decisions and patent writing for innovative work.

**People**

* Run 1:1s that are about growth, not sprint status.
* Coach engineers on when to trust AI output and when to push back. Model it explicitly, not just in retrospect.
* Give clear, timely feedback; build real development plans; address performance early.
* Help your team see that directing AI well is a skill worth building, not just a tool to adopt.
* Calibrate hiring panels, provide written feedback, contribute to calibration discussions.

**Cross-functional & Culture**

* Be the PM partner who holds a definition-of-ready and surfaces risks before they land in a leadership meeting.
* Engage escalations directly; produce RCAs; own P1/P2 support SLAs.
* Set the tone on your team: accountability, directness, recognition of others' work.
* Watch for workload and wellbeing signals before they become problems.
* Lead by influence across teams and functions ; comfortable driving cross-team technical decisions without direct authority

**Experience**
**What We're Looking For**

* 10+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years managing teams of 5 or more.
* BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Enough architectural depth to evaluate tradeoffs, including in AI-assisted output.
* Background in platform, API, data, or infrastructure engineering.
* Comfortable in a PM/Design pod environment; fluent with JIRA and ProductBoard or equivalent.
* Strong fundamentals in data structures, design patterns, and object-oriented programming.
* Proficient in Python or Java; enough depth to engage meaningfully in code review and design conversations.
* Strong enough in distributed systems, data pipelines, or APIs

**What Sets You Apart**

* You've run a platform or infrastructure team where other engineers are your customers.
* You've coached an IC through a meaningful promotion and can say concretely what that looked like.
* You've worked with AI-assisted engineering workflows and have a practical approach to reviewing output, not just a philosophy about it.
* You've collaborated across time-zones and know how to make it work.
* You can adopt a framework before it's perfect.

**Our Benefits:**
Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.
  
  
We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com.

title: Product Marketing Senior Manager
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

 

For more information, visit


www.sonicwall.com

or follow us on


X,


LinkedIn

,


Facebook

, and


Instagram

.

 

**Overview**

SonicWall is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own go-to-market strategy and execution for our Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and Threat Protection product lines, along with other assigned product lines across the SonicWall portfolio. This individual contributor role also drives the success of SonicWall's Technology Alliance Partner Program, ensuring partner value propositions and joint go-to-market plans translate into measurable pipeline and revenue impact. The role also maintains working knowledge of SonicWall SonicSentry, our Managed Security Services (MSS) business, to support consistent messaging and cross-functional alignment where the two offerings intersect.

You will develop positioning and messaging, lead product launches, build the sales and channel enablement tools that win deals, and serve as the subject-matter expert who translates complex security technology into clear, compelling, customer-facing value. This role requires deep hands-on execution rather than team management — you will drive results directly, in close partnership with product management, engineering, sales, and channel teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

Strategy & Positioning

* Own go-to-market strategy for EDR/Threat Protection and other assigned product lines, including value propositions and positioning tailored to target markets, buyer personas, and vertical/compliance requirements.
* Conduct ongoing competitive research and maintain subject-matter-expert-level understanding of competitors' strengths, weaknesses, and market moves across EDR/XDR, endpoint security, and other owned product lines.
* Partner with product management and engineering to translate technical capabilities into differentiated customer-facing messaging and business value propositions.
* Maintain working knowledge of SonicWall SonicSentry (MSS) sufficient to support cross-sell messaging, answer sales/partner questions, and keep positioning consistent across the endpoint and MSS portfolio

**Go-to-Market Execution**

* Plan and lead product launches end to end for endpoint and other owned product lines — coordinating cross-functional stakeholders across product, engineering, sales, and support to execute the launch cycle and drive adoption.
* Build sales enablement assets, including pitch decks, battlecards, objection handlers, competitive comparisons, and training materials for direct and channel sales teams.
* Produce thought-leadership and demand-generation content — blogs, whitepapers, eBooks, videos, and web content — that positions SonicWall as a leader in endpoint security and the other product lines you own.

**Technology Alliance Partner Program**

* Own the marketing strategy and success metrics for the Technology Alliance Partner Program, ensuring partner value propositions, co-marketing assets, and joint go-to-market plans drive measurable partner and pipeline growth.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with alliance partners to support joint go-to-market execution and co-selling motions.

**Customer, Market & Partner Insight**

* Develop deep customer and partner knowledge through market research, segmentation and persona development, customer interviews, and internal business metrics.
* Identify and evaluate new market opportunities, industry compliance requirements, and emerging threats relevant to endpoint security and your other owned product lines, and recommend appropriate marketing activity.

**Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Define and track success metrics for launches, campaigns, and the partner program; report on performance against targets.
* Continuously test, measure, and refine messaging, campaigns, and enablement materials based on results and field feedback.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6-8 years of product marketing experience, with meaningful time at a B2B security or technical software company; experience with EDR/endpoint security, threat protection, or network security strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ownership of go-to-market strategy and execution for at least one product line or service offering, from launch through lifecycle.
* Strong knowledge of the security market, including EDR/XDR, endpoint threat protection, and firewalls, plus emerging categories such as Zero Trust and SASE; working familiarity with managed security services (MSS) a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to translate complex technical concepts into business-oriented value propositions for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Proven ability to independently build sales enablement content — pitch decks, battlecards, training — that drives measurable sales results.
* Strong analytical and business skills; comfortable using data to prioritize initiatives and measure marketing effectiveness.
* Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive projects to completion across cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Willingness to travel to visit customers, prospects, and partners as an essential part of the role.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience building or running technology alliance or channel partner marketing programs.
* Prior professional experience in product management or another strategic technical role.
* MBA or other advanced business degree.
* Strong grasp of current market trends and emerging technologies in cybersecurity.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Engineering, or a related field required; advanced degree a plus.
* 6-8+ years of relevant product marketing experience. This is an individual contributor role

title: Senior Projects Manager – Computational Biology/Bio-Computing & AI
description:
**Job Title: Senior Projects Manager – Computational Biology & AI**

**Experience:**
5–10 years of Experience with substantial hands-on experience in computational biology/bioinformatics, AI/ML, with demonstrated leadership of handling complex technical projects. Must have proficiency in Python/ relevant scientific computing & AI frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and associated data science libraries. Should be experienced with large-scale data processing, distributed computing, cloud-computing, GPU-based model training, or high-performance computing, DevOps & MLOps.

**Education: Ph.D**
. in Bioinformatics/Computational Biology/Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, or a related quantitative discipline with strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning models, and modern AI architectures.

**Role Type:**
Full-time | Research, Technology Product Development & AI Innovation

**Position Overview:**

We are seeking a highly accomplished and visionary
**Senior Projects Manager – Computational Biology & AI**
to lead the research, development, and deployment of innovative computational algorithms, large-scale machine learning models, and advanced artificial intelligence systems for multi-omics biological data.

The role will focus on building next-generation AI capabilities that integrate, analyze, and interpret complex, heterogeneous, and high-dimensional biological datasets, especially on
**multi-omics datasets and other molecular and clinical data modalities**
.

The successful candidate will lead multidisciplinary teams in developing scalable AI/ML architectures, multimodal foundation models, predictive algorithms, and automated interpretation engines that transform complex biological data into clinically and scientifically meaningful insights. This position combines
**scientific innovation, AI/ML research leadership, computational platform development, and project/program management**
, requiring the ability to translate complex scientific challenges into robust, scalable, and impactful AI-driven solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI/ML Algorithm Development and Innovation**

* Lead the design and development of innovative computational algorithms and advanced machine learning models for biological data analysis, interpretation, and prediction.
* Develop novel approaches for extracting meaningful biological signals from complex, noisy, sparse, high-dimensional, and heterogeneous datasets.
* Drive research and implementation of deep learning, transformer-based architectures, graph neural networks, generative AI, self-supervised learning, contrastive learning, and other advanced AI methodologies.
* Establish methodologies for model training, predictive modelling, model optimization, validation, benchmarking, explanability and continuous improvement.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and translate promising research into scalable computational solutions.

**2. Multi-Omics Integration & Multimodal AI**

* Lead the development of algorithms and AI models capable of integrating and interpreting diverse biological data types.
* Design advanced computational frameworks for cross-modal data integration, representation learning, feature extraction, and biological knowledge discovery.
* Develop unified or interoperable AI models that learn from multiple data modalities and generate integrated biological and clinical interpretations.
* Address challenges associated with missing modalities, batch effects, technical variability, data sparsity, population heterogeneity, and differences across platforms and experimental technologies.
* Explore the development of multimodal biological foundation models capable of learning generalizable representations across datasets, diseases, populations, and use cases.

**3. Large-Scale Machine Learning and AI Model Development**

* Architect, develop, and manage large-scale AI/ML models trained on extensive and diverse biological, molecular, clinical, and biomedical datasets.
* Lead the development of domain-specific foundation models, including models for biological sequence understanding, molecular representation learning, disease signatures, & integrated multi-omics interpretation.
* Build scalable data-processing and model-training pipelines to support large datasets, distributed computing, GPU-based workloads, and high-throughput analytical workflows; and optimize computational efficiency, inference performance, reproducibility, scalability, and deployment readiness..
* Develop reusable model architectures, training frameworks, feature libraries, and computational components that can be applied across multiple scientific and clinical applications.
* Establish strategies for pretraining, fine-tuning, transfer learning, domain adaptation, & continual model improvement.

**4. Automated Biological and Clinical Data Interpretation**

* Lead development of automated interpretation engines that convert raw or processed biological data into structured, actionable, and scientifically grounded insights.
* Build AI-driven workflows that integrate data quality assessment, feature extraction, model inference, evidence aggregation, interpretation, & report generation.
* Develop computational approaches for identifying disease-associated molecular patterns, clinically relevant biomarkers, molecular subtypes, & potential mechanisms of disease to enable automated interpretation across multiple use case.
* Incorporate biological knowledge bases, pathway databases, literature-derived evidence, and other curated knowledge resources to improve interpretability & contextual relevance.

**5. Computational Biology Research and Scientific Leadership**

* Define the computational biology & AI research roadmap in alignment with organizational scientific, product, and business objectives; and translate emerging scientific discoveries & computational methodologies into practical AI capabilities.
* Identify high-impact novel research opportunities at the intersection of systems biology, multi-omics, machine learning, & precision medicine and lead development of novel methodologies, algorithms, prototypes, & proof-of-concept systems.
* Critically evaluate scientific literature, benchmark emerging methods, and establish best practices for computational research; incorporate methodological innovation, reproducible research, & publication-quality analytical standards.
* Collaborate with domain experts to ensure that developed models capture meaningful biological relationships rather than relying solely on statistical associations.

**6. Project and Program Management**

* Own end-to-end execution of complex AI and computational biology projects, from problem definition and feasibility assessment through research, development, validation, and deployment.
* Develop project plans, milestones, resource requirements, timelines, budgets, and measurable success criteria, and manage multiple concurrent projects and prioritize initiatives based on scientific value, technical feasibility, strategic importance, and business impact.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams comprising computational biologists, bioinformaticians, laboratory scientists, clinicians, and product teams.
* Establish effective project governance, risk management, technical reviews, and performance reporting processes. Anticipate scientific, data, computational, regulatory, operational risks, and develop mitigation strategies.
* Ensure timely delivery of robust, scalable, well-documented, and maintainable AI solutions.

**7. Data Engineering, DevOps, MLOps, and Platform Development**

* Guide the design of scalable data architectures and computational pipelines for the ingestion, harmonization, transformation, and analysis of multi-omics & clinical datasets.
* Oversee the development of robust workflows for data preprocessing, quality control, normalization, feature engineering, and metadata management.
* Establish model development, deployment practices covering experiment tracking, version control, automated testing, model registries, monitoring, & reproducibility.
* Operationalize research models within production-grade computational platforms, APIs, analytical applications, and automated reporting systems, and promote cloud-native and distributed computing architectures where appropriate.
* Ensure appropriate data security, access controls, privacy protections, and governance throughout the data and model lifecycle.

**8. Model Validation, Explainability, and Responsible AI**

* Establish rigorous validation frameworks to assess model accuracy, robustness, generalizability, reproducibility, and clinical or scientific utility.
* Design appropriate benchmarking strategies, independent test sets, external validation studies, & prospective evaluation approaches where feasible, and evaluate model performance.
* Develop interpretable AI methods that help scientists & clinicians understand model predictions and their supporting evidence.
* Implement uncertainty quantification, out-of-distribution detection, bias assessment, & safeguards against unsupported interpretations.
* Work with clinical, quality, regulatory, and compliance teams to align development and validation practices with applicable requirements, particularly for intended clinical use.
* Ensure that models and automated interpretations are evaluated against defined acceptance criteria before operational deployment.

**9. Team Leadership and Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams across computational biology, AI/ML research, bioinformatics, and data science and establish a culture of innovation, scientific integrity, technical excellence, collaboration, & accountability.
* Communicate scientific findings, technical strategies, project status, and business implications to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Translate broad scientific and clinical requirements into clearly defined computational problems, development roadmaps, and measurable deliverables.
* Build cross-functional alignment among research, clinical, product, and commercial teams, and manage collaborations with all external stakeholders, where required.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Would you like to build highly available, scalable and distributed engineering systems for one of the largest data lakes in Amazon? Does Petabyte scale excite you?  
  
Spektr is Amazon Ads' exabyte-scale central data lake: the unified catalog for petabytes of campaign, ad-serving, billing, and measurement data. Hundreds of teams and Amazon's advertiser-facing AI agents depend on it for discovery, ingestion, transformation, and querying at scale. If you want large-scale engineering with tangible business impact, this is the team.  
  
We're rebuilding Spektr ground-up with an AI-first architecture, and building fully-automated domain agents that let customers manage their big data lifecycle in a single click. In parallel, we're adopting Apache Iceberg / S3 Tables with serverless compute, scaling horizontally via a data mesh pattern for 5 growth in volume and demand. If you thrive on greenfield experimentation and shipping things that matter to the business, keep reading.  
  
As a Sr SDE on this team, you will own the core platform services that power Amazon Ads data infrastructure, consolidating legacy systems into clean, API-first services that cut job creation time from weeks to less than a day. You will build MCP-enabled AI interfaces that let AI agents create and run data pipelines on Spektr at 99%+ success rate, directly shaping how GenAI discovers and consumes data across Amazon Ads. You will design and operate high-scale Java services on AWS-native infrastructure (Spark, EMR Serverless, Kinesis, Step Functions), processing petabytes of data daily at 99.9% availability. You will also drive deployment automation, replacing manual release cycles with CI/CD pipelines that accelerate delivery velocity for a platform serving Tier-1 advertising data systems.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Engage with key decision makers such as Product & Program Managers to understand customer requirements and brainstorm on solutions

* Ensure testability, maintanability and low operational footprint for your code

* Innovate on AWS technology to improve latency, reduce cost and operations

  
A day in the life  

* Focus on core engineering opportunities to guarantee system availability that matches our data growth
* Work with a skilled team of engineers, managers and decision makers to consistently meet customer demand
* Automate monitoring of data availability, quality and usability via simplified metrics and drive innovations to improve guarantees for our customers

  
About the team  
The mission of the Ads Datalake team is to provide data that helps the advertising organization make informed analyses and decisions for our customers and to determine and deploy investments for future growth via a set of central and unified products and services.  
  
Our team focuses on simplicity, usability, speed, compliance, cost efficiency and enabling high-velocity decision making so our customers can generate high quality insights faster.  
  
We are a global team with presence across India and North America.

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience

**Introduction to role:**

Are you ready to turn complex data into clear, confident decisions that shape the future of life-changing medicines? In this role, you will develop patient, volume, and revenue forecasts for strategic brands and early assets across Global priority markets and the US—work that directly informs brand strategy, investment decisions, and how we reach patients faster!

Based at Manyata Tech Park, Bangalore on a hybrid schedule (three days a week in office) with a 2 PM - 11 PM IST shift, you will partner closely with forecasting leadership and Commercial teams. Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where your analysis sparks strategy and your point of view earns trust?

**Accountabilities:**

* Documentation and Communication: Deliver forecasts with clear, accessible documentation of assumptions, confidence levels, and key drivers; proactively surface issues that matter to the business.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field
* 6+ years of direct Pharmaceutical forecasting experience with an in-depth knowledge of forecasting techniques, models and approaches
* Good understanding of multiple disease areas, with experience in rare diseases/ OBU including how patients move through their respective diagnosis and treatment pathways, including treatment dynamics
* Experience integrating insights from market research and secondary data analysis into forecast assumptions
* Experience using a range of data sources and analytics involving standard data in the Pharmaceutical industry – e.g. IQVIA (MIDAS, DDD NPA, Monthly Xponent), claims data (Truven, Marketscan), epidemiological data, etc. For US forecasting, experience with TRx / NBRx / NRx data and methodologies
* Strong analytical expertise; excellent Excel, financial modelling and forecasting skills
* Ability to build trusted relationships across a range of partner groups including Marketing, Analytics, Operations, and Technology
* Confirmed experience in problem solving and continuous improvement
* Strong written and verbal communication

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred (e.g., PhD, MBA, Masters)
* Knowledge and experience in sophisticated statistical forecast methodologies and applied AI / ML / automation
* Experience working with Power Apps, specifically PowerBI
* For US forecasting, confirmed understanding of US Market Access and gross-to-net

description:
**Job Requirements**  

Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.

Ad Platforms is responsible for Disney’s industry-leading ad technology and products – driving advertising performance, innovation, and value in Disney’s sports, news, and entertainment content, across all media platforms.

As a Sr Product Development Engineer I, you will be assuming a pivotal role within our team, helping shape the future of our foundational services within the Quote-to-Cash space. You will be responsible for guiding the technical direction of our team and ensuring the delivery of high-quality solutions that meet the needs of our user base.

The ideal candidate should be proficient in Python, Django and/or Flask, SQL, Terraform, and have experience with JavaScript. They must combine engineering skills with strong communication skills to work with stakeholders to turn business requirements into efficient, scalable features.

While The Walt Disney Company is a large company, ideally, we’d like if you have some previous experience in a U.S. startup environment and be comfortable performing multiple roles. We strive to get things done quickly, at high quality, and we are committed to the agile methodology. Our work is guided by lean principles (looking at value and looking for waste; not doing anything ‘for the sake of doing it’).

We’re looking for a passionate technical expert who wants to come here to do their very best work and make their mark, adding their chapter to the long and storied history of The Walt Disney Company. Someone who holds themselves and their team accountable in a professional, collaborative manner. A collaborative technologist who seeks to bring the best out in themselves and their team. Someone who can provide guidance, a fresh perspective, and innovative insight into our initiatives.

**Responsibilities:**

* Full lifecycle of software development (requirements gathering, designing, building, testing, maintenance, and support)
* Work within a cross functional team of engineers building software in a collaborative & agile development environment

Foster an open environment of mutual support and engineering effectiveness Escalate and report project status, progress, risks to your leadership

* Influence and drive software engineering and architecture best practices and standards within the team
* Support the team in continuously improving the organization’s tools for owning and operating software

Author and provide feedback on technical proposals and root cause analyses Provide technical guidance and coaching to a team of software engineers

* Lead the design, development and deployment of microservices including inter-service communication and data consistency
* Lead the design and development of high-quality solutions using Django/Flask, showcasing advanced proficiency in Python, SQL/NoSQL, Serverless architecture, API Design, and Security
* Work with databases and message queues to ensure seamless data flow and integrations
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate user requirements into functional and scalable solutions
* Champion best practices for Software development, ensuring adherence to quality standards and coding guidelines

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Engineering, or another technical field
* Have 5+ years of experience in web application development or software engineering in a large enterprise environment using modern frameworks
* Have excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Have strong problem-solving and analytical skills
* Have deep expertise in Python and frameworks like Django and/or Flask
* Have deep expertise in core libraries including, django-ninja-extra, npmy, pydantic, pyyaml, pytest, ruff, and sphinx
* Have deep knowledge of Postgres and other SQL and NoSQL databases
* Have deep knowledge in designing and developing serverless architectures
* Have experience with Kafka, Kinesis, and Redis (Elasticache)
* Possess extensive experience in developing industry-level, highly available and scalable services
* Have expertise in cloud-based computing principles and practices
* Have deep understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Docker/containerization, Kubernetes/orchestration and AWS
* Have expertise with cloud infrastructure technologies: AWS Lamda, Terraform, K8S, Spinnaker, IAM, ALB, etc.
* Have experience working with observability tooling such as DataDog
* Have a track record of championing quality engineering, be adamant that all code is written in a way that can be tested with unit tests
* Have experience working with high-performing teams using Agile and Lean methodologies and frameworks

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related technical discipline is highly desirable
* Experience creating performant User Interfaces leveraging HTML/CSS/JS and React or other frameworks
* Experience with AI (GenAI, LangChain, RAG, Machine Learning)
* Previous work experience in digital advertising
* Experience working with vendor teams to deliver high quality results
* Strong curiosity about how Disney delivers the Magic and a desire to be a part of it

This position is with Disney (India) Private Limited, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology.
