title: Senior Marketing Manager
description:
About Hexnode

Hexnode is a global leader in Unified Endpoint Management (UEM), trusted by over 100 countries and managing millions of devices worldwide. With a rapid pace of innovation, we have established ourselves as a dominant force across Apple, Windows, Android, macOS, Linux, and tvOS.

Why Hexnode?

Hexnode is a rare combination of global scale, product excellence, and startup-level velocity. We operate in a mission-critical category—supporting organizations that rely on secure, reliable device management every single day. Joining Hexnode means stepping into a company in hyper-growth mode. With millions of devices under management and 100+ annual feature releases, you will have the opportunity to shape the next phase of a category-defining platform.

Role

We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Manager to lead our PMM team and own the end-to-end PLG ecosystem. If you’re an expert at translating deep technical capabilities into persuasive narratives and using data to crush friction points, join us and help us shape the future of Unified Endpoint Management.

Responsibilities

• Own the end-to-end launch lifecycle. Define the positioning and messaging that showcases

Hexnode’s innovative edge, ensuring our platform stands out as the modern standard against

legacy competitors.

• Lead the strategy for self-serve onboarding and user retention. Use product analytics to identify "Aha!" moments and friction points, designing in-app experiences that drive feature adoption and reduce Time-to-Value (TTV).

• Oversee the product analytics ecosystem. Define event-driven tracking schemas and build high- level visualization dashboards to monitor churn risk, usage trends, and customer health scores.

• Act as the "Editor-in-Chief" for the PMM team. Ensure all content—from whitepapers to in-app

tooltips—is persona-specific, persuasive, and technically accurate.

• Directly manage a team of Product Marketing Leads and PLG specialists. You will be responsible for their professional development, quality of output, and cross-functional alignment.

• Partner with Product Management and Engineering to route NPS data and customer feedback

into the roadmap, ensuring Hexnode remains a customer-centric platform.

Required Experience & Expertise

• 8–12 years in Product Marketing, with a significant portion dedicated to B2B SaaS.

• Proven experience in a team lead or people management capacity.

• Deep expertise in Product-Led Growth, including hands-on experience with product analytics

and in-app communication strategies.

• Highly proficient in data interpretation. You should be comfortable building dashboards and

turning usage data into actionable GTM pivots.

• Exceptional ability to translate complex cybersecurity and UEM concepts into value-based

narratives for IT admins and C-level stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have

• Domain experience in UEM, Cybersecurity, or Endpoint Management.

• Advanced proficiency with Pendo, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Gainsight.

• Experience with the "2-Tier" distribution model (VARs, MSPs, and Distributors).

Hexnode is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage candidates of

all backgrounds, identities, and experiences to apply.

title: Bus Unit Mgr, EMG Seals India
description:
**Position Summary**
The Business Unit Manager is responsible for leading the overall performance, growth, and operational effectiveness of a defined business unit. This role provides strategic and day-to-day leadership across operations, supply chain, sales, customer service, financial performance, and continuous improvement. The Business Unit Manager ensures alignment with business objectives, customer expectations, safety standards, quality requirements, and profitability targets.
  
  
The incumbent is expected to demonstrate mastery competency of the Win Strategy that align to Parker culture and beliefs, stimulating broad cross collaboration at all levels and disciplines within the enterprise to ensure the exceptional execution of the enterprise.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* The position of Business Unit Manager is responsible for the safety, compliance, profitable growth and financial performance of EMG Seals & O Rings India
* Lead cross functional team of Operations (Plant Production, QC, Supply Chain and CRM) and Commercial team to drive Moulding and Packing Business of EMG India.
* Leads strategy deployment for the business unit concentrating on Lean initiatives, safety and product quality.
* Works with current and potential customers to promote and leverage company technologies, systems, products and services. Drive distribution growth using Value program.

**Accountabilities**
Identify the major, specific end results that the position is responsible for achieving. (Not statements of day-to-day details, duties or responsibilities.)
  
  

* Implement Parker Win Strategy initiatives to attain Premier Customer Service, Profitable Growth and Financial Performance
* Own profit and loss performance, including revenue growth, margin improvement, cost control, and working capital management.
* Establish business objectives, KPIs, budgets, forecasts, and performance improvement plans.

**Essential Job Functions**
(The fundamental job duties)
  
  

* To profitably grow the business by pursuing new business opportunities, work closely with existing and potential customers to promote and leverage Seals and O Rings products and technologies and services.
* Responsible for leading, guiding, evaluating and developing team for Seals business to ensure achieving the business objectives and comply with all relevant regulations and laws. Mentor and coach direct reports in order to expand their capabilities and build management depth in the organization.
* Develop new manufacturing technologies and/or make use of new supplier to fulfil customer demand.
* Plan develop and implement Growth Strategy. Define short- and long-term strategic goals and execute the related action plans to enable growth. Identify market opportunities, risks, and competitive trends to support long-term growth
* Lead supply chain activities including procurement, materials planning, inventory control, supplier performance, and logistics.
* Lead SIOP, financial & operational planning and execute the related action plans.
* Support business development, pricing strategy, contract negotiations, and customer retention initiatives.
* Have experience in driving Channel Sales
* Monitor sales pipeline using Sales Force, order intake, market share, and customer profitability.
* Work closely with sales teams to identify growth opportunities and deliver customer-focused solutions.
* Improving Molding and Packing Seals business in India , and positioning EMG Seals business for sustained growth by applying new approaches, business models, tools and competencies,
* Closely collaborating with Global Division and developing local products of PU Seals, O Rings, Bonded Seals, PTFE and other products for key growth market
* Drive Engineering and NPD to design and develop new products, reviews drawings and layouts to ensure clarity, completeness, form, fit, functionality, and conformity to standards, procedures, and specifications.
* Provide leadership to ensure best utilization of resources in obtaining goals, regulatory compliance, and compliance with corporate and regional policies. Support, communicate, reinforce, and defend the mission, vision, values, philosophy and culture of the organization. Participate in the development of the organization's strategic plan.
* Position EMG business for determined annual growth by developing several new business platforms based on technology and product competencies. The organizations focus on Off highways market, General Industries, Transportaion and Oil & Gas . In order to drive significant growth, while growing attack market and penetrating into new market segments such as Semicon, Data Centre, Life Science are imperative.
* Motivate and lead the organization effectively to implement the strategy and achieve the desired results. Utilize communication, interpersonal and influencing skills effectively with the regional and global organization and customers. Lead team by motivating all staff to move in a strategic direction and to work as a team to achieve the goal.
* Vision the future and provide strategic direction and insights into potential markets, prioritize opportunities, develop a strategic plan to approach the customers, and implement the strategy.

**Qualifications**
**MANDATORY JOB REQUIREMENTS:**

* 15+ years of experience as a senior manager in Sales and Operational leadership positions in the chemicals, Rubber, polymer or related industries
* Conversant with rubber product manufacturing process and machineries
* A Bachelor’s degree with a business or technical focus preferably Rubber or Polymer Engineering, Chemical and Mechanical Engineering
* Proven track record of identification, evaluation, and commercialization of new business opportunities with industrial customers.
* Strong Business Acumen with strong analytical skills and well versed with P&L, financial metrices.
* Excellent teamwork, interpersonal, communication, persuasion, influencing, planning, problem-solving skills. Lead essential functions
* Strong leadership and good communicator with both internally and toward customers.
* Is equally comfortable discussing business or technology topics to develop business opportunities for Parker
* Other personal characteristics: Entrepreneurial; Collaborative and inclusive; Articulate; Highly energetic; Ability to handle ambiguity; Ability to work across boundary.
* A Bachelor’s degree with a business or technical focus
* Fluency in English excellent managerial communication and command over language

title: Program Manager – Automotive Parts & Accessories
description:
The Accessory Program Manager will serve as the primary liaison between the Accessories team and Vehicle Teams, ensuring all accessory parts and programs are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with OEM standards. This role demands a strong blend of program governance, technical coordination, and stakeholder communication across the full product development lifecycle through Start of Production (SOP).
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Program & Timeline Management**

* Own end-to-end program tracking for accessory parts and systems, maintaining accurate and up-to-date timelines.
* Compile, manage, and report program schedules, identifying milestone risks proactively.
* Escalate late parts and programs to the appropriate stakeholders; support (but not necessarily lead) recovery plan execution.

**Liaison & Communication**

* Act as the primary interface between Accessories and Vehicle Teams, ensuring alignment on program requirements and deliverables.
* Author, track, and coordinate responses to technical Bulletins issued to or from Vehicle Teams.
* Write, manage, and follow up on Engineering Requisitions (ERs) throughout the program lifecycle.

**Budget & Economic Management**

* Compile and track budgets at vehicle, part, and system levels.
* Manage economic follow-up covering engineering costs, tooling and means, and part pricing.
* Perform global synthesis of costs and risks; report critical financial risks to OEM management with a defined action plan.

**Technical Coordination**

* Coordinate all technical activities from program kick-off through SOP, including technical specification, validation plan definition and follow-up.
* Manage supplier engagement: selection, follow-up, TKO (Tool Kick-Off), and part approval processes.
* Oversee fitting instruction documentation and distribution to relevant teams.

**Risk, Governance & Reporting**

* Drive project progress across accessory and service parts projects; proactively identify risks and issues.
* Define and implement mitigation strategies to protect program delivery commitments.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure project dependencies are delivered on time and in scope.
* Provide structured status reporting to internal leadership and client program teams.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Automotive, or related Engineering discipline (mandatory).
* 12+ years of experience in automotive program management, preferably in accessories, service parts, or OEM delivery.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) certification is a strong added advantage.
* Prior exposure to OEM programs

**Essential Skills**
**Required Skills & Competencies**




+ Strong program and project management skills, including timeline management, budget control, and risk mitigation.
+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills – ability to work across OEM, supplier, and internal teams.
+ Solid automotive engineering background with understanding of accessory and service parts development processes.
+ Familiarity with Engineering Requisition (ER) processes, technical bulletins, and supplier management in an OEM environment.
+ Experience managing cross-functional technical teams and vendor/supplier coordination.
+ Strong analytical skills for budget tracking, risk synthesis, and reporting.
+ Proficiency in MS Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Project); PLM/PDM tools knowledge is an advantage.

**Experience**
**Total Experience**
12 TO 15 Years in Program Management

title: Principal Product Manager, Recovery Orchestration
description:
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.

**What to know:**

* Commvault does *not* conduct interviews by email or text.
* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
* Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com

  

**About Commvault**

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own the strategy and execution for our recovery orchestration platform — the layer that automates, sequences, and validates how enterprises bring critical systems back online after an outage, ransomware event, or disaster. This is a build-and-scale mandate: you'll be responsible for unifying what are today somewhat separate capabilities into a single, coherent platform story — with the pricing, packaging, and GTM discipline to make it a durable, high-margin product line, not just a feature bundle. You'll operate at the intersection of enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, and cloud architecture, working with engineering, pricing/finance, field enablement, and customer success to take this from current state to a major platform launch.

**Key Responsibilities**

Product Strategy & Platform Vision

* Define and evolve the strategy for a unified recovery orchestration platform spanning multiple cloud workloads (compute, storage, databases) across AWS, Azure, and GCP

* Build the narrative for *why* orchestrated, tested recovery is a distinct platform capability — not a checkbox feature — for CISOs, infrastructure/DR leaders, and compliance stakeholders

* Own the roadmap sequencing across phased capability delivery

Pricing & Packaging

* Partner with Finance/Pricing to fix structural pricing issues (cost allocation across platform vs. product SKUs, bundle economics, SaaS vs. software parity) that directly affect adoption and retention

* Build the business case and options analysis for executive/CPO-level pricing decisions, using cost-vs-price framing

* Ensure packaging reflects real customer buying patterns rather than internal architecture boundaries

Cross-Functional Execution

* Drive a large, multi-team engineering workback (dozens of workstreams across workload teams, UI/UX, and platform) toward a release date

* Identify and escalate real schedule risk early and keep the leadership informed.

* Partner with field enablement and customer success to close the gap between product capability and what's actually sold, deployed, and renewed

Customer & Market Insight

* Validate positioning and pricing directly with field teams (solutions engineers, field CTOs) and customers — not just internal stakeholders

* Understand the two adjacent buyer personas this platform serves (security/CISO buyers focused on isolated recovery and forensics, and infrastructure/DR buyers focused on operational recovery) and make deliberate calls on how the platform positions to each without diluting either

* Identify new opportunities and problems to solve in the recovery space.

Executive Communication

* Write clear PRFAQs, business cases, and stakeholder updates for senior leadership audiences

* Present pricing and platform strategy directly to all stakeholders

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline.
* 8+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time in enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud platforms, or data resilience (backup/DR/ransomware recovery adjacent domains)

* Demonstrated experience owning pricing and packaging decisions with measurable business impact (not just feature roadmaps)

* Experience running large, cross-team technical programs with a hard external deadline (multiple engineering teams, dozens of dependencies, workback tracking)

* Strong grasp of cloud infrastructure fundamentals across at least one hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, or GCP) — compute, storage, database recovery patterns

* Track record of building platform narratives for technical, security-conscious enterprise buyers (CISO, VP Infrastructure, Head of DR)

Excellent written communication — comfortable producing PRDs, PRFAQs, and exec-level business cases independently  



**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Master's Degree preferred.
* Direct experience with backup, disaster recovery, cyber recovery, or ransomware resilience products

* Familiarity with isolated recovery environment concepts (malware scanning, forensics-safe validation environments)

* Experience managing SKU/pricing structures across SaaS and on-prem/software delivery models

* Background partnering with channel/field enablement teams on complex technical products

* Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, and engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations to translate business needs into reliable technical solutions.

title: Lead Commercial Lending Servicing Specialist
description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a **Lead Commercial Lending Servicing Specialist** to support and service **Asset Based Lending (ABL)** portfolios within Commercial Banking Operations. This role is responsible for leading moderately complex to complex servicing activities, ensuring accurate execution, regulatory compliance, and superior customer outcomes. The role also serves as a **platform subject matter expert (such as: Loan IQ, LUCAS, STUCKEY etc.)** and owns **training and talent development initiatives** for the ABL servicing group.

The position requires strong collaboration with Line of Business (Relationship and Portfolio Management teams) Risk & Technology partners, while acting as an escalation point for client issues, operational risks, and process gaps

**In this role, you will:**

* Review and negotiate complex loan servicing transactions, evaluate risks, and devise strategies to mitigate risks and identify procedural modifications
* Serve as an escalation point in the resolution of client issues
* Conduct quality reviews and monitor key performance metrics as related to efficiencies and effective processes
* Coordinate servicing activities to resolve open customer issues, loan and regulatory diligence and on-going portfolio maintenance; interact with internal and external customers
* Evaluate and upload data into the systems of record
* Research complex business and operational decisions
* Ensure compliance with all policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements
* Strategically collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues, and managers to resolve issues and achieve goals; may contribute to strategic initiatives and projects
* Make decisions in complex and multi-faceted situations requiring solid understanding of the function, policies, procedures, and compliance requirements that influence and lead broader work team to meet deliverables and drive new initiatives
* **Asset Based Lending (ABL) Servicing**
  + Lead a variety of servicing activities for **moderately complex to complex Asset Based Lending products**, including revolving lines, term loans, borrowing base structures, and collateral‑driven facilities.
  + Coordinate all aspects of loan servicing to ensure accurate execution and timely resolution of customer needs.
  + Review and process:
    - Interest, fees, principal activity, and repricing events
    - Amendments, waivers, renewals, and restructurings
    - Borrowing base updates and collateral‑driven changes
  + Review and negotiate complex loan servicing transactions, evaluate operational and credit‑related risks, and implement mitigation strategies.
  + Serve as an escalation point for **customer, system, and operational issues**, ensuring timely and effective resolution.
  + Identify system, data, or process gaps and recommend procedural modifications, automation opportunities, or control enhancements.
  + Maintain and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) and system documentation aligned to ABL servicing.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Serve as a **primary liaison** with Line of Business, Control & Risk, Technology, and Operations teams.
  + Coordinate the resolution of open customer service issues involving internal and external partners.
  + Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues, and managers to achieve business objectives.
  + May lead projects, oversee daily team deliverables, perform critical end‑of‑day check‑outs, and mentor lower‑level staff.
  + Contribute to strategic initiatives and continuous improvement efforts within ABL Operations.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of Commercial Loan Servicing experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

* **hands‑on proficiency** with **Loan IQ, LUCAS, STUCKEY** etc. or equivalent commercial lending platforms.
* **training‑related experience**, including drafting training plans, delivering training programs, and defining onboarding milestones.
* **2+ years of experience supervising daily team deliverables**, including critical end‑of‑day controls and check‑outs.
* Strong understanding of **Asset Based Lending products**, Syndicated Loan Servicing, collateral structures, and servicing workflows.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.

**Desired Qualifications**

* + Strong knowledge of loan documentation and ability to interpret **Legal Credit Agreements**.
  + Ability to prioritize work, meet deadlines, and perform effectively in a fast‑paced, deadline‑driven environment.
  + Strong critical thinking, problem‑solving, and conflict‑resolution capabilities.
  + Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
* Recognized for delivering **exceptional customer service** and strong stakeholder partnership.

**Posting End Date:**

30 Oct 2026

**1. Job Purpose**

To drive sales growth, develop new business opportunities, maintain strong customer and dealer relationships, achieve annual sales targets, and ensure the profitability of orders while supporting the company's overall business objectives.

**2. General Skills Required**

* Courteous and professional communication.
* Prompt and reliable responses to customer and business queries.
* Punctuality, accountability, and dependability.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of company information.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills.

**3. Job-Specific Skills**

* Thorough product knowledge.
* Annual sales and marketing target planning.
* Business development, networking, and market expansion.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Knowledge of excise, sales tax, customs, and other applicable laws and regulations relating to sales and marketing.
* Leadership and team coordination.
* Familiarity with insulated truck bodies and cold-room terminology.
* Product estimation, costing, pricing, and negotiation skills.
* Computer proficiency, particularly MS Office.
* Market development and customer acquisition.

**4. Qualifications and Experience**

* **Option 1:** Postgraduate qualification with a minimum of 3 years of relevant industry experience.
* **Option 2:** Graduate qualification with a minimum of 5 years of relevant industry experience.

Relevant experience in sales, marketing, business development, or a related industry is preferred.

5. Key Roles and Responsibilities

**5.1 Sales and Customer Relationship Management**

* Manage sales activities, including customer registration, customer development, and relationship management.
* Maintain regular communication with customers and dealers to promote and secure orders for the company's Blue Ice Nirvan products.
* Identify new customers, dealers, and business opportunities to expand market reach.

**5.2 Dealer and Customer Database Management**

* Maintain and update dealer and customer information.
* Develop and maintain a database of market opportunities, ongoing projects, customer requirements, and industry trends.
* Conduct market intelligence activities and share relevant information with management.

**5.3 Quotations and Order Management**

* Understand BOQs (Bills of Quantities), project layouts, and customer specifications.
* Prepare quotations and maintain relevant records and documentation in line with applicable IS standards and company procedures.
* Follow up with customers for order finalisation, execution, and collection of payments.

**5.4 Profitability and Cash Flow**

* Ensure the profitability of orders booked.
* Monitor order costs, pricing, and commercial terms.
* Support timely payment collection and maintain healthy cash flow for the smooth functioning of operations.

**5.5 Meetings and Reporting**

* Attend and participate in internal review meetings.
* Submit sales reports, business updates, market information, and other reports as required by management.
* Monitor sales performance against agreed targets and recommend corrective actions when necessary.

**5.6 Company Vision and Interdepartmental Coordination**

* Ensure that sales and marketing activities align with the company's vision, mission, and objectives.
* Coordinate with other departments to support business growth and ensure smooth organisational functioning.
* Work collaboratively with internal teams to meet customer requirements and delivery commitments.

**5.7 Policies, Procedures, and Performance Standards**

* Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of departmental policies, procedures, and performance standards.
* Ensure compliance with applicable company policies and approved operating procedures.

**5.8 Payment Collection and Statutory Documentation**

* Ensure timely collection of payments from customers.
* Collect applicable statutory forms and other required documents from customers, wherever relevant.
* Coordinate with the concerned departments for proper documentation and record maintenance.

**5.9 ISO Compliance and Documentation**

* Implement and maintain applicable ISO procedures and documentation.
* Ensure records are properly maintained and available for internal and external audits, wherever applicable.

**5.10 Regulatory Compliance**

* Monitor and comply with applicable Indian road transport regulations and other statutory requirements relevant to the company's products.
* Coordinate with the concerned departments to ensure compliance with applicable product, transportation, and documentation requirements.

**5.11 Confidentiality and Information Management**

* Maintain and update all sales-related data, customer records, and business information.
* Ensure that confidential company information is protected and disclosed only to authorised persons.

**5.12 Additional Responsibilities**

* Perform any other duties or responsibilities assigned by management from time to time, consistent with the role and business requirements.

**6. Annual Sales Target**

The annual sales target shall be mutually agreed upon between the Sales Manager and management. Performance will be reviewed periodically against the agreed targets and business objectives.

**7. Performance Evaluation Criteria**

Performance may be evaluated based on:

* Achievement of agreed annual and periodic sales targets.
* New customer and dealer acquisition.
* Customer relationship management and retention.
* Order profitability and contribution to business growth.
* Timely payment collection and cash-flow management.
* Accuracy of quotations, records, and sales reports.
* Compliance with company policies, applicable regulations, and ISO procedures.
* Coordination with internal departments and overall performance.

**8. General Conditions**

The Sales Manager shall discharge all assigned duties responsibly, maintain professional conduct, safeguard confidential company information, and comply with the instructions and policies issued by management from time to time.

**Prepared By:** HR & Administration  
**Approved By:** Working Director / Authorised Management Representative

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Application Engineer, Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
BlackRock’s Post Trade & Accounting group is seeking a Vice President-level engineering leader to advance our enterprise Client Reporting platform. This role encompasses technical leadership, system design, and direct coding responsibilities, enabling the development of robust, event-driven platforms that deliver reliable solutions for institutional and Aladdin clients globally. You will lead development of core platform capabilities across distributed services and data systems, shaping long-term architecture for a mission-critical platform where scale, accuracy, resiliency, and auditability are essential. You will also partner across product and operations to drive modernization, automation, and AI-enabled engineering practices. About the Team The Client Reporting team delivers and manages BlackRock’s enterprise Client Reporting platform, providing end-to-end reporting solutions for a diverse global base of accounting and institutional clients. We oversee the full lifecycle of report production and distribution—ensuring quality, scalability, and operational excellence through advanced QC workflows, exception management tools (including the Aladdin dashboard), and robust monitoring frameworks. The team manages reporting inventory and KPIs, supports both standardized and highly customized data sets, and enables access to reporting-ready data through digital portals and reporting libraries. We also power a dynamic self-service experience, offering secure document delivery via API, SFTP, and Secure Links, along with flexible tools for client-driven report configuration and branding. By owning the critical systems and processes behind client reporting, the team plays a central role in shaping client experience, driving automation and innovation, and delivering scalable, resilient solutions for industry-leading clients. What You’ll Do Lead development, architecture, and design of distributed, event-driven systems (Java/Python) Evolve scalable microservices and API-first platforms aligned to enterprise strategy Architect high-throughput data systems integrating SQL/NoSQL, streaming, and caching technologies Drive performance, resiliency, observability, and production excellence Provide full-stack technical leadership across backend and frontend (Angular/React) Translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions and executable roadmaps Manage stakeholders and lead global teams to deliver against strategic milestones Lead adoption of AI-assisted SDLC practices (Copilot, Claude, Windsurf, etc.) Design safe and scalable LLM integration patterns (prompt engineering, structured outputs, streaming, tool/function calling) Architect multi-step or agent-based workflows (e.g., LangChain, Google ADK or equivalent) Define shared prompts, agent contracts, and AI governance standards across teams Guide teams in translating ambiguous problems into structured, AI-augmentable execution plans What you'll bring B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). 7+ years of progressive software engineering experience with proven leadership of teams or major platforms Strong expertise in Java, Python, and distributed systems architecture Experience designing highly available, real-time enterprise systems Deep understanding of APIs, microservices, data modeling, and scalability patterns Experience with SQL, NoSQL, and streaming technologies (e.g., distributed event streaming and messaging platforms, Redis) Exposure to cloud-native and DevOps practices (Open Container Initiative (OCI) container image packaging and runtime, Enterprise-grade container orchestration platform supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, CI/CD) Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional influence skills Demonstrated experience integrating AI into engineering workflows and production platforms Nice to Have Experience with distributed event streaming and messaging platforms, Redis, or other distributed systems technologies Cloud-native experience (Open Container Initiative (OCI) container image packaging and runtime, Enterprise-grade container orchestration platform supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, Azure/AWS/GCP) Exposure to CI/CD and observability tooling Interest in financial systems, reporting platforms, or investment processes
  
  
**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

**Business Relationship Manager / Senior Business Analyst – ServiceNow**

Experience: 10–12 years overall, with 5+ years in Business Analysis, Business Relationship Management, ITSM, or ServiceNow-related roles.

* The individual will understand business priorities, identify opportunities for process improvement, and translate business needs into clear requirements, functional designs, and actionable ServiceNow implementation roadmaps.
* The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, stakeholder management, process expertise, analytical thinking, and a practical understanding of the ServiceNow platform.

**1-Key Responsibilities**

**Business Relationship Management**

* Establish and maintain strong relationships with business leaders, process owners, product owners, and IT stakeholders.
* Understand business strategies, operational challenges, priorities, and transformation objectives.
* Conduct regular stakeholder engagement sessions, business reviews, and roadmap discussions.
* Build a demand pipeline aligned with business value, urgency, risk, and strategic objectives.

**Business Analysis and Requirement Translation**

* Analyse, validate, and document business requirements through workshops, interviews, process walkthroughs, and stakeholder consultations.
* Translate business problems into functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and business rules.
* Identify gaps between current-state processes and desired future-state operating models.
* Develop business process maps, use cases, functional specifications, and requirements traceability matrices.
* Collaborate with ServiceNow architects, developers, administrators, and process consultants to validate feasibility and define appropriate solutions.
* Ensure requirements are clear, testable, prioritised, and aligned with platform standards.

**Demand Management**

* Maintain a structured demand register covering business requests, improvement opportunities, regulatory needs, and technical debt-related business impacts.
* Assess and prioritise demands based on business value, customer experience, operational efficiency, risk reduction, effort, and strategic alignment.
* Facilitate backlog refinement and prioritisation with business and delivery stakeholders.
* Develop business cases, value assessments, and implementation roadmaps.
* Track demands from initial intake through requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and value realisation.

**2-Required Skills and Competencies**

**Business and stakeholder skills**

* Strong stakeholder engagement, influencing, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to engage with senior business leaders and technical teams.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to challenge requirements constructively and manage competing priorities.

**Business analysis skills**

* Business requirements elicitation and documentation.
* User stories, acceptance criteria, process mapping, and functional specifications.
* Current-state and future-state analysis, gap assessment, and root-cause analysis.
* Agile delivery practices, backlog management, and UAT coordination.
* Business case preparation and benefits realisation.

**ServiceNow and ITSM skills**

* practical understanding of the ServiceNow platform and its capabilities.
* Strong understanding of ITIL and ITSM processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Knowledge Management.
* Ability to map business requirements to ServiceNow functionality and standard platform capabilities.
* Understanding of integrations, workflows, CMDB, reporting, dashboards, and automation concepts.
* Awareness of ServiceNow governance, release management, platform configuration, and customisation best practices.

**3-Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 8–12 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in enterprise IT, ITSM, ServiceNow delivery, business analysis, or relationship management.
* Demonstrated experience translating business needs into technology solutions.
* Experience working with cross-functional business and technology teams in an AMS, product, transformation, or managed-services environment.
* ServiceNow certifications such as Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Application Specialist, or relevant micro-certifications are desirable.

CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, ITIL 4, or Agile/Scrum certifications are advantageous

description:
**Job Title:** Brand Manager  
**Department:** Marketing  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years  
**Location:** Borivali West

Job Summary

We are looking for a creative, strategic, and results-driven Brand Manager to develop, manage, and strengthen the company's brand identity and market presence. The candidate will be responsible for brand positioning, marketing strategy, campaign planning, competitor analysis, content direction, and maintaining consistent brand communication across all channels.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of consumer behaviour, market trends, digital marketing, and brand development, along with the ability to coordinate with internal teams, agencies, and external partners to execute effective brand initiatives.

Key Responsibilities1. Brand Strategy & Positioning

* Develop and implement brand strategies aligned with the company's business objectives.
* Define brand positioning, value proposition, target audience, and key brand messaging.
* Establish brand guidelines to maintain consistency across marketing materials, digital platforms, and customer communications.
* Conduct market research to identify customer needs, emerging trends, and growth opportunities.
* Strengthen brand awareness, credibility, and differentiation in the market.
* Ensure consistent representation of the brand across all customer touchpoints.

2. Market Research & Competitor Analysis

* Conduct regular market research to understand industry trends, customer preferences, and market opportunities.
* Analyse competitor brands, marketing strategies, pricing, positioning, and promotional activities.
* Identify gaps in the market and recommend strategies to improve brand competitiveness.
* Monitor customer feedback, brand perception, and market developments.
* Prepare reports and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making.

3. Marketing Campaigns & Brand Communication

* Plan, execute, and monitor integrated marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels.
* Develop campaign briefs, communication plans, promotional concepts, and brand messaging.
* Coordinate with digital marketing, content, design, sales, and external agencies to execute campaigns.
* Ensure all marketing materials align with the brand's tone, identity, and positioning.
* Track campaign performance and recommend improvements based on results.
* Support product launches, promotional activities, exhibitions, events, and brand awareness initiatives.

4. Content & Digital Brand Management

* Develop content strategies for social media, websites, email marketing, and other communication channels.
* Work with content creators, designers, and digital marketing teams to develop relevant brand assets.
* Review and approve creative content, advertisements, brochures, presentations, and promotional materials.
* Maintain consistency in brand voice, visual identity, and communication standards.
* Coordinate social media campaigns and monitor engagement, reach, and audience response.
* Identify opportunities to improve the brand's digital visibility and audience engagement.

5. Product Marketing & Business Coordination

* Work closely with product, sales, and business development teams to understand product features, benefits, and target markets.
* Translate product features into clear customer benefits and compelling marketing messages.
* Develop product positioning, promotional strategies, launch plans, and marketing collateral.
* Support sales teams with presentations, brochures, product information, and other brand materials.
* Coordinate with distributors, channel partners, agencies, and other stakeholders to ensure consistent brand execution.
* Align brand initiatives with business growth, lead generation, and customer acquisition objectives.

6. Brand Performance & Budget Management

* Develop and manage brand marketing budgets in coordination with management.
* Monitor campaign spending and ensure effective utilisation of marketing resources.
* Define and track key brand performance indicators, including brand awareness, engagement, reach, lead generation, and campaign ROI.
* Prepare regular reports on campaign performance, market trends, and brand growth.
* Use data and customer insights to improve marketing effectiveness and brand performance.
* Recommend new initiatives to strengthen brand visibility and business outcomes.

7. Team & Stakeholder Coordination

* Coordinate with internal teams, marketing agencies, vendors, and business partners.
* Manage timelines, deliverables, and priorities for brand-related projects.
* Provide creative direction and feedback to designers, content creators, and marketing team members.
* Present brand strategies, campaign plans, and performance reports to management.
* Ensure timely execution of assigned brand initiatives and marketing projects.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication, or a related field.
* MBA in Marketing or a relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* 3–5 years of experience in brand management, marketing strategy, or a related role.
* Experience in developing brand strategies, managing campaigns, and conducting market research.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Google Workspace, and marketing analytics tools.
* Familiarity with social media platforms, digital marketing, content management, and brand analytics.
* Experience in FMCG, consumer goods, home appliances, or a related industry is an advantage.

Required Skills

* Strong strategic thinking and brand-building capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Creativity, storytelling, and content evaluation skills.
* Strong analytical and market research abilities.
* Project management and cross-functional coordination skills.
* Understanding of consumer behaviour and marketing trends.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Budget planning, performance analysis, and problem-solving abilities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Growth in brand awareness and market visibility.
* Improvement in brand engagement and audience reach.
* Successful execution of marketing campaigns within agreed timelines and budgets.
* Consistency in brand identity and communication across channels.
* Effectiveness of competitor analysis and market research.
* Performance of product launches and promotional initiatives.
* Contribution of marketing activities to qualified leads and business growth.
* Improvement in brand perception, customer engagement, and campaign ROI.

title: Product Owner
description:
Product Owner at Fold Health, owning the care delivery and care management experienceof a value-based care platform used by provider groups, MSOs, and ACOs.

About Fold Health

Fold Health is a value-based care technology platform used by provider groups, MSOs,ACOs, and large practices to succeed in value-based care. Fold sits as the intelligence andworkflow layer on top of the EHR, integrating deeply across EHRs, claims, HIE feeds, labs,and other data sources to unify data, automate operational work, close care and codinggaps, and give care teams the insight they need to improve outcomes and lower cost. Weare building the operating layer that makes value-based care actually workable for thepeople delivering it.

About the role

This Product Owner owns the care delivery and care management experience of theplatform: the workflows care teams, care managers, and coordinators rely on every day.You will shape how care plans, longitudinal patient views, risk assessments, and care andcoding gap closure come together into tools that reduce manual work and improve qualityand risk accuracy. You will be the bridge between clinical and operational needs and theengineering team that builds for them, turning a complex value-based care problem intosoftware that care teams actually want to use. We build AI-first, and we want productpeople who bring that same mindset to how they discover, specify, and ship.What you will own

Translate the product vision and clinical and operational needs into clear, well-defineduser stories with complete, testable acceptance criteria, documented in the ticket asthe single source of truth.

Own and maintain a healthy, prioritized backlog so there is always ready, well-definedwork ahead of each sprint.

Act as the voice of the care team in Agile delivery: lead grooming, join sprint planningand daily standups, and unblock requirement questions quickly.

Deeply understand care management and care coordination workflows: care plans,longitudinal patient records, risk assessments, transitions of care, chronic andprincipal care management, annual wellness visits, and care and coding gap closure.

Product Owner JD

Page 1 of 3

Work with designers on intuitive workflows for care managers, nurses, andcoordinators, providing clear UX requirements while the design team owns the finaldesign.

Review build output against acceptance criteria before it reaches QA, so quality issuesare caught early and not in validation.

Document the scenarios for user acceptance testing, and own and close the productgaps that surface during UAT.

Keep product documentation accurate and complete for every release, and own clear,comprehensive release notes.

Partner with Engineering and QA to prioritize bugs by client and clinical impact anddrive them to timely resolution, balancing critical fixes against roadmap progress.

Define the success metrics for your area, analyze real usage and feedback, and turnthat into the next round of improvements.

Judge whether a client-specific need should be productized into a reusable platformcapability or handled as a one-off, so the platform compounds rather than fragments.

Be the single point of contact for product questions in your area for internal teams,partners, and clients.

Collaborate with care operations, quality, and risk-adjustment stakeholders to ensureworkflows map correctly to value-based care programs and measures.

Who you are

2 or more years as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar role in a healthcaretechnology company or a related field.

An AI-first mindset. You are already hands-on with AI tools in everyday work, and youwant to be on a team that builds product AI-first, applying AI across discovery,specification, and delivery. We are looking for forward thinkers, not AI skeptics.

Working knowledge of the US healthcare system, primary care delivery, and value-based care models and workflows.

Familiarity with care management and care coordination: care plans, transitions ofcare, chronic and principal care management, annual wellness visits, and care gapclosure.

Understanding of Medicare and value-based programs (MA, MSSP, ACO) and how careworkflows map to them.

Exposure to care and coding gaps and risk adjustment, and to the billing that sitsbehind care management programs such as CCM, TCM, APCM, and AWV.

Awareness of EHR and HIE systems and integration with them.

Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, with experience leading cross-functional Agile teams. CSPO or similar certification preferred.

Clear, structured communication and the ability to drive consensus across clinical,operational, engineering, and client stakeholders.

Analytical mindset with the ability to define metrics and make data-driven decisions.Ability to write basic SQL to validate healthcare data is a plus.

Genuine empathy for the care managers, nurses, and coordinators who use theproduct, and the judgment to design for their day.

Nice to have

A clinical or care-management background, or direct experience building caremanagement or population health products.

Familiarity with quality measures and Star Ratings (HEDIS, NCQA, eCQM) and withHCC and RAF risk adjustment.

Experience with population health, cohorts, and worklist-driven care team workflows.

Basic understanding of BI and reporting tools and of how features translate intodashboards.

Awareness of how LLM and AI-enabled workflows can be applied responsibly inhealthcare.

In this role, you will contribute to discovery, solution design, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and support activities for Coupa solutions across procurement, sourcing, contracts, supplier management, invoicing, and related modules. You will work with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, deliver quality work products within project timelines, and support implementation and post-go-live activities across the solution lifecycle.
  
  
**Work you'll do**

* Lead discovery workshops, document business requirements, map current-state processes, identify process gaps, and design future-state workflows aligned to Coupa capabilities.
* Configure and support Coupa modules based on project scope, including Procurement, Sourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management, Supplier Information Management, Invoicing, Expenses, Coupa Pay, and Spend Analytics.

**The team**
Enterprise Performance
  
  
Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions.

We excel at translating strategic objectives into tangible, measurable outcomes at the operational level. By aligning high-level goals with frontline execution, we ensure our clients realize real value and improved performance across every stage of their supply chain and operations.

Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai

11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST, as per business requirements
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 9+ years of experience implementing or supporting Coupa across source-to-pay process areas, including requisitioning, sourcing, contracts, invoicing, supplier management, expenses, or payments
* Experience leading discovery workshops and documenting business requirements, process flows, and functional designs
* Experience configuring Coupa modules such as Procurement, Sourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management, Supplier Information Management, Invoicing, Expenses, Coupa Pay, or Spend Analytics
* Experience supporting integrations between Coupa and enterprise resource planning platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or Workday Financials

* Experience supporting system integration testing, user acceptance testing, defect triage, deployment, or hypercare activities

* Experience supporting service-level agreement-based application support, ticket management, or root cause analysis
* Experience delivering training, user enablement materials, or software demonstrations for procurement platforms
* Experience supporting quarterly release management, upgrade planning, or post-go-live optimization
* Coupa or procurement platform certifications

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

title: Growth Partner — Strategy & Execution
description:
Title: : Growth Partner — Strategy & Execution | Work Directly With the Founder

Pune Exp: 5 - 9 Years

Timing: 3pm -11pm | Monday to Saturday (2nd & 4th Saturday Off)

Joining: Immediate

Website: https://www.stage7.co/

Address: NIBM road, Pune

**The Opportunity**

Stage7 is building a growth company designed to help ambitious brands scale through strategy, technology, creative, and performance.

We're looking for someone who thinks like an entrepreneur, moves like an operator, and understands growth beyond advertising.

You'll work directly with the founder to build Stage7's acquisition engine from the ground up.

**What Makes This Role Different**

We don't need another person who brings ideas to meetings.

We need someone who can identify opportunities, build conviction, and make things happen.

Someone who asks the right questions, challenges assumptions, understands the economics, and owns execution.

**Your job is to turn ambiguity into decisions and decisions into measurable growth.**

**What You'll Do**

* Build Stage7's go-to-market strategy and customer acquisition engine.
* Identify high-potential US brands and develop compelling reasons for them to work with us.
* Own demand generation across paid media, outbound, partnerships, content, and unconventional channels.
* Develop hypotheses, launch experiments, interpret results, and make confident decisions.
* Work with the founder on positioning, offers, pricing, and acquisition economics.
* Build campaigns and systems using AI, automation, and data.
* Lead a small, high-performing team while remaining deeply involved in execution.
* Take ownership of qualified pipeline and marketing-sourced revenue.

**The Person We're Looking For**

**A thinker who executes. An executor who questions.**

You should be someone who:

* Has strong opinions backed by reasoning and evidence.
* Can disagree with the founder and explain why.
* Doesn't wait for perfect information to take action.
* Understands the difference between being busy and moving the business forward.
* Can move from strategy to execution within hours, not weeks.
* Has experience generating real business outcomes, not just impressions, clicks, and leads.
* Takes ownership when experiments fail and knows what to try next.
* Is comfortable building with limited resources before scaling a team.

**Your First 90 Days**

**Days 1–30:**
Understand the market, challenge our assumptions, define acquisition hypotheses, and launch initial experiments.

**Days 31–60:**
Identify early signals, optimize offers and channels, and establish a consistent qualified pipeline.

**Days 61–90:**
Double down on proven opportunities, improve acquisition economics, and build a repeatable growth engine.

**What We Value**

* Conviction over consensus.
* Execution over presentations.
* Evidence over opinions.
* Ownership over delegation.
* Commercial outcomes over vanity metrics.

**Why Join Stage7?**

You'll work directly with a founder who has spent over a decade building and scaling digital businesses.

You'll have the freedom to challenge ideas, influence decisions, build systems, and shape the company's growth direction.

This is not a role for someone looking for a comfortable management position.

**It's for someone who wants to build something meaningful and have a direct impact on its success.**

**To Apply**

Share one growth initiative you personally built, what you believed would work, what the data revealed, and what you changed as a result.

title: Launchpad Fellowship
description:
**About Atlys**

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.

**The Role**

The
**Launchpad Fellowship**
is a full-time, in-office internship designed for final-year students and recent graduates looking to gain meaningful, hands-on experience before stepping into their first full-time role.

You’ll work closely with teams across operations, growth, research, strategy, customer experience, product, and process improvement, gaining exposure to how a high-growth startup operates, makes decisions, and solves real customer problems at scale.

**The Job**

* **Growth, Research & Strategy:**
  Work on business problems across growth and strategy, conduct research, identify opportunities, and turn insights into actionable recommendations.
* **Operations & Customer Experience:**
  Work on real customer journeys, manage core visa operations, and understand how we deliver a seamless experience at scale.
* **Product & Process Improvement:**
  Identify user pain points and operational inefficiencies, and work with product and process teams to build better solutions, tools, and workflows.
* **Cross-Functional Execution:**
  Work closely with different teams, take ownership of projects, and learn to prioritise, move quickly, and solve problems in a fast-paced startup environment.
* **Capstone & Leadership Exposure:**
  Take ownership of a real business challenge, develop a solution, and present your work to leadership, while receiving regular mentorship and feedback throughout the fellowship.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Are a final-year student or recent graduate looking for a full-time, in-office, high-intensity internship.
* Are a quick learner who is comfortable with ambiguity and unfamiliar problems.
* Communicate clearly and take ownership without waiting to be told what to do.
* Are curious about product, operations, customer experience, or how businesses work.
* Thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy figuring things out independently.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*

**What you can expect**

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s what you can expect:

* **Competitive compensation and equity**
  so you participate in the value you help create.
* **A thoughtful leave policy**
  with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* **Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office**
  , so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* **Great tools to do your best work**
  , including high-spec equipment and software.
* **An office designed for more than just work**
  , with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Product Associate
description:
About the Company

PlaySuper is India's first Gaming Commerce company, pioneering a new way for 500M+ gamers, an audience growing at 19.6% YoY, to shop inside games.

It is a white-label SaaS plugin that integrates into casual and hyper-casual games, transforming in-game coins into real-world value. Players can redeem them for brand coupons, digital services, or even physical products inside fully customizable in-game stores.

For gaming studios, PlaySuper directly solves the industry's toughest challenge, low retention, while also boosting monetisation. For brands, it unlocks a massive high-attention audience that already spends billions on in-game experiences, enabling targeted engagement with measurable ROI. Unlike traditional ads, PlaySuper embeds commerce into gameplay itself, improving recall, conversion, and loyalty.

In under two years, PlaySuper has onboarded 20+ studios, 3,000+ brands, and reached 6M+ DAUs through its partners, backed by $1.6M funding from Jungle Ventures (Chimera), Audacity VC, IAN Capital Fund, 100x.VC, and leaders from Meta, Tata, Dyson, and Amazon.

playsuper.ai

The Role

We are looking for a
**Product Associate**
who thinks in
**funnels, user behaviour, and data**
. You will work directly with the founding and product team on PlaySuper's live commerce surfaces across partner games.

This role is ideal for someone who:

* Is obsessed with why users drop off and what makes them convert
* Can pull their own data instead of waiting for someone else to
* Ships fast, writes clearly, and is comfortable with ambiguity
* Uses AI tools aggressively to move faster

You will not be writing specs in isolation. You will own surfaces that millions of players see.

The role starts as a
**3-month full-time internship**
in Gurgaon and converts to a
**permanent Product Associate**
position on performance.

What You'll Do

* Own specific surfaces of the in-game store: homepage, category pages, product pages, cart, checkout
* Write PRDs, event taxonomies, and analytics specs that engineering can build from directly
* Run your own analysis on funnels, retention, and conversion to find where users leak
* Design and run A/B tests, then defend the results with data
* Work with design to build store experiences that feel native to the game, not bolted on
* Support partner studios with launch readiness, integration checks, and performance reviews
* Build proposals and merchandising strategies for partner games
* Turn open-ended problems into prototypes quickly, using AI and vibe-coding tools

What We're Looking For

* Strong analytical ability, comfortable with SQL and dashboarding tools
* Clear, structured written communication, no fluff
* Genuine interest in gaming, commerce, or rewards-led products
* Ability to prototype ideas independently using AI tools
* High ownership, low ego, fast iteration

Strong Plus (Nice to Have)

* **1-year experience as a Product Associate at a startup or product-led company.**
* **Experience at a consumer internet, e-commerce, gaming, or fintech startup**
* **Familiarity with event-based analytics stacks such as ClickHouse, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Metabase**
* **Prior exposure to loyalty, cashback, rewards, or in-app purchase systems**
* **Shipped side projects, prototypes, or products of your own**

Structure and Location

* **First 3 months:**
  Full-time paid internship. You will own a live surface from day one, not shadow someone else's work.
* **Post 3 months:**
  Conversion to a permanent Product Associate role, based on performance.
* Full-time, in-office, Gurgaon.

**khushboobhatia@playsuper.ai**

title: Assistant Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection.  Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well-being.
  
  
Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
  
  
Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting & Reconciliations, Management Reporting & Analysis, Research & Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support & Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
  
  
The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications.  The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting & regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
  
  
**Job Description\***
This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1) understanding the Change, (2) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams & Users until implementation of the Change.  It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements.  The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements.  This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc.  Collaborate with the Users & procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in-house GRIFFIN & AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology & Testing Teams where relevant.

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
  
  
Certifications If Any - AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
  
  
**Experience Range\***

description:

Job Description

͏

vii.    Develop resource / manpower plans for the Sub-Practice aligned to the growth strategy and confirmed / pipeline opportunities
  
b.    Drive strategic partnership with the key Vendor Partner (SAP/Oracle/MS etc.)
  
i.    Align the business growth plans over the next 2-3 years with the vendor s (MS/SAP etc.) business strategy
  
ii.    Nurture vendor relationships to affect technology collaboration and combined go-to-market partnership opportunities 
  
c.    Review and drive the execution of the strategy and business plan for the Sub- Practice
  
i.    Monitor demand pipeline MIS and conduct regular cadence calls with the sales teams to review target achievement.
  
ii.    Support BU/ Geography sales teams by bringing the technical expertise and thought leadership to influence and shape client s thinking of the solution
  
iii.    Conduct regular cadence calls and dashboard reviews to review delivery and people metrices
  
iv.    Conduct monthly review for key accounts with Delivery Unit teams (for SL/DU)
  
v.    Interact and engage with the client leadership to communicate and update progress against account plan, project delivery etc.
  
vi.    Participate in regular business reviews with Leadership and share Practice performance across revenue, growth, operational and capability parameters

͏

**2.    Drive focus on demand generation through market differentiation**
a.    Drive Go-To-Market strategy for the Sub-Practice
  
i.    Lead the shaping of value proposition and branding of the sub-practice to aid selling
  
ii.    Direct the team to make effective decisions regarding target markets, offering, distribution and client relationship management
  
iii.    Help prioritize and budget for marketing related events and activities 
  
iv.    Lead development of product marketing plan and business case for key offerings to enable solution led sales 
  
v.    Identify push and pull tactics to be used for demand generation 
  
b.    Educate sales teams, BU client servicing team and client teams about sub-Practice s offerings and differentiation 
  
c.   Drive building of sales pipeline through upstream Consulting services 
  
i.    Build Advisory and Consulting capabilities in identified technical and functional domain areas for niche differentiation
  
ii.    Grow consulting led sales to develop higher value revenue streams 
  
d.    Drive positive market perception through Thought Leadership in own domain
  
i.    Manage relationships with Analysts and Industry groups in order to proactively shape market s perception of Wipro s strength in the practice domain
  
ii.    Formalize and drive targets for analyst rankings, client testimonials and partner credits to attain market referencability and recognition 
  
iii.    Represent Wipro in industry forums in the practice domain (e.g. Microsoft/ SAP etc.) to gain and retain high mindshare of key vendor partners
  
iv.    Be the voice of Wipro s Thought Leadership in the Practice domain by speaking in industry forums, seminars, writing blogs, articles, whitepapers etc.
  
v.    Partner with BUs and alliance partners to conduct events, develop presentations or other materials to present thought leadership in client forums

͏

**3.    Drive focus on revenue and growth**
a.    Collaborate with SL /Practice Leaders to proactively mine existing client accounts to increase account run-rates and convert competition share
  
b.    Plan, track and forge growth via new account opening. Support sales hunting effort to acquire new logos

ii.    Consult with architects and senior level IT managers to assess and enhance current solution strategies and pre-sales material
  
iii.    Guide the team to design appropriate solutions for client proposals and produce clear, concise and technically accurate responses to RFPs 
  
iv.    Approve key proposals and RFP responses before submitting to clients 
  
v.    Work with sales team to provide pre-sales support activities such as RFP response, doing use case demonstrations, and participating in the customer calls to sell solutions

i.    Engage across multiple capabilities/ ecosystems to structure the solution and the deal

iii.    Interact with client to keep them engaged in the development of the solution and the deal

i.    Work with Strategy group to evaluate vendor partners for M&A and partnership related opportunities 
  
ii.    Identify and suggest on ventures investments to create deeper market penetration opportunities
  
iii.    Develop and maintain 360-degree transactional and strategic relationships with alliance partners

ii.    Review and approve business case and investment for IPs and solutions. Envision viable proof of concepts

i.   Support in managing and resolving complex client escalations to mitigate revenue leakages or opportunity losses 
  
 

͏

b.    Review effective technical scope management and solutioning in the sub-practice
  
c.    Review the delivery plans and partner with the Practice Delivery Head (PDH) s to ensure alignment with the growth strategy
  
d.    Monitor and review delivery dashboards/ MIS and key metrices (utilization, onsite/offshore billing, billing efficiency etc) across Practice to track progress and identify potential red flags
  
e.    Manage and support resolution of client escalations related to delivery for projects in the Practice DU 
  
f.    Plan and drive initiatives and actions to be taken up at a Practice level to achieve cost optimization and improve service standards
