title: Director- Revenue Operations & Intelligence
description:
**About the company**

Algoworks is an award-winning artificial intelligence, engineering services and experience transformation firm with offices across the United States, Europe, South America and India. We bring together a global team of engineers, architects, designers, researchers and operators united by rigor, accountability and a commitment to delivering measurable results.

For over 20 years, Algoworks has partnered with Fortune 500 organizations across the Americas, Europe and Asia to define, build and run technology that drives meaningful business outcomes. Our work combines human-centered design, engineering excellence and AI-powered capabilities to solve complex challenges with clarity and precision. Innovation, particularly in the responsible application of AI, is embedded in how teams approach problem-solving and continuous improvement.

At Algoworks, growth is continuous and closely tied to impact. Teams collaborate across geographies and disciplines, strengthening outcomes through shared insight and collective expertise. The culture values transparency, open dialogue and an environment where every voice is heard and contribution is recognized.

Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact.

Follow the video below to know about us!
Clipchamp

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a world-class, experienced, and proven Revenue Operations leader to strengthen how Algoworks understands, manages, and improves commercial performance. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer and working closely with senior leadership across Sales, Marketing, Delivery, and Technology, this role will be responsible for making the go-to-market (GTM) operating model work better, not simply reporting on its performance.

The position combines revenue intelligence with process design, data governance, systems effectiveness, and adoption to create a trusted, forward-looking view of the revenue engine. The role will improve how teams operate from lead generation through revenue realization.

This is not a Salesforce architect or engineering role. The successful candidate must understand GTM systems deeply enough to define how they should support the business, identify where processes or data are failing, and work hand-in-hand with technical
specialists to implement scalable improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Executive Revenue Intelligence**

* Create integrated, forward-looking views of pipeline, bookings, backlog, forecast, revenue, and customer growth.
* Explain material movements, underlying drivers, emerging risks, and growth opportunities in concise, executive-ready terms.
* Ensure leadership receives actionable insights and recommendations rather than simply reports and dashboards.

**2. Commercial Performance & Predictability**

* Evaluate pipeline health, coverage, movement, conversion, sales velocity, deal slippage, and forecast risk.
* Analyze performance across customers, service lines, markets, geographies, and revenue streams.
* Recommend focused interventions to improve commercial performance and revenue predictability.

**3. Revenue Operating Model**

* Establish clear business definitions for pipeline stages, opportunity categories, forecast classifications, and critical revenue measures.
* Identify broken handoffs, recurring exceptions, duplicated effort, and unnecessary manual work across the revenue lifecycle.
* Redesign high-value processes, define required business rules and controls, and drive adoption of the improved operating model.

**4. Marketing, Sales & Finance Alignment**

* Connect Marketing activity to qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes, including funnel conversion, lead quality, attribution, and channel effectiveness.
* Support Sales with pipeline, forecast, conversion, and account insights.
* Help Finance connect commercial expectations with bookings, backlog, and revenue realization.
* Create a consistent and trusted fact base across Sales, Marketing, Alliances, Finance, and leadership while respecting each function's responsibilities and decision rights
  **.**

**5. GTM Systems Effectiveness, Data & CRM Governance**

* Be accountable for the business effectiveness, data quality, governance, and adoption of the GTM technology ecosystem, with Salesforce serving as the primary commercial source of truth.
* Define business requirements and operating standards for opportunity hygiene, field consistency, close dates, lead and campaign data, source attribution, metric definitions, workflows, reporting discipline, and user adoption.
* Work hand-in-hand with Salesforce, BI, data, and technology specialists to translate GTM requirements into scalable architecture, integrations, automation, and system improvements.
* Ensure business outcomes and user adoption remain the primary focus of technology improvements.

**6. Strategic Revenue Initiatives, Automation & AI**

* Lead a focused portfolio of initiatives that materially improve revenue visibility, predictability, or operating effectiveness.
* Frame complex commercial problems, prioritize opportunities by business impact and feasibility, and define the desired operating outcomes.
* Coordinate implementation with relevant functional and technical specialists.
* Identify practical applications of analytics, automation, and AI to improve forecasting, data quality, decision support, and recurring revenue processes.

**Required Technical Skills & Competencies**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Revenue Intelligence, or Commercial Strategy.
* At least 5 years in senior roles involving revenue analysis, commercial operations, or cross-functional revenue management.
* Strong understanding of complex B2B revenue models, including pipeline, forecasting, bookings, backlog, revenue realization, and customer growth.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to connect revenue expectations to operational and financial outcomes.
* Deep working knowledge of Salesforce from a Revenue Operations perspective, including data model concepts, workflows, governance, adoption, and integration patterns. Hands-on development is not required.
* Experience with marketing automation and GTM platforms such as Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, Amplemarket, or comparable tools.
* Advanced Excel capabilities and experience with BI platforms such as Power BI.
* Experience defining metrics, analytical frameworks, business requirements, GTM processes, data standards, system adoption measures, and executive reporting.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive cross-functional outcomes without relying on direct authority.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Substantial experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Revenue Intelligence, or Commercial Strategy.
* Experience in senior roles involving revenue analysis, commercial operations, or cross-functional revenue management.
* Strong understanding of B2B revenue models, pipeline management, forecasting, bookings, backlog, and revenue realization.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen.
* Deep working knowledge of Salesforce for Revenue Operations, including governance, data quality, workflows, adoption, and integrations.
* Advanced Excel skills and experience with BI tools such as Power BI.
* Experience developing executive-level reporting, defining business metrics, and
  translating analysis into actionable recommendations.
* Ability to align Sales, Marketing, Finance, Alliances, and other stakeholders around shared commercial outcomes.
* Strong process design, analytical, prioritization, and problem-solving capabilities.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Experience in technology services, SaaS, consulting, cloud, AI, digital engineering, or another complex B2B environment.
* Experience with marketing automation and GTM platforms such as Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement and Amplemarket.
* Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude or equivalent platforms to improve analysis, workflows, data quality, or decision support.
* Exposure to SQL, data modeling, advanced analytics, automation, or AI-enabled decision support.
* Ability to learn adjacent GTM platforms and technologies quickly.

**Desired Attributes**

* A strategic thinker who remains grounded in data and measurable business outcomes.
* Intellectually curious, independent in judgment, and commercially pragmatic.
* Able to simplify complex business questions and communicate a clear point of view.
* Constructively challenges inconsistent information and unsupported assumptions.
* Comfortable working directly with senior executives and functional leaders.
* Strong at distinguishing between commercial, process, data, and technology issues.
* Highly structured, proactive, and disciplined in prioritization and follow-through.
* A collaborative team player with a positive attitude and a great personality.

title: Senior Manager E-commerce & Marketplaces
description:
Pegasus, part of the B. Jain Group, is an established children’s publishing brand with a wide portfolio of books, educational products and screen-free learning experiences.

With an established presence across Amazon India, leading online marketplaces and our own D2C website, we are looking for a capable e-commerce leader to strengthen our online business and drive its next phase of growth.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a commercially driven and people-oriented
**Senior Manager – E-commerce &**

**Online Sales**
to lead our existing team of performance marketing, marketplace and cataloging professionals.

The role requires someone with a strong understanding of how e-commerce businesses operate, from product visibility and online merchandising to advertising effectiveness, sales conversion and profitability.

The selected candidate will be responsible for setting direction, developing the team, reviewing performance and ensuring that our products achieve their full sales potential across online channels.

**This is a business management and team leadership role, rather than a hands-on advertising or catalog execution position.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Growth & Commercial Ownership**

* Take ownership of overall online sales performance, revenue targets and profitability.
* Develop channel-wise and product-wise growth strategies across Amazon India, other marketplaces and the Pegasus website.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales, organic visibility, market share and contribution margins.
* Ensure that advertising expenditure and operational costs are aligned with commercial objectives.
* Drive sustainable business growth through effective planning, prioritization and execution.

**2. Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead and develop an existing team of performance marketers, marketplace specialists and cataloging professionals.
* Establish clear responsibilities, measurable KPIs and accountability across functions.
* Review individual and team performance, provide direction and ensure timely execution.
* Coach team members, resolve operational challenges and build a collaborative, high-performance culture.
* Assess resource requirements, identify capability gaps and improve team productivity.

**3. Performance Marketing & Marketplace Management**

* Provide strategic and technical direction to specialists managing Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads and marketplace promotions.
* Evaluate advertising strategies, campaign structure, budgets and effectiveness.
* Monitor ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, customer acquisition costs, conversion rates and overall advertising efficiency.
* Ensure continuous optimization of advertising spends while balancing revenue growth and profitability.
* Guide the team in improving product visibility, organic rankings and marketplace sales performance.

**4. Product Performance & Online Merchandising**

* Ensure effective listing, positioning and presentation of products across all relevant online channels.
* Oversee catalog quality, content, keywords, images, A+ content, pricing and promotional strategies.
* Monitor product-wise performance and identify opportunities to improve discoverability and conversions.
* Plan and oversee successful launches of new books, series and product categories.
* Coordinate with editorial, product development, marketing, design and inventory teams to ensure products are online-ready and commercially supported.
* Ensure systematic attention to both bestselling and underperforming products.

**5. Performance Reviews & Business Analytics**

* Establish robust reporting and review processes covering sales, advertising, catalog quality and profitability.
* Analyze channel-wise and product-wise performance to identify commercial opportunities and execution gaps.
* Conduct structured reviews with team members and ensure follow-through on agreed actions.
* Prepare monthly business reviews and actionable growth plans for management.
* Take responsibility for achieving agreed targets within approved budgets.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–10 years of relevant experience in e-commerce or online retail.
* Proven experience managing and developing teams handling marketplaces, performance marketing or digital commerce.
* Strong knowledge of Amazon India, including marketplace advertising, catalog management and sales optimization.
* Good understanding of D2C performance marketing, particularly Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Experience managing advertising budgets, sales targets and business performance.
* Strong understanding of online merchandising, product discoverability, conversion optimization and marketplace operations.
* Sound commercial judgment with the ability to balance growth and profitability.
* Strong analytical, communication, people management and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to guide technical specialists, hold teams accountable and deliver measurable business results.

Experience in consumer products, books, toys, educational products, stationery, baby products or similar categories would be an advantage.

**Why Join Pegasus?**

* Lead an established online business with significant growth opportunities.
* Manage an existing team of specialists rather than build operations from scratch.
* Take meaningful ownership of commercial strategy, team performance and business growth.
* Work closely with senior leadership in a growing Indian consumer brand.
* Opportunity to build a scalable and high-performing e-commerce function.

title: Senior AI & Decision Science Engineer
description:
**OUR STORY**
**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**
**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**
**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**
**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**
**Full-Stack AI & Automation Engineer**
**Human Resources - Strategic Planning & Analytics CoE**
**About The Team & Your Role**
Strategic Planning & Analytics team is architected to move beyond traditional HR, functioning as a strategic engine that fuels ST’s growth through five specialized pillars: Business Partnerships, Products & AI, Workforce Insights, Data Science, and Workforce Planning Architecture. We are currently in an ambitious build-phase, moving away from legacy processes to create a sophisticated, tech-enabled function that mirrors the engineering excellence of the semiconductor industry. We don’t want to just manage headcount; we want to orchestrate the future of HR using AI.
  
  
As a member of this team, you won’t be working in a silo. You will be at the intersection of human capital and advanced technology, leveraging AI and data science to solve complex organizational challenges and expected to be a foundational builder. We are looking for pioneers to help us design and implement our first generation of advanced analytics and AI-driven products. You won't just be using technology—you will be architecting the roadmap, selecting the tools, and establishing the frameworks that will define how ST manages its global talent for years to come. If you are energized by the challenge of redefining the "H" in HR through the lens of data and innovation, you’ve found the right place.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* End-to-End AI Prototyping: Architect, build, and deploy conversational bots and transactional AI agents from scratch in a sandbox environment.
* Workflow Orchestration & Automation: Design and manage complex, multi-system automation workflows using tools like n8n to automate actions (e.g., orchestrating system lookups, mock API executions, and conditional task routing).
* LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering: Integrate prototypes securely with internal OpenAI/ChatGPT APIs, mastering prompt design, function calling, tool use, and state management.
* Interface & UI/UX Evolution: Build lightweight, responsive web interfaces (e.g., Streamlit, Next.js) for quick stakeholder testing, ensuring the backend logic is decoupled via webhooks for future migration into Microsoft Teams.
* Code Hygiene & Handoff Documentation: Maintain code transparency, track version changes, and collaborate efficiently using GitHub. Author structured "Industrialization Blueprints" (JSON payloads, API mappings, and logic flows) to seamlessly hand over for full scale production

**Required Background & Skills**

* AI Orchestration Frameworks: Expert-level workflow creation using tools like n8n (advanced JavaScript/Python execution nodes, webhooks, and sub-workflows) or equivalent orchestration frameworks
* AI & LLM Mastery: Practical experience implementing conversational APIs, embedding architectures, vector stores, and advanced prompt engineering constraints.
* Full-Stack Core Development: Strong programming proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/Node.js. Comfort writing clean API connectors, handling RESTful requests, parsing JSON, and maintaining code via GitHub.
* Enterprise Collaboration Ecosystems: Prior familiarity or structural understanding of building integration layers, bots, or webhooks for the Microsoft 365 / MS Teams ecosystem is highly desirable.
* Candidate should possess “Can-do” attitude, with an ability to thrive in an unstructured environment
* 9 to 12 years of software engineering/automation experience (with at least 2–3 years focused on building AI agents/bots from scratch).
* Masters/ PhD in Computer Science, Information Technology equivalent
* Understanding of HCM systems like Oracle is an added advantage
* Excellent English, quantitative, technical, and storytelling skills

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.
  
  
At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.
  
  
To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

**Function:** International Business / Global Feed Sales  
**Location:** Noida / Mumbai / Bangalore  
**Experience:** 12+ Years  
**Industry:** Media / Broadcast / News / Content Sales  
**Travel:** International travel as required  
**Education:** Bachelor's degree required; MBA or postgraduate qualification preferred

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced International Sales leader to drive global commercial growth for the organisation's international news feed, broadcast content, and associated media products.

The role will focus on expanding international distribution, developing strategic B2B partnerships, commercialising media content, and generating revenue across global markets. The candidate will work closely with international broadcasters, DTH/IPTV operators, OTT platforms, digital platforms, content aggregators, media networks, and other strategic distribution partners.

This is a **pure B2B international media sales role** requiring extensive industry experience, an established global media network, strong commercial acumen, and a proven track record of delivering international sales revenue.

Key Responsibilities1. International Feed Sales & Distribution

* Develop and execute the international sales strategy for the organisation's news feed and broadcast content.
* Drive distribution across international broadcasters, cable operators, DTH, CTV, IPTV, OTT, and digital platforms.
* Identify and develop new business opportunities across international markets and territories.
* Build and manage a strong pipeline of international distributors and strategic media partners.
* Negotiate distribution, carriage, licensing, and commercial agreements with international partners.

2. International Business Development

* Identify new revenue streams for international news feeds, media content, and related products.
* Develop market-entry strategies for priority regions, including the United States and other high-value markets.
* Identify untapped opportunities across territories, distribution channels, and media platforms.
* Establish strategic partnerships to expand international reach and revenue generation.

3. Content Sales & Media Licensing

* Drive the commercialisation of live news, linear feeds, digital content, video packages, and other eligible media assets.
* Develop content syndication and licensing opportunities with international media organisations.
* Structure customised commercial partnerships based on market requirements and partner objectives.
* Collaborate with legal, editorial, and content teams to negotiate commercially viable licensing agreements.

4. Revenue Generation & Business Ownership

* Own international sales targets, revenue generation, and business growth across assigned markets.
* Develop annual business plans, revenue forecasts, pricing strategies, and territory-wise sales plans.
* Consistently achieve and exceed assigned revenue targets.
* Monitor market performance, competitor activity, pricing trends, and emerging commercial opportunities.
* Acquire new clients while expanding revenue from existing strategic accounts.

5. Global Client & Partner Management

* Build and maintain relationships with CEOs, Managing Directors, Heads of Distribution, Content Acquisition Heads, Commercial Heads, and other senior decision-makers.
* Develop long-term partnerships with international broadcasters, distributors, aggregators, OTT platforms, and media networks.
* Serve as the primary commercial contact for key international accounts.
* Lead contract renewals, account expansion, and strategic partnership development.

6. Market Intelligence & Competitive Strategy

* Monitor international broadcasting, news, OTT, and digital media trends.
* Evaluate evolving content consumption patterns, distribution models, and platform economics.
* Analyse competitors and benchmark international news networks.
* Translate market intelligence into actionable sales strategies and business development plans.

7. Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Editorial, Content, Product, Technology, Legal, Finance, Marketing, and Operations teams.
* Coordinate partner onboarding and the delivery of international feed and content distribution agreements.
* Ensure commercial commitments align with operational capabilities and content rights.
* Resolve partner issues and maintain high levels of client satisfaction.

Required Skills & Experience

* 12+ years of proven experience in international media sales, broadcast distribution, content sales, or media business development.
* Strong understanding of the global news, television, broadcasting, and digital media ecosystem.
* Demonstrated experience selling international TV feeds, broadcast channels, media content, programming, or media rights.
* Established relationships with international broadcasters, DTH operators, cable/MSO players, IPTV and OTT platforms, aggregators, and media networks.
* Proven track record of managing and achieving significant international revenue targets.
* Strong commercial negotiation skills and experience closing complex, multi-country business agreements.
* Experience developing new international territories and expanding media distribution into new markets.
* Sound knowledge of content licensing, syndication, distribution, and carriage models.
* Ability to engage effectively with CXOs and senior decision-makers across global media organisations.
* Strong business development capabilities, including lead generation, pipeline management, deal negotiation, and closure.
* Excellent presentation, communication, influencing, and relationship management skills.
* Willingness to undertake international travel as required.

Ideal Candidate Background

Candidates with relevant experience in the following sectors will be preferred:

* Global and international news networks
* Broadcast and television networks
* International media companies
* TV distribution and channel carriage companies
* Content licensing and syndication companies
* OTT and digital media platforms
* DTH, IPTV, and cable/MSO operators
* Media aggregators and global news agencies
* International media sales and distribution organisations

Preference will be given to candidates with direct experience in the international distribution and commercialisation of news channels, live news feeds, video content, broadcast programming, or media rights.

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline is mandatory.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in Marketing, International Business, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.

Key Success Parameters

* Achievement of international revenue and sales targets.
* Expansion into new international markets and territories.
* Acquisition of new distribution partners and strategic accounts.
* Growth in international feed distribution and content licensing revenue.
* Successful negotiation and closure of commercial agreements.
* Retention and expansion of existing international partnerships.

ClearrCUT
  
  
Job Description – City Head, Kolkata
  
  
Position: City Head – Kolkata
  
Location: Kolkata, West Bengal
  
Department: City Operations & Business Growth
  
Reporting To: CEO / Management
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The City Head – Kolkata will be responsible for the overall business performance of ClearrCUT across Kolkata. This is a leadership and ownership role covering revenue growth, operations, customer experience, professional/service partner management, team performance, expansion, and profitability.
  
  
The City Head will operate as the business owner for the Kolkata market and will be accountable for achieving monthly targets while maintaining strong service standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Revenue & Business Growth
  
  
- Own and achieve Kolkata's monthly booking, revenue and collection targets.
  
- Develop city-level strategies to increase bookings, repeat customers and average order value.
  
- Identify new customer acquisition and business development opportunities.
  
- Work closely with Marketing and Management on campaigns, offers and growth initiatives.
  
- Track daily, weekly and monthly revenue performance and take corrective action when required.
  
  
2. City Operations
  
  
- Take complete ownership of day-to-day ClearrCUT operations across Kolkata.
  
- Ensure smooth booking allocation, professional availability and timely service execution.
  
- Maintain high service completion rates and minimise cancellations.
  
- Resolve operational bottlenecks quickly and ensure accountability across the team.
  
  
3. Team Leadership & Performance
  
  
- Lead the Operations, Customer Support, Sales/Business Development and city-level execution teams.
  
- Set clear KPIs and individual/team targets.
  
- Conduct regular performance reviews and daily/weekly business reviews.
  
- Identify underperformance and implement improvement plans where required.
  
- Build a performance-driven and accountable work culture.
  
  
4. Professional / Service Partner Management
  
  
- Ensure adequate availability of verified and high-quality service professionals.
  
- Monitor professional performance, attendance, customer ratings and service quality.
  
- Support onboarding and activation of new professionals based on demand.
  
- Maintain healthy professional relationships while enforcing ClearrCUT service standards.
  
  
5. Customer Experience
  
  
- Ensure excellent customer experience from booking to service completion.
  
- Monitor complaints, refunds, cancellations and repeat service issues.
  
- Ensure critical customer complaints are resolved quickly.
  
- Improve customer retention, ratings and repeat booking percentage.
  
  
6. Expansion & Market Development
  
  
- Identify high-potential areas and service categories for expansion across Kolkata.
  
- Build hyperlocal growth plans based on customer demand and professional availability.
  
- Support new category launches and geographical expansion.
  
- Monitor competitor activity and recommend appropriate market actions.
  
  
7. P&L & Cost Control
  
  
- Take ownership of Kolkata city-level profitability.
  
- Monitor revenue, discounts, incentives, refunds and operational expenses.
  
- Improve productivity and control unnecessary operational costs.
  
- Work towards sustainable contribution margin and city profitability.
  
  
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
- Monthly Revenue & Collection Achievement
  
- Booking Growth
  
- Service Completion Rate
  
- Cancellation Rate
  
- Customer Rating & Complaint Resolution
  
- Repeat Customer Rate
  
- Active Professional Count
  
- Professional Utilisation
  
- Team Productivity
  
- Customer Acquisition & Retention
  
- City Contribution Margin / Profitability
  
- Expansion Performance
  
  
Candidate Profile
  
  
- Strong experience in operations, sales, business development or city management.
  
- Experience in home services, beauty & wellness, hyperlocal, marketplace, consumer services or startup operations will be preferred.
  
- Strong leadership and people-management capabilities.
  
- Highly target-oriented with strong execution skills.
  
- Comfortable working with numbers, dashboards and performance metrics.
  
- Ability to solve operational problems independently and make fast decisions.
  
- Strong understanding of the Kolkata market.
  
- Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership.
  
  
What We Expect
  
  
We are looking for a City Leader, not simply an Operations Manager.
  
  
The successful candidate should be capable of taking ownership of the Kolkata business, building a high-performance team, increasing revenue, maintaining excellent customer experience and developing ClearrCUT into a strong and profitable city-level business.
  
  
Core Principle:
  
Own the City. Own the Number. Own the Customer Experience.

title: Category Manager
description:
Category Manager – Gold Jewellery

**Company:**
Ashapuri Gold Ornament Limited

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Employment:**
Full-time | On-site

**Open Positions:**
2

About the Company

Ashapuri Gold Ornament Limited is an established jewellery manufacturing company based in Ahmedabad, specialising in traditional, antique and heritage-inspired gold jewellery. We work with leading jewellery businesses across India, combining skilled craftsmanship, product innovation and large-scale manufacturing expertise.

We are looking for experienced and commercially driven
**Category Managers**
to strengthen our jewellery product development and merchandising functions.

Key Responsibilities

* Independently manage assigned gold jewellery product categories, from concept development to production readiness.
* Plan and develop new jewellery collections based on market trends, customer requirements and category opportunities.
* Coordinate with jewellery designers, CAD teams, artisans, sampling teams and production departments.
* Oversee product selection, prototype development, costing, weight optimisation and manufacturing feasibility.
* Develop assortments across different product types, weight bands and price segments.
* Analyse category performance, product gaps, approval rates and development timelines.
* Ensure timely execution of collections while maintaining high standards of quality and craftsmanship.
* Collaborate with internal sales, merchandising and manufacturing teams to meet business objectives.
* Monitor product development progress and maintain accurate category reports.
* Identify new designs, techniques and opportunities to improve product competitiveness.

Desired Experience & Skills

* Preferably 3–10 years of relevant experience in gold jewellery manufacturing, product merchandising, category management or product development.
* Strong understanding of traditional gold jewellery, including exposure to Plain Antique, Glass Kundan, Temple or Colourstone Jewellery.
* Practical knowledge of jewellery design processes, CAD development, sampling, costing and production.
* Ability to assess jewellery designs for commercial suitability, craftsmanship, weight and manufacturing feasibility.
* Strong communication, coordination, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and familiarity with jewellery ERP or product development systems.
* Experience working with organised jewellery manufacturers or major jewellery retail brands is an advantage.

Relevant industry experience and demonstrated product knowledge will receive strong consideration.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to manage specialised gold jewellery categories.
* Direct involvement in new collection development and product innovation.
* Collaboration with experienced designers, artisans and business leadership.
* A professional environment with long-term career growth opportunities.
* Compensation aligned with relevant experience and capabilities.

**Interested candidates should apply through LinkedIn with their updated resume.**

Candidates with a relevant jewellery product portfolio or examples of successfully managed collections are encouraged to share them during the selection process.

title: Creative Brand & Growth Marketing Manager
description:
Brand, Creative & Growth Marketing Manager

**Location:** Navrangpura, Ahmedabad | Full-time, in-office

DHARTI Singtel is Ahmedabad’s heritage edible-oil brand, rooted in the city’s Kapasia Bazar trading history before its 1960 trademark registration. We are relaunching DHARTI as a modern, premium direct-to-consumer (D2C) brand. We are currently not in the market.  
Mention **“DHARTI SING TEL”** to someone over the age of 45 who was born and raised in Ahmedabad and has spent most of their life here, and you may see something shift immediately: recognition, memory, a sense of home.

We are looking for a hands-on marketer who combines **brand thinking, creative storytelling and performance marketing;** someone who can turn consumer insights into distinctive social media campaigns and translate marketing activity into measurable business outcomes.

You will work directly with the fifth-generation promoter, with the opportunity to shape the brand’s relaunch and growth from an early stage. Lot's to learn and do.

What you will do

**1. Build the brand**

* Research consumers, competitors and category conventions to identify opportunities for differentiation.
* Develop brand positioning, messaging and storytelling that make DHARTI recognisable and relevant.
* Translate the brand’s heritage and product attributes into compelling consumer communication.

**2. Lead social media strategy and campaigns**

* Develop and execute social media campaigns across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and WhatsApp to build awareness, educate consumers, generate enquiries and drive sales.
* Conceptualise original and creative ideas for Reels, Stories, posts, carousels and other social media formats.
* Develop campaign narratives, creative hooks, content themes and calls to action.
* Brief and collaborate with the graphic designer to turn ideas into effective content and advertising creatives.
* Evaluate audience response and use what you learn to improve future campaigns.

**3. Own performance marketing**

* Independently plan, run and optimise paid social media campaigns through Meta Ads.
* Test audiences, creative approaches, messaging, offers and landing pages.
* Track relevant metrics, including reach, engagement, click-through rates, conversion rates, customer acquisition cost (CAC) and return on ad spend (ROAS).
* Identify why campaigns underperform and recommend practical improvements.
* Use Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads where there is a clear business case, including brand visibility where appropriate.

**4. Connect marketing to business results**

* Track the customer journey from social media exposure to enquiry, purchase and repeat order.
* Identify which activities generate genuine customers rather than engagement alone.
* Analyse campaign performance, customer feedback and acquisition economics to guide decisions.
* Report clearly on what worked, what did not, and what should change next.

**5. Lead DHARTI’s Amazon launch**

* Coordinate and own the marketing workstream for Amazon Seller Central onboarding and marketplace launch.
* Manage product listing content, imagery, keywords, pricing and promotional readiness.
* Coordinate documentation and operational requirements with relevant internal or external partners.
* Monitor listing performance and identify opportunities to improve visibility and conversion.

What we are looking for

* Relevant experience in brand marketing, creative marketing, performance marketing or digital marketing.
* Strong creative judgement, consumer understanding, storytelling and copywriting skills.
* **Hands-on Meta and Google Ads experience**, including campaign optimisation and performance analysis.
* Ability to connect creative decisions with customer acquisition and commercial outcomes.
* Experience briefing and working with designers and other execution partners.
* An analytical, curious and accountable approach to solving problems.
* Comfort working directly with a promoter in a growing business where initiative and execution matter.

**Good to have:** Experience with Amazon Seller Central or e-commerce marketplaces, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, analytics tools, and FMCG, food or D2C brands. Gujarati and Hindi proficiency would be an advantage.

What success looks like

* A recognisable and differentiated brand presence.
* Original social media campaigns that generate meaningful consumer interest and sales.
* Measurable improvement in customer acquisition and marketing efficiency.
* Clear understanding of which marketing activities create business value.
* A successful Amazon marketplace launch.

How to apply

Please share your CV and relevant work samples. Include at least one example of a campaign you personally worked on, explaining your contribution, the thinking behind it and the results achieved.

We value original thinking, practical execution and commercial judgement; not just platform familiarity or a polished portfolio.

**Compensation:** Based on experience and skills.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Co-Founder Entrepreneur with investment
description:
**Company Description**
At JusPnCorp India Private Limited, we operate as a Farmer Production Company committed to connecting farming communities directly with markets. Our mission is to empower local farmers through access to resources, technology, and fair trade opportunities that support long-term growth. We focus on sourcing high-quality rice, spices, dry fruits, and dal directly from trusted producers, ensuring freshness, authenticity, and sustainable cultivation. By working with JusPnCorp, partners and customers contribute to a more resilient agricultural ecosystem and healthier choices for consumers. The company is driven by impact, transparency, and strong relationships across the agricultural value chain.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Co-Founder Entrepreneur role with investment, based in Coimbatore. The Co-Founder will collaborate on defining and executing overall business strategy, including market positioning, product portfolio expansion, and partnerships with farming communities and buyers. Day-to-day responsibilities include overseeing operations from sourcing to distribution, building and managing key supplier and customer relationships, and ensuring quality and sustainability standards are met. The role involves actively participating in financial planning, investment decisions, and fundraising activities, as well as monitoring performance metrics and driving growth initiatives. The Co-Founder will also represent the company in stakeholder meetings, promote brand visibility, and help build a strong team and culture aligned with JusPnCorp’s mission.

**Qualifications**

* Strong entrepreneurial mindset, with experience in building or scaling businesses, preferably in agriculture, food supply chain, or FMCG.
* Demonstrated ability in business strategy, operations management, and stakeholder relationship building.
* Financial acumen, including investment readiness, budgeting, and understanding of unit economics and profitability.
* Knowledge of agricultural markets, farmer networks, or rural supply chains is highly beneficial.
* Effective communication, negotiation, and leadership skills to work with farmers, partners, and internal teams.
* Willingness to make a capital investment and take shared responsibility for business risks and rewards.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Agriculture, Supply Chain, or a related field; relevant entrepreneurial or industry experience may substitute formal education.
* Ability to work on-site in Coimbatore, travel to farming communities, and engage directly with local stakeholders.

title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Moveworks
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Moveworks)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Strong understanding of the Move works platform, including enterprise search, conversational AI, natural language understanding (NLU), employee support automation, and AI-driven workflow orchestration.
* Knowledge of Move works integration capabilities with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Slack, HR systems, identity platforms, and enterprise applications
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of ServiceNow applications (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD).

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Escalate early when a project is drifting rather than reporting it after the fact.

**Customer and Communication Skills**

* Comfortable talking to customers and translating what they want into a written scope.
* Organised, with a bias for closing things rather than tracking them.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with high-volume SMB or inside-sales customers.
* Exposure to conversational AI or automation.

title: Consultant – DEI Projects

Project planning and execution, analytics coordination and stakeholder management

The role requires a highly organised, analytical and dependable project management professional who can convert strategic direction into structured project plans, coordinate stakeholders, maintain timelines and documentation, identify risks, follow actions through to closure, and produce accurate management updates.

This role is ideal for someone who may not yet be a DEI subject-matter expert but demonstrates
**exceptional ownership, follow-through, learning agility and programme-management discipline**
.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Women Leadership Development Programme**

Own execution across multiple cohorts.

Responsibilities include:

* Develop and maintain cohort-wise project plans covering key milestones, dependencies and owners.
* Coordinate nominations, participant onboarding and programme communications.
* Maintain master calendars covering assessments, workshops, mentoring, coaching, leadership interactions and other planned interventions.
* Coordinate with internal facilitators, external learning partners and vendors.
* Track attendance, assessments, programme milestones, IDPs, Action Learning Projects and other participant deliverables.
* Follow up proactively with participants, reporting managers, mentors and relevant stakeholders.
* Identify slippages and programme risks and escalate them with clear recommended actions.
* Coordinate participant feedback and programme evaluation.
* Maintain programme records, evidence and documentation.
* Prepare monthly cohort dashboards and programme status reports.
* Coordinate programme closure and lessons learnt.

**2. DEI Dashboard, Analytics & Reporting**

Provide project-management and analytical coordination for the DEI dashboard and reporting agenda.

Responsibilities include preparation of insights for review by the DEI Lead through:

* Maintain the DEI dashboard requirement tracker.
* Work with HRSS/Analystics Team for creating evidence-based, automated dashboard.
* Support dashboard testing and document issues requiring resolution.
* Coordinate requirements and data inputs with HR Analytics, HRBPs, TA and other data owners.
* Consolidate and conduct first-level checks of recurring data submissions.
* Identify missing, inconsistent or incomplete information and coordinate correction.
* Maintain source documentation and version control.
* Prepare recurring DEI scorecards and management reports.
* Translate validated data into charts, summaries and draft insights for review by the DEI Lead.
* Maintain action trackers arising from DEI governance meetings.

**3. Women Representation & Talent Pipeline Tracking**

Provide project-management support for gender representation priorities.

Responsibilities include:

* Maintain representation and hiring action trackers.
* Coordinate periodic inputs from TA and HRBPs.
* Track agreed hiring, retention and representation actions.
* Consolidate hiring-funnel information for governance reviews.
* Support tracking of women attrition hotspots and agreed interventions.
* Maintain cluster/function-level action plans.
* Schedule governance discussions and record decisions/actions.
* Follow up with action owners until closure.
* Prepare monthly progress updates for DEI review.

**4. DEI Portfolio PMO & Governance**

Create a predictable project-management backbone across the DEI portfolio.

* Maintain an integrated DEI project calendar.
* Follow up on actions and highlight overdue deliverables.
* Support vendor, PO and invoice coordination with relevant functions.
* Consolidate project updates into leadership-ready presentations.
* Maintain a simple portfolio-level RAG status.
* Escalate risks with context and possible resolution options rather than simply forwarding issues.
* Maintain confidentiality when dealing with employee, assessment and talent information.

**Essential**

* **2–4 years of professional experience**
  , preferably in project/programme management within HR, Talent Management, Learning & Development, Organisational Development, Employee Engagement, DEI or related functions.
* Evidence of coordinating
  **multiple concurrent projects**
  with different stakeholders and deadlines.
* Demonstrates
  **complete ownership**
  of assigned projects, proactively driving actions, anticipating risks, following commitments and ensuring closure without requiring repeated direction or follow-up.
* Strong Excel capability, including formulas, PivotTables, data cleaning, and structured analysis.
* Strong PowerPoint skills with the ability to create concise management presentations.
* Experience maintaining project plans, trackers, action logs and status reports.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Working familiarity with Microsoft Teams, SharePoint and Microsoft Office.

**Preferred**

* Demonstrated stakeholder follow-through.
* Comfortable working with data and identifying basic discrepancies or missing information.
* Exposure to Power BI or another dashboarding tool.
* Experience supporting leadership-development or L&D programmes.

title: Delivery Manager (Technical)

title: Senior Projects Manager – Computational Biology/Bio-Computing & AI
description:
**Job Title: Senior Projects Manager – Computational Biology & AI**

**Experience:**
5–10 years of substantial hands-on experience in computational biology/bioinformatics, AI/ML, with demonstrated leadership of handling complex technical projects. Must have proficiency in Python/ relevant scientific computing & AI frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and associated data science libraries. Should be experienced with large-scale data processing, distributed computing, cloud-computing, GPU-based model training, or high-performance computing, DevOps & MLOps.

**Education: Ph.D**
. in Bioinformatics/Computational Biology/Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, or a related quantitative discipline with strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning models, & modern AI architectures.

**Role Type:**
Full-time | Research, Technology Product Development & AI Innovation

**Position Overview:**

We are seeking a highly accomplished and visionary
**Senior Projects Manager – Computational Biology & AI**
to lead the research, development, and deployment of innovative computational algorithms, large-scale machine learning models, and advanced artificial intelligence systems for multi-omics biological data.

The role will focus on building next-generation AI capabilities that integrate, analyze, and interpret complex, heterogeneous, and high-dimensional biological datasets, especially on
**multi-omics datasets and other molecular and clinical data modalities**
.

The successful candidate will lead multidisciplinary teams in developing scalable AI/ML architectures, multimodal foundation models, predictive algorithms, and automated interpretation engines that transform complex biological data into clinically and scientifically meaningful insights. This position combines
**scientific innovation, AI/ML research leadership, computational platform development, and project/program management**
, requiring the ability to translate complex scientific challenges into robust, scalable, and impactful AI-driven solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI/ML Algorithm Development and Innovation**

* Lead the design and development of innovative computational algorithms and advanced machine learning models for biological data analysis, interpretation, and prediction.
* Develop novel approaches for extracting meaningful biological signals from complex, noisy, sparse, high-dimensional, and heterogeneous datasets.
* Drive research and implementation of deep learning, transformer-based architectures, graph neural networks, generative AI, self-supervised learning, contrastive learning, and other advanced AI methodologies.
* Establish methodologies for model training, predictive modelling, model optimization, validation, benchmarking, explanability and continuous improvement.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and translate promising research into scalable computational solutions.

**2. Multi-Omics Integration & Multimodal AI**

* Lead the development of algorithms and AI models capable of integrating and interpreting diverse biological data types.
* Design advanced computational frameworks for cross-modal data integration, representation learning, feature extraction, and biological knowledge discovery.
* Develop unified or interoperable AI models that learn from multiple data modalities and generate integrated biological and clinical interpretations.
* Address challenges associated with missing modalities, batch effects, technical variability, data sparsity, population heterogeneity, and differences across platforms and experimental technologies.
* Explore the development of multimodal biological foundation models capable of learning generalizable representations across datasets, diseases, populations, and use cases.

**3. Large-Scale Machine Learning and AI Model Development**

* Architect, develop, and manage large-scale AI/ML models trained on extensive and diverse biological, molecular, clinical, and biomedical datasets.
* Lead the development of domain-specific foundation models, including models for biological sequence understanding, molecular representation learning, disease signatures, & integrated multi-omics interpretation.
* Build scalable data-processing and model-training pipelines to support large datasets, distributed computing, GPU-based workloads, and high-throughput analytical workflows; and optimize computational efficiency, inference performance, reproducibility, scalability, and deployment readiness..
* Develop reusable model architectures, training frameworks, feature libraries, and computational components that can be applied across multiple scientific and clinical applications.
* Establish strategies for pretraining, fine-tuning, transfer learning, domain adaptation, & continual model improvement.

**4. Automated Biological and Clinical Data Interpretation**

* Lead development of automated interpretation engines that convert raw or processed biological data into structured, actionable, and scientifically grounded insights.
* Build AI-driven workflows that integrate data quality assessment, feature extraction, model inference, evidence aggregation, interpretation, & report generation.
* Develop computational approaches for identifying disease-associated molecular patterns, clinically relevant biomarkers, molecular subtypes, & potential mechanisms of disease to enable automated interpretation across multiple use case.
* Incorporate biological knowledge bases, pathway databases, literature-derived evidence, and other curated knowledge resources to improve interpretability & contextual relevance.

**5. Computational Biology Research and Scientific Leadership**

* Define the computational biology & AI research roadmap in alignment with organizational scientific, product, and business objectives; and translate emerging scientific discoveries & computational methodologies into practical AI capabilities.
* Identify high-impact novel research opportunities at the intersection of systems biology, multi-omics, machine learning, & precision medicine and lead development of novel methodologies, algorithms, prototypes, & proof-of-concept systems.
* Critically evaluate scientific literature, benchmark emerging methods, and establish best practices for computational research; incorporate methodological innovation, reproducible research, & publication-quality analytical standards.
* Collaborate with domain experts to ensure that developed models capture meaningful biological relationships rather than relying solely on statistical associations.

**6. Project and Program Management**

* Own end-to-end execution of complex AI and computational biology projects, from problem definition and feasibility assessment through research, development, validation, and deployment.
* Develop project plans, milestones, resource requirements, timelines, budgets, and measurable success criteria, and manage multiple concurrent projects and prioritize initiatives based on scientific value, technical feasibility, strategic importance, and business impact.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams comprising computational biologists, bioinformaticians, laboratory scientists, clinicians, and product teams.
* Establish effective project governance, risk management, technical reviews, and performance reporting processes. Anticipate scientific, data, computational, regulatory, operational risks, and develop mitigation strategies.
* Ensure timely delivery of robust, scalable, well-documented, and maintainable AI solutions.

**7. Data Engineering, DevOps, MLOps, and Platform Development**

* Guide the design of scalable data architectures and computational pipelines for the ingestion, harmonization, transformation, and analysis of multi-omics & clinical datasets.
* Oversee the development of robust workflows for data preprocessing, quality control, normalization, feature engineering, and metadata management.
* Establish model development, deployment practices covering experiment tracking, version control, automated testing, model registries, monitoring, & reproducibility.
* Operationalize research models within production-grade computational platforms, APIs, analytical applications, and automated reporting systems, and promote cloud-native and distributed computing architectures where appropriate.
* Ensure appropriate data security, access controls, privacy protections, and governance throughout the data and model lifecycle.

**8. Model Validation, Explainability, and Responsible AI**

* Establish rigorous validation frameworks to assess model accuracy, robustness, generalizability, reproducibility, and clinical or scientific utility.
* Design appropriate benchmarking strategies, independent test sets, external validation studies, & prospective evaluation approaches where feasible, and evaluate model performance.
* Develop interpretable AI methods that help scientists & clinicians understand model predictions and their supporting evidence.
* Implement uncertainty quantification, out-of-distribution detection, bias assessment, & safeguards against unsupported interpretations.
* Work with clinical, quality, regulatory, and compliance teams to align development and validation practices with applicable requirements, particularly for intended clinical use.

**9. Team Leadership and Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams across computational biology, AI/ML research, bioinformatics, and data science and establish a culture of innovation, scientific integrity, technical excellence, collaboration, & accountability.
* Communicate scientific findings, technical strategies, project status, and business implications to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Translate broad scientific and clinical requirements into clearly defined computational problems, development roadmaps, and measurable deliverables.
* Build cross-functional alignment among research, clinical, product, and commercial teams, and manage collaborations with all external stakeholders, where required.

title: Lead - Partner enablement
description:
**About Rocketlane**

Rocketlane is a fast-growing, category-defining SaaS company transforming customer onboarding and professional services automation. Our mission is simple: help B2B companies deliver a seamless, consistent, and efficient onboarding experience — reducing chaos and driving better customer outcomes.

Today, we’re a team of 200+ passionate builders creating a product that teams genuinely love to use. Backed by leading investors like 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners, we’ve raised over $105M to fuel our growth.

As Rocketlane scales into enterprise deals, new geographies, and an expanding partner ecosystem, the Professional Services (PS) team is at the forefront of this evolution. With growth, the cost of inconsistent onboarding and reactive enablement becomes more pronounced — and we’re no longer willing to accept that trade-off.

This role exists to change that.

If you’re excited about building a high-impact enablement function within a product-led PS organization that deeply values delivery quality, ownership, and customer experience — this is your opportunity.

**The Problem You're Solving**

Right now, a new Implementation Manager at Rocketlane learns on the job. There's no structured path, no certification, no single source of truth. Status decks exist in six versions. When a new product feature ships, the PS team finds out the same way customers do. Ongoing training? Mostly ad hoc.

You're the person who fixes all of that and then makes it impossible to go back to the old way.

**What This Role Actually Is**

You've run implementations. You've been in the room when things go sideways. You know what "good delivery" looks like because you've done it and you've probably thought "someone should write this down properly."

That someone is now you.

As Enablement Lead for Professional Services, you own three things end-to-end:

1. The learning path for every new PS hire From day one to first solo customer engagement - structured, sequenced, and certified. Not a folder of decks. An actual program.

2. Feature enablement, every release cycle You sit close to Product. When something ships, your team knows about it before the customer does - with a playbook, not a Slack message.

3. The PS collateral library One version of every template. One source of truth. Always current. You own it, you maintain it, you retire things that are stale.

This isn't a content coordination role. You're building a function from scratch and running it as a continuous program — complete with certifications, gamification, and a feedback loop that actually closes.

**What You'll Own?**

**New Hire Learning Path**

* Design and run a structured onboarding curriculum from "what is Rocketlane" to "ready to own a customer engagement"
* Build the certification program: assessments, scoring rubrics, pass criteria, refresh cycles
* Create role-specific tracks for IMs, Solution Architects, and partners, not one-size-fits-all
* Gamify progression so completion is a milestone, not a checkbox

**Feature Enablement (with PM)**

* Embed yourself in the product release cycle - beta reviews, early access, pre-launch prep
* Translate every significant release into: what changed, what to demo, what to watch out for, what to update in delivery
* Deliver live sessions and async content so the team is never caught flat-footed on a customer call
* Feed practitioner feedback back to Product, you're the voice of the field

**PS Collateral & Knowledge Base**

* Own the single source of truth for all PS templates: status decks, SteerCo decks, project plans, QBR frameworks, escalation playbooks
* Establish version control and content hygiene - one template, one owner, one place to find it
* Audit the library regularly; retire anything that misleads someone in the field
* Use AI tools to create, repurpose, and update content faster

**You're Right for This If...**

* You've spent 7+ years in SaaS delivery - implementations, onboarding, or CS and have personally owned enterprise customer engagements
* You've built or maintained enablement content before and know the difference between a deck and a learning experience
* You already use AI tools to do your job faster and you're curious about what's next
* You'd rather build the playbook yourself than write a brief about why one is needed
* You get energy from teaching others and from being in the field enough to know what's worth teaching
* You're comfortable presenting to a room of skeptical senior consultants and a customer SteerCo in the same week

**Bonus Points**

* You've enabled or certified an external partner / reseller network
* You have instructional design or structured curriculum experience
* You've worked in a high-growth SaaS environment where the product changes faster than the docs

**What You Won't Find Here**

* A role where you hand off content for someone else to deliver
* A team that's figured it all out - you're building the rails, not riding them
* A manager who needs to tell you what needs fixing

**The Stack You'll Work With**

Rocketlane · Notion · LMS · AI content tools · Close collaboration with Product, CS, and the Professional Services team

**Why join us?**

At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:

**Impact and ownership:**
You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.

**Work with the best:**
We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.

**Celebrate wins:**
Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.

**Learn and grow:**
We’re all about learning—we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and learn a lot about AI.

**Flexibility and balance:**
While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pajamas optional (at least outside the office).

title: EV Charger Installation Supervisor
description:
**Company Description**

EVtron Tech is a startup focused on designing, manufacturing, and deploying electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions for logistics fleets, factories, and commercial facilities.

Our mission is to accelerate India’s transition to sustainable mobility through reliable EV charging hardware, smart charging software, and turnkey deployment solutions.

We manufacture our own EV chargers and develop an in-house Charging Management System (CMS) that enables operators to monitor and manage charging infrastructure through web and mobile platforms.

**Role Description**

We are looking for an
**Installation Supervisor**
to join our growing team and support the installation and commissioning of EV charging infrastructure across customer locations.

This role is ideal for diploma candidates who enjoy field work, coordinating installation activities, and ensuring projects are executed safely and efficiently. The primary responsibility is to supervise installation teams and electricians while ensuring installations are completed as per company standards and project timelines.

The role offers exposure to EV charging infrastructure, electrical installations, customer interactions, commissioning activities, vendor coordination, and end-to-end project execution in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Supervise the installation of EV charging stations at customer sites.
* Coordinate and guide electricians, contractors, and installation teams during project execution.
* Ensure electrical wiring, cable routing, earthing, mounting, and associated installation activities are carried out as per company standards.
* Conduct site inspections and verify site readiness before installation activities begin.
