title: Sr. Partner Operations Manager, Prime Video
description:
**Description**
How often have you had an opportunity to be at ground zero of a disruptive, fast-growing, and revolutionary global Amazon service? How frequently do you get to start from the foundation and solve customer needs at a global scale in a fast-growing entertainment streaming industry? At Prime Video, we are pioneering a new generation of digital supply chain at a remarkable speed to accelerate our market position and global reach. If this sounds interesting, come build the future of streaming entertainment with us!
  
  
Prime Video is a global premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies — all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business — available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic and global environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. The Partner Operations Management (POM) team is looking for a bright, partner-obsessed, driven, and creative individual to join our team in India. POM is responsible for driving a world-class partner experience through enabling partners to deliver assets of all varieties on-time, in full and at the Prime Video quality bar.
  
  
As a Sr. Partner Operations Manager, you will serve as the primary relationship owner for our third-party studios, content distributors, and fulfillment vendors (collectively "partners") in India. You will build and nurture long-term, strategic partnerships — engaging studio executives to influence their supply chain investments, delivery workflows, and feature adoption strategies. You will be the voice of the partner within Prime Video, capturing partner-specific insights and regional nuance to ensure our partners succeed and our customers benefit.
  
  
In this role, you will own the end-to-end partner experience — from driving timely and cost-effective delivery of source materials to identifying improvement opportunities through reporting, data analysis, and innovative workflow enhancements. You will conduct regular partner business reviews, manage complex escalations, and tailor strategies to individual partner contexts across India's diverse content landscape (including SVOD, AVOD, TVOD,Channels, and partner direct business lines). The ability to develop, own, and report on key performance metrics is critical.
  
  
This role will work with executive-level leadership within the streaming community. Internal teams include content acquisition, marketing, engineering, content processing, legal, finance, and accounting teams. External teams vary based on partner and may include marketing, rights management, IT, engineering, localization, compliance, and digital operations teams.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned studio partners in India, building trusted executive-level relationships that influence partner investments in delivery capabilities and content quality
* Conduct trend analysis and deep dives on partner performance against KPI targets to drive perfect delivery to Prime Video
* Act as the voice of the partner — capturing partner-specific feedback, regional nuances, and operational realities to advocate for solutions that enable partner success
* Own and lead regular partner business reviews (WBRs,MBRs, QBRs), translating performance data into actionable strategies tailored to each partner's context
* Manage complex escalations that may span across multiple business units, driving resolution while maintaining strong partner relationships
* Distill insights on partner capabilities to advise and enhance business strategies such as new content and market launches in India
* Drive partner adoption of delivery best practices and new platform capabilities by tailoring strategies to individual partner needs and technical maturity
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, product development, and cost reduction through data analysis and direct partner engagement
* Drive long-term solutions through next-gen automation and AI innovations to complex workflows
* Mentor team members and help develop talent across the organization

A day in the life
  
  

* Engage directly with studio partner executives to understand their priorities, address delivery challenges, and align on strategic goals
* Lead partner performance reviews, using data-driven insights combined with partner context to identify root causes and drive improvements
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure partner feedback is heard and acted upon, influencing how Prime Video builds and evolves its tools and features
* Design workflow strategies for accelerated content delivery in multiple languages and formats across India's diverse content ecosystem, while simplifying and eliminating redundant practices
* Streamline business and technology solutions that strengthen our partnerships while advancing our services
* Work effectively in a team environment and cross-functionally with Prime Video Catalog technology teams, engineers, business teams, analytics, and product

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 7+ years of account management, project or program management or buying experience, or MBA
* Experience communicating results to senior leadership, or experience in building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience building and growing relationships with internal and external partners
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Can work proactively and independently, meet deadlines, and deliver on projects and tasks
* Experience negotiating with internal and external stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree or above in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
* Knowledge of digital video landscape, including solid understanding of digital video distribution technologies
* Experience in analyzing data to drive decisions
* Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
* Experience in the entertainment industry
* Experience building and maintaining relationships with business partners

Support marketing campaigns by ensuring CRM workflows (email, lead scoring, workflows, customer journeys) are set up correctly. title: Team Lead, Provider Data Operations
description:
**Our Mission**
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
**About The Role**
***We’re hiring an AI-first Operations Team Lead; an operations leader who uses AI to build better workflows, not just talk about its potential.***
As a Provider Data Operations Team Lead, you will lead and coach a team while owning productivity, quality, and SLA performance. You will bring clarity to ambiguous problems, remove workflow bottlenecks, and ensure the team executes consistently against operational goals.
  
  
You will also use AI hands-on in your daily work. You’ll identify repetitive or error-prone tasks, test AI-enabled approaches, balance speed with accuracy and human review, and turn successful experiments into repeatable workflows the broader team can adopt safely and effectively.
  
  
**A Day in the Life of a Provider Data Operations Team Lead:**

* Use AI to Improve Daily Operations: Use AI tools hands-on to analyze problems, accelerate routine work, summarize information, improve data quality, and support better decisions. Regularly ask where a manual workflow can be simplified, automated, or redesigned.
* Identify, Pilot & Scale AI-Enabled Solutions: Spot high-value opportunities to reduce repetitive work or prevent errors. Design practical pilots, define success measures, evaluate results, and partner with AI, Product, Systems, and Operations teams to turn proven ideas into sustainable workflows.
* Balance Speed, Accuracy & Human Review: Apply sound judgment to determine where AI can operate independently and where human validation is required. Monitor output quality, surface risks, and ensure AI-enabled processes remain accurate, explainable, and aligned with established guardrails.
* Lead Team Execution & Daily Operations: Oversee day-to-day operations for a team of 8-10 Researchers, Associates, and Senior Associates. Provide clear direction on case handling, workflow interpretation, and complex troubleshooting to deliver consistently against productivity, quality, and SLA targets.
* Manage Workflows & Drive Throughput: Own workload distribution, proactively identify bottlenecks, and reallocate work to maintain flow and meet operational goals. Independently manage complex workstreams with minimal supervision.
* Ensure Quality & Process Adherence: Provide quality oversight through case reviews, audits, and trend analysis. Ensure consistent application of SOPs and policies, address escalations, and maintain high standards across both human and AI-assisted outputs.
* Coach & Develop Team Members: Deliver coaching tailored to individual strengths and development areas. Support onboarding, training, and continuous skill-building, including helping team members use AI tools confidently, responsibly, and effectively.
* Lead Change & Drive Adoption: Translate new tools and pilots into clear operating guidance. Gather team feedback, address adoption barriers, and reinforce the behaviors needed to make improved workflows stick.
* Partner with Stakeholders in India and the US: Build strong cross-functional relationships, align on priorities and success measures, manage expectations, and escalate appropriately to ensure smooth execution across time zones.
* Navigate Ambiguity & Drive Continuous Improvement: Break ambiguous problems into clear next steps, use data and experimentation to learn quickly, and create repeatable processes from successful solutions.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in data operations, business operations, analytics, research, or customer service. People management experience is preferred; however, strong individual contributors with hands-on AI or automation experience and demonstrated readiness to transition into a leadership role will also be considered.
* An AI-native approach to problem-solving: you naturally explore whether manual work can be improved, automated, or supported by AI.
* Experience using Claude is a plus.
* Hands-on experience in building AI-enabled tools, agents, workflow automations, or data/process automation solutions to solve business or operational problems.
* Ability to evaluate AI output critically, recognize limitations, and design appropriate human-review checks to protect accuracy and data quality.
* Demonstrated ability to turn experiments into documented, measurable, repeatable workflows and coach others through change.
* Strong operations leadership, including workload management, performance coaching, SLA ownership, quality oversight, and escalation handling.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to use data to diagnose problems and measure impact.
* Curious, hands-on, and quick to learn new tools; comfortable experimenting within defined guardrails.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace applications, plus experience with tools such as Salesforce and Confluence and the ability to work with large data sets.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a track record of building engaged, adaptable, and high-performing teams.
* A Bachelor’s degree from a reputed institution with a strong academic record.
* Experience in US healthcare or healthcare technology is a plus.
* Experience working across global or cross-time-zone teams, particularly India and the US, is a plus.

**You do not need to be an engineer or an AI researcher.**
You should be excited to learn, willing to experiment hands-on, and motivated to use AI to make operations faster, more accurate, and easier to scale.
  
  
**Benefits**

* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare/creche facility for kids
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check-ups
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2025-2026

**About Us**
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.
  
  
Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values -

**Role Summary**
The Principal Technology Portfolio Lead is a senior strategic leadership role responsible for overseeing the planning, forecasting, governance, optimization , and financial management of the organization's technology portfolio across Infrastructure, Cloud, Applications, Cybersecurity, Data Platforms, and Enterprise Technology Services.
  
  
This role serves as the critical bridge between Technology Leadership, Finance, Vendor Management, Procurement, and Business stakeholders to ensure effective management of both Capital ( CapEx ) and Operating Expenses ( OpEx ). The individual will drive financial transparency, portfolio optimization, investment prioritization, cost efficiency initiatives, and long-range technology financial planning.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong financial acumen with deep understanding of technology domains including cloud computing, infrastructure, applications, software engineering, software licensing, hardware lifecycle management, data center services, and managed services. They must possess the ability to influence senior leaders and drive strategic decisions through data-driven insights and innovative financial management practices.

**Technology Portfolio Financial Management**

* Own and manage the end-to-end technology financial portfolio across Infrastructure, Cloud, Application Development, Cybersecurity, Data Platforms, and Enterprise Services.
* Lead annual budget planning, quarterly forecasting, monthly financial reviews, and multi-year strategic financial planning processes.
* Develop and maintain technology investment roadmaps aligned with business and enterprise technology strategies.
* Create financial models to support investment decisions, business cases, technology transformations, and modernization initiatives.

title: Eng Pgm Manager -Sustainability
description: Job DescriptionThe ideal candidate will lead, coach, and guide a motivated, high-performing engineering team with clear objectives, accountability, and a strong culture of collaboration, innovation, and execution excellence. Plan resources, assign priorities, remove delivery barriers, and enable the team to meet quality, schedule, productivity, and cost commitments across design, engineering, testing, and site support, with a focus on compliance with industry standards and grid codes.Responsibilities RESPONSIBILITIES Project Design and Engineering: Participate in project design and detailed engineering. Understand and create Single Line Diagrams for Electrical Networks and Switchgear components. Prepare Bills of Materials (BOM), Functional Design Specifications (FDS), Heat Load/Current Load Calculations, General Arrangement (GA) drawings, and Input/Output (IO) assignments. Power Plant Controller and Power Management Systems: Lead the architecture, design, integration, testing, and commissioning of PPC and PMS solutions for PV solar, wind, BESS, utility, and industrial applications, including Front-of-the-Meter projects and compliance with the Indian Grid Code. Develop and validate control functions for voltage and frequency regulation, active and reactive power control, LVRT, HVRT, black start, load sharing, peak shaving, demand management, generation scheduling, grid synchronization, load shedding, and energy optimization. Integrate PPC and PMS with SCADA, Energy Management Systems, protection relays, meters, generators, renewable sources, and third-party equipment while ensuring interoperability, cybersecurity, safety, and regulatory compliance. Sustainability Projects: Lead sustainability and decarbonization projects, including renewable energy integration, energy-efficiency improvement, electrification, microgrids, and emissions-reduction initiatives. Conduct technical and commercial assessments, establish energy and carbon baselines, define measurable sustainability targets, and track project performance and benefits realization. Collaborate with customers, suppliers, consultants, and cross-functional teams to develop scalable, cost-effective sustainability solutions aligned with business objectives and applicable environmental requirements. Testing, Compliance, Simulation, and Modeling: Develop test procedures, conduct demonstrations aligned with grid-code requirements, and perform PSCAD and PSSE model simulations for renewable energy projects. SCADA and PLC/RTU Engineering: Prepare and configure SCADA databases and execute PLC/RTU programming using Function Block and Structured Text languages. Electrical Systems, Communications, and Integration: Design HV/MV/LV electrical networks to applicable engineering standards and integrate protection relays, IEDs, switchgear, SCADA, and third-party devices. Apply IEC 61850, IEC 60870-101/104, ICCP, OPC, DNP3, Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, and other relevant communication protocols. Project Delivery and Customer Coordination: Participate in Pre-FAT, FAT, and Integrated FAT (I-FAT) with EPCs and end users; coordinate project updates, work assignments, and customer requirements. Travel to global sites as required to support project execution. Site Installation Supervision: Supervise installation and commissioning of BESS projects, including Containers, Power Conversion Systems (PCS), HVAC, and power cabling. Oversee BESS Container and Module installation, jumper connections, and battery module installations. Interface with 3rd party vendors to ensure effective collaboration. Supervise installations of high-voltage DC panels & systems, ensuring adherence to design specifications. Prepare As-Built drawings and documentation, including cable schedules as per site modifications. Monitor contractor progress and manage site operations.9 . Solution Consultancy And Market Alignment Lead solution consultancy engagements to understand customer needs and translate business and technical requirements into competitive, scalable, and compliant BESS and PPC solutions. Identify market trends, customer feedback, and application gaps; collaborate with Product Management and Engineering to drive product enhancements that strengthen product-market fit.10 . Productivity And Cost Optimization Drive engineering productivity through standardization, reuse, automation, and continuous improvement of design and delivery processes. Develop technically robust, cost-optimized solutions by evaluating architecture alternatives, lifecycle costs, risks, and value-engineering opportunities without compromising safety, quality, or compliance.11 . Sales And Customer Support Partner with Sales to support opportunity qualification, solution positioning, technical proposals, bid responses, and customer presentations. Deliver clear and persuasive technical presentations, solution demonstrations, and workshops that communicate business value and address customer requirements. Training, Certification, and Capability Development: Develop a role-based training and certification plan through an EMS Engineering consultant, covering required competencies, proficiency levels, assessment criteria, and certification pathways. Establish Share & Learn sessions led by Offering Management (OM) on the offering portfolio, customer needs, competitive landscape, and market benchmarking. Organize cross-functional Share & Learn sessions led by Technical Support Centre (TSC) and Operations on project execution, lessons learned, commissioning experience, and field best practices. Implement Grid Compliance and PSCAD training and certification pathways for TSC, R&D, and Engineering teams, with practical case studies and project-based assessments. Build a curated learning plan using internal subject-matter experts, supplemented by specialist providers such as Power Projects India and LTTS. Explore partnerships with engineering consultants, universities/research institutions, and Power Projects India to co-develop customized curricula, hands-on labs, mentoring, and certification programs. Define an annual training calendar, participant cohorts, completion targets, skill assessments, and effectiveness measures to track capability improvement and application on live projects. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Enable effective collaboration across Offering Management, Solution Consultants, R&D, Integrated Supply Chain (ISC), Services, and Legal to align customer requirements, solution architecture, product capabilities, sourcing and delivery constraints, serviceability, contractual obligations, risk, and compliance throughout the opportunity and project lifecycle. Establish clear ownership, decision forums, communication cadence, and timely escalation mechanisms to accelerate decisions, manage interdependencies, reduce rework, and ensure coordinated execution from bid and design through commissioning and lifecycle support.QualificationsBasic Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (B.E. Electrical/B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering). 12+ years of relevant technical experience in the delivery of electrical projects, including electrical systems and panel boards. Prior experience in data center electrical design or energy storage integration is a plus. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. Customer-focused with a collaborative mindset and adaptability to changing environments. Self-motivated and capable of functioning with minimal supervision. Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams in a diverse and global environment.Preferred Qualifications In-depth understanding of BESS project design and delivery, including resolution of site technical issues. Experience in reviewing customer and engineering design requirements and creating project scope documents, technical reports, and proposals. Proven track record in delivering renewable energy systems, particularly BESS and photovoltaic (PV) systems. Experience in the design and deployment of Power Management Systems, Energy Management Systems, microgrids, or hybrid power systems. Demonstrated experience delivering sustainability, energy-efficiency, decarbonization, or renewable-integration projects with measurable business and environmental outcomes. Knowledgeable about inverters and DC converters within BESS projects, including inverter controls and operational standards. Proficient in analyzing single-line drawings, system studies, and protective relay settings applicable to renewable projects. Familiarity with industry standards and grid codes relevant to electrical power systems. Experience with power engineering modeling software such as ETAP or SKM. Proficient in modeling using Excel, Homer, and/or Matlab and interpreting simulation results.About UsHoneywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Transition Management & Value Realization Officer
description:
**Why Mizuho**

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone.

It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who share the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest banks in the world.

**About the Team:**

The Operating Services team is a central function that supports Mizuho Pune by driving operational efficiency, governance, and process standardization. The team integrates key enabling capabilities, including Chief of Staff, COO support, Business Management, Transition Management & Value / Benefits Realization (TMO) and Communications.

It provides structured oversight to ensure consistent execution of transitions, knowledge transfer, and change initiatives, while maintaining strong adherence to internal policies, controls, and risk management frameworks. Through its integrated approach, the team enables effective demand management, enhances operational performance, and supports the delivery of strategic priorities across Mizuho Pune.

**Summary:**

In this role, you will support Value Realization (including benefits realization) by tracking and driving value delivery across strategic initiatives. Additionally, the role involves planning, governing, supporting and monitoring transitions, ensuring Day-1 readiness, and providing actionable insights to mitigate risks and optimize operational continuity. You need to ensure outcomes from approved business cases are clearly defined, tracked, and realized.

Responsibilities include coordinating transition activities, tracking knowledge transfer, supporting governance forums, and enabling standardization across functions and regions. The role requires to collaborate closely with global leaders, HR, Facilities, and IT service management teams to identify risks, monitor KPIs, and communicate progress and outcomes to senior stakeholders. The role also covers value tracking, governance, and insights to improve transparency, support decision-making, and drive accountability.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in transition management, SDLC lifecycle, knowledge management and value tracking, with the ability to engage stakeholders across global teams. Strong analytical skills, stakeholder engagement, attention to detail, and effective communication are critical to success in this role.

**Responsibilities:**

* Apply and refine the Value / Benefits Realization framework, including value drivers, metrics, and standard templates across programs and towers
* Track business case baselines, assumptions, and value targets; monitor variances and highlight deviations
* Monitor realization of benefits (cost, productivity, efficiency, etc.) for the GCC; drive the definition and measurement of the metrics; identify risks or gaps and support corrective actions
* Define transition scope, timelines, drive transition execution by managing detailed plans, including RAID logs, RACI, and structured status reporting to ensure visibility and control across all workstreams. Identify and actively manage transition risks, dependencies, and critical path items; define mitigation plans and drive timely escalation
* Maintain comprehensive documentation covering transition plans, stage gate approvals, KT outputs, decisions, lessons learned, and post-transition evaluations. Maintain structured documentation of business cases, assumptions, and tracking outputs to ensure consistency and traceability
* Support governance forums by preparing dashboards using reporting tools like PowerBI, progress updates, and insights for leadership reviews and decision-making, providing a clear view of baseline vs actuals, key variances, and actions. Identify improvements in tracking, reporting, or processes to enhance visibility and efficiency.
* Identify and highlight value leakage drivers (e.g., transition delays, extended overlap, scope changes) and work with stakeholders on mitigation
* Collaborate with Business, Finance, and Delivery teams to align value tracking with transition plans, hiring progress, and key milestones.
* Act as the central coordination point for all transition activities, enabling structured communication and alignment across global stakeholders
* Continuously review transition processes to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and delays; implement improvements, standardization, and automation where applicable

**Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of experience in transition management and value realization within global banking environments. Experience leading multi-wave, global, or offshore transitions.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in IT, Engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA preferred
* Experience tracking business cases, benefits realization, and performance metrics across programs or portfolios
* Proficiency with reporting/dashboarding tools like PowerBI
* Hands-on experience managing the end-to-end transition lifecycle including planning, knowledge transfer, assessments, cutover, and hyper-care. Experience developing SOPs, process maps, RACI matrices, and transition dashboards.
* Exposure to transition or large-scale change programs preferred (e.g., GCC, offshoring, transformation initiatives)
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across IT, HR, Finance, and global delivery teams. Experience facilitating workshops and executive reviews.
* Strong analytical skills to identify risks, resolve issues, and ensure operational readiness, and ability to interpret data and highlight clear insights. Attention to detail in monitoring KPIs and operational readiness.
* Proactive in adopting best practices and driving process improvements through new tools and techniques. Experience tracking business cases, benefits realization, and performance metrics across programs or portfolios
* Experience working with dashboards, reporting tools, and financial data. Ability to prepare structured governance materials and communicate clearly in leadership forums

**Company Overview:**

Mizuho Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Based in India, Mizuho Pune supports Mizuho’s international businesses by delivering high-quality, scalable, and resilient services across multiple functions.

Mizuho Pune plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, standardization, and innovation for Mizuho Americas. By combining deep domain expertise with strong process, technology, and analytical capabilities, it partners closely with regional and global teams to support corporate and investment banking, capital markets, and corporate services functions, while adhering to the highest standards of risk management, regulatory compliance, and control.

Mizuho Pune offers competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with industry standards and local market practices.

Mizuho Pune is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

Employment is subject to applicable background verification checks in accordance with Indian laws and company policies.

title: Technical Change Manager
description:
**Exp must 6 to 10 years, Location Pune, Delhi**

**Job Description (JD) – Change Manager**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced
**Technical Change Manager**
with strong expertise in
**ITIL Change Management, ServiceNow, Automation, AI-driven Operations, and Process Innovation**
. The role will be responsible for governing technical changes across infrastructure, cloud, applications, and security environments while driving automation-led transformation initiatives to improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, and enhance service quality.

The ideal candidate should possess a combination of
**technical governance, process consulting, automation strategy, and continuous improvement capabilities**
with experience in implementing AI/ML, RPA, ServiceNow workflows, and operational excellence programs.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Change Management Governance**

* Lead and govern the end-to-end Change Management process aligned with ITIL best practices.
* Chair Change Advisory Board (CAB) and Emergency CAB meetings.
* Review, assess, and approve infrastructure, cloud, application, security, and database changes.
* Ensure all changes adhere to risk, compliance, security, and audit requirements.
* Drive change success rate improvement and reduction of change-related incidents.

**Automation & Process Innovation**

* Identify automation opportunities across IT Operations and Service Management processes.
* Design and implement workflow automation using ServiceNow, RPA, AI/ML, Power Platform, or similar platforms.
* Develop automation roadmaps to reduce manual effort and operational risks.

* ServiceNow Now Assist
* AIOps
* Predictive Intelligence
* Automated Risk Assessment
* Intelligent Change Approval

**Process Transformation & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead ITSM process maturity and optimization initiatives.
* Conduct process assessments and implement best practices across Change, Incident, Problem, Release, and Request Management.
* Apply Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, and Design Thinking methodologies to improve operational efficiency.
* Drive continual service improvement (CSI) initiatives through data-driven decision-making.
* Establish process KPIs and implement monitoring frameworks.

**Technical Risk & Impact Assessment**

* Evaluate high-risk and enterprise-wide technical changes.
* Validate implementation, testing, rollback, and recovery plans.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cloud, Security, DevOps, and Application teams to assess change impacts.
* Implement automated risk scoring and compliance validation mechanisms.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with customers, business leaders, technical teams, and service delivery managers.
* Present automation and transformation strategies to stakeholders.
* Lead workshops, process reviews, and governance meetings.
* Communicate major changes and transformation initiatives effectively.

**Metrics & Reporting**

* Define and track key operational metrics including:
* Change Success Rate
* Failed Change Rate
* Emergency Change Percentage
* Automation Coverage %
* Manual Effort Reduction
* Productivity Gains
* Cost Savings through Automation
* Service Improvement KPIs

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of IT Infrastructure, Cloud, Applications, and Security Operations.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow ITSM and Change Management modules.
* Experience with ServiceNow Flow Designer, Integration Hub, and Automation Engine.
* Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure Automation, and AIOps platforms.
* Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Familiarity with scripting and automation technologies:
* PowerShell
* Python
* REST APIs
* Power Automate
* RPA Tools (UiPath, Automation Anywhere)

**Process & Governance Expertise**

* Strong understanding of:
* ITIL v4
* Change Enablement
* Release Management
* Service Transition
* Continual Service Improvement
* Experience designing enterprise-wide automation frameworks.
* Expertise in process re-engineering and service transformation programs.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong consulting and stakeholder management abilities.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to influence senior leadership and customer stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
* Leadership experience managing cross-functional global teams.

**Preferred Certifications**

* ITIL v4 Managing Professional / Strategic Leader
* ServiceNow CSA
* ServiceNow CIS-ITSM
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt / Black Belt
* PMP / PRINCE2
* Agile Scrum Certification
* Microsoft Power Platform Certification
* Azure/AWS Cloud Certifications

**Experience Requirements**

* 6-to 10+ years of experience in IT Infrastructure, Service Management, or IT Operations.
* 5+ years of experience in Change Management and Governance.
* Proven experience delivering automation, AI, and process transformation initiatives.
* Experience working with large enterprise customers and global delivery environments.
* Strong background in ServiceNow-based transformation programs.

**Key Success Measures**

* Increased Change Success Rate (>98%)
* Reduction in Emergency Changes
* Improved Operational Efficiency through Automation
* Reduction in Manual Effort and MTTR
* Increased Process Compliance and Audit Readiness
* Tangible Cost Savings and Productivity Improvements
* Higher Customer Satisfaction and Service Reliability

This profile is ideal for organizations seeking a
**Technical Change Manager who can combine governance, ServiceNow expertise, AI/Automation adoption, and process innovation to drive operational transformation.**

title: Strategy Consultant
description:
**Position:**
Program Manager – Urban Initiative

**Location:**
Delhi

**An initiative supported by The Convergence Foundation**

**About URBAN Project**

India is urbanising rapidly, and its cities are where the country's economic future will be decided. Services already form the largest part of the Indian economy, and well-functioning cities are essential to sustaining services-led growth and creating jobs at scale. Yet urbanisation in India has often been unplanned and under-resourced, leaving cities struggling with weak planning, a difficult business environment, fragmented governance, and chronic under-financing. Getting urbanisation right – rapid yet sustainable – is one of the highest-leverage opportunities for India's economic transformation.

The Urban Initiative is supported by The Convergence Foundation, the Urban Initiative is being established to help India build the policy ecosystem needed to drive economic growth through rapid and sustainable urbanisation. It will work systemically—developing policy perspectives and partnering with the government to advance reform—rather than engaging in on-ground implementation. Its work will be organised around four interconnected pillars:

* **Regional economic and spatial planning:**
  Creating regional economic plans that feed into better, more growth-oriented master plans for cities and their surrounding regions.
* **Ease of doing business:**
  Enabling more sensible development control norms and regulations that make it easier to build, invest and do business in cities.
* **Governance:**
  Strengthening how cities are managed, including the devolution of power to empowered, accountable city governments.
* **Financing:**
  Ensuring cities are adequately funded and well managed – through better allocation of public money, raising local resources, and involving the private sector through PPP and other models.

Across each pillar, the initiative will build a strong policy perspective, drawing on best practices from better-run Indian cities as well as relevant global examples. It will work closely with the central government – including NITI Aayog and the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) – to drive policy change at the national level, and with state and city governments where there is genuine interest and appetite for reform. The initiative will remain a small, high-quality team focused on ideas, influence and partnerships rather than implementation.

**Position Summary**

The Economic growth team works with internal and external stakeholders on cross functional projects. This role sits within the team's Urban Development initiative, which explores emerging issues and whitespaces in the urban development policy ecosystem. The Program Manager (PM) should have strong problem-solving skills, secondary research capabilities and analytical prowess. In addition, as well as excellent oral & written communication skills. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a bias towards action and the ability to work with ambiguous requirements. The PM will have a steep learning curve and would be expected to hit the ground running on live projects with Government institutions.

**Areas of Work:**

The Program Manager will:

* Work with Economic Growth team and leadership to identify and scope priority areas in the urban development policy ecosystem, with a focus on ease of doing business in cities, urban finance, and city planning
* Engage in dipstick secondary research to diagnose binding constraints in issue areas and develop initial hypotheses around opportunities for impact (e.g. which regulatory constraints, if solved for, can improve ease of doing business in a city)
* Develop evidence-based benchmarking frameworks to compare cities on regulatory performance and identify opportunities to streamline approvals, improve governance, and accelerate urban economic growth
* Engage with policymakers, urban practitioners, and other ecosystem stakeholders to validate findings, refine priorities, and build partnerships
* Oversee the creation of knowledge material across priority areas by identifying potential partners, developing terms of reference and managing projects to their completion
* Provide continued program/grant support to organisations, programs or public goods that might stem as a result of the scoping exercise

**Required Qualifications, Skills and Abilities**

* Undergraduate or masters degrees from top tier institutions. While there is no preference for a particular major or specialisation, prior experience in urban development or related sectors will be preferred
* Up to 4 years of work experience in a consulting or challenging/ high growth environment
* Excellent analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills
* Solid planning and organisational skills with high attention to detail, accuracy, protocol and deadline
* Excellent writing ability that is clear, concise and analytic in style
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder-facing skills including solid presentation and facilitation skills
* High level of flexibility and responsiveness with the ability to shift priorities quickly and as organisational demands require
* Ability to do research and distil important concepts in a structured, concise, yet comprehensive manner
* Operating style suited to working in a small-organisation setting, where teamwork and resourcefulness are highly valued

**Compensation**

Remuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy pay scales and will depend upon the candidate's experience

**Location**

New Delhi, India

title: Founder's Office (Psychologist)
description:
About Antahā

Antahā is a global movement creating micro-communities across major cities to address loneliness at scale. It is built on three core values: Compassion, Connection, Community.

The ambition is large. The method is intimate. Loneliness is not solved by reach alone, by digital tools, or by any system that removes the human from the centre. It is solved by people who actually show up — for one another, for an evening, for a quiet space to belong in.

**About the Work**

Founder, Sitender is a teacher shaped by years of monastic living in the Himalayas. His work spans teaching, hosting signature events and intimate gatherings, and private one-on-one consulting. It is active across UAE, the US, NZ, and scaling fast across cities and continents.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Founder's Office Manager to be the operational spine of everything Sitender does — the bridge between Sitender and the world. You will hold the whole picture, ensure nothing is dropped, and protect the founder's time for the work only he can do: teaching, hosting, and building.

This role calls for a grounding in psychology. Much of the work is human: reading a room, understanding what a participant or private client needs, handling sensitive relationships with care, and shaping experiences that feel safe and meaningful. Your training helps you understand people, not treat them. This is a non-clinical role.

You will run the day-to-day across the founder's speaking and teaching calendar, marketing, and social media assisted by interns — the full surface area of a founder's office. This role suits someone equal parts organised and intuitive: able to manage a tour spreadsheet down to the last detail and to sense what a moment, a room, or a relationship needs. You will work closely with a distributed team across India, Europe, and the US.

What You Will Do

• Own end-to-end event logistics — venues, vendors, travel, run-of-show, and on-ground coordination for events, gatherings, and retreats

• Manage the founder's speaking and teaching calendar — inbound requests, scheduling, preparation, and follow-up

• Bring a psychological lens to participant and client experience — onboarding, follow-up, feedback, and noticing when someone needs more care or a referral

• Help design and refine gatherings and programs with an understanding of group dynamics, belonging, and emotional safety

• Drive marketing execution across channels — campaigns, partner briefs, content scheduling, and asset coordination

• Run social media end-to-end — posting, community engagement, growth, and a consistent voice and aesthetic

• Coordinate across a distributed team and external collaborators in multiple time zones

• Keep the founder's office moving — inbox triage, prioritisation, and making sure projects don't stall

• Anticipate needs before they arise, so the founder can stay present to the work

**Who You Are**

Essential

• A degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Psychology, Counselling, or a closely related field

• 3+ years in operations, executive support, chief-of-staff, or founder's office roles

• An exceptional organiser who thrives across many moving parts without losing the details

• A strong written communicator with a feel for brand voice and visual consistency

• Comfortable delegating social media and marketing execution

• Calm under pressure, discreet, and self-directed — you don't need to be managed

• Drawn to the work of stillness and inner growth, and at ease in a space that values presence over noise

**Preferred**

• Experience supporting a founder, executive, or public-facing figure

• Experience in counselling, organisational psychology, wellbeing programs, or community and group facilitation

• A background in events, hospitality, or a fast-moving operation

• Willing to travel to the UAE, US

• A personal practice in meditation, somatic work, or related modalities

• Multilingual (Italian, Arabic, or others a plus)

**Personal Qualities**

• You hold complexity calmly — many threads at once, nothing dropped

• Quiet confidence and sound judgement; people trust you with what matters

• Discretion, depth, and integrity in all things

• A genuine desire to grow through this work, inwardly as well as professionally

**What You Receive**

• Competitive compensation, with structure and benefits discussed directly based on experience and location

• A rare seat at the centre of a growing body of work — teaching, events, and a movement being planted across cities worldwide

• Direct collaboration with the founder and a depth of perspective few roles offer

• Access to all events and sessions as a participant — your own growth is part of the role

• Room to grow as the work expands across the US, Europe, the Gulf, and beyond

**Education & Background**

A background in psychology is essential. Beyond that, we care less about where you studied and more about who you are: your capability, character, and care. We're looking for someone whose reliability and judgement have shaped the path they've walked, however unconventional that path has been.

Compensation & Onboarding

The role begins with an 8-week probation period, paid at a mutually agreed figure while we find our rhythm and see the work in motion. On successful completion, based on performance and delivery, you'll step into the role permanently with a full CTC upwards of 6 LPA, negotiable for the right profile and growing as the work expands across cities.

To Apply

Send a personal note to hello@antaha.org — not just a CV. Tell us who you are, what draws you to this work, and why this role calls to you. We won't respond to generic applications; we're looking for a specific kind of human being, and we'll know when we find them.

Without the personal note, we will not be responding to your application.

www.antaha.org

www.sitendersehrawat.com

We are seeking an experienced and proactive professional to lead government liaison, regulatory coordination and approvals for aviation-related projects, including the establishment of Flight Training Organisations (FTOs) in India.

* Demonstrated experience in government liaison, regulatory affairs or regulatory coordination, preferably within aviation or infrastructure.

* Experience engaging with government departments and managing applications, permissions and regulatory documentation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong drafting capabilities in English and Hindi.
* Strong stakeholder management, follow-up, organisational and problem-solving skills.
* Willingness to travel to Delhi and project sites as required.

* Prior involvement in establishing an FTO or obtaining DGCA FTO/ATO approvals.
* Experience working with DGCA, AAI, BCAS or state civil aviation departments.
* Exposure to aerodrome development, land permissions, government MoUs or aviation infrastructure projects.
* An educational or professional background in aviation, aviation management, aircraft operations or a related field.

title: Project Head

Job Overview

As the Project Head, you will be responsible for overseeing the end-to-end execution of client projects across social media marketing, performance marketing, and website development. You will act as the primary point of coordination between clients and internal teams, ensuring that deliverables are completed on time, within scope, and in line with client objectives.

About People Matters

People Matters is a leading HR and talent-focused media and community platform serving business leaders across India and Southeast Asia. We partner with CEOs, CHROs, Tech Leaders and senior decision-makers to drive conversations around talent strategy, leadership, and the future of work.

Through high-impact physical conferences, large-scale virtual summits, roundtables, research-led initiatives, and digital properties, People Matters enables meaningful engagement between brands and the HR ecosystem.

We combine community, content, and curated experiences to help organizations strengthen their employer brand and business impact.

Role Overview

We are looking for a dynamic and detail-oriented Event Operations Manager/Assistant Manager to lead the planning and execution of People Matters’ conferences and new experiences & Initiatives.

The role will be responsible for managing the end-to-end event operations lifecycle — from planning, budgeting and vendor management to on-ground execution and post-event closure.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in managing B2B events, conferences, corporate events, or large-scale experiences and should be comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Event Planning & Execution

● Own the end-to-end operational planning and execution of physical, virtual, and hybrid events.

● Develop detailed event plans covering timelines, logistics, production, staffing, vendors, and on-ground requirements.

● Coordinate with internal teams including Sales, Client Servicing, Content, Marketing, and Design to ensure seamless event delivery.

● Ensure all event deliverables are executed as per agreed timelines, scope, and quality standards.

● Manage production agencies, AV partners, venues, F&B, fabrication, branding, logistics, travel, and other event suppliers.

● Ensure vendor deliverables meet agreed quality, timelines, and commercial commitments.

● Build a reliable and cost-effective vendor ecosystem.

3. Budget & Cost Management

● Prepare and manage event budgets in line with approved commercial plans.

● Track event expenses, purchase orders, invoices, and vendor payments.

● Identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising the attendee or client experience.

● Monitor event profitability and ensure operational decisions are aligned with business objectives.

4. On-Ground Operations & Experience

● Lead on-ground event operations and ensure smooth execution across all touchpoints.

● Manage venue setup, registration, stage and production, branding, seating, F&B, hospitality, transportation, and attendee movement.

● Coordinate with venue teams and vendors to resolve real-time operational challenges.

● Ensure a high-quality experience for speakers, delegates, partners, and other stakeholders.

5. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Management

● Work closely with internal stakeholders to understand event objectives and translate them into operational plans.

● Coordinate with speakers, delegates, partners, venues, vendors, and external agencies.

● Maintain clear communication and timely updates across stakeholders.

● Anticipate operational risks and proactively develop contingency plans.

6. Post-Event Closure & Reporting

● Ensure timely post-event closure, including vendor reconciliation, documentation, and financial settlements.

● Conduct post-event reviews to identify learnings and improvement areas.

● Track operational KPIs and event performance metrics.

● Maintain event documentation, vendor databases, checklists, and standard operating processes.

Experience & Skills

● 2–6 years of experience in Event Operations, Conference Management, Event Production, Experiential Marketing, or related roles.

● Proven experience managing end-to-end B2B events, conferences, roundtables, or corporate events.

● Strong vendor management and negotiation skills.

● Hands-on experience with event logistics, production, AV, fabrication, venues, F&B, and attendee management.

● Good understanding of event budgeting, cost control, and commercial management.

● Ability to manage multiple events, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.

● Strong planning and organisational skills.

● High attention to detail and ownership mindset.

● Strong problem-solving and crisis-management abilities.

● Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

● Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

● Solution-oriented and proactive approach.

● Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Why Join Us?

● Opportunity to work with top HR and business leaders across India & Southeast Asia.

description:
**About Atari**
Founded in 1972, Atari is one of the world’s most iconic consumer brands and a pioneer in the video game industry, recognized worldwide for its multi-platform games and licensed products. Atari owns and/or manages a portfolio of more than 400 games and franchises, including globally recognized brands such as Asteroids®, Centipede®, Missile Command®, Pong®, and RollerCoaster Tycoon®.
  
  
The Atari family of brands includes Digital Eclipse, Nightdive Studios, Infogrames, AtariAge, MobyGames, as well as Coatsink, Early Morning Studios, and Stormteller Games—spanning game development, publishing, and community experiences worldwide. Today, Atari Inc. continues to build on its legacy by developing games, hardware, and experiences that honor the past while driving innovation for the future.
  
  
Over the past two years, we've been building Atari India, a growing team that plays a critical role in supporting our global operations. We're proud of the team we've assembled so far, and we’re just getting started. As part of a lean, high-impact organization, the team in India works closely with colleagues in North America and Europe on projects that move the company forward. Whether you're helping launch a new game, keeping our infrastructure secure, or supporting day-to-day operations, your work here matters. Join us as we continue to grow Atari India and build the future of a legendary brand.
  
  
Position: Game Producer : Platform GamesExperience: 3–6 years Location: Remote (requires core overlap with Europe/India time zones)Employment Type: Contractual(3 months)
  
  
**Overview**
We're reimagining Atari's classic arcade catalog as short-session games for Reddit, MSN and emerging channels. We need a Game Producer to own the pipeline end to end, shaping game strategy, turning concepts into shipped live titles, and keeping developers, designers, QA and external studios moving in sync.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Own each title across its full lifecycle: strategy, concept, production, testing, launch and live-ops
* Shape game strategy and pitch new concepts and IP for the roster
* Coordinate internal developers/designers and external studios, unblocking the team to hit timelines
* Run agile/scrum planning: sprint schedules, standups and roadmap tracking across multiple titles at once
* Own and keep the game tracker/dashboard current: status, ownership, timelines
* Manage platform partner relationships (Reddit, MSN): format, submission and certification
* Manage external studio and vendor relationships, and drive IP intake and rights clearance with legal/licensing
* Own KPIs (games live, revenue/daily player, engagement) and drive initiatives to improve them; report weekly
* Manage risk across game timelines: flag slippage early and drive mitigation and release management
* Scout new IP and channels (Discord, YouTube Playables, Telegram) for expansion

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 3+ years as a game producer/associate producer (casual, mobile or browser games)
* Shipped games end to end, managing both internal and external/outsourced teams
* Working knowledge of Unity and HTML5 pipelines, and staying current with platform game technology
* Hands-on experience with agile/scrum planning and sprint scheduling in a live production pipeline
* Strong PM and communication skills; comfortable juggling multiple titles at once
* Experience with platform partner launch/certification requirements
* Experience managing external studio/vendor relationships and timeline risk

**Preferred**

* Passion for retro/arcade gaming and the Atari IP library
* Comfort using data (dashboards, revenue-per-player) to make ship/stop calls

Why Join Us?
  
  

* Build in gaming, not just hire for it: real ownership and direct access to leadership
* Hybrid, flexible, trust-driven environment
* Zero-cost comprehensive medical cover
* Ambitious, collaborative, genuinely fun team

title: Senior AI & Decision Science Engineer
description:
**OUR STORY**
**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**
**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**
**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**
**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**
**Full-Stack AI & Automation Engineer**
**Human Resources - Strategic Planning & Analytics CoE**
**About The Team & Your Role**
Strategic Planning & Analytics team is architected to move beyond traditional HR, functioning as a strategic engine that fuels ST’s growth through five specialized pillars: Business Partnerships, Products & AI, Workforce Insights, Data Science, and Workforce Planning Architecture. We are currently in an ambitious build-phase, moving away from legacy processes to create a sophisticated, tech-enabled function that mirrors the engineering excellence of the semiconductor industry. We don’t want to just manage headcount; we want to orchestrate the future of HR using AI.
  
  
As a member of this team, you won’t be working in a silo. You will be at the intersection of human capital and advanced technology, leveraging AI and data science to solve complex organizational challenges and expected to be a foundational builder. We are looking for pioneers to help us design and implement our first generation of advanced analytics and AI-driven products. You won't just be using technology—you will be architecting the roadmap, selecting the tools, and establishing the frameworks that will define how ST manages its global talent for years to come. If you are energized by the challenge of redefining the "H" in HR through the lens of data and innovation, you’ve found the right place.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* End-to-End AI Prototyping: Architect, build, and deploy conversational bots and transactional AI agents from scratch in a sandbox environment.
* Workflow Orchestration & Automation: Design and manage complex, multi-system automation workflows using tools like n8n to automate actions (e.g., orchestrating system lookups, mock API executions, and conditional task routing).
* LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering: Integrate prototypes securely with internal OpenAI/ChatGPT APIs, mastering prompt design, function calling, tool use, and state management.
* Interface & UI/UX Evolution: Build lightweight, responsive web interfaces (e.g., Streamlit, Next.js) for quick stakeholder testing, ensuring the backend logic is decoupled via webhooks for future migration into Microsoft Teams.
* Code Hygiene & Handoff Documentation: Maintain code transparency, track version changes, and collaborate efficiently using GitHub. Author structured "Industrialization Blueprints" (JSON payloads, API mappings, and logic flows) to seamlessly hand over for full scale production

**Required Background & Skills**

* AI Orchestration Frameworks: Expert-level workflow creation using tools like n8n (advanced JavaScript/Python execution nodes, webhooks, and sub-workflows) or equivalent orchestration frameworks
* AI & LLM Mastery: Practical experience implementing conversational APIs, embedding architectures, vector stores, and advanced prompt engineering constraints.
* Full-Stack Core Development: Strong programming proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/Node.js. Comfort writing clean API connectors, handling RESTful requests, parsing JSON, and maintaining code via GitHub.
* Enterprise Collaboration Ecosystems: Prior familiarity or structural understanding of building integration layers, bots, or webhooks for the Microsoft 365 / MS Teams ecosystem is highly desirable.
* Candidate should possess “Can-do” attitude, with an ability to thrive in an unstructured environment
* 9 to 12 years of software engineering/automation experience (with at least 2–3 years focused on building AI agents/bots from scratch).
* Masters/ PhD in Computer Science, Information Technology equivalent
* Understanding of HCM systems like Oracle is an added advantage
* Excellent English, quantitative, technical, and storytelling skills

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.
  
  
At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.
  
  
To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

description:

title: Account Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Enviropol Engineers Pvt. Ltd., incorporated in 2003, is a leading Indian engineering company specializing in air pollution control and biomass drying solutions. Headquartered in Noida, with facilities in Greater Noida and Pune, the company has successfully delivered over 500 projects across more than 30 countries for major industrial clients. Enviropol provides advanced technologies such as Wet Scrubbers, ESPs, Bag Filters, Wet ESPs, and Hybrid Biomass Dryers to help industries meet global emission norms and improve operational efficiency. Backed by experienced technocrats and in-house manufacturing supported by modern tools like 3D modeling and CNC fabrication, Enviropol focuses on innovation, quality, and reliability. Guided by values of Integrity, Excellence, and Collaboration, the company promotes a “WIN-WIN-WIN” philosophy where clients, partners, and employees grow together while contributing to cleaner, sustainable industrial development.
  
**Role Description**
The Project Engineer role is a full-time, on-site position based in Noida. The Project Engineer will support the planning, design, and execution of air pollution control and biomass drying projects, working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure technical accuracy and on-time delivery. Day-to-day responsibilities include preparing project plans and schedules, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, reviewing engineering drawings and specifications, and supporting procurement and installation activities. The role involves monitoring project progress, managing technical documentation, assisting in commissioning and performance testing, and resolving site-related issues in collaboration with senior engineers. The Project Engineer is expected to maintain high standards of safety, quality, and compliance, while contributing to continuous improvement in project delivery and client satisfaction.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Project Engineering and Electrical Engineering skills relevant to industrial air pollution control and biomass drying systems.
* Candidates should possess Project Management and Project Planning skills to handle timelines, resources, and coordination across multiple stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to collaborate with clients, vendors, site teams, and internal departments.
* Candidates should ideally hold a degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Environmental Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Candidates should have familiarity with industrial equipment, basic drafting or 3D modeling tools, and understanding of safety and environmental compliance norms.
* Candidates should demonstrate problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and readiness to visit project sites as required.

title: BIM Coordinator
description:
**Job Description: Building Information Modeling (BIM)**
**Position:**
BIM Coordinator
  
  
**Experience:**
10 to 20+ Years
  
  
**Location:**
Ahmedabad
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Position Overview**
The
**BIM Coordinator**
is responsible for establishing, governing, and driving Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Virtual Design & Construction (VDC) workflows across preconstruction and field operations.
**This position operates under a management and coordination framework rather than an in-house modeling/production drafting model.**
All design models and trade-specific fabrication models (LOD 350/400) are authored by external design consultants and specialized trade subcontractors (MEPF, structural steel, concrete, drywall/framing, and building envelope). The BIM Coordinator serves as the GC's central technical authority who orchestrates model federation, establishes project BIM standards, audits incoming data, facilitates multi-trade clash resolution, and bridges model data into field execution, 4D logistics, and reality capture.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* BIM Execution Planning (BEP) & Governance
* Author, implement, and enforce project-specific BIM Execution Plans (BEP/BXP) aligned with owner agreements, prime contract deliverables, and industry benchmarks (ISO 19650, AIA G202).
* Define modeling scopes of work, coordinate origins, project grid benchmarks, Level of Development (LOD 300 to LOD 400/500) requirements, and geometric tolerances for all subcontractor agreements.
* Establish and govern the project Common Data Environment (CDE) using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, Procore, or Revizto, setting upload schedules, permission tiers, and automated folder distribution workflows.
* Multi-Trade Coordination & Subcontractor Oversight
* Lead weekly spatial coordination meetings with MEPF, structural, framing, and specialty trade subcontractors to drive constructability resolution before fabrication and installation.
* Manage and federate trade models; run automated and manual clash analyses using Navisworks Manage and Revizto, distinguishing real physical/clearance conflicts from false positives.
* Hold trade contractors accountable to coordination milestones, clash resolution sign-offs, and agreed-upon space allocations according to contract documents.
* Manage issue-tracking platforms (e.g., Revizto, ACC Issues, BIM Track), issuing action items, constructability RFIs, and tracking items to verified closeout.
* Subcontractor Model Auditing & Quality Assurance (QA/QC)
* Audit incoming trade models to verify compliance with BEP guidelines, coordinate systems, parameter schemas, naming standards, and equipment clearance requirements.
* Review subcontractor shop drawings, fabrication spool sheets, and sleeve/penetration layouts directly against the federated model for sign-off prior to field installation.
* Ensure all models incorporate manufacturer-approved cut sheets, maintenance access envelopes, and code-required clearances.
* 4D Logistics, 5D Preconstruction & Constructability Analysis
* Leverage design and trade models during preconstruction to extract quantities for estimating and constructability reviews via Assemble Systems, Navisworks, or CostX.
* Partner with Project Schedulers and Superintendents to assemble 4D construction simulations (e.g., Synchro 4D or Navisworks TimeLiner) linked to CPM schedules (Primavera P6 / MS Project) for site logistics, crane staging, and trade sequencing.
* Support project teams in developing site logistics visualizations, temporary works layouts, and sequencing presentations for owner and stakeholder meetings.
* Reality Capture & Field Layout Integration
* Manage jobsite laser scanning (LiDAR / SLAM) operations (via self-perform scanning or specialty scanning vendors) and integrate registered point clouds into active federated models.
* Perform scan-to-BIM comparison and deviation analysis (floor flatness/levelness, concrete anchor placement, MEP penetration verification) to catch discrepancies prior to concrete pours and interior buildouts.
* Prepare and export coordinated layout point data to field layout teams utilizing Robotic Total Stations (RTS) (e.g., Trimble Field Link, Leica iCON).
* Equip and train field superintendents, foremen, and project engineers to access federated models on tablets for real-time site verification.
* Handover, Closeout & Process Automation
* Manage the collection, validation, and assembly of final coordinated As-Built models, COBie data, and asset handover deliverables required for owner facility management.
* Implement workflow automations, clash reporting routines, and model health verification scripts using Dynamo, Python, or API integrations across Navisworks, Revizto, and ACC.
* Conduct post-coordination reviews with project teams to capture lessons learned and continuously improve subcontractor BIM contract language and company coordination protocols.

**Key Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related discipline.
* Minimum 10+ years of experience in BIM with significant experience as a BIM Coordinator, or BIM Lead.
* Proven expertise in BIM coordination, model management, and multidisciplinary project delivery.
* Proficiency in Revit.
* BIM model development in MEPF disciplines must have.
* CADWorx
* Strong hands-on experience with Navisworks Manage, including clash detection, rule creation, reporting, and model coordination.
* Strong understanding of BIM workflows, standards, and project execution methodologies.
