title: Link Building Lead
description:
**Company:**
LinkBuilding.Company

**Location:**
On-site — Naroda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Experience:**
2–6 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Us**

LinkBuilding.Company is a link building agency working with global brands, including billion-dollar businesses and Nasdaq-listed companies.

We help businesses grow their organic search visibility through strategic link building, editorial placements, and innovative SEO initiatives. As search evolves, we are also exploring opportunities in AI search visibility and generative engine optimization.

**We are scaling massively.**
We currently deliver approximately 300 links per month, and our goal is to reach
**1,000 links per month in 2027**
while building a lean, efficient team.

Achieving this growth will require better systems, stronger execution, smart automation, and people who take complete ownership of their work.

We are looking for a Link Building Lead who wants to be part of this journey and help build a delivery operation that can scale significantly without unnecessary overhead.

**About the role**

We are looking for a Link Building Lead who can take complete ownership of our end-to-end delivery operations.

You will manage the team members responsible for planning placements, coordinating production, and getting links live. Your responsibility will be to ensure everyone understands their priorities, receives the necessary mentorship, and delivers work on time.

We need someone who doesn't just assign tasks but takes accountability for the final outcome.

You will be responsible for ensuring monthly commitments are achieved, identifying bottlenecks before they become problems, improving team productivity, and building systems that allow us to scale delivery while keeping the team lean.

This is an on-site leadership role at our office in Naroda, Ahmedabad.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Delivery Management**

* Own the complete link building delivery process, from placement planning to getting links published.
* Create monthly delivery plans and break them into weekly priorities.
* Ensure client commitments are completed within agreed timelines.
* Track progress, identify bottlenecks, and proactively resolve delays.
* Ensure every placement has a clear owner, deadline, and next action.

**2. Team Management & Mentorship**

* Lead and mentor planning executives and production executives.
* Assign responsibilities, set priorities, and establish clear expectations.
* Help team members improve their research, execution, and decision-making skills.
* Monitor individual performance and address productivity or quality issues.
* Build a team that takes ownership of its work and operates with minimal supervision.

**3. Placement Planning & Quality Control**

* Ensure the team identifies relevant, high-quality placement opportunities for clients.
* Evaluate websites based on organic traffic, topical relevance, website quality, and placement suitability.
* Review proposed placements to ensure they meet client requirements and budgets.
* Maintain quality standards while achieving delivery targets.

**4. Production & Link Acquisition**

* Oversee negotiations, follow-ups, content coordination, and link publication.
* Ensure approved placements move efficiently through the production pipeline.
* Resolve issues that prevent placements from going live.
* Verify published links and ensure delivery records are updated accurately.

**5. Scaling Operations & Process Improvement**

* Build efficient workflows and SOPs that support increasing delivery volumes.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and reduce manual work.
* Improve coordination between planning and production to minimize delays.
* Track team productivity and identify ways to increase output without proportionally increasing headcount.
* Turn new strategies and business initiatives into actionable plans with clear owners and deadlines.
* Continuously improve operational efficiency as we move toward our 1,000 link monthly targets.

**6. Accountability & Reporting**

* Track monthly delivery targets and individual team performance.
* Maintain visibility into planned, ongoing, delayed, and completed placements.
* Identify delivery risks early and implement corrective actions.
* Keep management informed about progress, challenges, and solutions.
* Take ownership of outcomes rather than waiting for the founder to follow up on tasks.

**Requirements**

* 2–6 years of experience in link building, off-page SEO, or SEO operations.
* Previous experience managing a team and multiple client campaigns.
* Strong understanding of guest posts, link insertions, editorial link building, and website quality assessment.
* Familiarity with tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Sheets, and project management systems.
* Strong leadership, planning, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* A proactive, ownership-driven mindset with a focus on results.
* Interest in building scalable systems and improving team productivity.
* Willingness to work full-time from our office in Naroda, Ahmedabad.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Your performance will be evaluated on:

* Achievement of monthly link delivery targets.
* Timely completion of client commitments.
* Quality and relevance of published placements.
* Productivity and development of team members.
* Reduction of operational bottlenecks and unnecessary manual work.
* Improvements in delivery efficiency and scalability.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Monthly delivery commitments are consistently achieved.
* Planning and production teams work together efficiently.
* Every team member understands their responsibilities and is accountable for results.
* The team delivers more without unnecessary increases in headcount.
* Processes become more efficient, predictable, and scalable.
* The founder can trust you to manage the delivery operation independently.

Ultimately, your mission is to help us evolve from delivering 250–300 links per month to a highly efficient operation capable of delivering thousands of links every month without compromising quality.

**How to Apply**

We don't want to evaluate candidates based on their CV alone. We want to understand how you think, how you approach problems, and how you can contribute to our growth.

Before applying, visit LinkBuilding.Company and research our business, services, positioning, and the types of clients we work with.

Then email us at ravi@linkbuilding.company with the following:

**1. Your Introduction**

Briefly explain your experience in link building, SEO operations, and team management. Include the size of the team you have managed and the monthly delivery volume you have handled.

**2. Your Research**

What have you learned about LinkBuilding.Company? What opportunities do you see for improving our delivery operations or helping us scale?

**3. Your Scaling Strategy**

We currently deliver 250–300 links per month and aim to reach 1,000 per month in 2027.

How would you approach scaling delivery to these levels while keeping the team lean and maintaining placement quality?

**4. Your First 30 Days**

What would you focus on during your first month, and how would you start adding value to the business?

Keep your response concise, practical, and specific to our business. We value candidates who do their research, think independently, and take ownership.

**Email subject:**
Link Building Lead — Your Name

Please include your CV along with your responses.

We're looking for someone who wants to take ownership, build a strong team, create scalable systems, and help us build a significantly larger operation.

* Generate and track general purchase indents for departmental consumables and production items
* Handle Change Control, Deviations, Investigations, and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) in coordination with QA
* Prepare, review, revise, control, and implement SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) for sterile manufacturing operations
* Prepare production plan vs actual reports on daily and monthly basis based on material availability

**Designation: Senior Manager – Industrial Engineering**
**Location: Gandhinagar, Gujarat**
**About The Role**
The Sr. Manager – Industrial Engineering owns the Industrial Engineering function across all Group Bayport plants and processes — printing, stitching, cutting, and across the Covers & All (outdoor furniture covers, cushions) and BannerBuzz (banners, signage & displays) product lines. This is a senior, cross-plant leadership role: standardising IE method and measurement (SAM/MOST, line balancing, layout re-designing, SMED) across previously fragmented, undocumented practice, and directly supervising the Stitching IE and Plant Area IE teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Plant-Wide IE Leadership


+ Lead plant-level Industrial Engineering strategy across all factory floors — printing, stitching, cutting, and across the Covers & All (outdoor furniture covers, cushions) and BannerBuzz (banners, signage & displays) product lines.
+ Act as direct supervisor for the IE — setting priorities, reviewing output, and developing the team.
+ Standardise IE methodology, templates and reporting formats so results are comparable across areas and roll up cleanly to Management.

* Methods, Layout & Line Balancing


+ Own workstation layout design, line ergonomics and tooling standardisation across all plant areas.
+ Direct line-balancing exercises against Takt Time on printing, stitching, cutting, and across the Covers & All (outdoor furniture covers, cushions) and BannerBuzz (banners, signage & displays) product lines.
+ Review and approve area-level SMED / quick-changeover initiatives before roll-out.

* Time & Motion Standards


+ Own delivery of the Departmental SAM (Standard Allowed Minutes) Catalog, in partnership with MDM team for BOM set-up.
+ Validate area process times against field time-study data before they are published as standard.
+ Sign off the time-study methodology and sample sizes with each Plant Area IE before field work begins.

* Visual Management


+ Implement hourly production tracking boards – with BPM Team.
+ Introduce Poka-Yoke / mistake-proofing where scrap or quality leakage is systemic rather than one-off.

* Cross-Functional Partnership


+ Partner with MDM Team for BOM Preparation for Time Measurement (Crue member size/labour/machine).
+ Partner with the Manager, Global Capacity to feed validated IE process-time data into the Capacity vs Demand model and the monthly Capacity Governance Review.
+ Partner with the Manager, Automation & Business Analyst on layout and line-balancing implications of newly commissioned machines, and on post-commissioning variance audits.
+ Support the Ops Excellence Head on the phased CIP / LDM / VSM roll-out.

**Qualifications & Experience**




+ B.E. / B.Tech in Industrial, Mechanical or Production Engineering; a Master's degree or equivalent Lean/Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher) is preferred.
+ 10–15 years of progressive Industrial Engineering experience in an apparel manufacturing environment, including at least 8 years in a managerial role leading multiple engineers or areas.
+ Demonstrated, hands-on expertise in BOM/SAM/MOST/MTM time-study methods, line balancing, workstation layout design and Takt Time setting.
+ Experience standing up or running a structured time-study or work-study programme, including supervising junior engineers/interns collecting field data.
+ Prior exposure to apparel, soft-furnishing, furniture or comparable multi-SKU manufacturing is preferred, across the Covers & All (outdoor furniture covers, cushions) and BannerBuzz (banners, signage & displays) product lines.
+ Working proficiency in Excel and, ideally, Power BI, for data-driven decisions.

**Skills & Competencies**




+ Senior stakeholder management — comfortable presenting to and being evaluated.
+ People leadership across multiple, physically dispersed teams and areas.
+ Analytical rigor balanced with pragmatic, shop-floor-first problem solving.
+ Structured change management — able to introduce new standards without disrupting live production.
+ Clear written and verbal communication for cross-functional coordination with MDM, Global Capacity and Automation.

**Key Performance Indicators**




+ BOM Preparation for Time Measurement (Crue member size / labour / machine calculation) – SKU wise
+ Departmental SAM Catalog — % of process elements documented and signed off, against plan.
+ Line efficiency / OEE improvement on lines where IE has intervened.
+ On-time delivery of hourly production tracking board roll-out.

title: GenAI Lead
description:

We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education.
  
  
**Job Overview:**
We are seeking an innovative and highly skilled
**Lead Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer**
to spearhead the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI-powered solutions. In this role, you will lead a team of engineers and data scientists to harness cutting-edge Generative AI technologies and implement them to solve complex business problems, enhance user experiences, and drive innovation. **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field (Ph.D. preferred).

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in building Conversational AI applications using cloud-based services and in orchestrating AI/ML services for building a complete solution

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Moveworks)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Strong understanding of the Move works platform, including enterprise search, conversational AI, natural language understanding (NLU), employee support automation, and AI-driven workflow orchestration.
* Knowledge of Move works integration capabilities with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Slack, HR systems, identity platforms, and enterprise applications
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of ServiceNow applications (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD).

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: GDS M and E - Sourcing Specialist
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description:**
GDS Meetings & Events Sourcing Manager
  
  
**Job Title:**
GDS Meetings & Events Sourcing Manager
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The GDS Meetings & Events (M&E) Sourcing Manager will be responsible for the strategic sourcing, contracting and supplier management of hotels, venues, destination management companies (DMCs), event agencies, production houses, transportation providers and other event-related suppliers supporting EY meetings and events globally.
  
  
This role will serve as the subject matter expert for venue and event sourcing, providing commercial guidance and market intelligence to stakeholders while driving value, compliance, cost optimisation and service excellence. The successful candidate will possess strong hospitality industry knowledge, a deep understanding of hotel operations and contracting terminology, and the ability to negotiate complex event agreements across multiple markets. The role will work closely with internal stakeholders, procurement teams, meeting planners and suppliers to deliver sourcing solutions that align with EY's Meetings & Events strategy and policies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategic Venue & Supplier Sourcing

+ Lead venue sourcing activities for meetings, conferences, leadership events, training programmes, offsites and client-facing events.
+ Analyse event requirements and develop sourcing strategies aligned with business objectives, budget and attendee experience expectations.
+ Source and evaluate hotels, convention centres, resorts, event venues, destination management companies (DMCs), event agencies and other event suppliers.
+ Conduct market research and benchmark venue rates, supplier capabilities and industry trends to support decision-making.
+ Provide venue recommendations based on location suitability, contractual terms, operational feasibility, attendee experience and commercial value.

* Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management

+ Lead RFP, RFQ and proposal evaluation processes for hotels, venues and event suppliers.
+ Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, concessions and contractual protections to maximise value and mitigate risk.
+ Ensure all supplier agreements comply with EY procurement policies, legal requirements and standard contract templates.
+ Drive savings initiatives through strategic sourcing, preferred supplier utilisation and volume-based negotiations.
+ Support supplier renewals and contract reviews while maintaining a strong supplier governance framework.

* Hospitality & Industry Expertise

+ Serve as the M&E team's subject matter expert on hotel operations, venue management and hospitality contracting.
+ Demonstrate strong knowledge of hotel industry terminology including:

- Guest room blocks and pickup analysis
- Attrition and cancellation clauses
- Food & Beverage minimum commitments
- Meeting room rental structures
- Complimentary ratios and concession strategies
- Revenue displacement and peak period pricing
- Force majeure and risk mitigation clauses
- Commission and non-commission models, and negotiated rate structures

+ Advise stakeholders on hotel operational considerations that impact cost, attendee experience and event success.
+ Maintain knowledge of regional and global hospitality market trends, supplier capabilities and emerging venue solutions.

* Stakeholder Management

+ Partner with meeting sponsors, event planners and business stakeholders to understand sourcing requirements and event objectives.
+ Provide sourcing guidance and recommendations throughout the meeting and event lifecycle.
+ Act as the primary escalation point for venue and supplier-related issues during sourcing and contracting phases.
+ Build strong relationships with key hotel brands, venue operators, event agencies and industry partners.

title: Senior Engineer - QA
description:
**Location:**

**Description**
We are looking for a Senior Automation Test Engineer with strong expertise in test automation, API testing, and performance and load testing to help us build reliable, scalable, and high-quality software.
  
  
In this role, you will take ownership of automation and performance testing for assigned product areas. You will design and maintain automated test suites, develop performance test scenarios, analyse system behaviour under different workloads, and work closely with developers to identify bottlenecks and improve application reliability.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who combines strong programming skills with practical performance engineering experience. You should be comfortable working independently, investigating complex failures, and translating test results into actionable insights.
  
  
The role also requires regular collaboration with our US-based counterparts. Candidates should be comfortable attending meetings during evening hours in India to support cross-functional planning, technical discussions, and project execution.
  
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* **Test Automation:**
  Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test suites using Python and frameworks such as Robot Framework, PyTest, and Playwright.
* **API Testing:**
  Own automation for REST APIs, including functional, integration, contract, negative, authentication, and end-to-end scenarios.
* **Performance and Load Testing:**
  Design, develop, and execute performance, load, stress, and endurance tests to evaluate application behaviour under varying workloads.
* **Performance Test Scripting:**
  Build and maintain reusable performance test scripts using tools such as Locust, JMeter, or k6, with a strong emphasis on code-driven performance testing.
* **Performance Analysis:**
  Analyse response times, throughput, error rates, resource utilisation, and latency percentiles to identify bottlenecks and performance degradation.
* **Root Cause Investigation:**
  Collaborate with developers and infrastructure teams to investigate performance issues across APIs, services, databases, and distributed systems.
* **Performance Benchmarking:**
  Establish performance baselines, define measurable acceptance criteria, compare results across releases, and identify regressions before production deployment.
* **CI/CD Integration:**
  Integrate functional automation and performance smoke tests into CI/CD pipelines, enabling early detection of regressions and faster feedback.
* **Framework Engineering:**
  Improve automation framework architecture, reusable libraries, test data management, parallel execution, reporting, and test reliability.
* **Test Strategy and Planning:**
  Define test coverage and approaches for new features, identify quality risks early, and determine appropriate functional and non-functional testing requirements.
* **Troubleshooting and Debugging:**
  Investigate complex failures using application logs, API traces, monitoring dashboards, and performance test reports.
* **Code Reviews and Mentoring:**
  Review automation code, promote coding standards, share technical knowledge, and support the development of junior engineers.
* **Quality Reporting:**
  Communicate test coverage, automation health, performance trends, bottlenecks, and release risks through clear, actionable reports.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**
  Work closely with developers, product managers, DevOps, and US-based engineering counterparts to align on quality goals and delivery priorities.

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–8 years of hands-on experience in software testing and test automation, including substantial experience with API automation.
* Strong programming skills in Python or Java, with the ability to develop clean, reusable, and maintainable test code.
* Strong hands-on experience with at least one automation framework, such as Robot Framework, PyTest, or Playwright.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, HTTP protocols, authentication, schema validation, and integration testing.
* **Strong practical experience in performance and load testing**
  , including designing workloads, executing tests, interpreting results, and investigating performance bottlenecks.
* Hands-on experience with at least one performance testing tool such as Locust, Apache JMeter, or k6.
* Understanding of key performance metrics, including response time, throughput, requests per second, error rate, concurrent users, and p90/p95/p99 latency.
* Experience analysing performance test results and correlating application behaviour with logs, monitoring metrics, database activity, or infrastructure resource utilisation.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent.
* Proficiency with Git, including branching, pull requests, and code review workflows.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings to cross-functional stakeholders.
* **Willingness and availability to attend regular meetings with US-based counterparts during evening hours in India**
  , depending on team and project requirements.
* Ability to work onsite in Bengaluru.

****PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS****

* Experience building or significantly enhancing automation frameworks from scratch.
* Experience with performance testing of REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, or cloud-hosted applications.
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, or equivalent.
* Experience investigating performance issues involving databases, connection pools, caching, queues, or network latency.
* Experience using Docker and Kubernetes for test execution or environment management.
* Experience optimising test execution through parallelisation and reliable CI/CD integration.
* Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical decisions within a QA team.

**About Brivo**
Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category-defining, cloud-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single-site businesses to global enterprises.
  
  
As the unified global leaders in cloud-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90+ countries. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure.
  
  
With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com.
  
  
*Brivo is an equal employment opportunity employer and values diversity. Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. title: Associate Director, CTI - Development, Clinical Dev
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**CTI MD Tech@Lilly**
**Associate Director, CTI - Development, Clinical Dev**
Management Level: M1 | Job Family: Information Technology
  
  
**About The Organization**
CTI - Development owns the digital capability that patients, sites and study teams meet first: consent and data capture, patient engagement, and the systems that get a study designed, started and set up. The portfolio spans Trial Capabilities, Clinical Experience and patient engagement, and AI & Analytics. The organization is mid-transformation, modernizing platforms and scaling AI and agentic use cases while operating under strict GxP/GCP, data integrity and inspection-readiness requirements.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Associate Director, CTI - Development, Clinical Dev, leads a team of engineering, product and delivery professionals and owns delivery, technical direction and capability growth across the Trial Capabilities, Clinical Experience and AI & Analytics domains. The role sits where clinical process meets engineering: close enough to the build to lead a design review and challenge an architecture, fluent enough in trial execution to shape how a study team actually works. It owns the demand relationship with clinical development business owners, directs the partner teams delivering a material share of the work, manages allocated budget and contractor capacity against plan, and is expected to set the agenda for AI and agentic adoption rather than wait for direction on it. Hands-on technical experience is expected and non-negotiable: a practitioner who has built and shipped software and integrations directly, and who stays current enough to pressure-test an architecture or a build versus buy call. The role is scoped at the upper end of the band and is expected to grow into responsibility for broader teams as the portfolio expands.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
**Delivery Ownership**

* Own delivery execution across the portfolio (scope, schedule, quality, dependencies, release readiness, production health) for clinical experience and patient engagement products (eConsent, ePRO/eCOA, patient portals and apps) and study start-up capabilities (site activation, study build, CTMS/eTMF integration).
* Run the standing delivery cadence of operational reviews, backlog grooming, planning cycles (e.g., PI Planning) and release governance as a single portfolio-wide rhythm, and apply product-management rigor to prioritization, scoring business value, technical debt, effort and risk explicitly and agreeing success measures before work starts.
* Define and implement the portfolio metrics framework: release predictability, defect escape, production reliability, study build and site activation cycle time, and adoption by sites, study teams and patients. Instrument it where stakeholders can see it, not inside a backlog tool.
* Identify and solve organizational and operational problems and technical challenges across the portfolio, from resourcing conflicts and scope ambiguity to cross-team dependencies, escalating only what falls outside established guidelines and doing so with a recommendation.

**Technical Direction & Engineering Standards**

* Set and defend the technical direction of the portfolio; review architecture and design, challenge weak decisions, and own standards for APIs, data contracts, interoperability (CDISC, HL7/FHIR) and reuse across clinical platforms.
* Own the architecture and design decisions for the portfolio's products, approve solution and integration designs, and run a design review cadence that catches problems before a release rather than after one.
* Raise the engineering bar on test automation, CI/CD, observability and the deliberate reduction of technical debt.
* Stay personally current: spend enough time in the code, the integrations and the production systems to judge an estimate, read a pull request and ask the questions only a practitioner asks.

**AI & Agentic Transformation**

* Define and land a 12 to 24 month vision for AI and agentic capability in study start-up and clinical experience: protocol and document intelligence, automated study build, site and patient-facing assistants. Make the business case for it.
* Find the use cases, prove them quickly at low cost, and take the ones that work through validation into production use with the evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop design that requires.
* Build the team's AI fluency, make AI-assisted engineering the normal way of working, and partner with business owners to redesign clinical process rather than automate around it.

**Resource, Budget & Vendor Management**

* Forecast resource needs across the portfolio and manage allocated budget and contractor capacity within approved guidelines, including allocation, ramp-up and release decisions.
* Own vendor and partner delivery: define scope, outcomes and acceptance criteria, hold suppliers to the same engineering, quality and GxP standards as internal teams, and manage performance on predictability and quality.
* Own SOW/MSA follow-ups, renewals and scope amendments, shape the sourcing mix for the portfolio, and protect institutional knowledge through documentation, code ownership and cross-training.

**Business Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as the technology partner for business owners and study teams: the person they call first, and the person who tells them when an idea will not work. Represent the portfolio externally with platform vendors, sites and industry forums, influencing partner roadmaps toward Lilly's needs.
* Run the demand relationship: capture and challenge incoming requests, agree priorities against capacity, and keep one honest view of the roadmap and what has been traded away. Contribute to the Clinical Dev business-area plan by translating the modernization roadmap into resourced delivery cycles.
* Translate clinical need into technical options, and constraint, risk and cost into language a business owner can act on, with no surprises at release.

**People Leadership**

* Hold management responsibility for the team, including hiring, onboarding, goal-setting and performance appraisals; hire for the capability the portfolio needs next, such as AI engineering, product thinking and clinical domain depth.
* Coach and develop through specific feedback, honest check-ins and a development plan each person recognises as their own; serve as career advisor and partner with HR on growth plans.
* Grow engineering craft, not only careers: use design and code review as teaching moments, and build shared practice across internal pods and partner teams so good patterns spread.
* Build bench strength and succession, remove single points of failure, and lead through senior engineers, technical leads and partner pod leads as the portfolio grows, setting direction for work executed beyond direct line management.

**Quality, Compliance & Process Leadership**

* Deliver in a GxP/GCP-regulated environment covering computer system validation, 21 CFR Part 11, data integrity, inspection and audit readiness; design for security and patient data privacy from the start; own incident response and the service levels agreed with study teams.
* Implement and refine a standard framework for backlog management, delivery governance and execution (Agile/Kanban, PI Planning), and own the portfolio-level leadership reporting cadence.

**Required Skills And Expertise**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in technology delivery, engineering leadership or product/platform management, including 4+ years of people-leadership experience managing technical teams.
* Deep, current, hands-on engineering background: able to build, review and troubleshoot services, APIs and integrations, not solely credentialed from past roles. Fluency in at least one modern programming language and SQL, with working command of cloud platforms and integration patterns.
* Proven experience taking AI, machine learning or agentic solutions beyond proof of concept into governed production use.
* Experience managing vendor and contractor relationships, including SOW/MSA administration within established commercial guidelines, and forecasting resource needs against an allocated budget.
* Demonstrated success owning a senior business relationship: shaping demand, negotiating priorities and capacity, and holding credibility through difficult delivery news.
* Demonstrated experience defining delivery or product metrics frameworks that stakeholders actually use.
* Demonstrated success building and retaining a technical team: hiring engineers, coaching through design review, and keeping critical talent.
* Experience operating in regulated (GxP) environments, including computer system validation and inspection-readiness practices, with fluency in Agile/Kanban delivery and tooling (Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow or equivalent).
* Strong communication skills, translating technical trade-offs into business, clinical and regulatory language.

**Preferred Skills**

* 4+ years supporting clinical development technology: study start-up, site activation, patient- or site-facing systems, or clinical data capture.
* Experience with Veeva Vault Clinical, Medidata or comparable clinical platforms, working knowledge of clinical data standards (CDISC CDASH/SDTM, HL7/FHIR), and exposure to decentralized or hybrid trial designs.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field (Master's preferred); Agile or PMP certification a plus.
* Demonstrated ownership of delivery for a portfolio or platform, shaping technical direction from direct engineering experience.

description:
**About The Opportunity**

Application Deadline: 30 October 2026
  
  
**Job Description**
**Title**
AI Solutions Engineer
  
  
**Department**
AMP – Research & SI
  
  
**Location**
Bengaluru or Gurgaon, India
  
  
**Reports To**
Principal Engineer
  
  
**Level**
4
  
  
We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
  
  
Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.
  
  
As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.
  
  
**About Your Team**
Asset Management Platforms (AMP) is responsible for the design, engineering and delivery of technology solutions that support Fidelity's global Asset Management business. We partner with Research Analysts, Portfolio Managers, Asset Management Operations, Sustainability teams, and Distribution teams across Europe and Asia to deliver modern platforms that enhance investment research, knowledge discovery, data-driven insights, and informed investment decision-making.
  
  
Our team develops and supports the technology ecosystem used across multiple investment capabilities, including Equities, Fixed Income, Multi-Asset, Systematic Investing, and Sustainable Investing. Our platforms underpin critical research processes including company and market research, sustainability analysis, financial modelling, investment content management, knowledge discovery, collaboration, and research analytics, enabling investment professionals to generate high-quality investment insights and improve client outcomes.
  
  
As Artificial Intelligence continues to transform investment research and software engineering, we are investing in modern engineering practices that combine AI-assisted software development with AI-powered research capabilities to improve productivity, accelerate insight generation, and enhance engineering quality. The AI Solutions Engineer will play a key role in designing, developing, and delivering enterprise AI solutions while enabling engineering teams to adopt AI-enabled development practices safely, effectively, and responsibly across the Research Technology platform.
  
  
**About Your Role**
The AI Solutions Engineer is a hands-on technical engineer responsible for accelerating software engineering delivery through the effective adoption of Artificial Intelligence and modern engineering practices.
  
  
Working closely with Engineering Leads, Solution Architects, Product Owners and software engineering teams, you will identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI-assisted development while maintaining Fidelity's high standards for architecture, engineering governance, software quality and security.
  
  
You will combine strong software engineering expertise with practical knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI-powered development tooling to establish best practices for AI-assisted software engineering. This includes to make effective use of technologies such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI coding assistants to improve software design, implementation, testing, documentation and operational support.
  
  
The role is equally focused on engineering excellence and innovation. You will apply modern software and AI engineering practices through hands-on design, development, testing, deployment, and production support, contribute to architectural decisions within established standards, support the adoption and continuous improvement of CI/CD, DevSecOps practices and implement approved security, governance, and Responsible AI controls throughout the software development lifecycle.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to shape how AI is adopted across Asset Management Platforms, helping engineering teams deliver high-quality software faster while ensuring solutions remain secure, maintainable and aligned with Fidelity's engineering standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Engineering Enablement**

* Design, build, deploy, and support enterprise AI applications using LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool calling, and agentic workflows.
* Build grounded RAG pipelines covering document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata enrichment, hybrid retrieval, reranking, citation, and response validation.
* Develop AI agents capable of planning, reasoning, maintaining context, invoking approved tools, and executing governed business workflows.
* Integrate commercial and open-source models through platforms such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent services.
* Implement prompt and model configuration management, evaluation datasets, automated quality testing, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Evaluate AI technologies progmatically and select solutions based on business value, quality, security, latency, scalability, and cost.
* Coach and mentor engineering teams in the effective use of Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI-assisted development tools.

**Software Engineering**

* Build complete AI-assisted apps using modern frontend technologies such as Angular or React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Develop secure and scalable APIs, microservices, and orchestration services using Python, FastAPI, Node.js, or NestJS.
* Integrate applications with enterprise APIs, market and research data, document repositories, collaboration platforms, and structured and unstructured data sources.
* Work with Relational, NoSQL, Cloud and vector technologies such as PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Snowflake and pgvector.
* Participate in engineering practices, including modular design, API contracts, code reviews, performance optimization and secure coding.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Champion modern engineering practices including Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery and DevSecOps.
* Work with engineering teams to optimise software delivery pipelines.
* Promote unit test automation and engineering best practises throughout the SDLC.
* Create reusable AI services, reference implementations, engineering standards, and ready-to-use development capabilities that improve developer productivity.

**Architecture & Governance**

* Collaborate with Solution Architects and Engineering Leads to ensure solutions align with Fidelity's target architecture.
* Ensure AI-assisted software development complies with engineering standards, security policies and regulatory requirements.
* Promote sound software engineering principles including maintainability, scalability, resilience and observability.

title: Manager, Engineering
description:
**Our Mission:**
6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.
  
  
**Our People:**
People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Delivery**

* Lead sprint delivery for a team of 6–12 engineers: planning, dependencies, risks, release readiness.
* Think about how work gets sequenced across people and AI-assisted workflows, not just story points.
* Keep JIRA, ProductBoard, and the dependency tracker current. No stale tickets, no surprises at SoS.
* Track cycle time and escaped defects; own the trend, not just the number.

**Technical**

* Review code and AI-generated output for whether it solves the right problem. Clean tests aren't enough.
* Define what needs human sign-off, what can be spot-checked, and what warrants a second pass.
* Write specs that work as contracts: clear scope, explicit constraints, stated boundaries.
* Stay close to architecture decisions, tech debt, and incident response.
* Contribute to software architecture decisions and patent writing for innovative work.

**People**

* Run 1:1s that are about growth, not sprint status.
* Coach engineers on when to trust AI output and when to push back. Model it explicitly, not just in retrospect.
* Give clear, timely feedback; build real development plans; address performance early.
* Help your team see that directing AI well is a skill worth building, not just a tool to adopt.
* Calibrate hiring panels, provide written feedback, contribute to calibration discussions.

**Cross-functional & Culture**

* Be the PM partner who holds a definition-of-ready and surfaces risks before they land in a leadership meeting.
* Engage escalations directly; produce RCAs; own P1/P2 support SLAs.
* Set the tone on your team: accountability, directness, recognition of others' work.
* Watch for workload and wellbeing signals before they become problems.
* Lead by influence across teams and functions ; comfortable driving cross-team technical decisions without direct authority

**Experience**
**What We're Looking For**

* 10+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years managing teams of 5 or more.
* BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Enough architectural depth to evaluate tradeoffs, including in AI-assisted output.
* Background in platform, API, data, or infrastructure engineering.
* Comfortable in a PM/Design pod environment; fluent with JIRA and ProductBoard or equivalent.
* Strong fundamentals in data structures, design patterns, and object-oriented programming.
* Proficient in Python or Java; enough depth to engage meaningfully in code review and design conversations.
* Strong enough in distributed systems, data pipelines, or APIs

**What Sets You Apart**

* You've run a platform or infrastructure team where other engineers are your customers.
* You've coached an IC through a meaningful promotion and can say concretely what that looked like.
* You've worked with AI-assisted engineering workflows and have a practical approach to reviewing output, not just a philosophy about it.
* You've collaborated across time-zones and know how to make it work.
* You can adopt a framework before it's perfect.

**Our Benefits:**
Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.
  
  
We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com.
  
  
*We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. All email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain. We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com*

title: Software Engineering Manager- Build and Release Engineering
description:
This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Software Engineering Manager – Build and Release Engineering**
We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead the team responsible for build, release engineering, source code administration, and sandbox tooling supporting large-scale systems, including the release pipeline for HPE Networking's JUNOS and EVO platforms. This is a working manager role: you will set direction and manage a high-performing team while staying directly engaged in the engineering work. The role combines technical depth with people leadership, requiring the ability to build and mentor high-performing engineers while driving strategic DevSecOps initiatives across the organization.
  
  
As a leader, you will define and execute the roadmap for CI/CD infrastructure, source code administration, and developer sandbox environments; partner with cross-functional engineering, release, and product managers; and establish best practices that enable scalable, reliable, high-velocity development workflows, all while remaining close enough to the code and systems to guide technical decisions credibly and unblock your team when needed.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team responsible for build, release engineering, source code administration, and sandbox tooling for large-scale systems, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement, while staying directly engaged in the codebase and infrastructure.
* Personally contribute to architecture, design reviews, and complex debugging for CI/CD platforms, source control systems, and sandbox infrastructure, not just direct the work from a distance.
* Own the architecture, scalability, and reliability of enterprise-wide CI/CD, source code management, and sandbox platforms, staying technically deep enough to make and defend design decisions.
* Define and drive the CI/CD, source code administration, and automation strategy for JUNOS and EVO platform delivery, aligning with broader engineering and business objectives.
* Oversee the development of robust automation frameworks for build, test, release, source code administration, and infrastructure orchestration, contributing code and scripts directly where it accelerates delivery.
* Establish and enforce best practices for version control, branching strategies, artifact management, and release governance across large, distributed codebases.
* Drive DevSecOps practices across the build and release pipeline, including generation and management of Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) and Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange (VEX).
* Drive adoption of AI/ML-driven automation and observability to improve pipeline efficiency, detect issues early, and reduce cycle time.
* Ensure production CI/CD, SCM, and sandbox systems meet high standards for availability, performance, scalability, and security; act as a technical escalation point during critical incidents.
* Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement efforts across CI/CD, SCM, and sandbox infrastructure, often diagnosing issues directly alongside the team.
* Influence and guide organizational DevSecOps maturity, setting standards and driving consistency across teams.

**What You Need To Bring**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test - Database Automation
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
  
  
**About Us**
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
  
  
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
  
  
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
  
  
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
  
  
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
  
  
**About The Role**
Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.
  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test with extensive industry experience to define and execute the design, development, and maintenance of Fivetran’s test automation tools and framework using reliable and scalable techniques.
  
  
As a Senior SDET, you will focus on solving complex testing difficulties by designing, developing and improving automation and reporting frameworks. You will invest in improving test stability and performance of the framework by developing innovative solutions to boost Fivetran’s testing efficiency. You will also coach Fivetran quality engineers to be the best in class automation engineers, and will continuously work with the team to ensure high standards for automation. The ideal candidate will be highly technical, detail-oriented, creative, motivated, and focused on achieving results.
  
  
In addition, this role emphasizes leveraging AI driven solutions to accelerate testing, enhance developer productivity, and improve operational insights, making Fivetran’s quality practices smarter, faster, and more scalable.
  
  
This is a full-time position based out of our Bangalore office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.
  
  
**Technologies You’ll Use**

* Languages & Frameworks: Java (17+), JUnit, REST Assured, Shell scripting; Python
* Infrastructure & Tooling: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Bazel, Buildkite
* Cloud & Platform: AWS, GCP, Azure
* Observability & Monitoring: Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog
* CI/CD & Automation: Jenkins, CircleCI, GitHub Actions
* Data & Testing:ELT pipelines, test automation utilities, whitebox testing strategies
* Databases: SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, SAP , Oracle, DB2 ertc)

**What You’ll Do**
  
  

* Review requirements, specifications and technical design documents to provide meaningful, risk-focused feedback.
* Design and evolve scalable automation frameworks in Java with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, and data correctness.
* Write high-signal test strategies for complex features and automate them across multiple environments.
* Improve CI/CD pipelines by building robust validation layers that prevent silent failures and regressions.

+ Build internal tools and proof-of-concepts using AI/LLM technologies to:
+ Accelerate debugging and failure triaging
+ Generate high-quality test scenarios
+ Detect flaky patterns or regression risks
+ Improve log analysis and root-cause identification
+ Enhance developer and QA productivity

* Design AI-assisted workflows that integrate seamlessly into the existing automation and release pipelines.
* Experiment with and implement agent-based systems or LLM-powered tooling that streamline development and testing processes.
* Actively measure and improve engineering impact through reliability metrics, automation efficiency, and defect prevention signals.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to drive a culture of quality ownership and automation-first thinking.
* Collaborate with engineering and product leaders to align testing priorities and business objectives.

**Skills We’re Looking For**

* 6+ years of experience in the software industry with strong passion for quality, automation, and engineering excellence.
* Deep understanding of OOP principles and strong proficiency in Java.
* Expertise in designing scalable automation frameworks and identifying negative, edge, and high-risk scenarios.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems risks such as schema drift, idempotency failures, data inconsistencies, and race conditions.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with tools such as Jenkins, Buildkite.
* Experience working with backend automation frameworks.
* Testing data pipeline or ELT platforms, with hands-on exposure to Change Data Capture (CDC) mechanisms, connector-based data ingestion, and validating data accuracy and consistency across source and destination systems at scale.
* Deep understanding of database internals
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI/LLM tools to significantly accelerate development, debugging, test design or automation activities.
* Experience building AI-assisted tools, workflows, or agents that integrate into engineering pipelines.

**Bonus Skills**

* Experience testing against cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) or CDC source databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
* Familiarity with log-based CDC mechanisms (binlog, WAL, ) and handling schema drift or evolution scenarios.
* Exposure to distributed systems testing, large-scale data reconciliation, and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) on cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* Familiarity with data extraction using API-based polling, batch/file ingestion, and query-based incremental syncs.

**Perks And Benefits**
100% employer-paid medical insurance- Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
- RSU stock grants\*
- Professional development and training opportunities
- Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
- Monthly cell phone stipend
- Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.
\*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information
  
  
*Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.*
We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.
  
  
Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

title: SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test) | AstraLink Connect
description:
**SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test) | AstraLink Connect**

📍
**Bengaluru | 4 to 6 years | Full-time | On-site / Hybrid**

**Do you find the bug everyone else missed?**

AstraLink Connect is a network security platform. It brings together networking appliances, cloud services, web, desktop and mobile apps, VPN connectivity, firewall management, IDS/IPS, VLANs, access control and device management.

You'll be our first dedicated SDET. This isn't a role where you get a list of test cases, run them and report what passed. You'll learn how a feature works, work out where it can break, design the test strategy, automate it, and dig into every failure.

**How we think about testing**

Say we ship a feature that pushes a configuration change from our cloud to a customer's router. Checking that the config reaches the router is only the start. We'd expect you to ask:

* What if the router goes offline halfway through?
* What if the request reaches the backend twice?
* What if the dashboard accepts the config but the appliance rejects it?
* What if the user loses permission while the operation is running?
* What if the cloud thinks it applied, but the router disagrees?
* Can the system recover without leaving the customer in a broken state?

Then you'd decide which of those should become automated tests. That's the mindset we're hiring for.

**What you'll do**

* Own test strategy and quality for features, from development to production release
* Build automated end-to-end, integration, API and regression tests in TypeScript with Playwright
* Test workflows across our apps, backend APIs, cloud infrastructure and networking appliances
* Cover happy paths, negative cases, boundaries, permissions, concurrency and failure conditions
* Validate networking behavior: VPNs, firewalls, VLANs, routing, DNS, DHCP and access policies
* Test real-world failures: flaky connectivity, appliance restarts, API errors, partial operations
* Add tests to CI/CD and set up release quality gates the team relies on
* Investigate failures using app logs, browser traces, API responses and device logs
* Write bug reports precise enough that engineers can find the real problem fast

**What we're looking for**

* 4 to 6 years in SDET, QA automation, or software engineering with real testing ownership
* Strong TypeScript / JavaScript (Python is a plus)
* Experience building and maintaining production-grade test suites with Playwright, Cypress or similar
* You test APIs in code, not only in Postman
* A solid grasp of REST, HTTP/HTTPS and client-server architecture
* Comfortable reading an unfamiliar codebase (we use Go and TypeScript) and debugging with developers
* Experience with Git and CI/CD
* Good understanding of test isolation, test data, mocking and negative testing

**Networking knowledge matters**

Connect isn't another CRUD SaaS. You don't need to be a network engineer, but you should be comfortable with TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, NAT, ports, firewalls, VPNs and VLANs. You should be able to open a terminal, read logs, make API calls, and figure out why two systems aren't talking.

**Bonus if you have worked with:**

* Linux and shell tooling
* WireGuard or other VPN technologies
* Network/security products
* Docker and containerised environments
* AWS
* MQTT or event-driven systems
* Mobile application testing
* Performance/load testing
* Security testing
* Hardware or networking appliances
* Observability and distributed-system debugging

**How you work**

* Methodical: you reproduce a problem before you report it
* Clear: you can push back on a release, with evidence
* You take ownership without waiting to be told what to test

**What success looks like**

Within your first few months, we'd expect you to:

* Understand the critical user journeys and failure points across Connect.
* Establish reliable automated coverage for our highest-risk workflows.
* Reduce repetitive manual regression testing.
* Catch regressions before they reach production.
* Make failures easier for engineers to reproduce and diagnose.
* Help establish clear release criteria and quality gates.
* Build a test suite the engineering team actually trusts.

Over time the goal is simple: when the pipeline is green, the team is confident to ship.

**Why join**

* You'll shape how quality works here from day one, as our first SDET
* A bug here isn't just a broken button. It can be a firewall rule that didn't propagate or a VPN that fails under one network condition. Your work prevents that.
* A small team, with the freedom to improve our test architecture and tooling as we grow

description:

* Perform manual testing across web applications and mobile apps on Android and iOS, including functional, regression, compatibility, usability, installation/update, and device/OS-specific scenarios.

* Perform testing on physical devices and emulators/simulators across representative Android and iOS versions, and capture device logs/crash details when troubleshooting issues.
* Identify, log, track, and retest defects using tools such as JIRA, Bugzilla, or similar.
* Ensure comprehensive test coverage and maintain traceability between requirements and test cases.
* Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives in an Agile/Scrum environment.

**Automation Testing Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts for web applications and, where applicable, mobile applications.
* Hands-on experience with Playwright or Selenium for web UI automation testing; exposure to Appium or a similar mobile automation framework is preferred.
* Candidate should have used Playwright and/or Selenium in previous projects and should be able to create and maintain automation test suites independently. Experience testing Android and/or iOS applications in real projects is also expected.
* Identify suitable manual test cases for automation and improve smoke and regression coverage through automation.
* Analyze automation failures and identify whether issues are related to application defects, test scripts, test data, or environment/configuration.
* Maintain reusable automation components, page objects, test fixtures, test data, and utilities.
* Integrate automated tests with CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar.
* Generate and review automation execution reports and communicate failures clearly to the development team.

**Collaboration & Reporting**

* Work closely with developers, product managers, and business analysts to clarify requirements and resolve issues.
* Provide timely and detailed test execution status reports to the QA Lead / Project Manager.
* Support UAT by assisting business users and validating fixes.
* Work with developers to improve application testability and contribute to continuous testing practices.

**Quality Assurance Practices**

* Follow industry best practices for QA, including risk-based testing and defect management.
* Ensure compliance with organizational quality standards and processes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing practices, automation coverage, and methodologies.

**Additional Expectations**

* Mentor junior testers by sharing knowledge and reviewing test cases and automation scripts.
* Take ownership of testing for assigned modules or projects with minimal supervision.
* Provide input for test effort estimation and project planning.
* Identify opportunities for test optimization and improvements in QA processes.
* Be able to explain automation framework design, locator strategy, waits, assertions, reporting, test data management, and troubleshooting of flaky tests.

**Key Skills Required**

* Strong knowledge of STLC (Software Testing Life Cycle) and SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle).
* Proficiency in writing test cases, test scenarios, and clear bug reports.
* Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA, Bugzilla, Mantis, or similar.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology.
* Good understanding of functional, regression, integration, UAT, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing.
* Basic knowledge of SQL for backend data validation.
* Practical experience with Playwright or Selenium WebDriver.
* Hands-on mobile app testing experience on Android and/or iOS; familiarity with Appium or a similar mobile automation framework is an added advantage.
* Good understanding of Page Object Model (POM), reusable components, assertions, waits, test fixtures, and data-driven testing.
* Experience with at least one programming/scripting language such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Python.
* Basic understanding of API testing and API automation using Postman, REST Assured, Playwright API testing, or similar.
* Familiarity with Git/version control and basic CI/CD concepts.
* Ability to troubleshoot flaky tests and improve automation reliability.
* Understanding of when a test case should be automated versus kept as a manual test.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Experience testing across multiple browsers such as Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari/WebKit, and across representative Android/iOS devices and OS versions.
* Experience with mobile app testing, including native/hybrid apps, WebView flows, device permissions, network conditions, app lifecycle, and release validation, is preferred.
