Your opportunity
  
  
At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
  
  
Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region .
  
  
Our team is seeking a Software Development & Engineering Manager with a passion for the retirement industry and a strong history of leading development teams. Our mission is to build, maintain, and modernize our robust set of solutions.
  
  
What you have
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in: Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related field with 7+ years of progressive, post-Bachelor’s related experience.
* Advanced .NET development skills, with applicable experience developing in .NET/.NET Core.
* Advanced coding experience in C#
* Knowledge of object-oriented design patterns.
* Professional experience with RESTful API development.
* Professional experience with relational databases (SQL Server is preferred)
* Professional experience with SQL and SQL Stored Procedures
* Professional experience with source code repositories tools, GitHub
* Professional experience with CI/CD pipelines.
* Professional experience with distributed multi-tier applications
* Professional experience with the Agile methodology.
* Experience with production deployments
* Ability to conceptualize the best tactical approach for a team to deliver a solution
* Ability to follow and guide best practice solutions
* Ability to effectively communicate complex software solutions to both technical and nontechnical audiences
* Ability to present project details to technical and nontechnical audiences
* Effective relationship builder: ability to partner cross-functionally, cross-enterprise and work effectively with various levels of the organization

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using Copilot and/or other AI tools for development
* Experience developing single-page UI applications and reusable components using Angular
* Experience with Domain Driven Design (DDD)
* Experience developing enterprise financial service applications
* Experience working in the Retirement Technology for Defined Contribution retirement plans.
* Experience using Splunk

What’s in it for you
  
  
At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. title: Manual Test Engineer
description:
**Job Title : Manual Test Engineer**
**Experience : 3-5 yrs**
**Location : Hyderabad**
**OSI Digital**
is looking for a skilled Manual Test Engineer with strong hands-on experience in functional testing and API testing. The ideal candidate should be proficient in requirements analysis, test design, test execution, defect reporting, and API validation using tools such as Postman and SOAP UI.
  
  
The candidate must be capable of working independently in an Agile environment, coordinating directly with clients and project stakeholders, clarifying business requirements, and delivering testing activities within agreed timelines. Good communication, analytical thinking, and ownership of assigned deliverables are essential.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria to understand expected application behavior.
* Identify requirement gaps, ambiguities, and dependencies, and proactively obtain clarifications from Business Analysts, Developers, clients, and other stakeholders.
* Design, review, and maintain comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, test data, and requirements traceability.
* Perform manual functional, integration, end-to-end, and regression testing of applications.
* Design and execute positive, negative, boundary, and exception-handling scenarios for APIs.
* Perform defect retesting and regression testing to ensure that fixes do not introduce unintended side effects.
* Execute assigned testing activities within agreed timelines while maintaining expected quality standards.
* Work effectively in Agile/Scrum teams, participate in sprint ceremonies, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Communicate directly with clients and stakeholders to clarify requirements, discuss defects, provide testing updates, and manage expectations.
* Provide regular status reports covering testing progress, completed activities, pending work, blockers, risks, and defects.
* Use Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools to manage test activities, defects, and project work items.
* Leverage AI tools to support test case generation, requirements analysis, test data identification, and test documentation, with appropriate manual validation.
* Maintain basic awareness of test automation tools such as Selenium or Playwright and identify suitable opportunities for automation.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Manual Functional Testing — Mandatory
* Strong hands-on experience in manual testing of web-based or enterprise applications.
* Excellent understanding of SDLC, STLC, and defect life cycle.
* Ability to design and execute test scenarios covering positive, negative, boundary, and end-to-end workflows.
* Experience in functional, integration, and regression testing.
* Requirements Analysis and Test Design — Mandatory
* Strong ability to understand business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience identifying requirement gaps, dependencies, and ambiguities.
* Ability to seek timely clarifications and translate requirements into effective test coverage.
* Experience preparing test scenarios, detailed test cases, and test data.
* Defect Management — Mandatory
* Experience logging clear, reproducible defects with appropriate evidence and expected versus actual results.
* Ability to assess defect severity, support prioritization, retest fixes, and perform regression testing.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Agile Delivery and Client Communication — Mandatory
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned testing deliverables.
* Confidence in interacting directly with clients and project stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication, interpersonal skills, team coordination, and customer service orientation.
* Ability to provide clear, timely status updates and escalate risks or blockers proactively.
* Test and Project Management Tools
* Hands-on experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar project and defect management tools.
* Familiarity with test management, defect tracking, and requirements traceability practices.

**Preferred Skills**

* Basic exposure to UI automation using Selenium or Playwright.
* Experience using AI tools to assist with test case design, test documentation, test data generation, and testing analysis.
* Basic understanding of SQL queries and database validation.
* Exposure to CI/CD processes and software release cycles.

title: Lead Quality Engineer - 11776
description:

Decisions related to hiring, compensation, training, or evaluating performance are made fairly, and we provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and employees.
  
  
Please be advised that inquiries or resumes from recruiters will not be accepted.
  
  
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read Coupa’s Privacy Policy and understand that Coupa receives/collects your application, including your personal data, for the purposes of managing Coupa's ongoing recruitment and placement activities, including for employment purposes in the event of a successful application and for notification of future job opportunities if you did not succeed the first time. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Product Engineer
description:
**About the role:**

We are building internal products that change how enterprise implementation work gets done. The products are live, in daily use, and growing. We are hiring experienced product engineers to build on them. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will pick up items from a live backlog, design the solution, build it, prove it works and ship it. The work spans the full stack, from data and services through to the screens people use. It suits an engineer who is comfortable owning something end to end, works well with an incomplete brief, and enjoys building tools that other professionals rely on to do their job.

**Job Location:**
Hyderabad, Bhubaneswar, Kolkata, Noida

**What you will be doing:**

•
**Delivering from the backlog.**
Items are raised continuously as the products are used and as new capability is needed. You take them, size them, build them and see them through to production.

•
**Building across the stack.**
Services, data model, integrations and user interface. You own the change from end to end rather than handing it across a boundary.

•
**Working with structured and unstructured data.**
Reading, transforming and validating data from documents, spreadsheets, exports and APIs, where the input is real and rarely clean.

•
**Integrating with enterprise platforms.**
Authenticating, reading and writing to business systems through their APIs, and handling the realities of rate limits, failures and partial results.

•
**Applying AI where it earns its place.**
Large language models are part of how these products work. You will build with them, measure them, and know when a deterministic approach is the better engineering answer.

•
**Proving the work.**
Automated tests, verified behaviour, and a release you can explain. Quality is part of delivery here, not a separate phase.

•
**Shaping what gets built.**
You will have direct input into priorities and approach. Experienced engineers here are expected to have opinions and argue them.

**Skills and experience**

**Commercial experience**
: 8+ years building and shipping production software, with meaningful time at senior level.

**Core languages:**
Strong TypeScript and JavaScript across back end and front end. Python or C# as a secondary language is welcome.

**Back end:**
Modern Node.js, API design, authentication, validation and error handling in a service you have run in production.

**Front end:**
React with modern patterns: function components, hooks, client-side data fetching and state. Clean, usable interfaces without a designer holding your hand.

**Data:**
Strong relational database skills. Schema design, real SQL, transactions, indexing and migrations. Comfortable modelling tables, columns, keys and relationships from a messy business problem.

**Data formats**
: Confident with JSON, XML, XPath and query languages, spreadsheet formats and document parsing. You can work with a schema you did not design and cannot change.

**Cloud:**
Building and running services in a major cloud, ideally Azure. Identity, secrets management, deployment and monitoring.

**AI engineering:**
Practical experience building with large language models: prompt design, structured output, validating what comes back, cost and latency as measured numbers.

**Engineering practice:**
Automated testing as a habit, version control discipline, and code that the next person can maintain.

***Highly regarded***

• Working knowledge of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 ecosystem and the Power Platform

• Familiarity with other enterprise business platforms such as NetSuite, SAP or Salesforce

• Experience with enterprise integration patterns and middleware

• Document intelligence, information extraction or natural language processing

• Reporting and analytics platforms

• Background in professional services or consulting, so you understand the people the products serve

title: Lead, Tech (Private Credit)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
The Private Credit Tech group at D. E. Shaw & Co. is looking for an experienced software developer to join our Tech team based in Hyderabad and Gurugram. This team is an extension of the firm's Private Credit business, based in the New York and London offices. The Private Credit business involves providing loans to private companies to facilitate capital for business growth, expansion, or refinancing existing debt. The Private Credit Tech team plays a critical role by developing the tools used by the business team for their daily workflows, working closely with the analysts to build analytical and operational tools that streamline pre- and post-trade business functions.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will collaborate directly with the product manager, the desk (based out of US and UK), and the Financial Research team based out of our India office to understand their workflows and requirements. You will design, build, and own full-stack web application platforms spanning post-trade analytics, underwriting and modeling, and deal-sourcing workflows, driving projects from requirements gathering and architecture through implementation, testing, and deployment. A core part of the role is developing a deep understanding of the desk's point of view so you can propose sound technical solutions to real business problems, while balancing pragmatic, quick-turnaround delivery with designs that endure as requirements evolve. You will take end-to-end ownership of the systems you build and hold a high bar for both quality and timeliness, championing clean coding practices, thoughtful design reviews, and robust, performance applications. You will actively use generative AI tools to accelerate your own productivity across prototyping, coding, testing, and troubleshooting, and look for opportunities to apply GAI to unlock new capabilities and streamline business workflows. You will also partner with other infrastructure teams to deliver solutions that scale and contribute to a strong engineering culture through knowledge sharing and mentorship — with the opportunity to grow into leading a small team by next year.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related technical field, with an exceptional foundation in algorithms, data structures, and object-oriented programming
* 5 years of software development experience, with strong hands-on programming experience in Python
* Front-end development experience, especially in ReactJS/Redux, with the ability to deliver full-stack web applications
* Good SQL skills to understand the existing infrastructure and build new tools
* Technical and architecture design experience, with the ability to translate vague, high-level requirements into well-structured, coherent designs
* Hands-on experience using generative AI / LLM-assisted developer tools to accelerate development and automation
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders
* The drive to learn about the finance domain and related analytics
* An interest in and aptitude for mentoring and leading a small team

Preferred qualifications:
  
  

* Prior experience in the finance domain, particularly in private credit, fixed income, or capital markets
* Experience owning projects end-to-end and driving them to completion

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/LeadTechPCJuly26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers

title: Digital Factory Global Application Analyst
description:
**The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership**
With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, Gloria and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.
  
  
At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.
  
  
**Job Description**
Position Overview:
  
  
We are hiring a
**Digital Factory Global Application Analyst**
to serve as the key link between business stakeholders, solution architects, and project teams. This role is essential for translating business requirements into functional designs and ensuring successful implementation of digital initiatives. The role will also be a cornerstone in M&A-related activities, supporting the functional transition to a newly independent digital organization by helping define and deploy new systems, processes, and capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Work closely with business stakeholders to define and document functional requirements for digital solutions that enable business continuity and transformation post-acquisition.
* Lead functional planning for M&A carve-out activities, including requirement gathering for new systems, gap analyses, and support for clean-room or transitional environments.
* Translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, and process maps.
* Collaborate with architects and technical teams to align solutions with functional expectations.
* Support workshops, design sessions, and future-state business process mapping.
* Lead user acceptance testing, training coordination, and go-live planning.
* Promote standardization and best practices across the enterprise.
* Monitor project delivery to ensure business value realization and feedback loops.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Supply Chain, Business, or related field (Lean/Six Sigma a plus).
* 7+ years of experience in manufacturing or supply chain, with digital project involvement.
* Experience with functional roles in MES, ERP, APS, WMS, or related platforms.
* M&A or carve-out experience preferred, especially in functional stream design and execution.
* Fluent in English (Spanish or other languages a plus).

**Skills And Competencies**
**Technical Skills**

* Deep understanding of manufacturing and supply chain business processes.
* Experience with requirement documentation, functional specs, and UAT.
* Familiarity with major platforms (e.g., SAP, Kinaxis, Rockwell, Siemens).
* Exposure to M&A transition environments, clean-room operations, or digital separations.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong facilitation and communication skills.
* Ability to navigate uncertainty and evolving business environments.
* Empathy for end users with a focus on value and usability.
* Highly collaborative and proactive in engaging stakeholders.

**Why Join Kidde Global Solutions?**

* Be at the forefront of driving digital transformation in a global organization with a legacy of innovation and excellence.

title: Lead QA – Release & Automation
description:
**Lead QA – Release & Automation**

**About Williams-Sonoma, Inc.**

Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer. Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play. We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond. Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. We are committed to sustainability, continuously working to protect our planet, while building an open and collaborative culture across our organization.

With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide.

Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide.

**Role Overview**

Williams-Sonoma is seeking a Lead QA – Release & Automation to lead end-to-end mobile QA activities across iOS and Android releases, with strong hands-on experience in mobile testing and automation.

This role will own QA release sign-off, coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders, drive release regression, and continuously improve QA processes through automation and AI-enabled testing. Exposure to Web, API, and Microservices testing will be an added advantage.

The ideal candidate will help accelerate release velocity while ensuring high quality across multiple engineering teams contributing to shared releases.

**Impact of the Role**

• Accelerate release velocity while ensuring high quality across multiple engineering teams contributing to shared releases.

• Improve QA processes through automation and AI-enabled testing.

• Reduce release timelines and improve deployment frequency through optimized QA validation and regression processes.

• Drive continuous improvements in automation coverage, pipeline health, defect leakage, and release readiness.

Technology Platforms You Will Work On

• iOS and Android mobile applications

• Mobile automation frameworks such as Appium or equivalent tools

• Mabl, Selenium, and Playwright

• Web, API, and Microservices testing

• CI/CD platforms including Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms

• AI-powered testing solutions, AI-assisted test generation, self-healing automation, and intelligent test selection

**Key Responsibilities**

• Own end-to-end QA release sign-off for mobile applications across iOS and Android.

• Lead release regression testing and ensure production readiness across multiple engineering teams.

• Partner with Engineering, Product, DevOps, Release Management, and Vendor QA teams to plan, coordinate, and execute successful releases.

• Define and standardize QA release processes, quality gates, and release sign-off criteria.

• Drive mobile automation strategy across iOS and Android to maximize automation coverage and reduce manual regression effort.

• Ensure automation suites are stable, maintain high pipeline pass rates, minimize flaky tests, and support reliable CI/CD execution.

• Continuously optimize QA validation and regression processes to reduce release timelines and improve deployment frequency.

• Champion AI-powered testing solutions, AI-assisted test generation, self-healing automation, and intelligent test selection.

• Monitor QA metrics such as automation coverage, execution success rate, pipeline health, defect leakage, and release readiness, driving continuous improvements.

• Coordinate with multiple engineering teams to streamline testing activities and remove bottlenecks in the release process.

• Mentor QA engineers and promote best practices in automation, quality engineering, and release management.

**Qualifications**

• 10–12+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, QA Automation, or Release QA for enterprise applications, including 4+ years of hands-on mobile testing and automation experience.

• 3+ years of experience leading QA release management or centralized regression testing teams.

• Must have strong experience in Mobile QA across iOS and Android, including functional, regression, release, and automation testing.

• Must have hands-on experience with mobile automation frameworks such as Appium or equivalent mobile automation tools.

• Exposure to Mabl, Selenium, Playwright, Web testing, and API testing is good to have.

• Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.

• Experience working in Agile environments with multiple teams contributing to shared releases.

• Must have a strong understanding of release management, quality governance, and regression optimization.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in large-scale retail/eCommerce organizations.

• Experience leading QA transformation initiatives.

• Exposure to Web and API testing.

• Experience leveraging AI-enabled testing to accelerate software delivery.

**Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center**

• Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family.

• Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact.

• Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale.

• Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges.

• Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement.

title: Sr Mgr Software Engineering
description:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem
  
ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.
  
As a Sr Mgr Software Engineering in Pune, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem!
  
Role Summary
  
We are seeking a Sr Mgr Software Engineering to lead a cross-functional team (Software Engineering, DevOps/Platform, Support and Quality Engineering) building and operating a low-latency, high-throughput core banking product platform. You will be accountable for end-to-end delivery: architecture-to-production execution, operational excellence, reliability, security/compliance, and an automation-first quality strategy. You will also bring demonstrated experience delivering AI-enabled initiatives and implementing AI-based solutions in production.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
1) Engineering Leadership & Delivery
  
- Lead and grow a cross-functional team spanning backend, frontend, DevOps/Platform engineering, and Quality Engineering; drive strong ownership, execution discipline, and continuous improvement.
  
- Own delivery for roadmap initiatives and platform modernization across the full SDLC: planning, design, implementation, reviews, testing, release, and production operations.
  
- Establish and communicate technical direction in partnership with Product Management and Architecture to ensure the platform meets business goals and non-functional requirements.
  
2) Low-Latency, Reliability, and Performance (NFR-First)
  
- Drive performance and latency engineering: define latency/throughput SLOs, performance budgets, regression testing, and capacity planning to maintain predictable low-latency behavior under load.
  
- Build “always-on” operational readiness: observability (logs/metrics/traces), runbooks, safe rollouts (feature flags, progressive delivery), and rapid rollback practices.
  
- Partner with Platform/SRE functions to ensure Kubernetes runtime reliability patterns (HA, scaling, and operational tooling) are built into the product delivery lifecycle. ,
  
3) DevOps / Platform Engineering Ownership
  
- Lead the team’s cloud-native delivery model on Kubernetes (including GitOps-based deployment and configuration-as-code). ,
  
- Own and evolve CI/CD and artifact practices using technologies such as Ansible, Nexus, Carvel toolchain (e.g., ytt, kapp-controller), and Kubernetes-native release workflows.
  
- Ensure secure, repeatable environment provisioning and reliable deployments across dev/test/stage/prod with automation as the default.
  
4) Quality Engineering & Test Automation (Shift-Left)
  
- Build a “quality-first” culture with an automated testing strategy across unit/integration/e2e, with strong coverage targets and non-negotiable quality gates.
  
- Implement and operationalize modern test orchestration and automation tooling, including Testkube, and enforce reliable, maintainable CI test execution.
  
- Drive security and compliance testing as part of CI/CD (SAST/DAST/dependency scanning), ensuring regulated-workload readiness and auditability. ,
  
5) AI-Enabled Engineering & Delivered AI Projects (Must-Have)
  
- Lead delivery of AI-enabled initiatives in two dimensions: 1. AI-accelerated SDLC (planning, code review, test generation, documentation, defect reduction), and
  
2. AI/ML/GenAI solution delivery where AI is part of the shipped product or operational capability. ,
  
  
- Establish responsible AI usage practices: teams are encouraged to use AI, but remain accountable for outputs; validate correctness, security, and maintainability before merging.
  
- Enforce safe prompting and data handling: never place secrets/credentials/PCI/PII into prompts; use placeholders and abstractions.
  
6) People Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  
- Coach engineers, DevOps, and QE leads; build career plans, performance feedback loops, and hiring strategies to raise the talent bar.
  
- Collaborate with Product, Security, Compliance, and Operations leaders to deliver outcomes with transparency, predictable execution, and clear metrics.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
- 15+ years in software engineering building distributed systems; 5+ years leading teams (engineering + DevOps and/or QE leadership experience strongly preferred).
  
- Proven experience building and operating low-latency, high-throughput systems in banking, payments, or other regulated transaction platforms.
  
- Hands-on expertise with: - Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures (microservices, containerization, orchestration)
  
- Java backend development (high-performance, concurrent, resilient services)
  
- Angular (modern web UI, performance-minded frontend engineering)
  
- Ansible (automation/configuration management)
  
- Nexus (artifact repository and dependency management)
  
- Cloud Infrastructure ( Familiarity with deployment and development on public and private cloud Azure , AWS, OpenShift)
  
- Carvel toolchain (e.g., ytt, kapp-controller) for packaging/config/deploy workflows
  
- Testkube for test orchestration and automation
  
  
- Demonstrated delivery of AI projects implemented in real environments (production or production-like), such as: - GenAI-assisted developer workflows with measurable outcomes (quality/velocity/defect reduction), and/or
  
- AI/ML capabilities embedded into product or operations (e.g., automated diagnostics, anomaly detection, intelligent triage, or similar).
  
  
- Strong engineering excellence mindset: automated testing, security-by-design, observability, and disciplined release practices.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications

title: Manager Software Development
description:

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA
  
  
**PURPOSE**
We are seeking a highly technical Engineering Manager who has progressed from a Software Developer to Technical Lead and ultimately into Engineering Management.
  
  
This role is not a traditional Project Manager or Scrum Master position. The Engineering Manager will serve as the technical bridge between Architects, Product Owners, Development Teams, QA, DevOps, and Senior Leadership, ensuring business objectives are translated into scalable and sustainable technical solutions.

* Champion continuous improvement initiatives across development lifecycle processes.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE**
**Essential**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience with at least:
* 4+ years as a Software Developer / Senior Software Engineer / Technical Lead.
* 3+ years leading software engineering teams.
* Demonstrated career progression from Software Engineer → Technical Lead → Engineering Manager.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale software products.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications.
* Experience leading architecture reviews and technical design workshops.
* Hands-on software development background in:
* Java and/or .NET ecosystems
* REST APIs and Microservices
* Event-driven architectures
* Cloud Platforms (Azure preferred)

**Highly Desirable**

* Experience with:
* Kubernetes
* Docker
* Azure Services
* Kafka/RabbitMQ
* API-led integrations

**MUST-HAVE TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES**

* Technical Solution Design

* Cloud-Native Architecture
* Microservices Architecture
* System Integration
* API Design and Governance
* DevOps & CI/CD
* Security by Design
* Performance & Scalability Engineering

**PEOPLE LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

* Technical Leadership
* Stakeholder Influence
* Strategic Thinking
* Decision Making
* Communication
* Conflict Resolution
* Cross-functional Collaboration

**EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
* Cloud certification (Azure/AWS/GCP) , Nice to Have.
* TOGAF, Azure Architect, or equivalent architecture certification is nice to have.

**What We Offer**
We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting & Reconciliations, Management Reporting & Analysis, Research & Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support & Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
  
  
The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications.  The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting & regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
  
  
**Job Description\***
This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1) understanding the Change, (2) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams & Users until implementation of the Change.  It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements.  The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.

* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
**Position Summary**

We are hiring a Salesforce Developer with development depth to own the day-to-day health of our Salesforce environment and to build the automation, integrations, and custom functionality the business runs on. Salesforce is the enterprise CRM system of record and sits alongside Salesforce CPQ, Certinia (PSA, SCM, OIM), and NetSuite as part of MGT's consolidated stack.

This role sits on the Platforms Enterprise Applications team, which holds central governance over Salesforce across all MGT business units. Configuration changes, enhancements, bug fixes, and development work move through this team under a common SDLC and a single release process. Business units request and prioritize; this team designs, builds, and deploys.

The work is hands-on and split roughly 60/40 between configuration, release management, and platform governance on one side, and Apex, Lightning Web Components, and integration work on the other. You will support multiple business units as their processes converge onto a single org, so comfort with competing requirements and legacy workflows is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Development**

* Build and maintain Apex triggers using a single-trigger-per-object handler pattern, along with batch, queueable, and scheduled Apex.
* Develop Lightning Web Components and Screen Flows for user-facing functionality; extend standard objects before introducing custom ones.
* Write and maintain unit tests with meaningful assertions, not coverage padding; hold the org above the deployment threshold with a target of 90%+ on new code.
* Write efficient SOQL and design for governor limits and large data volumes, including indexing and selective query patterns.
* Build inbound and outbound integrations using REST/SOAP callouts, Platform Events, Named Credentials, and External Services.
* Participate in code review and follow a source-driven SDLC: Git-based version control, feature branching, SFDX, and automated deployment pipelines. Change-set-only deployment is not acceptable practice here.

**Platform Administration and Governance**

* Own user lifecycle, profiles, permission sets, permission set groups, role hierarchy, sharing rules, and field-level security; move the org toward a permission-set-driven model.
* Act as a gatekeeper for org changes: no direct production configuration, no unmanaged side deployments, no business-unit-local automation outside the governed pipeline.
* Administer license allocation across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, and Certinia, and report on utilization against contracted entitlements.
* Maintain org health: technical debt reduction, deactivation of unused fields and automations, retirement of Workflow Rules and Process Builder in favor of Flow.
* Enforce naming conventions, documentation standards, and metadata hygiene mechanically where possible — validation rules, required approvals, and automated checks rather than process reminders.
* Manage sandbox strategy, refresh cadence, and data seeding.
* Vet AppExchange packages for security review status, license model, and integration impact before installation.

**Integration and Consolidation**

* Support the ongoing consolidation of acquired-entity CRM and quoting processes onto the enterprise Salesforce org, including data mapping, deduplication, and cutover support.
* Maintain integrations between Salesforce, NetSuite, Certinia, and the enterprise integration layer (MuleSoft Anypoint Platform); work with the integration team on error handling, retry logic, and reconciliation.
* Support Salesforce CPQ configuration — product and price rules, bundles, quote templates, approval processes — and the handoff from closed-won to project delivery and billing.
* Contribute to data quality controls: duplicate rules, matching rules, required-field enforcement, and periodic audits.

**Support and Enablement**

* Serve as tier-2/3 escalation for Salesforce issues; triage, root-cause, and resolve within agreed service levels.
* Intake, size, and prioritize enhancement requests through a single backlog rather than ad hoc side channels.
* Build and maintain reports, dashboards, and report types for sales, delivery, and finance leadership.
* Produce release notes and deliver enablement to end users and business-unit admins after each release.
* Manage the three annual Salesforce releases: evaluate impact in preview sandboxes, test critical paths, and communicate changes.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years of Salesforce development experience in a production environment with 200+ users.
* 2+ years writing production Apex, including triggers, asynchronous processing, and test classes.
* Demonstrated experience with Lightning Web Components and the Lightning App Builder.
* Strong Flow skills, including subflows, error handling, and Flow-to-Apex handoffs.
* Working knowledge of the Salesforce security and sharing model, including OWD, sharing rules, and manual and Apex sharing.
* Experience with Git-based version control and a modern deployment toolchain (SFDX, Gearset, Copado, Flosum, or equivalent).
* Experience integrating Salesforce with at least one ERP, finance, or PSA system.
* Salesforce Administrator certification.
* Professional written and spoken English, and the ability to explain technical constraints to non-technical stakeholders.
* Reliable home office setup and the ability to work the required overlap hours.

**Required Qualifications**

title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Moveworks
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Moveworks)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Strong understanding of the Move works platform, including enterprise search, conversational AI, natural language understanding (NLU), employee support automation, and AI-driven workflow orchestration.
* Knowledge of Move works integration capabilities with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Slack, HR systems, identity platforms, and enterprise applications
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of ServiceNow applications (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD).

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Product Illustrator and Writer
description:
**Location:**
Bengaluru (On-site)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Team:**
Design & Marketing

**About Hunar**

Hunar is a voice AI platform helping businesses automate and simplify frontline recruitment and workforce opera-tions.

We’re building AI-powered products that help businesses engage with candidates, automate repetitive conversations, and manage high-volume hiring more eﬀiciently.

We’re a fast-moving startup based in Bengaluru, working with businesses that hire and manage frontline workforces at scale.

**About the role**

We’re looking for a
**Product Illustrator & Writer**
who can bring ideas to life through both visuals and words.

You’ll work across product design, marketing, and brand communication, creating illustrations that give our prod-ucts personality and writing that makes complex technology feel simple, approachable, and human.

From illustrations within the product to website visuals, UX copy, feature announcements, and newsletters, you’ll help shape how Hunar looks, sounds, and communicates with its users.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys both visual storytelling and writing, and understands how the two can work together to create compelling experiences.

**What You'll do**

**Illustration and visual storytelling**

• Design illustrations for product interfaces, empty states, onboarding experiences, and feature announcements.

• Create illustrations and visual assets for website pages, marketing campaigns, and newsletters.

• Develop and maintain a distinctive, consistent illustration language for Hunar.

• Translate complex AI concepts and product capabilities into simple, engaging visual stories.

• Experiment with different illustration styles and creative approaches while maintaining brand consistency.

**UX writing and product communication**

• Write clear, concise, and intuitive UX copy, including labels, instructions, tooltips, empty states, error mes-sages, and onboarding content.

• Work with product designers to make complex workflows easier to understand through thoughtful language.

• Create content for new feature launches, product updates, and in-app announcements.

• Establish and maintain consistency in the product’s voice and tone.

• Think critically about how writing influences usability, comprehension, and user behaviour.

**Marketing and content**

• Write compelling copy for website sections, landing pages, and marketing campaigns.

• Conceptualise, write, and design newsletters and product announcement emails.

• Collaborate with the marketing team on creative campaigns and product storytelling.

• Help communicate Hunar’s value proposition to different audiences through clear messaging and strong visu-als.

**What we're looking for**

• Strong illustration skills with a portfolio demonstrating creativity, versatility, and attention to detail.

• Excellent writing and storytelling skills, with an ability to make complex ideas simple, clear, and engaging.

• Good understanding of visual design fundamentals, including composition, colour, typography, and hierarchy.

• Proficiency in illustration and design tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, or equivalent soft-ware.

• Ability to adapt your illustration and writing styles to different contexts, audiences, and communication goals.

• An understanding of how illustrations and copy work together within digital products.

• Strong conceptual thinking and an ability to communicate the reasoning behind creative decisions.

• Ability to take ownership of projects, work independently, and collaborate across teams.

• A willingness to experiment, learn quickly, and iterate based on feedback.

**Good to have**

• Experience creating illustrations for SaaS products, websites, or digital interfaces.

• Familiarity with UX writing, content design, or product communication.

• Experience with motion graphics or animated illustrations.

• An understanding of B2B products and technology-driven businesses.

• Experience writing and designing email newsletters, feature announcements, or marketing campaigns.

• Familiarity with AI products and an interest in making emerging technologies more approachable.

**What you'll get to work on**

• Shaping the illustration language of a growing AI product.

• Building visual narratives for new features and product experiences.

• Improving how users understand and interact with AI through thoughtful UX writing.

• Creating campaigns and communication assets used by real businesses.

• Working closely with product designers, engineers, and marketers, with the opportunity to own projects from concept to execution.

**Who should apply ?**

We’re open to both
**full-time candidates and students looking for a Graduation Project internship**
.

We’re particularly interested in people with backgrounds in communication design, illustration, visual design, or related disciplines, although your portfolio and ability to think creatively matter more than your degree.

You don’t need to be equally experienced in every aspect of the role, but you should have a genuine interest in both illustration and writing.

Your portfolio should ideally showcase your illustration work, conceptual thinking, and examples of writing or visual storytelling.

title: Founder's Office
description:
**About Wingy**

Love and dating should feel exciting. For most of us, they come with a lot of anxiety too. Wingy is an emotionally-intelligent wingwoman who works alongside you through every part of your love life, helping make modern dating a lot less anxiety-inducing.

We are backed by Gruhas Collective Consumer Fund, ajvc, Anupam Mittal and other leading consumer-tech founders.

**First, about this JD**

You’re expected to work without one.

This is what we’re doing today and where we need help today. It will change, probably by the time you finish onboarding. If you need a fixed scope, this will be a rough ride. If a shifting one sounds like the fun part, read on.

**Two north stars: user growth and retention**

You and the founders own these together. Everything else is negotiable.

**For growth, you’ll:**

* Run our UGC engine: creators, concepts, briefs, output and iteration
* Find the channels we haven’t discovered yet
* Learn and run Meta ads. You don’t need to know how today, but you’ll need to in six weeks.
* Dig out the user insights behind winning hooks: the line that makes someone stop scrolling because it’s uncomfortably about them

**For retention, you’ll:**

* Uncover why some users stay and others disappear, and shape the product journey so more of them stick
* Optimize the whole funnel, from channels, messages and hooks that bring in the right people to the product flow itself

**You’ll probably do well here if you:**

* Are curious about people and always ask the next question
* Can take a user call in the morning, look at a retention cohort in the afternoon, and see how the two connect
* Have made something with a measurable result: content, ads, a product or a community
* Understand hooks, storytelling and internet culture, and can explain why something worked
* Start without a brief, a team or permission
* Hold strong opinions and drop them when the data disagrees

You don’t need a PM title or dating-app experience. Experience with consumer social, marketplaces or Gen Z products helps, but we care far more about how you think and how fast you move.

**What you’re signing up for**

A seat next to the founders for everything: product, users and the messy middle. You’ll learn how a consumer company gets built by building one.

In exchange, you get ambiguity, pace and real ownership, plus a healthy amount of ESOPs and skin in the game.

**How to apply**

Write to priyansha@meetwingy.com about the cool things you’ve done and include a link to your resume or LinkedIn.

title: UI/UX Designer (Brand & Video)
description:
**This role covers three crafts — product interface design, brand and graphic design, and video editing. If you only want to do one of them, this is not the job.**

**THE DATES THAT CANNOT MOVE:**

* **In-person interview:**
  20–30 November 2026, at our Bengaluru office. It cannot be done online.
* **Applications close:**
  15 November 2026. We may close early once the position is filled.
* **Joining date:**
  1 December 2026. Non-negotiable.

You must be free of notice period obligations by 1 December. If you are serving a 60 or 90-day notice, the timing will not work and we cannot make an exception.

**Please read this advertisement to the end before you apply. It is long on purpose — it tells you exactly what the job is, what it is not, and what we will not budge on.**

**WHO WE ARE:**

Jane Aerospace is a Bengaluru-based aerospace and drone supply chain company. We source aircraft parts, drone components and industrial materials for operators, MROs and manufacturers, and we are building Supply Chain as a Service — a subscription model that takes over procurement for our clients entirely.

We run three companies: Jane Aerospace Pvt Ltd (India), Jane Tech Labs Ltd (Hong Kong) and Jane Aero Tech Supply Chain FZCO (UAE). We are bootstrapped, we move quickly, and people here own real things early.

**THE ROLE:**

This job covers three crafts: product interface design, brand and graphic design, and video editing. You would be the only designer in the company, serving both the engineering side and marketing.

**One thing we want to be honest about.**
Nobody at one to three years is world-class at all three of these, and we are not pretending otherwise. We want someone genuinely strong in at least one, competent in the other two, and hungry to get better at all of them. Of the three, we weight product interface design highest — good video can be topped up with freelancers; interface judgement cannot.

The second honest thing: this is a lot of work for one person, and we know it. The volume is capped in writing below rather than left open, and if the work justifies it we expect to add a second designer around March or April.

**Who holds your queue.**
Your time splits roughly 60% marketing work and 40% product interface work, and the Marketing Specialist holds your queue so two teams cannot pull you in two directions at once. That protection is deliberate: this role fails when nobody owns the queue — everything becomes urgent, the interface work slips because it has no weekly deadline, and a year later the company has a lot of social posts and no design system.

**WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO:**

**Product interface — about 40% of your time-**

* Design the interfaces for our internal tools and customer-facing products: the hiring and assessment platform, the BD dashboards, and the SCaaS front end.
* Work directly with our engineering team to get your designs built properly rather than approximately. They currently design their own screens because there is nobody else to do it, and that stops being their job when you join.

**Brand and graphic — the guidelines exist, the system does not -**

* Own and extend the Jane brand system. We have a brand guidelines document. What we do not have is the working apparatus built from it — templates, deck and document masters, social formats, and a version that holds up across three companies with three audiences.
* Produce social and campaign creative against the marketing calendar, for three companies that each keep their own identity.
* Create recruitment and careers creative. We are hiring seven people right now and will hire more.

**Video — capped, and the cap is real -**

Our content model is one substantial long-form piece per brand, cut down into everything else: about six long-form pieces a month — India weekly, Hong Kong and the UAE monthly — plus the short-form derivatives taken from them. Anything beyond that is agreed case by case, not an open queue.

We have written the cap down because an uncapped video queue is the most reliable way to destroy a role like this. The derivatives are the part that expands without anyone noticing.

**WHAT YOU GET PAID:**

Rs 40,000 to Rs 45,000 per month CTC (Rs 4.8–5.4 lakh per annum), depending on experience and on the strength of your portfolio. CTC means cost to company; your in-hand figure will be lower after statutory deductions, and we will show you the exact breakdown at offer stage.

* Compensation reviewed formally at six and twelve months, against evidence.
* A proper machine and the software you need, including AI tooling.
* PF and ESI as per statute.

The real compensation here is the ownership. You would take a brand from a guidelines document to the thing three companies actually run on, and design the products as well as the marketing. Most designers wait years to own that much surface.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

* **MANDATORY —**
  a portfolio containing ALL THREE: at least one real product or app interface, a body of marketing and brand creative, and edited video you cut yourself. A portfolio that is all posters, or all app screens, does not qualify. An application without a portfolio link will not be reviewed.
* You can explain WHY you made a design decision, not just show the result. We will ask, in person, and we will keep asking.
* 1 to 3 years in design. This is not a fresher role.
* Figma to a professional standard — components and systems, not just static frames.
* Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve for editing, and After Effects or equivalent for basic motion.
* A real grasp of hierarchy, usability and accessibility, not just what looks good.
* You can work from a written brief without being walked through it.

**Nice to have, not required -**

* Having built a design system from scratch. Data visualisation and dashboard design — our BD dashboards need it. Deeper motion graphics, sound design or subtitling. Comfort with AI-assisted design and video tooling: we use it and so should you.

**PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:**

We mean this sincerely — it saves everyone time.

* You cannot attend an in-person interview in Bengaluru between 20 and 30 November 2026.
* You cannot join on 1 December 2026, for any reason, including notice period.
* You are not in Bengaluru and are not willing to relocate here at your own arrangement before joining.
* You are looking for a work-from-home or hybrid role. This is fully work from office.
* Your portfolio is entirely template-based work with no original system design.
* You cannot show before-and-after reasoning on a user experience decision.
* Your video reel is entirely stock footage.
* You want to specialise narrowly in one craft right now, or work only on product design — 60% of this job is marketing work.
* You want to own marketing strategy. The Marketing Specialist owns the calendar and the angle; you own how it looks.

**OUR HIRING PROCESS:**

Four rounds. We have deliberately kept the unpaid work small.

1. **Application —**
   short questions and your portfolio link. The portfolio is mandatory and must show all three disciplines.
2. **Craft test —**
   timed, online. A critique of an existing interface, and your written reasoning against a short design brief. Around 45 minutes.
3. **Video interview —**
   recorded, online. You explain the thinking behind your own craft test answers.
4. **In-person with the Managing Director —**
   at our Bengaluru office, 20–30 November. Includes a full portfolio walkthrough — bring the work and expect to be asked why, repeatedly.

The portfolio walkthrough sits in the in-person round on purpose. A walkthrough is only worth anything if the person listening can ask the next question, and the next one after that. That is not something we are willing to automate.

**On AI: use it.**
We do, and we expect you to. But you will be asked to account for your own decisions in rounds three and four, and work you cannot explain is worth nothing to us.

All online rounds complete by 19 November. We make offers on a rolling basis.

**HOW TO APPLY:**

Apply through the link on this posting and answer the application questions in full. Attach your CV, your portfolio link, and a short covering note in your own words — not a template.

title: Product Designer
description:
**Job Description**
What we are building Revenue work is spread across inboxes, calendars, CRMs, calls and individual memory. Reps spend time reconstructing context, deciding what deserves attention and keeping commitments from slipping. It brings context and execution together. When AI can understand conversations, recommend next steps, take action and learn from users, we need to rethink the experience itself - not just add AI to traditional SaaS interfaces. This is not a traditional UI/UX Designer role We are not looking for someone who takes requirements from Product and turns them into polished screens. We need someone who understands user problems independently, questions assumptions, explores different solutions and develops a point of view on what the product should do before deciding what it should look like. We want someone obsessed with the why. Why does a rep behave a certain way? Why does a problem exist? Why should we solve it? Why is one approach better than another? Why might an established design pattern no longer make sense? We do not expect you to have every answer. We expect you to be curious and resourceful enough to find them - and to care just as deeply about how beautifully you bring those answers to life.
  
  
Your role at company: Own the journey from customer understanding to product thinking, interaction design, visual craft and shipped experience. Work directly with reps, founders and engineers. Bring insight and recommendations, not only mockups. The challenge is both conceptual and creative: decide when should recommend, act, ask, explain or stay quiet; make room for human judgment when AI gets something wrong; and turn that complexity into an experience that feels simple, intuitive and exceptional.
  
  
Your scope and work Understand the problem, not just the requirements. Proactively talk to users, observe workflows and review customer conversations. Learn how reps think, decide and work. Go beyond feature requests to uncover the underlying problems and motivations. Own the product experience. Take ambiguous problems from discovery to shipped experiences. Explore fundamentally different approaches, reason through edge cases and tradeoffs, and recommend a direction with a clear why. Make it exceptionally beautiful. Bring outstanding taste in typography, color, composition, spacing, density and visual hierarchy. Use motion, transitions and micro-interactions with purpose - to clarify behavior, build trust and create delight. Obsess over details without losing sight of the whole experience. Design for an AI-native world. Rethink how people interact with systems that understand context, recommend and act. Design for trust, feedback, user control and recovery when the AI is wrong. Challenge conventional interface patterns where better ones can exist. Move quickly and ship. Sketch, prototype and test early. Use whatever methods and tools best help you learn and bring ideas to life. Collaborate with engineers through implementation and take responsibility for what actually ships.
