title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
**Senior Graphic Designer**

**Location:**
Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

**Experience:**
4-6 years

**About the Company**

BigBrainCo is a dynamic digital agency that helps brands and content creators strengthen their online presence through innovative strategy, content creation, and data-driven insights. The company works with diverse clients across industries, developing and executing impactful social media campaigns that connect creative quality with measurable audience and business outcomes. Our team combines strategic thinking, visual storytelling, production capabilities, and performance awareness to deliver work across major digital platforms. Designers contribute directly to how clients are represented online, translating brand goals and campaign requirements into clear, engaging, and effective visual communication. Because the agency manages multiple accounts and formats, the work offers exposure to varied industries, creative challenges, and evolving brand systems. BigBrainCo values ownership, collaboration, speed, consistency, and continuous improvement. This role will join a creative environment where strong design judgment is trusted, high-visibility work is visible to clients and internal leaders, and better systems are encouraged to improve quality and delivery across the wider team.

**About the Role**

The Senior Graphic Designer owns BigBrainCo’s most demanding and high-visibility design work across client accounts while delivering the full range of visual assets required for social and content campaigns. You will design YouTube thumbnails, Instagram creatives and carousels, brand kits, style guides, reusable templates, and motion-supporting assets. The role combines hands-on execution with advanced creative judgment, ensuring every output is visually strong, platform-appropriate, brand-consistent, and aligned with performance goals such as click-through rate and audience engagement. You will review junior designers’ work, mentor newer team members, and help establish stronger design systems, SOPs, and file workflows. Close collaboration with video editing and production teams will ensure consistency between static, motion, and narrative formats. This is a growth-track opportunity for a designer ready to own complex accounts, improve how the team works, and build toward leading the Graphic Design function.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own high-visibility design across client accounts, translating complex briefs into clear visual solutions that strengthen brand presence, audience engagement, and campaign performance.
* Design click-worthy YouTube thumbnails for scheduled uploads, using strong composition, hierarchy, branding, and performance awareness to support channel growth and improve CTR.
* Create Instagram static creatives and carousels that follow platform best practices while preserving visual hierarchy, brand identity, readability, and consistent audience communication.
* Build and maintain client brand kits and style guides covering typography, colour palettes, logo usage, and design language as the single source of visual truth.
* Develop editable social templates that accelerate recurring content production, reduce avoidable rework, and help the wider team deliver consistent output across accounts.
* Review junior and associate designers’ work, provide actionable feedback, and support onboarding and capability development before work reaches the Creative Head.
* Improve design SOPs, file management, and workflows while collaborating with video and production teams to maintain visual and narrative consistency across formats.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, with a portfolio demonstrating strong thumbnails, social creatives, brand identity systems, and visual communication across multiple formats.
* Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro or motion design workflows, enabling effective collaboration with video editors and production teams on crossover creative requirements.
* Strong understanding of YouTube and Instagram design requirements, including visual hierarchy, mobile readability, platform conventions, brand consistency, and creative decisions that support CTR.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain brand kits or style guides across multiple clients or brands, keeping guidance current and usable by the wider team.
* Advanced design judgment with the independence to solve complex creative briefs, manage competing priorities, and deliver polished work with minimal oversight.
* Clear, constructive communication skills for reviewing junior designers’ work, explaining design decisions, and giving feedback that improves quality and capability.

**Additional Plus**

* Prior experience in a digital, social media, or creative agency environment managing multiple client brands and fast-moving production schedules.
* Experience mentoring junior designers, contributing to team standards, or preparing for formal ownership of a Graphic Design function.
* Familiarity with performance-led creative thinking, including using audience response, content objectives, and campaign outcomes to inform visual decisions.

**What You'll Bring**

* You bring 4–6 years of graphic design experience, ideally gained in an agency environment where multiple brands, deadlines, and creative standards must be managed at the same time. Your portfolio should show strong YouTube thumbnails, Instagram creatives and carousels, brand identity work, reusable templates, and motion or motion-adjacent design.
* You are highly proficient in Photoshop and Illustrator and understand how platform context changes the way visual work should be structured, read, and evaluated. You can design for click-through rate, attention, clarity, and brand impact rather than aesthetics alone.
* You are comfortable building brand kits and style guides, identifying outdated guidance, and making visual systems practical for a wider team. You work independently on complex briefs, communicate decisions clearly, and maintain quality under delivery pressure.
* You are also ready to review junior designers’ work with specific, respectful feedback and support their development. Most importantly, you bring ownership, sharp visual judgment, operational discipline, and the ambition to grow into a future Graphic Design team lead.

**Why Join Us**

* Own the agency’s most complex and high-visibility design work from day one, with direct influence on how diverse brands appear and perform across digital platforms.
* Follow a clear growth path toward leading the Graphic Design team while building leadership experience through mentorship, quality review, and design systems ownership.
* Build a varied portfolio spanning YouTube thumbnails, social campaigns, brand systems, reusable templates, motion collaboration, and high-impact client work.
* Work in a collaborative, creative, and high-energy environment where strong ideas, practical improvements, and accountable execution are valued.

**What We Offer**

* Full-time Senior Graphic Designer opportunity based in Mumbai, with ownership of high-visibility client work and meaningful creative responsibility.
* Broad exposure to brands and content creators across industries, enabling portfolio growth across social, branding, thumbnails, templates, and motion collaboration.
* Structured opportunity to influence design workflows, mentor junior talent, and progress toward leading the Graphic Design team.
* Collaborative agency culture with cross-functional exposure to strategy, content creation, video editing, production, and data-informed campaign execution.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Job Description: UX/UI Designer

**Company**: Sanatan Seva Setu  
**Experience**: 1–3 Years (early stage)  
**Employment** **Type**: Full-time  
**Work** **Arrangement**: On-site  
**Compensation**: Negotiable based on skills and experience

About the Role

Sanatan Seva Setu is looking for a user-focused UX/UI Designer who can transform product requirements into intuitive, seamless, and user-friendly digital experiences.

The role requires someone who can think from the user's perspective, understand product requirements, ask the right questions from a UX standpoint, identify potential friction points, and design experiences that make discovering and booking pujas and seva simple and effortless.

You will own the user journey across our homepage, service discovery, and booking flows, ensuring a consistent experience across mobile apps (if applicable), desktop web, and mobile web.

We are looking for a designer who understands that good UX goes beyond visual design. It requires anticipating user needs, challenging unclear requirements, simplifying complex interactions, and continuously improving the overall product experience.

***Key Responsibilities***

***1. Product Requirement Understanding***

* **Collaborate with the product team to understand business requirements, feature objectives, user needs, and expected outcomes.**
* **Analyse every requirement from a UX perspective before beginning the design process.**
* Ask relevant questions, identify missing information, challenge assumptions, and highlight potential usability issues.
* Translate product requirements into clear user problems, user stories, flows, and design solutions.
* Identify edge cases, dependencies, and scenarios that could create confusion or friction.
* Align with product stakeholders and developers on functionality, feasibility, and expected behaviour before finalizing designs.

***2. User-Centred Thinking & Problem Solving***

* **Consistently think from the user's point of view when designing features, interfaces, and workflows.**
* Understand user intent, expectations, behaviour, and potential pain points at every stage of the journey.
* Identify unnecessary steps, confusing information, unclear calls to action, and barriers to user journey.
* **Simplify complex interactions and make interfaces intuitive, accessible, and easy to navigate.**
* Anticipate user questions and design interfaces that provide the right information at the right time.

***3. User Journey & Booking Flow Ownership***

* Design, maintain, and continuously improve end-to-end booking journeys.
* **Ensure users can move smoothly from discovering a puja or seva to understanding its details, selecting an option, providing required information, making payment, and receiving booking confirmation.**
* **Minimize unnecessary steps, repeated inputs, confusing forms, and avoidable drop-offs.**
* Design clear form interactions, validation messages, error handling, loading states, payment failure states, and recovery flows.
* **Ensure booking flows remain consistent, predictable, and easy to complete across supported platforms.**

***4. Service Discovery & Navigation***

* Own and Improve the discovery experience so users can easily find relevant pujas, jaap and mantra services, mannat pujas, chadhava, and other seva offerings.
* Design intuitive navigation, category structures, search and filtering experiences where applicable, and clear content hierarchy.
* **Help users understand the differences between offerings and choose the most relevant service for their needs.**
* **Reduce confusion during browsing and create a natural path from discovery to booking.**
* Review discovery journeys regularly to identify usability gaps and opportunities for improvement.

***5. Homepage Design & Maintenance***

* **Own the UX/UI of the homepage and continuously improve its structure, navigation, content hierarchy, and user journeys.**
* **Ensure users quickly understand what Sanatan Seva Setu offers and how to access relevant services.**
* Organize homepage sections, service categories, promotional content, trust elements, and calls to action around user needs.
* **Maintain consistency between the homepage, discovery pages, service-detail pages, and booking experience.**
* Adapt the homepage to different screen sizes, devices, and user contexts.
* Collaborate with the product team to prioritize homepage improvements based on user needs and business objectives.

***6. Cross-Platform UX/UI Design***

* **Design seamless, responsive experiences across mobile applications (android, IOS) where applicable, desktop web, and mobile web.**
* **Adapt layouts, navigation, interactions, forms, and content hierarchy to suit each platform.**
* **Ensure a consistent experience while accounting for platform-specific behaviour and constraints**.
* **Define responsive layouts, breakpoints, component behaviour, and interaction patterns.**
* Identify differences between desktop and mobile usage and design accordingly rather than simply shrinking desktop screens.
* **Validate designs across relevant screen sizes and ensure important tasks remain easy to complete on every supported platform.**

***7. Design System & Global CSS***

* **Maintain consistent UI patterns, design components, typography, spacing, colours, and interaction behaviour across the product.**
* **Research and create the information architecture.**
* **Good to have, not mandatory: Basic understanding of global CSS, CSS variables, design tokens, reusable styles, and responsive CSS.**

***8. Prototyping, Validation & Design QA***

* Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs using **Figma**.
* Validate important interactions and user journeys before development.
* **Conduct usability reviews and use feedback, available analytics, and observed user behaviour to guide improvements.**
* **Review implemented screens against approved designs and identify visual or functional inconsistencies.**
* Iterate on designs based on feedback, usability findings, and changing product requirements.

***Required Skills***

* 1–3 years of experience in UX/UI design, product design, or a similar role – **the years are not hard number, conviction & interest in this space is important.**
* **Strong user-centred thinking and the ability to evaluate requirements from a UX perspective.**
* **Ability to understand product requirements, ask meaningful questions, and identify missing scenarios before designing.**
* Experience designing user journeys, information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity interfaces.
* Strong understanding of booking flows, service discovery, navigation, forms, and conversion-focused UX.
* **Proficiency in Figma, including auto layout, reusable components, prototyping**, and product/developer handoff.
* **Strong understanding of usability, interaction design, visual hierarchy, and accessibility fundamentals.**
* **Ability to identify friction points and simplify complex user journeys.**
* Good documentation, and problem-solving skills.
* **Attention to detail and the ability to take ownership of a feature from requirement understanding through implementation review.**

**Expected Deliverables**

* **User journeys and flow diagrams for discovery and booking.**
* **UX analysis of product requirements, including clarification questions and identified edge cases.**
* **Responsive UI designs for mobile, desktop web, and mobile web.**
* **Homepage design improvements and ongoing maintenance.**
* **Service discovery, service-detail, and booking-flow designs.**
* **Reusable UI components and design-system documentation.**
* **Error, loading, empty, validation, and payment-related states.**
* **Developer-ready Figma files and implementation specifications.**
* Design QA reviews and recommendations for reducing friction across the product.

***Expected Working Approach***

The candidate should follow a user-first design process:

* Understand the requirement: Clarify the product objective, business need, and expected outcome.
* Think from the user's perspective: Identify what the user wants to achieve, what information they need, and what might confuse them.
* Ask UX questions: Challenge assumptions, uncover missing scenarios, and identify potential friction before designing.
* Map the journey: Define the simplest practical path to completing the user's task.
* Design and validate: Create wireframes and prototypes, gather feedback, and refine the experience.
* Build for every platform: Adapt the experience for mobile, desktop web, and mobile web.
* Collaborate and implement: Work with developers to ensure the design is understood and implemented correctly.
* Monitor and improve: Identify friction, review feedback, and continuously improve the experience.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

**We are looking for someone who:**

* Thinks like a user advocate, not just a visual designer.
* Understands requirements before jumping into design.
* Asks the right questions and proactively identifies UX problems.
* Takes ownership of the homepage, discovery experience, and booking journey.
* Prioritizes simplicity, clarity, consistency, and frictionless task completion.
* Understands responsive design and platform-specific user behaviour.
* Communicates clearly with product stakeholders and developers.
* Values scalable design systems and consistent implementation.
* Takes responsibility for the experience beyond handing over a Figma file.

Interested candidates should share:

* An updated CV or résumé.
* A portfolio demonstrating UX/UI or product design work.
* At least one case study showing how they understood requirements, identified user problems, mapped a journey, and developed a solution.
* Examples of responsive designs and booking or discovery flows, if available.
* Relevant experience, current location, and expected compensation.

Candidates should be prepared to explain their design decisions, the questions they asked before starting, the friction points they identified, and how their solution improved the user journey.

Apply for: UX/UI Designer

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Launchpad Fellowship
description:
**About Atlys**

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.

**The Role**

The
**Launchpad Fellowship**
is a full-time, in-office internship designed for final-year students and recent graduates looking to gain meaningful, hands-on experience before stepping into their first full-time role.

You’ll work closely with teams across operations, growth, research, strategy, customer experience, product, and process improvement, gaining exposure to how a high-growth startup operates, makes decisions, and solves real customer problems at scale.

**The Job**

* **Growth, Research & Strategy:**
  Work on business problems across growth and strategy, conduct research, identify opportunities, and turn insights into actionable recommendations.
* **Operations & Customer Experience:**
  Work on real customer journeys, manage core visa operations, and understand how we deliver a seamless experience at scale.
* **Product & Process Improvement:**
  Identify user pain points and operational inefficiencies, and work with product and process teams to build better solutions, tools, and workflows.
* **Cross-Functional Execution:**
  Work closely with different teams, take ownership of projects, and learn to prioritise, move quickly, and solve problems in a fast-paced startup environment.
* **Capstone & Leadership Exposure:**
  Take ownership of a real business challenge, develop a solution, and present your work to leadership, while receiving regular mentorship and feedback throughout the fellowship.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Are a final-year student or recent graduate looking for a full-time, in-office, high-intensity internship.
* Are a quick learner who is comfortable with ambiguity and unfamiliar problems.
* Communicate clearly and take ownership without waiting to be told what to do.
* Are curious about product, operations, customer experience, or how businesses work.
* Thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy figuring things out independently.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*

**What you can expect**

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s what you can expect:

* **Competitive compensation and equity**
  so you participate in the value you help create.
* **A thoughtful leave policy**
  with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* **Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office**
  , so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* **Great tools to do your best work**
  , including high-spec equipment and software.
* **An office designed for more than just work**
  , with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Product Associate
description:
About the Company

PlaySuper is India's first Gaming Commerce company, pioneering a new way for 500M+ gamers, an audience growing at 19.6% YoY, to shop inside games.

It is a white-label SaaS plugin that integrates into casual and hyper-casual games, transforming in-game coins into real-world value. Players can redeem them for brand coupons, digital services, or even physical products inside fully customizable in-game stores.

For gaming studios, PlaySuper directly solves the industry's toughest challenge, low retention, while also boosting monetisation. For brands, it unlocks a massive high-attention audience that already spends billions on in-game experiences, enabling targeted engagement with measurable ROI. Unlike traditional ads, PlaySuper embeds commerce into gameplay itself, improving recall, conversion, and loyalty.

In under two years, PlaySuper has onboarded 20+ studios, 3,000+ brands, and reached 6M+ DAUs through its partners, backed by $1.6M funding from Jungle Ventures (Chimera), Audacity VC, IAN Capital Fund, 100x.VC, and leaders from Meta, Tata, Dyson, and Amazon.

playsuper.ai

The Role

We are looking for a
**Product Associate**
who thinks in
**funnels, user behaviour, and data**
. You will work directly with the founding and product team on PlaySuper's live commerce surfaces across partner games.

This role is ideal for someone who:

* Is obsessed with why users drop off and what makes them convert
* Can pull their own data instead of waiting for someone else to
* Ships fast, writes clearly, and is comfortable with ambiguity
* Uses AI tools aggressively to move faster

You will not be writing specs in isolation. You will own surfaces that millions of players see.

The role starts as a
**3-month full-time internship**
in Gurgaon and converts to a
**permanent Product Associate**
position on performance.

What You'll Do

* Own specific surfaces of the in-game store: homepage, category pages, product pages, cart, checkout
* Write PRDs, event taxonomies, and analytics specs that engineering can build from directly
* Run your own analysis on funnels, retention, and conversion to find where users leak
* Design and run A/B tests, then defend the results with data
* Work with design to build store experiences that feel native to the game, not bolted on
* Support partner studios with launch readiness, integration checks, and performance reviews
* Build proposals and merchandising strategies for partner games
* Turn open-ended problems into prototypes quickly, using AI and vibe-coding tools

What We're Looking For

* Strong analytical ability, comfortable with SQL and dashboarding tools
* Clear, structured written communication, no fluff
* Genuine interest in gaming, commerce, or rewards-led products
* Ability to prototype ideas independently using AI tools
* High ownership, low ego, fast iteration

Strong Plus (Nice to Have)

* **1-year experience as a Product Associate at a startup or product-led company.**
* **Experience at a consumer internet, e-commerce, gaming, or fintech startup**
* **Familiarity with event-based analytics stacks such as ClickHouse, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Metabase**
* **Prior exposure to loyalty, cashback, rewards, or in-app purchase systems**
* **Shipped side projects, prototypes, or products of your own**

Structure and Location

* **First 3 months:**
  Full-time paid internship. You will own a live surface from day one, not shadow someone else's work.

  Conversion to a permanent Product Associate role, based on performance.

title: Senior User Experience Researcher
description:
**Position Overview**

We are looking for a Senior User Researcher to independently own research for one or more product charters and mentor juniors on technical craft. The role requires translating complex product and business problems into well-scoped research studies, synthesising findings into compelling narratives, and ensuring insights shape product and design decisions.

This is not a supported IC role. The expectation is full outcome ownership — from scoping through to insight implementation — within the researcher’s assigned charter.

**Must-have**

* 5+ years of hands-on user research experience with a track record of independently leading complex projects from scoping to delivery.
* Background in a consumer or marketplace product company with demonstrated ability to connect research to business and product outcomes.
* Experience contributing research during 0-1 product builds — where user needs and problem space were undefined — not just feature-level research.
* Comfort with ambiguity: able to break down large, poorly-defined problems into structured, cohort-based research plans.
* Strong qualitative depth with ability to integrate quantitative and analytics inputs into research synthesis.

**Good to have**

* Some experience informally guiding or reviewing the work of junior researchers, even without a formal mentoring title.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Design, Psychology, Social Sciences, or related fields. Quality of work experience takes precedence over formal education.

title: Founder's Office
description:
**About Wingy**

Love and dating should feel exciting. For most of us, they come with a lot of anxiety too. Wingy is an emotionally-intelligent wingwoman who works alongside you through every part of your love life, helping make modern dating a lot less anxiety-inducing.

We are backed by Gruhas Collective Consumer Fund, ajvc, Anupam Mittal and other leading consumer-tech founders.

**First, about this JD**

You’re expected to work without one.

This is what we’re doing today and where we need help today. It will change, probably by the time you finish onboarding. If you need a fixed scope, this will be a rough ride. If a shifting one sounds like the fun part, read on.

**Two north stars: user growth and retention**

You and the founders own these together. Everything else is negotiable.

**For growth, you’ll:**

* Run our UGC engine: creators, concepts, briefs, output and iteration
* Find the channels we haven’t discovered yet
* Learn and run Meta ads. You don’t need to know how today, but you’ll need to in six weeks.
* Dig out the user insights behind winning hooks: the line that makes someone stop scrolling because it’s uncomfortably about them

**For retention, you’ll:**

* Uncover why some users stay and others disappear, and shape the product journey so more of them stick
* Optimize the whole funnel, from channels, messages and hooks that bring in the right people to the product flow itself

**You’ll probably do well here if you:**

* Are curious about people and always ask the next question
* Can take a user call in the morning, look at a retention cohort in the afternoon, and see how the two connect
* Have made something with a measurable result: content, ads, a product or a community
* Understand hooks, storytelling and internet culture, and can explain why something worked
* Start without a brief, a team or permission
* Hold strong opinions and drop them when the data disagrees

You don’t need a PM title or dating-app experience. Experience with consumer social, marketplaces or Gen Z products helps, but we care far more about how you think and how fast you move.

**What you’re signing up for**

A seat next to the founders for everything: product, users and the messy middle. You’ll learn how a consumer company gets built by building one.

In exchange, you get ambiguity, pace and real ownership, plus a healthy amount of ESOPs and skin in the game.

**How to apply**

Write to priyansha@meetwingy.com about the cool things you’ve done and include a link to your resume or LinkedIn.

title: Product Illustrator and Writer
description:
**Location:**
Bengaluru (On-site)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Team:**
Design & Marketing

**About Hunar**

Hunar is a voice AI platform helping businesses automate and simplify frontline recruitment and workforce opera-tions.

We’re building AI-powered products that help businesses engage with candidates, automate repetitive conversations, and manage high-volume hiring more eﬀiciently.

We’re a fast-moving startup based in Bengaluru, working with businesses that hire and manage frontline workforces at scale.

**About the role**

We’re looking for a
**Product Illustrator & Writer**
who can bring ideas to life through both visuals and words.

You’ll work across product design, marketing, and brand communication, creating illustrations that give our prod-ucts personality and writing that makes complex technology feel simple, approachable, and human.

From illustrations within the product to website visuals, UX copy, feature announcements, and newsletters, you’ll help shape how Hunar looks, sounds, and communicates with its users.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys both visual storytelling and writing, and understands how the two can work together to create compelling experiences.

**What You'll do**

**Illustration and visual storytelling**

• Design illustrations for product interfaces, empty states, onboarding experiences, and feature announcements.

• Create illustrations and visual assets for website pages, marketing campaigns, and newsletters.

• Develop and maintain a distinctive, consistent illustration language for Hunar.

• Translate complex AI concepts and product capabilities into simple, engaging visual stories.

• Experiment with different illustration styles and creative approaches while maintaining brand consistency.

**UX writing and product communication**

• Write clear, concise, and intuitive UX copy, including labels, instructions, tooltips, empty states, error mes-sages, and onboarding content.

• Work with product designers to make complex workflows easier to understand through thoughtful language.

• Create content for new feature launches, product updates, and in-app announcements.

• Establish and maintain consistency in the product’s voice and tone.

• Think critically about how writing influences usability, comprehension, and user behaviour.

**Marketing and content**

• Write compelling copy for website sections, landing pages, and marketing campaigns.

• Conceptualise, write, and design newsletters and product announcement emails.

• Collaborate with the marketing team on creative campaigns and product storytelling.

• Help communicate Hunar’s value proposition to different audiences through clear messaging and strong visu-als.

**What we're looking for**

• Strong illustration skills with a portfolio demonstrating creativity, versatility, and attention to detail.

• Excellent writing and storytelling skills, with an ability to make complex ideas simple, clear, and engaging.

• Good understanding of visual design fundamentals, including composition, colour, typography, and hierarchy.

• Proficiency in illustration and design tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, or equivalent soft-ware.

• Ability to adapt your illustration and writing styles to different contexts, audiences, and communication goals.

• An understanding of how illustrations and copy work together within digital products.

• Strong conceptual thinking and an ability to communicate the reasoning behind creative decisions.

• Ability to take ownership of projects, work independently, and collaborate across teams.

• A willingness to experiment, learn quickly, and iterate based on feedback.

**Good to have**

• Experience creating illustrations for SaaS products, websites, or digital interfaces.

• Familiarity with UX writing, content design, or product communication.

• Experience with motion graphics or animated illustrations.

• An understanding of B2B products and technology-driven businesses.

• Experience writing and designing email newsletters, feature announcements, or marketing campaigns.

• Familiarity with AI products and an interest in making emerging technologies more approachable.

**What you'll get to work on**

• Shaping the illustration language of a growing AI product.

• Building visual narratives for new features and product experiences.

• Improving how users understand and interact with AI through thoughtful UX writing.

• Creating campaigns and communication assets used by real businesses.

• Working closely with product designers, engineers, and marketers, with the opportunity to own projects from concept to execution.

**Who should apply ?**

We’re open to both
**full-time candidates and students looking for a Graduation Project internship**
.

We’re particularly interested in people with backgrounds in communication design, illustration, visual design, or related disciplines, although your portfolio and ability to think creatively matter more than your degree.

You don’t need to be equally experienced in every aspect of the role, but you should have a genuine interest in both illustration and writing.

Your portfolio should ideally showcase your illustration work, conceptual thinking, and examples of writing or visual storytelling.

title: Senior Connections Strategist
description:
**Senior Connections Strategist**

Omnicom Global Solutions, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gurugram, Pune and Mumbai IN

**About Omnicom Global Solutions**

Omnicom Global Solutions (OGS) is an integral part of Omnicom Group, a leading global marketing and corporate communications company. Omnicom’s branded networks and specialty firms deliver advertising, strategic media planning and buying, digital and interactive marketing, direct and promotional marketing, public relations, and other specialized communication solutions to over 5,000 clients across more than 70 countries.

OGS India serves as a key global capability center for Omnicom, enabling its agencies and group companies with scaled delivery, specialized expertise, and integrated solutions. Our capabilities span Media, Data & Analytics, Technology, MarTech, Commerce, Business Support Solutions, Creative Production, Healthcare, and Strategy & Insights.

With a workforce of over 7,000 professionals in India, OGS continues to expand its capabilities and global impact, supporting the evolving needs of clients and agencies. We are committed to building future-ready talent and delivering high-quality, outcome-driven solutions.

*OGS India continues to expand its scale and capabilities through the integration of additional global operations, further strengthening its position as a strategic solutions engine for Omnicom.*

**Let’s build what’s next.**

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a Senior Connections Strategist who will play a key role in developing insight-led audience and communications strategies for leading brands. In this role, you will identify how, where, and when brands can meaningfully connect with audiences across channels and touchpoints. You will leverage audience intelligence, cultural insights, and media understanding to build strategic frameworks, uncover growth opportunities, and develop compelling recommendations that drive marketing effectiveness. Working closely with strategy, media, creative, and data teams, you will translate research and audience insights into clear strategic narratives and client-ready solutions.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Develop insight-led connections strategies that identify opportunities for brands to engage audiences across paid, owned, earned, social, digital, and emerging channels.
* Build and refine target audience profiles using consumer research, audience intelligence tools, and behavioural data.
* Analyse audience mindsets, motivations, media consumption habits, and cultural trends to uncover actionable insights.
* Utilize research platforms such as GWI and other audience intelligence tools to support strategic recommendations.
* Create audience segmentation frameworks and customer journey maps that inform communication planning and activation.
* Develop connections frameworks, communication ecosystems, and go-to-market recommendations for brands and campaigns.
* Collaborate with media, creative, strategy, and analytics teams to ensure consumer insights are effectively translated into marketing solutions.
* Synthesize complex data and research into concise, compelling, and actionable client-facing presentations.
* Monitor industry, media, consumer, and cultural trends to identify emerging opportunities for brands.
* Present strategic recommendations and insights confidently to internal stakeholders and client teams.
* Independently manage projects and workstreams while ensuring high-quality outputs and adherence to timelines.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 4-6 years of experience in Connections Planning, Communications Planning, Audience Strategy, Consumer Insights, Brand Strategy, or related strategic marketing functions.
* Proven experience developing audience-first marketing or communications strategies.
* Hands-on experience with audience research platforms, particularly GWI, and familiarity with tools such as YouGov, social listening platforms, and other audience intelligence solutions.
* Strong understanding of the media landscape, including digital, social, paid, owned, earned, and emerging channels.
* Ability to interpret research and data to generate meaningful consumer and business insights.
* Experience creating audience segments, customer journeys, communication frameworks, and strategic recommendations.
* Excellent storytelling, presentation, and communication skills with the ability to translate complex information into clear narratives.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency in PowerPoint and other presentation and reporting tools.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working within advertising agencies, media agencies, consulting firms, or brand strategy teams.
* Exposure to integrated marketing, communications planning, or connection planning methodologies.
* Experience collaborating with creative, media, data, and analytics teams.
* Familiarity with social listening, cultural intelligence, and market research platforms.
* Experience developing client-ready strategic presentations and facilitating stakeholder discussions.

title: Business Analyst Intern
description:
**About Codemonk**
Codemonk is a Product Engineering and AI-focused technology company helping startups and enterprises build scalable digital products. Our expertise spans Product Engineering, Cloud, AI, GenAI, Computer Vision, and modern digital platforms.
  
  
We work closely with clients to solve complex business challenges by combining deep technical expertise with strong product thinking.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Business Analyst Intern who is eager to learn how technology solutions are designed and delivered in a real-world IT services and product engineering environment.
  
  
As a Business Analyst Intern, you will work closely with Business Analysts, Project Managers, Developers, and other stakeholders to understand business requirements, support documentation, and contribute to the early stages of solution development.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who is curious about technology, business problem-solving, and product development and wants to build a career in Business Analysis.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Requirement Analysis & Documentation
* Assist Business Analysts in gathering and analysing business and functional requirements.
* Help convert business requirements into clear and structured documentation.
* Assist in preparing: Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs)
* User Stories
* Acceptance Criteria
* Use Cases
* Process Flows
* Maintain and update project documentation as requirements evolve.
* Stakeholder & Team Collaboration
* Participate in client and internal requirement discussions and meetings.
* Work closely with Business Analysts and Project Managers to understand project objectives and requirements.
* Coordinate with development and QA teams to clarify functional requirements when required.
* Document meeting discussions, action items, decisions, and follow-ups.

* Conduct research on technologies, products, competitors, and industry trends to support solution discussions.
* Assist in analysing business problems and identifying potential solution approaches.
* Support the team in preparing presentations, solution documents, and project-related materials.
* Develop an understanding of how business requirements are translated into technology solutions.
* AI & Emerging Technologies
* Gain exposure to projects involving Generative AI, AI/ML, Computer Vision, and other emerging technologies.
* Research and understand basic concepts and potential business applications of emerging technologies.
* Process & Quality Support
* Help maintain consistency and quality across BA documentation and templates.
* Assist in tracking requirements and ensuring documentation is up to date.
* Support the team in identifying gaps, dependencies, and open questions in project requirements.
* Required Skills & Qualifications
* Bachelor's degree or currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Strong interest in technology and software product development.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to organise information and present it in a clear and structured manner.
* Good attention to detail.
* Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced environment.
* Basic understanding of software development concepts is preferred.

**Nice to Have**

* Basic understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Miro, Figma, or similar tools.
* Basic knowledge of APIs, databases, or web/mobile applications.
* Interest in Generative AI, LLMs, AI/ML, or Computer Vision.

**What You'll Learn**

* How business requirements are gathered and analysed.
* How software projects move from an initial idea to development and delivery.
* How to create professional business and functional documentation.
* How Business Analysts collaborate with clients, developers, designers, QA teams, and project managers.
* How technology solutions are evaluated and structured to solve real business problems.
* Exposure to AI, GenAI, and Computer Vision projects.

**Work Culture & Benefits**

* Work Schedule: 5-day work week, with regular working hours from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
* Learning & Development: Access to free Udemy courses across various domains and Claude Partner Network courses.

**Why Join Codemonk?**

* Gain hands-on exposure to real-world technology and product engineering projects.
* Work alongside experienced Business Analysts and engineering teams.
* Get exposure to emerging technologies, including GenAI and Computer Vision.
* Develop practical skills in requirements analysis, solution documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Opportunity to build a strong foundation for a career in Business Analysis, Product Management, or Solution Consulting.

**Note:**
This is a paid internship.Skills: brd,frd,user stories

title: Product Manager II
description:

We believe that diversity and inclusion for people from all walks of life is key to our success as a company.

We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, visa fees, or anything else during the hiring process. We do not extend offers via text-based apps or use Microsoft Teams for interviews. title: UIUXDesigner
description:
**Company Description**
I Life Technologies is a growing technology company focused on building innovative digital products and solutions for a diverse range of customers. The organization emphasizes user-centric design, modern technology stacks, and collaborative development practices. Team members work closely across disciplines to deliver intuitive, efficient, and reliable experiences. I Life Technologies values continuous learning, open communication, and a culture of respect and inclusion, making it a supportive environment for design professionals.
  
**Role Description**
The UI/UX Designer will be responsible for designing intuitive, user-centered interfaces for web and mobile applications in close collaboration with product and engineering teams. Day-to-day tasks include conducting user research, creating wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity visual designs, and iterating based on feedback and usability testing. The role also involves maintaining design systems, ensuring consistency across products, and documenting design decisions for cross-functional stakeholders. This is a full-time, on-site position based in Chennai, requiring regular collaboration with local team members and participation in design reviews, workshops, and project planning sessions.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong skills in user interface design and visual design, including layout, typography, color, and interaction patterns.
* Experience in user experience design activities such as user research, persona development, journey mapping, and usability testing.
* Proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, or equivalent) and familiarity with design systems.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders, communicating design concepts clearly.
* Understanding of responsive design principles and basic knowledge of front-end capabilities (HTML, CSS, and common frameworks) is beneficial.

* Bachelor’s degree in Design, HCI, Visual Communication, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong attention to detail, comfort with feedback and iteration, and commitment to inclusive, accessible design practices.

title: Senior Analyst Market Research
description:
**Job title**
: Senior Analyst – Market Research
  
  

* Hiring Manager: Group Lead I&A
* Location: Hyderabad
* % of travel expected: Travel required as per business need, if any
* Job type: Permanent and Full time

**About The Job**

Sanofi Global Hub (SGH) is an internal Sanofi resource organization based in India and is setup to centralize processes and activities to support Specialty Care, Vaccines, General Medicines, CHC, CMO, and R&D, Data & Digital functions . SGH strives to be a strategic and functional partner for tactical deliveries to Medical, HEVA, and Commercial organizations in Sanofi, Globally.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**
The overall purpose and main responsibilities are listed below:
  
  

* At our Sanofi we are leveraging analytics and technology, on behalf of patients around the world. We are seeking those who have a passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision making that will allow us to tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
* Within our commercial Insights, Analytics, and Data organization we are transforming to better power decision-making across our end-to-end commercialization process, from business development to late lifecycle management.
* Analytics and/or forecasting deliverables support planning and decision making across multiple functional areas such as finance, manufacturing, product development and commercial.
* In addition to ensuring high-quality deliverables, our team drives synergies across the franchise, fosters innovation and best practices, and creates solutions to bring speed, scale and shareability to our planning processes. As we endeavour, we are seeking a dynamic talent for the role of “Senior Analyst – Market Research”
* We are looking for a team member to support our analytics team based out of US. Robust analytics is a priority for our businesses, as the product potential has major implications to a wide range of disciplines.
* It is essential to have someone who understands and aspires to implement innovative analytics techniques to drive our insights generation across different franchises.
* This role is responsible for executing Immunology global market research projects and managing a consistent, timely market research process across global products. This includes finalizing questionnaires, developing recruiting lists, aggregating data, interpreting results, cross-referencing secondary sources, and reporting findings
* The role requires a close partnership with market researchers based in the US and EU, as well as external agencies that manage panels and collect data on our behalf.
* People:

* Actively lead and develop SGH operations associates and ensure new technologies are leveraged.
* Initiate the contracting process and related documents within defined timelines; and collaborate with global stakeholders for project planning and setting up the timelines

**Performance indicators:**
Feedback from (end stakeholders) on overall satisfaction.

* Draft research materials (such as questionnaire, discussion guide, stimuli, etc.) to help address the key business objectives.
* Manage market research / programming and fielding vendors.
* Analyze quantitative/qualitative primary market research data to address the key business objectives.
* Develop an impactful PowerPoint presentation and accurately report insights and recommendations.

* Translates understanding of brand strategy and client needs & beliefs into likely hypotheses, and ensures analytical approach is effective in testing hypotheses to find most relevant insights
* Prior experience to apply advanced statistical knowledge / survey programming expertise to solve a business problem
* Able to present key insights & recommendations to stakeholders in an engaging way (when appropriate)

* Drives and leads project management through various phases of the project including kick-off, execution, insight generation and data visualizations

* Provide appropriate context for study findings based on prior market research, including secondary sources
* Process:
* Contribute to overall quality enhancement by ensuring high scientific standards for the outputs
* Secure adherence to compliance procedures and internal/operational risk controls in accordance with all applicable standards
* Refresh report on frequency/cycle basis (weekly/monthly/quarterly/annually), along with QC checks for each refresh
* Use latest tools/technologies/methodologies and partner with internal teams to provide support on all sort of regular and ad hoc market research activities such as insights distillation, report generation, insights mining etc.

* Stakeholder:
* Work closely with global teams and/ external vendors to ensure the end-to-end effective project delivery of the designated publication/medical education deliverables also to prioritize work and deliver on time-sensitive requests
* Be able to provide and defend gathered intelligence, methodology, content, and conclusions to the global leadership in a clear, concise format.

**Experience**
About you
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in pharmaceutical product Market Research.
* Experience with an pharma therapy area is preferred.
* In-depth knowledge of analysis techniques and use of different approaches;
* Demonstrated leadership and management in driving innovation and automation leveraging advanced statistical and analytical techniques

**Soft skills**
: Strong learning agility; Ability to manage ambiguous environments, and to adapt to changing needs of the business; Good interpersonal and communication skills; strong presentation skills a must; Team player who is curious, dynamic, result oriented and can work collaboratively; Ability to think strategically in an ambiguous environment; Ability to operate effectively in an international matrix environment, with ability to work across time zones; Demonstrated leadership and management in driving innovation and automation leveraging advanced statistical and analytical techniques
  
  
**Technical Skills**

* Strong quantitative, research, and data analytical skills
* Knowledge of statistical and programming tools (SPSS, Q, or similar)
* Experience in statistical approaches, including conjoint, MaxDiff, linear regression, correlation, factor and cluster analyses a plus; Advanced MS-office skills (MS-Excel and MS-PowerPoint)
* Slide creation skills a plus (i.e. ability to bring creativity to slides vs. text and data heavy-driven slides)
* Experience of using analytical tools like Power BI, Qliksense, Tableau, Smartsheet, and Alteryx etc;
* Expert knowledge of Excel and proficiency in VBA
* Experience of developing and managing dashboards
* Project management abilities; capable of prioritizing and handling multiple projects simultaneously
* An aptitude for problem solving and strategic thinking
* Ability to synthesize complex information into clear and actionable insights
* Proven ability to work effectively across all levels of stakeholders and diverse functions
* Solid understanding of pharmaceutical development, manufacturing, supply chain and marketing functions

title: R&D Psychometrician -  Talent Assessment & AI Tools
description:
**Role Summary**

The Psychometrician work on the scientific design and validation of an in-house assessment ecosystem, combining deep psychometric expertise with assessment design capability, applied research, AI-enabled assessment innovation, and cross-functional collaboration. This strategic role involves building psychometrically sound assessments from scratch, designing competency measurement frameworks, creating assessment blueprints and validation plans, partnering with Product, Engineering, HR, and Leadership teams, leveraging AI technologies responsibly, and establishing long-term governance standards for assessment quality and fairness. The successful candidate will help establish Granules' internal assessment science capability.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Assessment Design**

* Design and develop occupational personality assessments.
* Develop Situational Judgment Tests (SJTs) across organisational levels.
* Build competency-based behavioural assessments.
* Design leadership and management assessments.
* Build role-specific technical and functional assessment frameworks.
* Partner with HR and business leaders to define measurable competencies.
* Support the creation of assessment analytics and monitoring dashboards.

**2. Assessment Development Lifecycle**

* Lead item writing initiatives.
* Design scoring frameworks and interpretation models.
* Continuously review and improve assessment quality.

**3. Psychometric Validation & Research (Accountable)**

* Lead assessment validation efforts, including content validation, construct validation, criterion-based validation, predictive validity studies, and convergent and discriminant validity analysis.
* Conduct and oversee reliability analysis, internal consistency studies, item analysis, factor analysis, exploratory factor analysis (EFA), confirmatory factor analysis (CFA), and measurement invariance testing.
* Perform fairness and adverse impact studies.
* Design pilot studies and develop benchmarking methodologies.
* Build role-based norm groups and establish revalidation and monitoring processes.
* Conduct ongoing talent assessment research and benchmark against leading assessment providers such as SHL.
* Recommend evidence-based enhancements.

**Candidate Profile**

**Experience**

* MSc in Psychometrics, Industrial Psychology (I/O) or Organisational Psychology, or related field OR PhD in Organizational Psychology.
* 3+ years of experience in assessment development and psychometrics.
* Certification from Indian Institute of Business Psychology (IIBP) or IIBP‑aligned courses (Preferred).
* Demonstrated experience building assessments from scratch.
* Experience conducting validation and reliability studies.
* Experience designing competency frameworks.
* Experience working with talent assessment or leadership assessment products.

**Core Competencies :**

* Classical Test Theory (CTT).
* Item Response Theory (IRT).
* Factor Analysis.
* Test Validation.
* Measurement Invariance.
* Fairness and Bias Analysis.
* Norm Development.
* Quantitative Research Methods.
* Survey Design.
* Experimental Research.
* Predictive Modeling.
* Statistical Interpretation.

**Additional Skills**

* Prior experience with SHL, Korn Ferry, DDI, Thomas International, Central Test, or PSI.
* Experience with R, Python, SPSS, JASP, Jamovi, Qualtrics, or Excel.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or other generative AI platforms.

Develop and maintain the Functional Safety Plan, timelines, and work products. Ensure processes are followed and all safety artifacts are created and reviewed. Define safety goals, safety mechanisms, and safety requirements (FSR/TSR). Requirements Engineering Write, review, and maintain functional and technical safety requirements. Ensure bi-directional traceability between requirements, design, implementation, and validation. Support system, hardware, and software teams to interpret and implement safety requirements. Hardware & Software Safety Collaborate with hardware architects to define safety mechanisms for MCU, PMIC, watchdog, self-tests, power domains, fault handling, etc. Support software teams in designing safety-compliant drivers, boot, diagnostics, and monitoring logic. Review MCU safety manuals, safety architecture, and vendor documentation (e.g., Infineon Traveo II, NXP, Renesas). Safety Analysis & Verification Conduct and review FMEA, FTA, FMEDA, DFA, Dependent Failure Analysis. Calculate FIT rates, single-point fault metrics, and latent fault metrics. Create safety validation plans and support unit/integration/system-level testing. Audits, Assessments & Compliance Prepare safety case documentation for customer and auditor reviews. Work with internal/external assessors (TÜV, Exida, OEM auditors). Support ASPICE, cybersecurity (ISO 21434), and quality-compliance alignment. Cross-Functional Collaboration Provide training and guidance to development teams on ISO 26262 processes. Work directly with system architects, hardware designers, software teams, testing, quality, cybersecurity, and program management. Participate in design reviews and ensure safety considerations are incorporated early.Required Skills & Qualifications Technical Skills Strong understanding of ISO 26262 Part 2–12 and full safety lifecycle. Expertise in safety analyses: FMEA, FTA, FMEDA, DFA. Understanding of safety architecture for MCUs, SoCs, and automotive ECUs. Experience with safety mechanisms: lockstep CPUs, watchdogs, ECC, BIST/MBIST, CRC, voltage monitoring, clock monitoring, safe states, etc. Experience with requirements management tools: DOORS, Polarion, Jama, etc. Working knowledge of embedded systems, microcontrollers, hardware design, and automotive software development. Domain Knowledge Automotive electronics: clusters, body control, powertrain, ADAS, infotainment, or battery systems. Exposure to ASPICE, ISO 21434 (Cybersecurity), and OEM-specific safety processes. Experience 5–15 years of experience in automotive embedded systems. Minimum 5+ years in Functional Safety roles. Experience delivering at least one safety-critical product to SOP. Preferred Qualifications Certified Functional Safety Engineer/Professional (TÜV, Exida). Experience with safety implementation on MCUs like Infineon Traveo II, NXP S32, Renesas R-Car, TI Hercules. Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Embedded Systems, or related engineering field. Experience with model-based development (MATLAB/Simulink). title: Service Catalogue Manager
description:
**1. Role Purpose**

The Service Catalogue Manager is responsible for developing, maintaining, standardising, and governing AVASO’s global service catalogue. The role ensures that all service offerings are clearly defined, commercially aligned, operationally deliverable, and documented in a consistent format for use by Sales, Solutioning, PMO, Service Delivery, and Operations teams.

The position will serve as the central owner of service catalogue information, ensuring accuracy, completeness, version control, stakeholder validation, and periodic updates throughout the service lifecycle.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Service Catalogue Development & Ownership**

* Develop and maintain a centralised, structured global service catalogue covering AVASO’s service offerings.
* Define service descriptions, scope, deliverables, prerequisites, exclusions, dependencies, and delivery models.
* Maintain service classifications, categories, subcategories, and standard service attributes.
* Ensure each catalogue entry has a clearly defined service owner and documented approval.
* Identify and eliminate duplicate, outdated, incomplete, or inconsistent service entries.

**B. Service Definition & Standardisation**

* Work with Solutioning, Sales, PMO, GFS, GSC, Professional Services, Digital Workspace, and other relevant teams to define and validate service offerings.
* Standardise service descriptions and delivery requirements across regions while accommodating approved local variations.
* Document service eligibility, resource requirements, delivery assumptions, and operational dependencies.
* Ensure service definitions are sufficiently clear to support solution design, proposals, service transitions, and operational execution.

**C. Catalogue Data Management & Tools**

* Maintain accurate catalogue data using ServiceNow or an equivalent service management platform, supported by structured repositories and reporting tools as required.
* Establish data quality checks for completeness, consistency, accuracy, and duplication.
* Manage catalogue updates, version control, approval workflows, and change history.
* Maintain catalogue records, supporting documentation, ownership details, review dates, and approval status.
* Develop reports and dashboards to track catalogue completeness, pending validations, overdue reviews, and data quality.

**D. Governance & Stakeholder Management**

* Establish and maintain the service catalogue governance process, including submission, review, approval, publication, and retirement of services.
* Coordinate with service owners and functional leaders to validate service information and resolve outstanding gaps.
* Conduct periodic catalogue reviews and ensure timely updates following changes to service scope, delivery models, or commercial arrangements.
* Maintain an action tracker for pending service definitions, approvals, and stakeholder confirmations.
* Escalate overdue inputs, conflicting definitions, and governance exceptions to the designated leadership team.

**E. Commercial & Operational Alignment**

* Coordinate with Finance, Sales, and Solutioning to ensure service descriptions align with approved pricing models, cost assumptions, and commercial terms.
* Capture relevant SLAs, service coverage, response and resolution commitments, resource requirements, and delivery constraints.
* Ensure catalogue entries reflect approved service capabilities and do not introduce unapproved commercial or operational commitments.
* Support proposal preparation, solution validation, transition planning, and service onboarding by providing accurate catalogue information.
* Identify opportunities to simplify service offerings, improve standardisation, and reduce repetitive solutioning effort.

**3. Required Skills & Experience**

Mandatory Requirements

* Proven hands-on experience in service catalogue management, IT service management, service portfolio administration, or a closely related role.
* Strong capability in service definition, documentation, classification, standardisation, and data governance.
* Practical experience with ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM/service management platform.
* Strong stakeholder coordination skills, including working with technical, commercial, and operational teams.
* Experience maintaining structured repositories, managing change records, and producing management reports.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent attention to detail.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM knowledge.
* Experience supporting global IT services, field services, managed services, EUC, networking, or professional services.
* Working knowledge of Power BI, Excel, or similar reporting tools.
* Familiarity with service costing, pricing structures, SLAs, and service delivery models.

**4. Key Competencies**

1. Catalogue Ownership: Takes accountability for end-to-end catalogue completeness, accuracy, and usability.
2. Analytical Thinking: Identifies information gaps, inconsistencies, duplication, and opportunities for standardisation.
3. Governance Discipline: Maintains clear ownership, approvals, review cycles, and audit trails.
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Obtains inputs and resolves issues across multiple functions and regions.
5. Execution & Attention to Detail: Delivers accurate documentation, maintains action trackers, and meets agreed deadlines.

**5. First 90-Day Deliverables**

First 30 days — Assess and Baseline

* Review the existing service catalogue, available documentation, and governance processes.
* Validate the service inventory, service owners, and information gaps.
* Establish a prioritised remediation and stakeholder validation tracker.

Days 31–60 — Standardise and Govern

* Implement standard service catalogue templates and mandatory data fields.
* Define ownership, approval workflows, change control, and review cadence.
* Begin resolving incomplete, duplicated, or outdated service records.

Days 61–90 — Operationalise and Report

* Publish the validated catalogue in the agreed central repository or platform.
* Implement catalogue quality and governance reporting.
* Establish a recurring review process and a prioritised improvement roadmap.

**6. Role Boundaries**

The Service Catalogue Manager owns catalogue structure, service definitions, data quality, governance, and maintenance.

The role collaborates with, but does not independently replace, the responsibilities of:

* Solutioning: Solution architecture, technical design, and proposal ownership.
* Sales / Commercial: Customer commitments, pricing approval, and contract negotiations.
* Service Delivery: Validation of operational feasibility and actual delivery capability.
* Finance: Approval of costing assumptions and commercial models.



**7. Success Profile**

The successful candidate will be a hands-on Manager who can independently organise service information, work with multiple stakeholders, establish disciplined governance, and maintain a reliable global catalogue. The role prioritises execution, data quality, service standardisation, and cross-functional coordination rather than a large team-management remit.

title: Functional Safety Application Engineer
description:
UST is looking for a Functional Safety Application Engineer to join our team supporting Class B (IEC 60730/60335) and SIL 2 (IEC 61508) safety solutions across our PSoC Control and XMC microcontroller portfolio.

**General Purpose:**

* Developing and maintaining code examples demonstrating Class B and SIL 2 self-test coverage, including CPU, RAM, Flash, clock, stack, and watchdog diagnostics.
* Debugging and validating self-test libraries and safety diagnostics across application code, register-level, and board-level environments.
* Collaborating with R&D, Software, and Marketing teams to align safety content with product roadmaps and customer requirements.
* Authoring and maintaining application notes, safety manuals, and technical documentation.
* Supporting Class B / SIL 2 certification activities, including preparing evidence packages and coordinating with internal teams and third-party certification bodies.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or equivalent

**Experience Requirements:**

* 3 - 6 years of experience in embedded development.
* Skilled in C programming, with experience in C++, Python, and/or assembly language.
* Solid understanding of standard MCU peripherals and system resources, including clocks/PLLs, watchdogs/timers, UART, SPI, I2C, ADC, and PWM.
* Experience with Arm Cortex-M MCUs, preferably PSoC Control and XMC families, across single- and multi-core architectures.
* Ability to debug and root-cause issues at the application code, register, and board level; comfortable using debuggers such as GDB/JTAG, oscilloscopes, and fault-injection techniques.
* Working knowledge of IEC 61508 (SIL 2) and/or ISO 26262 is desired; familiarity with IEC 60730/60335 Class B requirements is advantageous.
* Hands-on experience with Class B / SIL 2 self-test libraries, including CPU register/PC/interrupt tests, RAM march tests, Flash CRC/signature checks, clock monitoring, and stack/watchdog tests, is a plus.
* Experience authoring or contributing to safety manuals, FMEDA reports, and application notes is a plus.

**Professional Skills:**

* Effective oral and written communication skills, including technical documentation.
* Ability to translate certification and standards requirements into practical application content, such as code examples, application notes, and training materials.
* Ability to independently plan and prioritize deliverables against program timelines.

title: BIM Content Creator
description:
**Mott MacDonald**
is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.
  
  
We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.
  
  
Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be
**brilliant**
.
  
  
Role purpose
  
  
The MIC BIM Component Creator develops, tests, documents and maintains intelligent, reusable, data-rich BIM content for the Moata Intelligent Content (MIC) library. The role converts engineering and project requirements into reliable digital components that enable standardized, efficient and automated design delivery across infrastructure and building projects.
  
  
Working with MIC curators, content checkers, approvers, publishers and project teams, the role ensures that content is technically accurate, lightweight, interoperable, correctly classified and ready for controlled publication and reuse.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  

* Develop and maintain parametric, data-rich BIM content, including Revit families, AutoCAD-based components, Civil 3D subassemblies and other platform-specific assets required by MIC.
* Interpret briefs, engineering requirements, manufacturer information and project standards, then convert them into clear content specifications and fit-for-purpose digital components.
* Apply MIC naming, classification, parameter, metadata, category, subcategory and documentation standards consistently throughout the content lifecycle.
* Build content that is efficient in file size, stable in use, visually appropriate, correctly constrained and suitable for reuse in large project models.
* Configure and test geometry, parameters, formulas, types, visibility settings, connectors, materials and data outputs, as applicable to the authoring platform.
* Create and test Civil 3D subassemblies using Subassembly Composer, including parameters, targets, conditions, codes and corridor behavior where required.
* Complete self-checks and peer checks before content is submitted through the MIC review, approval, versioning and publication gateways.
* Respond to checker and approver feedback, correct identified issues and maintain traceable records of revisions, testing and status.
* Maintain content documentation, thumbnails, reference files, metadata, version information and progress updates in the relevant MIC tracking and catalogue systems.
* Collaborate with project teams, engineering specialists and digital delivery stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve technical issues and support content adoption.
* Provide practical support to users, investigate content-related issues and implement controlled updates without compromising existing use cases.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for standardization, batch processing, automation, quality assurance and reusable workflows.
* Share knowledge with colleagues and develop capabilities across relevant Autodesk, Bentley, GIS, data and automation platforms.

**Essential Qualifications And Experience**

* HNC/HND, diploma, degree or equivalent practical experience in engineering, architecture, construction technology, information technology or a related discipline.
* Demonstrable experience creating, editing and quality-checking BIM or digital engineering content within at least one engineering discipline.
* Strong knowledge of BIM content-development principles, including parametric modelling, data structures, classification, naming, performance optimization and quality assurance.
* Proficiency in Revit family creation, including parameters, formulas, nested content, categories, subcategories, visibility controls, materials and testing.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD and Civil 3D; hands-on experience with Civil 3D Subassembly Composer is required for roles supporting corridor content.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, schedules, manufacturer data and project requirements.
* Experience working within controlled review, approval, version-management and publication processes.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines and locations.

Desirable knowledge and experience
  

* Experience with Bentley platforms, including MicroStation, OpenBuildings Designer, DGN and CEL content.
* Working knowledge of GIS platforms such as Esri ArcGIS.
* Experience with content catalogues or repositories such as Bentley Component Center and Autodesk Content Catalogue.
* Knowledge of shared-parameter management, data integration, batch processing or tools such as DiRoots.
* Exposure to scripting or automation for BIM content creation and quality assurance, such as Dynamo, Python or platform APIs.
* Experience developing generic or manufacturer content for the Water, Wastewater, Transport, Energy or Built Environment sectors.

Technical quality expectations
  
  
**Quality area**
**Expected outcome**
**Functionality**
Content behaves predictably across the intended types, views, levels of detail and project conditions.
  
  
**Data quality**
Parameters, metadata, classifications and units are complete, accurate, consistent and usable.
  
  
**Performance**
Geometry and file size are proportionate to purpose and do not create avoidable model-performance issues.
  
  
**Standards**
Naming, categories, subcategories, materials, documentation and catalogue information follow current MIC requirements.
  
  
**Verification**
Content is tested, warnings and redundant elements are resolved, and evidence is available for review.
  
  
**Lifecycle control**
Revisions, dependencies, references, status and publication information are recorded and traceable.
  
  
Personal attributes and behaviors
  

* Quality-focused, methodical and attentive to detail.
* Curious about technology and willing to build capability across multiple authoring and data platforms.
* Collaborative and respectful, with a strong commitment to shared team outcomes.
* Proactive in planning work, raising risks, solving problems and following tasks through to completion.
* Comfortable receiving, applying and providing constructive technical feedback.
* Committed to continuous learning, knowledge sharing and an automation-first mindset.

Measures of success
  

* Components meet agreed requirements and pass MIC checking and approval with minimal avoidable rework.
* Deliverables are completed to the agreed scope, quality and schedule, with progress and risks communicated clearly.
* Published content is reusable, discoverable, correctly documented and supported through its lifecycle.
* Feedback from users and reviewers is converted into measurable improvements to content and working practices.
* This role contributes to stronger standards, automation, platform capability and knowledge sharing across the MIC team.

**Flexible working**
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.
  
  
**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing

**Employment Compliance Requirement**
As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**
