title: Content Intern
description:
**About Skydo:**

Behind every Indian business going global is money they worked hard to earn. But when it's time to get paid, they wait days and lose 3-7% of their revenue to hidden forex markups and fees nobody explains, just to receive what's already theirs.

We're fixing this. Skydo gives exporters flat fees, zero forex markup, settlement in hours, and compliance that's handled for them from start to finish.

**Join us and help millions of ambitious businesses get paid the way they deserve.**

**About the Role :**

As a Content Intern at Skydo, you own the entire blog engine. From crafting outlines and assigning briefs to writers and agencies, to making sure deadlines are met, quality holds up, and every published post performs, you are the point of contact who keeps the whole thing on track. Every blog that goes live on Skydo passes through you.

**What you will do:**

* End-to-end blog ownership: Run the pipeline from topic intake to published post, keeping the editorial calendar accurate and current
* Editorial quality: Review and sharpen outlines before they go into production, then review
* every draft for accuracy, structure, tone, and depth, fact-checking every claim
* Operational ownership: Manage freelance writers and content agencies, assign briefs
* based on topic fit, and hold everyone to the dates they committed to
* Feedback loops: Give writers feedback specific enough to make the next draft better, and track whether quality improves over time
* Distribution and performance: Publish in the CMS, repurpose blogs across LinkedIn,
* newsletters, and social, and work with SEO to track performance and plan reworks

**You’re a good fit if you have:**

* Excellent writing and editing instincts, with a sharp editorial eye and a keen eye for errors
* A fact-checker's mindset: you verify every claim, number, and regulation against a primary source before it ships
* The ability to go deep on financial and compliance concepts like FEMA, RBI purpose codes, FIRA, and EDPMS, and explain them in plain English
* The appetite to learn Skydo's product and pricing inside out, including how we compare to the alternatives exporters actually consider
* Comfort in the messy middle: juggling writers, agencies, deadlines, and last-minute changes without losing the plot
* Bonus: a blog, newsletter, or body of published work of your own, with receipts to show for it.

**The mindset we’re seeking:**

* Radical Accountability: Full ownership is your default. You track how published blogs perform, work out what is landing and what is not, and act on it without waiting for someone to point it out
* Editor's Instinct: You spot what a draft is missing and explain it clearly enough that the writer gets it right on their own next time
* Builder's Ambition: You want to build a system that keeps running after you set it up.

title: Environmental Engineer
description:
**Job Description – Environment Engineer: -**

**1. Environmental Management System (EMS)**

* Implement and maintain environmental management programs in accordance with ISO 14001 requirements and company policies.
* Support the identification and evaluation of environmental aspects, impacts, risks, and opportunities associated with manufacturing operations.
* Monitor environmental performance and drive continual improvement initiatives across the facility.

**2. Statutory Compliance and Regulatory Management**

* Ensure compliance with applicable environmental laws, regulations, and requirements of the State & Central Pollution Control Board and other regulatory authorities.
* Monitor the validity of environmental consents, authorizations, permits, and statutory records.
* Maintain compliance documentation, prepare periodic reports, and coordinate regulatory submissions within stipulated timelines.
* Support regulatory inspections, audits, and closure of observations.

**3. Environmental Monitoring and Pollution Control**

* Monitor air emissions, wastewater discharge, ambient air quality, noise levels, and other applicable environmental parameters.
* Ensure the effective operation and monitoring of pollution control systems and environmental infrastructure.
* Coordinate environmental sampling and testing with approved laboratories and follow up on corrective actions for deviations.
* Identify potential environmental risks associated with manufacturing processes and recommend appropriate preventive and corrective measures.

**4. Waste Management**

* Monitor the segregation, storage, handling, and disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous waste in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.
* Ensure proper maintenance of waste inventory, disposal records, manifests, and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with authorized waste recyclers and disposal agencies and support periodic vendor audits.
* Promote waste minimization, recycling, and resource recovery initiatives.

**5. Environmental Training and Employee Engagement**

* Conduct environmental awareness and training programs for employees, contract workers, and relevant stakeholders.
* Promote employee participation in environmental improvement initiatives and encourage environmentally responsible workplace practices.
* Conduct routine environmental inspections and workplace awareness activities to improve environmental compliance and housekeeping.

**6. Environmental Audits and Risk Assessment**

* Conduct periodic environmental audits and inspections to identify gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Assist in developing and reviewing environmental aspects-impact assessments and operational controls.
* Track audit findings, coordinate corrective and preventive actions, and verify their effective closure.
* Support emergency preparedness activities related to environmental incidents, including chemical spills and potential pollution events.

**7. Sustainability and Carbon Emission Reduction**

* Support initiatives to reduce energy and water consumption, waste generation, and carbon emissions.
* Collect, analyze, and maintain environmental performance data for sustainability reporting.
* Identify opportunities for resource conservation, recycling, and adoption of environmentally sustainable practices.
* Assist in implementing corporate sustainability goals and environmental improvement projects.

**8. EPR – Extended Producer Responsibility**

·       Drive the EPR module for packaging plastics and e-waste in accordance with the latest E-waste & Plastic Management Rules

·       Co-ordinate with supply chain and recycling partner to ensure on-time fulfilling of EPR obligations and file returns.

**9. Documentation and Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Maintain accurate environmental records, operating logs, inspection reports, training records, and compliance registers.
* Prepare periodic environmental performance reports and present key observations to the EHS team and management.
* Coordinate with Manufacturing, Production, Maintenance, Facilities, Supply Chain, and other functions to implement environmental controls and improvement actions.
* Support environmental investigations and ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.

**Key skills & competencies for this position:**

·       At least 2-3 years of manufacturing industry experience and working knowledge meeting the JD.

·       Strong communication & Interpersonal skills for cross functional co-ordinations.

·       Proficiency in local language (Kannada) is a mandate. Multilingual proficiency shall be an added advantage.

·       Good analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

·       Understanding of ISO 14001 Environment Management Systems & EPR modules.

·       Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint for report preparation.

·      Attention to detail, and a proactive approach to environmental improvement.

**Education level and/or certification and training requirements, as well as years of experience**

·       A Bachelor / Master degree in ‘Environment Engineering’ is a mandate requirement as per Karnataka State Pollution Control Board.

·       Max work experience for this role shall not exceed 4 yrs.

·      Any additional environment / sustainability related courses / certifications would be preferred.

* Ergonomics
* Safety
* Quality
* Logistics
* Future capacity
* Conduct capacity calculations and bottleneck analysis.
* Establish cycle-time targets.
* Develop & implement line balancing for volume ramp-up.
* Identify and eliminate bottleneck operations.

* Repetitive movements

title: Sr. Supplier Development Engineer (RF Integration)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.
  
  
**SR. SUPPLIER DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER (RF INTEGRATION)**
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.
  
  
SpaceX is developing a low latency, broadband internet system to meet the needs of consumers across the globe. Enabled by a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites, Starlink will provide fast, reliable internet to populations with little or no connectivity, including those in rural communities and places where existing services are too expensive or unreliable. We are looking for talented, creative, and driven engineers to develop, drive, and maintain suppliers, from initial concept development to full scale production.
  
  
This is a high-profile, cross functional position that plays a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and scalability of the user terminal manufacturing at our global suppliers. You will work in close coordination with internal engineering and manufacturing departments as well as with global base of suppliers to execute effective, creative and smart supply chain strategies to achieve production goals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement RF test cases and calibration procedures for Starlink user terminals at external suppliers
* Working in close collaboration with hardware and software engineers rapidly develop design validation and production test solutions for our high-volume consumer products
* Establish strong linkages between assembly data and final RF test performance, driving root cause analysis of yield limiters
* Use statistical tools such as SPC and DOE to monitor, and JMP to analyze, control, and improve yield across the manufacturing line
* Develop and maintain risk models to evaluate RF test strategies and ensure effective test coverage across corner cases in individual manufacturing processes
* Sustain and optimize RF integration workflow and throughput in a high-mix assembly configuration environment, driving continuous improvements in cycle time and cost
* Collaborate with design teams to provide feedback on DFM (Design for Manufacturability) and yield optimization opportunities with focus on RF integration
* Support installation and qualification of new RF test tools, including both capability enhancements and capacity expansions
* Work closely with production team and electronics hardware vendors to resolve equipment and process-related issues
* Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), engineering instructions, and test documentation
* Planning, proposing, and leading experiments to produce timely and accurate analyses used to drive design, development, and supply chain decisions, with a focus on scalability for high volume electronics manufacturing
* Planning validation exercises to demonstrate initial feasibility as well as manufacturing capability at high volumes, incorporating throughput modeling and yield optimization
* Reviewing progress of development activities at supplier locations and serve as point of escalation for critical process related issues, ensuring alignment with high volume ramp-up requirements
* Assigns specific tasks and work with SpaceX suppliers to support process development and/or data gathering activities aimed at achieving consistent high throughput and low defect rates
* Establish validation procedures to qualify process equipment during development builds as well as mass production, incorporating statistical process controls and capacity planning for high volume output
* Actively participate in the program planning and monitoring process assuming responsibility for key deliverables at all milestones, including quality gates for volume ramp-up

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical or electronics engineering
* 5+ years of professional experience with antennas, RF communication systems, or electronics hardware

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Master's degree or PhD in electrical or electronics engineering
* 10+ years of professional experience with antennas, RF communication systems, or electronics hardware
* 5+ years of experience in electronics manufacturing, including leadership roles in supplier development or process engineering for complex consumer electronics systems
* 5+ years of experience in final assembly, test and packout
* Experience with basic principles of antenna theory and designing wireless communications systems
* Thorough understanding of RF active and passive components
* Experience characterizing radio performance at microwave frequencies
* Programming experience in Python, C#, C++, or MATLAB
* Experience in analyzing large datasets and dispositioning hardware based on data
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple suppliers and projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to work independently with excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proven track record of production ramp-up for high-volume electronics manufacturing, preferably in consumer electronics

**Additional Requirements**

* Position is based in Bangalore, India and requires being onsite - remote work not considered
* Must be willing to work long hours and weekends when needed to meet critical deadlines
* Ability to travel: Up to 50% of work week travel may be required to suppliers in Southeast Asia

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

* Capabilities.

Business Acumen

title: Senior Developer Relations Manager, Robotics
description:
NVIDIA is enabling the next generation of physical AI through accelerated computing, AI software, simulation, robotics platforms, and cloud-to-edge infrastructure. This role will lead hands-on Developer Relations for robotics, edge AI, and physical AI developers in India, helping technical teams bring AI-powered systems from prototype to production.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a senior technical DevRel leader with strong understanding of robotics development, AI perception, edge deployment, simulation, autonomy, and the business realities of deploying physical systems. This person should be comfortable building demos, writing or reviewing code, running workshops, debugging developer issues, explaining robotics architecture tradeoffs, and translating field feedback into useful product input. They will work closely with NVIDIA product, engineering, solution architecture, sales, marketing, and ecosystem teams to build a stronger robotics developer presence in India.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Build and execute a technical Developer Relations strategy for robotics, edge AI, and physical AI companies in India.
* Develop strategic relationships with founders, CTOs, robotics engineers, perception teams, simulation developers, product leaders, and system integrators.
* Identify priority workloads including robot perception, sensor fusion, autonomy, path planning, simulation, synthetic data generation, digital twins, edge inference, fleet learning, and warehouse automation.
* Assess which robotics and edge AI workloads are a strong fit for GPU acceleration by profiling bottlenecks and distinguishing compute-bound problems from sensor IO, memory bandwidth, network, latency, power, or orchestration constraints.
* Build and adapt robotics demos, sample code, reference architectures, lab material, and technical guides that help developers evaluate and adopt NVIDIA technologies.
* Guide developers on NVIDIA cloud-to-edge platforms, accelerated AI workflows, simulation, model optimization, edge inference, and deployment patterns.
* Run robotics-focused code labs, workshops, architecture reviews, office hours, developer sessions, technical webinars, and community programs.
* Partner with internal NVIDIA teams to support priority robotics accounts and unblock technical adoption.
* Build ecosystem engagement across robotics startups, industrial automation partners, universities, and research communities.
* Capture field insights on hardware requirements, software tooling gaps, deployment blockers, and competitive dynamics.

**What We Need To See**

* Bachelor's degree in robotics, computer science, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, AI, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in technical Developer Relations, robotics, autonomous systems, edge AI, embedded systems, computer vision, simulation, solution architecture, or technical ecosystem development.
* Understanding of robotics software stacks, AI perception, sensor fusion, edge deployment, model optimization, and production constraints for physical systems.
* Hands-on programming experience in Python and C++ with familiarity in Linux-based development, robotics middleware, sensor data pipelines, and edge deployment workflows.
* Familiarity with cloud-to-edge workflows, containers, Linux, embedded platforms, APIs, and modern AI development practices.
* Ability to profile and reason about robotics workloads, including GPU suitability, compute intensity, memory bandwidth, sensor IO, latency, throughput, batching, power, thermal limits, and cost/performance tradeoffs.
* Ability to engage deeply technical engineering teams and senior business stakeholders, with credibility in live demos, technical troubleshooting, architecture reviews, and developer education.
* Hands-on exposure to NVIDIA robotics and edge AI platforms such as Isaac Sim, Isaac ROS, Isaac Lab, Omniverse Replicator or synthetic data workflows, Jetson, TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, CUDA, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute, and NGC containers.
* Ability to demonstrate simulation-to-real workflows, robot perception pipelines, synthetic data generation, edge inference optimization, and deployment patterns across cloud, workstation, and embedded environments.
* Familiarity with NVIDIA software used for physical AI workloads, including model optimization, sensor data processing, computer vision acceleration, ROS 2 integration, and deployment on edge systems as well as ability to build robotics-focused demos, lab material, and reference architectures that show how NVIDIA platforms accelerate perception, autonomy, simulation, and physical AI development.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Hands-on experience with robotics frameworks, simulation environments, computer vision, synthetic data, digital twins, or autonomy stacks.
* Experience creating workload qualification frameworks, benchmark plans, or technical decision guides that help robotics developers decide when GPU acceleration is the right fit.
* Track record as a technical DevRel practitioner, including public talks, workshops, GitHub samples, blogs, tutorials, reference architectures, or developer community programs.
* Experience with warehouse automation, industrial robotics, AMRs, autonomous machines, smart manufacturing, or logistics automation.
* Ability to translate robotics developer needs into scalable ecosystem programs and product feedback.

title: Learning And Development Specialist
description:
**Job Brief:**

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic
**Senior Technical Trainer / Lead Technical Trainer**
with
**15+ years of experience**
in Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS), FATP, or high-volume manufacturing environments. The role will lead the organization's technical capability development strategy for both Direct Labour (DL) and Indirect Labour (IDL) employees across SMT, Assembly, Testing, Packaging, Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, Manufacturing Excellence, and Production Support functions.

The incumbent will be responsible for designing and implementing enterprise-wide technical training frameworks, competency development programs, leadership capability initiatives, certification systems, and workforce transformation projects that support operational excellence, quality improvement, productivity enhancement, and future manufacturing readiness.

**Experience:**

* **15+ years of overall experience**
  in Technical Training, Manufacturing Operations, Learning & Development, Capability Building, or Organizational Development.
* Minimum
  **8–10 years of experience in EMS/FATP or Electronics Manufacturing environments.**
* Proven experience leading large-scale workforce competency development and technical capability-building initiatives.
* Strong exposure to training strategy, training governance, skill certification frameworks, and manufacturing transformation projects.
* Experience in managing technical trainers, training coordinators, or L&D teams is preferred.
* Experience working with global customers, audits, and industry standards is an added advantage.

**Educational Qualification**

* Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in EEE, ECE, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent.
* Master's Degree or Post-Graduate Certification in Learning & Development, Operations Management, or Manufacturing Excellence is preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Training Strategy & Capability Development**

* Define and drive the organization's technical capability development roadmap aligned with business goals.
* Develop structured competency frameworks for DL, IDL, Technicians, Engineers, Supervisors, and Functional Leaders.
* Lead enterprise-wide technical training and certification programs.
* Establish career progression and skill-upgradation pathways across manufacturing functions.
* Partner with leadership teams to identify current and future workforce capability requirements.

**Training Design & Delivery**

* Conduct capability development programs in SMT, Assembly, Testing, Packaging, Quality, Reliability, and Manufacturing Systems.
* Drive workforce readiness initiatives supporting automation, Industry 4.0, and digital manufacturing.
* Enable productivity improvement, defect reduction, and quality enhancement through structured training interventions.

**Competency Assessment & Governance**

* Establish training governance mechanisms, competency matrices, certification frameworks, and skill audit systems.
* Lead technical certification assessments and workforce qualification programs.
* Monitor effectiveness through training KPIs, productivity improvements, quality metrics, and employee skill enhancement.
* Ensure audit readiness for customer, regulatory, and internal compliance requirements.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, HR, and Senior Leadership teams.
* Engage with external training partners, certification bodies, educational institutions, and industry forums.
* Mentor trainers, supervisors, engineers, and functional leaders on capability-building initiatives.

**IDL Capability Development Areas**

* Six Sigma (Green Belt / Black Belt Methodologies)
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Advanced Problem-Solving Techniques
* SPC & Advanced Quality Tools
* PFMEA, Control Plan & APQP
* Equipment Reliability & TPM
* Industrial Engineering & Capacity Planning
* Production Planning & Process Optimization
* Yield Improvement & Defect Reduction
* IPC Standards & Quality Requirements
* Manufacturing Excellence & Operational Excellence
* Industry 4.0 & Smart Manufacturing Concepts
* Project Management Fundamentals
* Change Management & Leadership Development

* Strong expertise in Electronics Manufacturing (EMS/FATP) operations.
* Deep understanding of SMT, Assembly, Testing, Packaging, and Manufacturing Systems.
* Expertise in learning strategy, instructional design, training delivery, and competency management.
* Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, TPM, Quality Systems, and Continuous Improvement methodologies.
* Excellent presentation, facilitation, coaching, mentoring, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical skills with experience in training analytics and capability measurement.
* Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS), digital learning platforms, and competency management tools.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, and digital training platforms.

**Preferred Certifications**

title: Content & Copywriter – B2B Tech Marketing
description:
**Job Description**
Content & Copywriter – B2B Tech Marketing
  
  
**Job Type:**
Full-time, Permanent
  
  
**Experience:**
2–5 Years
  
  
**Industry:**
B2B Technology / Digital Marketing Agency
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru
  
  
**About Us**
Blufig is a full-service B2B marketing agency helping technology and enterprise brands achieve their digital growth goals. Having worked with 130+ brands, we aim to transform the B2B agency landscape through innovative, data-driven, and AI-powered marketing solutions.
  
  
We are looking for a versatile
**Content & Copywriter**
who can combine compelling storytelling with strategic messaging to create content that informs, engages, and converts. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in both content writing and copywriting, with the ability to simplify complex technology concepts and adapt their writing to different audiences, platforms, and brand voices.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
You will manage end-to-end content and copy delivery across multiple client accounts, creating everything from SEO blogs and website content to landing pages, ad copy, email campaigns, social media content, case studies, and marketing collaterals.
  
  
You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced agency environment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, managing client feedback, maintaining quality standards, and using AI tools to improve research, ideation, writing, and editing workflows.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Content Writing & Copywriting
* Create high-quality content and compelling copy for websites, landing pages, blogs, SEO articles, LinkedIn, social media, email campaigns, advertisements, case studies, video scripts, presentations, and marketing collaterals.
* Write persuasive, audience-focused copy that supports brand awareness, lead generation, engagement, and conversions.
* Translate complex B2B technology products and services into clear, engaging, and benefit-driven messaging for business decision-makers.
* Develop content aligned with client objectives, target audiences, brand positioning, tone of voice, and marketing goals.
* Adapt writing styles across formats, industries, channels, and stages of the B2B buyer journey.
* Content Strategy & Planning
* Understand content briefs, campaign objectives, audience personas, and business goals before developing content.
* Contribute to content strategies, editorial calendars, campaign concepts, messaging frameworks, and content distribution plans.
* Identify relevant topics, content angles, audience pain points, and storytelling opportunities.
* Align content with SEO fundamentals, search intent, and relevant keywords wherever required.
* AI-Assisted Writing & Optimization
* Use AI writing tools and LLMs to support research, brainstorming, content outlines, first drafts, headline variations, and content repurposing.
* Create effective prompts to generate relevant, context-rich, and usable outputs.
* Review, edit, and humanize AI-assisted content to ensure originality, accuracy, clarity, brand consistency, and a natural writing style.
* Identify and eliminate generic, repetitive, vague, or AI-sounding language.
* Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows that improve efficiency without compromising creativity or content quality.
* Editing, Quality Control & Delivery
* Edit and proofread content for grammar, clarity, structure, tone, factual accuracy, and consistency.
* Conduct quality checks to ensure deliverables meet client requirements and brand guidelines.
* Manage revisions, stakeholder feedback, and approval cycles while maintaining high editorial standards.
* Ensure timely delivery of multiple content assignments across client accounts.
* Develop and follow content processes that improve quality, consistency, and workflow efficiency.
* Collaboration & Client Coordination
* Work closely with content strategists, designers, digital marketers, SEO specialists, web developers, and account managers.
* Coordinate with clients on content briefs, feedback, revisions, and approvals for assigned accounts, where required.
* Incorporate feedback constructively and maintain clear communication throughout the content delivery process.

**Requirements**
Required Skills & Qualifications
  
  

* 2–5 years of relevant experience in content writing, copywriting, or a combination of both.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in both long-form content and short-form, conversion-focused copywriting.
* A strong portfolio showcasing blogs, website content, landing pages, social media posts, email campaigns, ad copy, case studies, or other marketing assets.
* Excellent writing, editing, proofreading, storytelling, and communication skills.
* Ability to simplify technical or complex concepts into clear, compelling, audience-focused messaging.
* Understanding of content strategy, audience intent, brand positioning, and marketing objectives.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Comfort working with feedback, ambiguity, and changing priorities in an agency environment.
* Practical experience using AI writing tools and LLMs for research, ideation, drafting, editing, and content optimization.
* Strong editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted content is accurate, specific, engaging, and aligned with brand voice.

**B2B technology, SaaS, enterprise, or digital marketing agency experience will be an advantage.**
Good to Have
  
  

* Knowledge of SEO fundamentals, keyword research, on-page optimization, and search intent.
* Familiarity with CMS platforms such as WordPress or HubSpot.
* Understanding of email marketing tools and campaign content.
* Exposure to ABM (Account-Based Marketing) and B2B demand-generation campaigns.
* Understanding of the B2B sales funnel and how content supports awareness, consideration, and conversion.
* Experience maintaining brand voice guidelines across multiple clients.

**Benefits**
Benefits
  
  

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Health insurance for you and your family.
* Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team.
* Exposure to diverse B2B technology brands and marketing challenges.
* A fast-paced, collaborative environment that encourages learning and innovation.
* The opportunity to make a meaningful impact on client growth through content and copywriting.

title: Marketing Associate – Brand, Communications & Market Intelligence
description:
**The Role**

We’re looking for a Marketing Associate who will be the single point of contact (SPOC) for all marketing at Magron. You’ll be the person who brings our story to life, whether that’s a pitch deck for investors, a campaign creative, a market report, or representing us at an expo. This is a high-visibility role working directly with the founder, ideal for someone who wants ownership early in their career and is excited to build a brand from the ground up.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own Magron’s marketing end to end as the central point of contact for agencies, vendors, media, partners and internal teams
* Create compelling visual content (social media creatives, brochures, product visuals, event collateral, and short-form video) using Adobe Creative Suite
* Build polished presentations for investors, partners, customers and events, translating technical and business ideas into clear, persuasive stories
* Conduct market and competitor research across the Indian and global EV and automotive landscape, and turn findings into actionable insights
* Represent Magron at auto expos, launch events, media interactions and partner meetings
* Support PR, product launches, brand campaigns and digital marketing initiatives
* Maintain brand consistency across every touchpoint, from our website to our showroom floor
* Track campaign performance and suggest improvements based on data

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2–5 years of experience in marketing, brand communications, or a related role (startup or automotive experience is a strong plus)
* Hands-on proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign; Premiere Pro or After Effects is a bonus)
* Excellent presentation skills, with a strong eye for design and storytelling in PowerPoint, Keynote or similar tools
* Solid research and analytical ability, comfortable digging into market data and making sense of it
* Genuine interest in automobiles, electric mobility and the startup ecosystem
* Outstanding written and spoken English; proficiency in additional Indian languages is an advantage
* A confident, articulate communicator with a polished, professional presence, someone who can walk into any room and represent the brand with credibility
* Sharp, curious and self-driven, comfortable with ambiguity and juggling multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Design, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

**Why Join Magron**

* Work directly with the founder and play a key role in shaping a new Indian EV brand
* Real ownership and visibility from day one, not just execution
* Exposure to product, technology, fundraising and go-to-market, all under one roof
* Be part of a team building deep tech and clean mobility in India

title: Lead Application Engineer II- BMS Presales
description:
**What You Will Do**
The primary responsibility for this role is to work on end-to-end presales engineering activities of Fire and Security opportunities within India from various verticals (e.g., Transportation, Data Center, Commercial, Industries, Fit-outs, Key Accounts, etc.). You will be handling techno-Commercial activities of the projects covering various ELV systems such as Fire Alarm System, CCTV Surveillance & Security System, Access Control System, Public Address System, Parking Management System, Structured Cabling System, network Infrastructure, Building Management Systems etc. You should own the technical consideration to win the job and should be part of HOTO process to get the D&E and OPS approval for booking
  
  
**How You Will Do It**

* Review the project inputs and project intake form shared by the Front desk/Sales.
* Analyze the requirement and initiate the Kick-off call with Front Desk after getting CoE SFDC Code and time frame.
* Prepare designs on given floor plans to arrive with the BOQ; in case BOQ is unavailable.
* Identify potential issues/risks and proactively bring them to the customer's knowledge and help to mitigate the identified risks.
* Initiate the discussion with OEMs & subcontractors and get the right solution and proposal from OEMs.
* Analyze the proposal and commercials received from the OEM and verify the same based on the past data and benchmark costing available in the SCM Database.
* Upon completion of cost comparison, prepare the optimized techno-commercial Costing sheet, Proposal, and Compliance Statements.
* Once the deliverables are ready, perform Self QC and get the 2nd level QC done by the Delivery Manager. Eventually, submit the deliverables to the Front Desk.
* Perform 2nd level QC of the deliverables done by other Application Engineers in the team
* Update the SFDC regularly, and complete timesheet & assigned training on time.
* Actively negotiate and follow up with OEMs and Internal OPS/ Post Sales team to get the right kind of prices for the project.
* Regularly participate in the Daily Call /Cadence Call with the business team.
* Actively derive the strategy for increasing the win rate.
* Align with Organization KPIs such as Quality, Cycle Time, OTD, Win rate, Productivity, etc.

**What We Look For**

* BE (Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication)
* Must have 10+ years of relevant experience in ELV Systems domains.
* Strong knowledge of ELV & ICT Systems (Fire Alarm System, CCTV, Access Control, PAVA, Intrusion Detection Systems, Intercom Systems, Gate Barriers, Car parking system, Structured Cabling, Network Switches, etc.).
* Knowledge in Building Management System will be added advantage for the role.
* Must have India projects' presales and estimation experience on various verticals.
* Design know-how of the ELV & ICT Systems.
* Capable of understanding ELV Systems specifications and doing product selections along with the deviation/compliance statements.
* Must be able to work on complex costing sheets covering Material, Engineering, Operations, and Subcon costs.
* Skill in articulating offered solutions in a structured way through high-standard technical proposal documents.
* Must have a strong network with the 3rd party vendors in India.
* Must be a quick learner & keen on problem-solving techniques.
* Proficient in written and verbal communication.
* Must be a good team player.

**Preferred**

* Work experience in all leading access control products (e.g., Software House, Lenel, HID, Suprema, Bosch, Honeywell, etc.)
* Work experience in all leading CCTV products (e.g., American Dynamics, Milestone, Genetec, Pelco, Axis, etc.)
* Knowledge of Fire Alarm Systems products such as Notifier, Simplex, and EST (Edward).
* PAVA, Structured Cabling and Network infrastructure know-how is a must.
* Knowledge of ACAD, Visio, and Excel.
* Security and fire alarm systems' product certifications will be added advantage.

title: Sr. Staff - Project Accounting Global Module Owner
description:
**Job Description**
It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you’re in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.
  
  
**Who are we?**
Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.
  
  
Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!
  
  
*Summary:*
The Wabtec Finance IT Team is growing to support our worldwide consolidation of ERP environments and financial systems transformation.  If you are a Finance IT professional with leadership skills, Oracle implementation expertise, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we would like to invite you to get to know us.
  
  
The Project Accounting Global Module Owner (GMO) will be involved in projects ranging from enhancements to ERP implementations and major initiatives impacting Finance systems/processes, evaluating requirements, proposing high level solutions aligned with global standards and ensuring successful deployments.
  
  
*Duties and Responsibilities:*

* Lead activities for Finance ERP implementations and major initiatives including planning, configuration, testing, training, conversion strategies, and on time rollouts for financial modules
* Evaluate project requirements and assess viability and impact of proposals on existing business processes and system architecture
* Capture high level solutions and business process flows for major initiatives which have impact on business processes or system architecture. Analyze and highlight any gaps or inefficiencies within the proposals when aligned with cross functional business processes and system architecture
* Ensure changes related to finance ERP implementations/major initiatives go through proper testing and relevant documentation is created for future reference
* Own and maintain important process documentation and workflow designs that are relevant to cross functional business processes and system ecosystems
* Transition new implementation solutions to the operational support team for level 1 and level 2 issues and provide support for level 3 issues
* Communicate lessons learned post implementation
* Proactively Identify and drive projects that simplify the system footprint and/or streamline finance processes
* Work with IT leaders and module owners for prioritization of critical issues and assist on resolution when required
* Support the IT organization and finance with month end close activities as related to finance modules and integrations when required
* Other duties as assigned

*Minimum Qualifications:*
(To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.)
  
  

* Minimum of 5 years’ experience with implementation of Oracle Project Accounting and Oracle Financials
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in an information systems design (development experience with implementation, customization, business analyst or technical analyst experience) implementation or operations
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or "STEM" Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math) or Masters in Business Administration

*Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:*

* Knowledge of finance processes particularly Oracle Project Accounting, and key ERP functionalities and configurations aligned to those processes
* Understanding of the key tables used by Oracle finance modules and how they are related
* Experience with Oracle Financials Cloud platform is a plus
* Strong team player – collaborates well with others to solve problems and actively incorporates input from various sources
* Demonstrated customer focus – evaluates decisions through the eyes of the customer, builds strong customer relationships, creates processes with customer viewpoint and partners with customers to help shape their future initiatives
* Strong analytical and strong problem solving skills -communicates in a clear and succinct manner and effectively evaluates information / data to make decisions, anticipates obstacles and develops plans to resolve, creates actionable strategies and operational plans
* Change oriented – actively generates process improvements, champions and drives change initiatives, confronts difficult circumstances in creative ways, balances multiple and competing priorities and executes accordingly

*Physical Demands:*

* Frequently communicating with others to exchange information

title: Lead - Partner enablement
description:
**About Rocketlane**

Rocketlane is a fast-growing, category-defining SaaS company transforming customer onboarding and professional services automation. Our mission is simple: help B2B companies deliver a seamless, consistent, and efficient onboarding experience — reducing chaos and driving better customer outcomes.

Today, we’re a team of 200+ passionate builders creating a product that teams genuinely love to use. Backed by leading investors like 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners, we’ve raised over $105M to fuel our growth.

As Rocketlane scales into enterprise deals, new geographies, and an expanding partner ecosystem, the Professional Services (PS) team is at the forefront of this evolution. With growth, the cost of inconsistent onboarding and reactive enablement becomes more pronounced — and we’re no longer willing to accept that trade-off.

This role exists to change that.

If you’re excited about building a high-impact enablement function within a product-led PS organization that deeply values delivery quality, ownership, and customer experience — this is your opportunity.

**The Problem You're Solving**

Right now, a new Implementation Manager at Rocketlane learns on the job. There's no structured path, no certification, no single source of truth. Status decks exist in six versions. When a new product feature ships, the PS team finds out the same way customers do. Ongoing training? Mostly ad hoc.

You're the person who fixes all of that and then makes it impossible to go back to the old way.

**What This Role Actually Is**

You've run implementations. You've been in the room when things go sideways. You know what "good delivery" looks like because you've done it and you've probably thought "someone should write this down properly."

That someone is now you.

As Enablement Lead for Professional Services, you own three things end-to-end:

1. The learning path for every new PS hire From day one to first solo customer engagement - structured, sequenced, and certified. Not a folder of decks. An actual program.

2. Feature enablement, every release cycle You sit close to Product. When something ships, your team knows about it before the customer does - with a playbook, not a Slack message.

3. The PS collateral library One version of every template. One source of truth. Always current. You own it, you maintain it, you retire things that are stale.

This isn't a content coordination role. You're building a function from scratch and running it as a continuous program — complete with certifications, gamification, and a feedback loop that actually closes.

**What You'll Own?**

**New Hire Learning Path**

* Design and run a structured onboarding curriculum from "what is Rocketlane" to "ready to own a customer engagement"
* Build the certification program: assessments, scoring rubrics, pass criteria, refresh cycles
* Create role-specific tracks for IMs, Solution Architects, and partners, not one-size-fits-all
* Gamify progression so completion is a milestone, not a checkbox

**Feature Enablement (with PM)**

* Embed yourself in the product release cycle - beta reviews, early access, pre-launch prep
* Translate every significant release into: what changed, what to demo, what to watch out for, what to update in delivery
* Deliver live sessions and async content so the team is never caught flat-footed on a customer call
* Feed practitioner feedback back to Product, you're the voice of the field

**PS Collateral & Knowledge Base**

* Own the single source of truth for all PS templates: status decks, SteerCo decks, project plans, QBR frameworks, escalation playbooks
* Establish version control and content hygiene - one template, one owner, one place to find it
* Audit the library regularly; retire anything that misleads someone in the field
* Use AI tools to create, repurpose, and update content faster

**You're Right for This If...**

* You've spent 7+ years in SaaS delivery - implementations, onboarding, or CS and have personally owned enterprise customer engagements
* You've built or maintained enablement content before and know the difference between a deck and a learning experience
* You already use AI tools to do your job faster and you're curious about what's next
* You'd rather build the playbook yourself than write a brief about why one is needed
* You get energy from teaching others and from being in the field enough to know what's worth teaching
* You're comfortable presenting to a room of skeptical senior consultants and a customer SteerCo in the same week

**Bonus Points**

* You've enabled or certified an external partner / reseller network
* You have instructional design or structured curriculum experience
* You've worked in a high-growth SaaS environment where the product changes faster than the docs

**What You Won't Find Here**

* A role where you hand off content for someone else to deliver
* A team that's figured it all out - you're building the rails, not riding them
* A manager who needs to tell you what needs fixing

**The Stack You'll Work With**

Rocketlane · Notion · LMS · AI content tools · Close collaboration with Product, CS, and the Professional Services team

**Why join us?**

At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:

**Impact and ownership:**
You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.

**Work with the best:**
We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.

**Celebrate wins:**
Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.

**Learn and grow:**
We’re all about learning—we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and learn a lot about AI.

**Flexibility and balance:**
While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pajamas optional (at least outside the office).

title: PMS Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION – PMS ENGINEER**

**Role - Executive PMS Engineer**

Location - Chennai, Tamil Nadu (Work from Office)

**Shift: 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM**

**Job Summary**

The PMS Engineer is responsible for developing, maintaining, standardizing, and optimizing Planned Maintenance System (PMS) databases across the managed fleet. The role involves maintaining vessel machinery and equipment structures, maintenance job plans, spare parts, running-hour counters, and compliance-related maintenance requirements. The PMS Engineer will work closely with technical teams, vessel personnel, internal stakeholders, and software providers to ensure data accuracy, regulatory readiness, consistent fleet standards, and effective technical reporting.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. PMS Database Management & Data Quality Assurance**

* Build, update, and maintain vessel equipment hierarchies using SFI coding and company-defined standards.
* Develop and maintain PMS databases for new vessel takeovers, existing fleet vessels, fleet acquisitions, and system migrations.
* Review machinery and equipment details, including maker, model, specifications, component relationships, and associated records.
* Configure and update maintenance job plans, including job descriptions, calendar-based and running-hour intervals, and work instructions.
* Incorporate maker-recommended jobs, company-standard maintenance jobs, compliance jobs, and spare parts into the PMS database.
* Validate PMS data against maker manuals, machinery particulars, equipment lists, drawings, and other technical documents.
* Identify and resolve missing, duplicate, incorrect, or inconsistent components, jobs, spare parts, and counters.
* Support data migration, reconciliation, and validation between PMS platforms while preserving available historical maintenance records.
* Maintain standardized naming conventions, data-entry protocols, version control, and records of database changes.

**2. Maintenance Optimization & Compliance Monitoring**

* Ensure PMS maintenance jobs are aligned with maker recommendations, company SMS requirements, applicable statutory requirements, and class survey schedules.
* Verify that safety-critical, compliance-critical, and business-sensitive equipment is correctly classified and mapped in the PMS.
* Monitor maintenance intervals, running-hour counters, overdue jobs, and other compliance-related parameters.
* Review PMS data and maintenance records to identify gaps that may affect inspections, audits, vetting, or vessel maintenance.
* Support corrective and preventive actions arising from PMS reviews, vessel inspections, audits, and vetting observations.
* Assist with PMS-related requirements under ISM, SIRE, CDI, and TMSA, including relevant maintenance-management and data-governance activities.

**3. Reporting, Data Analysis & Inventory Control**

* Prepare reports on PMS database status, data quality, overdue maintenance, compliance gaps, and implementation progress.
* Use Microsoft Excel formulas, lookup functions, data-cleaning techniques, PivotTables, conditional formatting, and charts to generate reports.
* Develop and maintain reusable Excel templates and dashboards for recurring PMS reporting requirements.
* Review spare-parts mapping and identify discrepancies between equipment records, PMS data, and available inventory information.
* Analyze PMS datasets to identify recurring errors, data inconsistencies, and opportunities to improve maintenance processes.
* Collaborate with BI and data teams to improve reporting, data integration, automation, and management visibility.

**4. Fleet PMS Support & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Provide PMS database support to vessel teams, Technical Superintendents, and shore-based technical departments.
* Coordinate with vessel personnel to obtain missing machinery particulars, maker manuals, equipment details, and maintenance information.
* Liaise with PMS software providers and internal IT or technical teams to resolve application issues, data discrepancies, and system enhancement requests.
* Track issues, action items, implementation timelines, and closure status to ensure timely resolution.
* Support consistent implementation of PMS standards across new takeovers and the existing fleet.
* Participate in PMS reviews, technical meetings, familiarization sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**5. Audit Readiness & PMS Governance**

* Support internal and external audits and inspections within the scope of PMS data, maintenance jobs, and maintenance records.
* Review PMS-related observations and assist in implementing corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain PMS data standards, audit trails, database documentation, and quality-control procedures.
* Support relevant TMSA Element 4 and 4A requirements relating to maintenance management, equipment reliability, and PMS data governance.
* Ensure assigned PMS action items are completed within agreed timelines and supporting records are maintained.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marine Engineering or an equivalent marine engineering qualification.
* Typically 3–5 years of relevant experience in marine engineering, preferably including sea-going experience and hands-on shore-based PMS database management.
* Experience in a ship management company, vessel operator, or maritime technical management environment is preferred.
* Practical understanding of marine machinery, maintenance practices, maker manuals, spare parts, and technical documentation.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including lookup functions, formulas, data cleaning, PivotTables, and charts.
* High attention to detail, good organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with shipboard and shore-based stakeholders.

**Technical Skills**

* Hands-on experience with maritime PMS applications such as ShipPalm, SmartPAL, ShipNet, AMOS, BASSnet, Danaos, or Sertica is an advantage.
* Knowledge of SFI coding, equipment hierarchies, component structures, maintenance job configuration, and spare-parts mapping.
* Ability to interpret machinery particulars, maker manuals, equipment specifications, and maintenance instructions.
* Experience with PMS data migration, data reconciliation, validation, and quality assurance.
* Knowledge of Power Query and Power BI or other reporting and visualization tools is desirable.

**Soft Skills & Core Competencies**

* Meticulous attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate, standardized data.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to translate technical requirements into clear data structures and reports.
* Good time management, prioritization, and follow-up skills.
* Willingness to learn new PMS platforms, reporting tools, and automation solutions.

**Experience & Qualifications**

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marine Engineering or an equivalent marine engineering qualification.

Experience: 3–5 years of relevant experience, preferably combining sea-going exposure with shore-based PMS work in a ship management company or fleet operator.

**Alternative:**
Ex-seafarers and junior engineering officers seeking to transition ashore into technical data management may be considered, particularly where they demonstrate sound knowledge of marine machinery, maintenance practices, and strong data-handling skills.

**Key Performance Expectations**

* Accurate, standardized, and up-to-date PMS databases for assigned vessels.
* Timely completion of PMS database development, updates, and migration activities.
* Reduction in missing data, duplicate records, and maintenance-job mapping discrepancies.
* Reliable mapping and monitoring of critical equipment, maintenance jobs, counters, and spare parts.
* Timely resolution and tracking of PMS data issues and support requests.
* Improved reporting, compliance visibility, and audit readiness through consistent data quality and process improvement.

**Overall Role Objective**

To ensure that PMS databases across the fleet remain accurate, standardized, compliant, and operationally effective, supporting reliable vessel maintenance, regulatory readiness, and continuous improvement in technical fleet management.

title: Preconstruction Coordinator - Senior Analyst
description:
**About DESRI**
DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 13 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 85 renewable energy projects in 24 states. DESRI is run by a dynamic team with offices located at New York, Denver, Houston and Hyderabad (India).
  
  
**About The Role**
In this role, you will work as an embedded member of DESRI’s Preconstruction team, executing delegated tasks assigned, reviewed, and owned by U.S.-based Precon Leads. You will build a deep understanding of how DESRI takes projects from site studies and technical due diligence through EPC procurement and contract execution, and progressively take on a more active role in supporting consultant engagement, RFP management, scheduling, bid evaluation, and contract administration.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Operate as an embedded member of the Preconstruction team, participating in project calls, email traffic, and internal discussions across assigned Precon Leads’ project portfolios.
* Support consultant proposal solicitation and comparison — reaching out to EORs, geotechnical firms, and other consultants against provided SOWs, tracking responses, and building structured cost, scope, and schedule comparison matrices for Precon Lead review.
* Support RFP preparation and data room setup — compiling and formatting RFP packages, drafting standard RFP sections from established templates, and building out and maintaining data rooms against the RFP checklist.
* Coordinate EPC outreach logistics for RFP preview and release, tracking confirmations, managing distribution lists, and maintaining a log of outreach communications for Precon Lead visibility.
* Maintain and update the living SOW document as project inputs evolve, flagging inconsistencies between iterations and supporting progression from Preliminary SOW through RFP-level SOW to Final Contract SOW.
* Support development and ongoing maintenance of the preconstruction schedule, tracking milestones across site studies, EPC engagement, RFP issuance, and contract execution, and flagging schedule risks and delays for Precon Lead attention.
* Build out bid leveling matrices and comparison frameworks, compile initial proposal-vs-scope alignment reviews, and organize bidder clarification logs and Q&A trackers.
* Maintain version-controlled Basis of Design (BOD) logs across project iterations, flagging equipment selection changes and downstream impacts for Precon Lead awareness.
* Support development of project-specific EPC risk registers, contributing to populating and maintaining the register as familiarity with individual projects and site conditions builds.
* Maintain a master exhibit log for each active contract, tracking current exhibit versions, ownership, and outstanding open items, and surfacing anything stale or blocking progress for Precon Lead attention.
* Receive, organize, and log redlined exhibits, preparing clean comparison documents for Precon Lead review, and support the Contracts Manager in maintaining the baseline exhibit template library.
* Triage contract-related email and correspondence, summarizing outstanding items and action owners for Precon Lead review, and flagging urgent items requiring immediate attention.

**Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering, or a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, or Construction Management or related field.
* Around 2–5 years of experience with large infrastructure or energy projects — in preconstruction, project development, project controls, owner’s engineer / PMC, contracts administration, or infrastructure advisory. Renewable energy experience is preferred but not required.
* Strong analytical and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple RFP, estimating, and contract workstreams and data rooms simultaneously.
* Comfort with contract administration, version control, and detailed document tracking, including redlines, exhibit logs, and checklists.
* Working knowledge of project scheduling tools such as Primavera P6 or MS Project and strong Excel skills; exposure to Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, or Smartsheet is an advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to work directly with senior U.S.-based Precon Leads, Contracts Managers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Comfort operating across multiple projects and workstreams simultaneously, in an environment where scope is not always fully defined.
* A proactive and detail-oriented approach, with the judgment to flag gaps, risks, and blockers — such as stale exhibits, schedule slippage, or scope outliers — before they impact deadlines.

validation obligations remain applicable

title: Robotics Program & Operations Intern
description:
**Future Kraft (part of The Robot Foundry)**

**Location:**
Lodha Signet, B571, Lower Parel

**Training:**
1–2 weeks, followed by hands-on responsibility across all functions

Who Can Apply?

We welcome applications from students, recent graduates, and diploma holders with an interest in technology, robotics, and hands-on learning.

**Preferred educational backgrounds:**

* Diploma in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or related technical fields.
* B.Sc. in Electronics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Physics, or related disciplines.
* B.Sc. graduates who have completed practical courses or certifications in robotics, Arduino, electronics, coding, or STEM education.
* Candidates from vocational or technical training programs with relevant hands-on experience.
* Candidates with practical experience in robotics clubs, maker spaces, technical workshops, or teaching children.

**An engineering degree is NOT required.**

What Matters More Than Your Degree

We're looking for someone who:

* Is comfortable assembling, testing, and troubleshooting basic electronics and robotics kits.
* Can follow technical instructions and quickly learn new systems.
* Is extremely organised with equipment, inventory, schedules, and documentation.
* Can communicate clearly and confidently with children.
* Is comfortable handling both technical and operational responsibilities.
* Is willing to prepare materials, pack kits, set up classrooms, teach, clean up, and maintain equipment.
* Is dependable, punctual, detail-oriented, and proactive.
* Can work with Google Sheets, Docs, Calendar, and basic digital tools.
* Is available for scheduled weekend classes.

What You'll Do

You will be responsible for the complete operational cycle of our robotics courses:

**Before classes:**
Test and prepare kits, create and collate course materials, maintain inventory, coordinate venues, track schedules, and remind the founders of upcoming sessions.

**During classes:**
Set up the classroom, assist with or conduct robotics sessions, support children with activities, troubleshoot equipment, and maintain a safe and engaging environment.

**After classes:**
Count and check components, reset and repack kits, clean and restore the classroom, store equipment, update trackers, and prepare for upcoming sessions.

**Throughout the week:**
Manage class calendars, coordinate with vendors and venues, track supplies and replacements, maintain documentation, and ensure everything is ready on time.

Training & Expectations

You will undergo
**1–2 weeks of intensive practical training**
in robotics kits, course content, teaching, quality control, inventory, and class operations.

After training, you should be capable of managing responsibilities across all these areas with founder oversight and appropriate safety supervision.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a short introduction to
**sudarshan@coboticca.com**
.

Tell us about a technical project you've built, a workshop you've participated in, or an activity you've helped organise. This is mandatory. Applications without technical project descriptions will not be considered.

**We value practical skills, initiative, and reliability over degrees and marks.**

title: Solution Engineer : Mumbai
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for
**domain-first, systems-oriented engineers**
who understand how real-world systems (in renewable energy
**,**
automotive, manufacturing, IoT, etc.) generate and use data — and can translate that into meaningful AI-driven workflows using DevRev.
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer, you will act as a
**trusted advisor**
, combining
**domain expertise, engineering depth, and problem-solving**
to help customers unlock value from their data through DevRev’s AI platform.
  
  
You will work closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to design solutions that go beyond demos — enabling
**real-world automation, intelligence, and agentic workflows**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with customers to deeply understand domain workflows, systems, and data flows (e.g., connected vehicles, factory systems, IoT environments)
* Translate real-world signals (sensor data, logs, events) into insights, workflows, and automated actions
* Build and showcase AI-driven workflows, automations, and agentic use cases
* Design and articulate end-to-end solutions (data ingestion → processing → decision → action)
* Act as a technical advisor, guiding customers on how DevRev can integrate into and enhance their existing systems
* Deliver tailored demos, PoCs, and solution walkthroughs grounded in real-world use cases (not generic SaaS demos)
* Support integrations with external systems via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines
* Contribute to technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and solution architectures
* Stay current on industry trends (renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, IoT, AI) and bring insights into customer conversations

**Qualifications & Skills**
**Domain Expertise**

* Experience in renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, industrial systems, or IoT environments
* Strong understanding of:
* Connected systems (vehicles, machines, robotics, embedded systems)
* Sensor ecosystems (CAN, telemetry, vision systems, IoT devices)
* Real-world data (signals, logs, time-series)
* Familiarity with manufacturing workflows (inspection, defect detection, production cycles).
* Ability to explain data flow from system → processing → business outcomes

**Engineering Depth**

* Strong system-level thinking
* Experience with:
* Data pipelines, APIs, integrations, distributed systems
* Experience in Python / TypeScript / JavaScript (or similar)
* Understanding of system design, reliability, and failure handling
* Exposure to AI/ML in industrial use cases (vision systems, predictive maintenance, log-stream analysis, etc.)

**Problem Solving & Use Case Thinking**

* Ability to translate data → insights → workflows → actions
* Experience designing end-to-end systems
* Strong analytical mindset to identify automation opportunities from real-world signals

**AI & Tools**

* Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents
* Familiarity with prompt design and AI workflows
* Tools: Postman, GitHub, Jira, Cursor, Claude Code

**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!
  
  
*DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*

**Job Description**
About the Role
  
  
The EDI Support Subject Matter Expert (SME) serves as a key resource supporting the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement and strategic development of Castrol's EDI ecosystem. This role provides functional and technical expertise across EDI operations, SAP integrations, trading partner onboarding, issue resolution, and process optimization.
  
  
The position partners closely with business teams, IT&S, external vendors, and trading partners to support seamless electronic transactions and ensure critical customer-facing processes operate efficiently.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Analyze and support resolution of EDI transaction, mapping, and integration issues.
* Verify root cause analysis outcomes for production incidents and recommend or confirm corrective actions.
* Identify exception trends and create action plans to improve performance.
* Support resolution of complex document processing and interface exceptions.
* Manage Key Customer Scorecards and KPI’s to expected levels

Trading Partner Onboarding
  
  

* Manage E2E onboarding of new customers, distributors, and other trading partners.
* Convert customer EDI requirements and specifications into process and technical specifications.
* Create implementation project plans and coordinate with technical teams to ensure scope and on-time delivery
* Coordinate testing activities and support successful implementation and go-live activities.
* Validate transaction compliance and connectivity requirements.

Mapping & Integration Support
  
  

* Support EDI mapping development, enhancement, and validation activities.
* Provide expertise on SAP IDOCs, Order-to-Cash and logistics processes, and EDI transaction standards.
* Partner with business stakeholders, IT&S and integration providers to evaluate and validate proposed solutions.
* Assist with testing, defect analysis, and production readiness activities.

Subject Matter Expertise & Consultation
  
  

* Act as a trusted EDI advisor to business teams, IT&S, and support organizations.
* Provide consultation and knowledge sharing on EDI processes, standards, and best practices.
* Creation of Support documentation, training materials, operational procedures, and EDI Specifications.
* Serve as an escalation resource for complex EDI-related issues.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Identify opportunities to improve EDI processes, monitoring, and support effectiveness.
* Recommend automation and process enhancements that improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Support digital transformation initiatives involving integration and customer connectivity.

**Experience Required**

* Expertise in supporting Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) business processes.
* Advanced knowledge of ANSI X12, EDIFACT and cXML transaction standards.
* Expertise troubleshooting EDI transaction delivery, mappings, and document flows.
* Deep understanding of SAP IDOCs used in Order-to-Cash and logistics processes
* Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Demonstrable capability to work effectively across cross-functional business and technical teams.
* Expertise with OpenText/GXS, SPS Commerce, or similar EDI platforms.
