description:
**Title: Consultant - Program and Instructional Design**

**No. of Positions: 1**

**Location: Preferred from Delhi (Includes travelling for meetings as and when required)**

**Consultancy Tenure: 9 Months (12 – 15 Days per month)**

Breakthrough is seeking a Consultant with relevant experience and knowledge of working within a collective / coalition in the social sector. The role involves developing GTE curriculum, training modules, and digital learning resources, along with designing and facilitating workshops and training sessions for diverse stakeholders. The consultant will be working in close collaboration with the Senior Consultant for India Coalition and the Chief Thematic Officer to complete the design phase deliverables as listed below:

***Key Responsibilities:***

**Content development and instructional design**

* Design and develop GTE content, curriculum, training modules, and learning resources based on research, field insights, and programme needs.
* Support formative research, pilot testing, content refinement, and finalisation, including digital learning products such as interactive games, webinars, and online training modules.
* Work with internal teams, government stakeholders, and civil society partners to adapt content for different contexts and support its adoption.

**Training design, delivery, and quality assurance**

* Independently plan, design, and facilitate training workshops for internal teams, implementing partners, government representatives, and other stakeholders.
* Develop training calendars, facilitation guides, monitoring tools, and feedback mechanisms.
* Monitor training quality, assess participant feedback, and recommend improvements to content and delivery.

**Programme planning and delivery coordination**

* Manage programme workplans, timelines, milestones, and action trackers, including coordination across ICEGE's five Design Phase workstreams.
* Track progress, resolve routine bottlenecks, and flag risks requiring leadership attention.
* Ensure timely completion of activities and deliverables in coordination with internal teams, partners, and external consultants.

**Partner engagement, consultations, and convenings**

* Coordinate with Coalition partners, Working Group co-leads, the Design Committee, youth representatives, government stakeholders, and technical consultants.
* Co-lead the operational planning and organisation of physical and online workshops, consultations, training sessions, and partner convenings.
* Coordinate agendas, background materials, stakeholder inputs, meeting documentation, and follow-up actions.

**Documentation, knowledge management, and dissemination**

* Maintain organised programme documentation, shared repositories, decision logs, meeting records, and version-controlled resources.
* Analyse and document learning from content development, training delivery, consultations, and programme implementation.
* Support the preparation and dissemination of publications, learning resources, reports, and knowledge products for internal and external audiences.

**Review, validation, and progress reporting**

* Coordinate review and validation processes for programme outputs, training resources, and Coalition Design Phase deliverables.
* Consolidate stakeholder feedback, track revisions, and prepare materials for management review and approval.
* Prepare regular progress updates, process documentation, learning summaries, and inputs for programme reviews and donor reports.

**Project, budget, and operational management**

* Support the compilation of final programme deliverables, implementation plans, and transition documentation, ensuring that responsibilities and next steps are clearly recorded.

***Specific Knowledge, Skill & Experience Required:***

* 10-15 years of relevant experience in programme management, instructional design, content development, training, or multi-stakeholder initiatives.
* Experience developing curricula, training modules, facilitation resources, and digital or blended learning content.
* Strong understanding of gender equality, education, adolescent development, and participatory learning approaches.
* Experience designing and facilitating workshops and training programmes for diverse audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to independently coordinate complex projects, multiple stakeholders, consultants, and time-bound deliverables.
* Experience working with civil society organisations, government institutions, coalitions, or development-sector partnerships.
* Strong analytical, writing, documentation, facilitation, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Google Workspace, and relevant digital learning and project-management tools.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgement, anticipate challenges, and manage competing priorities.

**About Breakthrough:**

Breakthrough works on culture change by shifting social norms that limit women and girls from reaching their full potential. We work with adolescents and young people aged 11-25 years aiming for an entire generation to shift and push for change. Over time, we have worked with more than 5.4 million adolescents and young people, aged 11 to 25, to encourage aspiration, agency, leadership and negotiation through our work in schools and communities. title: Launchpad Fellowship
description:
**About Atlys**

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.

**The Role**

The
**Launchpad Fellowship**
is a full-time, in-office internship designed for final-year students and recent graduates looking to gain meaningful, hands-on experience before stepping into their first full-time role.

You’ll work closely with teams across operations, growth, research, strategy, customer experience, product, and process improvement, gaining exposure to how a high-growth startup operates, makes decisions, and solves real customer problems at scale.

**The Job**

* **Growth, Research & Strategy:**
  Work on business problems across growth and strategy, conduct research, identify opportunities, and turn insights into actionable recommendations.
* **Operations & Customer Experience:**
  Work on real customer journeys, manage core visa operations, and understand how we deliver a seamless experience at scale.
* **Product & Process Improvement:**
  Identify user pain points and operational inefficiencies, and work with product and process teams to build better solutions, tools, and workflows.
* **Cross-Functional Execution:**
  Work closely with different teams, take ownership of projects, and learn to prioritise, move quickly, and solve problems in a fast-paced startup environment.
* **Capstone & Leadership Exposure:**
  Take ownership of a real business challenge, develop a solution, and present your work to leadership, while receiving regular mentorship and feedback throughout the fellowship.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Are a final-year student or recent graduate looking for a full-time, in-office, high-intensity internship.
* Are a quick learner who is comfortable with ambiguity and unfamiliar problems.
* Communicate clearly and take ownership without waiting to be told what to do.
* Are curious about product, operations, customer experience, or how businesses work.
* Thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy figuring things out independently.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*

**What you can expect**

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s what you can expect:

* **Competitive compensation and equity**
  so you participate in the value you help create.
* **A thoughtful leave policy**
  with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* **Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office**
  , so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* **Great tools to do your best work**
  , including high-spec equipment and software.
* **An office designed for more than just work**
  , with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Strategy Consultant
description:
**Position:**
Program Manager – Urban Initiative

**Location:**
Delhi

**An initiative supported by The Convergence Foundation**

**About URBAN Project**

India is urbanising rapidly, and its cities are where the country's economic future will be decided. Services already form the largest part of the Indian economy, and well-functioning cities are essential to sustaining services-led growth and creating jobs at scale. Yet urbanisation in India has often been unplanned and under-resourced, leaving cities struggling with weak planning, a difficult business environment, fragmented governance, and chronic under-financing. Getting urbanisation right – rapid yet sustainable – is one of the highest-leverage opportunities for India's economic transformation.

The Urban Initiative is supported by The Convergence Foundation, the Urban Initiative is being established to help India build the policy ecosystem needed to drive economic growth through rapid and sustainable urbanisation. It will work systemically—developing policy perspectives and partnering with the government to advance reform—rather than engaging in on-ground implementation. Its work will be organised around four interconnected pillars:

* **Regional economic and spatial planning:**
  Creating regional economic plans that feed into better, more growth-oriented master plans for cities and their surrounding regions.
* **Ease of doing business:**
  Enabling more sensible development control norms and regulations that make it easier to build, invest and do business in cities.
* **Governance:**
  Strengthening how cities are managed, including the devolution of power to empowered, accountable city governments.
* **Financing:**
  Ensuring cities are adequately funded and well managed – through better allocation of public money, raising local resources, and involving the private sector through PPP and other models.

Across each pillar, the initiative will build a strong policy perspective, drawing on best practices from better-run Indian cities as well as relevant global examples. The Economic growth team works with internal and external stakeholders on cross functional projects. The Program Manager (PM) should have strong problem-solving skills, secondary research capabilities and analytical prowess. In addition, as well as excellent oral & written communication skills. * Work with Economic Growth team and leadership to identify and scope priority areas in the urban development policy ecosystem, with a focus on ease of doing business in cities, urban finance, and city planning

* Oversee the creation of knowledge material across priority areas by identifying potential partners, developing terms of reference and managing projects to their completion
* Provide continued program/grant support to organisations, programs or public goods that might stem as a result of the scoping exercise

**Required Qualifications, Skills and Abilities**

* Undergraduate or masters degrees from top tier institutions. While there is no preference for a particular major or specialisation, prior experience in urban development or related sectors will be preferred
* Up to 4 years of work experience in a consulting or challenging/ high growth environment
* Excellent analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills
* Solid planning and organisational skills with high attention to detail, accuracy, protocol and deadline
* Excellent writing ability that is clear, concise and analytic in style
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder-facing skills including solid presentation and facilitation skills

title: D365 Functional Consultant
description:
**Role purpose:**

Provide hands-on D365 Finance & Operations functional support and delivery capability, helping the D365 Functional Lead maintain a stable, controlled and continuously improving global finance platform.

**Working Pattern**

India-based role with regular UK/EU hours overlap for global collaboration

**Purpose and Context**

FNZ has deployed Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations as a core global finance platform. Following global go-live, the Finance Systems team is strengthening permanent in-house capability to stabilise the platform, support Finance operations, deliver controlled improvements and prepare for future modules and entity deployments.

This is a hands-on functional role reporting to the Finance Systems Functional Lead - Finance & Operations. The role holder will configure and support D365, investigate issues, translate Finance requirements into workable solutions, produce documentation and test evidence, and contribute to controlled releases and continuous improvement.

The position requires practical D365 Finance experience. It is not a coordination-only or general business analyst role. The successful candidate must be comfortable working directly in the application, partnering with Finance users and technical teams, and taking assigned work through to a documented and supportable outcome.

**Key Responsibilities**

D365 Functional Support and Configuration

* Provide hands-on functional support across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash and Bank, Fixed Assets, Expense Management, Project Accounting and Financial Reporting.
* Configure approved changes in D365 under the direction and design authority of the D365 Functional Lead.
* Analyse business requirements, current processes and system behaviour; document solution options, functional requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain accurate configuration, process and support documentation so that knowledge is retained within FNZ.

Incident, Close and Operational Support

* Investigate functional incidents and service requests, reproduce issues, identify root causes and coordinate resolution with Finance users, technical teams and vendors.
* Support month-end and year-end close activities, reconciliations and business-critical finance processing, including agreed out-of-hours support where required.
* Distinguish defects, data issues, training needs and enhancement requests, ensuring each is progressed through the appropriate support or change process.
* Contribute to the upkeep of known-error records, support procedures, knowledge articles and recurring-issue analysis.

Change, Testing and Release Delivery

* Prepare functional specifications, process flows, test scenarios, test data and expected results for approved changes.
* Execute system, integration and regression testing; support business users with user acceptance testing and evidence capture.
* Assess the impact of proposed changes on modules, integrations, reporting, data, security and financial controls.
* Support release planning, deployment readiness, post-release validation and early-life support.

Data, Integrations and Reporting

* Support finance master data, financial dimensions, posting profiles, workflows, opening balances, sub-ledger data and intercompany processing.
* Investigate functional issues affecting interfaces with banking, payments, expense, tax, consolidation and reporting platforms.
* Work with Data and Reporting teams to validate D365 outputs and support reconciliation of reports to the general ledger.
* Assist with data migration, cleansing, mapping, validation and reconciliation for future deployments and entity onboarding.

Controls, Documentation and Governance

* Follow Finance Systems governance for demand intake, design approval, environments, testing, release and production change.
* Produce clear and complete evidence for configuration changes, testing, approvals and deployments.
* Support segregation-of-duties reviews, access-control testing, ITGC evidence and audit requests relating to assigned areas.
* Escalate control, data-integrity and operational risks promptly to the D365 Functional Lead.

Continuous Improvement and Knowledge Transfer

* Identify opportunities to use standard D365 capability, simplify processes, reduce manual work and improve user experience.
* Contribute to the prioritised D365 backlog with evidence on business impact, risk, urgency and delivery effort.
* Provide guidance and knowledge transfer to Finance users and Finance Systems colleagues.
* Develop broader cross-module capability while maintaining deeper expertise in allocated functional areas.

**Required Skills and Experience**

Essential

* 5+ years of hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations / Dynamics AX functional experience, with substantial exposure to finance modules.
* Practical configuration experience in at least three core areas such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash and Bank, Fixed Assets, Expense Management or Project Accounting.
* Good understanding of Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash processes, including close, reconciliation and financial-control requirements.
* Experience creating functional requirements, solution documentation, test scripts, test evidence and user guidance.
* Experience investigating production issues and working with technical teams on integrations, data fixes and extensions.
* Experience of system, integration, regression and user acceptance testing, together with controlled release and post-deployment validation.
* Ability to work directly in D365, analyse system behaviour and progress assigned work independently within agreed design and governance standards.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to work effectively with Finance users, global colleagues and external delivery partners.
* Disciplined approach to documentation, knowledge sharing, prioritisation and escalation.

**Preferred**

* Finance or accounting qualification, or equivalent practical experience in a Finance Systems environment.
* Experience in financial services, fintech, asset servicing or another regulated, multi-entity environment.
* Knowledge of IFRS, statutory reporting, segregation of duties and ITGC requirements.
* Experience with D365 Consolidation, Treasury and Cash Management, Project Accounting, Subscription Billing or Revenue Recognition.
* Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Workiva, Azure DevOps or finance-data integrations.
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant Associate certification or equivalent evidence of current D365 Finance capability.

**Success Measures**

* Assigned incidents and service requests are investigated thoroughly, documented clearly and resolved or escalated within agreed priorities.
* Configuration and change deliverables are accurate, supportable and aligned with approved functional designs.
* Testing is comprehensive, with traceable scenarios, results, defects and evidence.
* Month-end, year-end and business-critical processing receive reliable functional support.
* Documentation and knowledge transfer reduce reliance on individual contractors and external partners.
* Continuous-improvement items deliver measurable operational, control or user-experience benefits.
* Finance stakeholders and Finance Systems colleagues experience responsive, practical and dependable support.

**Employment Terms and Ways of Working**

* Permanent, full-time appointment into FNZ Technology (India) Private Limited [legal employing entity to be confirmed by HR].
* Direct reporting line to the Finance Systems Functional Lead - Finance & Operations and integration into the global Finance Systems team.
* Standard FNZ India employment terms, benefits, leave, probation and notice provisions apply, subject to HR confirmation.
* Appointment is subject to satisfactory pre-employment checks, right-to-work verification and any role-specific screening.
* UK/EU hours overlap is expected for regular collaboration, with flexibility around critical close, release and incident periods.
* All work must comply with FNZ information-security, data-protection, acceptable-use, change-control and records-management requirements.

**Role Description**
This is a part-time remote role for an ITGC Audit Consultant. The consultant will review and assess IT general controls across systems and infrastructure, including access management, change management, backup and recovery, and IT operations. Day-to-day work will involve analyzing control design and effectiveness, testing and documenting controls, and preparing clear audit workpapers and reports. The role includes collaborating with finance and accounting teams to understand the impact of IT controls on financial reporting, identifying control gaps, and recommending practical remediation steps. The consultant will participate in discussions with client stakeholders, support audit planning and scoping, and help ensure adherence to relevant standards and regulatory requirements.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills for evaluating IT controls, identifying risks, and interpreting complex data.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of Internal Controls, particularly IT general controls related to access, change management, and IT operations.
* Candidates should possess understanding of Finance and Financial Statements to link IT controls with financial reporting and compliance requirements.
* Candidates should possess foundational Accounting knowledge to support audit procedures and interpretation of accounting impacts.
* Relevant professional certification (e.g., CISA, CIA, CA, CPA, or equivalent) is beneficial.
* Experience with ITGC audits, SOX or similar regulatory frameworks, and risk-based audit methodologies is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage multiple assignments, and meet agreed timelines.

description:

One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting & Reconciliations, Management Reporting & Analysis, Research & Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support & Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
  
  
The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications.  The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting & regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
  
  
**Job Description\***
This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1) understanding the Change, (2) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams & Users until implementation of the Change.  It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements.  The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements.  This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc.  Collaborate with the Users & procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in-house GRIFFIN & AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology & Testing Teams where relevant.

**Education\***
Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
  
  
Certifications If Any - AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
  
  
**Experience Range\***
5 to 8 years
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast-paced, every-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)

**Desired Skills**

* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry

* Understanding of automation tools like Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI
* Knowledge/ Experience with Copilot/ Other AI tools usage in day-to-day BAU processes
* SQL, Database knowledge & ability to analyze data and related flows
* Knowledge of Agile methodology and tools (i.e., JIRA)

11:30 am to 8:30 pm

Gurugram/Mumbai

title: Content Manager - Research (Industrials- Machinery)
description:
**Position Summary**
*The primary output of this research is the transcript: a written record of each human-moderated interview, published on GLG's Library, our access-controlled research platform, for use by institutional investors.*
The Content Manager serves as the Machinery & Electrical Equipment subject matter expert within the Energy & Industrials pod and owns its expert research content coverage. The role identifies the companies, themes and investor questions that warrant coverage; defines and validates the Network Member profiles needed; designs differentiated interview agendas; leads human-moderated one-to-one interviews; and develops recurring programs for execution by Associates. The Content Manager reviews content for research quality and relevance and works with Associates and Compliance through publication.
  
  
The role requires an investor mindset and deep knowledge of Machinery & Electrical Equipment, including its companies, value chain, financial statements, operating drivers, industry cycles and current debates. The Content Manager must also understand relevant credit, private-market and other investor perspectives well enough to assess the sub-sector broadly; ask incisive questions; challenge superficial answers; and produce content that leaves investors materially better informed.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Coverage ownership and research agenda**

* Set and maintain the research agenda for Machinery & Electrical Equipment, including priority companies, themes, catalysts, investor debates and underserved information needs.
* Identify emerging themes, inflection points and content gaps early, connecting macro, sector and sub-sector developments to company-level implications.
* Translate earnings calls, conferences, market events, client demand and usage signals into timely interviews and recurring content programs for Machinery & Electrical Equipment.
* Use a shared research foundation to develop several distinct conversations on the same company or topic without producing repetitive content.

**Network Member strategy and interview leadership**

* Build and maintain a map of the roles, organizations, value-chain positions and geographies needed to answer priority research questions.
* Define and validate Network Member profiles, screening criteria and briefing context that distinguish direct visibility from nominal seniority.
* Design investor-focused interview agendas and questions that go beyond public commentary and generate original insight.
* Lead human-moderated one-to-one interviews, listening actively, probing inconsistencies and redirecting the conversation toward material investor questions.

**Structured programs, quality and collaboration**

* Define the research objective, respondent criteria, question sets and cadence for channel checks and other recurring structured programs within Machinery & Electrical Equipment.
* Brief Associates executing those programs, review representative output and determine whether it meets substantive research and quality standards.
* Work with Associates and Compliance to resolve substantive questions and carry approved content through publication.
* Capture company briefs, Network Member knowledge, question frameworks and findings in reusable form to strengthen future coverage of Machinery & Electrical Equipment.
* Collaborate across the sector pod when sub-sector, asset-class, regional or thematic perspectives would materially improve the research, and contribute to team ideation, knowledge sharing and quality calibration.
* Use AI-enabled research and moderation tools to deepen preparation and improve efficiency, applying judgment to validate outputs.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5–10 years of relevant experience in equity or credit research, buy-side or sell-side analysis, research services, strategy consulting, corporate strategy, primary research or an expert network.
* Deep expertise in Machinery & Electrical Equipment, preferably developed through public-equity or comparable fundamental research, with sufficient familiarity across credit, private-market and other relevant investor perspectives to assess the category broadly.
* Experience producing research or insight for institutional investors or another sophisticated financial audience.
* Strong working knowledge of financial statements, operating drivers and the performance indicators relevant to Machinery & Electrical Equipment.
* Strong interest in financial markets, company and industry analysis, and business dynamics, with the intellectual curiosity and discipline to maintain deep expertise within Machinery & Electrical Equipment.
* Demonstrated ability to translate research objectives into incisive, investor-relevant questions designed to generate differentiated insight.
* Excellent verbal communication and live-interviewing skills, including the ability to probe beyond surface-level responses and challenge senior operators in real time.
* Strong written English and research judgment, with the ability to distinguish incremental insight from general commentary.
* Ability to own Machinery & Electrical Equipment independently, collaborate effectively within the Energy & Industrials pod, and deliver high-quality work at speed in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Independent ownership of company, industry or thematic research within Machinery & Electrical Equipment that informed an investment, strategy or operating decision.
* Direct exposure to expert interviews, earnings or market-event analysis, or senior-level research discussions.
* Relevant language skills, local-market knowledge, transaction experience or technical credentials for specialist mandates.
* MBA, CFA, CA or a relevant graduate or technical qualification.

**About GLG / Gerson Lehrman Group**
GLG is the world’s leading platform for trusted human expertise. We connect global decision-makers—from hedge fund managers and private equity partners to strategy leaders at Fortune 500s—with the specific, authoritative voices required to answer their most critical questions.
  
  
At GLG, you are an extension of our clients' core teams. You will work at the intersection of industries and global markets, navigating high-stakes challenges across the full spectrum of their strategic initiatives. Operating within the industry’s most trusted research environment, you’ll help our clients capture the nuanced perspectives that drive smarter, faster business outcomes.
  
  
We are a global team of pragmatic problem-solvers who mirror the intensity of the markets we serve. If you are driven by intellectual curiosity and a bias toward action, join us in reinventing the industry we invented.
  
  
Gerson Lehrman Group, Inc. (“GLG”) is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, race, religion, color, marital status, disability, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Project Consultant
description:
Nexa Health Pvt Ltd, Noida**We are hiring: Project Consultants — Hospital Operations, Quality & Safety, Accreditation/Compliance, Hospital Architecture & Healthcare Planning, and Hospital MEP**
Nexa Health Pvt Ltd, Noida, is building a multidisciplinary healthcare consulting team to support hospitals, healthcare providers, and healthcare infrastructure projects across India. We invite applications from experienced professionals with a long-term commitment to healthcare transformation, quality improvement, safe facility design, and operational excellence.Roles Available
**1. Project Consultant — Hospital Operations Management**

* Lead or support hospital operational transformation projects, including departmental workflows, capacity planning, patient flow, resource utilisation, cost optimisation, and service-line improvement.
* Conduct onsite operational assessments, prepare gap analyses, implement improvement plans, and support hospital leadership teams.
* Develop SOPs, KPIs, dashboards, review mechanisms, staffing norms, and operational governance frameworks.
* Coordinate with clinical, nursing, administrative, finance, procurement, and support-service teams.

**2. Project Consultant — Quality & Patient Safety**

* Design and implement hospital quality-management systems, patient-safety programmes, incident reporting, root-cause analysis, clinical audit, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support hospitals in establishing quality committees, safety culture, infection-prevention practices, medication-safety systems, and measurable quality indicators.
* Train hospital teams on quality tools, patient-safety standards, documentation, and corrective and preventive action planning.
* Conduct onsite assessments, audits, and implementation reviews.

**3. Project Consultant — Accreditation & Compliance (JCI/NABH)**

* Lead or support hospital readiness programmes for NABH, JCI, and other applicable accreditation or regulatory frameworks.
* Conduct gap assessments, documentation reviews, tracer audits, mock surveys, and corrective-action planning.
* Guide hospitals in policy and SOP development, committee structures, quality indicators, credentialing, facility-safety compliance, and survey preparedness.
* Support implementation of accreditation recommendations and sustained compliance after assessment.

**4. Project Consultant — Hospital Architecture & Healthcare Planning**

* Support hospital feasibility studies, master planning, functional programming, departmental zoning, and clinical/non-clinical space planning.
* Develop or review hospital layouts that optimise patient flow, staff movement, infection-control requirements, accessibility, safety, future expansion, and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate medical planning with hospital operations, clinical teams, medical-equipment planners, MEP consultants, structural consultants, and statutory approval processes.
* Prepare or review concept plans, schematic designs, departmental layouts, area statements, and design briefs aligned with applicable healthcare norms and project requirements.
* Support design reviews for new hospital projects, expansions, renovations, and retrofit assignments.

**5. Project Consultant — Hospital MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing)**

* Review, plan, or coordinate MEP design and implementation for hospitals and healthcare facilities, including HVAC, electrical systems, backup power, earthing, plumbing, water supply, drainage, sewage/wastewater management, fire detection and suppression, and building-management systems.
* Support planning and coordination of medical gas pipeline systems, medical equipment interfaces, IT/low-voltage systems, pneumatic tube systems, and other hospital-specific engineering requirements.
* Conduct technical due diligence, design reviews, load assessments, system audits, and commissioning support for healthcare projects.
* Ensure coordination between architectural, structural, medical-planning, equipment, and MEP teams to avoid clashes, rework, and operational inefficiencies.
* Support compliance with applicable building codes, fire and life-safety norms, infection-control considerations, energy-efficiency requirements, and healthcare facility standards.

Key Expectations

* Candidates should have relevant experience in hospital operations, healthcare quality, patient safety, accreditation, hospital architecture/healthcare planning, or healthcare MEP design and project coordination.
* Strong analytical, documentation, stakeholder-management, design-review, training, and project-implementation skills are essential.
* The roles require
  **onsite visits to client hospitals, project sites, and healthcare facilities anywhere in India, as and when required**
  . Candidates must be willing and able to travel extensively.
* Professionals should be comfortable working independently, managing multiple assignments, coordinating with multidisciplinary teams, meeting deliverable timelines, and maintaining confidentiality and professional ethics.
* Preference will be given to candidates with a long-term vision aligned with Nexa Health’s growth and healthcare-impact objectives.

Engagement Structure

* The initial engagement will be on a
  **purely contractual/project basis**
  .
* The contractual engagement may initially be for a defined project period, assignment, milestone, or deliverable-based scope, subject to the terms of the individual engagement agreement.
* Onboarding into a full-time employment relationship with Nexa Health Pvt Ltd may be considered
  **after 3–6 months from the date of begining of the project**
  , subject to business requirements, financial stabilisation of the company, satisfactory performance, and mutual agreement.
* Any employment offer, if made, will be governed by a separate written appointment letter or employment agreement.

Compensation and Long-Term Benefits

* Contractual professionals will receive agreed professional fees/remuneration as per the scope, duration, complexity, and deliverables of the assignment.
* Upon transition to full-time employment, eligible team members may be considered for a
  **fixed salary**
  , in accordance with the role, experience, and company policy.
* **ESOPs, stake-based benefits, and performance-linked incentives**
  may be offered in accordance with Nexa Health’s internal policies, eligibility criteria, vesting conditions, and applicable laws.
* Such benefits are discretionary, policy-based, and may be offered preferentially to initial team members who demonstrate sustained performance, commitment, and long-term alignment with the company’s vision.
* No representation in this advertisement should be construed as a guaranteed offer of employment, ESOPs, equity, or incentive payment.

Equal Opportunity StatementNexa Health Pvt Ltd is an equal-opportunity employer. Applications are welcome from all qualified candidates, irrespective of gender, religion, caste, disability, or other protected personal characteristics. Selection will be based solely on merit, relevant experience, role requirements, and organisational fit.How to ApplyInterested candidates may share their updated CV, portfolio/project list where applicable, current location, notice/availability period, expected professional fee or compensation, and a brief note on relevant hospital projects handled, to: drsanjeevkalra11@nexahealthconsult.comSubject line:

title: BIM Content Creator
description:
**Mott MacDonald**
is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.
  
  
We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.
  
  
Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be
**brilliant**
.
  
  
Role purpose
  
  
The MIC BIM Component Creator develops, tests, documents and maintains intelligent, reusable, data-rich BIM content for the Moata Intelligent Content (MIC) library. The role converts engineering and project requirements into reliable digital components that enable standardized, efficient and automated design delivery across infrastructure and building projects.
  
  
Working with MIC curators, content checkers, approvers, publishers and project teams, the role ensures that content is technically accurate, lightweight, interoperable, correctly classified and ready for controlled publication and reuse.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  

* Develop and maintain parametric, data-rich BIM content, including Revit families, AutoCAD-based components, Civil 3D subassemblies and other platform-specific assets required by MIC.
* Interpret briefs, engineering requirements, manufacturer information and project standards, then convert them into clear content specifications and fit-for-purpose digital components.
* Apply MIC naming, classification, parameter, metadata, category, subcategory and documentation standards consistently throughout the content lifecycle.
* Build content that is efficient in file size, stable in use, visually appropriate, correctly constrained and suitable for reuse in large project models.
* Configure and test geometry, parameters, formulas, types, visibility settings, connectors, materials and data outputs, as applicable to the authoring platform.
* Create and test Civil 3D subassemblies using Subassembly Composer, including parameters, targets, conditions, codes and corridor behavior where required.
* Complete self-checks and peer checks before content is submitted through the MIC review, approval, versioning and publication gateways.
* Respond to checker and approver feedback, correct identified issues and maintain traceable records of revisions, testing and status.
* Maintain content documentation, thumbnails, reference files, metadata, version information and progress updates in the relevant MIC tracking and catalogue systems.
* Collaborate with project teams, engineering specialists and digital delivery stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve technical issues and support content adoption.
* Provide practical support to users, investigate content-related issues and implement controlled updates without compromising existing use cases.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for standardization, batch processing, automation, quality assurance and reusable workflows.
* Share knowledge with colleagues and develop capabilities across relevant Autodesk, Bentley, GIS, data and automation platforms.

**Essential Qualifications And Experience**

* HNC/HND, diploma, degree or equivalent practical experience in engineering, architecture, construction technology, information technology or a related discipline.
* Demonstrable experience creating, editing and quality-checking BIM or digital engineering content within at least one engineering discipline.
* Strong knowledge of BIM content-development principles, including parametric modelling, data structures, classification, naming, performance optimization and quality assurance.
* Proficiency in Revit family creation, including parameters, formulas, nested content, categories, subcategories, visibility controls, materials and testing.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD and Civil 3D; hands-on experience with Civil 3D Subassembly Composer is required for roles supporting corridor content.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, schedules, manufacturer data and project requirements.
* Experience working within controlled review, approval, version-management and publication processes.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines and locations.

Desirable knowledge and experience
  

* Experience with Bentley platforms, including MicroStation, OpenBuildings Designer, DGN and CEL content.
* Working knowledge of GIS platforms such as Esri ArcGIS.
* Experience with content catalogues or repositories such as Bentley Component Center and Autodesk Content Catalogue.
* Knowledge of shared-parameter management, data integration, batch processing or tools such as DiRoots.
* Exposure to scripting or automation for BIM content creation and quality assurance, such as Dynamo, Python or platform APIs.
* Experience developing generic or manufacturer content for the Water, Wastewater, Transport, Energy or Built Environment sectors.

Technical quality expectations
  
  
**Quality area**
**Expected outcome**
**Functionality**
Content behaves predictably across the intended types, views, levels of detail and project conditions.
  
  
**Data quality**
Parameters, metadata, classifications and units are complete, accurate, consistent and usable.
  
  
**Performance**
Geometry and file size are proportionate to purpose and do not create avoidable model-performance issues.
  
  
**Standards**
Naming, categories, subcategories, materials, documentation and catalogue information follow current MIC requirements.
  
  
**Verification**
Content is tested, warnings and redundant elements are resolved, and evidence is available for review.
  
  
**Lifecycle control**
Revisions, dependencies, references, status and publication information are recorded and traceable.
  
  
Personal attributes and behaviors
  

* Quality-focused, methodical and attentive to detail.
* Curious about technology and willing to build capability across multiple authoring and data platforms.
* Collaborative and respectful, with a strong commitment to shared team outcomes.
* Proactive in planning work, raising risks, solving problems and following tasks through to completion.
* Comfortable receiving, applying and providing constructive technical feedback.
* Committed to continuous learning, knowledge sharing and an automation-first mindset.

Measures of success
  

* Components meet agreed requirements and pass MIC checking and approval with minimal avoidable rework.
* Deliverables are completed to the agreed scope, quality and schedule, with progress and risks communicated clearly.
* Published content is reusable, discoverable, correctly documented and supported through its lifecycle.
* Feedback from users and reviewers is converted into measurable improvements to content and working practices.
* This role contributes to stronger standards, automation, platform capability and knowledge sharing across the MIC team.

**Flexible working**
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.
  
  
**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing

**Employment Compliance Requirement**
As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**

title: Powertrain Simulation and Modeling Engineer
description:
**Job Title:**
Powertrain Simulation and Modeling Engineer - Aircraft Electronics & Software Development

**Department:**

Research & Development (R&D)

**Industry:**
Aerospace, Aircraft Electronics & Avionics

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience Requirements: 2 years**
or more of experienced candidates.

Candidates may be considered at different experience levels based on their technical capabilities:

* Strong fundamentals in MATLAB, Simulink, Python, control systems, and electrical/electronic engineering.
* Practical experience in aircraft electronics, powertrain modeling, electric propulsion, embedded systems, simulation automation, or aerospace system validation.

**Educational Qualifications:**

Bachelor's or master's degree in one of the following disciplines:

Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Instrumentation and Control Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Embedded Systems or a related engineering discipline.

Candidates with relevant professional experience in MATLAB/ Simulink, aircraft electronics, electric propulsion, powertrain simulation, or Python-based engineering tools are encouraged to apply.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a skilled MATLAB/Simulink engineer with expertise in aircraft electronics, powertrain system simulation, and Python programming to support the development, modeling, simulation, analysis, and validation of aircraft systems.

The candidate will be responsible for developing MATLAB/Simulink-based simulation models for aircraft powertrain systems, electrical power distribution, propulsion systems, control algorithms, and avionics applications. The role also involves Python-based automation, engineering data analysis, software testing, and integration of electronic and embedded control systems.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of system modeling, aircraft electrical and electronic systems, powertrain performance analysis, and programming, with the ability to work across hardware, software, and system engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. MATLAB/Simulink Development**

* Develop and maintain simulation models using MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow.
* Implement mathematical models, control algorithms, and system-level simulations for aircraft applications.
* Perform dynamic system analysis, numerical simulations, and performance evaluations.
* Develop MATLAB scripts for engineering calculations, data processing, visualization, and simulation automation.
* Debug simulation models and validate results against design requirements and test data.
* Support model-based design and simulation-driven development activities.

**B. Aircraft Powertrain Simulation and Modeling**

* Develop MATLAB/Simulink-based simulation tools for aircraft powertrain systems.
* Model aircraft propulsion and powertrain architectures, including conventional, electric, and hybrid-electric systems, as applicable.
* Develop and analyze models of electric motors, generators, batteries, inverters, power converters, motor controllers, and associated electrical systems.
* Perform aircraft power demand, load estimation, energy consumption, efficiency, and endurance analysis.
* Simulate powertrain operating conditions, transient responses, load variations, and system performance.
* Develop battery models and implement State of Charge (SOC) estimation and energy management algorithms, where applicable.
* Analyze electrical power generation, distribution, conversion, and consumption within aircraft systems.
* Integrate powertrain models with sensors, control units, avionics interfaces, and embedded controllers.
* Conduct simulation-based verification and validate powertrain performance against theoretical calculations, system specifications, and available test data.
* Support the development of reusable MATLAB-based aircraft powertrain simulation tools and engineering workflows.

**C. Aircraft Electronics and Avionics**

* Support the modeling, development, and testing of aircraft electronic systems and avionics subsystems.
* Analyze sensor interfaces, data acquisition systems, instrumentation, and electronic control units.
* Develop algorithms for signal processing, sensor data analysis, monitoring, and fault detection.
* Support integration between electronic hardware, embedded software, and simulation environments.
* Analyze system performance and troubleshoot electrical, electronic, and control-related issues.
* Assist in the development of automated test procedures for aircraft electronic systems.

**D. Python Programming and Automation**

* Develop Python scripts and utilities for simulation automation, engineering calculations, and data analysis.
* Automate MATLAB/Simulink model execution, parameter sweeps, test cases, and report generation.
* Process and visualize simulation outputs, test logs, sensor measurements, and powertrain performance data.
* Develop tools for comparing simulation results with experimental or hardware test data.
* Implement data processing, plotting, statistical analysis, and performance evaluation workflows.
* Integrate Python-based tools with MATLAB/Simulink workflows using suitable interfaces.

**E. Embedded Systems and Communication Interfaces**

* Support the development and testing of embedded control systems used in aircraft electronics and powertrain applications.
* Work with microcontrollers, electronic control units, sensors, and actuator interfaces.
* Develop or integrate control algorithms intended for embedded implementation.
* Understand and work with communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, and ARINC 429, as applicable.
* Assist with hardware-software integration, data logging, debugging, and interface testing.
* Collaborate with firmware and hardware engineers to resolve system integration issues.

**F. Testing, Verification, and Validation**

* Perform Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Model-in-the-Loop (MIL) testing.
* Support Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing, where applicable.
* Develop test scenarios, test scripts, verification procedures, and validation reports.
* Analyze simulation and test results to identify performance deviations and potential design issues.
* Maintain technical documentation, model specifications, test records, and engineering reports.
* Follow applicable aerospace software, system safety, quality, and configuration management processes.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong programming knowledge in MATLAB and Python.
* Practical knowledge of MATLAB/Simulink for system modeling, simulation, and algorithm development.
* Understanding of aircraft electronics, avionics, electrical systems, or aerospace engineering fundamentals.
* Knowledge of dynamic system modeling, control systems, and numerical analysis.
* Understanding of aircraft powertrain concepts, electrical power systems, or propulsion system fundamentals.
* Ability to develop scripts for engineering calculations, data processing, and simulation result analysis.
* Familiarity with debugging, software testing, verification, and technical documentation.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Technical Skills**

* Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, Stateflow, Simscape, and Simscape Electrical.
* Familiarity with Aerospace Toolbox and other relevant MATLAB toolboxes.
* Knowledge of aircraft powertrain simulation, electric propulsion, or hybrid-electric propulsion systems.
* Experience in modeling batteries, electric motors, generators, inverters, converters, and electrical loads.
* Understanding of battery State of Charge (SOC), energy management, power demand, and efficiency calculations.
* Knowledge of control system design, signal processing, sensor modeling, and fault detection.
* Familiarity with embedded C/C++, microcontrollers, and hardware-software integration.
* Experience with SIL/HIL testing, automated test frameworks, and model-based design.
* Familiarity with Git, version control, and software configuration management.
* Knowledge of aerospace development standards, including DO-178C where applicable to the project.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and mathematical modeling skills.
* Practical problem-solving and debugging capabilities.
* Ability to translate engineering requirements into simulation models and software tools.
* Good understanding of electrical and electronic systems.
* Ability to analyze complex simulation outputs and prepare technical reports.
* Attention to detail, quality, reliability, and safety.
* Effective communication and collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Willingness to learn new aerospace technologies and simulation methodologies.

title: BIM Coordinator
description:
**Job Description: Building Information Modeling (BIM)**
**Position:**
BIM Coordinator
  
  
**Experience:**
10 to 20+ Years
  
  
**Location:**
Ahmedabad
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Position Overview**
The
**BIM Coordinator**
is responsible for establishing, governing, and driving Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Virtual Design & Construction (VDC) workflows across preconstruction and field operations.
**This position operates under a management and coordination framework rather than an in-house modeling/production drafting model.**
All design models and trade-specific fabrication models (LOD 350/400) are authored by external design consultants and specialized trade subcontractors (MEPF, structural steel, concrete, drywall/framing, and building envelope). The BIM Coordinator serves as the GC's central technical authority who orchestrates model federation, establishes project BIM standards, audits incoming data, facilitates multi-trade clash resolution, and bridges model data into field execution, 4D logistics, and reality capture.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* BIM Execution Planning (BEP) & Governance
* Author, implement, and enforce project-specific BIM Execution Plans (BEP/BXP) aligned with owner agreements, prime contract deliverables, and industry benchmarks (ISO 19650, AIA G202).
* Define modeling scopes of work, coordinate origins, project grid benchmarks, Level of Development (LOD 300 to LOD 400/500) requirements, and geometric tolerances for all subcontractor agreements.
* Establish and govern the project Common Data Environment (CDE) using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, Procore, or Revizto, setting upload schedules, permission tiers, and automated folder distribution workflows.
* Multi-Trade Coordination & Subcontractor Oversight
* Lead weekly spatial coordination meetings with MEPF, structural, framing, and specialty trade subcontractors to drive constructability resolution before fabrication and installation.
* Manage and federate trade models; run automated and manual clash analyses using Navisworks Manage and Revizto, distinguishing real physical/clearance conflicts from false positives.
* Hold trade contractors accountable to coordination milestones, clash resolution sign-offs, and agreed-upon space allocations according to contract documents.
* Manage issue-tracking platforms (e.g., Revizto, ACC Issues, BIM Track), issuing action items, constructability RFIs, and tracking items to verified closeout.
* Subcontractor Model Auditing & Quality Assurance (QA/QC)
* Audit incoming trade models to verify compliance with BEP guidelines, coordinate systems, parameter schemas, naming standards, and equipment clearance requirements.
* Review subcontractor shop drawings, fabrication spool sheets, and sleeve/penetration layouts directly against the federated model for sign-off prior to field installation.
* Ensure all models incorporate manufacturer-approved cut sheets, maintenance access envelopes, and code-required clearances.
* 4D Logistics, 5D Preconstruction & Constructability Analysis
* Leverage design and trade models during preconstruction to extract quantities for estimating and constructability reviews via Assemble Systems, Navisworks, or CostX.
* Partner with Project Schedulers and Superintendents to assemble 4D construction simulations (e.g., Synchro 4D or Navisworks TimeLiner) linked to CPM schedules (Primavera P6 / MS Project) for site logistics, crane staging, and trade sequencing.
* Support project teams in developing site logistics visualizations, temporary works layouts, and sequencing presentations for owner and stakeholder meetings.
* Reality Capture & Field Layout Integration
* Manage jobsite laser scanning (LiDAR / SLAM) operations (via self-perform scanning or specialty scanning vendors) and integrate registered point clouds into active federated models.
* Perform scan-to-BIM comparison and deviation analysis (floor flatness/levelness, concrete anchor placement, MEP penetration verification) to catch discrepancies prior to concrete pours and interior buildouts.
* Prepare and export coordinated layout point data to field layout teams utilizing Robotic Total Stations (RTS) (e.g., Trimble Field Link, Leica iCON).
* Equip and train field superintendents, foremen, and project engineers to access federated models on tablets for real-time site verification.
* Handover, Closeout & Process Automation
* Manage the collection, validation, and assembly of final coordinated As-Built models, COBie data, and asset handover deliverables required for owner facility management.
* Implement workflow automations, clash reporting routines, and model health verification scripts using Dynamo, Python, or API integrations across Navisworks, Revizto, and ACC.
* Conduct post-coordination reviews with project teams to capture lessons learned and continuously improve subcontractor BIM contract language and company coordination protocols.

**Key Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related discipline.

title: Director - SLED Proposals & Pursuit Excellence
description:
**Director - SLED Proposals & Pursuit Excellence**
==================================================

**What are we looking for:**
============================

**We are not looking for someone whose idea of proposal leadership is reviewing documents after everyone else has finished writing them. We are looking for a builder, problem solver and owner. The right person will see an ambiguous RFP, a fragmented team and an aggressive deadline and instinctively create structure around it. They will ask the difficult questions early, push teams to make decisions, challenge weak assumptions, refuse to submit mediocre work and take personal ownership of the quality of every major pursuit. This person should be comfortable recommending a No-Bid when the facts do not support pursuit, and equally comfortable mobilizing a cross-functional team when Dash decides to compete.**


**Pursuit Leadership & Win Strategy**
=====================================

* Own the proposal lifecycle from qualified opportunity through final submission, clarification, oral presentation and post-award handoff.
* Lead structured Bid/No-Bid decisions based on strategic fit, contract access, customer knowledge, incumbent position, competition, past performance, technical capability, delivery feasibility, economics and probability of win.
* Establish win themes, differentiators, competitive positioning and evaluator-focused response strategies.
* Challenge teams when the solution, evidence or value proposition is not strong enough to win.
* Participate in strategic capture planning for high-value pursuits before RFP release.

**Proposal Governance**
=======================

* Establish and enforce a repeatable Dash proposal methodology covering kickoff, compliance matrix, proposal outline, writing assignments, solution reviews, executive reviews, production and submission.
* Run a daily or near-daily pursuit war room covering pipeline, active capture, proposal status, risks, dependencies and next actions.
* Ensure every submission is compliant, responsive, persuasive and delivered on time.
* Establish clear ownership and escalation paths so issues are identified early rather than discovered near the deadline.

**Team Leadership**
===================

* Lead the Capture, Proposal Development and Technical Bid/Solution functions in India.
* Coach proposal writers and capture professionals to become stronger strategic contributors rather than task executors.
* Set quality standards and provide direct editorial and strategic feedback.
* Build a culture where people take ownership, communicate risks early and solve problems rather than simply escalating them.

**Content & Knowledge Management**
==================================

* Develop and govern Dash's reusable public-sector proposal content library.
* Maintain high-quality reusable content for corporate qualifications, technical capabilities, management approaches, transition, staffing, past performance, resumes, security, quality, cloud, data, AI and application modernization.
* Create templates, checklists, review criteria and pursuit playbooks; retire outdated or weak content.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**
===============================

* Work closely with U.S. business development, account leaders, solution architects, delivery leaders, finance, legal/compliance, recruiting and executive leadership.
* Convert SME input into a cohesive customer-facing story and hold owners accountable for timely inputs.
* Support oral presentations, demonstrations, clarification responses and negotiations when required.

**Continuous Improvement & Metrics**
====================================

* Track opportunities reviewed, go decisions, submissions, compliance defects, shortlist/interview rate, awards, win rate, cycle time and reasons for loss.
* Conduct structured win/loss reviews and convert lessons learned into process improvements.
* Identify responsible uses of AI and proposal technology to improve research, content reuse, compliance checking and productivity without compromising confidentiality or accuracy.

**Required Experience & Skills**
================================

* 12+ years of experience in proposals, bids, capture, presales or government contracting.
* Significant direct experience supporting U.S. government opportunities; strong SLED experience is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex IT services or professional-services proposals.
* Strong understanding of RFP/RFQ/RFI requirements, compliance matrices, evaluation criteria and public-sector procurement processes.
* Exceptional written and spoken business English and strong executive-level editing skills.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams under aggressive deadlines and challenging senior stakeholders constructively.
* Experience developing proposal processes, templates, content libraries and quality standards.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**
=========================================

* APMP certification or meaningful Shipley-style proposal/capture experience.
* Experience with IT services, application development, cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, staffing or digital transformation.
* Experience with U.S. state contract vehicles, cooperative contracts, MSP/VMS programs or large government IDIQ-style vehicles.
* Experience managing an India-based proposal/capture team supporting U.S. operations.

**The Personality We Are Looking For**
======================================

* Takes ownership even when the problem technically belongs to someone else.
* Hates surprises and surfaces issues before they become emergencies.
* Is comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.
* Can be demanding without becoming difficult to work with.
* Cares deeply about winning but is disciplined enough to recommend a No-Bid.
* Asks how the team can make the process better after both wins and losses.
* Does not need constant supervision or detailed instructions.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within the first six months, this leader should have established a predictable capture-to-submission operating model, clear pursuit gates, reusable proposal assets, consistent review practices and measurable visibility into why Dash is winning or losing government pursuits.

title: Electrical and Instrumentation Engineer

Coordinate with clients, consultants, and vendors to resolve technical queries, review comments, and engineering discrepancies.

Monitor document submission, review, approval, and revision status to ensure timely completion of project deliverables.

Coordinate and support Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), routine testing, functional checks, and electrical control circuit string testing.

Review hazardous-area equipment requirements and verify applicable IECEx, ATEX, and PESO certifications as specified in project documents.

Coordinate technical interfaces between motors, VFDs, LCSs, instrumentation devices, and control systems, including Modbus TCP/IP communication requirements.

Review and resolve client comments on engineering documents and coordinate the incorporation of revisions for resubmission and approval.

Coordinate with procurement and project teams to ensure technical requirements are addressed during equipment ordering, inspection, and delivery.

Maintain project engineering records, vendor documentation, inspection reports, and technical correspondence.

description:
Swiggy Dineout is building India’s largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its
  
  
partner restaurants across its network for 21000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to
  
  
augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore
  
  
restaurants across all categories - from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and
  
  
offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a
  
  
mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the
  
  
experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!
  
  
Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant
  
  
partners where users can save up to 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using
  
  
the dine out feature on the Swiggy app.
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Summary -
  
  
The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given
  
  
territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise
  
  
Value (GMV) per month.
  
  
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
  
  
specific geographies assigned
  
  
Responsibilities -
  
  
Account & Partner Relationship Management
  
  
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with
  
  
internal stakeholders
  
  
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is
  
  
correct and image coverage is high
  
  
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for
  
  
month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
  
  
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc.
  
  
to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
  
  
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers
  
  
and partners at the restaurants
  
  
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
  
  
Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
  
  
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance
  
  
metrics to the partner
  
  
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable
  
  
conversions and grow the business.
  
  
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,
  
  
conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
  
  
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
  
  
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and
  
  
explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
  
  
Interaction with Stakeholders:
  
  
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations
  
  
(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
  
  
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
  
  
Functional Competencies
  
  
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
  
  
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads
  
  
RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
  
  
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
  
  
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise
  
  
transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition
  
  
**Qualifications**
Desired Skills -
  
  
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
  
  
knowledge of English
  
  
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing
  
  
channels
  
  
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
  
  
Effective communication skills
  
  
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
  
  
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
  
  
Analytical, good Excel skills.
  
  
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
  
  
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people
  
  
at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
  
  
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
  
  
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
  
  
and success of campaigns.
  
  
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal
  
  
drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.
