title: Purchase Executive
description:
The Executive – Purchase will support domestic procurement activities for architectural and interior products. The role involves coordinating purchase requirements, sourcing vendors, obtaining quotations, comparing prices, processing purchase orders, following up on deliveries, and maintaining optimum inventory levels. The incumbent will work closely with warehouse, customer connect, dispatch, accounts and finance teams to ensure timely availability of materials, cost-effective purchasing, accurate documentation and smooth business operations.

A) **Key Accountabilities:**

**Major Details**

Domestic Procurement:

Source and procure domestic architectural and interior products as per approved business requirements.Obtain quotations and prepare comparative statements for review.

Inventory Levels / MSL

Monitor product-wise stock levels and Minimum Stock Levels (MSL).Flag low, excess, slow-moving and dead stock for timely action.

Domestic Purchase Monitoring:

Track purchase requirements and prepare purchase schedules based on sales/dispatch needs and stock position.Follow up to ensure timely procurement and avoid stock-outs.Escalate requirements needing approval.

PO Management:

Prepare and process Purchase Orders (POs) after obtaining the required approvals.Check item description, quantity, rate, taxes, delivery terms and payment terms before issuing POs.Track open POs and coordinate with Accounts & Finance on payment schedules.

Vendor Management & Rate Negotiation:

Identify vendors and obtain quotations for required products.Compare pricing, quality, lead time, payment terms and delivery conditions.Maintain vendor details and support periodic vendor performance reviews.Negotiate routine rates and terms within approved limits and escalate exceptions for approval.

Coordination & Inventory Planning:

Coordinate with Customer Connect, warehouse and dispatch teams on pending and upcoming orders.Check material availability and delivery timelines.Follow up on shortages or delays to minimise dispatch impact.

Purchase Planning & Control:

Assist in preparing monthly purchase plans based on sales forecasts, consumption trends and stock movement. Monitor vendor lead times and adjust follow-ups as required.Support cost-effective stock management and prepare purchase MIS reports.

Documentation & Reporting:

Maintain purchase records, quotations, comparative statements, POs and vendor documents. Prepare reports on purchase status, pending orders and vendor delivery performance. Update item and vendor masters in the ERP system as required.

· **Functional Competencies**

Knowledge of domestic procurement and purchase processes Quotation analysis and price comparison Basic negotiation and vendor coordination skills Working knowledge of ERP systems and MS Excel Understanding of inventory, MSL and purchase documentation

· **Behavioral Competencies :**

Good communication and follow-up skills Attention to detail and accuracy Planning, organisation and time management Cross-functional coordination and problem-solving Ownership and willingness to learn

B) **Authorities:**

**Decisions to be taken Independently**

Prepare routine POs as per approved quotations and purchase requisitions Vendor follow-up and delivery tracking Prepare price comparisons and purchase MIS Coordinate stock checks and routine purchase follow-ups

**Decisions to be taken with peers:**

Discuss purchase priorities and delivery schedules with warehouse, Customer Connect, dispatch and finance teams Coordinate with Design/Project teams to confirm technical specifications Recommend vendors and rates based on quotation comparisons

**Decisions to be taken with Seniors:**

High-value or out-of-budget purchases Approval of new key vendors, exceptional commercial terms and policy/process changes Major procurement plan or budget changes Any purchase outside delegated authority

title: Outward & Dispatch Executive
description:
We are a leading aerospace and defence trading company, specializing in the supply of consumables, spare parts, and equipment. We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Operations & Dispatch Executive to support our logistics, inventory, and dispatch operations. The role involves coordinating material movement, maintaining records, ensuring timely deliveries, and supporting smooth day-to-day supply chain activities.

Job Description:

**A. Dispatch Order Processing**

* Receive and review Delivery Orders (DOs), Purchase Orders (POs), and dispatch requisitions from authorised personnel.
* Verify product details, part numbers, quantities, specifications, pack sizes, colour codes, shelf life, delivery address, and required delivery dates.
* Prepare the required copies of the Delivery Order and share them with the Stores Team for material picking.
* Generate Material Requests (MRs) in the RSR software.
* Coordinate with Stores for material picking, packing, and preparation of the Store Out Note (SON).
* Proceed with dispatch documentation after confirmation of material handover and completion of the store-out process.
* Prepare applicable Joint Venture (JV) entries for raw material combinations and quantity conversions as per the work instruction.

**B. Dispatch Documentation**

* Prepare Delivery Challans, invoices, Release Notes/Certificates of Conformance (CoC), and dispatch checklists.
* Arrange supporting documents such as MSDS, TDS, test reports, Manufacturer's Certificate of Conformance, and Boeing Batch Approval Certificate, wherever required.
* Verify dispatch documents against the customer requirements and prescribed checklist.
* Prepare two sets of dispatch documents: one for the customer and one for company records.
* Arrange additional invoice copies as required by customers or courier agencies.
* Coordinate SEZ/EOU shipment documentation, including LUT Bond and DTA copies, wherever applicable.
* Submit the relevant shipment documents to Accounts for record-keeping.
* Maintain dispatch documentation and records as per company procedures.

**C. Material Verification and Packaging**

* Coordinate with Stores to ensure the correct products and quantities are picked against the Delivery Order.
* Verify part numbers, specifications, batch numbers, manufacturing dates, expiry dates, and shelf life, wherever applicable.
* Ensure materials are properly sealed and protected against leakage or transit damage.
* Coordinate suitable packaging using cartons, bubble wrap, cushioning materials, pallets, and stretch film, as required.
* Ensure packages are labelled with product details, batch numbers, manufacturing dates, colour codes, safety instructions, and handling requirements, wherever applicable.
* Coordinate product inspection and shipment photographs for trans-shipment consignments.
* Ensure hazardous materials are packaged, labelled, and handled according to applicable requirements.

**D. Temperature-Sensitive Material Dispatch**

* Identify temperature-sensitive materials requiring special shipping arrangements.
* Arrange insulated packaging, cooling materials, and data loggers as required.
* Ensure two data loggers are placed in the shipment, including one backup logger, as prescribed in the work instruction.
* Activate and position the data loggers correctly before shipment.
* Record the data logger serial numbers and provide handling or reading instructions when required.
* Obtain the prescribed *Life Span of Temperature Sensitive Material* form (FORM/SCDIS/RSR/63) from Stores.
* Photograph the material before packing and complete the prescribed form.
* Ensure temperature-sensitive material dispatch is processed within the bonded store as specified in the work instruction.

**E. Shipment Coordination and Tracking**

* Coordinate with courier agencies, transporters, freight forwarders, and the Logistics Team for timely dispatch.
* Assist in selecting suitable transportation based on shipment size, destination, material type, and delivery timeline.
* Coordinate safe loading and transportation of materials.
* Ensure dispatches are planned according to the required delivery dates.
* Share dispatch documents and shipment tracking details with customers through email.
* Communicate dispatched and pending product details to the relevant stakeholders.
* Track shipments until final delivery.
* Follow up with logistics partners regarding shipment delays and delivery issues.
* Inform the Sales Team and customers promptly about delays or changes affecting delivery timelines.

**F. Proof of Delivery and Record Maintenance**

* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD) from courier agencies or delivery personnel.
* Share POD copies with customers and obtain receipt acknowledgement wherever required.
* Maintain dispatch records, tracking details, delivery confirmations, and PODs.
* Update dispatch information accurately in the RSR software and relevant tracking sheets.
* Ensure records are complete, traceable, and readily available for audits.

**G. Coordination and Compliance**

* Coordinate with Sales, Stores, Quality, Accounts, and Logistics to ensure smooth dispatch operations.
* Escalate discrepancies in material details, documentation, packaging, or shipment status before dispatch.
* Coordinate with the Quality Team for customer complaints involving damaged, incorrect, or missing materials.
* Support internal and external audits by maintaining accurate dispatch records.
* Participate in departmental KPI reviews and implement corrective actions for identified gaps.
* Follow company work instructions, quality procedures, and applicable safety requirements.

TransUnion is a leading global information and insights company that makes trust possible in the modern economy. As a result, businesses and consumers can transact with confidence and achieve great things. **Influences, monitors and supports the delivery of annual revenue and profitability targets:**

* Is rated highly by regional peers and internal customers on KPI’s – value creation, responsiveness, speed, ease of doing business

* Develops talent and creates a connected community of best practice sharing & application

Title & Property Due Diligence ● Verify land titles, ownership records, and supporting property documents. ● Identify legal risks before project acquisition and escalate material issues to management. ● Handle legal matters involving encroachments, easement rights, and land acquisition. 4. Regulatory & Compliance ● Support compliance with applicable laws, including the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016 (RERA), the Transfer of Property Act, 1882, and the Indian Contract Act, 1872. ● Liaise with government departments and authorities for approvals, documentation, and other legal matters. 5. Case Tracking & Reporting ● Maintain an updated litigation tracker covering case status, next hearing dates, deadlines, and action items. ● Prepare Management Information System (MIS) reports and provide regular litigation updates to management. ● Assess legal risks and recommend preventive or corrective actions. 6. Dispute Resolution ● Explore practical out-of-court settlements where appropriate and in the company’s best interests. ● Handle negotiations with customers, landowners, contractors, and vendors, coordinating with advocates when required. Key Skills & Competencies ● Working knowledge of real estate litigation, property documentation, and applicable laws. ● Strong legal drafting, documentation, negotiation, and coordination skills. ● Ability to manage multiple cases, deadlines, and confidential records with attention to detail. ● Clear communication and reporting skills, with a practical approach to legal risk management.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
**Our Mission**
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
**Your Impact On Our Mission**
As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) you’ll play a critical role in putting power back into the hands of the patient by helping us meet and exceed our sales growth goals. This isn’t your standard sales job - you’ll be given constant support, with a hands-on, immersive training program, consistent feedback, and development, and work alongside driven and passionate sales professionals.
  
  
Your Sales Manager will act as your dedicated coach, guiding you through the outbound sales strategies. You’ll master communicating value efficiently, navigating gatekeepers, and executing a successful outreach strategy from our comprehensive training program.
  
  
Shift timings: From 7.30 pm to 4.30 am or similar.
  
  
You’ll enjoy this role if you are…
  
  

* Courageous, determined, and not afraid to fail
* Motivated by meeting and exceeding targets and goals
* Comfortable working remotely in a night shift and a strong believer in individual accountability
* IIntellectually curious and looking to develop and grow your sales and persuasion skills
* Enthusiastic about working in a diverse and supportive team environment

Your day-to-day is…
  
  

* Dialing the provided outbound leads and scheduling meetings for Sales Executives
* Working closely with your manager and sales executives to track meeting success rate and outcomes
* Communicating and collaborating with global team members on best practices and processes
* Innovating and testing creative ways to gain access and trust with prospective customers
* Smartly prioritize and organize your time to be as productive as possible
* Working closely with your manager to implement coaching and feedback
* Attending weekly team, and all employee meetings to understand the why behind your work, and the impact it has on Zocdoc’s patients

You’ll be successful in this role if you have…
  
  

* A desire to have a career in sales
* Experience working in night shifts
* Proven experience in setting meetings with key decision-makers in international markets, with a strong preference for the US.
* Skilled in generating leads through outbound strategies, including cold calling, emailing, and account research to identify and attract target prospects
* Experience with persuasion and objection handling
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* The desire to receive and implement feedback
* A passion for creating a better patient experience
* A dedicated space where you can work in comfort with minimal distractions
* A dedicated high-speed internet connection of 10 Mbps (up/down)

**Benefits**

* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare/creche facility for kids
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace.
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave(over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check-ups
* Zocdoc is certified as a great place to work 2025-2026

**About Us**
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.
  
  
Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values -
*Together, Not Alone*
, we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

title: Accounts Executive - Finance & Accounts
description:
· **Designation:** Accounts Executive

· **Department:** Accounts & Finance

· **Location:** Pune, Maharashtra

· **Experience:** 1–3 Years

· **Employment Type:** Full-Time

· **Reporting To:** Accounts Manager / Finance Manager

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Accounts Executive to manage day-to-day accounting activities, GST and TDS compliance, bank reconciliations, vendor and customer transactions, and financial documentation. The candidate will support timely and accurate accounting operations, statutory compliance, payment processing, and preparation of financial reports.

The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in accounting principles, practical knowledge of GST and TDS, working experience with accounting software such as Tally, and good proficiency in MS Excel. Candidates who can independently handle GST calculations, GST return preparation, and TDS-related activities will be preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Day-to-Day Accounting**

· Record daily financial transactions, including sales, purchases, receipts, payments, journal entries, and expense transactions.

· Maintain books of accounts, ledgers, and supporting accounting records accurately.

· Prepare and post journal vouchers, payment vouchers, receipt vouchers, and contra entries.

· Verify invoices, bills, debit notes, credit notes, and other supporting documents before accounting.

· Ensure proper accounting classification and timely recording of transactions.

**2. GST Compliance & Returns**

* Calculate GST on applicable sales, purchases, and expense transactions.
* Prepare and verify GST-related data for periodic return filing, including GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B.
* Reconcile sales and purchase records with GST data and identify discrepancies.
* Review Input Tax Credit (ITC) eligibility and reconcile purchase records with available GST information.
* Coordinate with the Finance Manager, tax consultant, or Chartered Accountant for GST return filing and compliance requirements.
* Maintain GST invoices, supporting documents, and records required for statutory compliance and audits.

**3. TDS Compliance**

· Identify transactions subject to Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) and apply the relevant provisions and rates.

· Calculate and record TDS deductions on applicable vendor payments, professional fees, contractor payments, and other transactions.

· Track TDS payable and ensure timely coordination for deposit of TDS within applicable due dates.

· Prepare and reconcile TDS-related data for quarterly returns, including Form 24Q and Form 26Q, wherever applicable.

· Assist in the preparation and issuance of TDS certificates, such as Form 16A, and coordinate with the tax consultant for compliance.

· Maintain TDS records and resolve discrepancies in deductions, challans, and returns.

**4. Accounts Payable & Receivable**

· Process vendor invoices and verify them against purchase orders, approvals, and supporting documents, wherever applicable.

· Prepare vendor payment details and coordinate for timely payment processing.

· Maintain customer outstanding records and assist in payment follow-ups.

· Reconcile vendor and customer ledgers and resolve differences in balances.

· Track advances, outstanding payments, and pending invoices.

**5. Bank & Ledger Reconciliation**

· Prepare bank reconciliation statements (BRS) and investigate unmatched transactions.

· Reconcile vendor accounts, customer accounts, bank balances, and other ledger balances.

· Identify duplicate entries, missing transactions, and accounting discrepancies.

· Coordinate with banks, vendors, customers, and internal departments to resolve reconciliation issues.

**6. Expense Management & Verification**

· Verify employee claims, travel expenses, petty cash transactions, and other business expenses.

· Check supporting bills, invoices, receipts, and approvals before accounting or processing.

· Maintain expense records and ensure correct accounting treatment.

· Assist in monitoring expenses and preparing expense summaries.

**7. Financial Reporting & MIS**

· Prepare periodic accounting reports, expense statements, payment reports, outstanding statements, and ledger summaries.

· Assist in preparing monthly financial data and schedules for management review.

· Maintain Excel-based trackers for payments, receipts, GST, TDS, and other accounting activities.

· Support month-end and year-end closing activities by preparing reconciliations and supporting schedules.

**8. Documentation, Audit & Record Management**

* Maintain organized records of invoices, vouchers, bank statements, GST returns, TDS challans, and other financial documents.
* Assist in providing documents and accounting data for internal reviews, statutory audits, and tax assessments.
* Ensure financial records are accurate, complete, and readily accessible.
* Coordinate with internal teams, auditors, and external consultants for accounting and compliance-related requirements.

**9. Accounting Software & Excel**

* Record and maintain transactions using Tally or other accounting/ERP software.
* Use MS Excel for accounting calculations, reconciliations, data analysis, and report preparation.
* Apply Excel functions such as VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIF/SUMIFS, IF, filters, sorting, and Pivot Tables, as required.
* Ensure accounting data is updated accurately and maintained in accordance with internal processes.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* B.Com or an equivalent qualification in Commerce or Accounting is preferred.
* 1–3 years of relevant experience in accounting and finance operations.
* Practical knowledge of day-to-day accounting, journal entries, ledger maintenance, and bank reconciliation.
* Working knowledge of GST calculations, GST returns, Input Tax Credit, and related reconciliations.
* Practical knowledge of TDS deductions, applicable rates, challans, and return-related activities.
* Proficiency in Tally and MS Excel.
* Knowledge of basic accounting principles and applicable statutory compliance requirements.

**Required Skills**

* Strong understanding of accounting fundamentals.
* Good numerical, analytical, and reconciliation skills.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in financial records.
* Ability to manage deadlines and multiple accounting activities.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Problem-solving ability to identify and resolve accounting discrepancies.
* Integrity and confidentiality when handling financial information.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate with internal teams, management, auditors, and consultants.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in day-to-day accounting, GST and TDS compliance, ledger and bank reconciliation, vendor payments, and financial documentation. Candidates who can independently handle GST calculations and return preparation, TDS-related activities, and Excel-based accounting reports will be given preference. Experience working in a CA firm or handling multiple clients' accounts is an added advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Accuracy and timeliness of accounting entries.
* Timely preparation of GST and TDS data and completion of assigned compliance activities.
* Accuracy of bank, vendor, customer, and ledger reconciliations.
* Timely processing and recording of vendor payments and customer receipts.
* Accuracy of expense verification and accounting documentation.
* Timely preparation of MIS reports and accounting schedules.
* Maintenance of complete and audit-ready financial records.
* Timely resolution of accounting discrepancies and pending items.

definition, pricing approvals and commercially important discussions.

visibility.

· Consistency of market activation and ability to independently create new opportunities.

· Accuracy and discipline of CRM updates, forecasting and follow-up.

title: Chief Business Officer – Contract Manufacturing & Institutional Healthcare
description:
**Reports To:** Founder & CEO

**Location:** India (Hybrid / Key Pharma Hubs)

**Company:** JollyRx

**Employment Type:** Full-time, Executive Leadership

About JollyRx

JollyRx is building an asset-light pharmaceutical manufacturing grid. We connect corporate hospital networks, emerging healthcare brands, and digital health platforms with audited, Schedule M and WHO-GMP certified production facilities operating with unbooked line capacity. By retaining formulation custody, managing independent dual-gate NABL quality testing, and removing the capex-heavy barriers of traditional CDMOs, JollyRx delivers dependable, flexible finished dosage form (FDF) production with zero plant capex.

Role Overview

The **Chief Business Officer (CBO)** will lead commercial expansion, enterprise client acquisition, and multi-year supply partnerships. You will own the bridge between institutional demand—hospital pharmacy networks, healthcare brands, retail pharmacy chains, and institutional distributors—and our managed contract manufacturing grid.

This is a high-ownership executive role accountable for full commercial P&L, pipeline conversion, pricing strategy, and scaling high-margin net revenue across domestic institutional and emerging export channels.

Key Responsibilities

* **Commercial GTM & Revenue Leadership:**Design and execute the institutional go-to-market strategy to secure recurring contract manufacturing, white-label, and institutional supply partnerships across hospital chains, corporate pharmacies, and consumer healthcare brands.
* **Institutional Account Closures:**Lead high-stakes enterprise negotiations directly with Chief Procurement Officers (CPOs), Pharmacy Directors, and Heads of Purchase, positioning JollyRx's core value: flexible minimum order quantities (MOQs), reliable dispatch timelines, and independent lab quality verification.
* **CDMO & White-Label Pipeline Expansion:**Drive new business development for custom formulation batches and contract manufacturing services, expanding wallet-share across core therapeutic segments (oral solids, liquid orals, sterile injectables, specialized nutrition, and synbiotics).
* **Cross-Functional Grid Synchronization:**Work in lockstep with the Technical Services, Quality Assurance, and Sourcing teams to match incoming demand volumes with qualified, idle production shifts across partner facilities.
* **Commercial P&L & Working Capital Rigor:**Structure competitive pricing, manage commercial payment terms, protect blended gross take-rates (targeting 18%+), and maintain strict working capital discipline across customer receivables.
* **Executive Team Building:**Recruit, mentor, and lead a focused institutional key accounts team capable of navigating long-cycle hospital formularies and private-label contract reviews.

Key Requirements

* **Experience:** 12 to 18 years of commercial leadership in third-party manufacturing (TPM), CDMO business development, institutional pharma sales, or B2B healthcare supply chain management.
* **Network & Access:** Established, active relationships with procurement leadership, hospital administration committees, and supply chain directors across major Indian hospital networks and regional healthcare chains.
* **Technical & Commercial Fluency:** Strong working knowledge of pharma manufacturing realities, including technology transfers, loan licensing, batch sizing economics, regulatory documentation, and compliance frameworks (Schedule M, WHO-GMP).
* **P&L Track Record:** Demonstrated history of managing business units or commercial divisions generating ₹50 Cr+ in annual institutional revenue with disciplined gross margins.
* **Execution Style:** Hands-on commercial closer who thrives in an entrepreneurial, asset-light, and fast-moving environment.

Candidate Evaluation Criteria

* **Year 1 Milestone:** Secure 25+ recurring institutional healthcare accounts and contract manufacturing clients, validating consistent monthly batch dispatches on the grid.
* **Margin Integrity:** Maintain blended gross transaction margins of 18% to 22% while structuring contract terms that minimize working capital exposure.
* **Category Penetration:** Successfully expand initial single-SKU institutional pilot orders into multi-formulation recurring annual supply agreements.

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹120,000.00 per month

title: Business Process Outsourcing
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION (JD)Outsourcing Expert – BPO Process Acquisition & Business Development

**Company:** Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd.  
**Designation:** Outsourcing Expert / BPO Process Acquisition Manager  
**Department:** Business Development, Outsourcing & Strategic Partnerships  
**Industry:** EdTech | BPO | ITES | Customer Support | Business Outsourcing  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Mode:** Remote / Hybrid / On-Site (As per Company Requirements)  
**Experience:** 2–7+ Years (Relevant BPO Process Acquisition Experience Preferred)  
**Compensation:** Negotiable | Fixed Salary + Performance-Based Incentives (Based on Experience and Results)  
**Reporting To:** Founder & Top Management

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a growing organization operating in the fields of **Education Technology (EdTech), Professional Skill Development, Recruitment, Business Consulting, and Technology-Driven Services.**

As part of our strategic business expansion, we are entering the **Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and IT-Enabled Services (ITES) industry**, with the objective of establishing domestic and international outsourcing operations.

We aim to build a reliable BPO division capable of delivering high-quality customer support, technical support, back-office operations, and other business outsourcing services.

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Outsourcing Expert / BPO Process Acquisition Manager** who can independently identify outsourcing opportunities, establish relationships with direct clients, negotiate commercial agreements, and successfully bring genuine BPO processes into the organization.

**This is a process acquisition and business development position, not a customer support executive role.**

The selected professional will play an important role in establishing and expanding the company's BPO division.

1. PRIMARY OBJECTIVE

The primary responsibility of the Outsourcing Expert will be to **acquire genuine domestic and international BPO processes for Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd.**

The candidate must be capable of identifying potential clients, generating outsourcing opportunities, negotiating business terms, coordinating process onboarding, and ensuring successful project acquisition.

Initially, the company is targeting outsourcing opportunities suitable for approximately **10–25 operational seats**, with the potential to expand based on business requirements.

2. KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIESA. BPO Process Acquisition

* Identify and acquire genuine domestic and international BPO outsourcing processes.
* Establish direct connections with companies seeking outsourcing partners.
* Generate qualified leads for inbound, outbound, voice, non-voice, and back-office processes.
* Identify outsourcing opportunities suitable for the company's operational capabilities.
* Acquire customer support, technical support, email support, chat support, and other relevant processes.
* Develop a sustainable pipeline of outsourcing projects and potential clients.
* Identify both short-term and long-term BPO business opportunities.
* Coordinate with clients to understand operational requirements and commercial expectations.

B. Direct Client Acquisition & Business Development

* Identify companies interested in outsourcing their customer support or business operations.
* Build professional relationships with domestic and international decision-makers.
* Connect with business owners, outsourcing managers, procurement teams, and vendor management departments.
* Generate leads through LinkedIn, professional networks, email campaigns, referrals, and industry platforms.
* Schedule business meetings with potential outsourcing clients.
* Present the company's outsourcing capabilities and proposed service models.
* Negotiate process requirements, operational expectations, and commercial terms.
* Convert qualified business opportunities into confirmed outsourcing projects.
* Develop long-term business relationships and repeat outsourcing opportunities.

C. Domestic & International BPO Expansion

* Identify outsourcing opportunities in the Indian market.
* Explore international opportunities, particularly in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and other relevant markets.
* Research international outsourcing trends and client requirements.
* Identify opportunities for offshore customer support and back-office services.
* Support the development of scalable outsourcing operations.
* Recommend suitable markets, industries, and outsourcing service categories.

D. Process Verification & Commercial Negotiation

* Verify the legitimacy of outsourcing clients and process providers.
* Evaluate the commercial feasibility and profitability of proposed processes.
* Understand pricing models, including per-seat, per-agent, hourly, per-transaction, and performance-based billing.
* Negotiate commercially viable payment terms and operational conditions.
* Coordinate discussions relating to contracts, SLAs, NDAs, and other business agreements.
* Identify potential risks, hidden charges, unrealistic commitments, and fraudulent outsourcing opportunities.
* Ensure that no outsourcing process is accepted without proper management approval and verification.

E. Process Onboarding & Operational Coordination

* Coordinate the transition of acquired processes to the company's operations team.
* Understand staffing, training, infrastructure, software, and technology requirements.
* Assist management in planning operational capacity and workforce requirements.
* Coordinate client training, knowledge transfer, and process documentation.
* Support pilot operations and process launch activities.
* Maintain communication between clients and internal operational teams.
* Assist in resolving commercial or operational concerns during process implementation.

F. Strategic Growth & Management Reporting

* Develop a structured BPO client acquisition strategy.
* Identify profitable outsourcing service categories and expansion opportunities.
* Maintain a database of potential clients, leads, proposals, and active negotiations.
* Submit regular reports on client outreach, meetings, proposals, and acquisition progress.
* Present business growth opportunities directly to the Founder and Top Management.
* Recommend improvements in pricing, client acquisition, partnerships, and business development strategies.
* Contribute to the long-term revenue growth and sustainability of the company's BPO division.

3. TYPES OF PROCESSES WE ARE LOOKING TO ACQUIRE

The selected candidate should have the ability to source opportunities across the following categories:

**Domestic BPO Processes**

* Inbound Customer Support
* Outbound Customer Support
* Domestic Voice Processes
* Non-Voice Processes
* Email & Chat Support
* E-commerce Customer Support
* Order Management & Customer Assistance
* Back-Office Operations
* Lead Generation & Appointment Setting
* Technical Helpdesk Support

**International BPO Processes**

* International Voice Processes
* US / UK / Australian Customer Support
* International Chat & Email Support
* Technical Support
* International Back-Office Operations
* E-commerce Support
* Customer Experience Management
* SaaS Customer Support

The company will prioritize legitimate processes with clearly defined commercial terms, operational requirements, and sustainable revenue potential.

4. REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, or a related discipline preferred.
* Relevant experience in BPO process acquisition, outsourcing sales, international business development, or client acquisition.
* Strong understanding of domestic and international BPO operations.
* Existing professional connections with direct clients, outsourcing decision-makers, or procurement teams will be a significant advantage.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and business presentation skills.
* Ability to independently identify and close outsourcing opportunities.
* Understanding of BPO pricing, SLAs, contracts, and client onboarding procedures.
* Experience using LinkedIn, CRM tools, email outreach, and professional networking platforms.
* Strong analytical, commercial, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate with senior leadership.

5. PREFERRED CANDIDATE PROFILE

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Have previously acquired BPO processes for an outsourcing company.
* Have an established network of genuine direct clients.
* Understand the complete BPO process acquisition lifecycle.
* Can independently manage client discussions from lead generation to commercial closure.
* Have experience acquiring processes for small or growing BPO operations.
* Can provide a practical roadmap for securing the company's first outsourcing project.
* Are comfortable working in a growing organization and contributing to the development of a new business division.

**Candidates with proven BPO process acquisition experience and direct client relationships will receive preference.**

6. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated on:

* Number of genuine outsourcing leads generated.
* Number of qualified direct-client connections established.
* Client meetings scheduled and completed.
* Proposals submitted and negotiations progressed.
* Number of commercially viable processes acquired.
* Revenue potential and profitability of acquired projects.
* Successful process onboarding and launch.
* Client relationship quality and retention.
* Accuracy of reporting and pipeline management.
* Overall contribution to the company's BPO business expansion.

Targets will be established according to the company's operational readiness, available resources, and business priorities.

7. AUTHORITY & REPORTING STRUCTURE

The selected candidate will be authorized to:

* Communicate with prospective outsourcing clients.
* Conduct business development and client acquisition activities.
* Schedule and attend client meetings.
* Present company-approved business proposals.
* Discuss outsourcing requirements and proposed commercial models.
* Coordinate with internal teams regarding process feasibility.
* Recommend potential clients and outsourcing agreements for management approval.

**Important:** Final authority regarding contract execution, pricing approval, financial commitments, process acceptance, and strategic partnerships will remain with the Founder or authorized Top Management.

The candidate will not be permitted to make binding commitments or sign agreements on behalf of the company without written authorization.

8. WHAT WE OFFER

* Opportunity to build and expand a new BPO business division.
* Direct interaction with the Founder and Top Management.
* Exposure to domestic and international outsourcing markets.
* Opportunity to develop long-term strategic client relationships.
* Performance-linked incentives and professional growth opportunities.
* Scope for advancement into senior business development or BPO leadership positions based on demonstrated performance.

9. HOW TO APPLY

Interested candidates with relevant experience in **BPO Process Acquisition, Outsourcing Business Development, Direct Client Acquisition, or International BPO Sales** are invited to apply.

Applicants should share:

* Updated CV / Resume
* LinkedIn Profile
* Total Relevant Experience
* Types of BPO Processes Previously Acquired
* Domestic / International Client Acquisition Experience
* Notice Period
* Current and Expected Compensation

**Company:** Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

**Join Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd. and play a key role in building our domestic and international BPO outsourcing division.**

We are looking for a professional who can do more than generate leads — **we need someone capable of bringing genuine outsourcing business, building direct client relationships, and converting opportunities into operational BPO projects.**

**Regards,**  
**Talent Acquisition & Top Management**  
**Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd.**

Job Summary

Ivory Aesthetics is looking for a well-presented, enthusiastic, and client-focused **Laser Therapist / Technician & Front Desk Executive** to manage aesthetic treatments, assist the doctor during procedures, and handle front desk and day-to-day clinic operations.

The ideal candidate should have practical knowledge of skincare and aesthetic treatments, good communication skills, a professional attitude, and the ability to manage client appointments, enquiries, follow-ups, and administrative responsibilities alongside treatment duties.

Key Responsibilities1. Laser Treatments & Aesthetic Procedures

* Perform laser-based aesthetic treatments, including laser hair reduction, following clinic protocols, appropriate training, and the doctor's instructions.
* Perform aesthetic treatments such as facials, HydraFacial, OxyGeneo, carbon facials, microdermabrasion, and chemical peels, as trained and authorized.
* Assist the doctor during aesthetic procedures, including PRP, GFC, microneedling, and other doctor-led treatments.
* Assess and record relevant client skin concerns, treatment history, and progress, and escalate clinical concerns to the doctor.
* Explain treatment procedures, expected outcomes, session intervals, and pre- and post-treatment care to clients.
* Maintain accurate treatment records, consent documentation, before-and-after photographs, and follow-up notes.
* Ensure the safe handling, cleaning, maintenance, and readiness of laser machines and aesthetic equipment.

2. Reception & Client Management

* Welcome clients warmly and maintain a professional, hospitable front desk experience.
* Handle incoming calls, WhatsApp enquiries, Instagram enquiries, and other client communications.
* Schedule appointments, manage the clinic calendar, confirm bookings, and coordinate rescheduling.
* Register new clients, maintain client records, and update contact and appointment details in the clinic management software.
* Manage client check-ins, waiting times, treatment-room coordination, and check-outs.
* Explain consultation charges, treatment pricing, packages, and available offers accurately.
* Coordinate appointment reminders, post-treatment follow-ups, review requests, and client feedback collection.
* Handle routine client queries professionally and escalate complaints or clinical questions to the doctor.

3. Doctor & Clinic Assistance

* Prepare treatment rooms, equipment, consumables, and required documentation before appointments.
* Assist the doctor during procedures by arranging supplies, maintaining aseptic conditions, and supporting patient comfort.
* Monitor consumable stock, maintain inventory records, and inform management when supplies need replenishment.
* Ensure proper cleaning, disinfection, sterilization where applicable, and biomedical waste segregation as per clinic protocols.
* Maintain treatment-room hygiene, equipment logs, and daily opening and closing checklists.
* Assist with routine administrative work and other clinic operations as required.

4. Sales, Client Education & Follow-Ups

* Educate clients about suitable clinic services and prescribed or recommended skincare products within the scope of training and authorization.
* Explain treatment packages, session plans, and pricing without making unrealistic promises or guaranteeing results.
* Support ethical sales of aesthetic services and skincare products in line with clinic targets.
* Follow up with existing clients regarding upcoming sessions, maintenance appointments, and treatment progress.
* Encourage satisfied clients to share genuine feedback and reviews.
* Maintain professional client relationships and contribute to client retention and repeat bookings.

5. Professional Standards

* Maintain confidentiality of client information, photographs, medical history, and clinic records.
* Follow clinic SOPs, hygiene requirements, equipment safety procedures, and doctor-approved treatment protocols.
* Maintain punctuality, professional grooming, a courteous manner, and a service-oriented attitude.
* Participate in relevant training and stay updated on aesthetic technologies, skincare products, and clinic procedures.

Qualifications & Skills

**Education**

* Minimum: 12th pass.
* A certificate or diploma in cosmetology, beauty therapy, skincare, or laser treatments is preferred.

title: SDR
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a driven and organized Sales Development Representative (SDR) to manage

and qualify incoming sales leads and convert them into qualified sales opportunities.Your

primary responsibility will be to own incoming leads from the moment they enter the sales

pipeline — contacting prospects quickly, understanding their requirements, qualifying the

opportunity, scheduling product demonstrations, and consistently following up to move

prospects through the sales process.You will act as the first point of contact for prospective

customers and play an important role in ensuring that genuine opportunities do not get lost due

to delayed responses or inadequate follow-up.

Key ResponsibilitiesIncoming Lead Management – Primary Responsibility

● Handle incoming leads generated through the website, marketing campaigns, referrals,

WhatsApp, calls, partnerships, and other lead-generation channels.

● Contact new leads promptly and ensure defined response-time SLAs are consistently

met.

● Conduct initial discovery calls to understand the prospect's company, current processes,

pain points, requirements, and reason for evaluating the product.

● Qualify leads based on defined criteria such as customer profile, use case, company size,

requirement, decision-making process, urgency, and buying intent.

● Identify the relevant decision-makers and stakeholders involved in the purchase.

● Clearly communicate the product's core value proposition and determine whether there is

a potential fit.

● Schedule product demonstrations with qualified prospects and coordinate with the

relevant sales team member.

● Ensure prospects attend scheduled demos through confirmations, reminders, and

rescheduling where required.

● Conduct persistent and structured follow-ups with prospects through calls, WhatsApp,

email, and other appropriate channels.

● Re-engage leads that have gone cold or have stopped responding.

● Maintain complete and accurate records of every lead, interaction, follow-up, qualification

status, and next action in the CRM.

● Ensure no qualified lead is lost because of missed follow-ups or poor lead management.

● Provide clear context and qualification notes when handing qualified opportunities to the

salesperson responsible for closing the deal.

Outbound Prospecting – Secondary ResponsibilityWhen inbound lead volumes permit, the SDR

will also support new business generation by:

● Researching and identifying potential target companies.

● Identifying relevant decision-makers within target accounts.

● Conducting outbound prospecting through phone, email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and other

appropriate channels.

● Qualifying outbound prospects and scheduling meetings or product demonstrations.

● Following up with prospects until they are qualified, disqualified, or moved into a nurture

pipeline.

What We're Looking For

● 1–3 years of experience in B2B sales, inside sales, business development, telesales, or

SaaS sales.

● Strong verbal and written communication skills.

● Comfortable speaking with business owners, operations teams, HR teams, and senior

decision-makers.

● Strong questioning and listening skills with the ability to understand a prospect's actual

business problem.

● Excellent follow-up discipline — you should be comfortable contacting a prospect

multiple times across different channels.

● Ability to differentiate between genuine sales opportunities and low-intent enquiries.

● Organized and capable of managing a large number of leads simultaneously without

losing track of follow-ups.

● Comfortable working with defined targets and conversion metrics.

● Familiarity with CRM systems and sales tools is preferred.

● Professional communication skills in English and Hindi; additional languages are an

advantage.

Career GrowthStrong performers can progress into roles such as Senior SDR, Account Executive,

Business Development Manager, or Sales Manager, based on performance and demonstrated

ability to manage the sales process.

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per hour

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

**About the role**

As an Account Specialist, your goal is to grow the coverage and quality of Agoda’s supply network in India. You will acquire new accommodation partners and, alongside your team, support a mixed portfolio of newly onboarded and high-potential partners. You will combine proactive outreach at high velocity, effective negotiation, and data-driven follow-through to turn promising partnerships into live, bookable supply.

**In this role, you’ll get to:**

* Build and prioritize a pipeline of prospective accommodation partners across assigned Indian markets, including independent properties, hosts, and local operators aligned with the supply plan.

description:
Location: Gurugram — On-site, Full-time

Compensation: ₹9–14 LPA CTC + incentives

Experience: 2+ years of relevant B2B sales experience

Working hours: US Eastern business hours — evening/night shift in India

Role: Hands-on individual contributor

**About Intellemo AI**

Intellemo AI helps brands, marketing teams and agencies create cinematic AI videos through a structured production workflow.

Teams develop scripts, audio, storyboards and video clips in stages, approve the work before final production, and revise individual shots while preserving the rest of the video. Usage is billed in video seconds, giving customers a clearer understanding of production costs.

We’re building our US outbound sales team to reach businesses that need a more efficient way to create and revise marketing videos.

**Who We’re Looking For**

You have personally called US prospects, handled objections and booked qualified meetings. You’re comfortable researching accounts, starting conversations with decision-makers and following up consistently.

You’ll work directly with the founders to generate sales opportunities among US brands, D2C businesses, marketing teams and selected agencies. Your primary responsibility will be turning your own outbound activity into qualified product demos.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Outbound Prospecting**

* Research target companies and identify relevant founders, CMOs, Heads of Marketing and creative decision-makers.
* Make cold calls to US prospects and run coordinated outreach through email and LinkedIn.
* Build and maintain your prospect list using Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and other available tools.
* Personalise outreach around a prospect’s business, marketing activity and potential video use cases.

**Qualification and Meeting Generation**

* Understand how prospects currently create videos, where revisions cause delays and whether Intellemo addresses a relevant need.
* Qualify interest, decision-making responsibility, requirements and buying timelines.
* Book product demos with the founders, capture useful discovery notes and follow up to improve meeting attendance.
* Support founder-led demos and commercial follow-ups as opportunities progress.

**AI-Assisted Execution**

* Use AI tools to improve account research, call preparation, outreach personalisation and follow-ups.
* Learn Intellemo’s workflow well enough to explain its value clearly and recognise suitable customer use cases.
* Review your calls, test messaging and apply feedback to improve results.

**CRM and Follow-ups**

* Keep prospect records, activity, meeting outcomes and next steps accurate in the CRM.
* Track your calls, conversations, meetings booked, meetings held and qualified opportunities.
* Share recurring objections and customer feedback with the founders and product team.

**Required Qualifications**

* At least 2 years of hands-on B2B sales development, outbound sales or inside sales experience, including 1 year prospecting US-based businesses.
* Experience as an SDR, BDR, Lead Development Representative, Inside Sales Executive or Business Development Executive.
* Recent experience personally making cold calls and executing email and LinkedIn outreach.
* Individual responsibility for a qualified-meeting or pipeline target, with clear examples of personal results.
* Strong spoken and written English, including discovery, objection handling and asking for meetings.
* Consistent follow-up habits and experience maintaining activity in a CRM.
* Availability for full-time, on-site work in Gurugram during US business hours.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience selling SaaS, software, AI products, IT services or digital marketing services.
* Hands-on familiarity with Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Nooks or comparable prospecting and dialing tools.
* Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce or another CRM.
* Familiarity with marketing workflows, creative production or AI video tools.

**Why Join Intellemo?**

* Work directly with the founders on US customer acquisition.
* Sell an AI product you can use and demonstrate yourself.
* Contribute practical feedback that shapes sales messaging and product development.
* Have clear visibility into the meetings, opportunities and revenue your work helps generate.

Success in this role means consistently generating qualified US demos that are attended and progress into relevant sales opportunities.

Apply with your resume. During the interview, we’ll discuss your US outbound experience, personal prospecting activity and meetings generated.

ICICI Life Insurance Limited (formerly ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Limited) is one of India’s leading private sector life insurance providers, recognized for its strong position in the industry and customer-centric approach. Sonar Sansar is a heritage jewellery brand built on over 70 years of craftsmanship and three generations of business innovation. Sonar Sansar operates a 1,500 sq ft flagship showroom in Bandhaghat, Howrah, offering finely crafted gold, diamond, and silver jewellery, including both ready-made and custom designs. With in-house manufacturing, the brand provides high-quality pieces at fair prices, supported by honest practices, transparency, and a strong after-sales relationship focus. **Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Jewelry Salesperson role based in Haora. Daily responsibilities include explaining product features and pricing, presenting collections, handling inquiries, and offering recommendations that align with customer preferences and budgets. The role involves completing sales transactions, managing billing and documentation, maintaining displays and stock presentation, and supporting visual merchandising standards. **Job Description: Digital Marketing Executive**

**Location:** Howrah / Kolkata, West Bengal (On-site)  
**Experience:** 1–3 years (freshers with relevant practical skills may also apply)  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Permanent  
**Industry:** Rice Milling Equipment  
**Department:** DIGITAL MARKETING

**1. Role Overview**

We are looking for a proactive and digitally savvy **Digital Marketing Executive** to strengthen our online presence and generate business enquiries for our rice milling machinery business.

The primary responsibility will be to improve the company's website visibility, attract potential customers through digital channels, and convert online interest into qualified business leads. The candidate should understand how businesses can use SEO, Google Ads, social media, and other digital marketing channels to reach prospective customers and drive business growth.

The role will also involve supporting the company's gradual transition from paper-based records to simple digital systems using Microsoft Excel and Google Forms. This will be a secondary responsibility, and training can be provided wherever required.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Digital Marketing & Lead Generation (Primary Responsibility)**

* **Website Optimisation:** Evaluate the existing company website and identify opportunities to improve its visibility, content, user experience, and ability to generate customer enquiries.
* **Search Engine Optimisation (SEO):** Identify relevant industry and product keywords, optimise website content, and implement SEO practices to improve organic search rankings.
* **Digital Customer Acquisition:** Identify and evaluate digital channels such as Google Search, Google Ads, LinkedIn, Facebook, and WhatsApp Business to reach potential customers and generate qualified leads.
* **Performance Marketing:** Plan, execute, and monitor digital advertising campaigns, particularly Google Search Ads, to attract potential buyers actively searching for rice milling machinery and related solutions.
* **Content Development:** Create and coordinate digital content showcasing the company's machinery, product features, applications, customer benefits, installations, and company capabilities.
* **Social Media Management:** Manage the company's LinkedIn and Facebook presence by publishing relevant content, showcasing products and projects, and engaging with prospective customers.
* **Lead Tracking & Follow-up:** Maintain a structured record of enquiries received through the website, advertisements, social media, and other digital channels, and coordinate with the sales team for follow-up.
* **Marketing Performance Analysis:** Track website traffic, enquiries, qualified leads, cost per lead, and campaign performance to identify opportunities for improvement.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Research competitor websites and digital marketing practices to identify new ways to increase online visibility and customer acquisition.

**B. Basic Digitalisation & Business Process Improvement (Secondary Responsibility)**

* Assist in converting selected paper-based business records into organised digital formats using Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
* Create simple data-entry templates to maintain customer details, enquiries, machine installations, and other relevant business information.
* Use basic Excel functions, filters, sorting, and PivotTables to organise information and prepare simple reports.
* Develop Google Forms for basic customer feedback, enquiry collection, and internal data collection where required.
* Identify opportunities to simplify routine processes through basic digital tools and recommend practical improvements.

*Advanced Excel, programming, complex dashboards, and large-scale digital transformation projects are not requirements for this role.*

**3. Candidate Profile**

**Essential Skills**

* Basic to good understanding of digital marketing, particularly SEO, Google Ads, website optimisation, and online lead generation.
* Ability to identify suitable digital channels for reaching potential customers and growing a B2B business.
* Familiarity with website content management and basic website analytics.
* Good written communication skills for developing marketing content and product-related communication.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
* Analytical thinking, willingness to experiment, and an ability to interpret basic marketing performance metrics.
* Proactive attitude, ownership of responsibilities, and willingness to learn new tools.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience in B2B marketing, industrial products, machinery, manufacturing, or engineering.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, or keyword research tools.
* Experience with WordPress or other website content management systems.
* Basic graphic design skills using Canva or similar tools.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn marketing, WhatsApp Business, or lead management tools.
* Experience coordinating with website developers or external digital marketing agencies.

**4. Performance Expectations**

The candidate will be evaluated primarily on their ability to:

* Improve the company's online visibility and website performance.
* Generate relevant business enquiries through digital channels.
* Improve the quality and cost-effectiveness of digital leads over time.
* Identify and recommend new opportunities for online customer acquisition.
* Maintain consistent digital marketing activities and provide periodic performance updates.

Secondary expectations include maintaining organised digital records and supporting the adoption of simple digital tools across the business.

**5. Who Should Apply?**

This role is suitable for someone who enjoys digital marketing, understands how online channels can generate business opportunities, and wants to build practical experience in B2B marketing.

The ideal candidate need not be an expert in every digital marketing tool. We value strong fundamentals, practical execution skills, analytical thinking, and the willingness to learn and grow with the business.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

**Experience Required:** Minimum 3+ Years in Education Sales, Course Sales, Business Development, or Student Enrollment  
**Salary:** Competitive Fixed Salary + Performance-Based Incentives (Based on Experience)

***About the Role***

We are hiring a target-driven Education Sales Executive / Business Development Counsellor to drive student admissions and revenue growth for our professional training academy.

The candidate will be responsible for managing sales enquiries, conducting course consultations, nurturing prospective students, closing admissions, and achieving monthly enrollment targets.

Our academy provides career-oriented courses in Digital Marketing, Graphic Designing, Video Editing, Web Development, App Development, E-commerce, Freelancing, Content Creation, and other professional skill development areas.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in educational sales or training institute admissions, excellent persuasion skills, and a proven ability to convert leads into paying students.

**This is a sales-focused role, not just a general counselling position.** The primary objective is to generate revenue through successful student enrollment and effective lead conversion.

Key Responsibilities

* Drive student admissions and business development for the academy's training programs.
* Handle inbound course enquiries and conduct outbound calls to prospective students.
* Convert marketing-generated leads into paid course enrollments through structured sales follow-ups.
* Explain course benefits, pricing, curriculum, career opportunities, and enrollment procedures.
* Identify prospective students' requirements and recommend suitable training programs.
* Follow up consistently with warm leads, interested prospects, and undecided applicants.
* Handle sales objections related to course fees, course value, career outcomes, competition, and payment concerns.
* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and track lead status, follow-up schedules, and conversion rates.
* Achieve daily calling, follow-up, monthly enrollment, and revenue targets.
* Identify opportunities to upsell advanced courses or recommend additional relevant programs where appropriate.
* Maintain accurate sales records using CRM software, Google Sheets, or other lead management tools.
* Coordinate with the marketing team to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and campaign performance.
* Share regular sales reports, lead feedback, and enrollment forecasts with management.
* Maintain professional communication and ensure a positive admission experience for every prospective student.

***Courses and Programs***

The candidate will be responsible for promoting and selling courses such as:

* Digital Marketing and Advanced Digital Marketing
* Graphic Designing and Creative Design
* Video Editing and Content Production
* Web Development and Website Designing
* App Development
* E-commerce and Online Business
* Freelancing and Client Acquisition
* Content Creator and Personal Branding Programs
* AI Tools and Emerging Digital Skills

***Eligibility Criteria***

* Minimum **3+ years of relevant experience** in education sales, course sales, business development, admissions, or sales at an EdTech company or training institute.
* Demonstrated experience in lead conversion, sales follow-ups, and achieving enrollment or revenue targets.
* Strong communication, negotiation, persuasion, and objection-handling abilities.
* Ability to confidently pitch courses and communicate their value to prospective students.
* Experience managing leads from digital advertising, websites, social media, telecalling, or other enquiry channels.
* Ability to work with sales targets, performance metrics, and structured follow-up processes.
* Proficiency in Google Sheets, MS Excel, WhatsApp Business, and CRM or lead management tools.
* Self-motivated, disciplined, and comfortable working remotely with minimal supervision.
* Ability to manage multiple prospects and maintain an organized sales pipeline.

***Preferred Experience***

Preference will be given to candidates who have worked in:

* Digital marketing institutes or computer training centres.
* EdTech companies and online learning platforms.
* Professional certification and vocational training institutes.
* Career-oriented coaching centres or skill development academies.
* Education consultancy businesses with direct student enrollment targets.

Candidates with a consistent record of achieving sales targets and converting paid admissions will be preferred.

***Performance Expectations***

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Number of qualified leads contacted and followed up.
* Lead-to-admission conversion rate.
* Monthly student enrollment numbers.
* Revenue generated through course sales.
* Follow-up discipline and sales pipeline management.
* Overall contribution to the academy's business growth.

***Work Arrangement***

The position will initially be remote. As the academy expands, the role may transition to an onsite position based on business requirements. Applicants should be comfortable with this potential change.

***Salary and Career Growth***

* Competitive fixed salary based on relevant experience and demonstrated sales performance.
* Additional incentives linked to successful admissions and business development results.
* Opportunity to progress into Senior Education Sales Executive, Business Development Manager, Admissions Team Lead, or Sales Manager roles.
* Opportunity to contribute directly to the growth of a professional education and skill development business.

***How to Apply***

Candidates with at least 3 years of relevant experience in education sales, course admissions, EdTech sales, or business development are invited to apply.

Please submit your updated resume with details of your previous roles, sales responsibilities, and achievements in student enrollment or revenue generation.

**Note:** This is a target-oriented position. Candidates must be comfortable with follow-up calls, sales conversations, admission closures, and monthly performance goals. Freshers without relevant experience will not be considered.

description:
**Medical Representative (MR) – Pediatric Division**

**Company:**
Cognova Lifescience Pvt Ltd

**Job Location:**
Ahmedabad HQ / Rajkot HQ, Gujarat, India

**Job Type:**
Full-time | Field Sales

**Experience:**
1–3 Years Preferred

**About Cognova Lifescience Pvt Ltd**

Cognova Lifescience Pvt Ltd is a Gujarat-based pharmaceutical marketing company dedicated to pediatric and neuropediatric healthcare. We focus on promoting differentiated, high-quality formulations designed to meet the evolving needs of pediatricians, neuropediatricians, and young patients.

At Cognova, we believe in building business through scientific product promotion, ethical marketing practices, strong professional relationships, and consistent field execution. Our focus is on developing best-in-class pediatric products that earn the trust of doctors, parents, and healthcare partners.

We are looking for motivated and professionally driven Medical Representatives who are passionate about pharmaceutical sales, doctor relationship management, and building sustainable business growth.

**Role Overview**

As a Medical Representative (MR), you will be responsible for promoting Cognova's pediatric and neuropediatric brands to pediatricians, neuropediatricians, and other relevant healthcare professionals within your assigned territory.

The role requires regular fieldwork, scientific product detailing, prescription generation, chemist and stockist coordination, and achievement of assigned sales targets.

The ideal candidate should have a strong sense of ownership, effective communication skills, professional discipline, and the ability to build long-term relationships with healthcare professionals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Doctor Promotion & Scientific Detailing**

* Promote Cognova's pediatric and neuropediatric products to doctors through effective scientific detailing.
* Communicate product features, differentiating USPs, and relevant clinical information using approved visual aids and promotional materials.
* Build and maintain strong professional relationships with pediatricians, neuropediatricians, and other relevant healthcare professionals.
* Collect doctor feedback and execute approved product promotion campaigns.

**2. Sales & Business Development**

* Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets for the assigned territory.
* Drive prescription generation and sustainable secondary sales growth.
* Identify potential doctors, new business opportunities, and untapped market segments.
* Monitor territory performance and take appropriate actions to improve business productivity.

**3. Chemist & Stockist Management**

* Maintain professional relationships with chemists, stockists, and distributors.
* Ensure product availability and follow up on orders in coordination with channel partners.
* Monitor secondary sales, stock movement, and product rotation.
* Identify market-level supply issues and coordinate timely resolution.

**4. Fieldwork & Territory Management**

* Conduct regular fieldwork for 5–6 days per week, as per company policy.
* Maintain 8–10 quality professional calls per working day.
* Follow the approved tour plan and daily work schedule.
* Participate in joint fieldwork with seniors whenever assigned.
* Maintain effective coverage of the assigned doctor universe and territory.

**5. Reporting & Performance Monitoring**

* Submit daily call reports (DCR) and other required reports through the company's designated application.
* Maintain accurate doctor records, tour plans, and sales-related data.
* Track competitor activities, market trends, and customer feedback.
* Review performance regularly and work towards continuous improvement.

**6. Meetings, Training & Professional Development**

* Attend scheduled weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual sales meetings.
* Participate actively in product training and skill-development programs.
* Improve product knowledge, scientific detailing, communication, and territory management skills.

**Candidate Profile & Qualifications**

* Graduate in Science, Pharmacy, or a related discipline preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience as a Medical Representative in pharmaceutical sales preferred.
* Experience in pediatric, nutraceutical, or specialty pharmaceutical divisions will be an advantage.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to understand product information and communicate it clearly to healthcare professionals.
* Target-oriented, self-motivated, and comfortable with regular fieldwork.
* Good planning, reporting, and territory management skills.
* Professional conduct, punctuality, integrity, and willingness to learn.
* Candidates with relevant local market knowledge and established doctor relationships will be preferred.

**What You Can Expect at Cognova**

* Opportunity to work in a focused pediatric and neuropediatric pharmaceutical portfolio.
* Exposure to differentiated product promotion and scientific doctor detailing.
* A performance-driven work environment with regular guidance and training.
* Opportunities to develop pharmaceutical sales, territory management, and professional relationship-building skills.
* A team culture that values quality, ethics, discipline, learning, and ownership.

**Join Cognova Lifescience**

If you are passionate about pharmaceutical sales and want to build your career in pediatric healthcare, we invite you to join our growing team.

**Apply now and become part of Cognova's journey towards building trusted, best-in-class pediatric brands.**

**🌐 Website:**
https://www.cognovalifescience.com

  Ahmedabad HQ / Rajkot HQ, Gujarat
