description:
Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Singanallur, Tamil Nadu, India; Singapore**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience gathering and presenting technical and financial data to promote products, services, and solutions.
* Experience working in a customer-facing role.
* Experience with measurement platforms, analytics, and attribution modeling.
* Ability to communicate in English and Mandarin fluently to engage and support China-based clients.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with implementation/configuration of Measurement, Web Analytics or Attribution Strategy with non-last click attribution, cross-device measurement, conversion tracking, Geo-Experiments, incrementally/lift, online-to-offline measurement, offline data import.
* Experience influencing advertiser/agency decision makers.
* Experience with App attribution platforms like Appsflyer, tracking social listening platforms (e.g., Sprinklr, Traackr or CreatorIQ).
* Experience leading third-party measurement, site analytics, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), and data systems.
* Knowledge of Google measurement capabilities across ads and media platforms including Google Ads, Search Ads 360, Google Analytics.
* Knowledge of the digital ads ecosystem and privacy changes.

**About the job**
-----------------

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

Data Transformation Leads (DTLs) are specialists with a focus of helping advertisers scale their use of Google measurement and attribution solutions to drive measurement maturity. You will have product expertise in specific Google measurement solutions and action on the insights produced.  
  
You will work with Large Customer Sales (LCS) pods and help advertisers deploy the latest measurement technologies to drive measurement maturity in the SEAS region. You will use the understanding of industry practices, digital media trends, and the influencing skills to convince advertisers to take the necessary actions to determine brand, media customer value and channel impact. You are aligned at the country level and will develop strategic measurement plans for the book of business, develop activation plans and track progress. You will drive a feedback loop with regional and global product leads on product requirements for Data and Measurement solutions.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive product utilization and advanced feature adoption across Google Analytics and Google Ads measurement solutions, supporting product specialists in solving complex attribution cases.
* Lead holistic client measurement consultation to mature conversations around advanced or full-funnel measurement.
* Align with Product and Go-To-Market teams for Fund Programs management and client agreement activation of measurement strategic value-adds.
* Activate South East Asia (SEA) strategy through deep client consultations and product rollouts, driving privacy foundations product adoption, Consent Mode activation, and first-party data (1PD) integration.
* Familiarize with and consult on App Measurement solutions such as AppsFlyer and Adjust to support client needs.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. title: Assistant branch head
description:
**Company Description**
Medcity Study Abroad, powered by Medcity International Overseas Corporation, is a trusted overseas education and international healthcare career consultancy supporting students and professionals in building global futures. The organization specializes in study abroad programs, international university placements, nursing and healthcare careers, visa guidance, language training, and healthcare licensing pathways across destinations such as Germany, the UK, Ireland, Canada, Australia, and wider Europe. Applicants benefit from personalized counselling, transparent guidance, and end-to-end assistance, from course selection and admissions to visa processing and career planning. By simplifying the overseas education and migration process, Medcity Study Abroad helps individuals make informed decisions and successfully transition to international education and career opportunities. Based in India, the organization supports learners and professionals worldwide.

**Role Description**
The Assistant Branch Head is a full-time, on-site role based at the Kochi branch, supporting the overall management and performance of the center. This position assists in overseeing daily branch operations, including counselling workflows, admissions processes, and service delivery to students and professionals seeking overseas education and healthcare career opportunities. The role involves supervising and guiding counselling and support staff, ensuring adherence to company standards, and maintaining a high level of client satisfaction through timely communication and accurate information. The Assistant Branch Head supports branch-level marketing activities, local outreach, and relationship-building with partners, training institutes, and universities as needed. The role also includes monitoring branch targets, preparing periodic reports, coordinating with senior management, and contributing to continuous improvement of processes and services.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong leadership, team supervision, and people management skills to support branch operations and guide staff effectively.
* Candidates should possess excellent communication, interpersonal, and counselling skills to interact with students, families, and professionals in a clear and supportive manner.
* Candidates should possess organizational, time management, and multitasking skills to handle multiple admissions, visa, and documentation processes efficiently.
* Candidates should possess problem-solving, decision-making, and conflict resolution skills to address client issues and operational challenges promptly.
* Candidates should possess customer service orientation and relationship management skills to build trust and maintain long-term client and partner relationships.
* Relevant experience in overseas education consulting, student counselling, or healthcare career guidance is highly beneficial.
* A bachelor’s degree in any discipline, preferably in business, management, education, or a related field, is desirable.
* Proficiency in MS Office tools and comfort with CRM or counselling management systems will be an advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in Kochi and flexibly support branch schedules and events as required.

title: Sales Rep./ Territory Business Executive
description:
**Summary**
As a Sales Representative at Novartis, you’ll build strong relationships with healthcare professionals and deliver solutions that make a real difference for patients. You will be responsible for driving territory performance by executing robust business plans, building strong customer relationships, and delivering impactful, compliant engagement. You will focus on achieving sales and growth objectives through effective multi-channel customer interactions, data-driven insights, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  
  
If you are looking to launch a new product in a specialty portfolio in a priority TA and create a meaningful impact for patients, then this is the right place for you
  
  
By personalizing your approach, using data, and working closely with your team, you’ll help us achieve our mission—making every interaction and outcome matter.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Location: Kochi**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Create and execute territory business plan aligned to brand strategy (targeting, coverage, quarterly priorities, cycle plans) to achieve productivity and performance
* Drive effective launch execution for new product by ensuring market readiness
* Build strong relationships with KOLs & customers to support product advocacy & generate demand
* Lead multichannel execution to maximize coverage and influence
* Drive high-quality, compliant, HCP engagement using evidence-led, value-based selling; strengthen disease/patient pathway understanding and objection handling
* Use data, sales, prescription insights and market intelligence to optimize targeting, improve call effectiveness, plan territory actions and optimize sales performance
* Work with distribution / trade partners to ensure availability, primary–secondary alignment and stock/expiry risk control in priority channels
* Provide insights to enhance promotional effectiveness and territory performance & collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize resources and forecasts
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting and resolve issues promptly
* Ensure brand plan execution and KPI governance (coverage, call quality, demand drivers, availability) and manage risks across competition, access and supply
* Champion compliance and uphold Novartis’ ethical standards

**Role Requirements**

* Science educational background is must, B.Sc., B. Pharma
* Management degree preferred
* Minimum 2 years in pharmaceutical sales, preferably in specialty sales
* Minimum 2 years of sales experience in Dermatology segment
* Strong scientific acumen with the ability to translate clinical and product knowledge into value-based selling, effectively communicating differentiated patient and therapeutic benefits to HCPs
* Proven ability to drive prescription generation and achieve sales targets leveraging
* Strong knowledge of disease management and treatment protocols
* Ability to engage with healthcare professionals from the territory effectively
* Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills

**Why Novartis:**
Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.
  
  
As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience in a pre-sales engineering, professional services, or customer-facing technical architecture role.
* Experience in programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud infrastructure technologies.
* Experience engaging with, presenting to, and influencing both technical stakeholders and executive leaders (C-level) during complex sales cycles.
* Experience driving technical discovery and value-based selling to map enterprise business goals to technical architectures.
* Location: Candidates based in Mumbai or Bangalore will be prioritised.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
* Deep expertise in graph database technologies (e.g., Neo4j) along with knowledge of relational, NoSQL, and data visualization tools (e.g., D3.js, Linkurious).
* Proven experience building joint GTM solutions and co-selling with hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP), strategic ISVs, and global systems integrators.
* Industry expertise within highly regulated sectors such as Banking & Financial Services, Telco, and Government.

**About The Job**
As a Solutions Engineer, you will be a key driver of Neo4j’s growth by shaping technical solutions that address complex enterprise challenges. You will serve as the technical authority during the pre-sales lifecycle, moving beyond standard product demonstrations to architect robust, value-driven graph database solutions. You will engage deeply with BFSI & Enterprise customers and strategic partners—including hyperscalers like AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud—to design interconnected data ecosystems that prove the tangible ROI of the Neo4j portfolio. In this role, you will blend consultative technical prowess, sales acumen, and ecosystem collaboration to accelerate adoption and secure the technical win.
  
  
Neo4j is the world leader in graph technology, helping organizations capture real-world context to drive choices for applications like artificial intelligence, fraud detection, and recommendation engines. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage connection-first data architectures to solve the world's most critical business problems. Turn your technical expertise into impact by helping India’s largest enterprises unlock the value of AI with connected data.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the technical win for complex enterprise accounts, leading technical discovery, product demonstrations, and competitive positioning from evaluation through opportunity conversion.
* Design, build, and deliver proof-of-value (PoV) prototypes, tailored solution architectures, and technical workshops that clearly articulate Neo4j’s unique value proposition.
* Partner closely with hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP), systems integrators, and ISVs to architect joint solutions, execute co-sell initiatives, and deliver technical enablement programs.
* Act as a cross-functional technical orchestrator, collaborating with internal sales teams on deal qualification and ensuring a seamless architectural handoff to Professional Services and implementation partners.
* Champion Neo4j’s technology by contributing to thought leadership, presenting at webinars and industry conferences, and supporting local developer community and marketing events.
* Travel to customer sites and partner events as required to run technical workshops and advance strategic engagements.

title: Value Advisor - SAP Supply Chain

+ Plan and lead discovery workshops and site walk-throughs across inbound, storage, picking, packing, outbound, yard and transport.

+ Turn findings into a clear problem statement and prioritized improvement opportunities.

* Present and defend the value case to operations leaders, finance and procurement.
* Co-own deal strategy with the Account Executive: win themes, solution narrative, proposal storyline and orals.
* Brief and drive Presales and Practice Directors for demos and solution designs prove the value case.

* Build reusable assets: discovery guides, warehouse and transport value-lever libraries, ROI calculators, industry point-of-views.
* Track the SAP supply chain roadmap, automation market and AI developments; turn them into customer-ready stories.
* Contribute to events, webinars and content that reinforce Westernacher's leadership in supply chain.

* Proven experience running discovery sessions and building business or value cases.

.

Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.

title: Sr Manager - Customer Interaction Suite
description:
**About The Company**
Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
  
  
Job Description — Solution Engineer (aka STS), CCaaS & Voice AI (Individual Contributor)
  
  
Company: Tata Communications
  
  
Function: Solution Engineering (aka STS) — Customer Interaction Suite
  
  
Role Type: Individual Contributor (IC) — no people management
  
  
Location: Pune, Mumbai, Bengaluru, or Gurugram (hybrid; on-site as per project needs)
  
  
Experience: 6–9 years in contact centre / cloud telephony / voice AI solution engineering
  
  
Travel: Up to 30% (client sites within India and occasional overseas)
  
  
**About The Role (a Note From The Hiring Head)**
Tata Communications is one of the world’s most interconnected digital infrastructure companies, built on our Digital Fabric that connects networks, cloud, and customer interactions for global enterprises. Within our customer experience portfolio, we sell and deliver cloud contact centre (CCaaS) and AI-driven engagement solutions end to end — including our InstaCC™ contact centre platform, the Smartflo CCaaS platform, and the Kaleyra CCaaS/CPaaS suite we acquired in 2023 (messaging, voice, video and chat APIs), alongside a global OEM ecosystem spanning Genesys Cloud CX, Amazon Connect, Webex Contact Centre, NICE CXone
  
  
Every enterprise deal we win now hinges on two things: a well-architected CCaaS solution and a compelling Voice AI story — voice bots, IVR transformation, speech-enabled self-service, and agent-assist. I am looking for a hands-on Solution Engineer who lives in that intersection: someone who can take a customer’s call-flow diagram and turn it into a winning, priced, demonstrable solution.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Pre-sales and Solution Design
  
  

* Own the technical win in the sales cycle: conduct discovery workshops with enterprise customers, document their current contact centre estate (telephony, routing, IVR, CRM, WFM, analytics), and translate business requirements into a target-state CCaaS + Voice AI architecture.
* Design end-to-end solutions across our portfolio — InstaCC, Smartflo, and Kaleyra CCaaS/CPaaS — and across OEM platforms (Genesys Cloud CX, Amazon Connect, Webex Contact Centre, NICE CXone, Five9), including telephony integration (SIP trunking, WebRTC, SBCs), channel routing (voice, chat, WhatsApp, email), and CRM/helpdesk integration.
* Architect the Voice AI components specifically: conversational IVR and voice bots, ASR/STT and TTS selection, NLU and LLM-driven dialogue design, barge-in, DTMF fallbacks, latency and WER budgets, and clear escalation to human agents.

Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept
  
  

* Build and maintain compelling demos that showcase CCaaS workflows and Voice AI behaviours (voice bot conversations, sentiment detection, agent-assist) that our sales teams can take into customer rooms.
* Scope, build, and run PoCs with customers; define success criteria (containment, deflection, CSAT impact) and deliver crisp readouts.

RFPs, RFIs and Commercial Support
  
  

* Lead the technical portions of RFPs/RFIs and solution defence presentations; write the technical response, solution narrative, and architecture diagrams.
* Support commercials: build bill-of-materials, platform sizing, voice/AI consumption estimates, and effort/cost inputs for SOW and pricing decisions — while keeping the solution technically honest.

Partner and Ecosystem Engagement
  
  

* Work closely with our platform partners (Genesys, Amazon, Webex, and others) on roadmap access, licensing nuances, and joint solutioning for large deals.
* Validate third-party and our own AI component choices (speech engines, LLM-based voice agents, analytics) against real customer use cases.

Implementation Handoff and Feedback
  
  

* Hand over won deals to delivery/implementation teams with clean solution documentation; join the first design reviews to ensure what was sold is what gets built.
* Feed market learnings — what wins, what doesn’t, what customers ask for — back into our product and portfolio teams.

Must-Have (Non-Negotiable)
  
  

* CCaaS depth — 6+ years designing, demonstrating, or deploying contact centre solutions on at least one leading platform (Genesys Cloud/CX, Amazon Connect, NICE CXone, Five9, Avaya, Webex CC) and a working command of cloud telephony: SIP, PRI/trunking, WebRTC, SBCs, DTMF, call recording, and omni-channel routing.
* Voice AI expertise — Demonstrable experience designing and delivering voice AI / conversational AI solutions: IVR and voice-bot design, ASR/STT and TTS engines (e.g., Azure Speech, Google STT, Amazon Transcribe/Polly), NLU and/or LLM-driven dialogue flows, barge-in and error handling, and real-world tuning for accuracy (WER), latency, and containment.
* Solution engineering craft — Proven track record in pre-sales: discovery, solution architecture, demos, PoCs, RFP/RFI responses, BoM and pricing support.
* India market context — Understanding of India’s telecom/enterprise landscape relevant to voice workloads: carrier numbering and provisioning practices, TRAI/DoT compliance considerations, and how enterprise contact centres buy telephony in India.
* Communication — Ability to explain architecture to CIOs and call flows to operations heads; comfortable presenting and debating in customer rooms; excellent written technical documentation.

Good to Have
  
  

* Exposure to CPaaS APIs (messaging, voice, WhatsApp) — experience with Kaleyra or similar is a plus.
* CRM and ecosystem integration knowledge (Salesforce, MS Dynamics, helpdesk platforms).
* Working knowledge of speech analytics, sentiment analysis, real-time agent-assist, and LLM-based voice agents.
* Relevant certifications (Genesys, AWS Connect, Google/cloud speech services, etc.).
* Experience with managed services or telco hosting models in the CCaaS space.

What Success Looks Like (KPIs)
  
  

* Technical win rate on supported opportunities; number of deals where our solution architecture and demos were decisive.
* PoC success rate and time-to-PoC.
* Quality and completeness of RFP responses and solution documentation (on-time, high first-pass accuracy).
* Accuracy of solution/BOM estimates versus won contract scope.
* Customer and internal stakeholder feedback (sales, delivery, partners).

title: Manager – Business Development & Debt Syndication
description:
**Company:**
Growthally Advisors
  
  
**Job Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Experience:**
3–9 Years
  
  
**Department:**
Corporate Finance / Debt Syndication

**Role Overview**
Growthally is looking for a highly driven
**Manager – Business Development & Debt Syndication**
to drive client acquisition, deal origination, and revenue generation for its AIF & Credit Fund platform.
  
  
This is a
**front-end, target-driven role with focus on Business Development and Debt Syndication Execution**
. The ideal candidate will be responsible for independently sourcing new clients, building a strong deal pipeline, developing referral networks, and converting funding requirements into successful debt transactions.
  
  
The role requires a strong hunter mindset, established industry relationships, commercial acumen, and the ability to originate and close corporate and SME debt deals, including structured debt, growth capital, and refinancing opportunities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Development & Client Acquisition
* New Client Acquisition: Independently identify, approach, and onboard corporates, SMEs, business owners, and promoters seeking debt funding, structured credit, growth capital, or refinancing solutions.
* Lead Generation & Deal Origination: Build and maintain a strong pipeline of self-sourced business opportunities through direct outreach, networking, referrals, and market intelligence.
* Promoter & CFO Relationships: Develop and maintain relationships with promoters, CFOs, founders, business owners, family offices, and corporate decision-makers.
* Channel Partner Development: Establish and strengthen referral networks with Chartered Accountants (CAs), consultants, investment bankers, financial advisors, brokers, and other intermediaries.
* Funding Solutions & Pitching: Understand clients’ financial requirements and pitch suitable AIF, Credit Fund, and structured debt solutions based on their funding needs.
* Revenue Generation: Achieve business development targets through successful client acquisition, deal sourcing, transaction closures, and fee generation.
* Market Mapping: Identify potential sectors, companies, and emerging businesses with debt funding requirements aligned with Growthally’s investment strategy.
* Relationship Management: Build long-term client relationships to generate repeat business, referrals, and cross-selling opportunities.
* Networking & Brand Building: Represent Growthally at industry events, CFO forums, business conferences, and networking platforms to strengthen market presence and generate leads.
* Market Intelligence: Track competitor activity, prevailing interest rates, credit market trends, lender appetite, and structured debt opportunities.
* Debt Syndication & Deal Execution
* Initial Deal Assessment: Gather preliminary financial information and assess the client’s funding requirement, business profile, repayment capacity, and broad transaction feasibility.
* Deal Structuring Support: Coordinate with internal credit and investment teams to evaluate suitable debt structures, funding options, and potential transaction terms.
* Documentation & Due Diligence: Coordinate the collection of financial statements, business information, KYC documents, and other necessary documentation from clients.
* Internal Coordination: Act as the primary point of contact between clients and Growthally’s credit, investment, legal, compliance, and operations teams.
* Transaction Progress Monitoring: Follow up on credit evaluation, due diligence, internal approvals, documentation, and other execution milestones to facilitate timely closure.
* Negotiation & Closure Support: Assist in coordinating commercial discussions, term negotiations, and transaction documentation through disbursement or deal closure.
* Compliance & Deal Quality: Ensure that sourced opportunities meet preliminary fund eligibility criteria and adhere to internal processes and applicable compliance requirements.
* Post-Closure Relationship Support: Maintain client engagement after transaction closure to identify additional funding requirements and future business opportunities.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong business development, sales, and client acquisition capabilities.
* Proven experience in sourcing and converting corporate or SME debt opportunities.
* Good understanding of debt syndication, structured finance, corporate finance, and credit products.
* Strong network among promoters, CFOs, business owners, CAs, consultants, and financial intermediaries.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to independently generate leads, develop a pipeline, and achieve revenue targets.
* Commercial awareness and the ability to identify viable funding opportunities.
* Strong coordination and follow-up skills to support debt transaction execution.
* High ownership, self-motivation, resilience, and a performance-driven mindset.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Mandatory: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Preferred: MBA / PGDM in Finance, Marketing, or Strategy.
* Additional Advantage: CFA or other relevant finance certifications.

**Experience & Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 3–9 years of experience in Business Development, Client Acquisition, Debt Syndication, Corporate Banking, Relationship Management, NBFCs, Investment Banking, or Fintech lending.
* Demonstrated ability to independently source clients and generate a healthy pipeline of corporate and SME funding opportunities.
* Existing relationships with promoters, CFOs, founders, CAs, consultants, and other financial intermediaries will be an advantage.
* Experience in structured debt, private credit, AIFs, credit funds, or corporate lending will be preferred.
* Candidates with a strong sales orientation and a proven track record of revenue generation and deal closures are encouraged to apply.

**Compensation & Incentives**

* Competitive fixed compensation with aggressive performance-linked variable incentives.
* Higher incentives for proprietary deal sourcing, successful transaction closures, AIF / Credit Fund opportunities, and structured debt transactions.
* Quarterly performance reviews based on business generation, pipeline quality, fee generation, and deal closures.
* Opportunities for accelerated career growth based on performance and revenue contribution.

**This role is primarily suited for a business development professional who can independently originate debt transactions and drive revenue, while coordinating with internal teams to facilitate execution and closure.**
**How To Apply**
Interested candidates can share their profile or resume at 07506 236023.

title: TC - CS - IAM - Saviynt - Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- Saviynt Staff**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

title: GDS M and E - Sourcing Specialist
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description:**
GDS Meetings & Events Sourcing Manager
  
  
**Job Title:**
GDS Meetings & Events Sourcing Manager
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The GDS Meetings & Events (M&E) Sourcing Manager will be responsible for the strategic sourcing, contracting and supplier management of hotels, venues, destination management companies (DMCs), event agencies, production houses, transportation providers and other event-related suppliers supporting EY meetings and events globally.
  
  
This role will serve as the subject matter expert for venue and event sourcing, providing commercial guidance and market intelligence to stakeholders while driving value, compliance, cost optimisation and service excellence. The successful candidate will possess strong hospitality industry knowledge, a deep understanding of hotel operations and contracting terminology, and the ability to negotiate complex event agreements across multiple markets. The role will work closely with internal stakeholders, procurement teams, meeting planners and suppliers to deliver sourcing solutions that align with EY's Meetings & Events strategy and policies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategic Venue & Supplier Sourcing

+ Lead venue sourcing activities for meetings, conferences, leadership events, training programmes, offsites and client-facing events.
+ Analyse event requirements and develop sourcing strategies aligned with business objectives, budget and attendee experience expectations.
+ Source and evaluate hotels, convention centres, resorts, event venues, destination management companies (DMCs), event agencies and other event suppliers.
+ Conduct market research and benchmark venue rates, supplier capabilities and industry trends to support decision-making.
+ Provide venue recommendations based on location suitability, contractual terms, operational feasibility, attendee experience and commercial value.

* Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management

+ Lead RFP, RFQ and proposal evaluation processes for hotels, venues and event suppliers.
+ Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, concessions and contractual protections to maximise value and mitigate risk.
+ Ensure all supplier agreements comply with EY procurement policies, legal requirements and standard contract templates.
+ Drive savings initiatives through strategic sourcing, preferred supplier utilisation and volume-based negotiations.
+ Support supplier renewals and contract reviews while maintaining a strong supplier governance framework.

* Hospitality & Industry Expertise

+ Serve as the M&E team's subject matter expert on hotel operations, venue management and hospitality contracting.
+ Demonstrate strong knowledge of hotel industry terminology including:

- Guest room blocks and pickup analysis
- Attrition and cancellation clauses
- Food & Beverage minimum commitments
- Meeting room rental structures
- Complimentary ratios and concession strategies
- Revenue displacement and peak period pricing
- Force majeure and risk mitigation clauses
- Commission and non-commission models, and negotiated rate structures

+ Advise stakeholders on hotel operational considerations that impact cost, attendee experience and event success.
+ Maintain knowledge of regional and global hospitality market trends, supplier capabilities and emerging venue solutions.

* Stakeholder Management

+ Partner with meeting sponsors, event planners and business stakeholders to understand sourcing requirements and event objectives.
+ Provide sourcing guidance and recommendations throughout the meeting and event lifecycle.
+ Act as the primary escalation point for venue and supplier-related issues during sourcing and contracting phases.
+ Build strong relationships with key hotel brands, venue operators, event agencies and industry partners.

* Supplier Performance & Governance

+ Monitor supplier performance against contractual service levels and programme expectations.
+ Support supplier onboarding, due diligence and ongoing relationship management activities.
+ Maintain sourcing databases, preferred supplier catalogues and venue intelligence resources.
+ Identify opportunities to enhance supplier performance, improve service delivery and strengthen strategic partnerships.

* Reporting & Process Improvement

+ Analyse sourcing activity, contract performance and savings opportunities through reporting and KPI management.
+ Support compliance monitoring and programme governance initiatives across the M&E function.
+ Drive continuous improvement initiatives to streamline sourcing processes, improve stakeholder experience and enhance programme efficiencies.
+ Own and drive data entry and accuracy on CVENT and contract uploads on ARIBA
+ Support sourcing-related technology platforms, databases and supplier management tools.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, Tourism, Business Administration, Procurement, Supply Chain or a related field preferred.
* Hospitality or procurement-related professional certifications are advantageous.

**Experience**

* Minimum 3 – 5 years of experience in hotel sales, venue sourcing, hospitality procurement, destination management, corporate event management or strategic sourcing.
* Strong experience negotiating hotel contracts and managing large-scale venue sourcing projects.
* Experience working with global hotel chains, event agencies and hospitality suppliers.
* Demonstrated knowledge of meetings and events operations and procurement practices.
* Experience working in multinational, matrixed and stakeholder-driven environments is highly desirable.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong expertise in hotel, venue and event supplier sourcing, with a deep understanding of hospitality operations and industry terminology.
* Proven contract negotiation, supplier management and procurement experience with a strong commercial mindset.
* Ability to drive cost optimisation, budget management and data-driven sourcing decisions.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills across all levels.
* Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving capabilities with attention to detail.
* Ability to build and maintain strategic supplier relationships while working independently in a global, fast-paced environment.

**What We Look For**
We are seeking a commercially minded sourcing professional with deep hospitality industry expertise and a proven ability to negotiate complex event agreements. The ideal candidate will combine strong market knowledge, supplier relationship management and strategic thinking to deliver best-in-class sourcing solutions while supporting EY's global Meetings & Events programme objectives.

description:

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Lead - Digital Marketing
description:
**About the company :-**

Dezerv is a house of investing solutions for high-net-worth and affluent Indians. Dezerv is co-founded by Sandeep Jethwani, Vaibhav Porwal, and Sahil Contractor. They have led successful wealth management businesses and managed over USD 7 billion in assets. The Dezerv team brings together decades of investing expertise from leading global financial institutions like JP Morgan, UBS, BNP Paribas, etc. Our team of experts monitors the performance of portfolios and rebalances them if required to ensure long-term success. We are backed by marquee firms like Premji Invest, Accel, Elevation, Matrix, etc. Since inception, our clients have trusted us with over 18000+ Crs of their assets.

**Why are we building Dezerv?**

Investing is stressful and emotional. Building & growing wealth is difficult and time-consuming. Most individuals struggle with managing their investments and money. Our goal is to help individuals grow their wealth without the stress, time, and costs involved in a traditional investment. At Dezerv, we are building a platform that leverages our decades of investment expertise to help individuals invest better for their future.

**What are we trying to solve/mission?**

We are passionate about helping Indians invest better. We manage investments with active oversight to help both sophisticated and new investors build long-term wealth across various market conditions.

**Role Overview :-**

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role at the intersection of data, growth, and product. As Lead– Digital Marketing, you will own all paid digital user acquisition for Dezerv — architecting, executing, and optimizing campaigns that bring high-intent investors onto the platform. You will work closely with the Product, Data, and Business teams to drive measurable growth while keeping customer acquisition costs (CAC) firmly in check.

**Why This Role at Dezerv?**

* Ownership from Day 1 — Lead and shape the entire performance marketing charter
* Category-defining product — Market a platform that genuinely changes how HNI Indians invest and manages their wealth.
* Data-first culture — Work with real-time dashboards, rigorous A/B testing, and sharp analytics
* Rapid growth — High learning curve, fast promotions, and significant market opportunity
* Collaborative leadership — Direct access to founders and leadership team

**Key Responsibilities :-**

**1 Strategy & Execution**

* Channels of Distribution: Plan and execute full-funnel performance marketing strategies across Meta, Google, YouTube, programmatic, and emerging digital/non-digital channels.
* Drive user acquisition for the Dezerv app with a sharp focus on investor onboarding and activation.
* Creative & Comms expertise – Need to have solid creative sensibilities who understand what kind of creative narrative will drive impactful growth in CAC & scale efficiencies for HNI.
* Deep consumer research & brand building: This role requires a very deep and psychographic understanding of the TG and being able to clearly identify unique insights & ability to put those into a sharp comm and brand strategy takes the pie.
* Hands-on expertise: Ideal for someone who likes to get their hands dirty from writing scripts, to conducting high-quality shoots, managing $ spends on distribution to working closely with the product team to build and launch new offerings.

**2 Optimization & ROI Management :-**

* Optimize all channels to deliver the best possible ROI while meeting user growth targets
* Continuously improve media and product performance funnels — from ad impression to first investment
* Monitor and manage Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), LTV, ROAS, and other performance KPIs.

**3 Experimentation & Analytics :-**

* Design and run rigorous A/B tests on creatives, messaging, targeting parameters, and landing experiences
* Analyze campaign data and consumer behavior to derive actionable insights and iterate quickly
* Identify high-impact user experience improvements and work with Product to implement them

**4 Stakeholder Management & Reporting :-**

* Report periodically to leadership on campaign performance, trends, and recommendations
* Collaborate with Product, Design, Data, and Business teams to plan and execute integrated campaigns
* Provide clear, data-driven, and actionable insights to business stakeholders
* Drive end-to-end cross-functional projects and ensure alignment across internal teams.

**5 Trends & Innovation :-**

* Stay ahead of digital marketing trends, platform updates, and new technologies
* Ensure Dezerv maintains a competitive edge and brand leadership in the performance marketing space

**Requirements :-**

* 5-7 years of relevant experience in growth & brand marketing or digital growth roles.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
## About the Role

Own utilisation of a distributed rental inventory network through performance and retention marketing. Every SKU is a depreciating asset — idle inventory is a cost, not a missed sale. ROAS and CAC are levers, not the goal.

The Weekly Loop: Read → Diagnose → Act → Review

Read the utilisation report every week (by SKU × city)

Diagnose: visibility, budget, catalogue, retention, or genuinely low demand?

Act: pull the right lever across Google, Meta, catalogue, or lifecycle

Review the following week; iterate

## Key Responsibilities

- Read the utilisation report every week (by SKU × city)

- Diagnose visibility, budget, catalogue, retention, or genuinely low demand

- Act by pulling the right lever across Google, Meta, catalogue, or lifecycle

- Review the following week and iterate

## Requirements

- 1–4 years hands-on running Google Ads and Meta Ads

- Comfortable reading data weekly and drawing own conclusions

- Real diagnostic instinct — knows which lever to pull and when

## Preferred Qualifications

- Not a fit if instinct is “spend more, ROAS good” without asking why

- Not a fit if wants brand/creative work more than performance and data

- Not a fit if SKU × city-level granularity sounds like too much detail

## What We Offer

- Free access to entire rental catalogue

- Health insurance

- Flexible working hours

- Direct mentorship from Demand Gen Lead

- Real autonomy from day one

## Location & Work Mode

- Bangalore, onsite

title: Brand Marketing Manager
description:
**About Fam (previously FamPay)**

  

Fam is India’s first payments app for everyone above 11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.
  
  
We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.
  
  
Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.

  
  
About this Role
  

At Fam, we believe great marketing sits at the intersection of culture, creativity, and execution. Building for Gen-Z means staying deeply connected to how young people think, communicate, consume content, and engage with brands.

  

We're looking for a Marketing Manager who can turn ideas into high-impact campaigns across digital, social, influencer, and on-ground channels. You'll own execution end-to-end—bringing together cross-functional teams, creators, partners, and internal stakeholders to deliver campaigns that are timely, relevant, and memorable. We're also looking for someone who is AI-native - comfortable using AI tools to accelerate research, campaign planning, content ideation, workflows, and execution.

  

This role is for someone who has a strong pulse on internet culture, loves bringing order to ambitious ideas, and can balance creative thinking with operational excellence. If you enjoy building campaigns that people don't just see, but genuinely engage with, you'll fit right in.

**Must Haves**
  

  
* Under-graduate degree in marketing, business, communication, or related field
  
* 3-5 years of experience in campaign management, brand marketing, growth marketing, or integrated marketing
  
* Strong execution capabilities across digital, on-ground, and influencer-led campaigns
  
* Experience managing end-to-end campaign timelines and cross-functional coordination
  
* Deep understanding of internet culture, social media trends, and Gen-Z consumer behaviour
  
* Ability to think creatively while maintaining strong operational rigor
  
* Experience working closely with creative, product, influencer, and partnerships teams
  
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  
  

  
**Good To Haves**
  

  
* Experience in fintech, consumer internet, D2C, or fast-paced startup environments
  
* Existing awareness of influencer ecosystem and creator partnerships
  
* Experience launching product GTM campaigns
  
* Familiarity with meme culture, creator economy, and pop-culture trends
  
* Ability to identify and capitalize on cultural moments quickly
  
* Understanding of campaign performance metrics and reporting
  
  

  
**Roles and Responsibilities**
  

  
* Lead end-to-end execution of integrated marketing campaigns across digital, influencer, social, and on-ground channels
  
* Own campaign project management - timelines, coordination, execution tracking, stakeholder alignment, and delivery
  
* Work closely with brand, product, design, growth, and partnerships teams to bring campaigns to life
  
* Drive product GTM campaigns with strong creative and cultural relevance
  
* Identify trending internet moments, social conversations, and creator opportunities relevant to Fam’s audience
  
* Coordinate influencer collaborations and external partnerships for campaigns and launches
  
* Ensure campaigns maintain consistency with Fam’s brand voice and resonate with Gen-Z audiences
  
* Balance creative thinking with operational excellence and execution speed
  
* Contribute campaign ideas rooted in social behaviour, youth culture, and internet-first storytelling
  
* Monitor campaign performance and optimize execution based on insights and learnings

  
  

**Perks That Go Beyond the Paycheck**

  

• Relocation assistance to make your move seamless.

  

• Free office meals (lunch & dinner).

  

• Generous leave policy, including birthday leave, period leave, paternity and maternity support, and more.

  

• Salary advance and loan policies for any financial help.

  

• Quarterly rewards and recognition programs, and a referral program with great incentives.

  

• Access the latest gadgets and tools.

  

• Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family, mental health support.

  

• Tax benefits with options like food coupons, phone allowances, car/device leasing.

  

• Retirement perks like PF contribution, leave encashment and gratuity.

  
  

**Here’s all the tea on FamApp ☕️**

  

FamApp focuses on financial inclusion of the next generation by providing UPI & card payments to everyone above 11 years old. Our flagship Spending Account, FamX, seamlessly integrates UPI and card payments, enabling users to manage, save, and learn about their finances effortlessly.

  
  

**Revolutionizing Payments and FinTech**

  

FamApp has enabled 10 million+ users to make UPI and card payments across India, removing the inconvenience of carrying cash everywhere. Users get to customise their FamX card with doodles, which lets them add a personal touch to their payments.

  
  

**Trusted by leading investors**

  

We’re proud to be supported by renowned investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital, and esteemed angels Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.

  
  

**Join Our Dynamic Team**

  

At Fam, our people-first approach is reflected in our generous leave policies, flexible work schedules, comprehensive health benefits, and free mental health sessions. We don’t mean to brag, but we promise you’ll be surrounded by some of the most fun, talented and passionate people in the startup space.

  
  

Want to see what makes life at Fam so awesome? Check out our shenanigans at @lifeatfam 😛
  
  
**PS - We’re looking for someone with an AI-native mindset, who actively leverages AI in their day-to-day work, as we encourage and embed it across every level at Fam.**

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

description:
**Social Media & Content Strategist**

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**

**Salary:**
₹45,000 – ₹50,000 per month

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a creative, proactive, and execution-focused Social Media & Content Strategist to build and grow Edit Lobby’s online presence across social media platforms.

The ideal candidate should understand what makes content perform, be strong at content ideation and scripting, and have the ability to turn ideas into engaging, high-performing content. You will work closely with leadership, editors, designers, and creators to build Edit Lobby’s brand, personal brands, and content ecosystem.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can think strategically, write creatively, and execute quickly.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute social media strategies to increase brand awareness, engagement, audience growth, and inbound leads.
* Own the content strategy and content calendar across Edit Lobby’s social media platforms.
* Research trends, formats, creators, and content opportunities relevant to the media, creative, and business space.
* Generate creative and unconventional content ideas for reels, short-form videos, carousels, posts, campaigns, and other formats.
* Write strong scripts, hooks, captions, CTAs, and creative briefs for social media content.
* Understand audience psychology and create content designed for retention, engagement, and shareability.
* Work closely with editors, motion designers, and creators to turn concepts into high-quality social media content.
* Creative-direct social media content and provide clear direction on storytelling, visuals, editing style, hooks, pacing, and overall execution.
* Manage and maintain the social media content calendar, ensuring consistent publishing.
* Develop content strategies for Edit Lobby’s brand as well as personal branding initiatives for leadership and key team members.
* Identify opportunities to build thought leadership and authority through personal branding and founder-led content.
* Monitor social media performance and analyze metrics such as reach, engagement, retention, follower growth, and leads.
* Continuously test new content formats, hooks, ideas, and distribution strategies based on performance data.
* Stay updated with social media trends, platform changes, viral formats, and emerging content styles.
* Collaborate with the marketing, creative, and leadership teams on campaigns, launches, partnerships, and brand initiatives.
* Identify potential collaborations with creators, brands, communities, and industry personalities.
* Support marketing campaigns and initiatives that generate awareness and qualified leads.
* Maintain a strong and consistent brand voice across all content and communication.
* Take ownership of content execution from idea → script → production → publishing → performance analysis.

**Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience in social media, content strategy, content marketing, personal branding, or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other relevant social media platforms.
* Strong knowledge of short-form content, reels, hooks, storytelling, and audience retention.
* Excellent content ideation, scripting, copywriting, and communication skills.
* Ability to understand trends and adapt them creatively to a brand.
* Strong creative judgment with an understanding of what makes content engaging and shareable.
* Experience working with editors, designers, creators, or creative production teams.
* Understanding of personal branding and founder-led content is highly preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple content initiatives and deadlines simultaneously.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, highly creative environment.
* Strong ownership mindset — someone who can take an idea and drive it through to execution without constant supervision.
* Data-driven approach to content, with the ability to learn from performance and continuously improve.

You are curious, creative, proactive, and closely connected to what is happening in the content and social media space. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you - hr@editlobby.com

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
**THE DATES THAT CANNOT MOVE:**

* **In-person interview:**
  20–30 November 2026, at our Bengaluru office. It cannot be done online.
* **Applications close:**
  15 November 2026. We interview on a rolling basis and may close early once the position is filled.
* **All online rounds complete by:**
  19 November 2026.
* **Joining date:**
  1 December 2026. Non-negotiable.

You must be free of notice period obligations by 1 December. If you are currently serving a 60 or 90-day notice, the timing will not work and we cannot make an exception. Please do not apply — it saves us both the time.

**Please read this advertisement all the way to the end before you apply. It is long on purpose. It tells you exactly what the job is, what it is not, how we assess you and what we will not budge on. Applications from people who clearly have not read it are easy to spot, and we do not take them forward.**

**WHO WE ARE:**

**Jane Aerospace is a Bengaluru-based aerospace and drone supply chain company. We source aircraft parts, drone components and industrial materials for operators, MROs and manufacturers — imported and locally procured — and we are building Supply Chain as a Service, a subscription model that takes over procurement for our clients entirely.**

**We operate three companies: Jane Aerospace Pvt Ltd (India), Jane Tech Labs Ltd (Hong Kong) and Jane Aero Tech Supply Chain FZCO (UAE). You would own the public face of all three.**

**We are bootstrapped. No outside funding, and none being sought. We are small, we move quickly, and people here own real things early.**

**THE ROLE:**

**Almost everything Jane sells today is sold by someone picking up a phone. That works, but it does not compound, and it means every conversation starts from nothing. Few have heard of us before we call.**

**Your job is to change that. You would be our first marketing hire, and the mandate is visibility — constant, credible, specific — so that when a buyer at an MRO or a defence manufacturer picks up the phone to one of our BD associates, the name is already familiar and already trusted.**

**What you would own -**

* **The social and content presence of all three companies.**
* **What we publish, where, and in what voice — the creative and channel decisions are yours to make and to defend.**
* **Visibility beyond our own channels: podcasts, interviews, independent digital outlets, creators in the aerospace, drone, supply chain and manufacturing space.**
* **The production line itself — the repeatable process that turns one piece of work into a fortnight of output.**

**One thing we want to be honest about -**

**Positioning sits with the founder. Which markets we farm, what we sell and to whom — those decisions are made by the Managing Director and will be for some time. What is genuinely yours is how we show up: the angle, the format, the channel, the voice, the calendar, and the judgement about what is worth publishing at all.**

**HOW THE CONTENT ACTUALLY WORKS:**

**One substantial piece of work per brand, broken down into everything else. We are not asking one person to invent nine separate content streams — we are asking for a production line.**

* **LinkedIn —**
  the core channel. Posts, articles, case notes, founder commentary. This is where aerospace and defence procurement buyers actually are.
* **YouTube —**
  long-form. Founder explainers, field reports, teardowns, customer problem walkthroughs, podcast and interview appearances. This is the source asset; everything else is cut from it.
* **Instagram —**
  short-form, derived from the long-form. Clips, stills, carousels. Reach and recognition rather than direct buying intent.
* **Cadence is tiered by company, because they are not equally busy:**
* **Jane Aerospace Pvt Ltd (India) — long-form weekly, with derivatives across the week.**
* **Jane Tech Labs Ltd (Hong Kong) — long-form monthly, with derivatives across the month.**
* **Jane Aero Tech Supply Chain FZCO (UAE) — long-form monthly, with derivatives across the month.**

**Each company keeps its own identity and its own audience. They are not one brand with three logos, and the voice for a Hong Kong trading entity is not the voice for an Indian supply chain business.**

**WHERE THIS ROLE GOES:**

**Within about six months we expect to have AI agents doing the repetitive end of this work — cutting the derivatives, drafting the first version, scheduling, monitoring. We are telling you this in the advertisement for two reasons.**

**First, so you understand what we are optimising for: we do not need someone whose value is raw output volume, because that part is going away. We need someone who can define a process clearly enough to hand it over, judge what comes back, and hold a consistent voice across three brands without writing every word of it.**

**Second, because it is the interesting part of the job. You would be among the first marketers anywhere to run three brands with a team of agents rather than a team of juniors. If that is attractive to you, say so in your application.**

**WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO:**

* **Own and publish to the content calendar across three companies and three platforms, consistently. Consistency beats brilliance here — a dead company page reads as a dying company.**
* **Write. Posts, articles, case notes, scripts, email campaigns, landing page copy — in an engineering-credible voice, for people who buy industrial components for a living.**
* **Run the founder’s content programme: shaping the narrative, drafting, and turning what happens inside the business into things worth reading and watching.**
* **Extract and sanitise stories from live work — interviewing the BD and sourcing teams, and making sure nothing published exposes a client, a supplier or a price.**
* **Pursue visibility beyond our channels: build the list, pitch the angle, chase the podcast, the interview and the independent outlet. Small and frequent beats big and never.**
* **Brief the designer properly, in writing, so their video and graphic work does not need three rounds of clarification.**
* **Build our employer brand. We are hiring seven people right now and will hire more.**
* **Report with numbers on what is working, and be willing to kill what is not.**
* **From roughly month four, define and supervise the AI agents that take over the repetitive production work.**

**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT:**

* **It is not company positioning or pricing. Those sit with the Managing Director.**
* **It is not a design or video editing job. We have a designer for production — though being able to cut a rough clip yourself will make you faster.**
* **It is not performance marketing. We are not running paid acquisition at this stage, and if we do it will be a separate decision.**
* **It is not an agency-management role. You do the work; you do not brief it out and report on it.**

**WHAT YOU GET PAID:**

**Rs 40,000 to Rs 45,000 per month CTC (Rs 4.8–5.4 lakh per annum), depending on experience and on what you demonstrate in the assessment. CTC means cost to company; your in-hand figure will be lower after statutory deductions, and we will show you the exact breakdown at offer stage.**

* **Compensation reviewed formally at six months and at twelve months, against evidence.**
* **A real budget for the tools you need, including AI tools. We do not expect you to pay for your own software.**
* **PF and ESI as per statute.**

**The real compensation at this stage is the exposure: three brands, full ownership of the public face of the group, direct access to the founder every day, and a seat at the front of how marketing work is actually changing. At one to three years, very few roles offer that.**

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

* **MANDATORY —**
  writing samples with your name on them: published work, a portfolio, a newsletter, anything real. An application without them will not be reviewed.
* You can genuinely write: clear, specific, no filler. This remains the single most important requirement.
* 1 to 3 years in marketing, ideally B2B. This is not a fresher role.
* Evidence of a creative idea that was yours. Not a campaign you were on — an angle, a format or a hook you came up with and can explain the thinking behind.
* A working understanding of how reach actually behaves on LinkedIn, YouTube and Instagram, and of how the three differ.
* Comfort with AI tools, and the judgement to know when their output is not good enough. We use them here and we expect you to.
* You can brief a designer and judge creative work without needing to make it yourself.
* You publish something imperfect on schedule rather than something perfect late.

**PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:**

**We mean this sincerely — it saves everyone time.**

* **You cannot attend an in-person interview in Bengaluru between 20 and 30 November 2026.**
* **You cannot join on 1 December 2026, for any reason, including notice period.**
* **You are not in Bengaluru and are not willing to relocate here at your own arrangement before joining.**
* **You are looking for a work-from-home or hybrid role. This is fully work from office.**
* **Your portfolio is follower counts and engagement rates with no link to reputation or pipeline.**
* **You have only worked in an agency, on accounts whose outcome you did not own.**
* **You need an established brand and a large budget to be effective.**
* **Writing is not your strength.**
* **You want to own positioning and strategy at company level from day one.**

**OUR HIRING PROCESS:**

**Four rounds. We have deliberately kept the unpaid work small.**

1. **Application —**
   short questions, your CV, and your writing samples. The samples are mandatory.
2. **Assessment —**
   timed, online. Creative judgement, channel thinking, and one short practical brief — around 45 minutes of writing, not a weekend project.
3. **Video interview —**
   recorded, online. You talk us through your own assessment answers and the thinking behind them.
4. **In-person with the Managing Director —**
   at our Bengaluru office, 20–30 November.

**HOW TO APPLY:**

**One last time: if you have skipped to this section, go back and read the rest.**

title: Product Marketing & Content Executive
description:
**Job Description: Product Marketing & Content Executive (1-4 years)**

**Company:** Factori.ai

**Department:** Marketing

**Location:** Bangalore, HSR Layout

**Work Mode:** 5 Days Work From Office

**About Factori**

Factori is the real-world data layer for enterprise AI. Our real-world intelligence platform connects business decisions and AI systems to aggregated physical-world signals through the Real World Graph. We help enterprise teams bring external context into decisions about locations, markets and customers. Our marketing team is building awareness and qualified demand among multi-location retailers and QSR businesses, starting with the US market.

**The Role**

We are looking for a hands-on marketer who combines product marketing with strong content creation skills. You will help retail buyers understand what Factori does, why it matters and how our insights solve real business problems. Working closely with the Product Marketing Lead and Growth Lead, you will develop product messaging, sales enablement materials, customer stories, thought leadership and digital content. You will translate complex data and product capabilities into clear, credible and engaging narratives that educate buyers, strengthen Factori’s positioning and support marketing and sales efforts.

This is an individual contributor role with equal ownership across product marketing and content marketing.

**What You Will Own**

**A. Product Marketing (50%)**

* Buyer and Market Research: Research retail buying situations, including expansion, site selection, competitor evaluation and local marketing. Gather insights from customer interviews, sales conversations and market research to understand buyer needs and pain points.
* Product Positioning and Messaging: Translate Factori’s capabilities, including aggregated mobility signals, points of interest, APIs and MCP, into clear business value propositions for retail expansion leaders, marketers and analysts.
* Sales Enablement: Create solution briefs, one-pagers, sales decks, demo scripts, FAQs, objection-handling documents and competitive comparison materials to help sales teams communicate Factori’s value.
* Customer Stories and Use Cases: Work with product, data and customer-facing teams to develop evidence-based customer stories, use cases and original-data narratives. Clearly document sources, assumptions and limitations.
* Product Launches: Coordinate messaging and launch assets for confirmed product capabilities, including announcements, demos, FAQs and sales enablement materials. Ensure all communication reflects actual product availability.
* Feedback and Optimization: Gather feedback from sales, customers and marketing campaigns to refine messaging, strengthen positioning and improve the effectiveness of sales materials.

**B. Content Marketing (50%)**

* Content Strategy and Planning: Develop and execute a content calendar aligned with Factori’s marketing priorities, target retail audiences, product narratives and business objectives.
* Long-Form Content Creation: Write high-quality blogs, articles, industry explainers, thought leadership pieces, reports and other educational content focused on retail intelligence, location analytics, consumer behaviour and AI-driven business decisions.
* SEO-Focused Content: Create search-friendly content around relevant keywords, customer questions and industry topics. Collaborate with SEO and web specialists to improve content discoverability and organic visibility.
* Thought Leadership: Turn Factori’s insights, research and expertise into compelling content for executive LinkedIn posts, company updates, newsletters and other relevant channels.
* Content Repurposing: Adapt original research, customer stories and product insights into multiple formats, including blogs, social posts, email content, webinar materials, infographics and sales collateral.
* Editorial Quality: Maintain high standards for writing, structure, clarity, factual accuracy, tone and consistency across all content. Work with subject-matter experts to validate technical and business claims.
* Content Performance: Track relevant metrics such as organic traffic, engagement, content-assisted conversions and asset usage. Use performance data and audience feedback to improve future content.

**Required AI Knowledge and Skills**

Practical knowledge of using AI to design, execute and improve product marketing and content workflows is required.

* Proficiency with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or equivalents for research synthesis, content development, messaging, ideation and sales enablement.
* Ability to use AI to accelerate content production while maintaining originality, factual accuracy, brand consistency and appropriate human review.
* Understanding of prompt design, context grounding and source verification, including validating claims against approved product documentation, customer evidence and reliable sources.
* Ability to build repeatable AI-assisted workflows with clear inputs, review steps and quality checks.
* Awareness of responsible handling of confidential information, copyright considerations and the limitations of AI-generated content.

**What You Bring**

* Experience in product marketing, content marketing, B2B writing or a related role, with work samples demonstrating your individual contribution.
* Strong writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business audiences.
* Experience creating multiple content formats, such as blogs, articles, thought leadership, case studies, product collateral or sales enablement materials.
* Understanding of product positioning, buyer personas, value propositions and how content supports the customer journey.
* Familiarity with SEO fundamentals, keyword research, content optimization and content performance metrics.
* Practical experience using AI in repeatable workflows, including fact-checking, source verification and improving output quality.
* Strong collaboration and project management skills, with the ability to work across product, sales, data and marketing teams.
* Comfort working with spreadsheets, charts and basic performance reports, and the ability to distinguish verified findings from assumptions.

Experience with B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, retail technology, data products, geospatial intelligence or AI-driven solutions is useful but not mandatory.

**What Success Looks Like**

In your first 90 days, you will understand Factori’s priority retail buyers, establish a strong foundation of approved messaging and content themes, and deliver a coordinated set of product marketing and content assets. Success will be measured through the quality and accuracy of messaging, adoption of sales enablement materials, consistency and effectiveness of content production, organic visibility, audience engagement and contribution to qualified marketing engagement and sales conversations.

**Why Join Factori?**

Your work will shape how enterprise buyers understand Factori and its real-world intelligence platform. You will work with experienced marketing leaders, explore practical applications of AI in marketing and build content and messaging that help a growing business reach the right audiences.

title: Lead, SEO & Content Strategy
description:
**Lead, SEO & Content Strategy**

**Location: Hyderabad**

**Experience: 5-6 years**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Lead, SEO & Content Strategy to manage and grow Zetexa's organic search presence.

You will be responsible for planning SEO strategies, managing content, improving website rankings and traffic, and working with different teams to generate leads through organic search. This is a hands-on role where you will both plan the strategy and execute the work.

**Key Responsibilities**

**SEO Strategy**

* Create and manage the SEO strategy and monthly/quarterly SEO plans.
* Find new opportunities to increase organic traffic, rankings and leads.

**Keyword Research**

* Research keywords related to Zetexa's products, travel, destinations and connectivity.
* Identify the right keywords and topics for blogs, landing pages and product pages.

**Content Strategy**

* Plan the content calendar based on keywords, search trends and business requirements.
* Guide writers on what content to create and how it should be structured.

**Content Management**

* Review and improve blogs, landing pages and website content for SEO and user experience.
* Update old content to improve its rankings, traffic and relevance.

**On-Page SEO**

* Optimise page titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal links and website content.
* Identify pages that are not performing well and work on improving them.

**Technical SEO**

* Regularly check the website for technical SEO issues such as crawling, indexing, broken links and page speed.
* Work with developers to fix technical SEO issues and ensure new website changes are SEO-friendly.

**International SEO**

* Manage SEO for different countries and international markets.
* Work on country-specific keywords, landing pages and hreflang where required.

**Link Building**

* Plan and manage link-building activities to improve website authority and rankings.
* Identify relevant websites, partnerships and content opportunities for quality backlinks.

**SEO Tools & Reporting**

* Use tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs/SEMrush and Screaming Frog to track SEO performance.
* Prepare regular reports on traffic, rankings, leads and other important SEO metrics.

**SEO & Content Performance**

* Track how blogs and landing pages are performing and identify areas for improvement.
* Focus on converting organic traffic into enquiries, leads and business opportunities.

**AI & New Search Trends**

* Keep up with changes in Google search, AI Overviews and AI-based search platforms.
* Test new SEO and content approaches based on changes in search behaviour.

**Team Management**

* Manage and guide SEO specialists, content writers, freelancers or agencies.
* Set clear tasks, review their work and ensure SEO and content activities are completed on time.

**Cross-Team Coordination**

* Work with Marketing, Product, Engineering and Design teams on SEO and content requirements.
* Ensure SEO is considered when launching new products, pages, markets or website changes.

**Requirements**

* 6-9 years of experience in SEO, Content Marketing or Organic Growth.
* At least 2 years of experience in a senior or lead SEO role.
* Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, content SEO and link building.
* Hands-on experience with Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs/SEMrush and Screaming Frog.
* Good understanding of keyword research, search intent and content planning.
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS and JavaScript for SEO.
* Experience working with developers and content teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to understand SEO data and take the right actions.
* Good communication and team-management skills.
* Experience managing writers, freelancers or SEO agencies.
