title: Creative Specialist
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The position is a non-supervisory position in our Digital Marketing team. This position is responsible for creating and/or customizing content and artwork for marketing assets like emails, advertisements, social media posts, infographics, flyers, brochures, presentations, etc. This position will work closely with other members of the digital marketing team, business units, internal graphic designers and communication team, regional colleagues, freelance graphic designers and agencies.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
**The Creative Specialist Has The Following Responsibilities**

* Creatives Development: Design visually appealing graphics and artwork using marketing-ready core content and messages to develop assets like emails, social media posts, flyers, brochures, infographics, short motion graphics, and basic multimedia assets for marketing campaigns.
* Creative Customization: Customize graphic and multimedia content and creatives to suit the needs of different campaigns and audience segments. Ensure all assets are optimized for various digital platforms (e.g., websites, social media, email campaigns) and formats. Adapt content to fit different regional or linguistic requirements when applicable
* Collaboration:
* Work closely with content strategy specialist, campaign managers, business teams and, when applicable, regional PoCs to gather insights and feedback, ensuring assets are aligned with campaign needs.
* Maintain asset repository and share assets with regional PoCs.
* Creative Content Review:
* Review and edit creative assets, including graphics and multimedia content, developed by freelancers and external agencies to ensure alignment with brand guidelines, tone, and messaging strategy
* Submit and ensure review of new content and assets by internal review committee(s)
* Performance Assessment & Recommendations: Work closely with the analytics team to assess creative content performance and make recommendations for further visual and stylistic customization or adjustments based on engagement metrics
* Industry Awareness: Stay up to date with industry trends, consumer behavior, and competitor content strategies to inform the visual and creative direction of content

**Who is USP Looking For?**
The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in graphic/multimedia design, or a related field. A background in pharmaceutical/life sciences or other scientific industry with a strong understanding of scientific terminology is required.
* 5–7 years of experience in creative design and graphic content creation . Exposure to a diverse range of content types, including social media visuals, Google display ads, flyers, case studies, white papers, infographics, and multimedia assets is highly desirable.
* Proven experience in tailoring creative content to meet diverse audience needs, demonstrating adaptability in tone, style, and messaging based on different customer segments and campaign objectives.
* Expertise in graphic design software such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) or similar tools (e.g., Canva), with working knowledge of video and animation tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or similar.
* Strong design sensibility and visual storytelling skills with the ability to adapt tone, style, and content structure for different audiences and formats.
* Strong analytical skills to assess creative content performance and drive data-informed design decisions.
* Excellent organizational skills with the capacity to manage multiple creative projects and deadlines simultaneously. Ability to prioritize tasks and ensure timely delivery of high-quality assets.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Proven track record of collaborating across teams with minimal supervision.

**Additional Desired Preferences**
Desired preferences include highlighting any additional preferred levels of expertise for the role—reminder: items listed here are not requirements and do not disqualify a candidate from consideration.
  
  

* Experience in multimedia creation, motion graphics, or basic video editing for digital marketing purposes.
* Proven track record of working within a creative marketing agency or design studio

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
None, this is an individual contributor role.
  
  
**Benefits**
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
  
  
Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.
  
  
**Job Category**
Publications
  
  
**Job Type**
Full-Time

title: Account Manager I , Seller Growth
description:
**Description**
Shift Type: EU (11AM to 8PM or 12PM to 9PM) IST
  
  
Through the Amazon Marketplace, Amazon provides individuals or enterprises the opportunity to sell their goods on the Amazon platform. Worldwide, more than a million sellers use this Marketplace and thereby contribute to the success of Amazon
  
  
Are you interested in innovating to deliver an excellent level of service to Amazon’s Selling Partners? At Amazon International Seller Services, our mission is to make Sellers successful on Amazon. The seller growth function devises programs to recruit new Sellers and improve existing Seller performance by driving them to adopt to relevant Amazon products and services. We provide necessary support to new Sellers starting from their launch on Amazon to removing blockers and setting them up for success by leveraging various programs and tools. This is a unique opportunity to combine sales experience with marketing automation and product development. You will be helping new Sellers interested in selling on Amazon from all Product Categories by proposing various programs that meet Sellers’ needs (e.g., Fulfillment by Amazon, Sponsored Product ads, Brand Registry, Seller Powered Coupon, and Deals). In this role, you will be expected to think analytically, and solve problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and balance multiple and often conflicting priorities. You will communicate with peers doing a similar role as well as cross functionally. The ability to manage a valuable prospect list is vital; candidates must be comfortable prospecting, cold-calling, and negotiating via phone.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Recruiting Sellers and supporting them in their onboarding journey and managing Seller relationship by championing their needs at Amazon. Teach Sellers how to be more successful on Amazon through education on available tools, policies, and relevant growth opportunities leveraging related Amazon programs and products.
  
  
Managing and driving the growth of the Sellers’ business by driving adoption of programs that accelerate their revenue such as Fulfillment by Amazon, Sponsored Product ads, Seller Powered Coupon, and Deals
  
  
Managing key improvement initiatives and projects: driving efficiencies through tools and processes, simplifying SOPs, improving Seller educational content, and identifying blockers in registration, while working with the relevant internal team members global partners.
  
  
Manage prioritization and trade-offs across Seller experience, performance, and operational load.
  
  
Use metrics to identify growth drivers or problems, and act on improvement opportunities.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of sales or account management experience
* 2+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles experience
* Bachelor's degree

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in relationship management within technology, start-ups, or SaaS Platforms

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Reels Creator Intern (Unpaid)
description:
Reels Creator Intern (On-Camera)

**Purple Business | Social Media & Content Marketing**

**Company:**
Purple Business

**Website:**
https://purplebusiness.in

**Position:**
Reels Creator Intern

**Department:**
Social Media, Content & Marketing

**Location:**
Remote / Flexible

**Work Type:**
Internship | Flexible Working Hours

**Compensation:**
To be mutually agreed and disclosed before joining

**Reporting To:**
Founder & Social Media Team

About Purple Business

Purple Business is an emerging AI-powered business growth platform designed to help small businesses grow through intelligent marketing, advertising, customer insights, and AI-powered automation.

We're building a platform that helps entrepreneurs, restaurant owners, cafe owners, and other small business owners make better business decisions and grow their businesses.

We're looking for a
**confident, expressive, creative, and camera-friendly Reels Creator Intern**
who enjoys speaking in front of the camera and creating engaging short-form content.

**We're specifically looking for someone who wants to be ON CAMERA, not someone who only edits videos.**

You'll have the opportunity to become one of the recognizable faces of Purple Business across Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and other social media platforms.

Key Roles & Responsibilities1. On-Camera Reels Creation

1. Appear on camera and create engaging Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other short-form videos.
2. Confidently speak to the camera and present content in a natural, expressive, and engaging manner.
3. Record educational, entertaining, promotional, and storytelling-based videos.
4. Present scripts with personality, confidence, and effective communication.
5. Experiment with different presentation styles, hooks, expressions, and storytelling techniques.
6. Independently record videos using a smartphone or suitable camera setup.
7. Develop an engaging on-camera personality that audiences can recognize and connect with.

2. Content Ideation & Storytelling

1. Brainstorm interesting video ideas around entrepreneurship, small businesses, AI, digital marketing, and business growth.
2. Research trending reels, viral formats, trending audio, and popular social media content.
3. Convert complex business and marketing concepts into short, easy-to-understand, entertaining videos.
4. Develop engaging introductions, creative hooks, storytelling structures, and calls to action.
5. Collaborate with the social media team to prepare video scripts and content concepts.
6. Suggest new content formats, creative experiments, and opportunities to engage our target audience.

3. Small Business Interviews & Real-World Content

1. Interview small business owners, entrepreneurs, cafe founders, restaurant owners, and other business professionals.
2. Conduct recorded conversations about their entrepreneurial journeys, business challenges, marketing strategies, and experiences.
3. Prepare interesting interview questions that encourage meaningful and engaging conversations.
4. Identify opportunities to create engaging reels from interviews and business owner stories.
5. Collaborate with the team to produce content featuring real businesses and entrepreneurs.
6. Help build connections with small business owners who could potentially become part of the Purple Business community.

4. Social Media & Video Editing Team Collaboration

1. Work closely with Purple Business's social media managers, content strategists, and video editors.
2. Participate in content brainstorming sessions and creative discussions.
3. Coordinate with video editors to transform raw recordings into polished reels.
4. Provide inputs on video hooks, pacing, captions, presentation, and audience engagement.
5. Collaborate with the design and marketing teams on content calendars and promotional campaigns.
6. Take feedback constructively and continuously improve your on-camera presentation and content quality.

5. Brand Representation & Social Media Growth

1. Become one of the public-facing content creators representing Purple Business.
2. Help establish a recognizable personality and communication style for our social media channels.
3. Create content that resonates with small business owners, entrepreneurs, and people interested in business growth.
4. Contribute toward increasing social media reach, engagement, followers, and brand awareness.
5. Explore innovative video formats that can make Purple Business's social media presence stand out.
6. Collaborate with the founders on selected videos, product demonstrations, interviews, and brand campaigns.

Requirements

* **Comfortable and confident speaking directly to a camera.**
* Strong verbal communication and presentation skills.
* Expressive personality and engaging storytelling abilities.
* Interest in Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and short-form video content.
* Ability to record reasonably clear videos using a smartphone.
* Creativity and willingness to experiment with different video formats.
* Basic understanding of social media trends and audience engagement.
* Comfortable collaborating remotely with creative and marketing teams.
* Willingness to receive feedback and continuously improve.
* Interest in entrepreneurship, AI, business, marketing, or startups.

Preferred, But Not Mandatory

* Previous experience making Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or personal content.
* Experience with public speaking, anchoring, acting, hosting, or interviewing.
* Background in journalism, mass communication, theatre, or content creation.
* Basic scriptwriting or video editing skills.
* Familiarity with AI tools for generating content ideas and scripts.

**Professional video editing experience is NOT required.**
Our video editing team can help with post-production. Your primary responsibility is presenting, recording, and bringing great content ideas to life.

Who Should Apply?

We particularly encourage applications from:

* Aspiring content creators and influencers.
* Students who enjoy making Instagram Reels.
* Confident public speakers and college event anchors.
* Aspiring actors, presenters, and interview hosts.
* Journalism and mass communication students.
* Individuals with engaging personalities who love being on camera.

You do not need a large Instagram following or professional content creation experience.

What matters most is your
**camera confidence, communication ability, personality, creativity, and willingness to learn.**

Learning & Growth Opportunities

1. **On-Camera Confidence:**
   Develop professional presentation, storytelling, public speaking, and communication skills.
2. **Content Creation Experience:**
   Gain practical experience creating Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, interviews, and brand videos.
3. **Personal Branding:**
   Build a portfolio of published content and develop your identity as an on-camera creator.
4. **Direct Founder Collaboration:**
   Work closely with the founding team on content, marketing, branding, and creative initiatives.
5. **Professional Creative Team:**
   Collaborate with experienced and aspiring social media managers, video editors, and designers.
6. **Social Media Marketing:**
   Learn how brands grow through content strategy, audience engagement, storytelling, and organic marketing.
7. **Entrepreneurship Exposure:**
   Interact with small business owners and learn about their experiences, challenges, and growth strategies.
8. **Interviewing Skills:**
   Gain hands-on experience interviewing entrepreneurs and turning conversations into engaging content.
9. **AI-Assisted Creativity:**
   Explore AI tools for scriptwriting, research, content ideas, and creative experimentation.
10. **Career Growth:**
    Potential opportunities to transition into paid content creation, social media, or brand representative roles based on performance and company growth, without any guarantee of future employment.

Working Arrangement & Compensation

* **Remote and flexible working hours**
  , with mutually agreed recording schedules and deliverables.
* Work collaboratively with the social media and video editing teams.
* Participate in occasional virtual content planning meetings and recording sessions.
* Any in-person interviews or travel will be planned and agreed upon in advance.
* Compensation, internship duration, and engagement conditions will be confirmed in writing before commencement, including any legally required remuneration.
* Potential future paid opportunities may be considered based on individual performance and the company's growth.

How to Apply

Along with your application, share:

1. Your resume or LinkedIn profile.
2. Your Instagram profile or links to any reels/videos you've previously created, if available.
3. **A short 30–45-second introduction video of yourself speaking about small business growth directly to the camera. Send this to Supreet on LinkedIn for greater chance of selection.**

For the introduction video, you can talk about yourself, why you enjoy content creation, or an interesting business or marketing idea.

No professional editing, expensive equipment, or studio setup is required.

**We're looking for your confidence, personality, speaking skills, and creativity—not your video editing abilities.**

**Become one of the faces of Purple Business and help us create content that reaches and inspires small business owners across India.**

**Purple Business**

EC-Council is the world's largest cybersecurity technical certification body. We have trained and certified more than 400,000 information security professionals worldwide, helping shape the global cybersecurity workforce.
  
  
www.eccouncil.org
  
  
**Role Overview**
As Digital Marketing Lead, you will be responsible for executing day-to-day digital marketing activities across organic and owned channels. Working within the marketing strategy and direction set by leadership, you will translate plans into consistent, high-quality execution across social media, email, content, community, and events. This is an execution-focused role for a proactive and independent professional who can take a brief from concept through to delivery, ensuring work is completed to a high standard and on schedule.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Social Media**

* Manage social media channels end-to-end, including content creation, publishing, scheduling, and ORM.
* Monitor channel performance and identify opportunities to improve reach, engagement, and follower growth.

**Email Marketing & HubSpot**

* Execute email marketing through HubSpot, including nurture campaigns, newsletters, announcements, promotional campaigns, and event communications.
* Build emails, lists, segmentation, workflows, forms, and basic automation within HubSpot.
* Monitor campaign performance and maintain basic reporting on engagement and conversions.

**Content & Publishing**

* Manage and execute marketing content calendar end-to-end.
* Write and edit high-quality B2B content across social media, email, blogs, website pages, testimonials, interviews, and campaigns.
* Adapt content to defined brand voice and audience.
* Publish and schedule approved content across owned channels.

**Creative & AI-Assisted Content Production**

* Use AI tools confidently across research, ideation, writing, editing, repurposing, and content production while maintaining quality, accuracy, and brand voice.

* High-output, execution-oriented mindset with the ability to manage multiple concurrent deliverables and deadlines.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
Marketing Specialist — Lotus Care IN

**Company:**
Lotus Care IN

**Job Type:**
Full-time

**Work Mode:**
Remote

**Working Days:**
Monday to Saturday (6 days a week)

**Compensation:**
₹3–10 LPA CTC, including variable pay

Company Description

Lotus Care IN is a premium home care platform that connects families across India with carefully verified and trained care professionals for elderly care, personal care, post-surgery recovery, dementia support, home assistance, and companionship.

The organization is built on the belief that care should feel like family, emphasizing trust, dignity, and human connection rather than transactional interactions. Lotus Care IN serves both families seeking reliable support for aging loved ones and care professionals who want recognition and fair compensation for their expertise.

The platform offers flexible care options, including one-time, recurring, and long-term services, with transparent pricing and continuity of care from familiar caregivers. Lotus Care IN is designed specifically for Indian families, focusing on high-quality, human-centered care in the home environment.

Role Description

The Marketing Specialist is a full-time, remote role responsible for driving brand awareness, customer engagement, and lead generation for Lotus Care IN across digital and offline channels.

The specialist will develop and execute marketing strategies and campaigns, create and manage content for social media and other platforms, and support initiatives that connect families and care professionals with the Lotus Care IN platform.

Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting market research, analyzing customer insights, collaborating with sales and operations teams to align messaging, and tracking campaign performance against key metrics. The Marketing Specialist will also strengthen the brand's positioning around trust and family-like care, manage communication with potential customers, and support customer service initiatives to ensure a consistent and positive experience.

The role requires a proactive, results-oriented professional who can work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple priorities, and contribute to the company's growth.

Key Responsibilities

* **Marketing Strategy:**
  Develop and execute marketing strategies to increase brand awareness, customer acquisition, and engagement.
* **Digital Marketing:**
  Plan and manage campaigns across social media, digital platforms, and other relevant channels.
* **Content Creation:**
  Create compelling, audience-focused content, including social media posts, campaign creatives, blogs, and promotional materials.
* **Lead Generation:**
  Identify opportunities to generate qualified leads from families seeking home care services and potential care professionals.
* **Market Research:**
  Research customer needs, competitor activities, market trends, and opportunities in India's home care sector.
* **Brand Positioning:**
  Communicate Lotus Care IN's core values of trust, dignity, continuity, and compassionate care.
* **Sales and Customer Engagement:**
  Support lead nurturing, customer onboarding, and communication with prospective customers.
* **Campaign Analytics:**
  Monitor campaign performance, analyze key metrics, and recommend improvements to optimize results.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**
  Work closely with sales and operations teams to align marketing activities with business objectives.
* **Customer Experience:**
  Support customer communication and service initiatives to ensure a positive and consistent brand experience.

Qualifications and Skills

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt messaging for diverse audiences.
* Market research skills, including customer insight gathering, competitor analysis, and trend identification.
* Sales and customer service skills, including lead nurturing, customer onboarding, and empathetic communication.
* Understanding of marketing strategy, audience segmentation, campaign planning, and multichannel marketing.
* Familiarity with digital marketing tools, social media management platforms, and basic analytics tools such as Google Analytics and CRM platforms.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines.
* A results-oriented mindset with an interest in customer acquisition, brand growth, and performance measurement.
* Experience in healthcare, home care, consumer services, or a related sector is an advantage.
* A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Compensation and Working Schedule

* **Annual CTC:**
  ₹3,00,000–₹10,00,000 per annum (₹3–10 LPA), including variable pay.
* **Working Days:**
  Monday to Saturday, six working days per week.
* **Work Mode:**
  Fully remote.
* **Employment Type:**
  Full-time.

The compensation package will be structured based on the candidate's skills, relevant experience, and suitability for the role. The stated CTC includes variable compensation.

Who Should Apply?

* We are looking for a proactive and empathetic marketing professional who can combine strategic thinking, creative execution, customer understanding, and performance analysis to help Lotus Care IN grow. If you are passionate about building a trusted brand and making quality home care more accessible to Indian families, we would love to hear from you.

title: Associate Campaign Manager
description:
**Associate Campaign Manager**

**Company: AstroGuruji**

**Location: Mumbai, India**

**Job Type: Full-time, On-site**

Company Description

**AstroGuruji**
is a digital platform that connects users with verified astrologers through chat and voice consultations, making astrological guidance more accessible and convenient. The platform allows users to explore experts, understand their areas of specialization, and choose consultations that fit their needs.

Trust, ease of use, and a high-quality consultation experience are central to AstroGuruji’s mission. By combining traditional astrological knowledge with modern technology, the team is focused on building a reliable, user-friendly experience at every step. AstroGuruji is growing and continuing to expand its product, platform, marketing initiatives, and team.

Role Description

As an
**Associate Campaign Manager**
at AstroGuruji, you will support the planning, execution, monitoring, and optimization of marketing and promotional campaigns across digital and offline channels. This role requires hands-on knowledge of
**Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other paid advertising platforms**
, along with an understanding of performance marketing, audience targeting, campaign analytics, and conversion optimization.

You will assist in setting up and managing advertising campaigns, monitoring daily performance, coordinating creative assets, tracking budgets, analyzing key metrics, and identifying opportunities to improve campaign results. You will work closely with marketing, sales, product, and creative teams to support user acquisition, app installs, engagement, consultation bookings, and business growth.

The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, detail-oriented, and eager to develop expertise in paid media and digital campaign management in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

Key Responsibilities1. Paid Advertising and Performance Marketing

* Assist in planning, setting up, executing, and optimizing paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), YouTube Ads, Google Display Network, and other relevant platforms.
* Manage and monitor Google Search, Display, Performance Max, remarketing, app promotion, and lead generation campaigns.
* Support paid social campaigns, including audience targeting, retargeting, creative testing, and campaign optimization.
* Assist with advertising on other platforms, such as LinkedIn Ads, programmatic advertising networks, affiliate channels, and other relevant paid media platforms.
* Monitor campaign budgets, impressions, clicks, app installs, registrations, conversions, and advertising spend.
* Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance, reduce acquisition costs, and increase return on advertising spend.
* Coordinate with creative and content teams to develop ad creatives, copy, and promotional assets.

2. Campaign Planning and Execution

* Support the development and execution of marketing campaigns aligned with business objectives and growth targets.
* Maintain campaign calendars, timelines, budgets, and execution trackers.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external agencies to ensure campaigns are launched on time.
* Assist with promotional campaigns, seasonal offers, festive campaigns, product launches, and customer acquisition initiatives.
* Ensure campaign messaging, creatives, landing pages, and promotional offers are consistent with brand guidelines.
* Track campaign deliverables and follow up with stakeholders to ensure timely execution.

3. Campaign Analytics and Reporting

* Monitor daily campaign performance and prepare regular reports on key marketing metrics.
* Track key performance indicators, including CPC, CPM, CTR, CPA, CPI, CAC, conversion rate, and ROAS.
* Use Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Ads reporting, Meta Ads Manager, spreadsheets, and dashboards to analyze campaign performance.
* Assist with Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, Meta Pixel, and other tracking tools to ensure accurate campaign measurement.
* Identify performance trends, audience insights, and areas for improvement.
* Recommend data-driven changes to targeting, bidding, budgets, creatives, and campaign structure.
* Maintain accurate campaign records and communicate performance updates to relevant stakeholders.

4. Growth Marketing and User Acquisition

* Support campaigns designed to increase app installs, registrations, first-time consultations, and repeat user engagement.
* Assist in developing remarketing and retargeting campaigns to re-engage existing users and improve conversions.
* Help analyze the customer acquisition funnel and identify opportunities to reduce drop-offs.
* Coordinate with product and sales teams to align campaign activities with user acquisition and revenue objectives.
* Support initiatives across digital advertising, referral marketing, influencer campaigns, and customer engagement channels.

5. Project Coordination and Stakeholder Management

* Coordinate campaign activities with marketing, design, content, product, sales, and operations teams.
* Manage multiple campaign tasks, deadlines, and deliverables simultaneously.
* Communicate campaign requirements, progress updates, and performance insights clearly.
* Support external agency and vendor coordination, including creative delivery and campaign execution.
* Stay updated on paid advertising trends, platform updates, and digital marketing best practices.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field is preferred.
* Practical knowledge or experience in digital marketing, campaign management, performance marketing, or paid media advertising.
* **Proficiency in Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager**
  , including campaign setup, audience targeting, budget management, bidding strategies, ad optimization, and performance reporting.
* Understanding of Google Search Ads, Display Ads, YouTube Ads, Performance Max, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, app promotion campaigns, and remarketing.
* Familiarity with other paid advertising platforms, including LinkedIn Ads, programmatic advertising, affiliate marketing, and other relevant digital advertising channels.
* Basic understanding of performance marketing metrics, including CPC, CPM, CTR, CPA, CPI, CAC, conversion rate, and ROAS.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, Meta Pixel, and campaign analytics tools.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret campaign reports and identify optimization opportunities.
* Good communication, coordination, and project management skills.
* Proficiency in spreadsheets, presentation tools, and marketing dashboards.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.
* Willingness to learn new marketing technologies, advertising platforms, and campaign optimization techniques.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* A proactive, growth-oriented mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes and continuous improvement.
* Interest in astrology or willingness to learn about the astrology industry is an advantage.

Preferred Qualifications

* Hands-on experience running Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns for mobile applications, consumer brands, e-commerce businesses, or digital platforms.
* Familiarity with app install campaigns, mobile attribution tools, Firebase, AppsFlyer, or Adjust.
* Basic knowledge of landing page optimization, A/B testing, retargeting, and conversion rate optimization.
* Google Ads, Google Analytics, or Meta Blueprint certifications are an advantage.
* Experience coordinating with creative agencies, marketing vendors, or external advertising partners is beneficial.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance in this role will be measured through:

* Timely and accurate campaign setup and execution.
* Growth in app installs, registrations, and qualified users.
* Campaign performance improvements across CPC, CTR, CPA, CPI, and ROAS.
* Efficient budget utilization and adherence to campaign budgets.
* Accuracy of campaign tracking, reporting, and analytics.
* Improvements in conversion rates and user acquisition performance.
* Effective coordination with internal teams and external partners.

Why Join AstroGuruji?

* Opportunity to work with a growing technology-driven consumer platform.
* Hands-on exposure to Google Ads, Meta Ads, and multi-channel performance marketing.
* Opportunities to learn campaign analytics, audience targeting, and growth marketing strategies.
* Collaborative environment with exposure to marketing, product, and business teams.
* Opportunity to contribute directly to user acquisition and business growth.

**How many creatives should we launch this week?Which 5 audiences should we test next and why?When do you kill an ad?When do you increase budget by 20%, 50% or 2X?Is the problem the creative, audience, offer, landing page or product?Why did CPM increase?Why is CTR falling?Why is Meta giving us cheap clicks but expensive purchases?What is our real CAC after considering contribution margin?**

**2. Build a creative testing machine:**

You will work closely with the creative team to create a systematic testing engine.

You will decide:

* What creatives need to be made
* How many variants to test
* Which hooks to test
* Which angles to test
* Which formats to test
* Which audience each creative is intended for
* Which winning creatives should be scaled
* Which losers should be killed

For example:

**10 hooks × 3 visual executions × 2 offers**

should not be random experimentation.

You should be able to build a
**structured testing matrix**
and understand which variable is actually driving performance.

**3. Creative Intelligence**

You won't just consume creatives.

You'll help
**create them.**

You should be comfortable with:

* Canva
* AI image generation
* AI video tools
* ChatGPT
* AI copywriting tools
* Basic Photoshop / Figma is a plus
* Meta Creative tools
* Rapid static ad creation

You should be capable of saying:

“This concept needs to be tested today.”

…and then actually making a usable first version yourself rather than waiting two days for a designer.

**4. Google Ads**

You will also manage / work closely on:

* Google Search
* Performance Max
* Shopping
* Brand vs non-brand
* Keyword research
* Search intent
* Negative keywords
* Conversion tracking
* Budget allocation
* ROAS / CAC optimisation
* Landing-page optimisation

Meta will be your
**specialisation**
; Google should be a strong secondary capability.

**5. Amazon Ads**

Hands-on experience with Amazon advertising is required.

You should understand:

* Sponsored Products
* Sponsored Brands
* Sponsored Display
* Keyword strategy
* Search term analysis
* Product targeting
* Competitor targeting
* Amazon ROAS / TACoS
* Organic + paid interaction
* Product detail page optimisation

**6. Quick Commerce**

Experience with platforms such as:

* Blinkit
* Zepto
* Swiggy Instamart
* Amazon Fresh / other relevant platforms

You should understand how paid visibility, search placement, product availability, pricing, promotions and conversion interact on quick-commerce platforms.

**7. Competitor & Market Intelligence**

This is another area I would make a
**core responsibility**
, because it differentiates this role.

You should constantly be researching:

**Competitor Ads**

* What are competitors advertising?
* Which creatives are they repeatedly running?
* What hooks are they using?
* What offers are they pushing?
* Which products are they promoting?
* How are they positioning themselves?

**Competitor Products**

* Pricing
* Bundles
* Offers
* Reviews
* Ratings
* Product positioning
* Claims
* Landing pages
* Amazon listings

**Audience Intelligence**

* Who are competitors speaking to?
* What problems are they addressing?
* What objections are consumers raising?
* What language are customers using?

**Tools**

You should be comfortable using relevant tools such as:

* Meta Ads Library
* Similarweb
* SEMrush / Ahrefs
* Google Trends
* Amazon research tools
* Social listening tools
* Ad intelligence platforms
* Competitor tracking tools
* AI research tools

**You don't need to know every tool. You need to know how to find the answer.**

**8. Data & Analytics**

You should live inside numbers.

Track and analyse:

**CTR**

**CPC**

**CPM**

**Hook Rate**

**Hold Rate**

**CVR**

**CAC**

**CPA**

**AOV**

**ROAS**

**MER**

**LTV**

**Contribution Margin**

**Frequency**

**iROAS**

And importantly:

**Understand the relationship between them.**

For example:

CPM ↑ → CTR ↓ → CPC ↑ → CVR ↓ → CAC ↑

You should be able to identify
**where the actual problem is**
instead of simply saying:

“Meta performance has gone down.”

**9. Scaling**

We are specifically looking for someone who has
**actually scaled campaigns**
, not someone who has only managed ₹2–5 lakh/month budgets.

You should have experience with:

* Scaling winning campaigns
* Increasing spend without destroying efficiency
* Creative fatigue
* Audience saturation
* Budget reallocation
* Geographic expansion
* New product launches
* New customer acquisition
* Retention / remarketing
* Scaling from ₹X/day → ₹X lakh/day

We want someone who can demonstrate:

**“This was the starting point.**

**This was the budget.**

**This was the CAC/ROAS.**

**This is what I changed.**

**This is where we reached.”**

**10. Build the Performance Marketing Dashboard**

You will own weekly performance reporting.

Not vanity reports.

Every week you should be able to tell the founders:

**WHAT HAPPENED?**

**WHY DID IT HAPPEN?**

**WHAT DID WE LEARN?**

**WHAT ARE WE TESTING NEXT?**

**WHERE SHOULD WE PUT MORE MONEY?**

**WHERE SHOULD WE STOP SPENDING?**

**The Person We Are Looking For**

**You might be the right person if:**

* You genuinely enjoy Meta Ads.
* You spend time inside Ads Manager even when nobody asks you to.
* You understand creative performance.
* You obsess over CAC and ROAS.
* You have personally scaled campaigns.
* You know how to structure experiments.
* You understand audiences deeply.
* You are comfortable with large budgets.
* You can work with founders directly.
* You can create a quick ad yourself.
* You use AI to accelerate your workflow.
* You are constantly researching competitors.
* You are uncomfortable making decisions without data.

**You are probably NOT the right person if:**

* Your primary skill is simply campaign setup.
* You outsource every creative decision.
* You only know boosted posts.
* You cannot explain why an ad won.
* You have never personally scaled spend.
* You report impressions and reach but don't understand unit economics.
* You need someone else to tell you what to test.

**Mandatory Experience**

I'd make these requirements quite specific:

**Required:**

* 3–7 years performance marketing experience
* Strong hands-on Meta Ads experience
* Experience with either a
  **D2C brand or performance marketing agency**
* Demonstrated experience managing substantial advertising budgets
* Experience contributing to
  **$1M+ in attributable revenue / GMV**
* Strong understanding of CAC, ROAS, LTV and contribution margin
* Google Ads experience
* Amazon Ads experience
* Quick-commerce advertising experience
* Canva + AI creative tools
* Strong analytical skills
* Competitor research / ad intelligence experience

**Preferred:**

* Food / FMCG / nutrition / wellness / beauty / D2C experience
* Experience scaling a consumer brand
* Experience launching a new product from zero
* Experience working directly with founders
* Basic design/video editing ability
* Strong understanding of landing-page CRO

title: Social Media Marketing Intern
description:
We're changing how people buy from real places.

Until now, commerce has had two halves. Online, people buy in seconds, but they can't trust a photo. In person, they trust what they see, but they have to make the trip. GetPorted joins the two. Customers walk into a real shop, hotel or restaurant from their phone, see it exactly as it is, and buy the exact thing in front of them, straight from the owner. The shampoo in aisle 3, second shelf. The room with the sea view. The table by the window.

Today, marketplaces and middlemen take up to 30% of every sale and keep the customer. We're giving the customer back to the business.

2,500+ spaces digitised. 10 million+ views. Seven divisions: retail, hotels, restaurants, sports, real estate, healthcare and venues, plus CarPorted, our eighth division, for automobiles. See it for yourself at getported.in.

WHY BUILD THIS WITH US

This is not another marketplace. A marketplace turns a business into one listing among thousands and takes a cut of every sale. We're doing the opposite: bringing the real business itself online, so the physical and the digital finally become one place to buy from. It's a new way for commerce to work, and it's being built right now.

We're early and small, so nobody here just watches. The people who join now won't just work on this. They'll help decide what it becomes. If you're looking for just a job, there are easier ones. Join us if you want your work to change how a whole country buys.

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You'll work directly with our founder, Jatin, who has done this before:

• Built STANDARDE, a chain of 24 retail stores with 2,00,000+ monthly footfalls, backed over multiple rounds by marquee angel investors and advisors from India, the US and the UK, and incubated at IIM Lucknow

• Built HIGHLIGHT, the world's first AI search engine for offline retail. It digitised stores with a proprietary spatial data-collection system and made them searchable

• Used that retail intelligence to launch 30+ brands in Pune's offline stores, from Perfora and Blue Nectar to Shark Tank India brands Bamboo India and Dobiee

• A design and data architect who has built 8 software products, across AI, search, marketplace, ERP, POS, data tagging and field operations, and wrote the retail data-capture schemas underneath them

• A serial entrepreneur who runs several ventures at once

AI-NATIVE, FROM DAY ONE

We believe in being AI-native. The repetitive, boring parts of your work go to world-class automation and AI, so your energy goes into what only you can do: the creative thinking that makes the business a success. For that, every one of us gets a premium Claude Team account, the highest tier of Claude's Team plan, worth ₹14,999 a month. AI handles the busywork and multiplies your output. The thinking stays yours. (The account is for work only: usage is monitored, and it isn't for personal use.)

THE ROLE: SOCIAL MEDIA INTERN

On GetPorted, customers don't scroll through photos. They step inside the real place from their phone, look around as if they were standing there, and buy what's in front of them. A shopper walks down the aisle and orders the shampoo straight off its shelf. A guest walks through a resort and books the room with the sea view they're looking at. A family walks into a restaurant from home and reserves the table by the window. A buyer walks round a car, inside and out, and books the test drive.

Your job is to make people feel that before they've even tried it: the moment they realise they're inside a real place, free to look anywhere, one tap from buying. Every reel, post and ad should carry that feeling, on Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube.

How something looks and feels decides whether people trust it. That goes for every experience we build, and for every post and ad that leads to one. So we care about design, and about how our marketing makes a business owner or a customer feel, as much as what it says.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Plan and post content for GetPorted, its seven divisions, and CarPorted, our eighth division, for automobiles

• Turn our experiences into reels and short videos that stop the scroll

• Design posts, covers and ads that feel as good as the product

• Run our ads and keep improving them: test the creative, the copy and the audience, so the budget goes to what works

• Write captions that start with a business owner's real problem, then show what changes

• Reply to comments and messages, and pass every business enquiry to sales

• Track what works each week, and do more of it

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• You live on Instagram and can explain why one reel works and another doesn't

• You have an eye for design, and you can edit short videos (CapCut, Canva, Premiere or similar)

• You write clearly, and you're curious about ads and numbers

• Bonus: you already make content, for yourself, a club or a brand. Put the link in your CV.

• If you meet most of this, apply.

WHO THIS ISN'T FOR

• If you post without asking why it will work

• If "good enough" is good enough for you

• If you're here only for the certificate

WHAT YOU GET

• A paid internship (stipend)

• Your own premium Claude Team account, worth ₹14,999 a month, for work

• A certificate and a letter of recommendation

• Your work seen by business owners across eight industries

WHERE: Remote, or hybrid in Pune if you prefer

Before you apply, walk into a few of our live experiences at https://getported.in/

This role is a mix of data hygiene, GTM engineering, email deliverability and domain management, and scraping and enrichment operations.

  

**Responsibilities**

  
* Own CRM data hygiene and maintain high-quality contact and account data
  
* Audit and optimise CRM properties, lifecycle stages, and deduplication processes
  
* Build and maintain scalable enrichment workflows in Clay
  
* Run enrichment waterfalls (email, phone, LinkedIn, firmographics)
  
* Manage scraping workflows using Bright Data and Apollo exports
  
* Prepare outbound lists and ensure they are campaign-ready with low bounce rates
  
* Reduce duplicate and stale records across CRM and data sources
  
* Implement and manage email validation workflows
  
* Maintain reporting on list health, data completeness, and coverage metrics
  
* Document workflows and create repeatable, scalable processes
  
* Run light scripts or technical executions where needed
  
  

**Requirements**

  
* 3+ years in RevOps/Sales Ops/GTM Ops/Data Ops
  
* Strong hands-on HubSpot CRM
  
* Strong hands-on n8n
  
* Strong hands-on Clay
  
* Experience with data enrichment tools (Lusha, Apollo, etc.)
  
* Experience with Smartlead
  
* Understanding of email deliverability (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warm-up)
  
* Ability to troubleshoot automation workflows and light scripting
  
  

**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Bounce rate consistently under target (for example, under 2%)
  
* Domain and inbox health stable, with no deliverability incidents (blacklisting, spam flags)
  
* CRM data completeness improved (email, LinkedIn, and firmographics)
  
* Reduced duplicates and stale records
  
* Reliable, repeatable n8n and Clay workflows for list building, enrichment, and segmentation
  
* Faster turnaround time on outbound ready lists
  
  

  
**Benefits**

Delhi NCR

The ideal candidate has deep DTC experience editing paid ads, understands direct response principles, runs a current AI stack in production, and delivers volume and quality in the same week without being chased.
  
  
**Who are we?**
KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters, and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon, and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space — $22M+ in revenue and targeting $45-50M in 2026. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're lean, we move fast, and every person on this team has a massive impact on the business.
  
  
**What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**
Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values: work smart, overdeliver, speed is king, and better everyday. We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow.
  
  
**If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.**
If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders, and see huge career growth by playing a big role in scaling it to $100m+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, work in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, and play a big part in our growth being hands-on and active, all while having a
**generous performance bonus structure**
— then you've come to the right place.
  
  
**Key Objectives**

* Consistent output of 8 ad briefs per week, maintaining volume and quality simultaneously
* Increase your performance bonus by analyzing prior video metrics to increase views and conversions
* Apply direct-response copywriting principles to review scripts
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy, managing your daily workload efficiently to meet deadlines without needing hand-holding or frequent check-ins
* Quickly learn and master new tools and software, and editing techniques as social media trends evolve, often with less than a day's notice
* Ensure every video meets our exacting quality standards and perfectly matches the provided instructions, minimizing the need for revisions
* Maintain clear, proactive communication with the company founders and executive team, providing updates when necessary
* Create ad variations and iterations to scale winning ads and improve performance
* Collaborate with the creative strategy team to bring ad concepts to life
* Apply direct response marketing principles to editing (hooks, problem/solution flow, testimonials, CTAs)
* Stay up to date on internet trends and editing styles to ensure our ads feel native and engaging

**Requirements**

* Fully remote
* Fluent in English
* Proven experience creating short-form direct-response videos for DTC brands
* Proven experience with professional video-editing software is required. We have a strong preference for Adobe Premiere Pro
* Paid Ad Focus: Proven experience editing Meta/Facebook paid ads that convert
* Volume: Comfortable producing 8 ad briefs per week
* Tools: Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro
* Creative & Analytical Mindset: Ability to combine storytelling with data-driven feedback to refine and improve ads
* No issue working overtime or on weekends if needed. You're passionate about your work and excited by the idea of producing ads that millions will see
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders
* Deep DTC Experience: You can name the brands and the spend levels behind your work — not just categories
* Meta VSLs: Proven experience with short and long form Meta VSLs. Long form is the bulk of what we run
* AI Stack: You run a current AI stack in production, not one you tried once
* Output: You deliver volume and quality in the same week, without being chased

**KPI'S you will own**

* 8 ad briefs per week Quota
* 80% First-Pass Approval Rate: At least 80% of submissions require no revisions

**Accountabilities**

* Deliver 8 ad briefs per week
* Edit VSLs and DR video ads with AI-first workflows
* Weekly iterations on top-performing ads to drive continuous improvement
* Ensure ads are visually compelling, on-brand, and optimized for performance
* Stay plugged into social media/UGC trends to keep our creatives fresh and competitive
* Troubleshoot underperforming campaigns by testing different edits, structures, and hooks
* Work fluently across AI video and UGC tools (Higgsfield, and similar)
* Collaborate closely with strategists, copywriters, and performance teams

**This Role Is Not For You If**

* You are a meticulous video perfectionist who will spend hours refining a single transition or effect. With a high daily quota, success in this role demands efficiency. Adhering perfectly to the video template at speed is valued over spending extra time on minor details that don't contribute to views or conversions
* You thrive in highly collaborative, team-oriented environments with frequent meetings and brainstorming sessions. This is a high-autonomy, "heads-down" role where you will be working independently the majority of the time to meet your individual production goals
* You are a methodical planner who prefers stable, long-term projects and predictable workflows. Our environment is inherently dynamic. The tools, guidelines, and video styles can change overnight, and you must be able to pivot instantly without frustration

**How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**
We review applications on a rolling basis. If you're a great fit and the timing isn't right immediately, you'll be first in line when a spot opens up, exceptional candidates may be hired immediately.
  
  
Our process has three stages:
  
  

* Application Review + Screening - we assess your background and experience to confirm mutual fit
* Technical Interview + Creative Brief - a short practical exercise so we can see how you think and work
* Culture Fit Interview - a final conversation with the founder to make sure this is the right team for you and you're the right person for us

KPIs and performance targets will be defined together before your start date so expectations are crystal clear from day one.
  
  
For this role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business — and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed.
  
  
**Salary Expectation**
USD $1,000 - $1,500 per month (based on experience and expertise) + percentage of ad spend bonus structure.
  
  
**We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta only.**

title: Associate GM/Marketing Manager
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a strategic, data-driven, and creative
**Brand Marketing Manager**
to drive the positioning, messaging, adoption, and growth of our SaaS products. This role sits at the intersection of product, marketing, sales, and customer success, ensuring that our products resonate with the right audiences and achieve strong market penetration.

The ideal candidate will have
**4+ years of experience in Product Marketing within SaaS, B2B, or D2C environments**
, with a proven track record of launching products, driving customer engagement, managing digital marketing initiatives, and building compelling go-to-market strategies. You should be comfortable translating complex product capabilities into customer-centric value propositions while leveraging digital channels, social media, content, and AI-powered marketing technologies to drive awareness and demand.

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, collaborating across teams, and creating impactful product stories that fuel growth, we'd love to hear from you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Marketing & Go-to-Market Strategy**

* Develop and execute product marketing strategies aligned with business goals, customer needs, and market opportunities.
* Own product positioning, messaging, value propositions, and competitive differentiation across target segments.
* Lead go-to-market (GTM) planning and execution for new product launches, feature releases, and product enhancements.
* Create customer-focused messaging frameworks that effectively communicate product benefits and business outcomes.

**Demand Generation & Digital Marketing**

* Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social media, email, webinars, events, content marketing, and partner channels.
* Drive demand generation initiatives to support pipeline growth, customer acquisition, engagement, and retention.
* Collaborate with performance marketing teams to optimize campaigns across paid, organic, and owned channels.
* Manage product-focused digital campaigns, landing pages, lead nurturing workflows, and conversion optimization initiatives.

**Social Media & Brand Visibility**

* Own product-related social media strategy and content planning across platforms such as LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Instagram, and industry communities.
* Develop engaging product storytelling content including blogs, videos, customer success stories, case studies, webinars, and thought leadership assets.
* Build and manage online communities to strengthen customer engagement and product advocacy.
* Collaborate with influencers, industry experts, and partners to enhance product awareness and credibility.

**Market Research & Competitive Intelligence**

* Conduct market research, customer interviews, competitor analysis, and industry trend assessments.
* Gather customer insights to influence product positioning, messaging, and roadmap discussions.
* Monitor market trends, emerging technologies, and customer behavior to identify growth opportunities.

**Sales Enablement & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Leadership teams to align marketing efforts with business objectives.
* Develop sales enablement materials including presentations, product collateral, battle cards, FAQs, demo scripts, and customer-facing assets.
* Support customer acquisition and retention initiatives through targeted marketing programs and customer lifecycle campaigns.

**AI-Powered Marketing & Analytics**

* Leverage AI-powered marketing tools for content creation, audience segmentation, campaign optimization, marketing automation, and customer insights.
* Identify opportunities to integrate AI technologies into marketing workflows to improve efficiency, personalization, and campaign effectiveness.
* Track and analyze campaign performance, product adoption metrics, lead generation KPIs, and customer engagement data.
* Generate actionable insights and recommend optimization strategies based on performance analysis.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
* **4+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, Digital Marketing, or related roles within SaaS companies.**
* Experience working with
  **B2B and/or D2C SaaS products**
  and understanding of subscription-based business models.
* Proven experience in product launches, go-to-market strategy, customer engagement, and demand generation.
* Strong understanding of product positioning, messaging, competitive analysis, and customer journey mapping.
* Hands-on experience managing digital marketing campaigns across social media, email, paid media, content marketing, and marketing automation platforms.
* Experience with AI-powered marketing tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Jasper, Canva AI, HubSpot AI, or similar platforms.
* Strong analytical skills with experience using marketing analytics, CRM, and reporting tools.
* Excellent communication, storytelling, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in SaaS, Technology, MarTech, AdTech, FinTech, HRTech, MediaTech, or Digital Product companies.
* MBA or certifications in Product Marketing, Digital Marketing, Growth Marketing, or AI for Marketing.
* Experience with Product-Led Growth (PLG), customer lifecycle marketing, and SaaS customer acquisition strategies.
* Exposure to marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, or similar tools.
* Experience managing webinars, virtual events, partner marketing, and customer advocacy programs.
* Familiarity with SEO, content marketing, ABM (Account-Based Marketing), and performance marketing.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation and career growth opportunities
* Opportunity to work with innovative SaaS products and emerging technologies
* A collaborative, agile, and learning-focused culture
* Exposure to AI-driven marketing initiatives and cutting-edge product marketing practices
* Learning, certification, and professional development support
* Employee-friendly policies, wellness programs, and flexible work environment

title: Brand Marketing Lead
description:
**Job Description: Brand Marketing Lead**

**Company:**
upGrad Study Abroad

**Level:**
Associate Director

**Reporting to:**
Head of Marketing

**About the Role**

We are looking for a consumer-first Brand Marketing Lead to build upGrad Study Abroad into a distinctive, trusted and top-of-mind brand for Indian students aspiring to study overseas.

The role will own brand communication, positioning, integrated campaigns, consumer insights, social media marketing, content marketing and PR across the student journey. The mandate is to move beyond lead-generation-led communication and build a compelling brand that students and parents recognise, trust and actively consider when making one of their most important life decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Brand Strategy & Positioning**

* Define and strengthen brand positioning, value proposition and messaging across student segments and study-abroad destinations.
* Translate product strengths, university partnerships, scholarships and student outcomes into compelling consumer propositions.
* Ensure consistent, differentiated brand communication across channels and funnel stages.
* Build trust and preference among students and parents by addressing their key aspirations, concerns and decision-making barriers.

**2. Integrated Campaigns**

* Conceptualize and execute integrated, full-funnel brand campaigns across digital, social, video, influencer and other relevant channels.
* Develop campaign strategies and creative briefs aligned with business priorities, target audiences and consumer insights.
* Partner with Performance Marketing and Creative teams to maximise campaign effectiveness and extend winning propositions across channels.
* Track campaign impact through relevant brand and business metrics, including awareness, consideration, branded search and assisted conversions.

**3. Consumer Insights & Market Intelligence**

* Develop a deep understanding of student and parent needs, motivations, aspirations and barriers through research and consumer feedback.
* Track competitor positioning, messaging, campaigns and emerging category trends to identify opportunities for differentiation.
* Translate consumer insights into actionable communication strategies, campaign ideas and content themes.
* Establish a continuous feedback loop using social listening, community conversations, campaign data and student interactions.

**4. Social Media Marketing**

* Own the social media strategy across relevant platforms, building brand salience, engagement, trust and consideration.
* Develop platform-specific content strategies that balance brand storytelling, student utility, topical conversations and conversion opportunities.
* Drive creator-led content, student stories and community engagement to build credibility with prospective students.
* Track channel performance and continuously optimize content formats, engagement and audience growth.

**5. Content Marketing**

* Own the content strategy across formats, including video, YouTube, editorial, long-form content, website and student success stories.
* Build content around destination choices, courses, scholarships, university partnerships, career outcomes and study-abroad decision-making.
* Ensure content is consumer-first, differentiated, credible and aligned with the brand positioning and student journey.
* Work closely with the Creative, Social Media and Organic Growth teams to maximise content reach, engagement, discoverability and business impact.

**6. Public Relations & Communications**

* Develop and execute PR strategies to strengthen brand credibility, visibility and thought leadership.
* Identify opportunities for leadership profiling, expert commentary, research-led stories, partnerships and announcements.
* Ensure consistent messaging and effective communication across external touchpoints, in collaboration with internal stakeholders and PR partners.

**What We're Looking For**

* 7-9 years of marketing experience, with substantial ownership of brand strategy and integrated campaigns.
* Experience in consumer internet, education, fintech, travel, marketplaces, D2C or other high-consideration consumer categories.
* Strong understanding of digital-first brand building and the relationship between brand investment and performance outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to turn consumer insights into differentiated positioning and compelling creative platforms.
* Experience managing agencies, creative teams, social media, content and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong analytical ability to measure brand outcomes and connect them to business performance.
* Excellent communication, storytelling, stakeholder management and team leadership skills.
* Leverage AI tools for consumer insights, campaign ideation, content development, creative experimentation and personalisation to improve marketing effectiveness, speed and scale while maintaining brand consistency.

**The ideal candidate:**
A brand builder who combines strategic depth, consumer empathy and creative excellence with a sharp understanding of commercial outcomes.

title: Performance Marketer, Marketplaces
description:
If you can win a listing page of fifteen near-identical products in under two seconds, this one is yours.

Marketplaces are not a channel we bolt on at the end. For a lot of Indians, the listing is the brand.

**ABOUT CLIENT:**

Our client is in the business of building tasteful brands across categories and geographies. That could mean 0 to 1, 1 to 10, or 10 to 1000. Six months in, they are about 25 people, each one here to do the best work of our lives.

**WHY WE THEY HIRING**

Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart. Different platforms, different rules, different shoppers, and almost no transferable playbook between them. They need someone who actually knows the difference.

This is the unglamorous half of the business and it still decides the year. Share of search, assortment, ratings, the merchandising calendar, whether they are in stock in the dark store that matters. You own all of it.

You will work across several brands at once, some launching, some scaling, and you will decide where each one deserves to show up.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

•
**Retail media.**
Sponsored products, brands and display on marketplaces, plus ad products on quick commerce. Keyword harvesting, bid logic, placement, budget split by platform.

•
**Share of search.**
The keywords they intend to own, where they currently rank, and the plan to close the gap. Organic and paid together, not as separate projects.

•
**Listings and content.**
Titles, bullets, A+ content, images, thumbnail logic, variant structure. You brief the writer and designer and you are the last check before it goes live.

•
**Assortment and pricing.**
Which SKUs go where, pack sizes by platform, price ladders, promos, platform-funded offers and what they actually cost them.

•
**Ratings and reviews.**
Seeding, responding, spotting the product problem hiding inside a run of two-star reviews, and telling the people who can fix it.

•
**Stock and operations.**
Working with supply chain on forecasts, appointments, fill rate and the dark-store footprint. Going out of stock in your top city is a performance problem.

•
**The numbers.**
ROAS and TACoS by platform, velocity per store, conversion by listing, contribution after platform fees. You own the dashboard and report it honestly, including the months it looks bad.

**MUST HAVES**

**Skills**

• Two to four years running marketplace or quick commerce accounts with your own budgets. Brand side, seller side or agency, they care about the accounts.

• Platform depth, not surface familiarity. Seller Central or Vendor Central, Flipkart Ads, and at least one quick commerce platform you have actually operated.

• Keyword and bid craft. Harvesting, negatives, placement modifiers, and a view on when to stop bidding on your own brand term.

• Listing judgment. You can look at a page and say why it is losing, and it is usually not the price.

• Sheets at a working level. Pull a bulk file, fix it, upload it, without breaking the catalogue.

• Comfort with the operations side. Forecasts, fill rate and appointments are part of the job, not someone else’s.

**Additional**

• Food or FMCG experience is a real advantage. Shelf life, pack sizes and compliance copy change every answer.

• Startup speed. A listing goes live today, a promo is live tomorrow, and the read happens before the weekend.

• Comfort with ambiguity. New brands, no history, no benchmarks to lean on.

• You can think without AI. Use the tools to move faster, never to think for you.

• You read the back of packs in other people’s trolleys and you have opinions about a shelf you had nothing to do with.

title: Senior Manager E-commerce & Marketplaces
description:
Pegasus, part of the B. Jain Group, is an established children’s publishing brand with a wide portfolio of books, educational products and screen-free learning experiences.

With an established presence across Amazon India, leading online marketplaces and our own D2C website, we are looking for a capable e-commerce leader to strengthen our online business and drive its next phase of growth.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a commercially driven and people-oriented
**Senior Manager – E-commerce &**

**Online Sales**
to lead our existing team of performance marketing, marketplace and cataloging professionals.

The role requires someone with a strong understanding of how e-commerce businesses operate, from product visibility and online merchandising to advertising effectiveness, sales conversion and profitability.

The selected candidate will be responsible for setting direction, developing the team, reviewing performance and ensuring that our products achieve their full sales potential across online channels.

**This is a business management and team leadership role, rather than a hands-on advertising or catalog execution position.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Growth & Commercial Ownership**

* Take ownership of overall online sales performance, revenue targets and profitability.
* Develop channel-wise and product-wise growth strategies across Amazon India, other marketplaces and the Pegasus website.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales, organic visibility, market share and contribution margins.
* Ensure that advertising expenditure and operational costs are aligned with commercial objectives.
* Drive sustainable business growth through effective planning, prioritization and execution.

**2. Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead and develop an existing team of performance marketers, marketplace specialists and cataloging professionals.
* Establish clear responsibilities, measurable KPIs and accountability across functions.
* Review individual and team performance, provide direction and ensure timely execution.
* Coach team members, resolve operational challenges and build a collaborative, high-performance culture.
* Assess resource requirements, identify capability gaps and improve team productivity.

**3. Performance Marketing & Marketplace Management**

* Provide strategic and technical direction to specialists managing Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads and marketplace promotions.
* Evaluate advertising strategies, campaign structure, budgets and effectiveness.
* Monitor ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, customer acquisition costs, conversion rates and overall advertising efficiency.
* Ensure continuous optimization of advertising spends while balancing revenue growth and profitability.
* Guide the team in improving product visibility, organic rankings and marketplace sales performance.

**4. Product Performance & Online Merchandising**

* Ensure effective listing, positioning and presentation of products across all relevant online channels.
* Oversee catalog quality, content, keywords, images, A+ content, pricing and promotional strategies.
* Monitor product-wise performance and identify opportunities to improve discoverability and conversions.
* Plan and oversee successful launches of new books, series and product categories.
* Coordinate with editorial, product development, marketing, design and inventory teams to ensure products are online-ready and commercially supported.
* Ensure systematic attention to both bestselling and underperforming products.

**5. Performance Reviews & Business Analytics**

* Establish robust reporting and review processes covering sales, advertising, catalog quality and profitability.
* Analyze channel-wise and product-wise performance to identify commercial opportunities and execution gaps.
* Conduct structured reviews with team members and ensure follow-through on agreed actions.
* Prepare monthly business reviews and actionable growth plans for management.
* Take responsibility for achieving agreed targets within approved budgets.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–10 years of relevant experience in e-commerce or online retail.
* Proven experience managing and developing teams handling marketplaces, performance marketing or digital commerce.
* Strong knowledge of Amazon India, including marketplace advertising, catalog management and sales optimization.
* Good understanding of D2C performance marketing, particularly Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Experience managing advertising budgets, sales targets and business performance.
* Strong understanding of online merchandising, product discoverability, conversion optimization and marketplace operations.
* Sound commercial judgment with the ability to balance growth and profitability.
* Strong analytical, communication, people management and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to guide technical specialists, hold teams accountable and deliver measurable business results.

Experience in consumer products, books, toys, educational products, stationery, baby products or similar categories would be an advantage.

**Why Join Pegasus?**

* Lead an established online business with significant growth opportunities.
* Manage an existing team of specialists rather than build operations from scratch.
* Take meaningful ownership of commercial strategy, team performance and business growth.
* Work closely with senior leadership in a growing Indian consumer brand.
* Opportunity to build a scalable and high-performing e-commerce function.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for leading the digital marketing team, developing effective marketing strategies, managing paid advertising campaigns, improving organic search rankings, generating quality leads, and achieving business objectives through data-driven marketing initiatives.

* Monitor key metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, and ROAS.
* Conduct A/B testing of ad copies, creatives, and landing pages to improve campaign performance.
