* Manage social media platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.
* Plan content calendars and coordinate with content writers and graphic designers.
* Analyze social media performance and implement strategies to improve engagement and reach.

**4. Meta Ads Management**

* Create, manage, and optimize Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns using Meta Ads Manager.
* Develop lead generation, retargeting, and audience segmentation strategies.
* Monitor campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and cost per lead.
* Test ad creatives, formats, and targeting strategies to improve results.
* Track conversions and prepare regular campaign performance reports.

* Assign tasks, monitor daily activities, and ensure timely completion of projects.
* Coordinate with SEO executives, PPC specialists, social media executives, content writers, and designers.
* Conduct regular team meetings, review performance, and provide constructive feedback.
* Ensure accountability, productivity, and continuous improvement within the team.

**6. Strategy, Reporting, and Client Communication**

* Develop comprehensive digital marketing strategies aligned with company objectives.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly performance reports for management.
* Analyze campaign data and recommend improvements based on performance metrics.
* Communicate marketing strategies, campaign updates, and results clearly to management and clients, wherever required.
* Stay updated with the latest digital marketing trends, tools, advertising policies, and search engine algorithm changes.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* 6–10 years of hands-on experience in digital marketing.
* Strong knowledge of SEO, PPC, SMO, Google Ads, and Meta Ads.
* Proven experience in team management and leadership.
* Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in lead generation, conversion optimization, and performance marketing.
* Proficiency in Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, and Meta Ads Manager.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns, projects, and deadlines efficiently.
* Strong decision-making skills with a focus on achieving measurable business results.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience in a digital marketing agency or a performance-driven business environment.
* Proven track record of managing successful SEO and paid advertising campaigns.
* Ability to lead a team independently and handle multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong reporting, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* A target-oriented professional with a proactive approach to problem-solving and campaign optimization.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Improvement in organic website traffic and keyword rankings.
* Achievement of lead generation and conversion targets.
* Optimization of advertising costs and campaign ROI.
* Growth in social media engagement and brand visibility.
* Timely execution of marketing campaigns and projects.
* Team productivity and achievement of departmental goals.

  A strategic and hands-on digital marketing professional who combines technical expertise, leadership ability, strong English communication skills, and a results-driven mindset to deliver measurable business growth.

* **Conversion Optimisation:**
  Identify bottlenecks across product listings, landing pages, and checkout journeys to improve conversion rates.
* **Budget Management:**

* **Growth Strategy:**

What We’re Looking For

How We’ll Measure Success

* Higher ROAS and lower ACOS.
* Consistent growth in paid-attributed sales and total online revenue.
* Lower customer acquisition costs.

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

**Job Title:**
Manager – MD’s Office (PR & Corporate Affairs)

**Reporting To:**
Managing Director (MD)

Ahmedabad- Corporate office

Dynamic and evolving; scope is not limited to this Job Description

1. **Job Purpose**

To manage the Managing Director's desk end-to-end and act as the MD's trusted extension in public relations, liaisoning, stakeholder engagement, and day-to-day coordination. The role builds and maintains the organisation's professional relationships and corporate image with key stakeholders, architects, interior designers, builders, contractors, consultants, industry associations, government and regulatory offices (where required), and business partners, across India and international locations.

The incumbent should be extroverted, presentable, and technology-savvy, with strong interpersonal, communication, and execution skills, and the ability to effectively use AI tools to enhance productivity and efficiency.

This is not a fixed-routine role: new assignments, new people, and new challenges will arise every day, and the incumbent must stay ready to learn, adapt, and take up whatever the MD requires from time to time.

1. **Key Responsibilities**
2. **Relationship Management & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build and maintain professional relationships with architects, interior designers, builders, contractors, consultants, business leaders, industry associations, and other important stakeholders.
* Identify relevant stakeholders and professional networks to strengthen the organisation's external relationships and corporate presence.
* Arrange meetings with important clients and business partners for relationship-building purposes, and coordinate visits, hospitality, and follow-ups.
* Maintain a well-organised stakeholder database (contacts, interactions, commitments, important dates) and keep regular follow-ups going to strengthen long-term relationships.
* Share approved company information, corporate updates, and invitations with stakeholders.

1. **Liaisoning**

* Coordinate with government departments, regulatory authorities, industry bodies, and other external institutions whenever required.
* Understand official processes and documentation requirements, and follow up on applications, approvals, and correspondence until closure.
* Coordinate with internal departments such as Legal, Compliance, Administration, and HR for documents and inputs needed in liaisoning matters.
* Maintain records of liaisoning activities, communications, and pending matters, with a clear status tracker shared regularly with the MD.

1. **PR & Corporate Communication**

* Represent the MD and the company professionally at meetings and events, and communicate agreed information accurately.
* Maintain a positive corporate image through professional conduct, timely communication, and approved PR initiatives.
* Coordinate with media contacts and PR agencies, where applicable, as per management direction.
* Monitor industry news, competitor activity, and relevant market developments, and brief the MD on matters that need attention.

1. **MD's Desk & Executive Coordination**

* Attend meetings on behalf of the MD when authorised, record key discussion points, decisions, and commitments, and track them to timely closure.
* Coordinate with internal departments (Legal, Compliance, HR, Administration, Finance, Marketing, and others) for inputs, approvals, and closure of matters assigned by the MD.
* Provide regular updates to the MD on important matters, pending items, and stakeholder communication status.
* Handle the MD's correspondence, documents, and files, and maintain strict confidentiality of business and stakeholder information at all times.

1. **Events, Travel & Corporate Representation**

* Attend corporate meetings, official visits, industry events, and stakeholder engagements across India and internationally, as required.
* Participate in industry forums, associations, chambers, and professional gatherings to strengthen the company's network.
* Represent the company at events and functions in line with business etiquette and cultural protocol.
* Prepare post-event summaries and maintain a record of events, visits, and contacts made.

1. **Any Special Assignments & Ad-hoc Initiatives**

* Take up any new task, project, or initiative assigned by the MD from time to time, even if it is outside the listed responsibilities.
* Quickly research and learn new subjects, processes, industries, or tools as required by the MD's priorities, and deliver with ownership.
* Handle urgent and unplanned situations calmly, with sound judgement, and keep the MD informed.

1. **Nature of the Role**

This role sits at the centre of the MD's work and is dynamic by design. The responsibilities listed in this document are a starting point, not a limit. Every day may bring a new challenge, a new stakeholder, or a new requirement, and the incumbent is expected to:

* Stay curious and ready to learn new things quickly, without waiting for detailed instructions.
* Be proactive: anticipate the MD's needs, prepare in advance, and offer solutions along with problems.
* Stay flexible with priorities, working hours, and travel, as the MD's schedule and business needs change.
* Treat each new challenge as an opportunity to grow and add value to the MD's office and the organisation.

1. **Required Skills & Competencies**

**Technical Skills**

* Stakeholder Relationship Management
  **:**
  Ability to establish and maintain strong professional relationships with architects, builders, contractors, senior stakeholders, industry bodies, and business partners.
* PR & Corporate Relations: Ability to support public relations, corporate representation, stakeholder engagement, and professional networking.
* Communication & Documentation: Excellent written and spoken English, with good Hindi and Gujarati; ability to prepare formal correspondence, presentations, reports, and stakeholder communications.
* Research & Liaisoning: Ability to identify relevant authorities, associations, institutions, and stakeholders and understand official processes and documentation requirements.

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Adaptability & Flexibility: Adjusts to changing schedules, stakeholder needs, official procedures, and travel requirements, and stays calm under pressure.
* Proactiveness & Ownership: Takes initiative, anticipates needs, and sees assigned work through to closure without constant follow-up.
* Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Communicates clearly, confidently, and professionally with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leaders.
* Relationship Building: Builds trust and maintains constructive, long-term professional relationships.
* Confidentiality & Integrity: Handles sensitive company and stakeholder information with discretion and follows professional ethics.

1. **Education & Experience**

**Education**

1. Post Graduate in Business Administration, Public Relations, Communications, or a related field, or Public Administration will be an added advantage.
2. Digital & Office Tools: Strong working knowledge of MS Office or Google Workspace (Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides, Word/Docs), email, calendars, and video conferencing platforms and AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, or Gemini.

**Experience**

**About The Job**
Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.
  
  
Data Transformation Leads (DTLs) are specialists with a focus of helping advertisers scale their use of Google measurement and attribution solutions to drive measurement maturity. You will have product expertise in specific Google measurement solutions and action on the insights produced.
  
  
You will work with Large Customer Sales (LCS) pods and help advertisers deploy the latest measurement technologies to drive measurement maturity in the SEAS region. You will use the understanding of industry practices, digital media trends, and the influencing skills to convince advertisers to take the necessary actions to determine brand, media customer value and channel impact. You are aligned at the country level and will develop strategic measurement plans for the book of business, develop activation plans and track progress. You will drive a feedback loop with regional and global product leads on product requirements for Data and Measurement solutions.
  
  
Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

* Drive product utilization and advanced feature adoption across Google Analytics and Google Ads measurement solutions, supporting product specialists in solving complex attribution cases.

* Align with Product and Go-To-Market teams for Fund Programs management and client agreement activation of measurement strategic value-adds.
* Activate South East Asia (SEA) strategy through deep client consultations and product rollouts, driving privacy foundations product adoption, Consent Mode activation, and first-party data (1PD) integration.
* Familiarize with and consult on App Measurement solutions such as AppsFlyer and Adjust to support client needs.

**Employment Type:**

Full Time

**Job Code: 102026/01**

**Job Description:**

We are looking for a Video Editor & Motion Designer to create video for Netstratum and its software products. You will make product explainers, software walkthroughs, launch videos, company videos, and reels and short-form content for LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

This is a desk role. All work is done in software: editing, motion graphics, animation and screen-based product video. It does not involve filming or shooting. You will build videos from screen recordings, product UI, brand assets, stock footage, voiceover and music.

AI is central to this role. We want someone who uses AI tools every day to work faster, try more ideas and produce things a traditional editor could not make alone. You will combine AI generation with hands-on craft in After Effects and Premiere Pro.

You will work closely with the design, marketing and product teams.

**How you will use AI**

* Generate and extend visuals, backgrounds, B-roll and motion clips with AI video and image tools.
* Create AI voiceovers, translations and dubbing so one video can reach several markets.
* Use AI for scripting, storyboarding and quick concept versions before full production.
* Speed up editing with AI: auto-captions, rough cuts, cleanup, upscaling and object removal.
* Turn one long video into many short clips for reels and social posts.
* Test new AI tools as they appear, and share what works with the team.

**What you will do**

* Edit and animate videos for product promotion, marketing campaigns, social media and company communications.
* Turn software products into clear, engaging video: animated UI walkthroughs, feature explainers, tutorials and demo videos built from screen recordings and Figma designs.
* Create reels and short-form videos that hold attention in the first few seconds.
* Design motion graphics, animated text, kinetic typography, transitions and visual effects in After Effects.
* Take a video from brief to final export: script and storyboard input, editing, animation, colour, sound and delivery.
* Work across multiple brands and products, and keep each one consistent with its brand guidelines.
* Clean up and balance audio: voiceover, music and sound effects.
* Keep project files, assets and templates organised so work can be reused.
* Take feedback well and deliver on agreed timelines.

**Must have**

* Strong hands-on skill in Adobe After Effects and Adobe Premiere Pro.
* Hands-on experience with AI video, image and voice tools (for example Runway, Google Veo, Kling, Adobe Firefly, ElevenLabs or similar), and the judgement to know when AI output is good enough to use.
* Motion graphics fundamentals: keyframe animation, easing, masking, compositing and timing.
* Ability to animate software UI and screen recordings into clean product videos.
* A good sense of pacing, visual storytelling and typography.
* Basic colour correction and audio editing.
* Working knowledge of export formats, codecs, frame rates and aspect ratios (MP4, MOV, H.264, H.265).
* Ability to turn a written brief into a finished video.
* Attention to detail, good communication and the ability to manage several projects at once.
* A showreel or portfolio of your own work.

title: Product Marketing Manager, II
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
  
  
Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
  
  
From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
  
  
Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
  
  
Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
  
  
Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
  
  
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
  
  
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
  
  
**About The Role**
International payments is complex, competitive, and evolving fast. At Razorpay, we’re building the infrastructure that enables Indian businesses to grow globally; and we’re doing it at speed.As Product Marketing Manager for International Payments, you will own the go-to-market strategy for Razorpay's cross-border payment products – including card acceptance, digital wallets, and global multi-currency accounts.
  
  
You will craft positioning that resonates with merchants, drive high-impact launches, arm the sales team with competitive assets, and more. This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role where marketing, product, sales, and compliance intersect.
  
  
**Why Join Us?**
This role sits at the heart of how our international payments products go to market.
  
  
You’ll work from problem definition to adoption: shaping ICP, value propositions, launch plans, and scaled programs to drive GMV and activation.
  
  
Our product team ships fast across new corridors, payment methods, and use cases, so you’ll constantly work on zero‑to‑one bets as well as scaling proven products.
  
  
If you enjoy ownership, commercial impact, and solving real merchant problems in a competitive space, this role gives you visibility with leadership and direct influence on revenue.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own GTM for key launches end‑to‑end – customer and market insight, positioning, launch strategy, and post‑launch adoption
* Work with the business and product team to scale up brand-building initiatives for the 1-10 journey for Razorpay International Payments Brand.
* Turn complex international payments capabilities (FX rates, settlement, methods, compliance, risk) into clear, differentiated narratives grounded in merchant insights
* Define ICPs and key segments (D2C exporters, SaaS founders, global marketplace sellers, design services, etc.) and build segment‑specific messaging, use cases, and proof points
* Drive multi‑channel GTM programs (email, webinars, roundtables, social, PR etc.) to deepen engagement and adoption
* Build social proof at scale – identify the right merchants, craft case studies and customer stories, and plug them into sales material and social campaigns
* Partner with Product and Growth to identify opportunities across merchant cohorts, payment methods, and use cases
* Enable sales with sharp narratives and assets – pitch decks, one‑pagers, battlecards, objection‑handling, and regular training

**What You Bring**

* 4-6 years of experience in product marketing, brand building or similar, with meaningful experience owning launches and GTMs for technical or fintech products
* You’ve owned multiple products or major feature launches end‑to‑end and can speak to their impact
* You are a strong storyteller – you can take complex products and make them resonate with founders, product, and finance leaders
* You thrive in fast‑paced environments and can juggle multiple priorities
* You work well cross‑functionally – you can bring product, sales, growth, design, and PR together around a clear GTM plan
* Experience in fintech/payments is a plus; exposure to cross‑border or international payments is an added advantage, but not mandatory

Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.
  
  
Follow us on LinkedIn & Twitter

title: Growth Manager (3+ yrs exp)
description:
At MySivi, we're building India's first AI Tutor that's transforming how people learn spoken English. Our AI provides instant feedback on grammar, pronunciation, and fluency, helping users improve faster than ever before. Today, we've already helped
**2Cr+ users**
, and we're just getting started.

Our goal?
**Scale MySivi to ₹500Cr+ ARR in the next 6-8 months.**
We're looking for someone who wants to build, experiment, fail fast, learn faster, and drive massive growth alongside the founders.

We spend more than ₹20 lakhs per day on user acquisition. But growth isn't just about getting more installs, it's about converting those users into paying customers and building a profitable business.

We're looking for a
**Growth Manager who will own the entire funnel, from acquisition to purchase.**
You'll work closely with performance marketing, product, engineering, and creative teams to identify growth opportunities and turn them into measurable business results.

We've raised minimal funding, don't believe in burning money, and love to operate profitably.

**What will you do?**

🚀
**Own full-funnel growth:**
Take complete ownership of the user journey, from ad impressions and installs to activation, trial starts, purchases, and revenue.

📊
**Find growth opportunities:**
Analyse funnel data, cohort behaviour, CAC, ROAS, conversion rates, and retention to identify the biggest bottlenecks and opportunities.

🎯
**Drive acquisition:**
Work closely with performance marketers to scale Google and Meta campaigns, improve user acquisition efficiency, and attract high-quality users. Experiment on new channels.

🧪
**Run growth experiments:**
Form hypotheses, prioritise experiments, and test new ideas across creatives, onboarding, user activation, trial conversion, paywalls, pricing, and offers.

📱
**Improve product conversion:**
Work closely with product and engineering teams to ship experiments that improve activation, engagement, trial-to-purchase conversion, and revenue.

💰
**Own growth economics:**
Improve purchase revenue and ROAS while balancing acquisition costs, conversion rates, average order value, and retention.

🤝
**Break team silos:**
Bring marketing and product teams together around shared goals, clear metrics, and data-backed decisions. Take ownership of outcomes instead of passing problems between teams.

⚡
**Build a growth engine:**
Establish a systematic process for tracking metrics, running experiments, documenting learnings, and scaling successful initiatives.

**You will be a great fit if you:**

✔️ Have 3–7 years of experience in growth, growth marketing, product growth, or consumer internet businesses.

✔️ Have hands-on experience working across both paid acquisition and post-install conversion funnels.

✔️ Understand CAC, ROAS, LTV, retention, activation, trial-to-purchase conversion, and subscription economics.

✔️ Can independently analyse data, identify bottlenecks, form hypotheses, and turn insights into experiments.

✔️ Have worked closely with product and engineering teams to improve user journeys and conversion rates.

✔️ Take complete ownership of outcomes instead of waiting for instructions or blaming other teams.

✔️ Are comfortable getting your hands dirty: analysing data, building reports, setting up experiments, and following through until results are measured.

✔️ Thrive in a fast-moving startup where speed, execution, and measurable impact matter more than presentations.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience scaling consumer mobile apps with subscription or in-app purchase models.
* Experience with Google UAC (App Campaigns), Meta Ads, and mobile attribution tools such as Adjust or AppsFlyer.
* Experience with WebEngage, Amplitude, GA4, or other analytics and lifecycle marketing tools.
* Experience improving onboarding, activation, paywalls, pricing, and trial-to-paid conversion.
* Strong analytical skills, including SQL or the ability to independently investigate large datasets.
* Experience building growth processes or working across marketing and product teams.

**Why join MySivi?**

* Work directly with the founders on a high-impact business problem.
* Own a critical growth function with direct influence on revenue and profitability.
* Get the freedom to experiment, make decisions, and implement your ideas.
* Work with significant acquisition budgets and a team focused on measurable results.
* Help build a repeatable growth engine that can scale across multiple products.'

**This is not a traditional marketing role.**
We're looking for someone who can connect acquisition, product, and monetisation and take ownership of turning users into paying customers.

Please apply only if you enjoy solving growth problems hands-on, working with data, and taking ownership of business outcomes.

title: Director of Product
description:
**Cyware is where you belong!**

Cyware offers the technology organizations need to build a virtual cyber fusion center. With separate but integrated solutions including an advanced threat intel platform (TIP), vendor-agnostic security automation (SOAR), and security case management, organizations are able to increase speed and accuracy while reducing costs and analyst burn out. Cyware's virtual cyber fusion solutions make secure collaboration, information sharing, and enhanced threat visibility a reality for enterprises, sharing communities (ISAC/ISAO), MSSPs, and government agencies of all sizes and needs.

***Come join an exciting startup company in the cybersecurity space that just completed their $30 million dollar Series C funding!***

***We're a lean team, so your impact will be felt immediately. If this all sounds like a good fit for you, why not join us?***

**What You Will Do**

* Lead the definition of the product strategy and roadmap to support the organization vision and deliverables. Be the custodian of the strategy and garner support from leadership for initiatives. Convert the strategy into a roadmap for market dominance, moat and individual product strategy, counter competitive narrative and respond to customer requirements
* Manage the development of current and future features, user stories, and requirements while evaluating their potential and practicality by analyzing customer needs
* Collaborate with the UX design and Info dev teams to own the customer experience with the product
* Manage the entire product lifecycle from ideation, design, development, launch, end-of-life and migration
* Manage the product backlog and recommend alternative technical approaches to meet design requirements when needed
* Participate in development, testing, and deployment reviews to assure requirements are being properly addressed
* Product demonstration and training for the field, operational teams and critical customers
* Act as a leader within the company; help drive product innovation into the corporate culture

**What We Are Looking For**

Must Have:

* **Strong PM experience:**
  12+ years of experience as a Product Manager or a customer-facing role as a domain expert in an enterprise product environment with proven capability of leading product initiative across various stakeholders (both internal and external)
* **Domain Knowledge:**
  Good experience in Cyber security, preferably in Threat Intelligence and related areas. Should have hands-on experience with building & shipping products in these domains,Can credibly challenge and validate product decisions with practitioners
* **Applied AI Product Experience:**
  Has shipped AI/ML-powered features and not just managed roadmaps around them. Understands fundamentals related to model tradeoffs, latency, hallucination risk, evaluation pipelines, and what "AI-native" means in a security product context
* **Startup execution mindset:**
  Thrives in ambiguity with minimal process scaffolding. Leverages AI wherever applicable for the entire PDLC and can write their own PRDs, run customer discovery, define success metrics, and ship iteratively while collaborating with Engineering, GTM and Sales
* **Customer Obsession:**
  Understands the security buyer & user journey including SOC analysts, CTI leads, CISOs, and the procurement nuances. Can translate practitioner pain into product value props that close enterprise deals and retain customers long-term
* **Metrics & data driven mindset:**
  Is data & metrics driven and makes hard tradeoff decisions using usage data, NPS signals, win/loss patterns, etc. Comfortable with ambiguous data and uses frameworks to help guide
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* UX and/or User Interface Design skills will be a key plus
* A technical bachelor’s degree and MBA preferred

**Nice to Have:**

* ISAC / Threat Sharing Experience
* Deep AI & LLM knowledge
* Has been part of a team that has grown significantly quickly.

title: National Key Account Manager- ECom
description:
**National Key Account Manager - ECom**

**Location:**
Bengaluru

title: Brand Manager
description:
**About Company:**

Blissclub is one of India’s fastest-growing apparel brands, built with a singular mission: to build comfortable and functional apparel for India. We are reimagining the apparel space not just designing products, but building a movement. What started as a community-first D2C brand has expanded into experience-led retail destinations where our Blissqueens don’t just shop, they connect, discover, and belong.

Founded in 2020 by ISB alum Minu Margeret, Blissclub raised its Series A of $15 million in May 2022, led by Eight Roads Ventures and Elevation Capital. This was followed by a Pre-Series B round of ₹33 crore and a Series B round of ₹160 crore, led by Singularity.

Featured on LinkedIn’s Top Startups list in 2022 and 2025, we’re one of India’s fastest-growing D2C brands redefining comfortable apparel for India.

**Job Location:**
HSR Layout, Bangalore (on-site).

**The role:**

You will own a key part of how BlissClub shows up wherever a customer meets it: in content, on social, and in our stores. All of that work points at one goal, which is growing the core of the brand.

You will write the plan and ship the work. This is a hands-on seat, not a role where you only direct agencies.

* **Reports to:**
  Chief Business Officer
* **Works with:**
  Category, Growth, Revenue teams (D2C, Marketplaces, Retail) and the in-house Creative team

**What you'll own**

**1. Grow the Core**

* Own the brand plan for our core franchises across Activewear and Citywear. These are the hero ranges the business is built on.
* Partner with Category to sharpen each franchise's story: who it is for, why it wins and what we say about it. Keep that story consistent across the website, marketplace listings and store shelves.
* Build always-on and seasonal plans for the core with Growth and the D2C, Marketplace and Retail teams.
* Turn sales, review, research and performance data into sharp creative briefs, then measure what they delivered.
* Keep the Core fresh, relevant and aspirational through content, community and collabs

**2. Content Excellence**

* Set the content strategy for key communication pillars: what we say, to whom, in which formats and how often.
* Work with the in-house creative team from brief to final cut. You are the quality bar on every asset, including copy, visuals and edits.
* Own execution across owned channels: the website, social and CRM (email, WhatsApp).
* Run a monthly test-and-learn loop. Double down on content that moves engagement, conversion and brand metrics, and cut what doesn't.

**3. Social Media**

* Own the social strategy for each platform - Instagram and LI being key.
* Run the content calendar, the brand voice and the community management standards.
* Plan creator and collaboration content that fits the brand and doesn't just borrow reach.
* Grow the quality of engagement (saves, shares, comments, follower quality), not only reach.

**4. Retail Marketing**

* Build the retail marketing playbook with the Retail team, covering store launches, local activations and catchment marketing that drives footfall.
* Own in-store and storefront assets that turn browsers into buyers: windows, facade screens, visual merchandising communication, POS and in-store content.
* Track footfall and conversion lift by store and by campaign, then roll out what works as new stores open.

**5. Community & Collabs**

Make the people who wear BlissClub the brand's most credible voice. You will build and run our community: run and workout meetups, store events, and a steady flow of customer content. You will also own collaborations, including co-created drops, partnerships with studios, run clubs and like-minded brands, and long-term creator relationships that build affinity rather than renting reach. The test is simple: a community that brings people back, and collaborations that open new audiences for the core.

**Who you are**

You combine taste with rigour. You can spot great content, and you can prove that it worked.

* 5–7 years in brand marketing, with at least 3 years at a digital-first consumer brand in D2C, fashion, beauty or lifestyle.
* A portfolio of campaigns and content you led yourself. Please bring it to the first conversation.
* Hands-on social experience: you have run brand handles and know what works on Instagram today.
* You can turn data into a creative brief, and then show the impact of the work that came from it.
* You have driven outcomes with Category, Growth and Sales or Retail teams without having direct authority over them.
* You are a strong writer, because copy is part of this job.
* You are comfortable with numbers: you set KPIs, read dashboards and report results honestly.

**Good to have**

* Omnichannel or retail marketing experience, such as store launches, visual merchandising or catchment activation.
* Experience managing PR or creative agencies.
* A background in apparel, activewear or another comfort-led category.

www.blissclub.com

title: Product Management Principal Specialist
description:
**Job Title**
Product Management Principal Specialist
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Principal Product Manager will lead priority Front Office / SECO transformation initiatives from problem definition and MVP development through launch, adoption and scale. The role translates customer needs into clear product decisions and outcome-driven roadmaps, selecting the right mix of product, enablement and commercial levers to accelerate adoption.
  
  
Working across product, engineering, UX, marketing and customer-facing teams, the role will align delivery with go-to-market readiness and own outcomes beyond feature release—including activation, sustained usage, workflow migration and customer value realization. Central to this mandate is evolving Selling Platform Connect to improve how travel sellers shop, book and service content across graphical, cryptic and hybrid workflows.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Own the Product Vision, Strategy and Roadmap
  
  

* Own the vision, strategy and outcome-driven roadmap for priority Front Office / SECO initiatives, translating customer needs, user behavior, market insights and business priorities into clear hypotheses, adoption goals and measurable milestones.
* Develop compelling value propositions, product narratives and investment cases that connect customer value with revenue, cost, adoption and strategic impact.
* Define the path from MVP to scale through target segments, phased rollouts, readiness criteria and adoption measures, balancing existing workflow continuity with graphical and AI-led modernization and clear decisions to continue, adapt, reposition or stop.

Lead Adoption from MVP to Scale
  
  

* Own the end-to-end adoption strategy from customer validation and pilots through launch, activation, usage growth, workflow migration and sustained value realization, aligned with product strategy.
* Develop segment-specific adoption playbooks combining in-product guidance, defaults, incentives, enablement, advocacy and targeted campaigns, with clear criteria for voluntary or firmer migration approaches based on customer impact, prerequisites, risks and expected outcomes.
* Define success measures and use product analytics, customer evidence and business indicators to assess performance, remove friction across the user journey and refine the proposition, experience or adoption approach.
* Partner with Product Marketing, launch and customer-facing teams on positioning, readiness and enablement, turning successful pilots into repeatable go-to-market and adoption approaches that scale across customers, segments and related workflows.

Define and Use Adoption Metrics
  
  

* Define an end-to-end adoption measurement framework covering eligibility, enablement, activation, usage depth and frequency, retention, workflow migration and value realization, with clear baselines, targets and leading indicators tied to product and business decisions.
* Combine quantitative analytics with customer research and frontline feedback to understand adoption drivers and barriers, embedding instrumentation and analytics requirements into the roadmap before launch.
* Establish regular performance reviews to diagnose gaps, prioritize interventions and communicate progress and trade-offs to leadership.

Drive Cross-Functional Programs
  
  

* Lead complex cross-functional programs, aligning related roadmaps, dependencies and product decisions while preserving individual product managers’ ownership of execution.
* Establish shared outcomes, accountabilities, decision points, risks and success measures, ensuring launch timing reflects product, commercial, operational and customer readiness.
* Influence senior stakeholders, resolve misalignment and sustain momentum amid ambiguity and competing priorities, building reusable methods, governance and assets to scale adoption across markets, customer segments and related capabilities.

Engage Customers and Shape the Product
  
  

* Monitor competitors, technology trends and evolving travel seller needs to identify opportunities and inform product strategy and positioning.
* Build lasting customer and internal partnerships through discovery and co-creation, adapting product and adoption approaches to the workflows, constraints and operating models of TMCs, leisure agencies, online travel agencies and other seller segments.
* Represent the product in executive discussions, roadmap reviews, pilots and launches, translating feedback into scalable product decisions and clearly communicating workflow value and successful transition paths.

Strengthen Product Excellence
  
  

* Champion outcome-based planning, disciplined discovery, prioritization and post-launch learning across the product area.
* Coach product managers and cross-functional partners on adoption thinking, product analytics, experimentation and value realization.
* Make clear trade-offs between feature breadth, experience quality, operational readiness and adoption impact.
* Ensure accessibility, performance, reliability and usability are treated as adoption enablers within the product definition.

What You Bring
  
  

* Significant product management experience with evidence of leading complex B2B or enterprise initiatives from problem discovery and MVP definition to broad, sustained adoption across multiple teams, customer segments or product areas.
* A strong record of owning product strategy and roadmaps while making difficult trade-offs across customer value, business outcome, adoption potential, delivery complexity and long-term product direction.
* Deep practical knowledge of adoption levers, including segmentation, onboarding, enablement, in-product interventions, incentives, workflow defaults, experimentation and migration approaches.
* Experience defining adoption funnels and using product analytics, customer insight and operational data to guide decisions.
* Proven leadership of complex cross-functional programs without relying on direct authority.
* Strong customer-facing and executive communication skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous product problems into clear choices, decisions and next steps.
* Ability to operate at both strategic and detailed levels, from portfolio choices and senior alignment to user journeys, blockers and metric definitions.
* Experience in travel technology, travel selling, servicing, shopping, desktop workflows or large-scale workflow transformation is highly valuable; the stronger requirement is the ability to understand complex domains quickly and turn them into clear product choices, adoption paths and measurable outcomes.
* A collaborative, pragmatic and outcome-oriented leadership style with the courage to challenge assumptions and make difficult trade-offs.

**What We Can Offer You**
🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
  
  
🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.
  
  
🤗 A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.
  
  
🌟 A hybrid working model - We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them.
  
  
🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.
  
  
📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.
  
  
🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.
  
  
Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.
  
  
**Be aware of recruitment scams**
Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

title: Brand Lead
description:
**Medicine was never made for pets. It was adapted for them.**

Almost everything treating your dog or cat today started as a human formulation, repurposed and repackaged for animals as an afterthought. We want to change this: healthcare made for pets from the ground up, not borrowed.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Brand Lead to build our brand from the ground up. You'll define how we show up in the world: our positioning, identity, voice, creative direction and the experiences that make us distinctive.

This is a zero-to-one role with real autonomy. You'll turn customer and clinical insights into a brand people trust, remember and choose. You'll work across digital and offline touchpoints, partnering closely with founders, product and clinical teams to build a category-defining pet healthcare brand.

**Metrics you influence:**

Brand awareness, consideration, customer acquisition, retention and revenue.

What You'll Own

* Define and evolve our brand strategy, positioning and narrative.
* Own creative direction across campaigns, content, packaging, website and social.
* Build a distinctive visual and verbal identity that stays consistent as we scale.
* Turn customer, vet and market insights into compelling stories and creative concepts.
* Lead campaign development from brief to execution across online and offline channels.
* Build a content engine that educates pet parents and earns trust in pet healthcare.
* Work with growth to connect brand building with measurable business outcomes.
* Build relationships with agencies, freelancers, creators and creative partners.
* Establish brand guidelines and systems that help the team execute consistently.
* Identify cultural and category opportunities that can make us stand out.

What You Bring

* 5–8 years of experience in brand marketing, creative strategy or brand building.
* Proof that you've built or meaningfully shaped a brand, not just executed campaigns.
* Strong instincts for positioning, consumer insight, storytelling and creative direction.
* Experience building brands across digital and offline channels.
* An excellent eye for design, language and distinctive creative work.
* The ability to translate complex or technical subjects into simple, compelling stories.
* Experience in healthcare, pharma, D2C or another trust-led consumer category is a plus.
* An appetite for ownership. You'll be building the brand function, not inheriting one.
* Comfort working with ambiguity, moving quickly and making decisions without a playbook.

Why This Is Worth Your Next Few Years

* Build a brand from zero, with the autonomy to shape its direction.
* Help redefine how pet parents think about animal healthcare.
* Shape a global pet health brand at an early stage.
* Work directly with the founders, with real influence over strategy, creative and customer experience from day one.

title: Head of Strategy - Startup - 90 LPA
description:
We are looking for a strategic and commercially oriented Head of Strategy to work closely with the Founder/CEO in shaping the company's growth strategy, driving key business initiatives and translating strategic priorities into measurable business outcomes.

The role will involve identifying growth opportunities, evaluating new markets and business models, driving cross-functional initiatives, and supporting critical business decisions. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with business acumen, execution excellence and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Corporate Strategy & Business Planning**

* Develop and execute the company's short-term and long-term strategic priorities in alignment with the overall business vision.
* Partner with the Founder/CEO to evaluate business performance, identify growth opportunities and define strategic initiatives.
* Build business plans, financial models and scenario analyses to support key decisions.

**2. Growth Strategy & Market Expansion**

* Identify new markets, customer segments, revenue streams and expansion opportunities.
* Conduct market research, competitive benchmarking and industry analysis to identify emerging trends and growth levers.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in a high-growth startup, scale-up or technology-led business.
* Prior experience at a leading management consulting firm or in a corporate strategy role.
* Experience in fundraising, investor relations, M&A or strategic partnerships.
* MBA or equivalent advanced business qualification.

Key Success Metrics

* Achievement of strategic business priorities and growth objectives.
* Revenue growth, profitability and improvement in unit economics.
* Successful execution of strategic initiatives and market expansion plans.
* Improved business performance visibility and quality of decision-making.
* Measurable impact of cross-functional projects on business outcomes.

title: Founder's Office
description:
**About Wingy**

Love and dating should feel exciting. For most of us, they come with a lot of anxiety too. Wingy is an emotionally-intelligent wingwoman who works alongside you through every part of your love life, helping make modern dating a lot less anxiety-inducing.

We are backed by Gruhas Collective Consumer Fund, ajvc, Anupam Mittal and other leading consumer-tech founders.

**First, about this JD**

You’re expected to work without one.

This is what we’re doing today and where we need help today. It will change, probably by the time you finish onboarding. If you need a fixed scope, this will be a rough ride. If a shifting one sounds like the fun part, read on.

**Two north stars: user growth and retention**

You and the founders own these together. Everything else is negotiable.

**For growth, you’ll:**

* Run our UGC engine: creators, concepts, briefs, output and iteration
* Find the channels we haven’t discovered yet
* Learn and run Meta ads. You don’t need to know how today, but you’ll need to in six weeks.
* Dig out the user insights behind winning hooks: the line that makes someone stop scrolling because it’s uncomfortably about them

**For retention, you’ll:**

* Uncover why some users stay and others disappear, and shape the product journey so more of them stick
* Optimize the whole funnel, from channels, messages and hooks that bring in the right people to the product flow itself

**You’ll probably do well here if you:**

* Are curious about people and always ask the next question
* Can take a user call in the morning, look at a retention cohort in the afternoon, and see how the two connect
* Have made something with a measurable result: content, ads, a product or a community
* Understand hooks, storytelling and internet culture, and can explain why something worked
* Start without a brief, a team or permission
* Hold strong opinions and drop them when the data disagrees

You don’t need a PM title or dating-app experience. Experience with consumer social, marketplaces or Gen Z products helps, but we care far more about how you think and how fast you move.

**What you’re signing up for**

A seat next to the founders for everything: product, users and the messy middle. You’ll learn how a consumer company gets built by building one.

In exchange, you get ambiguity, pace and real ownership, plus a healthy amount of ESOPs and skin in the game.

**How to apply**

Write to priyansha@meetwingy.com about the cool things you’ve done and include a link to your resume or LinkedIn.

title: Co-Founder & CEO
description:
Co-Founder & Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

**Company:**
 Assessli

**Location:**
 Bengaluru, India | Hybrid / Flexible

**Experience:**
 10+ Years

**Compensation:**
 Equity-Based | Founder-Level Ownership | Performance-Linked Incentives

**Hiring Timeline:**
 4–6 Months

**Employment Type:**
 Full-Time

About Assessli

Assessli is an AI-powered EdTech company transforming personalized learning, student assessments, and educational intelligence.

With 
**200K+ users, an established technology platform, institutional partnerships, and ₹50 Cr+ in business opportunities nearing closure**
, Assessli is entering its next phase of growth.

As our existing founders shift their primary focus toward Dots-In and building Large Behavioural Model (LBM) infrastructure, we are looking for an experienced 
**Co-Founder & CEO**
 to take full ownership of Assessli's business operations, growth, and expansion.

**This is not a traditional CEO position. We're looking for an entrepreneurial leader who wants to build, own, and scale a company.**

What You'll Own

* **Business Leadership:**
   Lead Assessli's overall strategy, business operations, revenue, profitability, and P&L.
* **B2C Growth:**
   Scale our consumer EdTech platform through acquisition, retention, monetization, and subscription strategies.
* **B2B & B2G Expansion:**
   Drive partnerships and revenue through schools, colleges, universities, coaching institutes, and government education initiatives.
* **GTM & Revenue:**
   Build and execute scalable go-to-market strategies and sustainable business models.
* **Team Building:**
   Recruit, develop, and lead high-performing sales, marketing, growth, operations, and business teams.
* **Fundraising & Partnerships:**
   Lead investor engagement, strategic alliances, and business expansion opportunities.
* **Product Commercialization:**
   Translate our AI-powered education technology into scalable, revenue-generating products.

Eligibility Criteria
  
Mandatory Requirements

**1. Prior EdTech Founding-Team or Leadership Experience**

Candidates 
**must have previously worked in a founding team or held a senior leadership position at an EdTech company.**

Relevant positions include:

* Founder / Co-Founder
* CEO / COO / CRO / CBO
* Business Head / Business Unit Head
* VP / Director – Growth, Sales, Business, or Operations
* Early founding-team member with significant commercial responsibility

**2. Proven EdTech Business Scaling Experience**

* 10+ years of professional experience, with substantial leadership experience in EdTech.
* Demonstrated experience building or scaling EdTech businesses, products, or revenue-generating business units.
* Strong understanding of both B2C and B2B EdTech business models.
* Direct experience managing revenue, P&L, growth, or major commercial operations.
* Proven capability in customer acquisition, sales, institutional partnerships, and business expansion.

**3. Entrepreneurial Leadership**

* Ability to operate independently with a founder's ownership mindset.
* Experience building and managing cross-functional teams.
* Strong strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution.
* Willingness to commit full-time to scaling Assessli over the long term.

Preferred Background

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked in founding teams or senior leadership positions at companies such as:

title: Director Product Management
description:
**About Target**
As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.
  
  
Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.
  
  
Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Servicing organization well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target.
  
  
**About Team & Role**
Target Enterprise Services (TES) is a globally integrated organisation focused on delivering operational excellence and enterprise transformation through service operations, procurement, finance, product, analytics, automation, and AI. Operating through a highly collaborative, cross-functional model, TES partners across the enterprise to simplify processes, improve experiences, reduce friction, create scalable capabilities and unlock business value for Guests, team members, vendors, and business partners.
  
  
Product Teams at TES are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology, data science and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all products, technology and design work.
  
  
As a Director of Product Management, you will set the overall strategic vision for your product portfolio and lead the team in delivering measurable business outcomes. You will establish short- and long-term product goals, define quarterly Objectives and Key Results, prioritise investments, and manage product budgets and financials.
  
  
The Director of Product Management based in India is a strategic product leader responsible for accelerating Service Centre product capabilities and AI adoption, strengthening execution rigour, prioritising investments, enabling operational efficiency, and providing leadership across Product, Technology, Data, Design, and Operations teams globally and locally.
  
  
Further the role will be responsible for
  
  

* Driving day-to-day product excellence and velocity of Cross-functional teams
* Ensuring strong alignment between global product strategy and local execution, especially faster decision making
* Elevating product thinking, maturity, innovation, and data-driven decision-making leveraging Digital-first mindset.
* Serving as the site leader for product team functionally reporting to the US product leader

**Detailed Job Description**
Success in this role requires balancing strategic thinking with execution excellence, fostering strong product and engineering practices, and building high-performing teams. This leader will transform servicing data into actionable enterprise insights, accelerate digital adoption, reduce friction across customer journeys, and create scalable, reusable platforms that strengthen loyalty, improve productivity, and unlock enterprise value.
  
  
You will build, coach, and mentor a strong team of Product Managers while fostering a culture of progress, transparency, accountability, and efficiency. You will elevate the team’s performance by providing insightful, motivating, and constructive feedback and by partnering with senior leaders and peers across pyramids to resolve execution-related barriers.
  
  
You will lead product discovery with key stakeholders, validating hypotheses and concepts with customers before committing engineering capacity. You will guide complex work across multiple pyramids and interrelated specialities. You will use data and analytics to assess market context, inform decisions, evaluate product health and effectiveness, understand P&L impact, and provide clear recommendations to key stakeholders.
  
  
You will possess or develop a strong understanding of servicing platforms and systems, including data flows, transaction sequences, relevant technologies, and design principles, to enable innovative and scalable solutions across Target.
  
  
Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.
  
  
**About You**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of product management experience, including experience leading product teams, preferably within retail, consumer, or servicing environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading product-driven business transformation.
* Experience managing product portfolios, investment priorities, budgets, financials, and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of technology, data, analytics, and digital product development.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and align stakeholders across complex, cross-functional organisations.
* Expertise in establishing product vision, outcome-based roadmaps, OKRs, and success measures.
* Demonstrated ability to build, coach, and lead high-performing product teams.
* Expertise in agile product-development practices, including iterative development, discovery, experimentation, and backlog management.

title: Product Management Specialist - Fintech
description:
**Company Description**

FastFlowPe is a two-year-old, bootstrapped payment technology company building smarter payment infrastructure for businesses, with a focus on D2C brands and SaaS companies.

Our flagship product, Fast Checkout, is designed to help businesses improve payment success rates and optimise payment processing through intelligent payment gateway orchestration. By bringing multiple payment gateways together through a unified infrastructure, FastFlowPe helps businesses streamline payment collections, optimise transaction routing, simplify payouts and reconciliation, and deliver a smoother checkout experience.

Our platform combines payment gateway orchestration, smart routing, payment collection infrastructure and operational visibility to help businesses build more efficient and scalable payment operations.

As an early-stage company, we are focused on product innovation, merchant acquisition and building a scalable business. We are looking for entrepreneurial talent ready to take ownership, create new revenue opportunities and help shape FastFlowPe's next phase of growth.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an engineering-first Product Lead to own Fast Checkout's development and user experience, working closely with engineering, design, and business teams.

The ideal candidate combines software engineering experience with strong fintech domain knowledge, an understanding of market dynamics and user behaviour, and proven product execution skills.

You will manage the complete product lifecycle and progressively lead the development of new products, with a growth path toward
**Head of Product**
.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Product Ownership:**
  Manage product roadmaps, requirements, priorities, and feature development.
* **Engineering Collaboration:**
  Work with developers on technical feasibility, APIs, integrations, and implementation.
* **UI/UX:**
  Drive user journeys, wireframes, usability improvements, and intuitive product experiences.
* **Execution:**
  Manage development timelines, sprints, dependencies, releases, and delivery milestones.
* **Cross-functional Coordination:**
  Align engineering, design, sales, and operations teams.
* **Product Optimisation:**
  Use customer feedback, user behaviour, and product metrics to improve checkout conversion and payment success.
* **Fintech & Market Insights:**
  Understand fintech trends, competitive offerings, merchant needs, and evolving payment behaviours.
* **New Product Development:**
  Identify market opportunities and lead the development and launch of new products.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* **3–4 years of software engineering/development experience**
  and
  **1–2 years in Product Management/Product Ownership**
  .
* **At least 2–3 years of experience working in the fintech industry**
  , preferably in payments, payment gateways, payment orchestration, or checkout products.
* Strong understanding of the fintech ecosystem, market trends, merchant needs, and user behaviour.
* Knowledge of payment flows, APIs, integrations, and technical architecture.
* Proven experience managing product development timelines and cross-functional delivery.
* Strong interest in UI/UX, product design, and customer experience.
* Excellent communication, analytical, prioritisation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment.

Career Growth

* **Product Lead:**
  Own Fast Checkout and drive product execution.
* **Portfolio Leadership:**
  Lead new product development and manage multiple product roadmaps.
* **Head of Product:**
  Progress toward ownership of product strategy, portfolio, and team leadership based on demonstrated performance.

Why Join FastFlowPe?

* Own and shape a flagship payments product.
* Work directly with founders and engineering teams.
* Build new products from the ground up.
* Grow into a product leadership role as the company scales.

Application Process

Interested candidates can apply online or email their CV and covering letter to ishita.nema@gofastflowpe.com.

Please include:

* Your software engineering and product management experience.
* Your experience working in the fintech industry.
* An example of a product or feature you have taken from concept to launch.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Manager, Business Consulting**

The BAT practice at EY provides a rewarding career opportunity, targeted towards becoming a professional in delivering exceptional client service and support in Business Development activities. The team is mandated to support pre-deal and origination activities, including pursuits/origination client meeting decks, capital agenda info packs, value creation opportunity packs, industry insight packs, RFP solutioning, deal economics, orals participation, thought leadership packs and idea generation support. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in today’s marketplace, come join our dynamic BAT team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for Managers with experience in Life Sciences and Healthcare sector to join the BAT Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm and help drive revenue growth by working closely with EY stakeholders on new pursuits and support the practice in developing end-to-end proposals and proposal presentations to clients
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Conducting sector-based (Life Sciences and Healthcare) research and working on company documents, Sector PoVs, industry documents and unstructured problem statements
* Identifying sector themes for generating actionable business development analysis focused on Business Consulting and Technology Consulting domain
* Develop in-depth knowledge on Life Sciences & Healthcare sector/sub-sectors, to be able to add value while analyzing financial and strategic information of clients, and identifying opportunities based on market developments
* Undertake quality check (both qualitative and quantitative) to ensure:

+ Output is insightful and as per expectation of onsite teams
+ Delivering within agreed timelines

* Manage/handle multiple pursuits requests at a time and work with cross-functional teams to bring in appropriate expertise as per client needs
* Measure, monitor and improve client service by driving excellence in service delivery
* Develop excellent relationships with regional stakeholders and be responsible for a high degree of client satisfaction with origination process and work products
* Become embedded throughout origination lifecycle from early pursuits to RFP solutioning and delivery hand-off
* Work extensively on driving account growth through functional and sector specialized pitches

**Skills /and Attributes For Success**

* Consulting mindset: Think critically, structure ambiguity, and design solutions that address client challenges while creating measurable outcomes.
* Problem-solving & Analytical rigour: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills necessary for assessing current state and developing data-driven strategies for clients
* Storyboarding: Strong storyboarding skills, and ability to make judgement on filtering out relevant data and information pertaining to client requirements
* Strategic thought process: A strategic mindset to shape innovative, fact-based strategies & operating models; issue-based problem solving to decode & solve complex & unstructured business questions
* Architect Outcomes: Links strategy to execution, ensuring design is fit for purpose
* Custodian of Value: Keeps ROI and adoption at the center, not just “on-time/on-budget”
* AI-Enabled Practitioner: skilled in activating AI use cases and CoEs, ensuring client transformations are future-proof
* Adaptability & resilience: Thrive in dynamic environments, flexing client needs and embracing change with a solution-oriented approach.
* Collaboration & inclusivity: Operate effectively across cultures and time zones, fostering a respectful and team-oriented environment.
* Leadership presence: Demonstrate sound judgment in risk management and escalation; show confidence and credibility in client-facing interactions.

**To qualify for this role:**
**Must Have:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Systems, Engineering, Economics, or Social/Organizational Science and other similar fields; a Master’s degree OR MBA OR Master’s in business administration is preferred.
* 9+ years of relevant work experience
* Past experience in Life Sciences (Pharmaceuticals and MedTech) and Healthcare (Payers/Providers) sectors
* Strong understanding of Tech and AI-led solutions to address client problems
* Experience in Go to market documents, company and/or industry research and thought leadership documents
* Strategy Consulting Projects: The candidate should have experience in working on projects/workstreams such as strategy design, go-to market strategy, investment strategy and feasibility studies, transformation roadmap, competitive benchmarking, revenue and cost management, value creation, operating model strategy, AI-led digital strategy, digital transformation, pricing strategy and performance management framework (all or at least few)
* Business Acumen to drive actionable outcomes for clients with the latest industry trends, innovations & disruptions, metrics & value drivers
* Good Business sense and logical reasoning and should be able to conceptualize research storyboard along with strong PowerPoint and Excel skills
* Self-starter, proactive, comfortable working independently and taking on significant responsibility
* Experienced in presenting findings clearly in reports and other deliverables to clients
* Experience in mentoring, developing talent, and managing direct reports
* Able to simplify complex topics for senior stakeholders; strong written and presentation skills.

**What We Look For**
We look for people who can develop and implement creative solutions to challenging problems and work well with teams to do it. We look for people with an entrepreneurial spirit: innovative by nature, always creating new approaches, products, services, and technologies. Helping clients solve tough problems and implement solutions requires strong intellectual abilities and rigor as well as a practical sense of what works and what does not. We seek people who strive to lead themselves, their teams, and their communities, and who can foster effective teamwork to drive results. Is this you?
  
  
**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. You get to work on inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange.
  
  
Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* Freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
