title: Principal Product Manager, Recovery Orchestration
description:
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**
We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.
  
  
**What To Know**

* Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
* Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com
  
  
**About Commvault**
Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.
  
  
We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own the strategy and execution for our recovery orchestration platform — the layer that automates, sequences, and validates how enterprises bring critical systems back online after an outage, ransomware event, or disaster. This is a build-and-scale mandate: you'll be responsible for unifying what are today somewhat separate capabilities into a single, coherent platform story — with the pricing, packaging, and GTM discipline to make it a durable, high-margin product line, not just a feature bundle. You'll operate at the intersection of enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, and cloud architecture, working with engineering, pricing/finance, field enablement, and customer success to take this from current state to a major platform launch.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Product Strategy & Platform Vision
  
  

* Define and evolve the strategy for a unified recovery orchestration platform spanning multiple cloud workloads (compute, storage, databases) across AWS, Azure, and GCP
* Build the narrative for why orchestrated, tested recovery is a distinct platform capability — not a checkbox feature — for CISOs, infrastructure/DR leaders, and compliance stakeholders
* Own the roadmap sequencing across phased capability delivery

Pricing & Packaging
  
  

* Partner with Finance/Pricing to fix structural pricing issues (cost allocation across platform vs. product SKUs, bundle economics, SaaS vs. software parity) that directly affect adoption and retention
* Build the business case and options analysis for executive/CPO-level pricing decisions, using cost-vs-price framing
* Ensure packaging reflects real customer buying patterns rather than internal architecture boundaries

Cross-Functional Execution
  
  

* Drive a large, multi-team engineering workback (dozens of workstreams across workload teams, UI/UX, and platform) toward a release date
* Identify and escalate real schedule risk early and keep the leadership informed.
* Partner with field enablement and customer success to close the gap between product capability and what's actually sold, deployed, and renewed

Customer & Market Insight
  
  

* Validate positioning and pricing directly with field teams (solutions engineers, field CTOs) and customers — not just internal stakeholders
* Understand the two adjacent buyer personas this platform serves (security/CISO buyers focused on isolated recovery and forensics, and infrastructure/DR buyers focused on operational recovery) and make deliberate calls on how the platform positions to each without diluting either
* Identify new opportunities and problems to solve in the recovery space.

Executive Communication
  
  

* Write clear PRFAQs, business cases, and stakeholder updates for senior leadership audiences
* Present pricing and platform strategy directly to all stakeholders

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline.
* 8+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time in enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud platforms, or data resilience (backup/DR/ransomware recovery adjacent domains)
* Demonstrated experience owning pricing and packaging decisions with measurable business impact (not just feature roadmaps)
* Experience running large, cross-team technical programs with a hard external deadline (multiple engineering teams, dozens of dependencies, workback tracking)
* Strong grasp of cloud infrastructure fundamentals across at least one hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, or GCP) — compute, storage, database recovery patterns
* Track record of building platform narratives for technical, security-conscious enterprise buyers (CISO, VP Infrastructure, Head of DR)
* Excellent written communication — comfortable producing PRDs, PRFAQs, and exec-level business cases independently

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Master's Degree preferred.
* Direct experience with backup, disaster recovery, cyber recovery, or ransomware resilience products
* Familiarity with isolated recovery environment concepts (malware scanning, forensics-safe validation environments)
* Experience managing SKU/pricing structures across SaaS and on-prem/software delivery models
* Background partnering with channel/field enablement teams on complex technical products

title: Group Product Manager
description:
Licious is building the future of fresh meat and seafood in India. We operate at the intersection of
**consumer technology, fresh-food supply chain, operations and last-mile delivery**
, solving some of the most complex problems in the consumer internet space.

With a large and growing daily order base across multiple cities, our last mile is a critical part of both the
**customer experience and business economics**
. We are now investing in building a more technology-led, high-control and scalable last-mile network.

**What makes the role meaty...**

As the
**Group Product Manager**
, you will own the
**end-to-end product charter across Licious' logistics and delivery network — spanning first mile, mid mile and last mile**
, including Delivery Executives (DEs), 3P delivery partners and other frontline stakeholders.

Your charter will be to build and scale the technology that enables Licious to create a
**high-control, intelligent and scalable logistics network**
, while continuously improving customer experience, operational efficiency and unit economics.

You will:

* Own the
  **product roadmap across first mile, mid mile and last mile**
  , covering movement of inventory, order allocation, dispatch, transportation, delivery execution, exceptions and completion.
* Drive improvements in
  **SLA adherence — promised delivery time vs. actual delivery time**
  , cost efficiency and overall logistics unit economics.
* Partner deeply with
  **Supply Chain and Operations**
  to identify ground-level problems across the first, mid and last mile and build technology that improves
  **efficiency, productivity, predictability and control**
  .
* Own and evolve products and applications used by
  **Delivery Executives, frontline teams and logistics partners**
  , including the roadmap for future app-store deployment where relevant.
* Build the next generation of frontline workforce capabilities across
  **hiring, onboarding, L&D, incentives, gamification, engagement and performance tracking**
  .
* Improve the overall
  **Delivery Executive / frontline workforce experience**
  while ensuring a superior customer experience.
* Build frameworks to compare
  **3P vs. owned models**
  across CX, workforce experience, SLA adherence, productivity and unit economics.
* Leverage
  **AI and automation as first principles**
  to rethink how logistics products are designed, operated and scaled — moving beyond simply adding AI features to existing workflows.
* Develop an
  **AI-native product mindset**
  , identifying opportunities where AI agents, intelligent decisioning, predictive systems and automation can fundamentally change operational workflows and improve outcomes.
* Work closely with
  **Engineering, Data, AI/ML, Operations, CX and Business teams**
  to translate complex operational problems into scalable product solutions.
* Use data, experimentation and strong product judgment to identify the biggest levers for improving
  **speed, reliability, productivity and cost efficiency**
  .
* Coach and mentor
  **Product Managers and emerging product leaders**
  , raising the bar on product thinking, execution, stakeholder management and customer-centricity.
* Help shape the technology and operating model that will enable Licious to scale its logistics network across cities while maintaining high levels of
  **control, reliability and profitability**
  .

This is a role where
**Product meets real-world operations at significant scale**
. You will not just build software — you will influence how thousands of orders and inventory movements happen every day, how frontline teams experience the platform, and how Licious balances
**customer experience, operational efficiency and profitability**
.

It is an opportunity to solve problems across the
**entire logistics journey — from the first movement of inventory to the final delivery to the customer**
— while building products that can increasingly leverage
**AI, automation and intelligent decision-making**
.

**We hope that you have…**

**Education**

* A Bachelor's degree in
  **Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or a related discipline**
  .
* An MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is a plus, but
  **strong product experience will be valued over academic credentials**
  .

**Experience**

* **6–8 years of Product Management experience**
  , with meaningful experience owning and scaling products and ideally having led or mentored Product Managers.
* Experience in
  **logistics, supply chain, last-mile delivery, mobility, e-commerce, quick commerce, food delivery, hyperlocal or other operationally intensive businesses**
  .
* Strong understanding of
  **first mile, mid mile and/or last mile operations**
  , including networks, dispatch, order allocation, routing, capacity, SLAs and unit economics.
* Experience building products with a significant
  **ground operations / frontline workforce component**
  .
* Proven ability to use metrics and data to drive outcomes such as
  **on-time delivery, cost per delivery, productivity, utilisation, throughput and customer experience**
  .
* Experience working closely with
  **Operations, Engineering, Data Science/AI, CX and Business teams**
  .
* Strong product thinking and the ability to balance
  **customer needs, operational realities and business economics**
  .
* An
  **AI-native mindset**
  — you naturally think about how AI, automation, agents and intelligent decision-making can fundamentally change the way products and operational workflows are built.
* Experience coaching, mentoring or developing
  **Product Managers and product talent**
  .
* Comfort operating in ambiguous environments where the solution requires a combination of
  **technology, process, AI and operational change**
  .

**It would be great if you have…**

* Built or scaled a
  **Driver / Rider / Delivery Executive / frontline workforce app**
  .
* Experience across
  **first mile, mid mile and last mile**
  logistics or supply-chain products.
* Experience transitioning from or operating across
  **3P and owned delivery/fleet models**
  .
* Experience with
  **workforce management, gig-worker platforms or frontline workforce products**
  .
* Exposure to
  **incentives, gamification, engagement or productivity management**
  for frontline teams.
* Experience scaling products across
  **multiple cities and high daily transaction volumes**
  .
* Exposure to
  **routing, dispatch optimisation, ETA prediction, logistics optimisation or network planning**
  .
* Experience using
  **AI/ML, intelligent automation or agentic workflows**
  to solve operational or customer problems.
* A track record of
  **coaching and mentoring product talent**
  and building a strong product culture.

title: Product Manager
description:
**How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)**
**Role Summary**
The International Enablement team is seeking a Product Manager to define what we measure and how we track it across Delta’s digital platforms, including the Fly Delta App, delta.com, and our airport kiosks. Sitting at the intersection of product, business, and data, this role owns the measurement strategy for digital and international customer experiences – determining the metrics and KPIs the product team needs, then partnering with data engineers to source, model, and deliver.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**

* Lead dashboard strategy and design, transforming complex data into intuitive, insight-driven experiences that support business decision-making.
* Develop customer journey measurement frameworks, defining funnel KPIs, key interaction points, and supporting data requirements.
* Translate business needs into scalable data strategies, data products, dashboards, and analytical solutions.
* Own the analytics product backlog, prioritizing features and capabilities based on customer value, business impact, and technical feasibility.
* Lead the lifecycle of analytics products from discovery and definition through delivery, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.
* Define and communicate the vision, strategy, and roadmap for international analytics and measurement capabilities.
* Develop customer journey measurement frameworks, defining funnel KPIs, key interaction points, and supporting data requirements.
* Define the metrics, KPIs, and measurement framework that the product team needs to track the digital customer experience, servicing performance, and outcomes
* Establish and govern standardized metric definitions, classifications, and units of measure to ensure a single source of truth across teams
* Identify gaps in current data availability and define the requirements needed to close them
* Develop and execute enablement strategies that support Delta’s international growth and partner success
* Serve as a liaison between Delta and global partners to ensure alignment on technology integration and customer experience goals
* Create and own a cross-domain international technical roadmap and centralized backlog
* Collaborate with Commercial and IT teams to implement scalable solutions for international operations and partner engagement
* Evaluate enterprise-wide tradeoffs and make decisions that optimize reliability and partner outcomes
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI and Generative AI related use cases that enhance customer experience, operational efficiency and business outcomes.
* Partner with Data Science, Engineering, and Business teams to translate AI opportunities into scalable product capabilities and measurable value.
* Drive the integration of AI and machine learning capabilities into data products, analytics platforms, and decision-support solutions.

**What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)**

* 15+ years of IT experience, including 5+ years of Product Management experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, MBA or a related field.
* Experience working in Agile product development environments and partnering with IT & engineering teams to deliver iterative value.
* Experience with SQL databases for verification, testing.
* Ability to develop and own technical solutions in collaboration with commercial organizations and IT, from ideation to implementation
* Working knowledge of web/app analytics and tagging platforms (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Quantum metric, Google Analytics/GA4, Amplitude, or similar) and how instrumentation decisions affect downstream data quality.
* Ability to build good connections within Delta’s commercial and IT departments, as well as with external vendors
* Intellectually curious, highly motivated, and willing to challenge the status quo
* Can cut through ambiguity, identify solutions, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand and support complex systems, integrations, and data flows
* Excellent written and verbal skills and ability to communicate effectively with all levels of Delta’s organization
* Strong analytical and data skills
* Familiarity with AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, or analytics-driven models and AI platforms and ecosystems, including Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, AWS Sagemaker, Databricks or cloud-based machine learning services.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Ability to champion a collaborative environment by empowering team members, demonstrating resilience, being inclusive and building a culture of trust.
* Ability to build and sustain robust networks across internal and external stakeholders.
* Being a coach/mentor/advisor to drive continuous team development and growth.
* Use systemic thinking to drive business results and strategic decisions that enhance organizational outcomes.
* Ability to advocate for customer-focused innovations, model empathy in decision-making, inspiring others to approach problems from the customer’s perspective and decisions that reflect an uncompromising commitment to customer safety, fostering trust and loyalty.

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Familiarity with modern data platforms (Teradata, AWS & Azure).
* Working knowledge of SQL, data warehousing, ETL/ELT processes, and business intelligence tools(Tableau, PowerBI etc).
* Experience building executive dashboards and enterprise-wide measurement frameworks.
* Working knowledge of airlines and airline tools, processes, and data is strongly preferred
* Experience leading multiple projects with limited supervision and making well-informed priority tradeoffs
* Ability to work well with and rally diverse teams around the globe.
* Track record of delivering thoughtful solutions while meeting or exceeding deadlines
* Experience delivering AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, or analytics-driven products at an enterprise environment.

**About The Company**
What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service.
  
  
Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good.
  
  
In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. Delta was named to Glassdoor’s 2026 Top 100 Best Places to Work list for the ninth time, standing as the only airline recognized. Delta also secured the 11th spot on Fortune’s World’s Most Admired Companies list, marking its 13th consecutive year earning this distinction. Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience.
  
  
**About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore**
The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future Of Aviation. The organization is certified by the Great Place to Work Institute (India). The Delta Technology Hub was a finalist for the iVolunteer Awards 2024/2025 in the "Leader in Employee Volunteering" category. This nomination highlights our remarkable volunteering initiatives and the outstanding practices we implement to encourage and support our employee volunteering program.
  
  
For more information, please visit www.deltatechhub.com
  
  
**Why join?**

* Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience.
* Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs –exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships.
* Immerse yourself in an employee-centric culture.
* Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting-edge technology driven solutions.
* Avail a full range of benefits that support you and your family: Medical Insurance, Transportation to and from the DTH office, Complementary Cafeteria Meals, Special Travel opportunities and Travel Privileges, Car Lease Program, Paid time off, Parental Benefits and National Pension Scheme.

title: Product Manager -  Generalist
description:
**About Reo**
**Who we are**
Reo.Dev is a modern revenue stack for Developer focused companies. We help Developer Tool companies identify which Engineering Teams have an Urgent need for their product and the highest likelihood of conversion. We capture and analyze a wide array of developer activity data from Github, Docs, Docker Installs, Communities, other dev specific sources and convert them to sales signals.
  
  
Read more here: https://app.notion.com/p/roverly/About-Reo-Dev-18c33e0c3ba2808280f8e4235365a052
  
  
**Great! Now let’s talk about You and this Role! 🙌**
🎉
**What will you be working on?**
We’re looking for a Product Manager to join our early team and work directly with the founders to shape the future of Reo.Dev.
  
  
This role will focus on improving the onboarding and self-serve journeys within the product — specifically the first 90 days of user experience and early customer success — while also owning broader product initiatives across the platform.
  
  
Some of your work will include:
  
  

* Own end-to-end product development for key product areas — from discovery to launch
* Drive onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention initiatives across the product journey
* Work closely with founders, engineering, and design to ship fast, iterate continuously, and improve user experience
* Deeply understand user workflows, friction points, and customer needs through user conversations and product analytics
* Translate business and user problems into clear product requirements and execution plans
* Prioritize ruthlessly and focus on initiatives that create maximum customer and business impact
* Define product requirements, write detailed specs, manage sprint execution, and maintain strong documentation
* Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, sales, and customer-facing teams
* Drive product decisions using data, experimentation, and customer insights
* Contribute to product strategy, roadmap planning, and long-term product vision
* Work on complex AI and data-driven workflows powering developer and GTM intelligence

**👯
**Skills we are looking for in this role****
This is a key role at Reo.Dev and we are looking for ambitious people who want to help build the company through its next phase of growth.
  
  
We are specifically looking for candidates who:
  
  

* Have 5+ years of Product Management experience in early-stage tech startups
* Have strong experience in B2B SaaS products, ideally with exposure to PLG/self-serve product journeys
* Have worked on onboarding, activation, adoption, retention, or product growth initiatives
* Have experience working on complex systems and not just linear workflow products
* Are highly analytical and comfortable using product and usage data to drive decisions
* Can operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving startup environments
* Have strong product thinking, prioritization, communication, and execution skills
* Are highly hands-on and comfortable working closely with engineering and design teams
* Have exposure to AI products, developer tools, data products, or intelligence systems
* Have independently driven product initiatives from ideation to launch

**Preferred backgrounds:**

* B2B SaaS
* PLG SaaS
* Developer tools
* AI products
* Bottom-up SaaS products
* Growth/onboarding-focused PM roles

**👯
**What qualities we look for in our team members?****
While there is no stencil for the type of people we like, there are a few traits that might make Reo.Dev a better fit for you.
  
  
**Reo.Dev**
**might be a good fit if you:**

* Work hard, hands-on (that’s very important to us!) and want to grow really fast.
* Care about your work a great deal, find it highly unsettling if the quality of work is even slightly sub-par.
* Execute fast.
* Are hands on (we will not have elaborate reporting structures for the foreseeable future and hopefully ever).
* Are someone people like to work with, low on ego, high on humility.
* Have the ability to fail, learn and keep trying till you win. Start-ups are tough and we will not get everything right the first time.
* Have a longish view of your career growth and not optimising for the next 1-2 years.

title: Head Sales & Business Development - Railways
description:
****About SKF****

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit : www.skf.com /in

****About Industrial Markets****

The industrial market in India is a dynamic and rapidly evolving sector that plays a crucial role in a company’s economic growth, with the manufacturing sector being the most diverse and promising. Industrial customers aim to improve operational efficiency while prioritising quality, reliability, and value collaborations that demonstrate a commitment to customer satisfaction and address their evolving needs.

At SKF, we provide industry-leading engineering solutions and technologies to industrial market that consistently deliver reliability and efficiency in their day-to-day operations. We cater to a range of industrial sectors, including heavy industries, wind, metals, railways, and general machinery, and help customers achieve their key objectives, depending on their specific application needs and challenges around the machines and equipment.

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

Team Management

Bangalore

Evolve business strategies relevant to his/her market and implement marketing and pricing strategies to ensure profitable growth of the business with effective customer relationship management

Capacity to relate to all levels with customers and strong negotiating skills.

Experience of business development process in B2B.

Decision maker.

Manufacturing

Customers

**margaret.hirekerur@skf.com**

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

title: Sales Director
description:

title: Direct Sales Associate
description:
**About Us:** Founded in 2014, Vedantu emerged as a visionary in the ed-tech space, pioneering the shift towards online education in India. Our name, derived from 'Veda' (knowledge) and 'Tantu' (network), reflects our mission: to create a vast network of knowledge accessible to all. We embarked on a journey to transform the educational landscape, leveraging technology to make quality education available, affordable, and personalized.

**Our Leaders:** Vedantu`s founders Vamsi Krishna, Anand Prakash, and Pulkit Jain did their first venture in education, Lakshya, in 2006 which later got acquired by a listed company called MT Educare (Mahesh Tutorials) in 2012. As part of Lakshya, the founders taught and mentored more than 10,000 students and trained more than 200 teachers between them.

**Summary of the Role:** We are looking for highly motivated, energetic, and result-oriented Direct Sales Associates to join our high-growth EdTech sales team in Bengaluru and Chennai. In this role, you will be the face of the company, directly interacting with parents and students to understand their educational gaps and pitch our premium learning solutions.This is a hardcore direct role requiring a blend of persistent tele-calling, virtual counseling and field consulting to meet monthly revenue milestones.

● **Educational Counseling:** Act as an academic consultant by identifying the specific learning needs of students, mapping them to our courses, and conducting impactful product demonstrations.  
● **End-to-End Sales Closure:** Manage the complete sales pipeline from first contact, overcoming customer objections, to final payment collection and onboarding.

● **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English.  
● **Proficiency in local languages** (Kannada for Bengaluru / Tamil for Chennai) is highly desirable to build a local connection.  
● **Mindset:** High resilience, target-driven attitude, and ability to handle intense market rejection.  
● **Logistics:** Willingness to work on a rotational roster, including weekends (Saturdays & Sundays are critical business days in EdTech)

**What’s in it for You?**  
**Uncapped Incentives:** Direct correlation between your hard work and earning potential with best-in-industry monthly incentive structures.  
**Fast-Track Growth:** Performance-linked promotions enabling top performers to step up into Team Lead or Sales Manager roles within 12–18 months.  
**Comprehensive Training:** Robust 1 week sales boot camp covering product knowledge, consumer psychology, and consultative selling frameworks.

Pay: ₹350,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Analyst - Forecasting
description:

Contract type Full time

**Why choose AstraZeneca India?**
---------------------------------

Help push the boundaries of science to deliver life-changing medicines to patients. After 45 years in India, we’re continuing to secure a future where everyone can access affordable, sustainable, innovative healthcare.

The part you play in our business will be challenging, yet rewarding, requiring you to use your resilient, collaborative and diplomatic skillsets to make connections. The majority of your work will be field based, and will require you to be highly-organised, planning your monthly schedule, attending meetings and calls, as well as writing up reports.

**Who do we look for?**
-----------------------

Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. At AstraZeneca, breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicine for the world's most complex diseases. We empower people like you to push the boundaries of science, challenge convention, and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. You'll embrace differences and take bold actions to drive the change needed to meet global healthcare and sustainability challenges.

Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting-edge technology. Whether you join us in Bengaluru or Chennai, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.

**Success Profile**
-------------------

Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.

### **Tech innovators**

Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.

### **Ownership takers**

If you're a self-aware self-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.

### **Challenge seekers**

Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.

### **Proactive collaborators**

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-262639 **Date posted** 10/25/2026

**GCL : D1**
------------

**Introduction to role:**
-------------------------

Are you ready to turn complex data into clear, confident decisions that shape the future of life-changing medicines? In this role, you will develop patient, volume, and revenue forecasts for strategic brands and early assets across Global priority markets and the US—work that directly informs brand strategy, investment decisions, and how we reach patients faster!

Based at Manyata Tech Park, Bangalore on a hybrid schedule (three days a week in office) with a 2 PM - 11 PM IST shift, you will partner closely with forecasting leadership and Commercial teams. You will build and own models that set performance expectations, provide clarity on risk and opportunity, and guide cross-functional teams toward decisive action. Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where your analysis sparks strategy and your point of view earns trust?

**Accountabilities:**
---------------------

* Develop and own forecast models. Build, validate, and maintain strong short-term and long-term models. These models reflect current data, assumptions, and market dynamics for key brands and initial assets.
* Decision Support: Translate insights into clear recommendations, expertly defend methodologies and assumptions, and influence cross-functional collaborators with clear logic and quantified confidence.
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Align forecast assumptions and analytical outputs with partners in Marketing, Sales, Market Access and Pricing, Finance, Analytics, and Sales Operations to ensure a single, trusted view of demand.
* New Product Introduction: Develop volume forecasts for launches to feed strategic and operational planning, informing resourcing, supply, and market activation.
* Data and Methodology Difficulty: Identify and apply the right data sources and industry-leading approaches; integrate primary research and secondary data to ensure objectivity and comprehensive coverage.
* Sensitivity and Scenario Analysis: Conduct simulations and ranges (including Monte Carlo as appropriate) to clarify uncertainty, quantify upside/downside, and support risk management.
* Global Pipeline and Early Assets: Create new forecast frameworks as business needs emerge for pipeline assets, lifecycle management, and business development opportunities.
* US Planning Cadence: For US-focused work, participate in S&OP processes, submit volumes, and build weekly, monthly, and annual models and conversions aligned to commercial rhythms.
* Continuous Improvement: Evolve forecasting capabilities through innovation in methodologies, automation, and tools; champion standard processes that improve speed, reliability, and decision quality.
* Documentation and Communication: Deliver forecasts with clear, accessible documentation of assumptions, confidence levels, and key drivers; proactively surface issues that matter to the business.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field
* 6+ years of direct Pharmaceutical forecasting experience with an in-depth knowledge of forecasting techniques, models and approaches
* Good understanding of multiple disease areas, with experience in rare diseases/ OBU including how patients move through their respective diagnosis and treatment pathways, including treatment dynamics
* Experience integrating insights from market research and secondary data analysis into forecast assumptions
* Experience using a range of data sources and analytics involving standard data in the Pharmaceutical industry – e.g. IQVIA (MIDAS, DDD NPA, Monthly Xponent), claims data (Truven, Marketscan), epidemiological data, etc. For US forecasting, experience with TRx / NBRx / NRx data and methodologies
* Strong analytical expertise; excellent Excel, financial modelling and forecasting skills
* Ability to build trusted relationships across a range of partner groups including Marketing, Analytics, Operations, and Technology
* Confirmed experience in problem solving and continuous improvement
* Strong written and verbal communication

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred (e.g., PhD, MBA, Masters)
* Knowledge and experience in sophisticated statistical forecast methodologies and applied AI / ML / automation
* Experience working with Power Apps, specifically PowerBI
* For US forecasting, confirmed understanding of US Market Access and gross-to-net

--------------------

Join a high-performing, digitally savvy community where bold thinking is encouraged and supported. Here,unexpected teams come together to ignite bold ideas, using advanced technology and data to accelerate decisions impacting patients. You will have the freedom to think differently, take balanced risks, and see your work drive tangible change across the enterprise. We value persistence alongside ambition, and you will grow your craft by learning from bright minds who challenge and support one another every day.

-------------------

Bring your forecasting expertise to where it makes a difference—apply today to build models that guide bold decisions and improve patient outcomes!

title: Field Sales Manager – Mysore
company: Steel On Call Services (India) Private Limited
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
===================

**Field Sales Manager – B2C Sales (Steel Industry)**
----------------------------------------------------

**Company:** Steel on Call Services India Private Limited

**Department:** Sales & Business Development

**Designation:** Field Sales Manager – B2C

**Industry:** Steel / Iron & Steel – Mandatory

**Experience:** 6–10 Years

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Reporting To:** General Manager / Senior Management

**Work Location:** (Territory-Based) - Mysore/ Channapatna/ Ramanagara

### **1. Job Purpose**

The Field Sales Manager – B2C will be responsible for driving sales growth, developing new customers, managing assigned territories, and expanding the company's presence in the retail steel market. The role involves direct field sales, customer relationship management, dealer and retailer network development, lead generation, and achieving sales targets across assigned territories.

### **2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Territory Sales Management**

* Manage and develop assigned territories to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
* Identify potential markets, new business opportunities, and untapped customer segments.
* Prepare territory-wise sales plans and execute strategies to increase market penetration.
* Conduct regular field visits to monitor market conditions, customer requirements, and competitor activities.
* Ensure effective coverage of all key locations within the assigned territory.

**B. B2C Sales & Customer Acquisition**

* Generate sales from individual customers, homeowners, contractors, fabricators, and small construction businesses.
* Identify and convert potential customers for steel products, including TMT bars, structural steel, MS products, and other relevant steel materials.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with retail customers and end users.
* Generate leads through field visits, references, local networking, and other sales channels.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable products based on their needs.

**C. Dealer, Retailer & Channel Development**

* Develop and maintain relationships with local steel dealers, retailers, fabricators, and contractors to support B2C sales.
* Identify potential channel partners and expand the company's customer network.
* Build a strong referral network to generate repeat business and new leads.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely order processing and customer service.

**D. Sales Planning & Target Achievement**

* Achieve assigned sales targets, revenue goals, and customer acquisition objectives.
* Prepare daily visit plans, weekly sales reports, and monthly territory performance reports.
* Track sales pipelines, follow up on leads, and ensure timely conversion of enquiries into orders.
* Monitor sales performance and implement corrective actions wherever required.
* Maintain accurate customer information, sales records, and market intelligence.

**E. Payment Follow-Up & Customer Service**

* Coordinate with customers and internal teams regarding order status, delivery schedules, and product availability.
* Follow up on outstanding payments and support timely collections in accordance with company policies.
* Resolve customer concerns and ensure a positive buying experience.
* Develop long-term customer relationships to encourage repeat purchases and referrals.

**F. Market Research & Competition Analysis**

* Monitor competitor pricing, product availability, promotional activities, and market trends.
* Identify new growth opportunities within assigned territories.
* Provide regular feedback to management regarding customer preferences, demand patterns, and market developments.

### **3. Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing, or a related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Marketing or Sales will be an added advantage.

### **4. Required Experience & Skills**

* 6–10 years of experience in field sales, preferably in the steel or iron and steel industry.
* Mandatory experience in steel product sales and territory management.
* Strong understanding of the retail steel market and B2C customer acquisition.
* Proven track record of achieving sales targets and expanding customer networks.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to independently manage territories and travel extensively for field sales.
* Strong lead-generation, sales planning, and follow-up capabilities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, reporting tools, and CRM software is preferred.
* A valid two-wheeler or four-wheeler driving licence and own vehicle will be an advantage, depending on company requirements.

### **5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Achievement of monthly and annual sales targets.
* Number of new customers acquired.
* Territory-wise revenue growth and market penetration.
* Number of customer visits and qualified leads generated.
* Lead-to-order conversion rate.
* Repeat customer business and customer retention.
* Timely payment collections and reduction in overdue receivables.
* Accuracy and timeliness of sales reports.

### **6. Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should be a target-driven sales professional with strong field execution skills, hands-on experience in steel sales, and the ability to independently manage assigned territories. The candidate must be proactive in acquiring new B2C customers, developing local market networks, and driving sustainable sales growth.

### **7. Compensation**

Salary and incentives will be based on the candidate's experience, current compensation, and suitability for the role.

### **8. How to Apply**

Interested candidates with 6–10 years of relevant steel industry sales experience and a proven track record in B2C sales and territory management are encouraged to apply.

Our mission? To empower B2B companies with a smooth, consistent, and efficient way to onboard customers and manage client projects—reducing chaos and boosting customer satisfaction across industries.

1. Collaborate with Customer Success teams to ensure continued value realization for customers.

* Results-driven professional with
  **10+ years of experience**
  in project/program management, service delivery, and stakeholder engagement.

title: Channel Sales Manager
description:
**ABOUT HEXNODE**

Hexnode is a global leader in Unified Endpoint Management (UEM), trusted by over 100 countries and managing millions of devices worldwide. With a rapid pace of innovation, we have established ourselves as a dominant force across Apple, Windows, Android, macOS, Linux, and tvOS.

**WHY HEXNODE?**

Hexnode is a rare combination of global scale, product excellence, and startup-level velocity. We operate in a mission-critical category—supporting organizations that rely on secure, reliable device management every single day. Joining Hexnode means stepping into a company in hyper-growth mode. With millions of devices under management and 100+ annual feature releases, you will have the opportunity to shape the next phase of a category-defining platform.

**THE ROLE**

As a Channel Sales Manager, you will drive high-velocity pipeline creation and revenue growth through a strategic partner ecosystem across India. You will be responsible for the full partnership lifecycle: recruiting, enabling, and co-selling with top-tier VARs, MSPs, SIs, and Distributors to win enterprise accounts. You will engage key decisionmakers in IT, Cybersecurity, and Endpoint Infrastructure, establishing Hexnode as the partner solution of choice across the region.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Identify, onboard, and activate strategic partners (VARs, MSPs, SIs, and Distributors) across key Indian tech hubs.
* Jointly drive mid-market and enterprise deals, navigating complex buyer groups (1,000 to 10,000+ employees) to ensure successful deal closures.
* Conduct technical and commercial enablement sessions, pitch coaching, product demos, and competitive positioning against legacy UEM vendors.
* Collaborate on partner campaigns, co-marketing/MDF initiatives, and referral frameworks while maintaining a predictable pipeline forecast in CRM.
* Partner closely with internal Solutions Engineers, Direct Sales, Product, and Support teams to clear deal blockers and deliver smooth customer onboarding.

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years of hands-on B2B Channel Sales / Partner Management experience within SaaS, Cybersecurity, Cloud, or Enterprise IT Infrastructure.
* Demonstrated success in managing 2-tier distribution channels (Distributor/Reseller/MSP) and maintaining an individual or joint channel revenue quota.
* Strong track record of co-selling into Mid-Market and Commercial Enterprise segments across assigned territory.
* Established contacts and familiarity with regional VARs, System Integrators, and MSP networks (exposure to Apple-focused or Education resellers is a plus).
* Outstanding presentation and negotiation skills, with the ability to translate technical product value into clear partner business cases.
* Deep understanding of the Indian B2B tech buying behavior, enterprise IT procurement cycles, and regional business practices.
* Willingness to travel regionally for key partner meetings, QBRs, and joint customer visits.

title: Senior Product Manager, IX
description:
**Job Requirements**
**About Phenom**
Our purpose is to help a billion people find the right work! Phenom is an AI-powered talent experience platform redefining the HR technology landscape. We have grown into a global organization with offices in six countries and over 1,500 employees. As an HR tech unicorn, innovation and creativity are embedded in our DNA. Join us in making every talent moment phenomenal!
  
  
**Job Summary**
As a
**Senior Product Manager – IX (Integration Experience)**
at Phenom, you will drive the strategy, development, and launch of integration-focused products that enable seamless connectivity across enterprise platforms and deliver exceptional candidate and customer experiences.
  
  
You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to define product vision, translate customer needs into scalable solutions, and build developer-friendly integration experiences. The ideal candidate will bring strong product management expertise, hands-on understanding of integration platforms, workflows, APIs, No-Code/Low-Code platforms, Applied AI, and metadata management concepts.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Product Strategy & Vision: Define and execute the product roadmap, establish product vision, prioritize initiatives, and translate business objectives into measurable outcomes.
* Integration Experience: Drive the development of enterprise integration solutions, including Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS), API-centric products, and frameworks that enable seamless connectivity across enterprise applications.
* Workflow Orchestration: Build an understanding of workflow automation, orchestration, and configuration capabilities that streamline complex business processes across connected systems.
* No-Code/Low-Code Platforms: Drive product capabilities that enable users and developers to build, configure, and manage integrations and workflows with minimal coding.
* Applied AI: Identify opportunities to leverage Applied AI in integration experiences, workflow automation, intelligent data mapping, configuration, and troubleshooting.
* Metadata Management: Understand metadata models, schemas, mappings, transformations, and governance concepts to enable consistent, reliable, and scalable data exchange across enterprise systems.
* API & Developer Experience: Drive developer-focused and API-centric products, including API consumption, web services, authentication, data synchronization, error handling, monitoring, and documentation.
* Enterprise HR Integrations: Enable reliable data synchronization between enterprise HR systems, Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS), and other talent acquisition platforms.
* Customer & Market Insights: Engage with customers, partners, and internal development teams to understand business needs, identify product gaps, and translate feedback into product improvements.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver high-quality products from ideation through launch and continuous improvement.
* Agile Product Delivery: Manage product backlogs, user stories, prioritization, and releases using JIRA or equivalent tools and Agile/Scrum/Kanban methodologies.
* Product Adoption & Performance: Define success metrics, analyze product usage and performance, make data-driven decisions, and continuously improve integration reliability, usability, and customer satisfaction.
* Stakeholder Communication: Communicate product vision, strategy, and roadmap through effective storytelling and collaborate with global teams in a fast-paced environment.

**What You've Done**

* 7+ years of experience in product management, preferably in SaaS, enterprise technology, HR technology, or recruitment technology.
* Proven experience building, launching, and managing products from ideation to market adoption.
* Strong understanding of integration platforms (iPaaS), enterprise integrations, APIs, web services, and data synchronization across enterprise applications.
* Experience building or managing integration frameworks and developer-focused or API-centric products.
* Understanding of workflows, workflow automation, orchestration, and business process configuration.
* Experience working with or building No-Code/Low-Code platforms, preferably with hands-on exposure to integration and workflow capabilities.
* Understanding of Applied AI concepts and their potential applications in product experiences, automation, and intelligent integrations.
* Knowledge of metadata management, including schemas, data models, mapping, transformation, and data consistency across connected systems.
* Experience integrating enterprise HR systems, such as ATS, HRIS, CRM, and other talent acquisition or workforce platforms.
* Strong understanding of candidate experience and its impact on recruitment, talent acquisition, and employer branding.
* Proficiency in product development tools such as JIRA and experience with Agile, Scrum, or Kanban methodologies.
* Excellent product storytelling, strategic thinking, roadmap planning, prioritization, and data-driven decision-making skills.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and collaborate effectively with customers, engineering teams, and international stakeholders.
* Experience working in a startup, scale-up, or other fast-paced technology environment.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

**Benefits**

* Health and wellness benefits and programs to support holistic employee well-being.
* Flexible working hours and schedules, along with parental leave for new parents.
* Career development opportunities in a growing, innovative organization.
* A collaborative and inclusive work environment with perks and benefits across our global locations.

**Diversity, Equity & Inclusion**
Our commitment to diversity runs deep! Diversity is essential to building phenomenal teams, products, and customer experiences. Phenom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, taking collective action to create an inclusive environment where every candidate and employee feels welcomed, valued, and empowered. We recognize that building a more inclusive workplace is an ongoing journey, and we remain committed to continuous progress.

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

title: Field Sales Manager - Secunderabad
company: Steel On Call Services (India) Private Limited
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
===================

**Field Sales Manager – B2C Sales (Steel Industry)**
----------------------------------------------------

**Company:** Steel on Call Services India Private Limited

**Department:** Sales & Business Development

**Designation:** Field Sales Manager – B2C

**Industry:** Steel / Iron & Steel – Mandatory

**Experience:** 6–7 Years

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Reporting To:** General Manager / Senior Management

**Work Location:** (Territory-Based) - Secunderabad / Rangareddy

### **1. Job Purpose**

The Field Sales Manager – B2C will be responsible for driving sales growth, developing new customers, managing assigned territories, and expanding the company's presence in the retail steel market. The role involves direct field sales, customer relationship management, dealer and retailer network development, lead generation, and achieving sales targets across assigned territories.

### **2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Territory Sales Management**

* Manage and develop assigned territories to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
* Identify potential markets, new business opportunities, and untapped customer segments.
* Prepare territory-wise sales plans and execute strategies to increase market penetration.
* Conduct regular field visits to monitor market conditions, customer requirements, and competitor activities.
* Ensure effective coverage of all key locations within the assigned territory.

**B. B2C Sales & Customer Acquisition**

* Generate sales from individual customers, homeowners, contractors, fabricators, and small construction businesses.
* Identify and convert potential customers for steel products, including TMT bars, structural steel, MS products, and other relevant steel materials.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with retail customers and end users.
* Generate leads through field visits, references, local networking, and other sales channels.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable products based on their needs.

**C. Dealer, Retailer & Channel Development**

* Develop and maintain relationships with local steel dealers, retailers, fabricators, and contractors to support B2C sales.
* Identify potential channel partners and expand the company's customer network.
* Build a strong referral network to generate repeat business and new leads.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely order processing and customer service.

**D. Sales Planning & Target Achievement**

* Achieve assigned sales targets, revenue goals, and customer acquisition objectives.
* Prepare daily visit plans, weekly sales reports, and monthly territory performance reports.
* Track sales pipelines, follow up on leads, and ensure timely conversion of enquiries into orders.
* Monitor sales performance and implement corrective actions wherever required.
* Maintain accurate customer information, sales records, and market intelligence.

**E. Payment Follow-Up & Customer Service**

* Coordinate with customers and internal teams regarding order status, delivery schedules, and product availability.

title: Principal Product Manager, Recovery Orchestration
description:
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**
We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.
  
  
**What To Know**

* Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
* Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com
  
  
**About Commvault**
Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.
  
  
We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own the strategy and execution for our recovery orchestration platform — the layer that automates, sequences, and validates how enterprises bring critical systems back online after an outage, ransomware event, or disaster. This is a build-and-scale mandate: you'll be responsible for unifying what are today somewhat separate capabilities into a single, coherent platform story — with the pricing, packaging, and GTM discipline to make it a durable, high-margin product line, not just a feature bundle. You'll operate at the intersection of enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, and cloud architecture, working with engineering, pricing/finance, field enablement, and customer success to take this from current state to a major platform launch.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Product Strategy & Platform Vision
  
  

* Define and evolve the strategy for a unified recovery orchestration platform spanning multiple cloud workloads (compute, storage, databases) across AWS, Azure, and GCP
* Build the narrative for why orchestrated, tested recovery is a distinct platform capability — not a checkbox feature — for CISOs, infrastructure/DR leaders, and compliance stakeholders
* Own the roadmap sequencing across phased capability delivery

Pricing & Packaging
  
  

* Partner with Finance/Pricing to fix structural pricing issues (cost allocation across platform vs. product SKUs, bundle economics, SaaS vs. software parity) that directly affect adoption and retention
* Build the business case and options analysis for executive/CPO-level pricing decisions, using cost-vs-price framing
* Ensure packaging reflects real customer buying patterns rather than internal architecture boundaries

Cross-Functional Execution
  
  

* Drive a large, multi-team engineering workback (dozens of workstreams across workload teams, UI/UX, and platform) toward a release date
* Identify and escalate real schedule risk early and keep the leadership informed.
* Partner with field enablement and customer success to close the gap between product capability and what's actually sold, deployed, and renewed

Customer & Market Insight
  
  

* Validate positioning and pricing directly with field teams (solutions engineers, field CTOs) and customers — not just internal stakeholders
* Understand the two adjacent buyer personas this platform serves (security/CISO buyers focused on isolated recovery and forensics, and infrastructure/DR buyers focused on operational recovery) and make deliberate calls on how the platform positions to each without diluting either
* Identify new opportunities and problems to solve in the recovery space.

Executive Communication
  
  

* Write clear PRFAQs, business cases, and stakeholder updates for senior leadership audiences
* Present pricing and platform strategy directly to all stakeholders

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline.
* 8+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time in enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud platforms, or data resilience (backup/DR/ransomware recovery adjacent domains)
* Demonstrated experience owning pricing and packaging decisions with measurable business impact (not just feature roadmaps)
* Experience running large, cross-team technical programs with a hard external deadline (multiple engineering teams, dozens of dependencies, workback tracking)
* Strong grasp of cloud infrastructure fundamentals across at least one hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, or GCP) — compute, storage, database recovery patterns
* Track record of building platform narratives for technical, security-conscious enterprise buyers (CISO, VP Infrastructure, Head of DR)
* Excellent written communication — comfortable producing PRDs, PRFAQs, and exec-level business cases independently

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Master's Degree preferred.
* Direct experience with backup, disaster recovery, cyber recovery, or ransomware resilience products
* Familiarity with isolated recovery environment concepts (malware scanning, forensics-safe validation environments)
* Experience managing SKU/pricing structures across SaaS and on-prem/software delivery models
* Background partnering with channel/field enablement teams on complex technical products

Commvault is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are always committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status and we will not discriminate against on the basis of such characteristics or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we work.
  
  
Commvault’s goal is to make interviewing inclusive and accessible to all candidates and employees. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to participate in the interview process or apply for a position at Commvault, please email accommodations@commvault.com For any inquiries not related to an accommodation please reach out to wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com.

title: Brand Manager: Castrol Activ
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the team:**
As the Brand & Product Lead for Castrol Activ, you will shape the growth of the brand, with end-to-end responsibility across brand, product portfolio and commercial performance.
  
  
You will work closely with Sales, Product, R&D, Supply Chain, Finance, Insights and regional/global Marketing teams to translate consumer and market opportunities into winning brand and product plans.
  
  
On the product side, you will lead the Activ portfolio across its lifecycle, identifying opportunities for innovation and portfolio optimization. You will balance consumer needs, competitive positioning, pricing, cost and gross margin considerations to build a stronger and more future-ready portfolio.
  
  
On the brand side, you will shape and innovate the brand in line with evolving trends and consumer needs, translating the brand proposition into compelling campaigns and activation across ATL, digital, BTL and other consumer touchpoints.
  
  
Overall, the role combines brand building, portfolio strategy, commercial ownership and execution to drive the next phase of growth for Castrol Activ.
  
  
**Key tasks:**

* Own the business and financial performance of Castrol Activ, delivering targeted volume, revenue and gross margin objectives.
* Lead the Activ portfolio across both bikes and scooter engine oils, defining the role and growth agenda for the portfolio.
* Develop and execute the brand and portfolio strategy, balancing near-term business priorities with long-term growth opportunities.
* Lead the product lifecycle, innovation and portfolio optimization, responding to evolving consumer needs, market trends and OEM developments.
* Innovate and strengthen the Activ brand in line with emerging consumer and category trends, ensuring continued relevance and differentiation.
* Drive market share and brand equity performance, using consumer insights and other relevant market and brand health indicators to identify opportunities and actions.
* Lead the development and execution of integrated brand communication across ATL, digital, media, BTL and consumer activation.
* Partner closely with Sales and Channel Marketing to translate brand and portfolio strategy into strong regional, channel and in-market execution.
* Lead key product development and commercialization processes, working cross-functionally with R&D, Supply Chain, Finance and other stakeholders.
* Own ASP investment planning and effectiveness, including budget allocation, expenditure tracking and measurement of returns.
* Lead relationships with creative, media, research and other agency partners, ensuring high-quality execution against brand and business objectives.

**Experience required:**

* University degree in Engineering, Marketing, Business or a related discipline; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification desirable.
* Minimum 6 years of relevant Sales and/or Marketing experience, ideally covering brand, product or portfolio management.
* Demonstrated experience in brand strategy, portfolio management, innovation and commercialization.
* Strong understanding of integrated marketing communications across traditional and digital channels.
* Strong commercial orientation, with the ability to connect consumer and brand strategy with volume, pricing, margin and business performance.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects and influence multiple internal and external stakeholders.

Privacy

We may share it with service providers who support our recruitment, and it may be transferred to other Castrol entities internationally under appropriate safeguards. We keep it only for as long as necessary. For details of how we use your information and your data protection rights, contact privacy.response@castrol.com.
  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, socioeconomic status, neurodiversity/neurocognitive functioning, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to Castrol recruiting process (e.g., accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc.).*

title: Manager - Marketing, Colors
description:
**About the Team**

Colors is a leading Hindi General Entertainment Channel (GEC) within JioStar’s entertainment portfolio. The marketing team plays a key role in building show awareness, strengthening audience engagement and driving viewership through insight-led campaigns and integrated brand communication.

Working at the intersection of content, creativity, consumer understanding and media, the team partners with internal stakeholders and external agencies to bring show narratives to life, build audience connect and sustain the visibility of the Colors portfolio across television and digital platforms.

**About the Role**

The Manager – Marketing will be responsible for planning and executing integrated marketing campaigns for assigned shows on Colors, spanning new show launches, ongoing sustenance and key programming milestones. The role requires a strong understanding of consumer behaviour, creative communication and media effectiveness to translate content propositions into compelling campaigns that build awareness, drive audience interest and support viewership objectives.

The individual will work closely with content, creative, digital, media and distribution teams to develop campaign strategies, deliver impactful communication and maintain consistent visibility for shows throughout their lifecycle. The role calls for a balance of strategic thinking, creative judgement, executional rigour and a performance-oriented approach to marketing.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Show Launch Strategy & Integrated Campaign Execution**

* Develop and execute end-to-end marketing plans for new show launches, translating the show's premise, audience proposition and key differentiators into compelling consumer-facing communication.
* Build integrated campaign plans across television, OTT, digital, social media, print, outdoor advertising (OOH), public relations and on-ground activations, as relevant to the campaign objectives.
* Develop creative briefs, key visuals (KVs), messaging frameworks and campaign narratives in collaboration with creative and communication partners.
* Ensure the timely development and rollout of promos, campaign assets, internal branding and supporting communication across relevant platforms.
* Identify opportunities for innovative campaign formats, partnerships and audience touchpoints that can strengthen show awareness and distinctiveness.

**2. Consumer Insights & Marketing Strategy**

* Translate consumer research, audience behaviour, cultural trends and content insights into actionable marketing strategies and campaign ideas.
* Understand the target audience, viewing motivations and competitive landscape to sharpen show positioning, messaging and campaign relevance.
* Work with research and insights teams to identify audience opportunities, assess consumer perceptions and inform campaign planning.
* Proactively identify opportunities to strengthen audience interest, alongside potential risks to show visibility or engagement, and recommend appropriate marketing interventions.

**3. Show Sustenance & Portfolio Management**

* Develop proactive sustenance plans for assigned shows to maintain audience interest, reinforce show positioning and ensure continued visibility beyond the launch phase.
* Plan creative refreshes and communication interventions around key story developments, programming milestones, talent-led moments and other relevant opportunities.
* Monitor the marketing needs of assigned shows and recommend timely interventions based on audience response, content developments and campaign performance.
* Ensure consistent and coordinated communication across the Colors ecosystem, adapting campaign messaging and assets to suit the requirements of different platforms.
* Partner with relevant stakeholders to support the ongoing health and visibility of shows through their lifecycle.

**4. Campaign Performance & Effectiveness**

* Track campaign delivery and performance against defined marketing objectives, identifying opportunities to improve reach, engagement and media effectiveness.
* Conduct post-campaign and post-launch evaluations to capture key learnings, assess the effectiveness of campaign interventions and inform future planning.
* Develop a working understanding of television viewership metrics, including GRPs, reach and time spent viewing (TSV), and use relevant performance indicators to inform marketing decisions.
* Prepare campaign reviews, performance updates and presentations highlighting outcomes, insights and recommendations for optimisation.

**5. Cross-Functional & Agency Management**

* Collaborate with internal teams across Content, Digital, OAP, Graphics, Traffic, Presentation, Sales and Distribution to ensure aligned planning and seamless campaign execution.
* Brief and coordinate with external creative, media, production and research agencies to translate campaign objectives into effective deliverables.
* Manage campaign timelines, creative development, asset delivery and execution dependencies, ensuring quality and consistency across touchpoints.
* Maintain alignment among stakeholders through clear communication, timely follow-ups and effective resolution of executional challenges.

**6. Innovation, AI & Marketing Effectiveness**

* Leverage AI-enabled tools to support creative ideation, copywriting, pitch development, go-to-market (GTM) decks and campaign presentations.
* Explore new formats, consumer touchpoints and marketing approaches that can improve campaign relevance, speed and effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to streamline marketing workflows and improve the quality and efficiency of campaign planning and delivery.

**Skills & Attributes for Success**

* **Consumer-first mindset:**
  Ability to understand audience motivations, behaviour and cultural context, and translate these into relevant marketing strategies.
* **Integrated campaign expertise:**
  Experience planning and executing 360-degree campaigns across television, OTT, digital, social media, print, OOH and other relevant channels.
* **Creative judgement:**
  Ability to assess creative ideas, sharpen campaign messaging and ensure communication is distinctive, relevant and aligned with the show's proposition.
* **Executional excellence:**
  Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, timelines, stakeholders and deliverables simultaneously.
* **Analytical orientation:**
  Comfort interpreting campaign performance, consumer insights and basic television viewership metrics to inform decisions.
* **Stakeholder management:**
  Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and external agencies, aligning multiple partners towards shared objectives.
* **Digital and social media understanding:**
  Awareness of digital platforms, content formats and audience engagement approaches.
* **Innovation and adaptability:**
  Openness to experimenting with new campaign ideas, formats and AI-enabled tools to improve marketing outcomes.
* **Passion for entertainment:**
  Strong interest in Hindi GEC content, television programming, popular culture and evolving audience preferences.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications or a related discipline.
* 6–8 years of experience in marketing, brand management, integrated communications, advertising or media.
* Demonstrated experience in planning and executing integrated marketing campaigns, preferably across consumer-facing brands, media, entertainment or content-led businesses.
* Experience working with creative and media agencies, developing campaign briefs and managing end-to-end campaign execution.
* Exposure to campaign performance measurement, consumer research and digital marketing is preferred.

**Preferred / Good to Have**

* Experience in television, OTT, entertainment marketing or content-led campaigns.
* Understanding of the Hindi GEC landscape, audience preferences and competitive programming environment.
* Familiarity with television viewership metrics such as GRPs, reach and TSV.
* Experience using AI tools for creative development, research, presentations or marketing workflows.

**Key Collaborations**

* **Internal:**
  Content, Digital, OAP, Graphics, Traffic, Presentation, Sales, Distribution and Research teams.
* **External:**
  Creative agencies, media agencies, production partners and consumer research agencies.

**Internal Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment**

**Basic Qualifications**

* Must be able to travel to partner conferences and/or onsite visits throughout the region.

* Strong ability to build executive relationships and influence cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
