* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and timelines.
* Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth environments.‍

**Why Gruve**
At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.

description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**A. E-commerce Channel Management**

* Lead day-to-day operations across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Tata CLiQ, Blinkit, Instamart, Zepto and MARKETPLACE's website, as applicable.
* Ensure catalogue accuracy, listing completeness, pricing accuracy and product availability.
* Monitor listing suppression, Buy Box or equivalent offer visibility, catalogue issues, account health and platform escalations.
* Coordinate new SKU launches, listing updates, content uploads and product information changes.
* Ensure that products are listed correctly and that the right SKUs are available on the right channels.

**B. Inventory & Supply Chain Coordination**

* Work closely with the Operations team to plan inventory allocation and replenishment across marketplaces and warehouses.
* Monitor stock-outs, excess stock, inventory ageing and demand trends.
* Coordinate purchase-order requirements, inbound stock and marketplace fulfilment requirements.
* Improve inventory visibility and ensure that sales opportunities are not lost due to preventable stock shortages.
* Establish SKU-wise exception reporting and escalation mechanisms.

**C. E-commerce Performance & Commercial Analysis**

* Track sales, units sold, returns, cancellations, availability and other relevant marketplace KPIs.
* Monitor channel-wise and SKU-wise performance and identify opportunities to improve growth.
* Work with the Finance team to understand marketplace fees, discounts, returns, contribution margins and settlement differences.
* Coordinate with performance marketing agencies on advertising requirements, campaign calendars, stock availability and listing readiness.
* Monitor advertising outcomes with agencies and connect campaign activity with overall channel performance.

**D. Quick Commerce & Website**

* Manage operational requirements for quick-commerce platforms, including catalogue setup, assortment, availability, purchase orders, promotional coordination and issue resolution.
* Coordinate website product listings, pricing, product content and operational requirements with the relevant teams and service providers.
* Identify channel-specific opportunities and improve execution across existing and new e-commerce channels.

**E. Team Management & Process Improvement**

* Lead and organise the existing e-commerce/operations team, with clearly defined responsibilities and performance metrics.
* Establish standard operating procedures for listings, inventory allocation, order processing, catalogue updates and marketplace escalations.
* Improve workflows, data accuracy and execution discipline.
* Work with the warehouse and logistics teams to improve dispatch accuracy, fulfilment performance and returns processing.
* Drive process automation and better utilisation of the existing warehouse management and e-commerce systems.

**F. Reporting & Cross-functional Coordination**

* Prepare a regular e-commerce dashboard covering sales, inventory, listing health, stock-outs, returns, cancellations and operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with Finance on marketplace reconciliation and channel-level performance.
* Work with Marketing on promotions, campaigns, product launches and content requirements.
* Escalate material risks, opportunities and decisions requiring founder intervention.

**Candidate Profile**

* 68 years of experience in e-commerce operations, marketplace management or e-commerce business management.
* Prior experience with a D2C, consumer-products, retail or marketplace-led brand is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with Amazon and Flipkart; quick-commerce experience with platforms such as Blinkit, Instamart or Zepto is a strong advantage.
* Strong understanding of catalogue management, listing health, inventory planning, marketplace operations and account escalations.
* Experience managing teams and coordinating with warehouses, logistics partners, advertising agencies and internal stakeholders.
* Strong Excel and data-analysis skills, with the ability to interpret SKU-wise and channel-wise performance.
* Familiarity with e-commerce management systems, ERP/WMS tools and marketplace seller portals.
* High ownership, problem-solving ability and willingness to work hands-on in a lean organisation.

**Key Success Measures**

* Improved sales-channel execution and availability.
* Reduction in avoidable stock-outs, listing errors and catalogue issues.
* Accurate SKU mapping, pricing and marketplace content.
* Improved inventory allocation and replenishment discipline.
* Timely resolution of marketplace escalations.
* Better team productivity and standardisation of operating processes.
* Reliable e-commerce dashboards and coordination with Finance and Marketing.

**Role Boundaries**

The E-commerce Manager will own marketplace operations, availability, catalogue hygiene, channel execution and e-commerce performance monitoring. Performance marketing agencies will continue to execute paid advertising, with the Brand & Content Manager owning brand communication and creative strategy.

The E-commerce Manager will work with Operations on warehouse and logistics execution and with Finance on reconciliations and profitability. The role must coordinate these functions without duplicating their core responsibilities.

title: Sr Social Manager – Prime Video (AVOD), Prime Video (AVOD)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

External Job Description  
Amazon Prime Video is changing the way people watch movies and TV shows, offering multiple ways to instantly stream and watch videos. Our mission is to build the widest selection of digital video content and make it trivially easy for customers to enjoy great content wherever and whenever they want.  
  
We are looking for a creative, customer-obsessed Sr. Social Media Manager to drive campaign-led social marketing for Prime Video India's AVOD (MX Player by Prime Video) content slate. In this individual contributor role, you will be responsible for conceptualizing and executing social media campaigns that bring new titles to life for Indian audiences. You will work at the intersection of content, culture, and community to ensure every title launch creates maximum awareness, conversation, and excitement among fans and potential viewers.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Title Launch Campaigns: Own end-to-end social media campaign strategy and execution for new title launches, from announcement to post-launch engagement.
* Creative Conceptualization: Develop thumb-stopping, platform-native creative concepts and content ideas that generate buzz, drive conversation, and build anticipation for upcoming titles
* Content Calendar Management: Build and manage a robust content calendar aligned to the title release slate; plan phased campaign rollouts
* Platform Strategy: Create platform-specific content strategies across Instagram, X/Twitter, YouTube, Facebook, Threads, and emerging platforms
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with content marketing, PR, creative services, and talent teams to align on title positioning, key messaging, and asset creation
* Agency Coordination: Brief and manage creative and social agencies on campaign deliverables; review output to ensure quality, timeliness, and brand consistency; manage social campaign budgets.
* Talent & Creator Partnerships: Collaborate with talent (cast, directors) and digital creators/influencers to amplify title launches through authentic social storytelling
* Cultural Integration: Tap into cultural moments, trending conversations, and fan communities to make title campaigns locally relevant and shareable
* Performance Analysis: Track, analyze, and report on campaign performance metrics; derive actionable insights to optimize future campaigns and build scalable playbooks
* Community Engagement: Drive fan engagement and conversation around title launches; foster communities of superfans and leverage UGC to extend campaign reach
* Competitive Intelligence: Monitor competitor title launch strategies on social media; identify opportunities to differentiate and outperform
* Experimentation & Innovation: Test new formats, platform features, and engagement mechanics to continuously raise the bar on title campaign effectiveness and build scalable playbooks for future campaigns.

Platform Growth & Strategy: End to end ownership of MX By Prime Video’s social brand channels and strategy across Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and YouTube and others, including execution of activations from concept to post-implementation analysis. Expand MX By Prime Video’s brand presence on emerging and IN-specific social platforms. Work with platform partners to ensure the business is adopting the latest product features and best practices  
Brand Tone Of Voice: Constantly iterate and maintain MX By Prime Video’s personality and social tone of voice to stay relevant to fans and customers. Ensure consistent brand positioning and tone of voice across all platforms.  
Be the business POC for social media customer service team. Constantly improve processes to maintain a high-bar on customer interactions and satisfaction.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
* Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
* Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
* Experience communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience using Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience creating and executing integrated marketing lead generation campaigns using tactics that include live or virtual events, webinars, email, lead nurture programs, and CRM/sales insights
* Experience with Salesforce and Tableau

title: Brand Manager
description:
**Job Title:** Brand Manager  
**Department:** Marketing  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years  
**Location:** Borivali West

Job Summary

We are looking for a creative, strategic, and results-driven Brand Manager to develop, manage, and strengthen the company's brand identity and market presence. The candidate will be responsible for brand positioning, marketing strategy, campaign planning, competitor analysis, content direction, and maintaining consistent brand communication across all channels.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of consumer behaviour, market trends, digital marketing, and brand development, along with the ability to coordinate with internal teams, agencies, and external partners to execute effective brand initiatives.

Key Responsibilities1. Brand Strategy & Positioning

* Develop and implement brand strategies aligned with the company's business objectives.
* Define brand positioning, value proposition, target audience, and key brand messaging.
* Establish brand guidelines to maintain consistency across marketing materials, digital platforms, and customer communications.
* Conduct market research to identify customer needs, emerging trends, and growth opportunities.
* Strengthen brand awareness, credibility, and differentiation in the market.
* Ensure consistent representation of the brand across all customer touchpoints.

2. Market Research & Competitor Analysis

* Conduct regular market research to understand industry trends, customer preferences, and market opportunities.
* Analyse competitor brands, marketing strategies, pricing, positioning, and promotional activities.
* Identify gaps in the market and recommend strategies to improve brand competitiveness.
* Monitor customer feedback, brand perception, and market developments.
* Prepare reports and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making.

3. Marketing Campaigns & Brand Communication

* Plan, execute, and monitor integrated marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels.
* Develop campaign briefs, communication plans, promotional concepts, and brand messaging.
* Coordinate with digital marketing, content, design, sales, and external agencies to execute campaigns.
* Ensure all marketing materials align with the brand's tone, identity, and positioning.
* Track campaign performance and recommend improvements based on results.
* Support product launches, promotional activities, exhibitions, events, and brand awareness initiatives.

4. Content & Digital Brand Management

* Develop content strategies for social media, websites, email marketing, and other communication channels.
* Work with content creators, designers, and digital marketing teams to develop relevant brand assets.
* Review and approve creative content, advertisements, brochures, presentations, and promotional materials.
* Maintain consistency in brand voice, visual identity, and communication standards.
* Coordinate social media campaigns and monitor engagement, reach, and audience response.
* Identify opportunities to improve the brand's digital visibility and audience engagement.

5. Product Marketing & Business Coordination

* Work closely with product, sales, and business development teams to understand product features, benefits, and target markets.
* Translate product features into clear customer benefits and compelling marketing messages.
* Develop product positioning, promotional strategies, launch plans, and marketing collateral.
* Support sales teams with presentations, brochures, product information, and other brand materials.
* Coordinate with distributors, channel partners, agencies, and other stakeholders to ensure consistent brand execution.
* Align brand initiatives with business growth, lead generation, and customer acquisition objectives.

6. Brand Performance & Budget Management

* Develop and manage brand marketing budgets in coordination with management.
* Monitor campaign spending and ensure effective utilisation of marketing resources.
* Define and track key brand performance indicators, including brand awareness, engagement, reach, lead generation, and campaign ROI.
* Prepare regular reports on campaign performance, market trends, and brand growth.
* Use data and customer insights to improve marketing effectiveness and brand performance.
* Recommend new initiatives to strengthen brand visibility and business outcomes.

7. Team & Stakeholder Coordination

* Coordinate with internal teams, marketing agencies, vendors, and business partners.
* Manage timelines, deliverables, and priorities for brand-related projects.
* Provide creative direction and feedback to designers, content creators, and marketing team members.
* Present brand strategies, campaign plans, and performance reports to management.
* Ensure timely execution of assigned brand initiatives and marketing projects.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication, or a related field.
* MBA in Marketing or a relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* 3–5 years of experience in brand management, marketing strategy, or a related role.
* Experience in developing brand strategies, managing campaigns, and conducting market research.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Google Workspace, and marketing analytics tools.
* Familiarity with social media platforms, digital marketing, content management, and brand analytics.
* Experience in FMCG, consumer goods, home appliances, or a related industry is an advantage.

Required Skills

* Strong strategic thinking and brand-building capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Creativity, storytelling, and content evaluation skills.
* Strong analytical and market research abilities.
* Project management and cross-functional coordination skills.
* Understanding of consumer behaviour and marketing trends.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Budget planning, performance analysis, and problem-solving abilities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Growth in brand awareness and market visibility.
* Improvement in brand engagement and audience reach.
* Successful execution of marketing campaigns within agreed timelines and budgets.
* Consistency in brand identity and communication across channels.
* Effectiveness of competitor analysis and market research.
* Performance of product launches and promotional initiatives.
* Contribution of marketing activities to qualified leads and business growth.
* Improvement in brand perception, customer engagement, and campaign ROI.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: TransUnion INDAS, Sr. Manager, Carrier Relations
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

**Team Overview**

About TransUnion INDAS:
  
  
TransUnion is a leading global information and insights company that makes trust possible in the modern economy. We do this by providing an actionable picture of each person so they can be reliably represented in the marketplace. As a result, businesses and consumers can transact with confidence and achieve great things. This picture is grounded in our legacy as a credit reporting agency which enables us to tap into both credit and public record data; our data fusion methodology that helps us link, match and tap into the awesome combined power of that data; and our knowledgeable and passionate team, who stewards the information with expertise, and in accordance with local legislation around the world. A leading presence in more than 30 countries across five continents, TransUnion provides solutions that help create economic opportunity, great experiences and personal empowerment for hundreds of millions of people. We call this Information for Good®—it’s our purpose, and what drives us every day.

This is a remote position which may require occasional in-person attendance at work-related events at the discretion of management.  
  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

The ideal candidate will:

* Be a seasoned Business Development/Product executive with experience across leading Indian telecom carrier(s), and/or with C-level senior leadership connects across these carriers by working for a large vendor who may have done direct business with these carriers for Saas/other large deals
* Preferably have B2B business development experience, working with Enterprises and mid market businesses is good-to-have
* Experience working in a matrixed organization in close partnership with product management for an organization delivering complex and technical products or services would be a plus
* Proven track record to deliver and grow in a collaborative environment.
* The role will work closely with in-country as well as global leadership to ensure delivery of best-in-class enterprise communications solutions.
  

  

The TU INDAS Sr. Manager Carrier Relations is responsible for executing the market strategy for TransUnion’s mobile call authentication and identity solutions in India. They will report to Head Communication Solutions at TU INDAS and collaborate closely with the Global Communications Solutions team to:

* Bring in-depth knowledge of India’s telecommunication ecosystem and CXO & senior stakeholder relationships at the major Indian telco networks to help launch TU’s global solutions in India
* Develop business proposals for identified opportunities and partnerships.
* Execute the India go-to-market strategy.
  + Provide market insights, emerging critical client needs, and product feedback
  + Develop and deepen relationships with key stakeholders in the Indian Telco operators, and other entities in the Telco ecosystem
  + Develop business development strategy in collaboration with the Global Communications Solutions leaders
  + Actively drive the business development efforts including pre-sales and procurement process of the telco operators, as well as pre-sales and contracting with enterprises
  + Significant external focus to establish TU as a thought leader in this space in India within the relevant ecosystem of telecom companies (telcos), enterprises and regulatory entities like TRAI
  + Develop robust cross-functional relationships both within TU’s matrixed organization to accelerate evaluation and launch of TU’s solutions
* Work closely with legal, compliance and privacy teams to ensure our products are delivered in a privacy conscious and compliant manner
  

  
  

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

  
  

**How You’ll Contribute** :

**Executes regional strategy & develops operating plan(s):**

* Leverages own experiences combined with global ideas/inputs to develop medium to long-term growth strategy; develops business cases; enables communicates strategy and provides inputs to secure buy-in from the business.

* Provides feedback to the Global Communications leadership on local needs, features and functionality.

**Influences, monitors and supports the delivery of annual revenue and profitability targets:**

* Market development to set up a Communications Services LOB in TU INDAS -initially focused on accelerating market entry, fostering and building external partner relationships.

* Manage relationships with Telcos and Mobile OEMs to drive evaluation and market adoption of TU global solutions like Trusted Call Solutions (TCS) / Branded Call Display (BCD)

* Initiate sales engagements with large enterprises for consumption of TU services

* Work with the Global Solutions organization and India stakeholders to ensure launch of targeted solutions in India, and successful achievement of annual revenue goals going forward.

* Evaluate and execute local BD partnerships/integrations to supplement sales efforts.

**Builds a culture of collaboration:**

* Develops close relationships with leaders across the organization – product, sales, privacy, compliance; both in region and in the Center

* Is rated highly by regional peers and internal customers on KPI’s – value creation, responsiveness, speed, ease of doing business

* Develops talent and creates a connected community of best practice sharing & application

**What You’ll Bring:**

* 15 years+ of experience working in Business Development, Sales and/or PSS roles in large Indian telco carriers or in the telco ecosystem

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business or related fields from a reputed institution is required; Master’s degree would be a plus

* Experience building new businesses or product lines within large organizations, and in executing a cohesive go-to-market plan (differentiation, pricing, marketing, training & strategic partnerships)

* Ability to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced, cross-functional, matrixed environment.

  
  

**TransUnion Overview:**

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our **Workforce for Good** , which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.

  

Be a part of our **Workforce for Good** – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

title: Growth Partner — Strategy & Execution
description:
Title: : Growth Partner — Strategy & Execution | Work Directly With the Founder

Pune Exp: 5 - 9 Years

Timing: 3pm -11pm | Monday to Saturday (2nd & 4th Saturday Off)

Joining: Immediate

Website: https://www.stage7.co/

Address: NIBM road, Pune

**The Opportunity**

Stage7 is building a growth company designed to help ambitious brands scale through strategy, technology, creative, and performance.

We're looking for someone who thinks like an entrepreneur, moves like an operator, and understands growth beyond advertising.

You'll work directly with the founder to build Stage7's acquisition engine from the ground up.

**What Makes This Role Different**

We don't need another person who brings ideas to meetings.

We need someone who can identify opportunities, build conviction, and make things happen.

Someone who asks the right questions, challenges assumptions, understands the economics, and owns execution.

**Your job is to turn ambiguity into decisions and decisions into measurable growth.**

**What You'll Do**

* Build Stage7's go-to-market strategy and customer acquisition engine.
* Identify high-potential US brands and develop compelling reasons for them to work with us.
* Own demand generation across paid media, outbound, partnerships, content, and unconventional channels.
* Develop hypotheses, launch experiments, interpret results, and make confident decisions.
* Work with the founder on positioning, offers, pricing, and acquisition economics.
* Build campaigns and systems using AI, automation, and data.
* Lead a small, high-performing team while remaining deeply involved in execution.
* Take ownership of qualified pipeline and marketing-sourced revenue.

**The Person We're Looking For**

**A thinker who executes. An executor who questions.**

You should be someone who:

* Has strong opinions backed by reasoning and evidence.
* Can disagree with the founder and explain why.
* Doesn't wait for perfect information to take action.
* Understands the difference between being busy and moving the business forward.
* Can move from strategy to execution within hours, not weeks.
* Has experience generating real business outcomes, not just impressions, clicks, and leads.
* Takes ownership when experiments fail and knows what to try next.
* Is comfortable building with limited resources before scaling a team.

**Your First 90 Days**

**Days 1–30:**
Understand the market, challenge our assumptions, define acquisition hypotheses, and launch initial experiments.

**Days 31–60:**
Identify early signals, optimize offers and channels, and establish a consistent qualified pipeline.

**Days 61–90:**
Double down on proven opportunities, improve acquisition economics, and build a repeatable growth engine.

**What We Value**

* Conviction over consensus.
* Execution over presentations.
* Evidence over opinions.
* Ownership over delegation.
* Commercial outcomes over vanity metrics.

**Why Join Stage7?**

You'll work directly with a founder who has spent over a decade building and scaling digital businesses.

You'll have the freedom to challenge ideas, influence decisions, build systems, and shape the company's growth direction.

This is not a role for someone looking for a comfortable management position.

**It's for someone who wants to build something meaningful and have a direct impact on its success.**

**To Apply**

Share one growth initiative you personally built, what you believed would work, what the data revealed, and what you changed as a result.

title: Principal Product Manager, Recovery Orchestration
description:
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**
We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.
  
  
**What To Know**

* Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
* Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com
  
  
**About Commvault**
Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.
  
  
We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own the strategy and execution for our recovery orchestration platform — the layer that automates, sequences, and validates how enterprises bring critical systems back online after an outage, ransomware event, or disaster. This is a build-and-scale mandate: you'll be responsible for unifying what are today somewhat separate capabilities into a single, coherent platform story — with the pricing, packaging, and GTM discipline to make it a durable, high-margin product line, not just a feature bundle. You'll operate at the intersection of enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, and cloud architecture, working with engineering, pricing/finance, field enablement, and customer success to take this from current state to a major platform launch.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Product Strategy & Platform Vision
  
  

* Define and evolve the strategy for a unified recovery orchestration platform spanning multiple cloud workloads (compute, storage, databases) across AWS, Azure, and GCP
* Build the narrative for why orchestrated, tested recovery is a distinct platform capability — not a checkbox feature — for CISOs, infrastructure/DR leaders, and compliance stakeholders
* Own the roadmap sequencing across phased capability delivery

Pricing & Packaging
  
  

* Partner with Finance/Pricing to fix structural pricing issues (cost allocation across platform vs. product SKUs, bundle economics, SaaS vs. software parity) that directly affect adoption and retention
* Build the business case and options analysis for executive/CPO-level pricing decisions, using cost-vs-price framing
* Ensure packaging reflects real customer buying patterns rather than internal architecture boundaries

Cross-Functional Execution
  
  

* Drive a large, multi-team engineering workback (dozens of workstreams across workload teams, UI/UX, and platform) toward a release date
* Identify and escalate real schedule risk early and keep the leadership informed.
* Partner with field enablement and customer success to close the gap between product capability and what's actually sold, deployed, and renewed

Customer & Market Insight
  
  

* Validate positioning and pricing directly with field teams (solutions engineers, field CTOs) and customers — not just internal stakeholders
* Understand the two adjacent buyer personas this platform serves (security/CISO buyers focused on isolated recovery and forensics, and infrastructure/DR buyers focused on operational recovery) and make deliberate calls on how the platform positions to each without diluting either
* Identify new opportunities and problems to solve in the recovery space.

Executive Communication
  
  

* Write clear PRFAQs, business cases, and stakeholder updates for senior leadership audiences
* Present pricing and platform strategy directly to all stakeholders

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline.
* 8+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time in enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud platforms, or data resilience (backup/DR/ransomware recovery adjacent domains)
* Demonstrated experience owning pricing and packaging decisions with measurable business impact (not just feature roadmaps)
* Experience running large, cross-team technical programs with a hard external deadline (multiple engineering teams, dozens of dependencies, workback tracking)
* Strong grasp of cloud infrastructure fundamentals across at least one hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, or GCP) — compute, storage, database recovery patterns
* Track record of building platform narratives for technical, security-conscious enterprise buyers (CISO, VP Infrastructure, Head of DR)
* Excellent written communication — comfortable producing PRDs, PRFAQs, and exec-level business cases independently

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Master's Degree preferred.
* Direct experience with backup, disaster recovery, cyber recovery, or ransomware resilience products
* Familiarity with isolated recovery environment concepts (malware scanning, forensics-safe validation environments)
* Experience managing SKU/pricing structures across SaaS and on-prem/software delivery models
* Background partnering with channel/field enablement teams on complex technical products

Marketing Manager – Smart Beverage Vending Machines

**We are looking for a business builder, not just a marketing manager.**

**Company:** Innovative Startup | **Location:** Pune, Maharashtra  
**Experience:** 5–10+ years preferred | **Qualification:** MBA in Marketing (Mandatory)  
**Job Type:** Full-time | **Work Location:** Pune, with travel to Mumbai and other markets

About Us

We are an ambitious startup developing innovative, automated beverage vending machines for the Indian market. Our initial focus is on Pune and Mumbai, with plans to expand to other cities.

We aim to establish a strong presence in the emerging instant beverage vending business by deploying smart vending machines at high-footfall locations and developing strategic partnerships with businesses, institutions and property owners.

We are looking for an exceptional **Marketing Manager who can generate business, open doors, build strategic relationships and drive revenue growth from day one.**

This is not a conventional marketing job. We need a commercially driven professional who understands how to identify opportunities, approach decision-makers, negotiate deals and convert relationships into actual business.

Key Responsibilities1. Business Development and Revenue Generation

* Take ownership of business development and revenue generation for our beverage vending machine business.
* Identify and secure high-potential locations for vending machine installation in Pune and Mumbai.
* Develop business opportunities with shopping malls, corporate offices, IT parks, gyms, fitness centres, colleges, universities, hospitals, railway stations, airports, hotels and other high-footfall locations, subject to relevant permissions.
* Approach decision-makers, pitch our business proposition, negotiate commercial terms and close agreements.
* Build a strong pipeline of qualified prospects and convert opportunities into signed contracts and operational locations.
* Develop innovative commercial models, including revenue sharing, placement agreements, partnerships and other suitable arrangements.

2. Market Intelligence and Business Strategy

* Demonstrate a strong understanding of India's vending machine industry, particularly automated beverage dispensing and instant beverage vending.
* Research competitors, existing vending operators, market trends, customer preferences and emerging business opportunities.
* Identify promising locations, customer segments and business models for rapid market penetration.
* Understand the commercial potential of different locations, including expected footfall, customer demand, operating costs and revenue opportunities.
* Recommend pricing, placement strategies and partnership models that improve profitability and accelerate expansion.

3. Networking and Strategic Partnerships

* Develop relationships with corporate decision-makers, property owners, facility managers, mall operators, gym chains, institutional administrators and other relevant stakeholders.
* Leverage an established professional network to generate qualified business opportunities.
* Establish partnerships with businesses that can provide access to multiple locations or customer networks.
* Represent the company confidently in business meetings, negotiations, industry events and partnership discussions.
* Build long-term relationships that support repeat business and geographical expansion.

4. Sales and Commercial Negotiations

* Prepare compelling business presentations, commercial proposals and partnership pitches.
* Negotiate placement fees, revenue-sharing arrangements, minimum guarantees and other commercial terms where appropriate.
* Convert leads into signed agreements and ensure timely execution of business commitments.
* Work closely with the founders to develop practical, commercially attractive proposals.
* Track leads, meetings, proposals, conversion rates, signed agreements and revenue potential.

5. Launch and Market Expansion

* Lead business development activities for the initial launch in Pune and Mumbai.
* Build a structured pipeline of prospective vending machine locations and strategic accounts.
* Develop relationships with chains and organisations that could support deployment across multiple locations.
* Coordinate with technical and operational teams to ensure new locations are suitable for installation and service.
* Gather market feedback and recommend improvements to the product offering and commercial model.
* Develop a scalable business development strategy for expansion into additional cities.

6. Startup Ownership and Execution

* Work directly with the founders and take responsibility for measurable business outcomes.
* Demonstrate initiative, speed, resourcefulness and the ability to operate independently.
* Identify opportunities beyond conventional marketing channels.
* Bring commercially viable ideas, potential partners and new revenue opportunities to the table.
* Focus on business results rather than simply meetings, presentations or marketing activities.

Mandatory Qualifications

* **MBA in Marketing is mandatory.**
* 5–10+ years of relevant experience in business development, sales, strategic partnerships, channel development or commercial marketing.
* Demonstrated success in generating business, acquiring customers, negotiating commercial agreements and meeting revenue targets.
* Strong understanding of the Indian market and commercial decision-making processes.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to identify commercially attractive opportunities.
* Willingness to travel extensively within Pune, Mumbai and other markets as required.

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following sectors will be preferred:

* Vending machines and automated retail.
* Coffee vending, beverage dispensing and instant beverage businesses.
* Food and beverage distribution.
* QSR, cafés, food service and hospitality.
* Retail expansion and commercial property partnerships.
* Fitness chains, gyms and wellness businesses.
* Corporate facility management and institutional sales.
* Franchise development, channel partnerships and location-based businesses.
* Consumer products and technology-enabled retail solutions.

**Direct experience in the vending machine industry or an established network within the automated beverage business will be a significant advantage.**

The Candidate We Are Looking For

We want an exceptionally capable business generator who combines intelligence, confidence, communication skills and commercial instinct.

The ideal candidate will be:

* **A natural networker:** Comfortable meeting senior decision-makers and building meaningful business relationships.
* **Highly articulate and persuasive:** Able to communicate confidently, think on their feet and present a compelling commercial proposition.
* **Commercially smart:** Understands what makes a location, partnership or customer commercially valuable.
* **Proactive and well connected:** Knows how to reach the right people and turn introductions into business opportunities.
* **An excellent negotiator:** Capable of structuring mutually beneficial commercial agreements.
* **Market aware:** Understands the vending business, competitive landscape and potential customer segments.
* **Results oriented:** Focused on signed agreements, successful machine placements, revenue and business growth.
* **Entrepreneurial:** Comfortable building a business in an early-stage startup where initiative and execution matter more than hierarchy.

We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate how their personal efforts, market knowledge and professional network have generated substantial business in previous roles.

Compensation and Incentives

* **Salary is no bar for the right candidate.**
* Compensation will be decided based on experience, demonstrated business generation capabilities and suitability for the role.
* Attractive performance-linked incentives will be offered based on business development achievements and agreed performance parameters.
* Significant opportunities for professional growth and increased responsibility as the company expands.

We value measurable business results and are prepared to recognise exceptional performance.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit their CV along with a brief description of their business development achievements.

Please include:

* MBA qualification and specialisation.
* Total relevant work experience.
* Details of previous roles in sales, marketing or business development.
* Examples of major clients acquired, commercial partnerships established or new markets developed.
* Experience in vending machines, beverages, automated retail or related industries.
* Examples of revenue targets achieved and business generated.
* Current location and willingness to travel across Pune and Mumbai.
* Notice period and expected compensation.

title: Ads Strategy Manager – Pricing & Revenue
description:
**Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!**
Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here's why we stand out:
  
  

* We are trusted by over 450 million active users every month across 190+ countries
* We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
* We are powered by a team of 450+ employees from 45+ nationalities

We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you'll fit right in.
  
  
**The role:**
As a strategic, data-driven commercial thinker, you will shape how Truecaller's Ads business prices its inventory and grows revenue. You will sit at the intersection of Revenue Strategy, Monetization, Product, Sales and Finance.
  
  
A typical problem starts as a business question: are we leaving money on the table in a market, is our rate card competitive, should we shift inventory from programmatic to direct, or how will a new ad format affect yield?
  
  
You will dig into the data, build the business case, recommend the pricing or revenue move, align the right teams, and measure the impact.
  
  
You will be the go-to person for how Ads makes money, giving leadership a clear view of where revenue is coming from, where the next growth is, and what to do about it.
  
  
**What you'll do:**

* **Pricing strategy:**
  Own rate cards, floor prices and pricing models across formats, geographies and buying channels; benchmark against competitors and market rates.
* **Revenue growth:**
  Identify and size revenue opportunities across Direct Sales (DS) and programmatic (3P), and build the strategy and business cases to capture them.
* **Yield and monetization:**
  Analyze DS vs. 3P mix, eCPM, fill rate, auction dynamics and partner performance to maximize yield per user and per impression.
* **Packaging and deal strategy:**
  Design ad packages, bundles, premium inventory offerings and deal structures (PMPs, programmatic guaranteed, sponsorships) that advertisers want to buy.
* **Impact sizing:**
  Model the revenue impact of pricing changes, new ad formats, product launches and auction changes before they ship, and track outcomes after.
* **Experimentation:**
  Design and run pricing and floor-price tests; turn results into clear recommendations.
* **Revenue planning:**
  Partner with Finance on annual and quarterly revenue targets, and explain performance against plan to leadership, covering what happened, why, and what to do next.
* **Sales enablement:**
  Support quota setting, pricing guardrails and discount frameworks so Sales can sell with confidence and consistency.

**What you bring in:**

* 6–8 years in ads strategy, monetization, pricing, yield management or revenue strategy, ideally in ad tech or consumer internet.
* Proven track record of owning pricing or revenue decisions that delivered measurable growth.
* Deep understanding of ad monetization: direct vs. programmatic, eCPM, fill rate, floor pricing, auctions and yield optimization.
* Strong analytical skills: advanced SQL (BigQuery preferred), financial modelling in spreadsheets, and a BI tool.
* Experience presenting strategy and recommendations to senior leadership.
* **Commercial judgment:**
  Turns data into clear pricing and revenue decisions.
* **Strategic thinking:**
  Sees the bigger picture across market, advertiser and product, not just the numbers.
* **Ownership:**
  Takes an idea from hypothesis to recommendation, rollout and measured result.
* **Stakeholder influence:**
  Aligns Sales, Product and Finance around a single revenue view.
* **Experimentation mindset:**
  Tests, learns and refines rather than relying on assumptions.
* Able to influence Sales, Product, Finance and Engineering without direct authority.

**It would be great if you also have:**

* Experience with ad servers and SSPs (e.g., Google Ad Manager).
* Exposure to pricing in emerging markets such as India, MENA or Africa.
* A background in strategy consulting or business finance.

**What we offer:**
We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:
  
  

* **A comprehensive compensation package:**
  Learning and development allowance, voluntary provident fund (VPF) and/or national pension scheme (NPS) tax saving option provided, creche allowance
* **Modern tools to do your best work:**
  Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
* **A people-focused office culture:**
  We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
* **Truecaller's "Lab Days"**
  offer a space for imagination: 5 days each quarter, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they've always wanted to. It's a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.

**Come as you are:**
Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.
  
  
**Sounds like a great opportunity?**
We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.
  
  
We only accept applications
**in English**
.

title: Senior Manager E-commerce & Marketplaces
description:

With an established presence across Amazon India, leading online marketplaces and our own D2C website, we are looking for a capable e-commerce leader to strengthen our online business and drive its next phase of growth.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a commercially driven and people-oriented
**Senior Manager – E-commerce &**

**Online Sales**
to lead our existing team of performance marketing, marketplace and cataloging professionals.

The role requires someone with a strong understanding of how e-commerce businesses operate, from product visibility and online merchandising to advertising effectiveness, sales conversion and profitability.

The selected candidate will be responsible for setting direction, developing the team, reviewing performance and ensuring that our products achieve their full sales potential across online channels.

**This is a business management and team leadership role, rather than a hands-on advertising or catalog execution position.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Growth & Commercial Ownership**

* Take ownership of overall online sales performance, revenue targets and profitability.
* Develop channel-wise and product-wise growth strategies across Amazon India, other marketplaces and the Pegasus website.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales, organic visibility, market share and contribution margins.
* Ensure that advertising expenditure and operational costs are aligned with commercial objectives.
* Drive sustainable business growth through effective planning, prioritization and execution.

**2. Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead and develop an existing team of performance marketers, marketplace specialists and cataloging professionals.
* Establish clear responsibilities, measurable KPIs and accountability across functions.
* Review individual and team performance, provide direction and ensure timely execution.
* Coach team members, resolve operational challenges and build a collaborative, high-performance culture.
* Assess resource requirements, identify capability gaps and improve team productivity.

**3. Performance Marketing & Marketplace Management**

* Provide strategic and technical direction to specialists managing Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads and marketplace promotions.
* Evaluate advertising strategies, campaign structure, budgets and effectiveness.
* Monitor ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, customer acquisition costs, conversion rates and overall advertising efficiency.
* Ensure continuous optimization of advertising spends while balancing revenue growth and profitability.
* Guide the team in improving product visibility, organic rankings and marketplace sales performance.

**4. Product Performance & Online Merchandising**

* Ensure effective listing, positioning and presentation of products across all relevant online channels.
* Oversee catalog quality, content, keywords, images, A+ content, pricing and promotional strategies.
* Monitor product-wise performance and identify opportunities to improve discoverability and conversions.
* Plan and oversee successful launches of new books, series and product categories.
* Coordinate with editorial, product development, marketing, design and inventory teams to ensure products are online-ready and commercially supported.

**5. Performance Reviews & Business Analytics**

* Establish robust reporting and review processes covering sales, advertising, catalog quality and profitability.
* Analyze channel-wise and product-wise performance to identify commercial opportunities and execution gaps.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–10 years of relevant experience in e-commerce or online retail.
* Proven experience managing and developing teams handling marketplaces, performance marketing or digital commerce.
* Strong knowledge of Amazon India, including marketplace advertising, catalog management and sales optimization.
* Good understanding of D2C performance marketing, particularly Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Experience managing advertising budgets, sales targets and business performance.
* Strong understanding of online merchandising, product discoverability, conversion optimization and marketplace operations.
* Sound commercial judgment with the ability to balance growth and profitability.
* Strong analytical, communication, people management and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to guide technical specialists, hold teams accountable and deliver measurable business results.

Experience in consumer products, books, toys, educational products, stationery, baby products or similar categories would be an advantage.

* Lead an established online business with significant growth opportunities.
* Manage an existing team of specialists rather than build operations from scratch.

* Work closely with senior leadership in a growing Indian consumer brand.
* Opportunity to build a scalable and high-performing e-commerce function.

title: SDR
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a driven and organized Sales Development Representative (SDR) to manage

and qualify incoming sales leads and convert them into qualified sales opportunities.Your

primary responsibility will be to own incoming leads from the moment they enter the sales

pipeline — contacting prospects quickly, understanding their requirements, qualifying the

opportunity, scheduling product demonstrations, and consistently following up to move

prospects through the sales process.You will act as the first point of contact for prospective

customers and play an important role in ensuring that genuine opportunities do not get lost due

to delayed responses or inadequate follow-up.

Key ResponsibilitiesIncoming Lead Management – Primary Responsibility

● Handle incoming leads generated through the website, marketing campaigns, referrals,

WhatsApp, calls, partnerships, and other lead-generation channels.

● Contact new leads promptly and ensure defined response-time SLAs are consistently

met.

● Conduct initial discovery calls to understand the prospect's company, current processes,

pain points, requirements, and reason for evaluating the product.

● Qualify leads based on defined criteria such as customer profile, use case, company size,

requirement, decision-making process, urgency, and buying intent.

● Identify the relevant decision-makers and stakeholders involved in the purchase.

● Clearly communicate the product's core value proposition and determine whether there is

a potential fit.

● Schedule product demonstrations with qualified prospects and coordinate with the

relevant sales team member.

● Ensure prospects attend scheduled demos through confirmations, reminders, and

rescheduling where required.

● Conduct persistent and structured follow-ups with prospects through calls, WhatsApp,

email, and other appropriate channels.

● Re-engage leads that have gone cold or have stopped responding.

● Maintain complete and accurate records of every lead, interaction, follow-up, qualification

status, and next action in the CRM.

● Ensure no qualified lead is lost because of missed follow-ups or poor lead management.

● Provide clear context and qualification notes when handing qualified opportunities to the

salesperson responsible for closing the deal.

Outbound Prospecting – Secondary ResponsibilityWhen inbound lead volumes permit, the SDR

will also support new business generation by:

● Researching and identifying potential target companies.

● Identifying relevant decision-makers within target accounts.

● Conducting outbound prospecting through phone, email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and other

appropriate channels.

● Qualifying outbound prospects and scheduling meetings or product demonstrations.

● Following up with prospects until they are qualified, disqualified, or moved into a nurture

pipeline.

What We're Looking For

● 1–3 years of experience in B2B sales, inside sales, business development, telesales, or

SaaS sales.

● Strong verbal and written communication skills.

● Comfortable speaking with business owners, operations teams, HR teams, and senior

decision-makers.

● Strong questioning and listening skills with the ability to understand a prospect's actual

business problem.

● Excellent follow-up discipline — you should be comfortable contacting a prospect

multiple times across different channels.

● Ability to differentiate between genuine sales opportunities and low-intent enquiries.

● Organized and capable of managing a large number of leads simultaneously without

losing track of follow-ups.

● Comfortable working with defined targets and conversion metrics.

● Familiarity with CRM systems and sales tools is preferred.

● Professional communication skills in English and Hindi; additional languages are an

advantage.

Career GrowthStrong performers can progress into roles such as Senior SDR, Account Executive,

Business Development Manager, or Sales Manager, based on performance and demonstrated

ability to manage the sales process.

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

title: City Head – Kolkata
description:
ClearrCUT
  
  
Job Description – City Head, Kolkata
  
  
Position: City Head – Kolkata
  
Location: Kolkata, West Bengal
  
Department: City Operations & Business Growth
  
Reporting To: CEO / Management
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The City Head – Kolkata will be responsible for the overall business performance of ClearrCUT across Kolkata. This is a leadership and ownership role covering revenue growth, operations, customer experience, professional/service partner management, team performance, expansion, and profitability.
  
  
The City Head will operate as the business owner for the Kolkata market and will be accountable for achieving monthly targets while maintaining strong service standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Revenue & Business Growth
  
  
- Own and achieve Kolkata's monthly booking, revenue and collection targets.
  
- Develop city-level strategies to increase bookings, repeat customers and average order value.
  
- Identify new customer acquisition and business development opportunities.
  
- Work closely with Marketing and Management on campaigns, offers and growth initiatives.
  
- Track daily, weekly and monthly revenue performance and take corrective action when required.
  
  
2. City Operations
  
  
- Take complete ownership of day-to-day ClearrCUT operations across Kolkata.
  
- Ensure smooth booking allocation, professional availability and timely service execution.
  
- Maintain high service completion rates and minimise cancellations.
  
- Resolve operational bottlenecks quickly and ensure accountability across the team.
  
  
3. Team Leadership & Performance
  
  
- Lead the Operations, Customer Support, Sales/Business Development and city-level execution teams.
  
- Set clear KPIs and individual/team targets.
  
- Conduct regular performance reviews and daily/weekly business reviews.
  
- Identify underperformance and implement improvement plans where required.
  
- Build a performance-driven and accountable work culture.
  
  
4. Professional / Service Partner Management
  
  
- Ensure adequate availability of verified and high-quality service professionals.
  
- Monitor professional performance, attendance, customer ratings and service quality.
  
- Support onboarding and activation of new professionals based on demand.
  
- Maintain healthy professional relationships while enforcing ClearrCUT service standards.
  
  
5. Customer Experience
  
  
- Ensure excellent customer experience from booking to service completion.
  
- Monitor complaints, refunds, cancellations and repeat service issues.
  
- Ensure critical customer complaints are resolved quickly.
  
- Improve customer retention, ratings and repeat booking percentage.
  
  
6. Expansion & Market Development
  
  
- Identify high-potential areas and service categories for expansion across Kolkata.
  
- Build hyperlocal growth plans based on customer demand and professional availability.
  
- Support new category launches and geographical expansion.
  
- Monitor competitor activity and recommend appropriate market actions.
  
  
7. P&L & Cost Control
  
  
- Take ownership of Kolkata city-level profitability.
  
- Monitor revenue, discounts, incentives, refunds and operational expenses.
  
- Improve productivity and control unnecessary operational costs.
  
- Work towards sustainable contribution margin and city profitability.
  
  
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
- Monthly Revenue & Collection Achievement
  
- Booking Growth
  
- Service Completion Rate
  
- Cancellation Rate
  
- Customer Rating & Complaint Resolution
  
- Repeat Customer Rate
  
- Active Professional Count
  
- Professional Utilisation
  
- Team Productivity
  
- Customer Acquisition & Retention
  
- City Contribution Margin / Profitability
  
- Expansion Performance
  
  
Candidate Profile
  
  
- Strong experience in operations, sales, business development or city management.
  
- Experience in home services, beauty & wellness, hyperlocal, marketplace, consumer services or startup operations will be preferred.
  
- Strong leadership and people-management capabilities.
  
- Highly target-oriented with strong execution skills.
  
- Comfortable working with numbers, dashboards and performance metrics.
  
- Ability to solve operational problems independently and make fast decisions.
  
- Strong understanding of the Kolkata market.
  
- Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership.
  
  
What We Expect
  
  
We are looking for a City Leader, not simply an Operations Manager.
  
  
The successful candidate should be capable of taking ownership of the Kolkata business, building a high-performance team, increasing revenue, maintaining excellent customer experience and developing ClearrCUT into a strong and profitable city-level business.
  
  
Core Principle:
  
Own the City. Own the Number. Own the Customer Experience.

* Screen resumes and conduct preliminary interviews to assess candidate suitability.

* Manage large-scale hiring campaigns to support business ramp-ups and expansion plans.
* Conduct walk-in drives, mega hiring events, virtual drives, campus recruitment programs, and job fairs.
* Coordinate and manage bulk interview drives with hiring managers and operations teams.
* Ensure achievement of daily, weekly, and monthly hiring targets.
* Develop innovative sourcing strategies to attract quality talent in a competitive market.

* Support pre-boarding and onboarding activities.

* Ensure recruitment process compliance and documentation accuracy.
* Monitor recruitment metrics and identify areas for process improvement.
* Support employer branding initiatives and social media recruitment activities.
* Collaborate with Training and HR teams to ensure seamless onboarding and candidate handover.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related discipline.

**Experience**

* Experience in BPO/ITES recruitment with exposure to mass hiring is preferred.

* Strong sourcing and screening skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Interviewing and candidate assessment capability.
* Stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* Negotiation and influencing skills.
* Good analytical and reporting skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and ATS platforms.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.

* Time to Fill (TAT)

* Interview-to-Selection Ratio
* Recruiter Productivity (Hires per Month)

BPO/ITES environments handling high-volume hiring, ramp-up projects, domestic and international customer support programs, technical support hiring, non-voice operations, and strategic workforce expansion.

– Senior Manager – CPC Outreach

**Internship & Placement Execution:**

* Work with the CPC team to plan and execute the annual placement and internship calendar, ensuring adequate corporate   participation across sectors and roles.
* Coordinate with partner companies to gather Job Descriptions, confirm participation timelines, and manage the end-to-end recruitment process on campus.
* Ensure a high quality of roles offered – aligned to Plaksha’s student profiles.
* Oversee the entire placement process, from employer outreach to final offer negotiations, ensuring seamless execution.
* Organize company visits, pre-placement talks, industrial tours, guest lectures, and expert sessions to enhance corporate engagement.
* Work closely with students to provide guidance on career opportunities, resume building, and interview preparation.

**Brand Positioning & Market Intelligence:**

* Develop and maintain a strong understanding of industry hiring trends, competitor university placements, and evolving skill  demands to sharpen Plaksha’s employer positioning.
* Work closely with the founding community, faculty, and students to align industry engagement with academic objectives and student career aspirations.
* Collaborate with faculty to develop co-curricular projects, capstone assignments, and live case studies with corporate partners.
* Leverage professional networks, LinkedIn, and industry databases to generate actionable intelligence on potential partners and role opportunities.
* Provide inputs on Plaksha’s employer branding collateral, student showcase events, and digital outreach to strengthen corporate mindshare.

**Education & Experience**

* Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Business, Marketing, or related fields; MBA with specialization in Sales, Marketing, or Business Development is preferred
* Minimum 8–12 years of relevant experience in corporate relations, campus placements, B2B sales, talent advisory, or executive  search.
* Prior experience in a university placement office or an organization working at the intersection of academia and industry is an advantage.

**Key Skills**

* Excellent communication skills – oral and written – with the ability to engage senior leaders with confidence and credibility.
* Strong understanding of industry trends, employer expectations, and career pathways for students in technology and innovation
* Strategic thinking ability and analytical skills; ability to prioritize and execute in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
* Commitment to excellence, accuracy, and attention to detail in all external communications and data management.

**What can Plaksha offer you?**

* An opportunity to collaborate and work with the best global academic and business leaders.
* A challenging yet flexible workplace with a focus on excellence and leadership development for all team members.
* A work culture that promotes continuous learning and development, enabling people to be their best selves.
* An opportunity to be part of one of the largest collective philanthropy initiatives to reimagine higher education and build future skills for the next generation.

**B. Candidate Management & Offer Coordination**

* Coordinate salary discussions, negotiations, and compensation approvals with management.
* Release offer letters and coordinate joining formalities with selected candidates.
* Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Ensure effective follow-up with selected candidates to minimise offer dropouts and joining delays.

**C. Recruitment MIS & Reporting**

* Maintain and update recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and manpower status reports.
* Prepare weekly and monthly recruitment MIS covering open positions, interviews, selections, offers, and actual joinings.
* Monitor recruitment turnaround time (TAT), offer-to-joining ratio, and source effectiveness.
* Track recruitment costs and support manpower planning activities.

**D. Stakeholder & Consultant Management**

* Coordinate with recruitment consultants and external hiring agencies.
* Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future manpower requirements.
* Ensure timely communication with hiring managers regarding recruitment progress and challenges.
* Support employer branding and talent pipeline development initiatives.

3. Key Skills & Competencies

* Strong sourcing, screening, and interviewing skills.
* Proficiency in job portals such as Naukri and LinkedIn.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies and prioritise urgent requirements.
* Strong follow-up, coordination, and candidate relationship management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, Outlook, and recruitment MIS.
* Result-oriented approach with a focus on recruitment timelines and quality of hire.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely closure of assigned vacancies.
* Recruitment turnaround time (TAT).
* Quality of candidates shortlisted and selected.
* Offer acceptance and joining ratios.
* Reduction in candidate dropouts and offer declines.
* Accuracy and timely submission of recruitment MIS.
* Hiring manager satisfaction.
* Cost-effective utilisation of recruitment channels.

5. Desired Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in end-to-end recruitment, preferably in the manufacturing, engineering, industrial, or corporate sector. The candidate should be comfortable handling multiple vacancies simultaneously and coordinating with senior management and departmental stakeholders.

**Reporting To:** HR Manager / Talent Acquisition Manager

title: Corporate Relations Manager
description:
Role at a glance

**A full-time, outcome-driven role combining office work in Delhi with field outreach to companies and campuses across Delhi NCR.**

About DIYguru

DIYguru Mobility Pvt. Ltd. is India's largest ASDC-certified EV skilling organisation. Since 2016, we have trained 95,000+ learners through 49 accredited programs, working with 528+ corporate partners across 8 countries.

We work with IIT Delhi, IIT Jammu, ASDC, AICTE, Bosch, Hyundai and Tata Technologies, and connect trained talent to employers through emobility.careers and the Bharat eMobility Recruitathon. The Recruitathon's Delhi Edition brought together 12 companies and 323 pre-screened candidates, with 200+ shortlisted.

About the role

DIYguru is looking for a Corporate Relations Lead to build and manage strong relationships with corporate recruiters, HR professionals, hiring managers, colleges, universities, ITIs, diploma institutes and industry stakeholders.

The role combines office-based and field-level outreach: visits to corporate offices, college campuses, universities, ITIs, industry events and networking platforms to develop new partnerships and generate measurable opportunities.

Your core objective is to turn relationships into outcomes — hiring requirements, placements, internships, OJT opportunities, corporate training, Recruitathon participation, industry partnerships, MoUs and repeat hiring.

Key responsibilitiesCorporate relationships & hiring

* Build and maintain relationships with HR Heads, Talent Acquisition teams, Hiring Managers and industry stakeholders.
* Conduct corporate outreach through LinkedIn, email, calls, referrals, networking and physical visits to company offices.
* Generate corporate leads and convert them into active hiring requirements, placements, internships and OJT opportunities.
* Acquire hiring requirements and coordinate with the placement team on candidate mapping, shortlisting, interviews and hiring drives.
* Ensure hiring partners confirm role, compensation and terms in writing before drives, in line with DIYguru's Hiring Partner Guidelines.
* Develop long-term relationships with companies and identify opportunities for repeat hiring and strategic partnerships.

Campus & institute relations

* Visit colleges, universities, ITIs and diploma institutes to develop placement, hiring, internship and industry collaboration opportunities.
* Build and maintain relationships with college TPOs, placement officers, HODs, deans and training & placement teams.
* Identify opportunities for corporate training, industry projects, OJT, internships, placement drives and other industry–academia collaborations.

Representation & partnerships

* Represent DIYguru in corporate meetings, campus meetings, industry events, HR forums, job fairs, networking events and Recruitathons.
* Support corporate communication, employer branding, hiring partner engagement, partnership announcements and MoU coordination.

Reporting & tracking

* Maintain accurate CRM records, MIS, corporate and institute databases, lead pipelines, follow-up trackers and hiring reports.
* Track outreach activity and ensure measurable outcomes from every corporate visit, campus visit, meeting and networking activity.

Key skills

* Relationship & communication: Strong corporate and professional communication; corporate relationship management; strong networking and relationship-building skills; ability to run meetings and presentations.
* Business development: Field sales / business development mindset; lead generation and conversion; negotiation and follow-up; LinkedIn networking and outreach; college and industry outreach.
* Placement know-how: Recruitment and placement coordination; understanding of JDs and hiring requirements.
* Tools & reporting: Excel / Google Sheets, CRM and MIS management.
* Working style: Willingness to travel locally for corporate and campus visits; comfortable working with targets, field activities and measurable outcomes.

Who can apply
  
Qualifications & experience

* Graduate in any discipline; an MBA or PGDM in HR, Marketing or Business Development is preferred.
* 2–5 years of experience in corporate relations, B2B sales, business development, campus relations, placements or recruitment.
* Experience working with HR teams, recruiters or college placement cells is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with the EV, automotive, engineering or skilling sector is an advantage.

The ideal candidate

We prefer candidates who are comfortable with field outreach, travelling for meetings, and actively developing relationships with companies and educational institutions.

The ideal candidate can confidently meet HR teams, recruiters, TPOs, college management and industry professionals, understand their requirements, and convert those relationships into actual hiring and partnership opportunities.

What we offer

* Visible impact: Every partnership you build turns into jobs, internships and careers for EV learners.
* A strong network to start from: Work with DIYguru's base of 528+ corporate partners and established academic relationships.
* Flagship events: Play a lead role in employer engagement for the Bharat eMobility Recruitathon as it expands to new cities.
* Ownership: Build and own corporate relationships in one of India's fastest-growing sectors.
* Growth: A performance-based annual appraisal cycle and room to grow as DIYguru expands nationally and internationally.
