title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Dcluttr is an AI copilot for quick commerce. We are challenging a brand’s most trusted decision-making tool: gut feeling.

We are building a team to solve complex problems in the global quick commerce and e-commerce AI analytics space. Finding exceptional people is a big part of that journey, and we're looking for someone who can help us build a team that raises the bar.

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist at Dcluttr, you won't just be posting jobs and screening resumes. You'll work closely with the founders and hiring managers to understand what great talent looks like, identify the right people, and drive hiring across engineering, data, product, sales, marketing, and business functions.

This role is for someone who enjoys solving problems, finding people others might miss, and taking ownership of outcomes in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Responsibilities:**

1. Technical Recruitment

- Drive hiring for technical roles, including Backend Engineers, Data Engineers, Data Analysts, QA Engineers, and Product Managers.

- Understand job requirements, technical skills, and evaluation criteria to identify relevant candidates.

- Source candidates through LinkedIn, GitHub, job portals, referrals, college networks, and other relevant channels.

- Identify strong engineering and data talent, including candidates from top-tier engineering colleges.

- Work closely with engineering and product teams to understand candidate profiles, coordinate technical assessments, and streamline interview processes.

2. Non-Technical Recruitment

- Manage hiring across business functions, including Sales, GTM, Customer Success, Performance Marketing, HR, and Operations.

- Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements, prioritise open positions, and define candidate evaluation criteria.

- Build talent pipelines for current openings as well as future hiring requirements.

3. End-to-End Hiring

- Own the recruitment lifecycle, from understanding requirements and sourcing candidates to screening, interview coordination, offer management, and onboarding handover.

- Conduct initial screening calls to evaluate candidates on relevant experience, communication, motivation, and role suitability.

- Coordinate with interviewers, manage feedback, and ensure candidates move efficiently through the hiring process.

- Manage candidate follow-ups, salary discussions, offer rollouts, and closures in coordination with the relevant stakeholders.

- Maintain a strong candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.

4. Talent Sourcing & Market Research

- Proactively identify and engage relevant candidates instead of relying solely on inbound applications.

- Research companies, colleges, professional communities, and talent pools to identify potential candidates.

- Develop creative sourcing strategies for niche and difficult-to-fill positions.

- Build and maintain talent pipelines for recurring and upcoming hiring needs.

- Explore alternative hiring channels, referral networks, and campus hiring opportunities to improve the quality of candidates.

5. Stakeholder Management

- Work directly with founders and hiring managers to align on hiring priorities and timelines.

- Understand the difference between a good candidate on paper and someone who can thrive in an early-stage startup.

- Share regular hiring updates, highlight bottlenecks, and proactively suggest ways to improve hiring outcomes.

- Manage multiple open positions simultaneously while balancing urgency with candidate quality.

6. Recruitment Operations & Metrics

- Maintain accurate recruitment trackers and candidate databases.

- Track key metrics such as time-to-hire, sourcing effectiveness, interview conversion rates, and offer acceptance rates.

- Ensure timely interview scheduling, feedback collection, and candidate communication.

- Identify inefficiencies in the recruitment process and implement improvements to make hiring faster and more effective.

**Requirements:**

- 0–1 year of experience in Talent Acquisition, recruitment, or HR. Freshers with relevant internships are welcome.

- Strong interest in recruitment, talent sourcing, and understanding what makes people successful in different roles.

- Good understanding of LinkedIn, job portals, candidate sourcing, and recruitment processes.

- Willingness to learn the fundamentals of technical hiring and understand the skills required for engineering, data, and product roles.

- Strong communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to assess candidates beyond their resumes and ask relevant screening questions.

- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple roles and deadlines.

- A proactive, resourceful approach to problem-solving, with a willingness to experiment with different sourcing strategies.

- High ownership and accountability, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

**Why join us?**

-Work directly with the founders: Understand business priorities and help shape the team we're building.

- Build across functions: Get hands-on exposure to technical and non-technical hiring in an AI startup.

- Own the process: Take responsibility for your roles and see the impact of your work from sourcing to closure.

- Learn technical recruitment: Develop the ability to identify and engage strong engineering, data, and product talent.

- Move fast: Work in an environment where initiative, execution, and problem-solving matter.

- Grow with the company: Build a strong foundation in talent acquisition as Dcluttr scales.

You'll be part of a team where the quality of people we hire directly influences what we can build. The role will be fast-paced, demanding, and full of opportunities to learn.

If that sounds right to you, apply :)

title: Engineering Manager
description:

Gurugram, India

**Description**
Based in Gurugram, you will lead our newly established software team (currently four engineers) as we enter an exciting new phase of expansion. We are seeking an Engineering Manager who will build a strong, happy, high-performing team, creating the environment, clarity, and support that enables people to do their best work. This is a people-first role: you will have proven strength in leadership, scaling teams, and developing others. You will report to the Head of Software Product Engineering.
  
  
Aurora’s mission is to help drive the energy transition through data-driven energy market intelligence and software that supports decision-makers across the power system. Our platform includes microservices and modern web applications (TypeScript/Node, React, AWS). While this is a leadership-focused role, you will still do some hands-on senior engineering work, contributing code when needed, leading by example on quality, and helping the team make sound technical decisions
  
  
You will establish the people and process foundations for an effective engineering team: regular 1:1s, coaching and feedback, inclusive ways of working, and strong delivery practices (planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives). A key part of the role is growing the team through hiring, attracting, assessing, and onboarding great talent in Gurugram.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and grow the Gurugram engineering team, creating a positive, inclusive, high-trust culture with strong team health and engagement.
* Hire, onboard, and retain great engineers, owning the hiring process end-to-end in partnership with HR and engineering leadership.

* Run effective engineering processes and ceremonies (planning, daily coordination, reviews, and especially high-quality retrospectives) that drive continuous improvement and predictable delivery.
* Partner with Product and stakeholders to shape priorities, manage expectations, and ensure the team delivers valuable outcomes with a sustainable pace and high quality

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Required attributes:**

* Strong people leadership and emotional intelligence: able to build trust, communicate clearly, handle difficult conversations, and foster psychological safety.

* Demonstrated hiring capability: defining roles, running structured interviews, assessing both technical and behavioural skills, and making high-quality hiring decisions.
* Experience running effective team processes (e.g., planning, reviews, and retrospectives) and using outcomes to drive continuous improvement.
* Able to lead within a distributed environment and collaborate effectively with Oxford-based colleagues through proactive communication and inclusion.
* Experience working hands-on with our (or similar) stack: Node/TypeScript, ExpressJS, React, SQL/NoSQL, AWS and microservices.
* Strong organisational skills: can balance competing priorities, create clarity, and follow through on commitments.

**Desirable attributes:**

* Experience using delivery metrics (e.g., DORA) to inform team practices.
* Experience with engineering quality practices such as unit testing and CI/CD pipelines.

**What we offer**
Some of the benefits we include are:

* Accidental, term life and medical insurance
* Hybrid Work model
* Employee’s Provident Fund Scheme
* Maternity leave
* A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture
* Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.
* Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects

The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavorable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity.

• Support the design, configuration, implementation, and continuous improvement of Compensation and Total Rewards solutions within the HR technology landscape.
  
• Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate Compensation needs into scalable system and process solutions.
  
• Manage product backlog items, enhancements, change requests, and release activities, including testing, deployment, and user adoption.
  
• Develop and maintain expertise in end-to-end Compensation processes, including salary review cycles, compensation planning, compensation structures, system integrations, and stakeholder communications.
  
• Support and optimize Compensation-related solutions in SuccessFactors Compensation & Employee Central modules, integrated HR and vendor platforms, ensuring data accuracy and system reliability.
  
• Build strong relationships with stakeholders across Total Rewards, People & Culture, Global Business Operations, Data & Analytics, Security, and external partners to drive successful outcomes.
  
• Manage incidents, service requests, testing activities, compliance requirements, and continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging analytics, AI, and automation to enhance operational efficiency and user experience.
  
  
This is our wish list! If you don’t recognize yourself in all these points, you might still be an excellent candidate for the role.
  
  
The must-haves we see for this role is though:
  
• Strong understanding of Compensation, Collective Bargaining Agreements, as well as Total Rewards processes within a global organization.
  
• 7+ years of experience working with HR technology solutions, preferably SAP SuccessFactors Compensation and Employee Central.
  
• Knowledge of HR integrations and related processes.
  
• Experience managing system enhancements, incidents, and change requests.
  
• Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication abilities.
  
• Ability to simplify complex processes and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  
• Experience working in Agile product delivery environments.
  
• Familiarity with AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives within HR and Total Rewards.
  
  
  
The IKEA culture and values are very much a part of our business and day-to-day work life. For you to thrive and grow with IKEA it’s important for us that you share our values! You can read more about our values and life at IKEA on our website www.ikea.com.

**A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US**

You’ll be a vital part in the transformation of IKEA into a more front-line obsessed company by ensuring that we constantly understand what our co-workers are telling us
  
  
This means that you will:
  
  
• Work within a global digital Total rewards team to gather business requirements, support, and enhance the area of Compensation, while delivering effective solutions.
  
• Oversee and manage change requests, incidents, and enhancement activities related to Compensation, ensuring timely resolution, system stability, and minimal impact on business operations.
  
• Collaborate closely with Global Business Operations (GBO), HR stakeholders, and country teams to review related services delivered by vendors, ensuring compliance with agreed service levels, KPIs, and governance standards.

**TOGETHER AS A TEAM**

You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingkas global organisation.
  
  
• We are the Digital Compensation & Benefits team within Total Rewards subdomain, dedicated to ensuring seamless system for compensation for our P&C stakeholders in the Ingka digital landscape.

* **Internship & On-Job Training:**

* **Data & Reporting:**

title: Talent Intelligence Senior Analyst
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY Global Services**
**Global Talent Intelligence Senior Analyst**
This is an opportunity to become part of the Global Talent Delivery Team responsible for ensuring alignment of talent solutions, processes, and data, enabling continuous improvement through digital enablement and delivering management information and predictive talent insights. The successful candidate will join the Talent Insights and Analytics Team (TIA), a key sub function, who enables transformation by providing global, reliable, and integrated talent data solutions that help leaders make smarter, data-driven talent decisions.
  
  
The TIA Advanced Analytics Sub-Pillar team is expanding their Talent Intelligence capabilities to complement our existing data models and solutions.
  
  
Our mission is to leverage Talent Intelligence to support business decisions by combining and analyzing various sources of information about the external talent landscape. We provide Talent Intelligence solutions, analysis, and recommendations to EY business and talent leaders across all service lines and geographies, addressing challenges questions throughout the talent lifecycle.
  
  
Through our dedicated Global Talent Intelligence platform, we have access to millions of data points, including over 20 million mapped companies, 1.1 billion profiles, and data from 5,200 cities, all aligned to a central skills taxonomy of 3,400 skills and activities.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Talent Intelligence Analyst to join our global Talent Insights and Analytics team. This role will focus on talent and workforce external labor data, transforming data from external vendors, and producing actionable insights that resonate with stakeholders. The successful candidate will also be responsible for building Talent Intelligence solutions in PowerBI and integrating Talent Intelligence data into our existing suite of solutions.
  
  
You will work closely with the Global Talent Intelligence Behavioral Science Lead and other team members to provide actionable insights and recommendations that drive strategic workforce decisions. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your skills and contribute to the advancement of Talent Intelligence at EY.
  
  
**About You**
You are a detail-oriented and analytical professional with a strong background in data transformation, statistical analysis, and data visualization. You have a strong foundational understanding of labor market dynamics, and behavioral science and are eager to apply your skills to support Talent Intelligence initiatives. You thrive in a global and collaborative environment and are excited about the opportunity to work with a diverse team of experts to drive EY's talent strategy forward.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Understand and transform data from external vendors to ensure accuracy and relevance.
* Assess the effectiveness of data sources and data-gathering techniques and aid continuous improvement and enhancement of the overarching Talent Intelligence analytics suite development.
* Utilize programming languages such as R or Python to analyze and interpret data.
* Effectively leverage SQL to manipulate Talent Intelligence data.
* Create and maintain PowerBI dashboards to visualize data and communicate insights effectively.
* Conduct applied talent research and productize insights at scale, using both internal and external economic and talent data to build insights and recommendations.
* Collaborate with the Global Talent Intelligence Behavioral Science Lead and other team members to understand business needs and provide tailored Talent Intelligence solutions.
* Assist in the development and delivery of Talent Intelligence products, reports, and presentations.
* Monitor external best practices and internal feedback to identify and propose opportunities and support the functional leads in the feasibility analysis for the enhancement of existing practices, models, and processes.
* Contribute to a culture of continuous learning and development within the TIA team.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Behavioural Science, Psychology, or a related field.
* Deep subject matter expertise in data engineering, visualization, and related functional domains to generate and support insights and analytics.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as R and statistical software like SPSS.
* Experience with data visualization tools such as PowerBI.
* Foundational understanding of behavioural science principles and their application to Talent Intelligence.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information to non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* A proactive and innovative mindset, with a passion for leveraging data to drive strategic business decisions.

**What We Offer**
As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, global team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

title: Associate Director, CTI - Development, Clinical Dev
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
CTI MD Tech@Lilly
  
Associate Director, CTI - Development, Clinical Dev
  
**Management Level:** M1 | Job Family: Information Technology
  
  
**About the Organization:**  
CTI - Development owns the digital capability that patients, sites and study teams meet first: consent and data capture, patient engagement, and the systems that get a study designed, started and set up. The portfolio spans Trial Capabilities, Clinical Experience and patient engagement, and AI & Analytics. The organization is mid-transformation, modernizing platforms and scaling AI and agentic use cases while operating under strict GxP/GCP, data integrity and inspection-readiness requirements.
  
  
**Job Description:**  
The Associate Director, CTI - Development, Clinical Dev, leads a team of engineering, product and delivery professionals and owns delivery, technical direction and capability growth across the Trial Capabilities, Clinical Experience and AI & Analytics domains. The role sits where clinical process meets engineering: close enough to the build to lead a design review and challenge an architecture, fluent enough in trial execution to shape how a study team actually works. It owns the demand relationship with clinical development business owners, directs the partner teams delivering a material share of the work, manages allocated budget and contractor capacity against plan, and is expected to set the agenda for AI and agentic adoption rather than wait for direction on it. Hands-on technical experience is expected and non-negotiable: a practitioner who has built and shipped software and integrations directly, and who stays current enough to pressure-test an architecture or a build versus buy call. The role is scoped at the upper end of the band and is expected to grow into responsibility for broader teams as the portfolio expands.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities :**  
Delivery Ownership
  
  

* Own delivery execution across the portfolio (scope, schedule, quality, dependencies, release readiness, production health) for clinical experience and patient engagement products (eConsent, ePRO/eCOA, patient portals and apps) and study start-up capabilities (site activation, study build, CTMS/eTMF integration).
* Run the standing delivery cadence of operational reviews, backlog grooming, planning cycles (e.g., PI Planning) and release governance as a single portfolio-wide rhythm, and apply product-management rigor to prioritization, scoring business value, technical debt, effort and risk explicitly and agreeing success measures before work starts.
* Define and implement the portfolio metrics framework: release predictability, defect escape, production reliability, study build and site activation cycle time, and adoption by sites, study teams and patients. Instrument it where stakeholders can see it, not inside a backlog tool.
* Identify and solve organizational and operational problems and technical challenges across the portfolio, from resourcing conflicts and scope ambiguity to cross-team dependencies, escalating only what falls outside established guidelines and doing so with a recommendation.

Technical Direction & Engineering Standards
  
  

* Set and defend the technical direction of the portfolio; review architecture and design, challenge weak decisions, and own standards for APIs, data contracts, interoperability (CDISC, HL7/FHIR) and reuse across clinical platforms.
* Own the architecture and design decisions for the portfolio's products, approve solution and integration designs, and run a design review cadence that catches problems before a release rather than after one.
* Raise the engineering bar on test automation, CI/CD, observability and the deliberate reduction of technical debt.
* Stay personally current: spend enough time in the code, the integrations and the production systems to judge an estimate, read a pull request and ask the questions only a practitioner asks.

AI & Agentic Transformation
  
  

* Define and land a 12 to 24 month vision for AI and agentic capability in study start-up and clinical experience: protocol and document intelligence, automated study build, site and patient-facing assistants. Make the business case for it.
* Find the use cases, prove them quickly at low cost, and take the ones that work through validation into production use with the evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop design that requires.
* Build the team's AI fluency, make AI-assisted engineering the normal way of working, and partner with business owners to redesign clinical process rather than automate around it.

Resource, Budget & Vendor Management
  
  

* Forecast resource needs across the portfolio and manage allocated budget and contractor capacity within approved guidelines, including allocation, ramp-up and release decisions.
* Own vendor and partner delivery: define scope, outcomes and acceptance criteria, hold suppliers to the same engineering, quality and GxP standards as internal teams, and manage performance on predictability and quality.
* Own SOW/MSA follow-ups, renewals and scope amendments, shape the sourcing mix for the portfolio, and protect institutional knowledge through documentation, code ownership and cross-training.

Business Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Act as the technology partner for business owners and study teams: the person they call first, and the person who tells them when an idea will not work. Represent the portfolio externally with platform vendors, sites and industry forums, influencing partner roadmaps toward Lilly's needs.
* Run the demand relationship: capture and challenge incoming requests, agree priorities against capacity, and keep one honest view of the roadmap and what has been traded away. Contribute to the Clinical Dev business-area plan by translating the modernization roadmap into resourced delivery cycles.
* Translate clinical need into technical options, and constraint, risk and cost into language a business owner can act on, with no surprises at release.

People Leadership
  
  

* Hold management responsibility for the team, including hiring, onboarding, goal-setting and performance appraisals; hire for the capability the portfolio needs next, such as AI engineering, product thinking and clinical domain depth.
* Coach and develop through specific feedback, honest check-ins and a development plan each person recognises as their own; serve as career advisor and partner with HR on growth plans.
* Grow engineering craft, not only careers: use design and code review as teaching moments, and build shared practice across internal pods and partner teams so good patterns spread.
* Build bench strength and succession, remove single points of failure, and lead through senior engineers, technical leads and partner pod leads as the portfolio grows, setting direction for work executed beyond direct line management.

Quality, Compliance & Process Leadership
  
  

* Deliver in a GxP/GCP-regulated environment covering computer system validation, 21 CFR Part 11, data integrity, inspection and audit readiness; design for security and patient data privacy from the start; own incident response and the service levels agreed with study teams.
* Implement and refine a standard framework for backlog management, delivery governance and execution (Agile/Kanban, PI Planning), and own the portfolio-level leadership reporting cadence.

**Required Skills and Expertise :**  

* 10+ years of relevant experience in technology delivery, engineering leadership or product/platform management, including 4+ years of people-leadership experience managing technical teams.
* Deep, current, hands-on engineering background: able to build, review and troubleshoot services, APIs and integrations, not solely credentialed from past roles. Fluency in at least one modern programming language and SQL, with working command of cloud platforms and integration patterns.
* Proven experience taking AI, machine learning or agentic solutions beyond proof of concept into governed production use.
* Experience managing vendor and contractor relationships, including SOW/MSA administration within established commercial guidelines, and forecasting resource needs against an allocated budget.
* Demonstrated success owning a senior business relationship: shaping demand, negotiating priorities and capacity, and holding credibility through difficult delivery news.
* Demonstrated experience defining delivery or product metrics frameworks that stakeholders actually use.
* Demonstrated success building and retaining a technical team: hiring engineers, coaching through design review, and keeping critical talent.
* Experience operating in regulated (GxP) environments, including computer system validation and inspection-readiness practices, with fluency in Agile/Kanban delivery and tooling (Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow or equivalent).
* Strong communication skills, translating technical trade-offs into business, clinical and regulatory language.

**Preferred Skills:**  

* 4+ years supporting clinical development technology: study start-up, site activation, patient- or site-facing systems, or clinical data capture.
* Experience with Veeva Vault Clinical, Medidata or comparable clinical platforms, working knowledge of clinical data standards (CDISC CDASH/SDTM, HL7/FHIR), and exposure to decentralized or hybrid trial designs.

**Education & Experience:**  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field (Master's preferred); Agile or PMP certification a plus.
* Demonstrated ownership of delivery for a portfolio or platform, shaping technical direction from direct engineering experience.

title: Senior Engineering Manager - Benefits
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, **Rippling has raised $1.85B+** from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a high-impact platform engineering team responsible for core infrastructure and product foundations used across Rippling. This role owns multiple horizontal charters, including Data Deletion, Webscripts, Internationalisation, and Rippling Config Service. These systems sit at the intersection of platform scalability, developer productivity, compliance, configuration management, and customer-facing product quality. The ideal candidate is a strong engineering leader who can operate across ambiguous problem spaces, partner deeply with product and infrastructure teams, and build durable systems that scale with Rippling’s product surface.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Lead and grow a team of engineers working on critical platform charters.
* Own technical strategy and execution for Data Deletion, Webscripts, Internationalisation, and Rippling Config Service.
* Partner with product, design, compliance, security, and infrastructure teams to define roadmaps and delivery plans.
* Drive architecture reviews and ensure systems are reliable, scalable, maintainable, and secure.
* Establish clear ownership, operational excellence, and engineering quality across multiple platform surfaces.
* Balance short-term product needs with long-term platform investments.
* Mentor senior engineers and engineering leads, helping them grow their technical judgment and leadership.
* Improve execution rigor through planning, prioritization, metrics, incident reviews, and continuous process improvement.
* Represent the team in cross-functional forums and communicate tradeoffs clearly to senior leadership.

### **What We’re Looking For**

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, with 3+ years managing engineering teams.
* Experience leading platform, infrastructure, developer productivity, or shared product-surface teams.
* Strong technical judgment and ability to reason about distributed systems, data models, APIs, reliability, and scale.
* Proven ability to lead ambiguous, cross-functional charters with multiple stakeholders.
* Experience managing senior engineers and driving alignment across teams.
* Strong execution discipline: roadmap planning, project delivery, operational metrics, and incident follow-through.
* Ability to balance product velocity with long-term platform quality.
* Clear written and verbal communication, especially around tradeoffs and technical strategy.

### **Nice To Have**

* Experience with privacy, compliance, data lifecycle, or data deletion systems(GDPR, CCPA).
* Experience building internal platforms or frameworks used by many product teams.
* Experience with internationalisation/localisation systems.
* Experience with configuration platforms, feature/config rollout systems, or policy/config management.
* Experience with low-code, scripting, workflow, or extensibility platforms.

### **Why This Role Matters**

This team builds foundational systems that many Rippling products depend on. The role requires someone who can think like a platform owner: creating leverage for other teams, reducing duplication, improving reliability, and ensuring that core systems continue to scale as Rippling grows across products, countries, and customer segments.

### **About You**

You are a hands-on engineering leader who enjoys operating at both technical and organizational levels. You can dive into architecture when needed, but your real strength is creating clarity, building strong teams, and helping engineers deliver high-quality systems in complex environments.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: Assistant Manager - Global Benefits Operations
description:
**Job Description :**

**Context and scope**
=====================

Global Benefits Operations delivers benefits administration through consistent processes, reliable data, effective controls and responsive employee support. The Assistant Manager leads the assigned team across markets and time zones, translating approved benefit policies into accurate, timely and controlled operational delivery.

The scope includes annual benefit enrolment, joiner, mover and leaver administration, vendor data exchanges, purchase orders, invoice reconciliation, reporting and query management. Benefits may include health insurance, pensions, product allowances, car benefits and other locally approved arrangements, where assigned to the team.

**Purpose of the role**
=======================

Own the day-to-day performance of the assigned benefits operations service, protecting employee benefit continuity and financial accuracy. Build a capable team, resolve operational escalations and improve processes through standardisation, simplification and automation in line with the global payroll and benefits strategy.

**Financial responsibilities**
==============================

  

* Manage benefits purchase order creation, invoice validation and reconciliation within procurement requirements and delegated authority; coordinate timely payment with Finance and Accounts Payable.
* Reconcile vendor charges to approved rates, eligibility and enrolment data. Investigate discrepancies, recover or correct errors and escalate unresolved liabilities before service continuity is affected.
* Monitor assigned operational costs and spend against approved plans; provide variance insights and identify measurable efficiency opportunities.

**Market complexity**
=====================

  

* Lead service delivery across the assigned markets, accommodating local benefit rules, enrolment calendars, currencies, languages, vendor arrangements and time zones.
* Coordinate accurate and timely joiner, mover and leaver data and benefit changes across Workday, benefit platforms, vendors and Payroll. Validate payroll-impacting deductions, allowances and taxable benefit inputs within agreed cut-offs.
* Partner with Reward, market HR, Payroll, Finance, Procurement, Tax and Digital teams to resolve dependencies and clarify ownership at process hand-offs.
* Implement approved policy and regulatory changes with guidance from Reward, HR, Tax and Legal; maintain market-specific procedures and operational evidence.
* Manage sensitive employee data through approved access, transfer and retention controls. Maintain service continuity during peak enrolment, organisational changes and vendor or system transitions.

**Leadership responsibilities and capabilities**
================================================

  

* Lead Benefits Junior Managers and Case Specialists with clear accountabilities, work allocation, performance expectations and escalation routes.
* Plan capacity for routine activity and peak cycles; establish trained backups, maintain knowledge coverage and address capability gaps through coaching and development.
* Review service performance, aged cases, control exceptions and recurring failures. Hold team members and partners accountable for corrective actions and sustained results.
* Make timely operational decisions within delegated authority. Escalate material employee, financial, compliance and service risks with clear impact, options and recommended action.
* Build constructive relationships across functions and vendors; challenge missed commitments and resolve issues through evidence and clear ownership.
* Create an inclusive team environment where colleagues raise concerns early, learn from errors and take responsibility for employee outcomes.
* Deliver improvements with the Process Excellence and Transformation teams, ensuring implementation readiness, control integrity and measurable benefits.

**Decision rights and governance**
==================================

The role owns operational work allocation, quality assurance, service escalations and improvement delivery within the agreed scope. Approvals for expenditure, benefit changes and vendor commitments must follow delegated authority. Reward and market HR retain benefit policy and plan design decisions; Tax and Legal provide specialist interpretation. Vendor governance, including pensions, follows the agreed ownership model for each market.

**Top five accountabilities**
=============================

1. Benefits service delivery and employee experience

  

* Own accurate and timely delivery of assigned benefits administration, reporting, vendor data exchanges and annual enrolment activities against agreed service levels and calendars.
* Manage complex cases and escalations, prioritising employee impact and benefit continuity. Ensure timely updates, clear resolution ownership and follow-through.
* Maintain readiness plans for peak cycles, absence cover and service disruption; resolve upstream dependencies before deadlines are missed.

**2. Financial control compliance and assurance**
-------------------------------------------------

* Ensure assigned CARM controls, reconciliations and quality checks are performed, evidenced and independently reviewed in line with control design.
* Oversee purchase orders, vendor invoices and reconciliation exceptions, maintaining clear audit trails and appropriate segregation of duties.
* Coordinate audit requests and close findings; investigate control failures, implement root-cause actions and escalate material risks promptly.

**3. Vendor and stakeholder management**
----------------------------------------

  

* Manage operational performance of assigned benefits vendors through service reviews, action tracking and escalation of missed commitments.
* Work with Finance, Procurement and vendor owners to resolve billing and payment issues; support renewal and service improvement discussions with performance evidence.
* Agree responsibilities and cut-offs with Reward, HR and Payroll, ensuring unresolved issues have a named owner and escalation route.

**4. Digital enablement and process excellence**
------------------------------------------------

  

* Maintain accurate process maps, work instructions, benefits matrices, guides, factsheets and FAQs; ensure changes are approved, communicated and supported by training.
* Use Workday, benefits platforms and case management tools to improve data quality, reporting and workflow visibility.
* Deliver prioritised standardisation and automation initiatives with relevant partners, validating employee outcomes, controls and realised efficiency.

**5. Team leadership and capability building**
----------------------------------------------

  

* Set individual objectives, review performance and coach the team in benefits administration, financial controls, problem-solving and stakeholder communication.
* Maintain skills assessments, training plans and backup coverage for critical processes; address underperformance with clear expectations and support.
* Embed ownership, respectful challenge and continuous learning; ensure delivery quality is sustained during staffing and scope changes.

**Measures of success**
=======================

Performance will be assessed against agreed annual targets for service accuracy, timeliness and case SLAs; enrolment and benefit continuity; invoice and reconciliation completion; control execution and audit closure; vendor performance; backup coverage; and verified improvement benefits.

**Core skills required**
========================

  

* Benefits operations expertise – understand eligibility, enrolment, lifecycle changes and links to payroll, finance and employee experience.
* People leadership – plan work, coach colleagues, manage performance and build capability and backup coverage.
* Stakeholder management and communication – explain issues clearly, manage expectations and influence resolution across markets and functions.
* Analytical problem-solving and business acumen – investigate data and cost discrepancies, assess employee and financial impact and act on root causes.
* Governance and ethical judgement – apply controls, protect confidentiality and make proportionate decisions within delegated authority.
* Change agility and resilience – maintain operational discipline through competing priorities, peak cycles and process changes.

**Digital and technical skills required**
=========================================

  

* Practical experience with Workday or comparable HRIS, benefits administration platforms and case management systems.
* Advanced Excel capability, including formulas, pivot tables and reconciliation of data from multiple sources.
* Working knowledge of purchase order and invoice workflows, vendor reconciliation, access controls and secure employee data handling.
* Ability to produce service dashboards, maintain process documentation and validate interfaces and payroll-impacting benefit data.

**Advanced skills preferred**
=============================

  

* Exposure to European and multi-country benefits administration, including insurance and pensions operations.
* Experience with workflow automation, Power BI or equivalent reporting tools and structured process improvement methods.
* Experience supporting annual enrolment, vendor transitions, system changes or shared services transformation.

**Qualifications and experience required**
==========================================

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Typically 8–10 years of progressive experience in benefits, HR operations or related payroll service delivery, including at least 2 years of team supervision or operational leadership.
* Demonstrated experience in benefits administration, vendor coordination, financial reconciliations and control execution in a multi-country or shared services environment.
* Proven ability to lead a team, resolve complex operational issues and deliver measurable service or process improvements.
* Strong analytical capability, attention to detail and professional English communication. Payroll knowledge and relevant HR, benefits or process improvement qualifications are advantageous.

**Barriers to success in the role**
===================================

  

* Managing activity without taking ownership of employee outcomes, deadlines and unresolved exceptions.
* Weak capacity planning, insufficient backup coverage or failure to address capability and performance gaps.
* Late escalation of benefit interruptions, billing discrepancies, control failures or vendor issues.
* Inaccurate data, incomplete reconciliations or weak documentation and audit evidence.
* Poor collaboration across Reward, HR, Payroll, Finance and vendors, leaving process hand-offs unowned.
* Resistance to simplification, or implementing changes without validating operational readiness and controls.
* Discouraging constructive challenge, withholding concerns or disengaging when decisions are made.

**Flexible working statement**
==============================

Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you are supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one. Working arrangements should support the agreed service model, market time zones and critical benefits delivery periods.

**Diversity statement**
=======================

Our purpose is to celebrate life, every day, everywhere. Creating an inclusive culture where everyone feels valued and belongs is central to this purpose. We welcome people of different genders, ethnicities, abilities, ages, sexual orientations, social backgrounds, educational backgrounds and experiences. The role holder will help build a team that values different perspectives, provides equitable development opportunities and delivers respectful service to employees across our markets.

**About us**

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.

A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."

  Bengaluru
* Employment type

  Full Time Permanent
* Department

* Deadline

Candidate profile (title) Who you are

Candidate profile (text) - Default language We are looking for a Product Specialist to join us in developing ways for IKEA to stay relevant for our customers.
  
  
Our diverse team is growing, and we would love to talk with you, if you recognize yourself in some of the following:
  
  

* Support the design, configuration, implementation, and continuous improvement of Compensation and Total Rewards solutions within the HR technology landscape.
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate Compensation needs into scalable system and process solutions.
* Manage product backlog items, enhancements, change requests, and release activities, including testing, deployment, and user adoption.
* Develop and maintain expertise in end-to-end Compensation processes, including salary review cycles, compensation planning, compensation structures, system integrations, and stakeholder communications.
* Support and optimize Compensation-related solutions in SuccessFactors Compensation & Employee Central modules, integrated HR and vendor platforms, ensuring data accuracy and system reliability.
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders across Total Rewards, People & Culture, Global Business Operations, Data & Analytics, Security, and external partners to drive successful outcomes.
* Manage incidents, service requests, testing activities, compliance requirements, and continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging analytics, AI, and automation to enhance operational efficiency and user experience.

  
This is our wish list! If you don’t recognize yourself in all these points, you might still be an excellent candidate for the role.
  
  
The must-haves we see for this role is though:
  

* Strong understanding of Compensation, Collective Bargaining Agreements, as well as Total Rewards processes within a global organization.
* 7+ years of experience working with HR technology solutions, preferably SAP SuccessFactors Compensation and Employee Central.
* Knowledge of HR integrations and related processes.
* Experience managing system enhancements, incidents, and change requests.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication abilities.
* Ability to simplify complex processes and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience working in Agile product delivery environments.
* Familiarity with AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives within HR and Total Rewards.

  
  
The IKEA culture and values are very much a part of our business and day-to-day work life. For you to thrive and grow with IKEA it’s important for us that you share our values! You can read more about our values and life at IKEA on our website www.ikea.com.

Key responsibilities (title) A day in your life with us

Key responsibilities (text) You’ll be a vital part in the transformation of IKEA into a more front-line obsessed company by ensuring that we constantly understand what our co-workers are telling us
  
  
This means that you will:
  
  

* Work within a global digital Total rewards team to gather business requirements, support, and enhance the area of Compensation, while delivering effective solutions.
* Oversee and manage change requests, incidents, and enhancement activities related to Compensation, ensuring timely resolution, system stability, and minimal impact on business operations.
* Collaborate closely with Global Business Operations (GBO), HR stakeholders, and country teams to review related services delivered by vendors, ensuring compliance with agreed service levels, KPIs, and governance standards.

Team vision ( title) Together as a team

Team vision (text) You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingkas global organisation.
  
  

* We are the Digital Compensation & Benefits team within Total Rewards subdomain, dedicated to ensuring seamless system for compensation for our P&C stakeholders in the Ingka digital landscape.

title: Digital Content Author & Publisher
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Role Summary**
----------------

The Specialist, Digital Content Author & Publisher will create, update, validate, schedule, and publish web content using Adobe Experience Manager and related digital tools. The role combines hands-on content production with publishing operations, quality assurance, governance support, and optimization discipline. The successful candidate will be comfortable working in a structured, regulated environment where accuracy, accessibility, metadata, approvals, documentation, and first-time-right execution are essential to delivering a trusted digital experience.

**What This Role Owns**
-----------------------

* **Authoring and publishing execution:** Build, update, schedule, publish, and unpublish web pages and digital assets using AEM templates, components, content fragments, experience fragments, workflows, and approved publishing processes.
* **Publishing operations:** Support intake validation, request coordination, status tracking, release readiness, post-publish checks, content lifecycle updates, and recurring website maintenance.
* **Quality and compliance:** Apply brand, editorial, legal, regulatory, accessibility, metadata, and SEO standards before content moves live.
* **Operational documentation:** Maintain publishing logs, authoring instructions, page records, issue notes, and standard operating procedure updates to strengthen repeatability and reduce key-person dependency.
* **Optimization support:** Use analytics, site-health observations, SEO inputs, accessibility checks, and stakeholder feedback to identify practical improvements to content structure, findability, usability, and page performance.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Create, edit, format, schedule, publish, and maintain content across Northern Trust’s enterprise web properties using Adobe Experience Manager and related publishing tools.
* Build pages from approved requirements, content, designs, wireframes, templates, component guidance, and digital experience standards.
* Upload, organize, tag, and maintain digital assets, including images, documents, videos, PDFs, disclosures, and supporting media within AEM Assets or other approved repositories.
* Apply required metadata, page titles, descriptions, alt text, tagging, structured content guidance, internal linking, and SEO fundamentals to support discoverability and content quality.
* Perform pre-publish and post-publish quality checks for content accuracy, responsive display, link functionality, asset rendering, accessibility, metadata, and component consistency.
* Support content lifecycle management by updating, retiring, replacing, or escalating outdated content and ensuring published pages remain current and aligned to business requirements.
* Coordinate with marketing, content, UX, design, SEO, accessibility, analytics, compliance, legal, technology, and regional stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver work through approved workflows.
* Track assigned work, publishing status, issues, dependencies, and approvals using tools such as Workfront, Confluence, SharePoint, or comparable workflow platforms.
* Identify recurring publishing, component, content, asset, metadata, or workflow issues and escalate them with clear documentation, examples, and recommended next steps.
* Support continuous improvement of authoring standards, QA checklists, intake guidance, publishing procedures, documentation, and team knowledge-sharing materials.
* Assist with global, multi-site, and localized content updates, including language-copy or market-specific publishing workflows where applicable.
* Contribute to optimization efforts by reviewing performance signals, analytics inputs, SEO findings, accessibility observations, and stakeholder feedback to recommend content and page-level improvements.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s or above degree

* 2+ years of experience in digital content authoring, web publishing, CMS operations, digital production, or a related web experience role.
* Working knowledge of web publishing fundamentals (Templates, components, assets, metadata, workflows, approvals, staging, publishing, and content versioning).
* Foundational understanding of SEO, accessibility, metadata, & responsive design
* Strong attention to detail, organization, time management, follow-through
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Direct experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), particularly AEM Sites and AEM Assets
* Experience with more advanced AEM capabilities such as AEM Cloud/6.5, Multi Site Manager, Live Copies, language copies, content fragments, experience fragments, or publishing workflows.
* Experience supporting enterprise, global, multilingual, or multi-site websites.
* Experience in financial services or another highly regulated industry such as banking, insurance, healthcare, or pharmaceuticals.
* Familiarity with analytics/optimization platforms such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Adobe Target, or like.
* Experience with workflow/documentation platforms such as Workfront, Jira, ServiceNow, Confluence, or SharePoint.
* Basic HTML/CSS troubleshooting and/or basic image preparation and optimization skills.
* Familiarity with taxonomy, structured content, content lifecycle management, content reuse, or AI/search discoverability.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: ServiceNow Analyst
description:
Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We’re a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So, add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.

**Summary of the Role:**

The ServiceNow Analyst supports daily operations by handling incidents, service requests, problems, changes, and defects. Respond to production issues and help implement immediate resolution efforts across ServiceNow technology areas. Help maintain CMDB accuracy, performing regular audits, and keeping precise records

**About the Role:**

**Important Results:**

* **Operational Excellence:**

  Exceed defined Service level agreements for the ITSM suite, ensuring rapid resolution of Incidents, Problems, and Defects while maintaining detailed documentation.
* **Agile Development & Execution**:

  Take ownership of user stories, delivering high-quality solutions and configurations that follow ServiceNow best practices.
* **Platform Integrity & Health**:

  Perform/Support proactive system audits to identify performance bottlenecks, orphaned records, or best-practice deviations.
* **End-to-End Upgrade Support:**

  Contribute to platform upgrade cycles by performing impact analysis, managing clone-back activities, and remediating skipped records.
* **Quality Engineering (QA):**

  Build a library of ServiceNow ATF (Automated Test Framework) cases to ensure regression-free deployments.
* **Process Optimization:**

  Identify manual tasks within IT and HR Service Delivery and propose automated workflows to improve organisational efficiency, using Solutions like Now Assist, predictive Intelligence
* **Sprint Accountability:**

  Participate in sizing and story-pointing sessions to provide realistic effort estimates and ensure the team maintains a steady sprint velocity.

**Main Responsibilities:**

* **Service level agreement** **Management & Post-Incident Analysis**:

  Manage and resolve incident tickets, maintaining a high standard of service and meeting published performance targets. Contribute to Major Incident Management by participating in root cause analysis (RCA) and drafting post-incident reports to prevent recurrence.
* **Solution Development:**

  Translate user stories into technical requirements and high-quality ServiceNow configurations, ensuring agreement on architectural standards.
* **Requirement Refinement & Translation:** Act as a bridge between partners and technical execution by distilling ambiguous or high-level requirements into detailed, applicable technical specifications.
* **Technical Collaboration & Escalation**:

  Act as a technical escalation point for complex issues, coordinating with teams to lead high-priority incidents to resolution.
* **Continuous Process Automation**:

  Partner with different IT workstreams to identify manual bottlenecks and implement automated workflows using Integration Hub and Flow Designer.
* **Platform Lifecycle Support**:

  Help troubleshoot patch and release management issues, ensuring configurations remain compatible with new versions.
* **Strategic Technical Evaluation**:

  Support the assessment and implementation of new ServiceNow modules or third-party integrations

**About You:**

**Skills Required:**

* Challenge conventional wisdom regarding technology refresh and hype
* Experience probing deeper into "the why" behind a request, identifying the primary business problem to propose solutions that are technically viable and scalable within the ServiceNow framework.
* Communicate technical information to a non-technical audience.
* Work within a global team across cultures
* Exhibit core company behaviours that focus on how we at LS&Co. Operate together daily regardless of level, function or location.

**Years and Type of Experience Required:**

* 4+ years of experience with ServiceNow or other Service Delivery, Knowledge Management Applications.
* Experience with software development life cycle (SDLC), Agile, and Scrum methodologies.
* Knowledge in HR & Finance.
* ServiceNow Administrator certifications is good to have.
* Experience with ServiceNow Integration Hub, Orchestrator, and Service Portal is good to have.
* ITIL v3/4 certification is good to have.

**Benefits:**

We put a lot of thought into our programs to provide you with a benefits package that matters. Whether it is for medical care, taking time off, improving your health or planning for retirement, we've got you covered.

Here's a small snapshot:

* Complimentary preventive health check-up for you and your spouse
* OPD coverage
* Best in class leave plan including paternity and family care leaves
* Counselling sessions to prioritise mental well-being
* Exclusive discount vouchers on Levi’s products

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to empowering individuals from all walks of life to achieve their professional goals with us, regardless of race, religion, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, disability, sexual orientation, age, national origin, citizenship status, or genetic information. We actively seek and encourage applications from diverse candidates, including those with disabilities, and offer accommodations throughout the selection process upon request. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.*

**LOCATION**
------------

Bengaluru, India

**FULL TIME/PART TIME**
-----------------------

Full time

title: National Head HR – Business & Personal Finance
description:
ROLE SUMMARY (PURPOSE)

The National Head - Human Resources will be responsible for leading the people strategy for the Business & Personal Finance vertical, ensuring alignment between organizational goals, business growth, talent, culture, and operational excellence. The role will drive workforce planning, talent management, compensation & benefits, organization development, leadership capability, employee engagement, and HR governance while enabling sustainable business growth.

The incumbent will act as a strategic partner to the leadership team, ensuring the organization attracts, develops, engages, and retains high-performing talent while fostering a culture of accountability, customer centricity, innovation, and prudent risk management.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnering

* Develop and execute the HR strategy aligned to the organization's business objectives and growth plans.
* Partner with business leaders to drive organizational performance and workforce effectiveness.
* Provide strategic counsel on organization design, talent planning, culture, leadership, and change management.
* Build a high-performance culture that balances employee engagement, productivity, governance, and customer outcomes.
* Serve as a trusted HR partner to Business & Personal Finance leadership teams.
* Translate business strategy into actionable people initiatives.
* Support branch expansion, business transformation, productivity enhancement, and workforce optimization.
* Drive manpower planning and resource allocation to support business growth.

Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning

* Develop robust talent acquisition strategies to attract quality talent across sales, operations, credit, collections, and support functions.
* Ensure timely fulfilment of manpower requirements while maintaining quality of hires.
* Build a strong talent pipeline for key and critical positions.
* Strengthen employer branding initiatives to position the organization as an employer of choice.
* Ensure compensation structures remain market competitive and aligned with business objectives.
* Lead annual salary reviews, incentive programs, and retention initiatives.

Organization Development & Talent Management

* Institutionalise goal setting, performance reviews, productivity standards and consequence management aligned to business outcomes and role scorecards.
* Build succession plans and leadership pipelines for critical business roles; identify HiPos and create differentiated development and career-progression plans.
* Drive internal mobility, promotions and development opportunities based on performance, potential, readiness and business need.
* Lead organizational restructuring and workforce transformation initiatives as required.
* Drive competency framework development and career progression programs

Employee Engagement

* Strengthen listening channels, grievance redressal, recognition, manager effectiveness and employee communication across regions.
* Drive engagement initiatives that enhance employee satisfaction, commitment, and productivity.
* Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and ethical conduct.
* Strengthen internal communication and employee connect mechanisms.
* Drive diversity, inclusion, and employee wellness initiatives.

Capability Building & Leadership Development

* Create a role-based capability architecture for Business & personal finance covering sales, credit, underwriting, collections, risk, operations and people leadership.
* Use capability assessments and performance data to identify skill gaps and deliver learning interventions jointly with business and L&D teams.
* Build manager capability in coaching, performance conversations, employee relations, compliance and ethical decision-making.
* Measure learning effectiveness through productivity, incentive attainment, role readiness, internal movement and retention outcomes.
* Drive enterprise-wide learning strategies aligned to future business requirements.
* Strengthen managerial and leadership capabilities through structured development interventions.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning and innovation.

HR Operations, Governance ,Analytics & digital Transformation

* Ensure first-time-right execution across the employee lifecycle from hiring and onboarding through confirmation, movement, performance, rewards, employee relations and separation.
* Ensure compliance with labour laws, company policies, delegated authority, HR budgets, audit requirements and documentation standards across all locations.
* Ensure compliance with labour laws, statutory requirements, and internal policies.
* Strengthen HR governance frameworks and process controls. .
* Ensure seamless HR operations through process efficiency and digital HR solutions.
* Leverage people analytics to support strategic decision-making.
* Develop HR dashboards and workforce insights for leadership review.
* Lead HR technology initiatives to enhance employee experience and operational efficiency.
* Drive data-driven people management practices across the organization.

Strategic Growth & New Business Initiatives

* Partner with business teams in evaluating and supporting new product launches and market expansion initiatives.
* Assess organizational readiness, capability requirements, and talent implications of new business opportunities.
* Ensure people strategies support sustainable business growth while balancing risk and reward considerations.
* Build future-ready workforce capabilities to support evolving business models and customer expectations.

KEY INTERACTIONS

Internal Stakeholders

* CHRO and Corporate HR leadership
* CEO and Business Heads – BUSINESS & PERSONAL FINANCE
* National/Zonal business, sales and collections leaders
* Credit, Risk, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Audit and Technology teams
* Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, C&B, L&D, HR Operations, Employee Relations and HR Analytics teams
* Branch Managers and employees across business locations

External Stakeholders

* Recruitment partners, job portals and assessment providers
* Industry bodies, academic institutions and talent-market networks
* Labour-law advisors, statutory authorities and auditors, as required
* Employer-brand, survey and workplace-certification agencies

KEY DECISION TAKEN

* Workforce deployment and HR operating plans within approved strategy and budgets.
* Hiring channels, sourcing mix, selection governance and deployment priorities within approved manpower and compensation grids.
* Organisation structure, role design, spans/layers and workforce movement recommendations in partnership with business leadership.
* Talent segmentation, HiPo identification, succession slates, development actions and retention interventions.
* Performance, engagement, productivity and attrition interventions based on business and people analytics.
* Employee-relations actions and policy interpretation within delegated authority; escalation of high-risk matters to the CHRO, Legal or appropriate committee.
* HR vendor evaluation and recommendations within procurement and delegation-of-authority norms.
* Escalation or rejection of deviations relating to compensation, grade fitment, headcount, compliance or policy.

KEY SKILLS & BEHAVIOURAL ATTRIBUTES

* Strategic HR Leadership
* Business Acumen
* Talent Management
* Organization Development
* Compensation & Rewards
* Workforce Planning
* Change Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Leadership Development
* HR Analytics
* Governance & Compliance
* Innovation & Digital Mindset

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strategic and business-oriented mindset
* Strong execution and delivery focus
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders
* High ownership and decision-making capability

Behavioral Attributes- Driven and in alignment with our Purpose “To transform the life of the common man by improving their financial well-being” and anchored by our core value of integrity, collaboration, and excellence.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

**Educational Qualification**

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources from a reputed institution.
* Additional certifications in Organization Development, Labour Laws, or Leadership Development will be preferred.

**Experience**

* 15-20+ years of progressive HR leadership experience. Minimum 5 years in a national or multi-region HR leadership role with direct exposure to senior business stakeholders
* Extensive experience in HR Business Partnering, Talent Management, Compensation & Benefits, Performance Management, and Organization Development.
* Strong exposure to Financial Services, NBFC, Banking, Housing Finance, or Consumer Finance sectors.
* Proven experience leading HR for a geographically dispersed workforce.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across business locations.
