We develop banking software and provided related software services to our group companies(The Sella Group) based out of Italy. Centrico India is a 300 people company consistently rated as a Great Place to Work over the last 5 years.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Head of People and Culture**
to lead the end-to-end people agenda for our India GCC.

This is a
**hands-on leadership role**
for someone who enjoys understanding a business deeply, identifying the people priorities that really matter, and turning them into practical and sustainable HR practices.

You will work closely with the CEO India, business leaders, employees, and HR and business teams in Italy. You will also lead an experienced and high-performing HR team.

**What You Will Own**

You will lead the complete people agenda, including:

* **People Strategy & Workforce Planning:**
  Translate business priorities into workforce, capability, succession, and talent plans.
* **Talent Acquisition:**
  Ensure we hire the right talent for genuine business needs, with a strong focus on quality of hiring and candidate experience.
* **Talent & Performance:**
  Lead performance management, talent reviews, succession, promotions, career development, and retention of critical talent.
* **Learning & Competency Development:**
  Build meaningful learning journeys and strengthen technical, behavioral, managerial, and leadership capabilities.
* **Compensation & Benefits:**
  Lead compensation, promotion, and benefits processes, balancing performance, internal equity, market context, and affordability.
* **HR Operations & Compliance:**
  Ensure smooth and reliable employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, payroll coordination, benefits, employee movements, policies, and exits. Maintain appropriate HR governance and ensure compliance with applicable employment and labor requirements, statutory obligations, internal policies, audits, documentation, employee-data privacy, and record-keeping. Work with relevant internal teams and external partners to identify and address compliance risks proactively.
* **Employee Experience & Communication:**
  Create clear and honest employee communication and strengthen engagement, recognition, well-being, manager effectiveness, and the overall employee experience.
* **People Analytics & HR Technology:**
  Use
  **Workday**
  and people data to support better decisions, improve processes, maintain data quality, and provide meaningful workforce insights.
* **HR Team Leadership:**
  Lead, coach, and develop a strong team of 4–5 HR professionals, giving them both ownership and the context to make good decisions.

A key part of the role will be deciding
**what is worth doing**
. We are looking for someone who can learn from external best practices without simply importing them—someone who can adapt ideas thoughtfully to our business, culture, and scale.

**What We Are Looking For**

You will ideally bring:

* **12–15 years of broad HR experience**
  , preferably in a GCC, IT product, IT services company.
* Experience across workforce planning, recruitment, HR operations, HR compliance, compensation, talent management, learning, and employee engagement.
* A sound understanding of the
  **Indian employment and HR compliance environment**
  , with experience ensuring that HR policies, processes, documentation, statutory requirements, and employee-data practices remain compliant.
* Experience leading a capable HR team while remaining comfortable being hands-on.
* Strong experience partnering with senior business leaders.
* Comfort working with international stakeholders and across cultures.
* Good business judgment and the ability to turn people data and organizational insights into practical actions.
* Strong communication skills, particularly the ability to communicate complex or sensitive matters with clarity and maturity – With employees and with leadership teams both in India and Italy.
* Exposure to
  **Workday**
  or another enterprise HR platform. Workday experience is an advantage.
* A strong HR network who you can engage with.
* A good understanding of the evolving AI environment and what it means for the industry and people.
* Must have a postgraduate qualification in HR .

Please send your resumes to CEO\_India@centrico.tech.

description:
FE fundinfo is a leading financial data provider, connecting the investment industry across the UK, Europe, and Asia-Pacific through an integrated platform. Our skilled team empowers clients with data-driven insights, making the industry Navigate Complexity with Confidence!

description:
**Company Description**
Indian Corporate Law Chambers (ICLC) is a not-for-profit initiative focused on strengthening India’s business ecosystem through free legal aid, compliance support, and corporate governance empowerment. The organization serves MSMEs, startups, family-owned businesses, early-stage enterprises, NGOs, social enterprises, and corporates seeking CSR-backed legal empowerment. ICLC provides services such as legal advisory for corporate and commercial matters, compliance guidance, governance support, legal literacy programs, and drafting assistance for key business documents. By addressing gaps in legal awareness, compliance systems, and access to affordable advisory, ICLC helps organizations remain legally secure and sustainable. Its work is grounded in ethical legal practice, corporate governance best practices, collaborative support, and data-driven compliance frameworks.

The Human Resources Manager will oversee HR operations and people practices to support ICLC’s mission-driven work. This full-time, on-site role is based in Hyderabad and involves managing end-to-end recruitment, onboarding, and employee lifecycle processes. The role includes developing and implementing HR policies, performance management frameworks, and learning and development initiatives aligned with organizational values. The Human Resources Manager will handle employee engagement, conflict resolution, and grievance redressal while ensuring compliance with labor laws and regulatory requirements. The role also requires maintaining accurate HR documentation, HRIS records, and supporting leadership with workforce planning, culture-building initiatives, and HR analytics.

* Candidates should possess strong skills in recruitment, talent acquisition, and onboarding processes.
* Candidates should possess skills in HR policy development, performance management, and employee engagement.
* Candidates should possess skills in conflict resolution, grievance handling, and employee relations.
* Candidates should possess skills in compliance with labor laws, HR documentation, and HRIS or HR software tools.

* Strong communication skills, attention to detail, integrity, and the ability to work collaboratively with diverse stakeholders.

title: Agentic People Service Lead, Employee Success Operations - APAC (Individual Contributor)
description:
**Description**
The Agentic People Experience & Automation Hub (APEX) is the regional engine of Salesforce’s Global People Services & Operations, delivering an end-to-end hire-to-retire employee experience. Operating under Salesforce’s "Customer Zero" model, APEX leverages cutting-edge technology and AI agents to automate routine inquiries, empowering our team to focus on high-impact, complex resolution and high-touch support.
  
  
As an Agentic People Service Lead, Employee Success Operations - APAC, you sit at the strategic intersection of Tier 2 (T2) operational execution—spanning Benefits, Leave of Absence, Time Tracking, and Employee Relations—and regional project management. Beyond core case management, you will lead critical regional initiatives, incident responses, and compliance communications, collaborating closely with Benefits, Legal, Employee Success Business Partners, Employee Relations, and DET. Based in Hyderabad (hybrid), you will support ANZ, ASEAN and India, with working-hours overlap across APAC time zones and occasional regional travel as needed.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll lead through influence, coaching peers, owning projects and acting as a delegate for the Manager.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings an AI-first mindset, exceptional organizational and communication skills, and an eagerness to lead in a fast-paced environment. You are a trusted partner capable of building cross-functional relationships at all levels, managing highly confidential HR matters with complete discretion, and driving continuous operational innovation across the region.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* ES Business Operations
* Oversee daily case and inquiry handling for APAC region, covering queue health, SLAs, escalations and quality.
* Mentor and guide People Specialists on complex cases, share best practices and help maintain case quality, without formal line management
* Partner with the Manager to run team rhythms (huddles, workload allocation, coverage planning, handoffs) and act as delegate when the Manager is out of office.
* Identify trends in cases and recommend knowledge-article, process or tooling improvements.
* Act as the first point of escalation for complex T2 cases, make decisions within defined policy, and escalate high-risk or precedent-setting matters to the Manager.
* Provide regular coaching and feedback to People Specialists, and review case quality against SLA and CSAT targets.
* Use AI agents and automation to deflect routine inquiries, and feed case trends back into agent and knowledge improvements
* Project and program management (ES Business Operations)
* Plan and deliver ES initiatives end to end: scope, timelines, risks, stakeholder updates and post-launch reviews.
* Manage the APAC project pipeline and prioritization, and report status to ES leadership.
* Drive process standardization and operational readiness for new programs and policy changes.
* Act as the subject-matter reference for process and project questions within the team.
* Own delivery of assigned APAC initiatives against agreed milestones, and report progress, risks and outcomes to ES leadership
* ES compliance for ASEAN
* Support ASEAN ES compliance, including data privacy requirements, record-keeping and policy attestations, in line with local legal requirements
* Help maintain documentation, SOPs and controls so they meet local legal and company requirements.
* Run periodic quality and compliance checks, track remediation actions to closure, and work with Legal, Privacy and local HR/ER partners.
* Act as a key partner to the Global ES Compliance team, owning ASEAN inputs for audits and attestations through to closure

**You're Our Person If You have…**

* 8+ years in HR operations, shared services or People Operations, including leading projects or mentoring peers with/without formal authority
* Prior experience with Workday, Peopleforce, Google Workspace and any similar HRIS is highly desirable
* Working knowledge of APAC employment practices, HR generalist and business operations, and HR compliance
* AI-First and human/agent collaboration experience and mindset
* Proven project management skills
* Sound judgment in applying HR policy to varied situations across APAC
* Strong problem-solving skills with data analysis and reporting; scripting (Google Apps Script, Python) is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills
* Proven ability to influence and align stakeholders across regions
* Ability to work in a diverse work environment with ambiguity and multiple priorities
* Ability to handle confidential matters with discretion and manage multiple priorities independently

**Even Better If...**

* Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud and Slack, plus reporting or analytics tools.
* Working knowledge of ASEAN employment and data privacy regulations (e.g. PDPA)
* You hold Certification in project management (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2)
* You hold Certification in process improvement (e.g. Six Sigma, Lean, Kaizen)

**How We'll Measure Success**

* SLA and CSAT performance for APAC T2 cases.
* On-time delivery of regional projects.
* Timely closure of ASEAN compliance actions.
* Stakeholder feedback.

* Help maintain documentation, SOPs and controls so they meet local legal and company requirements.

**You're Our Person If You have…**

* 8+ years in HR operations, shared services or People Operations, including leading projects or mentoring peers with/without formal authority
* Prior experience with Workday, Peopleforce, Google Workspace and any similar HRIS is highly desirable
* Working knowledge of APAC employment practices, HR generalist and business operations, and HR compliance
* AI-First and human/agent collaboration experience and mindset
* Proven project management skills
* Sound judgment in applying HR policy to varied situations across APAC

title: HR Business Partner – People & Culture | Hyderabad
description:
**People Are at the Heart of Impact.**

**At Lighthouse Communities Foundation, our work is about creating opportunities for young people.**

**But sustainable impact doesn't happen without the people behind it.**

Great Centre Heads.  
Committed facilitators.  
Passionate outreach teams.  
Strong program leaders.  
People who show up every day because they believe the work matters.

**We're looking for an HR Business Partner who can help these people thrive.**

This is a hands-on, field-facing HR role where you'll work closely with leaders and teams across Hyderabad, understand what is happening on the ground, solve people challenges, strengthen HR practices, and help build a culture where employees can do their best work.

If you see HR as more than policies and processes — and believe that **strong people practices create stronger social impact** — this could be your opportunity.

**About Lighthouse Communities Foundation**

**Lighthouse Communities Foundation (LCF)** works in the areas of skilling, employability, and livelihoods for underserved youth.

Our Lighthouse model brings together **Government, Corporates, NGOs, and Communities** through a Public-Private Partnership to create sustainable pathways towards employment and socio-economic transformation.

Our centres are built around collaboration — with different stakeholders contributing resources, expertise, networks, and capabilities to help young people access better opportunities.

**Our work is guided by:**

**Empathy | Inclusion | Integrity | Courage**

**Your Role: Be the Bridge Between People & Purpose**

As an HR Business Partner, you'll partner with regional leadership, Centre Heads, program teams, and employees to make sure our people practices support both **employee experience and organisational outcomes**.

You'll work across:

**Hiring → Onboarding → Development → Performance → Employee Relations → Culture → Organisational Growth**

And because our teams work across centres and communities, this is a **field-facing HR role**.

You won't just hear about people challenges in meetings.

**You'll go where the teams are. Listen. Understand. Solve. Build.**

**What You Will Do**

**Partner With Leaders & Teams**

* Act as the primary HR point of contact for employees and managers across the assigned region.
* Partner with Centre Heads and program leaders on people-related matters.
* Understand team dynamics, people challenges, and organisational needs.
* Provide practical HR guidance to managers and employees.
* Coach leaders on people management and employee-related issues.
* Ensure HR support is timely, accessible, and solution-oriented.

**Build Teams That Can Deliver Impact**

**Great programs need great people.**

**You'll support the complete employee journey, including:**

* Recruitment coordination.
* Candidate screening.
* Interview processes.
* Offer and joining coordination.
* Employee onboarding.
* New-hire orientation.
* Early-stage employee support.

**You'll work closely with hiring managers and central HR to ensure we bring in people who are not only capable, but also aligned with our values and mission.**

**Help People Grow**

* Partner with central HR teams to implement learning and development initiatives.
* Identify capability-building needs across teams.
* Support training and development programs.
* Encourage a culture of continuous learning.
* Work with managers to identify development opportunities for their teams.

**Make Performance Management Meaningful**

**Performance management should be more than an annual form.**

**You'll support managers and employees with:**

* Goal setting.
* Performance reviews.
* Development planning.
* Regular feedback.
* Performance conversations.
* Capability-building interventions.
* Performance improvement processes where required.

**The goal is to create clarity, accountability, and growth — while ensuring performance practices are fair and aligned with organisational expectations.**

**Support Employee Relations**

* Serve as a trusted HR partner for employees and managers.
* Listen to employee concerns and help identify appropriate solutions.
* Support resolution of workplace issues in a fair and timely manner.
* Help managers navigate sensitive people situations.
* Promote a positive, respectful, and inclusive work environment.
* Ensure organisational policies and processes are understood and followed.

**Strengthen HR Practices Across Centres**

**Our teams work across different centres and communities.**

**You'll help ensure consistency while remaining sensitive to local realities.**

**This includes:**

* Implementing HR policies and processes.
* Supporting compliance requirements.
* Ensuring employees understand relevant policies.
* Identifying gaps in HR processes.
* Working with central HR to improve employee experience.
* Ensuring HR practices are aligned with organisational goals, values, and requirements.

**Use Data to Understand People**

**Good HR decisions need more than intuition.**

**You'll:**

* Monitor HR metrics and trends.
* Track hiring, onboarding, retention, performance, and other relevant people indicators.
* Identify patterns and areas requiring attention.
* Generate insights for leadership.
* Recommend practical solutions to improve HR effectiveness.

The question isn't just:

**“What is the number?”**

It's:

**“What is the number telling us about our people?”**

Be Present Where the Work Happens

This role involves **up to 70% travel across centres in the assigned region**.

**You'll spend significant time with teams on the ground, building relationships, understanding local realities, and providing hands-on HR support.**

**If you're someone who enjoys being close to the action rather than spending every day behind a desk, you'll enjoy this role.**

**Who Are We Looking For?**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in **Human Resources, Business Administration**, or a related field.
* Master's degree is preferred.

Experience

* **3–4 years of HR experience**.
* Experience in areas such as:
* Talent acquisition
* Employee relations
* Performance management
* Learning & development
* People management
* Organisational development

**Experience in a nonprofit, social-impact, education, skilling, or field-based organisation is an advantage.**

**Communication**

* Excellent communication skills in **English and Hindi**.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-building abilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with employees across different roles and backgrounds.
* Strong listening, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.

**You'll Thrive in This Role If...**

**You're someone who:**

* Sees HR as a business and people partner — not just a process owner.
* Is comfortable having difficult conversations with empathy and clarity.
* Can coach a manager through a people problem rather than simply quoting policy.
* Enjoys meeting people where they work.
* Can move comfortably between strategic conversations and operational problem-solving.
* Is curious about what is happening on the ground.
* Can work with people from very different backgrounds and roles.
* Is comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities.
* Can work independently and take ownership.
* Believes that inclusion is something you **build into everyday decisions**, not just something you write in a policy.
* Is genuinely motivated by the idea that better people practices can lead to better outcomes for young people.

**What Success Looks Like**

**In this role, success isn't simply:**

**“HR processes were completed.”**

It's when:

* The right people are hired at the right time.
* New employees feel welcomed and supported.
* Managers become stronger people leaders.
* Employees know what is expected of them.
* Performance conversations happen with clarity and fairness.
* Teams feel heard and supported.
* People challenges are addressed before they become organisational problems.
* Employees have opportunities to learn and grow.
* HR data helps leaders make better decisions.
* And ultimately, our teams are better equipped to create impact for young people.

**Why Join Lighthouse?**

**Build the People Behind the Impact**

**At Lighthouse, you'll get the opportunity to work at the intersection of:**

**People + Purpose + Field Operations + Organisational Development**

You'll work with diverse teams, engage with leaders across centres, and experience the realities of building people systems in a growing social-impact organisation.

You'll also be part of an organisation where our values matter:

**Empathy | Inclusion | Integrity | Courage**

Because creating opportunities for young people starts with creating an environment where the people doing the work can **learn, grow, contribute, and thrive.**

Ready to Build the People Behind the Mission?

If you're an HR professional who wants to move beyond transactional HR and become a genuine **people partner**, we'd love to hear from you.

**Role:** HR Business Partner – Field HR & People Development  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Experience:** 3–4 Years  
**Employment:** Full-time  
**Travel:** Up to 70%

**Apply at careers@lighthousecommunities.org mentioning the role and location in the subject line.**

***Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.***

**Come strengthen the people. Strengthen the teams. Strengthen the impact.**

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Project Management Executive
description:
Seeking an experienced Product Management professional who is passionate about building products that customers love. In this dynamic and fast-paced environment, will work with cross-functional teams to design, build, and roll out products aligned with the company’s vision and strategy. Join us in leveraging your expertise in product management to contribute to our organization’s growth and success.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Identify and fill product gaps and generate new ideas to grow market share, improve customer experience, and drive growth.
* Create buy-in for the product vision both internally and with key external partners.
* Develop product pricing and positioning strategies.

* Proven work experience in product management
* Track record of managing all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle.
* Ability to develop product and marketing strategies and effectively communicate recommendations to executive management.
* Solid technical background with understanding of software development and web technologies.
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up one’s sleeves.
* Effective collaboration with cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* MS/BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent preferred.

Role in one line: Product Manager (IC) for Apollo's internal business platforms, working with internal stakeholders across functions, 4–5 years of experience, Hyderabad, 6 days in office.

* 2–3+ years in a genuine PM role on internal tools, enterprise platforms or B2B products.
* Has taken at least one product through the full journey: discovery, requirements, build with engineering, UAT, rollout, adoption, and iteration.
* Strong stakeholder management, including handling competing priorities from multiple business teams.
* Enough technical understanding to work closely with engineering on workflows, integrations and data.

**Good to have:**

Domain exposure to supply chain, warehouse, retail operations, finance or HR systems. An engineering background. Experience driving adoption of a new tool among users who resisted change.

**Job Nature:**

* 6 Days Working (Mon to Sat)
* General Day Shift
* Work From Office only, No WFH/Remote Working

**Additional Information:**

* This is 6 days work from office role in Hyderabad
* Client is planning for a Walk-in-Drive on 31st October'26 (Mandatory) (No virtual interviews will be conducted)

**Required Qualification:**

Bachelor of Computer Science (B.Sc. (Computer Science)) ,Bachelor of Engineering - Bachelor of Technology (B.E./B.Tech.) ,Master of Computer Applications (M.C.A.) ,(MS or M.Tech) in Civil Engineering

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross-jurisdictional services. That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.

Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities.

For our business, for clients, and for you

* Conducting employee lifecycle changes
* Ensuring qualitative data records management and proper management of the contractual fields
* Checks for Onboarding and Offboarding employees within our HR and IT – ensure grating/deactivation of access following start/end dates
* Liaising with our local HR teams across the globe in relation to data management queries and clarifications
* Liaising with candidates and hiring Managers in relation to hiring process
* Ensuring company frameworks and approval process is followed
* Liaising with managers/employees on HR activities
* Issuing employment contracts following the global and local requirements
* Completing background check process
* Assisting in letter generation for various HR processes
* Assisting in ad-hoc administrative duties of the Global HR team

* Previous experience within similar HR role
* Excellent command of written and spoken English
* Attention to detail to ensure tasks are conducted at the highest standards
* Highly organised with a can-do attitude
* Ability to prioritise workload in a fast paced and deadline-oriented environment
* Proficient with Outlook, Microsoft Word and Excel

* A high level of visibility within a large organization on an upwards trajectory.
* Opportunity to work with a diverse, agile, and global team.
* Exposure to all aspects of the business, cross-jurisdiction and to working with senior management directly.
* The opportunity to innovate, bring discipline to brand activity and really make a difference.
* Work for a fast developing and one of the world leading independent fund administrators.
* Opportunities for professional development.
* Positive and hospitable work environment.
* Office location on communicative place at Hyderabad Hi-tech city center in modern office building.
* A genuinely unique opportunity to be part of an expanding large global business.

Job Description

Reporting To: Founder & CEO

**About Digital Nest**

Digital Nest is a fast-growing learning and development organization on a mission to redefine

career-focused education in India.

Through Digital Nest School of Business and Digital Nest School of Creativity, we are

building an industry-integrated learning ecosystem that connects education, startups,

businesses and employment. Our programs span Digital Marketing, Artificial Intelligence, Programmatic Advertising, Creative Technologies and Business Growth.

As we prepare for our next phase of expansion, we are looking for an entrepreneurial business leader who can help transform Digital Nest into one of India's leading next-generation education brands.

The Opportunity

Think Like a Founder. Lead Like a CEO. Execute Like an Entrepreneur.

We are looking for a strategic, commercially driven and execution-focused Business Head – Strategy & Operations to work directly with our Founder & CEO. This is not a conventional operations management position. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the company's growth strategy, driving revenue and profitability, developing high-performing teams, launching new business initiatives and building scalable organizational systems.

We are looking for someone who doesn't just manage a business but knows how to build, grow and scale one.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Strategy & Growth**

* Partner directly with the Founder & CEO to develop short-term and long-term business strategies.
* Build annual business plans, revenue projections and growth roadmaps.
* Identify new revenue opportunities, business verticals and market expansion possibilities.
* Lead market research, competitive analysis and business feasibility assessments.
* Translate strategic ideas into measurable business outcomes.
* Develop go-to-market strategies for new programs and initiatives.

**2. Revenue Growth & P&L Ownership**

* Own business revenue targets, operating budgets and profitability.
* Drive admissions performance, revenue optimization and business growth.
* Monitor lead conversion, customer acquisition costs, average order value, collections and contribution margins.
* Establish financial forecasting and performance reporting frameworks.
* Identify opportunities to improve operating margins and business productivity.
* Drive sustainable revenue growth through data-driven decisions.

**3. Cross-Functional Business Leadership**

* Lead admissions, marketing, academics, placements and business operations through functional teams.
* Establish departmental KPIs, accountability frameworks and performance review mechanisms.
* Conduct weekly and monthly business performance reviews.
* Mentor existing employees and develop the next generation of functional leaders.
* Improve collaboration, ownership and execution across departments.
* Resolve business challenges and enable faster decision-making.

**4. Business Operations & Scalability**

* Build scalable operating systems, SOPs and management processes.
* Improve organizational efficiency, productivity and service quality.
* Drive technology adoption, automation and data-driven decision-making.
* Strengthen student experience, operational consistency and business performance.
* Establish dashboards and management reporting systems.
* Develop a scalable operational framework for future expansion.

**5. New Business Initiatives & Strategic Partnerships**

* Identify and evaluate new business opportunities and revenue streams.
* Lead the planning and execution of new educational programs and strategic initiatives.
* Develop pricing models, investment proposals and expansion strategies.
* Build partnerships with startups, enterprises, recruiters and industry stakeholders.
* Collaborate with the CEO on strategic projects and long-term growth opportunities.

**6. People Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Build, mentor and lead high-performing teams.
* Identify leadership gaps and develop strong functional managers.
* Partner with HR on strategic hiring, performance management and leadership development.
* Build a culture of accountability, innovation and continuous improvement.
* Develop a strong second line of management to support business expansion.

### **Requirements**

**Who We're Looking For**

* 8–12+ years of experience in business management, strategy, operations, general management or business growth.
* Demonstrated experience managing revenue, profitability and business performance.
* Strong understanding of P&L management, financial planning and business strategy.
* Proven experience leading cross-functional teams.
* Track record of scaling businesses, improving profitability or building new business verticals.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with strong commercial and analytical capabilities.
* Ability to think strategically while remaining hands-on with execution.
* Excellent communication, decision-making and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership teams is an advantage.
* Experience in EdTech, education, consumer services, professional training or growth-stage startups is preferred.
* MBA from a reputed institution is an advantage, not mandatory.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first 12 months, you should be able to:

* Establish predictable revenue planning and business performance systems.
* Improve profitability, admissions productivity and operational efficiency.
* Build a strong, accountable management structure.
* Develop capable functional leaders and reduce founder dependency.
* Successfully launch and execute strategic growth initiatives.
* Create a scalable operating model for Digital Nest's next phase of expansion.

**Why Join Digital Nest?**

An Opportunity to Build, Lead & Grow

**1. Founder-Level Exposure**

Work directly with the Founder & CEO, participate in strategic decision-making and influence the future direction of the organization.

**2. Attractive Leadership Compensation**

Earn a competitive fixed package of ₹15–20 LPA with performance-linked incentives of up to ₹10 LPA annually.

**3. Employee Stock Ownership (ESOPs)**

Opportunity to participate in the company's long-term value creation through an ESOP grant, subject to eligibility, approvals and scheme terms.

**4. Pathway to COO**

High-performing leaders may have the opportunity to progress into a Chief Operating Officer role as Digital Nest scales.

**5. Real Business Ownership**

Take responsibility for business strategy, revenue growth, profitability, team leadership and operational excellence.

**6. Entrepreneurial Freedom**

Opportunity to build new business verticals, introduce innovative strategies and develop scalable business models.

**7. Health & Wellness Benefits**

Access to company-provided health insurance and employee wellness benefits, in accordance with company policy.

**8. Learning & Leadership Development**

Access to professional development opportunities, emerging technology programs, industry events and leadership learning initiatives.

**9. High-Impact Work Environment**

Work with an ambitious, growth-oriented team where your decisions directly influence business performance and organizational growth.

**How to Apply**

We are interested in business builders, growth leaders and entrepreneurial professionals who have delivered measurable business outcomes. Share your updated resume along with:

* The largest business or P&L you have managed.
* Revenue growth or profitability improvements you have delivered.
* Teams you have built or led.
* A brief description of a business you helped scale.

If you have the ambition to think like an entrepreneur, lead like a business owner and

build something meaningful, Digital Nest could be your next big opp

description:

The Talent Business Advisor - Manager is the accessible, on-the-ground HR partner for employees and leaders within assigned India Business Units (BU). This is an integral role in managing the execution of people-related initiatives and programs that enhance the employee experience for India talent. Reporting to the U.S. Talent Business Advisor team and working with the India Talent Director and local leadership, this role supports the operational and logistical needs of key talent processes and employee matters helping ensure a consistent, efficient, and people-centered approach to talent delivery.

This role collaborates with a range of stakeholders across the Talent Solutions team and business units to execute core HR functions such as onboarding, performance management, employee engagement, and workforce logistics. This position offers a unique opportunity to broaden and deepen experience in talent operations while learning how HR strategy is implemented in a professional services environment.

**Required Responsibilities**

* Serve as the first point of contact for employees and leadership on talent, HR policy and procedures.

* Build trusted relationships with BU leaders and provide practical counsel on business unit needs, employee matters and emerging talent risks. Work closely with India Talent Director and peers.

* Partner globally with U.S. Talent Business Leader and U.S. Advisors to manage the implementation of core talent processes across the employee lifecycle (e.g., onboarding, offboarding, performance management, absences, rewards processes, and employee engagement initiatives).

* Provide accurate local and Firm context, recommendations and regular status updates and visibility to the US Talent Business Leader; seek direction or approval for BU-specific or sensitive matters.

* Translate agreed guidance into clear stakeholder actions, establish owners and timelines, and follow each matter through resolution and formal closure.

* Create insightful reporting and analytics, with recommendations that inform leadership talent decisions.

* Identify recurring employee themes or policy misunderstandings and support targeted communications and consistent practices across India BUs.

**Capabilities**

* Demonstrated HR advisory, HR business partnering or generalist experience supporting both employees and business leaders in India.

* Experience handling employee concerns and workplace matters, including fact gathering, risk assessment, documentation, escalation and follow-through.

* Practical knowledge of India-specific HR policies, employment practices, governance and local requirements, with sound judgment on when specialist or legal guidance is needed.

* Experience operating across the employee lifecycle and coordinating with specialist teams such as Employee Relations, HR operations, etc.

* Strong stakeholder management in a matrixed environment, including the ability to work effectively with local leaders and remotely based business or talent leaders.

* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain policy, provide concise and proactive updates, surface risk and communicate sensitive decisions appropriately.

* High levels of discretion, empathy, organization and accountability, with a consistent record of driving actions to closure.

* Strong Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, HR technology platforms such as Workday, reporting tools, and approved AI-enabled resources.

**Professional Expectations**

* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, professionalism, and independent execution and management of assigned responsibilities.

* Exercise sound judgment in prioritizing work, identifying risk, recognizing matters requiring escalation, and protecting confidential information.

* Produce accurate, organized, and high-quality work products with strong attention to detail and data integrity.

* Anticipate needs, proactively address operational challenges, and approach change with a solutions-oriented mindset.

* Build strong working relationships through responsive communication, follow-through, and service excellence.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field preferred.

* 7-10 years of human resources, talent management, employee experience, people operations, business operations, or related professional experience preferred.

* Experience in a multinational, shared-services or globally matrixed organization.

* Experience partnering with US-based or other international HR and business stakeholders across time zones.

* Exposure to talent reviews, succession, career development, recognition, engagement and retention programs.

* Experience supporting organizational movement, promotions, role changes, mobility and employee exits.

* Experience identifying workforce themes and turning recurring issues into targeted manager or employee communications.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  
  
**How You Can Grow:**  
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  
  
**More about Crowe:**

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.

Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Head - Technology & AI | E-Commerce | AI Agents | Engineering & Automations
description:
**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Ergode builds and scales digital-first businesses across global marketplaces.

We have made a clear strategic choice: **Technology, Artificial Intelligence and automation will sit at the core of how we scale revenue, improve margins and increase productivity.**

We are looking for a **hands-on Technology & AI leader** who can convert business problems into working, adopted systems — quickly.

This is not a traditional IT leadership role.

You will own the intersection of **business, engineering, AI, automation, data, integrations, infrastructure and security**. You will work directly with the CEO and business leaders to identify high-impact problems, decide what should be built internally versus externally, and ensure solutions move from idea production adoption measurable business outcome.

Some of our systems need modernization. Some need stronger ownership and architecture. Others need to be replaced or rebuilt. We would rather be transparent about that upfront.

We need someone who enjoys that challenge.

**What You Will Own**
=====================

**1. Technology Execution & Delivery**
--------------------------------------

You will create an execution culture where technology commitments translate into shipped outcomes.

You will:

* Run Technology on clear weekly priorities with an owner, deadline and measurable outcome for every major initiative.
* Establish strong engineering execution across product development, integrations, automation, infrastructure and AI.
* Track commitments through completion — not merely development activity.
* Identify blockers early and make fast build/buy/outsource decisions.
* Hold internal teams and external partners accountable for scope, timelines, quality and business outcomes.
* Build clear visibility from:

**Business Requirement**  **Development**  **Production**  **Adoption**  **Business Impact**

* Develop engineers and technology managers into stronger owners and future leaders.
* Create sufficient documentation, architecture standards and ownership so no critical system depends on one employee or vendor.

### **Success means:**

Leadership should never need to repeatedly ask, **“Where is this project stuck and who owns it?”**

**2. Business-First Technology Strategy**
=========================================

Technology exists to improve business outcomes.

You will:

* Deeply understand how Ergode makes money across marketplaces, brands and channels.
* Understand marketplace fees, margins, inventory, pricing, advertising, catalogue operations, fulfilment and customer experience.
* Own the Technology & AI roadmap based on impact on:
  + Revenue
  + Gross margin
  + Productivity
  + Operating cost
  + Speed
  + Customer/vendor experience
* Work directly with business heads to identify operational bottlenecks.
* Challenge processes that should be eliminated or simplified before automating them.
* Translate business problems into scalable technology solutions.
* Own technology economics including cloud, AI/token usage, software licences, development and outsourcing.
* Report technology performance to leadership in **business outcomes rather than project activity**.

**3. AI, Agents & Intelligent Automation**
==========================================

AI is not an innovation project at Ergode. It is becoming part of how the company operates.

You will:

* Identify high-volume and high-value manual work suitable for AI or automation.
* Build and deploy AI agents and GenAI workflows into **real production environments**.
* Develop reusable AI architecture rather than disconnected experiments.
* Integrate AI into areas including:
  + Catalogue and content
  + Marketplace listings
  + Pricing
  + Inventory
  + Customer support
  + Sales
  + Finance
  + HR
  + Reporting and decision support
* Build with LLM APIs, RAG, agentic workflows, orchestration frameworks and workflow automation.
* Establish before/after baselines for every major automation.
* Measure:
  + hours/FTE capacity saved
  + cycle-time reduction
  + cost reduction
  + quality improvement
  + revenue/margin impact
  + user adoption
* Kill pilots that do not produce value and scale the ones that do.
* Ensure business teams actually adopt what Technology builds.

### **We are not looking for:**

Someone who has attended AI courses or built demos.

### **We are looking for:**

Someone who has **put AI into production and can show what changed because of it.**

**4. E-commerce Platforms & Marketplace Technology**
====================================================

Our technology must support a complex global marketplace operation.

You will own and strengthen:

* Marketplace integrations including Amazon SP-API, Walmart, eBay and other channels.
* Catalogue and listing infrastructure.
* Pricing and quantity synchronization.
* Order processing.
* Inventory and warehouse integrations.
* Returns, refunds and reconciliation workflows.
* Marketplace reporting and operational intelligence.
* API reliability and monitoring.

You will build toward a connected architecture where catalogue, inventory, order and marketplace information flows reliably across systems.

The goal is not simply integration.

The goal is **reliable commerce at scale**.

**5. Product & Platform Ownership**
===================================

You will take ownership of Ergode’s core internal technology platforms and ensure they become dependable business systems.

This includes:

* evaluating existing architecture,
* identifying technical debt,
* establishing clear module ownership,
* improving reliability and usability,
* prioritising development based on business value,
* and driving adoption after launch.

Technology is not complete when code is deployed.

**A feature is complete when the business can reliably use it and the expected outcome is visible.**

**6. Data Foundation & Decision Intelligence**
==============================================

AI is only as strong as the underlying data.

You will:

* Build reliable data flows across business systems.
* Establish clear sources of truth for critical business information.
* Reduce duplicate datasets and manual reconciliation.
* Improve data quality and ownership.
* Enable dashboards and AI systems to consume trustworthy business data.
* Build APIs and integration layers that allow new agents and applications to be deployed quickly.

**7. Architecture, Cloud & Engineering Quality**
================================================

You should be technically strong enough to challenge architecture and engineering decisions yourself.

You will:

* Review architecture for scalability, reliability, maintainability, security and cost.
* Establish coding, testing, documentation and deployment standards.
* Strengthen CI/CD and monitoring.
* Review estimates rather than blindly accepting them.
* Prototype when speed requires it.
* Make pragmatic technology choices rather than over-engineering.

We expect a leader who can move comfortably between a **CEO conversation about ROI and an engineering conversation about architecture.**

**8. Security, Reliability & AI Governance**
============================================

You will own the reliability and security of Ergode’s technology environment.

Responsibilities include:

* Cloud and infrastructure reliability
* Monitoring and uptime
* Incident management
* Root-cause analysis
* Backups and disaster recovery
* Identity and access management
* SSO
* Endpoint/device security
* Data protection

You will also establish practical AI governance covering:

* which company information can be shared with which AI systems,
* permissions available to AI agents,
* human review requirements for critical decisions,
* auditability,
* and acceptable AI use.

Compliance should appropriately address DPDP and relevant international privacy/security requirements.

**9. Build vs Buy vs Outsource**
================================

We do not believe everything must be built internally.

We do believe **Ergode must own the outcome.**

You will decide when to:

**BUILD** — when capability creates strategic advantage.

**BUY** — when a reliable product already solves the problem economically.

**OUTSOURCE** — when an external specialist can deliver faster.

For outsourced work, you will own:

* requirements,
* architecture,
* vendor selection,
* commercial evaluation,
* milestones,
* SLAs,
* quality,
* security,
* source code,
* documentation,
* handover.

No critical Ergode technology should become permanently dependent on one vendor or individual.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within the first 6–12 months, we expect visible movement across these areas:

### **Execution**

* Major technology initiatives have clear owners, deadlines and outcomes.
* Delivery predictability improves materially.
* Chronic technology bottlenecks reduce.

### **AI & Automation**

* Multiple AI agents/workflows are operating in production.
* Automation impact is quantified monthly.
* Manual workload is measurably reduced in targeted processes.
* Business adoption is visible rather than assumed.

### **Core Platforms**

* Critical marketplace and internal systems become more reliable.
* Technical ownership and documentation improve.
* Important business workflows no longer depend on fragile manual processes.

### **Data**

* Critical catalogue, inventory, order and operational data become more connected and trustworthy.

### **Business Partnership**

* Business leaders increasingly bring problems to Technology because they expect **working solutions, not project discussions**.

**Who We Are Looking For**
==========================

**Must-Haves**
--------------

* 10+ years of meaningful technology experience.
* 5+ years leading engineering/technology teams.
* Evidence of personally owning major technology delivery.
* Strong understanding of software engineering, architecture, APIs and integrations.
* AI/automation systems deployed into production with measurable impact.
* Practical experience with:
  + LLM APIs
  + RAG
  + AI agents / agentic workflows
  + Python
  + workflow automation platforms such as n8n/Make or equivalent
* Cloud experience across AWS, Azure or GCP.
* API/integration architecture experience.
* DevOps, deployment and monitoring understanding.
* Ability to evaluate architecture, code/design decisions and engineering estimates.
* Experience managing external technology partners.
* Experience owning meaningful technology budgets.
* Strong business and commercial orientation.

**Strongly Preferred**
----------------------

Experience in one or more of:

* E-commerce
* Marketplaces
* Retail technology
* D2C
* SaaS/platform businesses
* ERP/OMS/WMS
* Amazon SP-API or other marketplace integrations
* High-volume order/catalogue/inventory systems
* AI-first enterprise transformation

**Who Will NOT Fit This Role**
==============================

This role is probably not for you if:

* Your experience is predominantly IT infrastructure/helpdesk.
* Your leadership style is primarily delegation without technical depth.
* Your AI experience consists mainly of courses, certifications or prototypes.
* You measure success by projects delivered rather than business outcomes achieved.
* You require large teams before you can execute.
* You prefer lengthy planning cycles over shipping, learning and improving.
* You cannot challenge engineers, vendors and business leaders when necessary.

**The Person Behind the Resume**
================================

We care about experience, but we care equally about how you operate.

We value people who demonstrate:

**Ownership. Bias for action. Curiosity. Commercial thinking. High standards. Candour. Learning velocity.**

We would rather hire a builder who has repeatedly solved difficult problems than someone with the perfect title.

* Partner collaboratively with HR functional stakeholders, Payroll, Business Applications, and other HRIS team members to resolve requests and provide a consistent support experience.

Qualifications:

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**HUMAN RESOURCE EXECUTIVE (Talent Acquisition Focus)**

**6-Month Contract | Atraski (Group HR) | Delhi**

**ABOUT ATRASKI & OUR ECOSYSTEM:**

**Atraski is a marketing and creative services company headquartered in Delhi, with offices in Kolkata and Mumbai. Next, we’re expanding to Bangalore, Hyderabad and Guwahati. At Buzz, our flagship digital growth arm, works with 70+ brands across D2C, F&B, fashion, real estate and EdTech.**

**Alongside Atraski, our ecosystem includes sister ventures across creative production, fashion, hospitality, community and technology: Atraski Studios, Atraski Fashion, Atraski Events, At Stay, Jheeni, My City My Voice and Atraski Tech Transformations. Each venture runs its own business, and all of them share one people function.**

**THE ROLE**

**We’re hiring a Human Resource Executive whose main job is hiring. You’ll own full-cycle recruitment across Atraski and its sister ventures, from sourcing and screening to offer and joining. That includes building the first teams for our new offices in Bangalore, Hyderabad and Guwahati. Around 70% of the role is talent acquisition. The rest is core HR support, so every new hire is onboarded properly and recorded correctly. The role is employed by Atraski and based in our Delhi office. This is a 6-month fixed-term contract that can be extended or converted to full-time based on performance and business need.**

**Employment:**
 On Atraski’s payroll and contract, hiring for all ventures and locations in the ecosystem

**Office Location:**
 Delhi office (Chittaranjan Park / Greater Kailash)

**Schedule:**
 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM | Monday–Friday + alternate Saturdays | Occasional travel to new locations as needed

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

*Talent Acquisition (Primary — about 70%)*

* **Full-Cycle Recruitment:**
   Own hiring end to end for open roles across the ecosystem: role intake with managers, job posts, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer and joining.
* **Active Sourcing:**
   Find talent through LinkedIn, Naukri, Instahyre, Internshala, referrals, colleges and industry networks. Go out and find people instead of posting and waiting.
* **Hiring for New Cities:**
   Build the first teams for Bangalore, Hyderabad and Guwahati. Map the local talent market, find local sourcing channels and hire to the opening timelines.
* **Multi-Venture Hiring:**
   Recruit for very different roles: social media, performance marketing, design, video, account management, SEO, web development, operations, hospitality, fashion and events.
* **Screening & Evaluation:**
   Run first-round screening calls, review portfolios and work samples for creative and marketing roles, and shortlist against role-specific scorecards.
* **Interview & Offer Management:**
   Coordinate interviews with hiring managers, collect feedback quickly, roll out offers on the correct entity and follow up until the candidate joins, to cut drop-offs.
* **Pipeline & Talent Pool:**
   Maintain a live recruitment tracker by venture, role and city. Build a ready talent pool for roles we hire often.
* **Employer Branding:**
   Write engaging job posts and share hiring content on LinkedIn to position Atraski and its ventures as a great place to work.
* **Hiring Metrics:**
   Track time-to-hire, source-to-hire, offer acceptance and early attrition. Share a weekly hiring update with management.

*HR Support (Secondary — about 30%)*

* **Onboarding:**
   Handle joining formalities for every hire: appointment letters, document collection, greytHR profile setup, policy acknowledgements and induction.
* **Records & Compliance:**
   Map each new hire to the right venture, entity and location on greytHR. Support location-wise holiday calendars and state compliance (Professional Tax, Shops & Establishment) for new offices.
* **Exits:**
   Support resignations, handovers, exit interviews and F&F inputs, and use exit insights to improve hiring.
* **Payroll Inputs:**
   Share joiner and exit details with finance each month so payroll is processed correctly per entity.
* **Probation Tracking:**
   Coordinate 30/60/90-day check-ins and probation confirmations with managers to make sure new hires succeed.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

*Must Have*

* 1–3 years of recruitment experience, preferably in an agency, startup, recruitment firm or multi-business group.
* Hands-on sourcing on LinkedIn, Naukri and job portals, with a track record of closing positions, not just screening.
* Understanding of marketing and creative roles, and the ability to read a portfolio beyond the CV.
* Comfort managing many open roles across different teams and cities at the same time.
* Clear, persuasive communication in English and Hindi. You’ll be the first impression of our company for every candidate.

*Strong Signals (Not Mandatory)*

* Experience hiring for a new office or in multiple cities (Bangalore, Hyderabad or the Northeast is a plus).
* Volume hiring experience for junior and mid-level roles.
* Exposure to an ATS or HRMS (greytHR, Zoho Recruit, Keka or similar).
* Experience with campus hiring or intern programmes.
* Basic knowledge of onboarding and HR documentation.

*Mindset*

* **Closer, not a coordinator.**
   You measure yourself by people who join, not CVs forwarded.
* **Fast and persistent.**
   Good candidates move quickly, and so do you.
* **Quality-focused.**
   You hire people who stay and perform, not just fill seats.
* **Organised.**
   Multiple ventures, cities and roles don’t slow you down.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN 6 MONTHS**

* Open roles across the ecosystem closed within agreed timelines.
* First teams hired and onboarded as offices open in Bangalore, Hyderabad and Guwahati.
* Offer acceptance of 70% or above, with low early attrition among new hires.
* A live talent pool ready for frequently hired roles.
* Every new hire onboarded and recorded correctly on greytHR within their first week.
* A weekly hiring dashboard shared with management.

**WHY JOIN US**

* **Build teams, not just fill roles:**
   You’ll hire the people who shape our ventures and new cities.
* **Wide exposure:**
   Recruit across marketing, creative, fashion, hospitality, community and tech in one role.
* **Be part of the expansion:**
   Hire the founding teams for Bangalore, Hyderabad and Guwahati.
* **Growth path:**
   Strong performance on contract often leads to full-time conversion.

**COMPENSATION & CONTRACT TERMS**

* **Employer:**
   Atraski
* **Monthly stipend:**
   ₹20,000 per month, paid at the end of each calendar month
* **Total contract value:**
   ₹1,20,000 for 6 months
* **Contract status:**
   Fixed 6-month term, with possibility of extension or full-time conversion based on performance and business requirements.

**HOW TO APPLY**

**Send your resume and a 3–5 line note on why you want this role to**
anish.dhar@atraski.com or via LinkedIn DM.

*Include in your application:*

* A recent role you hired for end to end (role, time-to-hire, where you found the candidate)
* Your top sourcing channels and why they work for you
* A link to your LinkedIn profile

title: Learning and Development Manager, RFA
description:
**Job Description:**

**About AML RightSource**

We are AML RightSource, the leading technology-enabled managed services firm focused on fighting financial crime for our clients and the world. Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, and operating across the globe, we are a trusted partner to our financial institution, FinTech, money service business, and corporate clients.

Using a blend of highly trained anti-financial crime professionals, cutting-edge technology tools, and industry-leading consultants, we help clients with their AML/BSA, transaction monitoring, client onboarding (KYC), enhanced due diligence (EDD), and risk management needs.

We support clients in meeting day-to-day compliance tasks, urgent projects, and strategic changes. Globally, our staff of more than 4,000 highly trained analysts and subject matter experts is the industry's largest group of full-time compliance professionals. Together with our clients, we are Reimagining Compliance.

**About the Position**

We are seeking an experienced Learning and Development Manager to lead the strategy, operations, and continuous improvement of the Ready for Allocation (RFA) function in India.

The RFA group includes employees awaiting assignment to a client-focused team, typically after completing new-hire training or while transitioning between client engagements. It may also include employees on the bench awaiting project allocation in accordance with company policies.

The L&D Manager, RFA will be accountable for ensuring that employees within RFA remain skilled, engaged, professional, compliant, and ready for timely deployment. The role will oversee workforce-readiness planning, learning-needs identification, upskilling interventions, operational governance, stakeholder coordination, and the overall RFA employee experience.

This position will manage the L&D Coordinator responsible for day-to-day RFA operations and will work closely with Talent Development, Resourcing, HR, Workforce Management, Operations, and business stakeholders. The manager will use workforce data and business requirements to strengthen deployment readiness, reduce skill gaps, improve operational efficiency, and build a scalable RFA operating model.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **RFA Strategy and Governance**

* Define and drive the overall RFA workforce-readiness strategy in alignment with business, resourcing, and talent priorities.
* Establish clear operating standards, governance mechanisms, escalation paths, and accountability measures for the RFA population.
* Translate organizational policies into clear and practical RFA processes, guidelines, and employee expectations.
* Monitor the health and effectiveness of the RFA model and recommend changes based on workforce data, stakeholder feedback, and evolving business needs.
* Ensure consistency in the management of employees completing training, transitioning between client teams, or awaiting project allocation.

### **Workforce Readiness and Deployment Enablement**

* Oversee the readiness assessment of employees within RFA and ensure that skills, development needs, availability, and deployment status are accurately tracked.
* Partner with Resourcing, HR, Operations, and business leaders to understand upcoming talent requirements and prepare RFA employees for suitable opportunities.
* Identify barriers affecting employee deployment and coordinate appropriate learning, operational, or stakeholder interventions.
* Introduce structured readiness for employees to prepare for client project allocation.
* Provide leadership with timely visibility into workforce readiness, skill availability, development priorities, and deployment risks.

### **Learning Needs and Upskilling**

* Lead training-needs analysis for the RFA population using readiness data, business requirements, performance indicators, and stakeholder inputs.
* Design and oversee targeted upskilling pathways that keep employees client-ready while they await allocation.
* Prioritize learning interventions based on business demand, skill gaps, deployment opportunities, and employee readiness.
* Guide the creation of just-in-time learning resources to address immediate RFA concerns and emerging capability requirements.
* Evaluate the relevance and effectiveness of learning interventions and use findings to improve future programs.
* Collaborate with Talent Development colleagues and subject-matter experts to source, create, or facilitate appropriate learning solutions.

### **Data, Reporting, and Business Insights**

* Develop and maintain meaningful RFA dashboards, reports, and management insights.
* Analyze RFA data to identify skill gaps, readiness trends, allocation barriers, operational risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Define and monitor relevant measures for readiness, learning participation, skill development, deployment enablement, compliance, and employee engagement.
* Convert operational data into clear recommendations and decision support for senior stakeholders.
* Ensure data quality and consistency across RFA trackers, reporting tools, and HR systems.
* Use insights to prioritize interventions and demonstrate the business impact of the RFA function.

### **Team Leadership and Capability Development**

* Manage, coach, and develop the L&D Coordinator supporting RFA operations and enablement.
* Set clear priorities, performance expectations, and development goals for the coordinator.
* Review the quality and timeliness of readiness tracking, stakeholder communication, learning interventions, and RFA engagement activities.
* Delegate operational responsibilities while maintaining accountability for overall RFA outcomes.
* Build the coordinator’s capability in data analysis, stakeholder management, learning-needs analysis, facilitation, process improvement, and project execution.
* Create a collaborative, accountable, and improvement-oriented team environment.

### **Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary Talent Development point of contact for RFA readiness and capability development.
* Build strong relationships with HR, Resourcing, Workforce Management, Operations, client-facing teams, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Facilitate regular stakeholder reviews to discuss RFA status, deployment priorities, emerging skill requirements, risks, and required actions.
* Clarify ownership across teams and ensure timely follow-through on agreed actions.
* Escalate critical readiness, conduct, compliance, or deployment concerns through the appropriate channels.
* Communicate RFA priorities, expectations, risks, and progress clearly to employees and leadership.

### **Employee Experience, Professionalism, and Compliance**

* Create a structured and constructive experience for employees while they await allocation.
* Ensure employees understand the expectations associated with RFA, including availability, participation, learning completion, professional conduct, and communication.
* Oversee engagement initiatives that promote accountability, continuous learning, and connection to the organization.
* Work with HR and relevant stakeholders to manage recurring concerns related to participation, professionalism, conduct, or compliance.
* Ensure that RFA sessions and communications reinforce applicable company policies and workplace expectations.

### **Process Improvement and Automation**

* Review existing RFA processes to identify inefficiencies, duplication, manual work, and control gaps.
* Lead improvement initiatives that simplify workflows, strengthen accountability, and improve the accuracy and timeliness of information.
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring tracking, reporting, reminders, communications, and administrative activities.
* Partner with relevant technology and operations teams to implement sustainable solutions.
* Establish standard operating procedures and appropriate documentation for critical RFA processes.
* Encourage the responsible use of technology and AI-enabled solutions to improve scalability and employee support.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Relevant experience in Learning and Development, workforce readiness, talent operations, workforce management, or a related function.
* Experience leading people, projects, programs, or a significant operational workstream.
* Strong understanding of training-needs analysis, learning-program design, facilitation, and capability development.
* Strong analytical capability, including the ability to interpret workforce data, identify patterns, and translate findings into practical recommendations.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, and comfort working with HR systems and reporting tools.
* Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills, with the ability to work across Talent Development, HR, Resourcing, Operations, and business teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and project-management capability, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to improve processes and introduce scalable ways of working.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience managing a bench, redeployment, talent-pool, transition, or workforce-readiness program.
* Experience leading a coordinator, specialist, trainer, or similar role.
* Experience developing dashboards and reporting for workforce or learning initiatives.
* Exposure to capacity planning, resource allocation, employee transitions, or client-readiness processes.
* Experience with workflow automation, reporting automation, or AI-enabled learning and operational solutions.
* Experience working in a global or cross-regional organization.

We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.**
