title: Senior HR and Admin
description:
**Location:**
Gurugram, India | Full-Time, On-Site

**Scope:**
India & UAE Operations

**Experience:**
Minimum 8 years

1. Role Overview

Fête Events seeks an experienced HR & Administration Manager to independently build, implement, and manage the company's HR and administrative operations across India and Dubai.

This is a hands-on role requiring complete ownership of HR systems, policies, compliance, company documentation, renewals, procurement, and administration. The candidate must establish efficient, automated, and accountable processes with minimal management supervision.

2. Mandatory Experience & Skills

**HR Operations**

* Minimum 5 years' relevant HR and administration experience.
* Proven experience developing HR policies, SOPs, handbooks, employee contracts, forms, and procedures.
* Hands-on HRMS experience (Zoho People, Keka, or equivalent), including implementation and administration.
* Strong knowledge of recruitment, onboarding, probation, performance management, attendance, leave, benefits, and offboarding.
* Experience managing employee documentation and HR compliance.

**Administration & Compliance**

* Experience managing company registrations, trade licenses, statutory documents, insurance, contracts, and renewals.
* Ability to manage office/warehouse leases, vendors, utilities, telecommunications, & service agreements.
* Experience obtaining quotations, negotiating with providers, comparing proposals, & coordinating procurement.
* Knowledge of asset registers, company records, & administrative compliance.
* Familiarity with India and UAE requirements

**Technology & Professional Skills**

* Advanced Excel, Google Sheets, Google Workspace, and digital document management.
* Ability to develop dashboards, automated reminders, approval workflows, and reporting systems.
* Exceptional organization, attention to detail, communication, accountability, confidentiality, and independent execution.

3. Mandatory HR Deliverables

The manager must establish and maintain:

1. **Employee Database:**
   Complete records for all India and UAE employees.
2. **Documentation Register:**
   Contracts, IDs, visas, permits, insurance, & signed policies.
3. **Recruitment Tracker:**
   Vacancies, candidates, interviews, offers, & hiring progress.
4. **Onboarding & Induction:**
   Standardized checklists, orientation, paperwork, & employee setup.
5. **HR Policies & Handbook:**
   Implement company policies, procedures, forms, & SOPs.
6. **HRMS:**
   Configure the approved platform, migrate records, automate workflows, & train employees.
7. **Attendance & Leave:**
   Track attendance, working hours, leave balances, & approvals.
8. **Performance & Probation:**
   Review schedules, reminders, evaluation forms, & records.
9. **Benefits & Insurance:**
   Employee coverage, renewals, additions, & deletions.
10. **Offboarding:**
    Resignations, terminations, clearances, asset recovery, access removal, & settlement coordination.

4. Mandatory Administration Deliverables

The manager must establish and maintain:

1. **Company Legal Register:**
   Trade licenses, registrations, establishment cards, MOAs, POAs, & statutory records.
2. **Compliance & Expiry Tracker:**
   All employee and company renewals, deadlines, owners, & statuses.
3. **Corporate Insurance:**
   Public liability, workmen's compensation, medical, warehouse, motor, & other applicable policies.
4. **Premises Register:**
   Office/warehouse leases, deposits, renewals, & maintenance agreements.
5. **Vendor Register:**
   Supplier details, contracts, compliance documents, pricing, & renewals.
6. **Procurement Tracker:**
   Quotations, comparisons, approvals, purchases, & vendor follow-ups.
7. **Asset Register:**
   Laptops, phones, SIM cards, equipment, allocation, warranties, & recovery.
8. **Utilities & Telecom:**
   Electricity, internet, cooling, telecommunications, & service agreements.
9. **Fleet Register:**
   Vehicle registration, insurance, maintenance, & documents.
10. **Safety & Security:**
    Applicable inspections, certifications, safety records, & access controls.
11. **Banking & Finance Records:**
    Corporate KYC, banking mandates, tax registrations, & supporting documents, coordinated with accounts.
12. **Document Management:**
    Centralized secure filing, version control, archiving, & access permissions.

5. Quotation & Renewal Management

The manager must independently coordinate administrative procurement and renewals by:

* Identifying expiries and initiating action well in advance.
* Obtaining competitive quotations from service providers.
* Comparing pricing, scope, coverage, exclusions, and terms.
* Preparing comparison sheets with recommendations.
* Obtaining management approval before financial commitments.
* Coordinating approved renewals, procurement, and payments with accounts.
* Verifying renewed documents and updating registers.
* Preventing avoidable lapses in licenses, insurance, employee coverage, or essential services.

6. Mandatory 90-Day Implementation Plan

**Days 1–15 | Audit & Assessment**

* Audit employee files, HR policies, existing systems, and administrative records across India and Dubai.
* Review licenses, insurance, leases, vendor contracts, assets, and renewals.
* Identify missing documents, compliance gaps, expiries, and operational weaknesses.
* Prepare a prioritized action plan.

**Deliverable:**
HR & Administration Audit Report with corrective action tracker.

**Days 16–30 | Centralized Tracking**

* Establish employee master database and documentation register.
* Create compliance, expiry, insurance, lease, vendor, and asset trackers.
* Implement standardized digital filing, document naming, and access controls.
* Begin resolving documentation gaps and recommend an HRMS.

**Deliverable:**
Operational HR & Administration Master Dashboard with deadlines, owners, statuses, and reminders.

**Days 31–45 | HRMS Implementation**

* Configure the approved HRMS and migrate employee records.
* Establish onboarding, induction, offboarding, probation, and performance processes.
* Implement attendance, leave, documentation, and approval workflows.
* Develop standardized HR forms, templates, and checklists.

**Deliverable:**
Functioning HRMS and standardized employee lifecycle processes.

**Days 46–60 | Administration Systems**

* Complete company administration registers.
* Organize licenses, insurance, leases, assets, and vendor documentation.
* Implement quotation comparisons, procurement approvals, and renewal procedures.
* Establish administrative SOPs and automated reminders.

**Deliverable:**
Functional administration, procurement, and renewal management system.

**Days 61–90 | Independent Operations**

* Finalize HR policies, administrative SOPs, and priority documentation corrections.
* Train employees on systems and procedures.
* Implement weekly reporting and monthly dashboards.
* Verify tracking, approvals, reminders, and compliance processes.
* Demonstrate independent management of routine HR and administration.
* Submit a final implementation report.

**Deliverable:**
Fully structured HR and administration function operating with minimal management intervention.

7. Mandatory Reporting

**Weekly HR & Administration Report**

A concise report covering:

* Recruitment, vacancies, onboarding, probation, and exits.
* Missing employee and corporate documentation.
* Upcoming visas, licenses, insurance, and contract renewals.
* Quotations, procurement, and approvals pending.
* Vendor matters, assets, and outstanding administration tasks.
* Overdue actions, risks, and matters requiring management decisions.
* Completed work and priorities for the following week.

**Monthly Management Dashboard**

Must provide visibility into:

* Headcount by location and recruitment status.
* Probation, employee documents, and HR compliance.
* Licenses, insurance, contracts, and upcoming renewals.
* Administrative expenditure and cost-saving opportunities.
* Outstanding actions, deadlines, and compliance risks.

All pending actions must include an owner, deadline, status, and next step.

8. Mandatory Working Standards

The candidate must:

* Independently manage assigned HR and administration responsibilities.
* Complete tasks without repeated follow-ups or micromanagement.
* Maintain accurate, current, organized, and secure documentation.
* Anticipate deadlines and proactively address compliance risks.
* Coordinate effectively with India and Dubai teams, accounts, operations, IT, and vendors.
* Secure required approvals while independently handling execution.
* Introduce practical automation and process improvements.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of employee and corporate information.
* Take accountability for results, accuracy, deadlines, and continuous improvement.

9. Performance Evaluation & KPIs

Performance will be evaluated against:

* **Employee Records:**
  100% of active employees accounted for and records audited.
* **Company Documentation:**
  Complete inventory with gaps and corrective actions identified.
* **Expiry Tracking:**
  100% of known renewals recorded with advance reminders.
* **HRMS:**
  Implementation against the approved rollout plan.
* **Employee Processes:**
  Standardized onboarding and offboarding for every applicable employee.
* **Insurance:**
  All policies tracked and renewals initiated before deadlines.
* **Procurement:**
  Competitive comparisons and recommendations provided where required.
* **Reporting:**
  Timely weekly reports and monthly dashboards.
* **Compliance:**
  Zero avoidable lapses resulting from missed internal follow-ups.
* **SOPs:**
  Critical HR and administrative processes documented and implemented.
* **Independent Execution:**
  Routine tasks completed without constant supervision.

10. Candidate Assessment

Shortlisted candidates must demonstrate personally completed work, including anonymized examples where available:

* HR policies, SOPs, handbooks, and employee checklists.
* HRMS implementation and employee databases.
* Recruitment, compliance, and expiry trackers.
* Insurance quotation comparisons and administrative dashboards.

11. Final Hiring Expectation

We require an experienced professional who can
**build, implement, manage, and continuously improve the complete HR and administration infrastructure**
.

The ideal candidate is a proactive implementer, not simply an administrator following instructions.

**The objective is a systematic, compliant, technology-driven, accountable, and independently functioning HR and administration department across India and Dubai, requiring minimal day-to-day intervention from company leadership.**

**About The Position**
We are seeking an experienced Learning and Development Manager to lead the strategy, operations, and continuous improvement of the Ready for Allocation (RFA) function in India.
  
  
The RFA group includes employees awaiting assignment to a client-focused team, typically after completing new-hire training or while transitioning between client engagements. It may also include employees on the bench awaiting project allocation in accordance with company policies.
  
  
The L&D Manager, RFA will be accountable for ensuring that employees within RFA remain skilled, engaged, professional, compliant, and ready for timely deployment. The role will oversee workforce-readiness planning, learning-needs identification, upskilling interventions, operational governance, stakeholder coordination, and the overall RFA employee experience.
  
  
This position will manage the L&D Coordinator responsible for day-to-day RFA operations and will work closely with Talent Development, Resourcing, HR, Workforce Management, Operations, and business stakeholders. The manager will use workforce data and business requirements to strengthen deployment readiness, reduce skill gaps, improve operational efficiency, and build a scalable RFA operating model.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**RFA Strategy and Governance**

* Define and drive the overall RFA workforce-readiness strategy in alignment with business, resourcing, and talent priorities.
* Establish clear operating standards, governance mechanisms, escalation paths, and accountability measures for the RFA population.
* Translate organizational policies into clear and practical RFA processes, guidelines, and employee expectations.
* Monitor the health and effectiveness of the RFA model and recommend changes based on workforce data, stakeholder feedback, and evolving business needs.
* Ensure consistency in the management of employees completing training, transitioning between client teams, or awaiting project allocation.

**Workforce Readiness and Deployment Enablement**

* Oversee the readiness assessment of employees within RFA and ensure that skills, development needs, availability, and deployment status are accurately tracked.
* Partner with Resourcing, HR, Operations, and business leaders to understand upcoming talent requirements and prepare RFA employees for suitable opportunities.
* Identify barriers affecting employee deployment and coordinate appropriate learning, operational, or stakeholder interventions.
* Introduce structured readiness for employees to prepare for client project allocation.
* Provide leadership with timely visibility into workforce readiness, skill availability, development priorities, and deployment risks.

**Learning Needs and Upskilling**

* Lead training-needs analysis for the RFA population using readiness data, business requirements, performance indicators, and stakeholder inputs.
* Design and oversee targeted upskilling pathways that keep employees client-ready while they await allocation.
* Prioritize learning interventions based on business demand, skill gaps, deployment opportunities, and employee readiness.
* Guide the creation of just-in-time learning resources to address immediate RFA concerns and emerging capability requirements.
* Evaluate the relevance and effectiveness of learning interventions and use findings to improve future programs.
* Collaborate with Talent Development colleagues and subject-matter experts to source, create, or facilitate appropriate learning solutions.

**Data, Reporting, and Business Insights**

* Develop and maintain meaningful RFA dashboards, reports, and management insights.
* Analyze RFA data to identify skill gaps, readiness trends, allocation barriers, operational risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Define and monitor relevant measures for readiness, learning participation, skill development, deployment enablement, compliance, and employee engagement.
* Convert operational data into clear recommendations and decision support for senior stakeholders.
* Ensure data quality and consistency across RFA trackers, reporting tools, and HR systems.
* Use insights to prioritize interventions and demonstrate the business impact of the RFA function.

**Team Leadership and Capability Development**

* Manage, coach, and develop the L&D Coordinator supporting RFA operations and enablement.
* Set clear priorities, performance expectations, and development goals for the coordinator.
* Review the quality and timeliness of readiness tracking, stakeholder communication, learning interventions, and RFA engagement activities.
* Delegate operational responsibilities while maintaining accountability for overall RFA outcomes.
* Build the coordinator’s capability in data analysis, stakeholder management, learning-needs analysis, facilitation, process improvement, and project execution.
* Create a collaborative, accountable, and improvement-oriented team environment.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary Talent Development point of contact for RFA readiness and capability development.
* Build strong relationships with HR, Resourcing, Workforce Management, Operations, client-facing teams, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Facilitate regular stakeholder reviews to discuss RFA status, deployment priorities, emerging skill requirements, risks, and required actions.
* Clarify ownership across teams and ensure timely follow-through on agreed actions.
* Escalate critical readiness, conduct, compliance, or deployment concerns through the appropriate channels.
* Communicate RFA priorities, expectations, risks, and progress clearly to employees and leadership.

**Employee Experience, Professionalism, And Compliance**

* Create a structured and constructive experience for employees while they await allocation.
* Ensure employees understand the expectations associated with RFA, including availability, participation, learning completion, professional conduct, and communication.
* Oversee engagement initiatives that promote accountability, continuous learning, and connection to the organization.
* Work with HR and relevant stakeholders to manage recurring concerns related to participation, professionalism, conduct, or compliance.
* Ensure that RFA sessions and communications reinforce applicable company policies and workplace expectations.

**Process Improvement and Automation**

* Review existing RFA processes to identify inefficiencies, duplication, manual work, and control gaps.
* Lead improvement initiatives that simplify workflows, strengthen accountability, and improve the accuracy and timeliness of information.
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring tracking, reporting, reminders, communications, and administrative activities.
* Partner with relevant technology and operations teams to implement sustainable solutions.
* Establish standard operating procedures and appropriate documentation for critical RFA processes.
* Encourage the responsible use of technology and AI-enabled solutions to improve scalability and employee support.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Relevant experience in Learning and Development, workforce readiness, talent operations, workforce management, or a related function.
* Experience leading people, projects, programs, or a significant operational workstream.
* Strong understanding of training-needs analysis, learning-program design, facilitation, and capability development.
* Strong analytical capability, including the ability to interpret workforce data, identify patterns, and translate findings into practical recommendations.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, and comfort working with HR systems and reporting tools.
* Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills, with the ability to work across Talent Development, HR, Resourcing, Operations, and business teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and project-management capability, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to improve processes and introduce scalable ways of working.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing a bench, redeployment, talent-pool, transition, or workforce-readiness program.
* Experience leading a coordinator, specialist, trainer, or similar role.
* Experience developing dashboards and reporting for workforce or learning initiatives.
* Exposure to capacity planning, resource allocation, employee transitions, or client-readiness processes.
* Experience with workflow automation, reporting automation, or AI-enabled learning and operational solutions.
* Experience working in a global or cross-regional organization.

, handle routine accounting and taxation matters, coordinate with external professionals wherever required, resolve operational issues, and work closely with the partners to keep the firm organized, compliant, and efficient.

The ideal candidate should be practical, proactive, detail-oriented, trustworthy, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.

Key Responsibilities1. Accounts and Financial Management

* Manage day-to-day accounting, bookkeeping, journal entries, ledger maintenance, and bank reconciliations.
* Prepare and maintain profit and loss statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and other financial reports.
* Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, expense tracking, payment processing, and vendor accounts.
* Monitor cash flow, budgets, expenses, and financial performance.
* Maintain accurate financial records and ensure proper documentation of all transactions.
* Coordinate with auditors, chartered accountants, banks, and other financial institutions as required.

2. GST, Income Tax and Statutory Compliance

* Manage GST-related activities, including invoice verification, input tax credit reconciliation, preparation of GST workings, and coordination and filing of applicable GST returns.
* Handle income tax-related work, including tax computations, advance tax calculations, TDS compliance, and preparation and coordination of income tax return filings.
* Manage TDS calculations, deductions, payments, reconciliations, and applicable returns.
* Maintain statutory registers, tax records, supporting documents, and compliance calendars.
* Track filing deadlines, tax payments, notices, and other statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with the firm's chartered accountant and tax consultants for audits, assessments, tax notices, and complex compliance matters.
* Ensure compliance with applicable financial, taxation, and regulatory requirements.

3. Office Administration and General Management

* Oversee the firm's daily administrative activities and ensure smooth office operations.
* Manage vendors, service providers, office expenses, procurement, and facility-related requirements.
* Develop and implement internal processes, policies, checklists, and standard operating procedures.
* Maintain documentation, contracts, records, and confidential company information.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and implement practical improvements.

4. IT, Systems and Technology Management

* Oversee office IT infrastructure, computers, software, internet connectivity, email systems, printers, and other technology requirements.
* Coordinate with IT vendors and service providers for troubleshooting, maintenance, and upgrades.
* Manage software subscriptions, user access, data backups, and basic cybersecurity practices.
* Ensure proper access controls and confidentiality of financial and client information.
* Identify opportunities to automate accounting, reporting, documentation, and administrative workflows.

5. HR and Team Management

* Coordinate recruitment, onboarding, attendance, leave records, and employee documentation.
* Support payroll processing and coordinate salary-related statutory compliance.
* Set employee responsibilities, monitor performance, and ensure accountability.
* Supervise and coordinate with team members, resolve routine workplace issues, and promote a professional work environment.
* Coordinate training, internal communication, and implementation of company policies.

6. Business Operations and Management Reporting

* Prepare periodic management reports covering expenses, revenue, cash flow, compliance status, and operational performance.
* Monitor key business metrics and provide timely updates to the partners.
* Assist in budgeting, resource planning, cost control, and business planning.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely completion of operational and administrative tasks.
* Identify risks, follow up on pending matters, and proactively resolve issues before they affect business operations.

7. Client and Professional Coordination

* Coordinate with clients, vendors, banks, auditors, chartered accountants, tax consultants, and other professional service providers.
* Support client servicing and ensure timely follow-up on documentation and operational requirements.
* Maintain professional communication and ensure confidentiality in all business dealings.
* Support the partners in implementing business priorities and improving the overall client experience.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. B.Com, M.Com, MBA Finance, or equivalent qualifications are preferred.
* Approximately 5–10 years of relevant experience in accounting, taxation, finance, administration, or general management, preferably in a small or medium-sized organization.
* Strong practical knowledge of accounting principles, bookkeeping, financial statements, and bank reconciliations.
* Hands-on knowledge of GST, TDS, income tax compliance, and statutory filing procedures.
* Experience using accounting software such as Tally Prime, along with MS Excel and other business applications.
* Working knowledge of payroll, budgeting, vendor management, and office administration.
* Ability to coordinate IT systems and external service providers effectively.
* Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* High standards of integrity, confidentiality, accuracy, and accountability.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities independently and meet deadlines.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a
**hands-on General Manager who can manage accounts, taxation, compliance, IT coordination, HR administration, and general office operations under one roof.**

**We prefer someone who has worked in a CA firm, financial services company, consultancy, or SME environment and understands how to manage the practical, day-to-day requirements of a business.**

**The candidate should be comfortable handling routine work personally instead of only delegating tasks. They should also know when to seek support from a chartered accountant, tax expert, IT specialist, or legal professional for complex matters.**

**The role requires a self-driven individual who takes ownership, follows up without constant supervision, maintains accurate records, anticipates deadlines, and ensures that nothing important is overlooked.**

Key Performance Expectations

* Timely and accurate accounting, reconciliations, and financial reporting.
* GST, TDS, income tax, and other applicable compliance completed within prescribed deadlines.
* Accurate financial records and readiness for audits and assessments.
* Effective expense control, cash flow monitoring, and vendor management.
* Smooth functioning of office systems, IT coordination, and administrative processes.
* Timely payroll and employee documentation, as applicable.
* Reliable management reporting and regular updates to the partners.
* Strong ownership, accountability, confidentiality, and minimal need for day-to-day supervision.

**Work Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat

* **Work Arrangement:**
  Full-time, on-site

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Company Description

CodeKarma is a developer-focused platform that brings real production context directly into the coding workflow, enabling teams and AI agents to see what code actually runs, where latency and errors originate, and what is safe to change. By connecting production truth with the codebase, CodeKarma helps engineers understand real call paths, distinguish active code from dead code, and reduce time spent searching through dashboards and logs. This approach allows teams to deliver features faster, lower production risk, and meaningfully reduce technical debt. CodeKarma empowers engineering teams to avoid blind refactors, minimize guesswork about potential breaks, and ship software with greater confidence.

Role Description

This is a full-time, on-site Customer Success Manager role based in Bengaluru South. The Customer Success Manager will work closely with engineering and product teams to onboard new customers, understand their workflows, and ensure effective adoption of CodeKarma’s platform. Daily responsibilities include conducting customer check-ins, gathering feedback, analyzing usage data, and proactively identifying opportunities to improve customer outcomes and product value. The role also involves managing customer relationships, coordinating with internal teams to resolve issues, leading training sessions and demos, and preparing regular performance and success reports. The Customer Success Manager will help drive renewals and expansion by aligning CodeKarma’s capabilities with customer goals.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive Adoption: Walk the customer's engineering floor, engage directly with developers and teams, and make CodeKarma part of their daily workflows.

• Enable Teams: Conduct onboarding sessions, roadshows, workshops, and demos for developers, architects, engineering managers, and senior leadership.

• Build Use Cases: Help teams discover how CodeKarma can improve development, debugging, incident analysis, and engineering productivity.

• Monitor Engagement: Track active users, usage trends, adoption, and drop-offs. Proactively engage with users and teams to improve usage.

• Own Customer Feedback: Be the primary bridge between customers and CodeKarma. Own the tracking, communication, and follow-through of bugs, feature requests, feedback, and customer concerns, working closely with engineering and product teams.

• Build Relationships: Develop strong relationships with developers, champions, decision-makers, and engineering leadership.

• Drive Retention & Expansion: Demonstrate measurable value, ensure smooth renewals, and identify opportunities to expand CodeKarma across teams and products.

Qualifications

• Customer satisfaction and customer service skills to ensure a positive end-to-end experience and responsive support.

• Customer retention and relationship building skills to foster long-term partnerships and drive renewals and expansions.

• Analytical skills to interpret usage data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.

• Experience working with technical or SaaS products, preferably in developer tools or software engineering environments.

• Strong communication and presentation abilities, with confidence in engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to manage multiple customer accounts, prioritize tasks, and work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (such as Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or similar) or equivalent practical experience.

* • Previous experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Customer Support in a B2B setting is highly beneficial.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**About Exotel:**

Exotel is a leading cloud communications platform that helps businesses transform how they engage with their customers. Our solutions power enterprise conversations across voice, messaging, and digital channels, enabling businesses to deliver seamless, reliable, and scalable customer experiences.

We work with enterprises across industries, helping them solve complex communication challenges through cloud technology, APIs, and innovative communication solutions.

At Exotel, we operate at the intersection of communications, technology, and customer experience, helping businesses build better customer interactions at scale.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for an Enterprise Customer Success Manager to manage and grow relationships with some of Exotel’s largest enterprise customers.

In this role, you will own the customer relationship across the post-sales lifecycle - from implementation and solution launches to product adoption, renewals, and account expansion. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and internal teams to ensure successful deployments, resolve escalations, and identify opportunities to grow revenue from existing accounts.

This is a customer-facing, commercially accountable role that combines technical understanding, relationship management, project coordination, and revenue ownership.

The ideal candidate will have experience in SaaS customer success, technical account management, or enterprise account management, with a strong understanding of APIs and integrations. Experience managing customers in banking, financial services, or insurance (BFSI) will be an added advantage.

**What will you do:**

1. Revenue Ownership and Account Growth

* Own monthly and quarterly revenue targets for assigned accounts, driving renewals, upselling, and cross-selling opportunities.
* Identify opportunities to expand product adoption and increase revenue within existing customer accounts.
* Collaborate with Sales teams to develop account growth strategies and convert expansion opportunities into revenue.
* Lead commercial discussions, negotiate pricing and contract terms, and manage subscription renewals.
* Proactively identify renewal risks and develop plans to protect and grow existing revenue.

2. Customer Relationship Management

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned enterprise customers, building strong relationships with business, technology, and leadership stakeholders.
* Understand customer objectives, business challenges, and success criteria, translating them into actionable plans.
* Drive customer engagement, satisfaction, retention, and long-term value realization.
* Conduct regular customer reviews and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to demonstrate value, review progress, and identify growth opportunities.
* Manage customer expectations proactively and address concerns before they escalate.

3. Technical Account Management

* Develop a strong understanding of Exotel’s platform, APIs, integrations, and product capabilities.
* Explain technical concepts and solution capabilities effectively to both business and technical stakeholders.
* Work with customer engineering teams and Exotel’s internal Product, Engineering, and Support teams to facilitate integrations and resolve technical challenges.
* Conduct product demonstrations and solution discussions to showcase how Exotel’s capabilities address customer requirements.
* Help customers diagnose technical issues and coordinate with internal teams to drive resolution.

4. Implementation and Project Management

* Coordinate customer implementations and solution launches, ensuring alignment on scope, timelines, milestones, and responsibilities.
* Work across customer teams and internal stakeholders to manage dependencies, track progress, and mitigate delivery risks.
* Manage multiple customer projects simultaneously, prioritising activities based on urgency, business impact, and customer commitments.
* Ensure smooth transitions from implementation to ongoing account management and product adoption.
* Track project outcomes and help customers realise the intended business value from Exotel’s solutions.

5. Escalation Management and Cross-functional Collaboration

* Own customer escalations and drive timely resolution by coordinating with Support, Engineering, Product, Finance, and other relevant teams.
* Communicate issues, risks, progress, and resolution plans clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Partner with Finance and Accounts Receivable teams to resolve billing, payment, and commercial queries.
* Represent the voice of the customer internally, sharing feedback and recurring pain points to improve products and service delivery.

6. Reporting and Account Governance

* Maintain accurate customer, commercial, renewal, and engagement information in the CRM.
* Track account health, revenue performance, renewal timelines, product adoption, and expansion opportunities.
* Prepare account updates and business reviews that communicate progress, risks, outcomes, and next steps.
* Use account data to identify risks early and drive continuous improvement.

**What are we looking for:**

* 3-6 years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Enterprise Account Management, or a similar customer-facing role, preferably in a SaaS or technology company.
* Demonstrated experience owning revenue targets, including renewals, upselling, cross-selling, or account expansion.
* Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, and technical solutioning, with the ability to work effectively with engineering teams.
* Experience managing enterprise customers and coordinating multiple stakeholders across business and technology teams.
* Commercial acumen, including experience with pricing discussions, contract negotiations, and renewals.
* Excellent communication, relationship-building, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritise competing demands, and handle high-stakes customer situations.
* Proficiency in CRM systems for managing customer information, commercial opportunities, and account engagement.

**Good to have:**

* Experience managing customers in banking, financial services, or insurance (BFSI).
* Familiarity with cloud telephony, CPaaS, CCaaS, contact centre technology, or communication APIs.
* Experience supporting enterprise integrations and technology-led customer deployments.
* Exposure to customer health tracking, churn prevention, and account expansion strategies.

**Success Metrics:**

* Achievement of monthly and quarterly revenue targets.
* Renewal performance and revenue growth within existing accounts.
* Increased adoption of Exotel’s products and solutions.
* Successful customer implementations and timely resolution of escalations.
* Customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term account health.
* Identification and conversion of upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
* Effective account governance and cross-functional collaboration.

title: Key Accounts Manager - National IDN
description:
**Company Description**
At Intuitive, we are united behind our mission: we believe that minimally invasive care is life-enhancing care. Through ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints.
  
  
As a pioneer and market leader in robotic-assisted surgery, we strive to foster an inclusive and diverse team, committed to making a difference. For more than 25 years, we have worked with hospitals and care teams around the world to help solve some of healthcare's hardest challenges and advance what is possible.
  
  
Intuitive has been built by the efforts of great people from diverse backgrounds. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere. We strive to foster an inclusive culture built around diversity of thought and mutual respect. We lead with inclusion and empower our team members to do their best work as their most authentic selves.
  
  
Passionate people who want to make a difference drive our culture. Our team members are grounded in integrity, have a strong capacity to learn, the energy to get things done, and bring diverse, real world experiences to help us think in new ways. We actively invest in our team members to support their long-term growth so they can continue to advance our mission and achieve their highest potential.
  
  
Join a team committed to taking big leaps forward for a global community of healthcare professionals and their patients. Together, let's advance the world of minimally invasive care.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Primary Function of Position**
A da Vinci Key Accounts Manager is responsible for driving strategic growth of the da Vinci™ Surgical System within key Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs) across India. The role demands deep expertise in robotic-assisted surgery, the ability to build strong multi-level clinical and administrative advocacy within hospitals, advanced solution-selling capabilities, and the resilience to consistently achieve commercial objectives in a highly complex healthcare environment.
  
  
The KAM partners closely with hospital leadership, clinicians, and procurement stakeholders throughout the capital acquisition journey and beyond, delivering a high level of strategic insight, market intelligence, and value-based engagement. Beyond driving system adoption, the role is focused on enabling long-term program success by implementing strategic account initiatives that enhance robotic surgery excellence, strengthen customer partnerships, improve service delivery outcomes, and effectively navigate competitive dynamics.
  
  
**Essential Job Duties**

* Manage the complex sales process of the da Vinci™ Surgical System and strengthen partnerships with national IDNs
* Work closely with Area sales managers for demand generation with-in IDN network, help build clinical and executive advocacy for Intuitive ecosystem with-in the IDN network
* Collaborate with Clinical teams at Intuitive to support long-term business growth, strengthen the clinical sales process, and expand surgeon training and access to increase IDN-level utilization
* Partner with da Vinci Area Sales Director to develop an end-to-end sales process for Intuitive’s Key Accounts business to increase penetration and adoption within existing IDN customers
* Lead Intuitive India’s charter for building C-suite engagement with corporate offices of various National IDNs and strategize long-term partnerships to successfully scale robotics programs.
* Develop initial engagement with CXOs and senior hospital administrators, and lead stakeholder management for Intuitive India’s capital business
* Partner with commercial Solutions teams to implement localized and alternative financing solutions to expand access to robotic technology
* Develop MoUs and strategic programs that align Intuitive’s technology across the education, research, and clinical care ecosystem to drive RAS adoption.
* Establish the clinical, economic and ecosystem value of the Intuitive ecosystem within each IDN by working closely with cross-functional teams
* Lead complex negotiations for group contracts and multi-system deals
* Achieve annual sales targets, procedure targets, and strategic business goals

**Qualifications**

* Skilled in navigating end-to-end IDN procurement process, specifically for high value capital equipment
* Demonstrated strength in building strong advocates in the Key accounts setup through deep understanding of customer needs and various anchors/drivers for purchase of high value equipment
* Comprehensive understanding of the business beyond one's own area, including products/services and financial aspects. Ability to build productive working relationships with co-workers and external parties. Skilled in managing conflicts and negotiations
* Strong project management skills to drive initiatives towards the identified opportunities. They should be able to prioritize tasks, allocate resources, and ensure timely execution of projects to achieve desired outcomes
* Deep understanding of the Indian healthcare landscape, including national hospital groups, hospital business environments, and private-sector purchasing cycles
* Knowledge of the operating room environment
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills especially influence without authority
* Proven successful track record in capital medical equipment sales
* Ability to travel up to 50%, dependent upon account distribution
* Fluent in English

**Required Education And Training**

* Minimum master’s degree or equivalent experience required. MBA will be preferred
* Minimum of 8 years’ sales experience in healthcare/surgery or capital sales preferably in Key Accounts/Large Hospitals

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Success in introducing new technologies to the market is a plus

title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Checkpoint Systems, a division of CCL Industries, is a technology leader in RFID-based solutions that support digital transformation across industries such as retail, food and beverage, logistics, health and beauty, and DIY. The company provides vertically integrated RFID/RF solutions that help organizations optimize operations, enhance security, and protect valuable assets. With a strong track record of successful implementations, Checkpoint Systems delivers customized solutions that improve accuracy, efficiency, and customer experience. The team works closely with clients to understand their specific needs and supports their growth through innovation and industry-focused expertise.

We're looking for an experienced
**Service Delivery Manager**

who thrives on building trusted customer relationships, solving complex challenges, and driving operational excellence. In this role, you'll be at the center of our customer experience vis-a-vis support, partnering with enterprise clients and internal teams to ensure services are delivered seamlessly, issues are resolved effectively, and continuous improvements are always in motion. Additionally, you will also be leading critical incident calls, presenting service performance to executives, and influencing cross-functional teams to improve outcomes. 

**What You'll Own**

As a Service Delivery Manager, you'll serve as the operational lead for a portfolio of enterprise customers, ensuring they receive the l service, reliability, and partnership they expect from us.

**Build Trusted Customer Partnerships**

* Become the go-to operational contact for your customers.
* Support as a technical liaison between internal teams, field teams and customer teams.
* Develop strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels, from operational teams to senior leadership- both internal & external.
* Lead Service Reviews, Quarterly Business Reviews, and governance meetings that provide meaningful insights and outcomes.
* Act as a trusted advisor, helping customers maximize value from our services.

**Drive Service Excellence**

* Own service performance against SLAs, KPIs, and contractual commitments.
* Monitor service health, availability, customer experience, and operational metrics.
* Identify risks before they become issues and lead proactive mitigation efforts.
* Champion a culture of accountability and continuous improvement across teams.

**Lead During Critical Moments**

* Act as the customer-facing lead during major incidents and high-priority escalations.
* Coordinate support, engineering, product, and operations teams toward rapid resolution.
* Deliver clear, confident, and timely communications to customers and leadership.
* Ensure root causes are identified and corrective actions are implemented.

**Turn Insights into Improvements**

* Analyze service trends, recurring issues, and customer feedback.
* Develop and execute Service Improvement Plans that deliver measurable value.
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to improve platform stability, usability, and performance.
* Continuously look for opportunities to enhance the customer experience.

**Govern Change with Confidence**

* Ensure customers are informed and prepared for upcoming releases, upgrades, and maintenance activities.
* Assess customer impact and manage risk associated with service changes.
* Help ensure smooth adoption of new capabilities while minimizing disruption.

**What You'll Bring**

**Experience**

* 7+ years' experience in Service Delivery, IT Operations, Managed Services, or related customer-facing operational roles.
* Experience managing enterprise or strategic customer accounts.
* Proven track record leading major incidents, escalations, and service recovery efforts.
* Experience presenting performance metrics and operational updates to senior stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of SaaS, cloud-based platforms, and customer support operations.

**Skills & Attributes**

* Lead a 24x7 roster-based team from the front and not just delegate.
* Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills.
* Strong sense of ownership and customer advocacy.
* Ability to influence teams without direct authority.
* Calm and decisive under pressure.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into action.
* Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

**Nice to Have**

* ITIL Foundation or ITIL 4 certification.
* Experience with Azure, monitoring, and observability platforms.
* Experience working within SaaS, retail technology, or enterprise software environments.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or similar project management certification.

title: Delivery Manager (Technical)
description:
The Delivery Manager is responsible for end-to-end client delivery outcomes, operational stability, and account growth within assigned accounts. This is a
**technically hands-on delivery leadership role**
: you will be expected to understand architecture, code quality, environments, and release pipelines well enough to guide engineers, challenge estimates, and lead technical conversations with client stakeholders. The role operationalizes the
**3M Strategy (Manage, Monitor, Mine)**
, ensures adherence to the
**Tiered Operating Model**
, and acts as the primary day-to-day delivery contact for clients. You will work as a
**peer**
with global counterparts, drive client satisfaction, and proactively identify risks and expansion opportunities.

Because many of our clients are based on the US West Coast, this role includes regular late-night coverage from India so that PST clients have a responsive, accountable delivery lead during their working day.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 8+ years of delivery/project management in IT services or software engineering, with a hands-on technical background (developer, tech lead, architect, or DevOps/QA engineering) of at least 3 years

* Ability to read and review code or technical designs and hold credible technical discussions with engineers and client architects
* Experience managing multiple clients simultaneously (shared PM model)
* Strong working knowledge of Agile, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models
* Proven ability to work with COEs (e.g., Modern Engineering, Integration, Cloud, ERP)
* Excellent client-facing communication and risk management skills, including experience working with US clients
* Familiarity with tools like Jira, Confluence, DevOps pipelines, and health dashboards
* Willingness and ability to work late-night hours (up to ~1:00–2:00 AM IST) for PST client coverage
* Willingness to come to the office on short notice and to travel as business needs arise
* A dedicated home workspace with reliable internet and power backup for remote work

**Preferred**

* Experience with staff augmentation ? value-add delivery transformation
* Background in one or more COE domains (e.g., legacy modernization, low-code, AI, Mulesoft, Kafka, AWS/Azure, data engineering)
* Hands-on exposure to test automation, security and compliance practices, and AI-assisted development
* PMP, CSM, SAFe, or relevant cloud/DevOps certification
* Prior experience in a peer delivery model with global teams

title: Senior Manager, Client Solutions
description:
**About us**

Launched in 2017, WeWork India is one of India’s leading premium flexible workspace operators - GPTW certified (Nov 2024 – Nov 2025, Dec 2025 – Dec 2026). WeWork India has been the largest operator by total revenue for the past three fiscal years. Since its inception, WeWork India has expanded across 8 cities in Chennai, New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, and Hyderabad, with 79 operational centres spanning 9.1 million square feet. WeWork India has played a significant role in the growth of the flexible workspace sector and contributed to the evolution of its products and services, providing customised and curated solutions for various office space needs.

For more information, please visit our website.

**About the Role**

The Client Solutions team specializes in developing bespoke workplace strategies that address intricate client challenges, serving as a critical nexus between Sales and project design & delivery. As the primary technical interface during the sales lifecycle, this team ensures that every committed solution is feasible, realistic, and aligned with delivery capabilities.

This role provides PAN India leadership for the Client Solutions function, including team leadership, portfolio oversight, reporting and forecasting, escalation management, submission quality, process governance and client experience. The role holder will guide team members who manage routine project coordination and client communication, and will intervene directly on critical client discussions, cross-functional dependencies and escalations as required.

This is a high-ownership role suited to someone who combines commercial thinking, design expertise and client leadership. The successful candidate should be comfortable moving between a CXO-level client discussion, a workplace test-fit, a commercial review and a technical discussion with a D&B partner - while maintaining a clear view of the overall business objective.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise Solutioning & Technical Sales**

* Guide the Client Solutions team on pitch strategy and solution development, ensuring the proposed solution is the best fit for the client's requirements and supports opportunity conversion.
* Provide leadership oversight of key pitches and technical recommendations; direct hands-on solutioning or client involvement should be required based on complexity, risk or escalation.
* Partner with Sales and Enterprise teams to understand client business objectives, workplace strategy, headcount, operational requirements and timelines.
* Identify opportunities to optimise solutions based on cost, time, quality, experience and operational requirements.

**2. Due Diligence & Feasibility**

* Identify potential impacts on project budget, programme and quality at an early stage.
* Develop mitigation strategies and align internal stakeholders before commitments are made to the client.
* Oversee the team's assessment of material feasibility risks and ensure risks, dependencies and mitigation actions are recorded, communicated and escalated before client commitments are made.
* Participate in site walks or reviews where leadership intervention, a significant risk or an escalation requires it; routine site coordination should be managed by the relevant team member.

**3. Commercial & Project Planning**

* Balance client expectations with project feasibility and WeWork's commercial objectives.
* Ensure that proposed solutions are realistic, deliverable and aligned with agreed commercial parameters.
* Review portfolio-level risks to budgets, timelines and delivery commitments, and drive cross-functional action plans where business outcomes or client commitments are at risk.

**4. Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Provide oversight of client communication standards and hand-offs, ensuring communication is timely, accurate and aligned with agreed protocols. Routine client coordination should be owned by the designated
* Client Solutions team member, with the Lead stepping in for critical discussions or escalations.
* Act as the first point of escalation across the PAN India portfolio for complex client, project cross-functional issues, driving resolution with the relevant stakeholders.
* Promote a consistent client experience across projects to support satisfaction, repeat engagement and recurring business.
* Build strong relationships with enterprise clients, CRE leaders, workplace teams and senior decision-makers.
* Work closely with Sales, Real Estate, Design, Project Management, Procurement, D&B partners and other internal teams.
* Create alignment across stakeholders and drive timely decisions in a fast-paced environment.

**5. Design & Delivery Interface**

* Oversee quality and consistency of key submissions and outputs across relevant verticals, ensuring they meet client requirements and WeWork standards before submission where a review checkpoint is agreed.
* Focus direct involvement on high-risk, high-value or escalated matters; routine coordination and follow-up should remain with the assigned team members and functional owners.
* Maintain continuity between the solution sold and the solution delivered.
* Participate in regular site reviews and project progress discussions where required.
* Support resolution of design, technical and execution challenges during project delivery.

**6. Portfolio & Business Management**

* Build and run a standardised PAN India reporting and tracking system covering project status, milestones, business potential, forecast, risks, concerns, dependencies, owners and next actions.
* Provide regular leadership updates on pipeline movement, forecast changes, critical risks, escalations and decisions required; ensure data is accurate, current and actionable.
* Own the Client Solutions operating framework, including reporting cadence, review checkpoints, escalation routes, process standards and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Lead and develop direct reports, set priorities and accountabilities, review delivery quality and balance team capacity against business priorities.
* Manage multiple opportunities and projects simultaneously across different scales and stages. Prioritise opportunities based on business impact, urgency and probability of closure.
* Identify recurring challenges and opportunities to improve Client Solutions processes.
* Contribute to new initiatives, standardisation, solution frameworks and tools that improve speed and quality of delivery.

**Education and Desired Qualifications**

* The ideal candidate will bring 8–12+ years of relevant experience across architecture, workplace strategy, project management, interior fit-out, design management, commercial real estate or related AEC disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience in team leadership, portfolio-level reporting and forecasting, escalation management, process governance and driving consistent execution across multiple locations.

* Strong understanding of workplace planning, interior fit-out, MEP, technology and building infrastructure.

title: Manager, Implementation - IT Product
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
Rippling’s Product Specialist team ensures customers see incredible business transformation through Rippling's most complex products.
  
  
Our engagements are consultative. Our specialists deeply understand the customers’ unique pain points, offer creative solutions, and build/set up their Rippling environment to address their needs. Hence, our specialists serve as a bridge between the customer and product teams. They are instrumental in driving adoption.
  
  
As a Manager, IT Implementation, you will lead a team of ~7/8 specialists to drive the exponential impact of adoption and customer lifetime value (LTV) across Rippling’s IT product offerings (Identity and Access Management, Device Management, Inventory Management, and Third-Party IdP).
  
  
The ideal candidate has a proven track record of leading client-facing implementation, professional services, or technical client support teams in a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment, combined with the technical ability needed to guide specialists through complex customer environments.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Direct a global team of IT Product Specialists, fostering accountability, continuous professional development, and execution excellence.
* Lead the front-line execution of IT implementations from client kickoff through go-live, ensuring your team hits key milestones and maximizes product adoption.
* Identify and mitigate risks associated with implementation projects, act as an escalation point for complex client implementations and technical issues
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Rippling Sales, Technical Account Management, and Support teams to create a seamless customer journey
* Collaborate with Product & Engineering to continuously improve product functionality based on customer feedback in Implementation
* Monitor key performance metrics and continuous improvement on KPIs while helping to optimize playbooks and frameworks for increased simplicity and efficiency

**What You Will Need**

* 2+ years of professional experience directly managing teams within a customer-facing organization, such as Professional Services, Customer Implementation and Technical Client Support.
* Strong foundational knowledge of corporate IT landscapes. You must be comfortable coaching a team that works daily with MDM, identity provisioning (SSO, SAML/OIDC), Zero Touch deployment, and Endpoint Lifecycle Management (e.g., Google Workspace, Azure AD, Okta).
* 5+ years of overall experience in customer onboarding or software implementation, with a clear understanding of managing external customer relationships and project timelines.
* A track record of developing, tracking, and optimizing operational metrics, team capacity, and project timelines.
* Self-starter with a bias towards action, energized by ambiguity and a fast-paced environment, with a strong desire to build.

****Note****

* This is a hybrid role and will require you to work out of our Bangalore office three days a week.
* This job requires you a to work in the EST/PST shift.

**Additional Information**
Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com
  
  
Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: Sales Manager – B2B & Institutional (FMCG)
description:
Key Responsibilities

A. Business Development & Account Management

* Identify, acquire, and develop corporate and institutional customers across assigned market segments.
* Manage the complete sales cycle, including prospecting, product sampling, proposal development, negotiations, deal closure, and customer onboarding.
* Build and maintain long-term client relationships to drive repeat business, customer retention, and account growth.
* Develop and execute sales plans to achieve assigned revenue, sales volume, and profitability targets.

B. Distributor Development & Management

* Identify, appoint, and onboard new distributors and channel partners to expand market reach and strengthen sales coverage.
* Build and maintain strong distributor relationships while driving sales targets, territory coverage, and business development plans.
* Monitor distributor stock levels, inventory movement, product availability, and stock ageing to prevent stock-outs and excess inventory.
* Coordinate with distributors and internal teams to ensure timely replenishment, efficient order planning, and consistent product availability.
* Track distributor performance, including primary and secondary sales, wherever applicable, and overall business growth.
* Follow up on distributor payments and outstanding receivables while ensuring compliance with approved credit limits and payment terms.
* Conduct regular distributor performance reviews and implement corrective measures to improve sales productivity, collections, and market penetration.

C. Commercial Management

* Prepare quotations, sales proposals, pricing recommendations, and commercial offers in accordance with approved company guidelines.
* Negotiate pricing, margins, contracts, and payment terms within the scope of delegated authority.
* Monitor collections, follow up on overdue payments, and coordinate with the Finance team for credit approvals and reconciliation of outstanding balances.
* Ensure that all distributor and customer transactions comply with approved commercial terms, credit policies, and company procedures.

D. Cross-Functional Coordination

* Collaborate with Marketing, Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, and Quality teams to facilitate product approvals, documentation, order fulfilment, and customer requirements.
* Share sales forecasts, distributor stock updates, market intelligence, and customer feedback to support production planning, inventory management, and business decisions.

E. Reporting & Market Development

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records, distributor databases, sales pipelines, forecasts, stock reports, collection reports, and management information system (MIS) reports.
* Monitor competitor activities, market trends, pricing strategies, and emerging business opportunities.
* Represent the company and its brands at customer meetings, trade events, exhibitions, and relevant industry forums.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated against mutually agreed targets and key business metrics, including:

* Achievement of revenue, sales volume, and gross margin targets.
* New customer acquisition and new distributor appointments.
* Distributor productivity, territory coverage, and sales growth.
* Distributor stock availability, inventory movement, and stock ageing management.
* Collection efficiency, outstanding receivables, and compliance with approved credit terms.
* Repeat orders, customer retention, and existing account revenue growth.
* Sales forecast accuracy, CRM updates, and timely reporting.

Specific targets, measurement criteria, and weightages will be agreed upon with the reporting manager during onboarding.

4. Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong experience in B2B, corporate, institutional, or distributor sales, preferably within FMCG, food and beverages, packaged foods, or consumer brands.
* Proven ability to acquire new customers, appoint and manage distributors, develop key accounts, and achieve sales targets.
* Practical experience in distributor management, stock monitoring, inventory coordination, and payment collections.
* Sound understanding of pricing, profit margins, credit management, receivables, and commercial negotiations.
* Strong communication, negotiation, relationship management, planning, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in CRM tools, sales reporting, and MIS preparation.
* Ability to work independently, identify new business opportunities, and manage sales activities effectively.
* Willingness to travel within the assigned territory as required.

5. Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related discipline. An MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification will be preferred.
* 4–6 years of relevant experience in B2B, FMCG, distributor, corporate, or institutional sales.
* Demonstrated track record of business development, distributor network expansion, and revenue growth.
* Experience in corporate pantry supplies, HORECA (Hotels, Restaurants, and Catering), gifting, education, or healthcare segments will be an added advantage.
* Existing relationships with distributors, corporate buyers, procurement teams, or institutional partners will be preferred.

title: Manager- Operations cum Business Development
description:
Job Purpose
  
  
To oversee the smooth and efficient functioning of the fertility centre, ensure high standards of patient service, drive operational performance, strengthen referral networks and support business development initiatives across all branches of Aspire Fertility Center.
  
The role requires close coordination with doctors, clinical teams, front office, nursing, laboratory, accounts, marketing and external referral partners to achieve operational excellence and sustainable business growth.
  
  
2. Key Responsibilities
  
  
A. Center Operations & Administration
  
  
• Oversee the day-to-day functioning of the assigned centre(s) and ensure smooth patient flow.
  
  
• Monitor appointment scheduling, consultation coordination, follow-ups, patient registrations and billing processes.
  
  
• Ensure adequate staffing, duty rosters, attendance monitoring and coordination between departments.
  
  
• Monitor the availability of consumables, medicines and other operational requirements in coordination with the respective teams.
  
  
• Coordinate with IT, facility management, vendors and service providers to ensure timely resolution of operational issues.
  
  
• Ensure compliance with internal SOPs, documentation requirements and applicable regulatory procedures.
  
  
• Monitor the effective implementation and utilisation of HIMS and other operational systems.
  
  
• Conduct regular operational reviews and ensure timely closure of pending issues.
  
  
B. Business Development & Referral Network
  
  
• Identify and develop referral opportunities with gynaecologists, obstetricians, general practitioners, hospitals, diagnostic centres and other relevant healthcare professionals.
  
  
• Build and maintain professional relationships with existing and prospective referral partners.
  
  
• Plan and coordinate doctor outreach programmes, referral meetings, CME programmes, awareness initiatives and other approved engagement activities.
  
  
• Monitor referral enquiries, referral conversions and centre-wise performance.
  
  
• Identify opportunities to improve patient acquisition, consultation conversion, treatment initiation and follow-up adherence.
  
  
• Coordinate with the marketing team to implement approved business development initiatives.
  
  
• Track the effectiveness of referral activities and submit periodic performance reports.
  
  
• Support the development of ethical, sustainable and long-term referral relationships.
  
  
C. Performance Growth & Business Monitoring
  
  
• Monitor centre-wise enquiries, consultations, patient conversions, treatment cycles and other management-defined performance indicators.
  
  
• Analyse performance trends and identify areas requiring operational or business development intervention.
  
  
• Work with doctors and the front office team to improve appointment utilisation, patient engagement and continuity of care.
  
  
• Prepare monthly performance reports and action plans for management review.
  
  
• Coordinate the implementation of approved initiatives to improve centre performance and resource utilisation.
  
  
• Follow up on agreed action points and ensure timely execution.
  
  
D. Patient Experience & Service Quality
  
  
• Ensure professional, courteous and responsive patient service at every point of interaction.
  
  
• Monitor patient feedback, complaints, waiting times and service-related issues.
  
  
• Coordinate with the concerned departments to resolve patient concerns promptly.
  
  
• Ensure appropriate communication regarding appointments, reports, follow-ups and other service requirements.
  
  
• Identify recurring service gaps and implement corrective measures in coordination with management.
  
  
• Maintain patient confidentiality and ensure that all patient-facing activities comply with centre policies.
  
  
E. Team Coordination & Staff Management
  
  
• Supervise and coordinate the work of front office, patient coordination and other assigned operational staff.
  
  
• Conduct periodic team meetings and communicate operational priorities.
  
  
• Monitor staff productivity, punctuality, service standards and adherence to assigned responsibilities.
  
  
• Identify training requirements and coordinate staff training and performance improvement.
  
  
• Promote accountability, teamwork and effective communication between departments.
  
  
F. Reporting & Management Coordination
  
  
• Submit daily, weekly and monthly operational and business development reports, as required.
  
  
• Maintain updated records of referral partners, outreach activities, enquiries and conversion outcomes.
  
  
• Escalate critical operational issues, patient service concerns and compliance risks to management.
  
  
• Provide regular updates on targets, achievements, challenges and corrective action plans.
  
  
• Ensure that management decisions and approved initiatives are implemented within the stipulated timelines.
  
  
3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
Performance will be assessed using management-approved targets, including:
  
  
1. Centre-wise operational efficiency and adherence to SOPs.
  
2. Appointment utilisation and patient waiting time.
  
3. Enquiry-to-consultation and consultation-to-treatment conversion rates.
  
4. Growth in active referral relationships and referral-generated enquiries.
  
5. Centre-wise performance growth against agreed targets.
  
6. Patient feedback, complaint resolution and service quality.
  
7. Timely completion of reports, reviews and assigned action points.
  
8. Staff productivity, coordination and adherence to operational procedures.
  
9. Timely resolution of operational issues and effective resource utilisation.
  
  
Specific targets will be established by management based on center capacity, baseline performance and business objectives.
  
  
4. Qualifications & Experience
  
  
• Graduate or postgraduate qualification in Business Administration, Healthcare Management, Hospital Administration – Preferably from an IIM or another reputed Tier-1 management institute.
  
  
• Minimum 0-3years of relevant experience in healthcare operations, hospital administration, fertility centre management or healthcare business development.
  
  
• Experience in developing professional referral networks and managing healthcare service relationships is preferred.
  
  
• Knowledge of patient coordination, healthcare workflows, operational reporting and performance monitoring.
  
  
• Familiarity with hospital information management systems and Microsoft Excel or equivalent reporting tools.
  
  
5. Skills & Competencies
  
  
• Strong operational planning and execution skills.
  
• Excellent communication, interpersonal and relationship-management abilities.
  
• Business development, networking and negotiation skills.
  
• Analytical thinking and performance monitoring.
  
• Team leadership and cross-functional coordination.
  
• Problem-solving, decision-making and follow-through.
  
• Professional conduct, discretion and patient confidentiality.
  
• Ability to manage multiple priorities across departments and centres.
  
  
6. General Expectations
  
  
• Maintain professional standards and uphold the values and reputation of Aspire Fertility Center.
  
  
• Ensure that all business development activities are ethical and comply with applicable healthcare regulations.
  
  
• Work collaboratively with clinical and administrative teams without compromising clinical independence.
  
  
• Undertake other relevant responsibilities assigned by management in line with the role.
