title: Product Manager
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**Product Manager**
,
**Shipping as a Service**
(L24)
  
  
**About The Team And The Role**
**eBay Shipping is evolving from a marketplace capability into a reusable global platform.**
Our ambition is to make eBay's shipping services available to eBay entities and subsidiaries, external marketplaces, third-party commerce and logistics platforms, and sellers operating across multiple channels.
  
  
We are looking for a customer-obsessed Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end partner and client journey - from opportunity discovery and solution shaping through integration, launch and adoption. You will help early clients succeed while ensuring their needs are translated into scalable platform patterns rather than one-off implementations.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of B2B product, developer experience and global go-to-market. You will work closely with eBay Shipping Product and Engineering teams, Design, Analytics, Business, Legal, Finance, Operations and partner-management teams to create a repeatable model for bringing new clients onto the platform.
  
  
**What You Will Accomplish**

* Define the product strategy and roadmap for client onboarding, partner integrations and adoption of Shipping as a Service.
* Segment and prioritize target customers and use cases across eBay entities, subsidiaries, marketplaces, third-party platforms, high-volume sellers and multi-channel businesses.
* Own the complete client journey from discovery and requirements through technical integration, certification, production launch, growth and support.
* Develop repeatable integration patterns, reference journeys and onboarding playbooks that reduce time to first API call, first label and production scale.
* Partner with the Platform PM and Engineering teams to translate client needs into reusable APIs, configuration and operational capabilities.
* Shape the developer and partner experience, including documentation, onboarding, authentication and access controls, sandbox journeys, sample applications, integration checklists, and support processes.
* Work with client teams to define embedded shipping experiences that are simple, trustworthy and consistent while allowing appropriate flexibility for their customers.
* Lead cross-functional launch readiness across Product, Engineering, Business, Legal, Security, Payments, Reconciliation, Shipping Operations, Customer Support and Analytics.
* Build feedback loops with clients and partners to identify friction, prioritize improvements and continuously strengthen the platform proposition.
* Establish and own adoption metrics such as integration cycle time, activation, active clients, shipment volume, repeat usage, support contacts and partner satisfaction.
* Tell a compelling product and business story that aligns senior stakeholders around target clients, investment priorities, launch sequencing and measurable outcomes.

**What You Will Bring**

* 3+ years of product management experience, ideally across B2B, B2B2C, marketplaces, SaaS, developer products or platform integrations.
* Experience taking complex integrations from early discovery through production launch and adoption.
* Strong customer-discovery skills and the ability to distinguish reusable platform needs from client-specific requests.
* A track record of designing effective onboarding, activation or partner experiences using qualitative insight and funnel data.
* Strong understanding of APIs and technical integrations, with the ability to work credibly with client and platform engineering teams.
* Excellent product judgement, prioritization and execution discipline in ambiguous, multi-stakeholder environments.
* Strong analytical mindset; comfortable defining metrics, measuring integration and adoption funnels, and using data to prioritize improvements.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to align senior internal leaders and external partners.
* Ability to operate globally across markets, time zones, regulatory models and different client operating contexts.

**Additional Details**
eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

title: Lead II, Infrastructure/Network Architect
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the technical authority and trusted advisor for clients, engaging with stakeholders, governance teams, project executives, delivery teams, and technology vendors to define and drive infrastructure strategy and solutions.
* Lead the end-to-end architecture lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution definition through design, implementation, and successful delivery, ensuring solutions meet business objectives, timelines, and budget expectations.
* Design and govern enterprise infrastructure, data center, network, security, and cloud solutions, leveraging industry best practices to deliver scalable, resilient, secure, and high-performing environments.
* Translate business and technical requirements into comprehensive architecture deliverables, including solution architectures, HLDs, LLDs, migration strategies, implementation plans, and technical roadmaps.
* Provide technical leadership and oversight for infrastructure transformation initiatives, including cloud adoption, platform modernization, data center migrations, technology refreshes, and brownfield/greenfield deployments.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams and subject matter experts to evaluate technology options, overcome complex technical challenges, and ensure optimal solution design and delivery.
* Drive continuous improvement, innovation, automation, capacity planning, and operational excellence to enhance infrastructure performance, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.
* Lead technical reviews, architecture governance, risk assessments, and implementation activities, ensuring adherence to organizational standards, security requirements, and best practices.
* Mentor and guide engineering and operations teams, fostering technical excellence, knowledge sharing, and consistent delivery standards across projects and support functions.
Act as the primary escalation point for complex technical issues, providing expert guidance and ensuring effective resolution of critical infrastructure challenges.  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Experience:**

  

Minimum 7+years of IT Experience with Solid understanding of Data Center mainly Systems, Storage, Networking & Security, Application & Databases

  

**1. Network Platform Expertise:**

Install, configure, and troubleshoot various network platforms, including Cisco, Aruba, Viptela, Infoblox, F5, Fortinet, PaloAlto, and more.

Specialized in carrier solutions, private cloud access, and virtualization.

**2. Network Security and Voice Solutions:**

Install, configure, and troubleshoot security solutions like Palo Alto Firewalls, F5 Reverse-Proxy, VPNs, and voice solutions including Oracle SIP Federation and Microsoft Skype Enterprise.

Hands-on experience in migrating firewalls, upgrading firmware, and applying security patches.

**3. Cloud Hosting and Scripting:**

Hands-on experience with AWS and Azure cloud hosting solutions. Proficient in scripting languages: Ansible and Python.

**4. Network Design and Cisco ACI:**

In-depth knowledge on Cisco ACI, Configuration of User attributes, Design and application of filters, contracts, and policies, Fabric creation and policy configuration, North-south L3out connectivity, Provision and configuration of multi-pod environments, Dynamic tunnel establishment for communication, Configuration of pod spine access policies, Cisco ACI multi-site configuration and global contracts, Implementation of micro-segmentation.

**5. Project Management and Documentation:**

Develop an understanding of customer engagements, producing project-related documents such as SOW, High-Level Design, Low-Level Design, and Migration Plans.

**6. Network Monitoring and Maintenance:**

Utilize network monitoring tools to identify and resolve outages, latency issues, and bottlenecks.

Collaborate with vendors for maintenance scheduling, ensuring minimal disruptions to network service.

**7. Support Proficiency:**

Handle Business Critical Network outages, P1, P2 incident and drive quick resolution.

Provides 24/7 network support, including security and disaster recovery readiness.

Troubleshoot and resolve network issues, collaborating with IT professionals and providing support to L0 and L1 teams.

Establish structured engineering disciplines for streamlined network support operations.

On call support as needed

**8. Top 5 Skills in Network Domain:**

Advanced expertise in network platform installation and troubleshooting.

Specialized knowledge in Cisco ACI and NextGen Firewalls.

Proficiency in security solutions and voice technologies.

Strong scripting skills with Ansible and Python.

Meticulous network design, documentation, and project management.

**9. Products and Technologies**

* Cisco Small, Medium, Large Enterprise Routers, Switches,
* Cisco WLC/WIFI, Cisco Prime 3.1,ISE, ACS, Cisco ACI, Spine/Leaf, DC Technologies Switches such as 12k, 5940,7500, 5500 & 3600,
* Aruba 8400, 8320, 2930F & 3810M, Aruba Wi-Fi, Aruba ClearPass
* Viptela, Infoblox IPAM DDI/GSLB, Riverbed Steelhead optimizer,
* F5 LB such as LTM/GTM,
* Fortinet Firewall Management, FortiGate Manager, Palo Alto IPsec,
* Networking Tools Such as SolarWinds, Panaroma, MRTG, ZABBIX, Logic Monitor, HP IMC, Airwave and Mobility Controller and well versed with carrier solutions such as Ethernet, IP VPN, Internet, Hybridization (Palo Alto Local FW and Zscaler) , Private Cloud Access Solutions and Virtualization Solutions (uCPE)
* Next Generation: Firewalls Palo Alto, URL Proxification & Categorization, Reverse-Proxy: F5, VPN IPSec SSL, Cisco WSA, ASA, Firepower & Solution Virtualization
* Voice solutions, such as Oracle SIP Federation: SBC, ECB, ToIP, VoIP, softphone, Microsoft Skype Enterprise; Cisco; Alcatel, Fixed operator solutions: SIP Trunk, PSTN, Mobile operator solutions: 3G/4G, private camera, indoor/outdoor coverage.
Experience in Cloud hosting solutions and related tools: AWS; Azure; GCP  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience:**

* MS Project or other Project Management software
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to interact confidently with stakeholders of all levels

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Service Process Coach-South
description:
**Job Description**

**Role Overview**  
  
The After Sales Coach is responsible for driving dealership performance improvement through structured coaching, process assessment, and staff development across the after sales function. The role involves on-the-ground engagement with dealership teams to embed best practices, elevate customer satisfaction, and ensure consistent adherence to service processes and standards.

**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Coaching & Training**  
Coach customer-facing after sales staff (Service Advisors, CRM teams, Delivery personnel) on soft skills, complaint handling, communication, and empathy.  
  
Conduct live on-the-job (OJT) coaching sessions with real-time feedback and corrective guidance.  
  
Deliver structured training programs for non-technical dealership staff including workshops and one-on-one sessions.  
  
Support onboarding and induction of new dealership staff.  
  
**Process Implementation & Audits**  
  
Assess dealership after sales operations against defined SOPs and service standards.  
  
Conduct structured process audits and upload findings to relevant portals/systems.  
  
Perform gap analysis and develop actionable improvement plans aligned to dealership and OEM objectives.  
  
Implement best practice processes within dealerships and monitor compliance.  
  
**Customer Experience**  
  
Map and evaluate key customer journey touchpoints — from vehicle drop-off to post-service follow-up.  
Analyze CSI/NPS scores, VOC data, and customer complaint trends to identify service  
gaps.  
Drive experience enhancement initiatives — waiting lounge improvements,

implementation roles preferred.

an advantage.

Skills & Competencies  

* Strong understanding of after sales workshop operations — service processes, parts

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.

**Qualifications**  
  

* Graduate in any discipline; Diploma/Degree in Automobile Engineering preferred.
* Certifications in training, coaching, or automotive service processes will be an added

* Willingness to travel extensively (pan India or within assigned region).
* Proficiency in English + regional language(s) preferred.
* Familiarity with OEM portals, DMS systems, and digital reporting tools.

  
**Key Performance Indicators**  

* Dealership CSI/NPS score improvement.
* Audit scores and process compliance rates.
* Staff skill improvement post-training.

As the mobility industry undergoes rapid transformation, MSX International stands as a catalyst for innovation, equipping clients with cutting-edge tools and deep industry expertise to navigate evolving market dynamics. MSX International remains the go-to partner for leading automotive OEMs, offering innovative, research-driven strategies to elevate retail operations and accelerate business growth.

title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Advertising Core Infra
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Would you like to build highly available, scalable and distributed engineering systems for one of the largest data lakes in Amazon? Does Petabyte scale excite you?  
  
Spektr is Amazon Ads' exabyte-scale central data lake: the unified catalog for petabytes of campaign, ad-serving, billing, and measurement data. Hundreds of teams and Amazon's advertiser-facing AI agents depend on it for discovery, ingestion, transformation, and querying at scale. If you want large-scale engineering with tangible business impact, this is the team.  
  
We're rebuilding Spektr ground-up with an AI-first architecture, and building fully-automated domain agents that let customers manage their big data lifecycle in a single click. In parallel, we're adopting Apache Iceberg / S3 Tables with serverless compute, scaling horizontally via a data mesh pattern for 5 growth in volume and demand. If you thrive on greenfield experimentation and shipping things that matter to the business, keep reading.  
  
As a Sr SDE on this team, you will own the core platform services that power Amazon Ads data infrastructure, consolidating legacy systems into clean, API-first services that cut job creation time from weeks to less than a day. You will build MCP-enabled AI interfaces that let AI agents create and run data pipelines on Spektr at 99%+ success rate, directly shaping how GenAI discovers and consumes data across Amazon Ads. You will design and operate high-scale Java services on AWS-native infrastructure (Spark, EMR Serverless, Kinesis, Step Functions), processing petabytes of data daily at 99.9% availability. You will also drive deployment automation, replacing manual release cycles with CI/CD pipelines that accelerate delivery velocity for a platform serving Tier-1 advertising data systems.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Engage with key decision makers such as Product & Program Managers to understand customer requirements and brainstorm on solutions
* Design, code and deploy components and micro-services for the core job management pipeline
* Ensure testability, maintanability and low operational footprint for your code
* Participate in operational responsibilities with your team
* Innovate on AWS technology to improve latency, reduce cost and operations

  
A day in the life  

* Focus on core engineering opportunities to guarantee system availability that matches our data growth
* Work with a skilled team of engineers, managers and decision makers to consistently meet customer demand
* Automate monitoring of data availability, quality and usability via simplified metrics and drive innovations to improve guarantees for our customers

  
About the team  
The mission of the Ads Datalake team is to provide data that helps the advertising organization make informed analyses and decisions for our customers and to determine and deploy investments for future growth via a set of central and unified products and services.  
  
Our team focuses on simplicity, usability, speed, compliance, cost efficiency and enabling high-velocity decision making so our customers can generate high quality insights faster.  
  
We are a global team with presence across India and North America.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
**About the role**  

**Job Summary:**

As an Enterprise Architect at Tesco you lead the formulation, development and alignment of new and existing Technology with the Tesco Business Strategy to collectively deliver a simpler, flexible & sustainable architecture. You define, communicate and govern the enterprise architecture for Tesco by creating standards and guidance for Technology programmes and solutions in order to ensure  
it enables and delivers the Tesco Business Strategy.

**You will be responsible for**  

**In this job, I am accountable for:**

Following our Business Code of Conduct and always acting with integrity and due diligence and have these specific risk responsibilities:

* Fostering understanding of the current technology landscape and its impact on stakeholders:
* + Ensure we have models and materials that describe the landscape at a high-level and how it supports the business
  + Help colleagues of all levels to understand the bigger picture and their role / activities within it to aid decision making

**Whats in it for you?**  

At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you.

As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day.

Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.

**Physical Wellbeing** - Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle.

**About Us**  

At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. The company is expanding its presence across India and is looking for an experienced, result-oriented State Head to lead its business and operations in Tamil Nadu.

**Role Overview**

The State Head will be responsible for establishing, expanding, and managing Roofsol Homes' residential rooftop solar business across Tamil Nadu. The role requires an all-round professional with strong sales and business development capabilities, distribution network expansion experience, team leadership skills, and hands-on expertise in solar project execution and operations.

The candidate will be responsible for driving business growth, building a strong local partner ecosystem, managing state-level operations, and ensuring timely and quality execution of residential solar projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Sales & Business Development**

·      Drive residential rooftop solar sales across Tamil Nadu under the PM Surya Ghar scheme.

·      Develop and execute state-level business plans to achieve sales, installation, and revenue targets.

·      Identify new business opportunities, market potential, and growth avenues across the state.

·      Build relationships with customers, channel partners, dealers, distributors, and other relevant stakeholders.

·      Monitor sales pipelines, lead conversion, market performance, and achievement of business targets.

**2. Distribution Network Development**

·      Identify, appoint, and develop channel partners, dealers, and local business associates across key districts.

·      Expand the company's market reach through an effective distribution and partner network.

·      Train, guide, and support channel partners to improve lead generation, customer conversion, and business performance.

·      Ensure regular engagement with partners and address business-related challenges.

**3. Project Execution & Operations**

·      Oversee the end-to-end execution of residential rooftop solar projects, from order confirmation and site survey to installation and commissioning.

·      Coordinate with project teams, installation vendors, procurement, logistics, and other internal departments.

·      Ensure timely material availability, installation quality, adherence to safety standards, and customer satisfaction.

·      Monitor project progress and resolve execution-related issues to minimise delays.

·      Coordinate with relevant DISCOMs and other stakeholders for required approvals, net metering, inspections, and subsidy-related processes, as applicable.

**4. Team Leadership & State Management**

·      Build, lead, and manage the state-level sales and operations team.

·      Set performance targets, review team productivity, and drive accountability for business outcomes.

·      Develop local talent and ensure effective coordination between sales, channel partners, and project execution teams.

·      Establish regular reporting, performance monitoring, and operational review mechanisms.

**5. Business Planning & Performance Monitoring**

·      Prepare state-level business plans, sales forecasts, and expansion strategies.

·      Monitor sales, order bookings, installations, project turnaround time, customer satisfaction, and profitability.

·      Track market developments, competitor activities, and government policies affecting residential solar.

·      Ensure compliance with company processes, applicable scheme guidelines, and operational standards.

·      B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical, Mechanical, or a related engineering discipline.

·      10-12 years of overall professional experience, with substantial experience in the solar energy sector.

The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Agentic People Experience & Automation Hub (APEX) is the regional engine of Salesforce’s Global People Services & Operations, delivering an end-to-end hire-to-retire employee experience. Operating under Salesforce’s "Customer Zero" model, APEX leverages cutting-edge technology and AI agents to automate routine inquiries, empowering our team to focus on high-impact, complex resolution and high-touch support.

As an Agentic People Service Lead, Employee Success Operations - APAC, you sit at the strategic intersection of Tier 2 (T2) operational execution—spanning Benefits, Leave of Absence, Time Tracking, and Employee Relations—and regional project management. Beyond core case management, you will lead critical regional initiatives, incident responses, and compliance communications, collaborating closely with Benefits, Legal, Employee Success Business Partners, Employee Relations, and DET. Based in Hyderabad (hybrid), you will support ANZ, ASEAN and India, with working-hours overlap across APAC time zones and occasional regional travel as needed.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll lead through influence, coaching peers, owning projects and acting as a delegate for the Manager.

The ideal candidate brings an AI-first mindset, exceptional organizational and communication skills, and an eagerness to lead in a fast-paced environment. You are a trusted partner capable of building cross-functional relationships at all levels, managing highly confidential HR matters with complete discretion, and driving continuous operational innovation across the region.

  
  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Drive process standardization and operational readiness for new programs and policy changes.
* Act as the subject-matter reference for process and project questions within the team.
Own delivery of assigned APAC initiatives against agreed milestones, and report progress, risks and outcomes to ES leadership  

* **ES compliance for ASEAN**

* Help maintain documentation, SOPs and controls so they meet local legal and company requirements.
* Run periodic quality and compliance checks, track remediation actions to closure, and work with Legal, Privacy and local HR/ER partners.
Act as a key partner to the Global ES Compliance team, owning ASEAN inputs for audits and attestations through to closure

* Working knowledge of APAC employment practices , HR generalist and business operations, and HR compliance

Job Description

**About Digital Nest**

career-focused education in India.

Through Digital Nest School of Business and Digital Nest School of Creativity, we are

building an industry-integrated learning ecosystem that connects education, startups,

As we prepare for our next phase of expansion, we are looking for an entrepreneurial business leader who can help transform Digital Nest into one of India's leading next-generation education brands.

The Opportunity

Think Like a Founder. Lead Like a CEO. Execute Like an Entrepreneur.

We are looking for a strategic, commercially driven and execution-focused Business Head – Strategy & Operations to work directly with our Founder & CEO. This is not a conventional operations management position. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the company's growth strategy, driving revenue and profitability, developing high-performing teams, launching new business initiatives and building scalable organizational systems.

We are looking for someone who doesn't just manage a business but knows how to build, grow and scale one.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Strategy & Growth**

* Partner directly with the Founder & CEO to develop short-term and long-term business strategies.
* Build annual business plans, revenue projections and growth roadmaps.
* Identify new revenue opportunities, business verticals and market expansion possibilities.
* Lead market research, competitive analysis and business feasibility assessments.
* Translate strategic ideas into measurable business outcomes.
* Develop go-to-market strategies for new programs and initiatives.

**2. Revenue Growth & P&L Ownership**

* Own business revenue targets, operating budgets and profitability.
* Drive admissions performance, revenue optimization and business growth.
* Monitor lead conversion, customer acquisition costs, average order value, collections and contribution margins.
* Establish financial forecasting and performance reporting frameworks.
* Identify opportunities to improve operating margins and business productivity.
* Drive sustainable revenue growth through data-driven decisions.

**3. Cross-Functional Business Leadership**

* Lead admissions, marketing, academics, placements and business operations through functional teams.
* Establish departmental KPIs, accountability frameworks and performance review mechanisms.
* Conduct weekly and monthly business performance reviews.
* Mentor existing employees and develop the next generation of functional leaders.
* Improve collaboration, ownership and execution across departments.
* Resolve business challenges and enable faster decision-making.

**4. Business Operations & Scalability**

* Build scalable operating systems, SOPs and management processes.
* Improve organizational efficiency, productivity and service quality.
* Drive technology adoption, automation and data-driven decision-making.
* Strengthen student experience, operational consistency and business performance.
* Establish dashboards and management reporting systems.
* Develop a scalable operational framework for future expansion.

**5. New Business Initiatives & Strategic Partnerships**

* Identify and evaluate new business opportunities and revenue streams.
* Lead the planning and execution of new educational programs and strategic initiatives.
* Develop pricing models, investment proposals and expansion strategies.
* Build partnerships with startups, enterprises, recruiters and industry stakeholders.
* Collaborate with the CEO on strategic projects and long-term growth opportunities.

**6. People Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Build, mentor and lead high-performing teams.
* Identify leadership gaps and develop strong functional managers.
* Partner with HR on strategic hiring, performance management and leadership development.
* Build a culture of accountability, innovation and continuous improvement.
* Develop a strong second line of management to support business expansion.

### **Requirements**

**Who We're Looking For**

* 8–12+ years of experience in business management, strategy, operations, general management or business growth.
* Demonstrated experience managing revenue, profitability and business performance.
* Strong understanding of P&L management, financial planning and business strategy.
* Proven experience leading cross-functional teams.
* Track record of scaling businesses, improving profitability or building new business verticals.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with strong commercial and analytical capabilities.
* Ability to think strategically while remaining hands-on with execution.
* Excellent communication, decision-making and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership teams is an advantage.
* Experience in EdTech, education, consumer services, professional training or growth-stage startups is preferred.
* MBA from a reputed institution is an advantage, not mandatory.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first 12 months, you should be able to:

* Establish predictable revenue planning and business performance systems.
* Improve profitability, admissions productivity and operational efficiency.
* Build a strong, accountable management structure.
* Develop capable functional leaders and reduce founder dependency.
* Successfully launch and execute strategic growth initiatives.
* Create a scalable operating model for Digital Nest's next phase of expansion.

**Why Join Digital Nest?**

An Opportunity to Build, Lead & Grow

**1. Founder-Level Exposure**

Work directly with the Founder & CEO, participate in strategic decision-making and influence the future direction of the organization.

**2. Attractive Leadership Compensation**

Earn a competitive fixed package of ₹15–20 LPA with performance-linked incentives of up to ₹10 LPA annually.

**3. Employee Stock Ownership (ESOPs)**

Opportunity to participate in the company's long-term value creation through an ESOP grant, subject to eligibility, approvals and scheme terms.

**4. Pathway to COO**

High-performing leaders may have the opportunity to progress into a Chief Operating Officer role as Digital Nest scales.

**5. Real Business Ownership**

Take responsibility for business strategy, revenue growth, profitability, team leadership and operational excellence.

**6. Entrepreneurial Freedom**

Opportunity to build new business verticals, introduce innovative strategies and develop scalable business models.

**7. Health & Wellness Benefits**

Access to company-provided health insurance and employee wellness benefits, in accordance with company policy.

**8. Learning & Leadership Development**

title: Product Manager - AI
description:
**SOVOS**

**Associate Product Manager (AI-First)**
========================================

Product Management·Full-Time·India

**Build Your Future With Us**

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

**THE ROLE**

At Sovos, we're looking for an Associate Product Manager who will support product strategy and execution for a product area whilst taking on Product Owner responsibilities day to day. AI fluency is a core part of this role. You'll own the backlog, write sprint-ready stories, and leverage AI tools daily to research, analyse, draft, and prototype faster and more effectively. This is a global posting for India.

*More specifically, you will:*

* Own and prioritise the product backlog; keep it groomed two sprints ahead and write Jira stories with clear user story, context, acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then), and explicit out-of-scope details.
* Run sprint planning, refinement, and demos with engineering, QA, and design; accept or reject delivered work against acceptance criteria and coordinate UAT and release readiness.
* Support the Senior Product Manager on roadmaps, PRDs, and business cases; analyse usage data, support tickets, and customer feedback to identify problems worth solving.
* Work with customer success and sales to turn customer requests into validated requirements; track delivery, risks, and dependencies and report status clearly and honestly.
* Use AI tools (Claude or similar) daily for research, synthesis, drafting PRDs and stories, and analysing data; build repeatable AI workflows such as story-drafting templates or connected tools to save team time.
* Turn ideas into clickable prototypes or small internal tools using AI-assisted design or coding tools; demonstrate AI product sense by understanding LLM limits and specifying AI features with evaluation criteria and fallback behaviour.

**WHAT YOU BRING TO SOVOS**

* You've built solid experience (typically 2–3 years) in product, business analysis, or product ownership, with prior hands-on experience as both a Product Owner and in a product management role.
* Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and Jira (epics, stories, sprints, boards); you're comfortable managing backlogs and running agile ceremonies.
* Clear, concise written communication skills; you can write acceptance criteria an engineer cannot misread and deliver status updates that are honest and actionable.
* Comfortable with data: you can read a dashboard and use analytics tools to answer product questions; you bring an ownership mindset and follow through without being chased.
* AI fluency is essential: you use AI tools daily, write structured prompts, catch hallucinations and weak reasoning, and understand data-privacy risks; you can show real examples of building AI workflows, rapid prototyping, and responsible AI use with company-approved tools.
* Domain knowledge in tax, compliance, or fintech is a plus, as is experience with UI prototyping tools, design systems, or evaluating and shipping AI-powered features.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

**THE PROCESS**

We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:

**1**

**Pre-Employment Assessment**

Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.

**2**

**Video Interview**

A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.

**3**

**Meeting with a Recruiter**

A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.

**4**

**Live Interviews with the Hiring Team**

Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.

**LIFE AT SOVOS**

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

* Global Mentoring Programs
* AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
* Continuous Learning and Development
* Language Learning Support
* Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* Comprehensive Health Insurance (Day 1, company paid)
* Life and Accidental Insurance (company paid)
* Hybrid Work Arrangement
* Annual Health Check-up

**Equal Opportunity Employer**  
Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

**Company Background**
----------------------

Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries.

More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com.

title: Head - Technology & AI | E-Commerce | AI Agents | Engineering & Automations
description:
**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Ergode builds and scales digital-first businesses across global marketplaces.

We have made a clear strategic choice: **Technology, Artificial Intelligence and automation will sit at the core of how we scale revenue, improve margins and increase productivity.**

We are looking for a **hands-on Technology & AI leader** who can convert business problems into working, adopted systems — quickly.

This is not a traditional IT leadership role.

You will own the intersection of **business, engineering, AI, automation, data, integrations, infrastructure and security**. You will work directly with the CEO and business leaders to identify high-impact problems, decide what should be built internally versus externally, and ensure solutions move from idea production adoption measurable business outcome.

Some of our systems need modernization. Some need stronger ownership and architecture. Others need to be replaced or rebuilt. We would rather be transparent about that upfront.

We need someone who enjoys that challenge.

**What You Will Own**
=====================

**1. Technology Execution & Delivery**
--------------------------------------

You will create an execution culture where technology commitments translate into shipped outcomes.

You will:

* Run Technology on clear weekly priorities with an owner, deadline and measurable outcome for every major initiative.
* Establish strong engineering execution across product development, integrations, automation, infrastructure and AI.
* Track commitments through completion — not merely development activity.
* Identify blockers early and make fast build/buy/outsource decisions.
* Hold internal teams and external partners accountable for scope, timelines, quality and business outcomes.
* Build clear visibility from:

**Business Requirement**  **Development**  **Production**  **Adoption**  **Business Impact**

* Develop engineers and technology managers into stronger owners and future leaders.
* Create sufficient documentation, architecture standards and ownership so no critical system depends on one employee or vendor.

### **Success means:**

Leadership should never need to repeatedly ask, **“Where is this project stuck and who owns it?”**

**2. Business-First Technology Strategy**
=========================================

Technology exists to improve business outcomes.

You will:

* Deeply understand how Ergode makes money across marketplaces, brands and channels.
* Understand marketplace fees, margins, inventory, pricing, advertising, catalogue operations, fulfilment and customer experience.
* Own the Technology & AI roadmap based on impact on:
  + Revenue
  + Gross margin
  + Productivity
  + Operating cost
  + Speed
  + Customer/vendor experience
* Work directly with business heads to identify operational bottlenecks.
* Challenge processes that should be eliminated or simplified before automating them.
* Translate business problems into scalable technology solutions.
* Own technology economics including cloud, AI/token usage, software licences, development and outsourcing.
* Report technology performance to leadership in **business outcomes rather than project activity**.

**3. AI, Agents & Intelligent Automation**
==========================================

AI is not an innovation project at Ergode. It is becoming part of how the company operates.

You will:

* Identify high-volume and high-value manual work suitable for AI or automation.
* Build and deploy AI agents and GenAI workflows into **real production environments**.
* Develop reusable AI architecture rather than disconnected experiments.
* Integrate AI into areas including:
  + Catalogue and content
  + Marketplace listings
  + Pricing
  + Inventory
  + Customer support
  + Sales
  + Finance
  + HR
  + Reporting and decision support
* Build with LLM APIs, RAG, agentic workflows, orchestration frameworks and workflow automation.
* Establish before/after baselines for every major automation.
* Measure:
  + hours/FTE capacity saved
  + cycle-time reduction
  + cost reduction
  + quality improvement
  + revenue/margin impact
  + user adoption
* Kill pilots that do not produce value and scale the ones that do.
* Ensure business teams actually adopt what Technology builds.

### **We are not looking for:**

Someone who has attended AI courses or built demos.

### **We are looking for:**

Someone who has **put AI into production and can show what changed because of it.**

**4. E-commerce Platforms & Marketplace Technology**
====================================================

Our technology must support a complex global marketplace operation.

You will own and strengthen:

* Marketplace integrations including Amazon SP-API, Walmart, eBay and other channels.
* Catalogue and listing infrastructure.
* Pricing and quantity synchronization.
* Order processing.
* Inventory and warehouse integrations.
* Returns, refunds and reconciliation workflows.
* Marketplace reporting and operational intelligence.
* API reliability and monitoring.

You will build toward a connected architecture where catalogue, inventory, order and marketplace information flows reliably across systems.

The goal is not simply integration.

The goal is **reliable commerce at scale**.

**5. Product & Platform Ownership**
===================================

You will take ownership of Ergode’s core internal technology platforms and ensure they become dependable business systems.

This includes:

* evaluating existing architecture,
* identifying technical debt,
* establishing clear module ownership,
* improving reliability and usability,
* prioritising development based on business value,
* and driving adoption after launch.

Technology is not complete when code is deployed.

**A feature is complete when the business can reliably use it and the expected outcome is visible.**

**6. Data Foundation & Decision Intelligence**
==============================================

AI is only as strong as the underlying data.

You will:

* Build reliable data flows across business systems.
* Establish clear sources of truth for critical business information.
* Reduce duplicate datasets and manual reconciliation.
* Improve data quality and ownership.
* Enable dashboards and AI systems to consume trustworthy business data.
* Build APIs and integration layers that allow new agents and applications to be deployed quickly.

**7. Architecture, Cloud & Engineering Quality**
================================================

You should be technically strong enough to challenge architecture and engineering decisions yourself.

You will:

* Review architecture for scalability, reliability, maintainability, security and cost.
* Establish coding, testing, documentation and deployment standards.
* Strengthen CI/CD and monitoring.
* Review estimates rather than blindly accepting them.
* Prototype when speed requires it.
* Make pragmatic technology choices rather than over-engineering.

We expect a leader who can move comfortably between a **CEO conversation about ROI and an engineering conversation about architecture.**

**8. Security, Reliability & AI Governance**
============================================

You will own the reliability and security of Ergode’s technology environment.

Responsibilities include:

* Cloud and infrastructure reliability
* Monitoring and uptime
* Incident management
* Root-cause analysis
* Backups and disaster recovery
* Identity and access management
* SSO
* Endpoint/device security
* Data protection

You will also establish practical AI governance covering:

* which company information can be shared with which AI systems,
* permissions available to AI agents,
* human review requirements for critical decisions,
* auditability,
* and acceptable AI use.

Compliance should appropriately address DPDP and relevant international privacy/security requirements.

**9. Build vs Buy vs Outsource**
================================

We do not believe everything must be built internally.

We do believe **Ergode must own the outcome.**

You will decide when to:

**BUILD** — when capability creates strategic advantage.

**BUY** — when a reliable product already solves the problem economically.

**OUTSOURCE** — when an external specialist can deliver faster.

For outsourced work, you will own:

* requirements,
* architecture,
* vendor selection,
* commercial evaluation,
* milestones,
* SLAs,
* quality,
* security,
* source code,
* documentation,
* handover.

No critical Ergode technology should become permanently dependent on one vendor or individual.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within the first 6–12 months, we expect visible movement across these areas:

### **Execution**

* Major technology initiatives have clear owners, deadlines and outcomes.
* Delivery predictability improves materially.
* Chronic technology bottlenecks reduce.

### **AI & Automation**

* Multiple AI agents/workflows are operating in production.
* Automation impact is quantified monthly.
* Manual workload is measurably reduced in targeted processes.
* Business adoption is visible rather than assumed.

### **Core Platforms**

* Critical marketplace and internal systems become more reliable.
* Technical ownership and documentation improve.
* Important business workflows no longer depend on fragile manual processes.

### **Data**

* Critical catalogue, inventory, order and operational data become more connected and trustworthy.

### **Business Partnership**

* Business leaders increasingly bring problems to Technology because they expect **working solutions, not project discussions**.

**Who We Are Looking For**
==========================

**Must-Haves**
--------------

* 10+ years of meaningful technology experience.
* 5+ years leading engineering/technology teams.
* Evidence of personally owning major technology delivery.
* Strong understanding of software engineering, architecture, APIs and integrations.
* AI/automation systems deployed into production with measurable impact.
* Practical experience with:
  + LLM APIs
  + RAG
  + AI agents / agentic workflows
  + Python
  + workflow automation platforms such as n8n/Make or equivalent
* Cloud experience across AWS, Azure or GCP.
* API/integration architecture experience.
* DevOps, deployment and monitoring understanding.
* Ability to evaluate architecture, code/design decisions and engineering estimates.
* Experience managing external technology partners.
* Experience owning meaningful technology budgets.
* Strong business and commercial orientation.

**Strongly Preferred**
----------------------

Experience in one or more of:

* E-commerce
* Marketplaces
* Retail technology
* D2C
* SaaS/platform businesses
* ERP/OMS/WMS
* Amazon SP-API or other marketplace integrations
* High-volume order/catalogue/inventory systems
* AI-first enterprise transformation

**Who Will NOT Fit This Role**
==============================

This role is probably not for you if:

* Your experience is predominantly IT infrastructure/helpdesk.
* Your leadership style is primarily delegation without technical depth.
* Your AI experience consists mainly of courses, certifications or prototypes.
* You measure success by projects delivered rather than business outcomes achieved.
* You require large teams before you can execute.
* You prefer lengthy planning cycles over shipping, learning and improving.
* You cannot challenge engineers, vendors and business leaders when necessary.

**The Person Behind the Resume**
================================

We care about experience, but we care equally about how you operate.

We value people who demonstrate:

**Ownership. Bias for action. Curiosity. Commercial thinking. High standards. Candour. Learning velocity.**

We would rather hire a builder who has repeatedly solved difficult problems than someone with the perfect title.

title: Service Process Coach-West
description:
**Job Description**

Role Overview  
  
The After Sales Coach is responsible for driving dealership performance improvement through structured coaching, process assessment, and staff development across the after sales function. The role involves on-the-ground engagement with dealership teams to embed best practices, elevate customer satisfaction, and ensure consistent adherence to service processes and standards.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Coaching & Training**  
Coach customer-facing after sales staff (Service Advisors, CRM teams, Delivery personnel) on soft skills, complaint handling, communication, and empathy.  
  
Conduct live on-the-job (OJT) coaching sessions with real-time feedback and corrective guidance.  
  
Deliver structured training programs for non-technical dealership staff including workshops and one-on-one sessions.  
  
Support onboarding and induction of new dealership staff.  
  
**Process Implementation & Audits**  
  
Assess dealership after sales operations against defined SOPs and service standards.  
  
Conduct structured process audits and upload findings to relevant portals/systems.  
  
Perform gap analysis and develop actionable improvement plans aligned to dealership and OEM objectives.  
  
Implement best practice processes within dealerships and monitor compliance.  
  
**Customer Experience**  
  
Map and evaluate key customer journey touchpoints — from vehicle drop-off to post-service follow-up.  
Analyze CSI/NPS scores, VOC data, and customer complaint trends to identify service  
gaps.  
Drive experience enhancement initiatives — waiting lounge improvements,  
personalised service, customer engagement events.  
  
**Performance Management & Reporting**  
  
Monitor, evaluate, and report on dealership progress against KPIs (labour productivity,  
bay utilisation, service absorption, retention, repeat repairs, etc.).  
Prepare and submit detailed performance reports to regional managers and OEM  
stakeholders.  
Identify additional business opportunities within the dealership network.  
  
**Experience**  
  

* 10-15 years of experience in the automotive after sales domain.
* Min 5 years of prior experience in dealership coaching, consulting, or process

implementation roles preferred.  

* Background in workshop management, service head, or customer relations roles will be

an advantage.  

* Exposure to multi-brand dealership environments is desirable.

Skills & Competencies  

* Strong understanding of after sales workshop operations — service processes, parts

management, warranty, DMS/CRM tools.  

* Proven ability to coach and influence without authority.
* Analytical mindset with ability to interpret CSI/NPS data and workshop KPIs.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple dealership assignments simultaneously across geographies.
* Proficiency in audit and assessment methodologies.

  
**Qualifications**  
  

* Graduate in any discipline; Diploma/Degree in Automobile Engineering preferred.
* Certifications in training, coaching, or automotive service processes will be an added

advantage.  
  
**Other Requirements**  

* Willingness to travel extensively (pan India or within assigned region).
* Proficiency in English + regional language(s) preferred.
* Familiarity with OEM portals, DMS systems, and digital reporting tools.

  
**Key Performance Indicators**  

* Dealership CSI/NPS score improvement.
* Audit scores and process compliance rates.
* Staff skill improvement post-training.
* Number of dealerships coached/assessed per cycle.
* Repeat repair and complaint reduction rates.

 **Additional Information**

MSX International has been a trusted partner to leading automotive OEMs and mobility companies worldwide, providing strategic support to transform retail operations. With a strong foundation built on Dealer Performance Improvement, Repair Optimization, and Consumer Engagement, we empower businesses by integrating people, processes, and technology to drive measurable success. As the mobility industry undergoes rapid transformation, MSX International stands as a catalyst for innovation, equipping clients with cutting-edge tools and deep industry expertise to navigate evolving market dynamics. MSX International remains the go-to partner for leading automotive OEMs, offering innovative, research-driven strategies to elevate retail operations and accelerate business growth.

description:
**About Toll Group**
At Toll, we do more than just logistics - we move the businesses that move the world. Our 16,000 team members can help solve any logistics, transport, or supply chain challenge – big or small. We have been supporting our customers for more than 130 years. Today, we support more than 20,000 customers worldwide with 500 sites in 27 markets, and a forwarding network spanning 150 countries. We are proudly part of Japan Post — www.tollgroup.com
  
  

* Lead, direct and manage a logistics and Embellishment operation to ensure that the staff executes on delivering consistent high-quality level service and customer satisfaction; and achieves a profitable, cost efficient operations in compliance with company policies and procedures, ISO standards, GDP compliance and other regulatory guidelines.
* Maximize profitability through superior customer service, effective and prompt communications, and follow-up on all pending customer matters.

* Ensure SLA are met and actions to be taken to ensure all KPIs are met as agreed
* Safely and Quality Assurance - Ensure safe working practices and environment within the shift.
* Participate in Toll/Customer quality compliance and initiatives e.g. ISO accreditation/GxP Standards.
* Utilize effective communication or negotiation skills, employing diplomacy and sensitivity to resolve critical or escalated issues affecting the customer, staff, or senior management.
* Maintain performance statistics and ensure accurate record keeping of all operational documents.

* Utilize superior communications skills to motivate staff and develop effective working relationships with peers, executives, and clients.
* Train and certify new employees on all performance standards.

**What moves you?**
At Toll, you can help play a vital role in delivering what matters. From food, fuel, medicine and rescue services, we keep businesses and communities thriving. Every day brings change. We see that as an opportunity. To be curious. To ask the right questions. And build meaningful connections. Because finding new ways to solve problems is what we do. With a bold vision to expand our global reach, our 16,000+ people bring a passion for progress. We collaborate in friendly, caring teams, supported by approachable leaders who give us the autonomy to quickly make decisions with impact. Learn and grow with industry-leading training, alongside talented experts. Feel empowered to take on diverse challenges and new responsibilities to move you, our customers, and our world further.

title: Delivery Manager (Technical)
description:

* Experience managing multiple clients simultaneously (shared PM model)
* Strong working knowledge of Agile, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models
* Proven ability to work with COEs (e.g., Modern Engineering, Integration, Cloud, ERP)
* Excellent client-facing communication and risk management skills, including experience working with US clients
* Familiarity with tools like Jira, Confluence, DevOps pipelines, and health dashboards
* Willingness and ability to work late-night hours (up to ~1:00–2:00 AM IST) for PST client coverage

* A dedicated home workspace with reliable internet and power backup for remote work

**Preferred**

* Experience with staff augmentation ? value-add delivery transformation
* Background in one or more COE domains (e.g., legacy modernization, low-code, AI, Mulesoft, Kafka, AWS/Azure, data engineering)
* Hands-on exposure to test automation, security and compliance practices, and AI-assisted development
* PMP, CSM, SAFe, or relevant cloud/DevOps certification
* Prior experience in a peer delivery model with global teams

title: Business Technology Solutions Manager- Salesforce Delivery
description:
**ZS**
is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by
**bringing together data, science, technology**
and
**human ingenuity**
to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a
**client-first mentality**
to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.
  
  
We are seeking a seasoned Salesforce professional with a deep understanding of the Salesforce ecosystem, particularly in the field of Salesforce Health Cloud. This individual will play a crucial role in expanding our Salesforce practice, driving digital transformation across various industries, with a special focus on healthcare. Our firm looks to leverage your innovative thinking and leadership to develop cutting-edge business solutions that leverage AI and Analytics to deliver maximum value to our clients.
  
  
The candidate will be part of our Salesforce Expertise practice. As a Salesforce expert, the candidate will draw on their skills and experience to lead defining salesforce related business solutions/sales plays; work with team(s) to develop ZS capabilities (including: selling collateral and assets/accelerators/demos); and take the offerings to ZS’ client to convert to real opportunities, supporting the entire lifecycle of engagements. To do so, you will need to deeply understand customer requirements, understand the salesforce.com ecosystem and work closely with functional specialists to develop innovative, cutting-edge business solutions leveraging AI/Analytics to maximize the value to our clients. You will work closely with functional specialists to develop creative business solutions, solving some of the most exciting problems for our clients.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* End-to-End Delivery Management:

+ Deliver exceptional client service, ensuring projects stay within expected timeframes and budgets.
+ Review application and technical design documents, ensuring they follow Salesforce best practices and integrate effectively into the client's infrastructure.
+ Team and Capability Development:
+ Develop team skills and collaborate to create accelerators and assets that enhance our service offerings to clients.

* Offerings and Business Development:

+ Collaborate with ZS and industry experts to define integrated programs and offerings, taking them to market with the client service teams.
+ Lead large-scale business development and delivery engagements, especially in the Healthcare sector.

* Mentoring and Coaching:

+ Provide on-the-job feedback and coaching to team members and actively participate in the counseling and mentoring of junior consultants within the organization.

* Solution Architecture and Design:

+ Collaborate with healthcare organizations to understand their business needs and design customized Salesforce Health Cloud solutions.
+ Lead the architecture and design of scalable, secure, and high-performance Salesforce Health Cloud implementations.

* Technical Guidance and Quality Assurance:

+ Develop and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, data models, and integration patterns.
+ Conduct code reviews and ensure best practices are followed for Salesforce Health Cloud implementations.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree with major in Computers or Electronics.
* 10+ years’ of overall professional experience; with at least 5 years in a leadership role within a professional services firm.
* Proven experience as a Salesforce Health Cloud Architect, designing and implementing solutions for healthcare organizations.
* Strong understanding of the Salesforce platform, including platform configuration, Visual Force, Lightning, Workflows, Apex, and AppExchange.
* In-depth knowledge of healthcare data models and HIPAA regulations.
* Proficiency in shaping, providing consulting, building & implementing solutions using Salesforce cloud offerings.
* Good understanding of DevOps as they apply to Salesforce, including various methodologies and tools such as Salesforce DX.
* Active Salesforce Certifications Architect is strongly preferred.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to travel to meet client needs.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Salesforce certifications, such as Salesforce Certified Application Architect or Salesforce Certified System Architect.
* Proficiency in using MuleSoft and familiarity with other Salesforce cloud offerings like Sales, Service, Community, and Marketing Cloud.
* Working experience with Salesforce.com organization to leverage the ecosystem.
* The successful candidate will demonstrate a high level of motivation, excellent problem-solving skills, a strong work ethic, and executive-level presence and communication.

**How you’ll grow:**

* Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

**Perks & Benefits:**
At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations | Where we work | ZS.
  
  
**Hybrid working model:**
We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.
  
  
**Travel:**
Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.
  
  
**Considering applying?**
At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.
  
  
If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

title: Senior macOS Migration Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

**The Role**
