In this role, you'll be at the forefront of driving change and enabling our customers to harness the power of technology to achieve their wildest ambitions. From revolutionizing healthcare to shaping the future of finance, you'll collaborate with a diverse range of industries, tailoring cutting-edge solutions to meet each customer's unique needs.
  
  
As a trusted advisor, you'll forge strong relationships with our customers, gaining deep insights into their business objectives and long-term aspirations. Armed with this understanding, you'll provide expert guidance on how technology can be leveraged to propel them towards unprecedented success. From aligning processes to technology to developing and deploying bespoke solutions, you'll be the visionary architect behind their digital transformation journey. Your expertise in application development and deployment best practices will ensure seamless integration and optimized performance.
  
  
**What you will do**

* Lead the technical delivery of device migration waves during your shift, ensuring operational control, adherence to runbooks and predictable throughput.
* Own shift‑level triage for device migration failures (Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) registration, enrolment, compliance, conditional access, certificate/device identity issues) and coordinate rapid remediation.
* Validate pre‑req readiness (device inventory, hardware hash readiness, targeting, Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) profile assignment, migration scheduling) and enforce “go/no‑go” criteria.
* Oversee execution of tenant transition steps for Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) where applicable (collection of hashes, deregistration/deletion sequencing, re‑registration timing, end‑user reset/re‑provision coordination).
* Manage the shift backlog in the agreed ticketing system; priortize work items by risk, SLA and cutover schedule.
* Drive strong evidence capture: logs, screenshots, reports, change records and acceptance artefacts aligned to audit and client governance needs.
* Coordinate shift handover packs (work completed, exceptions, blockers, next actions, risk list) and ensure continuity across the three‑shift model.
* Partner with the Devices Solution Architect / discipline lead to update runbooks, troubleshooting guides and standard operating procedures based on real shift learnings.
* Engage vendor/tool support channels as required (e.g., Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) / Kandji/IRU / Jamf escalation paths, migration tooling vendors where used), ensuring timely escalations with complete evidence.
* Lead post‑migration validation checks and hypercare support for device cohorts; reduce repeat incidents through root cause removal and runbook improvements.

In this fast-paced environment, you'll have the exhilarating responsibility of helping customers choose between multiple applications, including packaged solutions. Your sharp insights and discerning judgement will empower them to make informed decisions that drive their organizations towards unprecedented heights.
  
  
Our consultants are restless for innovation. They are at the edge of technology, changing the way our customers implement business solutions – so, if you’re a problem-solver, an innovative thinker, and a self-starter with a passion high impact assignments which align technology to business outcomes, then we want to hear from you! Apply today to join our dynamic team that has a host of exciting projects and customers waiting for you to work with them to solve complex transformation puzzles through technology.
  
  
**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
As an Application Consultant at Kyndryl you will join the Kyndryl Consultant Profession, working with other Kyndryl Consultants, Architects, Project Managers, and cross-functional Technical Subject Matter Experts – presenting unlimited opportunities with unmatched support through our investment in your learning, training, and career growth.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* Minimum 7 years exp.
* M365 tenant-to-tenant device migration experience, specifically macOS.
* Strong hands-on experience with Jamf/Kandji, macOS provisioning, ADE, PSSO, compliance policies, and configuration profiles.
* Strong PowerShell and macOS scripting/automation skills.
* Experience troubleshooting device enrollment and migration issues.
* Experience with runbook-based 24x7 migration/factory operations, shift handovers, and documentation.
Strong stakeholder communication, troubleshooting, and ownership skills.  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Experience with profile/workstation migration tools such as Jamf, Kandji/IRU, or equivalent.
* Knowledge of Conditional Access and Microsoft device security controls.
* Microsoft certifications such as MD-102, MS-102, or SC-300.
* Experience with global/remote user migrations.
Understanding of ITIL incident, problem, and change management.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Professional audio systems, amplifiers, mixers, DSPs, microphones, and speakers.

title: Corporate Relations Manager
description:
Role at a glance

**A full-time, outcome-driven role combining office work in Delhi with field outreach to companies and campuses across Delhi NCR.**

About DIYguru

DIYguru Mobility Pvt. Ltd. is India's largest ASDC-certified EV skilling organisation. Since 2016, we have trained 95,000+ learners through 49 accredited programs, working with 528+ corporate partners across 8 countries.

We work with IIT Delhi, IIT Jammu, ASDC, AICTE, Bosch, Hyundai and Tata Technologies, and connect trained talent to employers through emobility.careers and the Bharat eMobility Recruitathon. The Recruitathon's Delhi Edition brought together 12 companies and 323 pre-screened candidates, with 200+ shortlisted.

About the role

DIYguru is looking for a Corporate Relations Lead to build and manage strong relationships with corporate recruiters, HR professionals, hiring managers, colleges, universities, ITIs, diploma institutes and industry stakeholders.

The role combines office-based and field-level outreach: visits to corporate offices, college campuses, universities, ITIs, industry events and networking platforms to develop new partnerships and generate measurable opportunities.

Your core objective is to turn relationships into outcomes — hiring requirements, placements, internships, OJT opportunities, corporate training, Recruitathon participation, industry partnerships, MoUs and repeat hiring.

Key responsibilitiesCorporate relationships & hiring

* Build and maintain relationships with HR Heads, Talent Acquisition teams, Hiring Managers and industry stakeholders.
* Conduct corporate outreach through LinkedIn, email, calls, referrals, networking and physical visits to company offices.
* Generate corporate leads and convert them into active hiring requirements, placements, internships and OJT opportunities.
* Acquire hiring requirements and coordinate with the placement team on candidate mapping, shortlisting, interviews and hiring drives.
* Ensure hiring partners confirm role, compensation and terms in writing before drives, in line with DIYguru's Hiring Partner Guidelines.
* Develop long-term relationships with companies and identify opportunities for repeat hiring and strategic partnerships.

Campus & institute relations

* Visit colleges, universities, ITIs and diploma institutes to develop placement, hiring, internship and industry collaboration opportunities.
* Build and maintain relationships with college TPOs, placement officers, HODs, deans and training & placement teams.
* Identify opportunities for corporate training, industry projects, OJT, internships, placement drives and other industry–academia collaborations.

Representation & partnerships

* Represent DIYguru in corporate meetings, campus meetings, industry events, HR forums, job fairs, networking events and Recruitathons.
* Support corporate communication, employer branding, hiring partner engagement, partnership announcements and MoU coordination.

Reporting & tracking

* Maintain accurate CRM records, MIS, corporate and institute databases, lead pipelines, follow-up trackers and hiring reports.
* Track outreach activity and ensure measurable outcomes from every corporate visit, campus visit, meeting and networking activity.

Key skills

* Relationship & communication: Strong corporate and professional communication; corporate relationship management; strong networking and relationship-building skills; ability to run meetings and presentations.
* Business development: Field sales / business development mindset; lead generation and conversion; negotiation and follow-up; LinkedIn networking and outreach; college and industry outreach.
* Placement know-how: Recruitment and placement coordination; understanding of JDs and hiring requirements.
* Tools & reporting: Excel / Google Sheets, CRM and MIS management.
* Working style: Willingness to travel locally for corporate and campus visits; comfortable working with targets, field activities and measurable outcomes.

Who can apply
  
Qualifications & experience

* Graduate in any discipline; an MBA or PGDM in HR, Marketing or Business Development is preferred.
* 2–5 years of experience in corporate relations, B2B sales, business development, campus relations, placements or recruitment.
* Experience working with HR teams, recruiters or college placement cells is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with the EV, automotive, engineering or skilling sector is an advantage.

The ideal candidate

We prefer candidates who are comfortable with field outreach, travelling for meetings, and actively developing relationships with companies and educational institutions.

The ideal candidate can confidently meet HR teams, recruiters, TPOs, college management and industry professionals, understand their requirements, and convert those relationships into actual hiring and partnership opportunities.

What we offer

* Visible impact: Every partnership you build turns into jobs, internships and careers for EV learners.
* A strong network to start from: Work with DIYguru's base of 528+ corporate partners and established academic relationships.
* Flagship events: Play a lead role in employer engagement for the Bharat eMobility Recruitathon as it expands to new cities.
* Ownership: Build and own corporate relationships in one of India's fastest-growing sectors.
* Growth: A performance-based annual appraisal cycle and room to grow as DIYguru expands nationally and internationally.

Skyline Digital Growth is a global performance marketing network focused on helping brands scale with measurable ROI and sustainable growth. The company connects advertisers with high-quality affiliates, publishers, and media buyers across multiple verticals and operates in the US, UK, UAE, Brazil, Europe, and fast-growing markets in Asia. Skyline Digital Growth offers affiliate program management, paid media buying, influencer and content marketing, retargeting, and funnel optimization. With a data-driven approach, transparent reporting, and access to premium partners, the company delivers ROI-focused strategies tailored to each brand. Skyline Digital Growth is a proud member of the Performance Marketing Association and builds long-term, performance-driven partnerships.
  
**Role Description**
The Affiliate Manager (Delivery) - International CPS is a full-time, on-site role based in Gurugram. This role is responsible for managing day-to-day relationships with international affiliate partners, ensuring delivery against Cost Per Sale (CPS) targets, and optimizing campaign performance across multiple markets. The Affiliate Manager will onboard new affiliates, negotiate commercial terms, monitor traffic quality, and work closely with internal teams to align offers, creatives, and tracking. The role includes analyzing performance data, preparing regular reports, troubleshooting tracking or delivery issues, and coordinating with sales and online marketing teams to support client objectives. The Affiliate Manager will also contribute to growth strategies, identify new opportunities within existing and new markets, and ensure a high standard of communication and service for partners and advertisers.
  
**Qualifications**

* Proficiency in affiliate and account management, with experience overseeing CPS or performance-based campaigns and managing partner relationships.
* Strong communication skills, including clear verbal and written communication and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Experience in sales and negotiation, with the ability to secure favorable terms, grow partner revenue, and meet performance targets.
* Knowledge of online marketing, including performance marketing concepts, tracking tools, optimization strategies, and digital campaign metrics.
* Ability to analyze data, interpret performance reports, and make informed recommendations for optimization and scaling.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfort working in an international environment, with an understanding of cultural differences and global market dynamics.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in performance marketing or affiliate management.

title: Infra & Cloud Service Delivery Director
description:
**Req ID:**
393558
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Infra & Cloud Service Delivery Director to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
Cloud, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity & Managed Services Operations | Experience: 14+ Years
  
  
At NTT DATA, we know that consistent service delivery builds lasting client trust. We invest in operational leaders who combine disciplined execution, technical understanding and strong people leadership to deliver reliable outcomes every day.
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
The Client Delivery Manager (CDM) is accountable for day-to-day service delivery, operational governance, SLA/KPI performance, cost efficiency, resource management and continual service improvement across assigned Cloud, Infrastructure and Cybersecurity engagements.
  
  
Reporting into the Client Delivery Executive (CDE), the CDM converts contractual and client commitments into disciplined daily, weekly and monthly execution. The CDM works with the Client Architect to operationalize transformation roadmaps, automation and AIOps improvements without compromising service stability.
  
  
Lead complex enterprise operations where service reliability, operational discipline and continuous improvement directly shape client confidence. The role operates in a clear three-in-a-box model: the CDE owns the business and client outcomes, the CDM runs service operations, and the Client Architect shapes technology strategy and transformation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Service Operations & Delivery Control
  
  

* Own daily operations across relevant service towers and ensure delivery meets SLAs, KPIs, SLOs, contractual commitments and operating procedures.
* Run daily, weekly and monthly operating rhythms, including service reviews, delivery dashboards, action tracking and closure governance.
* Maintain operational stability, service quality and business continuity across global, multi-vendor and multi-tower environments.

Incident, Problem, Change & Risk Management
  
  

* Lead operational response for major incidents, outages, missed SLAs and service escalations; ensure timely communication, restoration and follow-through.
* Drive root-cause analysis, problem management, corrective actions and service improvement plans to prevent recurrence.
* Govern change execution, operational risks, audit actions, security/compliance obligations and continuity or disaster-recovery readiness.

Resource, Vendor & Asset Management
  
  

* Manage workforce demand, staffing, shifts, skills, utilization, onboarding/offboarding, knowledge transfer and succession coverage.
* Coordinate tower leads, operations managers, partners and vendors; establish clear ownership and consequence-based closure of commitments.
* Oversee operational hardware/software assets, licenses and vendor dependencies within the service scope.

Cost Efficiency & Financial Operations
  
  

* Control delivery costs in line with the account operating plan and provide accurate operational inputs for revenue, cost, margin and forecast reviews.
* Drive productivity, pyramid optimization, capacity alignment, leakage prevention and efficient ramp-up/ramp-down of resources.
* Track operational benefits from automation, continuous improvement and cost-efficiency initiatives; escalate forecast or cost gaps with corrective actions.

Client Operations & Governance
  
  

* Serve as the primary contact for client operations leadership and lead service reviews, operational governance and action closure.
* Maintain clear and timely communication on performance, risks, incidents, recovery plans and improvement priorities.
* Support the CDE with MBR, QBR inputs, client escalations, renewals and delivery-led opportunities while keeping ownership centered on operational execution.

Automation, AIOps & Continual Improvement

title: City Head – Kolkata
description:

The City Head – Kolkata will be responsible for the overall business performance of ClearrCUT across Kolkata. This is a leadership and ownership role covering revenue growth, operations, customer experience, professional/service partner management, team performance, expansion, and profitability.

- Conduct regular performance reviews and daily/weekly business reviews.
  
- Identify underperformance and implement improvement plans where required.
  
- Build a performance-driven and accountable work culture.

- Ensure adequate availability of verified and high-quality service professionals.
  
- Monitor professional performance, attendance, customer ratings and service quality.
  
- Support onboarding and activation of new professionals based on demand.
  
- Maintain healthy professional relationships while enforcing ClearrCUT service standards.
  
  
5. Customer Experience
  
  
- Ensure excellent customer experience from booking to service completion.
  
- Monitor complaints, refunds, cancellations and repeat service issues.
  
- Ensure critical customer complaints are resolved quickly.
  
- Improve customer retention, ratings and repeat booking percentage.
  
  
6. Expansion & Market Development
  
  
- Identify high-potential areas and service categories for expansion across Kolkata.
  
- Build hyperlocal growth plans based on customer demand and professional availability.
  
- Support new category launches and geographical expansion.
  
- Monitor competitor activity and recommend appropriate market actions.
  
  
7. P&L & Cost Control
  
  
- Take ownership of Kolkata city-level profitability.
  
- Monitor revenue, discounts, incentives, refunds and operational expenses.
  
- Improve productivity and control unnecessary operational costs.
  
- Work towards sustainable contribution margin and city profitability.
  
  
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
- Monthly Revenue & Collection Achievement
  
- Booking Growth
  
- Service Completion Rate
  
- Cancellation Rate
  
- Customer Rating & Complaint Resolution
  
- Repeat Customer Rate
  
- Active Professional Count
  
- Professional Utilisation
  
- Team Productivity
  
- Customer Acquisition & Retention
  
- City Contribution Margin / Profitability
  
- Expansion Performance

- Ability to solve operational problems independently and make fast decisions.
  
- Strong understanding of the Kolkata market.
  
- Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership.

We are looking for a City Leader, not simply an Operations Manager.
  
  
The successful candidate should be capable of taking ownership of the Kolkata business, building a high-performance team, increasing revenue, maintaining excellent customer experience and developing ClearrCUT into a strong and profitable city-level business.

Own the City. Own the Number. Own the Customer Experience.

growing organization is strongly preferred.

**Urgency with judgment:**

and meetings.

Uses automation, AI, better workflows, and team capability to improve outcomes with existing resources.

Challenges delays and weak execution respectfully; brings teams together around customer

title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Moveworks
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Moveworks)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Strong understanding of the Move works platform, including enterprise search, conversational AI, natural language understanding (NLU), employee support automation, and AI-driven workflow orchestration.
* Knowledge of Move works integration capabilities with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Slack, HR systems, identity platforms, and enterprise applications
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of ServiceNow applications (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD).

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior IT Operations Lead – India
description:
****Who we are****

Born in 2014, Yoti is a digital identity and biometric technology company that makes it safer for people to prove who they are. The Yoti app was designed with privacy at its core, giving people a secure way to prove their identity and share third-party credentials with organisations and other people.

Today, we have over seventeen million app downloads around the world. We’ve expanded our offering to a suite of business solutions that span identity verification, age verification and estimation, e-signing, AI anti-spoofing technologies and we continue to think of innovative new offerings.

From day one, we’ve been working to fix an outdated identity system. This is not a journey we make on our own but with policy advisors, think tanks, researchers, academics, humanitarian bodies, our users and everyday people. We are committed to solving identity problems through grassroots research and social purpose initiatives.

****Purpose of the Role****

:

The Senior IT Operations Lead is a hands-on player-coach role, responsible for providing high-quality IT support and technical delivery while helping to lead and coordinate day-to-day IT operations for the local team in India.

This is not primarily a people-management position. Approximately 70–80% of the role will remain hands-on, covering day-to-day IT operations, technical troubleshooting, project work, security improvements, automation and other IT initiatives.

The role is suited to someone who can work autonomously, take ownership of issues and projects, communicate clearly, and ensure incidents, risks and operational concerns are properly investigated, documented, escalated and resolved.

A key part of the role is understanding not only what our IT policies, controls and processes require, but why they exist and the risks they are designed to address. This includes areas such as device security, hardware disposal, asset management, identity and access management, onboarding, offboarding and compliance-related activities.

The successful candidate will be expected to support users and maintain day-to-day IT services, while also having the technical capability and judgement to investigate more complex problems, improve existing systems and processes, and contribute to wider IT, security and automation projects.

****Role Overview:****

The Senior IT Operations Lead will act as a senior point of contact for local IT activities, working closely with the IT Manager, wider IT team, Infrastructure, Security and other internal departments.

The role requires strong technical troubleshooting skills, excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

This person will also provide additional technical capability for wider IT initiatives. They may be asked to investigate an existing system or process, assess whether it can be improved, automate a manual activity, review a technical or security configuration, or take ownership of a defined part of a larger project.

The expectation is not that the individual will already know the answer to every technical problem. They should, however, be capable of taking an objective, researching and investigating it independently, understanding the current configuration and requirements, evaluating possible solutions, and presenting a considered recommendation or implementation plan.

When incidents occur, the Senior IT Operations Lead will be expected to gather accurate information, perform appropriate troubleshooting, document what has been checked, identify impact, escalate appropriately and provide clear updates to the relevant teams.

The role will also help provide operational resilience for the India IT function, ensuring knowledge, capability and responsibility are not concentrated with a single local resource.

****Key Responsibilities****

****IT Support and Service Delivery****

* Provide high-quality 1st, 2nd and, where appropriate, 3rd line support to users.
* Support users across macOS, Windows, Linux, mobile devices, collaboration tools and office systems.
* Manage and resolve tickets through the IT ticketing system, ensuring clear updates, ownership and timely resolution.
* Support onboarding and offboarding processes, including account setup, device preparation, access changes and equipment return.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, video conferencing, meeting room and general office IT issues.
* Support MDM-managed and non-MDM-managed devices.
* Act as a senior escalation point for more complex technical and operational issues.
* Take ownership of issues through to resolution rather than relying on detailed step-by-step direction.
* Work collaboratively with the wider IT, Infrastructure and Security teams where issues cross technical or regional boundaries.

****Technical Projects, Automation and Continuous Improvement****

* Work with the IT Manager on technical projects and wider IT initiatives alongside day-to-day operational responsibilities.
* Take ownership of defined project activities from investigation and planning through to implementation and documentation.
* Review existing systems, configurations and processes and identify opportunities to improve security, reliability, efficiency or manageability.
* Investigate technical requirements independently and provide evidence-based recommendations.
* Identify repetitive or manual IT processes that could be improved or automated.
* Build, maintain or improve scripts and lightweight automation using appropriate technologies and APIs.
* Test changes appropriately and ensure technical improvements are documented and supportable.
* Review existing implementations rather than assuming that the current configuration is necessarily the best configuration.
* Contribute to improvements across IT platforms, identity and access management, endpoint management and other enterprise systems.

****Incident Ownership and Communication****

* Take ownership of technical issues and ensure they are properly investigated before escalation.
* Clearly document troubleshooting steps, findings, business impact, affected users, timelines and actions taken.
* Escalate issues to the IT Manager, Infrastructure, Security or other departments with enough detail for effective follow-up.
* Provide clear written and verbal updates during incidents.
* Follow up on incidents to ensure root cause, lessons learned and any required process improvements are captured.
* Recognise when an issue can be resolved independently and when escalation or additional expertise is required.

****Security, Compliance and Controls****

* Support and take ownership of relevant IT controls associated with
  ****SOC 2, ISO 27001 and internal security requirements****

  .
* Play an active role in supporting SOC 2 audit activities within India, including ensuring required processes are followed and appropriate evidence is available.
* Support the implementation and ongoing operation of new IT controls as responsibilities and compliance requirements evolve.
* Understand the purpose and intent behind controls rather than treating them solely as procedural requirements.
* Ensure hardware is handled securely throughout its lifecycle, including wiping, return, reuse, recycling or destruction.
* Assist with IT audits, asset audits, access reviews and evidence gathering where required.
* Confidently explain IT processes and controls and provide appropriate supporting evidence during audits or compliance reviews.
* Identify and raise concerns where processes or technical configurations create unnecessary security or operational risk.
* Work with the IT Manager and Security team to identify opportunities to strengthen existing technical controls.

****Local IT Ownership and Team Support****

* Act as a senior IT presence within the India office and take ownership of local IT operational matters.
* Help prioritise and coordinate day-to-day activities within the local IT team.
* Provide guidance, technical support and mentoring to other IT support staff.
* Delegate appropriate activities while remaining actively involved in technical and operational delivery.
* Review work where appropriate and help maintain a consistent standard of quality.
* Build effective working relationships with local teams and other business stakeholders.
* Coordinate with local suppliers and vendors where required.
* Ensure local processes are completed correctly and supported by appropriate documentation and evidence.
* Promote a culture of ownership, accountability, clear communication and continuous improvement.
* This is a
  ****hands-on leadership role rather than a traditional management position****

  . Leadership within the role comes from technical capability, judgement, ownership, mentoring and the ability to drive work through to completion.

****Key Systems and Platforms****

* You do not need to have experience with every system listed below but should have strong experience with similar enterprise IT tools and the ability to learn new technologies quickly.
* Google Workspace, including Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar and Admin Console.
* Google Meet and video conferencing.
* Slack for day-to-day communication and collaboration.
* Atlassian Jira for ticketing, support workflows and project tracking.
* Confluence for internal documentation and process guides.
* Microsoft Office 365 support where required.
* Apple Business Manager, including Automated Device Enrolment / DEP.
* MDM administration, preferably Iru (Kandji), Jamf, Google Workspace MDM or similar.
* Primarily macOS, iOS, iPadOS and Android devices. We also manage Windows and Linux endpoints.
* IT asset management systems; Snipe-IT experience is desirable but not essential.
* Identity, authentication and access management technologies.
* APIs and scripting technologies ideally Bash Shell or Python.

****Knowledge, Skills and Experience****

****Essential****

* Strong written and spoken English is essential for effective cross-regional communication and collaboration.
* Strong experience in IT support, IT operations, systems administration, desktop support or endpoint support.
* Experience supporting mostly macOS, Linux and Windows environments.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to work through unfamiliar technical issues methodically and independently.
* Ability to take ownership of technical work without requiring continuous supervision or detailed step-by-step instruction.
* Good understanding of onboarding, offboarding, account management and device lifecycle management.
* Experience using enterprise ticketing and work-management platforms such as Jira Service
* Management, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Freshservice or similar.
* Good understanding of identity, authentication, access management and IT security principles.
* Understanding of device security, encryption, least privilege, MFA and secure asset handling.
* Experience administering enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Ability to investigate an existing technical configuration, identify potential improvements and communicate recommendations clearly.
* Ability to communicate technical issues clearly and professionally to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong attention to detail when documenting issues, maintaining evidence and following IT processes.
* Ability to balance day-to-day operational responsibilities with project and improvement work.
* Ability to provide guidance and technical leadership to other team members.

****Desirable****

* Experience administering Google Workspace.
* Experience with Apple Business Manager and MDM platforms.
* Experience supporting Linux users.
* Experience with Slack, Jira, Confluence and Google Meet hardware.
* Experience with IT asset management systems.
* Experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar compliance frameworks.
* Experience scripting in Bash, Python, PowerShell or similar.
* Experience working with REST APIs or SaaS integrations.
* Experience automating IT administration or operational processes.
* Experience with SSO, SAML, SCIM or other identity and provisioning technologies.
* Experience supporting wireless networks, meeting rooms, AV systems, access control or security camera systems.
* Experience contributing to technical or security improvement projects.

****Interview Process****

Stage 1 - Call with a talent acquisition team member (30 minutes)

Stage 2 - Call with the tech team (45 minutes)

Stage 3 - Technical Test

Stage 4 - Final call with Hiring manager and tech team

****What’s in it for you?****

* Medical Insurance cover of INR 5 lakhs
* Life Insurance / Accidental cover
* Gratuity as per law
* PF as per law
* 18 days paid leave + 6 sick day leave (Yearly)
* 10 declared holidays (Yearly)
* 5 fully paid Selfie Days - for your own personal development, volunteering, charity events, etc
* Quarterly Team and company activities, Social clubs.
* Continuous learning opportunities (Annual Training budgets, conferences etc)

This is a great opportunity to join a company that is leading the way for innovative and responsible identity verification. We’re looking for people who can adapt to a fast-paced environment, as well as champion our brand and what we stand for. We value a positive attitude and people who have a collaborative, creative and transparent approach to solving problems.

****AI Usage during the recruitment process****

Please read our AI Usage in Recruitment policy to know more about how Yoti uses AI in the recruitment process and our stance on how candidates can use AI during the interview process.

****We believe in equal opportunities****

It takes a diverse community of passionate, talented and committed people to build a simpler, more secure way of proving identity. We’re an equal opportunity employer, so we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, with different outlooks and experiences.

We are proud to be a Disability Confident employer and we’re committed to making our recruitment process as inclusive and accessible as possible. If you have a disability or long-term condition and need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we’ll do everything we can to support you and to enable you to bring your best self to our hiring process.

****Employment checks****

If your application is successful please be aware that as part of our employment checks:

****Talent Pool****

If we consider that you might be suitable for other roles in the future, we will keep your details so we can contact you about these other roles. If you do not want us to keep your details for this purpose, please e-mail

peopleteam@yoti.com

title: Consultant
description:
**Opentext - The Information Company**
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  
**AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.**
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
**Your Impact**
OpenText is a world leader in Information Management, helping companies securely capture, govern and exchange information on a global scale. OpenText solves digital business challenges for Clients, ranging from small and mid-sized businesses to the largest and most complex organizations in the world. That is high tech without the drama.
  
  
UCMDB Technical Consultant will provide technology consulting in the field of Infra Structure Discovery to external customers. Responsible for providing Implementation and Solution support to meet customers’ business needs and, consequently, for understanding customers’ businesses. Responsible for application administration and customization tasks for one or several highly complex customer cloud and off cloud deployments. A Technical Consultant possesses technical expertise in implementing, tuning and optimizing product solutions, adhering to Micro Focus (now Open text) best practices.
  
  
**What The Role Offers**

* UCMDB Technical Consultant will provide technology consulting in the field of Infra Structure Discovery to external customers. Responsible for providing Implementation and Solution support to meet customers’ business needs and, consequently, for understanding customers’ businesses.
* Responsible for application administration and customization tasks for one or several highly complex customer cloud and off cloud deployments.
* A Technical Consultant possesses technical expertise in implementing, tuning and optimizing product solutions, adhering to Micro Focus (now Open text) best practices.
* Experience in working with other members at remote location (International)
* Time flexibility for meetings that may be conducted outside local business hours
* Experience in working with Product Support and R&D for product related issues.
* Demonstrated technical documentation skills - As\_build document, test plans, test results summary document etc.

**What You Need To Succeed**

* Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent degree in computer science or related area of study
* At least 3-5 years Micro Focus/OpenText CMS products (UCMDB and UD) Implementation experience
* Good Infrastructure Knowledge
* Basic Networking concepts, DB Concepts and Server OS concepts.
* Has sufficient technical knowledge to assist with the completion of specific deliverables.
* Able to communicate concepts with team and Customer.
* Able to produce basic documentation to required standards.
* Demonstrates understanding of assigned discipline or technical area.
* Demonstrate fundamental technical knowledge.

**One Last Thing**
OpenText is more than just a corporation, it's a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned.
  
  
Join us on our mission to drive positive change through privacy, technology, and collaboration.
  
  
At OpenText, we don't just have a culture; we have character. Choose us because you want to be part of a company that embraces innovation and empowers its employees to make a difference.

title: IT Techno Functional Analyst
description:
**Career Area**
Technology, Digital and Data
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
**Job Summary**
This role is responsible for the delivery, support, and continuous improvement of Transportation, Procurement, and Logistics IT solutions. The incumbent partners with business stakeholders, vendors, and IT teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure technology capabilities that enable critical supply chain operations.
  
  
The position participates in all phases of the solution lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution delivery, testing, implementation, production support, service management, and continuous improvement. The role contributes to operational excellence through automation, AI-enabled capabilities, process optimization, and data-driven decision making to improve business outcomes, service reliability, and user experience.
  
  
**What You Will Do: - Functional & Technical skills:**

* Strong knowledge of Supply Chain and Transportation Logistics, including international planning and execution, inbound and outbound transportation, multimodal operations (ocean, air, ground), freight visibility, analytics, consolidation, and network optimization.
* Experience with transportation platforms such as Blue Yonder (JDA) Transportation Management, E2open, Infor Nexus (GT Nexus), and related logistics technologies.
* Demonstrated Functional Analyst expertise with end-to-end product lifecycle ownership across Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Partner with business, operations, and product stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze processes, define functional and non-functional requirements, and develop solution designs aligned with business objectives.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans.
* Lead and support all phases of the product lifecycle, including requirements, design, development, testing, release planning, deployment, production support, and continuous improvement.
* Manage and continuously improve transportation technology products through ServiceNow-based service management processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, Release, Knowledge, and Service Request Management.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex application, integration, and production issues within established service level agreements (SLAs), coordinating with business teams, vendors, and support partners.
* Support and coordinate major incident management, root cause analysis, problem resolution, and corrective action planning to improve system stability, resilience, and business continuity.
* Coordinate cybersecurity vulnerability management activities, including risk assessment, remediation planning, patch coordination, security compliance, audit support, and timely closure of application and infrastructure vulnerabilities in partnership with security, infrastructure, and vendor teams.
* Manage application maintenance, environment management, server patching, platform upgrades, and technology refresh initiatives to maintain secure, reliable, and compliant systems.
* Drive operational excellence through automation, AI-enabled capabilities, self-service solutions, intelligent monitoring, predictive analytics, and process optimization initiatives that improve efficiency, service quality, and user experience.
* Measure, monitor, and improve service performance, operational processes, standards, and support effectiveness using data-driven metrics and continuous improvement practices.
* Create and maintain comprehensive test strategies, test plans, regression suites, and validation processes to ensure solution quality and release readiness.
* Develop and maintain deep functional, operational, and technical knowledge of transportation processes, applications, integrations, and emerging industry trends.
* Working knowledge of modern application architecture, Java/J2EE technologies, Spring Framework, REST APIs, SQL, Oracle/Snowflake databases, OpenShift, DevOps practices, and distributed system troubleshooting.

**Additional Information**
Experience: 4+ years of IT experience in application development, support, services and product delivery
  
  
Education: BE / B Tech / MCA
  
  
Shift: Project dependent
  
  

* 1 PM IST to 10 PM IST (North America & Europe Operations)
* 7:30 AM IST to 4:30 PM IST (Asia Pacific Operations)
* Weekend deployment activities & support (On-demand – Monthly or emergency release)

**What You Have**
**Operational & Behavioral Competencies:**

* Develop and maintain strong business, operational, and technical knowledge of transportation, procurement, and logistics processes and solutions.
* Effectively manage multiple assignments, projects, support activities, and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Apply analytical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify issues, evaluate options, and recommend solutions.
* Collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, vendors, and cross-functional IT teams.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrate accountability, ownership, and follow-through in assigned work and issue resolution.
* Adapt quickly to changing business priorities, technologies, and operational requirements.
* Demonstrate initiative, learning agility, customer focus, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**Top candidate might also have**

* Knowledge of Blue Yonder (JDA) TM, E2open, Infor Nexus (GT Nexus), and related transportation technologies.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies, ServiceNow IT Service Management (ITSM), Microsoft Azure DevOps, and CI/CD practices.
* Knowledge of Java, Python, SQL, middleware technologies, APIs, and data formats such as REST, JSON, XML, and EDI.
* Understanding of SOA, messaging, and enterprise integration concepts.
* Experience supporting enterprise applications, incident and problem management, and production operations.
* Knowledge of automation, AI-enabled capabilities, observability, monitoring, and cybersecurity best practices.

The successful candidate will possess strong written and verbal communication skills, a customer-focused mindset, and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions and support. The individual should be self-motivated, accountable, and capable of working independently while effectively collaborating with global business and IT teams. Flexibility to support global operations, production deployments, critical incidents, and continuous improvement initiatives is expected.
  
  
Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of India which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers.
  
  
**What You Will Get**
Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world. Here you earn more than just wage, because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day one benefits along with the potential of a variable bonus. Additional benefits include paid annual leave, flexi leave, medical and insurance (prorated based upon hire date).
  
  
**Final Details**
Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status.
  
  
If you are interested in joining our team, please apply using an English version of your CV. We look forward to meeting you!

title: Collaboration Platforms Administrator
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**About The Team And Role**
We’re excited to bring on a Collaboration Platforms Administrator based in Bangalore, India. As part of eBay’s Global Collaboration Services organization, this support-focused role will provide day-to-day operational support for our enterprise collaboration ecosystem, with primary responsibility for email services, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Slack, in addition to other services managed by the Collaboration Platforms team. The position will work as part of a global team of 10 direct peers supporting collaboration services at enterprise scale. We rely on this person to help keep these platforms operating securely, reliably, and efficiently, serving as a key point of ownership for L3 requests, troubleshooting, and escalations. This role will partner closely with IAM, Helpdesk Support, Security, Procurement, Collaboration Platforms Engineering, and business stakeholders to support service reliability, user needs, and ongoing platform operations.
  
  
Experience supporting collaboration and messaging platforms in a large global enterprise environment (20,000+ users).
  
  
Experience administering Slack Enterprise Grid in a large enterprise environment. Experience with Microsoft Graph, Exchange Online PowerShell, Google Apps Script, Google Workspace Admin APIs, or similar administrative automation tools. Experience implementing or supporting AI governance, enterprise AI capabilities, AI-powered automation, and collaboration platform integrations.
  
  
The ITSS Collaboration Platforms team enables eBay employees to communicate, collaborate, and work securely across the globe.
  
  
We administer and support enterprise messaging and collaboration technologies including Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Slack Enterprise Grid, Google Workspace, Cisco Cloud Email Security, and a portfolio of SaaS collaboration applications. Our team focuses on delivering secure, reliable, and scalable messaging and collaboration services while driving operational excellence, automation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
As a Collaboration Platform Administrator, you will provide operational support and administration for our collaboration ecosystem. You'll work closely with engineers, security teams, service owners, business partners, and vendors to troubleshoot issues, implement platform improvements, support integrations, and ensure our messaging and collaboration services remain highly available, secure, and scalable.
  
  
**What You'll Accomplish**

* Administer and support enterprise messaging and collaboration platforms including Exchange Online, Microsoft 365, Slack Enterprise Grid, Google Workspace, Cisco Cloud Email Security, and other SaaS collaboration services.
* Manage and troubleshoot enterprise email services, including mail flow, message hygiene, transport rules, mail routing, connectors, shared mailboxes, distribution lists, and email authentication technologies such as SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
* Support enterprise email security by administering Cisco Cloud Email Security policies, investigating phishing and spoofing incidents, analyzing message traces, and partnering with Information Security on email-related threats and escalations.
* Perform day-to-day platform administration, configuration, troubleshooting, incident response, and service restoration while meeting established service level objectives.
* Support platform security through identity management, access controls, data protection policies, and security best practices. Configure and support collaboration applications such as Monday.com, Figma, Lucid Software, Smartsheet, Calendly, Zoom, and related productivity platforms.
* Implement and maintain integrations between collaboration platforms using APIs, automation tools, and third-party applications.
* Support AI-enabled capabilities across collaboration platforms, including AI assistants, workflow automation, MCP servers, approved third-party AI integrations, and emerging AI technologies.
* Create and maintain automation using PowerShell, Google Apps Script, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, or similar technologies to improve operational efficiency.
* Develop operational reporting, dashboards, and metrics to improve service health, platform adoption, email deliverability, and operational efficiency.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, and standard operating procedures.
* Participate in change management activities, platform upgrades, testing, and production deployments.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Security, Identity, Infrastructure, Compliance, Legal, Vendor Support, and business stakeholders to resolve complex technical issues.
* Partner with service owners and vendors to evaluate new features, validate platform changes, and support the rollout of enhancements that improve security, reliability, and the employee collaboration experience.
* Participate in a global follow-the-sun weekday operational support rotation, providing on-call coverage during assigned regional business hours and ensuring seamless support through coordinated handoffs across global teams.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years of experience administering enterprise messaging and collaboration platforms in large-scale environments.
* Strong hands-on experience supporting Exchange Online, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Slack Enterprise Grid, and enterprise email infrastructure.
* Experience administering enterprise email security platforms such as Cisco Cloud Email Security (IronPort), Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Proofpoint, Mimecast, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of enterprise mail flow, SMTP, message routing, connectors, transport rules, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and email security best practices.
* Experience troubleshooting complex email delivery issues, message trace analysis, phishing investigations, and mail routing problems.
* Experience supporting SaaS collaboration platforms such as Monday.com, Figma, Lucid Software, Smartsheet, Calendly, Zoom, or similar technologies.
* Experience supporting identity and access management technologies, including SSO, SAML, SCIM provisioning, OAuth, and enterprise authentication.
* Experience working with REST APIs, Microsoft Graph API, Google Workspace APIs, Slack APIs, automation platforms, or scripting languages such as PowerShell or Google Apps Script.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity tools, AI agents, MCP servers, workflow automation, and enterprise governance of AI capabilities.
* Experience using monitoring, reporting, or log analysis tools such as Splunk or similar platforms.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across multiple cloud platforms.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across global teams and support both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment while maintaining a strong customer service focus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting collaboration and messaging platforms in a large global enterprise environment (20,000+ users).
* Experience administering Slack Enterprise Grid in a large enterprise environment.
* Experience with Microsoft Graph, Exchange Online PowerShell, Google Apps Script, Google Workspace Admin APIs, or similar administrative automation tools.
* Experience implementing or supporting AI governance, enterprise AI capabilities, AI-powered automation, and collaboration platform integrations.

title: MS Engineer (L1)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Data Centre Remote Technical Support Engineer (L1) is an entry level engineering role, responsible for providing a professional remote technical support service to clients by identifying and resolving technical incidents and problems.
  
  
Through pre-emptive service incident and resolution activities, this role will restore service to clients by driving incidents to an effective resolution and ensuring all requests, process events and resolution incidents result in zero missed service level agreement (SLA) conditions.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Maintains the support process and ensures that requests for support are handled according to the procedures.
* Use service assurance software and tools to investigate and diagnose problems, collect performance statistics and create reports, working with users, other staff and suppliers as appropriate.
* Identify and resolve problems following agreed procedures.
* Carry out agreed maintenance tasks.
* Ensures usage of knowledge articles in incident diagnosis and resolution and assist with updating as and when required.
* Perform defined tasks to monitor service delivery against service level agreements and maintains records of relevant information.
* Analyse service records against agreed service levels regularly to identify actions required to maintain or improve levels of service, and initiates or reports these actions.
* Prioritizes and diagnose incidents according to agreed procedures.
* Investigate causes of incidents and seeks resolution.
* Escalate unresolved incidents and follow up until incident is resolved.
* Provide service recovery, following resolution of incidents.
* Document and close resolved incidents according to agreed procedures.
* Maintain secure, accurate, complete, and current configuration on configuration items (CIs).
* Apply tools, techniques and processes to track, log and correct information related to CIs, ensuring protection of assets and components from unauthorized change, diversion, and inappropriate use.
* Remotely investigate and identifies root cause of incidents and assist with the implementation of agreed remedies and preventative measures.
* Maintain knowledge of specific specialisms, provides detailed advice regarding their application.
* Ensure efficient and comprehensive resolution of incidents, including ensuring that repairs are carried out by coordinating product requests, working with other team members.
* Provide continuous feedback to clients and affected parties and update all systems, portals and ticketing tools as prescribed by standard operating procedures.
* Identify problems and errors prior to or when they occur.
* Log all such incidents in a timely manner with the required level of detail with all the necessary.
* Cooperate with all stakeholders including client IT environments, vendors, carriers and colleagues to expedite diagnosis of errors and problems and to identify a resolution.

**Knowledge and Attributes:**

* Working knowledge of technical documentation.
* Knowledge on management agent concepts, redundancy concepts and remote console architecture within supported technical domain.
* Knowledge of vendor technologies, such as Cisco, EMC, Dell Avaya etc.
* Customer service orientated and pro-active thinking.
* Problem solver who is highly driven and self-organized.
* Good attention to detail.
* Good analytical and logical thinking.
* Excellent spoken and written communication skills.
* Team player with the ability to work well with others and in group with colleagues and stakeholders.

**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology or Computing or related field.
* Associate level certification in different Data Centre technologies such as Cisco, NetApp, EMC- Ex: CCNA (DC).

**Required Experience:**

* Entry level experience in call center routing technologies, voice over IP technologies, Security/firewalls, Networking (routing, switching, distribution, core and access layers) and IT infrastructure (storage, backup, computing, server virtualization and etc.).
* Entry level experience in technical support to clients.
* Entry level experience in diagnosis and troubleshooting.
* Entry level experience providing remote support in Data Centre technologies.
* Entry level experience in relevant technology.

**Workplace type:**
Hybrid Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long-term success. We invest over $3.6 billion each year in R&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure, and connectivity. We are also one of the leading providers of digital and AI infrastructure in the world. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group and headquartered in Tokyo.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

title: Digital Workplace Operations Lead
description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
As an Advisor, Operations Lead within the Digital Workplace team, you will serve as a senior individual contributor responsible for the operational health, governance, and continuous improvement of Cargill's endpoint and collaboration environment. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution — you will translate roadmap priorities into operationally sound, day-to-day practices while acting as a trusted subject matter expert across engineering teams, business stakeholders, and global service partners.
  
  
You will bring structure to complexity, data to decisions, and clarity to a fast-moving transformation — all without direct reports, but with significant influence across the teams and leaders you partner with.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Operational Excellence

+ Own and improve Digital Workplace operations, covering device lifecycle, provisioning, depot management, endpoint governance, and collaboration platforms.
+ Track KPIs and SLAs, identify risks, and drive improvements with cross-functional teams.
+ Maintain standardized procedures and act as an escalation point, ensuring timely, accountable resolution of complex operational issues across stakeholders.

* Collaboration Platform Governance

+ Support governance of the Microsoft 365 environment, including SharePoint permissions, OneDrive, Teams lifecycle, and security groups.
+ Collaborate with Security and IAM teams to ensure data protection and access control.
+ Drive attestation, automation, and audits, while aligning with Entra ID and HR systems to ensure accurate, compliant access governance.

* Governance & Compliance

+ Support the design and execution of governance frameworks for endpoint access, device compliance, collaboration platform policies, and Digital Workplace standards in alignment with Cargill's security and IT requirements.
+ Partner with Information Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure operational practices meet internal policy and external regulatory requirements across a global footprint.

* Program & Stakeholder Support

+ Collaborate with program teams to ensure operational readiness and seamless transition to steady-state operations.
+ Advise leadership with data-driven insights on service health and transformation progress.
+ Engage stakeholders and end users to gather feedback, drive change, and promote adoption of modern workplace tools across a global workforce.

* Continuous Improvement

+ Lead operational improvement initiatives using structured problem-solving to enhance efficiency and service quality.
+ Identify and implement automation opportunities across workflows in partnership with engineering teams.
+ Stay updated on Microsoft 365, Nexthink, and PCaaS trends, translating emerging capabilities into actionable operational recommendations for leadership.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field — or equivalent work experience.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT operations, Digital Workplace, or endpoint management in a large enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing device lifecycle, provisioning processes, and endpoint governance at scale (10,000+ devices preferred).
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 platform operations, including SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Exchange/mail governance.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to synthesize operational data into actionable insights and executive-ready communications.
* Proven ability to work effectively across matrixed, global organizations and manage multiple priorities without direct authority.
* Experience with ITSM frameworks (ITIL or equivalent) and operational reporting tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, Windows 365 (W365), Entra ID (Azure AD), and/or Nexthink.
* Familiarity with PCaaS (PC as a Service) operating models and global vendor management.
* Experience designing or operating SharePoint permissions governance programs, including oversharing remediation, attestation workflows, and automated access controls.
* Experience supporting large-scale technology transformation programs, particularly mid-flight rather than greenfield.
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent.
* Microsoft 365 certifications (e.g., MS-700, MS-900, or equivalent) a plus.
* Demonstrated experience with process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent).

**Competencies for Success**

* Operational Rigor — You bring discipline and structure to ambiguous environments, translating strategy into repeatable, scalable processes that hold up across a global, multi-industry organization.
* Stakeholder Influence — As a senior IC, you earn trust and drive alignment without formal authority, communicating clearly across engineering teams, business leaders, and end users alike.
* Breadth & Curiosity — You're comfortable owning both device operations and collaboration platform governance — and you actively seek to connect the dots between them.
* Ownership Mindset — You take accountability for outcomes, follow through on commitments, and proactively surface issues before they become problems.
* Data-Driven Thinking — You use metrics and evidence to drive decisions, tell compelling stories, and demonstrate operational value to leadership.

* Report service-impacting incidents to customers and internal stakeholders in a timely and accurate manner
