* Work closely with technical support teams, incident management teams, service desks, and first-line support functions
* Maintain operational excellence to support network availability and minimise service downtime
* Ensure accurate communication of faults and associated customer impact
* Contribute to continuous process improvements and operational efficiency initiatives
* Participate in a 24x7 shift environment to support business and customer requirements
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless customer service delivery

Who you are
  
  
**Essential Qualifications**

* Engineering degree or Engineering Diploma
* Basic networking knowledge, preferably with exposure to Cisco networking technologies
* Understanding of:

oOSI Model
  
  
oTCP/IP Protocol Suite
  
  
oBasic Routing and Switching Concepts
  
  

* Working knowledge of:

oWindows Operating Systems
  
  
oInternet Browsers
  
  
oMicrosoft Office Applications
  
  
oEmail Applications
  
  

* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English
* Methodical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Analytical mindset with attention to detail
* Ability to work effectively within a collaborative team environment
* Willingness to work rotational 24x7 shifts

**Desired Qualifications And Experience**

* Approximately one year of experience within ISP, Telecom or Managed Services environments
* Experience working in a Network Operations Centre (NOC)
* CCNA certification
* Postgraduate qualification in Advanced Networking
* Experience within a Managed Service Organisation
* Exposure to large-scale IP network environments

Behavioural Competencies
  
  

* Customer obsessed mindset
* Innovation hungry and eager to learn
* Speed and simplicity in execution
* Builds trust through accountability and professionalism
* Collaborative and inclusive approach to teamwork
* Self-motivated with the ability to prioritise effectively during high-pressure situations
* Strong commitment to continuous learning and development

Not a perfect fit
  
  
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
What’s in it for you
  
  

* Opportunity to work with large-scale global IP networks and telecommunications infrastructure
* Exposure to Cisco networking technologies and enterprise monitoring environments
* Experience collaborating with international stakeholders and technical teams
* Structured learning within a global managed services organisation
* Opportunity to contribute to service improvements and operational excellence initiatives
* Career development pathways within network operations and telecommunications services
* Hands-on experience in a critical customer operations environment

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Incident identification, validation, and fault reporting processes
* Network operations centre (NOC) best practices
* Stakeholder communication and customer incident management
* Service management and SLA-driven operations

title: Global Telecom Support
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior Mobility Telecom, Network Operations & Major Incident Lead will provide end-to-end technical and operational leadership for a global retail telecom and network environment supporting Mobility and E-Mobility services.
  
  
The role will act as a senior technical authority and operational integrator across internal support teams, network and telecom suppliers, application teams, service providers, business stakeholders and incident-management functions. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining network stability, leading the resolution of complex incidents, coordinating major incidents, overseeing infrastructure changes, driving root-cause analysis and improving the overall reliability, security and performance of the service.
  
  
The role requires strong ownership across a highly integrated support landscape where telecom, network, payment, loyalty, site systems and central applications cannot be managed as isolated service components.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Accountabilities**
**1. Global Telecom and Network Operations**

* Provide senior technical and operational leadership for global Mobility and E-Mobility telecom infrastructure.
* Maintain end-to-end oversight of network connectivity and associated infrastructure across retail sites, backbone services, data centres, third-party networks and externally managed connectivity services.
* Monitor the health, availability, performance and security of the telecom environment using enterprise and vendor monitoring platforms.
* Analyse monitoring alerts, operational events and service degradation indicators to determine business impact and initiate the appropriate response.
* Ensure incidents affecting routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN tunnels and associated connectivity components are correctly triaged and assigned.
* Maintain ownership of complex operational issues until resolution or until a complete and formally accepted handover has been performed.
* Support a global, follow-the-sun operating model, including participation in on-call, weekend and public-holiday support arrangements.
* Provide technical guidance to operations teams handling site-level, multi-site and infrastructure-wide disruptions.

The contract identifies global telecom monitoring, real-time infrastructure visibility, incident notification and escalation as core components of the service. It also covers routers, switches, firewalls, VPN tunnels, load balancers, backbone infrastructure and vendor-managed telecom services.
  
  

* Incident and Major Incident Management
* Lead the technical response for high-impact single-site, multi-site and global service incidents.
* Coordinate incident bridges involving network suppliers, telecom providers, application teams, site-support teams, service managers and business stakeholders.
* Perform initial and advanced technical triage to establish incident scope, affected services, market impact, urgency and priority.
* Ensure incidents contain sufficient diagnostic and business-impact information before escalation.
* Coordinate the creation and progression of incident and major-incident records in the relevant service-management platform.
* Manage P3 and P4 major incidents and support the designated incident-command function during P1 and P2 major incidents.
* Establish clear ownership across resolver groups and ensure suppliers engage within their contractual responsibilities.
* Schedule and lead technical calls when required to accelerate investigation and recovery.
* Maintain an accurate incident chronology, including decisions, actions, ownership, dependencies and restoration progress.
* Confirm service restoration through monitoring tools, resolver-group evidence or confirmation from the reporting party before closure.
* Ensure incident, recovery and closure communications are distributed to the appropriate internal and external stakeholders.
* Support incident managers by translating complex technical findings into clear operational and business-impact statements.

The scope requires first-level incident management, major incident management, prioritisation, ticket creation, supplier escalation, technical-call coordination, service-restoration confirmation and communications throughout the incident lifecycle.
  
  

* Advanced Troubleshooting and Technical Investigation
* Lead technical investigation of complex, recurring or high-impact telecom and network issues.
* Perform full-stack troubleshooting across the network path, including routing, switching, firewall policies, VPN connectivity, traffic flows, network security controls and dependent services.
* Use packet-capture and network-analysis tools to isolate faults at packet and protocol level.
* Analyse network traffic, device events, application logs, site-system logs and monitoring data to identify hard-to-detect issues.
* Develop and test technical hypotheses using available operational evidence.
* Coordinate cross-supplier troubleshooting where ownership or fault location is unclear.
* Determine whether failures originate within site infrastructure, telecom connectivity, network backbone, security services, vendor platforms, application services or third-party interfaces.
* Produce clear technical findings, recommended remediation actions and risk assessments.
* Provide technical direction to less-experienced engineers and operations analysts during critical incidents.

The contract specifically requires advanced troubleshooting, traffic analysis, packet-level investigation, knowledge of multiple routing protocols, network design expertise and analysis of site-system and application logs.
  
  

* Root-Cause and Problem Management
* Lead Root Cause Analysis for significant telecom, network and third-party incidents.
* Ensure root-cause documentation clearly describes the failure, contributing factors, business impact, recovery actions and preventive measures.
* Challenge incomplete or unsupported root-cause statements provided by suppliers.
* Track corrective and preventive actions through to verified completion.
* Raise and coordinate problem records for recurring or systemic issues.
* Use incident trends, operational data and recurring alert patterns to identify candidates for problem management.
* Facilitate technical reviews involving internal teams and external service providers.
* Ensure RCA documentation is completed within applicable operational timelines.
* Maintain traceability between incidents, problems, known errors, changes and improvement activities.
* Share lessons learned and incorporate agreed improvements into support procedures, monitoring rules and operational documentation.

The SWAT scope assigns responsibility for RCA leadership, documentation completion, supplier engagement, root-cause validation and accountability. The administrative support scope also includes problem management for supported operational platforms.
  
  

* Change, Migration and Implementation Support
* Assess telecom and network changes for technical risk, operational impact and business impact.
* Coordinate network changes, migrations and implementations with suppliers and delivery teams.
* Evaluate third-party changes that may affect Mobility services.
* Ensure relevant stakeholders review and approve changes before implementation.
* Create and distribute change notifications to internal and external stakeholders.
* Monitor the implementation of high-risk or business-critical changes.
* Coordinate technical support during change implementation and post-change validation.
* Verify that changes achieve the intended outcome without creating unacceptable service degradation.
* Support recovery or rollback activities when a change is unsuccessful.
* Ensure network, firewall, configuration, support and operational documentation is updated following implementation.
* Review project implementation plans for operational readiness, supportability and alignment with the existing environment.

The contract includes change coordination, third-party change-impact assessment, stakeholder approval, Change Notification Letters, implementation monitoring and technical support for network changes and migrations.
  
  

* Network Architecture and Design Assurance
* Act as a senior technical authority for the end-to-end Mobility telecom and network architecture.
* Review solution and network designs for reliability, availability, security, scalability, operability and supportability.
* Provide technical recommendations to project and delivery teams.
* Assess proposed changes against the existing telecom environment and relevant service dependencies.
* Architect, review or approve network designs within the candidate’s delegated authority.
* Identify operational risks, integration gaps, monitoring requirements and support-model deficiencies before production deployment.
* Ensure designs include appropriate diagnostic, failover, security, documentation and operational-support provisions.
* Support implementation teams during deployment, transition and early-life support.
* Ensure integration requirements across multiple suppliers and business partners are understood and coordinated.
* Promote standardisation and reduction of unnecessary technical complexity across the network landscape.

The SWAT team is defined as responsible for end-to-end technical architecture, multi-supplier process integration, project-impact assessment, technical recommendations, design review or approval and implementation support.
  
  

* Firewall, Security and Access Governance
* Provide senior oversight of firewall rules supporting the Mobility environment.
* Review firewall-rule changes for technical validity, security risk, business justification and implementation impact.
* Ensure access and infrastructure requests follow the required approval and governance processes.
* Review and manage third-party access requests relating to infrastructure, data-centre or service-support activities.
* Support access-control processes and periodic access reviews for relevant operational platforms.
* Coordinate with security, risk, infrastructure and supplier teams to resolve security-related network issues.
* Support compliance activities associated with Information Risk Management and Payment Card Industry requirements.
* Maintain appropriate records and technical documentation to support audit and compliance activities.
* Escalate non-compliance, uncontrolled access, unsupported connectivity or material security risks to the relevant stakeholders.
* Balance operational recovery requirements with security and access-control obligations during critical incidents.

The contract includes ownership of a significant portion of the firewall rule sets, third-party access management, infrastructure change requests and support for Information Risk Management and PCI compliance activities.
  
  

* Supplier and Stakeholder Management
* Act as the senior technical liaison between internal teams, business stakeholders, telecom providers, technology suppliers and third-party service providers.
* Establish clear technical and operational ownership across multi-supplier incidents.
* Hold suppliers accountable for investigation quality, contractual service obligations, recovery actions and root-cause deliverables.
* Escalate supplier-performance concerns through the appropriate operational and commercial channels.
* Obtain technical evidence from suppliers following incidents and changes.
* Challenge delays, unsupported conclusions and incomplete remediation plans.
* Coordinate dependencies between connectivity providers, managed-service suppliers, application teams and site-support teams.
* Provide concise updates to service management and business leadership.
* Maintain professional working relationships across geographically distributed and culturally diverse teams.
* Represent the telecom and network operations function in service reviews, project meetings, change reviews, incident reviews and technical governance forums.

The role descriptions require working across international teams, leading meetings, coordinating internal and external support entities and ensuring suppliers and vendors perform as required under their contracts.
  
  

* Monitoring and Service Improvement
* Drive proactive monitoring and early identification of telecom and service degradation.
* Review alerts, dashboards, thresholds and escalation paths to improve incident detection and response quality.
* Identify monitoring gaps across network, site, application and third-party services.
* Work with monitoring-service owners and suppliers to implement actionable alerts.
* Reduce alert noise, duplicate notifications and non-actionable events.
* Use operational data to identify reliability, performance and service-improvement opportunities.
* Lead network optimisation and continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Recommend automation opportunities for repetitive triage, notification, reporting and evidence-gathering activities.
* Track the effectiveness of implemented improvements through operational measures and incident trends.
* Ensure monitoring procedures remain aligned with changes to technology, business services and supplier arrangements.

The scope references proactive monitoring through tools and vendors, operational-data analysis, corrective actions, network optimisation and continuous service improvement.
  
  

* Documentation and Operational Readiness
* Create, maintain and continuously improve end-to-end technical and operational documentation.
* Develop network diagrams, support procedures, troubleshooting guides, escalation matrices, process flows and incident-response playbooks.
* Maintain accurate records of network circuits, racks, devices, configurations, inventory, contacts and service dependencies where applicable.
* Ensure documentation supports rapid triage within demanding incident-response timelines.
* Review project support models, support decks and operational-readiness documentation.
* Validate that new services have complete monitoring, ticketing, access, contact, escalation and Minimum Data Set information before operational handover.
* Establish documentation standards and quality controls for the support organisation.
* Conduct periodic reviews to identify outdated business-critical information.
* Ensure changes to applications, infrastructure, suppliers and contacts are reflected promptly in operational documentation.
* Train team members in the effective use of documentation and service-management tools.

The contract requires standardised network and process documentation, project-onboarding documentation, escalation information, support-model review, and maintenance of network infrastructure and inventory records.
  
  

* Team Leadership and Capability Development
* Provide technical leadership, coaching and guidance to network engineers, incident analysts and operations personnel.
* Define expected quality standards for incident handling, communications, ticket updates, documentation and technical investigation.
* Review the quality of team deliverables and provide constructive feedback.
* Lead technical knowledge-sharing sessions and post-incident learning reviews.
* Develop team capability in troubleshooting, service management, network analysis and stakeholder communication.
* Support workload prioritisation during periods of high incident demand.
* Delegate activities based on risk, complexity, urgency and engineer capability.
* Encourage ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement across integrated support teams.
* Act as an escalation point for technical, process and supplier-related issues.
* Support service leadership with resource planning, operational reporting and resolution of day-to-day delivery concerns.

The contract’s supervisor and service-manager descriptions include team guidance, delivery standards, training, workload management, status reporting, process development and escalation of critical issues.
  
  

* Reporting and Executive Communication
* Prepare monthly service reports covering incidents, recurring issues, improvement activities, technical achievements, risks and upcoming changes.
* Communicate the value delivered by the telecom and network operations team.
* Provide clear updates during high-impact incidents without unnecessary technical jargon.
* Produce technical call summaries, incident recaps, change notices and stakeholder notifications.
* Translate technical events into business-impact statements suitable for senior stakeholders.
* Report material operational risks and unresolved supplier dependencies.
* Ensure reports are accurate, evidence-based and suitable for governance review.
* Maintain action logs and follow up outstanding commitments with internal teams and suppliers.

Monthly reporting of achievements, value-added contributions and upcoming Mobility activities is explicitly included in the SWAT responsibilities. Incident, major-incident and change communications are also included throughout the support scope
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Education and Certifications**
**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Electronics, Engineering or an equivalent technical discipline.
* Equivalent significant professional experience may be considered where permitted by the organisation’s recruitment policy.

**Preferred**

* Cisco professional-level certification or comparable enterprise networking certification.
* ITIL Foundation or higher mandatory.
* Network-security or firewall certification.
* Cloud networking certification.
* Project management or Agile delivery certification.

The source identifies professional certifications as advantageous but does not mandate a specific certification.

title: Support Team Lead
description:
**Company Description**
Pulse Telesystems is a leading telecom solution provider in India, delivering personalized telecom services that support evolving business needs. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Chennai, the company has expanded into multiple major metropolitan cities, serving over 4,000 clients across diverse industries. Its offerings include Internet Leased Lines, VoIP Solutions, Cloud Telephony, Virtual Numbers, SIP Internet Calling, custom CRM integrations, and advanced spam monitoring and CNAM services. Pulse Telesystems is a trusted telecom partner for top enterprises such as Zoho, MGM Healthcare, Larsen & Toubro, CEAT, India Cements Ltd., and PVR Cinemas, helping them improve performance and reliability. Team members join a growing organization focused on innovation, service quality, and long-term client relationships.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly proactive, disciplined and accountable Support Shift Lead to own day-to-day support operations during an assigned shift. The person will actively monitor tickets and incidents from logging through resolution, enforce response and resolution SLAs, coordinate the team, and communicate clearly with stakeholders. This role requires a hands-on leader who follows up relentlessly, escalates risks early, maintains accurate updates, and holds the team to agreed processes and commitments.

**Key Responsibilities**

1.  Support Ticket & Incident Ownership

●      Monitor the support queue continuously and ensure every issue has a clear owner, priority, next action and target time.

●      Track tickets end-to-end—from acknowledgement and triage to troubleshooting, resolution, validation and closure.

●      Review ageing, overdue, stalled, reopened and high-priority tickets; drive action plans to prevent avoidable delays.

●      Enforce response, update and resolution SLAs; escalate potential breaches before they occur.

●      Coordinate major incidents, ensure timely technical escalation, and maintain an accurate incident timeline and handover notes.

2.  Team Leadership & Performance

●      Allocate and rebalance work based on severity, skills, workload and urgency; confirm ownership of every active issue.

●      Run shift kick-offs, periodic queue reviews and end-of-shift handovers.

●      Set clear expectations, monitor productivity and quality, and address missed commitments promptly and fairly.

●      Coach team members on troubleshooting, ticket hygiene, customer handling and escalation discipline.

●      Identify repeated performance gaps, document facts, and raise persistent issues to the Support Manager.

3.  Proactive Communication & Stakeholder Management

●      Provide timely, concise and factual updates to customers, internal teams, management and relevant stakeholders.

●      Communicate impact, current status, actions underway, blockers, ownership and the next update time—without waiting to be chased.

●      Alert stakeholders early when an issue risks breaching SLA or affecting business operations.

●      Coordinate with engineering, infrastructure, vendors and other teams until dependencies are resolved.

●      Ensure no critical issue goes silent and no shift ends without a documented handover of open risks.

4.  Process, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

●      Maintain accurate ticket records, incident notes, escalation details, workaround steps and resolution summaries.

●      Prepare shift reports covering ticket volumes, SLA performance, open/overdue incidents, major risks and follow-up owners.

●      Identify recurring incidents and recommend problem-management actions, knowledge-base updates and process improvements.

●      Follow support procedures, access controls, customer communication standards and incident-management policies.

●      Use ticketing and monitoring tools consistently; keep dashboards and operational trackers current.

Required Skills & Competencies

●      Strong ownership, urgency, discipline and follow-through; comfortable enforcing standards and holding people accountable.

●      Excellent written and verbal communication; able to provide clear updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

●      Sound incident triage, prioritisation, escalation and problem-solving skills.

●      Experience coordinating a support/helpdesk/service desk/NOC/application support team.

●      Strong organisation skills, attention to detail and confidence handling competing priorities.

●      Ability to remain calm, firm and professional during high-severity incidents or customer escalations.

●      Working knowledge of SLAs, ticket lifecycle, incident management, shift handovers and operational reporting.

Experience & Qualifications

●      Typically 3–6 years of experience in technical support, IT operations, service desk, application support or a related environment.

●      At least 1–2 years in a team-lead, shift-lead, senior support or incident-coordination capacity preferred.

●      Experience with ticketing tools such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Freshservice or similar.

●      Exposure to monitoring dashboards, SLA reports, escalation matrices and knowledge-base processes.

●      ITIL Foundation or equivalent incident/service-management training is an advantage.

Success Measures (KPIs)

●      SLA compliance for first response, stakeholder updates and resolution.

●      Reduction in overdue, ageing and unassigned tickets.

●      Quality and timeliness of incident communications and shift handovers.

●      Ticket documentation completeness and resolution quality.

●      Escalation timeliness, repeat-incident trends and customer/stakeholder feedback.

●      Team adherence to process, ownership and agreed action deadlines.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is firm but fair, highly visible in the support queue, and proactive by default. They do not wait for reminders, allow issues to drift, or accept vague status updates. They establish clear owners and deadlines, communicate risks early, verify that actions are completed, and maintain professional accountability without resorting to disrespectful or aggressive behaviour.

Application Note

* Applicants should highlight examples where they improved SLA performance, managed critical incidents, coordinated a support team, prevented escalations through proactive communication, or reduced ticket backlog.
* Please share the resume to hr@pulse.in/ samuel@pulse.in

title: Operations Specialist
description:
**About the Role**

OEC is in the middle of a multi-year journey to modernise its infrastructure and applications, transforming how we build, deploy, and operate software at global scale. The Operations Specialist (L2) is a core member of the Monitoring Team within the Enterprise Operations Team, responsible for the configuration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of OEC’s observability stack, primarily powered by Datadog.

In this role you will own L2 alert triage, incident response, dashboard development, and service onboarding — contributing to the team’s tooling standards and best practices. You will also handle day-to-day server monitoring, infrastructure support, and service management tasks that keep OEC’s global platforms running reliably.

**Key Responsibilities & Duties (essential to the job)**

**Monitoring & alerting**

* Design, configure, and maintain Datadog monitors, composite alerts, and notification channels for production and non-production environments.
* Own the L2 alert triage process — investigate, diagnose, and resolve escalated alerts from L1, ensuring timely root cause identification.
* Tune alert thresholds and suppression rules to minimise noise and reduce false positive rates.
* Manage SLO (Service Level Objective) definitions, tracking, and reporting across assigned services.
* Participate in the on-call rotation for critical monitoring alerts and P1/P2 incident response.

**Dashboards & observability**

* Build and maintain Datadog dashboards covering infrastructure health, application performance, log analytics, and business KPIs.
* Configure and manage Datadog APM (Application Performance Monitoring), distributed tracing, and error tracking for key services.
* Implement and manage log ingestion pipelines, parsing rules, and log-based monitors.
* Develop and maintain Synthetic monitors (API and browser tests) for uptime and user experience validation.

**Service onboarding & integrations**

* Onboard new services and infrastructure components into the Datadog monitoring framework in collaboration with DevOps, Cloud, and Engineering teams.
* Configure and maintain Datadog integrations with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Rackspace), Kubernetes, containerised workloads, and third-party tools.
* Support the migration of legacy monitoring tooling (SCOM, Dynatrace, Grafana, Prometheus, Pingdom, Apigee, Redgate, IDERA) into Datadog.

**Incident response & runbooks**

* Act as L2 escalation point during incidents — perform deep-dive investigations using metrics, logs, traces, and dashboards.
* Create, maintain, and improve runbooks for common alert scenarios, incident response procedures, and post-incident remediation steps.
* Contribute to post-incident reviews, documenting root cause findings and identifying monitoring gaps to prevent recurrence.
* Alerts system owners, stakeholders, and management of degraded system status and Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents; issues tickets for incident and problem escalation.

**AI & automation**

* Leverage Datadog AI capabilities including Watchdog, anomaly detection, outlier detection, and Bits AI to improve proactive issue detection.
* Implement forecast-based monitors for capacity management (CPU, memory, disk).
* Use AI-based alert correlation and deduplication features to reduce alert fatigue.
* Contribute to automation of repetitive monitoring tasks using Datadog’s API and scripting tools.

**Standards & governance**

* Adhere to and actively contribute to monitoring standards, tagging strategies, and naming conventions.
* Participate in regular alert quality reviews, dashboard audits, and SLO compliance checks.
* Maintain accurate documentation of monitoring configurations, integrations, and architectural decisions.
* Creates and maintains knowledge articles to be used internally and/or externally for training, best practices, solutions, or processes relating to applications, environments, and related technologies.

**Infrastructure operations & support**

* Analyses and troubleshoots Microsoft and UNIX/Linux server configurations and processes.
* Performs moderately complex database administration.
* Monitors data centre networks, infrastructure bandwidth, application health, servers, and other infrastructure; coordinates and communicates with vendors.
* Diagnoses and researches (using knowledge base) application incidents, monitoring alerts, and service requests; provides assistance and guidance to associate operations specialists.
* Adheres to all incident and service request processes and procedures in accordance with established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Diagnoses, researches, and resolves Level-2 technical hardware and software incidents, monitoring alerts, and service requests.
* Works on ad-hoc projects to support Infrastructure Engineering or other departments, as requested.
* Demonstrates a flexible and adaptable approach to work and adjusts to shifts in priorities as the needs of the business change.
* Collaborates with DevOps, Cloud, and application teams to align monitoring coverage with service requirements.

**Education**

A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline is required. In the absence of a degree, equivalent work experience directly related to the key responsibilities of the role will be considered as a substitute for the degree.

**Experience, Skills and Key Competencies**

At least 5+ years of experience in an infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or monitoring engineering role is required, with hands-on experience in Datadog and working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and containerised environments.

Must also be able to demonstrate the following skills and abilities:

**Technical skills**

* Hands-on experience with Datadog — monitors, dashboards, APM, log management, SLOs, and synthetic monitoring.
* Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS required; Azure or GCP a plus) and containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with observability concepts: metrics, traces, and logs.
* Experience with at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) for automation and tooling.
* Working knowledge of monitoring and alerting tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of ITSM concepts and ticketing workflows (Jira, JSM, or ServiceNow).
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft and UNIX/Linux server configurations, Active Directory, and internet protocols (HTTP, FTP, DNS, IP, SSH).

**Soft skills & competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex infrastructure issues under pressure.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills; able to produce runbooks and incident summaries for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Collaborative team player who can work effectively across Engineering, DevOps, and Operations disciplines.
* Self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues before they escalate.
* Flexible and adaptable approach to work; able to adjust to shifts in priorities as the needs of the business change.

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Special Position Requirements**

title: Technical Support/SKIL Instructor
description:
**About NCR Atleos**

NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.

Technical Support Specialist / Learning Instructor

Role Description:

As a Technical Support Specialist / Learning Instructor, you are considered a subject matter expert in NCR Atleos ATM products and act as an advanced level remote support analyst and technical learning instructor. You are part of our support services and learning delivery teams, and your passion for providing exceptional customer service, technical guidance, and effective instruction contributes to our world-class high level of customer satisfaction and associate readiness.

Acting as second line support to NCR Atleos Field Service Technicians and as an instructor for assigned technical learning programs, you will communicate in an open, helpful, and engaging manner with your focus being finding the right solution for each Field Service Technician, learner, and customer. You connect with Field Service Technicians to address questions and resolve various problems, including uncommon or complex issues, knowing when and who to turn to for additional support. You also facilitate classroom, lab, virtual instructor-led, and online learning experiences that enhance technical capability and improve the overall effectiveness of the business unit/organization.

You will have a proactive approach and may handle problems before they start by identifying knowledge gaps, improving course content, creating knowledge articles, and feeding live field learning back into training materials and knowledge systems. No matter the situation, your formal training, technical expertise, available knowledge repositories, and adult learning techniques will allow you to provide Field Service Technicians and learners what they need when they need it. Additionally, you will always be on the lookout for preventative measures you can take, escalate issues appropriately, contribute to continuous improvement, and serve as an ambassador for the NCR Atleos brand.

Your goal is to keep our Field Service Technicians, learners, and customers completely assured and satisfied through your technical expertise, instructional capability, consistent communication, and commitment to quality support and effective learning delivery.

Position Summary & Key Areas of Responsibility

As a Technical Support Specialist / Learning Instructor, you will provide support to Field Service Engineers who will generally be onsite at a customer location and requiring technical assistance.

The support will include problem identification, analysis, diagnosis, and resolution.

You will utilize Knowledge Systems provided by NCR Atleos and other vendors as appropriate to identify solutions to known problems.

You are responsible for ensuring that solutions provided are successful, ensuring first time and long-term resolution of the problem.

If no known solution can be identified, you are responsible for escalation to other support groups where deeper level skilled personnel are available.

You retain ownership of escalated problems/issues through to resolution.

You are responsible for ensuring that NCR Atleos Management is informed if resolution to a problem will take longer than contractual requirements require.

You will provide input to the Knowledge Systems as and when required and create and publish knowledge articles when required.

You will coordinate with your peers, Management, Learning teams, and other support groups in providing part numbers, technical details, field learning, and product/process information to Field Service Technicians and learners.

You will act as a second line escalation point for junior colleagues and provide coaching, mentoring, and technical guidance where required.

You will facilitate course delivery using classroom, lab, VILT (virtual instructor-led training), online, and other approved methods of instruction.

You will execute course delivery according to the published training schedule.

You will maintain classroom facilities, training center, lab environment, training equipment, and learning materials necessary for the class.

You will work collaboratively with and around other team members in a Lab environment.

You will support course development by providing subject matter expertise for assigned products, technical procedures, and service processes.

You will perform course maintenance and identify required updates to course content using existing knowledge, field feedback, service trends, and analytical skills.

You will use a variety of delivery techniques, leveraging formal and informal delivery tools such as virtual classrooms, web conferencing, discussion forums, blogs, wikis, job aids, and short-form instructional videos where applicable.

You may serve as course owner for assigned instructor-led training courses.

You will develop or support performance support materials, including job aids, technical tips, procedural guides, and YouTube-style videos where applicable.

You will mentor new instructors and support knowledge transfer across technical support and learning teams.

You will manage day-to-day operations of the learning center where assigned, including keeping it clean, organized, and ready to support the best learning environment possible.

You will use continuous improvement processes and tools to improve Services Learning and Technical Support processes and increase the value-add provided to our customers.

You will deliver quality support and enhanced results meeting established KPI and Customer SLA requirements.

You will provide onsite and lab support for equipment as required.

You must be willing and able to work flexible schedules, which may include night and weekend shifts, and perform overtime work upon management request or business need.

You will perform travel as required, where applicable.

You must maintain a valid driver’s license where required for in-country teams or travel-related responsibilities.

You will comply with NCR Atleos policies which include but are not limited to:

The Company’s Shared Values and Code of Conduct.

Employee Health and Safety policy and standards.

Accurate timekeeping and records of hours worked.

Company Fleet policies and requirements, where applicable, which include but are not limited to NCR Atleos requirements for safe driving.

You will perform other corresponding duties and tasks in accordance with your qualifications, as directed by Employer.

Basic Qualifications

High School Diploma.

Prior work experience in a Customer Support or Technical Support role is required, with experience supporting customers in the Financial sector and/or Retail and Hospitality sector being a must where applicable.

3–5 years of experience working with, supporting, troubleshooting, or servicing technical equipment, heavy machinery, ATMs, retail technology, networking hardware, or similar technical environments; or an Associate Degree in a technical field or in education.

Experience servicing NCR Atleos supported equipment or equivalent technical platforms is required where applicable.

Must be authorized to work in the country where position is posted.

Must be a local candidate for in-country teams.

PC proficiency.

Proficiency with Windows-based applications/tools and MS Office products.

Good English communication skills and telephony etiquette; other languages may be required for certain teams.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Strong demonstrated public speaking, facilitation, or presentation skills.

Ability to listen and communicate effectively in a professional environment.

Analytical and problem-solving skills.

Strong team player with the ability to work collaboratively in a matrix-managed organization.

Ability to explain technical concepts in clear and understandable terms to Field Service Technicians, learners, and other stakeholders.

Ability to work in an office environment either full time or on a hybrid work model where applicable.

Ability to work collaboratively in a lab environment and support onsite/lab-based technical learning and troubleshooting activities.

Willingness and ability to work flexible schedules, including shift hours, nights, weekends, and overtime as required by business need.

Must have the ability to carry and lift tool kits, training equipment, or parts of varying weights up to 50 lbs. where applicable.

Must be available to work in other training locations as needed, where applicable.

Must have a valid driver’s license where required for in-country teams or travel-related responsibilities.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Education, IT, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Knowledge of Electrical Engineering.

Advanced understanding of Networking Technology.

Previous experience as a field-based Field Service Technician.

Previous experience in a Learning, Education, Technical Training, or Instructor role.

2–3 years teaching adult learners technical topics, including hands-on mechanical, hardware, electrical, or networking modules.

Knowledge of NCR Atleos products, services, tools, and processes.

Experience servicing ATMs, PCs, servers, networking hardware, or related customer service technology.

Experience with course ownership, course maintenance, instructor-led training, virtual instructor-led training, and learning center operations.

Proven ability to work independently, juggle multiple projects, and adapt to frequent change.

Ability to build rapport with internal and external customers.

Ability to self-manage while maintaining accountability for support quality, learning delivery, and operational readiness.

Ability to manage and maintain a training center or lab environment in a manner that is conducive to learning.

Proven ability to learn quickly and translate field experience into training materials, knowledge articles, and performance support content.

Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job.

**EEO Statement**  
NCR Atleos is an equal-opportunity employer. It is NCR Atleos policy to hire, train, promote, and pay associates based on their job-related qualifications, ability, and performance, without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, marital status, age, mental or physical disability, genetic information, medical condition, military or veteran status, or any other factor protected by law.

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**

To ALL recruitment agencies: NCR Atleos only accepts resumes from agencies on the NCR Atleos preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, NCR Atleos employees, or any NCR Atleos facility. NCR Atleos is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: Senior Analyst - IT Infrastructure
description:
The Senior Analyst IT Infrastructure will be responsible for assisting with day-to-day IT support for local end-users while coordinating seamlessly with our global IT framework. Managing a highly technical environment of approximately 150 developers, 300 endpoints (mixed Mac and Windows), and corporate conference rooms, this role focuses on maintaining strict SLAs, elevating the customer service experience, and driving hands-on deskside support.
  
  
This is a 100% on-site, highly hands-on role designed for a professional capable of understanding complex infrastructure, working with global teams, managing asset lifecycles under local regulatory frameworks, and acting as the operational anchor for the site.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* SLA & Ticket Management: Responsible for supporting all incidents and service requests within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs), while assisting the Manager with escalations.
* Service Management Platforms: Fully understand, leverage, and demonstrate strong working knowledge of ServiceNow and Jira Service Management to track, manage, and optimize ticketing, customer-friendly support methods, and developer workflows.
* Asset & CMDB Governance: Own the local IT lifecycle from procurement to disposal. Ensure absolute integrity of the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) by meticulously tracking, auditing, and updating configurations and status changes for all local hardware and software assets.
* SEZ Regulatory Compliance: Direct and manage the movement of IT assets in strict accordance with Special Economic Zone (SEZ) regulations and STPI guidelines. Handle the end-to-end documentation for procurement, local clearances, and the formal bonding and de-bonding of infrastructure assets.

**Key responsibilities skills required:**

* Lead endpoint engineering and workplace technology operations, with primary responsibility for Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, Windows endpoints and VDI environments.

* Manage and troubleshoot Windows workstation imaging and deployment infrastructure, including task sequences, drivers, operating system builds and image lifecycle management.
* Provide hands-on technical support and engineering for VDI platforms, preferably Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) and/or VMware Horizon, including desktop delivery, application access, user-profile and performance-related issues.
* Troubleshoot Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) device identity, authentication, device registration and endpoint-management integration issues.
* Knowledge of PowerShell scripts and automation for endpoint configuration, deployment, remediation, health checks, reporting and repetitive administrative activities.
* Analyse recurring endpoint and VDI incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and implement permanent technical fixes and preventive improvements rather than relying solely on incident resolution.
* Lead technical activities for Windows upgrades, Intune/SCCM migrations, Autopilot adoption, VDI initiatives, application deployments, endpoint-security changes and workplace technology transformations.
* Monitor and improve endpoint health, deployment success, patch compliance, configuration compliance and VDI service performance, producing actionable technical and management reporting.
* Own and coordinate L2/L3 technical escalations involving endpoint, VDI and associated infrastructure dependencies, engaging Microsoft, Citrix, VMware, OEM and other technology vendors where required.
* Provide advanced support for VIP and business-critical users, combining deep technical troubleshooting with discretion, responsiveness and clear communication.
* Maintain endpoint-related technical documentation, SOPs, engineering standards, knowledge articles, build documentation and troubleshooting guides.
* Support basic troubleshooting of network, server, Cisco and Azure dependencies affecting endpoint and VDI services, engaging specialist infrastructure teams for deeper resolution where necessary.
* Apply ITIL and project-management practices to endpoint and workplace technology initiatives while maintaining a strong focus on hands-on engineering, automation and continuous technical improvement.

**Key skills required:**

* BTech/BE in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, with 3–4 years of relevant experience in endpoint engineering, workplace technology, EUC, or infrastructure operations.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Intune, including device enrolment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, application deployment, endpoint security policies, remediation, troubleshooting and device lifecycle management.
* Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft SCCM/MECM, including application/package deployment, software distribution, collections, compliance, patching, client troubleshooting and operating system deployment.
* Strong understanding of Windows Endpoint engineering, including Windows 11 administration, Group Policy, registry, PowerShell-based troubleshooting and enterprise workstation configurations.
* Hands-on experience with Windows Autopilot and modern endpoint provisioning, including troubleshooting enrolment and deployment-related issues.
* Strong experience with OS deployment and workstation imaging, including task sequences, driver management, image maintenance and deployment troubleshooting.
* Strong VDI expertise, preferably across technologies such as Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) and/or VMware Horizon, with hands-on experience supporting virtual desktop environments, application delivery, profile-related issues and performance troubleshooting.

* Practical experience with PowerShell scripting and automation for endpoint administration, remediation, configuration and operational efficiency.
* Strong troubleshooting capability across endpoints, VDI, network and infrastructure dependencies, with the ability to perform structured root-cause analysis rather than only first-level desktop support.

* Knowledge in IT asset management and end-to-end endpoint lifecycle management, including provisioning, refreshing, secure data wiping, decommissioning and disposal.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms, with experience in incident, service request, problem and change management.
* Ability to manage complex L2/L3 escalations, including collaboration with Microsoft, Citrix, VMware, OEMs and other technology vendors where applicable.
* Experience supporting VIP and business-critical users, with the ability to diagnose complex technical issues while maintaining strong communication and responsiveness.
* Experience with technical projects and enterprise endpoint transformations, such as Intune migration, SCCM/MECM modernisation, Windows upgrades, Autopilot adoption, VDI deployment or endpoint-security initiatives.

About the Role
  
  
The EDI Support Subject Matter Expert (SME) serves as a key resource supporting the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement and strategic development of Castrol's EDI ecosystem. This role provides functional and technical expertise across EDI operations, SAP integrations, trading partner onboarding, issue resolution, and process optimization.
  
  
The position partners closely with business teams, IT&S, external vendors, and trading partners to support seamless electronic transactions and ensure critical customer-facing processes operate efficiently.

* Analyze and support resolution of EDI transaction, mapping, and integration issues.

* Identify exception trends and create action plans to improve performance.
* Support resolution of complex document processing and interface exceptions.
* Manage Key Customer Scorecards and KPI’s to expected levels

Trading Partner Onboarding
  
  

* Manage E2E onboarding of new customers, distributors, and other trading partners.
* Convert customer EDI requirements and specifications into process and technical specifications.
* Create implementation project plans and coordinate with technical teams to ensure scope and on-time delivery
* Coordinate testing activities and support successful implementation and go-live activities.
* Validate transaction compliance and connectivity requirements.

Mapping & Integration Support
  
  

* Support EDI mapping development, enhancement, and validation activities.
* Provide expertise on SAP IDOCs, Order-to-Cash and logistics processes, and EDI transaction standards.
* Partner with business stakeholders, IT&S and integration providers to evaluate and validate proposed solutions.
* Assist with testing, defect analysis, and production readiness activities.

Subject Matter Expertise & Consultation

* Creation of Support documentation, training materials, operational procedures, and EDI Specifications.
* Serve as an escalation resource for complex EDI-related issues.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Identify opportunities to improve EDI processes, monitoring, and support effectiveness.
* Recommend automation and process enhancements that improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Support digital transformation initiatives involving integration and customer connectivity.

**Experience Required**

* Expertise in supporting Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) business processes.
* Advanced knowledge of ANSI X12, EDIFACT and cXML transaction standards.
* Expertise troubleshooting EDI transaction delivery, mappings, and document flows.
* Deep understanding of SAP IDOCs used in Order-to-Cash and logistics processes
* Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Demonstrable capability to work effectively across cross-functional business and technical teams.
* Expertise with OpenText/GXS, SPS Commerce, or similar EDI platforms.
* Expertise supporting customer onboarding and trading partner implementations.
* Expertise developing and validating EDI mappings.
* Advanced Knowledge of operational support models and incident management processes. ITIL Certification a plus

* Played a significant role in at least one major ERP Project

* Practical knowledge of WebLogic domains and clusters, Admin/Managed Servers, JVM, JDBC, JMS, security, deployments and performance troubleshooting

* Working knowledge of Oracle SQL/PLSQL and WebLogic Scripting Tool (WLST)

* Knowledge of High Availability, resilience and Disaster Recovery in middleware environments

Exposure to

would be beneficial.

title: Associate/Senior Associate - Service Desk Improvement
description:
### **Description**

The Associate / Senior Associate - Service Desk Improvement provides first-line support through telephone, portal, chat and email. The role records, categorises, priorities, diagnoses and resolves incidents, fulfils approved standard requests, and retains ownership of the customer experience when work is escalated. The Senior Associate operates with greater independence on complex first-line issues, supports shift handovers and quality, coaches colleagues, and contributes to knowledge and controlled shift-left. The role does not own specialist engineering, security investigation, application development or infrastructure administration unless an activity has been formally documented, trained, authorised and controlled for Service Desk fulfilment.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Core responsibilities**

* Act as a professional single point of contact for IT incidents and service requests through supported channels; verify user identity and capture the affected service, device, location, business impact and required evidence.
* Create, categorise and prioritise tickets accurately using agreed impact and urgency criteria; check known incidents and outages; set clear expectations and provide meaningful updates.
* Perform structured first-line diagnosis using approved knowledge, remote-support tools and troubleshooting methods; resolve within authorised capability and confirm restoration before closure.
* Fulfil approved standard requests only when required information, approvals and controls are present; route privileged, non-standard, engineering or business-approval work to the accountable team.
* Identify potential major incidents and security concerns promptly and engage the defined escalation process without attempting unauthorised investigation or remediation.
* Escalate unresolved issues with complete diagnostics, error details, screenshots/logs where appropriate, actions already taken, business impact and a clear next-step request.
* Retain end-to-end ownership of the customer experience after escalation by monitoring SLA position, following up with resolver teams, coordinating callbacks and confirming user acceptance before closure.
* Maintain high-quality work notes, resolution details, closure codes and shift handovers to support auditability, reporting, Problem Management and continual improvement.
* Use approved knowledge articles, identify gaps or outdated content, and create or improve draft knowledge from repeatable resolutions.
* Follow security, privacy, identity-verification, least-privilege and data-handling requirements always.
* Contribute to service measures including response, first-contact/first-line resolution, SLA compliance, aged backlog, reopen rate, misrouting, ticket quality, knowledge use and customer experience.
* Senior Associate: provide floor support, coach Associates, review ticket and escalation quality, support queue health and shift handover, and help validate new first-line procedures before adoption.

**First-line service coverage**

* Access, identity and JML assistance: password reset, account unlock, MFA, Okta and YubiKey support; approved mailbox, distribution/security group and collaboration access; joiner support for missing access/apps; accurate routing of mover, leaver, guest, auditor and privileged-access requests.
* Devices and software: Windows laptop/desktop triage, peripheral and printer troubleshooting, approved application installation/removal through Company Portal, Intune or SCCM, device-build evidence capture, mobile/tablet setup and enrolment, and lost/stolen device workflow initiation.
* Email, collaboration and file services: Outlook, Exchange/Microsoft 365, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, shared mailboxes, delegation, supported conferencing tools, Copilot access/standard-use triage, file sharing, removable-media requests and document-productivity tools.
* Connectivity and remote working: VPN, wireless, office connectivity, Citrix, client/external portal access, mobile Wi-Fi/tethering guidance and initial diagnostics for SFTP or allow-list requests before specialist routing.
* Meeting rooms, telephony and voice: displays, cameras, microphones, room technology, ClickShare, Teams Voice, Avaya, Genesys, digital fax, call recording, digital dictation and voice-recognition applications at first-line scope.
* Business and divisional applications: consistent intake, access triage, installation/add-in support where documented, outage identification and evidence-led routing to Product Support, line-of-business teams or vendors.
* Reporting and analytics: first-line access and client/browser diagnosis for Power BI, QlikView and SSRS; route workspace, gateway, dataset, report logic and underlying-data issues to the accountable owner.
* Infrastructure-generated contacts: capture user impact and correlate contacts for availability, backup/restore, cloud, database, server, network, capacity or continuity issues; specialist teams retain engineering accountability.

**Service boundaries**

* Out of scope unless formally shifted left: network/firewall configuration, server provisioning or patching, database administration, cloud/VM engineering, backup-policy or disaster-recovery design, security monitoring/investigation, application development/defect correction, procurement decisions and business-process support owned by Finance, Payroll, HR or divisional teams.
* Unsupported, retired or vendor-owned products must be routed according to the approved application support matrix; the Service Desk must not imply technical ownership where none is assigned.

**Experience & Education\***

* Associate: typically 1-5 years of relevant Service Desk, technical support or customer-facing IT support experience.
* Senior Associate: typically 5-9 years of relevant Service Desk experience, including independent handling of complex first-line issues, escalation quality, shift handover and peer support.
* Hands-on use of an ITSM tool such as ServiceNow to log, categorise, prioritise, update, resolve and close incidents and requests.
* Experience supporting users across Microsoft 365, Windows endpoints, identity/authentication, remote working, connectivity, devices and common collaboration tools.
* Experience working to SLAs while maintaining accurate ticket documentation and customer communication.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent recognised undergraduate qualification in technology, computer science, engineering or a related discipline; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
* Role-relevant technical training or certifications are advantageous when supported by demonstrable practical capability.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

**Knowledge, Skill, ability**

* Strong technical troubleshooting across Windows, Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, OneDrive/SharePoint, identity and access, MFA/Okta, VPN, Citrix, wireless, devices, peripherals, printers and approved software.
* Working knowledge of ITIL-aligned Incident Management, Request Fulfilment, Knowledge Management, escalation and Major Incident identification.
* Ability to distinguish an incident from a request, assess impact and urgency, select the correct service/category and gather evidence that enables rapid resolver diagnosis.
* Customer-focused communication: active listening, clear language, expectation management, ownership and professional handling of high-impact or frustrated-user situations.
* Ability to follow documented procedures and security controls, including identity verification, data handling, approvals and least privilege.
* Good written documentation with concise work notes, reproducible diagnostic steps, resolution details and effective handovers.
* Ability to manage competing priorities during high-volume periods, work collaboratively across global resolver teams and adapt to rotational shifts.
* Associate: demonstrates learning agility, procedural discipline and readiness to broaden technical coverage.
* Senior Associate: demonstrates sound judgement, coaching capability, queue awareness, quality focus and confidence challenging incomplete or incorrect routing without losing customer ownership.

**Essential requirement (non-negotiable) \***

* Hands-on Service Desk or equivalent first-line technical/customer support experience at the appropriate Associate or Senior Associate level.
* Demonstrated first-line troubleshooting capability across core workplace technology and authentication/connectivity issues.
* Excellent spoken and written communication with evidence of customer ownership and accurate expectation setting.
* Ability to work through approved rotational shifts supporting global operations from office location only.
* Proven ability to work to SLAs, maintain high-quality ticket records and escalate with complete diagnostic evidence.
* Commitment to security, privacy, identity verification, least privilege and approved procedures.
* Willingness to use and improve knowledge and to learn new services as controlled shift-left is introduced.

**Certification if any:**

* Preferred: ITIL 4 Foundation.
* Preferred: KCS Fundamentals or equivalent knowledge-management training.
* Advantageous: Microsoft 365 Fundamentals, Azure Fundamentals, ServiceNow Fundamentals/CSA exposure, CompTIA A+/Network+ or an equivalent role-relevant certification.
* Certifications support but do not replace demonstrable hands-on Service Desk capability.

  

### **About Davies**

We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses.  
  
We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. We deliver professional services and technology solutions across the risk and insurance value chain, including excellence in claims, underwriting, distribution, regulation & risk, customer experience, human capital, digital transformation & change management.  
  
Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK & the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20-fold, investing heavily in research & development, innovation & automation, colleague development, and client service. Today the group serves more than 1,500 insurance, financial services, public sector, and other highly regulated clients.

title: Technical Specialist MS - Systems
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L3) is responsible for providing a service to clients by proactively identifying and resolving technical incidents and problems. Through pre-emptive service incident and resolution activities, as well as product reviews, operational improvements, operational practices, and quality assurance this role will maintain a high level of service to clients. Their primary objective is to ensure zero missed service level agreement (SLA) conditions. The Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L3) is responsible for managing tickets of high complexity, conducts advanced and complicated tasks, and provides resolution to a diverse range of complex problems. This position uses considerable judgment and independent analysis within defined policies and practices. This role applies analytical thinking and deep technical expertise in achieving client outcomes, while coaching and mentoring junior team members across functions. This role focusses across two or more technology domains - Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications and / or Collaboration etc.
  
  
This role may also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.

* Ensures that assigned infrastructure at the client site is configured, installed, tested, and operational
* Performs necessary checks, apply monitoring tools and respond to alerts

* Assists in analysing, assigning, and escalating support calls
* Investigates third line support calls assigned and identify the root cause of incidents and problems
* Reports and escalates issues to 3rd party vendors if necessary
* Provides continuous feedback to clients and affected parties and update all systems and/or portals as prescribed by NTT
* Proactively identifies opportunities for work optimization including opportunities for automation of work
* Coaches L2 teams for advance technical troubleshooting and behavioural skills
* May manage and implement projects within technology domain, delivering effectively and promptly per client agreed upon requirements and timelines
* May work on implementing and delivering Disaster Recovery functions and tests

**Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:**

* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups
* Ability to plan activities and projects well in advance, and takes into account possible changing circumstances
* Ability to maintain a positive outlook at work
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment
* Ability to work hard and put in longer hours when it is necessary
* Ability to apply active listening techniques such as paraphrasing the message to confirm understanding, probing for further relevant information, and refraining from interrupting
* Ability to adapt to changing circumstances
* Ability to place clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and creating a positive client experience throughout the total client journey

**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience)
* Certifications relevant to the services provided (certifications carry additional weightage on a candidate’s qualification for the role)
* Relevant certifications include:

+ CCNP or equivalent certification
+ CCNP in Security or PCNSE certification or Firewall Vendor related certification is good to have along with advance technical certification like CCIE, CISSP
+ VMware certified Professional: Data Centre Virtualization
+ VMware Certified Specialist – Cloud Provider
+ VMware Site Recovery Manager: Install, Configure, Manage
+ Microsoft Certified: Azure Architect Expert
+ AWS Certified: Solutions Architect Associate
+ Veeam Certified Engineer (VMCE)
+ Rubrik Certified Systems Administrator
+ Zerto, pure, vxrail
+ Google Cloud Platform (gcp)
+ Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (oci)

+ SAP Technology Consultant
+ SAP Certified Technology Associate - SAP HANA 2.0
+ Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional
+ IBM Certified System Administrator - WebSphere Application Server Network

**Required Experience:**

* Seasoned Managed Services experience handling complex cross technology infrastructure
* Seasoned experience required in Engineering function within a medium to large ICT organisation
* Seasoned working knowledge of ITIL processes
* Seasoned experience working with vendors and/or 3rd parties

**Workplace type:**
On-site Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long-term success. We invest over $3.6 billion each year in R&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. description:
**Req ID:**
393623
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

In this role, Candidate is expected with an experience in core areas such as Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting, NAC (Network Access Control), and troubleshooting. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in the administration, upkeep, and upgrade of Cisco ISE solutions and deep understanding of network security concepts, Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting protocols, endpoint profiling, posture assessments, BYOD, Guest, pxGrid, DNAC integration with ISE and network access control (NAC) technologies.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and Implementation: Collaborate with infra and security teams to design, implement and customize Cisco ISE solutions, integrate third party solutions to bolster the security posture of the organization and to meet, security business and regulatory requirements.
* AAA Configuration: Review and configure Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting protocols such as RADIUS and TACACS+ on Cisco ISE for secure network access. Ensure to leverage industry best practices to reduce the attack surface areas.
* Endpoint Profiling: Understand, develop, and maintain endpoint profiling policies to classify and manage devices accessing the network based on their characteristics.
* Network Access Control (NAC): Deploy and manage NAC solutions using Cisco ISE to enforce security policies, monitor network access, and ensure compliance.
* Policy Management: Define and manage access control policies, posture assessments, and identity-based access controls within Cisco ISE.
* Integration and Collaboration: Collaborate with network, security, and IT teams to integrate Cisco ISE with other security solutions (SIEM and log management), identity providers, and network infrastructure components.
* Troubleshooting and Support: Diagnose and resolve complex issues related to Cisco ISE configurations, authentication failures, load balancer, licensing, and network access problems.
* Documentation and Training: Maintain comprehensive documentation of Cisco ISE configurations, policies, and procedures. Develop method and procedures in alignment with Change management best practices and provide training and knowledge transfer to varied team members.
* Upgrade and Patch Management: Plan and execute upgrades, patches, and maintenance activities for Cisco ISE deployments to ensure system stability and security. Escalate and troubleshoot along with Cisco TAC for identified bugs and potential work arounds.
* Integration and Collaboration: Collaborate with network engineers, security teams, and IT stakeholders to integrate Cisco ISE with other security solutions, applications, and network infrastructure components.
