The role holder will configure and support D365, investigate issues, translate Finance requirements into workable solutions, produce documentation and test evidence, and contribute to controlled releases and continuous improvement.

The position requires practical D365 Finance experience. It is not a coordination-only or general business analyst role. The successful candidate must be comfortable working directly in the application, partnering with Finance users and technical teams, and taking assigned work through to a documented and supportable outcome.

**Key Responsibilities**

D365 Functional Support and Configuration

* Provide hands-on functional support across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash and Bank, Fixed Assets, Expense Management, Project Accounting and Financial Reporting.
* Configure approved changes in D365 under the direction and design authority of the D365 Functional Lead.
* Analyse business requirements, current processes and system behaviour; document solution options, functional requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain accurate configuration, process and support documentation so that knowledge is retained within FNZ.

Incident, Close and Operational Support

* Investigate functional incidents and service requests, reproduce issues, identify root causes and coordinate resolution with Finance users, technical teams and vendors.
* Support month-end and year-end close activities, reconciliations and business-critical finance processing, including agreed out-of-hours support where required.
* Distinguish defects, data issues, training needs and enhancement requests, ensuring each is progressed through the appropriate support or change process.
* Contribute to the upkeep of known-error records, support procedures, knowledge articles and recurring-issue analysis.

Change, Testing and Release Delivery

* Prepare functional specifications, process flows, test scenarios, test data and expected results for approved changes.
* Execute system, integration and regression testing; support business users with user acceptance testing and evidence capture.
* Assess the impact of proposed changes on modules, integrations, reporting, data, security and financial controls.
* Support release planning, deployment readiness, post-release validation and early-life support.

Data, Integrations and Reporting

* Support finance master data, financial dimensions, posting profiles, workflows, opening balances, sub-ledger data and intercompany processing.
* Investigate functional issues affecting interfaces with banking, payments, expense, tax, consolidation and reporting platforms.
* Work with Data and Reporting teams to validate D365 outputs and support reconciliation of reports to the general ledger.
* Assist with data migration, cleansing, mapping, validation and reconciliation for future deployments and entity onboarding.

Controls, Documentation and Governance

* Follow Finance Systems governance for demand intake, design approval, environments, testing, release and production change.
* Produce clear and complete evidence for configuration changes, testing, approvals and deployments.
* Support segregation-of-duties reviews, access-control testing, ITGC evidence and audit requests relating to assigned areas.
* Escalate control, data-integrity and operational risks promptly to the D365 Functional Lead.

Continuous Improvement and Knowledge Transfer

* Identify opportunities to use standard D365 capability, simplify processes, reduce manual work and improve user experience.
* Contribute to the prioritised D365 backlog with evidence on business impact, risk, urgency and delivery effort.
* Provide guidance and knowledge transfer to Finance users and Finance Systems colleagues.
* Develop broader cross-module capability while maintaining deeper expertise in allocated functional areas.

**Required Skills and Experience**

Essential

* 5+ years of hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations / Dynamics AX functional experience, with substantial exposure to finance modules.
* Practical configuration experience in at least three core areas such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash and Bank, Fixed Assets, Expense Management or Project Accounting.
* Good understanding of Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash processes, including close, reconciliation and financial-control requirements.
* Experience creating functional requirements, solution documentation, test scripts, test evidence and user guidance.
* Experience investigating production issues and working with technical teams on integrations, data fixes and extensions.
* Experience of system, integration, regression and user acceptance testing, together with controlled release and post-deployment validation.
* Ability to work directly in D365, analyse system behaviour and progress assigned work independently within agreed design and governance standards.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to work effectively with Finance users, global colleagues and external delivery partners.
* Disciplined approach to documentation, knowledge sharing, prioritisation and escalation.

**Preferred**

* Finance or accounting qualification, or equivalent practical experience in a Finance Systems environment.
* Experience in financial services, fintech, asset servicing or another regulated, multi-entity environment.
* Knowledge of IFRS, statutory reporting, segregation of duties and ITGC requirements.
* Experience with D365 Consolidation, Treasury and Cash Management, Project Accounting, Subscription Billing or Revenue Recognition.
* Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Workiva, Azure DevOps or finance-data integrations.
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant Associate certification or equivalent evidence of current D365 Finance capability.

**Success Measures**

* Assigned incidents and service requests are investigated thoroughly, documented clearly and resolved or escalated within agreed priorities.
* Configuration and change deliverables are accurate, supportable and aligned with approved functional designs.
* Testing is comprehensive, with traceable scenarios, results, defects and evidence.
* Month-end, year-end and business-critical processing receive reliable functional support.
* Documentation and knowledge transfer reduce reliance on individual contractors and external partners.
* Continuous-improvement items deliver measurable operational, control or user-experience benefits.
* Finance stakeholders and Finance Systems colleagues experience responsive, practical and dependable support.

**Employment Terms and Ways of Working**

* Permanent, full-time appointment into FNZ Technology (India) Private Limited [legal employing entity to be confirmed by HR].
* Direct reporting line to the Finance Systems Functional Lead - Finance & Operations and integration into the global Finance Systems team.
* Standard FNZ India employment terms, benefits, leave, probation and notice provisions apply, subject to HR confirmation.
* Appointment is subject to satisfactory pre-employment checks, right-to-work verification and any role-specific screening.
* UK/EU hours overlap is expected for regular collaboration, with flexibility around critical close, release and incident periods.
* All work must comply with FNZ information-security, data-protection, acceptable-use, change-control and records-management requirements.

title: Assistant Manager Infrastructure & Network Management
company: Air India SATS Airport Services Private Limited (AISATS)
description:
**Job Title:**
**Assistant Manager – Infrastructure & Network Management**

**Department: Information Technology**

**Location: Gurgaon**

**Reporting to: Head of Technology**

**About the Role**

The role is responsible for managing enterprise IT infrastructure, network operations, systems administration, cloud and hosting environments, security controls, Microsoft platform administration and API integration ecosystems across multiple locations. The position will provide centralized governance while enabling effective support to distributed station-level IT teams, ensuring high availability, performance, security, scalability and operational continuity for business-critical technology services.

The ideal candidate will be a mid-to-senior level professional with 7 - 10+ years of relevant experience in complex, multi-location IT environments, preferably in aviation, logistics, ground handling, transportation, or other distributed operational industries.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Infrastructure & Server Management**

* Design, implement, administer and maintain enterprise IT infrastructure including on-premise servers, cloud infrastructure, virtualization platforms, storage, backup and related systems.
* Manage Windows and Linux server environments, including deployment, configuration, monitoring, patching, performance optimization, hardening and lifecycle management.
* Administer virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or equivalent technologies.
* Ensure server availability, capacity planning, backup readiness and operational resilience across business-critical systems.

**Network Management**

* Manage multi-OEM network infrastructure across centralized and station-level environments, including LAN, WAN, wireless, VPN, routing, switching, routers, switches, load balancers, DNS, DHCP and connectivity services.
* Monitor network health, availability, capacity and performance using enterprise monitoring and alerting tools.
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across multiple stations and coordinate timely resolution with internal teams, OEMs, service providers and vendors.
* Support network optimization initiatives to improve reliability, performance and user experience across locations.

**Cloud & Hosting**

* Administer Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud environments, including cloud resources, hosting platforms, identity integrations, monitoring and governance controls.
* Support cloud infrastructure planning, migration, optimization, high availability, backup and disaster recovery requirements.
* Ensure cloud and hosted environments are aligned with organizational security, compliance, cost and performance expectations.

**Security & Firewall Management**

* Administer firewall configurations, rule changes, access policies, VPNs and network security controls in line with organizational governance standards.
* Perform infrastructure hardening, patch management, vulnerability remediation, audit support and compliance-related activities.
* Coordinate with information security teams to implement security controls, monitor risks and support incident response for infrastructure and network environments.

**API Integration & Management**

* Manage and support enterprise integration services including REST APIs, SOAP web services, API gateways, middleware, managed file transfer, messaging platforms and event-driven integrations.
* Oversee API lifecycle activities including integration design support, deployment coordination, monitoring, performance optimization, troubleshooting and governance.
* Support secure and reliable integration between enterprise applications, operational systems, cloud platforms and third-party systems.
* Coordinate with application, security, cloud and development teams to ensure API availability, security, scalability and compliance.

**Microsoft Ecosystem Administration**

* Administer Microsoft platforms including Azure Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Intune, endpoint management, identity and access management and related policy controls.
* Support user access governance, device compliance, endpoint security policies, licensing coordination and Microsoft platform operational support.
* Ensure Microsoft ecosystem administration is aligned with enterprise security, productivity and governance requirements.

**Multi-Location Operations Support**

* Provide centralized infrastructure and network governance for distributed operations across multiple stations or business locations.
* Support station-level IT teams in troubleshooting, escalations, technology rollouts, documentation and operational issue resolution.
* Ensure standardization of infrastructure processes, monitoring, change control, compliance, documentation and support practices across locations.

**Team, Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, IT teams, OEMs, telecom service providers, cloud partners and technology vendors for operational support and project delivery.
* Manage vendor performance, service reviews, SLA adherence, escalation tracking and technology upgrade planning.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on availability, service quality, automation, risk reduction and operational efficiency.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, SOPs, inventory records, escalation matrices and operational runbooks.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* 7 - 10+ years of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, network administration, systems management, cloud operations, security controls and enterprise integration support.
* Experience in multi-location organizations with distributed IT operations and business-critical infrastructure environments.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong administration experience in Windows Server and Linux environments.
* Hands-on knowledge of virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of network technologies including LAN, WAN, routing, switching, VPN, firewalls, DNS, DHCP, load balancing and wireless infrastructure.
* Experience with multi-OEM network environments and vendor-supported technology landscapes.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience in firewall governance, network security controls, vulnerability remediation, patching and infrastructure hardening.
* Knowledge of API integrations, middleware, API gateways, REST/SOAP services, managed file transfers and messaging platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, ActiveMQ, or Azure Service Bus.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, backup, disaster recovery and troubleshooting tools.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft administration including Azure AD, Microsoft 365, Intune, identity, access, endpoint and policy management.
* Exposure to scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar tools will be an advantage.

**Functional Skills**

* Strong understanding of incident management, change management, problem management and service request fulfilment.
* Ability to develop and maintain documentation, SOPs, governance processes, audit evidence and operational controls.
* Strong troubleshooting skills in distributed, high-availability and operationally sensitive environments.
* Ability to manage priorities, escalations, dependencies and vendor deliverables in a time-bound manner.

**Preferred Experience**

* Prior experience in aviation, airport operations, ground handling, logistics, transportation, manufacturing, or other multi-location operational environments.
* Experience supporting infrastructure for mission-critical applications and 24x7 business operations.
* Experience with hybrid cloud, disaster recovery planning, infrastructure modernization, automation and technology standardization initiatives.
* Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect, CCNA, CCNP, VMware Certified Professional, ITIL Foundation, RHCSA, RHCE, or equivalent will be preferred.

**Key Competencies**

* Ownership mindset with strong accountability for infrastructure availability and operational continuity.
* Leadership capability to manage teams, vendors, escalations and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and decision-making skills.
* Clear communication and documentation skills for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a dynamic, distributed and time-sensitive operational environment.
* Proactive approach to risk identification, service improvement, security and compliance.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to partner with application, security, cloud, operations and business teams.

**Reporting Structure**

* The role will report to the Infrastructure Lead / Head of Technology.
* The role will work closely with application teams, Information security teams, station IT teams, business operations teams, service providers, OEMs and external technology partners.

**Location / Work Environment**

* The role will operate in a multi-location environment with centralized governance and distributed station-level support.
* The position may require coordination across corporate offices, operational stations, data centers, cloud environments, vendors and field IT teams.
* The candidate should be comfortable supporting business-critical operations, managing escalations and participating in planned maintenance, technology rollouts and incident response activities as required.

title: A PKI / ADCS Engineer
description:

Job Description

**Role Purpose**

Band B3

An L3 resource must possess in-depth knowledge of the following skills to meet customer expectations: -Thales Luna SA HSM -Thales CiphertrustManager KMS -Microsoft ADCS PKI

-A PKI / ADCS Engineer is responsible for designing, deploying, and managing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure including Root CA, Intermediate CA, and Issuing CA servers while ensuring secure certificate issuance and validation processes. The role involves hands-on management of Microsoft ADCS components such as NDES (SCEP), CEP/CES services, and integration with Active Directory for auto-enrollment and authentication.
  
-The engineer must manage complete certificate lifecycle activities including certificate request, issuance, renewal, revocation, and troubleshooting of certificate-related issues across users, systems, and applications. Strong understanding of certificate store architecture and certificate chain validation is required to ensure trust relationships within enterprise environments.
  
-The role requires implementation and maintenance of Certificate Policy (CP) and Certification Practice Statement (CPS) aligned to organizational security standards and compliance requirements. The candidate should also manage CRL infrastructure including base CRL and delta CRL, ensuring proper publication and accessibility via CDP and AIA locations.
  
-The engineer should possess strong knowledge of cryptographic principles including asymmetric and symmetric encryption, hashing, and digital signatures along with practical understanding of PKCS standards, Cryptographic Service Providers (CSP), and Key Storage Providers (KSP).
  
-The role involves supporting SSL/TLS certificates across internal and external applications and ensuring adherence to industry standards like X.509 and TLS protocols. Strong troubleshooting skills are required for resolving issues related to certificate enrollment, chain errors, CRL accessibility, and authentication failures.
  
-The candidate must have good understanding of Active Directory including Group Policy, auto-enrollment configuration, and integration with PKI services for enterprise identity and access management.
  
-The role includes ensuring PKI high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery by implementing proper backup, restore, and redundancy mechanisms across CA servers and related infrastructure.
  
-The engineer should work on operational support, monitoring PKI health, performing RCA for incidents, and maintaining documentation for PKI processes and environments.
  
Optional skills include experience with Linux-based certificate management, OpenSSL tools, cloud PKI platforms (Azure/AWS), and HSM integration for secure key management.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).
  
  
Monks is seeking an experienced Operations Manager to steer and scale the Delhi-based production team delivering rapid-turn editorial and marketing content. Sitting at the intersection of operational strategy and daily execution, this role oversees operations across multiple shifts, ensuring high-volume creative work is rigorously prioritized, staffed, reviewed, and delivered.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a seasoned operational leader who brings structure, data-informed rigor, and agility to a fast-moving, continuous delivery environment. You will manage regional capacity and team performance, establish scalable operational frameworks, partner directly with US-based Monks leadership, and serve as a key regional escalation point for senior client stakeholders.
  
  
An interest in AI, emerging technology, and modern creative production models is essential. All briefs, client communications, and creative deliverables will be in English.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead and govern day-to-day operations for the Delhi creative production hub across multiple shifts and concurrent workstreams.
* Serve as a key regional point of contact for US Monks leadership and client stakeholders, translating high-level business priorities into clear operational roadmaps.
* Oversee and optimize the end-to-end creative lifecycle, including intake, prioritization, resource allocation, QA, and delivery.
* Build and maintain regional capacity plans, balancing shifting demand against bandwidth, shift coverage, and project timelines.
* Manage, mentor, and elevate producers, project managers, and shift leads responsible for individual delivery pods.
* Establish and enforce standardized operating procedures (SOPs) across all shifts, including handoff protocols, documentation, version control, and asset packaging.
* Exercise sound operational judgment to optimize workflow continuity—knowing precisely when work stays within a shift and when a global handoff enhances turnaround speed.
* Partner with creative, editorial, and technical leadership to maintain craft quality and brand integrity without compromising delivery velocity.
* Drive client alignment on scope, deadlines, and bandwidth, resolving operational ambiguities independently and escalating to senior leadership only when strategic intervention is necessary.
* Track and evaluate operational health metrics (turnaround times, capacity utilization, SLA adherence, and error rates) to identify bottlenecks and implement continuous workflow improvements.
* Collaborate with AI and creative technology specialists to pilot and integrate automation tools into production pipelines.
* Direct structured team onboarding, cross-training, and the retention of client- and program-specific knowledge.
* Maintain discretion when handling confidential, unreleased, and sensitive client information.

**Experience You Bring**

* 7–10+ years of progressive experience in creative operations, production management, or program management within an agency, media company, or in-house creative organization.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi-shift creative production hubs and mentoring mid-level producers or project managers.
* Strong client-facing communication skills with proven ability to advise senior stakeholders and negotiate competing priorities.
* Demonstrated background managing rapid-turn creative formats (digital marketing, web content, editorial, design, and motion graphics).
* Proven track record of designing, scaling, and maintaining operational processes and QA standards across distributed teams.
* Expertise in capacity planning, resource forecasting, and workflow management platforms (e.g., Jira, Asana, Monday.com, or Airtable).
* Strong analytical problem-solving abilities and comfort operating autonomously within ambiguous, high-tempo environments.
* Experience collaborating across time zones, regional offices, and cross-functional teams.
* Fluency in written and spoken English, paired with polished executive documentation and presentation skills.
* Active interest or experience in integrating AI tools, automation, and workflow innovation into creative production.
* Flexibility to operate within a 24/7 global shift structure and participate in scheduled weekend and holiday leadership rotations.

**Working Model**
This is a hybrid leadership role supporting a global, multi-shift operating model. The Operations Manager will provide leadership coverage across early morning, evening, overnight, and nontraditional shifts. The role requires sufficient schedule flexibility to maintain operational continuity, support planned weekend and holiday coverage rotations, and address urgent escalations. Coverage schedules will be planned in advance wherever possible.
  
  
**About Monks**
Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.
  
  
This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.
  
  
We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
**Company:**
Legend of Toys

**Location:**
Bangalore (on-site, with travel to vendor sites)

**Reports to:**
Program Manager, L.O.T. Build

**Compensation:**
₹8 to 12 LPA, based on experience

**Experience:**
3 to 6 years

About L.O.T. Build

L.O.T. Build is Legend of Toys’ new line of 2D and 3D wooden puzzles and build kits. It includes officially licensed collections (Harry Potter, DC, Looney Tunes and other Warner Bros. properties) and original designs. Every kit is designed and made in India.

We’re growing from an in-house workshop into a wider manufacturing network. We need someone who can make sure that what we promise customers on launch day is actually built, checked, packed and in the warehouse on time.

What you’ll own

**Production planning and capacity**

* Turn the product roadmap and demand forecasts into a production plan, week by week and SKU by SKU
* Plan around laser-cutting capacity. Track machine hours, cut and engrave times per SKU, and how much each run yields
* Flag capacity shortfalls early, with options to fix them (extra shifts, outsourcing, changing the launch order)
* Co-ordinate with the NPD and central procurement for material readiness.

**Vendor development and management**

* Find, assess and bring on outside manufacturing partners (laser cutting, wood and MDF board, printing and decoration, packaging)
* Transfer production to new vendors: cutting files, fit tolerances, sample approval and first-article sign-off
* Run vendor scorecards on quality, on-time delivery, cost and responsiveness, and step in when a vendor is falling short

**Procurement and materials**

* Buy raw materials (plywood and MDF sheets, inserts, packaging, printed collateral) at the right cost and lead time
* Negotiate pricing, MOQs and payment terms, and keep a dependable second source for critical materials
* Keep material planning (BOMs, reorder points, safety stock) in step with production

**Quality control**

* Set QC checkpoints for incoming material, production runs and finished kits: piece count, fit, engraving quality and packaging
* Bring defect and return rates down by fixing problems at the source, working with design and production

**Inventory and fulfilment**

* Own inventory accuracy across raw material, work in progress and finished goods
* Coordinate with the D2C and marketplace teams on stock for launches, limited drops and made-to-order runs
* Manage inbound logistics from vendors and outbound handover to the warehouse

What we’re looking for

**Must have**

* 3 to 6 years in supply chain, production planning or procurement for a consumer product brand
* Hands-on experience managing outside manufacturers, including taking a new vendor from first sample to stable production
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills. You can build and run a production plan, capacity model and inventory tracker yourself
* Comfort on the factory floor. You’ll spend real time at vendor sites
* Clear communication in English and Hindi or Kannada for working with vendors

**Good to have**

* Experience with laser cutting, CNC, wood or MDF products, or kits made of many precise parts
* Background in a D2C startup, where launches are fast and volumes vary
* Familiarity with BIS certification or toy safety compliance

Who will do well here

* You plan ahead and spot problems early, before they turn into missed launches
* You’re comfortable with partial information and still commit to dates
* You hold vendors to high standards and keep good working relationships with them
* You care about the product. People pay us to build something beautiful, and every piece has to fit

Why join

* Build the supply chain for a new category from early on, with real ownership
* Work on officially licensed products from some of the world’s best-known entertainment brands
* Small, fast team with direct access to leadership

**To apply:**
send your CV with a short note on a supply problem you solved and what you changed.

title: Merchandising Operation Team Lead
description:

Catalyst Brands is a leading U.S.-based retail organization formed in 2025 through the merger of JCPenney and SPARC Group, combining multiple iconic fashion brands under one umbrella. The company manages a diversified portfolio of well-known brands including Aéropostale, Brooks Brothers, Nautica, Lucky Brand, and JCPenney. The company emphasizes innovation, digital transformation, and customer-centric strategies to enhance brand value and consumer engagement. Catalyst Brands is expanding its global presence, including a growing capability centre in India that supports technology, digital operations, and analytics. It aims to drive operational excellence and business growth by integrating technology, data-driven insights, and efficient retail practices.

We are seeking a dynamic, detail-oriented, and strategic Merchandising Operations Team Lead to oversee and optimize the end-to-end item creation and supplier onboarding processes across multiple business units. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong leadership capabilities, cross-functional collaboration, and a deep understanding of merchandise operations, item lifecycle management, and retail systems. The role requires interfacing with suppliers, merchants, digital operations, and inventory teams to ensure data integrity, operational efficiency, and flawless execution in JCPenney’s ecosystem.

catalogue management

Enjoy a rewarding career at Catalyst Brands Business Services, where we offer a competitive benefits

title: Manager - RevOps & GTM Engineering: 371
description:
**Born in India, Built for the World**

Amagi is an Emmy®-winning, agentic industry cloud platform powering the modern video economy. We help media companies unify streaming and broadcast workflows, modernize operations, and maximize monetization—from live remote production and real-time ad decisioning to automated playout and global content syndication.

Trusted by a majority of the world's top 50 listed media companies, Amagi delivers:

* 9,000+ channels across 300+ content distributors
* 500,000+ hours of content processed
* 26 billion+ monetized ad impressions

﻿﻿﻿

We power marquee brands including CBS, BBC, Warner Bros. Discovery, NBC, NBA, and DAZN—and the world's biggest events: The Olympics, Super Bowl, The Grammys, and the US Presidential Debate.

Amagi is built on the belief that freedom and happiness are essential for people to do their best work. We call it the Amagi Way: a unique DNA of goodness, purpose, and innovation that shapes how we work, the teams we build, and the impact we want to make together. Over the last two decades, it has been the driving force behind how we have redefined the video economy while contributing to the communities around us.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and listed on the BSE and NSE, Amagi is a global team of 1,000+ people spread across offices in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.

To learn more about our impact, we invite you to explore here.

**Work Mode                   : In-Office**

**Location                        : Bengaluru (Bannerghatta Road)**

**Job Profile:**

Amagi is hiring a Marketing Operations Lead to own the systems, data, and automation that power our GTM engine. This is not a traditional MOps seat - it sits at the intersection of marketing operations and GTM engineering. You’ll run the full marketing-ops backbone (campaign ops, lead lifecycle, attribution, database hygiene) while building AI-native automations that eliminate manual work across Sales, Marketing, and RevOps. If you instinctively reach for a Claude + Clay workflow before a spreadsheet, this is your playground - and you’ll own the reporting layer leadership runs on, accountable for turning dashboards into decisions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Marketing Operations Ownership**

Own the marketing-ops backbone: campaign operations, lead lifecycle, scoring/routing, attribution, and database hygiene across the funnel.

Administer HubSpot and Salesforce hands-on — objects, workflows, fields, and integration — keeping Salesforce as the single source of truth.

Drive SLA adherence and clean handoffs between Marketing, BDR/SDR, and Sales.

**AI-Native Automation & GTM Engineering**

Build end-to-end automations using a Claude + Clay combination plus n8n / Make to enrich, research, and act on data with minimal human overhead.

Stand up advanced enrichment and account-intelligence pipelines (ICP matching, contact/title enrichment, ABM, outreach automation).

Proactively identify automation opportunities; ensure workflows are scalable, fail-safe, and maintainable.

**Reporting That Drives Outcomes**

Own reporting and dashboards across HubSpot, Salesforce, and the GTM stack for stakeholders up to leadership.

Translate pipeline, campaign, and funnel data into actionable recommendations — and own the follow-through.

Use SQL (and Python where useful) to extract, transform, and analyze data across systems; run a 30-60-90 reporting cadence.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

Partner with Sales, SalesOps, BDRs, PMM, and Leadership to turn business needs into scalable systems.

Document workflows and data flows, train the team, and support rapid deploy-measure-iterate experiments.

**Skills and Expertise Required:**

AI-native operator: fluent in applying LLMs (Claude in particular) to design and ship real workflows — not just prompt occasionally.

Hands-on, advanced proficiency with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Clay (all must-have).

Proven ability to build automations with Claude + Clay and orchestration tools (n8n / Make); SQL for querying GTM data.

Reporting and dashboarding, with the judgment to turn data into action.

Strong grasp of GTM workflows: lead routing, scoring, ICP matching, ABM automation, attribution, and pipeline hygiene.

**Competencies**

Funnel & lifecycle ownership: govern lead lifecycle and stage definitions (Inquiry → MQL → SQL → Opportunity), scoring models, and routing rules.

Attribution & measurement: stand up and defend a campaign measurement and multi-touch attribution methodology tying activity to pipeline and revenue.

Campaign ops & data governance: own campaign setup, UTM/taxonomy, segmentation, QA, and database health (dedupe, normalization, enrichment, compliance).

Martech stack ownership: administer, evaluate, and rationalize the stack; manage vendors, renewals, integrations, and license/credit utilization.

Planning & stakeholder leadership: partner on target-setting and multi-BU campaign governance; drive cross-functional alignment on process, SLAs, and a single source of truth.

**Good-to-Have**

Python; warehouse / BI exposure (Databricks, Looker / LookML basics).

B2B SaaS GTM experience (post-IPO / high-growth); familiarity with Gong Engage, Outreach, or Swoogo.

**Who You Are**

AI-first by default: you reach for a Claude-powered workflow before a manual process and treat LLMs as core to how you operate.

Hands-on operator: equally at home building enrichment in Clay, configuring Salesforce and HubSpot, and reviewing pipeline with leadership.

A systems thinker with a bias for automation, strong ownership, and a builder’s instinct in high-growth environments.

You flag data-quality issues honestly rather than shipping polished-but-wrong output.

**Life at Amagi:**

Amagi is an equal opportunity employer. Our culture is built around four values that show up in how we work every day.

* **Be Vulnerable, Be You.**
  Authenticity is our baseline.
* **Goodness Wins.**
  We always lead with integrity.
* **Have Fun with Challenges.**
  We see obstacles as opportunities, not roadblocks.
* **Think Macro, Do Micro.**
  We dream big but execute with relentless precision.

﻿

**A Place That Takes Care of You:**

We care about you as a whole person, and our offerings reflect that. You and your loved ones have access to comprehensive health insurance and our Employee Assistance Program, which covers mental health counselling, financial and legal guidance, and diet and nutrition support. Our office spaces are naturally lit and ventilated, with nutritious meals available every day. An on-site gym and wellness rooms are available for you to rejuvenate. We believe good work should transcend building a great product. Our Employee Resource Group gives you a community within the company. Our volunteering programs and community initiatives give you ways to contribute to the world outside of it.

title: Regional Workplace Manager
description:
**Job Title**
Regional Workplace Manager
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
A regional leadership role responsible for managing workplace operations, people, suppliers, budgets, and compliance across a multi-site portfolio. The position focuses on delivering a best-in-class workplace experience while ensuring operational efficiency, client satisfaction, and service excellence.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Purpose**
As a key member of a global team, responsible for service delivery and ownership of the appropriate defined geographical region of the Client’s estate, ensuring services are delivered to agreed contractual service quality, commercial and compliance requirements.
  
  
**Key Interfaces**
Client Workplace Director(s), dedicated Service Partner Account-based team (Regional Workplace Managers, Workplace Managers and other team members), Client colleagues, contracted third party service providers and Platform team members.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
***Leadership***

* To be the visible leader of the Workplace team across the defined geographical region of the portfolio.
* To own and be accountable for the working environments within the region, to ensure a consistent high quality workplace experience for colleagues and visitors at all times.
* Line management of the Workplace Managers across the region, ensuring full compliance with both Service Partner processes and expectations and client requirements as these may change from time to time.
* Lead, coach and develop Workplace Managers and facilitate their cross collaboration, promoting consistent leadership capability, operational excellence, succession planning and a culture of continuous improvement across the region.
* To understand and live the client's values at all times, to be able to articulate what they mean and how they are applied in the execution of RWM responsibilities, and to ensure that all members of the regional team are able to do the same.
* To understand, commit to, uphold and be able to articulate the Operating Principles of this Agreement.
* To understand client's priorities globally and as they apply to the region.
* To understand and be able to articulate the vision for ‘next generation’ client's workplaces being delivered throughout the portfolio.
* To ensure the resources deployed in the region are appropriate at all times, and where adjustments are required to provide an evidenced case to the client's Regional Director for the region.
* To ensure that all direct reports have in place a measurable Development Plan identifying a clear career path and how to achieve it.
* To raise any matters of non-compliant performance and conduct of the Service Partner team in the region with line management and/or the Service Partner Human Resources, collating and providing evidence as required. Ensure client's Regional Director is informed of performance concerns and issues.

***Supply chain***

* To ensure all third-party services are delivered to the commitments of the global contract.
* Provide regional governance of supplier performance through regular performance reviews contract compliance monitoring, service improvement planning and relationship management.
* With Regional Directors, analyse supplier performance across the regional portfolio, identifying trends, risks and opportunities for service improvement.
* To recommend changes to third party supplier arrangements where service quality, commercial or compliance matters are compromised.

***Service quality***

* To regularly visit all locations within the region, depending on location of region.
* To establish and maintain relations with key client's colleagues in the region, as the trusted source of assistance and support as required.
* To provide an effective and responsive service to remotely managed locations, leveraging the supply chain where possible.
* Ensure workplace experience strategies, standards and initiatives are implemented consistently across the region, monitoring adoption, sharing best practice and supporting Workplace Managers in successful delivery.
* To regularly interact with fellow RWMs in other regions and to identify and share innovations with the RWM network for the benefit of the global contract.
* To manage the 9-point Key Performance Indicator (KPI) system for the region – based on colleague, commercial and compliance – and provide management reporting as required.
* Monitor operational performance across the regional portfolio through audits, KPIs, inspections and service reporting, ensuring corrective actions are implemented where required.
* To effectively manage minor works as directed by client and ensure that the appropriate resources are deployed in each case.
* To ensure that all Workplace Guides (full services directory) for locations across the region remain up to date at all times ensuring the updated guide is delivered to the client Change Management lead.
* To work closely with the client's IT team to ensure a seamless service across the region in areas such as access and security, visitor management, desktop IT, network availability and reprographics.
* To engage with the Service Partner published Research & Insight material and webinars to ensure access to evolving best practice in workplace management and as a contribution to continuous improvement in the role.

***Commercial***

* To effectively and diligently manage cost against budget for the region, reporting as required, and identifying potential cost savings opportunities when they arise.
* To identify any risks or threats to meeting budget as soon as they are known.
* Review regional financial performance, identifying improvements for operational efficiency, reviewing recommendations with Regional Director and Service Partner Finance Lead as required to retain approvals for implementation.

***Compliance***

* To effectively and diligently manage commercial risk in the region, maintaining an up to date register, as required to minimise and mitigate the potential effects of known and unforeseen risks.
* To effectively and diligently manage health and safety in the region, minimising or removing the potential for lost time incidents, completing all required audit requests, and liaising with specialist colleagues are required to deliver the service.
* To ensure all client's workplaces comply with defined foundation standards (‘client Workplace’) using the assessment tool as directed, reporting and costing upgrades where required to maintain alignment.
* To effectively and diligently manage sustainability within the region as directed by the client.
* To effectively and diligently manage the regional requirements of the client's Business Continuity Programme (BCP) within the region.

**Why join Cushman & Wakefield?**
As one of the leading global real estate services firms transforming the way people work, shop and live working at Cushman & Wakefield means you will benefit from;
  
  

* Being part of a growing global company;
* Career development and a promote from within culture;
* An organisation committed to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to providing work-life balance for our people in an inclusive, rewarding environment.
  
  
We achieve this by providing a flexible and agile work environment by focusing on technology and autonomy to help our people achieve their career ambitions. We focus on career progression and foster a promotion from within culture, leveraging global opportunities to ensure we retain our top talent. We encourage continuous learning and development opportunities to develop personal, professional and technical capabilities, and we reward with a comprehensive employee benefits program.
  
  
**We have a vision of the future, where people simply belong.**
That's why we support and celebrate inclusive causes, not just on days of recognition throughout the year, but every day. We embrace diversity across race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or persons with disabilities or protected veteran status. We ensure DEI is part of our DNA as a global community - it means we go way beyond than just talking about it - we live it. If you want to live it too, join us.

title: Planning Lead
description:
Role purpose

The Planning Manager leads end-to-end demand, supply, production and inventory planning for the Vision Care business. The role ensures reliable product availability, optimized inventory and efficient use of manufacturing and distribution capacity while balancing customer service, cost and working-capital objectives.

Key responsibilities

1. Sales and operations planning

•Lead the monthly S&OP/IBP cycle across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Manufacturing, Procurement and Logistics.

•Consolidate demand, capacity, supply, inventory and financial plans.

•Identify gaps and scenarios and facilitate management decisions.

•Maintain one agreed operational plan and track actions from planning reviews.

•Translate annual business plans into monthly and weekly operational plans.

2. Demand planning

•Lead statistical forecasting and market-input collection for lenses, coatings, consumables and related products.

•Review historical sales, seasonality, promotions, launches, tenders and customer trends.

•Challenge assumptions and resolve differences between commercial forecasts and statistical demand.

•Manage forecast accuracy and bias by product family, channel and region.

•Establish planning approaches for new products, phase-outs and intermittent demand.

3. Supply and production/Import planning

•Develop feasible supply and production plans across Import/Local plants, laboratories, distribution centers and external suppliers.

•Balance demand against material, machine, labor and supplier capacity.

•Set production priorities and manage bottlenecks, shortages and backlog.

•Coordinate make-to-stock, make-to-order and prescription-lens requirements.

•Ensure timely escalation of supply risks with clear recovery plans.

• Work with Procurement on supplier constraints, lead times and material availability.

4. Inventory management

• Define inventory targets, safety stocks, reorder parameters and segmentation policies.

• Optimize inventory across raw materials, semi-finished lenses, finished goods and consumables.

• Monitor ageing, slow-moving and obsolete inventory.

• Coordinate mitigation actions for excess stock and expiry or obsolescence risks.

• Improve working capital without compromising agreed service levels.

5. Product lifecycle and launch planning

• Lead supply-chain readiness for new products, coatings, technologies and portfolio changes.

• Coordinate demand ramp-up, material availability, production validation and initial stock.

• Manage end-of-life transitions and depletion of discontinued materials.

• Minimize write-offs and customer-service disruption during portfolio transitions.

6. Customer-service and exception management

• Monitor fill rate, order fulfilment, backorders and delivery performance.

• Lead cross-functional response to major shortages and demand changes.

• Prioritize constrained supply using agreed commercial and customer-service rules.

• Communicate recovery dates, risks and alternatives to relevant stakeholders.

7. Systems, data and process improvement

• Ensure accurate planning parameters and master data in SAP and associated planning tools.

• Drive planning automation, analytics and process standardization.

• Improve forecast models, planning horizons, frozen periods and exception-management rules.

• Support ERP, APS, IBP and digital supply-chain initiatives.

• Maintain planning documentation, controls and audit readiness.

8. Team leadership

• Build analytical, commercial and supply-chain capabilities within the team.

• Promote fact-based decisions, accountability and cross-functional collaboration.

• Establish succession and competency-development plans.

Key performance indicators

• Forecast accuracy and forecast bias

• Customer service level, OTIF and fill rate

• Production-plan adherence

• Inventory value, days of inventory and inventory turns

• Slow-moving and obsolete inventory

• Backorder value and ageing

• Capacity utilization

• Planning master-data accuracy

• S&OP action closure and decision quality

• Working capital and logistics-expedite/Diversion costs

Qualifications

•Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Operations, Engineering (STEM background mandatory).

•Master’s degree or MBA is advantageous.

•APICS CPIM/CSCP, IBF or equivalent certification is advantageous.

•Typically, 6-8 years of supply-chain experience, including at least 4 years in a planning role in handling complex SKU portfolio handling and assortment planning

•Experience in medical technology, optical products, healthcare, precision manufacturing or consumer goods is desirable.

Technical competencies

•Strong knowledge of demand, supply, production and inventory planning.

•Practical experience with S&OP or IBP processes.

•Advanced SAP experience, ideally including SD, MM, PP and APO/IBP.

•Strong Excel and data-analysis capabilities; Power BI or similar tools are advantageous.

•Understanding of MRP, capacity planning, safety stock and product lifecycle management.

•Ability to analyze complex product portfolios with short lead-time and customized-order requirements.

•Familiarity with Lean, continuous improvement and root-cause analysis.

•Leadership and behavioral competencies

•Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.

•Ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.

•Clear communication and effective meeting facilitation.

• Customer-focused and commercially aware decision-making.

• Confidence in managing ambiguity, constraints and competing priorities.

• Strong people leadership and coaching capability.

• High ownership, integrity and attention to detail.

title: Global Workplace Manager
description:
**Role: Global Workplace Manager**

**Location: Bangalore**

**Job type: Full time (2 years Contract)**

*This position offers a hybrid work model, allowing flexibility between working from home and our office.. Employees are expected to work 2 days in the office per week.*

**Why QS?**

At QS, we believe that work should empower you. That’s why we foster a flexible working environment that encourages every employee to own their career whilst flourishing personally and professionally. Our commitment to people development is recognised globally: QS is a Gold-accredited Investors in People organisation, placing us among the top 28% of workplaces worldwide. Our company values underpin everything we do – we collaborate, respect and support each other.

It’s our mission to empower motivated people around the world to fulfil their potential through higher education, ensuring that everyone has access to opportunities that change lives.

Our diversity makes us stronger. By sharing our experiences, we learn from one another and achieve more together, driving progress across the sector.

At QS, you’ll be responsible for implementing real change in the international higher education landscape. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that see a positive impact across the business and the wider sector.

We’re confident you’ll feel right at home here. QS was named as one of Newsweek’s Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces® in the UK (October 2023), recognising the respect, trust and appreciation that drive our culture every day.

**The role**

As the Manager, Global Workplace, you will lead the strategic direction and operational delivery of workplace and facilities management across all company sites. You will play a central role in shaping inclusive, sustainable, and service-driven office environments that enhance employee experience and reflect our values, especially in a hybrid, global context.

You will implement a globally consistent yet locally adaptable workplace strategy, integrating real estate, health and safety, sustainability, DEIB, smart technology, and employee wellbeing, while aligning with key business goals such as talent attraction, productivity, and cost optimisation.

You will also set and maintain hospitality-led workplace standards, guiding local Office Managers and Administrators in delivering welcoming, professional, and emotionally engaging workplace experiences. You will lead and mentor the global Workplace function, fostering a cohesive, high-performing team culture across regions, including dotted-line oversight of local workplace leads.

**Role responsibilities**

**Workplace Operations and Facilities Management**

* Lead and mentor a global team of Office Managers and Administrators, fostering a culture of excellence, hospitality, and service.
* Define and uphold consistent standards for workplace experience across all sites, including reception, meeting room readiness, space cleanliness, and sensory environment.
* Manage global lease and co-working agreements (new, existing, renewals), aligned with long-term business needs.
* Ensure all offices are compliant, well-maintained, and supportive of employee needs.
* Oversee vendor and facilities contracts (e.g. catering, cleaning, front-of-house) with a focus on quality of experience as well as cost and compliance, in partnership with Procurement and local People teams and Workplace teams.
* Collaborate with Corporate IT to ensure that AV, hybrid collaboration tools, and digital workplace technology are seamlessly integrated.

**Employee Experience, Culture and Hospitality**

* Champion a hospitality-first approach across all workplace functions, ensuring employees, guests, and executives are welcomed, supported, and impressed from arrival to departure.
* Lead global onboarding experience design, working with local teams to ensure professional, consistent, and branded orientations for all new joiners.
* Drive standards for meeting room setup, internal events, and visitor hosting, aligning with executive expectations and local office culture.
* Lead workplace DEIB efforts to ensure physical spaces reflect company values and are inclusive to all.
* Regularly collect and review feedback on employee workplace satisfaction, and act on findings to continuously improve services.

**Leadership of the Global Office Network**

* Train and develop Office Managers and Administrators on hospitality principles, service language, and brand-aligned space presentation.
* Facilitate a knowledge-sharing network across regions, enabling local teams to adopt best practices in hosting, space design, and event planning.
* Support global campaigns and moments (e.g. company-wide events, DEIB celebrations, sustainability activations) with coordinated execution across all offices.

**Sustainability and Environmental Leadership**

* Lead the Carbon Neutral strategy and annual data submission, and track monthly environmental KPIs (energy use, emissions, waste).
* Maintain sustainability policies and implement green practices across office locations.
* Partner with local offices to drive continuous environmental improvement and reporting.

**Health, Safety, Compliance and Policy Ownership**

* Oversee compliance with health and safety, quality, and energy standards through audits and inspections.
* Own and develop policies for health and safety, sustainability, accessibility, fire safety, and workplace operations.
* Ensure Business Continuity and London Disaster Recovery Plans are up-to-date for all global locations, in line with company policy, and train Workplace team members globally on managing the process.
* Conduct annual system tests and tabletop exercises and support global Disaster Recovery planning efforts.
* Contribute to ISO 27001 compliance by ensuring that physical workplace controls and security measures align with information security requirements.
* Collaborate with Procurement to coordinate the renewal of global corporate insurance policies, ensuring comprehensive risk management across the organisation.
* Oversee the implementation and maintenance of appropriate local insurance coverage in all relevant jurisdictions.

**Smart Workplace Technology and Data Insights**

* Use smart building data (e.g. occupancy sensors, booking systems, environmental sensors) to drive informed decision-making.
* Track and report KPIs such as space utilisation, comfort levels, and energy efficiency.

**Facilities and Project Delivery**

* Project manage global office moves, new openings, and refurbishments, ensuring on-time, on-budget, employee-friendly outcomes.
* Support space planning efforts to align with hybrid work models and team collaboration needs.
* Lead change management and internal communications related to space changes or transitions.

**Strategic Support, Reporting and Budget Oversight**

* Collaborate with the CPO and CFO to manage and optimise the Workplace budget.
* Drive cost savings through data-driven operational improvements, outsourcing, and vendor consolidation.
* Deliver monthly reports to the Executive Leadership Team covering hybrid working trends, sustainability, compliance, space utilisation, employee sentiment, and cost performance.

**Business Support and Event Planning**

* Provide workplace data and compliance documentation to support RFPs and tender responses.
* Plan and deliver global and regional workplace events, including the company’s flagship annual company Collab events.

**Other duties**

* Any other duties that fall within the scope and purpose of the role.

**Key skills and experience**

* Proven leadership experience in global workplace or facilities management, with a focus on employee experience, operational excellence, and regional consistency.
* Strong understanding of hospitality principles and delivering service-oriented environments, ideally with exposure to guest services, corporate hospitality, or premium client-facing environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop diverse, distributed teams, including mentoring Office Managers and Workplace Coordinators.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and partner across Executive, People, IT, Procurement, and Finance functions.
* Skilled in using workplace analytics (e.g. space utilisation, feedback, service trends) to inform planning and continuous improvement.
* Experienced in managing leases, contracts, and vendor relationships, with commercial acumen and attention to service quality.
* Comfortable delivering complex, cross-functional projects such as office moves, event planning, or workplace strategy rollouts.
* Deep commitment to inclusion, wellbeing, sustainability, and accessible workplace design.
* Organised and adaptable, with the ability to manage competing priorities and respond to emerging needs across regions.
* Qualified (or willing to become qualified) as a First Aider and Mental Health First Aider, as well as a Fire Warden. Training provided if needed.

Every space you manage is an opportunity to shape how people feel about coming to work. Lead with empathy, care, and pride, and you’ll create a workplace QSers love to be part of.

**So, who are we and what do we do?**

QS is the world leader in higher education services, analytics, insights and intelligence. From consultancy to student mobility, academic partnerships to branding solutions, our services power both institutional and individual success.

We’re behind the world’s most widely read university rankings (Meltwater 2023). Our QS World University Rankings® reach hundreds of millions, shaping decisions and guiding futures.

Since launching in 1990, our impact and influence have only grown. Today, we work with more than 2,000 of the world’s leading higher education institutions, over 12,000 employers, and governments seeking change and socioeconomic development through higher education.

Join QS and you’ll join an 800-strong community of problem-solvers, creators, collaborators and change-makers based in 40+ countries and 11 international offices, including Australia, Malaysia, India, Romania, Singapore, France, Germany, the USA and our headquarters in London.

With every talented new hire, business acquisition and bold initiative, we’re strengthening our reach and delivering even greater value to institutions and learners worldwide. Are you ready to shape the future of higher education?

**We take investing in our people very seriously.**

* Free subscription to the Calm App – the #1 app for sleep, meditation, and relaxation

* Access to a variety of diversity and inclusion initiatives and groups

**Like what you’ve heard? Great, apply now!**

As a candidate, we know the application and interview process can be daunting and so it’s important that you have a great experience with us. Our dedicated Talent Team will work hard to ensure you are fully informed at all stages, and you are really excited by this opportunity to do meaningful work in the education space.

**Equal opportunities**

QS Quacquarelli Symonds is proud to be a fair and equal organisation where everyone has the same opportunity to achieve their full potential, irrespective of their background or personal attributes. We celebrate our diversity and believe through sharing our experiences we can learn from one another, be stronger together, and enable our business to thrive.
