Our work combines human-centered design, engineering excellence and AI-powered capabilities to solve complex challenges with clarity and precision. Innovation, particularly in the responsible application of AI, is embedded in how teams approach problem-solving and continuous improvement. At Algoworks, growth is continuous and closely tied to impact. Teams collaborate across geographies and disciplines, strengthening outcomes through shared insight and collective expertise. The culture values transparency, open dialogue and an environment where every voice is heard and contribution is recognized. Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact. Follow the video below to know about us! Clipchamp Role Overview We are seeking a world-class, experienced, and proven Revenue Operations leader to strengthen how Algoworks understands, manages, and improves commercial performance. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer and working closely with senior leadership across Sales, Marketing, Delivery, and Technology, this role will be responsible for making the go-to-market (GTM) operating model work better, not simply reporting on its performance. The position combines revenue intelligence with process design, data governance, systems effectiveness, and adoption to create a trusted, forward-looking view of the revenue engine. The role will improve how teams operate from lead generation through revenue realization. This is not a Salesforce architect or engineering role. The successful candidate must understand GTM systems deeply enough to define how they should support the business, identify where processes or data are failing, and work hand-in-hand with technical specialists to implement scalable improvements. Key Responsibilities 1. Executive Revenue Intelligence Create integrated, forward-looking views of pipeline, bookings, backlog, forecast, revenue, and customer growth. Explain material movements, underlying drivers, emerging risks, and growth opportunities in concise, executive-ready terms. Ensure leadership receives actionable insights and recommendations rather than simply reports and dashboards. 2. Commercial Performance & Predictability Evaluate pipeline health, coverage, movement, conversion, sales velocity, deal slippage, and forecast risk. Analyze performance across customers, service lines, markets, geographies, and revenue streams. Recommend focused interventions to improve commercial performance and revenue predictability. 3. Revenue Operating Model Establish clear business definitions for pipeline stages, opportunity categories, forecast classifications, and critical revenue measures. Identify broken handoffs, recurring exceptions, duplicated effort, and unnecessary manual work across the revenue lifecycle. Redesign high-value processes, define required business rules and controls, and drive adoption of the improved operating model. 4. Marketing, Sales & Finance Alignment Connect Marketing activity to qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes, including funnel conversion, lead quality, attribution, and channel effectiveness. Support Sales with pipeline, forecast, conversion, and account insights. Help Finance connect commercial expectations with bookings, backlog, and revenue realization. Create a consistent and trusted fact base across Sales, Marketing, Alliances, Finance, and leadership while respecting each function's responsibilities and decision rights. 5. GTM Systems Effectiveness, Data & CRM Governance Be accountable for the business effectiveness, data quality, governance, and adoption of the GTM technology ecosystem, with Salesforce serving as the primary commercial source of truth. Define business requirements and operating standards for opportunity hygiene, field consistency, close dates, lead and campaign data, source attribution, metric definitions, workflows, reporting discipline, and user adoption. Work hand-in-hand with Salesforce, BI, data, and technology specialists to translate GTM requirements into scalable architecture, integrations, automation, and system improvements. Ensure business outcomes and user adoption remain the primary focus of technology improvements. 6. Strategic Revenue Initiatives, Automation & AI Lead a focused portfolio of initiatives that materially improve revenue visibility, predictability, or operating effectiveness. Frame complex commercial problems, prioritize opportunities by business impact and feasibility, and define the desired operating outcomes. Coordinate implementation with relevant functional and technical specialists. Identify practical applications of analytics, automation, and AI to improve forecasting, data quality, decision support, and recurring revenue processes. Required Technical Skills & Competencies Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field. 10+ years of relevant experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Revenue Intelligence, or Commercial Strategy. At least 5 years in senior roles involving revenue analysis, commercial operations, or cross-functional revenue management. Strong understanding of complex B2B revenue models, including pipeline, forecasting, bookings, backlog, revenue realization, and customer growth. Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to connect revenue expectations to operational and financial outcomes. Deep working knowledge of Salesforce from a Revenue Operations perspective, including data model concepts, workflows, governance, adoption, and integration patterns. Hands-on development is not required. Experience with marketing automation and GTM platforms such as Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, Amplemarket, or comparable tools. Advanced Excel capabilities and experience with BI platforms such as Power BI. Experience defining metrics, analytical frameworks, business requirements, GTM processes, data standards, system adoption measures, and executive reporting. Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive cross-functional outcomes without relying on direct authority. Must-Have Skills Substantial experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Revenue Intelligence, or Commercial Strategy. Experience in senior roles involving revenue analysis, commercial operations, or cross-functional revenue management. Strong understanding of B2B revenue models, pipeline management, forecasting, bookings, backlog, and revenue realization. Strong commercial and financial acumen. Deep working knowledge of Salesforce for Revenue Operations, including governance, data quality, workflows, adoption, and integrations. Advanced Excel skills and experience with BI tools such as Power BI. Experience developing executive-level reporting, defining business metrics, and translating analysis into actionable recommendations. Ability to align Sales, Marketing, Finance, Alliances, and other stakeholders around shared commercial outcomes. Strong process design, analytical, prioritization, and problem-solving capabilities. Good to Have Skills Experience in technology services, SaaS, consulting, cloud, AI, digital engineering, or another complex B2B environment. Experience with marketing automation and GTM platforms such as Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement and Amplemarket. Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude or equivalent platforms to improve analysis, workflows, data quality, or decision support. Exposure to SQL, data modeling, advanced analytics, automation, or AI-enabled decision support. Ability to learn adjacent GTM platforms and technologies quickly. Desired Attributes A strategic thinker who remains grounded in data and measurable business outcomes. Intellectually curious, independent in judgment, and commercially pragmatic. Able to simplify complex business questions and communicate a clear point of view. Constructively challenges inconsistent information and unsupported assumptions. Comfortable working directly with senior executives and functional leaders. Strong at distinguishing between commercial, process, data, and technology issues. Highly structured, proactive, and disciplined in prioritization and follow-through. A collaborative team player with a positive attitude and a great personality.

title: Senior Manager E-commerce & Marketplaces
description:

With an established presence across Amazon India, leading online marketplaces and our own D2C website, we are looking for a capable e-commerce leader to strengthen our online business and drive its next phase of growth.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a commercially driven and people-oriented
**Senior Manager – E-commerce &**

**Online Sales**
to lead our existing team of performance marketing, marketplace and cataloging professionals.

The role requires someone with a strong understanding of how e-commerce businesses operate, from product visibility and online merchandising to advertising effectiveness, sales conversion and profitability.

The selected candidate will be responsible for setting direction, developing the team, reviewing performance and ensuring that our products achieve their full sales potential across online channels.

**This is a business management and team leadership role, rather than a hands-on advertising or catalog execution position.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Growth & Commercial Ownership**

* Take ownership of overall online sales performance, revenue targets and profitability.
* Develop channel-wise and product-wise growth strategies across Amazon India, other marketplaces and the Pegasus website.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales, organic visibility, market share and contribution margins.
* Ensure that advertising expenditure and operational costs are aligned with commercial objectives.
* Drive sustainable business growth through effective planning, prioritization and execution.

**2. Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead and develop an existing team of performance marketers, marketplace specialists and cataloging professionals.
* Establish clear responsibilities, measurable KPIs and accountability across functions.
* Review individual and team performance, provide direction and ensure timely execution.
* Coach team members, resolve operational challenges and build a collaborative, high-performance culture.
* Assess resource requirements, identify capability gaps and improve team productivity.

**3. Performance Marketing & Marketplace Management**

* Provide strategic and technical direction to specialists managing Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads and marketplace promotions.
* Evaluate advertising strategies, campaign structure, budgets and effectiveness.
* Monitor ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, customer acquisition costs, conversion rates and overall advertising efficiency.
* Ensure continuous optimization of advertising spends while balancing revenue growth and profitability.
* Guide the team in improving product visibility, organic rankings and marketplace sales performance.

**4. Product Performance & Online Merchandising**

* Ensure effective listing, positioning and presentation of products across all relevant online channels.
* Oversee catalog quality, content, keywords, images, A+ content, pricing and promotional strategies.
* Monitor product-wise performance and identify opportunities to improve discoverability and conversions.
* Plan and oversee successful launches of new books, series and product categories.
* Coordinate with editorial, product development, marketing, design and inventory teams to ensure products are online-ready and commercially supported.
* Ensure systematic attention to both bestselling and underperforming products.

**5. Performance Reviews & Business Analytics**

* Establish robust reporting and review processes covering sales, advertising, catalog quality and profitability.
* Analyze channel-wise and product-wise performance to identify commercial opportunities and execution gaps.
* Conduct structured reviews with team members and ensure follow-through on agreed actions.
* Prepare monthly business reviews and actionable growth plans for management.
* Take responsibility for achieving agreed targets within approved budgets.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–10 years of relevant experience in e-commerce or online retail.
* Proven experience managing and developing teams handling marketplaces, performance marketing or digital commerce.
* Strong knowledge of Amazon India, including marketplace advertising, catalog management and sales optimization.
* Good understanding of D2C performance marketing, particularly Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Experience managing advertising budgets, sales targets and business performance.
* Strong understanding of online merchandising, product discoverability, conversion optimization and marketplace operations.
* Sound commercial judgment with the ability to balance growth and profitability.
* Strong analytical, communication, people management and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to guide technical specialists, hold teams accountable and deliver measurable business results.

Experience in consumer products, books, toys, educational products, stationery, baby products or similar categories would be an advantage.

**Why Join Pegasus?**

* Lead an established online business with significant growth opportunities.
* Manage an existing team of specialists rather than build operations from scratch.
* Take meaningful ownership of commercial strategy, team performance and business growth.
* Work closely with senior leadership in a growing Indian consumer brand.
* Opportunity to build a scalable and high-performing e-commerce function.

title: MDR Team Lead (India)
description:
**Summary**
Data has never been more valuable and vulnerable. As cybercriminals become more sophisticated and regulations more strict, organizations struggle to answer one key question: “Is my data safe?"
  
  
At Varonis, we see the world of cybersecurity differently. Instead of chasing threats, we believe the most practical approach is protecting data from the inside out. We’ve built the industry’s first fully autonomous Data Security Platform to help our customers dramatically reduce risk with minimal human effort.
  
  
At Varonis, we move fast. We’re an ultra-collaborative company with brilliant people who care deeply about the details. Together, we’re solving interesting and complex puzzles to keep the world’s data safe.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
Varonis MDR team is at the forefront of worldwide data detection and response services. We lead and redefine how data should be monitored, and protected and how data breach incidents should be handled. It’s a 24/7 global security service assisting customers to investigate and respond to security incidents.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced MDR Team Lead who will oversee a team of MDR Security Analysts. This oversight includes training and developing the knowledge and skills needed to execute the MDR mission, ensuring adherence to all operating policies and procedures, ensuring the delivery of the MDR service within all SLAs, and serving as a point of technical and operational escalation for MDR analysts. Data is the #1 target of attackers, and Varonis' Managed Data Detection and Response (MDDR) customers entrust our team with the security of their data. MDR Team Leads are the lynchpin of MDR operations, ensuring the team is working 24x7 to monitor, triage, investigate, and escalate incidents where data is at risk and to ensure we meet operational SLAs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**:**
Technical and operational escalation point for investigations, incidents, and other elements of the MDR service.
  
  

* Validate findings and coordinate investigative efforts with customers and internal teams.
* Ensure all investigative findings are documented and communicated appropriately by the team, including tracking in CRM.
* Lead or attend customer calls and represent the MDR service when required.

Team Management:
  
  

* Lead the recruitment and onboarding of new team members.
* Continuously train the team so they are equipped with the required skills and knowledge to effectively execute the MDR service.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and quarterly SWOT analyses to drive team growth and development.
* Develop strong work relationships within the MDR Team as well as with other departments ex. Product Support, Product Management, Engineering.

Service Management:
  
  

* Assist in the development, documentation, analysis, testing, and modification of Varonis’ threat detection systems, playbooks, runbooks, and the MDR Team operations.
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of all aspects of the MDR service.
* Oversee and execute programs, projects, operational tasks, and responsibilities related to the MDR service.

**Requirements:**

* Proven success in leading and managing within a team-oriented environment.
* 4+ years of experience working in cybersecurity operations in a global cybersecurity company
* 2+ years of experience leading a team.
* Degree or certification(s) in cybersecurity and/or proven ability to execute across cybersecurity operations disciplines, including monitoring, detection, investigation, and incident response.
* Proven ability to deliver security operations service while meeting SLA and other operational requirements.
* Knowledge of common security technologies and tools including network-based (firewall and IDS), host-based (EDR and AV), data-based (DLP and DSPM), and identity-based (PAM and IAM).
* Proven ability to creatively problem-solve when handling complex issues.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent communication skills in English (written and oral) and interpersonal skills (direct reports, colleagues, and customers).
* Attention to detail and the capability to deliver outcomes autonomously.
* This role may require working either a morning shift (6:30 AM–3:30 PM IST) or an afternoon shift (2:00 PM–11:00 PM IST).

title: City Head – Kolkata
description:
ClearrCUT
  
  
Job Description – City Head, Kolkata
  
  
Position: City Head – Kolkata
  
Location: Kolkata, West Bengal
  
Department: City Operations & Business Growth
  
Reporting To: CEO / Management
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The City Head – Kolkata will be responsible for the overall business performance of ClearrCUT across Kolkata. This is a leadership and ownership role covering revenue growth, operations, customer experience, professional/service partner management, team performance, expansion, and profitability.
  
  
The City Head will operate as the business owner for the Kolkata market and will be accountable for achieving monthly targets while maintaining strong service standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Revenue & Business Growth
  
  
- Own and achieve Kolkata's monthly booking, revenue and collection targets.
  
- Develop city-level strategies to increase bookings, repeat customers and average order value.
  
- Identify new customer acquisition and business development opportunities.
  
- Work closely with Marketing and Management on campaigns, offers and growth initiatives.
  
- Track daily, weekly and monthly revenue performance and take corrective action when required.
  
  
2. City Operations
  
  
- Take complete ownership of day-to-day ClearrCUT operations across Kolkata.
  
- Ensure smooth booking allocation, professional availability and timely service execution.
  
- Maintain high service completion rates and minimise cancellations.
  
- Resolve operational bottlenecks quickly and ensure accountability across the team.
  
  
3. Team Leadership & Performance
  
  
- Lead the Operations, Customer Support, Sales/Business Development and city-level execution teams.
  
- Set clear KPIs and individual/team targets.
  
- Conduct regular performance reviews and daily/weekly business reviews.
  
- Identify underperformance and implement improvement plans where required.
  
- Build a performance-driven and accountable work culture.
  
  
4. Professional / Service Partner Management
  
  
- Ensure adequate availability of verified and high-quality service professionals.
  
- Monitor professional performance, attendance, customer ratings and service quality.
  
- Support onboarding and activation of new professionals based on demand.
  
- Maintain healthy professional relationships while enforcing ClearrCUT service standards.
  
  
5. Customer Experience
  
  
- Ensure excellent customer experience from booking to service completion.
  
- Monitor complaints, refunds, cancellations and repeat service issues.
  
- Ensure critical customer complaints are resolved quickly.
  
- Improve customer retention, ratings and repeat booking percentage.
  
  
6. Expansion & Market Development
  
  
- Identify high-potential areas and service categories for expansion across Kolkata.
  
- Build hyperlocal growth plans based on customer demand and professional availability.
  
- Support new category launches and geographical expansion.
  
- Monitor competitor activity and recommend appropriate market actions.
  
  
7. P&L & Cost Control
  
  
- Take ownership of Kolkata city-level profitability.
  
- Monitor revenue, discounts, incentives, refunds and operational expenses.
  
- Improve productivity and control unnecessary operational costs.
  
- Work towards sustainable contribution margin and city profitability.
  
  
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
- Monthly Revenue & Collection Achievement
  
- Booking Growth
  
- Service Completion Rate
  
- Cancellation Rate
  
- Customer Rating & Complaint Resolution
  
- Repeat Customer Rate
  
- Active Professional Count
  
- Professional Utilisation
  
- Team Productivity
  
- Customer Acquisition & Retention
  
- City Contribution Margin / Profitability
  
- Expansion Performance
  
  
Candidate Profile
  
  
- Strong experience in operations, sales, business development or city management.
  
- Experience in home services, beauty & wellness, hyperlocal, marketplace, consumer services or startup operations will be preferred.
  
- Strong leadership and people-management capabilities.
  
- Highly target-oriented with strong execution skills.
  
- Comfortable working with numbers, dashboards and performance metrics.
  
- Ability to solve operational problems independently and make fast decisions.
  
- Strong understanding of the Kolkata market.
  
- Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership.
  
  
What We Expect
  
  
We are looking for a City Leader, not simply an Operations Manager.
  
  
The successful candidate should be capable of taking ownership of the Kolkata business, building a high-performance team, increasing revenue, maintaining excellent customer experience and developing ClearrCUT into a strong and profitable city-level business.
  
  
Core Principle:
  
Own the City. Own the Number. Own the Customer Experience.

title: CMA (COST AND MANAGEMENT ACCOUNTANT)
description:
Gwambo Studios Pvt. Ltd., based in Kolkata, is de Gournay’s Indian production center, specializing in the manufacture of exquisite hand-painted and hand-embroidered wallcoverings. The studio produces bespoke wallcoverings and allied products based on de Gournay’s extensive collection of standard designs as well as concepts and inspirations provided by clients. Each product passes through multiple intricate stages of production, combining artistic craftsmanship, technical expertise and specialized materials to transform design concepts into finished premium wallcoverings tailored to individual client requirements.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a hands-on costing professional who is comfortable working on the factory floor, engaging directly with production teams to understand complex, time-intensive manufacturing processes and translate them into accurate and reliable cost predictions. Working closely with production, accounting and IT development teams, the individual will improve cost capturing mechanism, develop reliable automated costing tools and integrate predictive costing into our ordering software. The role will also, down the line, drive the standardisation and continuous improvement of costing methodologies across our international group, support ERP implementation/enhancement and offer the opportunity to grow into a global costing leadership position.

**Location:**
Kolkata, India (base location will be the factory: Block B, Regent SME Industrial Park, N.H.-6. Village North Mouri, Andul, Howrah, West Bengal, 711302)

**Position:**
Manager - Costing & Cost Control (proposed designation, subject to finalisation)

**Salary:**
As per industry standards (the joiner would be on the payroll of Gwambo Studios Pvt. Ltd.)

Detailed Job Description:

**Key responsibilities would include:**

 Develop a thorough understanding of the company’s products, manufacturing techniques, production workflows and associated cost drivers.

 Map end-to-end production processes and establish appropriate cost elements and cost centres to enable accurate product-level and process-level costing.

 Develop, implement and maintain standardized costing methodologies, master data, SOPs and internal controls covering material consumption, labour hours, process rates, production overheads and other costing assumptions to ensure consistency, accuracy and continuity of the costing processes.

 Prepare, maintain and periodically review factory sales price lists for standard designs in line with approved costing principles and pricing guidelines.

 Analyze and strengthen factory accounting and cost center structures to ensure costs are appropriately captured and classified, with accounting records reasonably reflecting actual production activities and resource utilization on the ground.

 Prepare monthly costing MIS and management reports covering cost trends, standard-versus-actual variances, labour productivity, gross margin calculations and other key cost performance indicators.

 Analyze estimated and standard costs against actual production costs to improve costing accuracy, identify reasoning for variances and drive cost optimization and process efficiency.

 Manage and standardize the costing and quotation process for bespoke orders by ensuring adoption of the existing VEM methodology, while continuously improving and embedding it as a standard part of the costing workflow.

 Provide key cost parameter inputs to production and design teams to optimize production techniques and

designs in line with client budgets and vision.

 Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of variable pay and incentive

mechanisms for production teams.

 Develop standardized costing processes and reporting frameworks across production units to facilitate cost

benchmarking, performance comparisons and effective decision-making.

 Support the development and implementation of a standardized global costing automated system to enable

consistent cost reporting, cross-unit comparability and informed management decision-making.

**Candidate’s Profile**

 Essential

 Qualified Cost and Management Accountant.

 5 years of post-qualification experience in a manufacturing industry. Experience in a design-based industry

would be an added advantage.

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate financial

matters, insights and recommendations to senior management and cross-functional stakeholders.

 Strong hands-on experience in:

 Manufacturing and process costing

 Standard costing and variance analysis

 Cost estimation and quotation preparation

 Labour costing and productivity analysis

 Cost control and optimization

 MIS and management reporting

 Pricing and profitability analysis

 Budgeting and forecasting

 Maintaining costing master data and SOPs

 Inventory accounting and valuation

 Experience in managing and coordinating costing activities, including product costing, cost analysis and costcontrol

processes.

 Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, particularly Production, Procurement, Sales and

Finance, on costing, pricing and process improvement initiatives.

 Strong Excel and ERP skills.

 Act as a problem-solver by identifying costing and operational inefficiencies, analyzing root causes and driving

practical solutions to improve cost visibility, accuracy and control.

 Demonstrate strong ownership and initiative in independently managing responsibilities, driving tasks to

completion and delivering results with minimal supervision.

 Preferred

 Experience in a multinational / international reporting environment.

 Exposure to premium luxury goods industry.

 Experience in first-hand interaction with Senior Management & Promoters.

 Strong commercial orientation and ability to work closely with non-finance stakeholders.

description:
**About Group Bayport**
Group Bayport is a rapidly growing global e-Commerce, B2B2C, B2B and B2C organization and an industry leader in print technology, operating in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, UK, and India through its family of brands – Banner Buzz, Covers & All, Vivyx Printing, Circle One, Giant Media, Neon Earth, Optamark and North Cape.

**Website:**
https://groupbayport.com/about-us/
  
  
**LinkedIn:**
https://www.linkedin.com/company/groupbayport/mycompany/
  
  
**Designation: Senior Manager – Industrial Engineering**
**Location: Gandhinagar, Gujarat**
**About The Role**
The Sr. Manager – Industrial Engineering owns the Industrial Engineering function across all Group Bayport plants and processes — printing, stitching, cutting, and across the Covers & All (outdoor furniture covers, cushions) and BannerBuzz (banners, signage & displays) product lines. This is a senior, cross-plant leadership role: standardising IE method and measurement (SAM/MOST, line balancing, layout re-designing, SMED) across previously fragmented, undocumented practice, and directly supervising the Stitching IE and Plant Area IE teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Plant-Wide IE Leadership


+ Lead plant-level Industrial Engineering strategy across all factory floors — printing, stitching, cutting, and across the Covers & All (outdoor furniture covers, cushions) and BannerBuzz (banners, signage & displays) product lines.
+ Act as direct supervisor for the IE — setting priorities, reviewing output, and developing the team.
+ Standardise IE methodology, templates and reporting formats so results are comparable across areas and roll up cleanly to Management.

* Methods, Layout & Line Balancing


+ Own workstation layout design, line ergonomics and tooling standardisation across all plant areas.
+ Direct line-balancing exercises against Takt Time on printing, stitching, cutting, and across the Covers & All (outdoor furniture covers, cushions) and BannerBuzz (banners, signage & displays) product lines.
+ Review and approve area-level SMED / quick-changeover initiatives before roll-out.

* Time & Motion Standards


+ Own delivery of the Departmental SAM (Standard Allowed Minutes) Catalog, in partnership with MDM team for BOM set-up.
+ Validate area process times against field time-study data before they are published as standard.
+ Sign off the time-study methodology and sample sizes with each Plant Area IE before field work begins.

* Visual Management


+ Implement hourly production tracking boards – with BPM Team.
+ Introduce Poka-Yoke / mistake-proofing where scrap or quality leakage is systemic rather than one-off.

* Cross-Functional Partnership


+ Partner with MDM Team for BOM Preparation for Time Measurement (Crue member size/labour/machine).
+ Partner with the Manager, Global Capacity to feed validated IE process-time data into the Capacity vs Demand model and the monthly Capacity Governance Review.
+ Partner with the Manager, Automation & Business Analyst on layout and line-balancing implications of newly commissioned machines, and on post-commissioning variance audits.
+ Support the Ops Excellence Head on the phased CIP / LDM / VSM roll-out.

**Qualifications & Experience**




+ B.E. / B.Tech in Industrial, Mechanical or Production Engineering; a Master's degree or equivalent Lean/Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher) is preferred.
+ 10–15 years of progressive Industrial Engineering experience in an apparel manufacturing environment, including at least 8 years in a managerial role leading multiple engineers or areas.
+ Demonstrated, hands-on expertise in BOM/SAM/MOST/MTM time-study methods, line balancing, workstation layout design and Takt Time setting.
+ Experience standing up or running a structured time-study or work-study programme, including supervising junior engineers/interns collecting field data.
+ Prior exposure to apparel, soft-furnishing, furniture or comparable multi-SKU manufacturing is preferred, across the Covers & All (outdoor furniture covers, cushions) and BannerBuzz (banners, signage & displays) product lines.
+ Working proficiency in Excel and, ideally, Power BI, for data-driven decisions.

**Skills & Competencies**




+ Senior stakeholder management — comfortable presenting to and being evaluated.
+ People leadership across multiple, physically dispersed teams and areas.
+ Analytical rigor balanced with pragmatic, shop-floor-first problem solving.
+ Structured change management — able to introduce new standards without disrupting live production.
+ Clear written and verbal communication for cross-functional coordination with MDM, Global Capacity and Automation.

**Key Performance Indicators**




+ BOM Preparation for Time Measurement (Crue member size / labour / machine calculation) – SKU wise
+ Departmental SAM Catalog — % of process elements documented and signed off, against plan.
+ Line efficiency / OEE improvement on lines where IE has intervened.
+ On-time delivery of hourly production tracking board roll-out.

Key Responsibilities1. Accounts and Financial Management

* Manage day-to-day accounting, bookkeeping, journal entries, ledger maintenance, and bank reconciliations.
* Prepare and maintain profit and loss statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and other financial reports.
* Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, expense tracking, payment processing, and vendor accounts.
* Monitor cash flow, budgets, expenses, and financial performance.
* Maintain accurate financial records and ensure proper documentation of all transactions.
* Coordinate with auditors, chartered accountants, banks, and other financial institutions as required.

2. GST, Income Tax and Statutory Compliance

* Manage GST-related activities, including invoice verification, input tax credit reconciliation, preparation of GST workings, and coordination and filing of applicable GST returns.
* Handle income tax-related work, including tax computations, advance tax calculations, TDS compliance, and preparation and coordination of income tax return filings.
* Manage TDS calculations, deductions, payments, reconciliations, and applicable returns.
* Maintain statutory registers, tax records, supporting documents, and compliance calendars.
* Track filing deadlines, tax payments, notices, and other statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with the firm's chartered accountant and tax consultants for audits, assessments, tax notices, and complex compliance matters.
* Ensure compliance with applicable financial, taxation, and regulatory requirements.

3. Office Administration and General Management

* Oversee the firm's daily administrative activities and ensure smooth office operations.
* Manage vendors, service providers, office expenses, procurement, and facility-related requirements.
* Develop and implement internal processes, policies, checklists, and standard operating procedures.
* Maintain documentation, contracts, records, and confidential company information.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and implement practical improvements.

4. IT, Systems and Technology Management

* Oversee office IT infrastructure, computers, software, internet connectivity, email systems, printers, and other technology requirements.
* Coordinate with IT vendors and service providers for troubleshooting, maintenance, and upgrades.
* Manage software subscriptions, user access, data backups, and basic cybersecurity practices.
* Ensure proper access controls and confidentiality of financial and client information.
* Identify opportunities to automate accounting, reporting, documentation, and administrative workflows.

5. HR and Team Management

* Coordinate recruitment, onboarding, attendance, leave records, and employee documentation.
* Support payroll processing and coordinate salary-related statutory compliance.
* Set employee responsibilities, monitor performance, and ensure accountability.
* Supervise and coordinate with team members, resolve routine workplace issues, and promote a professional work environment.
* Coordinate training, internal communication, and implementation of company policies.

6. Business Operations and Management Reporting

* Prepare periodic management reports covering expenses, revenue, cash flow, compliance status, and operational performance.
* Monitor key business metrics and provide timely updates to the partners.
* Assist in budgeting, resource planning, cost control, and business planning.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely completion of operational and administrative tasks.
* Identify risks, follow up on pending matters, and proactively resolve issues before they affect business operations.

7. Client and Professional Coordination

* Coordinate with clients, vendors, banks, auditors, chartered accountants, tax consultants, and other professional service providers.
* Support client servicing and ensure timely follow-up on documentation and operational requirements.
* Maintain professional communication and ensure confidentiality in all business dealings.
* Support the partners in implementing business priorities and improving the overall client experience.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. B.Com, M.Com, MBA Finance, or equivalent qualifications are preferred.
* Approximately 5–10 years of relevant experience in accounting, taxation, finance, administration, or general management, preferably in a small or medium-sized organization.
* Strong practical knowledge of accounting principles, bookkeeping, financial statements, and bank reconciliations.
* Hands-on knowledge of GST, TDS, income tax compliance, and statutory filing procedures.
* Experience using accounting software such as Tally Prime, along with MS Excel and other business applications.
* Working knowledge of payroll, budgeting, vendor management, and office administration.
* Ability to coordinate IT systems and external service providers effectively.
* Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* High standards of integrity, confidentiality, accuracy, and accountability.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities independently and meet deadlines.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a
**hands-on General Manager who can manage accounts, taxation, compliance, IT coordination, HR administration, and general office operations under one roof.**

**We prefer someone who has worked in a CA firm, financial services company, consultancy, or SME environment and understands how to manage the practical, day-to-day requirements of a business.**

**The candidate should be comfortable handling routine work personally instead of only delegating tasks. They should also know when to seek support from a chartered accountant, tax expert, IT specialist, or legal professional for complex matters.**

**The role requires a self-driven individual who takes ownership, follows up without constant supervision, maintains accurate records, anticipates deadlines, and ensures that nothing important is overlooked.**

title: Head - Technical Support & Customer Experience
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Motadata builds enterprise software across Observability, AIOps, IT Service Management (ITSM), and infrastructure monitoring. As we advance our Motadata 2.0 transformation, we are looking for a customer-focused technical leader to strengthen global support, improve customer trust, and build a culture of ownership, urgency, and continuous improvement.

Mission: Transform support from a reactive ticket-handling function into a technically strong, accountable, and proactive

customer experience organization.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

•
**Lead global 24×7 support:**
Own support operations across time zones, shift handovers, SLAs, backlog health, escalations,

and major incident communications.

•
**Lead from the front:**
Join critical customer bridges, guide complex investigations, and work directly with engineers when thesituation demands it.

•
**Drive technical resolution:**
Lead troubleshooting across Observability, AIOps, ITSM, network/infrastructure monitoring, Linux,

networking, databases, APIs, integrations, and distributed systems.

•
**Own customer outcomes:**
Ensure clear updates, realistic commitments, end-to-end issue ownership, and follow-through until

the customer impact is addressed.

•
**Improve product quality:**
Drive evidence-based RCAs, prevent repeat incidents, and turn recurring customer pain points into

actionable feedback for Product, Engineering, QA, and Delivery.

•
**Build a high-performance team:**
Develop technical depth, accountability, coaching, escalation judgment, and leadership

capability; address persistent performance gaps.

•
**Scale through AI and automation:**
Improve triage, diagnostics, knowledge reuse, and repetitive workflows to raise productivity without defaulting to additional headcount.

**ROLE PROFILE & SUCCESS MEASURES**

• 15+ years in enterprise software support, technical operations, customer engineering, or a closely related function, including

substantial team/operations leadership.

• Hands-on experience in a software/product company with 300+ employees; experience scaling or transforming support in a

growing organization is strongly preferred.

• Proven ownership of international 24×7 support for enterprise customers, including major incidents and high-pressure escalations.

• Strong domain knowledge in one or more of Observability, AIOps, ITSM, NMS, infrastructure monitoring, or enterprise IT

operations.

• Able to guide technical investigations involving Linux, networking, logs, metrics, databases, APIs, integrations, and

performance issues; comfortable discussing evidence and root cause with Engineering.

• Experience with SLAs, CSAT, backlog management, incident/problem management, knowledge management, and cross-functional product feedback.

**LEADERSHIP BEHAVOUIRS WE VALUE**

•
**Urgency with judgment:**
Moves quickly, makes decisions with available evidence, and communicates risks honestly.

•
**Ground-level ownership:**
Willingly gets into logs, customer calls, and troubleshooting; does not lead only through dashboards

and meetings.

•
**Resourcefulness:**
Uses automation, AI, better workflows, and team capability to improve outcomes with existing resources.

•
**Accountability without blame:**
Challenges delays and weak execution respectfully; brings teams together around customer

impact.

•
**Customer empathy and integrity:**
Communicates transparently, owns mistakes, and never hides behind process or team

boundaries.

**HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED**

• Improved SLA performance, customer satisfaction, and quality of customer communication.

• Faster handling of critical incidents; fewer aged escalations and avoidable handoffs.

• Higher-quality RCAs and a measurable reduction in recurring issues.

• Stronger frontline troubleshooting and fewer avoidable escalations to Engineering.

• Improved team capability, knowledge reuse, and productivity through automation and AI.

This is not a ticket-monitoring role. We need a hands-on leader who can transform the support experience, earn customer trust, and improve the organization while delivering results

title: Manager, Manufacturing Injectables
description:
**Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The role is responsible for ensuring strict cGMP (Current Good Manufacturing Practices) compliance and overseeing end-to-end injectable manufacturing operations for the assigned production line. The role involves supervising aseptic manufacturing activities, ensuring adherence to GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and GDP (Good Documentation Practices) across General, Control, and Aseptic areas. The position is accountable for equipment and line validation status, change control, deviation management, and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) implementation. The role also leads SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) lifecycle management, production planning versus actual performance monitoring, and regulatory readiness. Additionally, the role requires maintaining accurate online documentation systems and aligning operations with USFDA (United States Food and Drug Administration) and ICH (International Council for Harmonisation) requirements.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Ensure and monitor all GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and GDP (Good Documentation Practices) activities, including cleaning and sanitization, across General, Control, and Aseptic areas
* Supervise overall injectable manufacturing operations during assigned shifts, ensuring aseptic compliance
* Ensure all equipment and manufacturing lines are validated and calibrated as per approved schedules
* Generate and track general purchase indents for departmental consumables and production items
* Handle Change Control, Deviations, Investigations, and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) in coordination with QA
* Prepare, review, revise, control, and implement SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) for sterile manufacturing operations
* Prepare production plan vs actual reports on daily and monthly basis based on material availability
* Ensure strict adherence to aseptic techniques and sterilization processes during injectable manufacturing
* Monitor CPPs (Critical Process Parameters) and CQAs (Critical Quality Attributes) during batch execution
* Support internal and external audits and ensure compliance with USFDA and ICH guidelines
* Responsible for preparation & review of the all-master documents of production
* Responsible to update on self-hygiene
* Responsible to attend the training as per training schedule and to ensure training of the team as per TNI

* Responsible to give training to all the subordinates, technicians, and operators of the department.

* Responsible to attend the training as per training schedule and to ensure training as per TNI.

description:

**Job Description:**
GDS Meetings & Events Sourcing Manager
  
  
**Job Title:**
GDS Meetings & Events Sourcing Manager
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The GDS Meetings & Events (M&E) Sourcing Manager will be responsible for the strategic sourcing, contracting and supplier management of hotels, venues, destination management companies (DMCs), event agencies, production houses, transportation providers and other event-related suppliers supporting EY meetings and events globally.
  
  
This role will serve as the subject matter expert for venue and event sourcing, providing commercial guidance and market intelligence to stakeholders while driving value, compliance, cost optimisation and service excellence. The successful candidate will possess strong hospitality industry knowledge, a deep understanding of hotel operations and contracting terminology, and the ability to negotiate complex event agreements across multiple markets. The role will work closely with internal stakeholders, procurement teams, meeting planners and suppliers to deliver sourcing solutions that align with EY's Meetings & Events strategy and policies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategic Venue & Supplier Sourcing

+ Lead venue sourcing activities for meetings, conferences, leadership events, training programmes, offsites and client-facing events.
+ Analyse event requirements and develop sourcing strategies aligned with business objectives, budget and attendee experience expectations.
+ Source and evaluate hotels, convention centres, resorts, event venues, destination management companies (DMCs), event agencies and other event suppliers.
+ Conduct market research and benchmark venue rates, supplier capabilities and industry trends to support decision-making.
+ Provide venue recommendations based on location suitability, contractual terms, operational feasibility, attendee experience and commercial value.

* Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management

+ Lead RFP, RFQ and proposal evaluation processes for hotels, venues and event suppliers.
+ Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, concessions and contractual protections to maximise value and mitigate risk.
+ Ensure all supplier agreements comply with EY procurement policies, legal requirements and standard contract templates.
+ Drive savings initiatives through strategic sourcing, preferred supplier utilisation and volume-based negotiations.
+ Support supplier renewals and contract reviews while maintaining a strong supplier governance framework.

* Hospitality & Industry Expertise

+ Serve as the M&E team's subject matter expert on hotel operations, venue management and hospitality contracting.
+ Demonstrate strong knowledge of hotel industry terminology including:

- Guest room blocks and pickup analysis
- Attrition and cancellation clauses
- Food & Beverage minimum commitments
- Meeting room rental structures
- Complimentary ratios and concession strategies
- Revenue displacement and peak period pricing
- Force majeure and risk mitigation clauses
- Commission and non-commission models, and negotiated rate structures

+ Advise stakeholders on hotel operational considerations that impact cost, attendee experience and event success.
+ Maintain knowledge of regional and global hospitality market trends, supplier capabilities and emerging venue solutions.

* Stakeholder Management

+ Partner with meeting sponsors, event planners and business stakeholders to understand sourcing requirements and event objectives.
+ Provide sourcing guidance and recommendations throughout the meeting and event lifecycle.
+ Act as the primary escalation point for venue and supplier-related issues during sourcing and contracting phases.
+ Build strong relationships with key hotel brands, venue operators, event agencies and industry partners.

* Supplier Performance & Governance

+ Monitor supplier performance against contractual service levels and programme expectations.
+ Support supplier onboarding, due diligence and ongoing relationship management activities.
+ Maintain sourcing databases, preferred supplier catalogues and venue intelligence resources.
+ Identify opportunities to enhance supplier performance, improve service delivery and strengthen strategic partnerships.

* Reporting & Process Improvement

+ Analyse sourcing activity, contract performance and savings opportunities through reporting and KPI management.
+ Support compliance monitoring and programme governance initiatives across the M&E function.
+ Drive continuous improvement initiatives to streamline sourcing processes, improve stakeholder experience and enhance programme efficiencies.
+ Own and drive data entry and accuracy on CVENT and contract uploads on ARIBA
+ Support sourcing-related technology platforms, databases and supplier management tools.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, Tourism, Business Administration, Procurement, Supply Chain or a related field preferred.
* Hospitality or procurement-related professional certifications are advantageous.

**Experience**

* Minimum 3 – 5 years of experience in hotel sales, venue sourcing, hospitality procurement, destination management, corporate event management or strategic sourcing.
* Strong experience negotiating hotel contracts and managing large-scale venue sourcing projects.
* Experience working with global hotel chains, event agencies and hospitality suppliers.
* Demonstrated knowledge of meetings and events operations and procurement practices.
* Experience working in multinational, matrixed and stakeholder-driven environments is highly desirable.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong expertise in hotel, venue and event supplier sourcing, with a deep understanding of hospitality operations and industry terminology.
* Proven contract negotiation, supplier management and procurement experience with a strong commercial mindset.
* Ability to drive cost optimisation, budget management and data-driven sourcing decisions.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills across all levels.
* Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving capabilities with attention to detail.
* Ability to build and maintain strategic supplier relationships while working independently in a global, fast-paced environment.

We are seeking a commercially minded sourcing professional with deep hospitality industry expertise and a proven ability to negotiate complex event agreements. The company is committed to delivering high-quality, integrated services while maintaining strong financial management, operational efficiency, and sustainable business growth.

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented
**Finance Manager**
to oversee the company's financial operations, accounting, reporting, taxation, and compliance functions.

The ideal candidate will have strong financial and analytical skills, practical knowledge of accounting and taxation, and the ability to support management in financial planning and business decision-making.

This role offers an excellent opportunity for a finance professional to take ownership of financial operations and contribute directly to the company's growth.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Financial Management & Reporting**

* Oversee day-to-day accounting and financial operations.
* Prepare and review financial statements, management reports, and MIS reports.
* Monitor cash flow, working capital, receivables, and payables.
* Prepare budgets, financial forecasts, and variance analysis.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to management.

**2. Accounting & Internal Controls**

* Ensure accurate and timely maintenance of books of accounts.
* Establish and monitor effective internal financial controls.
* Review accounting entries, reconciliations, and financial transactions.
* Coordinate month-end and year-end financial closing activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes and financial efficiency.

**3. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Oversee GST compliance, including return preparation and filing.
* Ensure compliance with TDS and applicable income tax provisions.
* Coordinate statutory audits, tax audits, and other financial reviews.
* Ensure timely completion of statutory filings and other regulatory requirements.

**4. Working Capital & Business Support**

* Monitor project costs, expenses, and profitability.
* Manage cash flow planning and working capital requirements.
* Analyse financial performance and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Support management in financial planning, business strategy, and decision-making.
* Coordinate with banks, auditors, consultants, vendors, and other stakeholders as required.

Eligibility Criteria

* **Qualification:**
  CA Intermediate or CMA Intermediate qualified.
* **Experience:**
  Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in accounting, finance, and financial management.
* Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, taxation, and statutory compliance.
* Practical experience in financial statements, MIS reporting, budgeting, and cash flow management.
* Good working knowledge of GST, TDS, and other applicable statutory compliances.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software.
* Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage responsibilities, and coordinate effectively with management and other departments.

Candidates with experience in engineering, fabrication, construction, project-based businesses, or related industries will be preferred.

Compensation

**₹60,000–₹90,000 per month**
, depending on the candidate's experience, technical expertise, and skill set.

How to Apply

Interested candidates who meet the above criteria are invited to apply through LinkedIn with their updated CV.

* **Join G8 Indo Gulf Pvt Ltd and contribute to our financial management and business growth.**

In this role, you will support accurate and timely monthly and quarterly financial close activities for assigned countries, perform general ledger and balance sheet reconciliations, resolve outstanding accounting items, and support financial reporting in accordance with applicable accounting policies and US GAAP requirements.

You will collaborate with global stakeholders, contribute to accounting process improvements and automation initiatives, support audits and system upgrades, and serve as a key contact for country- or region-specific accounting matters.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

1. Financial Close & General Ledger Management: Execute monthly and quarterly financial close activities, prepare and review journal entries, and maintain accurate general ledger records for assigned countries.

2. Balance Sheet Reconciliation & Accounting Accuracy: Perform periodic balance sheet account reconciliations, investigate variances, and resolve outstanding open items to support accurate financial statements.

3. Financial Reporting & Compliance: Support the preparation and analysis of financial reports, including profit and loss and balance sheet statements, while maintaining compliance with applicable accounting policies and US GAAP requirements.

4. Data Center & Intercompany Accounting: Support data center accounting activities and relevant accounting processes, including fixed assets, intercompany transactions, and associated financial reconciliations.

5. Audit & Internal Controls: Provide documentation and analysis for internal and external audits, ensure journal entries meet applicable control requirements, and contribute to maintaining accounting procedures.

6. Global Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with finance teams and stakeholders globally to support consistent close management, reporting, and financial data practices. Act as a single point of contact (SPOC) for assigned regional or country-specific projects and issue resolution.

7. Process Improvement & Automation: Identify opportunities to improve accounting efficiency, reconciliation quality, and financial close processes. Participate in global projects, cloud-based automation initiatives, and testing of system upgrades or process changes.

8. Knowledge Sharing & Team Development: Support the onboarding and training of new team members, share accounting knowledge, and contribute to effective team collaboration.

**Qualifications & Skills**
---------------------------

### **Mandatory**

Educational Qualifications & Experience

Candidates must meet one of the following qualification pathways:

* Qualified CA/CMA with 3–6 years of relevant experience in Accounting and Finance.
* B.Com, M.Com, CA/CMA Inter, or MBA with 8+ years of relevant experience in Accounting and Finance.

Technical & Functional Competencies

* Hands-on experience in general ledger accounting, journal entries, and month-end or quarter-end financial close.
* Experience performing balance sheet reconciliations, investigating variances, and resolving outstanding accounting items.
* Understanding of financial accounting, financial statements, and financial reporting processes.
* Ability to support accounting activities and maintain accurate financial records in a controlled financial reporting environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for accounting and reconciliation issues.

Professional & Behavioral Competencies

* Effective communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Ability to work with geographically distributed teams and global stakeholders.
* Self-driven, results-oriented approach with a strong sense of accountability.
* Team-oriented working style and commitment to financial accuracy, integrity, and responsible stewardship.

### **Good-to-Have**

The following are relevant differentiators described in the original JD, but their mandatory status has not been established:

* Experience with US GAAP accounting and reporting in a multinational environment.
* Exposure to data center accounting, fixed assets, or intercompany accounting.
* Experience supporting internal or external financial audits.
* Participation in global finance transformation or accounting process improvement projects.
* Experience with accounting automation, cloud-based financial systems, or system upgrade testing.
* Experience serving as a regional or country accounting SPOC.
* Experience training or onboarding new team members.

**Self-Assessment Questions**
-----------------------------

* Do I meet one of the specified education and experience pathways for this role?

* Do I have hands-on experience executing month-end or quarter-end financial close activities, including journal entries and general ledger accounting?

* Have I independently performed balance sheet reconciliations, investigated variances, and resolved outstanding accounting items?

* Am I confident interpreting financial statements and supporting accurate accounting and reporting activities?

* Can I collaborate effectively with global stakeholders while maintaining strong accountability for accounting accuracy and deadlines?

title: Financial Business Analyst 02– Order Management / Quote-to-Order
description:
As a Business Analyst in Customer Entitlement Services, you will research customer inventories, prepare accurate license entitlements, and help improve the processes that support customer orders. You will work with Sales, Deal Management, Finance, Pricing, and Data Migration, communicate with requesters, and identify opportunities to simplify work through automation. This IC1 role is on the AMER shift.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Research customer inventories and details in Oracle systems, including Asset Report, PeopleSoft (HAT), and ROSIE, to prepare accurate Oracle Health entitlements and identify usage patterns or optimization opportunities.
* Migrate customers' existing license information accurately and on time in line with Oracle policies, helping customers manage licenses and supporting Sales and Deal Management activity.
* Work with Sales, Deal Management, Finance, Pricing, Data Migration, and PRG to resolve entitlement needs and help process customer orders efficiently.
* Serve as a primary contact for process inquiries, clarify requester requirements, and deliver requested entitlement summaries within agreed timelines.
* Analyze volumes and trends, apply analytical and statistical rigor to complex problems, and report findings that support management decisions and process improvement.
* Simplify and automate Customer Entitlement Services processes while building knowledge of Oracle policies, systems, and research tools and maintaining periodic core-process certification.
* Maintain working knowledge of Oracle policies, systems, and research tools, and complete periodic core-process certification to support consistent entitlement decisions.
* Independently build comprehensive customer entitlements with attention to the potential effects of licensing decisions on revenue, billing, and terminations.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Mandatory**

* Strong research, analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills for assessing customer inventories and producing accurate entitlement information.
* Ability to understand customer requirements, communicate clearly with requesters, and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to work independently with limited direct supervision and deliver accurate summaries within required timelines.
* Ability to use data, volume trends, and analytical or statistical methods to support sound business decisions and process improvement.

**Good-to-Have**

* Familiarity with customer licensing, license migration, entitlements, or Oracle Cerner client inventories.
* Exposure to Asset Report, PeopleSoft (HAT), ROSIE, or comparable customer research systems.
* Understanding of pricing, quoting, booking, revenue recognition, invoicing, or related Sales and Finance processes.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Can I research customer inventories carefully and turn the findings into accurate entitlement information?
* Am I confident clarifying requester needs and coordinating with teams across Sales, Deal Management, Finance, Pricing, and Data Migration?
* Can I work independently, meet timelines, and maintain accuracy when preparing customer summaries?
* Can I analyze volume trends and apply sound analytical methods to improve processes and support decisions?

title: Analyst - Billing
description:

* **B. Com / MBA in Finance**

title: Strategy Consultant
description: Position: Program Manager – Urban InitiativeLocation: DelhiAn initiative supported by The Convergence FoundationAbout URBAN ProjectIndia is urbanising rapidly, and its cities are where the country's economic future will be decided. Services already form the largest part of the Indian economy, and well-functioning cities are essential to sustaining services-led growth and creating jobs at scale. Yet urbanisation in India has often been unplanned and under-resourced, leaving cities struggling with weak planning, a difficult business environment, fragmented governance, and chronic under-financing. Getting urbanisation right – rapid yet sustainable – is one of the highest-leverage opportunities for India's economic transformation.The Urban Initiative is supported by The Convergence Foundation, the Urban Initiative is being established to help India build the policy ecosystem needed to drive economic growth through rapid and sustainable urbanisation. It will work systemically—developing policy perspectives and partnering with the government to advance reform—rather than engaging in on-ground implementation. Its work will be organised around four interconnected pillars:Regional economic and spatial planning: Creating regional economic plans that feed into better, more growth-oriented master plans for cities and their surrounding regions.Ease of doing business: Enabling more sensible development control norms and regulations that make it easier to build, invest and do business in cities.Governance: Strengthening how cities are managed, including the devolution of power to empowered, accountable city governments.Financing: Ensuring cities are adequately funded and well managed – through better allocation of public money, raising local resources, and involving the private sector through PPP and other models.Across each pillar, the initiative will build a strong policy perspective, drawing on best practices from better-run Indian cities as well as relevant global examples. It will work closely with the central government – including NITI Aayog and the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) – to drive policy change at the national level, and with state and city governments where there is genuine interest and appetite for reform. The initiative will remain a small, high-quality team focused on ideas, influence and partnerships rather than implementation.Position SummaryThe Economic growth team works with internal and external stakeholders on cross functional projects. This role sits within the team's Urban Development initiative, which explores emerging issues and whitespaces in the urban development policy ecosystem. The Program Manager (PM) should have strong problem-solving skills, secondary research capabilities and analytical prowess. In addition, as well as excellent oral & written communication skills. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a bias towards action and the ability to work with ambiguous requirements. The PM will have a steep learning curve and would be expected to hit the ground running on live projects with Government institutions.Areas of Work:The Program Manager will:Work with Economic Growth team and leadership to identify and scope priority areas in the urban development policy ecosystem, with a focus on ease of doing business in cities, urban finance, and city planningEngage in dipstick secondary research to diagnose binding constraints in issue areas and develop initial hypotheses around opportunities for impact (e.g. which regulatory constraints, if solved for, can improve ease of doing business in a city)Develop evidence-based benchmarking frameworks to compare cities on regulatory performance and identify opportunities to streamline approvals, improve governance, and accelerate urban economic growthEngage with policymakers, urban practitioners, and other ecosystem stakeholders to validate findings, refine priorities, and build partnershipsOversee the creation of knowledge material across priority areas by identifying potential partners, developing terms of reference and managing projects to their completionProvide continued program/grant support to organisations, programs or public goods that might stem as a result of the scoping exerciseRequired Qualifications, Skills and AbilitiesUndergraduate or masters degrees from top tier institutions. While there is no preference for a particular major or specialisation, prior experience in urban development or related sectors will be preferredUp to 4 years of work experience in a consulting or challenging/ high growth environmentExcellent analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skillsSolid planning and organisational skills with high attention to detail, accuracy, protocol and deadlineExcellent writing ability that is clear, concise and analytic in styleExcellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder-facing skills including solid presentation and facilitation skillsHigh level of flexibility and responsiveness with the ability to shift priorities quickly and as organisational demands requireAbility to do research and distil important concepts in a structured, concise, yet comprehensive mannerOperating style suited to working in a small-organisation setting, where teamwork and resourcefulness are highly valuedCompensationRemuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy pay scales and will depend upon the candidate's experienceLocationNew Delhi, India

title: Senior Analyst, FP&A (Technology)
description:
**Department:**
Finance

**Location:**
Gurugram, India

**Work Hours:**
Hybrid | 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM IST

**Experience:**
5–8 Years

**Reports to:**
Senior Manager, Finance Business Partner — Product & Technology

**About Cvent**

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with a suite of solutions that help organizations manage the entire event lifecycle. Our mission is to transform the way meetings and events are planned, executed, and evaluated globally.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a strategic, analytically strong FP&A professional to join our team as a Senior Analyst I or II (level based on experience) – FP&A, supporting the Product & Technology mini-CFO in business partnering with Cvent's Product, Engineering, Cloud/DevOps and IT organizations.

Product & Technology is one of Cvent's largest investment areas. This role sits at the intersection of the product roadmap and the P&L: you will help leaders understand how engineering capacity, cloud hosting, software and tooling spend translate into product cost, margin and return. You will help Product, Technology and Finance leaders answer the core questions: what does each product cost to build and run, what does it return, and where should the next engineering and cloud dollar go.

You will drive core planning processes — annual operating plan, rolling forecasts and monthly spend tracking — and build the financial analysis behind investment decisions, from business cases through post-investment tracking. The ideal candidate can independently structure ambiguous problems across new datasets and stakeholders, and turn them into clear recommendations for senior leaders.

**AI Overview**

AI is an integral part of how this role works. You will use AI tools (e.g. Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to enhance efficiencies by automating reports, prepare dashboards for product leaders, perform spend analysis, improve forecasting accuracy, build business cases for new product development/ feature enhancements, and run scenario and sensitivity analysis, while validating outputs for accuracy.

This role involves frequent interaction with senior leaders across Product, Technology, IT, Accounting and Corporate Finance teams based in the U.S. and India.

**Key Responsibilities**

Product P&L, Planning & Spend Management (primary focus)

* Prepare and maintain the product P&L, including monthly and quarterly refreshes, variance analysis and commentary, to inform investment and scaling decisions for each product.
* Support the mini-CFO in translating product roadmaps and technology plans into the annual operating plan and rolling forecasts, with run-rate visibility and driver-based links between operational metrics and financial results.
* Maintain and improve allocation methodologies for shared R&D, platform, hosting and IT costs so that product-level profitability is reliable and consistent.
* Analyze opex and capex, and closely monitor headcount, contractor spend, software and licenses, and cloud hosting costs.
* Develop and track key Product & Technology efficiency metrics, including:
* R&D and Tech spend as a % of revenue
* Product contribution margin and gross margin by product
* Cloud hosting cost as a % of revenue and unit cost (per customer / event / registrant)
* Fully loaded cost per engineering FTE and contractor mix
* Software capitalization rate
* Total cost of ownership (TCO) and payback on approved investments

Cloud Cost & Optimization

* Work with Cloud/DevOps teams to improve cloud cost transparency, tagging and unit economics.
* Help leadership identify, size and deliver cost optimization opportunities across hosting, software, licenses and vendors.

Investments & Capital Planning

* Build business cases, in partnership with Product and Technology leaders, for new products, feature enhancements, platform modernization and tooling — using NPV/IRR, payback and ROI, including build-vs-buy comparisons, to guide prioritization and trade-offs.
* Track approved investments against their business cases, including benefits realized, total cost of ownership and post-investment performance.
* Support software capitalization and capex tracking, working with Accounting to ensure policy compliance.

Reporting, Automation & Cross-functional Work

* Design and automate KPI packs, product profitability views and investment performance dashboards for leadership, and present insights confidently to non-financial and senior audiences.
* Simplify recurring work to cut manual effort and improve accuracy, including through the use of AI tools.
* Lead or support ad-hoc strategic projects, including integration of acquired products into the product P&L and consolidation of technology and vendor costs.
* Extract and analyze data using tools like Adaptive Planning, Excel, BI platforms, cloud billing data and Jira.

**Qualifications**

* 5–8 years of experience in FP&A, business finance, or financial modelling, ideally at a technology/SaaS company or a multinational. Exceptional candidates outside this range will be considered.
* **Preferred background (either path works):**
  experience in a technology/SaaS organization either (a) in Finance partnering with R&D, Engineering, Cloud or IT, or (b) in Technology/IT finance, FinOps or cost analytics — with real exposure to how product and technology spend drives P&L outcomes.
* CA, MBA (Finance) or CIMA preferred; a commerce, economics or engineering graduate with strong FP&A experience will also be considered.
* Advanced Excel modelling, including P&L and scenario models, sensitivity analysis and clean, auditable model design.
* Understanding of SaaS P&L structure and cost allocation for shared R&D, platform and hosting costs.
* Working knowledge of software capitalization (ASC 350-40) and capex vs. opex treatment.
* Familiarity with cloud billing and cost management (AWS/Azure cost tools, FinOps practices) is a strong plus.
* Working knowledge of planning and BI tools such as Workday Adaptive Planning, Anaplan, Sigma, Tableau or Power BI; SQL is a plus.
* Hands-on proficiency with AI tools (e.g. Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to automate reporting, perform variance and data analysis, build financial models and support research.
* Strong data-driven mindset and the ability to structure and interpret large, imperfect datasets to generate insights.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including explaining financial results to non-finance stakeholders; proven ability to work closely with senior leaders is strongly preferred.
* Strong drive, curiosity, and willingness to learn.
