title: Performance Management Specialist META, GOOGLE and ECOMMERCE
description:
The Role

We are looking for a performance marketing specialist with proven experience in scaling
**FMCG, D2C, or consumer brands**
across paid digital media and e-commerce marketplaces. The ideal candidate will be obsessed with numbers, consumer acquisition, conversion, and profitability—not just impressions and clicks.

Key Responsibilities

* **Meta Ads:**
  Plan, execute, optimise, and scale campaigns across Facebook and Instagram to drive customer acquisition and revenue.
* **Google Ads:**
  Manage Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Display, and YouTube campaigns wherever relevant.
* **Marketplace Advertising:**
  Manage and optimise sponsored advertising across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, and other relevant e-commerce platforms.
* **Accelerate ROAS:**
  Improve Return on Ad Spend through audience segmentation, campaign restructuring, creative testing, retargeting, and funnel optimisation.
* **Reduce ACOS:**
  Continuously reduce Advertising Cost of Sales on marketplaces while growing sales and maintaining product visibility.
* **Scale Profitably:**
  Balance revenue growth, customer acquisition cost, contribution margins, and advertising spend to deliver sustainable business growth.
* **Creative Performance:**
  Work closely with the creative team to develop and test high-converting ad creatives, product videos, copy, and offers.
* **Analytics & Reporting:**
  Track ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, CAC, CTR, CPC, CVR, and revenue attribution. Build actionable reports and performance dashboards.
* **Conversion Optimisation:**
  Identify bottlenecks across product listings, landing pages, and checkout journeys to improve conversion rates.
* **Budget Management:**
  Allocate budgets dynamically across platforms based on performance, sales potential, and profitability.
* **Growth Strategy:**
  Develop scalable performance marketing strategies for launches, seasonal campaigns, promotional events, and new customer acquisition.

What We’re Looking For

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing.
* Proven experience in
  **scaling an FMCG, D2C, beauty, personal care, fragrance, or other consumer products business**
  .
* Strong practical expertise in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
* Demonstrable experience managing e-commerce marketplace advertising, particularly Amazon Ads and Flipkart Ads.
* A proven track record of improving ROAS, reducing ACOS, and scaling advertising-driven revenue.
* Strong understanding of unit economics, attribution, conversion funnels, and profitability.
* Data-driven thinking, analytical ability, and a bias for action.
* Experience with Shopify, Google Analytics 4, pixels, conversion tracking, and reporting tools will be an advantage.

How We’ll Measure Success

* Higher ROAS and lower ACOS.
* Consistent growth in paid-attributed sales and total online revenue.
* Lower customer acquisition costs.
* Improved conversion rates and advertising efficiency.
* Profitable scaling of digital and marketplace channels.

**Important:**
We are looking for someone who has actually scaled businesses and managed performance budgets—not someone whose experience is limited to running campaigns without measurable business outcomes. Immediate joiners are an advantage.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description - Life Actuarial (Manager),**
EY GDS Consulting Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost to support EY’s client-serving and enablement teams worldwide.
  
  
Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with advanced technology and automation capabilities to develop innovative solutions that deliver greater value to our clients. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team! We are looking for a Manager in our Business Consulting Practice within thes Life Actuarial domain.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for Managers within the Life Actuarial team delivering actuarial solutions and working closely with Senior Managers or client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and risk consulting professionals.
  
  
Our clients are large multinationals, conglomerate groups and domestic insurers within the Life insurance sector. The team delivers sustainable benefits to our clients by enhancing business decisions using improved and effective applications of core actuarial principles and methodologies within applicable standard practice.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals comes from diverse backgrounds, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients. This role will offer exposure to diverse areas comprising assets and liabilities within life actuarial domain.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Manager, you will:
  
  

* Responsible for delivering high-quality results and generating effective and impactful solutions
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagements are delivered within agreed timelines
* Review work completed by junior team members, ensuring high-quality deliverables during time-sensitive deadlines
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality, consistently driving projects to completion and ensuring that work is of a high standard

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Good analytical skills
* Hands-on experience in actuarial valuation and projections using FIS Prophet will be an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of Prophet model structure, data flows, checking frameworks, and control processes; ability to enhance and optimize existing Prophet models
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel; working knowledge of VBA is a strong advantage
* Project management experience and ability to manage teams and multiple stakeholders
* Ability to work effectively in high-pressure situations
* High level of self-motivation and ownership in driving deliverables
* Ability to leverage Generative AI and automation tools to enhance actuarial processes and deliverables.
* Strong presentation and documentation skills
* Willingness to travel to meet and work with clients

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Experienced resource – preferably 6-12 years
* Experience in one or more of the following areas: Actuarial reserving, Assumption setting, US GAAP / STAT, FIS Prophet

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Preferred Actuarial Degree
* A strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, business, finance, or a related field
* Overseas exposure (especially US market experience)
* Understanding of Life/Annuity products under US GAAP/STAT regulations
* Knowledge of FIS Prophet/ Insurance Risk Suite End-to-End (DCS, PP, PE, PRD, IDR and PP APIs) preferred

**What We Look For**

* Good communication skills
* Fluency in spoken and written English
* Experience of leading/supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building industry relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Fund Manager
description:
**Company Description**
OXEN CAPITAL PRIVATE LIMITED is an Alternative Investment Fund Category III (AIF CAT 3) manager, focused on sophisticated investment strategies and active portfolio management. The firm operates in a tightly regulated environment, providing structured investment products designed for informed investors seeking differentiated returns. Working at OXEN CAPITAL PRIVATE LIMITED offers exposure to advanced financial instruments, equity and multi-asset strategies, and rigorous risk frameworks. Team members collaborate closely on research-driven decision making and disciplined execution. The organization values integrity, analytical rigor, and a strong commitment to investor outcomes.

**Role Description**
The Fund Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in Ahmedabad. The Fund Manager will be responsible for designing and executing investment strategies for AIF Category III funds, including security selection, portfolio construction, and ongoing performance monitoring. Daily activities include conducting fundamental and quantitative research, analyzing macroeconomic and sector trends, evaluating equities and other instruments, and making data-driven investment decisions aligned with fund objectives and risk parameters. The role involves active portfolio rebalancing, risk management, and liquidity oversight, as well as preparing investment reports, reviewing performance attribution, and participating in investment committee discussions. The Fund Manager will collaborate with research, operations, compliance, and investor relations teams to ensure regulatory adherence, operational efficiency, and clear communication with stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Strong analytical skills, including financial modeling, data interpretation, and risk assessment.
* Expertise in investments and investment management, with experience in portfolio construction and strategy execution.
* Solid foundation in finance, including knowledge of capital markets, valuation methods, and regulatory frameworks.
* In-depth understanding of equities, including sector analysis, company fundamentals, and market dynamics.
* Relevant academic background, such as a degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CFA) are an advantage.
* Proven experience managing or contributing to institutional or AIF portfolios, with a track record of disciplined performance.
* Ability to work on-site in Ahmedabad, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and communicate complex investment concepts clearly.
* High standards of ethics, attention to detail, and comfort operating in a regulated investment environment.

title: Junior Project Cost & Revenue Manager
description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Junior Project Cost & Revenue Manager to support project planning, budgeting, cost estimation, resource management, and project execution. The role involves working closely with the management, project teams, and development team to ensure projects are planned efficiently, executed within budget, delivered on schedule, and aligned with organizational objectives.

·      Work closely with management to finalize project pricing, commercial feasibility, and profitability.

·      Plan and allocate project resources based on project priorities, workload, and business requirements.

·      Develop and maintain project schedules, milestones, and delivery timelines.

·      Monitor project progress against approved plans and ensure timely completion of deliverables.

·      Prepare and present project status reports, budget reports, utilization reports, and management dashboards.

·      Ensure project documentation, budgeting records, and resource allocation reports are maintained accurately.

·      Monitor project profitability by tracking planned versus actual costs and revenues.

·      Support management in capacity planning, workforce forecasting, and project pipeline analysis.

·      Ensure adherence to organizational project management standards, processes, and quality requirements.

·      Assist in improving project planning methodologies, cost optimization strategies, and operational efficiency.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

·      Strong understanding of project budgeting, cost estimation, and financial planning.

·      Knowledge of project scheduling, resource planning, and workload management.

·      Excellent analytical and numerical skills.

·      Strong coordination, communication, and stakeholder management abilities.

·      Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile/Waterfall methodologies.

·      Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and project management tools (e.g., Zoho Projects, Jira, Microsoft Project, ClickUp, or similar).

·      Ability to analyze project metrics and generate management reports.

·      Strong organizational skills with attention to detail.

·      Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

·      Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills.

**Educational Qualification**

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, business administration, project management, finance, or a related field.

Project management certifications will be an added advantage.

3–5 years of experience in Project Coordination, Project Planning, Project Costing, PMO, Operations, Business Analysis, or a related role.

Freshers with exceptional analytical skills, internship experience, or relevant project exposure may also be considered.

This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the beautiful state of Kerala.
  
  
Working in our practice, you will have the opportunity to work with clients to provide practical risk management, internal audit solutions and gaining valuable experience in a variety of clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
The role requires supporting and executing internal audit and other risk consulting engagements for Real Estate and construction companies. As part of the role, the candidate is expected to:
  
  

* Execute assigned workstreams in client engagements and coordinate effectively with the onsite team across the MENA region.
* Interact professionally with client stakeholders and support discussions with senior management.
* Perform end-to-end internal audit activities, including process understanding, walkthroughs, preparation of risk and control matrices and audit work programs, control testing, documentation of findings, and preparation of draft reports.
* Apply knowledge of risks, issues, trends, and end-to-end business processes in the Real Estate, Capital Projects, and Construction sectors.
* Support reviews of the project delivery (EPC) lifecycle, governance structures, organizational design, and Delegation of Authority frameworks.
* Review capital project business cases, including key assumptions, structure, and feasibility.
* Perform audit procedures covering engineering, planning, and cost-related areas, including master planning, engineering phases, stage-gate methods, and design maturity.
* Apply cost-estimating principles, cost-estimate classifications, LPM build-up techniques, and undertake BoQ analysis and material take-offs.
* Review procurement, contract, and commercial practices and apply project-control principles relating to schedule, cost, risk, and reporting.
* Analyze the integrity, completeness, and accuracy of project plans, cost estimates, and risk plans, and interpret contracts, reports, and dashboards.
* Review resource plans and schedules to assess their alignment with project objectives.
* Complete assigned work within agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards, and promptly escalate issues to engagement leadership.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and develop practical, evidence-based recommendations.
* Support business development activities, including research, proposal preparation, and development of marketing collateral.
* Comply with the firm’s quality and risk management policies at all times.
* Manage multiple assigned tasks and workstreams under the guidance of engagement leadership.
* Maintain proactive communication and professional working relationships with clients and team members.
* Guide junior team members on assigned tasks and review their work where required.
* Support engagement administration, budget monitoring, methodology development, and preparation of new solutions.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Excellent command of spoken and written English
* Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at short notice
* Strong analytical, organizational, and consulting skills
* Ability to manage assigned workstreams, collaborate effectively, and take ownership of deliverables
* Ability to multitask and deliver quality work under tight deadlines
* Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize effectively
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite, data analysis, and validation

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3–5 years of relevant experience in Internal Audit or Risk Management, preferably within the Real Estate, Construction, or Capital Projects sector.
* Experience executing or supporting audits involving cost estimation, engineering reviews, procurement, or project controls.
* Ability to interpret and assess project documentation, including project charters, schedules, cost plans, and risk assessments.
* A valid passport and willingness to travel internationally.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

As a member of the Global Subsidiary Governance Operations team, you will be supporting the delivery of a high-quality service for Shell’s subsidiaries, covering entity management, corporate governance, compliance processes, board activities, shareholder services and working to understand the corporate reporting and governance standards of the Shell group. Including statutory compliance activities, shareholder and board actions; issuing proxies and powers of attorneys; drafting resolutions; advice on governance and company secretarial issues; participation in liquidating, restructuring and other corporate projects and transactions; responsibilities for company secretarial processes, procedures, databases and know-how.

* Company secretarial support on legal transactions
* Acquisitions and/or divestments and/or mergers of entities
* Third party/commercial acquisition and/or divestment of assets

* Excellent planning and organisation skills, verbal and written skills, attention to detail and have the ability to work in a fast-paced, varied environment.

**Designation:**
Liaisoning Officer

**Department:**
Administration / Corporate Affairs

**Reporting To:**
General Manager – HR & Administration / Head – Administration / Management

**Location:**
Chennai

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Job Purpose**

The Liaisoning Officer will be responsible for maintaining effective coordination and communication between the organization and various
**Government Departments, statutory authorities, regulatory bodies, local authorities, public offices, and external stakeholders**
.

The role requires strong knowledge of government procedures, documentation, follow-up mechanisms, statutory requirements, and professional relationship management to ensure that organizational matters are processed efficiently and within the required timelines.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**Government & Regulatory Liaison**

* Act as the official liaison between the organization and relevant Government Departments, statutory authorities, regulatory bodies, and local administrative offices.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with concerned government officials and authorities.
* Coordinate with departments such as Corporation, Revenue, Police, Fire & Rescue, Labour, Education, Health, Pollution Control, Electricity, Water, Transport, and other applicable authorities.
* Facilitate the submission, processing, renewal, and follow-up of various applications, permissions, approvals, licenses, registrations, and statutory documents.
* Monitor changes in government rules, regulations, notifications, and statutory requirements relevant to the organization.
* Ensure timely follow-up on pending approvals, permissions, certificates, and official correspondence.

**Documentation & Compliance**

* Prepare and coordinate official letters, applications, representations, undertakings, declarations, forms, and other documents required for government authorities.
* Maintain proper records of applications submitted, acknowledgements received, approvals, licenses, certificates, and correspondence.
* Ensure that all required supporting documents are complete and submitted within stipulated timelines.
* Maintain a centralized tracker for all government-related applications, renewals, approvals, and pending matters.
* Coordinate with internal departments for obtaining necessary information and documents.

**Statutory Approvals & Renewals**

* Coordinate the timely renewal of licenses, registrations, certificates, permissions, and statutory approvals.
* Follow up with concerned authorities for inspections, visits, verification, and approvals.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders during government inspections and regulatory visits.
* Ensure that deficiencies or observations raised by authorities are communicated to the concerned departments and followed up until closure.

**Internal Coordination**

* Coordinate with HR, Administration, Finance, Engineering/Maintenance, Security, Academic, Hospital, Legal, and other departments as required.
* Obtain necessary approvals and documents from internal authorities before approaching external departments.
* Keep management informed about the status of important government-related matters.
* Escalate delays, regulatory concerns, or critical issues to the reporting authority promptly.

**Representation & Follow-Up**

* Represent the organization professionally before government offices and external authorities as authorized by management.
* Attend government offices for submission of documents, meetings, discussions, inspections, and follow-up activities.
* Schedule and coordinate meetings with government officials wherever required.
* Track commitments and action points arising from meetings with external authorities.
* Ensure that all communication with government authorities is conducted strictly as per organizational protocol and authorization.

**Legal & Regulatory Coordination**

* Coordinate with the Legal Department / external legal counsel on matters involving government authorities, notices, statutory compliance, and regulatory proceedings.
* Assist in responding to government notices, communications, and official correspondence.
* Coordinate the collection and submission of documents required for legal or statutory matters.
* Maintain confidentiality of sensitive organizational and government-related information.

**Management Reporting**

* Prepare periodic reports on:
* Pending government approvals
* Licenses and renewals
* Statutory compliance status
* Government correspondence
* Inspections and observations
* Critical follow-up matters
* Provide regular status updates to the reporting authority.
* Immediately highlight matters requiring management intervention.

**Key Performance Areas (KPA)**

1. Timely completion of government liaison activities.
2. Timely renewal of licenses, registrations, and statutory approvals.
3. Effective coordination with government departments and regulatory authorities.
4. Reduction of delays in obtaining approvals and permissions.
5. Accuracy and completeness of statutory documentation.
6. Effective handling of inspections and government visits.
7. Maintenance of proper records and follow-up trackers.
8. Timely escalation of critical regulatory matters.
9. Professional conduct and relationship management with external authorities.
10. Compliance with organizational authorization and communication protocols.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
* Degree/Diploma in
  **Public Administration, Business Administration, Law, Political Science, or related fields**
  will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* **2 – 3 years of relevant experience**

description:
Real Estate Legal Counsel

Full-Time / Night Shift

Location Hyderabad

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Real Estate Legal Counsel (3–5 years experience) to join our cross-border legal operations team in Hyderabad.

In this full-time role, you will be directly responsible for supporting real estate acquisition, leasing, conveyancing, and title examination transactions across Canadian jurisdictions (e.g., Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta).

SHIFT & WORK HOURS REQUIREMENT This role operates exclusively during Canadian business hours (night shift in IST) to align with onshore partners, client requirements, and legal registries. Typical hours: 6:30 PM – 3:30 AM IST or 8:00 PM – 5:00 AM IST (adjusted seasonally for Daylight Saving Time).

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Transactional & Conveyancing Support

• Manage end-to-end legal support for residential and commercial real estate acquisitions, dispositions, and refinancings in Canadian provinces.

• Draft, review, and negotiate agreements of purchase and sale, commercial leases, closing documents, deeds, mortgages, and assignments.

• Coordinate closing procedures, including preparing statement of adjustments, requisitions, and postclosing document management. 2. Title Examination & Due Diligence

• Review title searches, registry filings, encumbrances, easements, restrictive covenants, and liens using Canadian title software/portals.

• Identify title defects or off-title issues (zoning, tax assessments, building permits) and draft appropriate requisition letters.

• Prepare title insurance policies and liaise directly with underwriters to resolve underwriting exceptions. 3. Lease Review & Administration

• Abstract complex commercial leases (retail, office, industrial) and highlight key risks, options to renew, and indemnity clauses.

• Draft lease modifications, assignments, sublease agreements, tenant estoppel certificates, and nondisturbance agreements (SNDAs). 4. Stakeholder & Operational Coordination

• Interface seamlessly with Canadian onshore legal teams, brokers, lenders, escrow agents, and municipality offices during overlap hours.

• Maintain meticulously structured document repository systems, tracking key transactional deadlines, closing schedules, and legal conditions.

• Ensure compliance with local Canadian provincial real estate legislation, corporate governance, and antimoney laundering (AML/KYC) protocols.CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS Educational & Professional Credentials

• Degree: Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) or Master of Laws (LL.M.) from a recognized university.

• Experience: 3 to 5 years of proven legal experience specializing in real estate transactions, drafting, and conveyancing.

• Jurisdictional Exposure: Prior experience supporting Canadian, US, or UK real estate legal workflows is strongly preferred. Technical Competencies

• Strong mastery of lease drafting, title examination, and real estate closing document preparation.

• Proficiency with real estate management systems and legal tech platforms (e.g., Conveyancer, Teraview, or equivalent database tools).

• Advanced skills in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel) and document automation tools. SOFT SKILLS & OPERATIONAL EXPECTATIONS

• Flawless Communication: Exceptional verbal and written English skills suitable for direct collaboration with North American attorneys and corporate clients.

• High Precision: Exceptional attention to detail in drafting legal instruments, catching minor title discrepancies, and managing strict time deadlines.

• Night Shift Commitment: Demonstrated capacity and willingness to work consistent night shifts from the Hyderabad office or designated setup.

title: Vendor Relationship Manager III
description:
**Role Overview**
The VMO Analyst (Level III - Subject Matter Expert) serves as the primary strategic and governance coordination point for the global vendor, software contract, and hardware supply chain ecosystems.
  
  
Positioned above tactical queue operations, this role oversees contract metadata accuracy, high-value spend compliance, external workforce governance, and vendor performance audits. The Level III Analyst acts as the ultimate escalation point for transaction anomalies, coordinates critical M&A integration tracks, and anchors the Semi-Annual Supplier Business Review (SBR) cycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Supplier Governance & Performance Management (SBR):
* Project manage the end-to-end Semi-Annual Supplier Business Review cycle for major global original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and value-added resellers (VARs). Design and collect performance feedback surveys, conduct live stakeholder polling to eliminate bias, and compile unified supplier performance scorecards. Formally record action items and due dates during reviews and track post-SBR deliverables.
* Contract Lifecycle & Financial Compliance:
* Manage high-value contract records and track critical compliance milestones—including contract executions, renewals, true-ups, and expirations—within the enterprise Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) database. Enforce strict financial governance, ensuring no deal over $2M USD proceeds to contract signature without an approved spend authority approval artifact verified and uploaded. Audit complex prepaid software and hardware contracts to verify amortization schedules and ensure general ledger (GL) accuracy.
* M&A Contract & License Integration:
* Standardize, triage, and map software and hardware portfolios acquired during Mergers & Acquisitions using specialized trackers. Maintain the master integration register and run validation audits to isolate and filter out out-of-scope third-party embedded technology. Coordinate pre-close and post-close software deprovisioning, verifying Personally Identifiable Information (PII) constraints and securing formal Data Deletion Notices.
* External Workforce Policy Governance:
* Serve as the final compliance gatekeeper for contingent workforce onboarding and extension requests. Audit request submissions daily to verify manager hierarchies, confirm budget approvals, and enforce strict country-specific Length of Service and tenure policies before authorizing engagements.
* External Workforce Policy Governance:
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex purchase order pricing or quantity disputes raised by suppliers. Isolate commercial discussions by managing secure child ticketing workflows to shield internal strategy discussions from external vendors. Troubleshoot back-end system errors (such as missing supplier-item mappings or catalog blocks) to push correct records live in the procurement database.

PERFORMANCE & SERVICE LEVELS
  
  
Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured by location per service line.
  
  

* Contract Compliance: ensure 100% of reviewed supplier and software contracts comply with the client's agreed criteria (tracked as a KPI).
* Renewal Timeliness: complete contract renewals and milestone registrations ahead of expiry for ≥98% of in-scope agreements, with zero unintended lapses or auto-renewals.
* Repository Accuracy: maintain ≥99% accuracy across contract records, key dates and obligation metadata.
* Ticket Quality: ensure ≥95–97% of completed requests pass quality-assurance checks, with complete and accurate documentation, correct categorization, and full adherence to the approved SOP for the request type.
* SLA Response by Ticket Priority: Acknowledge and assign incoming VMO escalations within standard windows: 1 hour for high-priority issues, 3 hours for normal requests, and 6 hours for standard tickets.

description:

description:
**Job Description**
The person will be responsible for overseeing strategy relating to obtaining, managing and maintaining product Marketing Authorization’s and support Clinical Trial Authorization’s (where applicable) in line with business goals and legal requirements in partnership with above-country operational hubs. * In partnership with above-country operational hubs and above-country strategists, respond to NRA queries.

* Proactively take opportunities to develop or enhance working relationships with Regulatory Authorities and trade associations.

**:**

* Optimization of Clinical Development Plan (CDP) and Country Footprint.

* Participation in national CTA Trade Association working groups and advocacy activities.

* Perform database entry and the document management for regulatory transactions undertaken by Country Regulatory Strategists, in line with global SOPs.

* Following a request from a prescriber and internal approval to proceed with supply of unlicensed Pfizer medicines to address unmet patient needs, facilitate NRA approval for supply/import via above country execution hub.

* Via defined procedures notify relevant internal stakeholders of NRA approval of changes to packaging components and prescribing information and the timelines for associated implementation activities.
* Negotiate extensions to packaging artwork implementation with Regulatory Authorities when applicable.

* Support regulatory activities for the development and maintenance of medical devices if required.

description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

The Workforce Relations Lead Consultant provides expert guidance on complex workforce relations matters, ensuring compliance with employment laws and organizational policies to drive a positive, high-performing workplace culture. This role independently investigates complex allegations of discrimination and harassment while also advising and influencing leaders, agents, and employees to resolve complex workplace conflicts. * Utilize evidence-based communication/storytelling to advise resolution of complex workforce relation matters by presenting data-driven recommendations for all audiences
* Independently manage a large volume of complex workforce relations cases including, but not limited to, investigations of harassment, discrimination, inappropriate conduct, and performance management concerns, with adherence to communicated documentation expectations and service level agreements (SLAs)

* Provide expert consultation to leaders, agents, and employees on a wide range of complex workforce relations issues, including performance management, conflict resolution, and workplace investigations

Employee Relations

title: Assistant Manager, Regulatory Sciences (Evergreen Position)
description:
**Job Description**
The person will be responsible for overseeing strategy relating to obtaining, managing and maintaining product Marketing Authorization’s and support Clinical Trial Authorization’s (where applicable) in line with business goals and legal requirements in partnership with above-country operational hubs. Under the guidance and supervision of line management, lead strategic regulatory activities for assigned products and markets, and contribute to the implementation and leadership of projects and building expertise within the cluster regulatory team and support line management to make decisions that require developing innovative solutions to resolve complex problems.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
***Deliver Regulatory Strategy and Advise Cross-Functional Teams:***

* In line with assigned product and country responsibilities, utilise regulatory expertise to develop and deliver optimal regulatory strategies and plans to support the achievement of country business goals for both licensed and development products for Oncology portfolio for India, all TAs for Indochina and non-vaccine portfolio for Brunei.
* Represent Regulatory on cross-functional product teams and provide strategic regulatory input to the commercial operating planning process.
* Facilitate cross-functional awareness and understanding of regulatory issues and environment, including
* ensuring teams understand the potential opportunities and constraints that the latest legislation/upcoming changes to legislation might create for their commercial activities.
* Keep cross-functional colleagues and key stakeholders informed of progress with regulatory submissions.
* Work with above country strategists to provide country input into Global and Regional regulatory strategies as required.

***Provide Regulatory Advice and Information to meet Customer and Cross-Divisional colleague requests:***

* Use expert knowledge of national legislation, guidelines and regulatory environment to provide insightful responses to enquiries from cross-divisional Pfizer colleagues and indirect interactions with external customers.
* Advise on matters of compliance, national regulatory requirements and Pfizer regulatory policy.
* Use a variety of communication tools and techniques to present complex ideas.
* Anticipate potential objections and influence others.

***Manage New Registration/Marketing Authorization Applications***
**:**
**National Applications**

* Coordinate pre-submission meetings and other National Regulatory Authority (NRA) engagements, such as national Scientific Advice Meetings.
* Devise and obtain endorsement for submission strategy and plan and partner with above-country operational hubs and above-country strategists to obtain new product licenses. Manage associated interactions and negotiations with NRAs.

***Manage Marketing Authorisation (MA) Variation Applications:***

* Trigger locally driven submission demands (e.g. NRA queries and requests for local label updates).
* Input to assessing regulatory impact, agree filing strategy with other business functions as appropriate and participate in risk-based reviews with above-country hubs and communicate any locally triggered delays & risks impacting the submission/approval, to the above and in-country stakeholders.
* Work with above-country strategists and above-country operational hubs to supply country documentation/information for dossier build as applicable.
* Communicate NRA decisions to relevant internal stakeholders as applicable.

***Manage MA Renewal Applications:***

* Agree filing strategy with relevant stakeholders as appropriate and participate in risk-based reviews of plans with above country hubs.

***Management of NRA queries:***

* In partnership with above-country operational hubs and above-country strategists, respond to NRA queries.

***External Relationships***
**:**

* Proactively take opportunities to develop or enhance working relationships with Regulatory Authorities and trade associations.
* Develop and enact appropriate influencing strategies in order to negotiate optimal outcomes for the business on product issues.
* Utilize knowledge of NRA’s expectations, ways of working etc to appropriately direct company strategy. Share updates and regulatory intelligence with colleagues.
* Seek authority advice/clarification if regulatory position is unclear and answers are not available through internal network.
* Respond to spontaneous requests from authorities promptly and accurately.
* Work with authorities if Pfizer position differs from authority position to obtain a better outcome for the business/patients.

***Clinical Trials***
**:**

* Support the following strategic clinical development activities in partnership with national Regulatory Authorities, Above Country Regulatory Strategists and Clinical Trials Regulatory Strategy Execution (CTRSE) as applicable:
* Optimization of Clinical Development Plan (CDP) and Country Footprint.
* Communications with NRAs to clarify questions during assessment as required by CTRSE
* Support Regulatory Requirements Manager (RRM) updates for local Clinical Trial Applications (CTAs) and study conduct requirements.
* Participation in national CTA Trade Association working groups and advocacy activities.

**Populate and Maintain Regulatory Databases:**

* Perform database entry and the document management for regulatory transactions undertaken by Country Regulatory Strategists, in line with global SOPs.

***Obtain NRA Approvals for Supply of Unlicensed Medicines (Named Patient/Compassionate Use):***

* Following a request from a prescriber and internal approval to proceed with supply of unlicensed Pfizer medicines to address unmet patient needs, facilitate NRA approval for supply/import via above country execution hub.

title: Senior Engineer WAF
description:
**About Us**
Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
  
  
At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
  
  
**Why We Do What We Do**
In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
  
  
Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award-winning culture.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a Senior WAF Engineer with 6–10 years of experience in securing web applications and APIs using Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and edge security controls. The ideal candidate will have at least 3+ years of hands-on experience with Imperva (preferred) or Cloudflare.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for the design, implementation, and optimization of WAF policies, including rule tuning, deployment automation, and real-time response to security threats such as OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, bot attacks, and Layer 7 DDoS incidents.
  
  
You will collaborate closely with DevOps, SRE, and application development teams to enhance security posture while ensuring minimal false positives and maintaining optimal application performance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and manage WAF policies for web applications and APIs across environments (dev/stage/prod).
* Configure and tune managed rules and custom rules to mitigate OWASP Top 10 (SQLi, XSS, CSRF, RCE, LFI/RFI, SSRF, etc.).
* Perform rule tuning and false-positive reduction using traffic baselining, exception handling, and staged enforcement (monitor → challenge → block).
* Implement rate limiting, IP reputation, geo/ASN controls, and bot mitigation strategies to reduce abuse and credential stuffing.
* Integrate WAF logs with SIEM/log platforms (Splunk, Sentinel, ELK, QRadar) and build dashboards/alerts for threat monitoring.
* Support incident response for active attacks (L7 DDoS, exploit attempts), including rapid mitigation and post-incident improvements.
* Automate deployments using IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation/ARM/Bicep) and integrate with CI/CD pipelines.
* Conduct periodic security reviews, reporting, and metrics tracking (blocked events, top attacks, FP rate, MTTR).
* Collaborate with app teams on secure configuration (headers, TLS, authentication flows) and compatibility testing.
* Demonstrated experience in automation using PowerShell or Python to integrate with Imperva APIs for scalable WAF policy deployment, configuration management, and operational efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years experience in WAF engineering and Implementation.
* Hands-on experience with at least one WAF platform: Imperva(preferred), Akamai, ModSecurity, AWS WAF, Azure WAF, Cloudflare, F5 ASM/Advanced WAF,
* Strong understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, web app architecture, REST APIs, and common attack patterns.
* Proven experience tuning WAF rules and balancing security vs. false positives.
* Experience with logging/monitoring and SIEM integrations.
* Scripting/automation skills: Powershell/Python/Bash (plus regex and JSON/YAML).
* Familiarity with CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code principles.
* Good troubleshooting and stakeholder communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with bot management and advanced detection techniques (behavioral, fingerprinting where supported).
* Experience with API gateways and API security controls (schema validation, auth hardening).
* Working knowledge of cloud networking/CDN/reverse proxy concepts.
* Security certifications: AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, CCSP, CEH, Security+ (nice to have).

**Tools & Technologies**
WAF (AWS/Azure/Cloudflare/F5/Imperva), CDN, TLS, SIEM (Splunk/Sentinel), Terraform, CI/CD (Jenkins/GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps), Python, Linux, Git.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
  
  
**Accessibility Support**
We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

title: Field Sales Manager – Mysore
company: Steel On Call Services (India) Private Limited
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
===================

**Field Sales Manager – B2C Sales (Steel Industry)**
----------------------------------------------------

**Company:** Steel on Call Services India Private Limited

**Department:** Sales & Business Development

**Designation:** Field Sales Manager – B2C

**Industry:** Steel / Iron & Steel – Mandatory

**Experience:** 6–10 Years

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Reporting To:** General Manager / Senior Management

**Work Location:** (Territory-Based) - Mysore/ Channapatna/ Ramanagara

### **1. Job Purpose**

The Field Sales Manager – B2C will be responsible for driving sales growth, developing new customers, managing assigned territories, and expanding the company's presence in the retail steel market. The role involves direct field sales, customer relationship management, dealer and retailer network development, lead generation, and achieving sales targets across assigned territories.

### **2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Territory Sales Management**

* Manage and develop assigned territories to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
* Identify potential markets, new business opportunities, and untapped customer segments.
* Prepare territory-wise sales plans and execute strategies to increase market penetration.
* Conduct regular field visits to monitor market conditions, customer requirements, and competitor activities.
* Ensure effective coverage of all key locations within the assigned territory.

**B. B2C Sales & Customer Acquisition**

* Generate sales from individual customers, homeowners, contractors, fabricators, and small construction businesses.
* Identify and convert potential customers for steel products, including TMT bars, structural steel, MS products, and other relevant steel materials.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with retail customers and end users.
* Generate leads through field visits, references, local networking, and other sales channels.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable products based on their needs.

**C. Dealer, Retailer & Channel Development**

* Develop and maintain relationships with local steel dealers, retailers, fabricators, and contractors to support B2C sales.
* Identify potential channel partners and expand the company's customer network.
* Build a strong referral network to generate repeat business and new leads.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely order processing and customer service.

**D. Sales Planning & Target Achievement**

* Achieve assigned sales targets, revenue goals, and customer acquisition objectives.
* Prepare daily visit plans, weekly sales reports, and monthly territory performance reports.
* Track sales pipelines, follow up on leads, and ensure timely conversion of enquiries into orders.
* Monitor sales performance and implement corrective actions wherever required.
* Maintain accurate customer information, sales records, and market intelligence.

**E. Payment Follow-Up & Customer Service**

* Coordinate with customers and internal teams regarding order status, delivery schedules, and product availability.
* Follow up on outstanding payments and support timely collections in accordance with company policies.
* Resolve customer concerns and ensure a positive buying experience.
* Develop long-term customer relationships to encourage repeat purchases and referrals.

**F. Market Research & Competition Analysis**

* Monitor competitor pricing, product availability, promotional activities, and market trends.
* Identify new growth opportunities within assigned territories.
* Provide regular feedback to management regarding customer preferences, demand patterns, and market developments.

### **3. Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing, or a related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Marketing or Sales will be an added advantage.

### **4. Required Experience & Skills**

* 6–10 years of experience in field sales, preferably in the steel or iron and steel industry.
* Mandatory experience in steel product sales and territory management.
* Strong understanding of the retail steel market and B2C customer acquisition.
* Proven track record of achieving sales targets and expanding customer networks.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to independently manage territories and travel extensively for field sales.
* Strong lead-generation, sales planning, and follow-up capabilities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, reporting tools, and CRM software is preferred.
* A valid two-wheeler or four-wheeler driving licence and own vehicle will be an advantage, depending on company requirements.

### **5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Achievement of monthly and annual sales targets.
* Number of new customers acquired.
* Territory-wise revenue growth and market penetration.
* Number of customer visits and qualified leads generated.
* Lead-to-order conversion rate.
* Repeat customer business and customer retention.
* Timely payment collections and reduction in overdue receivables.
* Accuracy and timeliness of sales reports.

### **6. Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should be a target-driven sales professional with strong field execution skills, hands-on experience in steel sales, and the ability to independently manage assigned territories. The candidate must be proactive in acquiring new B2C customers, developing local market networks, and driving sustainable sales growth.

### **7. Compensation**

Salary and incentives will be based on the candidate's experience, current compensation, and suitability for the role.

### **8. How to Apply**

Interested candidates with 6–10 years of relevant steel industry sales experience and a proven track record in B2C sales and territory management are encouraged to apply.
